title: For Clever Admins: User profile pages in the Clever Dashboard
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001758#header1)  
2\. [Profile page tabs: Overview and details](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001758#header2)  
3\. [Profile page tabs: Guardians (students only)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001758#header3)  
4\. [Profile page tabs: Security tab](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001758#header4)  
5\. [Profile page: Actions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001758#header5)  
6\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001758#FAQ)

## Overview

Every user in your Clever Dashboard has their own profile page, including teachers, students, and staff. A user’s profile page gives you a quick, centralized view of that person’s information, so you don’t have to hunt across different parts of Clever to answer a question or troubleshoot an issue.

You can find a user’s profile page by searching for a user’s name in the search bar at the top of your Clever Dashboard, locating them via your [Clever Dashboard > Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser), or by clicking their name from a section, school, or group.

Once you’re on a profile page, you’ll see a few tabs that provide more information and allow you to take actions for a user. These tabs include **Overview**, **Details**, **Guardians**, and **Security**. Additionally, you’ll see an **Actions** drop down in the top right corner. We’ll walk through each below.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qzXnV) Please note:** What you can see and do on a profile page may vary depending on your [role](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702) and [permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001756). If you don’t see a tab or action mentioned here, check with your Clever Admin Owner.

* * *

## Profile page tabs: Overview and details

#### Overview tab (teachers and students only)

This is the default tab you’ll land on when navigating to a teacher or student’s profile. It’s great for a quick, at-a-glance summary of the user. It shows the sections a user is assigned to, a graph of their recent Clever logins, and a list of the apps shared with them.

![Screenshot of the Overview tab for a student's profile](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qykYI)

#### Details tab

This tab contains more specific information about a user, such as their Clever IDs, email address, username, and the date their account was created. For students, it also includes sensitive educational information, such as English Language Learner (ELL) or Individualized Education Program (IEP) status, when available.

![An example of the details tab on a student's profile](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qzZED)

* * *

## Profile page tabs: Guardians (students only)

For student profiles, this tab lists any parent/guardian or family contacts associated with that student in Clever, along with their relationship, contact type, and contact information.

![A screenshot of the guardians tab on a student's profile page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qzZhF)

* * *

## Profile page: Security tab

The Security tab gives you a single place to check a user’s security-related settings, instead of piecing that information together from several places in Clever. Depending on the user, you may see details like:

-   Active Multi-factor authentication (MFA) policy and status
-   Recovery options and last recovery time
    
-   Last password reset time
    
-   Groups the user belongs to
    

From this tab, you can also take relevant actions directly, such as resetting a password, resetting an MFA method, or resending an account claim notification.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qzXnV) Please note:** The Security tab shows information for one user at a time. If you need to review or update security settings for a large group of users at once, check out our [Bulk Security Actions article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001747) instead.

![Screenshot of an example Security tab on a student's profile page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qyXj9)

* * *

## Profile page: Actions

In the top right corner of a profile page, you’ll find an **Actions** drop down with shortcuts for common tasks, grouped by category. Depending on your school organization’s setup and the type of user you’re viewing, this might include options like:

-   Troubleshooting, like checking a user’s login or sharing status
    
-   Impersonation, like accessing the Clever Portal as that user
    
-   Password & account changes
    
-   Clever Badge management, like downloading or voiding a Badge
    
-   MFA management
    

Since the available actions depend on your school’s configuration and the user’s role, you may see a different set of options than what’s pictured here.

![Screenshot of the example actions available on a user's profile page in the admin Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSDh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qzb1V)

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**What’s the difference between the Security tab and the Actions drop down?**

-   The Security tab shows you a user’s current security-related settings and status. The **Actions** drop down lets you take action and includes some security-related shortcuts alongside other tasks, such as accessing the Portal as a user.

**Who can see the Security tab?**

-   Access depends on your Clever role and permissions. Clever Admin Owners and certain delegated custom roles typically have access, but not every Clever Admin will see this tab. You can learn more about [managing custom roles here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702), and the [granular permissions available here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001756).

**Can I edit a student’s sensitive education information from their profile page?**

-   The Details tab displays this information, but in order to edit it you must update it in your student information system (SIS) or via the custom data record if the user was added via custom data in Clever.

**Where can I see a user’s full login history?**

-   The Overview tab shows a quick graph of recent logins. For a more detailed history, check out our [Access Logs article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001698).

**Can parents/guardians or families see this profile page themselves?**

-   No. Profile pages are only visible to Clever Admins with the appropriate permissions. Families don’t have access to the Clever Dashboard.

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: How do I browse and search data in Clever with the Data Browser or Search Bar?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202483068)
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Bulk Security Actions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001747)
    
-   [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726)

title: For Clever Admins: Updating to SSO/Rostering applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001757#header1)  
2\. [Limitations of SSO-only and Saved Passwords apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001757#header2)  
3\. [Benefits of upgrading to full SSO & Rostering apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001757#header3)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001757#header4)

## Overview

Clever offers multiple ways for your school organization to connect with learning applications. While Single Sign-On [(SSO)-only and SSO (Saved Passwords) applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002370127) serve as SSO tools when a complete rostering integration for an application isn't available, updating your applications to full SSO & Rostering is one of the most impactful changes you can make for your school organization.

Using the full SSO & Rostering version of an application automates data transfers, boosts data privacy, and eliminates the administrative burden of manual account creation and maintenance in learning applications. By transitioning your tools to a complete rostering integration, you'll ensure that students and teachers have seamless, accurate, and secure access to their classes from day one.  
 

* * *

## Limitations of SSO-only and Saved Passwords apps

While SSO-only and Saved Passwords applications make signing in easier, they require long-term maintenance from IT teams.

**SSO-only applications**

These apps only authenticate user logins. They don't receive section or class enrollment data. As a result, teachers or admins must manually create classes and assign students within the app.

**SSO (Saved Passwords) applications**

Saved Passwords applications rely on you to configure rostering and user credentials directly with the application partner. This process requires constant maintenance to keep rostering up to date and to manage user credentials both directly in the application and in Clever. If you choose not to upload user credentials directly in your Clever Dashboard, students and teachers will be prompted at first login to enter their credentials.

While SSO-only and Saved Passwords applications are great options when an application doesn’t have a rostering integration with Clever, relying on them when a rostering application exists adds unnecessary workload and data friction to your technology ecosystem.

We recommend periodically checking your application setups to determine whether an application has added a rostering integration with Clever since your last search or since it was added as an SSO-only or Saved Passwords application.

* * *

## Benefits of upgrading to full SSO & Rostering apps

If a rostering integration is available for an application, upgrading to SSO & Rostering is strongly recommended. Here's why making the switch is essential:

-   **Automated data management:** Clever automatically provisions and updates user accounts, sections, and class enrollments based on changes in your Student Information System (SIS). You'll never need to worry about updating accounts manually when students or teachers switch classes or join your school organization.
    
-   **Streamlined setup:** Applications receive data in a standardized, normalized format. This automated workflow enables application teams to complete new account setups in under 24 hours on average.
    
-   **Enhanced cybersecurity & privacy**: Transferring roster data through Clever's automated pipelines is more secure than manually sharing spreadsheets or maintaining static password files. Every app connected through Clever runs on data minimization by default. This means it only receives the specific fields it needs, never a full copy of your SIS data.
    
-   **Minimal maintenance & granular control for admins:** The process runs seamlessly in the background, freeing your technical staff to focus on strategic projects rather than password resets and roster edits. Manage access directly from your Clever Dashboard by field, role, or school, and instantly disable entire data categories you don’t want to share.
    

  
 

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Why should our school organization move away from Saved Passwords applications?**

-   Saved Passwords apps require manual account creation outside of Clever and ongoing maintenance to keep credentials up to date. Upgrading to full SSO & Rostering automates account provisioning and eliminates the need for manual upkeep.
    

**Do SSO-only applications receive class and section rosters?**

-   No. SSO-only applications only handle user authentication and do not receive section, class, or enrollment data from your SIS.
    

**How do we update an application to use SSO & Rostering?**

-   You can review your connected applications in your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications). For any applications you have that are SSO-only or SSO (Saved Passwords), we recommend checking [our Application Gallery](https://www.clever.com/app-gallery) and your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) search to see if a rostering version of the app is available.
    
-   If you do see a rostering version, we recommend you request it in Clever or reach out to the application partner directly to start your transition. Their team will be able to share information on account matching, the transition process, and the timeline for moving to rostering through Clever. Most applications are up and running within 24-48 hours.
    

  
 

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Applications - What types of apps are on Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002370127)
    
-   [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Overview & Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488)
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Apps - Add/request or remove apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997)

title: For Teachers: The student experience in Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001753#header1)  
2\. [Student logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001753#header2)  
3\. [What students see in their Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001753#header3)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001753#header4)

## Overview

As a teacher, you're probably already familiar with your own Clever Portal, where you access your class resources and apps. Your students have a Portal too, and it's designed to work a lot like yours. Knowing what your students see, from login to their homepage, can make it easier for you to guide them, answer their questions, and troubleshoot issues when something doesn't look right.

This article walks through what students experience in Clever so you can better support them.

* * *

## Student logins

Before students reach their Portal, they need to log in. Similar to you, they’ll navigate to your school organization’s Portal URL.  From here, what the login looks like depends on the login method your school has set up. Common methods include:

-   **Google or Microsoft logins:** Students log in with an account they already have through school, such as Google, Microsoft, Canvas, etc.
    
-   **Clever passwords username and password**: Students enter a username and password provided by their school.
    
-   **Clever Badges**: Students scan a physical badge, similar to a QR code, to log in without typing. Clever Badges only work with Clever, not a QR code scanner.
    

If you're not sure which method your students use, check with your school's admin. 

* * *

## What students see in their Clever Portal

Once a student logs in, they land on their Portal homepage. They’ll see a simple page of tiles, or icons, for each app and resource their teacher or school has shared with them. Students click a tile to launch that resource, whether it's a reading program, a math app, or another classroom tool.

Any Teacher Pages shared with the student will appear at the top of their Portal under any resources they’ve favorited.

The student Portal is designed to closely match your Teacher Portal. The layout, navigation, and overall look and feel are consistent across both experiences, which can make it easier for you to guide a student through their screen since it resembles your own.

![Example student Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d1x7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000mvy5S) 

If your school organization sends notifications to students through Clever, students will see a red dot on their notification bell. When they click it, it’ll open a pop-up window in the middle of their screen. Students can read the notification and close it when they’re done.  
 

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Do students log in to their Portal the same way I do?**

-   Not necessarily. Your school chooses the login method for all users, so your login may look different than students’. Check with your school's admin if you're unsure which method your students use.
    

**Will a student's Portal look exactly like mine?**

-   Not exactly, but it's designed to feel familiar. Students see a simplified version of the same tile-based layout you use, with access to only the apps and resources shared with them.
    

**A student says they can't find an app. What should I check first?**

-   Confirm if the student should have access to the resource they’re looking for. If they should, have them browse for the app on their Portal homepage. If the student still can’t locate their resource, they can try searching for it with the search bar in the top right of their Portal.
    

* * *

**Related articles:  
  
**

-   [For Teachers: Chromebooks - the student experience](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236004628)

title: Troubleshooting: Clever IP addresses
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#header1) 2\. [Types of IP addresses](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#header2) 3\. [The Clever products and features affected and taking action](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#header3) 4\. [Information for app partners](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#header4) 5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#header5) ## Overview Clever periodically updates the Internet Protocol (IP) addresses it uses to send and receive traffic with school organizations and application partners. These updates are part of our ongoing security and infrastructure work, helping us align with industry best practices for protecting school and student data and supporting the commitments outlined in our [Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust). Updated IP addresses affect two kinds of traffic:  1. Clever connecting into your network (for example, to run syncs or verify logins). 2. An organization sending data to Clever (for example, uploading files via SFTP).  If your organization uses a firewall to restrict either kind of traffic by IP address, you'll need to keep your allowlist up to date whenever Clever's IP addresses change. **IMPORTANT:** If you use a firewall with IP-restricted traffic, **you must follow the instructions below to update addresses by Sept 30, 2026**, so your Clever syncs and logins continue to operate as expected. If you are adding a new firewall or starting to restrict IP addresses, you must add these IP addresses when doing so. Since these firewall settings live within your organization's network, Clever can't always tell whether you need to take action. Check with the right person at your organization, such as your IT team or network administrator, to confirm whether your firewall restricts traffic and, if so, whether Clever’s current IP addresses are allowed. If you don't use a firewall, or if your firewall isn't configured to restrict traffic by IP address, no action is needed on your end.  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwc1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000mwEWo)  Please note:** We recommend you bookmark this article and check back at least once a year to see if IP address updates have occurred. For school organizations, we recommend reviewing during your school rollover period. * * * ## Types of IP addresses Clever uses two types of IP addresses, depending on the direction the traffic is flowing: - **From Clever to the organization:** These are used when Clever sends traffic to an organization's network. For example, to sync data or verify login credentials against your Active Directory (AD) server. - **From the organization to Clever:** These are used when your organization sends traffic _to_ Clever. For example, uploading files via SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol). **Current IP addresses from traffic from Clever to the organization:** - 54.225.227.87 - 184.73.226.48 - 3.214.105.233 - 100.51.85.191 - 3.211.31.53 - 35.170.195.213 - 54.163.118.98 - 34.197.28.2 - 100.55.142.192 - 44.218.4.124 - 35.155.190.72 - 52.27.194.67 - 54.245.147.82 - 52.89.92.99 - 44.235.89.59 - 52.41.184.141 - 35.85.173.224 - 52.40.174.76 - 32.185.0.124 - 16.145.20.236 - 54.241.134.131 - 50.18.217.135 - 54.241.154.41 **Current IP addresses for traffic from the organization to Clever:** 35.153.220.107 98.82.62.247 18.207.52.5 32.184.222.110 54.68.126.218 16.148.239.204 54.215.0.59   * * * ## The Clever products and features affected and taking action
 

Product or feature

 		 

IP Address type

 
SSO or password reset via Active Directory or LDAPFrom Clever
IDM syncs with Active DirectoryFrom Clever
Active Directory staff syncingFrom Clever
SFTP-based data transfers to CleverTo Clever
App partners only: OneRoster SFTP exports for rostering or Content Mapping dataFrom Clever
If you use any of the products listed above, have a firewall enabled or add one, and haven’t allowlisted the IP addresses above, you’ll experience connection errors and/or failed sync connections. **How to check if you need to take action:** 1. Confirm if you use one of the products or features listed above. 2. Confirm whether your organization uses a firewall that restricts outbound or inbound connections by IP address. 3. If you're not sure, look for an open Task in your Clever admin dashboard related to this update, or reach out to support.clever.com for help. **IMPORTANT:** If you use a firewall for SFTP-based data transfers to Clever you’ll also need to update the SFTP Upload URL (domain) for your file transfers to sftp://sftp2.clever.com. The previous domain (sftp://sftp.clever.com) will no longer be available starting September 30, 2026. * * * ## Information for app partners If your application receives Clever rostering or Content Mapping data via a OneRoster CSV export via SFTP, and you use a firewall to restrict inbound connections by IP address, keep your allowlist up to date with the IP addresses for traffic [from Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#TrafficFromClever) [to the organization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#TrafficFromClever). If you don't update your allowlist in time, you won't be able to sync data for connected school organizations, and any new OneRoster exports to your SFTP server will fail until you add the new IP addresses.  * * * ## Frequently asked questions (FAQs) **What happens if my organization doesn't update its firewall by the current deadline?** - Affected syncs, logins, or password resets will fail until the update is made. **How often does Clever update its IP addresses, and why?** - Occasionally, as part of ongoing security and infrastructure work. We recommend checking this article at least once a year for the most current list. A natural time to do this is during your regular Back to School preparations to ensure you have the most up to date IP addresses in your firewall configuration. **Do all organizations need to take action?** - No. Only those using a firewall that restricts traffic by IP address need to make updates. **How do I know if we’re using a firewall that restricts traffic by IP address? Can Clever tell me this?** - Check with your IT or network administrative team. Clever has limited insight into your firewall settings. The best team to work with on this is your internal team, as Clever can’t tell you your exact network setup or limitations. **Our SIS manages our SFTP uploads. Do we, or does our SIS, need to allowlist these IP addresses since the data is coming from their system?** - Clever's team doesn't have insight into your SIS settings or whether your SIS has a firewall set up for SFTP exports. Please reach out to their team directly to determine if they have a firewall in place and if they’ll need to update IP addresses. **I only use one Clever feature that relies on IP addresses with traffic from Clever to my organization. Do I need to allow-list all of the addresses listed, or just one?** - All of them. The features and products listed above that cause traffic from Clever all share [the same set of IP addresses](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001752#header2), and Clever's connection may come from any address in that set. Allow-listing only one could still cause connection failures. You may not see use from a specific IP address for an extended period, but you should keep that address allowed to prevent issues down the line. **Who should I contact if I have questions?** - Start with your IT team to confirm your firewall setup. For anything Clever-related, contact support.clever.com. * * * **Related Articles:**  - [Clever IDM: Connecting to Active Directory via LDAPS](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001504) - [Sync Error: How do I resolve "SIS is not currently available at the URL provided"?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202493888) - [Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with LDAPS"](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387)   * * *

title: For Clever Admins: Configuring languages in Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001749#header1)  
2\. [Setting your own language](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001749#header2)  
3\. [Setting the language for your school organization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001749#header3)  
4\. [How teachers configure student languages](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001749#header4)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001749#header5)

## Overview

Clever is available in multiple languages and locales including Spanish, Australian English, and British English! As an Clever admin account owner, you can set your own language preference, set a default language for your entire school organization, and, if needed, step in to help configure language settings for students via their teacher’s profile. This article covers all three scenarios. Once a language is set, it'll stay in place every time that user logs back into Clever.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHM03)  Please note:** This feature is currently in early access. If you don’t see the options for updating languages described in this article, they’ll be available to you soon! 

* * *

## Setting your own language

You can update your personal language preference from your Clever Dashboard.

1.  Click your **name** in the top right corner of the dashboard.
    
2.  Select **Profile**.
    
3.  On the **Overview** page, find the language setting and select your preferred language.
    

Your Dashboard will display in your chosen language every time you log in.

![Profile language settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHyTV)   
  
 

* * *

## Setting the language for your school organization

Clever account owners can set a default language for their entire school organization.  This setting applies to students, teachers, and staff. Please note that individual language settings will override the school organization’s preferred language.

1.  From your Clever Dashboard, navigate to **Portal**.
    
2.  Select **Portal Settings**.
    
3.  Click **Customization**.
    
4.  Choose your preferred default language and save.
    

![School organization language settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHzZF) 

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHM03)  Please note:** If a teacher has already set a language for an individual student, that student-level setting won't be overwritten by an org-level change.

* * *

## How teachers can configure student languages

Teachers play an important role in managing students' language settings. They can update the language setting for individual students or an entire class through their Teacher Portal. The language setting applies to the student's entire Portal (all Teacher Pages, school org categories, etc.). Here's how each works and when you might need to step in.

**Teacher updates an individual student's language**

Teachers can go to **My Students > Student Roster**, select a class, click the student's name, and choose **Update Language** under **Student Tools**.

**Teacher updates an entire class's language**

Teachers can go to **My Students > Student Roster**, select a class, click **More Class Tools**, and select **Update Language** to apply a language to all students in that class at once.

If a teacher isn't available to update a student's language, you can use [Clever's **Access Portal As** feature](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000406146#Instructionstoimpersonate) to act on their behalf. This lets you log in as that teacher and make the update directly from their Teacher Portal view.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHM03)  Please note:** Remember, any changes you make while in a teacher’s Portal are live changes. Exercise caution when impersonating and making changes in a Teacher Portal.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Can students set their own language?**

-   Not at this time. Language settings for students are controlled by teachers or admins to keep choices aligned with how schools manage bilingual or multilingual instruction.
    

**Who can set the default language for a school organization?**

-   Currently only Clever Admin Owners can set the default language for the school organization.
    

**If I set a default language for the whole org, will it override individual student settings?**

-   No. Language settings applied at the student level by a teacher take priority and won't be overwritten by a school-level change.
    

**What if a student has multiple teachers that attempt to set their language?**

-   The most recently set language will apply on the student's account.

**Where do language settings apply for students?**

-   The student's entire Portal. This includes all Teacher pages, school org categories, etc. If a teacher sets a student's language, their entire Portal will be in that language, not just that Teacher's page.

**Will language settings persist at the end of a school year or during rollover?**

-   Yes. Once a language is set it won't change unless updated to another language.

**If a student's Clever Portal is in Spanish, will their apps also be in Spanish?**

-   Not automatically. Clever's language setting applies to the Clever Portal only. Whether an individual app is available in Spanish depends on that app's own configuration. Check with each app provider for guidance. If the application is available in Spanish, then update your language preferences in both Clever and that application for a consistent experience.
    

**What about users with dual roles like a teacher who's also an STL?**

-   Language preference is set at the user level, not the role level. So whatever language a user selects will apply regardless of which role they're currently in.
    

**Do you have resources I can share with other administrators or teachers?**

-   Yes. Please check out our one-pagers for [administrators](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/CleverinSpanish-Admins-EnglishVer-JUN2026-V4.pdf) and [teachers.](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/CleverinSpanish-Teachers-EnglishVer-JUN2026-V3.pdf)

**Is this feature available at no additional cost?**

-   Yes! Language settings are available to all schools on Clever at no extra charge.
    

**What if the language of a user's Dashboard or Portal doesn't match the language settings in Clever?**

-   Please review the language settings for your web browser and identity provider account. These settings may cause some areas of Clever to be translated, even if your settings in Clever indicate otherwise. Some web browsers have multiple language settings (for example, with Google, you can set the language for your browser, as well as your individual Google account). Please be sure to check all language settings that may be tied to your browser and accounts.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: How do I update my profile settings?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043053)
    
-   [For Teachers: Configuring languages in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001748)
    
-   [Clever Portal: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002720807)

title: For Teachers: Configuring languages in Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001748#header1)  
2\. [Setting your own language](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001748#header2)  
3\. [Setting languages for students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001748#header3)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001748#header4)

## Overview

Clever is available in multiple languages and locales including Spanish, Australian English, and British English! You can customize the language your Clever Portal displays both for yourself and for your students. This article walks you through how to set your own language preference, update the language for an individual student, and change the language for an entire class. Once a language is set, it'll stay in place every time that user logs back into Clever. 

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHptF)  Please note:** This feature is currently in early access. If you don’t see the options for updating languages described in this article, they’ll be available to you soon!

* * *

## Setting your own language

You can set your own language preference directly from your Clever Portal at any time.

1.  Navigate to the **profile icon** in the top right corner of your Portal.
    
2.  Select **Account Settings**.
    
3.  Under **Language Settings**, choose your preferred language from the drop-down.
    

Your Portal will now display in your chosen language every time you log in.

![Teacher Portal language settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHqnh)   
  
 

* * *

## Setting languages for students

You have two options for updating student language settings: one student at a time or an entire class in bulk.

**Updating an individual student's language**

1.  From your Teacher Portal, go to **My Students**.
    
2.  Select **Student Roster**, then click on the student's class.
    
3.  Click the student's name.
    
4.  Under **Student Tools**, select **Update Language**.
    
5.  Choose the language from the pop-up and save.
    

![Updating an individual student's language](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHrqD)

**Updating the language for all students in a class**

1.  From your Teacher Portal, go to **My Students**.
    
2.  Select **Student Roster**, then choose the class you'd like to update.
    
3.  Click **More Class Tools**.
    
4.  Select **Update Language** and choose the language for the class.
    
5.  If you have a student with a different language preference from the reset of the class, you’ll still be able to customize individual student languages as needed.
    

![Update a class of students language settings in bulk](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHspV)

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kHptF)  Please note:** Remember, once you configure language settings they’ll stay in place every time that user logs into Clever.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Can students set their own language?**

-   Not at this time. Language settings for students are managed by teachers or admins. This keeps language choices consistent with how your school structures bilingual or multilingual instruction.
    

**Will the language setting reset if an admin changes settings at the school level?**

-   No! A language you set for an individual student won't be overwritten by school-level changes. Student-level settings always take priority.
    

**If a student's Clever Portal is in Spanish, will their apps also be in Spanish?**

-   Not automatically. Clever's language setting only applies to the Clever Portal itself. Whether an app is available in Spanish depends on that app's own settings. Check with each app provider for guidance. If the application is available in Spanish, then update your language preferences in both Clever and that application for a consistent experience.
    

**When I set the language preference for a class, can I still change it for an individual student?**

-   Yes. While setting the language at the class level is a quick way to update a large group of students, you can still customize individual students' languages outside the class preference.
    

**Can students set their own language?**

-   Not at this time. Language settings for students are controlled by teachers or admins to keep choices aligned with how schools manage bilingual or multilingual instruction.
    

**What if a student has multiple teachers that attempt to set their language?**

-   The most recently set language will apply on the student's account.

**Where do language settings apply for students?**

-   The student's entire Portal. This includes all Teacher pages, school org categories, etc. If a teacher sets a student's language, their entire Portal will be in that language, not just that Teacher's page.

**What if I have both a teacher and STL role?**

-   Your language preference applies to your user account, not your role. So whichever language you set will follow you regardless of which role you're logged in as.
    

**Do you have a resource I can print or share with other teachers?**

-   Yes. Please check out our one-pager for [teachers.](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/CleverinSpanish-Teachers-EnglishVer-JUN2026-V3.pdf)

**What if the language in my Portal or a student's Portal doesn't match the language settings in Clever?**

-   Please review the language settings for your web browser and identity provider account (Google, Active Directory, etc.). These settings may cause some areas of Clever to be translated, even if your settings in Clever indicate otherwise. Please be sure to check all language settings that may be tied to your browser and accounts.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Teachers: Overview of the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000781723)

title: Clever + TrustEd Apps Management Suite (TAMS): Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001746#header1)  
2\. [Step 1: Reach out to Clever support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001746#header2)  
3\. [Step 2: Setup in TrustEd Apps Management Suite](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001746#header3)  
4\. [Step 3: Launch app in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001746#header4)

## Overview

Clever offers SSO via LTI 1.3 to the TrustEd Apps Management Suite (TAMS) app provided by the 1EdTech consortium. To connect with the TAMS app, please follow these steps.  
 

* * *

## Step 1: Reach out to Clever support

Reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) to request an invitation to connect to the TAMS app. Once this request has been made, support will reach out within 1-3 business days with a unique Client ID for you to copy and paste into your TAMS dashboard.  
 

* * *

## Step 2: Setup in TrustEd Apps Management Suite

1.  Log in to your TAMS dashboard as an administrator.
    
2.  Select **TrustEd Apps** and choose **Setup**.
    
3.  From **Connection Details**, copy and paste the following URLs into the corresponding input fields. Remove the angle brackets < > when copying URL values.
    
    1.  **Name:** <your preferred name for the TAMS app>
        
    2.  **Client ID:** <Clever support will send you a client ID to copy/paste>
    3.  **Issuer ID:** https://www.clever.com
    4.  **OIDC URL:** https://clever.com/oauth/lti/anon/receive/67a1459fc73e7b92121ab6ff
    5.  **JWKS URL:** [https://clever.com/oauth/lti/jwks](https://clever.com/oauth/lti/jwks)

* * *

## Step 3: Launch app in Clever

Once the connection in TAMS is established, accept the app invite in Clever and configure your application sharing permissions. If you need guidance on setting up sharing permissions, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dUFx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oMgwg)  Please note:** When connecting your app, you may see a message in Clever regarding a launch date. If you need your app to go live sooner or on a specific schedule, please specify your desired launch date to Clever support in your initial request, or follow up with support when a date is determined.

* * *

title: SFTP syncs: Understanding Clever's manual export specifications
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001745#header1) 2\. [Why each file matters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001745#header2) 3\. [Understanding key fields and requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001745#header3) 4\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001745#header4) ## Overview If you’re utilizing an SFTP sync or an SIS-Managed Auto Sync, Clever uses SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol) to safely move data from your SIS (Student Information System) into Clever. Think of these [SFTP specifications as a blueprint](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). When you provide data in the correct format, you're building a bridge that allows students and teachers to access their learning apps instantly. Even if you're using an Identity Provider like Google for sign-in, these files are the essential foundation that tells Clever who your users are so they can be matched to their accounts.  By understanding the "why" behind our data requirements, you can ensure a smoother sync and a better experience for your end users.  * * * ## Why each file matters Clever’s SFTP upload consists of five core files (schools.csv, students.csv, teachers.csv, sections.csv, enrollments.csv). For your initial sync to run successfully, we require all 5 files, even if you're only using sample data for some of them. Each file plays a specific role in creating a complete picture of your school organization: - **schools.csv**: This is your foundation. It identifies every building in your school organization so we can group users and sections correctly. Even if you are a single school organization, you still must include a schools.csv with your single school listed so that Clever can associate all other data in your account with this school. - **students.csv**: The source for student accounts. Without this, students can't log in to the Clever Portal. - **teachers.csv**: This identifies the educators. It creates their accounts and allows them to manage their digital classrooms and use tools like Teacher Pages. - **sections.csv**: These are the "classes." This file defines the groups where learning happens (e.g., 3rd Period Algebra). The sections.csv must exist so that classes can be tied to a school, and teachers can be assigned to those sections. - **enrollments.csv**: This file connects students to the specific sections created via the sections.csv above. Without this, a student might be in Clever but won't see any of their assigned apps or class resources.   ![Chart graphic showing the CSV file relationships](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dJ9F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hbXU5) * * * ## Understanding key fields and requirements Each field in the SFTP specification serves a specific purpose for authentication, rostering, or user experience. Clever has a limited set of required fields, but there are additional fields that it may be helpful to sync to ensure your end users have the best experience with Clever. In the table below, we’ve summarized required and recommended fields for syncing data to Clever. For a full list of accepted fields and values, [please see our Clever SFTP specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf).

Field

Required or recommended?

Rationale

Impact

 Unique Identifiers (school_id, student_id, teacher_id, section_id) RequiredThese are the most critical pieces of data. They act as the source of truth that ties a user to their data across different files. For example, the student_id in your students.csv must match the student_id in enrollments.csv, so Clever knows which student belongs in which class.If these IDs change in your SIS, Clever treats them as brand-new users or sections. This can result in "duplicate" accounts and, more importantly, a student losing their progress or saved work in their learning applications.
 First_name and last_name RequiredWe need names to identify accounts within the Clever Dashboard and the Portal.Name data is essential for identifying user accounts and customizing their experience.
 User emailsRecommended - may be required dependent on your setup  For most school organizations, the email address is the match point between Clever and your IdP (Identity Provider), such as Google or Microsoft.If the email in Clever doesn't match the email in your IdP, SSO (Single Sign-On) will fail because Clever won't know which Google or Microsoft account belongs to that user.
 User Number (teacher_number, school_number, student_number) RecommendedThis can be the same as your user ID number.

Some applications specifically look for user numbers, while Clever uses the user ID for internal linking.

If an application requires a student_number or teacher_number and it isn’t populated, this can cause data compatibility issues.
* * * ## Frequently asked questions (FAQs) **Why can’t I just upload a list of students?** - A list of students tells us _who_ is in the school organization, but not _where_ they're learning. We need the other files (such as enrollments and sections) to ensure they're connected to the right teachers and schools. **What happens if I leave a required field blank?** - If a required field is missing, the record (or the entire file) may fail to sync. You'll see these errors in your Clever Dashboard under the Sync section, where you can troubleshoot exactly what's missing. **Can I use my own headings for the CSV files?** - While it is recommended to use the headers listed in [Clever's specifications,](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) if you're manually uploading data to the Clever Dashboard, you'll have the option to map the headers used in your files to the relevant fields in Clever. [Learn more here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001608) **Why can’t I sync data directly from Google or Active Directory to Clever?** - While Google handles authentication, it typically doesn’t store rostering data such as which student is in which teacher's 3rd-period math class. The CSV files provide this essential mapping. - If you want to avoid creating users in two places, Clever offers IDM (Identity Management). This tool takes your MIS data and automatically creates the users in Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID for you! **Do I have to provide the** **student\_number** **if I already provided a** **student\_id****?** - While student\_number isn't required, and both student\_id and student\_number may be the same, we recommend including both because some applications specifically look for a Student Number, while Clever uses the ID for internal linking. Providing both ensures maximum compatibility with all your apps. **Why do I need a** **school\_id** **in every file?** - The school\_id ensures that every user, section, and enrollment is associated with the correct physical location.  * * * **Related articles:** - [SFTP Syncs: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078) - [SFTP Syncs: SFTP Sync FAQ](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001556) - [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408) - [SFTP & Manual Upload: How do I format my CSV files?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867) * * *

title: Clever + ParentSquare: Setup guide
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001744#header1) 2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001744#header2) 3\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001744#header3) 4\. [Support contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001744#header4) 5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001744#header5) ## Overview This guide walks through setting up ParentSquare in Clever.  Before reading this guide, please make sure your school organization is set up with Clever! If your school org hasn't been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup). For more information on setting up Clever for the first time, please see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271).   * * * ## Setup process If your school organization is already on Clever, you can connect ParentSquare’s application by accepting your invite or following these instructions: 1. Log into your Clever Dashboard and select _[Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)_ from the left navigation. 2. Search for ParentSquare 3. You'll be brought to a page where you can authorize your ParentSquare request. As Clever SSO and rostering for ParentSquare is provided at no cost to your school organization, you can mark that it has already been purchased. 4. You'll also be asked if you'd like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the ParentSquare icon in their Clever portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day. 5. Once you have made your selections, click **Request**. Once you have shared data with ParentSquare, the ParentSquare team will set up the initial sync and will reach out to you to discuss communicating with teachers. * * * ## Required fields Please make sure that you are sharing the following fields in your data sync from your SIS to Clever in order for ParentSquare to receive this data: **Student Records** - Required: district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, ext, grade, student\_number - Optional: dob, email, gender, home\_language, state\_id - Language fields (Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771) for more information on how to add these fields to Clever and how to share them with applications): - **home\_language** - **Home\_language\_code** **Contact Records** - Required: district, name, sis\_id, students, email, phone, relationship, student\_relationships, type **Teacher Records** - Required: district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, email, ext, title **Staff Records** - Required: district, name, schools, staff\_id, email, ext, roles, title **District Admin Records** - Required: district, name.first, name.last, email, title **Attendance.csv File** Attendance data fields. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001704?language=en_US) for how to add attendance data to Clever.
Column headerRequiredFormatNotes
Attendance_idNOString

Unique and constant id for attendance record.

Uniqueness is set at the SIS level and not guaranteed by Clever.

Attendance_dateYESDateThe date on which attendance was taken.
Attendance_statusYESOption (enum)

Possible values:

*Absent

*Tardy

Excuse_codeNOStringAny district code relating to the attendance record.
Student_idYESStringUnique and constant id for relevant student. Corresponds to ‘sis_id’ field in Clever. Must be unique across the district.
Section_idNOStringIf attendance_type is “section”, the relevant ID of the section. Corresponds to the ‘sis_id’ field on the section object in Clever.
School_idNOStringUnique and constant id for the school that the attendance record is assigned to. Corresponds to ‘sis_id’ field in Clever. Must be unique across the district.
Attendance_typeNOOption (enum)Supported values: “daily” or “section.” If not available, Clever will calculate based on whether or not there is a corresponding “section_id” on a given record.
* * * ## Support contacts **ParentSquare** Contact info: [support@parentsquare.com](mailto:support@parentsquare.com)  **Clever** Support.clever.com (click the chat icon in the corner of the screen) Contact Clever with issues that relate to: - Getting specific data fields into Clever - Setting up data sharing rules   * * * ## Frequently asked questions (FAQs) **Why am I getting a “data warning”?** - A data warning occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. You will see a data warning for ParentSquare if a student is missing student contacts. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943) for help syncing student contacts to Clever. **Why is a student or teacher missing from ParentSquare?** - Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to ParentSquare: - In your SIS data - In your Clever data - Is shared with ParentSquare in your data sharing permissions **Are staff supported?** - Yes, ParentSquare supports staff with Clever.   * * *

title: For Clever Admins: Why Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001743#header1)  
2\. [Modernizing access with single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001743#header2)  
3\. [Automating data rostering and management](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001743#header3)  
4\. [Prioritizing cybersecurity and data privacy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001743#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001743#header5)

## Overview

Clever serves as the central identity platform for your school organization, connecting all your digital learning tools in one secure location. It simplifies the digital classroom by providing students and teachers with a single point of entry for every application they use.

Clever automates the manual tasks of account creation and data management, so your team can focus on what matters instead of repetitive processes. By standardizing your technology ecosystem, Clever helps you build a more efficient and secure learning environment for everyone.

Through Clever’s unique [business model](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202393278), in which application partners pay Clever for secure, automated rostering, we’re able to offer many of Clever’s features at no cost to schools.

Additionally, Clever's terms prohibit application partners from charging schools an extra fee specifically for connecting through Clever (a "Clever premium"). Partners may still charge general integration or setup fees that apply **regardless** of which method a school uses to connect. If a vendor cannot explain why a charge would disappear if you used a different integration method, please escalate to Clever.

Clever does not sell student data. Student [data privacy](https://www.clever.com/trust/privacy) is a top priority for Clever; we are both FERPA and COPPA compliant and meet additional federal and state requirements.

We offer the following services at no charge to school organizations:

-   [Secure Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0y0WAC/secure-sync)
    
-   [Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZn3WAG/clever-portal)
    
-   [Single-sign on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0xxWAC/single-signon-sso)
    
-   Clever Badges
    
-   [Clever Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050299552)
    
-   Clever Library
    
-   [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)

You’ll also be able to contact our [support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) with any questions or issues. Our team has agents available to assist you Monday - Friday, 7am - 8pm ET.

[Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) and [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) are additional, optional paid products we offer at the request of school organizations to further secure identity and access and streamline technology in one simple platform.  
 

* * *

## Modernizing access with single sign-on (SSO)

Managing dozens of different usernames and passwords creates a significant barrier to learning and increases the workload for your technical support team. Clever’s Single Sign-On (SSO) removes this hurdle by allowing users to access all their authorized applications with one set of credentials.

For younger learners, we offer Clever Badges. Badges let students log in simply by holding a physical Badge up to a device camera. This streamlined access ensures that teachers don’t waste valuable learning time helping students login. If you’re already using SSO through an Identity Provider (IdP) like Google or Microsoft, or simply don’t want your students and teachers to have to learn _another_ set of credentials, you can use your current IdP with Clever to keep credentials consistent for students. That makes the transition to Clever seamless for your end users.

Beyond logging in, the Clever Portal acts as a personalized digital home base for every user. Admins and teachers can organize resources by grade level, subject, or school, ensuring that students see exactly what they need the moment they sign in. When you provide a consistent, reliable way to access tools, you'll see higher engagement across all your digital resources. You're not just adding a new tool; you're creating a gateway that makes every other piece of software in your school organization more effective.

* * *

## Automating data management and rostering

Many school organizations manage multiple syncs or data uploads for the various learning applications they utilize. Managing data per application can lead to data errors and lapses in user access. Clever’s Secure Sync connects directly to your Student Information System (SIS) to automate the entire provisioning process, ensuring you no longer need to manage individual syncs per application. When you update student or staff information in your SIS, Clever automatically reflects those changes across all your connected learning applications. This system ensures that every user has the correct access from their first day in the school organization.

You won't need to spend hours managing spreadsheets or manually creating accounts for every new software tool. This automation reduces the burden on your IT staff and keeps student data accurate across platforms. We've built this infrastructure to handle the heavy lifting so your staff can reclaim their time for more impactful wor

* * *

## Prioritizing cybersecurity and data privacy

Protecting student privacy remains a top priority for every school organization. Clever provides a secure infrastructure that complies with federal regulations like FERPA and COPPA by design. We give you full control over the data you share, letting you decide exactly which pieces of information each application can access. You'll find that our platform offers a level of visibility into data usage that's difficult to achieve when managing applications individually.

Our platform also includes advanced security features, such as Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Classroom MFA was designed to protect all of your end users' accounts with school-friendly second factors that don’t require a second device, like login pictures, Badges, and PIN codes. By using Clever, you're implementing a robust security layer that safeguards your digital ecosystem against unauthorized access while maintaining ease of use for students and staff.

We also offer tools to help you audit and manage app security. You can see which applications have access to what data and revoke that access at any time. This transparency helps build trust with parents and stakeholders who worry about student data privacy. We've designed Clever to be the safest way to manage a digital learning environment, so you don't have to choose between convenience and security.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Why should our school organization use Clever instead of managing apps individually?**

-   Clever centralizes your tools to increase adoption and secure your data in one place. You’ll save hundreds of hours by eliminating manual data entry and password resets.

**How does Clever protect our student data?**

-   We encrypt your data and strictly follow federal privacy laws like FERPA and COPPA. You maintain full ownership and control over exactly what information you share with each app.

**Is it difficult to set up a connection between our SIS and Clever?**

-   We’ve made setup straightforward by offering several easy ways to sync data to Clever. Our team provides clear documentation and support to guide you through every step.

**How do we encourage teachers who are resistant to adopting a new platform?**

-   Help teachers understand how Clever works with your current tools to save them time. Share training resources that help them to understand how Clever works and highlight the simplicity of helping students access their learning resources from Badges to backup login codes. You can also [book a paid Clever Training](https://schools.clever.com/applications/browse/clever-training) with a Clever expert customized to your teachers' needs and knowledge!

**What's the cost for a school organization to use the platform?**

-   Most of Clever's products and features, including SSO and Secure Sync, costs nothing for school organizations. Our application partners cover the costs so we can provide these essential services to you for free. Additional features such as Clever IDM and Classroom MFA are offered at a low price to ensure schools have access to secure digital learning.

* * *

**Related articles:**

title: For Clever Admins: Audit Logs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001742#header1)  
2\. [Using audit logs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001742#header2)  
3\. [What events are logged?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001742#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001742#header4)

## Overview

Audit Logs provide a chronological record of the most important changes happening across your school organization’s Clever account. They’re a clear trail of actions that impact your account’s security, user access, and data syncs. This tool helps you proactively monitor, ensuring your school organization’s data stays secure. It’s your go-to spot for keeping your sensitive information protected in an increasingly complex digital landscape. By using Audit Logs, you can:

-   **Investigate suspicious activity**: Quickly review recent changes to understand what happened, when it occurred, and who was involved.
    
-   **Troubleshoot faster**: Quickly check for recent changes to authentication methods or sharing rules that may impact user logins.
    
-   **Maintain compliance**: Record actions taken in Clever to meet your organization’s cybersecurity compliance and incident response requirements.
    
-   **Monitor high-risk changes**: Regularly review updates to catch potential security issues.  
     
    

* * *

## Using audit logs

For security reasons, Audit Logs will maintain data for actions taken within the last 60 days in your Clever Dashboard.

Navigate to your Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Audit logs to review information captured in your Audit Logs.

![Screenshot of the Audit Logs section](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doD3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fWevZ)

The main table displays your logs starting with the most recent event. You can narrow down the list using filters to find exactly what you're looking for. You can filter by:

-   **Date Range**: View events from a specific window of time up to 14 days.
    
-   **Action Taken**: Filter by specific event types, like updated MFA policy or app sharing changes.
    

Click on any row to see more detailed information about a specific logged event.

You can also export a CSV of your audit logs at any time by clicking the **Export CSV** link. This will allow you to export any 14 day period of events within the past 60 days.

  
![Screenshot of Audit logs section highlighting Export CSV link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doD3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iSixe)    

* * *

## What events are logged?

Clever logs any events that significantly impact your school organization’s security or your students’, teachers’, and staff members' access to Clever. This includes:  
  

-   User login changes
    -   Updates to identity providers (IdPs)/login methods (i.e., adding, removing, or editing a login method)
    -   Updates to multi-factor authentication (MFA) policies
    -   Updates to Clever Badge settings  
          
        
-   App connection changes
    -   Adding or removing an app
    -   Updates in sharing permissions
    -   Changes in field access settings  
          
        
-   Portal organization changes (both by the admin team and School Tech Leads)
    -   Adding, removing, or renaming categories
    -   Adding, removing, or renaming links
    -   Reordering resources and categories
-   Bulk security actions
    -   Scheduling a bulk security action immediately or for a specific date and time

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Who can see Audit Logs?**

-   Clever Admin Owners and Clever Admins can access Audit Logs.
    

**How long does Clever store these logs?** 

-   For security reasons, Clever stores Audit Log information for 60 days. If you need records for a longer period, we recommend exporting your logs to a CSV regularly.
    

**Does the Audit Log show student personal identification information (PII)?** 

-   Audit Logs don’t store or display PII. Audit logs notify you of the change made, the users it impacts at a high level (i.e., org-wide or user-specific), and the admin who made the changes.
    

**Can I use Audit Logs to "undo" a change?** 

-   While Audit Logs show you what changed and might even show previous configurations in the detail view, they don't replace configuration management and versioning. You’ll still need to manually adjust your settings if you want to roll back a change.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admin: Custom admin roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702)

title: For Clever Admins: Managing Library restrictions and application approvals
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header1)  
2\. [Approving newly added library applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header2)  
3\. [Blocking resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header3)  
4\. [Turning off Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header4)  
5\. [Supporting teachers when restricting the library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header6)

## Overview

Clever Library is a safe way for teachers to explore new classroom tools. Instead of finding new applications anywhere on the internet that may have varied data privacy standards, teachers can try new apps from the Library with data-privacy guardrails and admin oversight. Resources in the Library can be added to a teacher’s Teacher Page for easy access by students and teachers.

As a Clever Admin, you have primary control over what teachers can access in the Clever Library. You’re able to block Library applications that your school organization hasn’t approved or may not want teachers utilizing, and similarly you can leave approved apps accessible to teachers.

When a teacher adopts a Library application with SSO, Clever shares only the absolute minimum information: student first name, last initial, grade level, and course enrollment.

Clever does not share any sensitive information with Library applications, including student number, SIS ID, email, state ID, school information, or any demographic information about the student. All Library applications sign a [universal data privacy agreement](https://www.clever.com/trust/universal-dsa).

This article will guide you through setting up Library restrictions. If you’re looking for information on encouraging your teachers to explore the Clever Library for safe application use, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471). 

* * *

## Approving newly added library applications

Library application approval controls allow administrators to customize the Library to fit their school organization’s needs. 

On your [Clever Dashboard > Library controls > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/library/settings) tab, you’ll find the option to **Require approval for new Library apps** as well as **Subscribe to new Library app announcements**. These controls ensure that as new apps join the Library, you can stay on top of what is available to your teachers.

![Library setting page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z4NJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cc8zZ)   
 

If you elect to require admin approval for new applications added to the Clever Library, you’ll receive a notification in the Dashboard for applications that are in review and require your approval. We also recommend subscribing to announcements or selecting team members to receive them so that you can be sure to review new applications in a timely manner for teachers.

* * *

## Blocking resources

If your school organization prohibits particular resources, you may also add them to a block list. For instance, if your school’s firewall blocks specific websites, you can also block them in the Library as well. Blocking a resource will prevent teachers from adding it to their Clever Portal. It’ll also remove the application from the Portal and Teacher Pages of any teachers who had already added it. When they search for and attempt to add the application, the **Install** button will appear gray and unclickable, with a note to contact their Clever Admin for more information.

Clever recommends checking the teacher installs for an application before blocking to ensure that no teachers are currently using it. You can check which teachers are using a Library application via the [Library controls > Applications](https://schools.clever.com/teacher-installs) tab and clicking the **Export teacher install data** button.

If teachers are currently using an application you wish to block, you should notify them. See our [section below on supporting teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001741#header7) for more information.

To edit the list of resources currently being blocked by your school organization, please navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Library Controls > Applications tab](https://schools.clever.com/library/applications). To block a single application, click the **Block** button and confirm you want to block and remove the application for teachers. To block multiple applications, check the boxes next to each application you’d like to block, then click the **Block X selected** button to block all selected applications.

If a teacher searches for or tries to install a blocked resource, Clever will gray out the install button and display the message below that the application has been blocked.

![Blocked Library application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z4NJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000SmzaX)

To block all applications and select only approved apps:

1.  Click the top checkbox next to the **Application Name** column to select all apps.
    
2.  To preserve the installs of any allowed apps, use the search bar to individually search for and **uncheck these applications.** **If you do not remove these applications from the list, they’ll be deleted from Teacher and student Portals.**
    

Once you have unchecked any applications you’d like to allow and preserve data for, click the **Block X selected applications** button to block all other applications. See the video below for a quick tutorial on how to allow only specific applications:

##   

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Note:** Blocking a resource doesn't prevent teachers or students from going around the safety of the Clever Portal and accessing the resource directly.

* * *

## Turning off Library

If your school organization would like to disable all Library data sharing, you can do so by navigating to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Library Controls > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/library/settings). You’ll see the option to **Disable Clever Library.**

When disabling the Library, you’ll also have the option to remove all existing library installs from teachers and students.

Before removing library installs for teachers and students, we recommend reviewing the Teacher Installs data downloadable on your [Applications > Library controls > Applications tab](https://schools.clever.com/library/applications) and reaching out to any teachers currently using library applications to inform them of this change.

Clever will request that communication be sent to teachers to alert them of the upcoming changes to their accounts. Once complete, our team will securely remove the Library resources from their Clever Portal.

**Email Template for informing teachers of library application removals**

_Subject: Important update regarding Clever Library applications_

Hi \[Teacher Name\],

We are writing to let you know about an upcoming change to our digital resource settings. To ensure we are meeting the highest standards for student data privacy and security, we are updating our permissions regarding the Clever Library.

As part of this update, we will be turning off the Clever Library to allow for a closer review of our digital footprint. This means the Library apps you currently use will no longer appear in your or your students' Clever Portals after this date.

Thank you for your partnership in keeping our student data safe.

Best,

\[Admin Name\]

* * *

## Supporting teachers when restricting the Library

Some teachers may depend on applications available in the Clever Library. If you plan to block certain applications or turn the Library off entirely, we recommend informing teachers in advance.

Clever doesn’t notify teachers directly in advance about Library changes made by your school organization. Instead, we suggest you share the update internally because:

-   You can choose the timing and secure any necessary team approvals.
    
-   Clever can’t email every user due to subscription preferences.
    
-   Teachers are more likely to read an email from your school system than from Clever.
    
-   Hearing about changes directly from your team builds trust.
    

You can find and download a list of Library applications your teachers are using on your Clever Dashboard's [Applications > Teacher installs](https://schools.clever.com/teacher-installs) page. You can use this list to inform teachers of applications you plan to block or to tell only teachers currently using the Library that you plan to disable it.

Below are talking points you can use when preparing your message to teachers about changes to the Clever Library.

**Balancing teacher autonomy with security and data privacy** 

The Clever Library gives teachers the flexibility to discover and quickly start using new applications with their students. While every Library application signs a universal data-sharing agreement, some school systems have stricter requirements. These school organization may review Library applications more closely before allowing them to be used with students.

In many cases, this approach is driven by state legislation or the school system’s own risk assessment. As a result, certain applications may be removed from the Library until they have completed the school system’s security review or other application procurement and vetting processes.

**Protecting student data**

The Clever Library includes safeguards to protect student data. All Library applications sign a [universal data-sharing agreement](https://www.clever.com/trust/universal-dsa), and when a teacher installs an app, only the minimum necessary student data is shared (see details below).

However, school systems—not teachers—are ultimately responsible for protecting student data. With schools largely seeing an increase in cyberattacks, some are seeking greater oversight of classroom applications. This helps them understand where and how student data is being shared and better defend against cybersecurity threats.

[Data shared](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001453) with Clever Library apps:

**Teachers**

Clever ID

Name

Email

**Students**

Clever ID

Name (first name, last initial)

Grade

**Sections**

Clever ID

Name

Subject

Grade

Section number

Teachers

Students

### **Why some school systems choose to block Library apps** 

Many school systems are tightening controls around digital resources given the increased threat of cyberattacks on school systems, state legislation mandating increased security and oversight, and evolving technology (AI) complicating the nature of attacks. With school organizations being accountable for protecting student data, some are implementing stricter policies to ensure any resource a student uses in class has been vetted from a cybersecurity perspective. This helps schools account for keeping student data safe.

  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Where can I learn more about encouraging our teachers to use Clever Library for safe edtech resources?**

-   [Check out our article here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471).
    

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Managing Library restrictions and application approvals](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741)
-   [For Clever Admins: Clever Library privacy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001453)
