title: For Clever Admins: Preventing Microsoft Authenticator Prompts when using Classroom MFA as an External MFA Method
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001740#header1)  
2\. [Issue: Receiving Microsoft Authenticator prompts with Clever as your external MFA method](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001740#header2)  
3\. [Troubleshooting if your migration is complete](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001740#header3)  
4\. [Troubleshooting if you haven't completed migration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001740#header4)  
5\. [Additional considerations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001740#header5)

## Overview

When using [Classroom MFA as an external MFA method for Microsoft Entra ID,](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001683) some school organizations may find that new, unregistered users are prompted to install **Microsoft Authenticator** or use other Microsoft-native MFA methods instead of being redirected to Clever's Classroom MFA.

This guide helps Clever Admins configure their Microsoft Entra ID environment to ensure Classroom MFA is the primary requirement and to prevent conflicting Microsoft security defaults from interrupting the login flow.

 **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000c44iI) Please note:** The settings described in this article take place entirely within the Microsoft Entra Admin center. These prompts are controlled by Microsoft and are outside of Clever's technical control. Please contact Microsoft Support for help with their interface or configurations. Clever can only troubleshoot if redirection issues persist after you have followed all Microsoft-recommended steps.

* * *

## Issue: Receiving Microsoft Authenticator prompts with Clever as your external MFA method

Due to changing policies on Microsoft's side, some school organizations are receiving a prompt for new users to enroll in Microsoft Authenticator. This is occurring for some users because Microsoft is migrating toward a unified authentication methods policy, and legacy settings or registration campaigns are overriding the Clever External MFA Method configuration.

After configuring Classroom MFA as an External MFA Method, users may encounter the following behavior:

-   The login flow doesn't immediately redirect the user to Clever to enroll in their designated Classroom MFA method (e.g., Badge, Picture, or PIN).
    
-   Users are prompted to enroll in the Microsoft Authenticator app before they can access their applications.
    
-   Users who have previously registered a Microsoft MFA method (like SMS or Authenticator) are able to use that method to bypass Clever's Classroom MFA.
    

* * *

## Troubleshooting if your migration is complete

To confirm if your migration is complete, please check your Authentication methods > Manage Migration screen.

![Microsoft Authentication Methods screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000c5fPd)

If you've already completed the migration to the Microsoft Entra ID Authentication Methods policy, follow these steps to prioritize Clever:

1.  **Disable Microsoft Registration Campaigns:** In the Entra ID admin center, navigate to Protection > Authentication methods > Registration campaign.
    
    -   Select **Edit** and change the **State** to **Disabled**, then select **Save**.
        
    -   Alternatively, you can keep the campaign enabled but specifically exclude the group of users assigned to Clever Classroom MFA.
        
2.  **Disable System-Preferred MFA:**
    
    -   Navigate to Protection > Authentication methods > Settings > System-preferred multifactor authentication.
        
    -   Select **Edit** and change the **State** to **Disabled**, then select **Save**.
        
3.  **Disable or Exclude Microsoft Authenticator:**
    
    -   Navigate to Protection > Authentication methods > Policies.
        
    -   Select **Microsoft Authenticator**.
        
    -   Under the **Exclude** tab, exclude any Entra group that should be using only Classroom MFA.
        
    -   Repeat steps above for any enabled Built-in Authentication Method to exclude Classroom MFA groups so that they are not targeted.
        

* * *

## Troubleshooting if you haven't completed migration

If your Microsoft tenant is currently in the **Pre-migration** or **Migration In Progress** state, legacy policies may still be prompting users. To check your status, navigate to Protection > Authentication methods > Policies > Manage Migration.

![Microsoft Authentication Methods screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000c5fPd)

The recommended resolution here is to complete your migration to the Entra ID authentication methods policy. Microsoft will be requiring this of all users. [You can learn more in their article here.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/how-to-authentication-methods-manage)

If you aren't ready to complete your migration, please reach out to the Microsoft team for best steps on allowing External MFA Method logins without the prompts from Microsoft Authenticator or other Microsoft-native MFA.

* * *

## Additional considerations

**Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR):** If your users use Entra ID SSPR, Microsoft requires at least one native Microsoft method (like a phone number or email) to be enabled. In this specific scenario, you may not be able to limit users strictly to the Clever External MFA Method.

-   **Conditional Access:** Ensure your Conditional Access policy for Clever External MFA Method is set to Require multifactor authentication and NOT Require authentication strength, as the latter can sometimes conflict with External MFA Methods.
    
-   **External Guest Users:** If your tenant includes guest users (e.g., vendors or consultants), ensure you use Exclude groups rather than disabling methods tenant-wide, or they may lose their ability to log in.
    

For more detailed information on policy migration, please refer to [Microsoft's official documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/how-to-authentication-methods-manage).

* * *

title: For Clever Admins: Custom MDM configurations for the Clever iOS App
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#header1)  
2\. [Custom configurations and use cases](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#header2)  
          •   [SharedDeviceModeOn](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#SharedDeviceModeOn)  
          •   [BrowserPasswordLoginOn](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#BrowserPasswordLoginOn)  
          •   [DistrictId](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#DistrictId)  
3\. [Setup instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#header3)  
4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#header4)  
5. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001739#header6)

## Overview

This article explains how to configure the Clever iOS app (version 6.1 and later) using a Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution such as Jamf or Mosyle. These settings allow you to customize the app's behavior for your school organization’s specific needs.

Common configuration options that can be deployed via your MDM's Managed App Configuration feature include:

-   **SharedDeviceModeOn:** Automatically logs students out after they launch the first resource that takes them out of the Clever application.
    
-   **BrowserPasswordLoginOn**: Opens a web browser for password logins instead of the in-app login screen
    
-   **DistrictId**: Pre-configures the app with your school organization’s custom Portal URL, skipping the school picker.
    

You can use your MDM to configure these settings for all your managed devices or for a specific subset.

* * *

## Custom configurations and use cases

### SharedDeviceModeOn

This custom configuration can be enabled when students share iOS devices, and you want to ensure they log out of Clever between device swaps.

When a student launches a resource that takes them out of the Clever Portal (like a rostering/SSO application or an external link), the Clever app will automatically log them out when they return. This helps younger learners who may not remember to log out manually.

### BrowserPasswordLoginOn

When this configuration is applied, if a user (student, teacher, staff, etc.) opens the iOS application and selects the Password option to log in manually with a username and password, the application will automatically redirect the user to log in to Clever via the device's web browser. If you have a password manager set up in your web browser, user credentials will be automatically saved and entered for you to log in.

This configuration is best for school organizations:

-   **That log in with external IdPs via the Password tab, and would like those credentials saved by their browser’s password manager:** Credentials for IdPs like Google are often saved by the device browser’s password manager. Using this configuration allows your users to continue using that device browser (and its autofill capabilities) to log in to the IdP.
    
-   **With teachers who frequently use iPads to access Clever:** Teachers can log in to the Clever Teacher Portal via a web browser. The Clever app only supports the Student Portal.
    
-   **That prefer students to manually enter login credentials:** Web browsers can autofill login credentials for younger students who may struggle to type them each time.
    

### DistrictId

If your students log into their iOS devices with a username and password, enabling this setting will streamline their login process by removing the need to select their school organization on the login page. When a student taps **Password** on the login screen, they'll go directly to your district's login page.

You can find your school organization’s Clever ID via your Clever Dashboard. Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser), and you’ll find the ID at the top of the page.

![Example of where to locate your school organization ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZIi1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bFDvh)

* * *

## Setup instructions

These instructions provide general guidance on managing applications in your MDM. The Clever Support team does not have insight into your specific MDM setup. If you need additional support around setting up application configurations, we recommend reaching out to your MDM directly.

​You can use your MDM to configure these settings for all your managed devices or for a specific subset.

1.  **Create the configuration profile:** In your MDM console, create a new **Managed App Configuration** (also called "App Configuration" or "Custom App Settings" depending on your MDM).
    
2.  **Add the configuration keys:** Use the configuration in the property list (.plist) format in the relevant dropdown below for the settings you'd like to apply. **Depending on your MDM, you may be able to use the entire .plist sample, or you may need to work with your MDM to properly set these values per their specifications.** We do recommend always setting all three keys, even if you're setting some to false. This ensures consistent behavior and properly overwrites any previous configurations on the device.
    
3.  Copy and paste the .plist provided for your preferred scenario below, then modify the values for your district: 
    

SharedDeviceModeOn Use this configuration when you want students logging in with a username and password to skip the school picker and they share iPads on which you want students to be automatically logged out after launching a resource:  
  

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <dict>
    <key>SharedDeviceModeOn</key>
    <true/>
    <key>BrowserPasswordLoginOn</key>
    <false/>
    <key>DistrictId</key>
    <string>YOUR_DISTRICT_ID_HERE</string>
  </dict>
</plist>
```

  

Replace YOUR\_DISTRICT\_ID\_HERE with your school organization's Clever ID found on your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) page (example: 51e76ab1d93412f47b000c32).

BrowserPasswordLogin  
Use this configuration when your school org uses manual credentials for Clever logins, your teachers use iOS devices and the Clever application, or your schools use many Saved Passwords applications.   
  

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <dict>
    <key>SharedDeviceModeOn</key>
    <false/>
    <key>BrowserPasswordLoginOn</key>
    <true/>
    <key>DistrictId</key>
    <string>YOUR_DISTRICT_ID_HERE</string>
  </dict>
</plist>
```

  
Replace YOUR\_DISTRICT\_ID\_HERE with your school organization's Clever ID found on your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) page (example: 51e76ab1d93412f47b000c32). DistrictID  
Use this configuration to simply pre-configure the district, without changing logout or browser behavior:  

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <dict>
    <key>SharedDeviceModeOn</key>
    <true/>
    <key>BrowserPasswordLoginOn</key>
    <false/>
    <key>DistrictId</key>
    <string>YOUR_DISTRICT_ID_HERE</string>
  </dict>
</plist>
```

  
Replace YOUR\_DISTRICT\_ID\_HERE with your school organization's Clever ID found on your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) page (example: 51e76ab1d93412f47b000c32).

* * *

## Troubleshooting

### Settings aren't being applied

-   Verify that the app version is 6.1 or later.
-   Check that your MDM is targeting the correct app bundle ID: com.clever.InstantLogin
-   Ensure the configuration profile is assigned to the correct device groups.
-   Try force-closing and reopening the Clever app after the profile is deployed.

### Students still see the school picker

-   Confirm that DistrictId is set to your correct district ID (not your district's shortname or URL)
-   Verify the profile has been successfully installed on the device.

### Password login still shows in the in-app screen

-   Confirm that BrowserPasswordLoginOn is set to true (not false or missing).
-   Make sure all three keys are present in your configuration, even if some are set to false.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What if I don’t know where to find these settings in my MDM?**

-   Clever Support has limited insight into your school organization’s specific MDM settings. If your MDM setup doesn’t match the instructions above, please reach out to your MDM directly to determine where you should set up App Configurations.
    

**What if I have followed the steps and troubleshooting tips above, and the application still isn’t behaving as expected?**

-   Feel free to reach out to Clever Support! Please be sure to include:
    
    -   Your MDM solution (Jamf, Mosyle, Intune, etc.)
        
    -   The configuration plist you're using
        
    -   A description of the expected vs. actual behavior
        

**Can I customize the app behavior using the plist examples above?  
  
**

-   Yes! Feel free to set any of the criteria as **True** or **False** to customize your user’s login experience. For the best login experience, we recommend including all three criteria, even if you set some to false.

title: Troubleshooting: Expired SAML certificates
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001736#header1) 2\. [Why SAML certificates expire](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001736#header2) 3\. [How to update your certificate](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001736#header3) 4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001736#header4) ## Overview Clever can utilize **Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML)** to offer a secure and seamless **Single Sign-On (SSO)** experience for users through **identity providers (IdPs)** such as ADFS and Microsoft Entra ID. For this connection to remain secure and functional, Clever and your IdP must use valid security certificates to confirm the user attempting to log in and verify user identities. If these certificates expire or Clever or one of your Clever admins rotates them without an update to your IdP, users may experience login failures.  * * * ## Why SAML certificates expire You can think of SAML certificates as digital "padlocks" and "keys". Clever provides your IdP with a "padlock" (public certification), which your IdP uses to lock login data before sending it to Clever. Clever then uses its "key" (private key) to unlock it. For security reasons, SAML certificates are only valid for a limited period (typically several years). When a certificate reaches its expiration date, it must be replaced with a new one to maintain a secure connection. To avoid login errors, you should ensure you are always using the most up-to-date SAML certificate available via Clever.   * * * ## How to update your certificate When Clever updates its security certificates in its public metadata.xml file, Clever Admins must ensure their Identity Provider (IdP) recognizes these changes. If the IdP is not updated, students and staff will be unable to log in via SAML. Depending on your IdP, you may need to manually update your settings or ensure your system is automatically pulling the latest metadata from Clever. Below are the update methods available for each IdP:

IdP

Update Method

Automatic?

IdP's support documentation on updating certificates and metadata

 ADFS Federation Metadata URLYes (if configured; default is every 24 hours)
  • Learn about monitoring your certificate and automatic updates here
 Microsoft Entra ID Manual Field Edit No
  • Entra ID documentation
 Okta Manual Field Edit No
  • Okta documentation
 Duo SSO Manual XML upload No
  • Duo documentation
 Rapid Identity Manual XML paste No
  • RapidID documentation
Please see the instructions and documentation linked below for each IdP for updating Clever’s SAML certificate in their system. [You can find Clever’s most recent SAML Certificate here](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml). The recommended instructions are intended to be a guide for rotating your SAML certificate in your IdP. If you find that the instructions don’t match your exact experience, or if you have any questions regarding the navigation of your IdP system, please contact your IdP provider directly as Clever has limited insight into their systems. ADFS **Set ADFS to automatically pull updates from Clever** You can get a deep dive on monitoring your Relying Party Trust and setting up for automatic updates [here.](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/coreinfrastructureandsecurityblog/adfs-monitoring-a-relying-party-for-certificate-changes/259391) 1\. Open AD FS Management > Trust Relationships > Relying Party Trusts. 2\. Right-click Clever > Properties > Monitoring tab. 3\. Ensure the Metadata URL is: [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml) 4\. Check Monitor relying party and Automatically update. Microsoft Entra ID Follow [Microsoft’s instructions here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/saas-apps/clever-tutorial#configure-microsoft-entra-sso). 1\. Go to Entra Admin Center > Enterprise Applications > **Clever**. 2\. Select **Single sign-on** > **Basic SAML Configuration** > **Edit**. 3\. Manually update the Identifier or Reply URL if they have changed in the metadata. The URL should match the following: [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml) Okta [You can find Okta’s instructions here.](https://support.okta.com/help/s/article/Replace-SP-Signing-Certificate-In-OKTA) Okta does not support metadata file uploads or URL polling for custom SAML apps. Admins can manually extract information from Clever’s metadata.xml file and input that information into Okta’s admin UI.  1. In Okta Admin, go to Applications > **Clever** > **General** tab. 2. Under SAML Settings, click **Edit** > **Next**. 3. Manually update the Destination, Audience URI, or Certificate fields using data parsed from Clever's XML. For the Clever-signing-certificate, admin must replace Clever’s certificate for Clever’s custom SAML app in Okta. You must navigate to the **Advanced Settings** of the Clever app in Okta. 1. Log into the **Okta Admin Console.** 2. Navigate to **Applications** > **Applications** > Select **Clever**. 3. Go to the **General** tab. 4. Scroll down to **SAML Settings** and click **Edit**. 5. Click **Next** to reach the **Configure SAML** page. 6. Click **Show Advanced Settings**. 7. Find the **Signature Certificate** field. 8. Click **Browse files...**, select your clever.crt, and click **Upload Certificate**. Click **Next** and then **Finish**. Duo Duo requires a manual file upload whenever Clever's metadata changes. You can find [Duo’s instructions here](https://duo.com/docs/sso-clever#enable-clever-for-sso). 1\. Download the latest XML from [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml). 2\. In the Duo Admin Panel, go to Applications > **Clever**. 3\. Under **Service Provider**, click **Choose File** and upload the new XML. RapidID RapidID supports copy and pasting Clever’s metadata.xml. [Find their instructions here.](https://help.rapididentity.com/docs/configuring-saml-sso-with-clever) 1\. Copy the raw text from [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml). 2\. In RapidIdentity, go to Configuration > Security > Identity Providers > Federation Partners. 3\. Edit the **Clever** partner, go to the **Metadata** tab, and [paste the new XML text into the field.](https://help.rapididentity.com/docs/configuring-saml-sso-with-clever#launch-the-identity-provider-configuration-workspace) * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **How do I find the latest certificate?**  - You can always find Clever's current public certificate and metadata at: [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml). **Do I need to update immediately?**  - To ensure users don’t encounter login issues, Clever recommends keeping your SAML certificate up-to-date with the most recent version. **What if I update my certification and I’m still seeing login errors?**  - If your teachers or students are still experiencing Clever SSO login issues related to a SAML-based IdP after updating your certification, please check your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Access logs](https://schools.clever.com/access-logs) and see [this article for additional troubleshooting steps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/209026697). If you’re unable to resolve the issue, please contact our support team at [support.clever.com](https://support.clever.com/). * * *

title: For Teachers: Discontinuing Clever Messaging
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001732#header1)  
2\. [Why is Clever discontinuing Clever Messaging?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001732#header2)  
3\. [Timeline and changes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001732#header3)  
4\. [Next steps for teacher <> student communication](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001732#header4)

## Overview

Clever will discontinue Clever Messaging on December 31, 2025. We’re proud to have built a teacher < > student messaging product in 2020 to support schools with urgent needs when learning was often pushed fully remote due to COVID-19. As digital tools for classroom communication have expanded, many school organizations have chosen to implement platforms dedicated to secure messaging, and fewer and fewer teachers and students regularly use Clever for their classroom messaging needs.   
 

* * *

## Why is Clever discontinuing Clever Messaging?

As the education technology landscape has evolved, many districts have implemented specialized communication platforms. To ensure Clever is devoting all our resources to delivering the most secure and robust identity platform for education, we have made the difficult decision to discontinue the built-in direct messaging feature between teachers and students. This will help Clever be better positioned to support schools with new, free classroom tools like [Substitute Access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672) on Clever, Teacher and Student Portals that adhere to accessibility standards, and a faster student iOS app.  
 

* * *

## Timeline and changes

Teachers and students can continue to message each other directly on Clever until December 31st, 2025. After that date, there will no longer be an option for direct messaging between teachers and students in the Clever Portal. However, your ability to communicate with your students through your Clever Portal isn’t going away entirely.

**The [Class Announcements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045714731?language) feature will remain available**. You can continue to post one-way updates, reminders, or general announcements to all of your students or classes at the same time.  
 

* * *

## Next steps for teacher <> student communication

Your school organization has been alerted to this change. If you have questions about how to communicate with students going forward, please reach out to your school's IT team. Many school organizations already have a dedicated tool in place for secure teacher-to-student messaging that they will continue to use moving forward.  
 

* * *

title: For Students: How to re-enable camera access for Clever Badges
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001730#header1)  
2\. [Google Chrome](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001730#header2)  
3\. [Safari](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001730#header3)  
4\. [Microsoft Edge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001730#header4)

## Overview

When you use your Clever Badge to log in, your computer or tablet needs the camera turned on. A box may pop up asking if Clever can use the camera — click **Allow**. If you click **Block** or **Never Allow** by mistake, the camera won’t work to scan your Badge. To fix this, turn the camera back on so Clever can scan your Badge and log you in. 

If you’re still having trouble turning the camera on to scan your Badge, ask a teacher to help turn your camera back on using the steps below.  
 

* * *

## Google Chrome

1.  Go to the clever.com
    
2.  Click the three vertical dots in the top-right corner of Chrome and select **Settings**.
    
3.  Click **Privacy and security** in the left-hand menu, then select **Site settings**.
    
4.  Under **Permissions**, click **Camera**.
    
5.  Locate clever.com under the **Not allowed to use your camera** section.
    
6.  Click the trash can icon next to clever.com to reset the camera permission for the site.
    
7.  Return to clever.com and refresh the page to apply the new permissions.  
     
    

* * *

## Safari

1.  Click **Safari** located at the top left corner of your screen
    
2.  Click **Settings** > **Websites**.
    
3.  Click **Camera**. You should then see clever.com under **Allow websites to access the camera with the settings below:**
    
4.  Use the drop-down list to the right to update permission for the site by selecting **Allow** or **Ask**.
    
5.  Return to clever.com and refresh the page to apply the new permissions.  
     
    

* * *

## Microsoft Edge

1.  Go to the clever.com
    
2.  Click the icon to the left of the URL bar (it looks like a padlock or a triangle).
    
3.  Click **Permissions for this site** from the menu that appears.
    
4.  Locate **Camera** under the list of permissions and change its setting to **Allow** or **Ask every time**.
    
5.  Return to clever.com and refresh the page to apply the new permissions.  
     
    

* * *

title: For Teachers: Google Classroom add-ons
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001729#header1)  
2\. [How to use a Google Classroom add-on](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001729#header2)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001729#header3)

## Overview

Clever works directly with our application partners using [Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001664) to offer Google Classroom add-ons. Google add-ons simplify the login process, enabling students and teachers to access learning applications via single sign-on (SSO) in Google Classroom!

Please note that any add-on powered by Clever won’t allow you to link directly to content in your learning application, but it will simplify the login process to the application for your student right in Google Classroom!

  
  

* * *

## How to use a Google Classroom add-on

To use a Google Classroom add-on, your admin will need to add it for your school organization’s Google Workspace. Once they’ve added it to the Google Workspace you’ll be able to:  
  

1.  Create a course item on your Google Classroom page, such as an assignment.
    
2.  In the add-ons box, click the application you’d like to add.  
    ![Example assignment with Google add-ons available](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000P4y5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAX3l) 
    
3.  When prompted, select **Sign in with Google**.
    
4.  If Clever powers the add-on, you’ll receive a prompt to provide Clever.com access to your Google Account. Please click **Allow** to provide access.
    
5.  Click **Add attachment** on the application’s page, and you’ll successfully add a link to the application that students can use to log in without leaving Google Classroom!
    

If Clever powers the add-on, your students must be actively logged into their Clever Portal so that Clever can automatically log them into the application. If a student attempts to access the add-on without an active Clever session, Clever will prompt them to log in.

  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can I use the add-on if we don’t use Clever?**

-   If Clever manages the add-on, your users must have a Clever account to utilize the Google add-on, as Clever’s single sign-on supports it. If you have questions about an add-on, please reach out to your IT team or administrator directly. Clever doesn’t have insight into the add-ons your school may be utilizing.
    

**What will happen if a student attempts to use the add-on without a Clever Portal session active?**

-   Clever will prompt them to log in, then they can access the application.
    

**Can teachers link directly to specific assignments, lessons, etc., in the application?**

-   No, the add-on will not link to specific content in an application. It will sign in students and teachers without additional login steps.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Teachers: Clever + Google Classroom](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001470)

title: For Application Partners: Building a Google Classroom add-on with Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001728#header1)  
2\. [Requirements and building the add-on](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001728#header2)

4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001728#header4)

## Overview

Clever works directly with our application partners, utilizing Clever LMS Connect to offer Google Classroom add-ons. School administrators can install the add-on via their Google Workspace Marketplace to simplify the login process for districts and schools by enabling students and teachers to access their learning applications directly in Google Classroom via Clever’s single sign-on (SSO). The add-on can’t be used to link to specific content in your application, but will simplify logins for students and teachers directly in Google Classroom.

Learn more about [Clever LMS Connect here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001636) or [sign up for a call with our team](https://www.getclever.com/lms-connect-contact/).  
 

* * *

## Requirements and building the add-on

Clever is excited to partner with you in building a Google Classroom add-on! Please make sure your application meets the following requirements:

1.  You’re a Clever LMS Connect partner. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001636) or [sign up for a call with our team](https://www.getclever.com/lms-connect-contact/).
    
2.  Your success manager will work with you to add an addendum to your Clever contract regarding the Google add-on, or to include this language if you’re a new partner and interested in an add-on.
    
3.  Once the addendum is in place, the Clever team will require assets and copy to appear in the Google Workspace Marketplace. This includes your application name, a short description, a detailed description, and an icon. You will send these to your Clever Success Manager.
    
4.  The Clever team will work to build the add-on for your team, reaching out with any additional questions or information needed. This process can take up to a week, but is usually completed more quickly!
    

  
 

* * *

## The school experience

A school’s Google Workspace Administrator will search for and install the add-on via the Google Workspace Marketplace. Installation can take up to 24 hours to complete.

Once the installation is complete, teachers can easily link to the add-on in Google Classroom course items such as assignments and quizzes. Students with an active Clever session will be able to single sign-on into the application directly via Google Classroom.

For more details on the administrator experience, [see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001727). For more information on teacher experience, please see here.

##   

    **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4mT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAUyj)    Please note:** The add-on will provide SSO into your application, but teachers can’t use it to link directly to content in your application.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much engineering work does creating an add-on require from our team?**

-   None! Clever will complete the necessary work to build the add-on.
    

**Is there a fee for requesting or building an add-on?**

-   No! Clever offers the Google add-on build to partners using Clever LMS Connect.
    

**Can I share the add-on with schools that don’t use Clever?**

-   No. Schools that don’t use Clever will not be able to SSO into the application, since it is powered by Clever.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Google Classroom add-ons](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001727)

text:

## Overview

Clever works directly with our application partners using Clever LMS Connect to offer Google Classroom add-ons. Google add-ons simplify the login process for Google Education Plus customers, enabling students and teachers to access learning applications via single sign-on (SSO) directly in Google Classroom!

For the best experience, we suggest using [Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001609) in your Clever account for the smoothest integration between your Google Classroom, applications, and Clever.

##   

  
 

* * *

## Partners currently supported

-   Progress Learning  
     

* * *

## Getting the add-on for an application

1.  Navigate to your [Google Workspace Marketplace](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace) and search for the application. Ensure you’ve located the application that says **By: Clever. Inc.  
      
    ![Example of add-on by Clever Inc.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4o5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QA7xK)** 
2.  Once you locate the application, select **Admin Install.**
3.  You’ll receive a notification that you are about to install the application for your Google Workspace. Click **Continue.**
4.  Review and agree to the application’s terms and conditions for accessing your Google Classroom data. During this step, you can select if you’d like to identify specific groups or organization units (OUs) that will have access to the add-on. Click **Finish.**
5.  Configure the necessary settings if you’ve selected to add the application to specific groups or OUs and continue your setup.
6.  You’ll complete the add-on installation by selecting **Done.** It can take up for 24 hours for the app to be installed for your entire Google Workspace domain, organizational units, or groups.  
     

* * *

## Informing your teachers

When you’ve completed the installation process for the Google add-on, you’ll want to inform your teachers that they can start using it in Google Classroom!

**Click here for a recommended email template to inform your teachers.**

Hi \[teachers\],

We’ve added _\[application\]_ directly to Google Classroom! This means you can easily link directly to the application in your Google Classroom, and students won’t need to log in again. You won’t be able to link directly to specific content in the application, but it will provide easier access for your students to the app!

To add a direct link to the application to your Google Classroom:

1.  Create a course item on your Google Classroom page, such as an assignment.
2.  Under the add-ons, click _\[application\]_.  
    ![Example add-ons from a teacher assignment in Google Classroom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4o5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAPe5) 
3.  Select **Sign in with Google**.
4.  You'll receive a prompt to provide Clever.com access to your Google Account. Please click **Allow** to provide access.
5.  Click **Add attachment** on the application’s page, and you’ll successfully add a link to the application that students can use to log in without leaving Google Classroom!

This add-on is powered by Clever, so your students must be actively logged into their Clever Portal to be automatically logged into the app.

You can learn more in [Clever’s Help Center here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001729).

We hope this makes your logins and classroom management smoother!

Best,

_\[Name\]_

  
 

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Can I use the add-on if we don’t use Clever?**

-   No, your users must have a Clever account to utilize the Google add-on, as Clever’s single sign-on supports it.
    

**What will happen if a student attempts to use the add-on without a Clever Portal session active?**

-   Clever will prompt them to login, then they’ll be able to access the add-on.
    

**Can teachers link directly to specific assignments, lessons, etc., in the application?**

-   No, the add-on will not link to specific content in an application. It will sign in students and teachers without additional login steps.
    

**How will we be notified about new application add-ons?**

-   This article will be updated with new partners that have built add-ons, and we’ll notify schools when apps they roster via Clever have new add-ons available!
    

**How can I let an application partner know that I’m interested in them utilizing Clever LMS Connect?**

-   Navigate to the LMS Connect tab in your Clever Dashboard and click the **Submit app interest form** button. This will let the application know you’re interested in them using Clever LMS Connect.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001609)

title: Clever IDM: FAQs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001724#header1)  
2\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001724#header2)  
          •  [Provisioning](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001724#provisioning)  
          •  [Updating account information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001724#updatinginfo)  
          •  [Deprovisioning](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001724#Deprovisioning)  
          •  [Issues & troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001724#issuestroubleshooting)

## Overview

This article is for IDM customers who have an active subscription. You’ve completed the setup process, and now you’re wondering how to ensure everything is running smoothly and IDM is doing its intended job in the background with every sync. This article provides an overview of commonly asked questions by schools whose IDM sync is running.

By default, IDM syncs occur once per day, in the evening hours. At that time, Clever will compare the data in Clever to the accounts in Google, Active Directory, and/or Entra ID and create, update, or archive users appropriately.

[Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) if you’d like to customize your district’s IDM sync time or frequency.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### Provisioning

**How do I make sure IDM creates an account?** 

-   Users added to Clever will have accounts created by IDM in Google, Active Directory, and/or Entra ID. Clever IDM will provision if a user has an active record that exists in your SIS sync and the user is syncing to Clever.
-   To troubleshoot specific missing users, please first check your Clever sync report and the specific requirements of your Student Information System (SIS) and sync type for any missing records. If the user is syncing to Clever and is still missing from Clever IDM, please contact Clever Support for additional assistance.

**What will happen during summer when we pause our Clever sync?**

-   Clever SIS syncs typically pause at the end of the school year and unpause just before the Back to School season. When your sync is paused, data in Clever won’t be automatically modified or changed.
-   By default, Clever IDM’s nightly syncs will continue to run. Since no automatic data updates are happening in Clever, most of the time Clever IDM syncs won’t have any impact. 
-   We recommend using [Custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US) to add additional users you need to sync with IDM during your summer pause. See [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513) for more on IDM and Summer Pauses. 

**After a new user is created, how is the information synced/written back to our SIS?**

-   Clever IDM provides automated syncing only in one direction (from Clever to your destination). The Clever IDM page allows you to download a CSV file of usernames via the Clever IDM page to upload to your SIS.
-   Clever also provides SFTP access to user emails managed by Clever IDM. You can access the SFTP files by enabling Participation Reports and accessing the associated SFTP server as described in [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547#AutomatedSFTP).
-   The CSV files in the SFTP server contain mappings of user emails to their Clever ID, SIS ID, and User Type. Schools can use these files to personally build automation for writeback into their SIS on their end. Clever doesn’t support direct SIS write back automation outside of [this documentation](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001593). 

**Where can I learn more about account recovery and password management for my users?**

-   Please see our article [Clever IDM: Account recovery & password resets.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662)

### Updating account information

**What will IDM automatically update on an account? How does that happen?**

-   IDM will automatically update user information when it changes in the SIS for fields like role, name, grade, graduation year, and location. 
-   Updates occur when a user's first name, last name, user type, or organizational unit (OU) changes. When updating a user, the following fields are synced:
    -   User’s first name (if changed)
        
    -   User’s last name (if changed)
        
    -   Organizational unit as configured by the district (if changed)
        
    -   Suspension status
        
        -   Suspended if a user exists in the Google Directory under a managed OU but not in the most recent Clever data set.
            
        -   Unsuspended if a user was previously suspended (i.e., not in the Clever data set) but has been restored in the Clever data set within 300 days.
            
-   **Note:** If you are currently syncing an email field via your SIS, Clever IDM will not automatically update the destination’s email/username based on the formula you have set. You’ll need to update the email/username in your SIS, or contact support for further assistance.

**Can I review the changes Clever IDM is making to our users?**

-   Yes! After your initial Clever IDM sync, you can continue to track changes to your users via the [User management > Events tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management). On this tab, you can select a date range for which you’d like to review Clever IDM creates, updates, archives, and matched users. You can also apply filters to examine changes by destination (if you have multiple configured), event type (create, update, etc.), or specific users by name or SIS ID.
-   Once you find the event for the user and destination you’d like to review, click the dropdown arrow to examine more details.

### Deprovisioning

**How do I ensure IDM deprovisions an account?**

-   Clever IDM will deprovision accounts when you remove the user from the Clever data. If you want to keep students until a specific date, configure your Clever sync to include those students through that date.
-   Clever IDM doesn’t consider graduation date or any other field into consideration for deprovisioning, only whether the student has an active record that exists in the SIS sync.
-   Users deleted from Clever will have their accounts moved to the Archive OU in Google/Active Directory. In Entra ID, the account will be disabled. Users moved to the Archive OU are suspended if you turn on the "suspend on archive” setting. 
-   When users leave your district or school, Clever IDM will place them in the Archive OU during the next sync. If the user returns to Clever within one year of departure, their Clever account will be restored, and their Google account will be moved from the Archive OU to the appropriate active OU based on your Parent/Sub-OU settings. If a user returns after one year, Clever will generate a new Clever and Google account.

**How will users be deprovisioned during summer when we pause our Clever sync?**

-   Clever syncs typically pause at the end of the school year and unpause just before the Back to School season. When your sync is paused, data in Clever won’t be automatically modified or changed.
-   By default, Clever IDM’s nightly syncs will continue to run. Since no SIS data updates are happening in Clever, generally the IDM syncs won’t have any impact.
-   If you want to archive users during this period, we recommend doing so directly in your destination (Google, Active Directory, or Entra).

### Issues & troubleshooting

**Where do I go to see IDM’s activity?** 

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > User management > IDM tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management). At the bottom of this page, you will see Notifications and Issues flagged for your attention as Tasks. You can also see your Sync History and export your data here.
-   Clever administrators also have the option to subscribe to Clever IDM email notifications from the [email tab of the profile page](https://schools.clever.com/profile/emails). Subscription options include weekly reports, daily reports, and issue alerts. Clever Admin owners will be subscribed to weekly reports and issue alerts by default.

**How do I solve an issue I see in my IDM report?**

-   Some issues will be solvable within your Clever Dashboard. Other issues may require Clever to resolve the issue. Please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) if you need assistance.

**What if I want to update a setting in my IDM configuration?**

-   You can update settings anytime by navigating to your [Clever Dashboard > User management > IDM tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management?) and then clicking the **Edit destination provisioning** button.
-   Clever IDM will generate a preview. Review any changes made, and if you are satisfied click **Provision**.

**Where can I find additional content on Clever IDM?**

-   We have many articles on all of Clever IDM's features! Check out the resources below:
    -   [Clever IDM: Formulas](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555)
    -   [Clever IDM: Sync reports & issue troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001473)
    -   [Clever IDM: Preview sync visualizer & events](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001528)
    -   [Clever IDM: Account recovery & password resets](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662)
    -   [Clever IDM: Pushing and Pausing syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001532)

**How do I get support with IDM now that I’ve finished my onboarding process?**

-   Our Clever Support team will provide you with continued support beyond your onboarding implementation. If you’re looking for an upgrade to our standard support model, consider our [Premium Support subscription](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001646), which would also include support benefits for IDM. 
-   If interested, contact your District Partnerships Representative for more information or navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > IDM](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) page and click **Get Started** or **Purchase**.

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Sync reports & issue troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001473)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Summer Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513)

title: For Clever Admins: Teacher Pages
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001723#header1)  
2\. [What resources can teachers add to a Teacher Page?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001723#header2)  
3\. [Disabling student access to Teacher Pages during school breaks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001723#header3)  
4\. [Limiting Teacher Page customization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001723#header4)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001723#header5)

## Overview

Teachers can create personalized Teacher Pages to organize school applications, Clever Library applications, and their own links and PDFs that they want their students to access. While Teacher Pages provide teachers with a customized space to create a digital classroom environment, we recognize that, as the Clever Administrator, you may also need controls over Teacher Page settings.

As the Clever Administrator, you have additional controls to manage what resources your teachers can share via Teacher Pages and when students can access their Teacher Pages. Learn more below!

* * *

## What resources can teachers add to a Teacher Page?

Teachers may add the following resources to their Teacher Page:

-   School organization-wide applications you have added as the Clever admin
    
-   External links (URLs) to online websites and tools (e.g., Schooltube, Dictionary.com, a local library website, etc.)
    
-   External links to homework or assignments in Google Drive, Office Online, or Google Classroom
    
-   PDFs for students, like vocab lists, homework assignments, permission slips, etc.
    
-   Clever Library applications (if you have the [library enabled](https://schools.clever.com/library/settings))
    

* * *

## Disabling student access to Teacher Pages during school breaks

During school breaks, most schools are working to organize students, teachers, and schedules. While schedules are in progress, users' classes may change, and it’s important to maintain the privacy of schedules until the school is ready to share them widely with students and teachers.

To prevent accidental exposure of student schedules via Teacher Pages during school breaks, Clever administrators can turn off Teacher Pages for up to 90 days. When Teacher Pages are turned off, teachers can still access and edit their pages, but students won’t be able to see the pages. You can customize the date range during which you’d like to turn off pages. Your teachers will see a warning that their Teacher Page has been turned off until that date. Students will see a note in their Portal that Teacher Pages will be right back.

To turn off Teacher Pages, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Teacher Page Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/teacher-page-settings). Use the toggle to turn off Teacher Pages, then set your start and end dates within a 90-day range:

![Disable student access to Teacher Pages screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dz3d&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfDNt)

Your teachers will see the following banner letting them know that Teacher Pages are disabled:

![Teacher Page notification that students cannot see pages](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dz3d&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfDir)

Your students will see the following message in their Clever Portal:

![Student notification: Your Teacher Pages will be right back!](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dz3d&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfEGj)

_An example of a student’s Portal with the notification that Teacher Pages will be right back._

* * *

## Limiting Teacher Page customization

As the Clever Administrator, you have the best understanding of cybersecurity and school guidelines on content teachers can use with their students. If you’re concerned that teachers may add unapproved tools and websites to their Teacher Page, you can turn off the ability for teachers to add new links and PDFs to their Teacher Page.

![Disable PDFs & Links toggle](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dz3d&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfEi9)

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dz3d&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfFaz) Please note:** Enabling this setting will hide any resources previously added by teachers on their Teacher Page.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I permanently disable Teacher Pages?**

-   Teacher Pages can be disabled up to 90 days.
    

**Can I block Teachers from adding library applications?**

-   Yes! Learn how to [recommend and block library applications here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471#Header5)
    

**Will teachers and students be notified if I disable Teacher Pages?**

-   Yes, both teachers and students will see a note in their Clever Portal that Teacher Pages have been temporarily disabled.
    

**Will teachers be notified if I turn off the ability to add links and PDFs?**

-   Yes, teachers will receive a Portal announcement letting them know that links and PDFs have been turned off. Additionally, if they try to add a new link or PDF, they’ll see more information letting them know the feature has been disabled.
    

* * *

**Related articles:  
  
**

-   [Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)

title: For Teachers: Back to School recommendations
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001720#header1)  
2\. [Review your student roster for accuracy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001720#header2)  
3\. [Customize your Teacher Pages for the new school year](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001720#header3)  
4\. [Prepare to troubleshoot](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001720#header4)  
5\. [Check out analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001720#header5)  
6\. [Helpful videos and courses](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001720#header6)

## Overview

This guide is for teachers preparing for Back to School with Clever. If you haven’t used Clever, we recommend you take a deeper dive into learning about Clever and setting up your account by accessing our [Clever Academy certification for teachers](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers?user_type=teacher)! If you’ve used Clever before, we recommend reviewing this article to set yourself up for the first day of school.  
 

* * *

## Review your student roster for accuracy

When your schools complete setting up your classes and student rosters in your school’s student information system (like PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, Skyward, etc.), your school’s IT team and Clever Admin will allow this data to update in Clever as well. Once the data is updated in Clever, you’ll see student rosters for the new year in your Teacher Portal! We recommend looking in your Clever Portal via your **My Students > Student Roster tab**.

![Screenshot showing the Student Roster tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEef&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OvaqY)

If you notice any issues with students or classes, please reach out directly to your school administrator or IT team to get it resolved. The Clever team can’t assist with missing students or classes in Clever as your school organization manages this data.  
 

* * *

## Customize your Teacher Pages for the new school year

Teachers can create personalized Teacher Pages to house a variety of learning resources they want their students to access, such as PDFs, links, and applications. At the start of each school year, we recommend reviewing your existing Teacher Pages to ensure that:

1.  They’re shared with the correct classes
    
2.  They contain all the resources you want your students to have access to
    

If you create Teacher Pages per course, you may also want to create new Teacher Pages for any new classes you’re teaching. Learn more about Teacher Pages by watching our video below or checking out our [Help Center article on Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323).

##   

  
 

* * *

## Prepare to troubleshoot

-   Learn how to [generate a backup login code](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888?language=en_US#backup) via your **Portal > My Students > Student Roster**. If a student’s login credentials to Clever aren’t working, you can still get them logged in so they can start learning!
    
-   Learn how to generate and void Badges for students to speed up logging in. Check out [this video](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323) to learn how to manage Badges.
    
-   Know how to [open a resource](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005941566?#launching_apps) for all of your students at the same time!
    
-   If you or a student is missing an application in Clever, please reach out to your Clever Administrator to resolve the issue.
    
-   Running into application login issues? Review [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027035111) to learn about what could be happening.  
     
    

* * *

## Check out Analytics

Did you know you can view student access to resources from your teacher Portal? Check out a daily or weekly overview of student activity in Clever to better understand the resources your students are accessing. [Learn more here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360041755311)  
 

* * *

## Helpful videos and courses

-   [Become a Certified Clever Teacher!](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers)
    
-   [Clever Teacher Tips video series](https://clever.academy/clever-teacher-tips)
    
-   [Quick start - Cybersecurity basics for teachers](https://clever.academy/quick-start-cybersecurity-teachers)
    

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)
-   [For Teachers: Overview of the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000781723)
-   [For Teachers: What's Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222633468)

title: Arbor API sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001718#header1) 2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001718#header2) 3\. [Customizations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001718#header3) 4\. [School year rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001718#header4) 5\. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001718#header5) 6\. [Setting up email write back](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001718#header6) ## Overview This article provides an overview of the Arbor API sync. This sync: ✓ Runs every 4 hours ✓ Syncs staff **X** Doesn’t sync student contacts   * * * ## Setup New to Clever? Please contact your Customer Success Manager for setup directions.  You can [sign up here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup) if you haven’t yet connected with a district onboarding specialist. The Arbor sync allows Clever to connect to your Arbor Management Information System (MIS) to import data for Clever rostering, badges, and other services.  To set up an Arbor sync connection, please follow these directions: 1. Share the Name and DFE number of each school you would like to connect to Clever with our support team. 2. Clever will then use this information to send out a connection request. 3. Navigate to **_System > Partner Apps (API Users) on a school MIS site, or System > Partner Apps (API Users) on a MAT MIS_** site to approve the request for data access. 1. To view an app that is trying to connect with you, select Pending requests from the left-hand menu. ![Example image of Pending Requests in Arbor](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b6uT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OKUSL)    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b6uT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OKKEV)   Please note:** If you want more information on navigation within Arbor or this setup process, we recommend [checking out Arbor’s Help Center here](https://support.arbor-education.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009421273-Setting-up-and-managing-third-party-API-integrations-in-Arbor#h_01J82N5C5EASYYW0KP8AV23937).   4. Once accepted, our team will handle the rest!   * * * ## Customizations - The Arbor sync can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every four hours, but the time of day at which the sync occurs isn’t customizable. - Clever can filter exports from Arbor to limit the schools, teachers, and students included in the sync. [Reach out to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) to filter exports.   * * * ## School year rollover Your syncs will be automatically paused in late July  - resume in early September (specific date will be emailed to you directly) unless you manually [modify it in your settings.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) We automatically pause your data each year to reduce disruption during your busiest time. Pausing the sync will enable you to update data in your MIS or CSV files without interrupting student, teacher, or staff access over the summer. [Learn more about sync pauses here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507). When you update your Pause dates, we recommend updating your rollover dates in your sync settings. [Learn more about rollover dates here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886?#Rolloverdate)   * * * ## Default field mappings Below are the default field mappings for Arbor syncs managed by Clever. Please note: - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default or inaccessible to Clever. - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn the available options.  - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. title: For Families: Clever's Digital Learning Directory
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001713#header1)  
2\. [Viewing and using the Digital Learning Directory](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001713#header2)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001713#header3)

## Overview

We know many families are curious to understand better the digital resources and tools used with their students at school.

If your school organization has enabled it, Clever’s Digital Learning Directory allows you to see a list of all the learning applications your schools are using through Clever.

The Digital Learning Directory provides a list of the applications each school utilizes, which grades use those applications, and an overview of each application with a link to learn more at the application’s website.

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000beWL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000N6z8Q)  Please note:** Your school organization's team must turn on the Digital Learning Directory. Please contact your school organization directly if you’d like to be able to use this feature to preview digital resources your schools are using.

* * *

## Viewing and using the Digital Learning Directory

To view the Digital Learning Directory for your school organization, navigate to the URL your schools provided. It will look like this:

**http://clever.com/digital-learning/exampleschoolname**

The Digital Learning Directory will list only learning applications that your school organization has added to their Clever account.

![Example Digital Learning Directory](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000beWL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Nkchl)

You’ll be able to filter by school, view an overview of each application, determine which grades are using the application at which schools, and navigate to the application’s web page to learn more.

We recommend filtering to the school your student is at and looking at the applications for their grade level to understand best which resources your student may be using in their current school year.

If your school organization hasn’t enabled or has disabled the directory, you’ll receive the following error:

![Digital Learning Directory disabled](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000beWL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000NBqnd)

Please contact your school organization's IT team directly with any questions about allowing access to the Digital Learning Directory.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Why did I receive a “Digital Learning Directory disabled” page?**

-   Your school organization has disabled or not enabled the Digital Learning Directory. Please contact your school’s team directly with any questions about allowing access to the Digital Learning Directory.
    

**What if I don’t see a resource that my student says they use?**

-   Only applications added in Clever will show in the Digital Learning Directory. If you have questions about the applications your school organization is utilizing, please reach out to your student’s teacher directly.
    

**I see an application that I’d like my student to be using. Who do I contact?**

-   If you have questions about the applications your school is utilizing, please reach out to your student’s teacher directly. The Clever team can’t provide access to your school organization's resources. 
    

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Digital Learning Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001711)
    
-   [For Teachers: Digital Learning Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001712)
