title: For Clever Admin: Setting up account claim for your users
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001695#header1)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001695#header2)  
3\. [Rolling out account claiming to your users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001695#header3)  
4. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001695#header4)

## Overview

Getting new users set up on Clever (or any software) can require some legwork, especially if they don’t know their credentials or your Clever Portal login URL (e.g. Clever.com/in/chicago).

With Clever’s account claiming feature, students, teachers and non-instructional staff can get their accounts set up quicker, in a more secure way, and with less tech support. 

This feature is exclusively available to [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466) customers and those on our updated [Clever Passwords SSO method](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658).

Simply direct them to an account claim link unique for your schools, and users answer a few security questions to validate their identity. They’ll get their username and password for Clever as well as destinations like Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID.

This article walks through the Clever Admin setup process to turn this feature on for your schools. You can see the [end-user experience here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001696)  
 

* * *

## Setup process

The account claim process is available to end users when a new user is created via Clever IDM. 

It can also be triggered manually by going to a user’s profile > Support Tools > Reset Account Claim. Here’s how to configure account claim for your schools:

### **Step 1:**

Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Access control tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)[**.**](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) Scroll down to Account Claiming. Here, you'll set up an account claim policy for each user type. 

### **Step 2:**

Set up account claiming for each user type. In this article, we’ll start with students; feel free to start with any user type.

To enable users to claim their accounts, you’ll need at least two security fields for students and three for teachers/staff. You have several options for the primary security field. Options include fields like the user’s email address, State ID, and school organization username. Fields other than email address will be case sensitive, so please consider case when choosing fields.

You can modify the question displayed to make it easy for users to understand what's being asked, including a hint if needed.

![Screenshot of Account Claiming setup page showing State ID as a required field](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQW9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GPXCT)

### **Step 3:**

Next, add a secondary security field. You have options like grade, state ID, email address, and more. Optionally, you can add additional security fields by clicking **\+ Add field**.

![Screenshot of Account Claiming Setup showing State ID and Grade as required fields](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQW9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GPXdt)  

### **Step 4:**

Determine what happens after users claim their accounts.

You have two options for how users claim their new passwords. You can have them manually set their password according to the complexity settings you set from your [Password Settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662) page. Or you can regenerate a password using the format found in the IDM Setup page and show this new password to the user. When being shown the new password, users are prompted to practice entering it twice to encourage memorization.

![Screenshot of Account Claim screen showing password settings for end-users](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQW9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GPNUs)     
  
 

### **Step 5:**

Determine how many days the user has before their account claim expires. 

You can set distinct expirations for end users to access their new accounts via this claim flow from 1-21 days. If the end user does not claim their new account within that time, the claim will automatically expire. This helps remove lingering access points to your identity accounts.

Then, decide which Clever IDM destinations this should apply to. This allows you to select the places where the password will be reset when the claim flow is complete.

For example, you could be using Clever for both Google and Active Directory but only want the claim flow to apply to Google because end users are expected to manage AD credentials directly in Microsoft. Or you might want all of your IDM destinations (including Clever passwords) to be synchronized.

### **Step 6:**

Click on **Allow Students/Teachers/Staff to Claim their Accounts** and then click **Save**. Account Claim is now activated for the specific user type. If you’d like to turn it on for another user type (e.g., teachers) repeat these steps.

![Screenshot of Account Claim screen with Allow students to claim their accounts switch turned on](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQW9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GPZFt)

* * *

## Rolling out account claiming to your users

When you’re ready to start using account claiming for your schools, you have two options for users to access the setup flow. We recommend using both to take full advantage of account claiming:

1.  You can copy the URL to the claim flow page and share it with users who need to set up an account.
    
2.  You can also add a link to the account claim flow directly from your school’s Clever sign-on page.
    

  
![Screenshot of Account Claiming page with arrows pointing at two options to roll out account claiming to end users](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQW9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GPZUP)  

### **Suggested settings for using Account Claim during Chromebook sign-in**

Account Claim can be used directly from the Clever sign-in screen on a Chromebook when the **Allow access to account claim page from sign-on page** setting is enabled. 

Requirements:

-   **The Chromebook’s OU must be configured to redirect to the Clever sign-in page for access.** See [Single Sign-on (SSO): Setting up Clever Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever as an SSO Profile in Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645) for instructions. Note: Account Claim is only appropriate for non-badge users. To have your non-badge users see your Portal sign-in page, either remove “?specify\_auth=badges” from your sign-in page URL ([instruction 5c](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645#ConfiguringSSO)) or have users bypass the automatic camera by clicking **Log in** from the Badge scanning page.
    
-   The **Allow access to account claim page from sign-on page** setting must be enabled. 
    

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can account claim be turned on for only certain grades?**

-   Not currently. However, users will only know about it if you share the URL to the claim flow or if they find it in the troubleshooting section of your Clever Portal login URL. Furthermore, claims are only generated in the three following situations:
    
    -   a new user is created by IDM
        
    -   A Clever Admin manually resets the claim on an individual user from the Support Tools button on their overview page.
        
    -   A bulk password reset is initiated (this must be requested through Clever Support)
        

**Are we required to apply the account claim settings to a Clever IDM destination?**

-   No! You can have the students’ account claim credential be separate from any Clever IDM destinations. However, you can simplify credentials for users by applying the same credentials to any Clever IDM destination(s) your schools use.
    

**Is account claim appropriate for Clever Badge users?**

-   No. The Clever Badge is already a form of login - if you have your Clever Badge, there’s nothing you need to claim. Account claim is intended for users that will log into Clever with a username and password and can be used with any of the following login methods:
    
    -   Clever passwords
        
    -   Google
        
    -   Entra ID (SAML)
        
    -   Active Directory (SAML or LDAPS)
        

 **Are security fields case sensitive?**

-   Email addresses won’t be case sensitive, but for security reasons, other fields (such as IDs) will be.
    

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466)
-   [For Teachers & Students: Claiming your Clever account](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001696)

title: For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA rollout
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001685#header1)  
2\. [Rolling out Classroom MFA for the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001685#header2)  
3\. [Google-only: Setting up and rolling out Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001685#header3)  
4\. [Google-only: Setting up and rolling out Classroom MFA protection for Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001685#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001685#header6)

## Overview

We know that setting up a multi-factor authentication process requires a lot of change management for yourself, staff, teachers, and students! This article summarizes our recommended Classroom MFA rollout process based on what we have found to be successful for other school organizations setting up Classroom MFA. 

Since each school’s needs are unique, your rollout plan may vary! This article is an informational guide.  As you work with a Sales and Onboarding engineer, they will help you plan for a successful rollout of Classroom MFA.

If you need guidance on the technical setup steps for Classroom MFA, please see our article [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625). 

* * *

## Rolling out Classroom MFA for the Clever Portal

Starting with a small test group and adding Classroom MFA to larger groups of end users over time often results in the smoothest rollout. While you will be able to develop a custom plan with a Sales and Onboarding Engineer, we recommend the following:

1.  Configuring a policy for a test group. This group may include your technology staff members and 1-2 tech-savvy teachers at each school willing to help you in the testing process. Test with this group for approximately a week before moving to the next stage.
    
2.  Begin rolling out to wider groups. For example, you may start with one Kindergarten class, then all Kindergarten classes at a particular school, then all Kindergarten classes across the school organization, etc. This rollout step may take 1-2 weeks.
    
3.  Once you feel comfortable with these initial groups, continue your rollout more widely. For example, instead of rolling out to a single classroom at a single school, create a policy to roll out to all second-grade classrooms at a school or all second-grade classrooms across the school organization. You can pace your rollout at a speed that feels right for your school organization!
    

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e85J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CNGpx)  Clever Tip:**  Using the staged rollout model recommended above typically takes around four weeks for a school organization to complete Classroom MFA setup and rollout. Please see our article [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Implementation steps and timeline](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001671) for a closer look at the overall implementation steps and timeline.

* * *

## Google-only: Setting up and rolling out Clever Passwords

If you will be using Clever’s Classroom MFA to secure your users’ Google accounts, and your users are currently using Google as a login method to Clever, you will need to familiarize your users with using Clever Passwords as their identity provider (IdP).  We recommend the following steps for familiarizing users with the new login process:

1.  Add Clever Passwords as a second login option on your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page if you haven’t already. [This article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658) will guide you through the setup process. By adding Clever Passwords along with Google, users will gain comfort using Clever Passwords to log in instead of Google.
    
2.  Consider turning off Google logins to Clever if all students, teachers, and staff will utilize Clever Passwords. Please discuss this with your onboarding engineer to plan the best option for your school.  
      
    You'll want to communicate with your students, teachers, and staff any changes to Clever login methods. For example, if your students will move to use Clever Passwords for logins, but your teacher and staff logins will remain the same, you’ll want to share this with teachers (and perhaps students directly) that student logins will be changing.
    
3.  If all users will be using Clever Passwords, remove Google as a login option in Clever on your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
    
4.  Users will begin using Clever Passwords and Classroom MFA to access the Clever Portal.
    

* * *

## Google-only: Setting up and rolling out Classroom MFA protection for Google

Once your users know the process outlined above for utilizing Clever Passwords to access the Clever Portal, you’ll complete the final steps of configuring Clever as your IdP and setting up Classroom MFA. You’ll follow the recommended steps below:

1.  Users who use a Clever Badge to log in to their Chromebook are already set up with Clever as an IdP for Google and will automatically be protected at device sign-in with Classroom MFA. To begin using Classroom MFA with these users, simply add them to an MFA policy in your Clever Dashboard.  
      
    If you also want Classroom MFA to protect Google logins directly at the Google service for these users, you may need to adjust the SSO profile settings in Google Admin Console > Security > Authentication > SSO with 3rd Party IdP > Manage SSO profile assignments. Select the OU you've assigned to use Clever Badges into Chromebooks. **Select Have Google prompt for their username...** Then click **OVERRIDE**. Your onboarding engineer can provide more guidance on this update if needed.  
      
    ![Screenshot of MFA Google settings to override](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e85J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CNBf0)    
      
    You can slowly complete this step by starting with a single class, then moving to a grade level at a single school, then transitioning to an entire grade level across all schools, etc.
2.  For non-Badge users, you’ll need to configure the Google Workspace SAML Connection.  [This article,](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572) has instructions for completing this setup. You should configure a test group organizational unit (OU) in Google for initial testing and troubleshooting.
    
3.  For non-Badge users, once your test group is successfully up and running, begin to roll out to additional OUs. You can do this one grade or one school at a time.
    

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e85J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CNGpx)  Clever Tip:**  If you have any students in upper grades (6th grade or higher) using Clever Badges, we recommend talking to your onboarding engineer for test group recommendations.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How long does setting up and rolling out Classroom MFA typically take?**

-   Most school organizations complete the Classroom MFA setup and rollout within 4 weeks.
    

**How do I decide whether to set up Classroom MFA for just the Clever Portal or my Google accounts and devices?**

-   We recommend reviewing your school organization's cybersecurity insurance. Many companies are requiring school organizations to secure **all** accounts with multi-factor authentication.
    

**What resources are available to help me with the Classroom MFA setup for my users?**

-   Check out our Clever Academy course, [Clever Classroom MFA Setup and Rollout Quick Start Guide](https://clever.academy/quick-start-classroom-mfa-setup-and-rollout?user_type=district_admin) or our Help Center article [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625).
    

**How can I monitor Classroom MFA activation?**

-   Under your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Classroom MFA > Users](https://schools.clever.com/mfa?tab=users) tab you can see each individual’s Activation Status per policy.  
    ![Screenshot of Classroom MFA activation status](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e85J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGngz) 
    

**What is the best way to share these new MFA practices with teachers and students?**

-   Clever has a number of resources to help you and your end users adjust to Classroom MFA:
    
    -   For teachers and staff we recommend:
        
        -   [For Teachers & Staff: Setting up Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001619)
            
        -   [For Teachers: Setting up Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001619)
            
        -   Our step-by-step interactive setup tutorial
            
            [found here](https://www.iorad.com/player/2342213/For-Teachers---Staff--Setting-up-Classroom-MFA#trysteps-1)
            
    -   For students we recommend:
        
        -   Teachers can use [this slide deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1kWys1sPS6vNoUytPVGKmoZzxC4chVLyh1Vb6QquY2lQ/view) to help students through the Classroom MFA setup
            
        -   [This Kahoot! quiz](https://create.kahoot.it/share/learning-about-clever-classroom-multi-factor-authentication-grades-3-6/b100a003-b6fa-4550-92e0-9411f11e3797) to familiarize students with what MFA is
            
        -   [For Students: Setting up Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618)
            
        -   [For Families: What’s Classroom MFA?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001654)
            
    -   We also have email templates to help you share more:
        
        -   [For teachers and staff](https://clever.academy/quick-start-classroom-mfa-setup-and-rollout/1897735?reg=1&user_type=district_Admin)
            
        -   [For students and families](https://clever.academy/quick-start-classroom-mfa-setup-and-rollout/1897735?reg=1&user_type=district_Admin)
            
        -   [For school principals](https://clever.academy/quick-start-classroom-mfa-setup-and-rollout/2166551?user_type=district_admin&reg=1)

**How can teachers and staff get help with Classroom MFA?**

-   As a Clever Admin, you can either reset a user’s MFA method or generate a bypass code to share with them via their Profile Page in Clever.
    

**How can students get help with Classroom MFA?**

-   Depending on the MFA methods configured, teachers and staff may have various tools to help either reset or view student MFA factors. Teachers can also always [generate a backup login code](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888?#backup) for students which will not require the student to use a second factor.
    

**What permissions do staff have by default with Classroom MFA?** 

-   STLs have the following permissions assigned to their role:
    -   Can reset MFA configurations for teachers and students
    -   Can generate MFA bypass codes for teachers

**How can I assign staff more permissions in Classroom MFA?**

-   Please note that Staff (Portal Access) don't have permissions within Classroom MFA. If the STL permissions don't capture the access you're looking for you can create a custom role for a staff member and assign any of the permissions below. Learn more about managing custom roles [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702?language=en_US).
    -   Manage Classroom MFA settings - configure, update, and delete [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) settings (Includes access to user data)
    -   Manage MFA bypass codes - reset MFA bypass codes for specific users (includes access to user data through bulk downloading Badges only)
    -   Manage individual MFA reset - reset a user's MFA settings when they're locked out or need to re-enroll. Includes the ability to search for and view users.

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625)
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA implementation and timelines](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001671)
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Google Workspace SAML Setup Guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572)
    

* * *

title: For Clever Admins: Returning to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001684#header1)  
2\. [Step 1: Review and set up the sync with your Student Information System (SIS)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001684#header2)  
3\. [Step 2: Review and add applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001684#header3)  
4\. [Step 3: Review and edit your identity provider (IdP)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001684#header4)  
5\. [Step 4: Recommended next steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001684#header5)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001684#header6)

## Overview

Welcome back to Clever! We’re so excited to help you get set up. Clever offers many features, and getting started with the basics is easy. One of the biggest questions districts returning to Clever ask us is how long it’ll take to have their account up and running.  Account set-up times vary based on each district’s unique configuration, but we’ve seen many districts successfully get started with Clever in just a week!

If you are returning to Clever and still have an existing account, please navigate to schools.clever.com and input your username and password to get logged in. If you’ve forgotten your password, click the **Forgot your password?** button to receive a reset email.

If you previously deleted your account and are starting over from scratch, please sign up for a new account [here.](https://www.clever.com/district-signup) You’ll also want to navigate to our article [Setting up Clever: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271) as this will have the best information for setting up your account from the start.  
 

* * *

## Step 1: Review and set up the sync with your Student Information System (SIS)

If you are getting your account up and running again, you’ll either need to:

1\. Choose your **student information system (SIS)**

2\. Update your previous SIS selection

3\. Get the sync up and running with your same SIS again

Syncing data with Clever can be done with any SIS. Your sync sends information from your SIS to Clever so we can securely share the data you authorize with the applications you specify.

Navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in the dashboard. You’ll either find that you have not configured your sync:

![Screenshot of option to choose SIS](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TFEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WGpgr)

or that you previously set up your sync and had data syncing with Clever:

![Screenshot with sync details highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TFEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CFAzS)

### **If you have not configured your sync yet** 

You will need to choose your SIS from the drop-down menu. If you can’t find your SIS listed here, select _Other_. 

There are three ways to sync data to Clever: 

-   [Clever-managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US)
    
-   [SIS-managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US)
    
-   [SFTP Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US)
    

For any SIS-managed or SFTP syncs, our teams have limited insight into the export processes within your SIS. If you have any questions on how to export data from their system please work with your SIS team directly.

If you need guidance on what sync type you should use, you can learn more here: [Which sync type should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) 

##   

  
 

### **If you have previously configured your sync**

Please determine if you will continue to use the same sync. There are three ways to sync data to Clever: 

-   [Clever-managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US)
    
-   [SIS-managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US)
    
-   [SFTP Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US)
    

Aeries, Blackbaud, Infinite Campus, PowerSchool, and Skyward all support Clever-Managed Auto Syncs. You will likely need to update settings on your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page[](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings). Please locate the setup instructions for your sync in our Help Center.

SIS-managed and SFTP syncs require the use of an SFTP box for uploading data to Clever. If you are using one of these syncs, you'll find the settings for setup on your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. If you are setting up a SIS-managed auto sync, you’ll need to work with your SIS team directly. If you are setting up a manual SFTP , you can find instructions for setting up the sync [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078).

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TFEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CF3Bb)   Please note:** If your SIS has changed, please contact Clever Support to update your sync type.

* * *

## Step 2: Review and add applications

Clever seamlessly syncs data with any of your schools' applications that you connect to Clever via secure API connection. Examples include Newsela, Reading A-Z, and Mathspace. This automates the transfer of rostering data, saving you time in application setup and maintenance.  Clever is the only rostering partner that can transfer your data via API integration to applications, with a network of 1000+ applications for you to connect with, at no cost to your schools.

Navigate to your [Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page to check if any applications are still connected to your Clever account. If you have any rostering, rostering/SSO, or SSO applications still connected, you’ll need to contact the application team directly to let them know you’d like to start syncing data via Clever.

To [add new applications to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997), navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add applications page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add), and then request your desired application(s).

Once you’ve requested a learning application, each app partner has its own approval process. If you have questions about getting your request approved, impacts on existing application data, or changes to the login flow for your students and teachers, please reach out to the application partner directly.

**Sharing Data**

After you have added a new application to Clever, you’ll need to set data sharing permissions for the application. Sharing permissions specify what data you want to make available to a specific application, and ensure security of your data as you are in control of what is shared.

-   From the [Applications page](https://schools.clever.com/applications), find your newest application(s) from your list of connected learning applications. 
    
-   On the right side, choose **Share data now**.  
      
    ![Screenshot of the "Share data now" button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TFEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CFCBe)   
    

Find more information about sharing data with new applications here: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing data with new applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712?language=en_US).

* * *

## Step 3: Review and edit your identity provider (IdP)

If you decide to utilize the Clever Portal, you'll choose how students, teachers, and staff will log into Clever and access all your online learning applications. Utilizing the Clever Portal creates a one-stop-shop for your teachers to access applications, manage their online resources for students, and troubleshoot technology issues.

To review your settings or set up single sign-on (SSO):

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol).
    
2.  Check to see if you have previously set up an IDP. If you have, click **Edit** to review the settings previously configured. You can also add any additional IdPs if you’d like.
    
3.  If you did not previously configure an IdP, choose the identity provider (e.g. [Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503), [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576), [LDAP](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387), etc.) that works best for users in your school district. Find more information here: [Single Sign-On (SSO): identity provider (IdP) Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787?language=en_US).
    

Our Help Center offers step-by-step instructions for setting up each login method within your Clever Dashboard: [Single Sign-On (SSO): Identity Provider (IDP)/Login Method Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787).

##   

* * *

## Step 4: Recommended next steps

### **Continue your Clever Education in Clever Academy**

Whether you want to become a [Clever Certified Champion](https://clever.academy/path/become-a-clever-certified-admin?user_type=district_admin) who knows all about Clever, or you are looking for some [quick guides to get you started](https://clever.academy/page/course-catalog#search-by-course-category_quick-start-guides?user_type=district_admin), check out our free online training for both administrators and teachers in [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/).

### **Explore our add-on paid offerings Clever IDM, Classroom MFA, and Professional Development**

Get more out of your Clever account by utilizing Clever IDM to seamlessly manage the life cycles of your Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID accounts.  Gain access to powerful tools like password and account resets. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466).

Secure your end user’s accounts with Clever’s Classroom Multi-factor Authentication (MFA). Use student and teacher-friendly authentication factors such as picture, Badge, or PIN logins. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616).

Want to learn more about your Clever account or offload the work of training your teachers? Check out Clever’s [Consulting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646) or [Professional Development](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001511) services.

### **Inform your teachers and prepare them for Clever rollout**

If you’ve chosen to use Clever Portal with your district, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page to provide instructions on how they will access Clever. You can find instructions to download on your Clever Dashboard as shown in this screenshot: 

![Portal Settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TFEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CFM9N)

You can even check out [this Clever Academy course](https://clever.academy/year1-clever-admin-checklist/2084121?user_type=district_admin) for pre-written email templates to share more about Clever with your teachers.

If you’re using Clever just for rostering, ensure all apps your schools are using are added to Clever, and confirm teachers know how to log in to them.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How long will it take to set up my Clever account again?**

-   The timeline for setting up Clever will vary depending on whether you’ve previously set up your account. It will also vary based on what type of SIS and sync you choose, and which applications you hope to set up.
    

With this in mind, we cannot share an exact timeline, but our teams are happy to assist with getting you up and running!

**What resources are available to help me set up my account?**

-   We offer several resources designed specifically for districts just getting started with Clever! We highly recommend checking out any of our [Onboarding Courses](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding?user_type=district_admin) or our [Year 1 Clever Admin Checklist](https://clever.academy/year1-clever-admin-checklist?user_type=district_admin). If you’re looking for a more guided approach, learn more about our [Consulting Services here](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Clever-Consulting_2024.pdf).
    

**Who should I contact with questions?**

-   Please contact our support team with any questions as you work to get your account up and running again! They’ll be able to assist or connect you with the team that can best help! Click the blue chat box in the bottom right corner and follow the prompts to submit a ticket to their team.
    

**Will my onboarding timeline change if I want to use Clever IDM or Classroom MFA?**

-   Setting up Clever IDM or Classroom MFA is a separate onboarding process. You’ll need to complete the steps listed above for the general setup of your account before you can begin configuring Clever IDM or Classroom MFA. Our district onboarding and sales and onboarding engineer teams work closely and will be here to support you each step of the way!
    

**What are the different kinds of applications on Clever?**

-   When searching applications in your Clever Dashboard you’ll see different types of applications: rostering, rostering/SSO, SSO, SSO (Saved Passwords).  To learn more about these application types please see our article [For Clever Admins: Applications - What types of apps are on Cleve](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002370127)r?
    

**Where can I find more information about Clever’s data privacy and security practices?**

-   Please see clever.com/security or clever.com/trust for more information about our data privacy and security policies such as Clever’s processes for working with application partners.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [Setting up Clever: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271)
    
-   [What’s Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202000976)
    
-   [What is secure sync?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588)
    
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): What is SSO?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807)

title: For Clever Admin: Protecting Entra with Clever Classroom MFA
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#header1) 2\. [Setup in Entra](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#header2) 3\. [Setup in your Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#header3) 4\. [Using MFA with Windows Device login via Web Enabled Login](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#mfawindows) 5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#header6) ## Overview If your school organization uses Entra, you can use Clever Classroom MFA as an external MFA method to protect logins and meet [Microsoft’s MFA requirement](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/t5/core-infrastructure-and-security/microsoft-will-require-mfa-for-all-azure-users/ba-p/4140391) in a student-friendly manner.  External MFA Methods lets you choose an external provider (like Clever) to meet Microsoft’s multi-factor authentication (MFA) requirements when a school organization's user signs into Microsoft Entra ID. Classroom MFA helps increase students' digital citizenship skills as they navigate our digital environments in a safe and responsible way. ### **Example of Classroom MFA protecting Entra with login pictures:** ### ### **Example of Classroom MFA protecting Entra with a PIN:** ### This solution doesn’t require any Clever software deployed on-premises. After your end users complete primary Entra ID authentication (such as their username/password) they’ll be redirected to Clever's cloud service to complete MFA, and subsequently redirected back to Microsoft's service. This article walks through the setup process. ![Graphic showing how Classroom MFA protects Entra](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CC2AP) There are two parts: setup in Entra, and setup in your Clever Dashboard. **You must complete both setup portions** for Clever Classroom MFA to function in Entra. * * * ## Setup in Entra ### **Part 1: Create the group(s) of users you want to turn on MFA for** In the Entra or Azure console, go to **Groups > All Groups > New group**. Create the needed group(s). See [Microsoft’s article on group management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/fundamentals/how-to-manage-groups) for more information. ![Screenshot of Entra Admin Center Groups page with highlight around New group](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CC2rx)   ### **Part 2: Adding External MFA Methods** 1. If using the Entra console, go to **applications > App registrations > New registration**. If using the Azure console, go to **App registration > New registration**. You must have [Privileged Role Administrator](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference#privileged-role-administrator) access or higher. ![Screenshot of Microsoft Entra admin center with arrow pointing to New Registration](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGiKj) 2. The fields here should be filled in as follows: - **Name:** you can name this anything, but we recommend a clear name, like Clever Classroom MFA - **Supported account types:** For increased security, set the account types to Single tenant only, unless your Entra design crosses multiple tenants (e.g. staff in one tenant and students in a secondary tenant). - **Redirect URL:** Select web as the platform, then copy/paste the redirect URL from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > MFA > Integrations tab.](https://schools.clever.com/mfa?tab=integrations) - [](https://schools.clever.com/mfa?tab=integrations)Click **Register.** ![Screenshot of Register an application page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGqjh) 3. After clicking Register, you’ll be taken to the Overview screen. Copy and paste the Application (client) ID. You’ll need it for the next step, as well as for the [Setup in your Clever Dashboard section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#header3). ![Screenshot of Test application with Application (client) ID highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGJ30) 4. If using the Entra console, go to **Protection > Authentication methods > Add external method**. If using the Azure console, **Security > Manage > Authentication Methods > Add external method.** ![Screenshot of Authentication Methods | Policies page with highlight around Add external method (preview) button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGsqL) 5. Configure the fields as follows: - - **Name:** you can name this anything, but we recommend a clear name, like Clever Classroom MFA - **Client ID (from your Clever Dashboard)**: Grab this here: [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > MFA > Integrations](https://schools.clever.com/mfa?tab=integrations) tab > Copy Client ID. - **Discovery Endpoint**: Grab this from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > MFA > Integrations tab.](https://schools.clever.com/mfa?tab=integrations) - **App ID**: App ID from the previous screen (in Entra) - **Request Admin Consent**: this needs to be clicked  - **Enable and Target****:** See step six for more information on this step ![Screenshot of Enable and target screen with Enable set to on](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGeCJ) 6. **Enable and target** controls which groups are targeted for the EAM. It is up to your school organization to determine which group(s) you want to enable Classroom MFA for. Just keep in mind that this **must** align with the number of licenses you’ve purchased for Clever Classroom MFA. For instance, if you have 10,000 licenses but target 20,000 users, you would have an overage. - Click the **Enable** button. - Click set **Target > Select Targets**.  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HsFY9)  Please note:** Remember, you can either select all users or groups. You cannot select individual users. - - Select either all users or the group(s) you’d like to enable external MFA method.  ![Screenshot of Add directory members page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGr4g) ### **Part 3: Enforcing MFA for users in Entra** Next, you’ll enforce MFA for users. This makes MFA required for users. There are two options: enforcing for individual users, or setting up a conditional access policy which lets you enforce MFA for a group of users. Option 1: Enforcing for individual users 1. Go to **Entra.microsoft.com** **\> Users > All Users > Ellipsis (…) >  Per User MFA.** ![Screenshot of User tab in Entra with Per-user MFA highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGwp8) 2. Select the user and click **Enable**. ![Screenshot of Users tab in Entra](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGTiI) Option 2: Setting up a conditional access policy 1. This allows settings to be applied to a group of users. However, we’re currently troubleshooting this feature, so you may run into issues getting this to work on enforcing MFA on device logins. 2. To set up a conditional access policy, go to [Home > Protection > Conditional Access > Create new policy](https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_ConditionalAccess/ConditionalAccessBlade/~/Overview/fromNav/Identity). 3. Set the **Assignments** to include the group of users you targeted in [step six in part one](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001683#stepsix). ![Screenshot of select users and groups page with test-mfa group selected](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGqmw) 4. Set the Target resources to **All Cloud apps**. Add other restrictions as needed. ![Screenshot of Entra Conditional Access Policy screen with all cloud apps selected](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CH3XG) 5. Under **Access controls > Grant**, select Grant access, Require multifactor authentication, and click **Select**. ![Screenshot of Entra Conditional Access Policy screen with Require multifactor authentication selected](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CH6V7) Now that setup is complete in Entra, move to the next section to get things set up in Clever. * * * ## Setup in your Clever Dashboard After you’ve completed setup in Entra, head to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > MFA > Integrations tab](https://schools.clever.com/mfa?tab=integrations). If you don't have an active Classroom MFA subscription, click [**Set up an Entra integration**](https://schools.clever.com/mfa/integrations) to access the demo. ![Screenshot of Clever Classroom MFA page, on the Integrations tab with directions for setting up Microsoft Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CHCkD) 1. Click **Add Application (client) ID(s) from Entra to establish integration**. 1. You may have more than one application (client) ID if you have multiple Entra tenant(s) within your school organization. ![Screenshot of Add application ID(s) button in Clever Dashboard Entra setup page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CH7r3) 2. Add the Application (client) ID from Entra. If you need it, you can get it from the app overview page of Entra ID: ![Screenshot of Test application with Application (client) ID highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGJ30) 3. In the Integration page in your Clever Dashboard, click **Add directory (tenant) ID(s) from Entra to establish integration**. 1. You may have more than one directory (tenant) ID if you have multiple Entra tenants within your school organization. ![Screenshot of Add tenant ID(s) button in Clever Dashboard Entra setup page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CHDoL) 4. Add the Directory (tenant) ID(s) from Entra. If you need it, you can get it from the app overview page of Entra ID: ![Screenshot of Test application with Directory (tenant) ID highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000UbXRx) 5. After completing both the Entra ID and Clever Dashboard setup, ensure you’ve set up at least one MFA policy that will cover Entra ID users. If you need help with setup, check out [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625). IMPORTANT For Clever Classroom MFA to protect Entra ID, you must include the same users in your MFA policy/policies that you targeted in the Enable and target step during the Entra setup process. If users aren’t included in the MFA Policy, they will not be able to log in to their device and will see an error message. Also: the “Skip enforcement date” button in the MFA setup doesn’t affect Entra ID - MFA will be required for all users in the MFA policy whether this button is clicked or not: ![Screenshot of Skip enforcement date checkbox](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CGzv5)   6. Once all setup is complete, we recommend you test at least one user by logging in on their device and ensuring Classroom MFA comes up as expected. You should wait at least an hour after completing Entra and Clever setup steps to allow all settings to go live. * * * ## Using MFA with Windows Device login via [Web Enabled Login](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/identity-protection/web-sign-in/?tabs=intune)  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HsFMr)  Please note:** This requires a Windows 11 device version 22H2 with KB5030310 or higher. You can use Clever Classroom MFA with Windows web enabled login. This is useful if you plan to use shared devices/kiosks where you don't have a primary user logging in locally but rather over the web. To enable MFA for web-enabled login, use the following settings: - Ensure that MFA is enabled on the user directly. Using the conditional access policy does not include the windows login at this time. - Create an [Intune machine configuration policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/mem/intune/configuration/settings-catalog?tabs=sc-search-filter%2Csc-reporting) to include the following ([see here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/mem/intune/configuration/settings-catalog?tabs=sc-search-filter%2Csc-reporting) for more information).                               ![Screenshot of Configuration settings screen with arrow pointing at Edit screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnm5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CH1gk) 
 Setting Value Requirement
 
 Configure Web Sign In Allowed URLs clever.com Mandatory
 Configure Webcam Access Domain clever.com Optional (needed if using camera/Badge login)
 Enable Web Sign In Enabled Mandatory
* * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **I’m running into a problem in Entra, how can I get help?** 1. A temporary error due to Clever serving stale data to the user 1. In this case will resolve after waiting a maximum of 5 minutes 2. An incorrect Tenant ID configured in the Clever wizard, please double-check that your Tenant ID(s) are correct. 3. An incorrect Client ID configured in the Clever wizard, please double-check that your Client ID(s) are correct. * * * **Related Articles:**  - [Manage an external multifactor authentication method in Microsoft Entra ID (Preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/how-to-authentication-external-method-manage) (From Microsoft) - [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625)

title: For Clever Admins: Clever Badge Invalidation
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001682#header1)  
2\. [What's changing with Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001682#header2)  
3\. [How to void Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001682#header3)  
4\. [How a teacher can void individual student Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001682#header4)  
5\. [Generating and printing Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001682#generateprint)

## Overview

Clever is updating its Clever Badges policy to strengthen security and keep Badges up to date. Admins should void and print Badges annually during natural transitions like summer to keep them secure before the first day of school. Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature expiration dates. 

Voiding and printing Badges annually is critical for protecting student data. Leaving Badges active indefinitely can create security vulnerabilities that put sensitive information at risk. Implementing expiration dates is a vital step in safeguarding your school organization.

* * *

## What's changing with Clever Badges

Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. If a printed Badge has an expiration date, it will continue to work past that date. Newly printed Badges will not have an expiration date. 

Admins should still void and print Badges during your school organization's natural transition period, such as a summer or winter rollover.

  **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CBsW1)  Clever Tip:**  Looking for a quick way to refresh your Badges during rollover? Clever Badges printed to a PDF will match the square 2" Avery labels so you can easily print and stick them to an ID card, inside a folder, or in another secure spot!

* * *

## How to void Badges

**To void all Clever Badges in your school organization:**

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview) page.
    
2.  On the [Overview page](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview), check the box to select all schools
    
3.  Once you’ve selected all schools, you’ll see the option to Void All Badges at the top of the page. Click the Void All Badges button  
    ![Screenshot with instructions on how to void all Badges](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000W89ux) 
    
4.  Select your reason for voiding all Badges, and click Confirm

![Drop down to choose reasons for voiding Badges](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000C71V8)  

**To void an individual student’s Clever Badge:**

1.  Use the search bar at the top of your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to search for and navigate to the student's profile page
    
2.  Choose the **Support Tools** option to the right of the page
    
3.  Select **Void Clever Badge** and confirm that you’d like to void the Badge  
    ![Screenshot of drop down with option to void Clever Badge](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000C76JV) 
    
4.  After voiding the current Badge, you’ll then see the option to **Create Clever Badge** from the **Support Tools** menu.  
    ![Screenshot with the option to create a new Clever Badge](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000C71Bm) 

* * *

## How a teacher can void an individual student Badge

Teachers also can void and regenerate individual student Badges via their Clever Portal. This can be useful if a student’s Badge becomes invalid in the middle of the school year, and a teacher needs to generate a new one quickly. Teachers can void Badges by:

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu  
    
2.  Select the student's class
    
3.  Select the student from your roster and click Void Badge.
    
4.  The Badge will be voided. You can then click **View Badge** to download a brand new Badge for that student.   
    ![Screenshot with the steps for a teacher to void a Clever Badge](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000C6dHX) 
    

* * *

## Generating and printing Clever Badges

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Badges printed to PDF will match the Avery label template size for 2” square Avery labels perfectly! Additionally, printing Badges on sticky labels is a great way to ensure students don't lose them, which is more likely to occur when printed on paper. Clever also highly recommends providing students with Badge holders such as those seen [HERE](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=badge+holder&crid=1FY4FIYFATYGK&sprefix=badge%2Caps%2C177&ref=nb_sb_ss_ts-doa-p_1_5).

###   
  
**Generating and printing Badges in bulk**

By navigating to [Authentication > Badges](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview), you can select to download the Badges for individual schools, multiple schools, or all enabled schools. Clever Admins can choose to download active Badges or those that are associated with new users who have never had Badges generated previously.  

![Screenshot showing where to download a Clever Badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Zp2t)  

Depending on the file size, Clever will either download the Badges directly to your computer or email you a secure [.zip file](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/zip-and-unzip-files-8d28fa72-f2f9-712f-67df-f80cf89fd4e5) that can be downloaded to your desktop if the file exceeds our standard download limitations. The file will contain the following:

-   Folders with the names of each school 
    -   Subfolders with student Badges by grade level, including the Badge QR codes and names of each student.
        -   PDF of the grade level Badges
        -   PNG images of Badges
    -   Subfolders with student Badges by sections (i.e., courses/classes), including the Badge QR codes and names of each student.
        -   PDF of the grade level Badges
        -   PNG images of Badges

![Image of a tree folder structure.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C6q)  

###   
**Generating Individual Student Badges**

Badges can also be generated or voided on a per-student basis. To do this, please begin by searching for the student using the Clever Dashboard search bar or by navigating to the [Data browser > Students tab](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=students). Once you've located the student's record to access their profile page, select **Support Tools** in the top right to void their Badge or generate a new one. 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If the option to void or generate a Badge isn't available for a student, the student isn't included in the scope specified when you or another admin set up Clever Badges.

  
  
![Screenshot of the Clever Portal highlighting the Support Tools dropdown.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000baZB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Zp2y)

**Related Articles:** 

-   [Clever Badges: Overview and Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907)
    
-   [For Teachers: Clever Badges for Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000127406)
