title: Adjusting Skyward Multi Factor Authentication to resolve issues with Skyward Autosyncs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001676#header1)  
2\. [Adjusting Skyward settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001676#header2) 

## Overview

Skyward has implemented a requirement in their SMS 2.0 product so secured users that are configured as a "System Wide User" and those that have access to the Financial Management or Human Resources are required to use Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) when logging in with a Skyward Password. The MFA requirement will be removed if system wide access, HR and Finance Access are removed from a secured user.

  
If you've set up your Clever sync via a “System Wide User” you’ll need to make some updates to keep your Skyward sync running as expected.

* * *

## Adjusting Skyward settings 

To remove sync issues related to MFA being on in Skyward, follow these steps.

1.  Go to the **Product Setup** (portal), then navigate to **Skyward Contact Access > Security - SE > Setup > Configuration > Authentication Configuration.** 
    
    -   On this screen, locate the **Secured Users without System Wide Access**" option, and uncheck the **Require MFA** box.
        
2.  Change the “Clever” user such that it is no longer a "System Wide User" by going to **Product Setup** (portal) > **Skyward Contact Access > Security - SE > Super User - SU > Secured User - SU**, to view the Secured User list.
    
3.  Locate the "Clever" user in the list, then click the **Edit** button on the right-hand side of the screen.
    
4.  On the edit window, set the "System Wide Access" option to **No**, then click **Save**.
    
5.  Add the “Clever” user to an appropriate security group by going to **Product Setup** (portal) **\>** **Skyward Contact Access > Security - SE > Security Groups - SG > Web Student Management - WS**.
    
6.  On the Web Student Management screen, you'll want to configure the user in a way that makes sense for your district. Be sure to the user is added to a security group with access to Entity 000 and that the user has Level 5 access under the **AD - \*Administration**. If you’re not familiar with setting up this configuration, contact [Skyward Customer Success](https://support.skyward.com/) for help.

title: For Clever Admin: Short-term substitute access to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header1)  
2\. [How to enable this feature](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header2)  
3\. [The Clever Admin Experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header3)  
4\. [Teacher Experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header4)  
5\. [Substitute Experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header5)  
6\. [Resources for teachers and substitutes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#resources)   
7\. [Rollout Processes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header7)  
8. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#header6)

## Overview

Clever’s Substitute Access feature makes it easy for teachers to securely provide temporary access to Clever for their substitute. Instead of sharing their personal login credentials, teachers can generate a Sub Badge that allows short-term substitutes to log in and view the resources and Teacher Page they have provided them access to. This allows teachers to maintain secure credentials, while also giving substitutes the tools they need to manage their online resources effectively for the day.

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000I52i0)  Please note:** This feature is for short-term subs (up to 14 days). If you need longer coverage, like for parental leave, please see [this article on options for longer-term subs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001533).

* * *

## How to enable this feature

To enable this feature for your teachers:

1.  Log in to your **Clever Dashboard.**
    
2.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url).
    
3.  Click the **Substitute Access** tab.
    
4.  Toggle the **Enable Substitute Access** to enabled.
    
5.  Choose to enable for all school organizations, or select the schools where you would like Substitute Access to be available for teachers by clicking the blue **Edit** button that appears after you've turned the Enable Substitute Access button on.  
      
    ![Screenshot of Dashboard to turn enable substitute access](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000I9Q2Y)   
      
    
6.  You can create a notification to inform teachers of the substitute access feature.
7.  You also have the option to customize which applications substitutes will have access to. Use this feature to restrict access to applications with particularly sensitive data like test scores, IEP information etc. Use the block button to block individual applications, or use the checkboxes next to applications and the **Block X selected** button to block them in bulk.  
      
    ![Screenshot of the option to block applications](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Nq8U5)  

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000I52i0)  Please note:** For security purposes, Clever blocks PowerSchool and Google applications by default. These applications can’t be removed from the block list.

  
  

* * *

## The Clever Admin Experience

If a teacher is unexpectedly absent and cannot generate a Substitute Badge, you can impersonate the teacher to create one on their behalf using the [Access Portal as feature](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146?language=en_US#Instructions) and following the steps below under the **Teacher Experience** section. 

Admins have total control over active Substitute Badges and can immediately void a Badge at any time via your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Substitute Access tab](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/substitute-access) in the **View active Substitute Badges** section.

![Active Substitute Badges screen with void option highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oyNEf) 

  **![Light Bulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000A9z1i)  Clever Tip:** School Tech Leads can also generate and void Substitute Badges using their [impersonation tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047079271?language=en_US#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2) and following the steps in the **Teacher Experience** section below.

* * *

## Teacher Experience

Teachers can provide access to substitutes so they can access their resources and Teacher Page by following the steps below:

1.  Log in to your **Clever Portal.**
    
2.  Navigate to **Pages** > **Teacher Pages** on the left side of your Clever Portal.
    
3.  Click on the Teacher Page you want to provide the substitute access to.
    
4.  In the top right-hand corner, click **Share with substitute.**
    

![Screenshot of the Teacher Page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAPDt)

5.  This will take you to a preview of what the substitute will see when they log in with their Badge. You'll see in the image below that Google is greyed out. For security purposes, the subset of “restricted impersonation” apps won't be accessible. You'll find more information on which applications have [restricted impersonation below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675#restrictedapps).

![Screenshot of notification that Google is a restricted impersonation app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAMO7)

6.  To generate a Sub Badge that will provide login access for the substitute, click **Create Substitute Badge** and select the date you want the Badge to expire. The expiration date must be within 14 days.

![Select the date you would like the Badge to expire](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IS8LF)

7.  Once the date is selected, click **Create Substitute Badge** to confirm the date.
8.  Now you are ready to click **Download Substitute Badge** to download the Badge to your computer.

![Screenshot of Substitute Badge downloaded](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000A9R3G)      
 

* * *

## Substitute Experience

Substitutes will scan their Sub Badge to access Clever and will be limited to viewing only the Teacher Page that the teacher provided them access to. From there, they can log in to and use any applications available on that page as the main teacher. For security reasons, certain "restricted impersonation" apps won't be accessible to substitutes, but students will still be able to use these apps from their own Clever Portal. By default, Clever prevents users from accessing the Google suite applications (e.g., Google Sheets, Google Docs, etc.) and PowerSchool. You can add restricted applications on the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Substitute Access tab.](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/substitute-access)

![Screenshot of the Substitute experience](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAPNZ)

* * *

## Resources for teachers and substitutes 

Teachers will see [instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672) about how to use Substitute Access when they generate a Badge for substitutes. 

![Screenshot of Substitute Badge downloaded](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ec5TF)

The substitute Badge includes instructions on how to log in to Clever:

![Screenshot of Substitute Badge instructions](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfg1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ec5WT)

Here are additional resources you can share with teachers and substitutes to help them use this new tool: 

Teachers: 

-   [Teacher experience video](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/70fsw66drd?lid=ornb9y3dg4za)
-   [Clickable walkthrough](https://www.iorad.com/player/2464436/For-Teachers--Providing-subs-access-to-Clever-with-Substitute-Badges?#trysteps-1)
    
-   [Handout with instructions](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Holiday-Break-Subs-DEC2024-V2.pdf) 
    
-   [For Teachers: Substitute Access to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672)
    

Substitutes: 

-   [For Substitutes: Substitute Access to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001674)
    

* * *

## Rollout Processes

Here are a few simple steps to help you introduce the Substitute Access feature. Following these steps will help your team feel supported as they learn about the feature and confident using it on their own.

1.  **Gain Leadership Support:** Work with school administrators to implement the feature and highlight its importance.
    
2.  **Conduct Training:** Offer short hands-on training sessions to show teachers how to create a substitute page and generate a Badge. This gives them time to practice and helps them feel confident using the feature.  
    
3.  **Standardize the Process:** Pick one approach for your school organization, either have teachers share their existing Teacher Pages with subs, or train teachers to create a dedicated substitute page with a consistent set of resources your school organization wants all subs to have access to. 
    
4.  **Involve Key School Staff:** Train anyone who works with substitutes, like principals or front office staff, so they can check in substitutes and hand out the Badge easily.
    
5.  **Expand and Communicate:** Partner with your relevant regional offices to include the feature to substitute onboarding and training so that substitutes understand the benefits of using the feature in their role.
    

[Click here](https://www.clever.com/blog/2025/10/rolling-out-substitute-access-to-teachers-lessons-from-bend-la-pine) to learn how Bend-La Pine Schools implemented substitute access and now uses it to support their substitute teachers.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can subs use a Badge to access/log into their Chromebook?**

-   Not at this time, no. We recommend providing guest access to a device and then having a sub go to clever.com/badges.
    

**What if a sub’s device does not have a camera?** 

-   At this time, Sub Badges are only available as QR codes, so the sub’s device must have some sort of camera to scan the Badge.
    

**How should my teachers provide the Sub Badge to their substitute?** 

-   We suggest including it with their sub plans!
    

**Will subs be able to access everything the teacher can in the third party app?**

-   Yes, any applications on the Teacher Page will be accessible to the sub, and the sub will be logged into the application as the main teacher.
    

**Can I block applications that I don’t want substitutes to access?** 

-   Yes! By default, Clever blocks sub-access to Google and PowerSchool. You can add additional applications on the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Substitute Access tab](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/substitute-access). It's not possible to remove Google and PowerSchool from this list.

**How long can a teacher give subs access to their Teacher Page?**

-   Teachers can grant subs access for up to 14 days, allowing them to set a custom date within that timeframe.
    

**A teacher is unexpectedly absent. How could I, as an administrator, generate a Sub Badge for them?**

-   Administrators can generate Substitute Badges at any time by impersonating into a teacher’s Clever Portal.
    

**Can I see which substitutes have active Badges and void them if needed?**

-   Yes! You can do this via your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Substitute Access tab](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/substitute-access) in the **View active Substitute Badges** section.
    

**Can I, as an administrator, see when a sub accesses Clever?**

-   Yes, via [Access logs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001698).
    

**If I turn off Substitute Badges in the Dashboard, what will happen to existing Sub Badges?**

-   Any Substitute Badges currently active when you turn off Sub Badges will remain active until their selected expiration date.

**Is this a paid feature?**

-   No – the Substitute Access is a free feature! 
    

**Can teachers create more than one Sub Badge at a time?**

-   For security purposes, only one substitute Badge can be created at a time, even if the teacher has more than one Teacher Page. If they have multiple Teacher Pages that need to be shared, we recommend creating a Teacher Page that houses all of the resources in one and sharing that page.

* * *

title: For Teachers: Short-term Substitute Access to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672#header1)  
2\. [How to set it up](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672#header2)  
3\. [The substitute experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001672#header4)

## Overview

Clever's Substitute Access feature makes it easy for you to securely provide temporary access to your resources on Clever for your short-term substitute. Instead of sharing your personal login credentials, you can now generate a Sub Badge that allows substitutes to log in and view the resources and Teacher Page you have provided them access to. This allows you to maintain secure credentials while also giving substitutes the tools they need to manage your online resources effectively for the day.

  **![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000I5Ur7)  Please note:** Not all school organizations have enabled Substitute Access. If you don't see the option in your Clever Portal, please reach out to your IT or administrative team about enabling this feature.

This article is for teachers and substitutes using the short-term Substitute Access feature in Clever. If the substitute has their own account in Clever and is listed as a co-teacher on the classes you teach, [please refer to this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001534).

* * *

## How to set it up

Provide your substitute access to your resources and Teacher Page on Clever by following the steps below:

1.  Log in to your **Clever Portal.**
    
2.  Navigate to Pages > Teacher Pages on the left side of your Clever Portal.
    
3.  Click on the Teacher Page you want to provide the substitute access to.
    
4.  In the top right-hand corner, click **Share with Substitute.**
    

![Screenshot of the Teacher Page view](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAMHd)

5.  This will take you to a preview of what the substitute will see when they log in with their Sub Badge. In the image below, Google is greyed out. For security purposes, the subset of “restricted impersonation” apps will not be accessible. Restricted impersonation apps include Google Suite, PowerSchool, and any other applications set by your school’s Clever Admin.

![Screenshot showing Google is a restricted impersonation app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAMaz)

6.  To generate a Sub Badge that will provide login access for the substitute, click **Create Substitute Badge** and select the date you want the Badge to expire. The expiration date must be within 14 days.

![Screenshot of creating a Substitute Badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IS8LF)

7.  Once the date is selected, click **Create Substitute Badge** again to confirm the date.
8.  Now you're ready to click **Download Substitute Badge** to download the Sub Badge to your computer.
9.  Provide the [For Substitutes: Substitute Access to Clever Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001674) to your substitute for extra information and instructions.

![Screenshot showing Substitute Badge downloaded.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAMhR)

  
 

* * *

## The substitute experience

Substitutes will scan their Sub Badge to access Clever and will be limited to viewing only the Teacher Page you provided them access to. From there, they can log into and use any applications available on that page as the main teacher. For security reasons, certain "restricted impersonation" apps will not be accessible to substitutes, but students will still be able to use these apps from their own Clever Portal. This includes Google Suite applications, PowerSchool, and any other applications set by your school's Clever Admin.

![Screenshot of the substitute experience.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AAMnt)    
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I create more than one Sub Badge at a time?**

-   For security purposes, only 1 Substitute Badge can be created at a time, even if you have more than one Teacher Page. If you have multiple Teacher Pages that need to be shared, we recommend creating a Teacher Page that houses all of the resources in one and sharing that page. 
    

**Can subs use a Sub Badge to access/log into their Chromebook?**

-   Not at this time, no. We recommend providing guest access to a device and then having a sub go to clever.com/badges.
    

**What if a sub’s device doesn't have a camera?**

-   At this time, Sub Badges are only available as QR codes, so the sub’s device must have some sort of camera to scan the Sub Badge.
    

**How should I provide the Sub Badge to the substitute?**

-   We suggest including it in your sub plans!
    

**Will subs be able to access every application on my Teacher Page?**

-   No. Clever doesn’t allow substitutes to access Google or PowerSchool applications by default for security reasons. Your Clever Admin may also add additional applications to the restricted app list. The substitute will see these apps greyed out with a note that they are inaccessible to the substitute.
    

**Will subs be able to access everything I can access in the third party apps they have access to?**

-   Yes, any applications on the Teacher Page will be accessible to the sub. When the sub accesses the application, they'll be logged in as you, the main teacher. Greyed-out applications are inaccessible to subs, as set by your Clever Admin.

**How long can I give subs access to my Teacher Page?**

-   You can grant subs access for up to 14 days, allowing you to set a custom date within that timeframe.  
      
    

**Can I void a Sub Badge ahead of the expiration date?**

-   Yes, you can void a Sub Badge at any time. To void the Sub Badge navigate to your shared Teacher Page, click **Share with Substitute**, then click **Void Badge**.

**Why is a Sub Badge not working?**

-   If the Sub Badge is not working, it has likely expired, or your Clever Admin has voided it. If a Clever Admin has voided a Sub Badge, you’ll see a notification in your Clever Portal letting you know.  
    ![Example of a notification for a voided Substitute Badge in a teacher's Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oyQNp) 

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Short-term substitute access to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001675)
-   [For Substitutes: Substitute access to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001674)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020354392)

title: For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA implementation steps and timeline
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001671#header1)  
2\. [Implementation steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001671#header2)  
3\. [Timeline](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001671#header3)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001671#header4)

## Overview

This article briefly overviews the steps for setting up **Classroom Multi-factor Authentication (MFA)** and a timeline for onboarding and implementation. The timelines provided are a general guideline and will vary based on your school organization’s unique setup. Our onboarding engineers will be able to share a more specific timeline for your school organization during your onboarding process. If you want more specific guidance on the Classroom MFA setup process, please see our article [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625). 

* * *

## Implementation steps

While this article provides a general overview of the implementation steps for setting up Classroom MFA, each setup process may look different depending on your needs and your system setups.  An onboarding engineer will support your Classroom MFA implementation process. If you have questions regarding your school organization's setup steps, please contact your onboarding engineer directly.

1.  **Select users who will be required to use MFA**
    
    -   By group: Students, teachers, or staff. Student subsets can be grouped by schools, grades, or groups (IEP or ELL status).
        
    -   By specific user: identify specific users that will be required to use MFA.
        
2.  **Select MFA methods**
    
    -   Choose the MFA method you’ll allow for each user type. Options include picture logins, Badges, PINs, Mobile apps, App-based tokens, biometrics or security keys, text messages, or voice calls.
        
3.  **Configure MFA settings**
    
    -   Set user enforcement dates, re-authentication frequency, and guardian support specifications.
        
4.  **Set Policy name**
    
    -   Set a distinct name for your policy with a description for easy editing in the future. You can create multiple policies to configure settings for specific subgroups.
        
5.  **Preview and complete MFA configuration**
    
    -   Review of summary of your selections. You can always come back and edit your settings at any time.
        
6.  **User self enrollment**
    
    -   Users will be prompted to set up MFA based on your enforcement guidelines.
        
7.  **Optional:** **Set up Classroom MFA to protect Google Workspace and Chromebooks**
    
    You can configure additional settings in your Google Workspace to enable Clever to protect both your Google Workspace and Chromebooks in addition to the Clever Portal. [See this article for more information](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572).

* * *

## Timeline

![Image of Classroom MFA implementation timeline](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e825&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009mU3R)   

_This is an example timeline for setting up Classroom MFA. Implementation timelines will vary based on your school organization goal and timeline._

**Week 1**

-   Work with a school organization partnerships specialist to learn more general information about Classroom MFA, receive a quote for your school organization, verify your Classroom MFA order, and activate your services.
    
-   Once your service is activated, you’ll begin working with a Classroom MFA onboarding engineer to discuss the specifics of your configuration based on your current environment, including what you are hoping to protect with Classroom MFA (Clever Portal, Google Workspace accounts, Chromebooks, Entra ID, etc.).
    

**Week 2**

-   Begin setting up Classroom MFA policies with guidance from your onboarding engineer. You’ll configure settings for which users to manage, second-factor authentication options for each group, authentication frequency, etc.
    
-   Test logins for your users and adjust MFA policies as needed.
    

**Week 3**

-   Discuss rollout plan and change management for end users.
    
-   Explore training resources for end users.
    

**Week 4**

-   Ensure successful enrollment for end users.
    
-   Continued support from the Clever team.
    

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

**How long does it take to set up Classroom MFA?**

-   Most school organizations take approximately one to two weeks to set up Classroom MFA within Clever. End user training and rollout typically takes an additional two weeks, depending on how you’d like to notify and train your users.
    

**Can this timeline be expedited?**

-   This timeline varies greatly depending on each school organization’s current environment. The timeline also depends on your availability to test and make changes to your Classroom MFA setup, both within Clever and other systems (e.g., Google).
    

**What is the difference between your school organization partnerships team and your onboarding engineers?**

-   Our School Organization Partnerships team helps educate you on Classroom MFA, assists in verifying your order, and gets everything set up and activated. Our onboarding engineers ensure the technical implementation runs smoothly and meets your school organization's unique requirements.
    

**What permissions do staff have by default with Classroom MFA?** 

-   STLs have the following permissions assigned to their role:
    -   Can reset MFA configurations for teachers and students
    -   Can generate MFA bypass codes for teachers

**How can I assign staff more permissions in Classroom MFA?**

-   Please note that Staff (Portal Access) don't have permissions within Classroom MFA. If the STL permissions don't capture the access you're looking for you can create a custom role for a staff member and assign any of the permissions below. Learn more about managing custom roles [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702?language=en_US).
    -   Manage Classroom MFA settings - configure, update, and delete [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) settings (Includes access to user data)
    -   Manage MFA bypass codes - reset MFA bypass codes for specific users (includes access to user data through bulk downloading Badges only)
    -   Manage individual MFA reset - reset a user's MFA settings when they're locked out or need to re-enroll. Includes the ability to search for and view users.

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616)
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625).
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Google Workspace SAML Setup Guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572)

title: Clever IDM: Implementation steps and timeline
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001670#header1)  
2\. [Implementation steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001670#header2)  
3\. [Timeline](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001670#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001670#header4)

## Overview

This article briefly overviews the steps for setting up **Clever Identity Management (IDM)** and a timeline for onboarding and implementation. The timelines provided are a general guideline and will vary based on your district or school’s unique setup. Our onboarding engineers will be able to share a more specific timeline for your district during your onboarding process. If you are looking for more specific guidance on setting up your destination, please see the relevant article below:

-   [Clever IDM: Google setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Active Directory setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Entra ID setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553)
    

* * *

## Implementation steps

While this article provides a general overview of the implementation steps for each Clever IDM destination, each setup process may look different depending on your needs and unique system setups.  An onboarding engineer will support your Clever IDM implementation process. If you have questions regarding your district’s setup steps, please contact your onboarding engineer directly.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e80T&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009lPNa)   Please note:** In addition to the implementation steps described below, additional steps may need to be taken to adjust your student information system (SIS) sync to Clever to set up additional SFTP syncs. Our onboarding engineers will assist with any additional steps as needed!

Google

1.  **Connect to Google**
    
    -   Provide Clever with access to manage the provisioning of users in Google via a Google Super Admin account.
        
2.  **Select Users**
    
    -   Select which user types you’d like to provision for: students, teachers, and staff.
        
3.  **Set login credentials**
    
    -   Determine formulas for each user group’s username and passwords.
        
4.  **Set up organization units (OUs)**
    
    -   Determine formulas for sorting user types into your Google OUs.
        
5.  **Configure groups (optional)**
    
    -   Depending upon your setup and implementation plan, this step may come after initial account provisioning (step 7).
        
    -   Determine within Google if your groups meet the required Clever specifications, and edit as needed. Clever can manage both security and distribution groups.
        
    -   Within Clever, determine the groups you’d like to manage and create group membership rules for each.
        
6.  **Summary**
    
    -   Review a summary page of all the selections made for each user type for user account settings, OUs, and if included, groups.
        
7.  **Preview & Provision**
    
    -   Preview your Clever IDM setup, including updates, new users created, changes to OUs, etc.
        
    -   With approval from your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist, begin provisioning.  
          
        
    -   You’ll see a note in your account that IDM Provisioning is disabled and requires review from a Clever specialist. Our team must review your setup before your first provision to protect your destination accounts and prevent issues with SSO for your end users. Once your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist have approved your preview, begin provisioning.
    -   Review the provisioning process to ensure no errors or unexpected changes occur.
        
8.  **Password reset and account recovery (optional)**
    
    -   As part of Clever IDM, you can configure password reset and account recovery options for any destination and user type you choose to provision for (students, teachers, staff). This enables you to configure settings such as forcing users to reset passwords on first login, allowing teachers to reset student passwords, and setting up account recovery options should a password be forgotten.
        

Active Directory

1.  **Connect to Active Directory**
    
    -   Provide Clever with access to connect to your Active Directory server via LDAPS. You will need to work within your server to locate the LDAPS URL, SHA-256 fingerprints of SSL certificates, and Base DN to provide them in Clever for this secure connection.
        
2.  **Select Users**
    
    -   Select which user types you’d like to provision for: students, teachers, and staff.
        
3.  **Set login credentials**
    
    -   Determine formulas for each user group’s usernames and passwords.
        
4.  **Organize OUs**
    
    -   Determine formulas for sorting user types into your Active Directory OUs.
        
5.  **Configure groups (optional)**
    
    -   Depending on your setup and implementation plan, this step may come after initial account provisioning (step 7).
        
    -   Within Clever, determine the groups you’d like to manage and group membership rules.
        
6.  **Summary**
    
    -   Review a summary page of all the selections made for each user type for user account settings, OUs, and, if included, groups.
        
7.  **Preview & Provision**
    
    -   Preview your Clever IDM setup including updates, new users created, changes to OUs, etc.
        
    -   With approval from your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist, begin provisioning.  
          
        
    -   You’ll see a note in your account that IDM Provisioning is disabled and requires review from a Clever specialist. Our team must review your setup before your first provision to protect your destination accounts and prevent issues with SSO for your end users. Once your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist have approved your preview, begin provisioning.
    -   Review the provisioning process to ensure no errors or unexpected changes occur.
        
8.  **Password reset and account recovery (optional)**
    
    -   As part of Clever IDM, you can configure password reset and account recovery options for any destination and user type you choose to provision for (students, teachers, staff). This enables you to configure settings such as forcing users to reset passwords on first login, allowing teachers to reset student passwords, and setting up account recovery options should a password be forgotten.
        

Microsoft Entra ID

1.  **Connect to Microsoft Entra ID**
    
    -   Provide Clever access to manage user provisioning on your Entra ID domain. The user authorizing the access request must have admin access to the relevant Entra ID instance.
        
2.  **Select Users**
    
    -   Select which user types you’d like to provision for: students, teachers, and staff.
        
3.  **Set login credentials**
    
    -   Determine formulas for each user group’s usernames and passwords.
        
4.  **Summary**
    
    -   Review a summary page of all the selections made for each user type for user account settings.
        
5.  **Preview & Provision**
    
    -   Preview your Clever IDM setup including updates, new users created, etc.
        
    -   With approval from your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist, begin provisioning.  
          
        
    -   You’ll see a note in your account that IDM Provisioning is disabled and requires review from a Clever specialist. Our team must review your setup before your first provision to protect your destination accounts and prevent issues with SSO for your end users. Once your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist have approved your preview, begin provisioning.
    -   Review the provisioning process to ensure no errors or unexpected changes occur.
        
6.  **Password reset and account recovery (optional)**
    
    -   As part of Clever IDM, you can configure password reset and account recovery options for any destination and user type you choose to provision for (students, teachers, staff). This enables you to configure settings such as forcing users to reset passwords on first login, allowing teachers to reset student passwords, and setting up account recovery options should a password be forgotten.
        

* * *

## Timeline

The timelines shared below are general guidance for approximately how long most districts take to complete their Clever IDM setup process and a recommended timeline from our teams.  This timeline may vary depending on your district or school’s unique needs and setup.

![Timeline image showing Clever IDM onboarding timeline](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e80T&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009lpEn)  

_This is an example timeline for setting up Clever IDM. Implementation timelines will vary based on your district goals and timeline._

**Week 1**

-   Work with a district partnerships specialist to learn more general information about Clever IDM, receive a quote for your district, verify your Clever IDM order, and activate your services.
    
-   Once your service is activated, you’ll begin working with a Clever IDM onboarding engineer to discuss your goals, dig into the specifics of your configuration based on your current environment, and develop a custom implementation plan.
    

**Week 2**

-   Complete your Clever IDM setup steps with support from your onboarding engineer as needed. These steps typically include:
    
    -   Connecting to your first destination (Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID)
        
    -   Selecting your users
        
    -   Setting login credentials
        
    -   Organizing OU structure (Google and Active Directory only)
        
    -   Creating group membership rules (Google and Active Directory only)
        
    -   Additional field mappings
        
-   If you wish to set up multiple destinations, they will be configured later in the setup process. The Clever team recommends setting up one destination at a time.
    

**Week 3**

-   Review summary and preview changes with our onboarding engineer team. You’ll look for any last-minute changes or errors.  
      
    
-   You’ll not be able to complete your first provisioning on your own. Our team must review your setup to protect your destination accounts and prevent issues with SSO for your end users. Once your team and a Clever IDM onboarding specialist have approved your preview, you’ll begin provisioning.
-   Go live with provisioning and continue to monitor the sync.
    

**Week 4**

-   Further troubleshooting if needed.
    
-   Setting up any additional destinations (add a week of setup time for each additional destination).
    
-   Continued support from the Clever Support team beyond your onboarding implementation.
    

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How long does it take to set up Clever IDM?**

-   Most districts take approximately four weeks to set up their first Clever IDM destination. Additional destinations typically take less time to configure since you’re more familiar with the setup process.
    

**Does the setup timeline change if I’m provisioning multiple destinations?**

-   Yes. Plan to spend an additional week of setup for each destination.
    

**Can this timeline be expedited?**

-   This timeline varies greatly depending on each district or school’s current environment. The timeline also depends on your availability to make data changes or updates as needed during the setup process (like inputting user emails to your student information system (SIS) to ensure proper data syncing with Clever IDM).
    

**What is the difference between your district partnerships team and your onboarding engineers?**

-   Our District Partnerships team helps educate you on Clever IDM, assists in verifying your order, and gets everything set up and activated. Our onboarding engineers ensure the technical implementation runs smoothly and meets your district’s unique requirements.
    

**What if I want to manage non-teaching staff with Clever IDM, but they aren't stored in my student information system (SIS)?**

-   There are various options for syncing staff users, including CSV files, custom data, or an Active Directory sync. You'll want to ensure that you sync staff users to Clever before setting up Clever IDM. [Learn more in our article about adding staff to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547).

**Why do I see a note that my IDM provisioning is disabled?  
**

-   To protect your destination accounts and prevent SSO issues, our team must review your IDM setup before your first provisioning. Please reach out to the Clever team if you have any questions or to review your sync before you provision for a new destination.

**What permissions do staff have by default with Clever IDM?** 

-   STLs have the following permissions assigned to their role:
    -   Can view student IDM passwords
    -   Can reset student IDM passwords (when delegated resets are enabled for that destination and user type)
    -   Can reset teacher IDM passwords (when delegated resets are enabled for that destination and user type)

**How can I assign staff more permissions in Clever IDM?**

-   Please note that Staff (Portal Access) don't have permissions within Clever IDM. If the STL permissions don't capture the access you're looking for, you can create a custom role for a staff member and assign any of the permissions below. Learn more about managing custom roles [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702?language=en_US).
    -   Manage Clever IDM settings - configure, update, and delete [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) settings 
    -   Manage Individual user passwords - reset an individual user's Clever password from their profile or user search — for users who sign in with a Clever username and password or for users who leverage Clever IDM. Separate from MFA reset. Includes the ability to search for and view users.

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [Clever IDM: Google setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Active Directory setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Entra ID setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553)
    
-   [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466)

title: Clever Admin: Clever sync logic
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001668#overview)  
2\. [Primary school assignments](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001668#header1)  
3\. [Auto-generated section names](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001668#header2)  
4\. [Section grade assignments](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001668#header3)

## Overview

This article breaks down the logic of how Clever determines primary school assignments, creates auto-generated section names, and selects grade levels of sections.

This can be helpful if you're running into confusion on how any of these values are determined or if you'd like to change any of them.

* * *

## Primary school assignments

School association for students and teachers is based on **section enrollments.** If a student or teacher is enrolled in sections at multiple schools, Clever will associate the user with the related schools. A district should NOT attempt to connect a teacher or student with multiple schools by uploading the user multiple times in the students.csv or teachers.csv.  
  
Additionally, Clever will assign a primary school association. This will be the school that displays in their Clever Portal. When an application accesses the data for the user, the application will have access to both the user's primary school association, as well as their secondary associations.  
  
**Primary school is assigned based on where the user has the most section enrollments**.  For example: If a student is enrolled in 2 sections at School A and 4 sections at School B, their primary school assignment in Clever will be School B (regardless of the school assigned in the SIS).

You can see the primary school on the user's profile page, along with the other schools they're associated with listed in their sections.

![Primary and secondary school assignments](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000BNED&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009h69p) 

Additional details:

-   If a user has the same number of sections at two or more schools, Clever will choose the school where the total number of students enrolled in the user's sections is the greatest.
-   If a student or teacher's section enrollments change during the year, their primary school in Clever may also change.
-   If a student or teacher is not enrolled in any sections, Clever will use the school the user is assigned to in your SIS data.
-   A user will be shared with an application if either their primary _or_ secondary school is shared.
-   For information on how staff are associated with multiple schools, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547?language=en_US#h_6ed2513a-8d74-4c7b-8466-f860781757cb). 
    

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000BNED&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009h6GH)  Please note:** If you'd rather Clever use student and teachers' primary school exactly as it's listed in your student information system (SIS), please contact Clever Support. We can disable our default logic for either students, teachers, or both. Once this logic is disabled, Clever will look to your SIS data as the source of truth for primary school assignments.  

* * *

## Auto-generated section names

Section names in Clever are auto-generated to ensure uniqueness, improving recognition and usability for teachers and students. The auto-generated name is: **"course\_name" - "teacher\_last\_name" - "period"**  
  
If course\_name is not provided, the section "**name"** provided in your SIS data will be used. If neither course name or section name are provided, Clever will use **”teacher\_last\_name - period”**

![Section name logic](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000BNED&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009h6g5)

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000BNED&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009h6GH)  Please note:** Clever cannot customize the format of auto-generated section names. However, you can choose to sync your own section names to Clever by following the instructions based on your sync type [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001501?language=en_US#custom) and letting Clever know to turn off the auto-generation logic. 

* * *

## Section grade assignments

Section grades are automatically updated based on the most common student grade in the section. If you would like Clever to assign the section grade based on the grade provided by your student information system, reach out to Clever Support at support.clever.com and they can turn the default grade logic off for you.   
  

* * *

title: Clever + PebbleGo: Setup guide & rollover process
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001667#header1)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001667#header2)  
3\. [Recommended sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001667#header3)  
4\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001667#header4)  
5\. [School year rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001667#header5)

## Overview

This article contains information to help your school district set up with Clever and PebbleGo. You can also review the PebbleGo rollover process to help you prepare for Back to School season.   
 

* * *

## Setup process

1.  Make sure your school district is set up with Clever! 
    
    -   If your school district hasn’t been set up with Clever, you can get started [here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup).
        
2.  If your school district is already using Clever, you can add PebbleGo by following these instructions:
    
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and navigate to [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add).
    -   Search for PebbleGo and click on it when it appears in the list.
    -   You’ll then be brought to a page where you can request the application. When requesting PebbleGo select whether or not you have made a purchase.
    -   You can then opt to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   On the right side of the page, you can view the fields required by PebbleGo.
    -   When you have made your selections, click **Send integration request**.

* * *

## Recommended sharing rules

PebbleGo recommends that you share data by school. The simplest way is to set up your sharing using [**Share by Rules**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247?language=en_US) in Clever. You can create a sharing rule by following these steps:

1.  Set up your sharing rules:
    
    -   If you are setting up sharing rules for PebbleGo for the first time, please only share the school within your district that have active PebbleGo subscriptions. Reach out to [customersuccess@capstonepub.com](mailto:customersuccess@capstonepub.com) for assistance. 
        
2.  Configure your sharing rules by limiting sharing to only the schools and students that should be synced.
    

-   -   Once PebbleGo receives your data, they will have an additional filtering process. 
        

Once you've shared data with PebbleGo in Clever, you'll need to work with PebbleGo to finish your sync. PebbleGo’s rostering team will guide you through this process.

IMPORTANT   
Once you have spoken with PebbleGo’s rostering team and your data is received by the PebbleGo team, setup may take 5-10 business days, depending on the time of year.  

* * *

## Required fields

Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. 

PebbleGo requires the following data fields:

**Student Fields:** 

-   first and last name
    
-   district
    
-   school
    
-   sis\_id and student\_number
    

**Contact fields:** 

-   district
    
-   name
    
-   sis\_id
    
-   students
    

**Teacher fields:** 

-   First and last name
    
-   district
    
-   school(s)
    
-   sis\_id
    
-   Email
    

**District Admin fields:** 

-   district
    
-   first and last name
    
-   email
    
-   title
    

* * *

## School year rollover

PebbleGo will continue to sync and be active through Clever as long as the school's subscription is active. Near your expiration date Capstone’s renewal team will reach out to discuss your upcoming renewal of PebbleGo.

title: For Teachers: Clever LMS Connect
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001664#header1)  
2\. [Features](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001664#header2)  
3\. [Learn more](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001664#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001664#header4)

## Overview

For school organizations that choose to use it, Clever LMS Connect connects learning apps with the schools' Learning Management System (LMS) like Google Classroom, Canvas, and Schoology.

  
Clever LMS Connect works in the background to seamlessly sync assignments and grades from learning apps to the LMS gradebook, along with the one-click logins you’re used to with Clever.

![Graphic showing how Clever LMS connect interacts with Clever, the LMS, and learning apps](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000P4mn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000091IXB)   
 

* * *

## Features

Clever LMS Connect connects learning applications to your LMS through Clever and creates a seamless learning experience for students and teachers by:

-   Saving time: You and students can log in to applications with single-sign on directly from the LMS (if your school organization has enabled this)
    
-   Eliminating grade double entry: grades and assignments automatically sync between the LMS and learning applications, so students' submissions and grades automatically show up in the LMS.
    
-   Adding content and assignments: When you add an assignment in an app compatible with Clever LMS Connect, it’ll automatically show up in your LMS. This means that students can easily access applications and find assignments in their LMS.
    

View the videos below to see how Clever LMS Connect works for you and your students.

### **Canvas**

##   

### **Google Classroom**

##   

### **Schoology**

##   

* * *

## Learn more

Clever LMS Connect is available for free to school organizations, and will be available on a per-app basis as learning applications build their Clever LMS Connect integrations. 

If you’re not sure if your schools are using Clever LMS Connect, or which applications are available, please contact your school's tech support or IT team.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**How do I know if my school organization is using Clever LMS Connect? How do I know which apps are available?**

-   If you’re not sure if your school organization is using Clever LMS Connect, or which applications are available, please contact your school's tech support or IT team.
    

**If I create an assignment in an app compatible with Clever LMS Connect, will it automatically show up in the LMS? Are there any additional steps I need to take?**

-   There are no additional steps teachers need to take to enable assignment sync. 
    

**Will Clever LMS Connect pass grades back to our SIS?**

-   Not at this time. Clever LMS Connect will only sync grades and assignments between applications and your LMS.
    

**Is Clever LMS Connect a separate charge for school organizations?**

-   Clever LMS Connect is free for school organizations.
    

**Will Clever LMS Connect work if our school organization uses multiple LMSs?**

-   At this time, Clever LMS Connect will only work with one LMS per school organization. We hope to allow for multiple LMSs per organization in the future.
    

**Which LMS systems will work with Clever LMS Connect?**

-   We currently integrate with the three LMSs that are most used by schools - Google Classroom, Schoology, and Canvas. We plan to integrate with more in the future.
    

**Who do I contact for technical support with Clever LMS Connect?**

-   Please contact your school's IT/tech support team for help.

2. [Setting up account recovery for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, or Clever passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001663#header2)  
3\. [Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001663#header3)  
4. [Resetting your password in the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001663#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001663#header5)

## Overview

This article is an overview of the ways that students can recover and reset the password that they use to log into Clever.

You will only be able to recover and reset your password if your school has set this up for you.

* * *

## Setting up account recovery for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, or Clever passwords

If your school has set it up, you can use a backup method like email, security questions, or your phone number to get back into your Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, and Clever passwords accounts right from the Clever login screen! This helps if you’re having trouble with your password. As you read this article, it'll be helpful to know that Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google Workspace may also be referred to as third-party accounts.

If you are not sure what credentials you use to log in to Clever, your login screen will give you a hint! Navigate to your school’s login screen, and compare the icons below for each login type:

![Screenshot of login method icons](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r4Qg)   
 

If you follow the steps below, you’ll be able to reset your password if you get locked out of Clever or your school’s Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID accounts. It’s like having a backup plan for logging in!

To set up your backup method (if your school has this option), go to your Student Portal.

1.  Click on your name in the top right so you can choose **Account recovery** from the menu. If you do not see the **Account recovery** option, your school has not given permission for you to set up an account recovery option.   
      
    ![Account recovery example screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkZHF)    
      
    
2.  Click on **Set up recovery methods.** What options you see will depend on what your school has set up for you.   
      
    ![Example account recovery methods](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008qsZC)   
      
    
3.  Choose a recovery method and input the information.
4.  Depending on which recovery method you pick, you'll see instructions on what to do next.

It’s also possible that your school may have provided a recovery method for you using information in their records. For example, if you give your school your cellphone number, they may set up SMS as your account recovery option. If you’d like to update the information your school organization provides, you can do so using the recovery method setup described above.

* * *

## Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page

Now that you’ve set up your recovery method, you can use it to get back into your Clever, Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID accounts if you ever get locked out.

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:**

1.  From the Clever login screen, click on **get help logging in.  
    ** **![Get help logging in](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r7Uz)**
2.  Choose **Reset your account passwords.  
      
    ![Reset your account passwords](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkaLN)**  
3.  Input your school organization email address (not your recovery email). This should not be a personal email like [student@gmail.com](mailto:student@gmail.com), [student@hotmail.com](mailto:student@hotmail.com), [student@icloud.com](mailto:student@icloud.com) etc.  
      
    ![Account recovery page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r8E9)   
      
    
4.  You’ll be prompted to confirm your identity using a method you set up in your Portal settings.  
    ![Choose authentication method to confirm identity](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r4fC)   
      
    
5.  Now you can set up a new password for your account. Just type in a new password. If your school has any rules for passwords, you can check them by clicking **See requirements**. When you’re done, you can use your new password to log into your accounts.  
    ![Set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r8dx)   
      
    

### **To reset only your Clever password:**

1.  Select **Get help logging in!** to reset your password using the email address linked to your school organization's Clever account.   
    **![Get help logging in](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r7Uz)**
2.  Choose **Reset only your Clever password  
    ![Screenshot of Reset only your Clever Password option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ekb7l)** 
3.  Enter the email that you signed up with to receive password reset instructions, and click **Send**.  
    ![Recover account screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkbVx) 
4.  You'll receive an email with a link to reset your password. If you do not receive the email, please check your spam folder.

* * *

## Resetting your password in the Clever Portal

Alternatively, if you can get logged into your Student Portal and want to change your passwords (like if you accidentally shared your password with a friend), you can do it in your Portal. To reset your password in your Clever Portal:

1.  Click on your name in the top right corner, then choose **Set new password.** You don't need to use the recovery method for this.  
    ![Set new password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkVDf)
2.  Input your updated password and click **Set new password**. That’s it, you’re done!  
    ![Screen to set new password for Google and Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkNfu) 

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c7q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkcYT)   Please note:** Updating your password in Clever may also update your Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID passwords as well. Check in with your teacher if you are not sure what your password is!

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What if I can’t log in to Clever?**

-   If you’ve forgotten your username or aren’t sure how to reset your password, please reach out to your teacher for help.
    

**What if I don’t see the option for account recovery in my Clever Portal?**

-   Your school has not set up account recovery via Clever at this time. If you need to reset a password, please contact your teacher for help.
    

**What if I don’t have the option to change my password in my Clever Portal?**

-   Your school has not set up password reset via Clever at this time. If you need to reset a password, please contact your teacher for help.
    

**What are the password reset requirements?**

-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307)

title: Clever IDM: Account recovery and password reset
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001662#header1)  
2\. [Enabling account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001662#header2)  
3\. [Resetting all user passwords in bulk](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001662#header4)  
4\. [End user experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001662#header3)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001662#header6)

## Overview

This article overviews the account recovery and password reset functionality available through Clever IDM for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID. If you are not currently utilizing Clever IDM, you cannot configure account recovery and password reset through Clever for these identity providers (IdPs). If you’d like to learn more about Clever IDM, please see our article, [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466).

* * *

## Enabling account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID

 **![Pencil icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eOGX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r06v) Please note:** A small number of school organizations are using this feature with a slightly different user interface. The product works similarly, but screenshots and steps might differ slightly.

To enable this feature, navigate via [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Password Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/passwordsettings), click on **Enable Reset**, and then follow the prompts outlined below.

![Password Settings tab in Clever Dashboard showing the Enable Reset button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eOGX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008qrre)

1.  **Select Identity Providers**
    -   This step is where you’ll choose the destinations that users can reset passwords for – Active Directory, Microsoft Entra, Google. For Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google, only the destinations with an active connection via IDM will be available.
2.  **Select user groups**
    -   Choose for each user type (students, teachers, and staff) who will have permissions to reset their own passwords.
        
    -   For students and teachers, you can set up **Delegated Password Reset** to allow School Tech Leads and District Help Desk staff to change these user’s passwords.
        
    -   For students, you can either allow all students to reset passwords or allow students in certain grades and schools to reset their own passwords.  
          
        ![Image of custom student password reset group](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eOGX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r3Kv)  
        
3.  **Student configuration (if selected user group)**
    -   **Password**
        -   **Use Clever's recommendations:** Students will be required to use long, easy-to-remember passwords that have a minimum length of 8 characters.
        -   **Configure your own password complexity requirements**: Designate minimum and maximum password lengths, and check off requirements for use of lower case letter, upper case letter, number (0-9), symbol (e.g. !@#$%^&\*).
    -   **Settings**
        -   Check settings to:
            -   Confirm students cannot reuse their previous passwords
            -   Confirm students cannot use passwords commonly found in public data breaches.
            -   Show helper text (Clever will display a hint provided by you for end users when they create a new password. Ex: Must be ten characters with upper and lower case letters).
    -   **Account recovery methods**
        -   Select your recovery method(s): SMS, Email, or Security Questions.  
            If your schools use Classroom MFA, and SMS or voice calls are used as MFA methods in one of your school organization's MFA policies, SMS can’t be selected as a recovery method.  
              
            If you select SMS or email as an account recovery method, you’ll also have the option to choose a Clever field as the default for account recovery. For example, if you select email as the account recovery option, you can use an [extension field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) with the student’s personal email addresses as the default for student account recovery. Users can update the account recovery SMS number or email later. However, selecting a bulk field ensures that users have at least one recovery method defined without relying on the end user to configure it. The automatic account recovery information will stay up-to-date if the data in the Clever field changes.  
              
            If you select Email as a recovery method, you’ll also have the option to block users from using a specific domain for email recovery. Please include all domains you’d like to block on the initial setup. Adding additional domains after setup will remove users who previously set up a recovery email with that domain from receiving reset emails.  
              
            An example of a domain you may wish to block is your Google Workspace domain if your users use Google credentials for SSO to access Clever. Suppose your users have forgotten their Google password when logging into Clever. They’ll also have forgotten their Google password for email, which means they can't access the recovery email sent if they use their school Google account as their recovery email. Blocking this domain can help prevent users from using an email they won't have access to for recovery.  
            
4.  **Teacher configuration (if selected user group)**
    -   **Password**
        -   **Use Clever's recommendations:** Teachers will be required to use long, easy-to-remember passwords that have a minimum length of 8 characters.
        -   **Configure your own password complexity requirements**: Designate minimum and maximum password lengths, and check off requirements for use of lower case letter, upper case letter, number (0-9), symbol (e.g. !@#$%^&\*).
    -   **Settings**
        -   Check settings to:
            -   Confirm teachers cannot reuse their previous passwords
            -   Confirm teachers cannot use passwords commonly found in public data breaches.
            -   Show helper text (Clever will display a hint provided by you for end users when they create a new password. Ex: Must be ten characters with upper and lower case letters).
    -   **Account recovery methods**
        -   Select your recovery method(s): SMS, Email, or Security Questions.
            -   If your schools use Classroom MFA, and SMS or voice calls are used as MFA methods in one of your school organization's MFA policies, SMS can’t be selected as a recovery method.
            -   If you select SMS or email as an account recovery method, you’ll also have the option to choose a Clever field as the default for account recovery. For example, if you select email as the account recovery option, you can use an [extension field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) with the student’s personal email addresses as the default for student account recovery. Users can update the account recovery SMS number or email later. However, selecting a bulk field ensures that users have at least one recovery method defined without relying on the end user to configure it. The automatic account recovery information will stay up-to-date if the data in the Clever field changes.
            -   If you select Email as a recovery method, you’ll also have the option to block users from using a specific domain for email recovery. Please include all domains you’d like to block on the initial setup. Adding additional domains after setup will remove users who previously set up a recovery email with that domain from receiving reset emails.  
                An example of a domain you may wish to block is your Google Workspace domain if your users use Google credentials for SSO to access Clever. Suppose your users have forgotten their Google password when logging into Clever. They’ll also have forgotten their Google password for email, which means they can't access the recovery email sent if they use their school Google account as their recovery email. Blocking this domain can help prevent users from using an email they won't have access to for recovery.  
                
5.  **Staff configuration (if selected as a user group)**
    -   **Password**
        -   **Use Clever's recommendations:** Staff will be required to use long, easy-to-remember passwords that have a minimum length of 8 characters.
        -   **Configure your own password complexity requirements**: Designate minimum and maximum password lengths, and check off requirements for use of lower case letter, upper case letter, number (0-9), symbol (e.g. !@#$%^&\*).
    -   **Settings**
        -   Check settings to:
            -   Confirm staff cannot reuse their previous passwords
            -   Confirm staff cannot use passwords commonly found in public data breaches.
            -   Show helper text (Clever will display a hint provided by you for end users when they create a new password. Ex: Must be ten characters with upper and lower case letters).
    -   **Account recovery methods**
        -   Select your recovery method(s): SMS, Email, or Security Questions.  
            If your schools use Classroom MFA, and SMS or voice calls are used as MFA methods in one of your school organization's MFA policies, SMS can’t be selected as a recovery method.  
              
            If you select SMS or email as an account recovery method, you’ll also have the option to choose a Clever field as the default for account recovery. For example, if you select email as the account recovery option, you can use an [extension field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) with the student’s personal email addresses as the default for student account recovery. Users can update the account recovery SMS number or email later. However, selecting a bulk field ensures that users have at least one recovery method defined without relying on the end user to configure it. The automatic account recovery information will stay up-to-date if the data in the Clever field changes.  
              
            If you select Email as a recovery method, you’ll also have the option to block users from using a specific domain for email recovery. Please include all domains you’d like to block on the initial setup. Adding additional domains after setup will remove users who previously set up a recovery email with that domain from receiving reset emails.  
            An example of a domain you may wish to block is your Google Workspace domain if your users use Google credentials for SSO to access Clever. Suppose your users have forgotten their Google password when logging into Clever. They’ll also have forgotten their Google password for email, which means they can't access the recovery email sent if they use their school Google account as their recovery email. Blocking this domain can help prevent users from using an email they won't have access to for recovery.
6.  **Preview**
    -   Review a summary of settings configured for each user type. To edit your setup, return to the configuration step in the sidebar. To complete your setup, click **Save**.

![Example of staff preview/save](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eOGX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008r34n)

For a video tutorial of the setup steps, see below:

##   

* * *

## Resetting all user passwords in bulk

Through the password reset settings described above, you have the option to enable self-service password resets for end users, or to delegate which user types can reset other user’s passwords (e.g., teachers can reset students’ passwords), but these settings only allow for individual password resets.

Clever also supports the ability to bulk-reset passwords. To do so, please contact the Clever Support team by clicking the blue chatbox in the bottom right corner and following the prompts.

Our team can reset passwords in bulk for an entire user group (e.g., all students) or filtered down to a subset of a user group (e.g., students in a specific school). They are also completed per destination, meaning that if you manage both Google and Active Directory via Clever IDM, our team can reset just your Google passwords, Active Directory, or both destinations.

When contacting our team, please let them know:

1.  Which destinations you’d like to reset passwords for
    
2.  Which user types (teachers, students, staff)
    
3.  Any subsets of those user types (ex: students in grades 9-12)
    
4.  When the reset should occur
    

Our support team will follow up with any questions and work with you to ensure the password reset is applied as you requested!

* * *

## End user experience

Depending on the settings you configure for account recovery and password reset, students, teachers, and staff will have similar experiences for resetting passwords and recovering accounts.

The video below shows a sample of the password reset flow with Google for a student:

##   

If you’d like to provide guides to your end users on this feature and the setup, please refer to our articles below:

-   [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307)
    
-   [For Students: Password recovery and resets](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663)
    
-   [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)
    
-   [For School Tech Leads: Account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026004792)
    

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**What are Clever’s recommended password settings?**

-   Long, easy-to-remember passwords that have a minimum length of 8 characters for students, and 10 characters for teachers or staff.
    

**Is password reset available to every school organization?**

-   Password reset is available to school organizations utilizing Clever IDM with Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID. Password reset is also available to school organizations using Clever Passwords as a login method.
    

**What are some times when a school may wish to bulk reset user passwords?**

-   Below are some potential times when a school may wish to bulk reset passwords:
    
    -   During an extended school break when users may forget their passwords.
        
    -   When setting up Clever IDM to bring all password management into Clever so that teachers and help desk users can assist with password management.
        
    -   When setting up Clever IDM to synchronize multiple or all destination passwords.
        
    -   On a set schedule, if this may benefit your cybersecurity, for example, at the beginning of a new school year, or every X months.
        

**What are the password reset requirements?**

-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613)
    
-   [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307)

-   [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)
