title: Single Sign-on (SSO): Setting up Clever Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever as an SSO Profile in Google
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#Overview)  
2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#Setup)  
        _•_   [Configuring SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#ConfiguringSSO)  
        _•_   [Configuring OU targeting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#ConfigureOUtargeting)  
        _•_   [Testing on the Web](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#TestingontheWeb)  
        _•_   [Google settings for users and devices](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#AdditionalGoogleSettings)  
        _•_   [Testing on a Chromebook](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#TestingonChromebook)  
3\. [Known issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#KnownIssues)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#faqs)

## Overview

Clever works seamlessly with Chromebooks, providing students and teachers with access to all their learning applications while only logging in once per device. This means students are logged into their Chromebook, into Clever, and into any applications that the student has access to.

Google supports configuring other identity providers (IdPs) within the Google Admin Console. This article covers configuring Clever as an individual SSO Profile in Google.

  

Advantages of the SSO Profile configuration:

-   Students can use their Clever Badge for all Google sign-ins, not just school organization-managed Chromebooks.
    
-   The school organization can set up different SSO providers for various user groups (e.g., Clever for student Badge users, Entra ID for staff).
    
-   The SSO Profile configuration can target specific devices, so the Badge prompt only shows by default on the desired devices.
    

* * *

## Setup

The setup process has several parts, so please set aside roughly two hours to work through it. Please follow the instructions listed carefully to ensure proper configuration, and test it after setup!

##   
Part 1: Configuring SSO

1.  In your Clever Dashboard, go to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges > Chromebook tab](https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook). If you haven't already, add the Chromebook Login for SSO Profiles application to your Clever account by clicking the **Add application** button. The button will only show if you haven't added the application already.  
      
    ![Add application button for Chromebook Login for SSO Profiles](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OPi6T) 
    
    1.  Adding the application automatically shares it with all users in your schools. Clever recommends sharing the app with all users, even if they aren’t going to use Badges into Chromebooks. This way, if you ever expand Badges into Chromebook settings, you won’t need to adjust sharing. The app won’t be visible in the teacher and student Clever Portals.
        
    2.  Users won’t be able to log into Chromebooks with this app until you’ve configured the settings in Google Admin Console. You’ll configure these settings later in this article.
        
2.  Log into Google Admin Console and go to the [SSO with third party IdP](https://admin.google.com/ac/security/sso) settings page.
    
3.  Under the **Third-party SSO profiles** section, click **Add SAML Profile**.  
      
    ![Add SAML profile button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OPeZ8)   
      
    
4.  Copy the following information from the [Authentication > Badges > Chromebook tab](https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook) in your Clever Dashboard to the Google Admin Console SAML profile form:  
    1.  **SSO profile name:** “Clever - Badges” or any name of your choice. This won't be seen by end-users
    2.  **IdP entity ID**: paste the **IdP Entity ID**
    3.  **Sign-in page URL:** paste the **Sign-in page URL**
        -   If you want all users to log in to Chromebooks exclusively using Badges, you can add **?specify\_auth=badges** to the end of this value. This will make the Clever Badge camera the first screen the user sees upon opening the Chromebook.
    4.  **Sign-out page URL**: leave blank
    5.  **Change password URL**: leave blank, because Badges don’t use a password
    6.  **Certificate:** Download the verification certificate from your Clever Dashboard, then click **Upload Certificate** to upload it. The certificate file downloaded from Clever will be a .crt file. Google’s UI says that the file must be PEM or DER, but .crt will be accepted
    7.  Click **Save**  
          
        
5.   On the next page, note the **Entity ID** and **ACS URL** listed under **SP details**. You will need these in the next step.
6.  In the Configure SSO in Clever section (on the [Authentication > Badges > Chromebook tab](https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook)), paste the values from Google Admin Console:
    1.  **Entity ID:** paste the “Entity ID” noted in step six from Google’s SP details
    2.  **ACS URL:** paste the “ACS URL” noted in step six from Google’s SP details  
        
          ![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OPp4j)  **Please note:** Make sure the Entity ID and ACS URL are entered in the correct fields. They look very similar, and it’s easy to mix them up! The ACS URL should include “/acs”.
        
7.  _Optional_ If you utilize Clever Passwords and your Clever Passwords username matches your Google username, you have the option to configure settings to pre-populate usernames for your users on the Clever login page. To do so, check the box next to the **Send email address in the URL as the** _**login hint**_ **parameter** setting.
    
    ![Login hint settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iQSyb)  
    
      
    

* * *

## Part 2: Configuring OU targeting

Setting up OU targeting lets you determine who should be using Badges into Chromebooks. For example, first and second grade students or those who have IEPs. 

First, ensure that you have one or more [Organizational Units](https://admin.google.com/ac/orgunits) in Google containing the **users and devices** that should have access to the Badges into Chromebooks feature.

1.  Return to the [SSO with third-party IdP settings page](https://admin.google.com/ac/security/sso) in the Google Admin Console and scroll down to the **Manage SSO profile assignments** section. 
2.  Click **Get started** if you’ve never set up an SSO assignment or **Manage** if you have. 

If you’ve never set up an SSO assignment, click on **GET STARTED.**

![2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004ltzf)

If you already have SSO assignments set up, click on **MANAGE.**

![3.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004ldIB)

3.  In the sidebar, find the Organizational Unit or individual users for whom you want to use this feature. Then, in the main window, select **Another SSO profile,** and in the dropdown select the Clever profile created in Part 1. We recommended naming it “Clever - Badges.” This won't be seen by end users.

![SSO with third-party providers (IDPs) screen in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IIE8b)

_In this screenshot, we’ve selected the Students OU. You might select an OU based on user, grade, etc. based on how you’ve structured your Organizational Units._

4.  In the **Select what happens if users go directly to a Google service without first signing in with this SSO profile's third-party IDP section**, you may select either option depending on the user experience that works best for your school organization: 
    

![Manage SSO profile assignments screen in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IIF7t)

1.  -   **Have Google prompt for their username, then redirect them to this profile's IDP sign-in page:** Select this option if users should always use Clever to sign in to Google, including sign-ins on browsers and unmanaged devices (Recommended for most setups).
    -   **Require users to enter their Google username and password to sign in:** Select this if users should only use Clever to sign in to Google when initially logging in to a managed Chromebook device or if users should have the option to log into managed devices with either Badges or Google credentials.  
          
        Users will have to use their Google username and password to sign in to Google on browsers, non-Chromebook devices, and unmanaged Chromebooks. Choose this option if you're having issues with logins on some devices. If you have questions, please [contact our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326).

5.  Repeat for any other user or device OUs that should use the Badges into Chromebooks experience. For the best user experience, you should target both users AND their devices. Targeting the device as well as the user will cause Clever Badges to be the default login method. Otherwise, users must first type in their Google email address for Google to recognize that they are in a targeted OU.
    

* * *

## Part 3: Testing on the Web (optional)

If you selected the **Have Google prompt for their username, then redirect them to this profile's IDP sign-in page** setting in [step four of the Configure OU targeting section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#ou-targeting), you can test on the Web without a Chromebook device. 

If you selected **Require users to enter their Google username and password to sign in**, skip this part and proceed to [Part 4: Google Settings for users and devices](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#AdditionalGoogleSettings).

To test on the web you'll need:

-   A Google user in one of the targeted OUs
    
-   A Clever account whose email matches the Google user
    
-   A Badge for this Clever account
    

Here's what to do:

1.  In an Incognito or Private browser window, go to [accounts.google.com](https://accounts.google.com/) and enter the email address for the Google user account. You should be redirected to Clever to sign-in.
2.  Follow the Clever prompts to scan your Badge. You should be authenticated with Clever and then signed in to the Google account.
3.  Note that it may take some time for Clever and Google to each process their various authorizations to allow your user(s) to use SSO. If the login doesn’t work the first time, try again in a few minutes. If it still isn’t working, please review the steps above or [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326).

* * *

## Part 4: Google Settings for users and devices

In this section, you'll update your Google user and device settings to enable:

-   Clever to access the device camera on the login screen
    
-   Re-prompt for a Badge after the device is reopened after being closed
    
-   Sign the user into Clever automatically when they sign in to the device
    

### See below for written instructions, a video guide, or click here for a [step-by-step clickable tutorial](https://ior.ad/aQKj) of the setup!

##   

1.  Navigate to [Devices > Chrome > Settings](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/chrome/settings/user). In the search bar, type in “lock screen.”
    

![Lock screen section in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IHsOE)

2.  Set Lock Screen settings to: **Do not allow locking screen**. You can target this to specific OU(s) as well, if you only want this to apply to students using Badges.  
    ![4.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lw7u)
    
3.  Search for Single sign-on.
    
    ![Single sign-on option in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IIInJ)
    
4.  Set Single sign-on to **Enable SAML-based single sign on for Chrome devices**.  
    ![Enable SAML-based single sign-on for Chrome devices](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IIGn8) 
    
5.  Search SAML single sign-on login frequency. 
    

![Login frequency option in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IHqpT)

6.  Set SAML single sign-on login frequency to an appropriate duration. We recommend **Every 2 weeks** for the best experience.

![6.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lqTu)

7.  Search Idle settings and click **Idle settings**.
    

![Idle settings feature in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IJPJh)

8.  Set the following Idle settings as follows. This ensures that students aren’t prompted for a local password if the device locks.
    
    -   Set Action on lid close to **Logout** If your school organization is 1:1, you can change these idle settings to **Sleep**. 
        
    -   Set Lock screen on sleep to **Don't lock screen**
        
    -   Set AC idle action to **Logout**
        
    -   Set Battery idle action to **Logout**
        

![7.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004m0LB)

9.  Next, scroll down to the Startup section further down on the same page
    
10.  Change the Homepage configuration to **Homepage is always the URL set below**. Set your Homepage URL to your Clever Portal URL provided in your SSO & Portal > Badges> Chromebook page, or [you can find your Clever Portal URL here](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url).

![8.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lxok)

11.  Add your school organization's Clever Portal URL under the **Pages to load on Startup** settings

![Pages to load on startup settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000UJ6bV)

12.  Click the [Device settings](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/chrome/settings/device) tab at the top of the settings panel and scroll down to Sign-in settings.  
     ![9.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004m0eX)
13.  Set Guest Mode to **Disable guest mode**.  
     ![Guest mode screen in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IImex) 
     
14.  Set Sign-in Screen to **Never show user names and photos**.  
     ![11.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004llXV)
     
15.  Set Single Sign-On IdP Redirection to **Allow users to go directly to SAML SSO IdP page**.  
     ![Single sign-on IdP redirection](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IJ2i5)
16.  Set Single Sign-On Cookie Behavior to **Enable transfer of SAML SSO Cookies into user session**. This ensures a user is signed into both their Chromebook device and into Clever in the Chrome browser, saving students time.  
     ![Single sign-on cookie behavior](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Hvcmk)
17.  Enter **[https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login](https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login)** under Single sign-on camera permissions. These settings ensure that Clever has access to your Chromebooks' cameras to validate Clever Badge logins  
     ![Single sign-on camera permissions screen in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IJ3cX)
18.  Scroll down to Kiosk Settings and ensure that Managed guest session is set to **Do not allow managed guest sessions**  
     ![Managed guest sessions in Google Workspace](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drdx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IJNg5) 

* * *

## Part 5: Testing on Chromebook

To test on a Chromebook you'll need:

-   A Google user in one of the targeted OUs
    
-   A Chromebook device from a targeted OU
    
-   A Clever student account whose email matches the Google user
    
-   A Badge for this Clever student account
    

To test the login:

1.  Power on the device.
2.  When prompted, present the Badge.
3.  You should now be authenticated and logged into ChromeOS.

If you do not see the Clever login screen, double-check your OU targeting from [Part 2](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645#ConfigureOUtargeting).

If everything seems correct and you still don’t see the Clever login screen, restart the device. The device must be connected to the Internet, and SSO settings may take some time to apply. Depending on your configuration, you may need to first enter the Google email address of a user in the SSO target OU.

If you’re still not seeing a Clever login screen, please [contact Clever Support.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)

* * *

## Known Issues

**Badge scan looping or not logging in**

Users may experience issues logging in when SSO is enabled and the **Require password change** is set to ON on the Security tab of their user account in the Google Admin Console. This issue is due to a problem in how Google handles this situation - they are waiting for a password change that never happens since the user utilizes SSO to sign in. To workaround this, turn off **Require password change** for any SSO users.

**Multiple SSO Profiles**

If you have multiple SSO profiles in your school org (e.g., Clever and ADFS), then you should set the **Domain-specific service URLs** setting to **Require users to enter their username on Google’s sign-in page first**. Any other setting could cause issues for users signing in with specific SSO profiles.

**iPad and iPhone**

Users may encounter unexpected behavior when the **Have Google prompt for their username, then redirect them to this profile's IdP sign-in page** setting is enabled **and** if they are signing in to a native iOS application using Google on an iPad or iPhone with the Clever app installed. The initial login attempt will fail to redirect them to their target application, and they will have to retry the login again. If users frequently sign in to iOS applications with Google on shared iPads, consider switching this setting to **Require users to enter their Google username and password to sign in**.

* * *

## FAQs

**What is the best way to use Google applications (Docs, Sheets, Drive, etc.) through Clever?**

-   If you set up Clever as an IdP for Google, please see our article [Adding Google SSO applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001597) to provide the best login experience for all Google applications (drive, docs, sheets, etc.).
    

**What are the advantages of using Clever as an SSO Profile instead of the organization-wide SSO provider?**

-   Students will be able to use their Clever Badge for all Google sign ins, not just school organization-managed Chromebooks
    
-   The school organization can set up different SSO providers for different user groups (e.g. Clever for student Badge users, Entra ID for staff)
    
-   The SSO can be targeted to specific devices so that the Badge prompt is only shown by default on desired devices
    

**Why would I set up Clever as the organization-wide SSO Provider instead of an SSO Profile?**

-   Setting up Clever as the organization-wide SSO Provider is the standard configuration for setting up Chromebook logins. This setup is significantly easier since there are fewer settings to apply, and is recommended for admins less familiar with the Google Admin Console. For more information, please see [this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541)
    

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Setting up Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever via the Legacy setup in Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541)

title: Sync or SIS Conversion: Notifying applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001644#header1)  
2\. [Why is app notification important?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001644#header2)  
3\. [The district’s role](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001644#header3)  
4\. [Clever's role](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001644#header4)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001644#header5)

## Overview

If you’re switching sync types or student information systems (SISs) and/or changing sis\_ids, notifying applications is one of the most critical parts in ensuring that historical data is preserved for students and teachers in the application’s platform. In fact, this piece takes up the bulk of the timeframe during a sync or SIS conversion as we work with your applications to ensure a smooth transition!  
 

* * *

## Why is app notification important?

Our system generates unique Clever IDs for each record based on the sis\_id that we receive from the district. If student\_ids, teacher\_ids, staff\_ids, or school\_ids change in Clever, the Clever ID will also change. 

Changing user records in this way can cause issues in Clever and connected applications because many of our application partners use the Clever ID as the key identifier in their platform to manage records and preserve historical data. As such, we must notify the application support teams and give them a heads-up! This notification allows the applications to make any necessary changes needed to ingest the new data.  
 

* * *

## The district's role

Before starting a sync or SIS conversion in Clever, we recommend that districts proactively reach out to all SSO, Rostering applications that they’re connected with in Clever to make them aware of the upcoming changes to the data. This helps to expedite the conversion process and ensures that everyone is on the same page. **Here are a few things to keep in mind when reaching out to the applications:**

1.  The _tentative_ date you plan to start the sync or SIS conversion in Clever.
2.  Which SIS data fields will change (eg. student\_id, teacher\_number, email\_address, etc)?
3.  Confirm what key identifier the application uses to manage records and preserve historical data (eg. Clever ID, state\_id, teacher\_id, email\_address, etc).
4.  Does the application have to _match_ the data on their end prior to the sync conversion? Or will they need to ingest the new data first and then match it?
5.  Will the application need anything from the district or Clever, such as a crosswalk file of the data changes?
6.  Advise the application that you'll [pause the app sync in the Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607) until they confirm that everything is good to go within the application. Request that the application notify you directly once it’s okay to resume the app sync from Clever. 

![Screenshot of App sync pause feature, with highlight pointing to the on button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjOL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004YzgH)

  
 

* * *

## Clever’s role

The Clever team will contact some applications but not all! Our main goal is to contact SSO & rostering applications that use Clever IDs or SIS IDs as key identifiers. 

However, there are some applications that use other SIS fields (eg. student\_number, email\_address, etc.) to preserve data that would also need to be notified, and this is where the district comes in. The district would ultimately be responsible for informing all SSO & rostering applications of the pending changes in Clever.  
 

* * *

## FAQs

**Is there a list of applications that should be notified?**

-   Unfortunately, we don't have a comprehensive list! As such, we recommend notifying all SSO & rostering applications that you’re currently connected with in Clever.

**When should I start reaching out to the applications?**

-   The sooner, the better! We recommend reaching out at least a week in advance of starting the sync conversion process with Clever. 

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Pause your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001607)
-   [Secure Sync: Sync or SIS ID conversions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001566)

title: For Clever Admins: Tasks
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001642#header1)  
2\. [What are tasks?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001642#header2)  
3\. [Using tasks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001642#using-tasks)  
4\. [Dismissing tasks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001642#header3)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001642#header4)

## Overview

Over the school year, there are a variety of actions for you to take as a Clever Admin to ensure Clever works smoothly for you and your school organization.

  
Tasks help you keep track of everything: from prepping for summer school, to addressing data errors and everything in between.

* * *

## What are tasks?

Tasks highlight opportunities, issues, and errors that need attention, connecting you to resources you need and surfacing new features. With tasks, you have one more layer of support to ensure you're getting the most out of Clever.

![Clever Dashboard tasks / awaiting your action](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dz0P&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WQQnd)

In addition to tasks created by Clever, District Curriculum Leads can create a task to remind Clever Admin to accept any pending application invitations.

* * *

## Using tasks

Think of tasks as your Clever to-do list. They're there to remind you of important actions and other information.

For example, if there's an issue with your sync, you might see a task suggesting you take action to fix the issue.

Or, if a new feature has launched that might make your life easier, you might see a task encouraging you to check it out.

Consider logging in to Clever regularly to check for any new tasks to keep your Clever account in tip-top shape.

* * *

## Dismissing tasks

If there's a task that's not relevant to you, you can dismiss it by clicking the X to the right of the task.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Who else in my school organization sees tasks?**

-   All users with the role of [Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038) see tasks. District Curriculum Lead and District Help Desk users don't see tasks.

**Does a task go away for everyone if I dismiss it?**

-   No, it only goes away for you!

title: Clever + i-Ready: Setup guide & rollover process
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001641#header1) 2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001641#header2) 3\. [Recommended sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001641#header3) 4\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001641#required) 5\. [School year rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001641#header4) 6\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001641#header5) ## Overview This article contains information to help your school district set up with Clever and i-Ready. You can also review the i-Ready rollover process to help you prepare for Back to School season.    * * * ## Setup process - Make sure your school district is set up with Clever!  - If your school district hasn’t been set up with Clever, you can get started [here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup). - If your school district is already using Clever, you can add i-Ready by following these instructions: 1. 1. Log into your Clever Dashboard and navigate to [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add). 2. Search for i-Ready and click on it when it appears in the list. 3. You’ll then be brought to a page where you can request the application. When requesting i-Ready, select whether or not you have made a purchase. 4. You can then opt to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever. 5. On the right side of the page, you can view the fields required by i-Ready. 6. When you have made your selections, click Send integration request. Once requested, please reach out to i-Ready’s Roster Support team at [rosters-support@cainc.com](mailto:rosters-support@cainc.com) or your i-Ready Partner Success Manager to let them know you are ready to sync via Clever. _Data will not automatically sync to i-Ready as backend setup work is needed to provide your district access. Their team will help you get started!_   * * * ## Recommended sharing rules i-Ready recommends that you share data by school. The simplest way is to set up your sharing using [**Share by Rules**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247?language=en_US) in Clever. You can create a sharing rule by following these steps: 1. Set up your sharing rules: 1. If you are setting up sharing rules for i-Ready for the first time, please follow these instructions: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing data with new applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712). 2. If you need to edit existing rules, please follow these instructions: [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). 2. Configure your sharing rules by limiting sharing to only the schools and students that should be synced. - - Once i-Ready receives your data, they will have an additional filtering process.  Once you've shared data with i-Ready in Clever, you'll need to work with i-Ready to finish your sync. i-Ready’s rostering team will guide you through this process. IMPORTANT Once you have spoken with i-Ready’s rostering team and your data is received by the i-Ready team, setup may take 5-10 business days, depending on the time of year. * * * ## Required fields Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields.  ![Screenshot of i-Ready app setup page in Clever, with Data Quality tab highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003DC1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004SkyU) ### i-Ready requires the following data fields: **Student Fields:**  - first and last name - district - school - sis\_id and student\_number - State ID - DOB - Grade (0-12) - Class enrollments -  In order to log in to i-Ready, students need to be enrolled in a class that is shared with i-Ready.  **Staff fields:**  - First and last name - district - school(s) - sis\_id - Email - Class enrollments (for teacher role) - State ID **Section fields:**  - School ID - Section ID - Name i-Ready can sync site/school district-level administrators from Clever to i-Ready.  If your district selects this option, the following Clever Staff roles translate to the following i-Ready roles: 

Clever Role

i-Ready Role

Clever Admin i-Ready District Admin
Clever Help Deski-Ready District Admin
Clever District Curriculum Lead i-Ready District Admin
Clever School Tech Leadi-Ready School Admin
Clever Portal Access (Staff role)i-Ready School Admin
Unsure of what role a user should be in Clever? Check out this article for more information: [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726). * * * ## School year rollover ### Summer usage, i-Ready account rollover processes & preparation In addition to Clever’s Rollover processes, which are linked [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886?language=en_US), _i-Ready_ also has its own account rollover process.  - At the end of the district’s school year, _i-Ready_ pauses nightly syncs through the summer unless otherwise discussed with the school district.  - If you would like to continue syncing for Summer School, you must contact the _i-Ready_ team by emailing [rosters-support@cainc.com](mailto:rosters-support@cainc.com). - After the last day of school, _i-Ready_ will be accessible to users (as long as they are rostered in Clever) until the i-Ready Account Rollover, which typically occurs about two weeks before the start of the next school year.  - Don’t you know when your i-Ready Account Rollover will occur? Ask your district administrator, or if you are a district-level i-Ready administrator, follow [these steps](https://i-readycentral.com/pdfs/faq-leaders-how-can-i-prepare-for-the-i-ready-rollover/).  - In preparation for the new school year, please follow [Clever’s rollover processes](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886?language=en_US) to release your new academic year data. - _As a reminder, the sync hold needs to be released in Clever before i-Ready can receive your new year data._ After the i-Ready account rollover occurs, i-Ready is not accessible until the new school year data is shared with i-Ready and has been processed. Once data is shared with the i-Ready team, it can take up to five business days to get your account up and running for the next school year.    * * * ## FAQs **Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data error”?** - A data error occurs when the record is incompatible with i-Ready’s integration with Clever, resulting in the user or section not appearing in the application. Data errors must be resolved for users or sections in order to be successfully processed by the application. Reach out to Clever Support if you have questions about how to resolve your data error. - A data warning occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular data warning. - Please note that section name data warnings can be ignored for i-Ready.  **Why are student usernames inaccurate in i-Ready (e.g., an ‘AUTO\_’ username)?**  - My district’s students log in through a single sign-on (SSO) portal. - For school districts utilizing SSO, the “username” column in i-Ready has no functionality and can be ignored.  Teachers and Students should log in through their district portal by clicking the appropriate i-Ready tile or icon.   - My school district’s students log in directly through [https://login.i-ready.com/](https://login.i-ready.com/). - Suppose your district logs in directly through i-Ready, and a student needs their username corrected. In that case, a school or district administrator can update the username field by following these [linked steps](https://i-readycentral.com/faq/how-do-i-change-a-students-password/) in i-Ready Central.   **How can my district sync demographics from Clever to** **_i-Ready_****?** To see demographic reporting in the i-Ready Dashboard, you’ll need to sync demographic data via Clever by following these steps:   1. You’ll need to sync demographic data to Clever from your SIS or CSV file (depending on your sync type). 2. Once your data is in Clever, you’ll need to make sure it’s shared with i-Ready. In your Clever Dashboard, navigate to the Applications > My applications > i-Ready > Settings tab > scroll to the Field Access box. 3. Click on **Advanced Settings.** 4. Choose **Customize fields shared with i-Ready** (see a [how-to here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586) for instructions and screenshots) and click **Customize fields**. 5. Here, you can edit which fields are shared with the app. - Sensitive Student Information fields in Clever require an additional sharing step with i-Ready. Please see step-by-step instructions [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020926771).

Type of information

Clever field

i-Ready demographic field

Personal informationgendergender
raceethnicityId
hispanic_ethnicityhispanicOrLatino 
Sensitive student information ell_statusenglishLanguageLearner
iep_status specialEducation
frl_statuseconomicallyDisadvantaged
In addition to the fields above, i-Ready also offers extended demographics that vary by state. Please contact your i-Ready Partner Success Manager and/or [rosters-support@cainc.com](mailto:rosters-support@cainc.com) to learn about extension demographic fields for your state. A complete list of Clever demographics can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020926771?language=en_US). Please note that Hispanic/ Latino is not included in the values for **Race** in Clever and **EthnicityID** in i-Ready at this time. **Can students log in both via Clever SSO and the i-Ready website?** At this time, districts have the option to either utilize Clever SSO or log in directly via i-Ready.com. Currently, we don't support logging via both methods, you must choose one method.

title: Clever + VVAAS Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001640#header1) 2\. [Extension Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001640#header2) 3\. [SAS/VVAAS Roles for Single Sign-On](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001640#header3) 4\. [Standard Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001640#header4) 5\. [SAML Setup in your Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001640#header5) ## Overview Virginia’s Visualization and Analytics Solution (VVAAS) is a web-based tool available to all Virginia K-12 divisions. The VVAAS portal displays measures of students’ academic growth over time based on SOL testing data, diagnostic reports for student groups, and student projections to help educators improve student achievement and inform classroom instruction. Reports provided by VVAAS, in tandem with other data sources, can help educators make decisions regarding curriculum changes, identify and support long-term student goals, and help reveal trends of student groups needing additional support. This article covers the extension fields you will need to add to Clever for the VVAAS application (including user roles), the required standard fields, and the SAML setup steps to take within your Clever Dashboard. Please note, all users that need VVAAS access need accounts created (synced or manual) prior to the file upload.  All Clever Admins who need access to VVAAS will need a second Clever account. The account can be a "custom staff" or a "custom teacher". The Clever Admin will need to login from Clever.com and select from the drop-down Login as Teacher/Staff to access VVAAS in the Clever portal.   * * * ## Extension Fields Please add the following extension fields to your Clever rostering sync for each teacher and staff user who should have access to the VVAAS application. To learn how to add extension fields to your Clever sync, see: [For Clever Admins: Syncing custom (i.e. extension) fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912).

Description

 ext.additional_school_codes AdditionalSchoolCodesOne or more additional school codes separated by the “|” character.

For example, 160|3245|23

 ext.role RoleCode used to identify the account holder's role in the school division and determine what level of access is needed.

title: Clever + Verkada Guest Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001638#header1)  
2\. [Connect with Verkada via Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001638#header2)  
3\. [Initiating the Clever sync in Verkada Command](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001638#header3)

## Overview

Verkada supports rostering via Clever. District administrators can manage and update user and roster information in their SIS that syncs to Clever. Clever data syncs nightly with Verkada Guest to support the use of Student Guest types, including:

-   **Late Arrival** (tracking students who arrive to school late)
    
-   **Student Pick Up** (tracking when a student is picked up by their parent/guardian)
    
-   **Self sign-out** (tracking when a student leaves school early)  
     

* * *

## Connect with Verkada via Clever

Districts that are new to Clever can get started by signing up here. Clever is a free service for schools and districts! Existing Clever districts can request Verkada Guest from the Clever Dashboard. Log in to your administrator account and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add). Search Verkada Guest and click **Send integration request**:

![image3.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ssrt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003iQgE)

The Verkada team should reply to connection requests within 24 hours. 

  
Verkada Guest requires only student and student contact data to be shared via [Clever’s sharing settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US). For security and privacy, please only share data that is required for your district’s needs.

While in Clever, locate your unique district Clever ID from the Data browser. You’ll need to paste that ID in Verkada Command in the next step:

![image2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ssrt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003iMEQ)

  
 

* * *

## Initiating the Clever sync in Verkada Command

Follow these steps to complete the setup process:

1.  In Verkada Command, go to **All Products** > **Guest**. 
    
2.  In the left panel, click the **Guest Settings** icon
    
3.  Under **Organization,** select **Schools** to access the school settings.
    
4.  Select the **Sync students with Clever** option
    

![image1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ssrt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003iY5t)

5.  When prompted, enter your Clever district ID number.
    
6.  Assign a school from Clever to the corresponding school site in Verkada Guest. This links the school and the Guest site.
    

If you need assistance completing the setup process, please refer to the [Verkada Guest Overview](https://docs.verkada.com/docs/verkada-guest-overview.pdf) or [contact Verkada Support](https://help.verkada.com/en/).   

* * *

title: For Application Partners: Clever LMS Connect
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001636#header1)  
2\. [Features](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001636#header2)  
3\. [Viewing districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001636#header3)  
4\. [Learn More](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001636#header4)

## Overview

Clever offers application partners a solution that allows you to integrate with district LMSs easily via the Clever API. With Clever LMS Connect, districts can launch your application directly from their LMS using SSO while saving teachers time with gradebook syncs, and students jump into learning with seamless assignment syncs.  
  

![Graphic of Clever LMS Connect flow](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003fqc1)   
  

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** As seen in the graphic above, LMS Connect does **not** sync grades between the LMS and SIS, and vice versa. 

* * *

## Features

Clever LMS Connect connects your learning applications to district LMSs through the Clever API and is the easiest path to interoperability:

-   **Fast-track LMS integrations without overhauling your roadmap.**  
    Build on your existing Clever integration and be ready to support Canvas, Schoology, and Google Classroom in as little as 3-4 weeks.
-   **Sell confidently, knowing you can meet every district LMS requirement.**  
    Meet district RFP requirements for LTI 1.3, gradebook, and assignment syncs.
-   **Onboard schools quickly without data-matching headaches**  
    Clever LMS Connect will seamlessly match class and user data between your application and LMSs, so you don’t have to.

Application partners using Clever LMS Connect can also benefit from working with the Clever team to [create a Google add-on](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001728) for their application. Clever’s SSO powers the add-on and simplifies access to the application for students and teachers directly from Google Classroom.

View the video below to see the LMS Connect teacher and student experience. Please note that this demo is subject to change and is meant for illustrative purposes only.

##   

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** LMS Connect automatically syncs assignments and grades from applications to the district's LMS. However, if the district has cross-listed sections in their LMS, this functionality isn't currently available.

* * *

## Viewing districts

### Interested Districts

Districts can express their interest in using Clever LMS Connect with your learning application via their district’s Clever Dashboard. These requests can help you to track how many districts are interested in utilizing Clever LMS Connect with your learning application.

Within your Clever Dashboard, these requests will appear on your Home Page under the [District Overview](https://apps.clever.com/districts/overview).

**![Screenshot of where to find district requests in Application Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000007wFPG)**

### Clever LMS Connect Visibility

From your LMS Connect tab, you can view the status of Clever LMS Connect, as well as the Learning Management System (LMS), for any connected school district. Seeing this information upfront means your team knows which LMS a district is using and whether they've already connected to Clever LMS Connect before you request an invite.

To get there, go to:  [Clever Dashboard > Home > LMS Connect](https://apps.clever.com/districts/lms-connect).

![Example of view from LMS Connect tab with statuses](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000q0mLF)

Alternatively, you can view a specific district's Clever LMS Connect status from their profile page.

To get there, go to: Clever Dashboard > Home > click on district's name. 

![Example of what an application partner will see on a school organization's profile while setting up Clever LMS Connect](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000q0bL0)

A district may be labeled with one of the following statuses:

-   **Not set up** – The district has not yet configured an LMS with Clever.
    
-   **Setting up** – The district is in the process of configuring their LMS.
    
-   **Connected** – The district's LMS is connected and matched with Clever.
    
-   **Invited** – You have invited the district to connect their LMS but they haven't completed setup yet.
    

See below to learn more about integrating with Clever LMS Connect.

* * *

## Learn more

You’ll see a LMS Connect tab in your Clever Application Dashboard where you can schedule a call to get started:

![The app dashboard showing the LMS Connect page.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4Eb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003hEVp)  
  

If you're interested in utilizing Clever LMS Connect, you can also: 

1.  [Sign up for a call](https://www.getclever.com/lms-connect-contact/) to learn more and get a live demo of the experience in Google Classroom, Canvas, and Schoology.
2.  Review [developer documentation](https://dev.clever.com/docs/lms-connect-overview).
3.  Learn more in [Clever Academy.](https://clever.academy/ca-app-partners/1864717?reg=1&user_type=app_admin)

* * *

title: Clever + Great Minds® Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001626#header1) 2\. [Onboarding Steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001626#header2) 3\. [Required Data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001626#header3) 4\. [Accessing Great Minds via Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001626#header4) 5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001626#header5) ## Overview Great Minds supports Single Sign-On (SSO) and Rostering integrations with Clever. - **Single Sign-On (SSO)**: Users can access their Great Minds products anytime using their Clever login credentials. - **Rostering**:  District administrators can manage and update user and roster information in their SIS that syncs to Clever. Clever data syncs nightly with Great Minds.    * * * ## Onboarding Steps 1. Your Great Minds Digital Implementation Specialist will send you an invitation to our Great Minds Application via Clever. If you don’t see an invitation, you can send a request to our application. 2. When you accept the invitation, please share only schools and sections that will be utilizing Great Minds products. This can be done through [Clever sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). 3. Once you’ve launched your district and shared your data with Great Minds, their Digital Implementation Support team will complete your onboarding. 4. Your designated Digital Administrator will receive an email when your onboarding is complete. _**Note:** Users do not get an email once they have been rostered in Great Minds. Please distribute this information to the users in your organization._   * * * ##  Required Data Great Minds requires the following data from Clever to roster users in our digital platforms:

Required Field

Required Metadata

 District Name
 School Name

 Student

  • First Name
  • Last Name
  • Grade
  • District
  • School(s)
  • Student ID: Can contain alphanumeric characters and underscores only. Cannot contain spaces.

Teacher, School Admin, District Admin 

  • First Name
  • Last Name
  • Teacher/Staff ID (see sis_id, below)
  • Email: Can contain alphanumeric characters and the following supported characters only: + = , . @ and -. 
User sis_idssis_id maps to Student ID, Teacher ID, and Staff ID in Clever. sis_id's for users are required and must:
  • Be unique in your district for all user roles
  • Never be changed
  • Never be reused for different users
  • Only contain alphanumeric characters and underscores (no spaces)

If you need to change a user's sis_id or reuse a sis_id (not recommended), contact your Great Minds Digital Implementation Specialist to work with them to implement this change.

Sectiondistrict, school, name, grade, primary teacher, students

Each class is assigned a unique Section_id in Clever. The section_id must remain the same throughout the school year to avoid deleting existing sections and creating new sections in Clever and Great Minds. 

**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sriv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Data in Great Minds reflects the data synced from your SIS and shared via Clever. Historical data in Great Minds is retained through the persistence of local IDs (sis\_ids) that generate globally unique Clever IDs. _**Changing local IDs (sis\_ids) in your SIS will result in the deletion of existing records and the creation of new records in Clever and Great Minds.**_ To ensure that historical data is maintained in Great Minds throughout a given school year, districts are encouraged to use stable/consistent IDs for all records (student, section, teacher) that require data retention in Great Minds. If you anticipate sis\_ids changing throughout the school year, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/) to discuss the change. * * * ## Accessing Great Minds via Clever If your District uses Clever access to the Great Minds platform, you may log in using one of the following two options: **Option 1: Log in through the Clever website** 1. Choose your role. 2. Find your District. 3. Sign in using your Clever integration method (email or badge). 4. Locate and launch the Great Minds application. **Option 2: Log in through the Great Minds Digital website** 1. Navigate to [digital.greatminds.org](https://digital.greatminds.org/). 2. Select the Clever button. 3. Enter your School Name and select the correct school from the drop-down menu. 4. Enter your login credentials or select an alternate login method (e.g., Google) to access your account.    * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Does Great Minds support multi-role users?** - Yes. Great Minds supports multiple roles for staff users only (not students). Either using your SIS import or Custom Data through Clever, a user needs two roles and will need to be rostered as two separate users with the following information: - Each entry must have different sis\_ids. - Each entry needs to be the same email. - Each entry has different roles. - Each role should link to the same Clever User ID. **Can we access sync reports to help us correct any rostering/data errors?** - Yes. Clever sync reports can be accessed by administrators in the Manage application in their Great Minds account. See [Clever Sync Reports](https://digitalsupport.greatminds.org/s/article/Clever-Sync-Reports) on the Great Minds Help Center for more information. **Can I add users that are not in my rostering data source (SIS)?**  - Teachers and students must be in your rostering data source to appear in Great Minds. However, administrators can be created manually in Great Minds if necessary. [Contact the Great Minds Support Team](https://digitalsupport.greatminds.org/s/contactsupport) for more information.  **How can support staff (e.g., coaches) access Great Minds?** - See [Custom data: Non-teaching staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) for more information on adding non-teaching staff in Clever. By default, custom staff are assigned a Portal Access Only role in Clever, which means they will only have access to the applications that have been shared with them on a district level. * * * **Related articles:** - [Sharing Permissions: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) - [Custom data: Non-teaching staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) - [For Staff: School Tech Lead vs. Portal Only Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772)   * * *

title: For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#header1)  
2\. [Getting started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#header2)  
        •   [Step 1: Select users who will be required to use MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#selectusers)  
        •   [Step 2: Select MFA methods](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#selectmethods)  
        •   [Step 3: Configure MFA settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#mfasettings)  
        •   [Microsoft Edge device trust](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#devicetrust)  
        •   [Step 4: Set Policy name](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#policyname)  
        •   [Step 5: Preview and complete MFA configuration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#preview)  
3\. [Exploring the MFA Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#exploring)  
        •   [Managing Classroom MFA Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#managingmfabadges)  
4. [User self-enrollment](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#user)

## Overview

This article walks through the setup process for Classroom MFA.

For more information on how Classroom MFA works, pricing, and FAQs, please refer to [this Help Center article.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616?language=en_US) If you are interested protecting Google through the Workspace application, please refer to [this Setup Guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572?language=en_US). 

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
For more robust information, including teacher training resources and email templates to roll out Classroom MFA, we recommend going through our [Clever Academy Classroom MFA Quick Start Guide](https://clever.academy/quick-start-classroom-mfa-setup-and-rollout?user_type=district_admin).

  
 

* * *

## Getting started

You can begin setting up Classroom MFA right in your Clever Dashboard. [Click here](https://schools.clever.com/mfa) to jump right in and start your first MFA policy setup. 

In this guide, we'll mention end-users. End-users are people who will use MFA while accessing Clever, like students, teachers, or instructional staff.

### **Step 1: Select users who will be required to use MFA:**

-   **By Group**
    -   Students
        -   All students
        -   Students by schools, grades, and/or groups (IEP or ELL status)
    -   Teachers
        -   All Teachers
        -   Teachers by schools
    -   All Staff
-   **Or by specific users**

Classroom MFA can be set up with unique policies that you can combine subsets of users in. For your first policy, you may want to start with a small subset of test users rather than all teachers or staff. However, the decision is up to you. Learn about the [differences between Staff and Teacher users here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360032149791). School organization administrators also have some MFA options natively built into Clever, which [you can read about here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333)  

###   
  
**Step 2: Select MFA methods**

You can choose multiple MFA methods for your end users to choose from. When an end user (e.g. teacher) sets up their MFA, they'll get a list of possible MFA methods to set up. In this step, you'll define what MFA methods will be displayed as possible methods to an end user.  
  
It’s a good practice to have at least one other authentication method available to users so they can have a backup method. This way, if they are not able to use one method for any reason (e.g. their cell phone is not charged) they can use a backup method to successfully log in. This saves time by providing an alternative to users.

-   **Picture Logins**
    -   End-user uses two pictures that they select to verify their identity.
    -   Pictures can vary for age group. Younger students can utilize cartoon images, and older students can use realistic pictures. During policy setup, you'll choose which images the policy will use.
    -   This method is only permitted for students.
    -   Recommended for K-6 students, as it is easy to use.
    -   Clever admins and STLs can view student MFA picture selections from the Actions menu on the student's profile. Find out more [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#pictureselection). 
    -   This option does not require a second device.  
        
            **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QfoI1)    Clever tip:** You can set up separate MFA policies for students in younger grades and older grades (ex: K-2 and 3-6) to customize which login pictures students can utilize.
        
-   **Badges**
    -   End-user scans a printed or downloaded QR code via a device camera as a second factor after they provide their password.
    -   Recommended for students in grades 7-12. It pairs well with a password as the first authentication method. Recommended for teachers as a non-phone alternative.
    -   This option doesn't require a second device.
    -   Clever admins can bulk print student and teacher MFA Badges via the MFA Dashboard. 
    -   Teachers can manage MFA Badges for their students right from their Teacher Portal. Find out more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001656). 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If your students already use a [Clever Badge to SSO into Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907), we advise against using the MFA Badge as well because it will result in needing two badges to log into Clever. This is less secure than a Badge + other authentication method.  

-   **PIN**
    -   End user sets their own PIN by entering a 6-digit PIN code that they select to verify their identity. For security reasons, students cannot use use their ID number, birthday, sequential numbers (e.g., 123456, 678901), or repetitive digits (e.g. 000000, 111111).  Attempting to use an ID number, birthday, sequential or repetitive digits will surface an error during setup that states, “PIN is too weak.”
    -   This method is available to all students, and to teachers and staff at schools enrolled in Entra EAM.
    -   Recommended for students in grades 4-8.
    -   Not recommended for teachers or staff.
    -   This option doesn’t require a second device.
    -   Teachers can help manage MFA PINs for their students right from their Teacher Portal. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001656).
-   **Mobile app**
    -   End-user uses an app that generates a verification code - a Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP). They'll use this code to verify their identity during MFA.
    -   Choose an app that you recommend your end user should use to generate verification codes:
        -   Google Authenticator or
        -   Microsoft Microsoft Authenticator
    -   Authenticator apps are not dependent on wifi or internet networks to generate codes so these are great options for those with network concerns.
    -   We recommend using this method as it has a good combination of security strength and convenience. 
-   **App-based token**
    -   End-user uses an app that generates a verification code - a Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP). They'll use this code to verify their identity during MFA.
    -   Choose an app that you recommend your end-user should use to generate verification codes:
        -   Google Authenticator or
        -   Microsoft Authenticator
    -   We recommend using this method as it has a good combination of security strength and convenience.
-   **Biometrics or security key** (e.g., Apple Touch ID, Windows Hello, Yubikey) 
    -   End user uses a physical hardware key that plugs into the user device or is included in the device for authentication.
    -   Please note that Clever does not provide or re-sell hardware tokens. These must be school organization-provided. 
-   **Text message** 
    -   End user provides a phone number and receives a verification code by text message (SMS). Text messages do not support International numbers.
-   **Voice Call**
    -   End user provides a phone number and receives a verification code through an automatic voice message (call). Voice phone numbers support extensions. Voice phone numbers do not support international numbers.

###   
**Step 3: Configure MFA settings**

-   **Enforcement date** (required)
    -   End users will be prompted while logging into Clever to set up MFA 30 days before the enforcement date. They can skip the MFA setup until the enforcement date. After that, an end user will be required to set up MFA before being able to access Clever.
    -   When you select _Skip enforcement date_, it will make MFA optional for end users. They can set up MFA within their own profile settings but won’t be required to add it. 
    -   If you’re testing Classroom MFA, you’ll want to set the enforcement date within 30 days of when you want your test policy users to get set up, so it automatically triggers their enrollment.
-   **Re-authentication frequency** (required)  
    
     **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Chromebooks clear cookies every time a user logs out. Because of this, Classroom MFA will be required at every _**Chromebook**_ login—even if your policy is set to **Every 7 days** or **Every 30 days**. This is a known limitation of Chromebooks.
    
      
    -   Select how often a user will be prompted to MFA while logging into Clever:
        -   Every time - If the user is on a shared device and is signed out from Clever, they will be required to use Classroom MFA every time they log in to Clever. However, if they are using a 1:1 device, they will only need to authenticate once every 24 hours when this option is selected.
        -   Every 7 days - end user will use MFA every 7 days to log in to Clever.
        -   Every 30 days - end user will use MFA every 30 days to log in to Clever.
        -   Never - you can define secure networks (such as your school network) where users are exempt from MFA during login. If logging in outside of these networks, users will be prompted for MFA every time they login.
        -   Never - users on Microsoft Edge browsers with trusted devices are exempt from MFA during login.
    -   Optionally, you can add more conditions to the “Every 7-day” and “Every 30 days” settings by clicking _Advanced settings_. 

![Screenshot of MFA Configuration screen highlighting the Advanced settings link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000G9OY9)

-   In Advanced settings, you'll define safe zones, where the end user will use MFA every X days to log in. End users outside defined safe zones must re-authenticate every time. To define a safe zone use:
    -   Trusted user locations. Select country(s) where end users can log in every X days. 
    -   User new location. When an end user logs in from a new location, they must log in with MFA.
    -   Trusted networks. Specify networks with CIDR blocks where end users can log in every X days.
    -   Trusted devices. Specify the tenant ID where Microsoft Edge browsers on trusted devices can log in every X days.

![Screenshot of Advanced settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iEOKT)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** When multiple conditions are configured, all conditions must be met for the policy to apply. If you configure multiple MFA policies, after setup, you can rearrange them by dragging and dropping to set their order of preferred precedence.  

-   **Guardian support**
    -   You can allow guardians to receive a one-time MFA bypass code via email to bypass the student’s MFA if a student forgets their second factor. We only recommend enabling this feature if your school organization syncs accurate guardian contact emails to Clever. You can review the guardian information syncing to Clever via the [Clever Dashboard > Data Browser > Contacts](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=contacts)[](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=contacts) tab.
    -   An extra option to allow multiple guardians will appear if you allow one guardian. With this checked, up to 3 guardians can receive a one-time MFA bypass code via email to help a student who has forgotten their second factor.

![Screenshot of checkbox to enable guardian support](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pqnnF)

Not setting up with Microsoft Edge device trust? [Skip to Step 4: Set Policy name here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625#policyname).

### **Microsoft Edge device trust**

If you’re planning to have users sign in from Edge browsers on school-issued devices,  Clever can bypass MFA both on campus and at home by verifying the device. If you would like to set this up, follow the directions below.

1.  Ensure that you have checked Never, Every 7 days, or Every 30 days in the previous step.
    
2.  Check **Allow Device Trust using Microsoft Edge browser**  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iEQis) 
    
3.  Enter your Microsoft Entra Tenant ID in the provided field
    
    1.  Format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
        
    2.  You can find this in Microsoft Entra Admin Center → Overview
        
4.  Copy the URL displayed (you’ll need this for Microsoft configuration)  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iEa5V) Configure the Connector in the Edge Management Service

1.  Navigate to the Microsoft Admin Center
    
    Accordion summary…
    
    Accordion body…
    
    1.  Go to [https://admin.microsoft.com/Adminportal/Home#/Edge/Connectors](https://admin.microsoft.com/Adminportal/Home#/Edge/Connectors)
        
        1.  Admins must set up a configuration policy to assign to any Connector configuration. [Follow this guide to create a configuration policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-service)
            
        2.  Once you have at least one configuration policy created, visit the Connectors page in the Edge Management Service to access the Connectors page in the Edge Management Service
            
2.  Discover the Connector
    
    1.  Under Discover Connectors, locate the Clever Device Trust Connector and select Set up
        
3.  Select a Policy
    
    1.  In the Choose policy field, select a policy appropriate for your Connector configuration
        
4.  Enter URL patterns
    
    1.  In the URL patterns to allow, one per line field, input the URL for your configuration
        
5.  Provide Consent for the IDP Service Principal In the Application (client) ID field, select Consent to grant Clever access to retrieve device signals
    
6.  Save the Configuration.
    
7.  On a supported Microsoft Edge installation that is part of the tenant and group you configured the policy for, navigate to edge://policy and click the Reload Policies button. You should see the policy appear in the list, containing a Clever URL.
    

Accordion body…

Test device trust

From an Entra-joined Windows device with Edge browser:

-   Open Microsoft Edge
-   Navigate to your school’s Clever login page
-   Sign in with a user account in the MFA policy

The expected behavior when testing with a trusted device:

-   Device trust verification occurs automatically

-   If device trust checks, MFA is bypassed
-   User proceeds directly to Clever applications

The expected behavior when testing from a personal device or non-Edge browser:

-   Device trust check fails or is not applicable
-   User is prompted for MFA as configured in policy

### **Step 4: Set Policy name**

On this page you will name your policy. We recommend choosing a distinctive name and adding a description to describe the policy that you just set up.   
  
  

###   
**Step 5: Preview and complete MFA configuration**

Review your MFA configuration to make sure everything looks correct.

To enforce the policy, turn on the **Active** toggle. If you leave the toggle off, the policy will remain **Inactive** and won't be enforced.

![Screenshot of Active toggle turned on.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nnYty)

You can change the policy status or edit your configuration at any time.

When you're ready, click **Save MFA policy**.

That’s it! You’ve configured Classroom MFA. Congratulations on securing authentication for classrooms with Clever!

* * *

## Exploring the MFA dashboard

After completing setup, we recommend you check out the MFA dashboard, where you can:

-   Identify MFA enrollment status to quickly see which end-users have successfully activated MFA and which users still need to complete enrollment.
    
-   Download a CSV export of your MFA enrollment data to identify users who still need to enroll in MFA
    
-   Access a detailed MFA end-user list and MFA configuration
    
-   Add a new MFA Policy and reorder existing policies based on preferred precedence
    
-   Print Classroom MFA Badges in bulk for students, teachers, and staff
    
-   Edit your MFA configuration
    

![Screenshot of Classroom MFA page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000irIS8)

### **Monitoring MFA enrollment**

You can track MFA enrollment progress across your school organization from the [MFA enrollment report](https://schools.clever.com/mfa). This report helps you quickly understand how adoption is going and identify users who still need to enroll in MFA. The report automatically updates every 24 hours, allowing you to monitor enrollment progress throughout your rollout.

The report displays one of the following enrollment statuses based on your overall MFA adoption progress:

-   **In progress:** 0%–29% enrolled
    
-   **On track:** 30%–69% enrolled
    
-   **Strong:** 70%–100% enrolled
    

To review enrollment details more closely, click **Download CSV** to export time-stamped MFA enrollment data. You can use this report to search, filter, and audit unenrolled users.

### ![Screenshot of MFA enrollment progress](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000itKrB)

The CSV export includes the following fields:

-   Student Information System (SIS) ID
-   Name
-   Email
-   Role
-   School
-   Policy
-   Policy method(s) allowed
-   Is the user activated (true/false)
-   Activated method(s)

### **Managing Classroom MFA Badges** 

If you configure Classroom MFA Badges as an authentication option, there are a few methods for managing the creation and distribution of Badges:

1.  During the self-enrollment process outlined below, users can take a picture of or print their MFA Badge.
    
2.  Teachers can print, void, and generate student MFA Badges via their Portal troubleshooting tools.
    
3.  Clever admins can print, void, and generate student and teacher MFA Badges in bulk via the MFA Dashboard. 
    

  
 **To manage Badges in bulk:**

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Classroom MFA](https://schools.clever.com/mfa) page.
2.  Click the **Download all MFA Badges** button to download MFA Badges for all policies.  
    ![Screenshot of Download all MFA Badges button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HxhlV)  
3.  To download MFA Badges for a specific policy, navigate to the policy and then select the **Download MFA Badges** button. You will only see the option to Download MFA Badges if the policy includes Badges as an MFA method for students.  
    ![Screenshot of Download MFA Badges for a specific policy](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HxexK)  
4.  Your next steps will vary based on the current state of your student’s MFA Badges.
    1.  If you have not generated MFA Badges before, you’ll see the setup below to download all new student MFA Badges.  
        ![Screenshot of Download new MFA Badges prompt](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HxJMd)  
    2.  If some users have existing MFA Badges, and there are new students needing MFA Badges, you’ll see the checkbox below to **Only create Badges for students who haven’t set up Badges yet**.  
        ![Screenshot of Create Badges for a subset of students](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000gnuTt)    
          
        If you check the box and click **Download all new MFA Badges** it will only generate new MFA Badges for students who haven’t had an MFA Badge previously created.  
          
        If you **do not** check the box and click **Download all new MFA Badges**, all existing MFA Badges will be voided, and new Badges will be generated for all students. This may cause confusion if you have students or teachers who have already generated MFA Badges independently or with a teacher's help. You will need to confirm that you want to void all existing student MFA Badges before proceeding.  
        ![Screenshot of MFA Badges will be voided warning](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HxdbT)     
          
        
5.  You will receive a zip file of the selected Badges via email.

**To view student MFA picture selections:**

1.  Navigate to the student's profile from your Clever Dashboard.
2.  Click **Actions** > **View MFA Picture Selections**.  
    ![Screenshot showing drop down action to View MFA Picture Selection.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iLcgr)    
      
    ![Screenshot of selected MFA picture options.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iLd3R)  

* * *

## User self-enrollment

Once the school organization is within 30 days of the enforcement date of Classroom MFA that you determined during admin setup, the users you have assigned to MFA will begin to see a setup box upon login (See an example here: [https://clever.com/oauth/mfa/settings](https://clever.com/oauth/mfa/settings)). They can follow the prompts to choose the best methods for them and after completion should immediately receive their first authentication prompt. End users will be able to set up multiple MFA methods if they wish. 

Users can choose to set up later if they wish, up until the enforcement date.

### **Here's a run-through of the steps end users will go through:**

Step 1:

![Screenshot of Clever MFA setup.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003CGvJ)

Step 2: (this will vary depending on the user type)

![Screenshot of Clever MFA setup.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003CGyX)

Step 3:  (this will vary depending on the authentication method chosen)

![Screenshot of Clever MFA setup downloading a badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003CH1l)

Step 4:

![Screenshot of Clever MFA setup.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003CH4z)

Users can change their settings if desired, such as to set up another authentication method. Users can navigate to their account icon (top right corner) > MFA settings

![Screenshot of MFA settings in Teacher Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1i9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HxKDq)

To ensure the admin has visibility into the activation status of your users, you can reference the user report on the Classroom MFA dashboard.
