title: For Clever Admins: Neutral Third-Party Security Rubrics
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001621#header1)  
2\. [Recommended Third-Party Security Rubrics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001621#header2)  
3\. [Learn More](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001621#header3)

## Overview

Edtech vendors play a key role in supporting comprehensive school security. However, for K-12 administrators—especially those managing tech responsibilities alone—vetting vendors for data security can pose a challenge.

   
To support administrators in this process, we rely on trusted experts. This article provides you with neutral third-party security rubrics to help you select vendors with a cybersecurity-focused mindset.   
 

* * *

## Recommended third-party security rubrics

It is important for every school district to develop policies and priorities that best suit your district. We recommend using rubrics created by neutral third parties, such as the [Consortium for School Networking](https://www.cosn.org/about/) (CoSN) and the [Cybersecurity Infrastructure and Security Agency](https://www.cisa.gov/about) (CISA):

-   [CoSN: K-12CVAT: K-12 Community Vendor Assessment Tool](https://www.cosn.org/tools-and-resources/resource/k-12cvat/)
-   [CoSN: Cybersecurity toolkit on authentication management](https://www.cosn.org/tools-and-resources/resource/k12-cybersecurity-toolkit-authentication-management/)
-   [CoSN: NIST Cybersecurity Framework Resources Alignment for K-12](https://www.cosn.org/edtech-topics/cybersecurity/cosns-nist-cybersecurity-framework-resources-alignment-for-k-12/)
-   [CoSN + CISA: Online Cybersecurity Toolkit](https://www.cisa.gov/protecting-our-future-cybersecurity-k-12)
-   [CISA: Online Toolkit: Partnering to Safeguard K-12 Organizations from Cybersecurity Threats](https://www.cisa.gov/online-toolkit-partnering-safeguard-k-12-organizations-cybersecurity-threats) 

Clever has a close partnership with CoSN, and we’ll continue to support the creation of neutral third-party rubrics to provide districts with unbiased evaluation sources. Discover key steps to select edtech vendors with a cybersecurity focus to help protect student data on Clever’s Blog: [K-12 Administrator guide to evaluating edtech vendor security](https://www.clever.com/blog/2024/01/edtech-vendor-security). 

  
 

* * *

## Learn more

Clever is proud to join forces with the White House and the Cybersecurity Infrastructure and Security Agency (CIS) by signing the Secure by Design Pledge. We’re committed to supporting a secure, interoperable digital learning ecosystem and providing free and low-cost resources to school districts that strengthen cybersecurity. Learn more about our commitments [here](https://www.clever.com/secure-by-design-pledge).

You can also learn more about Clever’s comprehensive security program in our [Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust).

  
  

* * *

1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001620#header1)  
2\. [Technical requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001620#header2)  
3\. [Process to add Clever Academy courses to your LMS](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001620#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001620#header4)

## Overview

[Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin), our free training hub, has dozens of courses for teachers, [School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663), and [Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038). Content covers everything from onboarding to advanced features.

We’ve received feedback from schools that they’d like to host Clever Academy courses inside the learning management system (LMS) they use for teacher professional development. 

Good news! You can host Clever Academy courses in your LMS, if it’s compatible. This article runs through the technical requirements and process to add Clever Academy content to your LMS.  
 

* * *

## Technical requirements

Currently, Clever Academy courses can be shared with you as xAPI and CMI5 files, which you can add to your LMS. 

Supported LMSes for the xAPI launch type are:

-   Cornerstone onDemand
-   Litmos
-   Absorb
-   Sumtotal
-   Saba
-   Relias
-   ThinkZoom
-   Seismic Learning - Formerly Lessonly
-   Docebo (In Beta)
-   360 Learning
-   Thought Industries (In Beta)
-   UKG

Supported LMSes CMI5 launch type are:

-   Bridge
-   TalentLMS (In Beta)

**Integration features**  
When you add a Clever Academy course to your LMS, you have access to assignment engagement, such as which learners have completed the course. Specifics will vary based on the LMS you’re using.

* * *

## Process to add Clever Academy courses to your LMS

Follow these steps to get Clever Academy course(s) added to your LMS:

1.  Review the [technical requirements section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001620#header2) of this article and ensure you are using a supported LMS.
2.  Log in to Clever Academy and check out the [course catalog](https://clever.academy/page/course-catalog).
3.  Find one or more courses you want your users to access in your LMS
    -   **NOTE:** Ensure the content is relevant to the learner - for instance, if you’re looking to train your teachers, ensure the course is designated for teachers. 
4.  Email the Clever Academy team at [academy@clever.com](mailto:academy@clever.com) and share:
    -   Which LMS you're using
    -   Which user type(s) you want to share courses with (such as teachers, School Tech Leads)
    -   The links to the course(s) you'd like to add to your LMS
    -   The rough timeline to get the content added (we need a minimum of two weeks lead time)
5.  We will prepare the relevant xAPI or CMI5 file(s) and share them with you.  
     

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What if my LMS isn’t listed?**

-   We currently only support the listed LMSes - feel free to check back periodically to see if more LMSes are added.
    

**Is there a cost for this feature?**

-   This feature is currently free!
    

**Where can I find more technical information?**

-   [Technical documentation](https://support.skilljar.com/hc/en-us/articles/21429624328851-Selecting-the-Right-Content-Syndication-Launch-Type) is owned and maintained by the software that powers Clever Academy, Skilljar.

title: For Teachers & Staff: Setting up Classroom MFA
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001619#header1)  
2\. [What's Classroom MFA?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001619#header2)  
3\. [Setting up Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001619#header3)  
4\. [Adding authentication methods](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001619#header4)  
5. [Using Classroom MFA after setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001619#header6)

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** If you’re an admin trying to set up Classroom MFA for your teachers and staff, please reference [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616?language=en_US). 

## Overview

This article has information for teachers and staff on setting up Clever’s Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (Classroom MFA). As an optional add-on feature, Clever offers school organizations Classroom MFA to provide an extra layer of security for teacher and student logins.

**You’ll only have access to Classroom MFA if your school organization has added it to your Clever account.** 

For information on how to help your student’s set up their Classroom MFA, please see our article [For Teachers: Helping your students set up and troubleshoot Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001656).

##   

* * *

## What's Classroom MFA?

MFA is a way to log in to programs that requires you to use two methods (or factors) to prove your identity, like your username and password on your computer and a text message code sent to your phone. You likely already use MFA when signing in to other programs, such as your online bank account.

Clever’s Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) creates a second layer of security for student and teacher accounts without the need for a second device. This will help you to protect sensitive information through secured access without disrupting learning in your classroom.

Classroom MFA works by requiring a second factor of authentication for students and teachers using one of the following options that has been pre-selected by your school organization: 

-   Picture logins (students only)
-   Clever Badges
-   PIN (all students; teachers and staff at schools enrolled in Entra EAM)
-   Authenticator app
-   Text message (SMS)
-   Voice call
-   Biometrics or security key

* * *

## Setting up Classroom MFA

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/schoolorg-URL) and sign in the way you normally do. You'll be prompted to set up Clever Classroom MFA.
    

![Screenshot of Clever login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002fi7B)

2.  You’ll be presented with one or more authentication methods. Read more about authentication methods below. Choose a method and click **Next step**. 

![Classroom MFA setup options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002c7nJ)

4.  Follow the instructions to set up the authentication method. You can learn more about authentication options below. 
    
5.  Once you’ve finished the instructions, click **Exit settings**_._
    
6.  Optional: If your school offers more than one authentication method, you can click **Set up another method** to add another authentication option.  
    

* * *

## Adding authentication methods

Reminder: Authentication methods are used to prove your identity. You must add at least one authentication method to use Classroom MFA.

It is best practice to add multiple methods if your school has made other options available to you. This way, if you’re not able to use one method for any reason (e.g. your cell phone is not charged so you can’t get a text message ) you can use another method to successfully log in. This saves time by providing an alternative method for yourself.

### **Text message (also called SMS)** 

A numeric code is texted to a cell phone number you chose; you can type this code into your Clever login screen.  
  
**Setup tips:**

-   Make sure the number you add when setting up Classroom MFA will go to a phone you can access during the school day, as you’ll need the code texted to this number to log in to Clever. 
-   Also, keep in mind that this will not work for a landline. If you can only access a landline, consider an automated voice phone call.

### **Automated voice phone call** 

A numeric code is shared via an automated voice phone call to a number you choose (can be a landline or cell phone); you then type this code into your Clever login screen.  
  
**Setup tips:**

-   This will trigger a phone call to the number you added, so ensure you’ll be able to answer the phone and hear the code shared.

### **Mobile app** 

You install an app on a cell phone that provides you with a numeric code you type into your Clever login screen.  
  
**Setup tips:**

-   To access this option, you’ll need to install an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Authy) to a mobile device or tablet and follow the Classroom MFA setup steps in Clever. Be sure you can access this  device during the school day. You’ll need to scan a QR code, so ensure the camera works on the device.
-   Authenticator applications work without requiring cell service or network so this is still a great option if you have cell service concerns.

**Setup steps,** **Google Authenticator** **App:**_If your school organization uses the Microsoft Authenticator App, please see the directions_ [_here_](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001536?language=en_US#microsoft)_._ 

1.  **On your cell phone**, install the app by searching “Google Authenticator App” in the Google Play Store (Android) or the App Store (Apple). The app icon looks like this:
    

![Google Authenticator App icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002c9sL)

You can also click the links below to access the download page for the apps, but be sure to download the app **onto your phone or mobile device**, not on your computer:

![Google Play download button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cAWf)     ![Apple App Store download button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002c7KJ)   

2.  **On your computer**, open the Classroom MFA setup steps (this will show up after you attempt to log in to Clever), or, if you’re already logged in, go to the top right corner of your Clever screen and click the person icon (👤), then **MFA settings**.
    
3.  In the Classroom MFA setup directions, choose the App authentication method and click _Next step_ until you see the QR code (it looks like a square bar code).
    
4.  **From your phone**, open the authenticator app and select **Scan a QR code**. You may need to grant permission for the app to use your device’s camera. 
    
5.  Scan the QR code on the computer screen using your device’s camera. 
    
6.  After scanning the code, click _Next step_ on your computer.
    
7.  **On your device**, the app will provide you with a code. **On your computer**, type this code into the provided space on the Classroom MFA setup screen. 
    
8.  Click **Done**.
    
9.  Click **Exit settings**. You’re all set.
    

**After this initial setup, when prompted to use Classroom MFA, you won’t need to scan a QR code: you’ll just** **open the Google Authenticator App and tap on the account you added****. You’ll be provided with a numeric code to type into Clever. The code will change every 30 seconds.** 

**Setup steps,** **Microsoft Authenticator** **App:**_If your school organization uses the Google Authenticator App, please see the directions_ [_here_](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001536?language=en_US#google)_._

1.  **On your cell phone or mobile device**, install the app by searching “Microsoft Authenticator App” in the Google Play Store (Android) or the App Store (Apple). The app icon looks like this:
    

![Microsoft Authenticator app icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cBJ3)

You can also click the links below to access the download page for the apps, but be sure to download the app onto your mobile device, not on your computer.

![Google Play download button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002byLr)     ![Apple App Store download button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bxkl) 

2.  **On your computer**, open the Classroom MFA setup steps (this will show up after you attempt to log in to Clever), or, if you’re already logged in, go to the top right corner of your Clever screen and click the person icon (👤), then **MFA settings**.
    
3.  In the Classroom MFA setup directions, choose the App authentication method and click **Next step** until you see the QR code.
    
4.  **From your mobile device**, open the authenticator app, and review any user/privacy terms. If prompted to log in, you can press Skip in the top right corner (unless you have an account your school organization has given you directions to log into).
    
5.  Press the _Add account_ button, then _Work or school account_, then select **Scan a QR code**. You may need to grant permission for the app to use your device’s camera. 
    
6.  Scan the QR code on the computer screen using your device’s camera. 
    
7.  After scanning the code, click _Next step_ on your computer.
    
8.  **On your mobile device**, select the account you’ve just added, and the app will provide you with a code. **On your computer**, type this code into the provided space on the Classroom MFA setup screen.
    
9.  Click **Done**.
    
10.  Click **Exit settings**. You’re all set.
     

**  
After this initial setup, when prompted to use Classroom MFA, you won’t need to scan a QR code: you’ll just open the Microsoft Authenticator App and tap on the account you added. You’ll be provided with a numeric code to type into Clever. The code will change every 30 seconds.**

### **Biometrics or security key** 

You use a scanner on your device (like Apple Touch ID or Windows Hello) or an external device (like a Yubikey) to verify your identity.  
  
**Setup tips:**

-   To access this option, you’ll need either a scanner on your device, or a physical key that your school organization provides each time you need to verify your identity with Classroom MFA.
-   You can set up up to 4 biometrics or security keys (e.g., TouchID, FaceID, or 2 Yubikeys).

  
**Setup steps:**

1.  From the Classroom MFA setup screen, select **Security Key.**
    
2.  You may see a prompt from your computer asking you which option you’d like. Select **USB security key** (or similar, the exact wording varies by device). 
    
3.  Insert your Security key into your device. You may be asked to place your fingerprint on the key.
    
4.  Classroom MFA will verify the biometric or security key and then verify that setup is complete.
    
5.  Click **Done.**
    
6.  Click **Exit settings.** You’re all set.
    

  
**After this initial setup, when prompted to use Classroom MFA, you’ll simply verify your identity by using the biometric or security (such as scanning your finger, plugging in the Yubikey, etc.)**

### **PIN**

You enter a 6-digit PIN code.   
  
**Setup tips:**

-   To access this option, you’ll need to be enrolled in you school's Entra EAM. 

  
**Setup steps:**

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/schoolorg-URL) and sign in the way you normally do.
2.  Select PIN
3.  Enter your 6-digit PIN code twice. You cannot use sequential numbers (e.g., 123456, 678901) or repetitive digits (e.g. 000000, 111111). If your PIN is not secure enough you’ll see an error that says, “PIN is too weak.” They must match in order to save them.  
      
    ![Screenshot of PIN setup where user must create and confirm their PIN.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000m7Ouo) 

### **  
Badges**

You scan a printed QR code via a device camera as a second factor after you have provided your password. 

**Setup tip:**

-   You do not need  a printer to download and use your MFA Badge! You can download your MFA Badge as a PDF, take a picture of it on your mobile device or print it. 

**Setup steps:**

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/schoolorg-URL) and sign in the way you normally do.
    

![Clever login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002fgwc)

2.  Select **Badge** 
    

![Classroom MFA second factor options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cAwU)

3.  Click **Download and print Badge** (Remember our setup tip - you don’t need a printer!)
    

![Download/print Badge screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cCyH)

4.  Once you have secured your Badge, click **Next Step**
    

![Download, print, or save Badge screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cA5G)

5.  Hold up your newly downloaded Clever MFA Badge to the camera. 
    

![Show your Badge to finish setup screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cDHd)

6.  You should now be logged into your Portal! 
    

![Clever Portal screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002c7XE)

**Security tips for Badges:**

-   Never post a picture of your Badge on social media 
-   Don't leave your Badge unattended
-   When not using your Badge put it in a secured area
-   If you think your badge may have been compromised, void your Badge immediately and print a new one.

  
**Voiding and printing Badges**There are two ways to void a Badge:

1.  If a teacher or staff user has more than one MFA method set up, they can delete the Badge themselves from their portal: Teacher Portal > MFA settings > click on Badge under Your authentication methods > click **Remove**.
2.  If a teacher or staff user only has the Badge setup and no other MFA method, then they will need to contact their Clever Admin to reset MFA configurations for the user.

Teachers and staff users can not reprint the same Badge. They need to go through the process above and click **Remove** to remove the Badge from MFA Settings, and then confirm that the Badge should be removed. 

  
![MFA settings showing how to remove a Badge authentication method](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002ceJR)

  
Then click **Add method** and add a replacement Badge.  
  
![Image showing how to add MFA method](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cdFK)

* * *

## Using Classroom MFA after setup

After following the setup steps above, your school organization decides how frequently you’ll need to verify your identity using the additional method(s) you set up. Currently, your schools can require one of the following:

1.  MFA is required every time you sign in to Clever
2.  MFA is required once every seven days
3.  MFA is required once every 30 days. 

   
If your school has set Classroom MFA to be required every seven or 30 days, you can click the **Remember me for {#} days** checkbox when logging in via Classroom MFA, as shown in the screenshot below. 

![Verify your identity screen with Remember me for 7 days checkbox highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dG05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002cbn0)

Whenever you are required to use Classroom MFA (be that every time, or every seven or 30 days), you’ll need access to one of the methods you set up, be that your mobile device, a landline number you used to set up voice calls with, or your security key.  
  
You won’t be able to access your Clever account if you don’t have access to one of the method(s) you use to set up MFA if you are prompted to use MFA. If this happens, click the **Problems with MFA? button** to access information on contacting your IT team for a bypass verification code.

* * *

title: For Students: Setting up Classroom MFA
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#header1)  
2\. [What is Classroom MFA?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#header2)  
3\. [How do I use Classroom MFA?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#header3)  
        _•_   [Setting up login picture logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#header5)  
        _•_   [Setting up Clever MFA Badge logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#setbadge)  
        _•_   [Setting up PIN logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#PIN)  
4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#header5)

## Overview

In this article, you can learn more about what Classroom MFA is and how to use it when logging in. If you are experiencing any other type of issue, please reach out to your teacher.

##   

* * *

## What is Classroom MFA?

Classroom MFA is a way to safely log into your Clever account using two different login methods (or factors) to prove that you are logging into the correct account. Classroom MFA may require you to use any of the following options:

-   Picture logins
-   Clever Badges
-   PIN (6 digits)
-   Authenticator app
-   Text message (SMS)
-   Voice call
-   Biometrics or security key   
     

* * *

## How do I use Classroom MFA?

There are a few different login methods (factors) that you may be asked to use. Here are the general steps that you should follow. [Click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#header4) to learn about Classroom MFA login pictures, [or click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001618#setbadge) to learn about Classroom MFA Badges.

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/school-organization-URL) and sign in the way you normally do.
2.  You'll be prompted to set up Classroom MFA.
3.  Once you have set up Classroom MFA you can use Clever as you normally would! Don’t forget what you set up - Clever may ask you again on every time you log in, every seven days, or every 30 days depending on your school’s requirements.   
     

* * *

## Setting up login picture logins

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/school-organization-URL) and sign in the way you normally do.
    

![Clever login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002fhsf)

2.  Choose your login animal > Click **Next.** Depending on your grade, your login animals may look different!
    

![Login animal MFA options.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003OFDt)

3.  Choose your login food > Click **Next.** Depending on your grade, your login food options may look different!
    

![Login food MFA options.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003OFnN)

4.  Take a look at what you chose - don’t forget them! Click **Done**
    

               **![Image of two selected MFA options.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bU9F)**

5.  You should now be logged into your Portal! 
    

           ![Image of the Clever portal.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002feBd)    

  
  
 

* * *

## Setting up Clever MFA Badge Logins

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/school-organization-URL) and sign in the way you normally do.
    

![Clever login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002fckw)

2.  Select Badge (if given the option)
    

![Screenshot selecting Badge as the security method.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bfr3)

3.  Click **Download and print Badge**
    

![Screenshot of how to download a Badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bbIo)

4.  Once you have secured your Badge, click **Next Step**
    

![Screenshot of how to download a Badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bUve)

5.  Hold up your Clever MFA Badge to the camera. If you don’t have this, please ask your teacher for help.
    

![Image of how to use a Badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bfPe)

6.  You should now be logged into your Portal! 
    

![Image of the Clever portal.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002feJh)

If you've lost your Clever MFA Badge, or it won't work, don't worry! Your teacher can void your old one and print you a new one.

* * *

##   
Setting up PIN logins

1.  Go to your school organization's login screen (For example: Clever.com/in/school-organization-URL) and sign in the way you normally do.  
      
    ![Clever login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000093ddx)    
      
      
    
2.  Select PIN if given the option.  
    ![Screenshot selecting PIN security method.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000093dkP)     
      
    
3.  Enter your 6-digit PIN code twice. You cannot use sequential numbers (e.g., 123456, 678901) or repetitive digits (e.g. 000000, 111111). If your PIN is not secure enough you’ll see an error that says, “PIN is too weak.” They must match in order to save them!  
      
    ![PIN setup screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000093dvh)    
      
    
4.  You should now be logged into your Portal!     
    ![Image of Clever portal.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000093e5N)  

* * *

## Troubleshooting

If you forget your second login method (MFA factor) or make a mistake, don’t worry! Click **Try Again.**

![Error on Clever login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bgaD)

If you can’t remember how to login, select **Can not login?** and your teacher will be able to provide you with a single-use backup login code.

![Screenshot highlighting "Can not login?" link.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000064yi6)

Once your teacher has given you a backup code you can enter it > Click **Log in.**

![Image of entering a backup login code.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bk0f&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002bh03)

text:

[Uploading staff for SFTP districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#h_0dd3ead0-753b-4f03-832e-4566de0f0be3) 3. [Uploading staff for auto sync districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#uploadforautosyncs) 4. [Important Upload Tips](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#h_7d34a5fc-7ea7-45b5-b13a-b1714476522c) 5. [Associating staff to multiple locations or the district office](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#h_6ed2513a-8d74-4c7b-8466-f860781757cb)  6. [Editing & removing staff or updating their roles](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#h_01fc90f5-dae8-478d-8ac4-55814d917a44) 7. [Districts using Infinite Campus API or Skyward API syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#apisync) 8. [Automated Staff SFTP for auto syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001617#AutomatedSFTP) IMPORTANT This article shows directions for the classic user interface for adding staff (which some legacy districts use). If you notice the [Staff page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) of your account looks different from the documentation below, please [view this article instead](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547). ## Overview Clever Admins are able to provide various non-instructional staff (i.e. non-teaching staff) access to Clever. For an overview of Clever Roles and permissions, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726). **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If your schools use the **Infinite Campus API** or **Skyward API** sync type, [skip below to this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547?language=en_US#apisync) for information on how staff are automatically synced to Clever. If your schools use Active Directory, [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360028781552?language=en_US) to automatically sync staff data to Clever. For most schools, there are two ways to add staff to Clever:  1. Staff as part of your normal sync or a one-time sync upload. 2. [Custom Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471), added individually on a per-user basis. Please see the table below to determine the best method for your account. thod for your account. * * * ## Uploading staff for SFTP districts You can manually upload staff from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page by uploading a staff.csv file. This method is best for adding staff members in bulk if they are not synced to Clever by your student information system (SIS). **Please note:** You must explicitly share staff users [with your learning applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007) once you create them in Clever. To upload a staff.csv:  1. From your [Clever Dashboard,](https://schools.clever.com/) select [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload). 2. If you need an example file, click **Download example files** or download your existing staff.csv. Add a row to the file for each staff member you would like to add to Clever. **Do not remove** any staff users you still want to access Clever. If you remove a user from the staff.csv before re-uploading it their record will be deleted. To maintain existing account, add new user information to the file before re-uploading. 3. Upload your staff.csv file. When the cloud displays as green, select **Upload.** The staff updates will be reflected in Clever in about 15 minutes. ![Sync Upload page with with Upload Staff.csv and Upload button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000144Av) Schools that sync data to Clever via SFTP can also upload the staff.csv directly to their district's Clever SFTP folder. For instructions, visit: [SFTP: How do I upload my data to Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408)   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BqT) For additional information about Clever's SFTP and CSV formatting specifications, click [here](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). * * * ## Uploading staff for auto sync districts If your school's SIS isn't automatically syncing staff members to Clever, you can upload them in bulk directly from your Clever Dashboard. You'll navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) tab and upload a staff.csv file under "Manual upload." **Please note:** You must explicitly share staff users [with your learning applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007) once created in Clever. To upload a staff.csv: 1. From your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), select [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff). 2\. If you need an example file, click **Download example files** or download your existing staff.csv. Add a row to the file for each staff member you would like to add to Clever. **Do not remove** any staff users you still want to access Clever. If you remove a user from the staff.csv before re-uploading it their record will be deleted. To maintain existing account, add new user information to the file before re-uploading. 3\. Upload your staff.csv file. When the cloud displays as green, select **Upload**. The staff updates will be reflected in Clever in about 15 minutes.   ![Screen Shot 2023-04-11 at 3.50.14 PM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062ded) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BqT) For additional information about Clever's SFTP and CSV formatting specifications, click [here](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). * * * ## Important Upload Tips When uploading staff to Clever, there are a few important details to consider:   - Each unique staff member requires a unique staff\_id.    - **Always include all staff in the staff.csv** file if you still want them to have access to Clever. If you remove a user from the staff.csv before re-uploading the file their record will be deleted.    - The school\_id must match the school\_id (i.e. sis\_id) for a school in Clever. To locate this value, search for the school from the top search bar and select the school to bring up the school's profile page. Under **School Information,** find the **School ID.** Use this school\_id value in the staff.csv. ![School profile page with School ID highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004akYY) - For staff that are not associated with a specific school or are associated with the district office, use the school\_id value: DEFAULT\_DISTRICT\_OFFICE - Uploaded staff are auto-assigned the role [Portal Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772). Portal Access users don't have any administrative rights and can only single sign-on (SSO) to applications from their Clever Portal. Applications must first be [shared with them](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360031060451) by a Clever Admin. - For instructions on manually adding individual staff members to Clever via the [Custom Data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/teachers) feature, visit: [Adding custom staff to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471). ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BrR) For information on admin and staff roles in Clever, please visit: [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726). * * * ## Associating staff to multiple locations or the district office  **Multiple schools:**   To associate a staff member with multiple schools, create a separate row at each location. The only field that will be different for each row is the school\_id. For example, if a staff member should be associated with three schools, it should look like this: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BrW) **All schools:**   To associate a staff member with all schools in the district, enter school\_id: **district** ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Brl) **Default District Office**:   There is a default auto-generated district office in Clever. To associate a staff member with the district office, enter the school\_id: **DEFAULT\_DISTRICT\_OFFICE** ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpH) * * * ## Editing & removing staff or updating their roles 1. From your [Clever Dashboard,](https://schools.clever.com/) select [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload tab.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) 2. Under Download existing files, select staff.csv. The downloaded staff.csv file will contain all pre-existing staff in Clever for your district. ![Sync Upload page with staff.csv, Upload Staff CSV, and Upload buttons highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000145Bp) 3. Edit the records for staff as desired and save the file. 4. Next, upload the file. When the cloud displays as green, select **Upload.** The staff updates will be reflected in Clever in about 15 minutes.  To update a staff member's role from Portal Access to [School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663), please follow the instructions here: [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663)   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bs0) **Please note:** You should list all staff members in the staff.csv every time you upload a new file to Clever! The staff member will be deleted from Clever and connected applications if their record is not populated in the staff.csv. * * * ## Districts using the Infinite Campus API or Skyward API sync **Infinite Campus API**   Staff are synced to Clever if:   - **Teacher** _is not checked_ for their district assignment in Infinite Campus. All staff members that **do** **not** have 'Teacher' checked will appear as 'Administrator' in the OneRoster API and will be synced to Clever as Staff. If a user has 'Teacher' and another assignment checked. They will be synced to Clever as both a Teacher and Staff. Upon login to Clever, they can select which user session they wish to access via their Profile icon in their Clever Portal. We recommend using our manual CSV upload if you prefer greater control over which users sync to Clever as Staff. [Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) if you want to enable this option for your district.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BsF)    **Skyward API**   Staff are synced to Clever if both conditions below are true:   - "Teacher = False" (unchecked) - Their 'Title' is either blank or contains one of the following words: - Superintendent - Principal - Instruction - Curriculum - Director - Coordinator - Technology - Coach - Counselor - Admin ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BsK) Once staff members have been uploaded to Clever, you must ensure they are shared with the desired applications. For instructions, visit: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing staff with applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044771711?language=en_US). * * * ## Automated Staff SFTP for auto syncs  If your schools use a Clever-Managed Auto Sync that can’t sync staff (like PowerSchool, Infinite Campus auto, Skyward auto, Aeries API, and Blackbaud), we have a solution to automate your staff data upload!  This feature provides schools with an SFTP directory that can accept a staff.csv file.  Clever will use this staff.csv file as the source of truth, as this file will supersede any SIS-synced staff data. Utilizing your SIS sync or Custom data are preferred methods for syncing staff and you should only use this solution if you want to automate staff via SFTP that supersedes your SIS. To activate this feature, reach out to our support team. Once activated, you’ll see SFTP credentials on your [SIS sync page under the Staff tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) for you to use, as shown below. ![Screenshot of the staff.csv upload credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pCq8j)  Once you have the SFTP credentials, you can use an [FTP client](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US) like [Filezilla](https://filezilla-project.org/), or WinSCP, to upload your staff.csv file to the **preferred-sis-data** directory in your SFTP box. IMPORTANT: If you upload your staff.csv file to a directory other than preferred-sis-data, your data will not process, and you will not receive an error message. Please ensure that your staff.csv file is uploaded to the preferred-sis-data directory. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djjd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** A staff.csv uploaded to the preferred-sis-data directory will be processed during a sync pause. See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507) to learn more about sync pauses. If you plan to start syncing these staff members using your normal SIS sync after coming off pause, ensure that the staff\_id field in your staff.csv matches the staff\_id that will be used by your SIS sync. Learn more about the staff.csv file and how to format it [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OZckMFjSEPLYc4rOsncD17eMU3zQdoBB/view?usp=sharing). **Who does NOT need this feature:** - If you already have an SFTP directory, you would just need to automate your staff upload to that SFTP directory. - If you only want to upload staff manually, you would use [custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471?language=en_US).

title: For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616#header1)  
2\. [What is Classroom MFA?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616#header2)  
3\. [Pricing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616#header3)  
4\. [Getting Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616#header5)

## Overview

Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)  is a second layer of security for Clever without a second device. Classroom MFA protects applications that use Clever for single sign-on with age-appropriate second factors like Clever Badges or login pictures. This includes the Clever Portal, Google Workspace, and Google Chromebooks. This solution helps school organizations stay ahead of cybersecurity threats without disrupting learning.

![Image of Classroom MFA protection flow chart](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dB0P&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000FZtgx)

By providing a dual layer of authentication, Classroom MFA can help you meet cybersecurity insurance requirements and worry less about compromised credentials for your students, teachers, and instructional staff. As a bonus, Classroom MFA helps increase students' digital citizenship skills as they navigate our digital environments in a way that's safe and responsible.

Classroom MFA works by requiring a second factor of authentication for students and teachers via Clever Badges, pictures, authenticator apps, SMS, voice calls, or biometrics/hardware tokens, for any Clever-based SSO login. With the ability to require re-authentication for login attempts outside your designated country or network, rest assured potential bad actors will hit your MFA wall and get turned away.

 ![Images of Clever MFA picture logins and Badges for students](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dB0P&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005kDDt)     
 

* * *

## What is Classroom MFA?

This is a way for your students and teachers to securely MFA into Clever to protect all of your Clever applications without the requirement of a second device. Classroom MFA protects the Clever portal for your users. Any application that a student or teacher accesses from the Clever portal will have a layer of protection.

Classroom MFA currently supports the following factors:

-   Picture logins (students only)
-   Clever Badges
-   PIN (all students; teachers and staff at schools enrolled in Entra EAM)
-   Authenticator app
-   Text message (SMS)
-   Voice call
-   Biometrics or security key

* * *

## Pricing

For more information on pricing, please contact our team [here](https://www.clever.com/security-consultation).

School organizations can preview Classroom MFA before purchasing [here in your Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/mfa)!  After completing the configuration and viewing a free preview, IT administrators can purchase Classroom MFA directly in the Clever App Store.  
  
Clever’s digital learning platform (including single sign-on, rostering, messaging, and analytics) remains completely free for school organizations.  
 

* * *

## Getting Started

You can learn how to get started with Classroom MFA by checking out our article [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001625) or connecting with one of our cybersecurity specialists here: [https://www.getclever.com/mfa-contact-a-specialist](https://www.getclever.com/mfa-contact-a-specialist)  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How is Classroom MFA different from other MFA options on the market available?** 

-   Most MFA solutions available on the market are not designed for the classroom and require a second device to be present with their user. Classroom MFA eliminates the need for a second device making it accessible to teachers and students. 

**Will Classroom MFA work for my staff users?** 

-   Yes, your staff will be protected for any applications that are accessed only via single sign-on through Clever. If you would like to learn more or have other requirements for staff users, please connect with a cybersecurity specialist here: [https://www.getclever.com/mfa-contact-a-specialist](https://www.getclever.com/mfa-contact-a-specialist)

**Can students use the same Clever Badge they already use to log into Clever as their MFA Badge method login?** 

-   No, a Clever Badge and MFA Badge are not the same thing. For maximum security, we strongly recommend that school organizations assign an alternative MFA factor for students who already Badge into Clever.  

**Which applications are covered by Classroom MFA?** 

-   Classroom MFA will cover all Single Sign-on (SSO) and Rostering & Single Sign-on (SSO) applications. This includes the Clever Portal, Google Workspace, and Google Chromebooks.

**How can Classroom MFA protect Google?** 

-   Classroom MFA can protect Google through the Workspace application. Learn how to set up the Workspace app to protect Google for your school organization [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572?language=en_US)!

**How often will students, teachers, or staff be asked to use their second method of authentication?**

-   During the MFA configuration process, you'll be able to choose to have users re-authenticate every time they login, every 7 days, or every 30 days. You can also add IP addresses for secure networks (such as your school network) on which you can choose to never require a second factor.

**Can I turn off teacher troubleshooting tools for Classroom MFA?**

-   If you configure Classroom MFA for students, teachers will have some tools available in their Portal to troubleshoot login issues for students. For example, teachers can reveal student MFA pictures or reset them. It is not possible to turn off teacher troubleshooting tools for Classroom MFA at this time.

**Can students use Classroom MFA when logging into a Chromebook with a Clever Badge?**

-   Yes! Check out the video below to see what the login flow looks like:

text:

## Overview

This article briefly overviews the various account recovery and password reset options available through Clever. Please review the relevant section below and use the links for more information on your account recovery and password reset options.

* * *

## Resetting your Clever Admin passwords

For help resetting your own passwords or MFA, please see our articles:

-   [For Clever Admins: How do I reset my password?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202083536)
    
-   [Getting help resetting your Multi-factor Authentication access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333#resetting)
    

* * *

## Setting up Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID account recovery and password reset

If you are utilizing Clever IDM for either Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID, you can enable account recovery and password resets for any users you are currently provisioning accounts for (students, teachers, and staff). For more information on the setup and troubleshooting of Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID account recovery and password resets, please see our article [Clever IDM: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662).  
 

* * *

## Clever Passwords password resets

If you are utilizing Clever Passwords as the identity provider for Clever, you can customize whether students, teachers, and staff can reset their passwords via Clever. For more information, please see our articles or [Single sign-on (SSO): Clever Passwords - Log in with Clever (updated)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658).

* * *

## Resetting a student, teacher, or staff password.

As the Clever Admin, you may be able to assist students, teachers, and staff with password resets.

If you are utilizing Clever IDM and would like to reset an end user’s Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID password, please see this article for more information: [Clever IDM: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662).

If you use Clever Passwords as your identity provider, please see the article for more information:

-   [Single sign-on (SSO): Clever Passwords - Log in with Clever (updated)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658).
    

If you’d like to provide your end users with troubleshooting resources, we recommend:

title: For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#header1)  
2\. [Resetting teacher passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#header2)  
         •[Setting up account recovery](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#accountrecovery)  
         •[Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#resettingpwloginscreen)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#thirdparty)  
         •[Resetting your password in Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#resettingincleverportal)  
3\. [Resetting student passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#FAQ)

## Overview

Not being able to log in is no fun. However, if your school organization is using Clever passwords, Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google Workspace as a login method, you may be able to reset your password and the passwords of your students (students may also have the ability to reset their passwords). This depends on whether your school district has enabled this feature, and which login methods they have enabled for it.   
 

* * *

## Resetting teacher passwords

Not all school organizations allow teachers to reset their passwords. If you don’t see the option to reset your password, or if these steps don't resolve the issue, please get in touch with your [school organization's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) directly for help.

### **Setting up account recovery**

If your school has enabled it, you can use a backup method (such as email, security questions, or phone number) to regain access to your Clever, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google Workspace accounts right from your Clever login screen. This is handy if you cannot log in with your password successfully.

To set up your backup method (again, if your school had enabled this functionality), you need to be logged into your Portal.

1.  Click on your blue icon in the upper right corner to bring up your settings.   
    
2.  Click on **Set up recovery methods.** The recovery methods available to you depend on what your school organization has enabled.
    
3.  Choose a recovery method and input the information.
    
4.  Depending on what you choose for a recovery method, you will be prompted on how to continue.
    

![Gif of setting up a recovery method](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El83h)

It’s also possible that your school organization may have provided a recovery method for you using information in their records. For example, if your schools collect personal email addresses, they may set up your account recovery email as your personal email address. If you’d like to update the information your school organization provides, you can do so using the recovery method setup described above.

### **Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login screen**

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:**

1.  From the Clever login screen, click on **get help logging in.**
2.  Choose **Reset your account passwords.  
    ![Reset your account passwords screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El9vp)** 
3.  Input your school organization email address (not to be confused with a recovery email you have set up).   
    ![Account recovery](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElATh) 
4.  You’ll be prompted to confirm your identity using a method you set up in your Portal settings. Select how you’ll confirm your identity.
5.  You can now set up your new password for both your Clever and third-party accounts by inputting a new password. Your school may have password requirements, which can be viewed by clicking on **See requirements**. Once completed, you can use your new password for your third-party account(s).  
      
    ![Screenshot of the set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020isj)

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:**

1.  Select **Get help logging in!** to reset your password using the email address linked to your school organization's Clever account.  
      
    ![Login page showing an error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hqD)  
      
    
2.  Choose **Reset only your Clever password  
      
    ![Reset only your Clever Password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElCth)** 
3.  Enter the email that you signed up with to receive password reset instructions, and click **Send.  
      
    ![Screenshot of the Recover account page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hdK)**

### **Resetting your password in Clever Portal**

Alternatively, if you do have access to your Teacher Portal and want to update your password for any reason (e.g., you feel your passwords may have been compromised), you can do so by following these steps from your Teacher Portal:

1.  Click on your blue icon in the upper right corner to bring up your settings.  
    ![Screenshot of the Password reset option in Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElCKE) 
2.  From underneath **Log in password** click **Change passwords** to update**.** 

This is independent of the account recovery process and doesn’t require you to go through the recovery method.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkWMe)   Please note:** Your school organization's settings will determine which passwords you can reset through Clever. In the screenshot above you’ll see this user will reset both their Google and Clever password. Please pay close attention to the passwords you are resetting.

* * *

## Resetting student passwords

If your school has enabled it, you can reset student passwords for **Log in with Clever** and third-Party accounts. Best of all, it can be done right from your Teacher Portal! 

To update a student’s password:

1.  Click on **My Students** in the menu on the left side of your Teacher Portal.
2.  Choose **Student Roster**.
3.  You can find the student by filtering by class and then clicking on the student from the roster.
4.  You’ll see **Student Tools** on the right side of the Portal under the student’s name. From there, click on **Set new password**. Depending on your district’s settings, this will reset the student password for any login method managed by Clever.  
    ![GIF for resetting student password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El1Jy)   
       
    _In the video above, you'll see the student passwords will be reset for both Google and Clever passwords.  
    _
    
    Once updated, your student should be able to log in successfully with the new password you've created.
    
    If your school has enabled it, students may also be able to reset their own passwords. To see how students can reset their own accounts, check out this article: [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307).  
      
    

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How long do I need to wait after resetting my password before logging in?**

-   You can login immediately after resetting your password!
    

**What if I don’t have the option to reset my password?**

-   Reach out to your [school organization's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) for further assistance.
    

**Can Clever reset my password for me or tell me what my password is?**

-   No, the Clever Support team cannot reset your password for you or provide you with your password. Please reach out to your school organization directly if you’re having issues with your password.
    

**What are the password reset requirements?**

-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

title: What is SAML?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001610#header1)  
2\. [What is SAML?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001610#header2)  
3. [How SAML works](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001610#header3)  
4\. [How you can use SAML with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001610#header4)

## Overview

This article will give you an overview of what SAML is and how to use it. By the way, SAML stands for Security Assertion Markup Language, in case you were wondering!  
 

* * *

## What is SAML?

So technically, SAML is an open standard for exchanging authentication and authorization data between two parties. It’s commonly used for single sign-on (SSO), allowing users to sign in once and authenticate securely with multiple third-party applications. SAML is one of the methods Clever uses to help you access a variety of connected applications just by signing in to Clever!  
 

* * *

## How SAML works

Two primary roles in a SAML exchange are Service Providers (SP) and Identity Providers (IdP).

-   **Service Providers**: SPs are services or applications (like BrainPOP or Remind) that users want to access. Service Providers coordinate with Identity Providers to authorize and grant access to those services or apps.
-   **Identity Providers**: IdPs (like Active Directory or Google) authenticate the user (making sure you’re you!) and share authorization information with SPs. Identity Providers package the users' information into a well-known format known as a SAML Assertion.

The thing to know about SAML is that both SPs or IdPs can kick off the sign-in process into an app; it just depends on where you, as the user, visit first:

-   If you visit the application first, the application (or SP in SAML terms) will ask the Identity Provider for information about the user and then use that information to process the login, essentially asking the Identity Provider if you’re legit.
-   If you first visit an SSO application (or IdP like the Clever Portal) and then navigate to an application from a list of approved applications, the IdP will forward information to the Service Provider, giving them a heads up that you’re who you say you are.

To illustrate this, let’s look at the following scenario:  
You’re attending the Educators of the Year conference (yay, you!). When you arrive, you need to pick up your attendance badge and a color-coded lanyard to allow you into specific sessions at the conference. 

![Illustration of service providers and identity providers sign-in process](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001js5J)

You can get your badge and lanyard in one of two ways.  
  
**Option 1**: **Check in, then go to the venue for your session (like going through an IdP and then a Service Provider/app)  
**  
Checking in to the event involves contacting the event coordinators, who then verify registration and put together a packet with your badge and lanyard.   
**  
Option 2:** **Head to the venue and get checked in (like going to the Service Provider/app, and having it verify you via an IdP)**  
  
Alternatively, you can check in at the venue, which then contacts the event coordinators who verify your registration.  
  
Regardless of the check-in method, the result remains the same- your registration is verified, and you have the necessary badge and lanyard to participate in the sessions.  
In this scenario, the event coordinator acts as the Identity Provider while the venue acts as the Service Provider. The packet put together by the event coordinator is similar to the SAML assertion. You have two options for checking in. The first method, early check-in, is similar to the IdP-initiated flow. The second method, checking in at the venue, is similar to the SP-initiated flow.  
 

* * *

## How you can use SAML with Clever

You can add any SAML connection as an IdP into Clever! We offer support for Active Directory Federation Services  (AD and Entra ID), Okta, and Rapid ID. However, any SAML connection can be created by following the same steps outlined in [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218050687). Clever won’t have insight into the IdP other than those we offer support for.  
 

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

-   [Single sign-on (SSO): Configure a SAML-based IDP for access to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218050687)

title: For Clever Admins: Clever LMS Connect
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001609#header1)  
2\. [Features](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001609#header2)  
3\. [Learn More](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001609#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001609#header4)

## Overview

Clever is excited to announce that we're offering a solution to school organizations that allows you to directly connect your LMS with Clever. Clever LMS Connect allows school organizations to launch applications directly from their LMS, save teachers time by eliminating grade double entry, and easily add application content and assignments to their LMS.

![Screenshot of the Clever LMS Process](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cST7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001UEbH)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cST7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** As seen in the graphic above, LMS Connect does **not** connect your LMS to your SIS and vice versa. 

* * *

## Features

Clever LMS Connect connects learning applications to your LMS through the Clever API and creates a seamless learning experience for students and teachers by:

-   Saving time: Teachers and students can launch applications directly from the LMS (compliant with LTI launch protocol requirements).
    
-   Eliminating grade double entry: Teachers can sync grades and assignments between your LMS and learning applications.
    
-   Adding content and assignments: Teachers can automatically insert content and assignments directly from applications into the LMS. This means that students can easily launch applications and find assignments in their LMS.
    

View the videos below to see the LMS Connect teacher and student experience.

### **Canvas**

##   

### **Google Classroom**

##   

* * *

## Learn More

Clever LMS Connect is available for free to school organizations, and will be available on a per-app basis as learning applications build their LMS Connect integrations. We encourage you to reach out to applications that you are already rostering through Clever, and let them know that you're interested in using Clever LMS Connect with their application.

If you're interested in partnering with Clever to be one of our first school organizations to implement LMS Connect, please fill out our [interest form](https://www.getclever.com/lms-connect-contact-districts/). Plus, be sure to check out our [product releases](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/release-notes) for new updates on Clever LMS Connect. 

If none of your connected Clever apps have built an LMS Connect integration, you'll see a waitlist on the LMS Connect page in your Clever Dashboard: 

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > LMS Connect](https://schools.clever.com/lms-connect) page.
2.  Click **Join waitlist** & fill out your information.

![Screenshot of the LMS Connect waitlist button on the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cST7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003KiUb)

Clever will notify you when one of your apps becomes available to connect. 

Whether you're on the waitlist or you've already set up LMS Connect, you can also request that more of your Clever apps build integrations by clicking the app interest form:

![Screenshot of the LMS Connect app interest form link.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cST7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005dxJv)     
  

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What’s the difference between Clever LMS Connect and Google Classroom roster import?**

-   Google Classroom roster import allows school organizations to provision Courses in Google Classroom based on data in the SIS. Clever LMS Connect allows school organizations to sync assignments and gradebooks between applications and Google Classroom.
    
-   To ensure a quality data-matching experience with Google Classroom for Clever LMS Connect, Clever requires school organizations using Google Classroom to connect with the Google Classroom roster import app. As Google Classroom allows teachers to modify their own classrooms, this presents a challenge with maintaining data parity for Clever LMS Connect if a school organization is not using Clever to roster Google Classroom courses. 
    

**Do you know if Clever LMS Connect for Google Classroom will work with the free version of Google Fundamentals or would it require a paid tier with Google?**

-   School organizations using Google Classroom with Clever LMS Connect are required to connect with Clever’s Google Classroom roster import app to ensure a quality data-matching experience. As Google Classroom allows teachers to modify their own classrooms, this presents a challenge with maintaining data parity for Clever LMS Connect if a school organization is not using Clever to roster Google Classroom courses. 
-   Using the Google Classroom roster import application requires a Google Workspace for Education plus subscription.
    

**Will Clever LMS Connect pass grades back to our SIS?**

-   Not at this time. LMS Connect will only sync grades and assignments between applications and your LMS.

**Is Clever LMS Connect a separate charge for school organizations?**

-   LMS Connect is free for school organizations.

**Will Clever LMS Connect work if our school organizations use multiple LMSs?**

-   At this time, LMS Connect will only work with one LMS per school organization. We hope to allow for multiple LMSs per school organization in the future.

**Which LMS systems will work with Clever LMS Connect?**

-   We plan to integrate with all major LMSs, especially starting with those that are most used by schools - Google Classroom, Schoology, and Canvas. We plan to integrate with more in the future.
    

**Can I use Clever LMS Connect if I already have LTI integrations set up with certain apps in my LMS?**

-   Yes, with Clever LMS Connect you can manage all your rostering and LMS connections in one place. The advantage of Clever LMS Connect is you’ll only need to connect your LMS to Clever once, and then you can quickly connect with applications. You’ll no longer need to manage LMS data matching with applications individually.

**Does Clever support cross-listing with LMS Connect?**

-   LMS Connect automatically syncs assignments and grades from applications to your LMS. However, if your school organization has cross-listed sections in your LMS, this functionality isn't currently available.
