title: SFTP Syncs: SFTP web upload feature with field mapping
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001608#header1)  
2\. [Initial file upload](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001608#header2)  
3\. [Updating your data after your initial sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001608#header3)  
4\. [Review existing field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001608#header4)  
5. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001608#faq)

## Overview

The web upload tool now makes it easier to upload your schools' data to Clever by helping you match the columns in your files to the columns Clever requires, such as school\_id, using field mapping. A **field mapping** is when you assign the column headers you sync to Clever via CSV upload to a Clever field. You can associate a column header from your uploaded file to multiple required Clever fields.

For example, you could map your school number field to both School\_id and School\_number in Clever. Keep in mind that the reverse is not available, as you can’t associate a Clever field with multiple column headers. 

This is a useful tool for school organizations that manage their Clever files and don’t have a way to edit the files they are uploading. For example, if you are using a SIS-Managed Auto Sync and your SIS is not able to edit a file header for you. Keep reading to learn how to upload your files with field mappings!  
 

##   

* * *

## Initial file upload

**Step 1:** Prepare the following 5 required files to upload to Clever:

-   schools.csv
    
-   teachers.csv
    
-   students.csv
    
-   sections.csv
    
-   enrollments.csv
    
-   staff.csv (optional)
    

  
Make sure your files include all data that is marked as required for each file in the [Clever SFTP Specifications.](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** View the correct column headers for each file type in the [_How to format your files_](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding/onboarding-sync/1583190%E2%80%9D%20with%20%E2%80%9Chttps://clever.academy/path/onboarding/onboarding-sync/1583190?user_type=district_admin) section of this Clever Academy Quick Start Guide.

**Step 2:** Upload your files on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) tab as shown: 

![The upload page, where you can manually upload your CSV files.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dinZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001OVTV)

**Step 3**: After you click _Upload_, you’ll check that each required file (schools, students, teachers, sections, and enrollments) has the correct column headers.

![Field mapping setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dinZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001ORhe)

The required column headers are listed first. Once you fill out the required column headers, the optional fields will appear. Click _Next_ _step_ after going through each data type. During these steps, you’ll make sure that the column headers match the corresponding fields in Clever. **We do not recommend changing mappings for any ID fields (school\_id, student\_id, teacher\_id, section\_id, etc.) after a first sync as this will cause data to be deleted and recreated, potentially causing a loss of historical data.**

**Step 4**:  Once you’ve completed each CSV file, you’ll get to _Review & submit_.  Here you can review your column headers and the Clever fields. If everything looks correct, you can click _Submit_.  After approximately 30 minutes, your uploaded data will be reflected in Clever.

![Review & submit field mapping page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dinZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001VJPC)

* * *

## Updating your data after your initial sync

Any time you need to update your data in Clever, whether adding a new student or adjusting a field mapping, you'll need to repeat the above steps. Just be sure to include ALL records for each file type you upload. Any data missing from the files will be deleted from Clever.

Once you’ve uploaded your files, you will be prompted to review your field mappings to make adjustments as needed. If your field mappings don’t need to be changed, you can click _Submit_.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dinZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)   Please note:** Please do not change the field mappings for any sis\_id values (school\_id, student\_id, teacher\_id, section\_id, staff\_id) after your initial data sync. Changing sis\_ids may cause a loss of historical data. Please contact Clever Support if you need to change sis\_ids.

* * *

## Review existing field mappings

You can view your field mappings on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) tab at any time.

![Link to view field mappings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dinZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001OVbZ)   

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What does it mean to complete a field mapping?**

-   A field mapping is when one field is linked to another. With the field mapping tool, you assign a header (field) in your CSV files to a field in Clever.

**How do I know which field in my CSV files should I should map to each Clever field?**

-   You should choose the fields that are most closely related. For example, a value of 123456 in your student CSV titled **student\_code** may fit for both student\_id and student\_number. You can map the student\_code field in your students.csv to both the student\_id and student\_number fields in Clever.

**Do I need to change my field mappings after my first sync?**

-   Only if you have added new fields! Before each new data sync, you should review your existing field mappings to confirm that no changes are needed.

**Can I change my sis\_id mappings?**

-   Please consult Clever Support if you need to change any sis\_id (school\_id, student\_id, teacher\_id, section\_id) values. Changing ID field mappings may result in a loss of historical data.

**Why are my uploads via the Web Upload tool in Clever not completing?**

-   If you aren’t receiving a specific sync error, and it appears that files are not processing at all, your school organization may have a firewall in place that is blocking uploads.  Please check with your team internally to ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752).

* * *

**Related Articles:  
  
**

-   [SFTP Syncs: Viewing Clever CSV files](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001499)
-   [SFTP Syncs: Troubleshooting CSV formatting errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698)
    
-   [SFTP & Manual Upload](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867)

title: For App Partners: Clever Concierge
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001606#header1)  
2\. [How it works](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001606#header2)  
3\. [Input CSV Guidelines](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001606#header3)  
4\. [Output CSV format](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001606#header4)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5XF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever Concierge is currently only enabled for applications that support Secure Sync.

## Overview

Clever Concierge is our premium district onboarding service for partners implementing at scale. We’ll help you match your existing customers and quickly invite them to connect via Clever.  
 

* * *

## How it works

1\. From your Clever Dashboard > click **Clever Concierge** (left-side menu)

![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 11.15.16 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5XF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000012si8)

2\. Upload a customers.csv file containing your existing customer list

3\. Clever will perform a customer match based on the data you have uploaded

4\. You’ll receive a district match confirmation. You can work with your CSM to confirm the right folks are included in the bulk invite campaign. Please contact your Customer Success Manager with any questions about Clever Concierge. If you’re unsure of who to contact, feel free to reach out to contact [application-success@clever.com](mailto:application-success@clever.com)  
 

* * *

## Input CSV Guidelines

When creating an input CSV to upload to Clever's Concierge, we recommend using our [CSV template](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/2311-CONCIERGE_TEMPLATE-V1.csv) as a guide. The filename for the CSV file should be the following (all lowercase letters): customers.csv

![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 11.48.58 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5XF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000130qv)

Be sure to include as many of the fields listed below as possible. We strongly encourage you to include at minimum the District Name and NCES ID or MDR for best results.

-   District Name
-   NCES ID or MDR (providing accurate MDR numbers or NCES IDs will provide best results)
-   District State
-   District Contact Name
-   District Contact Email
-   Date the district should go live with SSO
-   Names of school sites using your application
-   NCES IDs of school sites using your application  
     

* * *

## Output CSV format

After you have uploaded your CSV, please allow up to a week for review. Our team will provide you with a CSV containing the following fields:

-   District Name
-   District Clever ID
-   State (if applicable)
-   Launch Status (if applicable)  
     

* * *

**Related Articles**

-   [For App Partners: Navigating the Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215800557?language=en_US)
-   [For App Partners: Transferring existing districts to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767?language=en_US)

title: Clever IDM: Account links
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001604#header1) 2\. [Linking accounts between Clever and a destination](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001604#header2) 3\. [Common troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001604#header3) ## Overview Clever IDM account links are the glue that ties a Clever IDM account and a destination, such as Google, Active Directory, or Entra ID, together. When an IDM sync runs, we create a link between what's in Clever and what's in the destination and provision a destination account and email based on the Clever account. * * * ## Linking accounts between Clever and a destination When an IDM sync runs, Clever creates a link between a Clever account and an account in either Google, AD, or Entra ID. If Clever IDM can't find an existing account with the relevant username or email address for a user, it will create a new account in the destination and link it to the corresponding account in Clever. Links are helpful in preventing issues, such as when a graduating student happens to share a username with an incoming freshman: 1. User 1, jsmith graduates 2. User 2, jsmith is an incoming freshman 3. We don't want user 2 taking over user 1's Google account 4. Clever throws a conflict to flag this issue for the Clever admin Without the links, we would erroneously automatically match Clever user 2 with the old jsmith account. Occasionally, because of inaccurate data in Clever or a destination, Clever IDM will incorrectly link a Clever account to an account in a destination. For instance, a user's email might sync to Clever with a typo, or with the wrong email address altogether. In such cases, the link connects that Clever user to the wrong email address. When this happens, you can remove the link, fix the typo, and run a new Clever IDM sync. There are two ways to unlink an active user. For archived users, you'll need to use the second method as their profile page will no longer be available in Clever. 1. You can remove the link by going to the Clever [Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) > User's profile page > Details tab > Clever IDM Information box > click Unlink user. ![Details tab of a Clever user profile showing IDM link information and the Unlink user button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eN5x&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000uyRJ) As long as you correct the data in Clever and/or the destination, the new link will be correct. 2. Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > User Management > IDM > Events tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) and click the drop-down menu for the user you need to unlink. You'll see an **Unlink user** button. Again, as long as you correct the data in Clever and/or the destination, the new link will be correct. ![IDM Events page with unlink user button circled](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eN5x&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000dnH2t) The link creation lifecycle follows these steps: 1. Clever IDM creates a link when we find a matching account in a destination or when it provisions a new one. - Example: Joyce is a new student at the school organization and her email address in Clever is provisioned in the destination and linked to her Clever account. 2. If your school organization syncs the user's email and username from your SIS, the link is updated automatically if the username changes. If you rely on a template-generated username or email, you must unlink to create a new template-generated username or email. - Example: A student is adopted and now has a new last name. Their last name change alters their username and email. Their link is automatically updated since you're syncing their username and email from the SIS! 3. If the Clever user is no longer in your SIS, we archive them via IDM. If a user returns to Clever within one year of departure and is in an Archive OU, their Clever account will be restored **and** moved from the Archive OU to the appropriate active OU based on your Parent/Sub-OU settings. If a user returns after one year, a new Clever and destination account will be generated. - Example: Joyce has the opportunity to be an exchange student for 6 months, so she leaves her school organization temporarily. When she gets back, her account is restored. 4. Once they're archived in IDM, the destination account is disabled. 5. If desired, you'll need to delete the accounts manually - Example: A couple of years later, Joyce graduates. Many Clever admins keep graduated seniors in archive OUs for a few months after graduation before deleting them. 6. Once the Clever user and the destination user are entirely deleted, we delete the link upon the next IDM sync. * * * ## Common troubleshooting Here are a few examples of some common issues:

Issue

Resolution

A user gets married, changes their name, and has a new email address. The link for that user is connected to the old email.If your school organization syncs the user's email and username from your SIS, the link is updated automatically if the username or email changes.

If you rely on a template-generated username or email, you must unlink to create a new template-generated username or email.

Once updated, the account will be correctly linked after the next Clever IDM sync.

There's a typo in a user's email that has been synced to Clever. Now that user is linked to the wrong email address.If your school organization syncs the user's email and username from your SIS, the link is updated automatically if the username or email changes.

If you rely on a template-generated username or email, you must unlink to create a new template-generated username or email.

Once updated, the account will be correctly linked after the next Clever IDM sync.

* * * #### **Related Articles:** - [Clever IDM: Sync reports & issue troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001473) - [Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467) - [Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505) - [Clever IDM: Entra ID Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553) * * *

title: Clever IDM: Organizing OUs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#header1)  
2\. [Organize OUs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#header2)  
         •[Parent OU](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#parentou)  
         •[Sub-OUs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#subou)  
         •[Archive OUs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#archive)  
         •[Ignored OUs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#ignored)  
3\. [Building sub-OUs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001603#header3)

## Overview

This article will help you understand how Clever IDM organizes users within your existing Active Directory or Google OU structures during the IDM setup process. The organization of these is very similar for both destinations, Active Directory and Google.

  
You can find the general setup for each destination type here:

-   [](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)[Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)
-   [Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)

* * *

## Organize OUs

OU stands for organizational unit, a group that an administrator can create in Active Directory or the Google Admin console to apply settings to a specific group of users, such as students or 7th graders.

Clever IDM will organize users into your existing OU structure and create optional sub-OUs based on Clever user data. A preview will display the resulting OU structure based on your selections during setup.

![Image of an OU structure](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000ux2D) 

### **Parent OU**

Select the primary OU where all users for the user type should reside. In the next step, the school organization can identify which sub-OUs Clever should create to organize students.   
Clever requires the following OUs for Google and Active Directory:

-   Parent OU for student users
-   Parent OU for teacher users
-   Parent OU for staff users
-   Parent OU for archived users

###   
**Sub-OUs**

Clever can create sub-OUs to organize users based on data in Clever, such as school, grade level, and graduation year. Please note that sub-OUs aren't required.

Here are a few popular options: 

Student sub-OUs:

-   {School}
-   {School} > {Grade}
-   {School} > {Graduation year}
-   {Grade}
-   {Graduation year}

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)****Graduation Year**:  If synced to Clever, IDM will use the **Graduation\_year** field from the school organization's SIS. Otherwise, IDM will automatically calculate the Graduation Year for students K-12 based on the student's **Grade** field. In calculating graduation year, Preschool, PreKindergarten, and TransitionalKindergarten will be treated as grade -1. Kindergarten is treated as 0.

Students in the following grade levels will NOT have a Graduation Year unless provided by the school organization: InfantToddler, 13, PostGraduate, Ungraded, Other.

Teacher sub-OUs:

-   {School} 

Staff sub-OUs:

-   {Department}
-   {Job code}
-   {custom formula}

Clever recommends implementing sub-OUs to assist with organization and permissions. 

### **Archive OUs**

Clever allows the school organization to determine the parent OU to which a user will be assigned when an account is removed from Clever. If a user is removed from Clever, they will be placed in the Archive OU during the next Clever IDM sync.

If a user returns to Clever within one year of departure and is in an Archive OU:

-   If a user returns to Clever within one year of departure and is in an Archive OU, Clever will restore their account and move it from the Archive OU to the appropriate active OU based on your Parent/Sub-OU settings.
-   Clever will generate a new Clever account and Active Directory or Google account if a user returns after one year. 

    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QCbo2)    Please note:** For Google, Clever IDM will manage the archival of users with any free Fundamentals, Fundamentals-archive, and Gmail-only licenses, as specified in your [Clever IDM archive OU setup](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management/setup/ous/archive-ou). To manage users with paid licenses, please use the [Google License Manager in your Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/license-manager).

How Clever IDM protects against the accidental archiving of multiple users by detecting unusual behavior:

1.  We calculate the percentage of users marked for archiving for each user type (e.g., students, teachers, and staff).
2.  If this percentage exceeds 20%, the archive will be automatically paused, and Clever admins will receive a notification.
3.  This notification will appear on the IDM dashboard, under the Tasks section.
4.  Clever Admins review users to determine whether or not they should be archived.

###   
**Ignored OUs**

Ignored OUs are OUs in your destination (Active Directory and Google) that you want Clever to ignore. Clever won't move users out of these OUs, and you'll manage them manually. You can use ignored OUs to implement more rigorous controls, such as applying settings for specific individuals or groups of users; for example you might have an ignored OU for users that blocks YouTube.. Multiple OUs can be selected.

By default, Clever IDM deactivates accounts when users are removed from Clever – unless they are in an ignored OU. The default behavior for users in ignored OUs is to ignore those accounts entirely. However, you can update this behavior as outlined below.

Clever IDM offers three options for student, teacher, and staff accounts in ignored OUs, giving you more flexibility. These options are available in the **Organize OUs** step of the IDM Provisioning Setup:

-   When users are removed from Clever, automatically suspend user accounts in ignored OUs.
    -   Clever IDM will update user accounts with this setting.
-   When users are removed from Clever, don’t automatically suspend user accounts in ignored OUs.
    -   You’ll suspend these user accounts.
-   Don’t match, update, or suspend users in ignored OUs. I will manage these user accounts myself.
    -   You’ll handle all updates for users in ignored OUs.   
          
        ![Screenshot of Ignored OUs highlighting where to edit](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000ux3p) 

* * *

## Building sub-OUs

Clever IDM can support OU modifications, which allow you to organize users based on data in Clever. The IDM format builder walks you through creating formats for sub-OUs. Please review our [Clever IDM: Formulas article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555) to learn more about using the format builder.

To access the formula builder for Clever IDM:

1.  Click on the **Organize OUs** step in the provisioning setup for Google or Active Directory.
2.  Click **Edit** in the OU for which you want to create a format.  
      
    ![the student OU setup in the IDM provisioning steps](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000040MHZ)   
      
    
3.  Click **Next step** in the blue box on the bottom right to get to the **Build your format** step.  
      
    ![Screenshot of the organize OUs step in the provisioning setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000040MPd)   
      
    
4.  Click **Build your format** to create sub-OUs. To learn more about your options with building a format, review our [Clever IDM: Formulas article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555).  
      
    ![screenshot of the build your format button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000040Mav)   
      
    
5.  You’ll have several options to build a format:
    1.  Block builder
        1.  Use a premade sub-OU format (can be edited)
        2.  Build a sub-OU format using blocks
    2.  Enter a format string (Advanced)  
          
        ![Screenshot of options for building a format for student sub-OUs](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000040Me9) 
6.  On the right, you can preview the data. If the format looks correct, click **Save format**.  
      
    ![screenshot of building a format for sub-OUs](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000047QI1)    
      
    

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The block builder approach for building formats doesn’t currently support extension fields or advanced function use. If you need to use your extension fields or write more complex functions that you know Clever supports but don’t see as an option, you’ll need to use the advanced option of entering a format string. See the [Clever IDM: Formulas article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555) for assistance with format strings.

If an error occurs with your format, you can view it in the red error box:  
  

![Screenshot of red callout box showing an error in the sub-OU format](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zr9V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000047tDZ)

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

-   [Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)
-   [Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)

* * *

title: Clever SSO Policy
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001602#header1)  
2\. [SSO Policy settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001602#header2)  
3\. [Disallowed users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001602#header3)

## Overview

Clever [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807) allows your schools’ students, teachers, and staff to log in to Clever and access their connected applications. Once users log into Clever, they simply click on an application icon in their Portal and are logged in to the learning app automatically via SSO.

  
For school districts that use Clever Passwords to log in as well as another Identity Provider (IDP), you can use our [SSO Policy](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/ssopolicy) to assign which users can use Clever Passwords as a login method and which users must use another IDP. This can be helpful for making sure your users are logging in with the method that you want them to use.  
 

* * *

## SSO Policy settings

If your district uses Clever Passwords and another IDP (such as Google or Active Directory) and you only want specific users to be able to use Clever Passwords, you can adjust this under [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > SSO Policy](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/ssopolicy).  
 

![SSO Policy settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmkP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000lVef)

* * *

## Disallowed users

If a user who isn’t authorized to use Clever Passwords attempts to log in with Clever Passwords, they’ll receive an error message that indicates they need to use another configured login method. The message isn’t customizable and will recommend they use your other configured login method(s).

![Screenshot showing disallowed user message on the login page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmkP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000lVjV)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with Office 365/Entra ID"](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889768)

title: Sharing Permissions: Unshare All Data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001601#header1)  
2\. [Share by rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001601#header2)  
3\. [Share by schools, share by district, school site sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001601#header3)  
4\. [Restore previous sharing settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001601#header4)

## Overview

This article explains how a school organization can unshare all data with an application without disconnecting from the application. The instructions are specific to your sharing type, which can be viewed on the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page.  
  
![Image with sharing rule types highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WkI9E)

* * *

## Share by rules

Please note these directions are for standard sharing. If using guided sharing, please switch sharing setup view to standard sharing.

![Sharing rule setup screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000ilKz)

If sharing by rules:

1.  Navigate to the application in Clever
2.  Click **Edit Sharing**
3.  Click **Edit Sharing Rules**
4.  Delete all existing sharing rules (Don't worry, you can restore your previous rules using [these directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001601#header4).)
5.  Click **Add Another Rule**
6.  Click **Custom Share by Student**
7.  Add the rule **Student SIS ID > equals any of > X  
    **Please note: you will need to click **Create "x"** to add this value  
    ![Custom Share by Student rule with SIS ID condition](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000ikC2)  
      
    
8.  Click **Done Editing**
9.  Click **Save Sharing Rules**

* * *

## Share by district, share by school, school site sharing

If sharing by district, school, or school-site sharing, please follow these directions. (Don't worry, you can restore your previous rules using [these directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001601#header4).)

1.  Navigate to the application in Clever
2.  Click **Edit Sharing**
3.  In the top-left, click **Change**
4.  Select **Share by rules  
      
    **
    
    Please note these directions are for standard sharing. If using guided sharing, please switch sharing setup view to standard sharing.
    
    ![Sharing rule setup screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000ilKz)
    
5.  Click **Custom Share by Student**
6.  Add the rule **Student SIS ID > equals any of > X  
    **Please note: you will need to click **Create "x"** to add this value  
    ![Custom Share by Student rule with SIS ID condition](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000ikC2)  
      
    
7.  Click **Done Editing**
8.  Click **Save Sharing Rules**

* * *

## Restore previous sharing settings

To restore previous sharing permissions:

1.  Navigate to the application
2.  Click **Past Rules**
3.  Locate the rule you would like to restore and click the dropdown
4.  Click **Revert to these rules**

title: Single sign-on (SSO): Adding Google SSO applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001597#header1)  
2\. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001597#header2)  
3\. [Adding a Google SSO app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001597#header3)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001597#header4)

## Overview

For school organizations that have set up Clever as an IdP into Google, using our Google SSO apps can provide a better Google login experience than using the [Saved Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?) version of those applications. Google SSO apps work on all devices.  
  
In this article, we’ll review the requirements and best practices for configuring Google SSO apps. 

### Which Google SSO apps are available

-   Gmail
    
-   Google Calendar
    
-   Google Classroom
    
-   Google Drive
    
-   Google Docs
    
-   Google Keep
    
-   Google Meet
    
-   Google Sheets
    
-   Google Slides
    

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmj7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Interested in deep-diving into how to best use Clever and Google together? Check out our course, [Clever & Google: Secure Connected Classroom Certification](https://clever.academy/clever-google-cert?user_type=district_admin) available in Clever Academy!

* * *

## Requirements

The Google SSO applications **require configuring a SAML connection** between your Clever account and your Google workspace. You can configure this SAML connection in 3 ways.

1.  Setting up Clever as the organization-wide SSO Provider in your Google Admin Console. Learn about this setup in our article [Single Sign-On (SSO): Setting up Badges into Chromebooks and Chromebook logins with Clever as your organization-wide SSO Provider](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541).
    
2.  Setting up Clever as an SSO Profile in Google. Learn about this setup in our article [Single Sign-On: Setting up Clever Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever as an SSO Profile in Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645).
3.  The **Google Workspace** app for school organizations with a Clever MFA subscription - see configuration instructions here: [For Clever Admins: Clever MFA Google Workspace SAML Setup Guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572).

Setting up Clever as your organization-wide SSO provider is the simplest configuration. If you have not already set up one of the above SAML connections, you will need to do so before proceeding.

If you configure more than one SAML connection for different users, ensure that the [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for the **Chromebook Login for SSO Profiles** or **Google Workspace** apps match the OU enrollment in your Google workspace. The individual Google SSO apps will use the same SAML connection that is configured for that user. Only share Google SSO apps with users who have a SAML connection. You can share the Google SSO apps with all users that have a working SAML connection regardless of which SAML connection that user utilizes.

IMPORTANT: If using on shared iOS devices with native Google apps, ensure that users explicitly log out of all Google accounts within the apps. If users do not explicitly log out, the Google session will remain accessible on the shared device within those apps.

* * *

## Adding Google SSO applications

Adding Google SSO applications is easily done from your Clever Dashboard. 

1.  Go to the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page and search for the Google SSO application you’d like to add. Ensure that you are not selecting the _Saved Passwords_ version of the application.

![Screenshot of adding a Google SAML application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmj7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000GflZ)  
 

2.  Send the integration request.
3.  Confirm that you have completed the SAML Connection.
4.  The application should now have the status of Launched in the Applications table. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360016204711) to understand the application's status.  Remember that your sharing rules for the application must include users in OUs managed by Clever in your Google Workspace in order for the logins to be successful.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Why use Google SAML rather than a Saved Passwords version of the app?**

-   The SAML app can be a better choice because: 
    -   With the SSO version, you don’t have to set up the user's credentials. Users are automatically logged in when they click on the icon in their Clever Portal. 
        
    -   With the SSO version, there is less room for error when users log in the first time.
        
    -   SAML connections are a secure industry standard for performing SSO
        

**Is there ever a situation where we should choose the Saved Passwords version?**

-   No. Once configured, the Google SSO apps provide a superior experience. 

**Does this work with Clever's Google Workspace app, which is included with Clever MFA?**

-   Yes. These Google SSO apps will work for any users who use the Clever Google Workspace app to access Google. 

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

-   [Single sign-on (SSO): Setting up Badges into Chromebooks and Chromebook logins with Clever as your organization-wide SSO Provider](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Setting up Clever Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever as an SSO Profile in Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645)
-   [For Clever Admins: Clever MFA Google Workspace SAML Setup Guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001572)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247)

title: Clever IDM: Exporting data to your SIS (also known as writeback)
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001593#header1) 2\. [Default fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001593#header2) 3\. [Custom fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001593#header4) 3\. [Setting up writeback](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001593#header3) [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001593#header3) ## [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001593#header3)Overview Clever IDM allows sync data export via download and SFTP from the [User management > IDM > Exports tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management). Using this feature, Clever IDM customers can write Clever IDM-generated data back to their SIS if their SIS can import CSV data. This provides another option for schools and can save Clever admin time. * * * ## Default fields The default fields exported from Clever to write back are Google email or AD/Entra ID userPrincipalName and passwords for any destination. Clever IDM export files include rows for all IDM-managed accounts by user type. Other fields may be available depending on your need. Please reach out to Clever Support and we may be able to help. * * * ## Custom fields If you would like to customize the file export, please review the options below and then reach out to Clever Support so we can help with your request. For highly customized mapping needs, contact Clever Support with details on what you’re looking to achieve, and our team will help configure it for you.  The following user types are able to be included:  - Student - Teacher - Staff The following fields are able to be included:

Field

 SisId
 Username
 UserType
 LastName
 CreatedAt
 Password
 StudentNumber
 SchoolSisId
SchoolName
StudentName
StudentGrade
By default, the export doesn’t include headers. If you want headers, please let Customer Support know. If you choose to include headers, the column headers will show the field name. If you want different header names, please let Clever Support know.   * * * ## Setting up writeback Follow these steps for setting up writeback to your SIS: ### **Steps 1-2 should be completed in Clever** 1. If exporting passwords, you must be using Clever IDM and have **Allow password export** enabled for each user type. This is configured in the **Set login credentials** step in the IDM wizard.   ![Screenshot of the Allow password export box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm3B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000009KPJ) 2. Enable **SFTP access for IDM exports** under the **Exports** tab in IDM. ![The Exports tab in Clever IDM](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm3B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001Da0I) ### **Remaining steps should be completed in your SIS** The specific steps to follow will depend on your SIS. We’ve included general information for SISes we know support imports or writeback, but this is not an exhaustive list. If unsure, your best bet is to contact your SIS directly.  **PowerSchool** The best way to set up writeback with PowerSchool is using their Data Import Manager (DIM), which supports automated scheduled imports. You can find DIM in PowerSchool by going to **Data & Reporting > Imports.** Learn more about [PowerSchool DIM here](https://ps.powerschool-docs.com/pssis-admin/latest/data-import-manager). If you do not need to writeback the Global ID or email fields, you can also use AutoComm instead of DIM. Learn more about [PowerSchool AutoComm here](https://ps.powerschool-docs.com/pssis-admin/latest/autocomm-setup). Clever will deliver AutoComm compliant files to the SFTP box in addition to the standard export files. **Infinite Campus** Reach out to the Infinite Campus [Technical Services](https://www.infinitecampus.com/services/technical-services) team to explore options for scheduled CSV imports. **Alma** Alma doesn't support regular automated imports from files sent to an SFTP folder, but they do support manual import via their import tool. As long as it’s a field in Alma’s import library for that entity, a Clever-formatted CSV can be used. For more information, be sure to reach out to their team directly. If you know of any other SISes that support data imports, please let us know by contacting Clever Support and referencing this article! To contact Clever Support, click the chat icon in the bottom right corner and work through the prompts. * * * **Related Articles:**  - [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466)

title: PowerSchool Plugin Sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#overview) 2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#setup)       • [Troubleshooting Installation Errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#installation_errors) 3\. [Updates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#update) 4\. [Customizations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#custom) 5\. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#Header3) 6\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#trouble) 7\. [Sync Errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#syncerrors2) 8\. [Default Field Mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#default_mappings) ## Overview ✓ Runs every four hours ✓ Syncs all students with an active enrollment status ("enroll\_status" = 0) ✓ Syncs teachers that are assigned to an active school and have an active staff status ("Status" = 1) ✓ Syncs co-teachers ✓ Syncs student contacts from PowerSchool v12.x (unlimited contacts). Please note, we highly recommend consolidating contacts prior to using the upgraded PowerSchool sync. More information on contacts can be found [here](https://help.powerschool.com/xvwqy85873/attachments/xvwqy85873/PowerSchool-SIS-Knowledge-Base/1457/1/ps12x_student_contacts_user_guide.pdf). ✓ Works alongside Google and O365 Single Sign-On (SSO) into PowerSchool. This allows SSO access to PowerSchool using Google or O365. It does not provide SSO to PowerSchool via Clever. More info [here](https://ps.powerschool-docs.com/pssis-admin/latest/powerschool-sis-as-oidc-service-provider-for-sso).) ✓ Sync users to the staff user role in Clever. Staff sync is available for school organizations that have set up the PowerSchool plugin sync option for the first time after February 2025. If you've been using the PowerSchool plugin sync prior to February 2025 and would like staff to be synced, please contact Clever Support to discuss potential options. ✓ Can sync the Central Office (school\_id = 0) or any teachers assigned to this site upon request. Please reach out to the Clever Support team to get started. ✓ Can sync users to the staff user role in Clever upon request. This will require a new version of the plugin to be installed. Please reach out to the Clever Support team to get started. Alternatively, staff can be manually added to Clever using [these directions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547). * * * ## Setup New to Clever? Please contact your school organization onboarding specialist for setup directions. If you have not yet connected with a school organization onboarding specialist, you can [sign up here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup). If you have an existing Clever account and would like to transition to the PowerSchool plugin sync, please contact our support team. Please note, the process of changing sync types can take 2-3 weeks. We highly recommend reviewing the conversion process as outlined [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049183691). ⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** If upgrading from the [legacy PowerSchool Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173), please confirm the following before proceeding: • Your current PowerSchool sync is active (no sync status errors). If your sync is broken, the plugin will not successfully generate for your account. • There are active enrollments for the current academic year. • SSO into PowerSchool SIS using an identity provider (Google or O365) as outlined [here](https://ps.powerschool-docs.com/pssis-admin/23.3/powerschool-sis-as-oidc-service-provider-for-sso) has NOT been enabled. • After you've received confirmation from Clever Support that your conversion is complete, you can enable SSO if you'd like, as well as remove the Clever User utilized for your previous PowerSchool Auto Sync. • Student contacts have been consolidated and upgraded to Unlimited Contacts if you plan to sync them to Clever. More information on contacts can be found [here](https://help.powerschool.com/xvwqy85873/attachments/xvwqy85873/PowerSchool-SIS-Knowledge-Base/1457/1/ps12x_student_contacts_user_guide.pdf). To securely install the upgraded PowerSchool sync, please follow these directions: ### **Download the Plugin** The PowerSchool plugin allows Clever to connect to your PowerSchool Student Information System (SIS) to import data for Clever rostering and Single Sign-On (SSO) services. The plugin contains a secure token that is specific to your school organization. Do not share the plugin with individuals outside your school organization or transmit the plugin through insecure methods such as email. 1. Log in to the Clever Dashboard 2. Navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. 3. Under **PowerSchool Plugin**, click **Download PowerSchool Plugin** to download to your local device ### **Install the Plugin** 1. Log in to PowerSchool as an administrator. 2. On the start page, choose **System Management** in the main menu on the left side. 3. Under **Server,** click **Plugin Configuration**. 4. Click **Install**. 5. Under **Plugin Installation File**, click **Choose File** 6. Select the file named **clever\_plugin.zip** from your device and click **Open.** (Do not unzip the file and install the .XML file) 7. In PowerSchool, click **Install** If the plugin installs correctly, it will take you back to the Plugin Management Dashboard. 8. A popup will appear requesting confirmation of registration. Click **Register**. The popup may take a moment to appear. Skipping this step will prevent a successful installation. 9. On the Plugin Management Dashboard, click the Enable/Disable checkbox next to the Clever Plugin, which will be named "District {{your District ID}}" _(example: "District 5a2b7742d220a50001d0880f")_. 10. In the sidebar that opens, click **Enable**. 🛑 **STOP**!**** **Be sure you _Enabled_ the plugin in Steps 10 & 11!** If your account is using the legacy PowerSchool sync, do not disable the Clever Admin access user in PowerSchool until you have received email confirmation of the upgrade from the Clever team. Disabling access will block the transition process. If you are an existing Clever school organization, you will receive an email from our team once the transition is complete. The "Sync Type" on the [SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page will also be updated. If any additional actions are required our team will contact you via email. ![Screenshot of the SIS sync Settings page showing the updated sync type after PowerSchool plugin transition](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000datF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000adm1) 🚨 **Do NOT "Regenerate Client ID and Secret" for the plugin; it will break your sync**. If you are informed that you need to regenerate the Client ID and Secret, please contact Clever Support. ![Screenshot of the PowerSchool plugin settings showing the Client ID and Secret fields](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000datF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000HURV) ## * * * ## Troubleshooting Installation Errors

Error(s)

How to Fix

"No active enrollments found for the new school year. Sync will resume once enrollments are published"The PowerSchool plugin sync is unable to find active enrollments for the current academic year. Clever automatically rolls over to the new school year on August 1st. To resolve the error, publish enrollments for the new academic year.
"Plug-in installation error"In the Clever Dashboard, click Download to generate the plugin. Once downloaded, install the plugin in PowerSchool.

You can view and download your district's latest plug-in here: https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings.

When installing the plug-in, please confirm:
  • You have clicked the enable button for the plug-in
  • Any previous plug-in versions have been deleted
  • You have installed the entire .zip file that downloaded from the Clever Dashboard (installing only the plugin.xml file will break the sync)
"User passwords no longer exportable from PowerSchool"

Your district is using one or more legacy password fields that are no longer available to Clever.

In PowerSchool v23.5.0.0 and later, the following fields are no longer exportable:

  • Students.Student_Web_Password
  • Teachers.Password
  • Teachers.TeacherLoginPW

In order to sync passwords to Clever, create a custom field in PowerSchool to store password data. Once created and populated with data, contact Clever Support and let us know the exact name of the table. We will update your sync configuration to pull the data into Clever.

"Update SSL certificate in order to continue syncing with Clever"Please update the SSL certificate for your PowerSchool account. For assistance with this process, please contact PowerSchool support.
"Registration was rejected by the publisher. Contact the publisher of this plugin for resolution.

Bad Request"

This error typically indicates that the registration token in the plugin has expired. Please reach out to Clever Support to have a new plugin generated.
* * * ## Updates Clever's team may need to provide an updated version of the plugin to ensure we meet your school organization's needs. You do not need to disable PowerSchool SSO to update your plugin. If Clever has indicated you need to install an updated version of the plugin, you can update the plugin using these directions: 1. Download the updated plugin as described [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001590#download). 2. Log in to PowerSchool as an administrator. 3. On the start page, choose **System Management** in the left sidebar. 4. Under Server, click **Plugin Configuration**. 5. Click **Install**. 6. Under **Plugin Installation File,** click **Choose File**. 7. Locate the existing upgraded sync - your plugin will have the name format: **District - {Clever District ID} _(example: "District - 5a2b7742d220a50001d0880f")_** 8. Click **Update** 9. Under **Plugin Installation File**, click **Choose File**. 10. Select the file named **clever\_plugin.zip** from your device and click **Open.** (Do not unzip the file and install the .XML file) 11. In PowerSchool, click **Install**. 12. If the plugin installs correctly, it will take you back to the Plugin Management Dashboard. 13. A message will indicate that the plugin was successfully updated. 14. A popup will appear requesting confirmation of registration. Click **Register**. The popup may take a moment to appear. Skipping this step will prevent a successful installation. 15. In the Enable Plugin confirmation sidebar that opens, click **Enable**. 16. On the Plugin Management Dashboard, ensure the Enable/Disable checkbox next to the updated plugin is checked. 17. On the Plugin Management Dashboard, locate your previous plugin version and delete it by clicking the **Delete** button in the actions column. **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000datF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000KKFnN) Please note:** If your ISP or IP address changes, Clever typically doesn't require your new IP address to sync with the PowerSchool Plugin. However, if your IP addresses are changing as a result of transitioning from on-premise to a cloud hosting server, please notify our support team, as this may require updates. * * * ## Customizations - PowerSchool syncs can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every four hours, but the time of day that the syncs occur is not customizable. Syncs can always be initiated/forced at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [Data sources > SIS sync page > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) - Clever can filter exports from PowerSchool to limit the schools, teachers, or students included in the sync. Reach out to Clever Support if you would like to filter exports. - To request customizations or filtering for your PowerSchool sync, please submit a request to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/). **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000datF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PwbQb) Please note:** If you'd like to sync additional data to Clever, you can do so via our automated custom data sync for school organizations using an auto sync. Please reach out [to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for access to your Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automatic exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for automation scripting. * * * ## School Year Rollover On August 1st, Clever will stop syncing last year's section data from PowerSchool. If you would like to stop syncing last year's sections and enrollments before August 1st, or if you would like to continue syncing last year's sections and enrollments after August 1st, please reach out to Clever Support. If enrollments for the new school year are not available after August 1st, you will receive the error: _"No active enrollments found for the school term configured in Clever"._ The error will be resolved once enrollments are published for the new school year. * * * ## Troubleshooting ### Missing Records If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following in PowerSchool:

Record Type

Troubleshooting Steps

EnrollmentsIf you are noticing incorrect enrollments in Clever and your plugin was installed prior to 8/24/23, please navigate to https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings and re-download the plugin. Upload and enable the plugin update to PowerSchool and enable. Once complete, press Sync now in the Clever Dashboard.
StudentsClever will only sync students that meet the following conditions:
  • Record is active
  • enroll_status = 0
TeachersClever will only sync teachers that meet the following conditions:
  • Record is active ("Active" box is checked)
  • Assigned to a school, not the district office (school_id = 0)
  • status = 1
SectionsClever will only sync sections that meet the following conditions:
  • Minimum of 1 active student enrolled
  • No_of_students > 0
  • TermID >= 3400 (please refer to TermID for current academic year)
Staff

Clever does not automatically sync records from PowerSchool to the Staff role in Clever. Upon request, Clever can adjust your sync so that staff sync is turned on. These staff will be associated with one site. Please note that users synced to Clever can be synced as staff or teacher, not both.

 

When staff syncing is off, Clever syncs all teachers with the following:

staffStatus=1, staffStatus=2, staffStatus=3, staffStatus=4

 

When staff syncing is on, Clever syncs:

Teachers: staffStatus=1, staffStatus=4

Staff: staffStatus=2, staffStatus=3


There may be users such as administrators, custodians, and para-professionals who might not use PowerSchool directly but need access to applications through Clever, which you can add as staff.

 

* * * ## Sync Errors Below you can find solutions to common sync errors that may display in your Clever Dashboard.

Error Message

Solution

"No active enrollments found for the school term configured in Clever"

There are no enrollments for the current school year. This can commonly happen starting August 1st when Clever stops pulling data from the prior school year. Once your school's data for the new school year is available and ready, Clever will automatically begin pulling it in.

"The data in your most recent sync has changed significantly. To prevent unintended loss of data, we have not processed this sync. Please review the "Action Required: Clever Sync on Hold" email to resolve this hold."

Your school organization is currently on hold due to significant changes in data. Please review the data hold using these directions.

We encountered an unknown error. Please try syncing again or contact Clever Support if this problem persists.

  • To resync, visit your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page and click on Sync Now.

  • If that doesn't resolve the issue, please reach out to Clever Support.

Plug-in installation error. Please follow these steps to resolve, and contact Clever Support if the problem persists. https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590#installation_errors

The following are the most common reasons this error occurs:

  • A prior version of the plugin was not fully removed from PowerSchool
  • The version of the plugin being installed is not the latest version from the Sync settings page
  • The plugin was not registered in PowerSchool
  • The plugin was not enabled in PowerSchool
  • The XML file, rather than the ZIP file, was installed as a plugin

To resolve, delete and re-install the PowerSchool plugin using the steps here.

If you encounter an error while installing the plugin, it most likely needs to be updated by Clever Support.

* * * ## Default Field Mappings Below are the default field mappings for PowerSchool plugin syncs that are managed by Clever. Please note: - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default, or not accessible to Clever. - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn what options are available. - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. This is common for grade, FRL\_Status, ELL\_Status, and IEP\_Status. ### Schools
