title: Sync Reports: Error messages
text:
This article contains the following:  1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#overview) 2\. [Schools](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#schools) 3\. [Students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#students) 4. [Teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#teachers) 5\. [Sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#sections) 6\. [Contacts / Student Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#contacts) 7\. [Staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001482#staff) ## Overview This article provides more details on the sync errors found in the error files downloadable from the [Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page in the Clever Dashboard. These errors indicate specific records that have failed to sync to Clever as a result of not meeting all requirements to successfully sync to Clever. ![Example image of errors that can be seen on the last attempted sync page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cwRB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000062kbB)  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cwRB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** It is common for the Last Attempted Sync page to display errors, and not all errors need to be resolved. In general, if an error is not impacting user access or causing downstream errors with applications, the error **does not** need to be resolved. Error counts may change and resolve over time as data changes in your student information system (SIS) throughout the school year. ## Schools

Error

Description

Duplicate school_id usedSchool_id must be unique to each site. If this error occurs, confirm the school_id is a field in your SIS that is unique to each school site. See our article this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions and a video tutorial.
Missing required fieldSchools must have the following fields populated to process: 
  • School_id
  • School_name
  • School_number
* * * ## Students

Error

Description

Missing required fieldStudents must have the following fields populated to process: 
  • School_id
  • Student_id
  • Last_name
  • First_name
School "X" not listed in data syncingThis error is rare for students. This indicates the School_id on the student's profile doesn't match a School_id in the Schools.csv file.

To resolve the error: 
  • Confirm the student is enrolled at the correct school site
  • Update export settings for the schools.csv to include the missing school 

See this article for step-by-step directions and a video tutorial.

* * * ## Teachers

Error

Description

Duplicate teacher_id used

Teacher_id must be unique to each teacher. Begin by confirming the teacher_id is not assigned to another teacher.

If the teacher_id is NOT unique. Correct the user's teacher_id in your SIS and upload another data set to Clever.

If the teacher_id is unique, this error is usually the result of the teacher being enrolled at two schools. Most SISs will export a user once per school site. Though this will prompt an error in the sync report, the teacher will successfully be processed into Clever and be connected to all their sections across both schools. As such, the error can be ignored.

See this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions.
Missing required fieldTeachers must have the following fields populated to process: 
  • School_id
  • Teacher_id
  • Last_name
  • First_name
School "X" not listed in data syncing.This indicates the School_id on the teacher's profile doesn't match a School_id in the Schools.csv file.

To resolve the error: 
  • Confirm the teacher is enrolled at the correct school site
  • Update export settings for the schools.csv to include the missing school 

See this article for step-by-step directions for troubleshooting.


This error is common for PowerSchool districts. Please see "Missing Staff" in this article for more information on resolving this error. 

* * * ## Sections

Error

Description

Duplicate section_id used

Section_id must be unique to each section. This error is usually an indicator that an alternate field from the SIS should be used for section_id to ensure the value is unique. 

If a globally unique identifier (GUID) is not available, consider combining two fields to create a unique value. Example: "section_id" + "course_number" + "period"

See this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions.
Missing required fieldSections must have the following fields populated to process: 
  • School_id
  • Section_id
  • Teacher_id
If Teacher_id is missing, it is usually the result of a missing section assignment in the SIS. This can often occur before the beginning of a school year when teacher hiring and assignments are being finalized. The error will resolve once enrollments are assigned.
School "X" not listed in the data syncingThis error is rare for sections. This indicates the School_id on the section's profile does not match a School_id in the Schools.csv file.

To resolve the error: 
  • Confirm the section is enrolled at the correct school site
  • Update export settings for the schools.csv to include the missing school 

See this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions.

No students

Sections must have at least one (1) active student enrolled in order to process. This error is common prior to a term when enrollments are still being finalized. 

This error can also occur if school_id, section_id, or student_id is not consistent across CSV files. 

See this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions.

Student XXX is not listed in the data syncing.

An enrollment was included in the enrollment.csv for student_id: XXXX but the student_id: XXXX does not exist in Clever
* * * ## Contacts / Student Contacts

Error

Description

Duplicate identifier

Contact_sis_id must be unique to each contact. This error is usually an indicator that an alternate field from the SIS should be used for contact_sis_id to ensure the value is unique.

Contact_sis_id is optional. If a unique id is not available, we recommend removing contact_sis_id from the students.csv

See this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions.
Missing required fieldStudent contacts must have the following fields populated to process: 
  • Contact_name
  • Contact_type
* * * ## Staff

Error

Description

Missing required fieldStaff must have the following fields populated to process: 
  • School_id
  • Staff_id
  • Staff_email
  • First_name
  • Last_name
School "X" not listed in data syncingThis indicates the School_id on the staff member's profile does not match a School_id in the Schools.csv file.

To resolve the error: 
  • Confirm the staff member is enrolled at the correct school site
  • Update export settings for the schools.csv to include the missing school 

See this article for step-by-step troubleshooting directions.

title: For Clever Admins: Troubleshoot Sharing tool
text:
![Clever Dashboard screenshot showing the Troubleshoot Sharing feature](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aqBC) This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001477#header1) 2\. [Using the tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001477#header2) 3\. [Match types](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001477#header3) ![Clever Academy logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035faQ) Getting started with the Troubleshoot Sharing tool? Check out our Product Spotlight: Troubleshoot Sharing Tool available in Clever Academy! ## Overview The **Troubleshoot sharing tool** is the perfect utility for quickly identifying why or why not a user is shared with an application. The tool is available to Clever Admins and District Help Desk users.  ![Screenshot of the Troubleshoot Sharing tool showing user search and sharing status](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aqAr) You can find the Troubleshoot Sharing tool in two places: 1\. From the Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Support tools > Troubleshoot sharing](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing) 2\. You can also access the tool from a student or teacher profile. - From a student profile, click Student Tools > [Troubleshoot user sharing](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing?utm_source=2021_Q3_web&utm_medium=helpcenter&utm_campaign=sharinganalyst_launch&utm_content=districts_message_A) - From a teacher profile, click Teacher Tools > [Troubleshoot user sharing](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing?utm_source=2021_Q3_web&utm_medium=helpcenter&utm_campaign=sharinganalyst_launch&utm_content=districts_message_A) * * * The **Troubleshoot sharing** tool can be used to troubleshoot sharing for the following record types: ![Green checkmark icon indicating a supported record type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY) Students ![Green checkmark icon indicating a supported record type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY) Teachers ![Green checkmark icon indicating a supported record type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY) Staff The tool **does not** support troubleshooting sharing for the following record types: ![Red no-entry icon indicating an unsupported record type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5) Clever Admins ![Red no-entry icon indicating an unsupported record type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5) Sections * * * ## Using the tool 1\. Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Troubleshoot sharing](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing) tool 2\. Select a user using **Clever ID, SIS ID, Name, or Email** and select the **Application Name** ![Screenshot of the user search field and Application Name dropdown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E2g) The tool will immediately check if the user is shared 3\. Review the **Sharing Status** ![Red Not Shared status badge](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CCWL) The user is not shared with the application. As a result, they will not have an account created in the application nor will they see the application in their Clever Portal. ![Green Shared status badge](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CCWQ) The user is shared with the application. If the application supports rostering, the student will have an account created in the application. If the application supports Single Sign-On (SSO), the user will see the application in their Clever Portal. 4\. Review the **Next Steps** Below the sharing status, Clever will provide recommendations on how to share or unshare an application with a user. ![Screenshot of the Next Steps recommendations panel](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2O5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CCdW) The two most common adjustments are: **Option 1 (RECOMMENDED):** **Update the user in your student information system (SIS).** This usually involves enrolling the student in a specific section or school in your SIS. The most common issue is the user is not enrolled in a section with a specific subject or grade level. **Option 2: Update the app's sharing rules** If a user is not shared, you can always update or add a sharing rule that matches the properties for that user. Directions for updating sharing rules can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). * * * ## Match types The **Troubleshoot Sharing** tool will run an analysis across all sharing rules for the selected application. For each rule, it will return one of the following match types. A user will be shared with an application if at least one (1) rule is a "Matching" rule.

Match type

Description

MatchingThe user matches all the rule's requirements to be shared with the application. Matching rules are outlined in green.

Example:

The user is associated with a school that is shared. Since this satisfies all criteria for the rule, the user is shared.
Partial Matching

The user matches some, but not all, the rule's requirements to be shared with the application.

Example:


This user is associated with a school that is shared, is enrolled in a section grade is 3-6, but is not enrolled in a section that section name contains 'math'. Since the user does not meet all criteria, the user is not shared via the rule.

Non-MatchingThe user does not match any of the rule's requirements to be shared with the application

Example:

This user is not associated with a section at a school listed. Since the user does not meet any criteria, the user is not shared via the rule.

title: Clever + Imagine Learning Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001474#overview) [2\. Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001474#setup)       • [Recommended Sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001474#sharing) 3\. [Required Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001474#required_fields) 4\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001474#faqs) 5\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001474#support_contacts) ## Overview Use this guide to help connect to Imagine Learning applications. ## Setup Process - Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup) or by accepting your invitation from Imagine Learning. For more information on setting up Clever for the first time, please see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271). Important: Imagine Learning has several apps on Clever. Please ensure you connect to the correct application(s) your district has purchased.   

Application Name

Icon

Description

Imagine MathImagine Math is a research-based, adaptive, online supplemental math solution suite for students in Pre-K through Geometry. Through personalized learning paths driven by the Quantile® Framework, Imagine Math engages students with motivational contests and charitable donations, intentionally scaffolds learning for grade-level success, and provides on-demand access to live, certified math teachers when students need it most.
Imagine Math FactsImagine Math Facts teaches fluency in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to elementary and middle school students through game-like activities with built-in rewards in an immersive 3-D world—helping each student gain math automaticity.
Imagine Language & LiteracyImagine Language & Literacy teaches foundational reading, reading comprehension, and language development skills to Pre-K to Grade 6 students through engaging digital activities, personalized learning paths, and offline resources.
Imagine EspañolImagine Español teaches Spanish foundational reading, reading comprehension, and language development skills to Spanish-speaking students in Pre-K to Grade 2 through engaging digital activities and offline resources.
Imagine ReadingImagine Reading teaches reading comprehension, academic discourse, and information synthesis skills to Grade 3 to 8 students through media-rich text sets (for online close reading), teacher-mediated discussion materials, and offline group project guidelines.
Imagine LecturaImagine Lectura builds strong readers, critical thinkers, and confident biliterate communicators through the study of high-quality, authentic Spanish language text sets with students in grades 3-5.
Galileo K-12Galileo is a Reading/ELA benchmark assessment that assesses students 3 times per year to appropriately place them on their individual instructional path. This comprehensive suite offers real-time reporting tools to reliably track student growth and provide the data to support effective teaching and learning, resulting in high student achievement against college and career readiness standards.
- If your district is already on Clever, you can connect Imagine Learning’s applications **by accepting your invite** OR following these instructions: - Log into your Clever Dashboard and select: [**Applications > Add Applications**](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation. - Search for Imagine Learning - You will then be brought to a page where you can authorize your Imagine Learning request. As Clever SSO and rostering for Imagine Learning is provided at no cost to the district, you can mark that it has already been purchased for the district. - You will also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the Imagine Learning icons in their Clever portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day. - Once you have made your selections, click Request! Once you have shared data with Imagine Learning, the Imagine Learning team will set up the initial sync and will reach out to you to discuss communicating with teachers.   ### **Recommended Sharing** Before sharing:   - Make sure to match product applications with purchased license counts.  - Ensure that students and teachers are in their correct grade levels and that classes are updated for the current school year in your Student Information System (SIS). Imagine Learning recommends that you “Share by Rules” in Clever (you can find more info about [“Share by Rules” here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)). Create a sharing rule by following these steps: 1. Access the Sharing Permissions page for Imagine Learning. To do this, log in to your Clever account and click the icon for Imagine Learning in the sidebar. From the 'Data Sharing' tab, click Share by Rules. 2. Configure your sharing rules by limiting sharing to only the schools, and students that should be synced, and by only sharing sections with the appropriate subject. - For Literacy products we recommend “Homeroom/Advisory” or “English/Language Arts”. - For Math products we recommend “Homeroom/Advisory” or “Math”. Important: To avoid delays in product access, Imagine Learning must receive your updated and completed sharing rules at least 7 business days prior to your target launch date.   * * * ## Required Fields Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. Imagine Learning requires the following data fields be sent: Student: - name - district - school - sis\_id and/or student\_number - credentials - grade Teacher/School Admin/District admin: - name - district - school(s) - email \*A few things to keep in mind for Math Products:  - In order for teachers to see students, and for student accounts to function properly, students must be assigned to a classroom. - Each educator should only be shared as a teacher or staff or a district admin. Accounts shared in more than one role may have the wrong role assigned in-product.  - Teachers can only be assigned to one school. - Students should only be shared with one math class, where possible.   - Co-teachers are not supported in sections.   * * * ## FAQs **Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data error”?** - A **data error** occurs when the record is incompatible with Imagine Learning’s integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Errors must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application. Reach out to Clever Support if you have questions about how to resolve your data error. - A **data warning** occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning. **Why is a student or teacher missing from Imagine Learning?** Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Imagine Learning: - In your SIS data - In your Clever data - Is shared with Imagine Learning in your data sharing permissions Please note, for the Math suite, a user may be missing because they are not enrolled or they are assigned to more than one school. **What if a teacher (and/or student) already has an Imagine Learning account outside of Clever?** When existing Imagine Learning users (both teachers and students) login through Clever, they will be prompted to type in their previous Imagine Learning username and password. Once a user's account has been linked to Clever, any progress previously made on the account will show up when they log in through Clever. **Can teachers and students be assigned to multiple school locations?** The Math suite only supports educators and students in one school. The Literacy suite supports educators in multiple schools, but not students. **Can multiple teachers/staff be assigned to the same course/section?** Imagine Learning can support multiple teachers or staff assigned to the same course/section. **Are staff supported?** Yes, Imagine Learning supports staff with Clever.  **Who should I ask for help with an issue?** If it’s related to data within Clever, or data coming from Clever, please contact Clever. If you are receiving an error message within the Imagine Learning URL, please contact Imagine Learning.   * * * ## Support Contacts Imagine Learning  [support@imaginelearning.com](mailto:support@imaginelearning.com) Clever support.clever.com (click **Support** in the bottom right corner and follow the prompts)

title: Clever IDM: Sync reports & issue troubleshooting
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#overview) 2\. [Tasks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#tasks) 3\. [Events](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#events) 4\. [Troubleshooting tips for destination-specific issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#troubleshootingtips) 5\. [Reports](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#reports) 6\. [Email Notifications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#email) 7. [Email not updating in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001473#notupdating) ## Overview This article runs through how the Clever IDM sync works and how to identify and resolve issues with your sync. By default, IDM syncs occur once per day, in the evening hours. At that time, Clever will compare the data in Clever to the accounts in Google, Active Directory, and/or Entra ID and create, update, or archive users appropriately.  - Users added to Clever will have accounts created in Google, Active Directory, and/or Entra ID - Users deleted from Clever will have their accounts moved to the Archive OU in Google/Active Directory. In Entra ID, the account will be disabled. - Users updated in Clever will be updated in Google, Active Directory and/or Entra ID if their user or organizational (e.g., school or grade level) attributes are changed. If you would like to customize your district’s IDM sync time or frequency, contact Clever support. * * * ## Tasks The [Tasks tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) contains a list of issues that need to be resolved for users. Below are the possible tasks and the actions required to resolve them:   

Task

Detail

Action

# user/s has/have unsupported characters and their account/s could not be created.These users have unsupported characters in fields used to create their email addresses and were not created in Google/AD/Entra.Contact support to resolve users that have unsupported characters.
# user(s) has missing fields and their account(s) could not be createdThese users have missing fields in your SIS used to create their email addresses and were not created in Google/AD/Entra.Please contact support for a list of users with empty fields.
[User email] already exists in Google/AD/Entra and their accounts could not be created.The email already exists in Google/AD/Entra, but has not been matched to an existing Clever user.

If this Google/AD/Entra user is the same as a Clever user, select “Yes match users”



If this user is different from an existing Google/AD/Entra user, select “no, create a new account” which will allow you to add a custom email address for this user.

# of users already exist in Google/AD/Entra and their accounts could not be created.There are more than 10 users that already exist in Google/AD/Entra, but have not been matched to an existing Clever user.Contact support to match more than 25 users. 
  * * * ##  Events After your initial Clever IDM sync, you can continue to track changes to your users via the [User management > Clever IDM > Events tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management). On this tab, you can select a date range for which you’d like to review Clever IDM creates, updates, archives, and matched users. You can also apply filters to examine changes by destination (if you have multiple configured), event type (create, update, etc.), or specific users by name or SIS ID. Once you find the event for the user and destination you’d like to review, click the dropdown arrow to examine more details. ![Screenshot of example Events page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StO9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PvnDh)  If you find that Clever IDM is managing a user in an unexpected manner, and you need help troubleshooting, please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326). Please see the section below on Sync history reports if you’re interested in downloading CSV files to review your Clever IDM sync changes. * * * ##  Troubleshooting tips for destination-specific issues Below are descriptions of possible issues you may see in your Events or Sync History reports. Please click the dropdown menu for the destination you'd like to review issues for. Google Issues

Issue

Description

Resolution

 Conflict with existing email address (conflictWithExistingUser) The user's email in Clever does not match the expected Google email, but an existing Google email match is found, however, we don't have an existing link between the Clever user and Google user.There are 3 options to resolve this:


1. On the Tasks tab, click Yes, match user. This  will create a link between the user’s Clever account and their Google account. 

2. On the Tasks tab, click No. You will be prompted to enter a custom email for the user.


3. Contact support. This option is required if there are more than 25 Conflicts.

conflictWithExistingGoogleUserThe email already exists in Google, but has not been matched to an existing Clever user.Options for resolving:

  1. Manually add the email to the sis_email field for the user.

  2. Click “Yes, match” in the task section of the IDM Dashboard.

  3. Contact support. This option is required if there are more than 25 conflicts.

Clever user already has this email address (conflictWithAssignedEmail)Two Clever users have the same email, or an alias for the user in Conflict exists on a different user.Ensure each Clever user has a unique email, or remove the conflicting alias from the target Google account
email: unrecognized identifier: emailThe user doesn’t have a value for the email field set in Clever.To resolve this issue, you can update the email value in the SIS.
Formula (template)Unable to compute template for a user's Google attribute. The user is missing an attribute required in a template. e.g. If the template error is on "OU" and the error is on student.graduation_year, please ensure you are syncing graduation_year for that student from the SIS.
 Incorrect formula formatIDM is not able to complete the action described by the template.This often occurs because there is a missing field, group, etc. Check the Description column of the Issues Report for more specific information about what is missing.
password: could not compute password for userUsers could not be created due to password template not being available in Clever dataCheck the password template.

What fields are in the template? If those fields do not exist on the affected user(s), the district must add those fields in the SIS.

unsafe archiveThis shows when you have more than 20% of users in a user type are flagged for archival. This is shown to prevent accidental archival.Click Archive in the IDM Dashboard under the Tasks tab if you do intend to archive more than 20% of users.
googleapi: Error 500: Internal error encountered., backendErrorUndeterminedPush a manual IDM sync to resolve, or contact Clever Support.
   Active Directory Issues

Issue

Description

Resolution

Conflict with existing email address (conflictWithExistingUser) The user's email in Clever does not match the expected Active Directory email, but an existing Active Directory match is found, however, we don't have an existing link between the Clever user and Active Directory user.There are 3 options to resolve this:


1. On the Tasks tab, click Yes, match user. This  will create a user association in clever

2. On the Tasks tab, click No. You will be prompted to enter a custom email for the user.


3. Contact support. This option is required if there are more than 25 conflicts.

Conflict with existing Active Directory email address (conflictWithExistingADMail)User conflicts with a target Active Directory account having a different UserPrincipalName, but the target mail attribute matches the user.If the user does match the target Active Directory entry, click 'Yes, match user.'"

If not, remove the Active Directory mail from the target entry so the user can be assigned.

Clever user already has this Active Directory email address (conflictWithAssignedADMail)Two Clever users have the same email, or an alias for the user in conflict exists on a different user.Ensure each Clever user has a unique email, or remove the conflicting alias from the target Active Directory account
conflictWithAssignedADSamAccountNameTwo Clever users would have the same ADSamAccountName, preventing them from syncing to AD.To resolve this issue, ensure users will have unique ADSamAccountNames based on Clever data.
 conflictWithExistingADSamAccountNameA user already exists in AD with this SamAccountNameTo resolve this issue, ensure users will have unique ADSamAccountNames based on Clever data.
email: unrecognized identifier: emailThe user doesn’t have a value for the email field set in Clever.To resolve this issue, you can update the email value in the SIS.
 Formula (template)Unable to compute template for a user's Active Directory attribute. The user is missing an attribute required in a template. e.g. If the template error is on "OU" and the error is on student.graduation_year, please ensure you are syncing graduation_year for that student from the SIS.
Incorrect formula formatIDM is not able to complete the action described by the template.This often occurs because there is a missing field, group, etc. Check the Description column of the Issues Report for more specific information about what is missing.
Could not find association for <user email>A user has multiple email aliases and both Clever ID and SIS IDs have changedContact Clever Support
password: could not compute password for userUsers could not be created due to password template not being available in Clever data 

Check the password template.

What fields are in the template? If those fields do not exist on the affected user(s), the district must add those fields in the SIS.

unsafe archiveThis shows when you have more than 20% of users in a user type are flagged for archival. This is shown to prevent accidental archival.Click Archive in the IDM Dashboard under the Tasks tab if you do intend to archive more than 20% of users.
unknown response with status: 503 body: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. retried and the latest reset reason: connection terminationThis is an Active Directory server connection errorThis will likely go away on the next IDM sync. Push a manual IDM sync to resolve
LDAP result Code 50 "insufficient access rights"IDM is unable to provision in AD, LDAP bind account does not have correct permissions. Could be at OU or individual user level.Please see Clever IDM: Connecting to Active Directory via LDAPS for step-by-step directions to fix this issue.
LDAP Result Code 51 "Busy"This is an AD server connection errorThis will likely go away on the next IDM sync. Push a manual IDM sync to resolve.
LDAP Result Code 68 "Entry Already Exists": 00002071: UpdErr: DSID-031B0C65, problem 6005 (ENTRY_EXISTS), data 0Indicates a potential Conflict on commonName (cn). Similar error code for a Conflict on userPrincipalName or sAMAccountName. Conflict may occur on longer names where IDM abbreviates UPN/username due to AD’s 20-character limit on sAMAccountName.

Search Active Directory for another user with the same CommonName as would be created for this user.

If UPN doesn't match due to IDM's 20-character limit on username, contact support.

LDAP Result Code 64 "Naming Violation": 00000057: LdapErr: DSID-0C090EA6, comment: Error in attribute conversion operation, data 0, v3839The DN structure is incorrect. IDM might be struggling to parse a common name/OU with commas.Correct DN structure. Reach out to Clever Support if you need additional assistance.
400, Unable to update the specified properties for on-premises mastered Directory Sync objects or objects currently undergoing migration. (And other '400' errors)These '400' errors appear to be Azure AD Connect sync blocking IDM from making changes to those users.Turn off Azure AD Connect for these users.
   Entra ID Issues

Issue

Description

Resolution

Conflict with existing email address (conflictWithExistingUser) The user's email in Clever does not match the expected Entra email, but an existing Entra email match is found, however, we don't have an existing link between the Clever user and Entra user. There are 3 options to resolve this:

1. On the Tasks tab, click Yes, match user. This  will create a user association in clever
2. On the Tasks tab, click No. You will be prompted to enter a custom email for the user.

3. Contact support. This option is required if there are more than 25 Conflicts. 

Conflict with existing Entra email address (conflictWithExistingADMail)User Conflicts with a target Entra account having a different UserPrincipalName, but the target mail attribute matches the user.If the user does match the target Entra entry, click 'Yes, match user.'

If not, remove the Entra mail from the target entry so the user can be assigned.

Clever user already has this email address (conflictWithAssignedEmail) Two Clever users have the same email, or an alias for the user in Conflict exists on a different user.Ensure each Clever user has a unique email, or remove the conflicting alias from the target Entra account
Clever user already has this Entra email address (conflictWithAssignedADMail)Two Clever users have the same email, or an alias for the user in Conflict exists on a different user.Ensure each Clever user has a unique email, or remove the conflicting alias from the target Entra account
email: unrecognized identifier: emailThe user doesn’t have a value for the email field set in Clever.To resolve this issue, you can update the email value in the SIS.
Formula (template)Unable to compute template for a user's Entra attribute. The user is missing an attribute required in a template. e.g. If the template error is on "email" and the error is on student.graduation_year, please ensure you are syncing graduation_year for that student from the SIS
Incorrect formula formatIDM is not able to complete the action described by the template.This often occurs because there is a missing field, group, etc. Check the Description column of the Issues Report for more specific information about what is missing.
password: could not compute password for userUsers could not be created due to password template not being available in Clever data Check the password template.

What fields are in the template? If those fields do not exist on the affected user(s), the district must add those fields in the SIS.

unsafe archiveThis shows when you have more than 20% of users in a user type are flagged for archival. This is shown to prevent accidental archivals.Click Archive in the IDM Dashboard under the Tasks tab if you do intend to archive more than 20% of users.
   * * * ## Sync History Sync history reports enable you to download a set of CSV files to review your Clever IDM sync changes. These reports have the information reflected on your Events tab, but allow you to filter and edit the data within the files. They're available for the last 30 days on the Sync History tab. For each report, there is an overview of:  - Sync time - \# Creates - \# Updates - \# Archives - \# Issues  Clicking![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StO9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003C88F) under the **Actions** column provides a zip of two CSV files.  - The issues.csv lists all users that were not created due to a Conflict. - The sync syncreport.csv lists all the users that were created, updated, or archived with their existing and new attributes. - In Google/AD, we additionally show OU and group placement and whether an update occurred. * * * ## Email Notifications Clever administrators can subscribe to Clever IDM email notifications from the [email tab of the Profile page](https://schools.clever.com/profile/emails). Subscription options include weekly reports, daily reports, and issue alerts. By default, Clever Admin owners will be subscribed to weekly reports and issue alerts.   * * * ## Email not updating in Clever If an email address is incorrect in Clever and IDM syncs the incorrect email to your destination, correcting it in the SIS will update the email unless your IDM sync is paused or there is a Conflict. If your sync is paused or there is a Conflict, the email will not update, so IDM will not write back the corrected email address to the user's Clever profile. Either unpause the IDM sync or resolve the Conflict and run your SIS sync again to update the email. If you are unable to do either of these, reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/) for assistance. * * * **Related articles:**  [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) [Clever IDM: Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467) [Clever IDM: Purchasing & Billing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001472) [Clever IDM: Account links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001604)

title: Clever products: Purchasing, billing, and renewals
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001472#overview) 2. [Purchasing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001472#purchasing) 3\. [Billing & Invoices](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001472#billing_invoices) 4\. [Renewals](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001472#renewals) ## Overview  This article describes the purchasing flow for paid Clever products, including Clever IDM and Classroom MFA. If you’d like a general overview of each product see below: - [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466) - [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001616) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you’re purchasing with a Purchase Order, we’ll email you the quote associated with your purchase at the end of the process for your district to utilize to create your Purchase Order. * * * ## Purchasing This section describes the purchasing flow for Clever products. From the [Clever Dashboard > Billing page](https://schools.clever.com/orders), you can view subscription costs, and related product information. You can also complete a request via the relevant area of the Dashboard (i.e., if you'd like to purchase Clever IDM, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > User Management > IDM](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) page). For questions related to purchasing or terms, please contact Clever Support. ### **1\. Select licenses** Before purchasing a Clever product, identify how many users you’ll need licenses for. Please note that both Clever Classroom IDM and Classroom MFA require a minimum purchase of 1,000 user licenses. * * * ### **2\. Pricing summary** View the pricing and determine the subscription length. By default, the subscription length is one year. You can also choose a two or three-year subscription in this step, which may come with a discount. * * * ### **3\. Payment method** Select your payment method: **Credit card** Enter the credit card details and mailing address. Select your district’s tax status. Click **Review your order.** **Purchase order** To complete your order with a Purchase order select **Purchase order** and enter your district’s billing zip code and tax status. * * * ### **4\. Review your order** Confirm the order details. If everything is correct:  **Credit card** Select **Pay**. Your card will be charged the amount listed on the invoice. **Purchase order** Confirm the quote information is correct and click **Review your quote**. * * * ### **5\. Purchase complete (for credit card orders) or Quote emailed (for Purchase orders)** **Credit card** Your purchase is complete and you can proceed with setting up your product! If you indicated your district is tax exempt, you’ll receive an email reminder to upload your tax exemption form. **Purchase order** The email with your quote will contain a **Submit purchase order** button. Additionally, you can navigate to view your in progress order [here](https://schools.clever.com/orders). Clicking that will bring you to a page where you can upload a copy of your PO and add a billing contact. When you click **Submit purchase order** on that page, we’ll activate or renew your product subscription (giving you access to the tool) and send an email to the billing contact you provided with instructions on how to pay. The billing contact will receive a link to the payment page, where you complete the payment process via credit card, bank transfer, or check.  If you indicated that your district is tax exempt, you’ll receive an email reminder to upload your tax exemption form. * * * ## Billing & Invoices

 

 

Unit Price

Clever IDM

For more information on pricing, please contact our team here.

Discounts may be available for multi-year subscriptions

 

Clever Classroom MFA

For more information on pricing, please contact our team here.

Discounts may be available for multi-year subscriptions

PaymentPayment is required for total users before implementation.
Billing frequencyAnnual
OveragesOverages up to 10% are not billed. If the total number of users managed by Clever IDM or Classroom MFA is over 10% of the paid amount, the district will receive an invoice with the difference at the end of the year. 
Payment methods supportedCredit card, ACH Payment, Check
Related termsSection 6 of the Additional terms for Schools
You can view your orders and subscription information by navigating from the [Clever Dashboard > Billing](https://schools.clever.com/orders) page. Here, you’ll find the following information: - Invoice due date - Subscription information - Invoice total and cost breakdown - Total licenses - Invoice recipient If you need to update the invoice recipient for your account, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance. ![screenshot of the Clever subscription billing page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002yepR)       * * * ## Renewals Renewing your Clever product subscription is easy! Before the end of your current subscription, you’ll receive notifications via email and in your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/). ![Product renewals tasks in the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WfwNO)   _An example of product renewals appearing in the Dashboard Tasks section._ Click the **renew** button in the email or Clever Dashboard to begin renewing. The renewal process is identical to the purchasing process described above. You’ll see a quote to renew your subscription based on the number of users currently managed by Clever IDM and/or Clever Classroom MFA and the subscription length. You can select a subscription length of one, two, or three years. Then, you’ll choose your desired payment method. Once you complete your renewal purchase, your subscription will be extended. You can also renew multiple products simultaneously, even if their subscription periods vary. For example, if you utilize Clever IDM and Premium Support, and both products are due for renewal, you can select to renew both subscriptions. Click the **renew** button for one of the products, and you’ll see the following screen: ![Edit subscription renewal screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPn9e)  When you select **Edit renewal subscriptions,** you can check a box to indicate whether you’d like to renew both products together or only one product, then click **Confirm selection.** ![Confirm selections for multi-product renewals](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPvS9)  Once you confirm which products you want to renew, you can edit the license count or add additional users. For example, you can edit the license count by adding teacher licenses to your subscription even if you only use Clever IDM for staff and students currently. ![Edit license count screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPvrx) Once you confirm your licenses for the upcoming subscription period, you’ll continue through the purchasing steps described above (pricing summary, payment method, order review, and completion of purchase). You can renew multiple subscriptions at any time, even if they have different expiration dates. Your **Pricing summary** will show that Clever prorates the cost based on your existing prescription periods. Renewing multiple products can help ensure they’re on the same renewal cycle, making them easier to manage. ![Pro-rated amount](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WMJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPqNe) If you have questions or need help adjusting your subscription, please contact our Clever Support team by clicking the chat icon in the corner of this screen. * * * **Related articles:**  - [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) - [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/article/000001616)

text:

Follow the steps here to get started. ## Required Data

Record Type

Required Fields

Students
  • First name
  • Last name
  • Home language
  • ELL status (optional)
Parent / Guardian
  • First name
  • Last name
  • Phone number
     
Teachers / Staff

Classes

## Setup Process **1\. Connect with TalkingPoints on Clever** The TalkingPoints team will send an invitation to connect with your district to your Clever account. Admins can accept the connection request by following Clever’s instructions here: [For District Admins: Apps - App invites.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045084272?language=en_US) If your district has not yet been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup.](https://clever.com/signup) You can also connect by requesting TalkingPoints via our Clever Dashboard. Log in and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add). Search **TalkingPoints** and click **Request application.** ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SsqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003C2QI)   **2. Add the required data to Clever**   **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Important:** TalkingPoints requires _home\_lanugage_ and _student contact_ fields in order to successfully integrate. Please read on for information on how to adjust your sync if you’re not already sending this data to Clever. Depending on your Clever data sync, you may need to adjust the sync to include home language data and student contact data.  - **District-managed SFTP sync**: Per [Clever’s SFTP instructions](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf), you can adjust your SFTP sync to include home language and contact data at any time.  - **SIS-managed SFTP sync**: Reach out to your SIS partner directly to add home language data and student contact data to your Clever sync. - **Clever-managed Auto Sync**: [Contact Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) to discuss modifying your sync. - **Unsure how you sync data to Clever?** [Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326?language=en_US). If you are not able to send home\_language to Clever via your sync, you may also use Custom Data to upload these fields directly in your dashboard. To learn more, see instructions for [Custom Data: Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131).  **3\. Share data with TalkingPoints.** TalkingPoints recommends sharing all records within the district. More information regarding sharing data can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712?language=en_US). **4\. TalkingPoints reviews your data for all required information** If there is any missing information, TalkingPoints will contact your school district and Clever to make the necessary changes. **5. TalkingPoints begins setting up your district’s TalkingPoints account.**   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SsqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  •  TalkingPoints syncs with Clever every night and will update new data to your TalkingPoints account as part of this process. •  You can manually add staff who are not in your SIS to TalkingPoints directly (ex: after school coordinators). •  Home languages can be edited directly in TalkingPoints. The Clever sync will not override manual edits. ## Support Contacts If the issue is related to data within Clever or coming from Clever, contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/). If the issue is related to functionality within TalkingPoints, please contact your TalkingPoints Partner Success representative.

title: For Teachers: Clever + Google Classroom
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001470#header1)  
2\. [What is Google Classroom roster import?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001470#header2)  
3\. [How does Classroom roster import work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001470#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001470#header4)

## Overview

With Google Classroom roster import, you can get straight to learning without worrying about the extra work that goes into getting your students set up in their Google Classroom courses!  
  
Once your school sets up the application via Clever, you will no longer need to create classes manually in Google Classroom. Your Classrooms will automatically be created based on your SIS and Clever data.  
 

* * *

## What is Google Classroom roster import?

Google Classroom roster import is an application allowing your district to connect data from Clever to your Google Classroom accounts. This means your Google Classroom course names will match Clever section names, and rosters will update automatically as you or your students change classrooms. We save you time by taking these time-consuming tasks off your plate!  
 

* * *

## How does Google Classroom roster import work?

Google Classroom roster import will be connected to Clever by your district administrator. Once a sync has completed your Google Classroom accounts will be updated with course data that exists within Clever. You will then have the option to accept or decline Clever-created courses in Classroom.  
  
Please note that courses will appear in Google Classroom once your district administrator(s) sync the classes for the term. This will typically be a few days before the start of instruction for students. Keep an eye out for these suggested synced classes and be sure to click **Accept**!  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000FCYj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BvD7)  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I still manually create courses in Classroom? Will existing courses that I created be overwritten by Clever-created courses?**

-   Teachers can still create courses and will have the option to decline any Clever-created courses and continue managing class rosters manually. Any courses that are created outside the Clever sync will not be edited or deleted by the Clever sync.

  
**Can I add and remove students from Clever-created courses?**

-   Yes! The sync will not overwrite your changes.

  
**Can I edit the Classroom names that Clever assigned?**

-   Yes! The sync will not overwrite your changes.

  
**Will co-teachers be able to access Clever-created courses? Can I add co-teachers to Clever-created courses?**

-   Yes, co-teachers are synced from the Clever data. Primary teachers can also manually add and remove co-teachers on their Clever-created courses in Google Classroom. Co-teachers will not be able to view courses until the primary teacher has accepted the course and it's in an active state.

  
**What happens if I accidentally decline a Clever-created course?** 

-   The district admins who manage your district's Clever account can restore courses that you accidentally declined.

  
**I'm seeing a lot of courses from other terms: can those be removed?**

-   You can either archive or decline the courses that you do not want to manage in Google Classroom.

  
**Is it possible to merge existing classes?**

-   This is currently not supported, but we'll update this page if that changes!

* * *

## Additional Resources

-   [**Check out this training slide deck for more information about what teachers can expect!**](https://bit.ly/google-teacher-deck)

title: Clever + Google Classroom: Setup guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. Overview  
2\. [Getting Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001469#header2)

## Overview

This article is a step-by-step walkthrough for setting up Google Classroom roster import via Clever.  
 

-    _For an overview of the capabilities of Google Classroom roster import, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001503?language=en_US)._
-   _For detailed requirements and troubleshooting, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001463?language=en_US)._

Google Classroom roster import helps you securely sync rosters from any SIS and automatically create and update courses in Google Classroom. It is available as an app [in the Clever app gallery](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/google-classroom-rostering) for any US or Canadian district using Google Standard Education or [Google Workspace for Education Plus](https://edu.google.com/products/workspace-for-education/education-plus/) for staff and students. Your district’s [Google Workspace Super Administrator](https://support.google.com/a/answer/2405986) will need to help set up Google Classroom roster import.

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
If you'd like step-by-step directions, teacher training resources, and more, check out our [Quick Start Guide on Google Classroom roster import in Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/quick-start-google-classroom?user_type=district_admin)!

* * *

## Getting Started

Once you've had the [Google Classroom roster import app](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/google-classroom-rostering) added to your Clever Dashboard, here’s how to proceed. Please note that approval of your request to connect with the app is automated, and can **take around 24 hours to be approved**, so please factor this into your timeline for getting set up!  
  
 _**To begin, access the setup wizard from the Google Classroom roster import**_ [_**app overview page**_](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering):  
  
![Clever\_\_\_Google\_Classroom\_roster\_import.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZBjF)  
  
  
**Step 1: Review details and FAQs about Clever’s Google Classroom roster import integration.**  
  
![Step one of Google Classroom roster import integration wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000E39rW)   
  
  
**Step 2: Preview your data.** You need student and teacher email addresses in Clever in order to utilize this integration. If email addresses are not stored in your SIS, you will need to [manually upload them via csv file](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026?language=en_US).  
  
![Step two of Google Classroom roster import integration wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000E2kEp) 

Google Classroom roster import uses the following fields to create and roster courses in Google Classroom:

-   **students**: email, Clever section id
-   **teachers**: email, Clever section id
-   **sections:** name, period, sis id, Clever section id
-   **optional:** additional fields used in naming the course, see Step 4 for more information

  
**Step 3: Sign in to connect your Google account.** Please note that a Google Workspace Super Administrator must complete this setup. The Super Admin whose token is being used needs to have an EduPlus license assigned.  
![Step three of Google Classroom roster import integration wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000E3JNq)   
  
  
**Step 4: Configure course names.** By default, course names and periods in Google Classroom are set by your section name and period in Clever. If you think the default name would be unclear to teachers, you can modify the naming convention using our course naming tool. This allows you to configure how courses should be named in Google Classroom by using the fields available in Clever.   
  
![Step four of Google Classroom roster import integration wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000E3M7B)   
  

Any fields selected must be populated with data or it will result in an error. In the example below, a school district chose **Course Number**, which isn't a required field in Clever. Since this isn't required, the warning box will appear, and if there is an error with any field, it will show in the preview on the right. Additionally, once courses are created and accepted by teachers, the course names will not be updated dynamically again unless a teacher manually changes the course name in Google Classroom.

![Screenshot showing a Google Classroom Roster Import Course Naming error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000027Pjh)

  
**Step 5: Enable ‘Clever Roster Import’ in the Google Admin console** and confirm this step is complete within your Clever dashboard.  
  
![Step five of Google Classroom roster import integration wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000E3GTD)   
  
  
**Step 6: Set your sharing permissions** to indicate which users should be connected to Google Classroom roster import. You can roster your entire district, select schools, or even specific users. Please see more about Clever sharing permissions [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US).  
  
Many districts prefer to share only the current term's sections to avoid confusion for their teachers.   
See the [course rollover article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001492) for more information.  
  
![Step six of Google Classroom roster import integration wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000E3Moj)   
  
  
**Step 7: Schedule your access dates for teachers and students.** Teachers will see courses when the teacher access date arrives, allowing them to prepare for the upcoming semester. Students will be added to courses on the student access date, allowing them to see the courses teachers have accepted. Data will sync for each user type at 12:30 AM PST/3:30 am EST on the access date input in the application’s settings.  
  
![Schedule access date page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000006n2r)  
  
If you ever need to go back and modify your configurations, including your first sync date, in the setup wizard, you can go back to it by clicking on this link on the overview page:   
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000MFoP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CMH6)  
  
  
**Step 8: Finished!** **Google Classroom courses will be created based on your Clever data.**  
  
When teachers log into Google Classroom, they’ll have the option to approve or reject the Clever-created courses. Teachers will need to 'accept' the courses in order to have them syncing automatically!

-   **For detailed requirements and troubleshooting, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001463?language=en_US).**
-   If you need further assistance with the setup, please reach out to Clever Support [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport?language=en_US)
-   If you’re interested in learning more about the teacher experience or sharing information with your district’s teachers, please see [this Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001470).
-   For an overview of the capabilities of the Google Classroom roster import application, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001503?language=en_US).
-   For an overview of handling summer or semester rollover, including how to communicate with teachers, see [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492?language=en_US).

title: Clever's Business Model
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Clever’s digital learning platform](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001468#Clever%E2%80%99s%20digital%20learning%20platform%20is%20%E2%80%93%20and%20always%20will%20be%20%E2%80%93%20free%20for%20districts.)  
2\. [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001468#Clever%20IDM%20is%20an%20optional,%20paid%20add-on%20for%20districts.)  
3\. [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001468#Classroom%20MFA)

## Clever’s digital learning platform

Clever’s digital learning platform, which 77% of US K-12 districts use to connect to their digital learning resources, is and always will be free for schools globally.  The free digital learning platform includes rostering, single sign-on, the Clever Portal, and Analytics all in one place.  
We believe that technology has the ability to empower teachers, create new ways to learn, and improve education outcomes for all students.  And we believe everyone - all students -  should be able to access EdTech quickly and securely.  
  
Our innovative business model is why we can offer Clever’s digital learning platform to districts for free.  We’re grateful to application partners who use and [pay Clever](https://clever.com/pricing) for secure, automated rostering so that educators and students can seamlessly log in to their digital learning resources for free.  We also work with our application partners to ensure their pricing is not higher for districts that use Clever.  
  
We continue to provide world-class training and support at no cost.  This includes self-paced, on-demand training for district administrators, school tech leads, and teachers on how to get started with Clever. Plus, find documentation customized for your role in our help center, or open a ticket with our dedicated support team.  
  
[Clever gives educators transparency, visibility, and control over data sharing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202393058?language=en_US). Student data is used only for educational purposes at the direction of the district - Clever never sells student data.  
 

* * *

## Clever IDM

Districts can add Clever IDM to their free Clever digital learning platform to automate identity management to help keep Google and Active Directory in sync with their SIS.  
  
We heard districts telling us they were looking for account provisioning solutions and wondered if Clever could help solve this problem.  That’s why we developed Clever IDM to provide a simple way to manage accounts. For more information on pricing, please contact [our team here](https://www.clever.com/security-consultation).  
  
We’re proud to offer Clever IDM at a fraction of the total cost of alternative identity management solutions because we want to be able to support all Districts in having access to improve their user security.  
 

* * *

## Classroom MFA

Districts can strengthen the security of their free Clever accounts by adding Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)—no second device required. Classroom MFA protects applications that use Clever for single sign-on, using age-appropriate second factors like Clever Badges or login pictures. This applies to the Clever Portal, Google Workspace, and Google Chromebooks.

We designed Classroom MFA to help districts stay ahead of cybersecurity threats without disrupting learning. For more information on pricing, please contact [our team here](https://www.clever.com/security-consultation).

We’re proud to offer an MFA solution built specifically for the classroom—no extra devices needed, making it easy for both teachers and students to use.

title: Clever IDM: Google Setup
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001467#overview)  
2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001467#setup)  
     • [Connect to Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001467#connect_to_google)
