     • [Events](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001467#Events)  
3\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001467#header3)

## Overview

Clever IDM helps school organizations automate account provisioning and lifecycle management for Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace. This affordable new offering provides school organizations with a simple workflow that can be completed in minutes to automate organizational unit (OU) and account management directly with Clever. Clever IDM automatically syncs users from your SIS to Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google daily for an entire year. Your Clever IDM dashboard can be found [here](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management).  
  
A full overview of Clever IDM and the setup process can be viewed below:

##   

* * *

##   
Setup

You can work through setting up your IDM configuration at any time; however, you won’t be able to complete the setup to start provisioning accounts without review from an onboarding specialist or our support team. Our team must review your setup before your first provision to protect your destination accounts and prevent issues with SSO for your end users. Contact your onboarding specialist for configuration review. If you're not sure who to contact, reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326).

 **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)**Click on the following links to find information about:  
• [Setting IDM login credentials](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001605)• [Organizing OUs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001603)  
• [Building sub-OUs with the IDM format builder](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001603#header3)  

### **Connect to Google**

In order to provision accounts, Clever must be granted access to manage the provisioning of users on your domain. The user authorizing the access request must have the ability to grant the following permissions:

-   View and manage the provisioning of users on your domain
-   View and manage organization units on your domain
-   View domains related to your customers

![Connect to Google to start setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aLgr)

#### Connect to Google troubleshooting

If you encounter either of the following errors (screenshots), please ensure that the Google Account you are connecting to Clever has the right level of access. For more information, see: [For Clever Admin: Minimum Google Admin access required to set up Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001681?language=en_US).

  
![Screenshot of a Google authorization error showing insufficient admin permissions](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YyAR)  
  
![Second Google connection error message shown when access is denied](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YyAb)

* * *

**Select your IDM Management Level**

Next, choose whether you’d like to set up **Full Provisioning and Password Management** or **Password Management Only**. Both options support Identity Management in Clever—it just depends on what works best for your school organization’s timing and goals.

**Full Provisioning and Password Management**

This option automates account security and password management through Clever IDM. Since it requires more setup time, many school organizations choose this path at the beginning of the school year or during a long break. It’s best for:

-   Automatically provisioning, updating, and archiving user accounts
    
-   Configuring password reset, account recovery, and account claiming settings
    
-   Building and maintaining OUs and groups from your SIS data
    

**Password Management Only**

This lighter setup gives you access to Clever’s secure password management tools for matched users, with the flexibility to configure it at your own pace.

It includes the same powerful IDM matching and collision detection as the full setup to ensure the right Clever user is matched to the right destination user—but requires less time to implement. It’s best for:

-   Piloting Clever IDM or starting setup mid-year
    
-   Accessing Clever’s password management tools
    
-   Managing matched users between systems
    

* * *

### **Select Clever Users**

Clever IDM can provision accounts for students, teachers, and staff. You may select for Clever to provision accounts for one or more of the following:  
  
**Students**  
Students are users that are enrolled as students in educational courses or sections.  
  
**Teachers**  
"Teachers" is the term Clever uses to refer to a school organization's instructional staff. These are the individuals that are directly managing a classroom and students.  
  
**Staff**  
"Staff" is the term Clever uses to refer to both non-instructional staff (e.g. secretaries, bus drivers, counselors) and instructional staff that are not directly in charge of a classroom (e.g. school tech leads, instructional coaches, and principals). These users are often a different employment designation than teachers and may even be managed outside the Student Information System (SIS) in an HR Information System (HRIS)

**Users with multiple user roles**  
If a user is assigned to multiple user roles (i.e. Teacher and Staff) in Clever, they will be provisioned a Google account if either role is selected for Clever IDM provisioning. If the school organization chooses to provision accounts for both teachers and staff _and_ a user is assigned to both teacher and staff roles in Clever, during Clever IDM setup the school organization will be able to select the primary role to be used for OU and group structure.  
  
**Users with existing Google accounts**  
Users with the same email address in Clever and Google will be matched/organized in the OU structure. Clever will NOT update the email address for existing Google accounts. To ensure accurate matching, please confirm accurate email addresses are synced to Clever from your student information system (SIS) prior to enabling Clever IDM.

Additionally, Clever IDM allows you to customize which subsets of users that you would like to provision. If you would like to filter by user type, grade, school, or extension field please contact Clever Support so that we can make those adjustments for you.

**Graduation rollover date**

If Clever IDM is set to manage your students, you will be prompted during this step to configure a graduation rollover date.

![Screenshot of IDM graduation year rollover prompt](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000007Wipu)

If you do not sync student graduation year directly from your SIS, Clever IDM will use this rollover date to calculate a graduation year for use in formulas. To ensure that this calculation associates your data with the correct school year, set a graduation rollover date. Clever IDM calculates the graduation year based on the student’s synced grade level. Data synced before the graduation rollover date will be associated with the previous school year for graduation year calculations. Data synced after the graduation rollover date will be associated with the upcoming school year for graduation year calculations. Providing a graduation rollover date enables Clever IDM to automatically update any information based on the graduation year (OUs, groups, etc.) as grade levels change during rollover. If your expected graduation rollover date changes, you can edit the graduation rollover date anytime by navigating to your Select Clever Users step in Clever IDM.

* * *

### **Data** **written to Google**

There are two pathways for Clever to set user data in IDM: creation and user modification.

**Creation**

In the case of user creation, the following fields are synced to Google:

-   User first name
-   User last name
-   User type (student, teacher, staff)
-   Primary email address as configured by the school organization
-   Organizational unit as configured by the school organization
-   Initial password as configured by the school organization

All newly created users are assumed to be unsuspended.  
  
**Modification**  
  
If a user exists in both Clever and Google data, IDM will optionally update the user. Updates occur when a user's first name, last name, user type, or organizational unit changes. When updating a user, the following fields are synced:

-   User first name (if changed)
-   User last name (if changed)
-   Organizational unit as configured by the school organization (if changed)
-   Suspension status
    -   Suspended if a user exists in the Google Directory under a managed OU but not in the most recent Clever dataset.
    -   Unsuspended if a user was previously suspended (i.e., not in the Clever dataset) but has been restored in the Clever dataset within 300 days.
-   Archive management
    -   Users with free Fundamentals, Fundamentals-archive, and Gmail-only licenses will have their archive behavior managed by Clever IDM. Users with paid licenses will have their archive status managed via the [Google License Manager](https://schools.clever.com/license-manager).
    -   You'll be able to select the archive behavior of users with a free license to one of three options in Clever IDM:
        -   Move to archive OU, suspend, and archive
        -   Move to archive OU and suspend
        -   Move to archive OU
    -   For Gmail-only licenses, we recommend having IDM move the users into an OU with automatic license assignment turned on for the Gmail-only license. Clever IDM does not directly manage Gmail-only licenses.

If you have questions or comments about the visibility of these attributes or would like additional attributes to be set by IDM, please contact Clever Support.

* * *

### **Data written to a student information system (SIS)**

We now provide SFTP access to user emails managed by Clever IDM. The SFTP files can be accessed by enabling Participation Reports and accessing the associated SFTP server as described in [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049642311?language=en_US).  
The CSV files in the SFTP server contain mappings of user emails to their Clever ID, SIS ID, and User Type. School organizations can use these files to personally build automation for write back into their SIS on their end. Clever does not support direct SIS write back automation outside of the above documentation.  
  

* * *

###   
**Group Membership**

 **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If your school connected to IDM before 8/4/26, refer to [Legacy Groups](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001467#Legacygroups) instead.

Clever IDM can manage users’ memberships in Google Workspace Groups, including both security and distribution groups. Please note that this doesn't create groups and can't be used to manage dynamic groups.

  
**Setting up**​To set up group membership management, start by confirming that the groups you want managed in Google are properly configured in the Google Admin Console.

Next, set up [Clever Groups](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001755?language=en_US) to define your membership rules, then match those Clever Groups to the Google groups you want IDM to manage. You can set up one or more membership rules for each user type you provision in IDM. Learn how to create [Clever Groups here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001755). Once you have created Clever Groups, learn about IDM group membership management [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001517?language=en_US).  
  

Legacy Groups

**Setting up**  
​In order to set up group membership management, you will need to start by confirming the groups you want managed in Google are properly configured.  
  
All Clever-managed groups must have unique names. As well, if you want to set up a rule to put users into different groups, the relevant group names must follow the same conventions. For example, if you want a rule set up that will add each user to a group for their school, the relevant groups need to be consistently named – e.g. “Toll Gate Elementary - Students”, “Hopewell Valley High School - Students”.  
  
If this isn’t possible for your school organization, please reach out to let us know. There are some more complicated setups that we can support.  
  
**Membership rules**  
When you reach out to Clever Support to set up group membership management, we’ll ask you for the membership rules you want to create and the groups you’d like Clever IDM to manage. You can set up one or more membership rules for each user type you provision in IDM.

* * *

### **Summary**

The summary page will display all the selections made for each user type for both user account settings and organizational structure (OUs).  
  
Confirm that all boxes for the user types that should be provisioned are marked ![Green checkmark icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BmEL)  
  
Select **Preview Google Accounts** once all selections have been confirmed.

* * *

### **Preview and provision**

Clever will generate a preview of the number of users that will be created or updated. Additionally, the system will flag any potential issues. When the preview is done generating, it is downloadable as a CSV file from the setup guide.  
  
You can also check on specific accounts that will be created/updated to ensure that they follow the process you'd like, via IDM Preview Sync Visualizer. Learn more about [IDM Preview Sync Visualizer here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001528).

You’ll see a note in your account that IDM Provisioning is disabled and requires review from a Clever specialist. Our team must review your setup before your first provision to protect your destination accounts and prevent issues with SSO for your end users. Please reach out to your onboarding specialist with any questions or for review of your preview before provisioning. If you're not sure who to contact, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326).  
  
**Purchase Summary**  
The purchase summary will display the estimated total per year for Clever IDM. Please note, this number is subject to change based on the number of user accounts managed and does not include sales tax.

After reviewing the results, select **Purchase Clever IDM** to proceed to the checkout flow and begin provisioning.

* * *

### **Events**

After your initial Clever IDM sync, you can continue to track changes to your users via the [User management > Clever IDM > Events tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management). On this tab, you can select a date range for which you’d like to review Clever IDM creates, updates, archives, and matched users. You can also apply filters to examine changes by destination (if you have multiple configured), event type (create, update, etc.), or specific users by name or SIS ID.

Once you find the event for the user and destination you’d like to review, click the dropdown arrow next to the event to examine more details.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**How long does setup typically take?**

-   Setup time depends on the number of students in the school organization, and the amount of customization required. Smaller accounts with no customization can be set up within 30 minutes, while larger accounts will take longer.
    
-   Implementation varies greatly depending on the overall quality of data in Clever, whether additional data is required, and the Clever Admin’s access to features at the school organization such as firewalls, servers, SIS data, etc.
    

**Can I provision for multiple destinations?**

-   Yes, Clever IDM can be used to provision multiple destinations such as both Google and Active Directory at no additional cost per user.
    

**Does Clever IDM change anything about my SIS to Clever data sync?**

-   No, the sync between your SIS and Clever will remain the same. However, email addresses created by Clever IDM will be stored as part of your Clever data.
    

**What if I want to manage non-teaching staff with Clever IDM, but they aren't stored in my student information system (SIS)?**

-   There are various options for syncing staff users, including CSV files, custom data, or an Active Directory sync. [Learn more in our article about adding staff to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547).

**Does Clever IDM change anything about existing single sign-on (SSO) access to applications?**

-   No, SSO access will remain the same. It may run more smoothly with the automated provisioning of user accounts.
    

**Can we maintain our current user email addresses?**

-   Yes! Work with your IDM Onboarding Specialist to maintain email addresses.
    

**When formatting the password in the Clever IDM setup, is this simply to create new passwords, or will this reset passwords across the entire domain?**

-   The password format will only be used for new accounts which are provisioned - this will not reset existing passwords.
    

**Will our email addresses and passwords sync back to our SIS?**

-   No, Clever IDM provides automated syncing only in one direction (from Clever to your destination). You are able to download a CSV file of usernames via the Clever IDM page to upload to your SIS.
    

**Does Clever IDM automatically calculate Graduation Year for students?**

-   If synced to Clever, IDM will use the graduation year field from your SIS. Otherwise, IDM will automatically calculate graduation year for students K-12 based on the student grade field. In calculating graduation year, PreKindergarten and TransitionalKindergarten will be treated as grade -1.
    
-   Students in the following grade levels will NOT have a graduation year unless provided by the school organization: InfantToddler, Preschool, 13, PostGraduate, Ungraded, Other.
    

**Why do I see a note that my IDM provisioning is disabled?**

-   To protect your destination accounts and prevent SSO issues, our team must review your IDM setup before your first provisioning. Please reach out to the Clever team if you have any questions or to review your sync before you provision for a new destination.

**What are the minimum required permissions for the Google Admin role used to set up Clever IDM?**

-   Please view this article: [For Clever Admin: Minimum Google Admin access required to set up Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001681).
    

**What if my question is not answered here?**

-   Check out our Clever Academy course, Quick Start - Getting started with Clever IDM for [Setup FAQs](https://clever.academy/quick-start-idm/1031502?user_type=district_admin) and [Troubleshooting FAQs](https://clever.academy/quick-start-idm/1031504?user_type=district_admin) or reach out to Clever Support.
    

**I can’t find the functionality I’m looking for. What should I do?**

-   Reach out to our teams at [support.clever.com](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326). The functionality may be available on the back end. If not, we may be able to add new functionality.
    

![Clever Academy logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eSSD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Interested in deep-diving into how to best use Clever and Google together? Check out our course, [Clever & Google: Secure Connected Classroom Certification](https://clever.academy/clever-google-cert?user_type=district_admin) available in Clever Academy!

* * *

* * *

**Related articles:**  
[Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466)  
[Clever IDM: Purchasing & Billing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001472)  
[Clever IDM: Sync Reports](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001473)  
[Clever IDM: Formulas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555)  
[Clever IDM: Account links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001604)

title: Clever IDM: Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466#overview)  
2\. [Pricing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466#pricing)  
3\. [Get Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466#get_started)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cvmr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036yCr)  
Getting started with IDM? Check out our courses available in [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/page/idm-qsgs)!

##   
Overview

Clever IDM helps districts automate account provisioning and lifecycle management for Microsoft Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google Workspace. This affordable new offering provides school districts with a simple workflow that can be completed in minutes to automate organizational unit (OU) and account management directly with Clever. Additionally, if you use Clever IDM with Google you can manage free Fundamentals, Fundamentals-archive, and Gmail-only licenses via Clever as well. Any paid Google license types can be managed via the [Google License Manager](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001707).

Clever IDM automatically syncs users from your SIS to Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google daily for an entire year. Your Clever IDM Dashboard can be found here.

* * *

## Pricing

For more information on pricing, please contact our team [here](https://www.clever.com/security-consultation). There are no additional costs if you want to manage users in multiple destinations (e.g. Google, Entra ID, and Active Directory).   
  
Districts can try Clever IDM before purchase.  After configuring the solution and viewing a free preview of their sync, IT administrators can purchase Clever IDM directly from the Clever Dashboard, without any involvement from a salesperson, if desired.    
  
Clever’s digital learning platform (including single sign-on, rostering, messaging, and analytics) remains completely free for districts.

* * *

## Get Started

To start using Clever IDM you must have your SIS sync to Clever set up. You can learn more about this requirement and [additional prerequisites to setting up Clever IDM here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001561).

If your data is already in Clever, you can start setting up Clever IDM free from your Clever Dashboard at any time. We also recommend [contacting our team](https://www.clever.com/products/clever-idm) to discuss your options, setup, and rollout plan.

For detailed instructions on the setup process, use the following resources:

-   [Clever IDM: Setup for Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467) and [Quick Start - Setting up IDM for Google](https://clever.academy/quick-start-idm)
-   [Clever IDM: Setup for Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505?language=en_US) and [Quick Start - Setting up IDM for Active Directory](https://clever.academy/quick-start-idm-ad)  
-   [Clever IDM: Setup for Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001553?language=en_US)

* * *

  
**Related articles:**   
[Clever IDM: Prerequisites and Planning](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001561)  
[Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)  
[Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)  
[Clever IDM: Purchasing, Billing, and Renewals](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001472)

title: Clever + Kahoot!
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001465#section1)  
2. [How does this affect current Clever customers?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001465#section2)  
3. [Will there be any changes to Clever’s existing data privacy policies?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001465#section3)   
4. [When will Clever rostering and SSO be available for my international customers (school districts)?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001465#section5)   
5. [How will Kahoot! and Clever integrate their platforms?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001465#section6)  

##   
Overview

Kahoot!, a global learning platform company, recently acquired Clever, Inc. The partnership between the two companies, with distinct and highly complementary offerings, provides improved learning solutions and offerings for U.S. schools and districts while accelerating the global expansion of Clever's solutions. Clever's big vision includes reaching even more students and working on new ways to make learning more enjoyable. We are thrilled that joining the Kahoot! Group will make that vision a reality even sooner. 

* * *

##   
How does this affect current Clever customers?

While we're excited about the changes, rest assured that we haven't changed. Clever is continuing to do what we do best. Our team's dedication to incredible customer support and reliability is unchanging. Our industry-leading commitment to student data privacy, security, and compliance is only getting stronger and will continue to be a key focus when scaling internationally. Finally, our innovative business model (i.e., working with our app customers to offer Clever's Digital Learning Platform to districts for free) isn't changing. We're remaining an open platform, accessible to all schools and companies.   
We do not expect that the acquisition will result in any significant changes at this time (or in the future) for existing Kahoot! or Clever customers. Both Kahoot! and Clever customers can expect business as usual and continue using both platforms as they did before. Over time, the ambition is to deliver an even more robust experience for all customers on the platform. The Clever platform will continue to be an open platform.  
 

* * *

##   
Will there be any changes to Clever’s existing data privacy policies? 

Clever remains fully committed to honoring all of the privacy practices documented in our current privacy policy as well as the commitments we've made to protect student data while complying with COPPA, FERPA, state student data privacy laws, and all contractual agreements. However, as Clever's international presence grows, we will need to expand our privacy and security compliance and data management programs to comply with local laws in other countries. As a result, you will likely see changes to our privacy policy as these additional protections are implemented. The acquisition will not impact Clever's privacy practices for our U.S. clients and partners. Clever's school, district, and student data will be protected as it is today and will not be impacted by the acquisition by Kahoot!. **All U.S. student data will continue to be stored in the U.S.**

* * *

##   
When will Clever rostering and SSO be available for my international customers (school districts)?

Learn more about using Clever internationally [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043013).   
 

* * *

##   
How will Kahoot! and Clever integrate their platforms?

We are actively building a plan for how Kahoot! and Clever will operate synergistically, including with regard to partner integrations. We are two companies with the potential to grow stronger, empowering users (e.g., districts, schools, teachers, students, parents, and lifelong learners) globally with industry-leading EdTech tools and resources. Our two teams will have a talent force of over 500 employees, leveraging deep application and product development expertise, technology, marketing, and engineering capabilities to deliver innovative solutions to customers worldwide. Kahoot! 's global learning community will also have the opportunity to discover the benefits of Clever, while Clever's app partners will be able to reach an international audience through Kahoot! 's global presence.

title: For Clever Admins: Syncing students’ preferred names
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#overview)  
2. [Syncing preferred name data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#default)  
3\. [Viewing preferred names in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#viewing_as_admin)  
4\. [The student and teacher experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#teacher_student_experience)  
5\. [Syncing preferred names as extension data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#extensiondata)  
6\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#faq)

## Overview

School organizations using [SFTP](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078), [SIS-managed auto sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973#SIS-Managed%20Auto%20Sync), or [Infinite Campus API Sync OneRoster 1.2](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767) sync type can sync preferred first, middle, and last names in their student data to Clever.

For example, if a student’s legal name is Jacob, but they go by Jake, you can sync Jake as their preferred first name.

When you sync preferred name data, this shows up in the students’ Clever Portal and in applications that accept this data. Some applications may not accept preferred name data.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dyqj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever previously had a feature that allowed students to change their name in their Clever Portal. Preferred name syncing replaces this feature, and students can no longer change their names themselves.

* * *

##   
Syncing preferred name data

To sync preferred name data, include one or more of the following fields in your Clever sync for students:

-   preferred\_last\_name
    
-   preferred\_middle\_name
    
-   preferred\_first\_name
    

For more on exporting these fields, you can find specific information based on your sync type:

-   [SFTP Syncs: Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078)
    
-   [SIS-Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973#SIS-Managed%20Auto%20Sync)
    
-   [Infinite Campus API Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767)
    

Once you’ve synced preferred name field(s), you must **go into each application and share the field(s)**, as preferred name is considered a sensitive field. [See here for information on sharing sensitive fields](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020926771#sharing). If you don't see the field as an option in your field access settings for a specific application, this means that the application doesn't accept the preferred name field at this time. Please contact Clever Support to determine if you can utilize an [extension field instead](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001464#extensiondata).

* * *

## Viewing preferred names in Clever

As a Clever Admin, you can view a student's preferred name (if populated) by comparing their Profile Page in your Clever Dashboard to the name in their Clever Portal. Start by going to: **Clever Dashboard > search for student > student’s profile page**. Note the name syncing at the top of their Profile Page. This will be values provided in the first\_name and last\_name fields of your data sync. Next, head to the top right corner of the Profile Page and click **Support Tools > Access Portal as user** and review the name in the top right corner of the student's Portal. If the preferred name is syncing, it will display in the Portal and be different than the synced name on their Profile Page.

* * *

## The student and teacher experience

### **Students**

Students can see their name in the upper right corner of their Clever Portal:  
  
  
![Image of a student's preferred name](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dyqj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062d4p)

Students can also see their preferred name in applications if that app accepts and shares preferred names.

### **Teachers**

The students’ preferred name (if populated) will show up on the teacher’s Clever Portal on the My Students > Student Roster page.

* * *

## Syncing preferred names as extension data

If an application doesn't currently accept preferred names as a field, but you'd like to send preferred names, you can provide the preferred names to Clever via an extension field.

Depending on your sync method with Clever, there are a few options you can consider for uploading extension data to Clever. Learn more about [extension data here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912).

Once the extension data is in Clever, our support team can assist with providing this data to your learning applications as the name fields for your students. Please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) with questions or to further explore your options for adding preferred names as extension data to sync to your learning applications.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Can students change their names themselves?**

-   No, this feature has been sunsetted.
    

**Do preferred names show up in Class Analytics?**

-   Presently, preferred name does not show up in Class Analytics.
    

**Is it possible to sync teachers’ preferred names?**

-   Presently, this feature is only available for students.

title: Clever + Google Classroom: Requirements & Troubleshooting
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#Overview)  
2\. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#requirements)  
3\. [Teacher experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#teacher_experience)  
4\. [Troubleshooting Errors on the Sync History page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#errors)  
5. [Using the Google Classroom Course Information Lookup Tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#Lookup)  
6\. [As-Needed: Reprovision any courses that teachers declined by accident](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#reprov)  
7. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463#faq)

## Overview

➕ [The Google Classroom roster import application is available to request in the Clever application gallery](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/google-classroom-rostering)! 

  
U.S. and Canadian school districts with a Google Standard Edition or [Google Workspace for Education Plus](https://edu.google.com/products/workspace-for-education/education-plus/) subscription for staff and students have the option to roster Google Classroom courses via Clever. If you’re interested in utilizing this rostering method, please visit your Clever Dashboard to accept your invite or [request the application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997?language=en_US).  
  
Once the application is connected and the scheduled sync start date has arrived, **Clever will provision Google Classroom courses based on your district’s SIS + Clever data.** Google Classroom course names will match to Clever section names and rosters will update automatically as students change sections in your SIS + Clever.  
  
The Google Classroom roster import application will:

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY)  Create Classroom courses and enroll students, teachers, and co-teachers based on Clever section data.  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY)  Automatically update rosters based on changes in Clever.  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY)  Allow teachers to manually add and remove students and co-teachers to Clever-created courses.  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY)  Allow teachers to rename Clever-created courses.  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRvY)  Allow teachers to accept or reject Clever-created courses.

  
The application will NOT:  
 

![no-entry.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5)  Create, modify, or delete user accounts in Google Workspace.  
![no-entry.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5)  Modify courses that teachers manually create in Classroom.  
![no-entry.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5)  Write Classroom grades back to your district’s SIS (but should be compatible with other grade passback solutions).  
![no-entry.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5)  Overwrite changes that teachers make to their courses, such as the course name or manual changes to enrollments  
![no-entry.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRv5)  Sync any Guardian info to Classroom or modify/overwrite any Guardian data

If you are already the district administrator for a Clever account, you can [r](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)equest Google Classroom Roster Import from your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page. Districts interested in Classroom rostering who don't already use Clever can [create a Clever account](https://www.getclever.com/districtsignup/) here to request the application.

## Requirements

-   **Districts must have a Google Standard Edition or [Google Workspace for Education Plus](https://edu.google.com/products/workspace-for-education/education-plus/) subscription for staff and students** in order to utilize the Google Classroom roster import application via Clever. If your district has questions about upgrading to Education Plus, please contact [na-k12-gwfe@google.com](mailto:na-k12-gwfe@google.com). 
    -   If your district has a paid 'legacy' subscription (also called “G Suite Enterprise for Education”) for staff and students then your district has access to this tool. To maintain access your district will need to renew the Education Plus tier when you are up for renewal.
-   One of your district's Clever Admins will need to coordinate with your district’s [Google Workspace Super Administrator](https://support.google.com/a/answer/2405986) for the initial setup of Google Classroom roster import.
    -   The domain for the Super Admin (\_ ex @school.org\_) must match the domain for your teacher's Google Accounts (also @school.org). For more info, see the setup guide [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001469?language=en_US). 
-   If you’re interested in finding out about your Google Workspace subscription or for help identifying your Google Workspace Super Admin, please log into your Google admin console.
-   Teachers, students and the Super Administrator can be in different subdomains, but they must all be part of the same primary [domain](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/6069226).
-   The application requires all Classroom users to have their Email field in Clever populated with the Google email. The emails need to already be provisioned. This Classroom rostering application does not generate any user accounts.
    -   For help with generating user accounts, [read here for more info on Clever IDM!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466?language=en_US)

## Teacher Experience

Once rostering is turned on for Google Classroom then teachers will have the option to accept Clever-created courses. They can also reject them and continue managing their rosters manually. Courses created outside Clever will not be modified or deleted by the Clever connection.  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BSVl)  
 

## Troubleshooting Errors on the Sync History page

If you notice that some rostering data is not successfully populating within Google Classroom automatically, please review the [Google Classroom roster import Sync History page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/gc-sync-history) of your Clever Dashboard.  
  
From that page, you will be able to download CSV files of the sync errors or successfully synced reports:

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CM5t)

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008zkPV)  Please note:** When sections match, we may or may not have updated the class. It'll also show as an update, but this doesn't mean that anything changed. It's just indicating that it is the new current state of the Google Classroom class.

### **__Below are some sync errors you might see, what they mean, and how you can resolve them!__**

  
**Error: 403: @CannotDirectAddUser - Unable to directly add the user to the course. Please check that the user account exists and is within the course admin's domain.**

-   Reason: The user can’t be added because they are in a different domain (e.g. gmail.com or @student.school.org) or their Google account could not be found.
-   Resolution: Look up the user’s email in Clever and Google and make sure the user’s email address matches an active, already-created Google account that belongs to the primary Workspace domain.

  
**Error: 400: @UserAccountSuspended - The user account specified in the request is suspended**

-   Reason: The user's Google account has been suspended. The user is still active in the SIS/Clever data and being shared with Google Classroom roster import.
-   Resolution: Check Google and the SIS to ensure that the user account is active in both systems or is removed in Clever.

**Error: 403: The caller does not have permission – unable to create Course because of issue with primary teacher**

-   Reason: The teacher account has not been created in Google Workspace or is in a separate domain than the Super Admin.
-   Resolution: Contact [Google Workspace Support](https://support.google.com/a/answer/1047213?hl=en) if you need help managing your synced users and subdomains. Teacher accounts should be created before syncing and the Super Admin should be able to manage all of the users who are synced with Classroom roster import.

**Error: 400: @JoiningUserNotEnabledForRosterImport Joining user is not enabled for SIS Roster Import via the current integrator (Clever).**

-   Reason: Unable to import user due to insufficient licenses or roster import settings.
-   Resolution: Please ensure the target user has sufficient workspace licenses and is managed by the connected Google service account. In addition, please ensure Clever is enabled for roster import: in Google Admin Console, go to Apps > Google Workspace > Settings for Classroom > Roster Import, and select ON-CLEVER. **Note: this setting must be set for all OUs containing students or teachers that have courses managed by Google Classroom roster import.**

**Error: 403: Request had insufficient authentication scopes. Reconnect Clever with a Google Super Admin account.**

-   Reason: Your latest Google Classroom sync failed because the sync did not have permission from a Super Admin account to modify your data in Classroom.
-   Resolution:  Please visit the [settings page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/settings) and use the Disconnect button under Google Authentication. Then press the Reconnect button and accept all of the requested permissions with a [Google Super Admin account](https://support.google.com/a/answer/2405986).  

  
**Error: 400: Bad Request - invalid\_grant - token has been expired or revoked**

-   Reason: Your latest Google Classroom sync failed because the connection between Clever and Google Classroom has broken.
-   Resolution: Please visit the [settings page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/settings) and reconnect Clever with a [Google Super Admin account](https://support.google.com/a/answer/2405986), making sure to include all of the requested permissions.  

  
**Error: 400: admin\_policy\_enforced**

-   Reason: Your latest Google Classroom connection failed because your Google Workspace domain has blocked the connection to Clever.
-   Resolution:  Navigate to the Google Workspace Admin console and add this Client ID to your allowlist: _598262247637-f2nenipsam9fohv8dfleifqbgbae8gui.apps.googleusercontent.com_ 

  
**Error: Could not remove student: Unknown email for \[student Clever ID\]**

-   Reason: This student has been removed from Clever, so the system is unable to remove them from the Google Classroom roster.
-   Resolution: You may need to delete their accounts manually in Google if they're still present on that end, or just ignore these messages if they are already missing there too. 

**Error: 403: The Super Admin user is not permitted to access Classroom**

-   Reason: Your latest Google Classroom sync was unsuccessful because the Google Classroom service is disabled for the Super Admin connected to Clever.
-   Resolution:  Visit the [Google Admin Console](https://admin.google.com/) to enable the Classroom service for that user. See [here](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/6023715) for info about controlling user access to Classroom.​​​​​​

**Error: 400: Precondition check failed - user account is disabled**

-   Reason:  The student or teacher account is disabled.
-   Resolution:  Check on the status of the user’s account within Workspace.

**Error: 404: The course was not found**

-   Reason:  The user could not be added to the course because the course could not be found. It has been archived or deleted.
-   Resolution:  [Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport?language=en_US) if you need help checking on the status of this course. 

**Error: Unknown email for the primary teacher on the section.**

-   Reason:  The primary teacher’s email in Clever is unknown to Workspace.
-   Resolution:  Check the email for the primary teacher on the section in Clever and Workspace to make sure it is correct and active in Workspace.

**Error: 400: Course member limit reached**

-   Reason:  The course has reached the limit of active users tied to it.
-   Resolution:  The primary teacher can add or remove co-teachers manually. The sync will not add teachers as long as the course member limit has been reached. See [this article](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/7300976) for more information.

**Error: 400: User course limit reached**

-   Reason:  The user has reached the limit on the number of courses joined and cannot be added to this course.
-   Resolution:  The user cannot be added as long as the limit on the number of courses joined has been reached. Check in Clever and Classroom to determine why this user is tied to a high # of courses. See [this article](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/7300976) for more information.

**Error: 400: Cannot remove course owner**

-   Reason:  The course owner may not be removed.
-   Resolution:  If you'd like to remove a teacher from a class, [transfer the ownership](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/7449476) of the class to another teacher, then remove the teacher.

**Error: 400: Ineligible Course Owner**

-   Reason:  Only a teacher with a valid account can be invited as owner of a course.
-   Resolution: Verify that the requested owner has an active Google account. If they do, please [contact Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport?language=en_US) .

**Error: 404: Requested entity was not found**

-   Reason:  The course or user could not be found in Google Classroom. 
-   Resolution: The course that couldn’t be found may have been declined, archived, or deleted. The teacher can create the course manually. For ‘user not found’ check if the email in Clever matches an existing account in Google Workspace. 

##  Using the Google Classroom Course Information Lookup Tool

  
You can follow these steps to determine the current state that a course is in, within Google Classroom, from inside of the Clever Dashboard!  
  
1. Navigate to the Profile View for a section in your Clever Dashboard. A quick way to do this is to search for and navigate to a section via the search bar at the top of Clever Dashboard:  
  
![1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036h6d)  
  
2\. On the section’s profile page - scroll down to the Google Classroom Course Information lookup tool.  
3\. Click the button to look up the current state of the Course within Classroom:  
![3.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036h8i)  
  
4\. Note the Google ID # and Google State. These can be used for further troubleshooting and to understand the current status of a Course:  
  
![Google Classroom course overview](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036h8n)   
  
5\. Here is information about the different Course ‘states’ that you could see:  
  
**Active:** The course is active.  
**Archived:** The course has been archived. Teachers can un-archive courses themselves.  
**Provisioned:** The course has been created, but not yet activated. It is accessible by the primary teacher and domain administrators, who may modify it or change it to the ACTIVE or DECLINED states.  
**Declined:** The course has been created, but declined. See below for instructions on how to reprovision a declined or archived course.

## As-needed: Reprovision any courses that teachers declined by accident

  
Be sure to let your teachers know that they need to **accept the synced courses in Google Classroom!** If you need to reprovision any courses that teachers declined or archived by accident, Clever Admins can do that from the section's profile page in the Clever Dashboard:   
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xlcW)  
 

## FAQ

  
**What will the courses be named when they sync to Google Classroom?**

-   Clever-created courses will utilize the section name in Clever as the course name in Google Classroom. You can also customize the course names directly from the Google Classroom roster import settings tab in your Clever Dashboard using fields that already exist in the data you sync to Clever. Teachers can modify this course name if they want, and their changes will not be overwritten by the sync.

  
**How are students and teachers matched between Google Workspace and Clever?**

-   Google Classroom rostering matches users between Clever and Google based on the email field in Clever and emails in Google Workspace. This means that all Classroom users must have the Email field in Clever populated with their Google email in order to utilize this rostering method. Students or teachers that do not exist in Google Workspace will not be associated with Classroom courses. 

  
**What happens if a student or teacher exists in Clever but does not exist in Google Workspace?**

-   The Google Classroom rostering app will not create, modify, or delete user accounts based on Clever data. Accounts must be created in Google Workspace for Education for them to be rostered to Google Classroom courses. Once an account in Google Workspace is created for the student or teacher, they will be added to their courses.

**Can we manage when the Google Classroom roster import application will start syncing and creating courses in Classroom?**

-   Yes, during the setup you can configure your first sync date. Courses will only be visible to teachers once this first sync is complete.

  
**What if some of my district’s teachers want to continue manually managing their Classrooms?**

-   Teachers can decline Clever-created courses and continue manually managing their rosters. Courses created outside Clever will not be modified or deleted by the Clever connection. The Clever team can’t help troubleshoot courses that are manually managed by teachers.

**How can I view manual changes that teachers have made in Google Classroom?**

-   You can view and track these changes on Google Classroom's audit and investigation page. Instructions can be found here: [Classroom log events](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/11362627).

**  
Do co-teachers sync with the classroom?**

-   Yes, co-teachers for sections in Clever will automatically sync to courses created by Clever as long as their email address in Clever matches their Google email address. 

  
**Can I use sharing rules to control which schools or sections are rostered in Classroom?** 

-   Yes! Clever will provision Classroom courses based on section data that is shared with Google Classroom rostering. You can use sharing rules to prevent certain types of sections from being synced, or to ensure that only the right schools are synced.

  
**Will this application share guardian information with Google?**

-   No, guardian information will not be shared with Google Classroom rostering via this application.

  
**Can Clever help me create user accounts in Google Workspace?** 

-   The Google Classroom rostering app does not provision user accounts in Google Workspace. For Identity Management options via Clever, please contact Clever Support.

  
**What happens if a teacher accidentally declines a Clever-created course?** 

-   Clever-created courses can only be declined if a teacher makes multiple clicks and confirms their intention to decline. If you need to restore a declined course, [re-provision the course per the instructions above](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001463#reprov).

  
**Is this connection available to schools with Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals?**

-   This integration is not available to schools with Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals.

  
**Is Google Workspace for Education Plus different from GSuite Enterprise for Education?** 

-   Google Workspace for Education Plus is the rebranded name for G Suite Enterprise for Education. All customers who previously purchased G Suite Enterprise for Education will receive new features and functionality that are released to the new Google Workspace for Education Plus editions.

  
**Can students remove themselves from a class? Will they be re-added on the next sync if they do? ​​**

-   You can adjust unenrollment settings for Google Classroom so students cannot remove themselves from a class. [Learn more here](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/11189334?hl=en). If a student unenrolled themselves prior to you toggling this feature off in Google Classroom, Clever's sync will not re-add the student. They will need to be added back manually.

  
**How often is the sync from Clever to Google Classroom?**

-   The sync runs on a nightly basis. The sync will also run after each SIS sync and after any changes to sharing permissions.

  
**Can I pause the sync between Clever and Google Classroom?**

-   Yes! You can configure a sync pause for the Google Classroom roster import application in your [**Clever Dashboard > Google Classroom roster import > Settings.**](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/settings) If you do not see the screen pictured below, please contact Clever Support. This option is intended for semester rollovers when enrollments are still being finalized.  
      
    ![Google Classroom roster import pause screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000FfVQc) 

  
**What happens to courses that are removed from sharing rules?**

-   If the course has already been accepted or declined by a teacher, there is no effect.
-   If the course has not yet been accepted or declined by the teacher, the course is removed from the list of provisioned courses that the teacher can review.
-   If the course is re-shared in the future, the course will again appear in the list of courses the teacher can either accept or decline

**  
What happens if I archive a course that's managed by Clever?**

-   If you archive a course, Google Classroom roster import can still add or remove students and teachers, and update the class owner.

title: For Teachers: How to leave an app review
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001462#one)  
2\. [Reviewing Library (teacher-added) apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001462#three)

## Overview

Clever provides teachers with the ability to review applications through Clever Library. Teacher reviews provide useful insight for other teachers and district administrators as they explore which resources would be most beneficial in their classrooms.

* * *

## Reviewing Library (teacher-added) apps

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNlB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288tJ)**Please note:** Teachers must have logged into the application once before the option to review will appear.

1.  Log into Clever Portal
2.  Search for the app name in the search bar in the upper right corner
3.  Click **Details** next to the app when it appears in the dropdown menu
4.  Click **Leave a review** in the upper right corner
5.  Complete the app review

![Screenshot of Clever Library with Leave a review button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNlB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004Sgmn)

title: For App Partners: Reviews for your Clever Library listing
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001454#overview)  
2\. [How teachers can leave a review for your application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001454#one)  
3\. [Best practices for requesting reviews from teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001454#two)  
4\. [How to read teacher reviews for your application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001454#three)  
5\. [How to reply to teacher reviews](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001454#four)

##   
Overview

Teacher reviews and comments are extremely valuable for curriculum leaders when evaluating existing or new edtech apps to purchase. In addition to leaving a rating, teachers often provide helpful comments on accessibility and usability for decision-makers to consider when assessing your application.    
  
You can increase the number of reviews on your app detail page by asking teachers who use your app to leave a review. Once teachers leave a review, you will be able to read and reply to the review in your dashboard. Reviews and any replies will also be published on your application’s public-facing profile page in the Clever Library.

##   
How teachers can leave a review for your application

Whether you have a Secure Sync or Library integration, once you are in the Clever Library, your application is eligible to receive verified teacher reviews.  
  
A **verified teacher review** means that the teacher has logged into your application at least once before leaving a review.  
 

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eEXJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002m1su)  
 

Teachers can leave reviews from their Clever Portal by navigating to your application via the search bar, and clicking 'Details'. 

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eEXJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ygUL)  
 

If you have a profile page in Clever Library, teachers can navigate to your Library listing's URL where they'll be able to leave a review (if they have already installed and used your application). This is useful if you want to direct teachers to a specific page where they can leave a review.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eEXJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C6R)**Please note:** You can identify teachers who installed your application in the Clever Library via your API.

##   
Best practices for requesting reviews from teachers

If your application doesn't have reviews, we encourage you to reach out to teachers directly to ask them to leave a review and comments in Clever.   
  
Clever is also proactively prompting teachers to leave reviews for the applications they use when they log into their Clever Portal.

-   Use value-based messaging when asking for reviews. When sending emails asking for reviews, include some tips, ideas, or guidance on how to get the most out of using your application. 
-   Optimize the timing of when you ask teachers for reviews. Consider timing your ask around when the teacher has used your product independently or with students, within a certain number of days after logging into your application, or during a time when they're likely to engage with your product.
-   Send one review request per teacher. If a teacher doesn't respond to your request for a review, don't send them a second request.

### Guidelines

-   Be open to all types of feedback. Teachers trust the feedback of other teachers, so having a range of reviews on your application gives you an opportunity to establish trust and authenticity with your users, in addition to receiving valuable product feedback.
-   Per [FTC guidelines](https://www.ftc.gov/tips-advice/business-center/guidance/ftcs-endorsement-guides-what-people-are-asking), don't offer money or prizes in exchange for reviews. If you offer an incentive for teachers to leave reviews, you must instruct the reviewer to indicate that this was an incentivized endorsement.

Clever is excited to be a trustworthy source of teacher reviews. With this in mind, we reserve the right to flag any unusual review behavior.

##   
How to read teacher reviews for your application

You can view all teacher reviews in your Clever Dashboard. Navigate to the **Library** tab, where you will see all your reviews listed. Depending on your integration(s), either Secure Sync or Library, you'll be able to see which version the reviewer is accessing next to their name.

  
![teacher reviews.jpg](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eEXJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y8Zv)

### Important things to note about reviews

-   Reviews will be sorted based on the date they were submitted.
-   You do not have the ability to delete reviews.
-   However, you do have the ability to reply to reviews. Reviews will be shared publicly on your profile page. Continue reading below for guidance on how to reply to teacher reviews.

## How to reply to teacher reviews

Applications can reply to each individual review directly in their dashboard by clicking on the 'Respond' button next to the review.  
 

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eEXJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002m1t4)

Teachers will see a notification in their Clever Portal that their review has a response.

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eEXJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002m1tO)

Your response will be visible to all visitors on your Application Detail Page.
