Add Filter:
  • Staff SIS ID > does not equal any of > XXX
OR
  • Email > does not equal any of > XXX
  • Please ensure the email addresses match exactly as they appear in Clever (including uppercase and lowercase letters), as they are case-sensitive.

 

...a bulk list of a subset of individual users by a specific field such as sis_id (i.e. students, teachers, staff)

Rule Type:
A custom share rule based on the user type (i.e. share by students, share by teachers, etc.)

Steps to take:

Individual users can be entered in bulk if separated by semi-colons.

To create a bulk list to copy into your sharing rule, create either a Google Sheet or Excel file with the users you need shared.

Use the =textjoin(";",true,[range]) formula.

For example, if you have a list of sis_ids in cells A2:A501 that you need to delimit by semi-colon and bulk paste into a sharing rule, click into a new cell and enter: =textjoin(";",true,A2:A501).

The formula output will be a list of all IDs from row A2 to row A502 that you can copy and paste into the sharing rule.

...Clever Admins, District Curriculum Leads, District Help Desk, or a Custom Role

✓   Admin Team
Rule Type:
Custom Share District Admin rule. Learn more here.
 
  * * * ## Troubleshooting Have a troubleshooting scenario that is not covered in this article? Please let reach out to our support team to make a suggestion!

Record Type

Problem

Description

StudentStudent not sharedThe most common reason that a student is not shared with an app is:
  • The student is not enrolled in a section that meets sharing requirements
To resolve the issue, enroll the student in a qualifying section in the SIS and sync with Clever. 
 
StudentStudent shared that should not be sharedThe most common reasons that a student is shared with an app in error are: 
  • The student is enrolled in sections at multiple schools and their additional school is being shared with the app
  • The student is enrolled in a section where students of a different grade level are being shared. If a section is shared, all students associated with the section are shared with the application, regardless of the student’s grade level. 
As a workaround for these scenarios, custom sections may be utilized as outlined here.
 
TeacherTeacher not sharedThe most common reasons that a teacher is not shared with an app are:
  • The teacher is not enrolled in sections in the SIS / Clever. 
  • The sections they teach do not meet sharing requirements. 
To resolve the issue, either enroll the teacher in a section in the SIS or add a Custom Share by Teacher rule for the app.
 
TeacherTeacher shared that should not be sharedThe most common reasons that a teacher is shared with an app in error are: 
  • The teacher is enrolled in sections at multiple schools and their additional school is being shared with the app
  • The teacher is a co-teacher on a section that is shared
  • The teacher is enrolled in a section where students of a different grade level are being shared. If a section is shared, all teachers and students associated with the section are shared with the application, regardless of the teacher or student’s grade level. 
As a workaround for these scenarios, custom sections may be utilized as outlined here.
 
StaffStaff are not sharedStaff are shared if sharing by school. If using sharing rules, an additional Custom Share by Staff rule is required.
 
Teacher and Staff (user has both account types in Clever)Teacher or staff user is not sharedOne user can have both a teacher and staff account in Clever, but you may want to customize which account is shared with a particular application. If you want to share only one account type with a specific application, we recommend structuring sharing rules around ID and referring to the specific teacher_id or staff_id for the user you want to share.
Student ContactsStudent contacts are not sharedStudent contacts are shared with an application using Field Access permissions. When enabled, all contacts are shared – filtering is not available. 
 
Student ContactsToo many student contacts are sharedStudent contacts are shared with an application using Field Access permissions. When enabled, all contacts are shared – filtering is not available. 

If you wish to only share a subset of student contacts, the filter must be applied to your SIS sync, which will remove the targeted contacts from Clever entirely. 
 

Clever Admins

Clever Admins are not shared / synced to app

All Clever Admins, District Curriculum Leads, and District Help Desk are shared with all applications.

Sharing of Clever Admins cannot be controlled per user. A district/school can choose to share all Admins (default behavior) or to completely disable sharing of Admins using Field Access controls. 



Application partners may choose whether to support rostering and SSO for these users. If interested in rostering or SSO for Clever Admins, please contact the application partner's support team for more information on what options are available for Clever Admins.

For applications that support Rostering and/or SSO, the application determines all permissions granted within the application.

Schools

In the application receives data there are schools listed that I haven't shared

This is common in Share by Schools rules since they share all data associated with teachers, sections, and students. If a teacher or student is associated with multiple schools, this additional school will be implicitly shared as data associated with the student or teacher.

This can also happen in Share by Rules if a student or teacher's primary school site is a school not explicitly shared, it will still be implicitly shared as their primary site.

* * * ## Check to see if a user is shared with the app Four methods that work for understanding if a user is shared by a rule are below!  

Method

How to utilize the method

Search for the app in the app section on the user's profileSteps:

  1. Open a second tab of your Clever Dashboard

  2. Search for the user (or locate them in the Data Browser) and open their profile page

  3. Use the Apps section on their overview page 

Utilize the Troubleshoot sharing toolSteps:
  1. Navigate to your Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Troubleshoot sharing tool.

  2. Enter the user's name and the application in question.

  3. Once populated, you will see the sharing status for the user.

For SSO/Rostering applications, you can check to see what the application is receiving Steps:

  1. Select the application in question from the list of apps on your Applications > My Applications page.

  2. Download the shared data from the app overview page under the Application Receives section.

Locate the user in the list of matching usersSteps:

  1. Select the application from the list of apps on your Applications > My Applications page.

  2. Click Edit sharing 

  3. Change the rows per page to 300 
  4. Use Cntl/Cmd-F to locate the user across fewer pages of results

title: Setup guide for Clever SSO into Entra ID
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#header1) 2\. [Prerequisites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#header2) 3\. [Configure Clever as an IdP for Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#header3) 4\. [Configure Entra ID as a Service Provider (SP) for Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#header4) 5\. [Verify federated authentication between Clever and Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#Verifyfedauth) 6\. [Removing Clever as an IdP for Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#removing)  7\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001546#troubleshooting) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Microsoft’s current version requirements can be found [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/education/windows/federated-sign-in?tabs=intune#windows-edition-and-licensing-requirements). ## Overview In this article, you'll learn the steps to configure Clever as a SAML identity provider (IdP) for Entra ID. Once configured, users will be able to use their Clever credentials or Badges to sign in to Entra ID, including on Windows deployments. Please note that if your school organization would like to utilize [Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907?language=en_US) for sign-in to Entra-joined Windows devices, you will need to complete the steps listed below to configure Clever as an IdP for Entra ID. Once Clever is configured, students will be able to use Badges to sign in to their Entra-joined Windows devices.  * * * ## Prerequisites To configure Clever as an IdP for Entra ID, the following prerequisites must be met: 1. An Entra ID tenant, with one or multiple custom Domain Name System (DNS) domains (i.e., domains that aren't in the format \***.onmicrosoft.com**) - If the federated domain hasn't yet been added to Entra ID, you will need to have access to the DNS domain to create a DNS record. This is required to verify the ownership of the DNS namespace - Learn how to [add your custom domain name using the Azure Active Directory portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/fundamentals/add-custom-domain) 2. Access to Entra ID with an account with the **Global Administrator** role 3. Access to Clever with an account with the **Clever admin** role To test federation, the following prerequisites must be met: 1. A Clever environment, with users already created **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Users require a matching field in Clever that is set to the same value as the ImmutableId in Entra ID. - - If your Entra users don’t have an ImmutableId set, use a stable, unchanging field as the identifier. Clever recommends using email, and this article will refer to email throughout. If you choose a different field, be sure to substitute it wherever email is referenced. - If the ImmutableId does not match a field in Clever, please update your data in Clever to contain a field that matches the ImmutableId. [Learn more about custom fields here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912). 2. Individual Entra ID accounts are already created: each Clever user will require a matching account defined in Entra ID. These accounts are commonly created through automated solutions, for example: - School Data Sync (SDS) - Entra ID Connect sync for an environment with on-premises AD DS - PowerShell scripts that call the Microsoft Graph API - Provisioning tools offered by the IdP - this capability is offered by Clever as a dedicated offering Please see [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/education/windows/federated-sign-in?tabs=intune#windows-edition-and-licensing-requirements) for Microsoft’s current version requirements. * * * ## Configure Clever as an IdP for Entra ID 1. To add Entra ID, please navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page, and search for the Entra ID app in the search bar. Click to request the application.  ![Screenshot of the Add Applications page of the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ad8mL) 2. Once the app is ready, the Clever admin will be notified via email to accept the invitation to the app 3. [Sign in to Clever](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-azure-ad/settings) as a Clever admin, then go to your Entra ID page via Application > My application > Entra ID, and click **Begin setup** to set up which of your users can access the app. Don’t worry, you can always come back and edit this setting at any time.  ![Screenshot of Clever Dashboard showing guided sharing for Azure AD](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ad8nx) 4. Once you have set up sharing, go to the **Settings** tab and configure the Entra ID SAML app with the following details:  ![Screenshot of the settings tab to configure Azure AD SAML app on the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ad8uP)  

Variable

Value

Assertion Consumer Service Urlhttps://login.microsoftonline.com/login.srf
Entity IDurn:federation:MicrosoftOnline
Name ID Formaturn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:email
5. Ensure that the Attribute for each user type is set to the field in Clever that contains the matching value to the ImmutableId in Entra ID. If you are using the recommended value of Email, select **Email** from the dropdown. If you are using a custom field, select **Custom** from the dropdown and enclose the custom field name in double curly brackets using all lowercase, for example, {{ext.field\_name}}. The other parameters should already be pre-configured.   Please take note of the **Identity Provider Metadata URL** value, as it will be required in the next step. For example: [https://samlidp.clever.com/saml-azure-ad/metadata/](https://samlidp.clever.com/saml-azure-ad/metadata/%3CGUID%3E); **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Federation won't work if the app has a launch date set in the future. Once the application is ready to be used, ask Clever Support to change the launch date. * * * ## Configure Entra ID as a Service Provider (SP) for Clever The configuration of Entra ID consists of changing the authentication method for the custom DNS domains. This configuration can be done using PowerShell.   ``` Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser -Force ``` Note, depending on your environment, the command above may give the following error: **Set-ExecutionPolicy: Operation is not supported on this platform.** In these cases, simply proceed with the remaining commands. Modify the **$idpMetadataUrl** and **$DomainName** variables of the following script to match your environment. When prompted to authenticate to Entra ID, use the credentials of an account with the **Global Administrator** role. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** In the code below, [https://clever.com/logout](https://clever.com/logout) should be in "double quotes" - there is a glitch with our Help Center preventing these from showing up, but please add them when you use the script. ``` Install-Module Microsoft.Graph -Scope CurrentUser Import-Module Microsoft.Graph $domainId = "your domain here" $idpMetadataUrl = "your SAML metadata URL here" $xml = [Xml](Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $idpMetadataUrl -ContentType "application/xml").content $cert = -join $xml.EntityDescriptor.IDPSSODescriptor.KeyDescriptor.KeyInfo.X509Data.X509Certificate.Split() $issuerUri = $xml.EntityDescriptor.entityID $signinUri = $xml.EntityDescriptor.IDPSSODescriptor.SingleSignOnService | ? { $_.Binding.Contains('Redirect') } | % { $_.Location } $signoutUri = https://clever.com/logout $displayName = "Clever Identity" Connect-MGGraph -Scopes "Domain.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.AccessAsUser.All" $domainAuthParams = @{ DomainId = $domainId IssuerUri = $issuerUri DisplayName = $displayName ActiveSignInUri = $signinUri PassiveSignInUri = $signinUri SignOutUri = $signoutUri SigningCertificate = $cert PreferredAuthenticationProtocol = "saml" federatedIdpMfaBehavior = "acceptIfMfaDoneByFederatedIdp" } New-MgDomainFederationConfiguration @domainAuthParams ``` Note, the configuration may take up to 60 minutes to update before end users will be redirected to your Clever Portal login when navigating to [https://portal.azure.com/](https://portal.azure.com/). * * * ## Verify federated authentication between Clever and Entra ID From a private browser session, navigate to [https://portal.azure.com](https://portal.azure.com/) and sign in with a Clever account: 1. As the username, use the email as defined in Clever 2. The user will be redirected to Clever to sign in 3. After Clever authentication, the user will be redirected back to Entra ID and be signed in ![Video of user being redirected back to Azure AD to be signed in](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Syva) * * * ## Removing Clever as an IdP for Entra ID To remove Clever as an IdP for your Entra ID domain, run the following command using PowerShell:   `Remove-MgDomainFederationConfiguration -DomainId `   For more information, see [Microsoft Support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.graph.identity.directorymanagement/remove-mgdomainfederationconfiguration?view=graph-powershell-1.0) or reach out to your Microsoft support contact. * * * ## Troubleshooting **Entra is not recognizing my user** This usually happens when the ImmutableId field in Entra is not being matched for this user in Clever. This may look like Microsoft error AADSTS51004 or AADSTS90072. To correct: 1. Double check what the ImmutableId is set to for this user in Entra using the following PowerShell - replace \[[user@example.org](mailto:user@district.org)\] with the UserId for your user. Check the value displayed after OnPremisesImmutableId. ``` get-mguser -UserId [user@district.org] -property DisplayName,Mail,OnPremisesImmutableId,UserPrincipalName,Id | Format-List DisplayName,Mail,OnPremisesImmutableId,UserPrincipalName,Id ``` 2. Check which field you are matching on in the Entra ID app in the Clever Admin dashboard. Navigate to [https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-azure-ad/settings](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-azure-ad/settings) and check which field is set for the matching value for your user type. Ensure that you are matching on the correct field in Clever that contains the ImmutableId value. If you are not matching on the right field, update that field by returning to the **Configure Clever as an IdP for Entra ID** section and see step 5. ![image2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000c0wf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004e6Iy)  3. Check the value of the matching field for your user in Clever. Use the Data Browser or search for your user at the top of your dashboard. On the user’s overview page, ensure that value in the field you are matching on exactly matches the ImmutableId in Entra that you found in step 1. * * *

title: Blackbaud API Sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544#header1) 2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544#header2) 3\. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544#header3) 4\. [Default Field Mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544#header4) 5\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544#header5) ## Overview
   ✓Syncs every six hours.
   ✓Manual syncs can be triggered in Clever Dashboard by navigating to Data sources> SIS sync > Settings > Sync Control and clicking Sync Now
   ✓

Syncs students, teachers, sections, schools

  • To sync to Clever, students and teachers must have usernames populated in Blackbaud
   ✓Syncs multiple student contacts per student
  • This is an optional setting in Blackbaud under Rostering options
   ✓Supports co-teachers
   ✓Supports custom field mappings
   XDoes not sync users to the “staff” role in Clever. Staff can be added to Clever using Custom Staff
 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)** If interested in using the Blackbaud API Sync with an existing Clever account, please contact support. Clever **highly** recommends that any transitions between SISs or sync types be completed during the summer. For more information on changing sync types, please [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049183691). * * * ## Setup ### **1\. Create API Credentials** To generate credentials, follow [these directions](https://webfiles.blackbaud.com/files/support/helpfiles/education/k12/full-help/content/bb-core-oauth.html). Clever recommends the following settings:  **Provider** - Name: Clever - Provider: Standard - Select Use **Legacy OAuth 1.0 authentication** **Rostering Options** - School Years: Current year - Multi-term classes: One record per term - Offering Types - Academic Groups: Required - Activity Groups: Optional - Advisory Groups: Optional - Courses: Return all - Parents: Include or exclude all parents **Gradebook Options** Clever does not support grade passback. No options need to be selected.   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sr2z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The following fields require the district to set Integration Mappings in Blackbaud in order for the data to pass to Clever:      •  Gender      •  Ethnicity For more information on Integration mappings, [click here](https://webfiles.blackbaud.com/files/support/helpfiles/education/k12/full-help/content/bb-core-integration-mappings.html). ### **2\. Enter API Credentials in Clever** In the Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) and enter the following credentials from Blackbaud   - Web Access URL: [https://{](https://{/)schoolDomain}.myschoolapp.com/ims/oneroster/v1p1/ - Consumer Key: “Key: from Blackbaud - New Consumer Secret: “Secret” from Blackbaud - Confirm New Consumer Secret: “Secret” from Blackbaud ### **3\. Sync** On the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings), find **Sync Controls** and click **Sync Now. ** **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sr2z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000KNUt7) Please note:** The Blackbaud API sync can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every six hours, but the time of day that the syncs occur isn't customizable. Syncs can always be initiated at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings)[](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) * * * ## School Year Rollover Data for new school years will be passed to Clever once the district has rolled over to the new school year in Blackbaud.  If a district would like to rollover sooner, follow these directions in Blackbaud:   1. Navigate to **Core**, hover over **Settings** in the navigation, and select **Integration settings**. On the **Integration settings** page, choose **OneRoster Settings**. 2. Open the Clever configuration and choose **Roster Options** 3. For **School Years**, check **Next Year** 4. Click **Save** In Clever: 1.  Navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings), find **Sync Controls** and click **Sync Now**. Please allow 15-20 minutes for the sync to complete.  If rolling over to the new school year, the sync will likely prompt a sync hold. Review the sync hold – if everything looks correct, click **Approve Changes** to allow the new changes to process into Clever. For more information on sync holds, please see this article: [Sync Holds.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358)   * * * ## Default Field Mappings Below are the default field mappings for the Blackbaud OneRoster API sync that are managed by Clever. If you'd like to customize field mappings, please contact Clever Support.   - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default, or not accessible to Clever - The Blackbaud OneRoster API sync does not support custom field mappings, but it does support value mappings - First\_name fields depend on settings within Blackbaud and are based on the user first name or the user preferred name. Clever will sync whichever name is in the user.givenName field of the Blackbaud API. If you wish to alter the first\_name field, please work with Blackbaud to alter the field surfaced via the API. - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. This is common for: Grade, FRL\_Status, ELL\_Status, and IEP\_Status.    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sr2z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Pwacb)    Please note:** If you’d like to sync additional data to Clever, you can do so via our automated custom data sync for auto sync districts and schools. Please reach out [to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for access to your Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automatic exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for automation scripting. ### **Schools**

title: Secure Sync: Changing SIS IDs
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001543#overview) 2\. [The Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001543#process) 3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001543#FAQ) ## Overview When you sync your data to Clever, you are required to provide an SIS ID for each user type, section, and school as follows:
Data TypeSIS ID Field
SchoolSchool_id
StudentStudent_id
TeacherTeacher_id
SectionSection_id
Staff (optional)Staff_id (if your school syncs staff)
Contacts (optional)Contact_sis_id (cannot be matched if ID changes occur)
These identifiers are what Clever uses to generate the Clever ID, so if the SIS ID changes, the Clever ID will change as well. The Clever ID is what creates the user and school accounts in Clever and in most connected applications. For this reason, Clever does not recommend changing SIS IDs, especially during a school year. We recommend that all SIS ID changes be made in the summer between academic years.   **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)****If an SIS ID change is being requested by an application partner:** Clever Support can update the data available to the application without affecting the core data in Clever or the data available to other applications. Please submit a support case with the following information:     •  The name of the application (Example: NWEA)     •  The record type (Example: Students)     •  The name of the field to be used as SIS ID (Example: State\_id) Here’s an outline, with an accompanying flowchart, of how changing an SIS ID can result in the loss of historic data. 1. Student Jamie Greene has an account in Clever with student\_id 7301. 2. Clever created the Clever ID of 641cbb82f81de671203cfc66 for Jamie’s account based on the SIS ID. 3. The student is shared with several applications via Clever and has accounts in each of those apps based on that Clever ID. 4. At some point, the school changes Jamie’s student\_id to C732001 and syncs the new ID to Clever, so student\_id 7301 is no longer syncing. 5. Clever now sees this as a new student and deletes Jamie’s account associated with student\_id 7301 since this ID is no longer syncing to Clever. 6. Clever creates a new account based on C732001 with a new Clever ID of 529ava3902efa349206cfs01. 7. Jamie’s connected applications are no longer receiving Jamie’s original Clever ID because it no longer exists. 8. The applications create a new account based on Jamie’s new Clever ID and delete or archive the previous account based on Clever ID 641cbb82f81de671203cfc66. This results in a loss of historical data and any progress since it is a completely new account.   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XMkv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000FxQM3)   Please note:** When a teacher\_id changes and data is not preserved, the teacher will lose their historical data in Clever and connected applications, as well as their Teacher Pages and resources they have added in their Clever Portal. **How does Clever help schools preserve data?** How do we preserve the Clever IDs if you need to change your sync and/or SIS IDs? By running our matching tool! Our matching tool matches up the existing SIS IDs in Clever with the new SIS IDs your schools are syncing. Please note that we can only match school\_id, student\_id, teacher\_id, and staff\_id values to preserve data. We are unable to match contact\_sis\_id, and section\_ids are unlikely to be matched as well, since section\_ids are expected to change during a conversion.  If we run into duplicate entries or other issues, this can slow the process, potentially adding several days to a week to the conversion. * * * ## The Process IMPORTANT: Reusing SIS IDs  Clever treats SIS IDs as unique identifiers and uses them to generate Clever IDs. To avoid data issues in Clever and connected applications, do not reuse SIS IDs within 300 days of when they were last used. Reusing IDs can add more than a week to the sync conversion process. If a change to the SIS ID is required, the following process will be followed.  1. **Contact Clever Support**  Submit a new support case at support.clever.com and let us know the record type that needs to be updated and the name of the field that should be used as the SIS ID in Clever.  2. **Migrate data** We will enable protection settings for your account to ensure your teachers and students are minimally affected by the data changes. During this period, all data syncing between the district, Clever, and connected applications will be paused. However, users will still be able to access Clever and their applications. Once the safety settings are applied, we ensure the necessary data from your SIS is syncing to Clever. If the data looks good, we will complete a matching process to preserve historical data where possible. ⚠️ **Please allow up to 2-3 weeks for the matching process to be completed.** During this time, your account may have a sync status of "On Hold" or "System Maintenance In Progress". This is normal and will resolve once Clever Support has finished the migration process.  ![For\_District\_Admins\_\_Sync\_Holds.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XMkv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062zJ3) 3. **Confirm data changes, sync with apps** The final step of the process is for our team to review the changes with you. Once the review is complete, you will release the hold. Once the updated data is live in Clever, please allow up to 48 hrs for the updated data to update in your connected applications. Application partners manage pulling data from Clever and processing it into their system. If you have any questions about the effect of data changes in an application, please contact the application's support team. They will be happy to assist! Ready to get started or have a question? [Contact our Support Team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).  * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **Which SIS IDs can Clever preserve?** - School\_id, student\_id, teacher\_id, staff\_id. The Clever team cannot preserve contact\_sis\_id data. Additionally, our migration tool is _not_ configured to preserve section IDs, as it is expected that section IDs will change during a sync conversion. However, if section IDs need to be preserved for an app connection, you can speak with the Clever team to discuss potential options. **Is there an option if I need more guidance and would like additional services from Clever for my sync conversion?** - Yes! We offer [Sync Conversion Consulting Services.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646#SyncSISConversions) The sync conversion process is a collaborative effort involving the district, Clever, and connected applications to achieve a smooth transition. While our sync conversion team is committed to helping you meet your goals, opting for our paid services can provide additional consultation and support to streamline the process further. [Contact our team here to learn more](https://schools.clever.com/applications/browse/clever-consulting). **Why does the sync or SIS ID conversion take 2-3 weeks?** - Anytime you execute record linkage between data sets, the integrity of the data is always at risk. Sync conversions involve numerous steps that must be performed accurately, and depending on the complexity and size of the data, this can take time. - During a school break is the best time to complete a sync conversion because the account is often already in a sync pause status. Many districts are reaching out to our teams to complete a sync conversion during the winter or summer break, which can impact timelines for completion. **What if I don’t need any historical data preserved? I don’t need to maintain their historical data in Clever or the connected applications.** - If this is the case, you can forego the sync conversion process. Teachers will lose any Teacher Pages created in Clever, and all users will lose historical data in their connected applications. Please provide in writing that you do not want our teams to preserve the historical data and that you understand that your users will no longer have any historical data in Clever or their connected apps. tags: sis conversions

title: Clever Portal: Launch a Kahoot
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001542#header1)  
2\. [Launching a Kahoot](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001542#header2)  
3\. [The Student experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001542#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001542#header4)

PLEASE NOTE If you’re not seeing the _Launch a Kahoot!_ button, make sure you [have added the Kahoot! app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672) from the Clever Library. 

##    
Overview

Teachers can save classroom time by launching Kahoot! directly from their Clever Portal by going to their **Kahoot! icon > three vertical dots ( ⋮ ) > Launch a Kahoot!**  
  
![Open a Kahoot! in the Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SQKX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000JTQ2b)            

* * *

## Launching a Kahoot

Before you begin, ensure that you have the Kahoot! application in your Clever Portal. If your district hasn't added it for you, you can add it as a Clever Library app. [Click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672?language=en_US) to learn how to add Kahoot! as a Clever Library app.  
  
When you’re ready to launch a Kahoot!, **make sure your students have logged in to Clever and have the Clever Portal open on their devices**. Then, follow these steps to start your game:

1.  Navigate to [Create.kahoot.it](https://create.kahoot.it/) and either create a Kahoot or select an existing one you want to use.
2.  Start the Kahoot and **copy the game PIN**.
3.  In the Clever Portal, go to **Kahoot! app > three vertical dots ( ⋮ ) > Launch a Kahoot!**
4.  Paste the game PIN into the e_nter_ **_Game_ _PIN_** field. 
    -   You can optionally check the **Populate student initials** box, which will automatically add students' initials instead of letting them add their own nicknames.
5.  Click **Next, choose your students**.
6.  Click **Next**, then select the class(es) or individual student(s) you want to launch the Kahoot for. Click **Continue** when ready.
7.  Ensure all students have their Clever Portal open on their device. Once all students are logged in, click **Launch Kahoot.**
8.  The Kahoot! will open in the students’ Clever browser tab. A confirmation will appear on your screen.
9.  Once your students are in the game, don't forget to share your screen to show the questions in Kahoot! 

   
 

* * *

## The student experience

Instead of navigating to [kahoot.it](https://kahoot.it/) to enter the game PIN, when teachers launch Kahoot! to students through Clever Portal, students will automatically enter the game and be prompted to create their nickname.   
  
After teachers select Launch Kahoot!, the game will launch for students in the same tab that Clever was in, where they’ll be prompted to enter their nickname. After they enter their nickname and select the **Ok, go** button, they can start playing.  
  
If you've chosen for their initials to populate, they'll be dropped right into the game without needing to click anything.

  
![Kahoot nickname screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SQKX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005SUGb)  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Why don’t I see the Launch a Kahoot feature in my Clever Portal?**

-   This feature is currently only available for teachers that have access to the Kahoot! application on Clever.

**How can I gain access to the Kahoot! application if my district hasn't added it for me?**

-   For an enhanced experience, contact your school or district administrator to see if access to the Kahoot! EDU application can be enabled for you.
-   Alternatively, you can install the Kahoot! application from the Clever Library. [Learn how to install applications from the Clever Library here.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672)

Note: Some districts choose to disable the Clever Library. If you don’t see it in your Clever Portal, it’s likely that your district has turned off this feature.

**How does Kahoot treat adding initials for students who have the same initials?**

-   If multiple students share the same initials, the first student to launch the app will claim those initials. Any students who try to join afterward with the same initials will see a message that the nickname is taken and will be prompted to choose a different one.

title: Single Sign-on (SSO): Setting up Clever Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever via the Legacy setup in Google
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#header1)  
2\. [Clever and Chromebook logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#header2)  
3\. [Setting up Clever logins via the legacy setup in Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#header3)  
     • [Prerequisites for setting up Badge or credentials-based logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#badgeschromebooks)  
     • [Part 1: Configuring SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#configuringsso)  
     • [Part 2: Configuring user and device settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#configuringuserdevicesettings)  
     • [Part 3: Testing on a Chromebook](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#testingonachromebook)  
4\. [Adding additional identity providers as individual SSO Profiles in Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#header4)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001541#faq)

## Overview

Clever works seamlessly with Chromebooks, providing students and teachers access to all their learning applications while only logging in once per device. Google supports several ways to utilize other identity providers (IdPs) within the Google Admin Console. This article covers how to configure Clever as the organization-wide single sign-on (SSO) provider for Google, which is a legacy setup and no longer our recommended workflow for most school organizations.

IMPORTANT  
Our general recommendation is to set up Clever as an individual [SSO Profile in Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645), as this offers more customization. For instance, you may want some students to log into Chromebooks with Clever Badges, while other students use a Google email and password. If you'd like to [set up Clever as an individual SSO Profile in Google, please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645).

* * *

## Clever and Chromebook logins

There are two login flows for using Clever with Chromebooks:

1.  **Students use Clever Badges to log into Chromebooks then access Clever.**
    -   Students open their Chromebook and scan their Clever Badge
    -   This automatically logs the students into their Chromebooks and Clever Portals (they don't need to log in again).
    -   Students can click on any learning application to begin their learning session.
    -   **Use case:** This is best for younger students and any students who might struggle with typing as they can access learning apps with zero typing.
2.  **Users log into Chromebooks manually, using credentials, then access Clever.**
    -   Users open Chromebooks and log in with their school-provided Google login credentials.
    -   After logging in, the Clever Portal is automatically opened for them (i.e., the user does not need to log in again).
    -   Users can click on any application icon to begin their learning session.
    -   **Use case:** This is best for older students who don't use Badges.

Depending on your preferences, each method can be configured separately for different Organizational Units (OUs) in your Google Admin Console.

* * *

## Setting up Clever logins via the legacy setup in Google

The simplest method to configure either Badges into Chromebooks logins or set up your users' Chromebooks to launch and log them into Clever automatically is to set up Clever as the organization-wide SSO Profile for your Google account.

![Google: Add third-party SSO profile for your organization](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008JUNZ)

If Clever is set as the organization-wide SSO Profile for your Google accounts, you can add additional SSO profiles for other IdPs. You can learn more about this in Google's support [documentation here](https://support.google.com/a/answer/12032922).

### Prerequisites for setting up Badge or credentials-based logins

### **Prerequisites for Badge Logins**

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008JVRh) Please note:** Clever Badges into Chromebooks are not compatible with [Kiosk Mode](https://support.google.com/chrome/a/answer/9273974?hl=en), and you must have the "set up SSO with third-party identity provider" checkbox selected under the [Third-party SSO profile for your organization](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/security/sso/domain-sso-profile) section of Google Admin.

1.  **Enable Clever Badges.**
    -   Head to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges.](https://schools.clever.com/badges/) Select **Begin Setup.**  
        ![Begin setup Badges screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008JN4M)
2.  **Confirm Google email addresses are populated for students in Clever.**
    -   To confirm if email addresses are populated, search for a few test students and confirm on their profile page if the email field is populated.
        
        If you utilize a student information system (SIS) [Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) and email addresses are missing, please navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page to specify which field in your SIS contains student emails. After your next sync, email addresses should be added to Clever. Please note: If you do not see the SIS field name containing student email addresses, contact Clever Support for assistance.

### **Prerequisites for credential-based logins  
**

1.  **Confirm Google SSO**
    -   Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol). Confirm Google is configured as a login method. For more information on setting up Google SSO, see this [Help Center Article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503).
        
2.  **Confirm Google email addresses are populated for students in Clever.**
    -   To confirm if email addresses are populated, search for a few test students and confirm on their profile page if the email field is populated.
        
        If you utilize a student information system (SIS) [Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) and email addresses are missing, please navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page to specify which field in your SIS contains student emails. After your next sync, email addresses should be added to Clever. Please note: If you do not see the SIS field name containing student email addresses, contact Clever Support for assistance.

### Part 1: Configuring SSO

Follow these step-by-step instructions for the best experience. These settings ensure that you set up Clever as an SSO mechanism into Google for your intended students without impacting how other students and teachers log into Google today in their web browsers.

![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OQ2zd) **Please note:** Need more info about these settings? Check out [this article](https://support.google.com/a/answer/12032922?visit_id=637988031616226805-4012522217&rd=1) on Google Workspace Admin Help.

1.  In your [Google Admin Console](https://admin.google.com/), navigate to [Security > Authentication > SSO with third-party IDP](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/security/sso) and click on Legacy SSO Profile.
    
2.  Using the information from the [Authentication > Badges > Chromebook tab](https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook) page in your Clever Dashboard, complete the following in the Google Admin Console Legacy SSO Profile form.
    
    1.  Tick the box for Enable legacy SSO profile.
        
    2.  Copy your unique Sign-in page URL and paste it into the form.
        
    3.  Copy your unique Sign-out page URL and paste it into the form.
        
    4.  Download your verification certificate and then upload it into the Google Admin Console.
        
    5.  Tick the box for Use a domain specific issuer.
        
    6.  Copy the network mask into the form.
        
        1.  **Do not enter network masks other than the one provided from Clever.** Entering a different network mask will result in undesired behavior when accessing Google and Chrome devices.
            
    7.  Leave Change Password URL as-is. Leaving this URL blank will allow students to change their password.
        
3.  Click Save and continue to the next step.
    

### Part 2: Configuring user and device settings

You can apply these settings to individual [Organizational Units](https://support.google.com/a/answer/182537?hl=en) (OUs), if you want to enable Badges into Chromebooks for only certain schools, grade levels, or types of users. The student account and the device they'll be using for Badges into Chromebooks need to be in an OU with these settings! You may consider setting up a test OU with a test student and a test device.

These settings allow students to log in with their Clever Badges from the moment the Chromebook screen turns on. They also enable the transfer of cookies, which lets them log into Clever and Google whenever they use a Clever Badge.

![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OQ2zd) **Please note:** You can quickly find each setting in Google by using Ctrl + F or CMD + F and typing in the name of the setting.

### See below for written instructions, a video guide, or click here for a [step-by-step clickable tutorial](https://ior.ad/aQwc) of the setup!

##   

### **Configuring user settings**

1.  Navigate to [Devices > Chrome > Settings > Users & browsers](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/chrome/settings/user) and scroll down to the Security section.
2.  Set Lock Screen settings to **Do not allow locking screen**.
3.  Set the following Idle settings.
    1.  Set **Action on idle** to **Logout**
    2.  Set **Action on lid close** to **"Logout"**
    3.  Set **Lock screen on sleep** to **Don't lock screen**
4.  Scroll a little bit until you reach the **Single sign-on and SAML single sign-on login frequency settings** in the **Security** section.
    1.  Set **Single sign-on** to **Enable SAML-based single sign-on for Chrome devices**.
    2.  Set **SAML single sign-on login frequency** to an appropriate duration. We recommend "Every 2 weeks" for the best experience.
5.  Next, scroll down to the Startup section further down the page.
    1.  Change the **Homepage URL** and **Startup pages** to your **Clever Portal URL**.
    2.  Add your school website as an additional **Startup page**

### **Configuring device settings**

1.  Navigate to [Devices > Chrome > Settings > Device](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/chrome/settings/device) and scroll down to the Sign-in settings section, then follow the guided steps below.
2.  Set **Guest Mode** to **Disable guest mode**.
3.  Set **Sign-in Screen** to **Never show user names and photos**.
4.  Set **Single Sign-On IdP Redirection** to **Allow users to go directly to SAML SSO IdP page**.
5.  Set **Single Sign-On Cookie Behavior** to **Enable transfer of SAML SSO Cookies** into user session.
6.  Next, enter this URL under **Single sign-on camera permissions**: [https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login](https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login). These settings ensure that Clever has access to your Chromebooks' cameras to validate Clever Badge logins.
7.  Switch to the **Managed guest session settings tab** and ensure that **Managed guest session** is set to **Do not allow managed guest sessions**.

### Part 3: Testing on a Chromebook

### First, confirm that student email addresses are syncing to Clever. Clever must have an active Google email address for the user to facilitate Chromebook login. Once confirmed, verify that you have saved your new settings.

### **Testing Badge logins**

Test a login with a Clever Badge to ensure students can scan and automatically access Clever. We recommend testing Badges into Chromebooks logins before releasing them to students. To test, you'll need both a Badge for a student and a device in the OU for which you have configured Badges into Chromebooks settings for.

### **Testing credential-based logins**

Test that students can log in with their Google credentials and that the Clever Portal automatically launches when logging into a Chromebook. To test, you'll need Google credentials for a student and a device in the OU for which you have configured the Clever launch settings for.

If you encounter any errors with either method, please confirm the steps above are configured exactly as indicated in the instructions. If the error continues to occur, please contact Clever Support for further assistance.

For additional troubleshooting assistance please see our article [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Troubleshooting.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247)

* * *

## Adding additional identity providers as individual SSO Profiles in Google

**Requirements:**

Support for multiple IdPs is available through these kinds of Google licenses:

-   Google Workspace Business Starter, Business Standard, Business Plus, Enterprise Essentials, Enterprise Standard, Enterprise Plus, Education Fundamentals, Education Plus ([purchase here](https://schools.clever.com/applications/browse/google-bundle)), Frontline, and Nonprofits, as well as legacy G Suite Basic and Business customers.
-   Cloud Identity customers.
-   Google for Education Plus + Clever IDM bundle ([learn more](https://schools.clever.com/applications/browse/google-bundle))

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008Jb45) Please note:** Adding additional identity providers as individual SSO Profiles in Google is not available to Google Workspace Essentials customers or on users' personal Google Accounts.

In your [Google Admin Console](https://admin.google.com/), navigate to [Security > Authentication > SSO with third-party IDP](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/security/sso) to make Clever the org-level SSO profile:

1.  Add additional IdP as a third-party SSO profile.
    
2.  Make Google sign-in the default sign-on method in the OU targeting settings (optional).
    
3.  Target students and student Chromebook OUs with the org-level profile.
    
4.  Target teachers/staff with the additional IdP profile.
    

  

![Adding additional SSO Profiles](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008Jbld)  
  

If you need further assistance, please get in touch with Clever Support by clicking Contact Support in our [Help Center](https://support.clever.com/).

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the best way to use Google applications (Docs, Sheets, Drive, etc.) through Clever?**

-   If you set up Clever and an IdP for Google, please see our article [For Clever Admins: Adding Google SSO Applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001597) to provide the best login experience for all Google applications (drive, docs, sheets, etc.).
    

**Do we need to require forced logout upon idle or lid close?**

-   No. These settings are recommended if devices are being shared by multiple users. If your school organization is 1:1, you can change these idle settings to **Sleep.** For more information on this topic, [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247?language=en_US#idlesettings).
    

**If I set Clever as the organization-wide SSO provider, can I set additional third-party SSO providers?**

-   Yes, please see the instructions in the article above to do so.
    

* * *

  
**Related articles:**

-   [Single Sign-on (SSO): Setting up Clever Badges and Chromebook logins with Clever as an SSO Profile in Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247)
-   [For Clever Admins: Adding Google SSO Applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001597)

title: Clever + Brainpop: Setup guide
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#header1) 2\. [BrainPOP applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#header2) 3\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#header3) 4\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#header4) 5\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#header5) 6\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#faq) 7\. [Support contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001540#support) ## Overview This guide walks through how to get set up with BrainPOP apps in Clever.  Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup) or by accepting your invitation from BrianPOP. For more information on setting up Clever for the first time, please see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271).   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b8GL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** BrainPOP has several apps on Clever. The BrainPOP Suite app powers rostering services. You’ll receive separate invites to BrainPOP, BrainPOP Jr., ELL, Español + Français, and/or Science SSO apps, depending on your school subscriptions. Please approve the SSO apps and leave the BrainPOP Suite app connected. * * * ## BrainPOP applications

Application Name

Icon

Description

BrainPOP SuiteBrainPOP offers cross-curricular movies and supporting features like coding projects, movie making, concept mapping, games, and primary source activities. Recommended for elementary and middle schoolers, as well as English language learners.

BrainPOP Suite powers rostering for all BrainPOP products.
BrainPOPBrainPOP offers cross-curricular movies and supporting features like coding projects, movie making, concept mapping, games, and primary source activities. Recommended for upper elementary and middle schoolers.
BrainPOP Jr.BrainPOP’s K-3 resource, offering cross-curricular movies and supporting features like coding projects, movie making, concept mapping, games, and primary source activities.
BrainPOP ELL
 		BrainPOP’s comprehensive English language learning program, featuring animated movies that model conversational English while seamlessly introducing grammar and vocabulary. 
BrainPOP EspañolBrainPOP Español offers cross-curricular movies and supporting features in Spanish. Recommended for upper elementary and middle schoolers.
BrainPOP Français
 		BrainPOP Français offers cross-curricular movies and supporting features in French. Recommended for upper elementary and middle schoolers.
BrainPOP Science
 		BrainPOP Science is a phenomenon-driven middle school science product that provides robust investigations, units, embedded assessments, and actionable diagnostics for 6-8th grade across Physical, Life, and Earth & Space Science.
* * * ## Setup process If your district is already on Clever, you can connect BrainPOP’s applications in one of two ways:  If BrainPOP invites you to connect, you can follow the directions in the emails you receive. You’ll receive separate invites to the BrainPOP Suite, along with BrainPOP Jr., ELL, Español + Français, and/or Science SSO apps, depending on your school subscriptions.  You can also request the apps needed to get going by following the steps below.   ### **Part 1: Set up rostering**  1. Log into your Clever Dashboard and click [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation. 2. Search for BrainPOP Suite – this app manages rostering for all BrainPOP applications.  3. You'll then be brought to a page where you can authorize your BrainPOP request. As Clever SSO and rostering for BrainPOP are provided at no cost to the district, you can mark that it has already been purchased for the district. 4. You'll also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the BrainPOP icons in their Clever portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day. 5. Once you have made your selections, click _Request_! ### **Part 2: Set up Single Sign-on (SSO)** 1. Log into your Clever Dashboard and click [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation. 2. Search for the BrainPOP product your district will be using, such as BrainPOP Jr. or Español – this app will manage Single Sign-on (SSO) into the app for your district users. 3. You'll then be brought to a page to authorize your BrainPOP request. As Clever SSO and rostering for BrainPOP are provided at no cost to the district, you can mark that it has already been purchased for the district. 4. You'll also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the BrainPOP icons in their Clever portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day. 5. Once you have made your selections, click _Request_! Once you have completed _both_ portions above, the BrainPOP team will set up the initial sync and will reach out to you to discuss communicating with teachers.   ### **Recommended sharing** Before sharing, ensure that students and teachers are in their correct grade levels and that classes are updated for the current school year in your Student Information System (SIS). BrainPOP recommends that you share all data for your district. The simplest way to do so is to select “Share All Data” in Clever. If you plan to share specific schools, you can find [more info about “Share by Rules” here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). You can create a sharing rule by going to the Sharing Permissions page for BrainPOP Suite. To do this, log in to your Clever account and click the icon for BrainPOP Suite in the sidebar. From the Data Sharing tab, click _Share All Data_.   * * * ## Required fields Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. BrainPOP **requires** the following data fields be sent: - Student: name, school, sis\_id, district, schools, graduation\_year, credentials - Teacher: district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, credentials, email, state\_id, teacher\_number, title - School Admin: district, name, schools, staff\_id, email, credentials, title, roles - District admin: district, name.first, name.last, email, title IMPORTANT  Be sure to keep the BrainPOP Suite app connected, as this powers rostering for all BrainPOP applications. * * * ## Troubleshooting **Apostrophes** Please keep in mind that if you're syncing any users whose names have apostrophes, they must be the vertical type (') instead of a curled version. If it's curled, it will trigger a data error and filter out the user! **Commas** BrainPOP doesn't currently support syncing users with commas in their name. Please remove the comma from the user's name in your data sync with Clever to prevent errors or issues.   * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions **Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data error”?** - A data error occurs when the record is incompatible with BrainPOP’s integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Errors must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application. Contact Clever Support if you have questions about resolving your data error. - A data warning occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.   **Why is a student or teacher missing from BrainPOP?** - Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to BrainPOP: - In your SIS data - In your Clever data - Is shared with BrainPOP in your data-sharing permissions **Can multiple teachers/staff be assigned to the same course/section?** - BrainPOP can support multiple teachers or staff assigned to the same course/section. **Can multiple teachers/staff be assigned to the same course/section?** - BrainPOP can support multiple teachers or staff assigned to the same course/section. **Why do I have to approve invites to multiple applications?** - BrainPOP has multiple student- and teacher-facing SSO applications in Clever (BrainPOP, BrainPOP Jr, BrainPOP ELL), all of which roster via the BrainPOP Rostering application.  - To use any BrainPOP product via Clever, please ensure that you’ve connected ‘BrainPOP Suite’ _and_ the SSO application for any of the BrainPOP products your district has purchased. All schools with a subscription to any BrainPOP product should be shared with the BrainPOP Suite app.  **Why did I get an email inviting me to connect with BrainPOP in Clever?** - If you received an invitation to connect to BrainPOP, BrainPOP Jr., or BrainPOP ELL, that means schools within your district have a subscription to a BrainPOP product. BrainPOP is excited to offer your district SSO and automated rostering via Clever starting this school year at no cost to you.  - The invitation from the BrainPOP team should include suggested sharing rules with the right schools listed. If you still have questions about which of your schools have subscriptions to a BrainPOP product or would like to speak with the BrainPOP team directly, please reach out to [onboarding@brainpop.com](mailto:onboarding@brainpop.com). * * * ## Support contacts ### **BrainPOP**   [Help.brainpop.com/hc/en-us/requests/new](https://help.brainpop.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)   Contact BrainPOP with issues that relate to: - An error message within any BrainPOP URL   **Clever** [Support.clever.com](https://support.clever.com/) (click the chat icon in the corner of the screen) Contact Clever with issues that relate to: - Data within Clever, or data coming from Clever.

title: Clever + NWEA MAP Growth: Sharing Program status
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001539#header1)  
2\. [Required Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001539#header3)  
3\. [Sharing Program Status: Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001539#header2)  
4. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001539#header5)  
5. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001539#header4)

## Overview

Before reading this guide, please ensure your district is set up with Clever and that you've added the NWEA MAP Growth app to your district's Clever account!  
  
If your district hasn't been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup). For more information on setting up Clever for the first time, please see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271).  
  
A District Admin must add the application in Clever. To add the NWEA MAP Growth app, search _NWEA MAP Growth_ in the search bar [of your Clever account](https://schools.clever.com/).  
  
When it comes to rostering for NWEA MAP Growth with Clever, one of the most common requests from districts is for the capability to summarize test results by program (e.g., 504, IEP, special ed, etc.).   
  
To address this need, the MAP system supports importing program designations from Clever, making program data available in several MAP Growth reports.  The “[Sharing Program Status: Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001539#header2)” section of this article explains how to share programs from Clever to NWEA MAP Growth.

* * *

## Required Fields

Check the [Data Quality](https://schools.clever.com/applications/nwea/warnings) tab of the NWEA MAP Growth app in your Clever Dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. NWEA MAP Growth requires the following data fields to be sent:  
   
**Student:**

-   sis\_id
-   name
-   district
-   school(s)
-   grade
-   race
-   gender
-   dob
-   hispanic\_ethnicity
-   state\_id (if you’re using NWEA as part of a state program)
-   frl\_status, iep\_status, ell\_status and extension fields are optional

**Teacher:**

-   district
-   name
-   school(s)
-   sis\_id
-   email

If you’re using NWEA as part of a state program, you may have additional fields required by your state, including but not limited to the state\_id field at the school level. Please see your state program documentation for the fields required by your state.  
 

* * *

## Sharing Program Status: Setup Process

If you’d like to import program designations from Clever into MAP, please read the following setup process.

###   
**Step 1: Find the MAP Custom Names for the programs you'll sync** 

When Clever sends program data to MAP (e.g., if a student is an ELL), the MAP system will attempt to import the data using the MAP Custom Names for the programs you’ve defined. Therefore, a good first step is to identify the MAP Custom Names that are already entered the MAP system (if any).  
   
![NWEA Programs screen, with highlight on Custom Name](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YNwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RkC2)  
  
To find the Custom Names for the programs in your district: 

1.  Log in to MAP at [teach.mapnwea.org](https://teach.mapnwea.org/).
2.  In the left navigation menu, click _Modify Preferences > Modify District_. 
3.  Scroll to the _Programs_ section. A list of programs showing the NWEA Standard Name and Custom Name appears.  
4.  Note the Custom Names for programs you want to sync using Clever.

Please keep in mind:

-   The NWEA Standard Name isn't used to match program data from Clever. 
-   The Custom Name is the name that shows on reports. 
-   It's possible for multiple Custom Names to have the same NWEA Standard Name, and it's also possible for the Custom Name to be identical to the NWEA Standard Name.  
-   If you need a program added (such as Individualized Education Plan (IEP)) that isn't a default value in the MAP System, you'll need to add the program in NWEA if you want this program data to sync from Clever. Follow these steps:

1.  In the left navigation menu of NWEA, select _Modify Preferences > Modify District_.
2.  Click _Add Program_, then select _Other_ as the Standard Name and paste the program name, like "Individualized Education Plan (IEP)" into the Custom Name text field.
3.  Click _Submit_ to save.

### **Step 2: Learn about Clever standard fields**

Clever has three standard fields that are pre-populated in the Clever system.

1.  ell\_status
2.  frl\_status
3.  iep\_status 

These three Clever standard fields, if shared with the MAP System, will automatically link up with the following MAP Custom Names if the MAP Custom Names are present in your MAP system (see chart below).   
  
![Chart with Clever and NWEA Map Growth naming conventions](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YNwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Rtib)  
This table provides an overview of values in Clever and what you would see in the MAP System under _Modify Preferences > Modify District_.  
  
 

### **Step 3: Identify if you need to modify or create new extension fields in Clever**

Now that you understand that Clever has three default fields that align with a small handful of common school programs, you can determine if you need to add or modify [extension fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912) in Clever to identify additional programs in your school (e.g., talented & gifted, after-school classes, etc.).  
  
The easiest way to do this is to compare the extension fields in Clever to the list of MAP Custom Names:

-   If the extension fields in Clever perfectly match (including spelling and punctuation) the list of MAP Custom Names, then no action is needed, and your data should transfer accurately.
-   If you have extension fields in Clever (e.g., Talented & Gifted) that aren't on the list of MAP Custom Names, you will need to create new MAP Custom Names to match these extension fields.
-   If you have MAP Custom Names (e.g., After School Program) that don't have a matching Clever extension field, you will need to create a new (or modify a current) extension field to match the MAP Custom.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YNwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The extension fields in Clever must perfectly match the MAP Custom Name (including **spelling and punctuation**).

###   
  
**Step 4: Creating new extension fields in Clever**

You can create new extension fields in Clever by [following the directions in this Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912). The exact process will depend on the sync type you have set up to connect your **Student Information System (SIS)** to Clever.  
   
If you need help syncing the data from your SIS into Clever in the correct format, contact Clever Support by clicking the blue chat box in the bottom right corner of the Help Center.  
  
The names of the Clever extension fields that the MAP system accepts are listed in the right-hand column in the table below. The data you'll enter in the CSV file to assign a particular student to a program will be the exact Custom Name of the program you have listed in the MAP system.   
  
![Table showing Clever Extension fields and how they need to be formatted as MAP Custom Names](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YNwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Rtig)  
  
  
Let's look at an example of students who are assigned different programs in Clever (via extension fields) that will then be sent over to MAP as a Standard Name or Custom Name:  
  
![Examples of students with Clever extension fields and MAP Custom Names](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YNwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RkIt)   
   
In the above example, you see that:

-   Student 123 will be assigned to two programs in MAP: the Remote Learning program and the Gifted and Talented program.
-   Student 456 will also be assigned to the Remote Learning program, as well as the Section 504 program.
-   Student 789 is assigned to two programs in MAP: the Remote Learning and Economically Disadvantaged programs.

### **Step 5: Share data with NWEA**

Now that the data is synced to Clever, you can share the data with NWEA. The instructions for sharing custom fields in Clever can be [found here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912?#h_d4ba1f6f-8f60-44ac-9b37-accadf95647e).  
   
Since these fields are considered sensitive, you must provide special permission for Clever to share these fields with MAP. Refer to [For District Admins: Syncing Sensitive Fields (i.e., ELL status, IEP status, FRL status)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020926771) for instructions.  
  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can I add multiple “other” programs as Clever Extension Fields?** 

-   For example, a district might have a program with a Custom Name in MAP called “Volleyball” and another program with a Custom Name called “Economically Disadvantaged”.

You can add multiple "other" extension fields! If you're using a CSV file to upload your extension fields, you'll simply list all of the extension fields for the student within the ext.other column, separating each field with a comma, as shown in this example, a student with sis\_id 789 is assigned Remote Learning and Economically Disadvantaged:  
![Example table with a student who has more than one ext.other values, separated by a comma](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YNwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RkM2)

  
  
**What if I have multiple programs that might match a different custom field name (such as ELL)?** 

-   If no students will ever be assigned to both programs (for example, a district might have “ELL Spanish” and “ELL Arabic” programs and students can only ever be assigned to 1 of these at most), then you can use the same custom field in Clever for both. The student assigned to, for example, ELL Spanish, should have “ELL Spanish” as the value for the ext.ell field, while the student assigned to ELL Arabic will have “ELL Arabic” in that field. 

The only field that NWEA will accept multiple values for the same student is ext.other. So if there is a chance that a student will be assigned to multiple programs that could have the same custom field name in Clever, you should use another field such as the ext.other field for these programs instead. The ext.other field will accept comma-separated values. 

* * *

## Support Contacts

**NWEA MAP Growth**  
[techsupport@nwea.org](mailto:techsupport@nwea.org)  
  
**Clever**  
[Support.clever.com](https://support.clever.com/) (click Contact Support)  
Contact Clever with issues that relate to:

-   Setting up sharing rules
-   Syncing required and optional fields to Clever 
-   Customizing field access

title: For Teachers: Using Clever as a long-term substitute teacher
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001534#header1)  
2\. [What’s Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001534#header2)  
3\. [How to get access to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001534#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001534#header4)

## Overview

If you’re a long-term substitute for a school, this article is for you! This article will run through what Clever is at a high level, how to get access, and FAQs. If you've been assigned a Sub Badge via Clever's Substitute Access feature, [please find more information here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001674).  
 

* * *

## What’s Clever

Clever connects school organizations with the applications and programs they use every day.

  
Students and teachers sign in to Clever and can then access hundreds of applications and programs. With just one username and password, students and teachers can get into many edtech programs, making digital learning quicker and easier.   
  
In addition, Clever shares up-to-date class rosters with apps and programs, so the class list is always accurate across all programs. When a new student is added or removed from a class, Clever shares this update with all programs connected to Clever.  
  
Finally, with Clever, teachers have access to troubleshooting tools. They can easily help students who are having trouble logging in without needing to contact the IT department.

## 

### **Why might you need to use Clever as a sub?**

Substitute teachers may cover a class for a short-term leave, like when someone is sick, or you may be covering a long-term leave, like a parental or medical leave. If you're a long-term sub who needs to work with students in their online curriculum, using Clever is the best way to keep track of students and their technology-based learning.

* * *

## How to get access to Clever

The school organization you are working with set up Clever, so you’ll need to reach out to the schools you’re working at to request access. Typically, a school's IT or technology team manages Clever, so you should ask your point of contact (such as the principal or a school admin) to reach out to the IT team.  
  
Once you’ve been added to Clever by the school organization, you’ll log in using their unique Clever web address, such as Clever.com/in/school-organization-name. If you don’t know this URL, you can also [click here to search for the school.](https://clever.com/oauth/district-picker?channel=clever&client_id=4c63c1cf623dce82caac&confirmed=true&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclever.com%2Fin%2Fauth_callback&response_type=code&state=9da401d904185a5260cfde336cfe34815f8c361e11c08c931bf4ccace2509eb1) Keep in mind that the school organization's account must be add you before you can access Clever.  
 

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIIT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)To learn more about Clever, you can check out our free, on-demand training: [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=teacher)! In as little as 10 minutes, you can learn more about Clever’s powerful features and use them to support digital learning. Please note that you must already have a Clever account before you can access Clever Academy.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who can I reach out to if I don’t have Clever access?**

-   Please reach out to your main point of contact at the school where you’re subbing (e.g., a principal).

**What if I am a short-term sub covering for a few days?**

-   Clever's [Substitute Access feature](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001672) will be the best fit for you! Instead of being assigned your own Clever account and login, the teacher you're subbing for will provide a Clever Badge that enables you to log into their Teacher Pages for the days you are covering. Access is limited to 14 or fewer days.

title: For Clever Admins: Adding a long-term substitute teacher
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001533#header1)  
2\. [How to add a substitute](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001533#header2)  
3\. [How subs log in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001533#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001533#header4)

## Overview

A common piece of feedback we’ve heard from substitute teachers is that they often aren’t given any access to edtech programs, making it hard for them to support students.

  
Good news! You can use Clever to give both long-term and short-term substitute teachers access to Clever and your school organization’s edtech programs.
