IMPORTANT This article covers the process for adding long-term subs to your schools. For short-term subs (roughly 14 days or less), please have teachers use our [short-term substitute teacher feature](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675).

  
Short-term access enables them to support students by:

-   Troubleshooting logins for students using Clever
-   Creating or viewing Teacher Pages
-   Launching apps and logging students out of Clever
-   Accessing edtech programs to check on student progress and offer support

* * *

## How to add a substitute

### **  
Long-term substitutes**

For a substitute covering a class for a longer period (such as parental leave), we recommend the following steps.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQj3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** For the teacher to log in, they must have an email that matches the Identity Provider (IdP) your school organization has set up. For example, if you use Google as your IdP, the teacher must have a Gmail address (either a personal one or one provided by your school organization). Alternatively, you can add [Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038)  as an IdP, which subs access via a username and password (and doesn’t require a specific email address/provider).

  
**Option 1: Add them as a teacher via your Student Information System (SIS):**  
  
This option is ideal, as it automatically creates their account in Clever and shares it with the section(s) they’ll be teaching in any connected apps.

1.  If possible, have the teacher added as the teacher of record in your Student Information System (SIS) and added as the teacher for the sections they’ll be covering. We also recommend providing them with an email address for your school organization as this is often required by apps and will help the sub to access Clever. 
    -   Note: If adding them as the teacher of record isn’t possible, you can also [add them as a co-teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748). Some edtech programs don’t support co-teachers, so please check with any critical programs directly.
2.  If you’re able to follow step one, your data sync will add the teacher to Clever and provide access to the sections you’ve added them to, along with any edtech programs those sections are shared with. As such, they’ll have access to Clever and edtech programs in the same way as any other teacher.
3.  Inform the substitute that they have a Clever account and an email account. You can [share this article with them](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001534), which runs through how Clever works for teachers and how they can access it. 

  
**Option 2: Add them as a custom teacher in Clever**  
  
If you add the sub as a custom teacher, you’ll have to take more manual steps than with option one.

1.  If option one isn’t viable, you can add the long-term sub as a [custom teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691) in Clever. **Note:** Please wait 15 minutes after adding the custom teacher before moving to step two; this allows the custom teacher to sync across Clever.
2.  [Add them as a co-teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748) for all the sections they’ll be teaching.

![Screenshot of the Section page with Add a co-teacher button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQj3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Qs4T)

3.  Inform the substitute that they have a Clever account. You can share [this article with them](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001534), which runs through how Clever works and how they can access it.

Once you've added the substitute teacher in Clever, they'll be able to log into Clever around 15 minutes after their account syncs. However, it may take up to 24 hours for applications to sync and create their accounts, as most app syncs occur nightly. If it’s been more than 24 hours and the sub is not showing up, we suggest contacting the app(s) in question or Clever Support.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQj3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please remember that, like any user added via Clever, subs who access Clever may count towards your license caps for your edtech programs. License management varies considerably from app to app, as some apps might offer an unlimited school organization or schools license while others charge per user. If you’re unsure if adding subs will affect any app subscriptions, please check in with the app directly.

### **Short-term substitutes**

The best method for managing short-term substitutes covering a class for 14 days or less is our [Substitute Access feature](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/substitute-access). This feature makes it easy for teachers to provide their substitutes with temporary access to Clever securely. Instead of sharing their personal login credentials, teachers can generate a Sub Badge that allows short-term substitutes to log in and view the resources and Teacher Page to which they have been given access. This allows teachers to maintain secure credentials while also giving substitutes the tools they need to manage their online resources effectively for the day. [You can learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001675).

If the Substitute Access feature doesn't seem like the right tool for your scenario, you can also follow the steps above for adding the substitute to your account as a custom teacher and assigning them as a co-teacher to the sections they'll be teaching. This method can take up to 24 hours for subs to access learning applications, which is why the Substitute Access feature is preferred.  
  

* * *

## How long-term subs log in to Clever

### **Subs with school organization email addresses** 

If the sub has an email address assigned by your school organization, they can sign in using that email at your school's Clever URL (such as Clever.com/in/school-nickname). If your school organization uses Clever Passwords as your Identity Provider (IdP), the teacher will use the username and password that you’ve configured for signing in (you can [check that here](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) if you’re not sure).

###  **Subs without school organization email addresses** 

If the sub doesn't have an email address from your school organization, they can sign in using a personal Google email account **if your organization uses Google as an identity provider**. Just be sure to use their Google email address when creating their account.  
  
If the sub does **not** have a school email address, _and_ your school doesn’t use Google as an identity provider, the sub will need to sign in via Clever Passwords. You can add this as an IdP [here](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings).

For those using the Substitute Access feature, please read more about [their login process here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001675#header5).

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can you provide substitutes with access for a specific date range?**

-   Yes! When adding the sub as a Custom Teacher, you can determine a date for them to lose access. Learn more about [custom teachers here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691).

  
**Will subs have access to Teacher Pages?**

-   Subs will have access to build their own Teacher Pages, whether they’re a regular teacher created via your SIS or a custom teacher. If the teacher the sub is covering for has Teacher Page(s), that teacher can also share their Teacher Page with the sub. You can find out more about [sharing Teacher Pages here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001523).

title: Clever IDM: Pushing and Pausing syncs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001532#header1)  
2\. [Pushing a sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001532#pushsync)  
3\. [Examples of when to pause](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001532#header2)  
4\. [Pausing a Clever IDM sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001532#header3)  
5\. [Resuming a Clever IDM sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001532#header4)

## Overview

Clever IDM’s default behavior is to sync once daily, at night. At that time, Clever will compare the data in Clever to the accounts in Google/AD/Entra and create, update, or archive users appropriately. 

There may be some reason that you want to temporarily pause your nightly Clever IDM sync, though. This article will walk you through the process of pushing, pausing, and resuming your Clever IDM syncs. 

## 

  
 

* * *

## Pushing a sync

To initiate a manual sync of IDM:

1.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > User Management > IDM.](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management)
2.  Click on the desired destination.
3.  Click **Edit <destination> provisioning.  
      
    ![Screenshot of edit provisioning button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StG5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VaU2X)**  
4.  In the bottom right, click **Provision <destination>  
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StG5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000025hzF)  
    **

* * *

## Examples of when to pause

Some examples of when pausing your Clever IDM sync may be helpful: 

-   Encountering issues with IDM? Pause your sync while you understand what the issue is. Resume your sync once you have identified the issue.
-   Making big changes to your Clever sync (summer rollover, semester rollover, changing an SIS)? Pause your sync. When the majority of your changes are complete, resume the sync. This will ensure that you don’t have too many rapid, unnecessary changes in your provisioned Google/Active Directory/Entra accounts while the SIS changes are happening.   
     

* * *

## Pausing Clever IDM syncs

On [the Clever IDM Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management/), select the destination that you want to pause the syncs for.   
  
![Pause button for Google syncs](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StG5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VaW7Z)   
  
Click the **Pause <Destination> Syncs** button and confirm the pause in the pop-up.  
  
Once you have confirmed the pause, your destination’s Clever IDM syncs should be paused.   
  
On the Clever IDM Dashboard, the destination will now have a **Paused** indicator, and a banner will appear, informing you that the syncs are paused.  
  
![IDM dashboard with banner at the top that says sync is paused](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StG5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005QM7c)  
  
While Clever IDM syncs are paused, you'll still be able to change your configuration settings and preview these changes.   
  
You won't be able to provision the changes until you resume the IDM syncs.   
  
If you have Clever IDM for more than one destination (e.g., for Google AND Active Directory), you can pause them each individually. This means that your Google IDM sync can still continue while your Active Directory IDM sync is paused.   
  
However, this also means you must manually pause both of them if you don't want any IDM syncs to run.   
 

* * *

## Resuming Clever IDM syncs

To resume Clever IDM syncs, click the **Resume <destination> Syncs** button on the [IDM Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management/). 

![IDM dashboard with sync paused, with Resume Google Provisioning Syncs button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StG5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005QM8L)  
  
A popup will appear, asking you to confirm the change. When you press confirm, Clever IDM will automatically kick off a preview of your accounts for you. Please review these changes and verify they are correct before your next nightly IDM sync. If you notice any unexpected changes, you may pause your syncs again at any time as you resolve the issues.  
  
Another way to resume Clever IDM syncs is to click the **Resume Syncs** button in the banner that informs you that your IDM syncs are paused. It works exactly the same as the button on the IDM Dashboard.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466)
-   [Clever IDM: Summer Rollover](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001513)
-   [Clever IDM: Sync Reports](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001473)

title: Clever + Virginia Wizard: Setup guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001531#header1)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001531#header2)  
3\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001531#header3)  
4\. [Getting support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001531#header4)

## Overview

This guide walks through how to get set up with Virginia Wizard in Clever.  
  
Before reading this guide, please make sure your division is set up with Clever! If your division has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup) or by accepting your invitation from Virginia Wizard. For more information on setting up Clever for the first time, please see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271).

* * *

## Setup process

-   If your division is already on Clever, you can connect Virginia Wizard’s application by accepting your invite (please email [wizard@vccs.edu](mailto:wizard@vccs.edu) to ask for an invitation to connect) OR following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)
    -   Search for **Virginia Wizard**.
    -   You'll then be brought to a page where you can authorize your Virginia Wizard request. As Clever SSO and rostering for Virginia Wizard is provided at no cost to the division, you can mark that it has already been purchased for the division.
    -   You'll also be asked if you'd like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the Virginia Wizard icons in their Clever Portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click **Request**.

Once you have shared data with Virginia Wizard, the Virginia Wizard team will set up the initial sync.

###    
Recommended Sharing

Before sharing:

-   Ensure that students and teachers are in their correct grade levels and that classes are updated for the current school year in your Student Information System (SIS).

Virginia Wizard recommends that you “Share all records in my district” in Clever. You can find more info about sharing data [here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)  
  
 

* * *

## Required fields

Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. Virginia Wizard requires the following data fields be sent:  
   
**Student:** district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, credentials, dob, email, ext, gender, grade, graduation\_year, hispanic\_ethnicity, location, race, state\_id, student\_number  
  
**Teacher:** district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, credentials, email, ext, state\_id, teacher\_number, title  
  
**School Admin:** district, name, schools, staff\_id, credentials, department, email, ext, roles, title  
  
**District admin:** district, name.first, name.last, email, title  
 

* * *

## Support Contacts

**Virginia Wizard**  
The Wizard team offers training for counselors and teachers on how to use Clever with student logins and rostering. Just request this by emailing [wizard@vccs.edu](mailto:wizard@vccs.edu).  
   
**Clever**  
Support.clever.com (click the chat icon in the corner of the screen)  
Contact Clever with issues that relate to the steps outlined in this article, or see Clever Academy for more information on how to get the most out of Clever.

title: Requesting a New Clever Account: Shared Student Information Systems
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header1)  
2\. [Exporting your data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header2)  
3\. [Communicate changes with applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header3)  
4\. [Historic data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header4)  
5\. [Logins may be impacted](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header5)  
6. [Alternatives to having your own account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header6)  
7. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001530#header7)

  ​

## Overview

Often charter schools (and sometimes small districts) share a Student Information System (SIS) with other schools or a larger school district.  Since Clever syncs data from your SIS, many districts and schools in this scenario share a Clever account, however, there are times when a district or school may prefer to maintain its own Clever account. Below are a few items to take into consideration when choosing if your school should manage its own Clever account.  
NOTE  
**If your SIS is managed by a separate team (e.g. a school district or charter school network), you will want to reach out to that team to consider the following information together.**   
 

* * *

## Exporting your data

If you share an SIS account with a district or group of schools, you'll need to know how to export and upload just your school’s data.   
  
This can be done via an [SFTP Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078), but you may need to work with the district or charter network team to ensure just your school’s data is exported. Clever isn't able to provide guidance on the export process from your SIS when using an SFTP sync. 

​

* * *

## Communicate changes with applications

Are you currently syncing data to any applications through the existing Clever account? If so, please contact your application representative if you are anticipating a change to your existing Clever account. Creating a new Clever account will provision users with new Clever IDs, potentially impacting historical data within connected applications. 

​

* * *

## Historic data

​If you have any students or teachers currently accessing an existing district account, Clever won't be able to preserve historical data across these accounts.  Individual application partners may be able to assist, but you will need to reach out to them directly.

Additionally, if you have students who are highly transient (move between schools in the district or charter network frequently), please consider that these students will not have data preserved as they potentially move between Clever accounts.  
 

* * *

## Logins may be impacted

If multiple schools share a Google Admin Console, Badges into Chromebooks can only be supported for one Clever account. The setup for Badges into Chromebooks requires the unique sign-in/sign-out URL for Clever, and this can only be input in Google once.

Clever Admin cannot have the same email address on multiple Clever accounts. If you wish to have the same admins on multiple accounts, a unique email address will be necessary for each account.

​

* * *

## Alternatives to having your own account

Many large districts prefer to use the School Tech Lead role to help manage individual school accounts within a larger district account.  
  
School Tech Leads have additional permissions such as the ability to customize their school’s Clever Portal, utilize School Site Sharing to control their school’s sharing rules for applications, and help with troubleshooting logins for users in their school. For more information on School Tech Leads please see our articles [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663?language=en_US) and [Sharing Permissions: Enabling School Site Sharing for School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366?language=en_US).  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

  
**Can I use a Clever-Managed Auto Sync or API Sync for an individual account if I share a Student Information System (SIS)?**

-   This depends on your SIS. Reach out to Clever Support for additional information.

**If I choose to share a Clever account with my district/network, can I update the emails for just my school?** 

-   It's common for districts to have one email domain stored in their SIS, while an individual school may also have its own unique domain. If you need to update emails in the existing account to reflect your preferred domain for student logins, you can do so by manually side-loading emails. See our article [Manually Uploading (i.e. side-loading) User Emails to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026?language=en_US) for more information, or reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/) for additional assistance.

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663?language=en_US) 
-   [Sharing Permissions: Enabling School Site Sharing for School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366?language=en_US)
-   [Manually Uploading (i.e. side-loading) User Emails to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026?language=en_US)

title: TN Universal Reading Screener - Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001529#overview) 2\. [Step 1: Sending Clever the required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001529#step1) 3\. [Step 2: Sharing extension fields with Applications used for the TN Universal Reading Screener](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001529#step2)   ## Overview Tennessee school districts can use Clever to integrate applications used for the Tennessee Universal Reading Screener and meet the state’s data requirements. While solutions may vary, districts can leverage their Clever Sync and use extension fields to manage their data for the TN Universal Reading Screener. Please reference the steps below to include these required data fields in Clever.  The following data fields are required by the Tennessee Department of Education: 1. **District ID (District Number)** - 5-digit ID\*  2. **School ID (School Number)** - 4-digit code\* 3. **Student Unique Student Identifier** - USID - Clever standard field - State ID -  Clever extension field - studentstateid.ext 4. **Teacher License Number (TLN)**  - Clever standard field - State ID -  Clever extension field - teacherstateid.ext (Highly recommended)  

Data Element

ColumnName

Definition

Length

Sample Value / Additional Info

District ID (District Number)

DistrictID

The number in the school directory assigned by the state to each district.

Max Length: 3
Data Type: Numeric
 

Source: School Directory / Department List Provided (column A in district tab). Unique in state, non-duplicated. 

School ID (School Number)

SchoolID

The number in the school directory assigned by the state to each school within a district.

Max Length: 4
Data Type: Numeric
 

School Directory / Department List Provided (column D in schools tab)
 
Unique in district, may be duplicated across state

 

State Assigned Student ID (USID)

SSID

Unique student ID generated by the state and assigned to a student.

MaxLength: 9
DataType: Numeric

 

Usually 7 digits; trim leading zeroes as needed

Teacher License Number (TLN)

TLN

Unique number assigned to an educator by the state when they are first entered into the teacher Certification and Licensure system

Data Type: Numeric  Usually 6 digits; trim leading zeros as needed.

If teacher has no TLN, schools/districts should use the last 4 of the instructors SSN for the TLN field.  Growth scores will not be calculated for those teachers if no TLN provided before final spring cumulative file. 

* * * ## Step 1: Sending Clever the required fields You can send Clever each field using the standard fields below:  **School ID (School Number)** - 4-digit code\* - schools.csv: Clever Standard Field - School\_ID **Student Unique Student Identifier** \- USID - students.csv: Clever standard field - State\_ID **Teacher License Number** **(TLN)**  - teachers.csv: Clever standard field - State\_ID   If you are unable to use the standard fields in Clever to send your data, you can leverage extension fields using the instructions below: **For SFTP and SIS-Managed Auto Syncs:** There are a couple of options for uploading custom field data to Clever via SFTP/CSV files: - Districts can add a custom/extension field column to one of the existing rostering files being synced to Clever (schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv, and enrollments.csv). The column name must begin with 'ext'. - For example: Fields such as 'Teacher License Number' or could be added to the teachers.csv with columns named 'ext.teacher\_license\_number' or 'ext.teacherstateid' to your CSV files. - If your district currently syncs data to Clever via SFTP, you can also upload custom fields via CSV files directly to your Clever SFTP folder by uploading to a subdirectory named /extensionfields. The files should be named: - schools\_ext.csv - sections\_ext.csv - students\_ext.csv - teachers\_ext.csv - staff\_ext.csv **For Clever Managed Autosyncs:** For the following auto-syncs, custom fields can be added by reaching out to Clever support to help set up custom field mapping using extension fields. - PowerSchool - Infinite Campus Auto Sync - Skyward Auto Sync - Illuminate Auto Sync - Aeries Auto Sync - SchoolInsight Auto Sync - iNow Auto Sync Please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us) and we can get this started for you. * * * ## Step 2: Sharing extension fields with Applications used for the TN Universal Reading Screener You can share your custom fields with any app by follow these steps: 1. Navigate to the overview page for the app and click on the **Settings** tab 2. Under **Field Access**, select **Advanced Settings** 3. Select **Customize fields shared with {app}** and click **Customize fields** ![advanced settings pop up box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjwD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Q1oY) 4. On the **Edit Student Fields** page, select **Next** 5. On the **Edit Contact Fields** page, select **Next** 6. On the **Edit District Admin Fields** page, select **Next** 7. You are now on the **Edit Extension Fields** page. Any extension fields that you have uploaded to Clever will be found in the left column under **Fields**. Click on the fields you wish to share with the app to bring it to the right column under **Share with {app}**. Once you have selected the desired fields to share, select **Save**. ![Edit extension fields pop up box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjwD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Q1oi)

title: Clever IDM: Preview Sync Visualizer and Events
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001528#overview)  
2\. [How to use Preview Sync Visualizer](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001528#how_to_use)  
3\. [How to use Events](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001528#header3)

## Overview

Clever enables you to check your configuration settings by user with the Sync Visualizer Preview tool. The **Sync Visualizer Preview** tool helps Clever admins understand the changes to be made to different users that are currently being managed by Clever IDM before the changes occur. This tool only shows the differences for users whose information changed. Users with no changes won’t show up in this tool.

To review all creations, matches, updates, and archivals after your Clever IDM sync has run, we recommend utilizing the Events tab on your Clever IDM overview page. The events tab will allow you to filter and locate specific users to view more details on how Clever IDM is managing their destination account.  
 

* * *

## How to use

The Sync Visualizer Preview tool is available during setup at the [Preview and Provision step](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management/setup/preview).   
  
![Check user button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000Bl3g)  
  
Please refresh your preview before attempting to use this feature  
  
To use this feature:

1.  Click **Check a user**
2.  Search for user by name or email
3.  Once you select a user, you will see information based on the action being done for the user. 

  
**For users that will be created, you will see:**

-   The locations where the user is or will be placed
-   First and last name
-   Clever IDM username
-   If the user needs to change their password on next login

  
![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PvXy)

  
  
**For users that will be updated, you'll see:**

-   Current Value of field(s) to be updated
-   Updated Value for field(s)

  
![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PvWh)

  
  
**For users that will be archived, you'll see:**

-   Original location of the user
-   New archive location

  
![UserArchived.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PvY8)

  
  
**For user accounts with current issues, you'll see:**

-   Issue type
-   Description
-   More details

![UserIssue.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PvYD)  
  
  
With this tool you can view and confirm expected changes to your users quickly and easily. If you discover unexpected changes, you can go back through the configuration to adjust what’s needed.

* * *

## How to use Events

After your initial Clever IDM sync, you can continue to track changes to your users via the [User Management > IDM > Events tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management). On this tab, you can select a date range for which you’d like to review Clever IDM creates, updates, archives, and matched users. You can also apply filters to examine changes by destination (if you have multiple configured), event type (create, update, etc.), or specific users by name or SIS ID.

Once you find the event for the user and destination you’d like to review, click the dropdown arrow to examine more details.

![Clever IDM Events view](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000dnDyZ)

It is also possible to unlink a user via the Events tab. It is necessary to unlink a user if Clever IDM incorrectly links a Clever account to an account in a destination due to an error in the user's data.

Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > User Management > IDM > Events tab](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) and click the drop-down menu for the user you need to unlink. You'll see an **Unlink user** button. As long as you correct the data in Clever and/or the destination, the new link will be correct.

  
![IDM Events unlink user button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YY45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000dnW8L)   

For archived users, this is the only way to unlink a user since they no longer have a Profile Page in Clever.

If you find that Clever IDM is managing a user in an unexpected manner, and you need help troubleshooting, please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326).

title: Troubleshooting: Issues with Shared Devices
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002315868#h_8a075af5-5de1-4277-8089-a13dfe9406e6)  
2. [Best practices for logging out of Clever and connected apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002315868#h_743a0d14-b4b4-466a-b9fb-531d369fb404)  
3. [Logging out of Clever on any device](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002315868#h_3c29aef2-3960-463d-a98b-7cd5461b8246)  
4. [Logging out of Clever and applications on iOS](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002315868#h_d87301f5-1524-4dc4-9cca-62b3f155a381)  
5. [Shared devices notifications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002315868#h_ff3cbf31-d88c-4bf4-a386-c8d116b522bc)  
6. [Time-out and inactivity](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002315868#h_e13b5e70-6314-4f8e-9ce4-e96b298c3fd1)

  

## Overview

When logging out, it's important to remember that single sign-on (SSO) can actually be broken down to up to 3 (three) separate login processes behind the scenes:  
 

1.  Identity provider login (e.g. Google)
2.  Clever login
3.  Application login (e.g. Khan Academy)

  
If a student is accessing a shared device, we recommend that they log out of each application and device after their session. Therefore users should log out of the application, the Clever portal, and the identity provider (Google, ADFS, etc.) per the steps below:  
 

## Best practices for logging out of Clever and connected apps

To ensure that a user's user session is ended before logging another user in, please follow these steps:  
  
**Step 1: Log the user out of any learning applications**

  
**Step 2: Log the user out of Clever**  
 

-   From the Clever Portal, click on the user's name in top right corner, select **Log out**

  
**Step 3: [Log out of Google](https://mail.google.com/mail/logout?hl=en) (if applicable) or the district's Identity Provider**

  
**Step 4: Log in to Clever as new user**  
 

-   Navigate to [https://clever.com/login](https://clever.com/login) and search for the new user's school. Once the school is located, they will log in with their Badge or credentials. They should now be successfully logged in to their account!

##   
Logging out of Clever on any device

Users can log out of the Clever portal by navigating to the top right corner of their portal (where they can find their name), and then selecting 'Log Out':  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmHN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BIrg)   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmHN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If your school organization is using Google as your identity provider (IdP), you can apply a setting from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) page that will automatically log users out of Google when they log out of Clever. This is helpful in situations where multiple users are logging into Clever on a shared device.  For more information, [see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503).

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmHN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BIrv)

## Logging out of Clever and applications on iOS

On an iOS device, double-click the home button (on newer iPad Pros, swipe up from the bottom of the display) to expose the application thumbnails. Swipe up on the Clever app and any learning apps that were launched. This will end a user's session when the device is shared.   
 

## Shared devices notifications

On certain devices, upon initial sign in to Clever, users will be asked whether or not they should be remembered on the device. If they select **No, only I use it**, then their Clever session will remain intact for 2 hours.   
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmHN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BIs5)

  
If the user selects **Yes,** Clever will treat the device as a shared device. In this case, users will be prompted with an option to sign in as a different user after 10 minutes of inactivity on the Clever portal.  
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** This feature gives users who share devices the option to log in to another account, in case logout best practices weren't followed.

  

## Time-out and inactivity

## Logging out

Users are logged out of Clever automatically if:   
 

-   If a user is inactive in Clever for 24 hours, they will automatically be logged out. Currently, there is no way to customize this behavior.  
     
-   The browser is _quit (e.g. "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._  
    Closing the browser window will not log the user out of Clever.   
     

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmHN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ELj)

 If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Troubleshooting: Canvas Login Issues
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333128#h_22c136c4-8d29-47d0-9453-722acaeb0612)  
2\. [Common errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333128#h_ba34aa51-62e8-47de-a300-c2b919b9f840)

##   
Overview

This guide is meant for district admins to troubleshoot issues their users are experiencing while attempting to access Clever with their Canvas credentials.  
  
If you're just getting started with Canvas and Clever, please take a look at the article on [Setting up single sign-on (SSO) with Canvas](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206629117). To identify issues in your single sign-on (SSO) setup, view your [Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Troubleshoot login](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-login) tool.

When a user selects **Log in with Canvas**, Clever will send the user to Canvas where they will enter their username and password. Clever never sees these credentials, but Canvas will redirect the user back to Clever with a token confirming the user logged in successfully.  
  
If it's the user's first time logging into Clever with Canvas, they may have to also approve Clever as an app they want to use. Clever will then match the Canvas user with a user in Clever, and log them into their app.

* * *

## Common errors

Here are the common errors that we identify, and how to resolve them:

-   **We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email or username.**

-   The unique identifier passed to us from Canvas doesn’t match any user in Clever. Most commonly, this is a user who isn’t yet synced to Clever. Alternatively, a field we match on (e.g. student number or email address) is missing in the SIS upload for the user in question. Please review your [Access logs](https://schools.clever.com/access-logs) to see which user matches we tried to make and then verify the correct information in your SIS and within Clever.

-   **We couldn’t log you in. Additional permissions are required.**

-   When a user logs in to Clever for the first time using Canvas, they are asked to give permission. If they deny permission, we don't get a valid code by which to authorize the user into Clever. Ask the user to try again, this time accepting the permissions to use Clever.
-   If the user is receiving an error message when logging in, try logging into your Canvas administrator dashboard and enabling “Clever Instant Login” under Developer Keys > Inherited.

-   **We couldn't log you in.**

-   This may indicate Canvas had an issue while we were attempting to log the user in. This can indicate that Canvas had a temporary network glitch or that there is a bug. If you are seeing this error occur frequently, please reach out as soon as possible to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) so we can help you troubleshoot.

-   **We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the email or username**

-   Please check your data in Clever to ensure that each user has a unique username for Canvas logins.

 If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We're happy to help!

title: Troubleshooting: Expired LDAP SSL Certificates
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037825791#header1)  
2\. [Expired SSL certificates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037825791#header2)  
3\. [Downloading new certificate fingerprints](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037825791#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037825791#header4)

## Overview

Clever will alert you ahead of when your LDAP SSL certificate is approaching expiration. A current SSL certificate is necessary to support [LDAPS login methods](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387) and [account recovery that relies on LDAPS](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025854292). The Clever Admin owner of the account will receive an email notification 2 weeks ahead of expiration and there will be an alert visible on the [SSO settings page](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) in the Clever Dashboard. You must [update your certificate](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037825791?language=en_US#header3) to ensure continued access to Clever using your LDAPS login method.  
 

* * *

## Expired SSL certificates

According to standard requirements, SSL certificates may have a lifespan of **at most 2-3 years.** As such, you may see examples of the following LDAP login error when your certificate expires.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmE9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EKf)

  

* * *

## Downloading new certificate fingerprints

To download the new SHA-1 fingerprint for your SSL certificate, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Login method tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) and click **Edit Settings** in the **LDAP Authentication** box.   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmE9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EKp)

  
If your LDAP server is connected to the Clever account via the LDAP URL, you should be able to click **Download From Server** to get an SHA-1 fingerprint for the latest SSL certificate on the server.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmE9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EKu)  
 

Click **Test Connection**. If you see the message below, then it worked and you can now test a login. If you do not see this message or if your users are still having trouble logging in, please contact Clever support to troubleshoot. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmE9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EKz) 

Be sure to exit and save your new settings!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmE9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EL4)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

  
**Will I be alerted if my LDAP Certificate has expired?**

-   The Clever Admin account owner, which can be seen on the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page, will receive an email from [no-reply@clever.com](mailto:no-reply@clever.com) with the subject: _There are issues with your LDAPS Certificate_, informing them that we have detected issues with your current LDAPS certificate. If your LDAPS certificate is managed by another member of your team, we recommend setting up an automatic forward based on the subject to the right member of your team.

title: Troubleshooting: ADFS, Office365, and SAML Login Issues
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/209026697#h_fa79bc56-3d0a-4fb9-94ad-d056faeae062)  
2. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/209026697#h_ab6fd265-ad74-486b-beb3-d8549065cf65)

## Overview

This guide is meant for people familiar with SAML and Active Directory who are trying to troubleshoot issues their users are seeing while using single sign-on (SSO). If you're just getting started with ADFS and Clever, we suggest accessing the article on [Setting up single sign-on (SSO) with ADFS](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576). To identify issues in your single sign-on (SSO) setup, view your [Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Troubleshoot login](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-login) tool.

##   
Troubleshooting

Normally, when a user selects 'Login with ADFS', Clever will send the user out to your AD or another SAML server where they will enter their username and password. Clever never sees this username and password, but your server will redirect the user back to Clever with a token confirming the user logged in successfully. Clever will then "match" the user in your AD or another SAML system with a user in Clever, and log them into their app.  
 

Occasionally errors do occur. Here are the common errors that we identify, and how to resolve them:  
 

-   **The ID used during login doesn't match any user in Clever** or **LDAP data provided during login doesn't match any user in Clever** 
    -   The unique identifier passed to Clever by the SAML server did not match any user in Clever. In essence, a user (let's call her "Susan") was successfully able to prove who she was to the district's identity provider (IdP), but when the IdP spoke to Clever and said, "Hey, can you log Susan in for me?", Clever responded, "Sorry, we don't have a Susan here." The most common cause of this is a user trying to log in that is not yet synced to Clever, but it could also be that the field we match on, say student number or email address, is missing in the SIS upload for the user in question. We show the matches we tried to make in your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Access logs](https://schools.clever.com/access-logs), so please check there first and then look up the corresponding information in your student information system (SIS) or Clever [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) to see if you can determine the issue.  

-   **No matching account found. The SAML server did not provide any login attributes**
-   **We did not receive any LDAP data that we could use to match a Clever user**
-   **We were unable to find an LDAP user for the user who logged in**  
    -   This is similar to when a user can’t be matched (explained above), however these errors mean that we didn't get any value that we could match on. For instance, say you are matching on email. If your server sent us "[sue.smith@espid.edu](mailto:sue.smith@espid.edu)" and we couldn't find that user, Clever would return an ID error. If your server didn't send us any attributes at all, or if Sue didn't have an email on the SAML server_,_ then we didn't receive any data to match on. Check in the SAML server to see that the impacted user has all the right attributes, and also take a look at your [claims rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617) to make sure all your claims rules are set up and mapped to valid attributes on your server. 

-   **Configuration issue. The 'Name ID' attribute is not set in the claim rules.**
    -   A somewhat misleading error message, but easy to solve. While technically correct, what this error really means is that you should check your claims rules and ensure that the "Name ID" attribute is set, as indicated in the [Help Center docs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576).  

-   **The SAML response didn't include an encrypted assertion**
    -   This error indicates there is something wrong with how Clever and your SAML server talk securely. This may be an issue with the certificate on your server. We recommend verifying your SSL certification installation using [this tool](https://www.sslshopper.com/ssl-checker.html).  
    -   If using Office365 or another SAML connection, under **SSO Settings > Login Method > Active Directory Authentication > Edit Settings,** please try checking the box to **Allow unencrypted SAML assertions (recommended with Entra ID)** and test another login. 

-   **SAML certificate doesn't match. Update the SAML certificate in Clever to match the one used by your SAML server**
-   **Your LDAP server used an SSL certificate we did not recognize.**
    -   This error indicates the certificate stored in Clever does not match. We recommend uploading a new metadata.xml file in your [SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings).
    -   To resolve these errors automatically in the future, you can use a metadata URL rather than a manually uploaded file.

-   **No success code received from your SAML server**
    -   A fairly rare error, this indicates that the status code we received back from your AD or SAML server wasn't a **success** status code. Often this is a rate-limiting issue, but it can also indicate your server is misconfigured, the network is down, or another server bug. We recommend checking that your AD or SAML server is operational and responding to authentication requests.  

-   **Unknown error. Please contact Clever Support with the error reference ID for assistance.** 
    -   This is an error with unknown origin. Please reach out to Clever Support.  
          
        

-   **LDAP data provided during login matches to multiple users in Clever**
-   **Multiple accounts are linked to the LDAP data we received**
-   **SAML attributes received matches to multiple users in Clever** 
    -   Please check your data in Clever to ensure that each user has a unique username for LDAP or SAML logins.

title: Troubleshooting: Google login issues
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333098#one) 2\. [Troubleshooting checklist](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333098#two) 3\. [Google Login Flow](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333098#three) 4\. [Troubleshoot login tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333098#four) 5\. [Common errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333098#five) ## Overview This guide is for district admins familiar with Google SSO through Clever. Use this information to troubleshoot login issues. If you're just getting started with Google and Clever, take a look at the article on [Single Sign on (SSO) with Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503).   * * * ## Troubleshooting checklist
Does the user have an active Clever account?
Is the email field populated in Clever for the user?
Is the email address in Clever correct? (up-to-date and no typos)
Are there any other users in Clever with the same email address? Their email address must be unique.
Is the user entering the correct email address? i.e. their school-provided email address, not their personal email address
* * * ## Google login flow When a user clicks **Log in with Google** from your district's [Clever login Portal URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503), Clever sends the user to Google where they'll enter their district-provided Google email address and password. Clever doesn't have access to Google passwords for users; however, once the user has entered their credentials, Google will redirect the user back to Clever providing a "token" that tells Clever this user has successfully logged in.  If it's the users first time logging into Clever via Google, the user may be prompted to approve Clever as a Google SSO application.  Once the user is logged in, Clever shares the user's token with any associated applications they attempt to log into. This allows the user to access their Clever apps via single sign-on (SSO) through Clever without needing to enter their credentials again.  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6t7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** When a Clever admin accesses the Portal as a user, they are **not** actually logged into Clever via Google. * * * ## Troubleshoot login tool There are occasional login issues that come up with district users. The first step in investigating a user login issue is to use the [Troubleshoot login tool](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-login). * * * ## Common errors Here are the most common errors, and how to resolve them: - **The email used during login doesn't match any user in Clever**  - The unique identifier passed to us from Google didn’t match any user in Clever. In essence, a user (let's call her "Susan") was successfully able to prove who she was to Google, but when Google came to tell Clever "Hey, can you log Susan in for me?", we responded "Sorry, we don't have a Susan here". The most common cause of this is a user trying to log in that isn’t yet synced to Clever, but it could also be that the field we match on, say student number or email address, is missing in the SIS upload for the user in question. We show the matches we tried to make in your [Access logs](https://schools.clever.com/school/instant-login/event-logs), so check there and then look up the corresponding information in your SIS and/or Clever [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) to see what might be going on. - **A user didn't grant permission to use Clever** - When a user logs in to Clever for the first time using Google, they're asked to give permission. If they deny permission, we don't get a valid code to log them in with, and show this error. Ask the user to try again, and accept the permissions to use Clever. - **Google encountered an issue during login. If this happens frequently, contact Clever Support for help** - A fairly rare error, this indicates Google had an issue while we were attempting to log the user in. This can indicate that Google had a temporary network glitch, or that there is a bug. If you are seeing this error occur frequently, please reach out as soon as possible to Clever Support so we can work with Google and help you troubleshoot. - **The email used during login matches to multiple users in Clever.** - Multiple users in Clever have the same email address. For example, siblings Sarah Smith and Samantha Smith both have the email address [sarah.smith@example.com](mailto:sarah.smith@example.com). Samantha’s email address will need to be updated to the correct email in the data syncing to Clever. - **Google is not enabled as a login method for this user** - A user attempted to login using an identity provider (IdP) that is not configured for their user type. For example, a student tried to login using Google credentials when they should login with Clever Passwords. - **User signs into their Chromebook and clicks to log into Clever with Google, but the screen spins or bounces them back to the login page.** - This error typically occurs if Clever is blocked in the security settings on the user's device. We recommend confirming that Clever is not blocked in the user's content settings at chrome://settings/content.   If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Troubleshooting: Logging in to applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045852232#header1)  
2. [Application is missing from Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045852232#one)  
3. [User is not logged in after clicking on the application icon in the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045852232#two)   
4. [Using the Access Portal As feature to troubleshoot](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045852232#accessportal)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** To troubleshoot problems logging in to applications, we highly recommend using the [Troubleshoot Login tool](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-login). More information on this resource can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046240972). 

## Overview

This article explains how to troubleshoot common application issues in the Clever Portal. It outlines steps to resolve missing applications, login failures, and how to use the "Access Portal As" feature. You'll also learn how to gather error messages and escalate issues to Clever or the application's support team.

* * *

##   
Application is missing from the Clever Portal

If a user does not see an application in the Clever Portal, there are a few things you can check:   
 

1.  Does the application support SSO?

![An image of the application Khan Academy's overview page in a Clever Dashboard. Under the title 'Khan Academy', 'SSO, Rostering' is highlighted with a red rectangle.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Rnd1)

2.  Does the application support SSO for this user type?

![An image of the application Khan Academy's overview page in a Clever Dashboard. 'SSO Supported user types: Students, Teachers, Staff, District Admins' is highlighted with a red rectangle.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Rndk)

3.  Is the user successfully shared with the application? More information on constructing sharing rules can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US#h_83465b3f-3a12-48b1-b616-0b8b1786d8ad).

**If sharing by district:** confirm the user is active in Clever.  
**If sharing by school:** confirm the user is associated with the school or is associated with at least one _section_ at the shared school.  
**If sharing by rules:** confirm the user meets all criteria for at least one of the sharing rules. The most common criteria that result in users not being shared are not meeting the requirements for enrolled sections. Ensure that they are enrolled in a section that meets the grade level, subject, course, etc. that is being shared with the application. You can review the Clever profile for a user, including associated sections, by using the search feature, located at the top of your Clever Dashboard.    
 

4.  Is the user successfully shared with the application? Use the [Troubleshoot Sharing tool](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing) to confirm. More information on this resource can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001477?language=en_US).
5.  Check to make sure that the application hasn't been hidden from users by a Clever Admin. You can find [more information here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000311483).
6.  Check to make sure that the application has not placed any filters on your application. You can learn more about how to request a change to an app filter [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003323043?language=en_US#HowRequestChange).

![An image of an application's overview page in a Clever Dashboard with a highlight around Filters.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ewz6J)

  
  
 

* * *

##   
  
User is not logged in after clicking on the application icon in the Clever Portal 

If a user clicks on an app icon in their Clever Portal and receives an error from the **application's website** **page**, please contact the application's support team for assistance.   
 

![A screenshot of an application login error. There is an i-Ready application icon, and below this a message titled ‘Oops!’. The body of text below this reads: “ErrorCode: S602 - We could not locate you in the i-Ready system. Please contact your system administrator.’](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EH7)

If the user clicks on the app icon and receives an error that is a **Clever website**, please contact Clever's support team with the error message.

Please note: If the user has recently changed schools or classes, or was recently synced to Clever, please allow 24 hours for their connected applications to be updated so they can log in.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If you are seeing an error at a web URL that is **not** a Clever address, it will be necessary to contact the application to fix the issue. Please reach out to the application's support team to investigate further!

* * *

##   
Using the **Access Portal As** feature to troubleshoot

Using the **Access Portal As** feature in your Clever Dashboard is a great way to troubleshoot and support teachers, students, and Portal-only staff with their technical issues. 

Clever makes it easy for admins to access the Clever Portal as an individual user, allowing them to see precisely what they see. When troubleshooting, this can help diagnose an issue, retrieve an error code or message, or gain visibility into what might be confusing. If you encounter an error code within a user's application account, you can capture an image of it and share it directly with the application's team to learn more.  
  
You should only use the **Access Portal As** feature for viewing purposes, and you should never edit anything as another user. Please note that using the Access Portal As feature won’t inform you whether a user can log into their Clever account successfully. To troubleshoot Clever logins, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202113063).  
  
You can utilize the Access Portal As feature when on a user’s profile page by clicking on the Support Tools button in the upper right corner and selecting **Access Portal as** the user.  
  
![Screenshot of the Access Portal As feature in the drop-down menu on the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062S2Y)  
  
  
You will then be taken to a screen to **Start Portal session**, which will take you to the user's Portal.  
  
![Screenshot of Clever Dashboard showing where to start the Portal session](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000X5Cjt)   
  
For security purposes,  if you’re accessing an admin or staff Portal, they’ll be sent a notification email letting them know their Portal has been accessed.

Be sure to log out of the user's Portal once you are done by clicking **End Portal session** in the upper right corner.  
  
![Screenshot of a teacher's Portal page showing where you can end the Portal session](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UAtB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062S4Z)

title: Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot Login tool - error messages
text:
This article contains: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051319711#overview) 2. [Result Types](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051319711#h_01EPYM8YSH8NEPF5JSKBCJ8DGF) 3\. [District Issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051319711#h_01EPX43W3K4JX2G127NX821Q7Z) 4\. [Clever Issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051319711#h_01EPX44GW5WF81K5QWMKJKTJCQ) 5\. [App Issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051319711#h_01EPX44R6FFKY3S2FCW5FVBR4W) ## Overview This article describes the possible results and actions that may be identified by the [Troubleshoot Login tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046240972).   * * * ## Result Types

Result type

Description

 Success
The key criteria passed the system check.
 Information
The system check was unable to automatically detect the error. Please see the info message for additional details on how to proceed. 
 Warning
The system check has indicated this issue may have contributed to the login failure. These issues may need to be resolved to restore logins.
 Failure
The system check has indicated this issue is causing the login failure. These issues must be resolved to restore logins.
## District Issues The following issues are resolved at the school district level. If a School Tech Lead (STL) is using the Troubleshoot Login tool and the resolution message indicates the point of resolution is the district, they will see an **Email district admin** button that will provide a quick link to email the district tech support contact. If no tech support contact is listed, the contact button will not appear, pictured below: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aiDp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E8o) To update your district support contact, please follow the directions found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049312351).  

Result

Result type

Description

The user is not shared with the appMessage: "This user is not shared with [app]. You may need to adjust sharing rules, or update the data syncing to Clever to make sure that the user is covered by an existing sharing rule."

Additional info: Options to fix users that aren't shared:

  • Update the user's information in your SIS to ensure they meet the sharing permissions set for the application or
  • Update the sharing permissions to share the user. See these articles on sharing permissions. 
The user is not shared with the library appMessage:

If the user is a teacher: "This user isn't shared with [app]. If they'd like to use [app], they can install it in the Clever Library."
Otherwise: "This user isn't shared with [app]. Teachers can install [app] in the Clever Library and share with this user."

Additional info: 
Library applications can only be added by teachers. Contact the teacher and request they add the application for their classroom using these directions.

The user is filtered out by app-side filtersMessage:

"This user is being filtered out by the application. Please refer to [app page link] to see what types of filters are in place. If you believe the filter has been placed incorrectly, please reach out to the application. If you would like help understanding the filter, please reach out to Clever support."

Additional info: 
To update or remove the filter, contact the applications' support team. Information on app-side filters can be found here. 

The user has data quality errorsMessage:

"This user was flagged by an app-specific data error. Data errors must be resolved for users to be successfully processed by the application. To resolve this error, you will need to update the data syncing to Clever. For more information about this error, please navigate to Data Quality."

Additional info: 
Application data errors must be resolved in order for login access to be restored. Update the data in your SIS and resync with Clever. 

The user has not logged in to Clever in the last 7 days

Message:
"This user has not logged in to Clever in the last 7 days. We recommend confirming that the user is logging in at the correct URL: {portal URL}.
If the user sees an error when they try to log in, you can copy the reference ID and look it up in the Login Logs."

Additional info: 
Often, users report that they're unable to log in to an application because they are actually attempting to log in to the resource directly instead of through Clever. We recommend testing the login to the application using the Access Portal as user feature to confirm the login is successful. Once confirmed, provide directions on how to log in to Clever to access the application. 

 
The user has data quality warningsMessage:

"This user was flagged by an app-specific data warning. This means that the user has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular data warning."

Additional info:
Data quality warnings usually don't prevent logins to applications. However, it is best practice to resolve warnings when possible. If you're unable to resolve the error, contact the app to see if they require the warning to be resolved in order to successfully log in. 

The district has not added the app Message:

"Your district has not added this app. You can request the app from the Request Applications page of your dashboard."

Additional info:
Applications can be added by navigating to Applications > Add Applications

The district hasn’t launched this app yet

Message:
"Hang tight! The application is preparing your district for launch. Users will not be able to access the application until the launch date: {launch date}. If you need to expedite the setup process, please reach out to the application directly."

Additional info: 
SSO to applications is only available to launched applications. Applications can adjust the launch date for you using these directions. 

The app hasn’t approved the district’s request

Message:
"We are waiting on the application's team to accept your request and proceed with the implementation. If you need to expedite the request process, please reach out to the application directly."

Additional info: 
SSO to applications is only available once an application has accepted your school district's request and has launched. If you need to expedite the request process, please reach out to the application provider directly, as Clever does not have insight into their acceptance process.

The district has deleted the app from their dashboard

Message:
"Your district has removed this app. If you'd like to add this app again, you can request it from the Request Applications page of your dashboard. If you do, please note that your user accounts will likely not be restored automatically. Additional setup will likely be required to match users to their historical data."

Additional info: 
SSO is not available if an app has been removed. Please follow the message's directions to restore access. 

The district has disabled SSO into the app for [user type] until [end date]

Message:
"Your district has disabled SSO into this app for [user type] until [end date]. You can change this setting here [link to app settings in the dashboard]."

Additional info:
SSO can be disabled for specific apps. This feature is commonly used prior to the beginning of a school year. See here to re-enable SSO.

The district has hidden the app from the [user type] portal until [end date] Message:

"Your district has hidden this app from the [user type] portal until [end date]. You can unhide this app by changing the icon visibility settings in the portal. [link to help center article]"

Additional info:
Apps can be hidden from specific users in the Clever Portal. See here to unhide an icon.

The app does not support SSO

Message:
"This application is for rostering only and does not support SSO for users through Clever. Try adding or requesting an SSO (Saved Passwords) application for this resource!"

Additional info:
Clever can only support SSO for applications that have built an SSO integration. Clever can build an SSO (Saved Passwords) integration if the app doesn't have one. To request an SSO (Saved Passwords) application, follow the directions found here. Learn more about application types here.

The app does not support SSO for [user type]

Message:
"This application does not support SSO for [user type] users through Clever. Try adding or requesting an SSO (Saved Passwords) application for this resource!"

Additional info: 
Some applications support SSO for specific user types. Locate the supported user types at the top of the applications' overview page.

The user does not have an email address

Message:
"This user does not have an email address in Clever. This may be affecting the user's ability to access Clever. Please check to see if the email address for this user is correctly populated in the SIS or the manually uploaded emails file."

Additional info: 
A missing email address may prevent a user from logging in to Clever or an application. Please confirm their email address is populated in your SIS and resync with Clever. If your district manually uploads emails, please update your manual email file and upload using the directions found here.

"The user's email address is duplicated
Other users with the same email: xxxxxx"

Message:
"This user's email address matches with the email address of another user. This may be affecting the user's ability to access Clever. You may need to remove the duplicate email."

Additional info: 
If a user's email address matches another user in Clever, this may prevent them from being able to log in to Clever or an application. Please confirm that their email address is correct and unique in your SIS and resync with Cle

## Clever Issues

Result

Result type

Description

This is likely an issue with a Saved Passwords application  Message:

"It looks like something's not working! Please try the troubleshooting steps in this article. If it's still not working, please reach out to Clever support."

Additional Info: 
Our system has detected there's an issue with the SSO (Saved Passwords) application. Click Contact Clever support to notify our team.

## App Issues

Result

Result type

Description

 This is likely an app issue  Message:

"We weren't able to identify any issues on Clever's end! We've confirmed that the user is shared with [app], and there are no associated data errors. We recommend reaching out to the application's support team to resolve this issue."

Additional info: 
This means we'll need the assistance of the application's support team as the error will likely need to be resolved in their system. Click the Contact Application button to message their team! 

If the application partner has not listed a support contact, the button will not appear.

title: Troubleshooting: Login Tools
text:
# Troubleshoot login issues and use backup login codes

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E3F)

This article contains the following:

1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046240972#overview)  
2\. [Using the troubleshoot login tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046240972#troubleshoot-login-tool)  
3\. [Backup login codes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046240972#backup-login-codes)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046240972#faqs)

## Overview

This article explains how to use Clever's troubleshoot login tool to diagnose and resolve login and access issues for students and teachers, along with how to use backup login codes as a temporary workaround.

* * *

## Using the troubleshoot login tool

The troubleshoot login tool is the perfect way to quickly identify the root cause of login errors and missing icons in Portal. You can find the tool in two places:

### From a student or teacher profile

1\. Go to **[Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Troubleshoot login](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-login)** if you're a clever admin, or find it on the Clever Dashboard home page if you're a school tech lead.

2\. You can also get to the tool from a student or teacher profile. From a user's profile, click **Support tools > Troubleshoot user login**.  
![Troubleshoot user login](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qZ3jR)

### From Support tools

1\. Go to **[Clever Dashboard > Support tools > Troubleshoot login](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-login)**.

2\. Select a user by their **Clever ID, Student Information System (SIS) ID, name, or email**, then select the **name of the app** they're having trouble accessing.  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E2g)

The tool will run a root cause analysis of the issue:

3\. Review the **Test summary**.  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E2l)

4\. Review the **Recommended Action**. This tells you _who_ needs to take action to resolve the issue — there are 3 possible options: school organization, app, or Clever.  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E2q)

5\. Review the **Issue Details** shown underneath the **Recommended Action**. This tells you how to fix any issues the tool flagged.

To make communication easier, use the **Copy issue description** button to quickly share this info with the school organization, app, or Clever.  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028E30)

The tool will also highlight related Help Center articles that can help you resolve the issues it detects.

Keep in mind — you might need to fix more than one issue to fully restore a user's login.

### Result types & error messages

For more on result types, error messages, and how to resolve issues, check out [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360051319711).

* * *

## Backup login codes

Backup codes are temporary codes that let students log in to Clever when their login credentials aren't working. You can generate these as many times a day as you need, so your student can keep logging in until the original login issue's resolved. **Backup codes expire after 15 minutes**, so make sure your student logs in before then — otherwise, you'll need to generate a new one.

### How to generate a backup code

1.  From your Clever Dashboard, search for the student you're helping.
2.  On the student's profile, click **Actions > Generate backup login code**.  
    ![Image with highlight around Generate backup login code from student's profile](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qZ2Lx)
3.  You'll get a seven-digit backup code. Write it down and share it securely with your student. Please note that it will expire in 15 minutes.  
    ![Backup login code for student](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qZ5Rt) 

### How does a student log in using a backup code?

1.  The student goes to your school organization's Clever Portal login page and selects **Get help**.
2.  They select **Use Backup Code**.  
    ![get help backup code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qZ2tp) ![use your backup code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qZ2vR)
3.  They enter the backup code, then select **Log in**.  
    ![type backup code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHIH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qZ2x3)

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Which apps show up in the troubleshoot login tool's app drop down?**

-   The app drop down only shows apps that have been added to your school organization's Clever account. If an app doesn't show up, it just hasn't been added yet.

**Will Library apps show up in the troubleshoot login tool?**

-   Yep! Apps teachers install through Library will show up in the troubleshoot login tool.

**Why can't I see the "Generate backup login code" option on a student's overview page?**

-   This tool's only available by default to clever admin account owners. Other admins will need the **Manage Login backup code** permission added to their role. For more on creating, managing, and deleting custom roles, [check out this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702).

* * *

## Related articles

-   [Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot Login tool - error messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360051319711)
-   [For Clever Admins: Managing custom admin roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Instant Login links
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205546348#overview)  
2. [How do Instant Login links work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205546348#how_it_works) ​​​​​​​  
3. [Finding an app's Instant Login Link](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205546348#finding_instant_login_links) ​​​​​​​

##   
Overview

Instant Login Links allow districts to embed application login URLs directly into their district's Single Sign-On portal, website, or Learning Management System (LMS). This allows district users to access Clever applications via your district portal using their Clever credentials. When district users click on an app's Instant Login Link, they are logged directly into the app via single sign-on (SSO) rather than into their Clever Portal.  
  
 

* * *

## How do Instant Login links work?
