-   When a user clicks on an app's Instant Login link from your district portal, they are redirected to your SSO Identity Provider (e.g. Google, Active Directory, etc.) to sign in. For additional information about Identity Providers (IDPs), visit: [Single Sign-On (SSO): Identity Provider (IdP) Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787).
-   Once the user is successfully authenticated, they will be logged in and taken to the application. They will not see their Clever Portal.

-   **Please note:** _If a user has already authenticated with your Identity Provider (IdP) and is currently logged in, they will skip the IdP login screen and be taken directly into the app._
-   _If there are multiple login methods available for accessing Clever, users may need to re-authenticate when using an instant login link._

* * *

##   
Finding an app's Instant Login Link

District admins can locate an app's Instant Login Link from the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page by clicking on the name of the application to open the app overview page. Then navigate to the app **Settings** tab to locate the link under **Application Information**. Copy the Instant Login Link to embed into your district portal, website, or LMS.

If you'd like to use the app icon in your district Portal, you can download the application icon image from this page as well.

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Thcf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BGyp)

  
Please note that Instant Login links are not available for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications and that each individual learning application determines which of the following user types they support:  
 

-   Students
-   Teachers
-   Staff
-   Clever District Admins

  
If a user type is _not_ listed under **SSO Supported User Types** in the app **Settings** tab, users of that type won't be able to access the application from your district portal via the Instant Login Link.

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Requesting SSO for applications that aren't yet on Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Requesting an application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001113446#one)  
2\. [What happens when single sign-on (SSO) becomes available for a Saved Password app?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001113446#two)

![Tip icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dzc)**Clever Tip:** _For a Saved Passwords app that already exists in Clever see:_ [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Overview & Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488)

## Requesting an application

Don't see an application you would like to use? No problem! Clever can securely build a connection for almost any application. To add a new application, click **Request app name** below the search results:

![Request app name link shown below the application search results](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003C0QQ)

To help Clever get the application ready for your school organization, submit the Login Page URL, as well as a working username and password for testing purposes:

![Form fields for Login Page URL, username, and password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drZ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003C0QL)

We'll email you once the application is ready for your school organization so you can continue with the next steps.

## What happens when single sign-on (SSO) becomes available for a Saved Password app?

Once single sign-on (SSO) becomes available for a Saved Password application, the app will be updated on the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page. If your school organization is already connected to a Saved Password app you will be able to continue to use it. The Clever team will work with you to switch over to the higher-quality single sign-on (SSO) application.

### Get started with these helpful resources:

-   [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Testing and Piloting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001921227)
-   [SSO (Saved Passwords): Converting external link apps to Saved Passwords apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002016328)

title: For Clever Admins: Navigating the new login experience
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#header1)  
2\. [Timeline](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#header2)  
3\. [What to expect](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#header3)  
4\. [Why Clever updated the login experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#header4)  
5\. [Email templates for communication with your schools about the new login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#header6)

## Overview

We know how important smooth logins are for your users. Clever’s new login experience simplifies logging in to minimize challenges and get to learning quickly. This article explains what’s changing, when changes will roll out, and how to prepare and communicate with users who may be impacted.

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** All updates listed in this article do not apply to all schools. Please review the notes listed in each phase to determine which users or schools will be impacted. 

   
 

* * *

## Timeline

Clever’s login experience will be rolled out in six phases between February 3rd and June 2026. This timeline is a rough estimate of when updates will occur, and some dates may shift as we continue to refine the experience. Districts can also choose to opt in to more frequent communications about ongoing login changes [here](https://www.clever.com/product-updates-subscription). Learn more about what these changes will look like below.

![Timeline displaying the different phases listed under what to expect](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000lLyCb)    
 

* * *

## What to expect

### **Two panel view** (Released)

![Two panel login screen with Google and Badge login options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aLcbp)

_This is an example school configuration with Google and Badges, but each school’s screen will vary based on your login methods._

![Two panel login screen with Microsoft and Badge login options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aVNWg)

_This is an example school configuration with Microsoft and Badges, but each school’s screen will vary based on your login methods._

Impacted users: All Clever users 

Clever’s login page is getting a refreshed look with two panels and new photography, while keeping the same familiar login flow. These updates are designed to make logging in easier, more secure, and more intuitive for all users.

### **New District login flow** (Released)

**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aLdo1)**

                     **![New login flow for districts on tablets](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aLdzJ)                    ![New login flow for districts on mobile devices](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aLeH3)**

Impacted users: Users who do not log in with a custom portal URL and instead go to clever.com/login 

Users who log into Clever without a district portal URL will see a new, student-friendly login page.

-   Badge users will no longer need to search for their school. They can simply click the Badge icon to log in faster.  
      
    
-   All other users will click the Password icon, then select their school, and follow the preferred login process from there.  
      
    

This update helps students and staff get where they need to go more quickly, with fewer steps.

### **Login and Help pages** (Released)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000dqKvR)

![Login screen with Microsoft and Badge login options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000doN32)

![Login screen with Microsoft](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000dodu9)

![Help page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000dprdM)

## ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000do82N)                    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000doNiw) 

Impacted users: All Clever users

All users will see a new district/school login screen with the district’s pre-configured login options. Users will also be able to see their [district’s default custom icon](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568?language=en_US#customicons) if one has been uploaded. If an icon has not been uploaded, users can expect to see a pre-populated icon. 

If users need help with logging in, they will no longer see the **_Having trouble?_** prompt on their login screen. Now, users will click **Get help** to be taken to their new Help page where users can find everything they need on one screen.  

Login hints for usernames and passwords will no longer be supported. If you need another way to support users during login, you can customize your login button labels. Learn how to customize them [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#hints). If you use SAML authentication and want your login button to show your Identity Provider instead of **Account**, you can learn how to update it [here.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012942731#SAML)

###   
**New Badge flow**

**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aKv3r)**

**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aLhgL)**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000im7ST)

Impacted users: Clever Badge users

Badge users will begin to see and hear a new success animation when they log in with a Clever Badge. If a login attempt is unsuccessful, users will see a clear error message explaining what went wrong.

### **Clever Passwords flow**

 **![Highlight around Clever Passwords login option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kVWXO)**

![Screenshot of home screen with username box.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000k4D0z)

![Screenshot of login page with password box.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000k4DQn)

Impacted users: Clever Passwords users

Clever Passwords users will first enter their username. Once verified, they will be asked to enter their password. If there's a typo or the account doesn't exist, the user is notified right away, so they don't have to enter a password to find out. This change makes the login experience clearer and easier for users and aligns with industry standards. 

### **Admin login flow**

![screenshot of new admin screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000lLufF)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000lLv3R)

Impacted users: Clever Admins

The Clever Admin login page is getting a refreshed look to help simplify logins.  
 

* * *

## Why Clever updated the login experience

Our goal with the new modernized login experience is all about getting learners, especially your youngest ones, to learning faster while reducing login-related help desk tickets that jam up your cues. 

The login is the secure gateway to learning where trust is verified. We want every login experience, regardless of which user type or how old the user is, to feel as seamless as using the rest of Clever is. But over the years, we’ve received a lot of feedback around how our diverse community accesses Clever and the challenges they face. That’s why we’re doing this overhaul of the login. It started in 2025 with improvements we made to error messages so students and staff can better understand what the issue is and address it quickly. We also added multi-role logins making it easy to toggle between your teacher and staff accounts without having to log out and back in. 

The changes you’ll see in 2026 are a continuation of this effort. We’ve examined every step of the login flow, worked through every common login challenge, and of course, rigorously tested our changes with all types of end users so we know it works. The changes you will see over the first half of 2026 will result in a modern, seamless, and secure login experience that prioritizes your students and helps them focus on learning above all else.  
 

* * *

## Email templates for communication with your schools about the new login page

**Click here for an email template to inform teachers of the two-panel view update**

Subject:  Important Update about change to Clever login look 

Hi everyone,

I'm writing to let you know that **starting on February 3rd**, the Clever login page is getting a fresh now look. The background picture is being updated to a new image that will only take up the left side panel (see example image below). There will be a few more small visual changes to the Clever login over the following months too. 

**Here is the important part:** This is a **visual update only**. The login process itself is **not** changing.

-   **Clever Badges** still work exactly the same way.
    
-   **Passwords/Google/SSO** logins still work exactly the same way.
    
-   **You do not need to do anything** to prepare.
    

**Why the change?** Clever is redesigning the login screen to be more focused and faster, making it easier for our younger students to find their login path and get to learning quickly.

**What to expect:** Because the screen looks different, students might ask if they are in the right place. Please assure them that **this is the official, secure Clever login page.**

Here is a preview of what this initial new login screen looks like so you can recognize it:

  
  

 ![New login page with two-panel view](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aLYuo)  

If you run into any issues, please reach out to our help desk as usual.

Best,

\[District Administrator Name\]

**Click here for an email template to inform teachers of the new district login page and the removal of login hints**

Subject:  Important Update about change to Clever login look 

Hi everyone,

I’m writing to let you know that **starting on April XXth** \[expected in late April but Clever will share the exact date\], the Clever login page is getting another small visual update. The sign-in buttons you normally see will be much bigger and bolder, but the sign-in options you use to log in on a regular basis will not change. 

**Here is the important part:** This is a **visual update only**. The login process itself is **not** changing.

-   **Clever Badges** still work exactly the same way.
    
-   **Passwords/Google/Microsoft SSO** logins still work exactly the same way.
    
-   **You do not need to do anything** to prepare.
    

**Why the change?** Clever is redesigning the login screen to be more focused and faster, making it easier for our younger students to find their login path and get to learning quickly.

**What to expect:** Because the screen looks different, students might ask if they are in the right place. Please assure them that **this is the official, secure Clever login page.**

Here is a preview of what the new login screen looks like, so you can recognize it: \[choose the image that most closely matches your own school organization's login methods\] 

 ![New login page with new Get help button. Login options are Badge, Google, and Clever Password.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000eY7JN)    

![New login screen with Get help button on iPad](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000eY7zJ)

![New login page with new Get help button. Login options are Badge, Google, and Clever Password.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000eY2y2)

If you run into any issues, please reach out to our help desk as usual.

Best,

\[District Administrator Name\]

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Why can’t schools opt out of this visual design?**

-   Even though Clever has allowed schools in the past to opt in/out of certain visual changes for a period of time, the nature of these login visual changes don’t allow us to do that. The initial login screens aren’t tied to a specific district/school org instance and so the experience will be universal. 
    
-   Even though schools can’t opt out, we’re confident that the changes are relatively minor and won’t provide major disruption to learners. We’ve validated each of the new screens via rigorous user testing with students and adults. 
    

**Why release in phases rather than all at once?** 

-   Adopting a phased roll out helps us prevent large-scale bugs by actively testing each release as it goes out. 
    
-   For example, if we released all at once over the summer and we have a mix of old and new code in the login code base, it could result in bugs during Back to School. We want to make sure users get in the first time, every time - so we need to release this universally.
    

**Will any core login functionality be changing?**

-   No, the login redesign is mostly a new visual treatment for each of the login screens in today’s flow. Students and teachers will login the same exact way they did before. 
    
-   The only “change” will be for admins as we give you a more direct route to access Clever. Your admin login screen will now have SSO/3rd Party IdP sign in options so you can quickly and easily navigate to Clever. 
    

**What should districts/school organizations do if they notice a suspected bug?** 

-   They should write into Clever support and let our support team know. They will work with our engineering team to resolve the bug as fast as possible. 
    

**How can districts best stay informed of the ongoing changes?**

-   Districts can choose to [opt in](https://www.clever.com/product-updates-subscription) to more frequent communications about ongoing login visual changes throughout the first half of the year. Otherwise, admins can reference back to this article and the [product releases page](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/release-notes?language=en_US) to see which updates have recently been rolled out. 
    

**How can students and teachers see the new changes?**

-   Students and teachers can reference the following articles to see the latest update to their login page. 
    
    -   [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging into Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307?language=en_US)
        
    -   [For Teachers: Logging into Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648?language=en_US)
        

  
 

**What can I use as an alternative to login hints?** 

1.  You can customize the text on login buttons to better support your students and teachers during sign-in. Follow the steps below.
    
    1.  Navigate to Authentication > SSO settings > [Customize](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/customize).
    2.  Click the pencil icon to edit the text.  
          
        ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000eLCAP)
    3.  Type a hint for students and teachers.  
          
        ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000eNLxZ)
    4.  Click **Save**.

**How do I change the Account button to show my Identity Provider (IdP) name?**

1.  If you’ve set up SAML authentication for your school organization, you can update the login button label from your Clever Dashboard using the steps below:
    

1.  1.  Go to Authentication > SSO Settings > [Login Method](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings)
    2.  Under your SAML Authentication, click **Edit Settings**
    3.  In **Step 3: Select your Identity Provider**, choose your IdP from the dropdown  
        ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hIpEb) 
    4.  Click **Save**

* * *

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Testing User Logins
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012704892#Overview)  
2\. [Testing SSO logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012704892#TestingSSOLogins)  
3\. [Tips and Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360012704892#TipsTroubleshooting)

##   
Overview

You’re almost ready to roll out Clever single sign-on (SSO) at your school organization saving students and teachers hours of class time each week! Before you do, you will want to run one last test to make sure your setup is working properly. This step should only take a few minutes to complete.

* * *

## Testing SSO logins

-   First, make sure you have the Clever login credentials for a few students and teachers.
-   Then, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page to copy your school organization's unique Clever login Portal URL. For instructions on customizing your Portal URL, visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838).
-   Open an incognito browser window (e.g. [Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95464?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en), [Firefox](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/private-browsing-use-firefox-without-history#w_how-do-i-open-a-new-private-window) & [Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4026200/microsoft-edge-browse-inprivate)).
-   Paste your school organization's Portal URL in the address bar and hit enter. This will lead you to your school organization's unique Clever login page.
-   Attempt to log in as various users to see if you are successful.

* * *

## Tips and Troubleshooting

-   If you can't use an incognito window, a regular browser window is fine. You will just need to make sure you’re logged out of Clever, and any other Identity Providers (e.g. Google, Active Directory), before attempting to log in as another user. Otherwise, you will continue to be logged in to your account rather than the one you are testing.
-   If you don’t have access to student or teacher login credentials, have a small group of teachers test their own logins to see if they are successful. You can share the [login instructions](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings) with them that are downloadable from your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page.
-   Utilize your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Access logs](https://schools.clever.com/access-logs) to make sure logins are successful, and find information about any errors you’re seeing. You can search for specific users and see more details on what caused the issue. For more about Access logs, visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202113063).

![Screenshot of an access log entry's details, showing login troubleshooting information](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dser&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aq9Z)

Once you’ve tested Clever SSO, and have confirmed successful logins, make sure to let your school organization users know they can log in! Track the success of your user logins and Portal usage from your [Clever Dashboard > Analytics > Portal analytics](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/sso-usage) page.

  
If you continue to have issues, please visit [these helpful troubleshooting articles](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/sections/201466977)!

![Clever "C" Logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dser&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dxv)  If your tests have been successful, see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360012942731) for details on launching Clever at your school organization!

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Troubleshooting
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/224420247#overview) 2. [Troubleshooting Clever Badge Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/224420247#troubleshooting) 3\. [Context on required and recommended settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/224420247#h_01EJ7HVRGW14QBH19B9F65V6F3) 4\. [Common Chromebook errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/224420247#chromeerrors) 5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/224420247#FAQ) ## Overview This article has troubleshooting tips for common Chromebook setup issues and provides Clever Admins with a brief overview of how Clever can be used to simplify Google Chromebook logins for your end users. There are two methods for using Clever with Google Chromebooks:    **1) Users use Clever Badges to log into Chromebooks, then access Clever.**   - Students open their Chromebooks and scan their Clever Badge. - This automatically logs the students into their Chromebooks and Clever Portals (they do not need to log in again). - Students can click on any learning application to begin their learning session. ## **2) Users log into Chromebooks manually, using credentials, and then access Clever.** - Students open Chromebooks and log in with their school-provided Google login credentials. - After logging in, the school organization’s Clever Portal is automatically opened for them (i.e., students do not need to log in again).   - Students can click on any application icon to begin their learning session. Depending on your preferences, each method can be configured separately for different Organizational Units (OUs) in your Google Admin Console. For either of the login flows above, Clever can be configured as either an organization-wide identity provider (IdP) for Google or an SSO Profile. Clever does recommend using the SSO Profile setup. For instructions on setting up Clever as an SSO Profile in Google, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001645).  For instructions on setting up Clever as an organization-wide IdP, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541). * * * ## Troubleshooting Clever Badge setup Below are some troubleshooting tips we put together in case you see unexpected issues logging into Chromebooks with Clever Badges.   ### **Test Chromebook logins with Clever Badges** 1. Create a test Organizational Unit (OU) and apply the Clever Badges settings to the OU. 2. Choose a student to test and generate a Clever Badge for them. Note, this must be a real student unless you have a test user with a Google account syncing with Clever. 3. Move that student to the test OU. 4. Move the Chromebook you’re using to the test OU. 5. Log in to the Chromebook using the student’s Clever Badge. ### **Check your setup** - _**Require a change of password on the next sign-in**_ Users are unable to log in using SSO when the **reset password on first login** functionality in the Admin Console is active. Make sure you're not using this functionality for any users accessing Google using SSO, including a Clever Badge login to a Chromebook. This is a limitation of Google SSO Using 3rd-Party IdPs. For more details on this topic, see this [Google support article](https://support.google.com/a/answer/60224?hl=en). - _Generate Clever Badges._ Make sure you’ve generated Clever Badges for your users. You can find instructions for generating Clever Badges **[here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907?language=en_US)**. ### ****Troubleshooting tips****   **_If Chromebooks do not prompt users to log in with Clever Badges:_** - Check the OU settings for your devices. The Chromebooks you want to set up to use Clever Badge logins should be in an OU with the Clever Badges settings applied. - Check your device settings. Kiosk mode and public sessions should be turned off for the Chromebooks you want to use with Clever Badges. - Check your version of Chrome. You should be using Chrome OS version M52 or later. **_If an error message appears after the Clever Badge is scanned:_** - Check the Chromebook OU settings for your students. Students who log in with Clever Badges should be in an OU with the Clever Badges settings applied. If students are not in the correct OU, their badges cannot authenticate into Chromebooks. - Validate the Clever Badge is working. Test the Clever Badge by using it to log in at [https://clever.com/in/badges](https://clever.com/in/badges). If that login isn’t working, the badge is likely invalidated. You may have to generate a new Clever Badge for the student. - Check your Clever sync for Google email addresses. Students using Clever Badges to log into Chromebooks should have Google email addresses synced to your Clever account. Clever uses this information to match users with their Google accounts. You can always check your synced data via the [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser#%7B%22sidebar%22:%22schools%22%7D). - Confirm if Google is allowed in your network filters, including http://accounts.google.com/signup/oauth. * * * ## Context on required and recommended settings Some school organizations have asked us why certain settings are required when setting up Clever Badges, and if there’s any flexibility in what’s required or recommended. This section provides context on why settings are required, and any flexibility. **Setup single sign-on**  - All of these settings are **required** in order to set up SSO. **Chrome User Settings** - Lock screen and idle settings are **required** to avoid a local device password prompt, which users don’t have access to. The password is encrypted and part of the process that powers Clever SSO into the Chromebook. - Single sign-on setting is **required** to enable SSO for Chromebooks. - SAML single sign-on login frequency settings are **recommended** to be every two weeks, but you can change this without causing issues. - Homepage URL and Startup pages are **recommended** to send the user directly to Clever on device startup. If you prefer another URL, that won’t affect SSO functionality. **In Chrome Device Settings:** - Disable guest mode to avoid confusion on student devices, as guest mode will not work with Badges. - Set Sign-in Screen to **Never show user names and photos**. It is **recommended** to avoid confusion. Enabling this will show previously logged-in users but will prompt for the local password instead of the Badge or Clever credential. - Set Single Sign-On IdP Redirection to **Allow users to go directly to SAML SSO IdP page** is **recommended** to eliminate the need for users to type their Google username prior to logging in. It may be **required** in some deployments depending on OU assignments - Set Single Sign-On Cookie Behavior to **Enable transfer of SAML SSO Cookies into user session** is **recommended** to allow the user to be signed in to Clever already once signed in to the device - Single sign-on camera permissions is **required** to enable Clever to access the device camera if you plan to use Clever Badges. - Set Managed guest session to **Do not allow managed guest sessions** is **recommended** to avoid confusion on student devices as guest mode will not work with Badges. * * * ## Common Chromebook errors Below are a list of common errors you may run into either with Badges or credentials-based logins. Steps for troubleshooting are also provided.

Error/Issue

Behavior

Resolution

 OU-based login errors Logins not working for Badges or credentials. Errors may say "Couldn't sign you in, contact domain admin" or "Error 400" It is extremely common that school organizations/schools apply settings to a student OU, but not a device OU. Please make sure that whatever settings you apply to your device OUs are also applied to your student OUs, and if you change settings for one OU you change them for the other as well.
 Login loopWhen a user tries to log into their Chromebook it brings them back to the sign in page without displaying any errors. This most commonly occurs for credentials-based logins, but can also occur for Clever Badges.Toggle options in the SSO Profile assignment section of the Google Admin Console.
Under Manage SSO Profile assignments, in the SSO Profile, change settings from Have Google prompt for their username, then redirect them to this profile's IDP sign-in page to the option Require users to enter their Google username and password to sign in and then back again. Restart a Chromebook and test the login again. It may take up to 10 minutes for the policy updates to apply on the device.
Couldn't sign in. Contact domain admin.User receives an error that states Couldn't sign in. Contact domain admin.

If this error is occurring for all users: This error is typically caused by missed settings in the OU setup. Generally, some settings are still being applied from the Parent OU if they have created Sub OUs. You should create a new "Test" OU and follow the setup instructions again. Then, place a Chromebook and student in the OU to test the flow. If the Test OU works, you can either move all students and devices to that OU that will use Clever Badges, or run through the setup guide on your current OUs and make sure the settings are not inherited from another OU in the Inheritance settings for SSO Profiles.

If this error is occurring for one or a few students: Move the affected user(s) to a different OU, wait for at least a minute, and then move them back to their original OU.

* * * ## Frequently asked questions **"Erase all local user data" - Is this setting required or recommended?** - **Erase all local user data** is not required or recommended for the Clever Badges into Chromebooks integration for most deployments, as it can cause issues with available device storage space.   **Can Clever Badges be used to log into Chromebooks without an internet connection (offline)?** - No. To facilitate logins, Chromebooks must be connected to the internet so Clever’s system can authenticate them. A user may elect to change the settings for their device to ensure a device is not locked upon idle or lid close. As long as the user does not power off the device or manually log out, their active session will be preserved.   **Can we use Clever Badges if our students and devices are on separate domains?** - If the domains are in the same Google Workspace, yes. The Badges into Chromebooks settings can be applied to each OU for the users and devices and will work for logins if configured correctly. If the students and devices exist on separate domains in different Google Workspaces you won't be able to configure Badges into Chromebooks. ** Do we need to require forced logout upon idle or lid close?** - No. These settings are recommended if devices are being shared by multiple users. If your school organization is 1:1, you can change these idle settings to **Sleep.** For more information on this topic, [click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/224420247#idlesettings). **Students receive the following error when logging in: _Assertion must contain at least one subject or attribute list_** - This error means that the student doesn't have an email address synced to Clever. To resolve the issue, please confirm their email is populated in your SIS and synced to Clever.  **Students receive the following error when logging in:** **_Sorry! This user does not have a Google email address associated with their Clever account. Please populate their email address and try again!_** - This error means that the student does not have an email address synced to Clever. To resolve the issue, please confirm their email is populated in your SIS and synced to Clever.  ![Clever Academy Logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmmL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jwB) Want to truly become a Clever Champion? Get certified in the [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Lenovo Stoneware / webNetwork
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_feccaef7-9b4f-4da9-a324-52a2030459b9)  
2. [Single sign-on (SSO) with Stoneware](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_a77815bb-439f-4e6d-8cec-f15ea0cc8fb5)  
3. [Can I use the Clever Portal instead of the Stoneware Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_784e3c16-5a02-4134-b4fe-4474aba9e32f)  
4. [Setup Preparation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_3994086c-3419-4cdb-829f-f18ef80e6c09)  
5. [Configuring the Public webApp for Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_ec96c63e-78d4-4993-9f8d-fa6405bd16c8)  
6. [Finishing setup with Clever support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_06c34a12-024a-45a0-ad1d-764770d06043)  
7. [Adding applications to the Stoneware Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215140667#h_969b15c1-55e9-475c-b09a-dfc992b0f9cd)

##   
Overview

Clever’s single sign-on (SSO) allows students and teachers to safely access education apps with a single username and password. You can rely on your existing user management system - single sign-on (SSO) supports common user management systems like Lenovo Stoneware.  
 

To use single sign-on (SSO) with Stoneware, you’ll need the following:

-   Active SIS sync with Clever
-   webNetwork version 6.3.0.167 and above

  
Before you start setting up single sign-on (SSO) with Stoneware, it’s important to look at the attributes in Stoneware and the data that’s synced to Clever - in order for users to be able to authenticate, there needs to be an attribute in Stoneware that matches the user’s sis\_id. Additionally, we recommend having your users’ mail attribute match the email address in Clever, though this is not mandatory. 

##   
Single sign-on (SSO) with Stoneware

1.  When you set up Stoneware, you define usernames and passwords for your users.
2.  When you set up single sign-on (SSO) with Stoneware, you create a hidden SAML application on your Stoneware portal, so when students authenticate to Stoneware, they are logged in to the hidden SAML application.
3.  When users click on an single sign-on (SSO) link, Clever queries the SAML application to see which user is logged in. The SAML application uses claims rules to identify the user, and we grant them access to the application if they are correctly set up in Clever and in Stoneware.

  
**Please note:** Because credentials are only entered on the Stoneware Portal log in screen, Clever will never know the usernames and passwords of your users.  
 

## Can I use the Clever Portal instead of the Stoneware Portal?

It’s possible to log in to the Clever Portal using your Stoneware credentials once single sign-on (SSO) with Stoneware is set up. However, as the Stoneware set up process requires adding single sign-on (SSO) links to the Stoneware Portal in order for users to be able to log in, districts generally prefer to use the existing Stoneware Portal.  
 

## Setup Preparation

If you haven't finished signing up for a Clever account yet, you can choose "Custom Username & Password" and "Synced Passwords" to start. Once you have access to the Clever Admin Dashboard, take the following steps:  
 

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page.
2.  Choose the shortname for your ingle sign-on (SSO) portal URL. The URL will be www.clever.com/_shortname_. Remember to use something that your students and teachers will remember easily.
3.  Keep Identity System set to **Google Apps** or **Clever Passwords** for now
4.  Add the contact information that students and teachers should reach out to if they have trouble with logging in to Clever - this should be someone who can help them reset their Stoneware credentials and/or make sure they are shared with the application they're trying to access through Clever.
5.  Click **Save**.

##   
Configuring the Public webApp for Clever

You’ll need to configure Stoneware to connect with Clever single sign-on (SSO). In order to do so, you’ll need to set up a public webApp for Clever.  
 

**Creating a Public webApp**  
 

1.  Open webAdmin, right-click **Applications Admin**, **Create Public Application**, and enter **Clever SSO** as the webApp name.
2.  Open the Clever SSO **Properties** tab and set the following properties:  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dvf)
    1.  Description: **CleverSSO**
    2.  Application Type: **Public**
    3.  Context Path (Alias) **/CleverSSO**
        1.  You may need to refresh the page for this option to appear
    4.  Assigned Relay(s): This should assign the app to each relay in your environment by default. //More complex setup? Reach out to StonewareUse the green ‘+’ icon to assign the app to each relay in your environment
    5.  Please note that **Assigned Link** should be blank

  
**Setting up Single-Sign-On to the Clever webApp**  
Open the Clever SSO **Authentication** Tab and set the following properties:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dvp)  
 

-   Type: ADFS
-   Identity: Use the Wizard to add an attribute that matches data in Clever
-   SAML Initiation: Service Provider
-   Assertion Consumer: [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/)
-   PFX Certificate: Click on the Wizard button  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dvu)
    -   Set Algorithm to RSA and Strength to 2048
    -   Click the **Generate** button, then the **Overwrite** button
-   Certificate: Use the wizard to configure the certificate as you would any other self-signed certificate.![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dvz)
-   SAML Logout Behavior: Full Logout

  
**Setting up Attributes for single sign-on (SSO)**

Open the CleverSSO **Attributes** or **Provisioning** tab and set the following properties:  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dw9)  
 

-   Attribute Assertion: Enabled
-   Type: SAML
-   Attribute Assertion Parameters: Use the green ‘+’ button to add the following attributes:
    -   clever.any.sis\_id = <the Stoneware Attribute that matches Clever sis\_id>
    -   clever.any.email = @@attr:mail@@
        -   This attribute is optional but recommended!

  
Once you’re done here, hit save and reload the page!

  
**Testing the Public webApp**  
Navigate to https:// <dns of your webNetwork system>/swPublicSSO/SAMLMetadata/CleverSSO - this should display a page like this:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DwJ)

  
You’ll want to double-check that the two attributes at the bottom match the attributes you set up in the CleverSSO webApp.  
 

If this page does not load or does not properly display the attributes, double-check your webApp configuration and assignments, and try reloading this page.

##   
Finishing setup with Clever support

Once you’ve finished the above, please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360001041326) and provide the following information:  
 

-   The URL that you used to test your CleverSSO webApp
-   An application that you’ve added to your Portal

  
We’ll help you finalize setup and test your first logins!

##   
Adding applications to the Stoneware Portal

You can add Clever apps to the Stoneware Portal using [single sign-on (SSO) links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205546348) - this allows users to access applications seamlessly, thanks to the public webApp you’ve set up. Once you’ve acquired the direct link from your Clever Dashboard, you can add it to the Portal by adding a new Link Object to your portal for each application and assigning it to the appropriate users.  
 

The Link Object should look like this:  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TheH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DwO)  
 

**Please note:** single sign-on (SSO) will only work for users who both have access to this Link Object _and_ are [shared with the application in question through Clever.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)

  
If you have any questions about setting up Clever SSO, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with Office 365/Entra ID"
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889768#Overview)  
2. [Preparing for Setup with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889768#PreparingForSetupClever)  
3\. [Setup in Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889768#SetupAzure)  
4\. [Setting up Entra ID SSO to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889768#SettingAzureSSO)  
5\. [Setting up Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889768#SettingUpClever)

## Overview

To use single sign-on (SSO) with Entra ID/Office 365, you'll need to make sure you have:  
 

-   Active SIS sync with Clever
-   Entra ID Premium OR Entra ID and PowerShell Proficiency

  
Not sure if you have Entra ID? If you have a paid subscription to Office 365 for your organization, you have a free subscription to Entra ID.

* * *

##   
Preparing for Setup with Clever

If you haven't finished signing up for a Clever account yet, you can choose Google to start. Once you have access to the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), take the following steps:  
 

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)
2.  Choose **Add Login Method**
3.  Choose **SAML Authentication**
4.  Enter your metadata URL (you can find out how to obtain your metadata URL below)
5.  Check the box for **Allow unencrypted SAML assertions**
6.  Click **Save**
7.  Add the contact information for the person students and teachers should reach out to if they have trouble with logging in to Clever - this should be someone who can help them reset their Entra ID credentials and/or make sure they are shared with the application they're trying to access through Clever.

![Screenshot of the Clever SSO settings page with support contact circled](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiBN)

8.  Next, navigate to [Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) and choose your school organization's Portal URL. The URL will be _www.clever.com/in/<shortname>;_. Remember to use something that your students and teachers will remember easily.

* * *

##   
Setup In Entra ID

You'll need to configure Entra ID to connect with Clever single sign-on (SSO). In order to do that, you'll need to:  
 

-   Add the Clever app to Entra ID
-   Set up SSO to the Clever App
-   Set up Claims Rules to allow Clever to match Entra ID users to Clever records
-   Assign users to the Clever App in Entra ID

  
**Adding the Clever App to Entra ID**  
 

1.  To add Clever from the gallery, perform the following steps:  
     
    
    1.  In the [Entra ID portal](https://portal.azure.com/), on the left navigation panel, click **Entra ID** icon.
        
        ![Screenshot of the Entra ID icon in the Azure portal navigation panel](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiBX)
        
    2.  Navigate to **Enterprise applications**. Then go to **All applications**.
        
        ![Screenshot of the Enterprise applications and All applications menu in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiBm)
        
    3.  Navigate to **Enterprise applications - All applications > Categories > Add an application** and search for **Clever**.
        
        ![Screenshot of adding an application and searching for Clever in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiC1)
        

* * *

##  Setting up Entra ID SSO into Clever

For single sign-on to work, Entra ID needs to know what the counterpart user in Clever is to a user in Entra ID. In other words, a link relationship between an Entra ID user and the related user in Clever needs to be established.  
 

In Clever, assign the value of the **user name** in Entra ID as the value of the **Username** to establish the link relationship.  
 

**Configure Entra ID single sign-on**  
 

In this section, you enable Entra ID single sign-on in the Entra ID portal and configure single sign-on in your Clever application.  
 

**To configure Entra ID single sign-on with Clever, perform the following steps:**  
 

1.  In the [Entra ID portal](https://portal.azure.com/), on the **Clever** application integration page, find the **Manage** section and select **single sign-on**.
    
2.  On the **Select a single sign-on method** page, select **SAML**.
    
3.  On the **Set up single sign-on with SAML** page, click the edit/pen icon for **Basic SAML Configuration** to edit the settings.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Set up single sign-on with SAML page in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bi9w)
    
    ![Screenshot of the Basic SAML Configuration edit panel in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiCV)
    
4.  On the **Basic SAML Configuration** section, enter the values for the following fields:  
     
    
    a. In the **Identifier (Entity ID)** text box, type a URL using the following: `[https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml)`
    
    b. In the **Reply URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL)** text box, type a URL using either of the following: `[https://clever.com/*](https://clever.com/*)` or `[https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert)`
    
5.  c. In the **Sign on URL** text box, type a URL using the following pattern: `[https://clever.com/in/<shortname>](https://clever.com/in/%3Cshortname%3E);`
6.  ![Screenshot of completed Basic SAML Configuration fields in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiCp)

8.  5\. Next, open the **User Attributes & Claims** section.

![Screenshot of the User Attributes and Claims section in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiDJ)

There will be required claims that you will not need to adjust at all.  
 

**Additional Claims** rules are used to allow Clever to determine which student or teacher is logging in. To do this, we match Entra ID attributes to data in Clever. _Claim name_ will be the [Clever field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617) and the _value_ is the field in Entra ID_._  
  
In order for users to be able to log in, there needs to be an attribute for each user type that exactly matches data in a field in Clever. We recommend adding three claims - one each for: 

-   Students
-   Teachers
-   Staff

To view the possible Clever _Claim name_ attribute values for each user type, see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617?language=en_US#h_0b0fa0fb-6c9f-41f3-b90a-d03342830537).

![Screenshot of example additional claims configured for students, teachers, and staff in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000S6psX)

6.  To generate the Metadata URL, navigate to **SAML Signing Certificate** and copy the **App Federation Metadata URL.**
    
    ![Screenshot of the SAML Signing Certificate section showing the App Federation Metadata URL](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiDi)
    

  
**Grant users access to Clever**  
 

In this section, you will enable students and teachers to use Entra ID single sign-on by granting access to Clever.  
 

To assign users to Clever, perform the following steps:  
 

1.  In the Entra ID portal, open the applications view, and then navigate to the directory view and go to **Enterprise applications** then click **All applications**.
    
    ![Screenshot of navigating to Enterprise applications and All applications to assign users](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiE2)
    
2.  In the applications list, select **Clever**.
    
    ![Screenshot of selecting Clever from the applications list](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiEM)
    
3.  In the menu on the left, click **Users and groups**.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Users and groups menu item in Entra ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiER)
    
4.  Click the **Add** button. Then select **Users and groups** on **Add Assignment** dialog.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Add button and Users and groups option in the Add Assignment dialog](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BiEg)
    
5.  On the **Users and groups** dialog, select the appropriate users from the Users list.
    
6.  Click **Select** button on the **Users and groups** dialog.
    
7.  Click **Assign** button on the **Add Assignment** dialog.
    

If you don't properly configure the settings above, or if a user isn't in a group assigned to Clever, they may receive a Microsoft error that states, "Your administrator has configured the application Clever to block users unless they are specifically granted ('assigned') access to the application. The signed in user is blocked because they are not a direct member of a group with access, nor had access directly assigned by an administrator."

To resolve this error, please review the steps above and ensure the user is in a group assigned to Clever.

* * *

##   
Setting up Clever

 

1.  In a different web browser window, log in and navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)
    
2.  On the **SSO Settings** page, perform the following steps:
    
    a. Select **Add Login Method**.  
      
    b. Select **SAML Authentication.**
    
    ![SAML Authentication IdP](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000TJQkT)
    
      
    c. Enter the **Metadata URL** you pulled from the Entra ID console in the **Metadata URL** text box.
    
    ![Screenshot of entering the Metadata URL in the Clever SSO settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dm1Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035kHE)
    
    d. Check the box for **Allow unencrypted SAML assertions**
    
    e. Click **Save.**
    

  
 If you have any questions about setting up Clever SSO, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: Single sign-on (SSO): Configure a SAML-based IdP for access to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218050687#Overview)  
2\. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218050687#Requirements)  
3\. [Next Steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218050687#NextSteps)

##   
Overview

You can add any SAML connection as an identity provider (IdP) into Clever! We offer support for Active Directory Federation Services ([AD](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576) and [Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001546)), Okta, and [Rapid ID](https://help.rapididentity.com/docs/configuring-saml-sso-with-clever?highlight=clever). However, any SAML connection can be created by following the same steps outlined in this article. Clever only supports one SAML IdP setup per account.

* * *

## Requirements

Here's what your Identity Provider (IdP) must have:

1.  Support for SP-initiated sign on using a Redirect Binding
2.  Response must be sent to a specified POST Binding `([https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert))`
3.  Response must contain an assertion encrypted using Clever's public key (found in the metadata file)
4.  The assertion must be signed with a private key owned by the IDP
5.  The assertion must contain an AuthnStatement with a SessionIndex
6.  The assertion must contain at least one attribute which can uniquely identify a Clever user
7.  Multiple attributes are allowed and only one needs to match a user, but only one user must be matched.
8.  Attributes should be in the form clever.\[user type\].\[field\] and contain the field they wish to match on.
    -   For example, an attribute with the name clever.student.sis\_id with a value of 12345 will attempt to find a student with the SIS ID of 12345. A user type of 'any' may be used to match both students and teachers with the same field.
9.  A LogoutRequest must be accepted at a Redirect Binding. The LogoutResponse should be sent to the specified HTTP-Redirect Binding `([https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert))`
10.  There cannot be a trailing whitespace or a newline at the start and end of the certificate.

 **![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doY1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever doesn't have insight into the configurations or set-up steps that allow your IDP to meet the above requirements for custom SAML connections. You can find more information here: [Single Sign-On (SSO): Identity Provider (IdP)/Login Method Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787)

* * *

  

## Next Steps

Once you have verified the above requirements and have either the URL or .xml file, you can navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol).  
  

1.  Click **Add Login Method** in the top right corner, then select **SAML Authentication**. This will allow for a SAML connection to Clever.

![Screenshot of the Choose Login Method page with SAML Authentication highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doY1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003Ebh7)

2.  Input your metadata URL in the text box.

![Screenshot of the metadata URL box to configure SAML authentication](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doY1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003Ebij)  
  

3.  Select your Identity Provider from the dropdown. If your Identity Provider is not available, select **SAML IdP**.

![Screenshot of step 3 in the configure SAML authentication setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doY1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003EbnZ)  
  

4.  Select **Save**.
5.  To finish the setup process:

1.  1.  Go to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Customize tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/customize) and customize your login screen by clicking on the gray pencil icons.
    2.  Add the Tech Support Contact details for the person that students and teachers should reach out to if they have trouble logging in to Clever; this should be someone who can help them reset their credentials and/or make sure they are shared with the application they're trying to access through Clever.
    3.  Add any login hints for your login methods (e.g., if you're using one login method for students and one for teachers).

![Screenshot of the metadata URL box to configure SAML authentication](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000doY1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000015ndp)

You should now be set up! Try a few logins and see if you run into any issues. If you have questions about this process, please contact our [support team.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with Canvas"
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206629117#h_3d32bb07-e611-4e3f-b174-56fbbe4d2974)  
2. [Set-up](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206629117#h_01ED7QWKBA00K6458ZANAHT2FQ)

##   
Overview

This article describes how school organizations can set up Canvas as a login method for Clever, meaning users will sign in to Clever with their Canvas credentials.  
  
  
![Canvas login button example](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlv7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DpX)  
  
  
If you are interested in configuring logins _**to Canvas**_ from Clever, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045827552). 

##   
Set-up 

To set up Canvas as a login method for Clever, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page. In the upper-righthand corner, click the **Add Login Method** button. From there, select Canvas Authentication and enter your Canvas instance URL. If you run into any issues with this, put [in a request to Clever Support.](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)   
  
A connection will be set up to match Canvas fields against Clever fields and authenticate users. Here are the default matches:

**Canvas field - \[Clever fields\]**

  
email -> \[email\]  
login\_id -> \[email, username\]  
sis\_user\_id -> \[sis\_id\]  
unique\_id -> \[email, credentials.district\_username, sis\_id, student\_number\]

  
If these default matches do not work for your school organization, please let us know in your support request.

title: Single sign-on (SSO): "Log in with NCEdCloud"
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026143131#h_0e1fda28-b4b8-46cb-a603-2c3bc4d2aeb4)  
2. [Configuring NCEdCloud IAM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026143131#h_a9a22605-881d-451e-a57b-7103659d07b4)  
3. [Customizing your Clever login option](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026143131#h_8de9e8a3-bc9b-4686-895d-9fef9d458318)  
4. [Clever Portal URL](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026143131#h_a66aafb0-8933-4548-ae87-c72e45cc591c)

  

## Overview

Clever single sign-on (SSO) allows North Carolina students and teachers to log in using their NCEdCloud IAM credentials. This article details the configuration process for setting up Clever single sign-on (SSO) with NCEdCloud IAM.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Doy) North Carolina Districts that are not currently on Clever should sign up for Clever [here!](https://clever.com/signup)

  

## Configuring NCEdCloud IAM

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
-   Select **Add Login Method** to the right-hand side.
-   Select **Active Directory Authentication** as your Identity Provider (IdP).

-   **Please note:** _This option establishes a SAML connection with NCEdCloud IAM. This will not establish Active Directory as your Clever SSO login method._

-   Enter the NCEdCloud IAM Metadata.xml file URL:

-   [https://s3.amazonaws.com/assets.clever.com/SAML/NCEdTest.xml](https://s3.amazonaws.com/assets.clever.com/SAML/NCEdTest.xml)

  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Dp8)

-   Select **Save**.

  

## Customizing your Clever login option

To customize the login option from your district's [Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838):

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
-   Select the **Customize** tab.
-   Click on the pencil icon to change the **Login with Active Directory** label to **Login with NCEd Cloud**.

         ![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-27.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BUzT)

-   Select **Save**.

  

## Clever Portal URL

Every Clever district has the ability to customize a unique [Clever login URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838) to share with district users in order to simplify the Clever login process. This URL is a direct way for users to log in to your district's Clever Portal rather than navigating to [Clever.com](https://clever.com/) and selecting their school from a drop-down menu. To do this:  
 

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page.
-   Click on the URL shortname in the **Clever Portal URL** box to edit it. The shortname is the part after `[https://clever.com/in/](https://clever.com/in/)`.
-   Update the editable text to the new shortname you'd like to use.
    -   **For example**: Updating the shortname to NorthernSchoolDistrict would change your Portal URL to: [https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict](https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict)
-   Select **Update** to save your changes.
-   Share the updated Portal URL with your district users so they can navigate directly to your district's Clever login page!

  
If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: For Families: How to download a Clever Badge for your student
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Downloading Student Badges from the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047770232#Downloading%20Student%20Badges%20from%20the%20Clever%20Portal)  
2\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047770232#Frequently%20Asked%20Questions)

## Downloading Student Badges from the Clever Portal

Students can download their own Badges from within the Clever Portal. Once a student logs in, they can find a Badge by clicking their profile icon in the top right corner, then selecting **Download Badge**.

![Video of downloading a student Clever Badge from the Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cBwv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DZZ)

Once they click **Download Badge,** their Badge will be saved as a PDF to the downloads folder on their device. Once downloaded, this PDF can be printed for use by your student. For information about Badges and how to use them, check out this article: [For Students: How do I log into Clever using a Badge?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020354392)  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

  
**Why don’t I see a “Download Badge” option?**

The Download Badge option is only available for students that have Badges enabled for them by their school organization. If you don’t see the **Download Badge** option, please contact your school organization's tech support contact. If you do not see a support contact listed, please contact your student's teacher.

![Screenshot of where to contact the school organization’s tech support.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cBwv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lSXC)

**How am I supposed to log in without a Badge?**  
 

In order to download a Badge, you will first need to log into the Portal using a non-Badge login method. To do so, follow the instructions here: [Logging in to the Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307). If you’re having trouble logging in, feel free to ask your teacher or school organization tech support contact for help.  
 

**What if I don't have a printer?**  
 

If you don't have a printer, a great alternative is to use your phone to display the Badge! Some options include:   
 

-   Take a picture of the Badge using your cellphone camera and scan the Badge from your photos app. 
-   Email the Badge to yourself and scan the Badge through the email app on your phone

Additional information on using your phone to display a Clever Badge can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020790571).

  
**What if I lost the Badge?**  
 

If you lose the Badge, you can always download a new one from the Portal. It’ll be the same as the one you lost so, if you find your old one, both will continue to work.

  
  
**Related articles:**

-   [For Families: Troubleshooting - Logins to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000067006?language=en_US)

title: For Families: Clever Badges
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020790571#Overview)  
2. [Logging in with a Badge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020790571#LoggingWithABadge)  
3. [Using a 6-digit Badge PIN](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020790571#UsingA6DigitPin)  
4. [What if my student forgot their Badge PIN?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020790571#WhatIfMyStudentForgotTheirBadgePIN)  
5. [What if I cannot print my student's Badge?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020790571#WhatIfICannotPrintMyStudentsBadge)  
6\. [Devices without cameras](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020790571#DevicseWithoutCameras)

##   
Overview

Clever Badges are an easy and secure way for your student to log in to Clever by scanning a Badge into a device's webcam rather than needing to enter a username and password! Badges are tied to the student. As such, changes in school, teacher, or section will not affect the Badge.    
 

* * *

##   
Logging in with a Badge

1\. Your student will first need to obtain a Clever Badge from their teacher or school. 

2\. Then, they will navigate to the Clever login page for your student's school organization, or go directly to [clever.com/badges.](https://clever.com/badges) Please do not attempt to use a QR reader to log your student in. Clever Badges are designed to be used directly with Clever and a QR reader won't log your student into Clever.

-   **Please note:** _There may be multiple schools by the same name, so please be sure to select the school associated with your student's school organization!_

3\. Select the **Clever Badge Log in** option.   
 

          ![Screenshot of Clever Badge login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DYb) 

4\. Your internet browser may ask you to allow clever.com to use your device's camera. Select **Allow**.  
 

          ![Camera settings to allow permissions](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DYg) 

5\. Hold your student's Badge up to the device's camera and wait for the green checkmark to log your student into Clever!   
 

        ![Successful Badge login with green checkmark](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XkZ9R)   

6\. Once your student is logged into their Clever Portal, they can click on the application icon they'd like to use:  
        ![Student Portal screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BDew) 

* * *

## Using a 6-digit Badge PIN

If your student's school organization has enabled Badge PINs for your student's account, your student will be asked to create or enter a 6-digit PIN. Be sure to have your student create a PIN that they will remember!  
 

![Badge PIN screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DYq)

* * *

## What if my student forgot their Badge PIN?

1\. If your student forgot their 6-digit Badge PIN, please contact your student's teacher or school to help them log in to Clever.  
 

![Invalid PIN login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DYv)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DZ0)**Please note:** If you are unsure who to reach out to at your student's school, you can typically locate the appropriate contact information by selecting the 'Get help signing in' or 'Get help logging in!' option from your school's Clever login page. 

![Get help logging in button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DZ5)

2\. Once your student is logged into their Clever Portal, they can reset their 6-digit PIN by clicking on their name in the top-right corner, and selecting **Reset your Badge PIN**. 

![Reset Badge PIN button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DZA)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DZF)**Clever Tip:** Teachers can help students log into Clever using a backup code, or by resetting the student's password! Check out this Help Center article for more information: [For Teachers: How do I help my student log into Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888) [](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888)

* * *

## What if I cannot print my student's Badge?

If you do not have access to a printer, try the following: 

1.  Save the Clever Badge to the photo app on your phone
2.  Open the website [clever.com/badges](https://clever.com/badges) on your student's computer or device.
3.  Open the photo of the Badge on your phone, turn your phone's screen to face the computer, and hold it up to the camera.
4.  The badge should successfully scan!  
      
    **Tip:** If it does not scan at first, try adjusting the distance and angle from the camera! 

* * *

## Devices without cameras

If a student does not have access to a device with a camera, they can log in using the school organization's normal login method (e.g. Log in with Google, Log in with Active Directory, Log in with Clever).

![Student doesn't have Badge access. Choose credentials login instead.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DZP)

If you require assistance with identifying their username and password for one of these login methods, please reach out to your school organization's [tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000067006).

title: For Families: What is Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [What is Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113708#h_3dd15e08-a7b2-473c-9586-07b90362d1e9)  
2. [How can my child log in to Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113708#h_ef3087d0-82ed-42d4-8ad9-66078b10f141)  
3\. [What should I do if I have a problem with Clever or a learning program?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113708#h_f708f1c1-3e02-44b8-be91-47bebe88424b)  
4\. [Is Clever safe for my child to use?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113708#h_ab5dbcb4-dd21-4dad-ab09-1e687aa06717)

##   
What is Clever?

Clever is an easy way for your child to log in and learn with all of the online programs they use at school. With their own personal portals, students can learn with resources selected by their teacher and district.

Schools use Clever so students can have all of their digital resources in one place. Clever also eliminates the need to remember multiple usernames and passwords.

* * *

##   
How can my child log in to Clever?

Your student can visit [clever.com/login](https://clever.com/login) to find their school and log in to Clever with their school-provided username and password. If your child has a Clever Badge, they can use their Badge to sign in at clever.com/badges.

Your school district may create a parent/guardian account that you can use to help your child log in. Learn more about parent/guardian accounts.

##   

 

* * *

##   
What should I do if I have a problem with Clever or a learning program?

If your child is unable to log in to Clever or if you encounter a problem with one of the programs on Clever, please contact your school. Your school will be able to help your child access their account, and can help troubleshoot any issues you may have run into.

Similarly, if you'd like more information on the applications and tools your child has access to, or believe they should have access to additional learning materials, please contact your school directly. The Clever team can't assist with student access to learning materials as your school manages this.

* * *

##   
Is Clever safe for my child to use?

Clever has worked with school districts and learning applications to create a safe, secure, private, experience for every student. Clever is set up and managed by schools - so every resource your child sees on Clever has been selected by their school. The data in Clever is only used to support your child’s education - it is never sold or used for advertising. 

Detailed information about Clever’s privacy, security and compliance policies and practices can be found in the [Trust Center](https://clever.com/trust).

title: For Families: Troubleshooting - Shared Devices
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020614031#overview)  
2. [Directions - General](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020614031#h_e0b953c4-37d8-4781-a616-6fe136aa6458)  
3. [Directions - Log in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020614031#step2)  
4\. [Directions - Chromebooks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020614031#h_de7aed1d-cd7b-44ef-93cb-2769693f6799)  
5\. [Need additional help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020614031#h_58aab7a5-42eb-4e5f-b5ae-655fb8e0860f)

## Overview

If your household has multiple students with Clever accounts using this same device, this article will help make sure that your children are properly logged out before the other logs in!

## Directions - General

To ensure that your child's user session has ended before logging the other in, please follow these steps:  
  
**Step 1:** **Log out of Clever**

-   From the [Clever Portal](https://clever.com/oauth/district-picker?channel=clever&client_id=4c63c1cf623dce82caac&confirmed=true&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclever.com%2Fin%2Fauth_callback&response_type=code&state=2e4d1c6c3d8dcf1aa85963f6b13785f43f2af226b719c68ca0952ba83e5f85c2) , click on the student's name in the top right corner, select **Log out.**

  
**Step 2: Log in to Clever as new user**

-   Navigate to [https://clever.com/login](https://clever.com/oauth/district-picker?channel=clever&client_id=4c63c1cf623dce82caac&confirmed=true&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclever.com%2Fin%2Fauth_callback&response_type=code&state=2e4d1c6c3d8dcf1aa85963f6b13785f43f2af226b719c68ca0952ba83e5f85c2) and search for your school. Once your school is located, click on the Google button ​and enter your **school email address** and password. You should now be successfully logged in to the new user's Clever account!

##   
Directions - Log in with Google

![Log in with Google button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bemT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DYM)

**Step 1:** **Log out of Clever**  
 

-   From the Clever Portal, click on the student's name in the top right corner and select **Log out.**

**Step 2: Log out of Google**  
 

-   Pro tip: you can [click on this link to sign out!](https://mail.google.com/mail/logout?hl=en)

**Step 3: Log in to Clever as a new user**  
 

-   Navigate to [https://clever.com/login](https://clever.com/login) and search for your school. Once your school is located, click on the Google button ​and enter your **school email address** and password. You should now be successfully logged in to the new user's Clever account!

## Directions - Chromebooks
