If your students share a Chromebook, we recommend setting up multiple profiles on the device. Once configured, each student should use their personal profile to prevent conflict between accounts.   
 

Step 1: Set up multiple profiles. Directions can be found [here](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/1059242?hl=en).  
 

Step 2: Sign in to the additional profile(s)  
 

Before you can sign in another person, be sure you've [added the second person](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/1059242) to your Chromebook. Then follow these steps:  
 

1.  Sign in to your Google Account.
2.  At the bottom right, select the time.
3.  Select your Google Account email.
4.  Select **Sign in another user**.
5.  You'll see a reminder to use the feature only with people you trust. Select **OK**.
6.  Pick a person, then enter their password. You can add up to 5 users.

  
**Switch between accounts you're signed in to**  
 

After you've added multiple people, you can switch between them:  
 

1.  Sign in to your Google Account.
2.  At the bottom right, select the time.
3.  Select the person you'd like to switch to.

All active people share some settings, such as networks. Other settings, like profile pictures and bookmarks, are specific to each person.

##   
Need additional help?

We recommend clearing the browser history (cookies, cache, etc.). For Chrome, you can clear the cache by following these steps:  
 

1.  On your computer, open Chrome.
2.  At the top right, click More ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bemT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lSXH).
3.  Click **More tools** > **Clear browsing data**.
4.  At the top, choose a time range. To delete everything, select **All time**.
5.  Next to "Cookies and other site data" and "Cached images and files," check the boxes.
6.  Click **Clear data**.

If you are using an alternate browser, please see the following documentation:  
 

-   [Apple Devices](https://clear-my-cache.com/apple-mac-os.html)
-   [Windows Devices](https://clear-my-cache.com/windows.html)

If the above steps have been completed but the login does not work, please have your students log in using a private window. This will ignore all existing user sessions, allowing other users to log in:  
 

1.  On your computer, open [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/).
2.  At the top right, click More ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bemT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lSXM)  **New Incognito Window**.
3.  A new window appears. In the top corner, check for the Incognito icon ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bemT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lSXR).
4.  Navigate to [https://clever.com/login](https://clever.com/login) and log in using the instructions outlined in Step 3.

If you are still running into issues, feel free to [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport)!

title: For Families: Troubleshooting - Clever iOS app
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020343092#Overview)  
2\. [Basic Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020343092#Basic%20Troubleshooting)  
3\. [Advanced Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020343092#Advanced%20Troubleshooting)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Please note:** The Clever iOS app requires iOS 16.6 or later and is compatible with iPads and iPhones. If you're using older devices that don’t support iOS 16.6+, your users can still access Clever via a web browser on their iOS device by opening the browser and navigating to your school organization’s Portal URL

##   
Overview

If you or your student are having issues with their iOS device and Clever, here are some recommended troubleshooting steps you can try to help.   
 

* * *

##   
Basic Troubleshooting

-   Before you begin, please make sure your device is using iOS version 16.6 or above.
-   Turn the device off and on again, then try again.
-   Uninstall, then re-install the Clever app, then try again.

If the above steps don't resolve your issue, you can also try accessing Clever directly from a web browser, such as Safari. If using Clever Badges, you can login at [https://clever.com/badges](https://clever.com/badges) in the Safari app.

If you encounter issues accessing Clever in a web browser, we recommend these steps:

-   Ensure that the iOS device has internet connectivity by navigating to any webpage in the Safari app.
-   Ensure that “Private Mode” is not enabled for Safari on the iOS device.
-   Ensure cookies are enabled for Safari.  This includes the device-wide setting, as well as for the Clever domain (clever.com). **Settings > Safari Block All Cookies**. Make sure Block All Cookies is toggled off -- you will know it is off when the slider turns grey.
-   Ensure Javascript is enabled for Safari. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Safari > Javascript**.
-   Ensure camera access is enabled for Safari. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Safari > Camera**.

* * *

##   
Advanced Troubleshooting

The steps below are for troubleshooting issues logging into Clever via a web browser on the iPad, such as Safari. The steps below **will not** work if you are attempting to troubleshoot in the Clever app.  
  

-   Ensure that on the device, the iOS network deny list is not enabled. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > General > Restrictions > Websites**.
-   Ensure that requests to Clever servers are not blocked or filtered by a firewall or network filtering software. See our Help Center article: Which Clever's domains should my network grant access?
-   In iOS 13, Safari has a new setting option that is enabled by default after updating an iPad from iOS 12. Please ensure that Safari's setting for “Request Desktop Website” is disabled. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Safari > Request Desktop Website**.
-   In iOS 14, users have the ability to choose a default browser other than Safari. Please ensure that Safari is the default browser for any device that will be used with the Clever app. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Browser > Safari**.
-   Ensure that no other software affects the way that Safari operates.

  
If the issue still persists, feel free to open a ticket with Clever Support!

title: For Families: Troubleshooting - Apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360021573031#Overview)  
2. [App is missing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360021573031#AppMissing)  
3. [Clicked on app, received an error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360021573031#ClickedOnAppReceivedAnError)  
4. [Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360021573031#ClickedOnAppCleverAskedForAUsername)  
5. [Problems within apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360021573031#ProblemsWithinApps)

##   
Overview

Occasionally, students will have issues with their applications (i.e. apps) in Clever. Here are some steps you can take to help your student if they are having trouble with a specific application.  
  

* * *

##   
App is missing 

If your student is missing an application in Clever, please ask your student's teacher for help. Your student's school organization will likely need to add the app to their Clever Portal for them. 

![Student Portal with an application missing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bbS1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DXi)

* * *

##   
Clicked on app, received an error

If your student clicks on an app icon in their Clever Portal and receives an error from the app's website page, **please ask your student's teacher to contact the Clever administrator or the application's support team for help**.  
 

_**Please note:**_ If your student has recently changed schools or classes, please allow 24 hrs for their connected applications to be updated so they can log in.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bbS1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DXs)**Clever Tip:** If you are seeing an error at a web URL that is **not** a Clever address, it will be necessary to contact the application to fix the issue. Please have your student's teacher reach out to the application's support team to investigate further!

  
Here are examples of common errors you might see for specific applications:

![Application-side login error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bbS1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DXx)

![Application-side login error example](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bbS1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DXA)

* * *

##   
Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Did you know?** Applications that show a Clever prompt to enter usernames and passwords require the Clever browser extension. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043488892) for details.

  
If a Clever page asks your student to enter a username and password for an application, enter the correct login information for that application, and click 'Save Login'. Clever will save this information and automatically log your student in next time they click the icon from the Portal! 

![Application login credentials screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bbS1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DY2)

If your student clicks on an application and sees the page below, this means the login credentials they entered are incorrect. Please enter your student's correct username and password for the application, and then select **Update & Log in**.

![Incorrect login credentials screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bbS1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DY7)

If you are still having trouble, ask your student's teacher to make sure you have the right username and password. They can contact Clever Support if further help is needed!

* * *

## Problems within apps

After your student is logged into an app successfully through Clever, any issues within the app would need to be addressed by the app provider.   
 

Clever is not able to resolve issues within the various applications. One way to think of it is, Clever helps a student "get in the door" of an application but, once inside, we have little insight into any issues that come up. Some issues might include:  
 

-   The app freezing
-   Not being able to access grades or textbooks
-   Your student runs out of time during a test
-   The app suddenly logs your student out
-   Missing lessons or assignments
-   Accessing the microphone or camera

If your student is running into an issue **within** the application, please ask your student's teacher to contact the application's support team for help.

title: For Families: Installing the Clever Browser Extension
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046857272#Overview)  
2\. [Download Links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046857272#Download%20Links)

## Overview

If your student uses Clever to learn from home, you may need to download the Clever browser extension to ensure that your student's learning applications work correctly. Downloading the Clever browser extension is essential to ensuring that your student can continue their learning uninterrupted from school, home, or both. The internet browsers that Clever supports are Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Microsoft Edge.   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHk9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The Clever browser extension is not required for iOS devices (e.g., iPads, iPhones) as these devices use the Clever app, which acts as the browser extension. Please ensure you have downloaded the Clever App from your device's App Store. For devices where the browser extension cannot be downloaded (e.g., Android, Kindles, Fire tablet), SSO (Saved Passwords) applications will not be accessible. For details, visit: [Clever Browser & Device Compatibility](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236226387)

* * *

## Download Links

Please see the links below for information and instructions for installing the Clever browser extension:

-   [Google Chrome Instructions](https://support.google.com/chrome_webstore/answer/2664769?hl=en) and [Install](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/clever/nopfnnpnopgmcnkjchnlpomggcdjfepo) 
-   [Microsoft Edge Instructions](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/find-add-or-remove-extensions-in-microsoft-edge-f3522273-d067-7435-6a9d-fdb99213e9a8) and  [Install](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/clever/innfnjgighoafebohpiamhnchmkoilgj)
-   [Mozilla Firefox Instructions](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/find-and-install-add-ons-add-features-to-firefox#:~:text=It%20will%20take%20you%20to,search%20for%20specific%20add%2Dons.&text=in%20the%20upper%2Dright%20area,in%20the%20toolbar%20after%20installation.) and [Install](https://crx.clever.com/firefox/download)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHk9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** These are links for the Clever extension. If you're looking for the Clever Plus Extension for [Edtech Analytics](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039420391) setup, please navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Analytics > Edtech analytics](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/edtech-usage) page. During the setup process you'll be provided with more information for setting up the Clever Plus Extension.

* * *

**Related Articles:**

title: For Families: Troubleshooting - Logins to Clever
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#Overview) 2. [How do I get help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#HowDoIGetHelp)  3. [Login Directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#LoginDirections)         _•_  [Log in with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#LoginWithClever)         _•_  [Log in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#LoginWithGoogle)         _•_  [Log in with Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#LoginWithActiveDirectory)          _•_  [Log in with Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#LoginWithBadges) 3\. [Logging out](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#LoggingOut)   ## Overview The first step to log your student into Clever is ensuring you are using a Clever-compatible device or browser. Please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043488892?language=en_US) for details. Once you have confirmed your device is compatible, you can navigate to your school organization's Clever login page, or to clever.com/login to search for your student's school in order to log in. - **Please note:** _There may be multiple schools by the same name, so please be sure to select the school associated with your student's school organization! If you cannot find their school, please ask their teacher how to log in to Clever._  * * * ## How do I get help? Login credentials for Clever are managed by the school organization. If you are unsure of your student's login credentials, receive an error when logging in, or your student's login suddenly stops working, please reach out to your teacher or the school organization's help desk for assistance.    You can find your school organization's technology support contact information on the Clever login screen. In most cases, school organizations provide an email address, phone number, or instructions guiding users to the appropriate contact person or department for assistance.   If you do not see a support contact listed, please contact your student's teacher.  ![Screenshot of Clever Login highlighting where to contact help.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DWb) * * * ## Login Directions Please navigate to the appropriate section below for instructions specific to your school organization's login method (e.g. Google, Active Directory, etc.).   ### **Log in with Clever** ![Screenshot of Log in with Clever icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DVw) If your student is using the **Log in with Clever** option, or only has the option to enter a username and password, enter their school organization credentials. _If your student receives an error stating **Invalid username or password**, this means the credentials your student has entered are incorrect for their Clever account._ ![Screenshot stating Invalid username or password.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BDOU)  If allowed by your school, your student can select the **Get help logging in!** option to reset their password. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DW1)**Please note:** Not all schools allow students to reset their own passwords. If you don't see the password reset option, or if this doesn't resolve the issue, please reach out to your student's teacher or school administrator for help with their Clever credentials. ### **Log in with Google** ![Screenshot of Log in with Google icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DW6) If your student is using the **Log in with Google** option, they will be redirected to sign in using their **school-provided** email address and password. They will _**not**_ log in using a personal Google (@gmail.com) email address.  If your student receives one of the below errors, here is what to do: 

Error

Details and next steps

Wrong password. Try again or click Forgot password to reset it. This error means they entered an incorrect password for their school-provided email address. They’ll need to enter the correct password for their account or reset it (if applicable).
We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email xxxx@gmail.com. Try again with your school issued email address. This error means that the email address they entered isn’t the same one linked to their Clever account. Please make sure you are using their school-provided email address. If you believe your student is using the correct email address, please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. The Clever team cannot provide login credentials. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team.
 We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the email xxxx@example.com This error means that the email address your student is attempting to log in with is duplicated in Clever. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team. The Clever team cannot edit email addresses or provide login credentials.
We couldn’t log you in.You may receive this error with additional details or by itself. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for further assistance in troubleshooting. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DWG)**Please note:** Your student's login credentials are configured by the school organization. If you are unsure what they are or are unable to reset your student's password, please visit [this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000067006#h_ffa9b241-1ab9-4cc4-bc4d-677ae0ece396). ### **Log in with Active Directory**  ![Screenshot of Log in with Active Directory icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DWL) If your student is using the **Log in with Active Directory** method, they'll be redirected to sign in to their school account through Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS). Student usernames and passwords for ADFS are managed by your student's school administration. Clever doesn't have access to these credentials. Their credentials are usually the email and password they use to log in to their computer at school. If your student receives one of the below errors, here is what to do:

Error

Details and next steps

We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email address or username.This error means the email address or username they entered isn’t in the school organization’s Clever account. Please make sure you are using their school-provided email or username. If your student is using the correct email or username, please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. The Clever team cannot provide login credentials. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team.
We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the student’s email or username.This error means that the email address or username your student is attempting to log in with is duplicated in Clever. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team. The Clever team cannot edit email addresses or provide login credentials.
We couldn’t log you in.You may receive this error with additional details or by itself. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for further assistance in troubleshooting. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.
### **Log in with Badges** - Select the **Clever Badge log in** option. You can also go directly to [clever.com/badges.](https://clever.com/badges)           ![Screenshot of Clever Badge log in](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DWQ)  - Your internet browser may ask you to allow clever.com to use your device's camera. Select **Allow**.           ![Screenshot of allowing camera access to Clever.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lSXv)  - Hold your student's Badge up to the device's camera and wait for the green checkmark to log your student into Clever! Please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020790571) for additional instructions for helping your student log in with a Badge. * * * ## Logging out To log out of Clever, navigate to the Clever Portal, hover over your student's in the top-right corner, and click **Log out**. ![Screenshot of how to log out of the Clever portal.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DWV) Users are also logged out of Clever automatically after:  - 24 hours of inactivity  - The browser is _quit (e.g. **Quit Google Chrome**)._ Note: Closing the browser window **will not** log the user out of Clever.  ![Screenshot of how to quit Google Chrome.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000be05&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DWa)

title: For Families: Clever security policies for student data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020791011#overview)  
2\. [Full Control from your school organization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020791011#districtcontrol)  
3\. [Student Data Privacy at Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020791011#studentdata)  
4\. [Infrastructure](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020791011#infrastructure)  
5\. [Additional Resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020791011#resources)

## Overview

Many of the nation’s largest school organizations rely on Clever to sync student information with learning applications, in part because security is a top priority. Clever keeps student information safe by ensuring:  
 

-   Full school organization control over data access rights at all times;
-   A robust [privacy policy](https://clever.com/trust) that governs Clever's use of student data; and
-   Protection through a tested and secure infrastructure.

* * *

##   
Full control from your school organization

School organizations control data access at all points in the process, from signup all the way through account provisioning. School orgs determine:  
 

-   What data Clever can access (always read-only);
-   How often they sync data with Clever;
-   Which applications can access data; and
-   How much data each application can access (via [data sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)).

  
Each school organization can fine-tune these settings at any time through the Clever Dashboard. If a school organization chooses to discontinue their Clever sync, they can do so at any time. Clever will delete their account and remove any residual data immediately upon request.  
 

* * *

## Student Data Privacy at Clever

Clever syncs basic information to manage user accounts in online learning applications, such as student and teacher identifiers, section names, and enrollment information.  
 

All rostering data that is synced with Clever is protected by industry-leading infrastructure (see below). Clever will never use or sell student information for marketing or other purposes.  
 

Additionally, Clever adheres to FERPA compliance under the FTC's School Officials Exemption, meaning that Clever provides a service on behalf of schools that schools themselves would usually provide. Furthermore, all Clever-supported applications agree to adhere to FERPA requirements in the terms of our partnership.  
 

To learn more about data privacy, you can read Clever's full [Privacy Policy.](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy)

* * *

##   
Infrastructure

Clever has spent years developing one of the best security infrastructures in K-12 education. Key features of Clever's industry-leading infrastructure are:  
 

-   AES256 data encryption for data at rest;
-   TLS with strong ciphers, with a preference for those with perfect-forward secrecy, for data in transit;
-   Multiple factor authentication;
-   Third-party security audits and code reviews;
-   Responsible disclosure (“bug bounty”) program;
-   Full-time security administrator; and
-   Employee background checks.

  
The syncing process is encrypted at all times using 256-bit encryption, which is double the standard used by the consumer banking industry. In addition, Clever's production environment is completely isolated from the internet, and all access is logged and secured using [multiple factor authentication](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333).  
 

Clever has a full-time security administrator and invests in regular third-party audits in order to ensure continual improvement of security protocols.  
 

* * *

##   
Additional Resources

To learn more about our security practices, you can read our [comprehensive security program.](https://www.clever.com/trust/security)

title: For School Tech Leads: Getting Help
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Contact the school or district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673591#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [Contact the application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673591#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)  
3\. [Contact Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673591#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)

##   
Contact the school or district 

Here are common examples of when your school's support contact will be best equipped to provide support:  
 

-   You or your student is unable to log in to Clever
-   An application is missing from the Clever Portal
-   Students or teachers are missing from Clever or an application
-   Data is missing or incorrect in Clever or an application
-   Adding a co-teacher to a class
-   Changing your user type in Clever

You can find your district's tech support contact information by clicking the **Get help signing in!** link on the Clever login screen. From here, you should see an email or phone number where you can reach the support contact for your district.

​![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oFh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lzUQ)

## Contact the application

Here are common examples of when an application’s team will be best equipped to provide support:  
 

-   You or your students click on an application in the Clever Portal and receives an error on the application's page or URL
-   You are receiving an error message on the application’s website
-   You are seeing incorrect data within the application, but correct data within the Clever Portal
-   You are having trouble accessing grades, homework, textbooks, resources, or running reports within the application
-   Your sections have access to the incorrect content within the application
-   You have questions about features within the application
-   The application does not save a student’s progress
-   The application is frozen or logs you or your students out

We recommend reaching out to the application's support team directly. Their contact information can usually be found by searching the app's name and "support contact" in Google.

## Contact Clever

For all other questions, Clever Support can be reached by selecting **Contact us** from the top of the Help Center (support.clever.com). Our team is available via email, Monday - Friday 7am - 7pm ET.

title: For Students: How do I log in to Clever using a Badge?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Log into Clever using a Badge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020354392#LoginUsingBadge)  
2\. [Log into Clever with a Badge on a Chromebook](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020354392#UsingBadgeChrome)  
3\. [Log into Clever with a Badge on the Clever App](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020354392#UsingBadgeApp)  
4\. [Using a 6-digit Badge PIN](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020354392#UsingBadgePin)  
5\. [What if I forgot my Badge PIN?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020354392#ForgotBadgePin)

  
Clever Badges are an easy way that you can log into Clever using your computer's webcam!  
 

## Log into Clever using a Badge

To log in using Badges, ask your teacher for your Clever Badge. From the Clever login page, you can click the '**Clever Badge Log in**' button. You can also go directly to [clever.com/badges.](https://clever.com/badges) You cannot use a QR reader to log into Clever.  
 

 ![Red box around Clever Badge Log in button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RYcbC)

Your browser may ask you to allow clever.com to use your computer's camera. Click **Allow while visiting this site** or **Allow**. If you accidentally clicked **Block** or **Never allow**, you can [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001730?language=en_US) to learn how to turn your camera back on.   
 

![Image shows a pop-up where clever.com asks to use your camera. Highlighted red box shows to click on Allow while visiting the site or Allow.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RYggQ)

Hold your Badge up to your computer camera and wait for the green checkmark to log you in to Clever!  
 

![Clever badge being help up to camera with a green check](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DSs)

## Log into Clever with a Badge on a Chromebook

To log in using Badges with your Chromebook, ask your teacher for your Clever Badge then follow these steps:

1.  Open your Google Chromebook 
    
2.  Click the **Clever Badge Log in** button. 
    
3.  Hold your Badge up to the camera.
    

Watch this video to learn how to log into your Chromebook with a Badge. 

## Log into Clever with a Badge on the Clever iOS app

Make sure that you have already downloaded the [Clever application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024746971?language=en_US) on your device. 

To log in using Badges with the Clever application, ask your teacher for your Clever Badge then follow these steps:

1.  Open the Clever application
    
2.  Allow the camera access to your device if you haven’t already
    
3.  Hold your Badge up to the camera
    

Watch this video to learn how to log into the Clever app with a Badge. 

## Using a 6-digit Badge PIN

If your school organization has enabled Badge PINs for your account, you will be asked to create or enter a 6-digit PIN. Be sure to create a PIN that you will remember!  
 

![choose a 6 digit number for a Clever pin](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RYqMP)

## What if I forgot my Badge PIN?

If you forgot your 6-digit Badge PIN, please contact your teacher to help you log into Clever. Your teacher can generate a backup code to help you log in to your Clever account using the instructions found here: [How do I help my student log in to Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888)  Please note that backup codes must be used within 15 minutes of when they are generated, and each backup code can only be used once!

![invalid pin error screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RYVl0)

Once you are in your Clever Portal, you can reset your 6-digit PIN by clicking on your name in the top-right corner, and clicking **Reset your Badge PIN**.  
 

![reset your pin screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RYgBn)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brzp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DTC)**Clever Tip:** Teachers can help students log into Clever using a backup code or by resetting the student's password! Check out this Help Center article for more information: [As a teacher, how do I help my student log in to Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888)

title: For Students: What is Clever and how to use it
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026162691#Overview)  
2\. [What is Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026162691#what-clever)  
3\. [What is single sign-on (SSO)?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026162691#WhatIsSSO)  
4\. [What is the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026162691#what-is-portal)  
5\. [Favoriting resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026162691#FavoritingApplications)  
6\. [Searching for resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026162691#SearchingForResources)

##   
Overview

In this article, you can learn more about what Clever is and how to use it in your class. If you are struggling to log into Clever, try reviewing [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307?language=en_US). If you are experiencing any other type of issue, please reach out to your teacher.  
 

* * *

##   
What is Clever?

Clever is an easy way for you to access all your learning applications. With Clever, you only have to remember **one username and password,** or use a [Clever Badge](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020354392), to log into all your applications.  
 

* * *

## What is single sign-on (SSO)?

**Single sign-on (SSO)** is what Clever uses to log you into all your learning applications. You only have to sign in once (a single sign-on) to the Clever Portal, then you can click on your learning applications without signing in again!

* * *

## What is the Clever Portal?

The Clever Portal is where you can access all your learning applications. Here is an example of a student's Clever Portal:

![Screenshot of the student Clever portal.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfFV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amsa)

Your Clever Portal might look different, depending on the applications your school has added to Clever. If you are missing an application you need in your Clever Portal, contact your teacher! 

  
If your Portal has a lot of icons and resources, consider “favoriting” and searching for the icons and applications you use the most! 

* * *

## Favoriting applications

**Here's how to favorite an application:**

1.  Log into your Portal at your school organization specific URL (ask your teacher if you need help with this step!) 
2.  Scroll to the appropriate application icon and click **the heart** in the upper right-hand corner of the icon
3.  This will add the application to the 'Favorites' category at the top of your Portal

  
To remove an application from your ‘Favorites’, simply click **the heart** again in the top right corner!  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfFV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Favoriting resources is only reflected in individual portals. Resources that teachers favorite will not be favorited for their students.  

  
![Screenshot of an App icon with the heart icon highlighted.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfFV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aopi) 

* * *

   

## Searching for resources

You can also search for school organization added resources and links and your teachers' pages. Simply navigate to the search bar at the top of your Clever Portal. When a result is clicked, you will be able to immediately be logged into the resource or redirected to the link or teacher page.  
 

![Screen recording of using the Clever search bar.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfFV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DTb)

title: For Students: Troubleshooting - Apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020618731#header1)  
2\. [App is missing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020618731#AppMissing)  
3\. [Clicked on app, received an error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020618731#ClickedAppReceivedError)  
4. [Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020618731#ClickedAppAskedUserPass)  
5\. [Problems within apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020618731#ProblemsWithApps)

## Overview

Here are some steps you can take if you are having trouble logging in to applications from your Clever Portal. If you still are experiencing issues, please ask your teacher for help.  
 

* * *

App is missing

If you are missing an application from your Clever Portal, **please ask your teacher for help**. Your school organization will need to add the application to your Clever Portal.

![student portal with application missing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brYP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQd)  

* * *

## Clicked on app, received an error

If you click on an application in your Clever Portal and get an error on the application's page, **please ask your teacher to contact your school organization's administrator or the application's support team for help**.  
  
**Clever Tip:** If you are seeing an error at a web URL that is **not** a Clever address, it's likely that the application can help you fix the issue. Please have your teacher reach out to the application's support team to investigate further!

Here are examples of common errors you might see for specific applications:

![Application- side login error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brYP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DS4)

![application side- login error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brYP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DS9)

* * *

## Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password

If a Clever page asks you to enter your username and password for an application, enter the correct login information for that application, and click **Save Login**. Clever will save this information and automatically log you in next time you click the icon from the Portal!

![application login credentials screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brYP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DPu)

If you click on an application and see the page below, this means we were not able to log you in with the username and password you provided. Please enter your updated username and password for the application, and click **Update & Log in**.

![incorrect login credentials screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000brYP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DSE)

If you are still having trouble, ask your teacher to make sure you have the right username and password. They can contact Clever Support if they still need help!  
 

* * *

## Problems within apps

After you are logged into an app successfully through Clever, any issues within the application would need to be addressed by the application's support team. 

Clever is not able to resolve issues _within_ applications. Some example issues the Clever cannot help with are: 

-   The app freezing
-   Not being able to access grades or textbooks
-   Your student runs out of time during a test
-   The app suddenly logs your student out
-   Missing lessons or assignments
-   Accessing the microphone or camera

If you are running into an issue **within** the application, please ask your teacher to contact the application's support team for help.

title: For School Tech Leads: Account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever passwords
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026004792#Overview)  
2\. [Set up Account Recovery](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026004792#header2)  
3\. [Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026004792#header3)  
4\. [Resetting your password in Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026004792#header4)  
5\. [Resetting a student or teacher's password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026004792#header5)

  
 

## Overview

If your school district has enabled  Active Directory (AD), Entra ID, Google, or Clever passwords as a login method for Clever, you may be able to reset your passwords from Clever. Please note that this setup will only be available to you if your district-level admin has enabled this.  
  
In your Clever Portal, if you click on your name and do not see the **Account recovery** or **Set new password** in your Clever Portal, you must contact your district to reset your Google, Active Directory, Entra ID (i.e., third-party), or Clever password.  
  

![Set new password drop down](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElIuH)

If you do see the option for password reset, you can reset your Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever passwords from within the Clever Portal. To ensure you can reset your password outside of the Clever Portal, you will need to set up an account recovery method.

* * *

## Set Up Account recovery

You will need to set up account recovery to have the ability to reset your password for a third-party when you are not signed in to your Clever account. To configure account recovery, from your Portal click your name, **Account recovery.**

![Account recovery Portal screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElJIT)

  
Once clicked, a modal will pop up where you can select your preferred account recovery method. Depending on what your school district has enabled, you may have the option to enter an email address, a phone number, or answer security questions when you need to reset your password.  
 

![Clever\_\_\_Portal.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Lig2)

  
 

It’s also possible that your school organization may have provided a recovery method for you using information in their records. For example, if your schools collect personal email addresses, they may set up your account recovery email as your personal email address. If you’d like to update the information your school organization provides, you can do so using the recovery method setup described above. 

* * *

##   
Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page 

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords**

1.  From the Clever login screen, click on **get help logging in.**
    
2.  Choose ****Reset your account passwords.  
      
    ![Reset your account passwords screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElK9h)**** 
    
3.  Input your school district email address (not to be confused with a recovery email you have set up).  
      
    ![Account recovery page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008rDCD)
4.  You’ll be prompted to confirm your identity using a method you set up in your Portal settings. Select how you’ll confirm your identity.  
    ![Confirm identity screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElQev)   
      
    
5.  You can now set up your new password for both your Clever and third-party accounts by inputting a new password. Your school may have password requirements, which can be viewed by clicking on **See requirements**. Once completed, you can use your new password for your third-party account(s).  
    ![Set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElQzt) 

### **To reset only your Clever password**

1.  Navigate to your district's login page and select **Get help logging in.  
    ![Get help logging in](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008rD2X)  
      
    **
2.   Click **Reset only your Clever password.  
      
    ![Screenshot of resetting only a Clever password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Elwms)** 
3.  Please enter your school email address. If you are unsure of the email address to utilize, please contact your district support contact. Clever Support cannot provide this information to you.\\
4.  After you enter your email, Clever will send you a verification code through the method selected when setting up account recovery. Once you enter the verification code, you can set a new password:  
      
    ![Set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EmE8g) 

The password must match the requirements set by your district and Clever. Here are some of the requirements from Clever:

-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

Once you've reset your password, you will be prompted to log in to the Clever Portal using your new password.

* * *

## Resetting your password in the Clever Portal

To reset your password while in the Clever Portal:

1.  Click on your name then **Set new password**.  
    ![Set new password drop down](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElIuH)  
      
    
2.  Input your new password, confirm the new password, and click **Set new password** to save.  
      
    ![Set new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EmGws) 

The password must match the requirements set by your district (example: minimum of 10 characters, including 1 number).

* * *

## Resetting a student or teacher's password (for school admin)

If you're a Clever School Tech Lead trying to reset a student or teacher's password, please [check out this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044867112)!

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613)
    
-   [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307)
    
-   [For Students: Password recovery and resets](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663)
    
-   [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)

title: For School Tech Leads: View usage data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020383911#h_47002a03-5fb7-4517-8fdd-a795e8001976)  
1\. [How to use filters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020383911#h_9d23c9da-96c6-4915-a3e6-c0eef845cd77)  
2\. [Description of available data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020383911#h_34040cd4-625b-4892-868f-614dc43557e8)  
3\. [How to export data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020383911#h_182ff593-ec2e-4db7-97b3-e6e2e23fcf9b)

##   
Overview

At Clever, we understand how important it is to track logins and application usage among your students and teachers. Using [Portal Analytics](https://clever.com/oauth/district_admin/login?target=%3BbzRrcGh2aDJ5Z252eDgzdnhjNjQ%3D%3BaHR0cHM6Ly9zY2hvb2xzLmNsZXZlci5jb20vYXV0aC1jYWxsYmFjaw%3D%3D%3BYTdiYWZhYWUxZDM1YjNmZjQ5ZmFhNDc4ZTkwYWU3M2IyN2FkNDE4YWUyZTY5Y2I2ZGRmYTUwYTZmM2M0ZGM1Mg%3D%3D%3BY29kZQ%3D%3D%3BZGlzdHJpY3RfYWRtaW4%3D), you can see graphs and statistics that show how many users are accessing their resources, how often they log in, and which schools or apps are being used the most! This data is provided as a general overview and is not viewable "by student" or "by teacher".  
  
This article will give you a breakdown of the available data and how you can use filters to narrow down the information you see.  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** As a School Tech Lead, you will only see the specific data for your assigned school sites. As such, you will not see the "Logins by school" list unless you are connected to multiple schools in Clever. If you do not see one of your school sites, please contact your district help desk.

##   

* * *

To get to the Portal Analytics page from your School Tech Lead Portal, you can navigate to the Clever Dashboard, by clicking **Dashboard** from the top menu  
 

Once in the dashboard, select the blue **View details** button to the right of, **Clever in your school**  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DPt)

* * *

## How to use filters

First, let's take a look at the available filters. You can use the filters to narrow down the usage data and focus on specific users, applications, and school sites. Different filter sets will cause charts to change- if the filters chosen do not apply to a chart, the chart will temporarily be hidden.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DPy)

**Time Range**  
Here you can select the time ranges that you want the charts to show. Select _School year to date_ if you'd like to see the usage data for the entire school year so far.  
 

**Units**  
Here you can select whether you'd like to view your data as a **percentage** (75% of all students have logged in) or in **absolute** terms (7,500 students have logged in).   
 

**Schools**  
_All My Schools_ - an overview of the data for all the schools assigned to you  
If you want to focus on a specific site, you can select it from the drop-down. Multiple school sites can be selected from the drop-down.  
  
Please note: the "Logins by School" graph is disabled when you select a single school.

**App**  
Select _All Apps_ if you want to view login data for all the apps connected to your Clever account. To look more closely at a specific app's usage, select it from the drop-down. When you select an app, the "Usage by App" graph is disabled.  
 

**App Type**  
Here you can select whether you want to see usage data for teacher-added, district-added, or both.  
 

**Grades**  
To look at the analytics for specific grade levels, select the grade(s) from the drop-down. Grades are based on _student_ grades, not the grade level for a section or a teacher.  
 

**Users**  
Here you can select whether you want to see usage data for students, teachers, or both.  
 

Please note: the _"Teachers"_ filter cannot be used in conjunction with the grade filter  
 

* * *

## Description of available data

Now that we know how to use filters to focus on specific areas, let's take a look at the different measures! The statistics shown are based on the _users who are being shared with apps._The metrics are not based on the total number of users in your Clever account.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQX)

**Usage by scoped users:** This number reflects the number of logins from the users that are shared with your applications.  
 

**Unique users:** This number reflects the unique number of users who have logged into an application.  
 

**Total Logins:** This number reflects the overall number of user logins.

###   
Daily Unique Users

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQ9)

**Daily unique users:** This chart reflects the unique number of users who have logged into an application per day. Hover your mouse over a date to see the number of daily unique users for that day. Please note that this chart is disabled if you are using the _School year to date_ time frame filter.

### Logins by app

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DR1)  
This number reflects the number of unique user logins to an individual application. Click on _Ascending_ or _Descending_ to order apps by the number of unique logins.

### Logins by school

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DR6)  
This number reflects the number of unique user logins from users at each school site you administer. Click on _Ascending_ or _Descending_ to order schools by the number of unique logins.  
 

Please note: you will only see the number of logins by school for the sites you administer. 

### Login Method / Device / Browser

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DRB)

**Login Method****:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins by login type. Users will be counted twice if they log in using different login methods- but only once if logging in multiple times using the same identity provider.  
 

**Device****:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins for each device. Users will be counted twice if logging into different devices but only once if logging in multiple times to the same device type.  
 

**Browser****:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins for each device. Users will be counted twice if logging in through different browsers- but only once if logging in multiple times through the same browser.

* * *

## How to export data

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCZd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOxb)  
Located at the top right of the Portal Analytics page, the **Export all data** button will download a CSV of the data you've currently filtered in your analytics view.

title: For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#Overview)  
2\. [New login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#header2)  
3\. [Login Directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#LoginDirections)  
        _•_   [Log in with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#LoginDirections)  
        _•_   [Log in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#LoginWithGoogle)  
        _•_   [Log in with Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#LoginActiveDirectory)  
4. [Backup Codes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#BackupCode)  
5\. [Setting up a backup login method for Active Directory, Entra ID, Google, or Clever passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#backup)  
6\. [Logging out](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#LoggingOut)  
7\. [How do I get help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002717307#HowHelp)

##   
Overview

This article is an overview of how students can get logged into Clever, and some basic steps for troubleshooting. If you are having trouble getting logged in, please reach out to your teacher directly. Clever’s support team can’t help if you don’t know your login credentials.

1.  To get into Clever, go to your school’s Clever login page. If you don’t know the page, visit clever.com/login and search for your school organization. If you can’t find it, ask your teacher for help! 
    
2.  To log in, use the username and password your school gave you. It might be your student number, ID, or email. If you’re not sure what they are, ask your teacher for help.  
     
    
3.  From your Clever Portal, click on the application icon you’d like to use!
    

##   

 

* * *

## New login page

Starting February 3, Clever is getting a new login page! If your login page looks a little different, don’t worry. Everything still works the same, so you can log in just like you always do. Check out the picture below to see what it could look like. Your screen might look a little different and that’s okay. You can still log in like usual. 

![Screenshot of Clever login page.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hEDUU)    
 

* * *

* * *

##   
Log in with Clever passwords

![Screenshot of Log in with Clever icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQ8)

If you are using the **Log in with Clever** button, you’ll need to use the username and password from your school. It might be your student number, ID, or email address.

If you see the error **_Invalid username or password_**, this means that the username and/or password you have entered aren’t correct for your Clever account. **Please ask your teacher for help.**

* * *

##   
Log in with Google

![Screenshot of Log in with Google icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQD)

If you are using the **Log in with Google** button, you’ll need to use your school Google email and password to log into your Clever account.

If you see the error message "_Wrong password. Try again'_, this means that either your email or password is incorrect. **Please ask your teacher for help.**

If you see a message saying **“We couldn't log you in, we can't find a Clever account for the email** **_[xxxx@example.com](mailto:xxxx@example.com)_****,”** it means the email you used isn’t the one linked to your Clever account. Make sure you’re using the email your school gave you. If you’re sure you’re using the email your school gave you, please reach out to your teacher directly for more help. Clever cannot provide your login credentials.

If you see any other message saying **We couldn’t log you in,** please contact your teacher for help. Provide them with as much information as you can about the error such as any other description of the error, the copyable Reference ID, and Admin troubleshooting steps. Clever **cannot** provide your login credentials. 

* * *

##   
Logging in with Active Directory 

![Screenshot of Log in with Active Directory icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQN)

If you click the **Log in with Active Directory** button, you’ll be taken to sign in with your school account through Active Directory Federation Services or Microsoft360. Use the username and password your school gave you. This is usually the same email and password you use to log on to school computers.

![Screenshot of Log in with School Organization account.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQS)

If you see a message saying **We couldn’t log you in, We can’t find a Clever account for the email or username** it means the email or username you used isn’t linked to your Clever account. Make sure you’re using the email or username your school gave you. If you’re sure you’re using the email or username your school gave you, please reach out to your teacher directly for more help. Clever cannot provide your login credentials.

If you see any other message saying **We couldn’t log you in,** please contact your teacher for help. Provide them with as much information as you can about the error such as any other description of the error, the copyable Reference ID, and Admin troubleshooting steps. Clever **cannot** provide your login credentials.

If you click on **Log in with Active Directory** or **Log in with Office365** and the login page fails to load, try [clearing your cache](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en). If accessing Clever from a Chromebook, we recommend [signing out](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/3420029?hl=en) of the Chromebook and [restarting the device](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/3420029?hl=en).

* * *

##   
Using a Backup Code

If you don’t know your Clever login info, your teacher can give you a Backup Code to help you log in. Just click the **Get help** link on the Clever login page, then choose **Use backup code**. Enter the code from your teacher and click **Log in**.

![Screenshot of Clever login highlighting get help.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iR9lp)

![Screenshot of the Use Backup Code option.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iRA1x)

* * *

## Setting up a backup login method for Active Directory, Entra ID, Google, or Clever passwords

If your school has set it up, you can use a backup method like email, security questions, or your phone number to get back into your Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, and Clever passwords accounts right from the Clever login screen! This helps if you’re having trouble with your password.

Find our step-by-step student guide for [account recovery and password resets here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663).

* * *

##   
Updating your password for Active Directory, Entra ID, Google, or Clever passwords

If your school has set it up, you can easily change all of your account passwords at one time through Clever! Read more about [resetting your passwords here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663).

* * *

##   
Logging out

To log out of Clever, navigate to the Clever Portal, hover over your name in the top-right corner, and click **Log out**.

![Screenshot of how to log out of the Clever portal.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQh)

Users are also logged out of Clever automatically after: 

-   24 hours of inactivity 
-   The browser is _quit (e.g. "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._  
    Closing the browser window will not log the user out of Clever. 

![Screenshot of how to quit Google Chrome.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DQr)

* * *

##   
How do I get help?

**Need help?** 

Your school manages your login info. If you’re not sure of your login details, see an error message, or something isn’t working, ask your teacher or the school organization’s help desk for help.  
  
You can find your school organization's tech support contact information by clicking the **Get help** link on the Clever login screen. From here, click **District contact**. You should see a box appear with email or phone number to reach your school organization's support contact. If you don’t see it, reach out to your teacher.  
 

​![Screenshot of Clever login page highlighting get help.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hONfR) 

![Screenshot of Clever login page highlighting District Contact.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hNhDD)

![Screenshot of the District Contact information.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOBKw)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfIj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Want to learn more about Clever? Check out [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=teacher) !

  
 

**Still can’t log in?** Ask your teacher for help! They can help you using the directions found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888).

title: For School Tech Leads: Sharing data with apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [What is data sharing?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020281091#Header1)  
2\. [Which applications am I able to share data with?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020281091#Header2)  
3\. [Sharing data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020281091#Header3)  

  
 

## What is data sharing?

The final step in adding an application to your district's Clever Dashboard is setting your sharing permissions. Sharing rules let Clever know which of your data you'd like to make available to an application, and which users should be able to access an application via Clever. Clever will not share data with an application until your district sets the application’s sharing permissions. The application will only appear on the Portal for teachers, students or staff that have been shared with the application.  
 

* * *

##   
Which applications am I able to share data with?

As a School Tech Lead you are only able to update sharing rules for applications that say, **School site sharing**, under the _Sharing_ column on the [Applications](https://clever.com/oauth/district_admin/login?target=%3BbzRrcGh2aDJ5Z252eDgzdnhjNjQ%3D%3BaHR0cHM6Ly9zY2hvb2xzLmNsZXZlci5jb20vYXV0aC1jYWxsYmFjaw%3D%3D%3BYTdiYWZhYWUxZDM1YjNmZjQ5ZmFhNDc4ZTkwYWU3M2IyN2FkNDE4YWUyZTY5Y2I2ZGRmYTUwYTZmM2M0ZGM1Mg%3D%3D%3BY29kZQ%3D%3D%3BZGlzdHJpY3RfYWRtaW4%3D) tab. This setting is configured by your district's Clever Admins.  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000GHXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DP5)  
  
For applications with **School site sharing** enabled, you can adjust the sharing permissions for these applications to grant or remove access for specific users and classes.  
 

* * *

##   
Sharing data

When school site sharing is enabled, School Tech Leads will be able to share data for their school by creating **sharing rules.** Examples of sharing rules include:   
 

-   All the math classes in a particular school;
-   The math classes for grades 3-6 in the district, except for in two schools; or
-   One specific teacher’s 11th-grade homeroom class.

  
For information on creating sharing rules, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247).

* * *

**Related articles:**

[Sharing Permissions: Enabling School Site Sharing for School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366)

title: PowerSchool: How do I unlock my PowerSchool account if I made too many sign in attempts with incorrect password?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058083#header1)  
2\. [How to fix this error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058083#header2)

## Overview

You may see a Sync Status error if the PowerSchool account you’ve provided for the Clever sync has an incorrect password - some districts’ PowerSchool settings will lock an account after a series of sign-in attempts with a wrong password.  
  
If this has happened, you'll see this error on your District Dashboard:  
 

Account locked due to sign in attempts with incorrect password. 
Please contact your SIS administrator to remove this restriction. 

* * *

## How to fix this error

1.  Log into PowerSchool from an administrator account (not the account you've shared with Clever).
2.  Navigate to the System Administrator view (click on the left menu link for ‘System’).
3.  Click on the link for ‘Security’.
4.  Click on the link for ‘Locked Accounts’.
5.  Verify that the account username shared with Clever is not listed here. If this account is listed, remove it.

Some PowerSchool systems also place IP restrictions on locked accounts for extra security. After removing the lock on the account, we recommend checking and removing additional IP restrictions with the following steps:

1.  From the System Administrator view, click back to ‘Security’.
2.  Click on the link for ‘Sign In Attempts Restrictions’.
3.  At the bottom of this page you’ll see a link for ‘View Disabled IP Addresses’. Click the link and verify that Clever's IP addresses are _**not**_ listed:

-   _54.241.134.131_
-   _50.18.217.135_
-   _54.241.154.41_

If you are unable to resolve this error following the recommendations above, please contact Clever Support for additional assistance.

title: Sync Error: How do I resolve "The password on the SIS account needs to be reset"?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202493918#overview)  
2\. [Fixing the error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202493918#fixing)

## Overview

If you notice an error message on your Clever sync that says, "The password on the SIS account needs to be reset," this article is for you. 

This may occur if you've updated the password for the Student Information System account shared with Clever. Some SIS accounts require users to set a new password after an administrator resets their password, and some require passwords to be changed periodically.

  
If your sync is experiencing this error, you'll receive an email and see this sync status on your Clever Dashboard:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DKU)

* * *

## Fixing the error

Step 1: Log in to your SIS as an administrator and reset the password for the Clever access account. You can see the username you’ve shared with Clever on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab.

Step 2: In a new window, log in to your SIS with the Clever access account username and the new password.

Step 3: Enter the temporary password and create a new password.  
  
![Example SIS password reset screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DKZ) 

Step 4: Update the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab in your Clever Dashboard with the new password.

Clever will try to sync at the next scheduled time, so you should see your sync status update within a few hours. You can also press **Sync Now** on your Sync Settings page to initiate a sync. You should see the next sync process within 30 minutes.

title: Sync Error: How do I resolve "Security preferences need to be set for this account"?
text:
Some SISs periodically request security preferences to be updated for active accounts. These preferences safeguard your account and allow for recovery if a password is forgotten.

  
When Clever encounters this error, your sync will not complete successfully. You’ll notice the following Sync Status message on your Clever Dashboard:  
  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P0000005zHu&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DKP)

  
How to fix this error:  
 

1.  Log into your SIS using the username and password you've shared with Clever.
2.  Follow the instructions to update your security preferences.
3.  Save your changes.
4.  Log out of your SIS and log back in with the same credentials to confirm that the error is resolved.

Once the security preferences are set and you can log into your SIS, you should see your sync resume shortly.

title: Sync Error: How do I resolve "SIS is not currently available at the URL provided"?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202493888#header1)  
2\. [How to resolve this error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202493888#header2)

## Overview

Many of Clever’s automatic syncs rely on the URL for your SIS to sync data. When Clever is unable to access this URL your sync cannot complete successfully.

![](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002137107/Screen_Shot_2017-01-11_at_1.52.59_PM.png)![Example of a sync error for an unavailable URL](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5cX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DKK) 

Some common causes for URL errors include:

-   URL includes a typo
-   URL does not direct to a valid SIS login page
-   URL is not accessible from outside of your school organization’s network/VPN
-   URL access is blocked by firewall restrictions
-   Your school organization needs to grant access to Clever's IP addresses 

* * *

## How to resolve this error

### Determine the correct URL to provide Clever:

1.  Find the URL you’ve shared with Clever on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab.
2.  Make sure that the URL you entered matches the one you use to log in to your SIS.
3.  Confirm that you can use this URL to log in to your SIS _from_ _outside of your school organization's network/VPN._
4.  If you’re not able to access the URL you provided, determine the correct URL and update it in Clever (check for typos, adjust firewall, etc.).

### Update your URL in Clever:

1.  Log in to your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) and navigate to the [Sync Settings page](https://schools.clever.com/settings/system) to update your SIS URL in Clever.
2.  When you click **Update** Clever will attempt another sync with your SIS, so you should see your Sync Status update within a few hours.

### Grant access to Clever IP addresses:

In the event that your school organization blocks IP addresses, you may need to [grant access to these IP addresses](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752) or clear them from being blocked.

Your school organization may also need to make sure ports 443 and 80 are open. 

* * *

title: Sync Error: How do I resolve "Invalid username/password specified?"
text:
Many of Clever’s Auto-Syncs rely on a read-only SIS account to sync data. When the username and password for this account are incorrect, your sync cannot complete successfully.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjHt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DKF)  
![](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002137027/Screen_Shot_2017-01-11_at_1.51.42_PM.png)

## How to fix this error:

1.  Check your credentials by logging into your SIS with the username and password you've provided to Clever. (You can find these credentials on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab. If you are unable to log in with the credentials it means they have expired, changed, or are no longer valid.
2.  Update the credentials in your SIS. We strongly recommend creating a separate read-only account in your SIS, just for the Clever sync. You can confirm the required permissions for this account in the [Auto-Sync section](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZnTWAW/clevermanaged-syncs?language=en_US) of our Help Center.
3.  Once you've updated the credentials, confirm that they are working by using them to log into your SIS.
4.  With new credentials in hand, navigate back to your [Sync Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page and enter the new credentials required to connect to your SIS, including username and/or password.
5.  Once entered, click ‘Update.' Clever will attempt another sync with your SIS as scheduled, so you should see your Sync Status update within a few hours.

title: Sync Error: What are "Insufficient Permissions"?
text:
Many of Clever’s Auto Syncs rely on a read-only SIS account to sync data. When the permissions for this account aren’t set correctly, your sync cannot complete successfully. You’ll see an error similar to these:  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjMj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BYE7)

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjMj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BYEC)

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TjMj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BYEM)

## How to fix this error:

1.  Find the article about your SIS in the [Auto Sync section of the Help Center](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZnTWAW/clevermanaged-syncs?language=en_US), and download the attached setup guide (found in each article).
2.  Confirm that the SIS account you’ve created for the Clever sync has access to all of the resources listed in your Permissions Guide. You can find the credentials for this account on your [Sync Settings page.](https://schools.clever.com/settings/system)

Once you’ve updated the permissions for this SIS account, you should see your sync status change with your next sync!

title: Is Clever available to all North Carolina LEAs and Charter Schools?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220507647#header1)  
2\. [Getting started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220507647#header2)

## Overview

Yes! LEA and Charter School Administrators in North Carolina have the ability to easily integrate over 200 additional leading educational applications into their NCEdCloud IAM Service portal for students and teachers.  

  
The Clever integration leverages industry leading security standards like SAML and OAuth in conjunction with Clever's powerful data sharing tools to give administrators in North Carolina the ability to easily deploy software to the classroom. 

* * *

## Getting started

To get started:  
 

1.  Tech Directors should visit the NCEdCloud IAM Service website under Target Applications ([https://ncedcloud.mcnc.org/target-applications](https://ncedcloud.mcnc.org/target-applications))
2.  Click on “Target Application Request Form”
3.  Select Clever from the list of Target Applications.
4.  Sign up at [https://www.clever.com/district-signup](https://www.clever.com/district-signup) and our district and school onboarding team will be in touch shortly to assist with your setup!

If you have any issues, [please contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326).
