title: Skyward Auto Sync
text:
This article covers the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058193#functionality) 2\. [Customization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058193#customization) 3\. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058193#rollover) 4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058193#troubleshooting) 5\. [Permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058193#permissions) 5\. [Default Field Mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058193#header6) ## Overview ✓ Syncs every six hours, by exporting via Skybuild ✓ Utilizes your Skybuild's default file export settings. For customization, see below. ✓ Supports co-teachers for sections, using the Teacher Alpha Key to determine the primary teacher ✓ For information on our Skyward API sync, [please visit this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028?language=en_US)  * * * ## Customization - The Clever team can set your Skyward sync to run nightly instead of every 6 hours, but the time of day syncs occur cannot be customized. The sync can be initiated at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [Data sources > SIS Sync > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings). - Syncs can also be customized to pull additional fields available through Skybuild. To request additional fields, please contact Clever Support.  - Clever can filter exports from Skyward to limit the schools, teachers, or students included in the sync. - Clever can help increase field length character limits so that longer field values aren't truncated in your sync. - To request customization and filtering for your Skyward sync, contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfCz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PwYkT)    Please note:** If you’d like to sync additional data to Clever, you can do so via our automated custom data sync for auto sync districts and schools. Please reach out [to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for access to your Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automated exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for scripting. * * * ## School Year Rollover Clever’s Skyward sync includes data for the current school year in Skyward. Once your Skyward system has transitioned to the new school year and there are active enrollments, Clever will sync the new school year data. If your Clever sync isn't paused and you haven't rolled over to the new school year, your sync may be listed as **Pending** or you may encounter a sync error due to the lack of active enrollments. Once you complete rollover in Skyward and have published sections and enrollments for the new year, the sync error should resolve. * * * ## Troubleshooting ### **Common sync errors and resolution steps** Below are some sync errors you may see in your Clever Dashboard. We recommend the following steps to resolve.

Error

Context and resolution

Invalid username/password specified. Please check SIS credentials on settings page.The credentials you have provided Clever on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page don't match the credentials in Skyward. Please follow the setup instructions on your Sync Settings page to confirm your credentials.
The password on the SIS account needs to be reset. Please log in to Skyward to set a new password, then update SIS credentials on the settings page.Skyward requires admin passwords to be reset periodically. The password for the Clever user in Skyward needs to be reset and then updated on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page.
Skyward is not currently available at the URL provided. Please update the URL in your system settings page if necessary.

Either the URL provided on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page is inaccurate, or your Skyward instance is down. 

  • Confirm the URL on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources> SIS sync > Settings page matches your Skyward URL.

Sync: Internal Errorpage.waitForEvent: Timeout 

120000ms exceeded while waiting for event "popup"

This error occurs when districts have a pop-up enabled on their Skyward login page. Please remove any pop-ups and the error should resolve.

Could not execute download of file builder query. Delete the saved query to rebuild it from your sync settings.

This error may occur if there are pop-ups or multi-factor authentication requirements for the Clever user. Please confirm that there are no pop-ups or multi-factor authentication requests during the login process to resolve this error.

### **Missing Records** If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following:  

Record Type

Troubleshooting

Student
  • Must have a current Entry record in the Entry/Withdrawal section of Skyward. The entry and exit date
    cannot be the same day!
  • If missing students are in pre-Kindergarten grade level, please reach out to Clever Support to adjust your sync configuration.
Teacher
  • Must be listed as Active in Skyward for the current school year
  • Make sure the teacher is in the correct security group
Staff
  • Clever doesn't automatically sync records from Skyward to the Staff role in Clever. Note that you can still upload staff manually or via SFTP.
Sections
  • Each section must have a teacher assigned to it
  • Check the filters that are in place for the ClassC export
If the record (student, teacher, section) is in Clever but data is missing or incorrect for the record (i.e. incorrect email, missing username), navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page.   Here you can view which fields Clever is pulling for each record and field. In the below example:    1. If a teacher's email address was incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "Work Email Addr" field in Skyward 2. If a teacher is missing State\_teacher\_id, you will see that Clever is not currently pulling this data. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfCz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DIE) **Email or Username Length** - The default field length for many fields is 15 or 20 characters. If you notice any characters being cut off, you can increase the field length by navigating to Export File Builder > StaffC (or whichever file) > Edit Selected Fields > Length (change it) > Save. * * * ## Permissions In order to facilitate an automatic sync with Skyward, we recommend the following: 1. Create an individual SIS account only for Clever -- no one else should log in with the same credentials 2. Limit Clever's SIS account to read-only access The following document outlines the specific account permissions required for Skyward: Setup Guide * * * ## Default Field Mappings Below are the default field mappings for Skyward auto syncs that are managed by Clever. Please note: - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default, or not accessible to Clever. - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn what options are available.  - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. **Schools**

This article contains the following: 1\. [SchoolInsight Auto Sync Functionality](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#h1) 2\. [Customization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#h2) 3\. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#h3) 4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#h4) 5. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#h6) 6\. [Setting up an automated SFTP sync with SchoolInsight's OneRoster export](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#seven) IMPORTANT  This article is for districts that are already syncing using the Clever-managed sync.  If your district is new to Clever, [please see this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237#seven) for directions on how to configure an automated sync data using SchoolInsight's OneRoster export utility. ## SchoolInsight Auto Sync Functionality ✓ Syncs data from SchoolInsight every six hours, by exporting via the Query Builder in Reports ✓ Syncs all teacher records (including those marked as inactive), unless customization is requested **X** Cannot sync co-teachers at this time   * * * ## Customization - SchoolInsight syncs can be customized to run nightly instead of every 6 hours. - Syncs can also be customized to pull additional fields available through the Query Builder in Reports. - Clever can filter SchoolInsight exports to limit the schools, teachers, or students included in the sync. - To request customizations for your SchoolInsight sync, contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326?language=en_US).  * * * ## School Year Rollover By default, Clever exports data for the current site year in SchoolInsight. To sync data for a different site year, request assistance from [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326?language=en_US). If you receive this error message when changing to a new school year, it means that your enrollments have not been set for the new term, and our sync cannot access them: ![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-4.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMt8) Once the new enrollments are finalized, your sync will start running again.   * * * ## Troubleshooting If a record (student, teacher, section) is in Clever but data is missing or incorrect for the record (i.e. incorrect email, missing username), navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) Here, you can view which fields Clever is pulling for each record and field. In the example below:    1. If a teacher's email address was incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "email\_address" field in SchoolInsight 2. If a teacher is missing State\_teacher\_id, you will see that Clever is not currently pulling this data. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DI4) * * * ## Default field mappings Below are the default field mappings for SchoolInsight syncs that are managed by Clever. Please note: - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default or not accessible to Clever. - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn what options are available.  - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. ## Setting up an automated SFTP sync with SchoolInsight's OneRoster export If you're setting up your SchoolInsight sync for the first time, you can use SchoolInsight/TeacherEase's OneRoster Export tool to sync data following the instructions below: 1. Go to your Clever SFTP box using the credentials on your Sync Settings page and create a folder titled "oneroster11" in the folder with your username (ex: home/happy-bookcase-1111-oneroster11). If you have difficulty with this step, please reach out to [our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance. 2. From your SchoolInsight Home page, click on **Import/Export**. ![SchoolInsight home page Import/Export link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RGr8r)  3. Under **Enterprise Data Access**, click on **Scheduled Exports. ![Scheduled exports](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RGrqP)**  4. Click on **Create Scheduled Export**. 5. Select **OneRoster Export** in the drop down menu. ![OneRoster Export in drop down menu](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RGsEb)  6. Fill in the required fields of School, Description, Time to Run, Academic Year, and Alert Email, then select the **Custom SFTP Account** button. Enter the credentials from your Sync Settings page into the fields (SFTP Server Address, SFTP Port, Username, Password). ![SFTP settings fields for SchoolInsight](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RGtFV)  7. In the directory field, enter oneroster11 with no other characters. 8. You must create a name for the ZIP file. Ex: OneRosterYourDistrictName (i.e. OneRosterMeadowlarkSchools) 9. Select all checkboxes in the screenshot below for the export 10. Save your settings. ![Directory/File Name, and Checkboxes](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5U1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RGtnN)

title: PowerSchool Auto Sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#overview) 2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#setup)   3\. [Customizations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#custom) 4\. [Syncing Student Emails](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#syncstudentemails) 5. [Syncing PowerSchool Student Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#contacts) 6\. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#Header3) 7\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#trouble)         - [Incorrect data for a record](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#incorrect)         - [Updating credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#updating) 8. [Sync Errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#syncerrors2) 9\. [Default Field Mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#default_mappings) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WrkL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DHk) **Please Note:**      • **The legacy PowerSchool Auto Sync will be deprecated at the end of July 2026.** If you currently use this sync, you must upgrade to the PowerSchool Plugin sync to avoid disruptions. Please reference our article [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590?language=en_US).    • If your schools use ESchoolPLUS as your SIS, please refer to our article on [SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US). This article is intended for districts using PowerSchool as their SIS. * * * ## Overview ✓ Runs every four hours, by exporting via Direct Database Export (DDE) ✓ Syncs all students with an active enrollment status ("enroll\_status" = 0) ✓ Syncs teachers that are assigned to an active school and have an active staff status ("Status" = 1) **X** Student email addresses are not synced by default. Information on syncing student emails from PowerSchool can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001494?language=en_US).  **X** Cannot sync the Central Office (school\_id = 0) or any teachers assigned to this site **X** Cannot sync co-teachers. As an alternative, districts can manually add co-teachers to sections directly within Clever. More information can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748) on co-teachers.  **X** Cannot sync staff to Clever. Staff can be manually added to Clever using [these directions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547). ##   * * * ## Setup **PowerSchool + Gsuite Integration** The Clever-managed Auto Sync is not compatible with PowerSchool instances that use the [Gsuite integration](https://help.powerschool.com/t5/Learning-Third-Party-Apps/How-do-I-add-G-Suite-integration-to-my-existing-PowerSchool/ta-p/346) or any other secondary single sign-on (SSO) integrations. If your district utilizes Gsuite with PowerSchool or another SSO integration, please see our directions for setting up the [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590) or an [SFTP sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZnSWAW).  New to Clever? Please contact your district onboarding specialist for setup directions. If you have not yet connected with a district onboarding specialist, you can [sign up here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup). If you have an existing Clever account and would like to transition to the Clever-managed auto sync for PowerSchool, please contact our support team using support.clever.com for details on changing your sync type. Please note, the process of changing sync types can take 2-3 weeks. We highly recommend reviewing the conversion process as outlined [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049183691). * * * ## Customizations - Your sync can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every four hours, but the time of day that the syncs occur is not customizable. Syncs can always be initiated/forced at any time from your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab > Sync controls box > Sync Now button](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings). - Clever can filter exports from PowerSchool to limit the schools, teachers, or students included in the sync. Reach out to Clever Support if you would like to filter exports. - To request customizations or filtering for your PowerSchool sync, please submit a request to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/?language=en_US). * * * ## Syncing Student Emails For information on syncing student emails, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001494).   * * * ## Syncing PowerSchool Student Contacts Clever pulls student contact data from the Students table in the DDE in PowerSchool by default. For reference, here are the default contact fields: - Emerg Contact 1 - Emerg Contact 2 - Emerg Contact 3 - Emerg Phone 1 - Emerg Phone 2 - Emerg Phone 3 - Emerg 1 Ptype - Emerg 2 Ptype - Emerg 3 Ptype - Emerg 1 Rel - Emerg 2 Rel - Emerg 3 Rel However, if you're using PowerSchool version 12+, the student contact table resides in the Data Export Manager (DEM) and allows for unlimited student contacts.  In order for Clever to sync these contacts from the DEM, you will need to first grant Clever access to the DEM. You can find more information here: [PowerSchool v12+: Student Contacts](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045111611). Alternatively, you can upload student contacts directly to Clever. With this option, your district can maintain maximum control and flexibility over which contacts you'd like to populate in Clever. You can upload contacts directly on your district dashboard. They will populate in Clever within about 15 minutes and should be available within your connected applications the following day. You can view instructions on how to upload contacts here: [Manually Uploading Student Contacts to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047089771).   * * * ## School Year Rollover On July 2nd, Clever will begin syncing data for the next school year. If you would like to begin syncing enrollments for the new School Year before August, please request assistance from Clever Support. If you notice the previous academic year's data syncing alongside the current academic year data, please contact Clever Support requesting that the filters for TermID and DateLeft be updated for your configuration.    * * * ## Troubleshooting ### Missing Records  If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following in PowerSchool:

Record Type

Troubleshooting Steps

StudentsClever will only sync students that meet the following conditions: 
  • Record is active
  • enroll_status = 0
TeachersClever will only sync teachers that meet the following conditions: 
  • Record is active ("Active" box is checked)
  • Assigned to a school, not the district office (school_id = 0)
  • status = 1
SectionsClever will only sync sections that meet the following conditions:
  • Minimum of 1 active student enrolled
  • No_of_students > 0
  • TermID >= 3200 (please refer to TermID for current academic year)
StaffClever does not automatically sync records from PowerSchool to the Staff role in Clever.

There may be users such as administrators, custodians, and para-professionals who might not use PowerSchool directly but need access to applications through Clever. If those users are missing from your Clever data, there are two options to sync them to Clever.

Option A) Sync as teacher
To sync the user as a teacher, confirm they meet the record requirements as outlined above. 

Option B) Manually add to Clever using Custom Data
If the user requires access to teacher features or will need to be connected to a section, add the user as a Custom Teacher.  

If the user does not require teacher features and only will be using Clever for Single Sign-On (SSO), add the user as Custom Staff. 
### **Incorrect data for a record** First, check if the data is correct in PowerSchool. You can view the default field mappings for PowerSchool syncs [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202058173#default_mappings). If you have customized your sync, you can view your custom mappings by navigating to the [**Sync > Settings**](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in your Clever Dashboard. In the **Sync Mappings** box, click on **View field mappings. **In this example:****  1. If a teacher's email address was incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "Email\_addr" field in PowerSchool. 2. If a teacher is missing State\_teacher\_id, you will see that Clever is not currently pulling this data. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WrkL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DHu) ### **Updating credentials** If you need to update your PowerSchool credentials for any reason, you can do so on your [Sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) and simply input the updated credentials and click **Update**. ![Screenshot of sync page on Clever Dashboard showing where to update sync credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WrkL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062fZ2) * * * ## Sync Errors Below you can find solutions to common sync errors that may display in your Clever Dashboard. 

Error Message

Solution

“PowerSchool is not currently available at the URL provided. Please update the URL in your system settings page if necessary.”

Some common causes for URL errors include:

  • URL includes a typo
  • URL does not direct to a valid SIS login page
  • URL is not accessible from outside of your district’s network/VPN
  • URL access is blocked by firewall restrictions
  • The district needs to allowlist Clever's IP addresses 
You can update the PowerSchool URL on the Sync > Settings page.

“Invalid username/password specified. Please check SIS credentials on the settings page.”

Your district's PowerSchool login URL has changed or the credentials have expired, changed, or are no longer valid.

You can update your district's credentials on the Sync > Settings page. 

Here is an article to assist with correcting this error and get your district's sync back up and running: Sync Error: How do I resolve "Invalid username/password specified"?
“Account locked due to sign in attempts with incorrect password. Please contact your SIS administrator to remove this restriction."

In order to get your district's sync back up and running successfully, you can follow the steps in this article.

"The password on the SIS account needs to be reset. Please log in to PowerSchool to set a new password, then update SIS credentials on settings page."

Step 1: Log in to PowerSchool as an administrator and reset the password for the Clever access account. You can see the username you’ve shared with Clever on your Sync > Settings page. 

Step 2: In a new window, log in to PowerSchool with the Clever access account username and the new password.

Step 3: Enter the temporary password and create a new password.

Step 4: Update the SIS sync > Settings page in your Dashboard with the new password.

"No active enrollments found for the school term configured in Clever."

Clever will only syncs enrollments (CC) if the DateLeft is greater than 8/1 of the current year.

Verify that enrollments for your district meet this requirement. Once the enrollments meet this requirement, your district's sync will resume.

“Failed to export Sections: got error Alert: Cannot Export No sections selected Export: Back”

Confirm there is active section data in PowerSchool and that the schedules for the new school year have been published.

PowerSchool 20.11.0 requires updates to permissions for Clever to sync. Please update PowerSchool permissions using the directions found at https://support.clever.com/hc/articles/360054192432 to resume your Clever sync.

Permissions in PowerSchool must be updated for the sync to continue operating. Follow the instructions here to resolve.

Error processing sign in request. This might be caused by an IP restriction on this account. Please contact your SIS administrator to remove this restriction.

This error is caused by restrictive settings within your PowerSchool instance that are interfering with the sync. To resolve:

  • Login to your PowerSchool admin account and navigate to System > Security > Sign In Attempts Restrictions > View Disabled IP Addresses and make sure the following Clever IP addresses have been whitelisted:

    • 54.241.134.131

    • 50.18.217.135

    • 54.241.154.41

  • In PowerSchool, navigate to System > Security > Locked Accounts. Check the "Locked Accounts" list in PowerSchool to see if the Clever Sync account is listed. If so, they would need to remove the account from the restricted list.

  • If the sync issue persists after the above adjustments, check if there is a time restriction enabled for the Clever sync account restricting our system's access to a certain time. If so, this may cause intermittent sync issues because of the restriction. We recommend adjusting restrictions.

 

Clever data sync requires access to the Powerschool Administrator Sign In Page. Please contact your SIS administrator to restore the correct log in settings for your district

This error appears when SSO or MFA have been turned on for administrators in PowerSchool. The legacy PowerSchool Auto Sync is not compatible with PowerSchool instances that use the Gsuite integration or any other secondary single sign-on (SSO) integrations. To resolve this, districts have two options to resume their sync:

  • Temporarily turn off SSO and follow the steps here to begin the transition to the PowerSchool Plugin Sync.

title: Infinite Campus API Sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#h_01EHZEZF2XJN2MMVWZ04HEB6WS) ​ 2\. [Requirement: User (Portal) accounts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#portal_accounts) 3\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#setup) 4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#troubleshooting) ​ 5\. [School year/term rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#Header5) 6\. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#default) ## Overview This article provides information on the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of the Infinite Campus API sync.[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#ICurlupdate) If you utilize or plan to utilize this sync, please note: - Your system version - Clever pulls data from Infinite Campus via the OneRoster Provisioning API, which is free for school organizations. In order to sync your data through the OneRoster API you'll need to make sure your Infinite Campus is on version 1733 or higher.      •  School organizations using OneRoster provisioning prior to Campus 1733 are free to continue using it      •  School organizations that were not using OneRoster provisioning prior to Campus 1733 may contact Campus Support to have the functionality enabled - Which version of OneRoster you plan to utilize. [1edtech](https://www.1edtech.org/) (formerly IMS Global) has released the final version of the OneRoster v1.2 format. See below for information on how to set up your connection with OneRoster 1.2 or how to upgrade your existing connection.[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#ICurlupdate) The Infinite Campus API Sync: - Runs every six hours, by querying the OneRoster API - Syncs all students who are designated as "active today" (activeToday = 1) - Syncs all active staff members (employment.active = 1) - Supports co-teachers for sections (sectionInfo\_teacherPersonID, sectionInfo\_teacher2PersonID, etc) - Students and teachers need Infinite Campus Portal accounts in order to sync to Clever (see below) - Support custom field mappings (please contact Clever Support to set this up) - The available fields can be found [here](https://www.imsglobal.org/lis/imsOneRosterv1p0/imsOneRosterCSV-v1p0.html#_Toc421598318)  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DGw)  Please Note:** Infinite Campus OneRoster API sync cannot sync ell\_status, frl\_status, and iep\_status. They can be uploaded via custom data. Visit [this article for instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912).  SFTP upload of custom data is available to all schools. Please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automatic exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for automation scripting. * * * ## Requirement: User (Portal) accounts In order for a person to be accessible in the Infinite Campus OneRoster API (and thus synced to Clever) the person needs a User (Portal) account in Infinite Campus. For documentation on creating user accounts, please review [this documentation](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/user-account). To create user accounts in bulk, please review [this documentation](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/user-account-batch-wizard). To verify if a person has a user account, search for the user in Infinite Campus. If the person has a username, they have a user account. In the example below, "Amelkin, Federique" has a user account but "Freda, Irene" does not. As a result, "Freda, Irene" will not be accessible to Clever via the Infinite Campus OneRoster API. To add a user account in Infinite Campus, click **Add User.**  ![Example of a user with vs. without a Portal account in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RvZm) * * * ## Setup ### **1\. Obtain API credentials** In order to configure the API sync you'll first generate API credentials in Infinite Campus:  1. Navigate to **Instruction > Settings > Digital Learning Application Configuration** (or **System Administration > Learning Interoperability** in the Classic Navigation) 2. Click **Add Application**, scroll to the bottom, and click **Connect to Other Applications** 3. Enter **Clever** as the application name ![Screenshot of browsing for applications in Infinite Campus to add Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lvqY)  4. Click **Generate New OneRoster Connection** ![Screenshot of where to generate a new OneRoster connection in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lvpL)  5. For OneRoster version, select your OneRoster version > **Generate ![Screenshot of generating a new OneRoster connection in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GgB7Y)**   6. Share ClientID, Client Secret, Base URL and Token URL ![Screenshot of setting up OneRoster connection in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lvml) **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DGw) Please Note:** If you already have connected Infinite Campus to Clever and would like to move from OAuth 1.0 OneRoster v1.2 with OAuth 2.0, please go to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page and click the **Upgrade** button. Then, start at [step 4](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767#step4) in the directions above. After moving to OneRoster 1.2 with OAuth 2.0, we recommend deleting or disabling your old connection that used OAuth 1.0.   IMPORTANT Regarding Staff: Before upgrading, be sure to check that any non-instructional staff you wish to include are associated with one of the following roles in Infinite Campus: **counselor**, **districtadministrator**, **principal**, **siteadministrator**, **systemadministrator**, or **proctor**.  ![Sync Settings screen with arrow pointing to OneRoster 1.2 upgrade button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000CCyH) ### **2\. Change sync type of Clever account** If you already have a Clever account and are switching to the API sync, [please contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). In your message, please specify which version of OneRoster (v1.1 or v1.2) you plan to use. Our team will need to switch your account sync type before you can move forward. If you are just getting started with Clever, the Infinite Campus API sync will be the default when you choose your sync type for your account. You're free to move on to the next step! ### **3\. Enter API credentials in Clever** Once your account's sync type is the Infinite Campus API sync, please take the credentials for the API and enter them into the [Sync Settings page](https://schools.clever.com/settings/system) in your Clever Dashboard: - **Base** **URL**: Enter the base URL copied from Infinite Campus  - For OneRoster v1.2, the URL should look like this: https:///campus/api/oneroster/v1p2//ims/oneroster - For OneRoster v1.1, the URL should look like this:  https:///api/oneroster/v1p1//ims/oneroster/v1p1 - **Client ID:** Enter the Client ID copied from Infinite Campus - **Client Secret:** Enter the Client Secret copied from Infinite Campus - **Confirm Client Secret:** Enter the Client Secret copied from Infinite Campus   ### **4\. Sync** Once you input and save your sync credentials, the sync will automatically begin running and complete within approximately 30 minutes. You can also click **Sync Now** on the Sync Settings page to start a sync at any time.  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DGw) Please note:** Infinite Campus syncs can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every six hours, but the time of day that the syncs occur is not customizable. Syncs can always be initiated at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) * * * ## Troubleshooting ### **Common sync errors and troubleshooting steps** #### Below are some sync errors you may see in your Clever Dashboard. We recommend the following steps to resolve:

Error

Context and resolution

There are currently no active academic sessions in your Infinite Campus instance. Your sync will resume once your academic sessions become active again.

Your current school year has ended, but the new school year has not yet begun.

Clever begins pulling enrollments 21 days before the enrollments become active. If the start of school is more than 21 days away but you'd like to see your new school year enrollments syncing into Clever, please reach out to Clever Support and let us know the first day of school, as well as when you'd like your enrollments to begin syncing.

Invalid Key/Secret specified. Please check SIS credentials on settings page.The credentials you have provided to Clever on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page don't match the credentials in Infinite Campus. Please follow these setup instructions and ensure the URL, client ID, and client secret match in Infinite Campus and Clever.
InfiniteCampus API is not currently available at the URL provided. Please update the URL in your system settings page if necessary.

Either the URL you have provided to Clever doesn't match the URL in Infinite Campus, or the Infinite Campus API is currently unavailable.

  • You can wait and try using the Sync Now button on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page after a period of time to see if API becomes available. If the issue doesn't resolve try the steps below.
  • Please follow these setup instructions and ensure the URL in Infinite Campus matches the URL in Clever.

Invalid sync credentials for Infinite Campus. Please update the sync credentials.

Or

Invalid username/password specified. Please check SIS credentials on settings page.

This error most commonly occurs if an API certificate has expired. To resolve:

  • Please confirm if your Clever API certificate status is valid (green).

  • To do so, navigate to User Security > OAuth Management > OAuth Client Management. The location may vary based on your SIS setup. Please reach out to Infinite Campus directly if you can’t locate the certificate status in your SIS.

  • If the status is red, please update the token expiration date and status. Once updated and green in Infinite Campus, update your web access URL, consumer key, and secret on the Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page.

Invalid API URL for Infinite Campus. Please update the Web Access URL in sync settings.

This error commonly occurs if the API certificate is generated for the wrong sync or OAuth type or the certificate information is input incorrectly. To resolve:

  • Navigate to your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page. Confirm if your sync type is set to Infinite Campus OneRoster 1.1 or 1.2 at the top of the page.

  • Review your Base URL. Confirm that the correct version of the api is referenced in the URL (v1p1 or v1p2).

  • If your sync type and Base URL do not match either:

    • Contact Clever Support to change your sync type on our backend

    • Regenerate your API certificate with the correct OneRoster version selected

  • If your sync type and Base URL do match, please confirm that you have entered the web access URL, consumer key, and consumer secret correctly:

    • Clever > Infinite Campus

    • Web Access URL > Base URL

    • Consumer Key > Client ID

    • Consumer Secret > Client Secret

  • If you have confirmed your sync settings are entered correctly, please ensure the following Clever IPs are allow-listed in your network:

    • 54.241.134.131

    • 50.18.217.135

    • 54.241.154.41

  • If the sync error persists, please contact Clever Support

URL must start with https://

Please confirm your URL starts with https://.

You may want to follow these setup instructions and ensure the URL in Infinite Campus matches the URL in Clever.

### **Missing records** If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following:  

Record Type

Troubleshooting

Student
  • Must have an active Infinite Campus User (Portal) account
  • Check that the student's Enrollment = Active
  • Must have a username populated in the useraccount.personID field in Infinite Campus
  • Make sure the student's enrollment start and end dates are in the active school year
  • The student's enrollment must not be flagged as a no show
  • The student must have person and current identity records
  • Make sure the student has a valid grade level designation
  • The following data items associated with the student’s enrollment must not be marked external LMS exclude: School, Calendar, Schedule Structure, Enrollment, and Grade Level
Student Contacts
  • Must have Infinite CampusUser (Portal) account
  • Also have to be listed as Type = Guardian
  • Each guardian must have the "Portal" checkbox checked under their student's relationship tab
Teacher
  • Must have an active Infinite Campus User (Portal) account
  • Check that EmploymentAssignment = Active
  • Check that the District Assignment start and end dates are valid
  • Assignment must be flagged as Teacher (Users > Status / Role)

Teachers are associated with schools based on their sections. If a teacher does not have any assigned sections and needs to be associated with multiple schools, Clever recommends syncing the user as "Staff". Please see the requirements below to sync a user as "Staff" from Infinite Campus. As an alternative, a user can also be added to Clever and associated to multiple schools using Clever's custom staff feature.
StaffThe user's District Assignment in Infinite Campus must meet all the following requirements:
  • Start Date and End Date are inclusive of current date
  • Username field must be populated
  • The record must have an email address
  • At least one flag other than 'Teacher' checked. 'Teacher' can be checked. (If 'Teacher' is checked, both a teacher and staff account will be provisioned for the user.)
  • A user must be associated with one of the following roles to be considered Staff: counselor, districtadministrator, principal, siteadministrator, systemadministrator, or proctor
School
  • The API sync only pulls the Primary master schedule, so if you have more than one master schedule at a site, each must be created as their own school instance
  • Check active status: District.Inactive !=1 or District.Inactive is null
Section
  • Check active status: Trial.Active=1 + Course.Active=1 + SchoolYear.Active=1
  • Check whether the section's term is current
  • Section must have a primary teacher and there must be at least one student enrolled
To **prevent** a record from syncing, ensure it doesn't meet all the criteria listed above for its record type. If the record (student, teacher, section) is in Clever but data is missing or incorrect for the record (i.e. incorrect email, missing username), navigate to the [**Sync > Settings**](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in your Clever Dashboard. Under **Sync Controls**, click **[View defaults.](https://assets.clever.com/documents/autosyncs/infinitecampusapi.pdf)** Here you can view which fields Clever is pulling for each record and field. In the below example:    1. If a teacher's email address was incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "contact.email" field in Infinite Campus 2. If a teacher is missing State\_teacher\_id, you will see that Clever does not have this data available to us via the OneRoster API. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  * * * ## School year/term rollover The Infinite Campus API sync requires that students be active in order to be synced through the API. Once a school year ends, students are no longer active in Infinite Campus. This causes the synced data to no longer include enrollments or student files. You may see the following error in your Dashboard: _"Encountered zero students data"_.  Once students and other record types are marked "Active" in Infinite Campus for the next school year, the sync will resume as expected. Alternatively, Clever will pull data 21 days prior to the beginning of the school organization's next active academic session. For example, if school begins on August 22nd, Clever will pull the upcoming data on August 1st. To preserve access for your users between school years, Clever recommends that you [put your sync on pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507) during the summer to prevent deletions.   * * * ## Default field mappings **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Infinite Campus OneRoster v1.2 has released a UI checkbox that when checked "Legal Names" are used over preferred names. When not checked, preferred names will be sent to Clever. To access this navigate to: Digital App Configuration > Select Clever app > Edit > Connection Configuration in Infinite Campus. Below are the default field mappings for Infinite Campus OneRoster API syncs that are managed by Clever. If you'd like to customize your field mappings, please contact Clever Support.   - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default, or not accessible to Clever. Infinite Campus determines what data to surface via the API. Learn more about Infinite Campus' data models below:  - [OneRoster 1.1 Data Models](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/oneroster-11-data-models) - [OneRoster 1.2 Data Models](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/oneroster-12-data-models) - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn what options are available.  - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. This is common for: Grade, FRL\_Status, ELL\_Status, and IEP\_Status. - If you want to sync data that isn’t surfaced to Clever, you can upload the data to Clever via SFTP as custom (extension) fields. Learn more about this [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912). ### Schools

title: Aeries Auto Sync
text:
This article contains the following:  1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#overview)  2. [Setting Up your Aeries Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#one)  3. [Aeries Auto Sync Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#two)​  4. [Customization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#three) ​  5. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#four) ​  6. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#five)  7. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016#six) ## Overview This article contains information on the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of the Aeries API sync. The Aeries API sync: ✓ Runs every four hours by querying the Aeries API ✓ Pulls all active students, teachers, and schools (“InactiveStatusCode” = blank) ✓ Syncs co-teachers by pulling the TeacherNumber1, TeacherNumber2, and TeacherNumber3 fields from the Sections table ✓ Supports Flex Scheduling (For schools using Flex Scheduling in Aeries, only a Staff record will be required) * * * ## Setting up your Aeries Auto Sync ### Introduction Clever allows the student data in Aeries to automatically sync with authorized applications. This eliminates the need for manual CSV transfers or complicated SFTP uploads. To sync data, Clever needs access to the Aeries API. The best practice when using Clever is to create a new Aeries API certificate for the Clever sync. ### Create an API Certificate for Clever 1\. Log in to your Aeries administrator account for the current school year. 2\. Select **Security** > **API Security** from the menu on the left. 3\. Add a new certificate named **Clever**. 4\. Grant read permissions to the following items in the Student Data and Scheduling tables: - Student Data - Special Programs - Contacts, Class Schedules/History - Enrollment History - Test Scores - Teacher Data - Staff Data - Master Schedule - Course Data - Classes - Schools - Terms. 5\. Save the certificate. 6\. Click **Display Certificate Details?** Then copy/paste your API certificate into the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) of your Dashboard.   ![Aeries screen with steps highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1gX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005QWGc)   * * * ## Aeries Auto Sync Requirements For the Aeries Auto Sync to work properly, your setup and user data must meet these requirements: - Your SIS must be connected to the internet. - Teachers in your district must have a Staff (STF) record in Aeries and be linked to a section to appear as teachers in Clever. - For teachers, InactiveStatusCode must be blank (TCH.TG / STF.TG = blank). Any value in this field will prevent the record from syncing.  * * * ## Customization - Aeries syncs can be customized to run nightly, instead of every 4 hours, but the time of day isn't customizable. Syncs can be initiated at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) - Syncs can also be customized to pull additional fields available through the Schools, Students, Courses, Sections, Staff, or Teachers tables. - Clever can filter Aeries exports to limit the schools included in the sync. - Some school organizations create schools without master schedules - or schedule students without placing them in sections (typically elementary schools).  Because Clever requires sections to process data, our system can automatically create sections for these students based on their teacher. Please submit a request to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) with a list of your schools (name and school number), and we will program our system to create sections in these schools. - To request customizations or filtering for your Aeries sync, request assistance from [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1gX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PwXYH)    Please note:** If you’d like to sync additional data to Clever, you can do so via our automated custom data sync for auto sync districts and schools. Please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for access to your Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automatic exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for automation scripting. * * * ## School Year Rollover Clever will begin syncing new school year data when summer school ends and the Sections (SEC) and MasterSchedule (MST) tables are active and available. To activate these tables, schedules must be copied over (Scheduling Process > Functions > Copy Scheduling Results to SEC & MST). Additionally, Clever filters out inactive enrollments. We use the enrollment's “DateEnded” field from the Aeries API to determine if an enrollment is expired, or inactive. An enrollment is considered inactive if the current date is one day past the "DateEnded" date. Of note, a section with no active enrollments in the Aeries API will appear on the Data sources > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync page as an error and won't sync successfully to your Clever instance. * * * ## Troubleshooting ### **Common sync errors and resolution steps** Below are some sync errors you may see in your Clever Dashboard. We recommend the following steps to resolve.

Issue or error

Resolution

There are no active enrollments in Aeries. This may be because your active calendar year has ended, in which case your sync will resume when the Sections (SEC) and MasterSchedule (MST) tables are active and available for the new school year.

  • Please confirm that rollover has been completed and published for the new school year. Ensure the MST tables (for each school) and CAR records (for all affected students) are available.

  • Once confirmed, trigger a re-sync with Clever on your Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab using the Sync Now button.

  • If you have confirmed enrollments are active for the new year and the issue persists, please contact Aeries support.

  • Must have InactiveStatusCode set to null (STU.TG = blank). Any value in this field will prevent the record from syncing. 

Duplicate sections after enabling Master Schedules

If you notice duplicate sections after enabling Master Schedules for specific school sites, please reach out to Clever Support to confirm we didn't previously enable the customization setting that creates sections for your school.
### **Missing Records** If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following:  

Record Type

Troubleshooting

 Student
  • Must have InactiveStatusCode set to null (STU.TG = blank). Any value in this field will prevent the record from syncing. 
  • Make sure the records don't have a "Leave Date"
 TeacherTeachers at your district must have a Staff (STF) record in Aeries and be tied to a section to show up as a teacher in Clever.     

  • InactiveStatusCode must be blank (any value in this field will prevent the record from syncing)

  • Must have all required fields on the teachers/staff table

  • Make sure the records don't have a "Leave Date"

Please note that any non-teaching staff assigned to sections in Aeries will automatically be associated with the Default District Office entity in Clever. They will still be connected to all associated sections, regardless of their primary school designation in Clever.

 Staff
  • Clever doesn't automatically sync records from Aeries to the Staff role in Clever.

There may be users such as administrators, secretaries, and para-professionals who might not use Aeries directly but need access to applications through Clever. If those users are missing from your Clever data, there are two options to sync them to Clever.

Option A) Sync as teacher

To sync the user as a teacher, assign them to a section.

Option B) Manually add to Clever using Custom Data

If the user requires access to teacher features or will need to be connected to a section, add the user as a Custom Teacher. 

If the user doesn't require teacher features and only will be using Clever for Single Sign-On (SSO), add the user as Custom Staff. 

 Sections
  •  In order for a section to sync, the school must have a master schedule. If a school doesn't use master schedules, Clever can auto-generate sections based on teacher/student assignments. Contact Clever Support if you would like this feature enabled. 
  • A section with no active enrollments won't sync to Clever. We use the enrollment's “DateEnded” field from the Aeries API to determine if an enrollment is expired or inactive. An enrollment is considered inactive if the current date is one day past the "DateEnded" date.
**Incorrect Records** If the record (student, teacher, section) is in Clever but data is missing or incorrect for the record (i.e. incorrect email, missing username), navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) in your Clever Dashboard. Under **Sync Controls**, click on [View defaults.](https://assets.clever.com/documents/autosyncs/aeries.pdf) Here, you can view which fields Clever is pulling for each record and field. In the example below:  1. If a student's email address is incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "STU.SEM" field in Aeries. 2. If a student is missing FRL\_status, you'll see that Clever doesn't pull this data by default. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e1gX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pDRHy) Some additional common errors are: 

Record Type

Error

Troubleshooting

StudentsIncorrect GradeIf a student's grade isn't correct in Clever, please contact Clever Support and provide the grade designation in Aeries and the desired value in Clever. Our team will update your configuration to translate the value accurately.  
StudentsMissing demographic dataIf your account is missing ELL_status, FRL_status, or IEP_status, please contact Clever Support. Our team can enable exporting these fields. 
TeachersIncorrect EmailThe email must be correct in the following three locations:
- the Teacher table
- the Staff table
- the Security Table/User Record (UGN Table)
SectionsMissing SectionsSchools must be on a MasterSchedule for sections to export to Clever. 

If a school doesn't use MasterSchedule, please contact Clever Support and provide the site's SchoolCode (LOC.CD) so Clever can generate sections for the school. 
* * * ## Default field mappings Below are the default field mappings for Aeries syncs that are managed by Clever. Please note: - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default, or not accessible to Clever. - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn what options are available.  - If a field isn't coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. This is common for grade, FRL\_Status, ELL\_Status, and IEP\_Status. - Clever generates section ID using the following formula: - SchoolCode + "S" + SectionNumber (if master schedule) - SchoolCode + "T" + TeacherNumber (if no master schedule) ### Schools
