title: Clever-managed Sync: How do I push a manual sync with my SIS?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004747027#header1)  
2\. [How do I push a manual sync with Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004747027#header2)

## Overview

If you have missing or incorrect data in Clever, you may want to have a data sync from your student information system (SIS) to Clever occur sooner than the scheduled time.  Pushing a sync can help resolve data errors faster than waiting for the next sync.  Learn more about manually starting a sync based on your sync type below.  
 

* * *

## How do I push a manual sync with Clever?

If your school organization utilizes a [Clever-Managed Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973), you can manually initiate a sync with your SIS from your Clever Dashboard.

If your school organization has a [SIS-Managed Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973), you'll need to contact your SIS rep for information on initiating a manual sync to Clever.

If your school organization manages an [SFTP sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US), you can trigger a sync whenever you like by uploading a new set of files to your SFTP directory. Uploading too many times in a short period may trigger a sync upload error.   
  
For a Clever-Managed Sync, navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings), click the **Sync Now** option under Sync Controls, and your SIS will start syncing with Clever. Syncs typically take around 10-15 minutes to process but could take up to 60 minutes depending on Clever's sync traffic, the number of updates to be processed, and the time of year (e.g. Back to School season is often busier).

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cdd3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000mCg9V)  Please note:** If your sync is paused, you won't see the Sync Now button. You'll need to clear the pause before you'll be able to sync data.

![Screenshot with sync now button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cdd3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000DJDOg)

  
After about 15 minutes, check your [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page to see if the sync has been completed. The sync notification will say **Successful** once the sync has been completed.  If it has completed, you'll see up-to-date information about your most recent sync as well as any data warnings that might need to be addressed! 

![Screenshot of a successful sync](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cdd3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000DJXjx)   
  
For sync errors, please visit the following articles for guidance: [Clever Sync Errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/global-search/sync%20error?language=en_US).

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Active Directory - Claims Rules
text:
This article contains the following: 1\.  [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215176617#h_73937e35-5beb-464e-b6fb-09ad789458f9) 2. [How do I use claims rules?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215176617#h_0b0fa0fb-6c9f-41f3-b90a-d03342830537) 3. [Defining the Field in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215176617#h_efeebee6-d407-468c-8755-6b064e7d03ca) 4. [Applying the claims rules to single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215176617#h_19be9f73-02f9-4591-b39d-f04e5f12727f) ## Overview When users sign in to their Identity Provider to use single sign-on (SSO), the identity provider sends us a piece of data and tells us which field in Clever contains matching data. Using this, we can identify the user and give them access to their applications.    Claims rules define which attributes are sent to Clever from the identity provider and which fields Clever should use to perform the match. You will need to find a claims rule for each user type (e.g. students, teachers, staff, etc.) that you want to use single sign-on (SSO) for.   ![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmcf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D9g)**Please note:** Claims rules are only necessary for Active Directory, Lenovo Stoneware / webNetwork, LDAPS, and Office 365 / Entra ID. ## How do I use claims rules? **Picking the right identity provider attribute**   First, look at the data in your Clever account - you can click on a record in the [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) to view all the information that’s currently synced in Clever.   Next, compare the data in Clever to the data attributed to users in your identity provider (IdP). Are there matches? In order for users to be able to log in, the data in the IdP attribute and the data in the field in Clever must match exactly.   Additionally, make sure you’re picking something that’s unique across all users. If a claims rule matches multiple users, Clever won't know which user to match it against and the login attempt will fail.   If you can find a match, great! That’s the attribute you should use for that user type. If not, you’ll want to sync additional data from your SIS in order to be able to create a match.   ### **Defining the Field in Clever** Once you’ve found a match, you’ll want to take note of the field in Clever it matches to. What’s the name of the field in the left column of the user's Detail view? Make a note of it! **![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmcf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Extension fields can't be used as an option at this time. The field in Clever is expressed in the claims rule “clever..”. Here are a few commonly used fields:  

Students

  • clever.student.email
  • clever.student.sis_id
  • clever.student.student_number
  • clever.student.credentials.district_username

Teachers

  • clever.teacher.email
  • clever.teacher.sis_id
  • clever.teacher.teacher_number
  • clever.teacher.credentials.district_username

Staff
(Previously: School Admins)

  • clever.staff.email
  • clever.staff.staff_id
  • clever.staff.credentials.district_username
  • clever.school_admin.email (outdated)
  • clever.school_admin.staff_id (outdated)
  • clever.school_admin.credentials.district_username (outdated)

District Clever Admins

  • clever.district_admin.email
You’ll notice that users share multiple fields - to match on the same field for multiple user types, you can use ‘any’ in place of the user type to try matching against all user types. - clever.**any**.email - clever.**any**.sis\_id - clever.**any**.credentials.district\_username ## Applying the claims rules to single sign-on (SSO) Click the link below to jump to Instant Login setup for your identity provider!   - [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576) - [Lenovo Stoneware / webNetwork](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215140667) - [LDAPS](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387) - [Office 365 / Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889768)

title: Managed Auto Sync Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202042973#Overview)  
2\. [Clever-Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202042973#Clever-Managed%20Auto%20Sync)  
3\. [SIS-Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202042973#SIS-Managed%20Auto%20Sync)

## Overview

Clever offers two types of "Managed Auto Syncs" that school organizations can utilize to securely sync (i.e., transfer) rostering data from their student information system (SIS), management information system (MIS), or student management system (SMS) to Clever. Clever Admins can then selectively share specific data with their school organization's connected learning applications. This article will detail the types of Managed Auto Syncs that Clever offers.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YXsn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If your SIS, MIS, or SMS is not listed below, or you would prefer to manually upload data, please visit this article for information on how to get started: [Which sync type should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202289278?language=en_US)

* * *

##   
Clever-Managed Auto Syncs

###   
**How does it work?**

Clever-Managed Auto Syncs are automated daily syncs primarily managed by Clever. These syncs securely transfer rostering data from your SIS, MIS, or SMS to Clever. With these types of syncs:

-   Clever integrates with your data system to regularly export data and securely transfer it to Clever. 
-   Once data is synced to Clever, Clever Admins can selectively share that data with connected learning applications.
-   The Clever Support team manages these types of syncs, so minimal help, if any, is needed from your SIS, MIS, or SMS provider.
-   Clever does not charge for Clever-Managed Auto Syncs!

### **List of Clever-managed Auto Sync SISes:**

-   [Aeries](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203005016)
-   [Arbor](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001718)
-   [Blackbaud](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001544)
-   [Bromcom](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001737)
-   ICON
-   [Infinite Campus API](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767?language=en_US)
-   [PowerSchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173)
-   [PowerSchool Plugin](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590?language=en_US)
-   [Skyward](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
-   [Skyward API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028?language=en_US)

### **Can I customize what rostering data is synced to Clever from our SIS, MIS, or SMS?**

In many cases, when setting up your Clever-Managed Auto Sync, the Clever Support team can assist with adding various filters or mappings to ensure the data in Clever reflects your school organization's needs. We can often remove unwanted fields or include additional fields in the sync. However, there are some limitations regarding how much data we can filter or how many fields we can map.  
  
There are also ways for Clever Admins to determine which fields (e.g., student number, teacher email, staff ID) Clever should map to from your SIS, MIS, or SMS so that the data populates correctly in Clever. This can be done from the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) [](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings)page.   
  
Please note that there are cases where Clever Support will need to map specific fields on behalf of your schools. These fields will _**not**_ show the option to **Edit** under the **Actions** column. Please contact Clever Support for more information or if a field is unavailable for mapping.  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YXsn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZykR)

###   
**What are the next steps?**

If your school organization is interested in setting up a Clever-Managed Auto Sync, the first step would be to identify if your data management system (SIS, MIS, or SMS) allows for this. Please see the [Systems that support Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US#Which%20Student%20Information%20Systems%20\(SIS\)%20support%20a%20Managed%20Auto%20Sync?) section of this article for more information. If your SIS, MIS, or SMS is not listed, an alternative option would be to set up a secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) sync type to securely transmit data to Clever or to manually upload data to Clever via the [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page.   
  
Please visit this article for more information: [Which sync type should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202289278?language=en_US)  
 

* * *

##   
SIS-, MIS-, SMS-Managed Auto Syncs

###   
**How does it work?**

For SIS-, MIS, and SMS-Managed Auto Syncs, Clever partners directly with the school organization's data management provider to offer an automated sync option that the school organization's SIS, MIS, or SMS provider would primarily manage. 

-   Clever does not require credentials or access to your system directly. 
-   To take advantage of these SIS-, MIS-, and SMS-managed syncs, please select your system from the Clever [sign-up page](https://www.getclever.com/districtsignup/) when requesting a new Clever account.
-   Clever will then provide instructions directing you on how to configure your sync to Clever.
-   Clever doesn't charge school organizations to use this sync type or any other aspects of our core platform. We don't have insight into costs (if any) charged by a SIS, MIS, or SMS provider to configure an automated SFTP export to a vendor.

###   
**List of SIS-managed Auto Sync SISes:**

-   Arbor
-   Ascender
-   Illuminate
-   SchoolInsight
-   ADAM
-   Aspen
-   Beehively
-   Chalkable iNOW (formerly STI)
-   Classe365
-   Educate
-   Edupoint Synergy
-   eSchoolData
-   FACTS SIS
-   Focus SIS
-   Genius SIS
-   go.edustar
-   Harmony
-   iPASS
-   JMC
-   JCampus
-   Jupiter iO
-   Lumen AXSIS
-   Mersys Campus
-   MiDataHub
-   MiStar
-   MMS
-   OASIS
-   OnCourse Systems for Education
-   ProgressBook (formally DASL for Ohio)
-   Q
-   QuickSchools
-   RDS
-   Realtime Inc.
-   Rediker
-   FACTS SIS - RenWeb
-   SalamanderSoft
-   SAM Spectra
-   SchoolBrains
-   SchoolSpeak
-   School Pathways
-   School Time
-   Sycamore
-   TEAMS
-   TxEIS
-   Tyler Schoolmaster
-   Tyler v9
-   Tyler v10

###   
**Can I customize what roster data is synced?**

With SIS-, MIS, and SMS-managed syncs, Clever has little insight into how data is filtered and exported from your data management system, so while we can provide guidance, we cannot implement changes or, in most cases, troubleshoot beyond reviewing the files we receive. To resolve any issues, please contact your SIS, MIS, or SMS representative (or whoever configured the Clever SFTP export) directly for support.  
 

###   
**What are the next steps?**

After creating your Clever account, please visit your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page for instructions on how to activate your SIS-, MIS-, SMS-Managed Auto Sync.

* * *

## **Related articles:**

-   [What is Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202000976?language=en_US)
-   [Sign up for Clever here!](https://www.getclever.com/districtsignup/)
-   [Which sync type should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278?language=en_US)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): What is SSO?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Staff Setup - Syncing staff from Active Directory (AD)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360028781552#h_e073f050-c221-42c0-a841-3eeded389021)  
2. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360028781552#requirements)  
3. [Active Directory staff sync preparations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360028781552#Header2)  
4. [Setting up the sync to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360028781552#Header3)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360028781552#h_01EKJNKV5XS8BSXE39GVW1CG5H)

##   
Overview

This article is an overview of how Clever admins can set up an automated sync with the district’s Active Directory server to sync non-instructional staff and school admins to Clever as **staff** users.

This sync between Active Directory and Clever will supplement any existing syncs between the district’s SIS and Clever and will _**only**_ be used to sync non-instructional staff users (i.e. non-teaching staff). While the Active Directory sync will supplement data from the existing sync, once enabled, it will be the only method for syncing staff to Clever, aside from Custom Data.  
 

* * *

##   
Requirements

1.  Your district utilizes an Active Directory server to manage non-instructional staff and school admins.
2.  The Active Directory Sync toggle has been enabled from your [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) tab.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D89) Once the Active Directory Sync toggle is enabled, non-instructional staff and school admins cannot be created through a manual CSV upload. Clever will thereafter ignore any _staff.csv_ files that may continue to be uploaded by the school organization. However, the [custom staff feature](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) will continue to work for individual account creation. Staff already uploaded to Clever via CSV will be preserved, and migrated to custom staff. 

* * *

##   
Active Directory staff sync preparations

**Staff sharing rules in Clever**

If you already have non-instructional staff in Clever, make sure your staff and school admin sharing permissions are in a good place for all of your district’s connected applications, so we’re not unintentionally sharing new users en masse.

For additional information, please visit:  [Staff Setup: Sharing staff with applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360031060451?language=en_US)

  
**Existing staff in Clever**

If your district has already synced staff to Clever via a _staff.csv_ or _admins.csv_ file, please make sure their 'Staff\_id' stays the same if you'd like to preserve their historical data in Clever. This field is the key identifier for staff members in Clever so, if an existing user is synced from Active Directory with a different 'Staff\_id', a new account will be created for them in Clever. 

  
**Create a new bind account**

Create a new bind account with _read-only_ permissions that Clever can use to query your LDAP server. Once created, take note of the account's _**userDN**_ (i.e. users distinguishedName) and password found in the Attribute Editor - you’ll need that for setup!

  
**Review your OU structure in Active Directory**

Identify whether classroom teachers are grouped in Organizational Units (OUs) together with non-instructional staff members.

-   If not, that’s great! Take note of the OU names that include only non-instructional staff.
-   If so, there’s a risk of creating additional user accounts in Clever for those who are already in Clever as teachers! This means that users would have both a teacher and a staff account in Clever. To counter this:
    1.  We suggest bulk-adding an extension attribute to staff member’s profiles that would distinguish these two staff types from one another in your server (e.g. extensionAttribute = **staff** if non-instructional and **teacher** if instructional).
    2.  Once the extension attribute is added, the attribute can be used in an LDAP filter during step 2 of the setup below - The staff query.

**Create a one-time school mapping CSV file**

We need a one-time upload to map existing schools in Clever to school names in Active Directory. The file should have two columns:

-   **School\_sis\_id** (as it appears in Clever)
-   **Active\_directory\_name** (should correspond to the field your query will be pulling for **school)**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D8E)

You can locate the school\_sis\_id or school\_id in Clever on the school's profile page:

![Screenshot of where to find school\_id](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000007qpon)

* * *

##   
Setting up the sync to Clever

-   Navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) tab
-   Toggle on **Active Directory Sync** to reveal a new setup tab 
-   Select **set up active directory sync** to configure the Active Directory sync in 4 steps

         ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lw1B)

-   **Step 1: Configure the connection** between Clever and your district’s Active Directory server by entering your district’s LDAP URL and port, certificate fingerprints, and the users DN and password for the read-only bind account set up in preparation. All of these steps are required to establish the connection. 
-   **Step 2: Add staff queries** to designate the OUs from which Clever should sync staff user accounts. Districts can set up multiple queries if needed, as well as set up filters to scope down the information pulled. For help writing your LDAP filter, see [this article](https://ldap.com/ldap-filters/). An **example** is shown below:  
    ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lvxj)  
    During this step, you’ll also indicate which Active Directory user attributes should map to the available Clever staff fields. 
-   **Step 3: Optionally configure a sync for staff** [extension/custom fields](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) such as security group, building code, etc. The Clever extension field will always begin with ‘ext.’
-   **Step 4: Upload your prepared school mapping CSV** so we will be able to link the existing school _sis\_ids_ in your district’s Clever account with the appropriate school names in Active Directory.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D8T)**Please note:** _If you'd like to add staff with multiple school associations in Clever, you can select a field in Active Directory that contains multiple values separated by commas. As long as these values are contained in the school mapping CSV from step 4, our system will parse these out and assign the staff user accordingly to the multiple schools within Clever._

  
After the sync is configured and a first sync runs, you can view the results on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data > Active Directory sync page](https://schools.clever.com/active-directory-sync). Syncs will run automatically every 24 hours but can be triggered from the Active Directory tab as needed. Like your normal SIS [Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) report, you can track staff account creations, updates, deletions, and errors from this tab.   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000artp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D8Y) _By default, if a user account from Active Directory does not have a school association, Clever will assign the staff member to the Clever-generated 'Default District Office' school site. To prevent this, please populate a school in the user attribute chosen for the staff school field mapping in step 2 above._ 

* * *

## FAQs

**If syncing staff from Active Directory is enabled, what will happen to existing staff accounts?**

-   If enabled, existing staff accounts that were uploaded via a staff.csv will be preserved and will be transitioned to **Custom Staff**. These records will display under [Data sources > Custom data > Staff tab](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/staff)**.** All custom staff that were created prior to Active Directory being enabled will also be preserved. 

**If syncing staff from Active Directory is disabled, what will happen to existing staff accounts?**

-   If disabled, any staff added to Clever via Active Directory will be removed from Clever upon the next sync with your district's student information system (SIS). The only staff that will remain in Clever are those that were created as Custom Staff: [Data sources > Custom data > Staff tab.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/staff)

**If syncing staff from Active Directory, can I manually add custom staff?**

-   Yes. If Active Directory sync is enabled, staff can still be manually created by navigating to **Support tools > Custom data > Staff**

**How often does the Active Directory staff sync run?**

-   Once daily, but on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) tab, you'll have the option to manually sync data at any time if you need a user to be updated immediately.

**What happens during a sync pause if I am syncing staff from Active Directory?**

-   Your staff will continue to sync from Active Directory even during a pause.

**What should I do if a staff user is not syncing via the Active Directory sync and is missing in Clever?**

-   Please be sure to review your OUs to ensure that the staff user is in an OU that is set to sync to Clever. If you've confirmed the user is in a selected OU, please contact support.

**Can I sync staff via Entra ID instead of Active Directory?**

-   Clever does not currently provide instructions or support for syncing staff users via Entra ID.

title: PowerSchool v12+: Student Contacts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045111611#Overview)  
2\. [Enabling Access to Data Export Manager (DEM)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045111611#EnablingAccessToDEM)  
3\. [Enabling Page-Level Permissions to Data Export Manager (DEM)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045111611#permissions)  
4\. [Default Student Contact Fields for v12+](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045111611#defaultfields)

 

## Overview

PowerSchool version 12+ now supports unlimited student contacts. These contacts no longer live on the Students table in Direct Data Export. As a result, Clever requires additional permissions to sync these contacts.    
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001Lf8&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Enabling the sync with PowerSchool v12 contacts will result in previously added student contacts being deleted from your Clever account. Additionally, if the district's data sync is on pause, new student contacts will not be reflected in your District Dashboard until a successful sync occurs after the pause ends.

 

* * *

##   
Process

1.  Enable access to Data Export Manager (DEM) for the Clever PowerSchool account.
2.  Enable page-level permissions to Data Export Manager (DEM).
3.  [Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) to enable the new contacts export for your account. 

 

* * *

##   
Enabling Access to Data Export Manager (DEM)

1.  From the main menu, click **System** on the left sidebar
2.  Under Security, click **Users by Group**
3.  Select the Clever access account from the list of users
4.  Go to the **Admin Access and Roles** tab
5.  Click the edit button (pencil icon) for the role for District Office (Home School)
6.  Enable Data Export Manager Access for this role by choosing **Data Export Manager/Export/Edit Access (No Group Defined)**
7.  Click **Submit**

 

* * *

##   
Enabling Page-Level Permissions to Data Export Manager (DEM)

1\. Navigate to **System > Security > Access to Page Permissions** (/admin/security/changepageaccesspriv.html). Set **Turn modify permissions = On** and click **Submit** 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001Lf8&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkW3)

2\. Navigate to the Data Export Manager (DEM) page under **Functions > Importing and Exporting > Data Export Manager** (admin/datamgmt/exportmanager.action). Click **Modify access privileges**  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001Lf8&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkXk)  
  
3. Find the security group assigned to Clever and set **Level of Access** to **Full**. Click **Submit**

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001Lf8&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkY9)  
  
4. Navigate to **System > Security > Access to Page Permissions** (/admin/security/changepageaccesspriv.html). Set **Turn modify permissions = Off** and click **Submit** ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001Lf8&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkWX)  
  
**Final Step:** Once you have enabled the above permissions, please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) to enable the new contacts export for your account. We will enable this feature and reply via email when this process is complete.  
 

* * *

## Default Student Contact Fields for v12+ 

Once the process is complete, the student contacts will be pulled from the default fields listed below:  
  
![Image of the PowerSchool default contact fields for v12+](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001Lf8&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005SpVk)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Active Directory - Password Recovery
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025854292#overview)  
2\. [District Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025854292#setup)

IMPORTANT:  This Password Recovery feature is no longer available for new configurations. We have released an improved password recovery feature, and you can find details here: [Clever Admin: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613#header3).

## Overview

Districts can allow users to easily reset their Active Directory passwords through Clever. Districts that are using SAML as their [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807) method provide Clever with secure access to their Active Directory server via an LDAP Bind Account, allowing district users to configure their own password reset method (either through email or text message) in Clever.  
 

## District Setup

To use the Clever Active Directory password reset feature, your district will first need to set up Active Directory as your login method from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DAP) For instructions on how to set up Active Directory as your district’s login method, visit: [Single sign-on (SSO): Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576).

  
Once this is established, select the **Manage Account Recovery** button. This will launch the District AD Account Recovery set-up wizard.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DAe)  
 

You will first need to enter the URL for your district’s LDAP server and the SHA-1 fingerprint.

  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DAj)  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DAt)**Please note:** If you don't know what your SHA-1 fingerprint is, you can select **Download from server**, and Clever will find it for you.

  
Next, configure the LDAP server:

-   User attribute to match to the specified Clever field
    -   _For the Search Attribute, provide the Active directory field you think would best serve as a field to search on in Active Directory and the Clever field it will match with. This field should be unique across all user types (e.g. students, teachers, school admins, etc.)._
-   The base DN
-   The Bind Account username and password

**Please note:** _The Bind Account will need to have write access, allowing Clever to find student and teacher accounts to reset their passwords._ 

  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DAy)  
 

Lastly, you will be able to set additional configurations, which include:

-   Surfacing the search field (user identifier) to users
-   Selecting which user types are allowed to use this feature
-   The AD password requirements
-   Email domains you would like to _exclude_ from being used as recovery methods
-   Whether or not teachers (and School Tech Leads) can reset their students' AD passwords

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D9h)

  
Select **Finish**. Students, teachers, and School Tech Leads can now reset their AD passwords from their Clever Portals!   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DB3) For instructions on how users reset their Active Directory password through Clever, visit: [For staff: How do I use Account Recovery?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026283931)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with ADFS"
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202102576#h_5b36781c-138b-4c08-ba2c-bf41efd2b389)  
2. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202102576#h_951db904-0703-4bc7-a91d-0b2303910644)  
3. [The user experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202102576#h_d6388a02-0c59-4be6-86db-24749e1010dd)  
4. [Configuring ADFS](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202102576#h_42bbacc6-f345-42b6-991a-0a4a086dcd9f)  
5. [Configuring Clever SSO with ADFS](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202102576#h_b9bc4519-fbaa-4521-8b19-719c6b8ec9f2)

##   
Overview

Clever single sign-on (SSO) enables users to be securely authenticated into connected applications via their Clever Portal. Users log in to Clever just once with one set of credentials, or using a Clever [Badge](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), and then click on the various app icons to be logged in automatically via SSO. Clever application partners rely on Clever's verification system of determining that a user is, indeed, who they say they are. Without Clever SSO, each application would need to maintain its own database of users and their credentials.   
 

This article details the setup process for using ADFS as your school organization's Clever SSO method.  
 

## Requirements

In addition to [the basic single sign-on (SSO) requirements](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787), you’ll need the following:  
 

-   Active Directory Federation Services 2.x, 3.x or 4.x
-   Metadata file accessible over HTTPS with a certificate signed by a valid certificate authority
-   Make sure the following IP addresses are allow listed in your firewall:
    -   54.241.134.131
    -   50.18.217.135
    -   54.241.154.41
-   At least one real account to use to test the connection: In order to test the connection after set-up, you’ll need the credentials of a student or teacher. You won’t be able to test with other admin credentials; it needs to be someone whose information is also in Clever. If this is problematic, we recommend creating a test teacher or student in your SIS, syncing with Clever, and using that account instead of a real one to test the connection.

## The user experience

1.  When you set up Active Directory, you define usernames and passwords for your users.
2.  When users access the [Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568) or a [single sign-on (SSO) link](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205546348), they’ll be prompted to log in to Clever using these credentials by clicking **Log in with Active Directory**
3.  Once they click this button, they will be redirected to your Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) login page.
4.  After users successfully log in to your Active Directory server, your ADFS instance will use [claims rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617) to tell us which user is logging in.

![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D7B)**Please note:** Because the credentials are entered only on the Active Directory login page, Clever will never know the usernames and passwords for your users.

##   
Configuring ADFS

You'll need to configure Active Directory to connect with Clever single sign-on (SSO). You'll need to update two areas:

-   Relying Party Trusts
-   Claim Rules

  
**Relying Party Trust**

1.  In ADFS Management, open **Trust Relationships > Relying Party Trusts**.
2.  Click **Add Relying Party Trust** and input **[https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml)** where it asks for Federation Metadata address

![Notification\_Center.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BM7J)

3.  On the next page, you can leave the default display name (Clever.com) or change it to any display name you choose.

![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BM7E)

4.  On the next page, select **Permit all users to access this relying party**

![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BM7Y)

5.  Review your choices and click **Finish**.

  
Clever should now be listed as a Relying Party Trust.

  
**Claim Rules**  
  
Clever.com will now appear in the list of Relying Party Trusts. Right-click the display name and select **Edit Claims Rules**. These rules will ensure that Clever matches students and teachers appropriately when they log in.  
 

1.  Select **Add Rule** - the default on the first page should be **Send LDAP Attributes as Claims**  
    ![Screenshot of Send LDAP Attributes as Claims selection](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/200792957/Screenshot_5_12_14__1_56_AM-3.jpg)![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-3.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BM7i)
2.  On the next page, you can set the **Claim Rule Name** to anything you’d like.
3.  Select **Active Directory** as the attribute store - there will be two adjacent drop-down menus.
4.  For the first attribute, select **SAM-Account-Name** on the left and **Name ID** on the right.  
    ![Screenshot of SAM-Account-Name and Name ID attribute selection](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/200803673/cropped_png-3.jpg)![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-4.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BM87)
5.  Two new drop-downs should appear. Use the new row of drop-downs to define a claims rule - a field in your Clever SIS sync that contains the same unique identifier as a field in Active Directory.

-   The left drop-down will contain the attribute you’d like to send
-   The right drop-down will contain the Clever field that we will match that data with. A list of supported entries for **Outgoing Claim Type**, as well as more information on Claims Rules can be found in our article: [Understanding Claims Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617).

Here’s an example of fully set up claims rules:

![Screenshot of finished ADFS claims rule setup](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/200700926/Screenshot_5_12_14__1_56_AM-13.jpg)![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-5.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BM8g)

In the above sample:

-   SAM-Account-Name matches to sis\_id for students in Clever
-   E-Mail-Addresses matches to emails for teachers in Clever.

  
This is what our systems will use to authenticate the user logging in and give them access to the correct applications through Clever.  
 

![Important note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D92)**Important Note:** You'll need to personalize the LDAP attribute and Outgoing Claim Type based on the data available in Active Directory and Clever for your school organization. Regardless of the personalized claims rules for your school organization, you **must** have the first claims rule pictured above (SAM-Account-Name -> Name ID).

6\. Select **Finish** to finalize setup in ADFS! 

##   
Configuring Clever SSO with ADFS

1.  Find your Metadata URL - in your ADFS Management Console, browse to Service > Endpoints > Metadata > Type: Federation Metadata. It should take the format: **https://<ADFS server name>/federationmetadata/2007-06/FederationMetadata.xml**
2.  Make sure your certificates are set up correctly - to do so, put your Metadata URL into [SSL Checker](https://www.sslshopper.com/ssl-checker.html). This tool will let you know if there are any issues that might prevent us from accepting your Metadata URL.

  
**Inputting your Metadata URL**  
 

Take the following steps in the Clever Admin Dashboard:   
 

1.  Under your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page, choose the shortname for your SSO portal URL. The URL will be **www.clever.com/in/_<shortname>_**. Remember to use something that your students and teachers will remember easily.  
     
2.  Under [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page, click **Add Login Method** and select **Configure SAML Authentication****.** Input your metadata URL in the text box and select **Save.** **![screenshot of the Choose Login Method page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dlqH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000016cI9)**  
     
3.  To finish the setup process, add the contact details for the person that students and teachers should reach out to if they have trouble with logging in to Clever; this should be someone who can help them reset their Active Directory credentials and/or make sure they are shared with the application they’re trying to access through Clever. Add this at your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Customize tab.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/customize)

  
You should now be set up - try a few logins and see if you run into any issues! If you have questions about this process, please [submit a request.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326?language=en_US)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with LDAPS"
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/207090387#overview)  
2. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/207090387#header2)  
3\. [Notes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/207090387#notes)

## Overview

Clever can connect to your school organizations's existing LDAPS provider to log students and teachers into their Clever Portal account. LDAPS is a more secure variant of LDAP that uses Transport Layer Security (TLS) to ensure that usernames and passwords are transmitted securely. For security reasons, Clever does not support using non-secure LDAP with single sign-on (SSO). We cannot provide support for upgrading your existing LDAP system to LDAPS at this time, but [this guide](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/kb/321051) may be helpful if you are using Active Directory.

* * *

##   
Setup

To provision accounts, Clever needs permission to connect to your LDAP server. To establish a successful connection with Clever, you will need to provide the following information for your LDAP server:  
 

-   LDAPS URL
-   SHA-256 fingerprints of server’s SSL certificate
-   Base Distinguished Name (Base DN)
-   One of:
    -   Username prefix/suffix and the field in the LDAP server we use to find the user once we have access, or
    -   Username and password for a bind account, a field in the LDAP server we use to find the user once we have access, and the field in the LDAP server used as the end user’s username.  
        
-   The property in your LDAPS accounts that we can match with data in Clever - if you're not sure what this could be, please see [this article about claims rules.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617)

In addition to providing the information above, if you use a firewall please give access to the [Clever IP addresses listed here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752) on port **636** to ensure a successful connection with your server.

  
Once you're ready, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol), and click **Add Login Method** on the top right. Select **LDAP Authentication** to open the setup wizard.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5fl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D6X) Please note:** Changing the certificate on the LDAPS server without updating the SHA1 fingerprint [here](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) will cause logins to fail until resolved. 

* * *

## Notes

-   If using a BIND account, the account will need read and search permissions on the base DN. We recommend you limit BIND account permissions to minimize the exposure of sensitive directory information.
-   If using a BIND account, the BIND Account Search Attribute and the BIND Account Username Attribute should NOT be the same.
-   If a school organization is using sAMAccountName and userPrincipalName, there is a high likelihood that their server is Active directory.
-   Use the "Match Automatically" tool to see what user objects look like.

As always, feel free to [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) if you run into any issues or have any questions about setting up LDAPS as your identity provider!

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: For SFTP districts: How do I add district offices or departments in the schools file?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025227492#header1)  
2\. [Adding offices or departments to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025227492#header2)

## Overview

If you're syncing data to Clever via SFTP by uploading CSV files, you can edit the schools.csv file to include district offices or departments that will appear as a "school" in Clever. 

This article provides additional information on how to edit your files to add additional offices or departments in Clever.  
 

* * *

## Adding offices or departments to Clever

If you are syncing via the SFTP method, you can edit the schools.csv file to include district offices or departments that will appear as a "school" in Clever.

Clever Admins syncing staff members to Clever must associate the staff with a particular school or schools. Most staff (i.e., Principals, APs, Dean of Students, etc.) are admins related to specific schools. 

However, some staff members don't serve specific schools. In this case, we’ll want to create "schools" in Clever that are actually district-level departments or offices. For example, a school could be named **Office of the Superintendent,** **Department of Secondary English Language Arts**, or **Division of Instructional Technology.** As long as the School\_ids are unique and consistent across syncs, they don't have to be real.

For example, below is a schools.csv file that contains "schools" that are truly offices or departments:

title: Sync Report error: Records not processed due to missing school
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003095266#header1)  
2\. [How to troubleshoot this error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003095266#header2)

## Overview

There are a number of errors that may surface on your **Last attempted sync page** related to individual data types. For example, you may see that students or teachers fail to sync to Clever due to being assigned to a school site that doesn't exist in your files and/or Clever.  
 

All students and teachers must be assigned to a school in order to be synced with Clever. There are a few reasons you may see the error “records not processed due to missing school”:  
 

-   The ‘School\_id’ field is blank for some or all students/teachers; or
-   The ‘School\_id’ field in the ‘students.csv’ or ‘teachers.csv’ file does not match a listed ‘School\_id’ field in the ‘schools.csv’ file.

* * *

## How to troubleshoot this error

1.  Visit the [Sync Report page](https://schools.clever.com/sync) of your Dashboard for detailed information about data that Clever was unable to process.
2.  Click the blue icon 'Download Changes' to download a list of records affected by this error.  
    ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000CQmj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lzTr)
3.  Make sure that ‘School\_id’ is populated for all records in your ‘students.csv’ and ‘teachers.csv’ files.
4.  Compare the ‘School\_id’ values in ‘teachers.csv’ and ‘students.csv’ to make sure they’re all present in ‘schools.csv’.  
      
    A common cause of mismatched IDs between files is a lost a leading zero - click [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698) for more information on identifying and resolving this error.

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

-   [Sync Reports: Error messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073643) 
-   [Sync Report error: Sections not processed due to missing students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073643)
-   [Sync Report error: Records not processed due to duplicate IDs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073603)

title: Sync Report error: Records not processed due to duplicate IDs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003073603#header1)  
2\. [How to troubleshoot this error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003073603#header2)  
3\. [Teachers at multiple school sites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003073603#header3)

## Overview

There are a number of errors that may surface on your **Last attempted sync page** related to individual data types. For example, you may see users fail to sync to Clever due to the use of duplicate IDs.  
 

Clever requires a unique ID for every record we process, and each data type contains at least one unique record ID field value: 'School\_id', 'Teacher\_id', 'Section\_id', or 'Student\_id'. If two or more records share an ID value, Clever will only process one record with that ID. The following error may be surfaced: _duplicate 'section\_id (school\_id, teacher\_id, student\_id)' used'_  
 

These unique IDs are used to make connections between data types and therefore need to be unique and consistent across all 5 files. For example, a school record in your ‘schools.csv’ file with 'School\_id' “12345” should be identified as “12345” for each student attending that school in the ‘students.csv’ file.  
 

## How to troubleshoot this error

1.  Visit the Sync Report in your Dashboard for detailed information about data that Clever was unable to process.  
     
2.  Click "Download Changes" to download a list of records affected by this error.  
      
    ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000CQjV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lzTh)
3.  Correct these errors in your uploads by determining a truly unique identifier for all records, or filter the data before you upload to Clever.

## Teachers at multiple school sites

  
To avoid receiving this duplicate ID error, teachers at multiple school sites should still only be listed once in the teachers.csv file with one school\_id as their primary school. However, they can then be associated with sections from multiple schools in the sections.csv file.

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Log in with Google
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#overview)  
2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#setup)  
3\. [Optional Settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#optional_settings)  
     _•_ [Google email source](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#email_source)  
     _•_ [Force Google logout when users log out of Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#force_logout)  
     _•_ [Append Domain](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#append_domain)  
     _•_ [Override Google domain](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#override)

IMPORTANT  
Admins must mark Clever as a trusted app in Google, or students, teachers, and administrators may lose access to Clever. Learn more here: [For Clever Admins: Google SSO 3rd party confirmation.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588)

##   
Overview

Clever single sign-on (SSO) allows students and teachers to log in using their school organization email addresses provisioned by Google. This means users will need to use their school organization-assigned Google email and password to log in to Clever (not an @gmail.com email address).

 **![Clever tip icon](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Google authentication supports multiple domains! No special configuration is required. Simply ensure that users' school email addresses are synced to Clever and they will be successfully authenticated into Clever.

* * *

##   
Setup

**Step 1:** Ensure that all school organization users have a school organization-provided Google email address in Clever. To verify this:

-   Navigate to the [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser#{%22sidebar%22:%22schools%22}) to make sure the **Email** field is populated for students, teachers, and staff. By using the **Add Filter** option, you can check to see if emails are populated by choosing the **Email** value as the Property, **Contains** as the Operator, and input **@** as the value. This will bring up a list of emails for the user type.

![Data Browser image showing how to search for user emails](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005S1fP)

-   **Please note:** School organization-provided Google email addresses can be synced to Clever from your student information system (SIS) or [side-loaded to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026), thus bypassing the sync. For more information on side-loading emails, read [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026).

  
**Step 2:** Admins can configure the single sign-on (SSO) settings from the [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.

-   Select **Add Login Method** to the far right.
-   Select **Google Authentication** as the Identity Provider.
-   Confirm the Google email source.
-   Select **Save**.

![Screenshot of the Clever Dashboard SSO settings page for adding Google Authentication](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BDnj)

  
**Step 3:** Test various users to ensure their login credentials work. To do this:

-   Ensure you have the credentials for a few students, teachers or staff.
-   Navigate to your school organization's [Clever login page](https://schools.clever.com/portal).
-   Enter the credentials of the user you are testing.
-   You should be successfully logged into Clever as the user!

Once the Google login method setup steps are completed, the Google login option will automatically appear on your school organization's Clever login page.

### Here's an interactive tutorial

_\*\* Best experienced in Full Screen (click the icon in the top right corner before you begin) \*\*_

[https://www.iorad.com/player/1996456/Adding-Google-as-an-Identity-Provider--IDP-](https://www.iorad.com/player/1996456/Adding-Google-as-an-Identity-Provider--IDP-)

* * *

##   
Optional Settings

###   
**Google Email Source**

If Google email addresses are not stored in your SIS, you can manually upload the emails to Clever in a separate file. To use this option, select: **Google emails are NOT stored in my district's SIS.**

**Please note:** manual email upload is not available to school organizations using [**Override domain.**](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202084503#override)

To do this, please follow the instructions [in this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026).

###   
  
**Force Google logout when users log out of Clever**

If your school organization is using Google as your identity provider (IdP), you can apply a setting from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page that will automatically log users out of Google when they log out of Clever. This is helpful in situations where multiple users are logging in to Clever on shared devices. When using a shared device, it is important to log the first user out of Google (in addition to Clever) before the next user logs in. Otherwise, some devices will not allow the second user to log in. School organizations can help to eliminate this issue by forcing the user's Google logout when they log out of Clever.  
  
When enabled:

**Chrome/Edge/Firefox**

When a user logs out of Clever, the coinciding Google session will also be terminated and the user will be automatically redirected to Clever's login page.

**Safari**

When a user logs out of Clever, they will be redirected to Google's logout page. To begin a new Clever session, users must manually navigate to Clever's login page.

To enable Force Google Logout:

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page and select the **Edit settings** option for Google.
-   Select **Force Google logout when users log out of Clever**
-   Select **Save**.

![Screenshot of the Force Google logout setting](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D5e)

![Information icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D5o) _**For more information** about supporting users on shared devices:_ [Troubleshooting: Issues with Shared Devices](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002315868)

### **Append Domain:**

You can pre-populate your Google domain for users to facilitate even easier logins! Simply use our "Append Domain" tool.

1.  Navigate to [Authentication > SSO settings > Login method tab.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings)
2.  Select **Edit settings** for Google Authentication
3.  Check the box for **Append my district's Google domain when users sign in**
4.  Enter your school organization's Google domain _without_ the @ symbol
5.  Select **Save**

![Screenshot of the Append Domain setting with checkbox](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D6I)

Once complete, users will see your Google domain pre-populated when they select **Log in with Google**. If your teachers or staff use a different domain than students, they can override the pre-populated domain by simply typing their entire email address. Once they enter '@,' the prep-populated domain will disappear.

![Screenshot of Google login button with domain pre-populated](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D5k)

### **Override Google domain:**

Occasionally, there are situations where school organizations change their Google domain but do not want to update all user email addresses in their SIS to the new domain.  
  
Email domain override only supports one domain. School organizations that use multiple domains _(example: @cleveracademy.com and @students.cleveracademy.com)_ are not supported.

  
**Please note:** The email addresses will still show the older domain when viewing a user's profile page in Clever; however, the user will be able to log in using the email address with the new domain. This will only work if users have an email address in Clever, and the username remains the same. For example, [JaneSmith@example.org](mailto:JaneSmith@example.org) could be appended to [JaneSmith@example.net](mailto:JaneSmith@example.net) by Clever as long as 'JaneSmith' remains the same.

  
Directions:

-   Navigate to the [Authentication > SSO settings > Login method tab.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings)
-   Select **Edit settings** for Google.
-   Select **Google email addresses are NOT stored in my district's SIS**, click **Next**
-   Enter your school organization's Google domain.
-   Select to which user types to override (e.g. Teachers, Students, or both)
-   Once saved, users will use their email with the domain you have set here to log in to Clever

![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D6N)**Please note:** _Clever doesn't have access to any Google passwords for users, so password-related issues will need to be resolved by the school organization._[Troubleshooting: Google User Login Issues.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/208333098)

![Clever Academy logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000drXV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Interested in deep-diving into how to best use Clever and Google together? Check out our course, [Clever & Google: Secure Connected Classroom Certification](https://clever.academy/clever-google-cert?user_type=district_admin) available in Clever Academy!

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: SFTP Syncs: OneRoster
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001975103#one) 2. [Preparing my Clever sync to accept OneRoster files](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001975103#two) 3. [Syncing student contacts via OneRoster](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001975103#four) 4. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001975103#four) 5\. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001975103#five) ## Overview As a member of the IMS Global Learning Consortium, Clever supports the IMS Global OneRoster standard. School organizations can send OneRoster [1.0](https://www.imsglobal.org/lis/imsOneRosterv1p0/imsOneRosterCSV-v1p0.html#_Toc421598318), [1.1](https://www.imsglobal.org/oneroster-v11-final-csv-tables#_Toc480293252), or [1.2](https://www.imsglobal.org/spec/oneroster/v1p2/bind/csv/#csv-format) formatted CSV files via Clever’s secure SFTP data pipeline. It’s the easiest, most secure way to support OneRoster using our proven platform without compromising functionality or data control. ![Oneroster and Clever data flow diagram](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTH7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BXcm)    * * * ## Preparing my Clever sync to accept OneRoster files To prepare your sync for OneRoster files follow the steps below: 1. **[Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)**: Our team will help you create a transition plan and timeline. Just let us know if you’re using OneRoster 1.0, 1.1, or 1.2. 2\. **Review the field mapping documentation:** Whether you are new to Clever or transitioning your sync type, you'll be provided with a field mapping document. This shows how OneRoster fields translate to the Clever fields your apps require. - **Please note:** Clever strictly interprets OneRoster 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 to ensure compatibility with evolving standards. You can find [official 1.1 formatting here](https://www.imsglobal.org/oneroster-v11-final-csv-tables). - **Required files:** 1. academicSessions.csv 2. classes.csv 3. courses.csv 4. demographics.csv 5. enrollments.csv 6. orgs.csv 7. users.csv 8. manifest.csv (Must list all 7 files above) 3\. **Automate transmission:** Send your CSVs to your Clever SFTP box. Use the correct subdirectory for your version: - - **1.0:** `/oneroster` - **1.1:** `/oneroster11` - **1.2:** `/oneroster12` 4\. **Share data:** Once complete, you can leverage Clever’s data-sharing interface to scope student rosters with applications and personalize your Clever Portal. * * * ## Syncing student contacts via OneRoster You can sync student contacts via the _users.csv_. To connect a contact to a student, use the agentSourceID as shown below: ![Example data format for syncing student contacts](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTH7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BXcw) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTH7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D4c) The _users.csv_ spec can be found here: [https://www.imsglobal.org/oneroster-v11-final-csv-tables#\_Toc480293266](https://www.imsglobal.org/oneroster-v11-final-csv-tables#_Toc480293266) * * * ## ![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTH7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063HrZ)Troubleshooting Below you can find solutions to common sync errors that may display in your Clever Dashboard if you are using a OneRoster SFTP sync.

Error Message

Solution

"A manifest.csv file is required for a OneRoster v1.1 SIS data sync"

Ensure the manifest.csv is in the OneRoster zipped file. Zip the files together as a group; zipping the folder itself will cause this error. The file should include all the required files:

• academicSessions.csv

• classes.csv 

• courses.csv

• demographics.csv (optional - mark as absent if you're not using this file.) 

• enrollments.csv

• orgs.csv

• users.csv

Could not find orgs.csv file

List the orgs.csv as bulk in the manifest.csv and ensure the file contains all required headers.

  • OneRoster 1.0 CSV formatting and specifications

  • OneRoster 1.1 CSV formatting and specifications

  • OneRoster 1.2 CSV formatting and specifications

If the error persists, please reach out to Clever Support to confirm your OneRoster version (1.0. 1.1, 1.2).

Encountered zero enrollments data

  • Confirm the enrollments.csv isn't empty (common during rollover periods).

  • Confirm the enrollment date format. It must be YYYY-MM-DD format per OneRoster specifications.

  • Check your users.csv and confirm users are enabledUser field is set to “True.”

Invalid manifest.csv

Confirm your manifest.version in the manifest.csv is set to 1.0.

A manifest.csv is required for a OneRoster 1.1 sync

  • Ensure your manifest.csv is present in the zipped file.

  • Ensure the manifest.version in the manifest.csv is 1.0.

  • Confirm all files in your manifest.csv are listed as either “bulk” or “absent”.

  • Ensure you have compressed (zipped) the files as a group. Compressing as a folder will cause this error.

Failed to start decoding manifest.csv

  • Confirm manifest.csv is formatted per OneRoster specifications (1.0, 1.1 or 1.2). Check file headers and files listed as “bulk” or “absent”. Manifest.version should be 1.0.

  • Confirm you zipped the files as a group rather than zipping a folder.

Below you can find solutions to common solutions to general data issues that may occur if you are using a OneRoster SFTP sync.

Error Message

Solution

User (student, teacher, etc.) missing from Clever

  • Please confirm all required fields are populated per the relevant OneRoster specification:

    • OneRoster 1.0 CSV formatting and specifications

    • OneRoster 1.1 CSV formatting and specifications

    • OneRoster 1.2 CSV formatting and specifications

  • Please confirm the username field is populated. This is required.

  • If using OneRoster 1.1 or 1.2, ensure that the role field is populated in the users.csv.

Missing terms or enrollments

Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD format to process.

Missing section or enrollment

Clever requires sections have a primary teacher and at least one student assigned.

  • Check the enrollments.csv and make sure that the teacher and students have the following fields populated:

  • status = active. If tobedeleted or inactive are marked, the enrollment will not sync to Clever.

  • schoolSourcedId = SourcedId (orgs.csv). This maps to the student's school_id in Clever.

  • userSourcedId = SourcedId (users.csv). This maps to the student_id and teacher_id.

  • role = student or teacher

Check the users.csv and make sure that the teacher and students are active (status = active & enabledUser = true).

Student enrollments are persisting after the end date has passed

Clever ignores start/end dates. To remove enrollments, please remove them from your enrollments.csv entirely.

Missing demographic data - date of birth

Confirm date is formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

Missing demographic data - race

Ensure you are using a value accepted by OneRoster and that each value is marked as “true” or “false” in your demographics.csv.

  • americanIndianOrAlaskaNative

  • blackOrAfricanAmerican

  • nativeHawaiianOrOtherPacificIslander

  • white

  • demographicraceTwoOrMoreRaces

  • hispanicOrLatinoEthnicity


If Hispanic_Latino is missing in Clever, ensure that hispanicOrLatinoEthnicity is the only field marked as true for the student in the demographics.csv, all other values should be marked as false.

Missing demographic data - gender

Confirm sex is populated in the demographics.csv.

  • For OneRoster 1.1 only male or female are accepted values.

  • For OneRoster 1.2 male, female, other, or unspecified are accepted values.

Issues with lineitems.csv

Please mark as “absent” in the manifest.csv. This file cannot sync to Clever.

Issues with the results.csv

Please mark as “absent” in the manifest.csv. This file cannot sync to Clever.

 If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help! * * * ## Default field mappings ### Schools Click here for OneRoster 1.1 default mappings
