title: Sync Report error: Sections not processed due to missing students
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003073643#header1)  
2\. [How to troubleshoot this error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003073643#header2)

## Overview

There are a number of errors that may surface on your **Last attempted sync page** related to individual data types. For example, you may see sections not process due to missing enrollments. Sections must have active students enrolled to be processed into Clever. We use the ‘enrollments.csv’ file to associate students with sections using their unique IDs; each ‘Student\_id’ listed next to a ‘Section\_id’ means that student is enrolled in that section. You may see a “records not processed due to no students enrolled” because:  
 

-   A section’s ‘Section\_id’ is not present in the ‘enrollments.csv’ file; or
-   A ‘Student\_id’ listed in the ‘enrollments.csv’ file is not present in the ‘students.csv’ file.

The error is often surfaced as: _invalid 'Course Roster' due to error 'no students'_  
 

* * *

## How to troubleshoot this error:

1.  Visit the [Sync Report](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page of your Dashboard for detailed information about data that Clever was unable to process.
2.  Click 'Download Changes' to download a list of records affected by this error.
3.  Search for the ‘Section\_id’ of the affected section(s) in your ‘enrollments.csv’ file.
4.  Make sure all sections with students enrolled are listed in your ‘enrollments.csv’ file.
5.  If you can find the ‘Section\_id’ in the ‘enrollments.csv’ file, copy the ‘Student\_id’ of students enrolled in that section and search for them in the ‘students.csv’ file.
6.  Make sure all students enrolled in sections are listed in your ‘students.csv’ file.

It’s also possible that certain records are not processed due to formatting errors in the CSV files. [Please see this article for troubleshooting CSV formatting errors.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698?language=en_US)

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

-   [Sync Reports: Error messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073643) 
-   [Sync Report error: Records not processed due to missing school](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003095266)
-   [Sync Report error: Records not processed due to duplicate IDs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073603)

title: SFTP Syncs: Sync status errors
text:
This article contains the following:  
 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203257407#overview)  
​ 2. [Received export with no headers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203257407#noheaders)  
​ 3. [Received export with zero data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203257407#zerodata)  
​ 4. [Unknown Column Names](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203257407#Unknown%20Column%20Names)  
 5. [Bad headers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203257407#badheaders) ​  
 6. [Missing Required SFTP File](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203257407#required)

## Overview

This article provides insight into the various sync status errors you might see on your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. Sync errors will typically prevent future syncs from processing successfully until the error is addressed.

* * *

## Received export with no headers

All five CSV files require column headers as listed in Clever’s SFTP Instructions. Uploading a CSV file without column headers will result in an error message like this:   
 

![Example sync error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTVd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D3E)  

You can take the following steps to fix this error:

1.  When you export data directly from your Student Information System (SIS) or through an SQL query, double-check that the export includes a header row.
2.  Headers must match Clever’s header names exactly in the SFTP Instructions.
3.  If you’re having trouble exporting data from your SIS, please contact your SIS directly; Clever is unable to troubleshoot exporting data from your SIS and SQL for SFTP Syncs.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTVd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D3J) If you need help formatting your CSV files, see the following Help Center article: [How do I format my CSV files?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867?language=en_US)

  
Once your files include header rows according to Clever’s specified file format, upload all five files again. Your sync status should change once your data is processed.      
 

* * *

##   
Received export with zero data

Clever requires all five CSV files to process your data upload. If one of your files is empty, you’ll see an error like this:  
 

![Example sync error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTVd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D3O)

You can take the following steps to fix this error:

1.  When exporting data directly from your SIS or through an SQL query, double-check that all active schools, students, sections, teachers, and enrollments are exporting.
2.  If you’re having trouble exporting data from your SIS, please contact your SIS directly; Clever is unable to troubleshoot exporting data from your SIS and SQL for SFTP Syncs.
3.  If your semester or school year has recently changed, check that the correct term is selected to export.
4.  For more helpful tips on semester and school year rollover, [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886)
5.  Once all five files include active data, upload all files to Clever again. Your sync status should change once your data processing completes.

* * *

##   
 Unknown Column Names

Clever only recognizes column headers that exactly match those listed in our [SFTP Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). If your file contains a header that Clever doesn’t recognize, you’ll see a similar error in your Dashboard:

![Image of sync error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTVd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044fBx)

To resolve this error:

-   Click on the link in the error message if you'd like to map the fields you synced to fields in Clever.
-   Check that all column header names in the identified file match those listed in the [SFTP Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf).

* * *

##   
Bad Header Errors

Clever sometimes encounters unreadable headers and you’ll receive an error. This error usually occurs when the number of fields in the CSV header row is different from the number of fields in data rows.

Common causes of this issue are:

-   Trailing commas
-   Extra commas in field values

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTVd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D3x) For more information on troubleshooting CSV formatting errors see this article: [How do I troubleshoot CSV formatting errors?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867?language=en_US)

* * *

##   
Missing Required SFTP File

Clever requires all 5 CSV files in each SFTP upload (schools.csv, students.csv, teachers.csv, sections.csv, and enrollments.csv). If you are missing one of these 5 files, you will receive this error in your Dashboard:  
 

![](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001687407/Screen_Shot_2017-01-09_at_9.18.12_AM.png)![Example sync error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cTVd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D47) 

To resolve this error:

-   Upload all 5 files to Clever in your next upload
-   Because every sync overwrites the data currently in your Clever account, each file needs to contain the previous data that should remain in Clever, as well as any desired changes.

 If you have any questions about sync errors, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: SFTP Syncs: Recommended tools (e.g. FTP Clients, CSV editing tools)
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [CSV & Text Editing Tools](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206020358#CSV) 2\. [FTP Clients](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206020358#FTP) ## CSV & Text Editing Tools Clever recommends using CSV and text editors to avoid file formatting errors. [See this help article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698) about formatting errors, and [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203257407) about sync status errors due to formatting.

CSVEdit

We love using CSVEdit to view CSV files without worrying about dropping leading zeros!

Sublime Text

If you need to modify your data before uploading your CSV files to Clever, Sublime Text is an easy-to-use text editor. Text editors are also great for identifying trailing comma issues.

TextEdit

If you’re a Mac user, TextEdit is your Mac’s default text editor. We recommend using a text editor to safely view and save CSV files without skewing data.

Notepad

Notepad is a simple text editor that you’ll find on your PC if you’re a Windows user; it’s a helpful tool to view CSV files.

Notepad++

A free Windows-based text editor, Notepad++ is great for viewing and editing CSV/text files. You can use tabs to open multiple files, and we love the search function!

* * * ## FTP Clients FTP Clients allow you to safely transfer files via Secure File Transfer Protocol. For more information about uploading data to Clever with an FTP client, [see this help article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408).

OpenSSH

OpenSSH is a suite of security-related network-level utilities based on the Secure Shell (SSH) protocol.

WinSCP

WinSCP is a free FTP client designed for Windows.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhJd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000p3wuv) Please note:** If you’re unable to connect to the remote site when using an FTP client, please check with your team if your school organization has a firewall that restricts traffic to or from Clever. If it does, please ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752).

title: SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever
text:
This article covers the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408#overview)  
2. [Option 1: Clever's Web Upload Tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408#option1)  
3. [Option 2: FTP client](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408#option2)  
4. [Locating your SFTP credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408#h_e2664819-a38c-4e2c-b906-8e3eefb0d6db)  
5. [Clever’s SFTP Host Keys](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408#h_f4dad0e9-3386-4c5e-a2d3-c7307d5930b0)

##   
Overview

This article will cover how to upload data to Clever for SFTP and SFTP SIS-Managed Auto Syncs. You have a couple of options for getting your school organization data into Clever (and, therefore, any other app you connect to Clever):

-   Option 1: Manually uploading the data via the [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page.
-   Option 2: Using an automated SFTP transfer ([see here for more information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078)).

* * *

##   
Option 1: Clever's Web Upload Tool

![Clever Academy logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)   
Onboarding to Clever and want to learn about uploading CSV files? Check out our [Onboarding - Getting your schools’ data into Clever](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding/onboarding-sync?user_type=district_admin) course, available in Clever Academy!

You can find the Web Upload tool from your [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page. From there you can drag and drop each file, or click the cloud to browse and attach each CSV file.  
  
Select **Upload** and wait until the top of the page displays **Your files have been uploaded** before leaving the page.   
 

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** While not always required, it is best practice to always upload the entire set of files (_schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv_ and _enrollments.csv_) every time you do an upload.  

To learn more about this process and how you can map your fields to Clever fields, please review [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001608?language=en_US).

If your sync is not processing via the Web Upload tool, it may be due to your school organization’s firewall settings. If your school org has a firewall that restricts traffic to or from Clever, please ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752) and attempt to upload your files again.

###   
**Why is the Web Upload Tool Missing?**

The Web Upload Tool is only available to school organizations that are SFTP. The Web Upload Tool page will redirect school organizations that use SIS-managed SFTP syncs or Clever-managed syncs to the Custom Data page:

  
![Screenshot of the upload tab on the sync page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Mg14)   
  

**How can I add staff?**

If your school organization uses an SIS-managed SFTP sync or a Clever-managed sync, you can upload staff on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) page via the following options:

-   Sync with your SIS auto sync
-   Upload a staff.csv to your Clever SFTP directory
-   Active Directory sync (if staff members have Active Directory accounts)
-   Add additional staff as Custom Data on the [Custom Data page](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/staff)  
      
    

![Screenshot of the Staff Data tab page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pAdM5)

  
 

* * *

## Option 2: FTP client

Another option for sending files to Clever is using the Secure File Transfer Protocol, also known as SSH File Transfer Protocol. The following outlines the process for manually uploading files through an [FTP client](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206020358). Many school organizations write a script to upload files via SFTP automatically. At this time Clever does not provide support for setting up these automations.

  
There are many FTP clients available (e.g. Transmit, [FileZilla](https://filezilla-project.org/) or WinSCP). When you choose an FTP client, first confirm that it will support SFTP, as not all clients will. SFTP is not the same as _FTP over SSH, FTP over SSL, FTPS or Simple File Transfer Protocol_. 

  
Each client's interface will look a little different, but each will involve similar steps. [Check out this interactive tutorial](https://ior.ad/a88l), or follow the instructions below which show Filezilla's interface:   
 

1.  Download and install an FTP client program that supports SFTP.
2.  Log into your Clever dashboard and locate your SFTP credentials in the SFTP Settings box on the [Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page (see below for more information).
3.  Open the FTP client program, enter your SFTP credentials ("host" is the SFTP Upload URL), and click 'Quickconnect'; Note: some FTP clients will require a modified URL configuration such as sftp.clever.com. Please reference their help documentation.
    
    ![Example FTP Client upload tool](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pAa85)
    
4.  Once the link between your **Local Site** and **Remote Site** is established, you should see the files already stored in the host site appear on the right side of the window.
5.  Browse the **Local Site** (your computer's hard drive, on the left side of the window) until you find all five of the CSV files you would like to upload. Drag them from the **Local Site** to the **Remote Site** into the folder with your school organization's username. In the image below, the username is wise-information-1089. (Please note: our system will only process files that adhere to our naming protocol– schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, enrollments.csv, sections.csv). Please be consistent with capitalization to avoid duplicate files.
    
    ![Example FTP Client](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D1D)
    
6.  This may prompt a pop-up to appear, pictured below. If so, allow the program to overwrite preexisting data in the host site with the incoming data. (You should only have 5 files in your 'Remote Site' at one time).
    
    ![FTP client overwrite data settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D1N)
    
7.  Clever will begin processing any updated files or new uploads approximately five minutes after they have been uploaded to your FTP box. Please note that it may take 30 minutes for the sync to fully complete.

If you’re unable to connect to the remote site when using an FTP client, it may be due to your school organization’s firewall settings. If your school org has a firewall that restricts traffic to or from Clever, please ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752) and attempt your connection or upload again.

![Clever "C" logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028D1S)  Clever does not move or delete files after processing, so please be sure your SFTP folder settings are configured to always write over existing files with newly uploaded files!

* * *

##   
Locating your SFTP credentials

You can find these credentials on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. To ensure the safety of your information, we will never send or request your SFTP password over email or on the phone.  
  
Please follow the instructions below to retrieve your SFTP username and password:  
 

1.  Log into your Clever account at http://schools.clever.com. You'll need to use the email and password that you created when you signed up for your Clever account.
2.  From the left sidebar, click [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync/).
3.  Click on the [Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab.
4.  You'll see the SFTP username and password. We suggest copy/pasting the password into your FTP client to prevent any typos.
    -   **Please note:** 
        -   _School organizations cannot change their SFTP usernames or passwords._
        -   _Please use the information in the SFTP Settings box (not the box titled SFTP Settings - Saved Passwords Applications)._
        -   _For the Veracross SIS, don't include the leading "sftp://"" at the beginning of the SFTP UPLOAD URL, otherwise you'll get a sync error._

           ![Screenshot of the Clever Dashboard Sync page showing where to find the SFTP Settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000diu1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pAbSL)    
 

* * *

##   
Clever’s SFTP Host Keys

Every time your school organization's SFTP client connects to Clever, it will check our SFTP server's Host Key to ensure your data is being safely transmitted to the correct server.

  
Each SFTP client handles Host Keys slightly differently. The following is documentation on some of the leading SFTP clients:  
 

-   [WinSCP](https://winscp.net/eng/docs/ssh_verifying_the_host_key)
-   [Filezilla](https://wiki.filezilla-project.org/Howto)

title: SFTP Syncs: Troubleshooting CSV formatting errors
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218518698#overview) 2\. [Error codes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218518698#errorcodes) 3. [Trailing commas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218518698#trailing%20commas) 4\. [Extra commas in field values](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218518698#extra%20commas) 5\. [Leading zeros](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218518698#leading%20zeros) ## Overview When you upload a CSV that contains one or more errors, you’ll see error messages in Clever. This article runs through errors and how to fix them for both automated SFTP and manual CSV uploads. When uploading data on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page, you’ll see the errors listed shortly after uploading the CSV file(s). You can find Clever's CSV file templates [here](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip). **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you want to download the most recent CSV files uploaded to Clever, you can do so at the [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. Learn more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001499#Downloading)! ![errors1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000013juT)  When errors occur from an SFTP sync, you’ll see the errors listed in the Status section on the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. ![error2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004yRxk)   One way to avoid some common errors is to understand how your files work together. This graphic is helpful to explain this:   [![Graphic of how Clever sync files work with each other](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000002aIj)](https://everpath-course-content.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com/instructor%2Fci3x2e49snygq5fv0p5f3ud4s%2Fpublic%2F1689994601%2FSFTP+How-your-data-works-dark-3.1689994601460.png)   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** To avoid CSV formatting errors, we recommend exporting data from your SIS directly in CSV format, and uploading those files directly to Clever without manipulating them. Excel is commonly used to view CSV files, but it often imposes formatting that skews data and results in SFTP upload errors. For error-free viewing and saving of CSV files, we recommend using an application built for CSV compatibility, such as CSVEdit, Sublime Text, Apache OpenOffice, TextEdit, or Notepad.   * * * ## Error codes and how to handle them The table below lists the errors you may see when you run into an SFTP error and how to resolve the errors. Of note, it is common for schools to see specific data errors on the Last Attempted Sync page, and these errors do not need to be fully resolved for the Clever sync to continue operating. These errors indicate a specific record that failed to sync to Clever, and as long as these errors are not directly impacting user access or applications it is typically safe to ignore these errors. Error counts may change and resolve over time as data changes in your SIS throughout the school year. ![Last attempted sync screen with data errors](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009BXZl)

Error:

Step(s) to take:

The following required file is missing:
[file]		Upload the required missing file(s).
 
The following required file is empty:
[file]		Ensure the file(s) in question contain the required data. The file should have a row of headers followed by at least one row of data. See the SFTP spec for the list of required data.
 
The following required file contains no data:
[file]		Ensure the file(s) in question contain the required data. The file should have a row of headers followed by at least one row of data. See the SFTP spec for the list of required data.
The following file is missing required headers:
[file] [missing header]		Double-check the file(s) have the missing header(s). See the SFTP spec for the list of required headers. 
The following file includes unsupported headers:
[file] [incorrect header]		Double-check the header(s) in the file(s) are spelled correctly and do not contain any characters other than letters. See the SFTP spec for the list of supported headers.
The headers in the following file could not be parsed:
[file]		 Check that the file is in CSV format.
The following file includes missing commas:
[file] [lines]		Ensure there are no missing commas in the file.
The following file includes extra commas:
[file] [line]		Ensure there are no extra commas. Jump to this section for more information.

 
The following file is missing required values:
[file] [column header] [line]		Add required value(s) for files.
The following students are in the enrollments.csv but missing from the students.csv:
[student_id]		Add respective students to the students.csv file.
The following sections are in the sections.csv but missing from the enrollments.csv:
[section_id]		Add respective sections to the enrollments.csv file.
The following teachers are in the sections.csv but missing from the teachers.csv:
[teacher_id]		Add respective teachers to the teachers.csv file.
The following schools are in the students.csv but missing from the schools.csv:
[school_id]		Add respective schools to the schools.csv file.
The following schools are in the teachers.csv but missing from the schools.csv:
[school_id]		Add respective schools to the schools.csv file.
The following schools are in the sections.csv but missing from the schools.csv:
[school_id]		Add respective schools to the schools.csv file.
The following schools are in the enrollments.csv but missing from the schools.csv:
[school_id]		Add respective schools to the schools.csv file.
The following schools are in the staff.csv but missing from the schools.csv:
[school_id]		Add respective schools to the schools.csv file.
The following students are in the guardians.csv but missing from the students.csv: [student_id]Add respective students to the students.csv file.
* * * ## Trailing commas Saving an Excel file as a CSV file can create extra commas at the end of each row. Trailing commas can result when columns are deleted or column headers removed. When the file is uploaded to Clever, an extra trailing comma will skew subsequent rows of data, preventing them from being processed.   To identify this issue, we recommend opening the file in a text editor (like Notepad for PC, or TextEdit for Mac). You’ll see trailing commas at the end of each row, like this:    ![Trailing commas appearing at the end of a line of raw data.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000h0BF) Take these steps to resolve the issue:   1. Open a new, blank spreadsheet in Excel. 2. Type in only the column headers for the data you will include in your upload. 3. Save the file as MS-DOS Comma Separated with a new name (e.g., “students2.csv”). 4. Open the old file (with the extra commas) and copy the rows below the column headers. 5. Paste the rows into the new file under your typed column headers. 6. Save your new file as MS-DOS Comma Separated again. 7. Once you’ve saved the data into the new file, you can close it and rename it to “students.csv” (the required file name for uploading to Clever). * * * ## Extra commas in field values Your data may sometimes include a comma within a field value (e.g., if a student’s last name is “Potter, Jr.”), and the comma-separated values file will treat the comma as a field separator unless the entire field value is enclosed in double quotation marks. The following record would NOT be processed to Clever. The three commas in the data row separate that record into four fields, but there are only three fields in the header row. ![leading zeros](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005ToOL) This record would get skewed to look like this:  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cz7) The following record WOULD be processed to Clever. Enclosing the "Potter, Jr." field value in double (straight) quotation marks tells Clever that the entire last name is "Potter, Jr."  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CzC) This record would be processed as: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CzH) * * * ## Leading zeros Numerical values (in fields like ‘school\_id’, ‘student\_id’, and ‘teacher\_id’) often begin with “0”, but Excel removes these leading zeros, which changes the value listed for that field. For example, student\_id “009844” becomes “9844”. When uploaded, Clever no longer recognizes that student: student “009844” is deleted and a new student, “9844”, is created. Once this incorrect data, caused by leading zeros, is uploaded to Clever, it may cause a hold due to changes in data. If the hold is approved, those unique SIS IDs can cause many issues, such as users or sections being re-created and losing their associated historical data in connected apps. If you need to open your CSV file in Excel, import your data as text to avoid dropping leading zeros:   1. In Excel, click **Data** > **Get External Data** > **Import Text File…** 2. Browse to select your CSV file and click **Get Data.** 3. Choose **Delimited** as the file type and click **Next.** 4. Check the “Comma” box as the delimiter and click **Next.** 5. Select all columns in the data preview and change their column data format to “Text”. 6. Click **Finish.**  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Z60v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** Leading zeros are not permitted in the "grade" column. Our specifications will error out the value "01" and only accept "1" in the grade field.   * * *  **Related articles:** - [SFTP & Manual Upload: How do I format my CSV files?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867) - [SFTP Syncs: SFTP Sync FAQ](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001556) - [Sync Reports: Error messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001482)

title: SFTP & Manual Upload: How do I format my CSV files?
text:
This article covers the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#step1) 2\. [What's a CSV file?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#step2) 3\. [Creating CSV files](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#How%20should%20I%20create%20my%205%20CSV%20files) 4\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#Which%20field%20headers%20do%20I%20need%20to%20include) 5\. [What will my files look like?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#What%20will%20my%20files%20look%20like) 6\. [Uploading multiple student contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#How%20do%20I%20format%20multiple%20student%20contacts) 7\. [Multi-site users (users at multiple schools)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#multiple%20teachers) 8\. [Quote Surrounded Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#quotes) 9\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114867#faq) ## Overview ![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv) If your schools are brand-new to Clever, we recommend going through our [onboarding courses in Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding?user_type=district_admin) to access step-by-step support on getting set up with Clever. This article describes how to set up the data files you'll send to Clever if you choose to manually upload your school or district's data or if you choose to set up an SFTP sync. As a refresher, you have a few options for getting your school or district data into Clever (and therefore any other app you connect to Clever): - Option 1: Manually uploading the data via the [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page. - Option 2: Using an automated SFTP transfer ([see here for more information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078)). - Option 3: Use a managed automatic sync ([see here for more information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202042973)). If you choose options one or two, you must properly format and upload five comma-separated value (CSV) spreadsheet files to get your data into Clever. All CSV files should follow Clever’s file formatting requirements, regardless of which applications you use. For more technical information, please refer to our [SFTP Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf), which provide highly detailed directions for setting up your CSV files. You must be logged in to view the SFTP Instructions. In addition, you can [check out this article for CSV formatting errors.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698)   * * * ## What’s a CSV file? [CSV files](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comma-separated_values) store a line of text for each data record, where the field values for that record are separated by commas. Here’s what comma-separated values look like:   ![Values separated by commas](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000d9OP) This data can also be represented in a table format, which is what you see when opening the file in a spreadsheet application like Excel. Here’s the same data represented as a table:   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cxf)   * * * ## Creating CSV files The best way to generate the five files you’ll upload to Clever is to export data directly from your Student Information System (SIS) in CSV format. Typing data by hand or manipulating data once it’s exported can lead to unexpected file formatting errors, which can prevent your data from being processed in Clever. Excel is commonly used to view CSV files, but it often imposes formatting that skews data and results in SFTP Upload Errors. For error-free viewing and saving CSV files, we recommend using an application built for CSV compatibility, such as CSVEdit, Sublime Text, Apache OpenOffice, TextEdit, or Notepad. For more information about troubleshooting file format issues, see [this help article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698). The file names for the CSV files should be the following (all lowercase letters):  - schools.csv - students.csv - teachers.csv - sections.csv - enrollments.csv The templates for these CSV files can be found [here](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip).  This graphic is helpful to explain how your files work together: [![Graphic of how Clever sync files work with each other](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000002aCH)](https://everpath-course-content.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com/instructor%2Fci3x2e49snygq5fv0p5f3ud4s%2Fpublic%2F1689994601%2FSFTP+How-your-data-works-dark-3.1689994601460.png) It is important that the file names are consistent in case (upper/lower case) in each upload. Uploading "Schools.csv" vs. "schools.csv" will result in two different files being stored in the district's SFTP box and can result in sync errors.  If you will be manually creating your CSV files, we highly encourage you to view [this playlist of videos](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLIUBNB4VJIjF7W0FusNaob5I4xy-MnMAZ). ## * * * ## Required fields Our [SFTP Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf) include all possible fields you can upload and indicate whether each is required by Clever (bolded in the SFTP specifications and marked “YES” or “NO” under “Required”). The screenshot below shows some of the possible fields for schools.csv, where ‘School\_id’ and ‘School\_name’ are required, but ‘State\_id’ is not required. ![SFTP Specification displays supported fields](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000fycv) Optional fields may be left blank, or you can leave them out of the CSV altogether. However, Clever recommends including as many fields as possible to take full advantage of reporting features in current applications, and to ensure compatibility with future app connections. Depending on which applications you connect your Clever account to, additional fields may be required beyond Clever’s minimum required fields. Check your district’s personalized SFTP instructions on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page to learn which fields are required by your connected applications.   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009BBse)   Please note: NCES\_id** and **MDR\_number** are not accepted fields. If you need to populate NCES ID or MDR values for your schools or district please contact Clever Support using the blue chat box in the bottom right corner of the Help Center. * * * ## What will my files look like? See the screenshots below for examples of how each file should look. Yellow highlighted areas represented the minimum required fields for each file. **Please note, the screenshots below do not show all possible fields for each file.** Please refer to Clever’s [SFTP Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf) to confirm all accepted fields. You can also download example files from the [Web Upload](https://schools.clever.com/settings/system/upload) page. Please see our note under “How should I create my 5 CSV files?” - if you view files in Excel, we recommend closing without saving to avoid formatting errors. ### schools.csv ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cxu) ### students.csv ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cxz) ### teachers.csv ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cy4) ### staff.csv ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cy9) ### sections.csv ![](/hc/article_attachments/215254247/Screenshot_2016-10-24_09.18.36.png)![](/hc/article_attachments/215254287/Screenshot_2016-10-24_09.19.06.png)![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CyE) ### ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CyJ) enrollments.csv ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CyO)![](/hc/article_attachments/215181108/Screenshot_2016-10-24_09.19.12.png) * * * ## Uploading multiple student contacts If you would like to sync more than one guardian/emergency contact for each student, you can list the student record multiple times in the students.csv file. Each row must have the same student information (student\_id, name, email address, etc.) but the contact columns will have different information for each contact. Even though the student\_id is listed multiple times, the student records will not receive a "duplicate id error" in the Sync Report for this particular instance. Please note - if providing student contacts, 'Contact\_type' and 'Contact\_name' columns are required. Below is what student contacts look like in the students.csv file: ![New contact for same student listed on additional row](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000fwGA) * * * ## Multi-site users (users at multiple schools) Users can be associated with multiple schools in Clever. Here's how that is done! ### **Students** Each student should only be associated with one school\_id in the student.csv, otherwise you will receive a "duplicate sis\_id" error. Students will be associated with multiple schools via their enrollments. If a student has enrollments in sections at multiple schools, they will be associated with the respective schools.    ### **Teachers** Each teacher should have only have one record in the teachers.csv file, otherwise you will receive a "duplicate sis\_id" error. Additional school associations will be processed from the sections.csv file. Clever will process all of the teacher's section assignments, giving them access to sections at multiple schools. Additionally, they will be associated with the respective schools. ### **Non-teaching staff** To associate a staff member with multiple schools, create a separate row at each location. The only field that will be different for each row is the school\_id. For example, if a staff member should be associated with three schools, it should look like this: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BrW) To associate a staff member with all schools in the organization, enter school\_id as **district** ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Brl) * * * ## Quote Surrounded Fields If a value for a field contains a comma or quotes, it will skew the CSV and result in one or more records not processing. To resolve the issue, export the CSV with quotes surrounding the fields.  For example: 

Before

After

Ford, Tom"Ford, Tom"
Thomas "Tom" Ford"Thomas "Tom" Ford"
Math, 2nd Period"Math, 2nd Period"
123 Baker Street, Apt. 102"123 Baker Street, Apt. 102"
Many SISs will have the option to surround field values in quotes upon export. For example, in PowerSchool's Data Export Manager, it is located under **Export Options:** ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZNg5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062iMa) For information on how to surround field values in quotes upon export, please contact your SIS directly.  **Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets** If manually constructing your file in Excel or Google Sheets, they do not have an automated way to export a field surrounded with double quotes. As such, the easiest way to add quote surrounds is on a field-by-field basis. For example, if you would like to surround Column B with double quotes, insert a blank column to the right (C), and enter the following formula in C2: \=CONCATENATE("""",B2,"""") Copy cell B2 and paste it to the rest of the desired cells to apply the concatenate formula. You can then "Hide" Column B prior to export to ensure the desired data is exported only once, surrounded in double-quotes. * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) For a complete list of all SFTP FAQs, [please see this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001556) **What CSV files are required to sync with Clever?** - The [Clever SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) outline the five required CSV files for a data sync to complete:  - schools.csv - teachers.csv - students.csv - sections.csv - enrollments.csv.  The staff.csv is an optional additional file for adding non-teaching staff to Clever. **Do I need to include a schools.csv file if we are a single school?** - Yes! The schools.csv is required even if you’re a single school. This is how Clever’s sync system will know to associate your teacher and students with the school. **Do I need to include a sections.csv file?** - Yes! The sections.csv file is how Clever syncs your classes and assigns students to their class(es). - Even if you only have one section/class per grade, a sections.csv is required. The section\_id can be any unique value that is kept consistent across the section.csv and enrollments.csv. If you’re making your own files, our team recommends keeping it simple and using single numbers (section\_id = 1, section\_id = 2 for each section/class). **How do I know if my data upload went through?** - A sync will occur any time data is successfully uploaded to Clever. - They generally take 15-30 minutes to complete. If you’ve uploaded new data to Clever, please give the sync at least 30 minutes to complete. - Once 30 minutes have passed, please review your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page for the status of your sync. You should also receive an email to the email address in your Clever profile. - [Click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663?language=en_US) to learn more about your sync status! * * * **Related articles** - [SFTP Syncs: SFTP Sync FAQ](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001556) - [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408) - [SFTP Syncs: Troubleshooting CSV formatting errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698)

title: SFTP Syncs: Overview
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#overview) 2\. [Manual sync overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#manualsync) 3. [Review SFTP instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#reviewsftp) 3\. [Export data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#exportdata) 4. [Format files](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#formatfiles) 5. [Upload data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#uploaddata) 6. [Update your data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#updatedata) 7\. [How often can you sync your data?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078#howoften) ## Overview In this article, we’ll review data upload options for when automated syncs aren’t available. The secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) sync allows school organizations  to “push” data to Clever. School organizations generate five required CSV files (_schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv,_ and _enrollments.csv_) from their data management system (such as a student information system (SIS)) or manually create the files in accordance with Clever's [specified file format](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). These files include data fields for each of the required five data types. You may include the optional _staff.csv_ file for your [non-instructional staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791), but it isn't required. * * * ## Manual sync overview As mentioned above, Clever requires five different data files (_schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv,_ and _enrollments.csv_). Each file has a job/function:

File

Description

 schools.csvCreates school profiles. Even if you are a single school organization, your one school must be listed in this file. 
 students.csvCreates student profiles. 
 teachers.csvCreates teacher profiles. 
 sections.csvCreates sections, i.e., classes and associates each one with a teacher 
 enrollments.csvCreates student enrollment associations to sections from the sections.csv 
 staff.csv (optional)Creates non-teaching staff profiles. Examples include principals, counselors, headmaster, etc. 
#### These files cascade and depend on one another. If there are no schools, then Clever cannot process students or teachers. If there are no students, Clever cannot process enrollments. If there are no enrollments, then Clever cannot process sections.  The graphic below shows how the files work together: ![Graphic showing how the five CSV files in Clever work together during a sync](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhGP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000095KSM)  * * * ## Review SFTP instructions Review Clever’s [SFTP Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) to [learn how to format your CSV files](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867) and to identify which fields are required by Clever and any learning applications you'll use in Clever. Please note that fields in bold are required by Clever, and fields highlighted in yellow must remain consistent across all CSV files.  The templates for these CSV files are available [here](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip).  If you’ve already [signed up](https://clever.com/signup%20) for a Clever account, select your sync type on the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. If you'll be using an SFTP sync, you'll find the [Clever SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) specific to your school organization, which include fields required by your connected applications. Not yet [signed up](https://www.clever.com/district-signup)? Take a look at our general SFTP instructions [here](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf). If you have questions about the instructions, please request help before proceeding by clicking the chat icon in the bottom right corner of this page. * * * ## Export data - Export your data from your data management system such as a SIS. Be sure to export all required fields. - Data can be exported directly from your SIS or through an SQL query. - If you’re unable to produce the required fields, please contact your SIS team directly. Clever is unable to troubleshoot data exporting from your system and SQL for SFTP Syncs. - We also recommend automating the process of exporting data from your SIS and uploading it to Clever. - If your school organization has a firewall that restricts traffic to or from Clever, please ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752).  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhGP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you do not utilize a SIS, you can manually create the required CSV files for syncing data to Clever in a program such as Excel or Google Sheets. * * * ## Format files - Format the five required CSV files (_schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv,_ and _enrollments.csv_) according to Clever’s specified [file format](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf). If you're including the optional staff.csv file, make sure to format that as well. - If you run into any issues, see [Troubleshooting CSV formatting errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698) for help! **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhGP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000095IQX) Clever Tip:** Making your files yourself? Check out our tutorial videos for each file type: [Schools.csv](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/8kgar7u78p), [students.csv](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/yesbibmc9f), [teachers.csv](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/zyjba7nx81), [sections.csv](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/2me6lzc2gg), [enrollments.csv.](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/hxz47rxvi1) * * * ## Upload data - Securely transfer the data to Clever using one of these two options: - Admins can upload files manually via the [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page. Need help using the Web Upload tool? See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US). - Or, admins can upload data directly to the Clever SFTP folder using an FTP client (e.g., Transmit, FileZilla, or WinSCP). [Click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408) for instructions on uploading data using an FTP client, or check out our [clickable tutorial](https://ior.ad/a88l). You’ll need your SFTP credentials from your [Clever Dashboard > Sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. This SFTP option also allows school organizations to write a script that automates the upload process. ![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhGP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv) Onboarding to Clever and want to learn about uploading CSV files? Check out our [Onboarding - Getting your schools’ data into Clever](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding/onboarding-sync?user_type=district_admin) course, available in Clever Academy! * * * ## Update your data - Repeat the steps above to update the data in Clever when student, teacher, or roster information changes. - Be sure to include all five files in your upload, and include ALL records for each file type. Your files should always contain all data. Clever will handle necessary additions, deletions, and updates. - You can always check your sync status on your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) homepage - here are some [common error messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203257407). * * * ## How often can you sync your data? - You can sync as often as you want! However, if your sync has been automated it may be set to sync once a day. - When a new set of files is sent to your SFTP directory we will automatically trigger a sync. Uploading too many times in a short period of time may trigger a sync upload error. * * * **Related articles:** - [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408) - [SFTP & Manual Upload: How do I format my CSV files?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867) - [SFTP Syncs: SFTP Sync FAQ](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001556)

title: For Clever Admins: iOS devices & the Clever app
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#overview)  
2. [How do I add the Clever iOS app?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#add)  
3. [Expected Login Behavior](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#Header1)  
4. [What happens when a user selects a learning application?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#select-app)  
5. [Best practices for using multiple apps in one session](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#switch)  
6. [Best practices for logging out of Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#Header4)  
7\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#FAQs)

##   
Overview

Students can log in to Clever on iPads using the Clever Single sign-on (SSO) application. The application allows students to access the Clever Portal and their Teacher Pages directly in the application, rather than launching Clever in a web browser. This article outlines the process of adding the app and its functionality for students.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfDt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Zg81p)  Please note:** The Clever iOS application doesn't support teacher, staff, or administrator logins. These users should access Clever via a web browser on their iOS device.

* * *

## How do I add the Clever iOS app?

The Clever application is available for free via the [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clever-instant-login/id1134186971). You can add the application to your devices manually, or use the Apple School Manager (ASM) and your MDM solution to find the Clever application and install it wirelessly to your iOS devices. Please see [more information below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024746971#janupdate) on updating versions.

The Clever iOS app requires iOS 16.6 or later and is compatible with iPhones and iPads.

If you are using older devices that don’t support iOS 16.6+, your users can still access Clever via a web browser on their iOS device by opening the browser and navigating to your school organization’s Portal URL (found on your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings page](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url)). From the browser, students can continue to log in to their Portal with their Badge or login credentials.

* * *

## Expected Login Behavior

  
**Students logging in with Badges**

1.  Please be sure your devices have the [Clever iOS app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clever/id1134186971) from the Apple App Store.
    
2.  Users will click on the Clever app to open it.
    
3.  The first screen students will see is the Clever Badge camera.
    
4.  Students have the ability to toggle between the front-facing and back-facing cameras.
    
5.  Students will need to hold their badge up to the camera on the mobile device.
    
6.  If the student is using a valid badge, they will see a green checkmark with sparkles signifying a successful login!
    
    -   _If the student sees a badging error message, they may need to reach out to their teacher or a Clever Admin for assistance._
        

7.  The student will then be logged into the Clever application and their Clever Portal. They can access all features of their Clever Portal, including their Teacher Pages, directly in the Clever app.
    
8.  Please see our section below on what happens when a user selects a learning application to learn more about the user experience beyond logging in.
    

You can preview the student experience in our videos below:

##   

An example of what the login could look like for students using a Badge and [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) pictures.

##   

**Logging in with credentials**

1.  Please be sure your devices have the Clever iOS app from the [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clever/id1134186971).
    
2.  When opening the Clever app, users will see the Badge Camera.
    
3.  They’ll select the “Password” tab at the bottom of the screen.
    
4.  The user will locate their school from the Clever login page.
    
5.  They’ll then select the method they want to use to login (ex: Login with Google or Login with Clever).
    
6.  The user will type their credentials and then be logged into the Clever application and their Clever Portal. They can access all features of their Clever Portal, including their Teacher Pages, directly in the Clever app.
    
7.  Please see our section below on what happens when a user selects a learning application to learn more about the user experience beyond logging in.
    

## 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfDt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cl0)**Please note:** The Clever app will remember the user's school organization after their first login on the device, so this user won't need to go through the process of selecting their school again if the Safari browser and/or Clever app were never fully closed, and device history has not been deleted.

* * *

## What happens when a user selects a learning application?

After users sign into the Clever app and they select an application, they'll be automatically authenticated into that learning application either in your device’s default web browser or the app’s standalone iOS application.

The login functionality is determined by application partners on a per-app basis.

* * *

## Best practices for using multiple apps in one session

We aim to connect students, teachers, and staff to as many of their resources as possible. After a user is logged in to Clever:  
 

1.  They can click on one of their connected applications.
    
2.  This will open the application or external link either in the device’s default web browser or the iOS application.
    
3.  If a user wants to go back to their Clever Portal, they should go back to the Clever application. From here they can launch an additional application, or access the same app again.
    

* * *

## Best practices for logging out of Clever

Whether using a shared device or not, the best practice is to always log out of your school organization's Identity Provider (IDP) in addition to Clever when you are finished. To do this, follow these steps:  
 

**Step 1:** Log out of the Clever application.

-   From the Clever Portal, click on your name in the top right corner, and select Log out.

  
**Step 2:** Log out of any learning applications and your school organization's Identity Provider (IdP) on your web browser.

-   **For example:** Google, Active Directory, LDAP, Canvas, Clever Passwords

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfDt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cle) For information regarding best practices on shared devices, please see this Help Center article: [For Families: Logging your students out of Clever on a shared device.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020614031)

If you have any additional questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help![](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020343092)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Will the Clever application log students out after any period of time?**

-   Clever won't log the student out. To log out they must select the person icon in the top right corner and **Log out**.

**Can teachers or staff use the Clever application to log in?**

-   No, the application is for students only. If teachers, staff, or administrators want to log in to Clever on an iOS device, they should use a web browser.

**I'm still using V5 or earlier of the Clever application. How can I update to the newest version of the Clever app?**

-   If you haven't already, Clever recommends that you opt into updates for the Clever Application in the App Store.
-   For school organizations using an MDM:
    -   If you've enabled auto updates in your MDM, the Clever application should automatically update.
    -   If you don't have auto updates enabled you’ll need to follow your MDM's instructions for manually opting into updates for a specific app. [The Clever app can be found in the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clever/id1134186971) and also found via Apple School Manager.
-   For school organizations without an MDM**:**
    -   Your team can manually install the new Clever app on student devices via the Apple App Store.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Families: Troubleshooting issues with the Clever iOS app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020343092)
-   [For Teachers: How do I troubleshoot using the Clever iOS app?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040332591)

title: For Clever Admins: Updating your tech support contact
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049312351#header1)  
2\. [Updating your tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049312351#h_01EG1KV4B0G26XYNNTJPV4NMD7)

## Overview

This article explains where to set or update your school organization's tech support contact in the Clever Dashboard, and where that contact information appears to users on your login page.  
 

* * *

## Updating your tech support contact

To abide by Clever's stringent [security and data policies](https://clever.com/trust), Clever Support will never provide user login credentials through any of our communications channels if a school organization user reaches out to us directly.

For this reason, each school organization should have a tech support contact for users to contact in the event of Clever login issues. This information can be updated by going to the [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)

  
![Tech Support contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6TJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aqC9)

  
The tech support contact information will be displayed when users select **Get help > Support Contact** from your school organization login page.

![Login page with highlight around Get help](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6TJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOAog)

![Screenshot of the login page help menu expanded to show the Support Contact option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6TJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOTCz)
