title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Setup & Configuration
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204982938#h_7a39f149-12d9-4a96-8208-66f206055d5d)  
2. [Portal Configuration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204982938#PortalConfigs)  
3\. [Identity Providers (IdPs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204982938#h_c6a6b798-fc31-479e-b8fc-bad1567220aa)  
4\. [Customize login buttons](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204982938#h_f2a8dc82-17d7-4dfa-b0d2-2aa2cc1b5766)  
5\. [Updating your Tech Support Contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204982938#h_01EG1KV4B0G26XYNNTJPV4NMD7)  
6\. [Rolling out single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204982938#RollingoutSSO)

![Clever Academy logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)   
Getting started with SSO? Check out our guide, [Onboarding - Setting up your schools' Clever login method](https://clever.academy/onboarding-login?user_type=district_admin), available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

​Clever Single Sign-On (SSO) enables users to be securely authenticated into connected applications via their Clever Portals. Users log in to Clever just once with one set of credentials, or using a Clever [Badge](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), and then click on the various app icons to be logged in automatically via SSO. Clever's application partners rely on Clever's verification system of determining that a user is indeed who they say they are. Without Clever SSO, each application would need to maintain its own database of users and their credentials.

Clever Admins can set up Clever SSO from their [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page. This article details the four main steps required to enable Clever SSO.

##   

* * *

##   
Portal Configuration

![Clever Portal URL setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BHmz)

The first step is to [set a custom Portal URL](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings) for your school organization, which your students and teachers will use to access Clever and their connected applications. To set a custom Portal URL for your school organization, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page.  
  
  
The Portal URL will be **www.clever.com/in/<shortname>;**. Remember to use something that your students and teachers will remember easily. To change your school organization's Portal URL, click the URL text box to edit the short name. Make sure to click **Save**. For more resources on managing the Portal, [click here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0xxWAC/single-signon-sso?language=en_US)

* * *

##   
Identity Providers (IdPs)

Clever SSO allows students and teachers to access education apps with the username and password they already use in your school organization. To add a login method for Clever, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol). In the top right corner, click **Add Login Method** and select the login method you wish to add for Clever.

Please visit the articles listed below for specific details about configuring Clever SSO for your school organization's Identity Provider (e.g. Google, Active Directory, Canvas, LDAP, etc.)

-   [Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038)
-   [Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503)
-   [Active Directory (LDAPS)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387)
-   [Active Directory (SAML)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576?language=en_US)
-   [Entra ID / Office 365](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889768?language=en_US)
-   [Canvas](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206629117?language=en_US)
-   [NCEdCloud](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026143131?language=en_US)
-   [Lenovo Stoneware / webNetwork](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215140667)

  
![Animated gif adding Google as an identity provider](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004apis)​

* * *

## Customize login buttons

The Clever login page can be further customized by:

-   Editing the login method text (e.g. 'Log in with Google' can be updated to 'Log in as Teacher')
-   Editing the login method order

![Clever Dashboard showing customizable login method order and buttons](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cji)

If you've set up SAML authentication for your school organization, you can update the login button label from your Clever Dashboard using the steps below:

1.  Go to Authentication > SSO Settings > [Login Method](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings)
2.  Under your SAML Authentication, click **Edit Settings**
3.  Under **Step 3: Select your Identity Provider**, choose your IdP from the dropdown
4.  Click **Save**

![SAML authentication settings showing the identity provider selection dropdown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hJ3np)

* * *

## Updating your Tech Support Contact

To abide by Clever's stringent [security and data policies](https://clever.com/trust), Clever Support will never provide user login credentials through any of our communications channels if a district user reaches out to us directly.

For this reason, each school organization should have a Tech Support contact for users to contact in the event of Clever login issues. This information can be updated from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.

![Clever Dashboard SSO settings showing the Tech Support contact field](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cjn)

The Tech Support contact information will be displayed on your school organization's Clever login page.

![Tech support contact information on login page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jsE)

* * *

## Rolling out single sign-on (SSO)

Clever has provided some helpful resources for when your district is ready to roll out Clever single sign-on (SSO) at your school organization:

**Distributing login information to teachers**

Once you've configured your single sign-on (SSO) settings, we recommend sending an email letting your teachers and staff know how to log in to Clever to access their connected applications.

Clever provides a downloadable PDF with login instructions (1) and an email template (2) for each connected application so that Clever admins can easily share login information with teachers.

![Login instructions for a specific application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BHoH)

  
To locate these resources, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page and click on the name of the specific application to open the app overview page.

The Login Instructions PDFs include:

-   Your school organization's Portal URL
-   Basic instructions for how to log in to Clever
-   Instructions on how to access the application from their Clever Portals.

![Example login instructions](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BHol)

The email contains:

-   Your school organization's Portal URL
-   Your school organization's Tech Support contact
-   Basic information about the app
-   A link to a video providing an overview of Clever SSO

![Email with login information](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BHov)   
  
  
If you select **View Email**, you'll see a preview of the email that will be sent to your teachers letting them know they now have access to that particular application. Select **Send** to send the email to teachers.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dsLV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Clever Tip:** The [Troubleshoot login tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046240972) can help you identify and diagnose common login issues for your users.

  
If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Identity Provider (IdP)/Login Method Options
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166787#step1) 2. [Identity Provider Options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166787#step2) 3. [Multiple Identity Providers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166787#step3) 4\. [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166787#resetting) ## Overview Clever [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807?language=en_US) allows your district's students, teachers, and staff to log in to Clever and access their connected applications. Once district users are logged into Clever, they simply click on an application icon in their Portal and are logged in to the learning app automatically via SSO. The first step in [setting up SSO](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938?language=en_US) in Clever is to select your district's Identity Provider (IdP).  If your district already uses one of the Identity Providers listed below, we encourage you to use that one for Clever SSO. If your district prefers to use an alternative SSO method, check out [Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038)! Once you have determined which IdP to use as your Clever SSO method, you will navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) to complete the setup.  Click [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/sections/207401927) for a list of helpful articles for setting up and managing Clever SSO for each IdP. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Thb3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Ciz)**Clever Tip:** If you need help determining which IDP to use, or setting up Clever SSO, please contact the [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) team for help!  * * * ## Identity Provider Options Below is a list of Clever-supported Identity Providers (IDPs). Click on the hyperlinked name of an IDP to learn more about the process and setup:  

IdP

 Requirements

   Things to Know

Active Directory / ADFS

  • Active Directory Federation Services 2.x or 3.x
  • Metadata file accessible over HTTPS with a certificate signed by a valid Certificate Authority
  • Can create a custom SAML
  • Requires manual Claims Rules setup

Canvas

  • Must already be using Canvas LMS and able to provide the URL for your school or district’s Canvas instance
  • Requires some manual testing to ensure correct setup.
  • Does NOT require the Canvas app integration with Clever

Clever Badges

  • Compatible with iOS devices, Chromebooks or Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge or Internet Explorer > 2013 or later
  • Computers/Devices with webcams
  • Printer needed
  • Available for students only
  • Students log in with a physical Badge
  • Teachers, District Administrators and School Tech Leads* can print student Badges.

* For their school(s) only 

Clever Passwords

 
  • Users can reset their own passwords (optional)
  • Teachers can reset student passwords (optional)
  • District Administrators can reset student & teacher passwords

Google

  • Users must have their district-provided (Google) email addresses in Clever
 

LDAPS

  • LDAP Server
  • Allowlist Clever’s external IPs
  • Credentials for a BIND account
  • Requires some manual testing to ensure correct setup
  • Works best with the Clever Portal, as LDAP does not allow for persistent sessions
  • Do NOT send BIND account credentials (or any other credentials) over email

Office 365 / Entra ID

  • Options:
    • Entra ID Premium
    • Entra ID and PowerShell Proficiency
  • Requires manual Claims Rules setup

Lenovo Stoneware / webNetwork

  • webNetwork 6.3.0167+
  • Works best with Single sign-on (SSO) links embedded in Stoneware portal

Rapid Identity

  • Users must have their district-provided email addresses in Clever
  • Requires setup in Rapid Identity per these instructions
* * * ## Multiple Identity Providers Districts can set up Clever Single sign-on (SSO) to allow for multiple identity providers. However, only one SAML Connection (ADFS, Entra ID, Stoneware, etc) can be active at a time.   * * * ## Resetting Passwords You can allow students, teachers, and staff to reset passwords to recover their Clever accounts for destinations (such as Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra, or Google Workspace) that you have set up in [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466). To learn more about how to reset passwords, please see [Clever Admin: Account recovery and password reset.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613) * * * **Related articles:** - [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): What is SSO?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166807#h_12181eb0-4143-448e-889e-c70c539525e3)  
2\. [How does SSO authentication work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166807#h_e3777c4f-3ae1-4d8c-8b35-ac80d98414fa)  
3\. [Who can use single sign-on (SSO)?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166807#h_e8cf159c-e044-4346-9ff2-215b8a8692db)  
4\. [Single sign-on (SSO) requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166807#SSOrequirements)  
5\. [Additional SSO options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166807#AddSSOoptions)

## Overview

Clever single sign-on (SSO) enables users to securely authenticate into connected applications via Clever Portal. Users log into Clever just once with one set of credentials, or using a Clever [Badge](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), and then click on the various app icons to be logged in automatically via SSO. Clever application partners rely on Clever's verification system of determining that a user is, indeed, who they say they are. Without Clever SSO, each application would need to maintain its own database of users and their credentials.

* * *

## How does SSO authentication work?

-   A user logs in to Clever via the school organization's Identity Provider (IDP) (e.g. Active Directory, Google, etc.) from the Clever login page.
-   Clever authenticates the user through the school organization's IDP.
-   If the user is verified, Clever creates a "token" (i.e. a piece of data) that identifies the user and then logs them in successfully.
-   The user then clicks on the appropriate application icon to open an application, and Clever provides the user's token to the application which authenticates the user. This means the user does not need to enter login credentials a second time.
-   The user is logged into the application successfully!

![Green checkmark](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ChI)**Clever Tip:** The Clever Portal also supports universal single sign-on for non-integrated Clever applications via SSO (Saved Passwords) authentication. [Read more about this here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488)!

* * *

## Who can use single sign-on (SSO)?

The following users can access applications through Clever single sign-on (SSO):

-   Students
-   Teachers
-   Staff
-   Clever admins

Please note that each individual learning application determines which of the user types listed above they support. Some apps only support two or three user types.

To find out which user types are supported by an application, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page, and click on the application name to open the app overview page. If a user type is not listed under **SSO Supported User Types**, users of that type won't be able to access the application through Clever.

![Screenshot of an app's overview page showing the SSO Supported User Types field](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgYP)

* * *

## Single sign-on (SSO) requirements

There are certain requirements that should be met in order to ensure a seamless Clever single sign-on (SSO) experience for users:

**1\. Users must have a record in Clever (via Secure Sync)**

-   In order for users to be able to log in, they must have an existing record in Clever. For more information on syncing rostering data to Clever, please see [What is Secure Sync?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588)

![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ChX)**Please note:** For best results, make sure that there is only one record for each user in Clever. If there are multiple records in Clever for the same user, users may not be able to log in. The only caveats to this are teachers who are also considered staff and have [both a teacher and staff account in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360032149791), or Clever admins who are also teachers or staff.

  
**2\. District Portal URL**

-   Each school organization has the ability to customize a unique Clever login page URL to share with school organization users. This URL is a direct way for users to log in rather than navigating to [Clever.com](https://clever.com/) and selecting their school. Custom URLs are in the format of **`[https://clever.com/in/<YOUR](https://clever.com/in/%3CYOUR) CUSTOM SHORTNAME>`** (e.g. [https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict)](https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict)
-   Your school organization's Portal URL can be customized from the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page in Clever. Visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838) for additional instructions.

![Screenshot of the Clever Dashboard Portal settings page showing the custom Portal URL field](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgYU)

  
**3\. Configure your Clever SSO login method (Identity Provider)**

-   For help determining which Identity Provider (IdP) your school organization should use and how to set it up, please see these articles:
    -   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Identity Provider (IdP) Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787)
    -   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Setup & Configuration](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938)

**4\. Tech Support Contact**

-   To abide by Clever's stringent [security and data policies](https://clever.com/trust), Clever support will never provide user login credentials through any of our communications channels if a school organization user reaches out to us directly.
-   For this reason, each school organization should have a Tech Support contact for users to contact in case of Clever login issues. This information can be updated from your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.

![Screenshot of the SSO settings page showing the Tech Support contact field](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgWU)

-   The Tech Support contact information will be displayed in your school organization's 'Get help logging in' page. Please visit [these articles](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/sections/201466977) for help troubleshooting user login issues.

![Screenshot of the Get help logging in page displaying the Tech Support contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgYe)

* * *

## Additional SSO options

**Allowing users to access Clever applications via your existing school organization portal, website or Learning Management System (LMS)**

-   Single sign-on (SSO) is designed to work with your existing school organization portal or website. You can allow users to authenticate into applications without using the Clever Portal by embedding single sign-on URLs (i.e. Instant Login Links) into your portal, website, or Learning Management System (LMS).
-   For information on Instant Login Links, please visit: [Single Sign-On (SSO): Instant Login links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205546348)

**Using the 'Log in with Clever' option**

-   Some applications provide a **‘**Log in with Clever’ option from their website login pages and mobile apps. This option allows your users to log in to the application from the app website using their Clever credentials!

![Screenshot of a Log in with Clever button on an application's login page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dt7t&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bgaf)

If you have any questions about Clever SSO, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)

title: Temporarily disable Clever logins using Access Control
text:
This article contains the following:   
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046702972#overview)  
2\. [Setting up access control](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046702972#setting_up_access_control)  
2\. [Updating access control](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046702972#updating_access_control)  
3\. [User experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046702972#user_experience)  
4\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046702972#faqs)

## Overview

Access control allows district admins to determine when students, teachers, and staff can access the Clever Portal and apps via Clever. Access control is intended as a temporary measure to limit potential student, teacher, or staff access to course-related information during sensitive time periods.  
  
When logging in to the Clever Portal or some connected applications, students, teachers, and staff are able to infer some information about which students and teachers are assigned to which classes (such as if they log into a reading app via Clever and see that they’re listed under 5th Period ELA with Ms. Thompson).  
  
By using access control, district admins can prevent students, teachers, and staff from viewing course-related information in Clever Portal or their connected applications by disabling login access. Note that disabling Access Control for students also restricts [Badges into Chromebooks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001645?language=en_US) even if a student is logging into the Chromebook for a purpose unrelated to the Clever Portal.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDyH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Users may still be able to log into third-party applications if the applications support login methods other than Clever. 

* * *

##   
Setting up access control

You can set up access control by following these steps:

1.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
2.  Go to the **Access control** tab and click **Edit**.  
       
    ![Access Control screen with highlight on edit link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDyH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xZ2f)  
      
    
3.  Select the user type(s) you wish to disable access for.
4.  Select the **Start** and **End Dates** for disabling access.  
       
    ![Control Access Control screen with students disabled August 22-31](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDyH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xZ39)

* * *

## Updating access control

You can return to the access control options to edit **Start** and **End Dates** at any time. You can also immediately restore access by clicking **Enabled** next to the relevant user type.  
  

* * *

## User experience 

Any user who tries to log into Clever or an application via Clever while their access is disabled will see a Clever login error stating that their login method is temporarily disabled until the set date.   
  

An example of what a student will see:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDyH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nSaXN)

* * *

## FAQs

**What type of information can users infer?**

-   Students
    -   Teachers by viewing Teacher Pages and apps they will use in their upcoming courses via Clever
    -   Teachers and classmates in some connected apps
-   Teachers
    -   Class and student associations from viewing sections and apps via Clever
    -   Class and student associations from viewing sections in connected apps
-   Staff
    -   Duties based on available apps

**Are there other options for hiding schedules from students, without blocking access to Clever?**

You can also [hide Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001723) for up to 90 days. This will prevent students seeing Teacher Pages for their new teachers, but they may still be able to determine classmates or teachers via learning applications.

**Should we enable Access Control?**

-   You can see what students, teachers, and staff see in their Portals using the **Access Portal as user** feature. Decide based on what a typical Portal looks like whether you want to disable login access using access control.

  
![Access portal as](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDyH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xt1K)

**Will this prevent students from accessing applications via login methods other than Clever?**

-   Access control will only block your students from logging into the Clever Portal and using Clever SSO to log into other applications (e.g. through **Log in with Clever** buttons). Access Control cannot prevent users from logging into applications via other methods.
-   If you want to block non-Clever login pathways to an application, we recommend reaching out to that application to discuss options with them directly.  
    

**How is this different from the hiding applications feature?**

-   Clever admin have the ability to [hide applications and links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000311483) in Clever. There are differences between hiding apps and access control:
    -   The hide feature:
        -   Only applies to individual applications and links – it can’t be applied to multiple resources at the same time. 
        -   Doesn't control users’ access to the Clever Portal. Users can still log in to the Clever Portal and see various features like Teacher Pages and Messaging.
    -   Access control:
        -   Allows administrators to disable access to all Clever applications at once.
        -   Prevents selected user types from logging into the Clever Portal.  
            

**When exactly will users be able to start logging in on disable end date?**

-   Users will be able to start logging in at midnight local time on the selected disable end date.  
    

**What should I do if I want to enable access before my scheduled end date?**

-   From your Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Access control tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol), select **Edit**, and change the disable end date to whatever new date you want to use. If you select the current day, users will gain access immediately.

title: Clever Portal: Hiding applications and disabling logins
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000311483#one) 2\. [Hiding apps vs disabling logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000311483#hidingdisabling) 3\. [Hiding SSO or SSO (Saved Password) applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000311483#sso) 4\. [How Clever Admins and School Tech Leads hide resources in the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000311483#linked) 5\. [How do hidden applications appear in Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000311483#three) ## Overview This article is an overview of the various methods for preventing logins and hiding applications in Clever. A school organization may wish to hide applications in a Clever Portal for many reasons, from scheduling an application launch to hiding resources during testing periods. Clever's visibility settings allow schools to manage application access with ease.  * * * ## Hiding apps vs disabling logins There are several options for Clever Admins and teachers to hide or limit access to applications through Clever.  If you want to: - Allow logins to Clever and the application, but hide the application in the Portal, you'll want to use settings for **Hiding in Portal.** - Allow logins to Clever, but disable logins to the application and hide it in the Portal, use **App Visibility**. - Prevent logins to Clever and to applications via Clever use **Access Control.** To better understand this, we have created a table that provides insight into these options. Please note that none of the features listed in the table below will block direct access to apps rostered through Clever (e.g. users can still log into the app at the app's website outside of Clever if the application supports this).

Feature

Access Control

 

App Visibility Settings

Hiding in Portal

Teacher Page Category Hiding

About the feature

Clever Admins can temporarily block Clever Portal access so that users can’t access Clever and their applications through Clever.

Clever Admins can hide specific applications in Clever and prevent users from using Log in with Clever (LIWC) buttons. The app will show up as disabled on Teacher Pages.

Clever Admins and School Tech Leads (if enabled) can hide specific apps and links on the District Page, but applications that are on Teacher Pages are still visible and can be used.

Teachers can enable this to hide categories and resources within the category on a Teacher Page.  This doesn’t affect visibility outside of the specific category on that Teacher Page.

Who can configure

Specified user types can't see the app in the Portal resource list or District Page (but can still see, use, and add on Teacher Pages)

No - there is no access to the Portal

No - the app isn't visible in Portal and shows up as disabled in Teacher Pages

Yes

Which users can this be applied to?

Staff, Teachers, Students - set by user type

Yes - no access to the Portal
