Help Center Articles

Temporarily disable Clever logins using Access Control

Clever Portal: Hiding Applications
Clever Portal: Disable logins to applications

Clever Portal: Hiding Applications

Clever Portal: Teacher Pages

Recommended Uses

Block user access during pre-school-year rollover to prevent early visibility of schedules/assignments

Block Clever-powered access to apps

  • For links
  • Usable by STLs
  • When you want teachers to be able to add apps to Teacher Pages but don't want an app visible on general Portal 

For teachers to hide resources they aren't currently using on their Teacher Pages

## Hiding SSO or SSO (Saved Passwords) applications **Step 1:** Log in to the Clever Dashboard and navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and click the app you'd like to hide. This will disable the application for the selected users. **Step 2:** Go to the Settings tab and click **Edit** in the Application’s visibility box. ![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-9.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKen&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMAh) **Step 3:** Select the user type you wish to hide the application from. Step 5 outlines hiding from multiple user types. ![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-10.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKen&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMB6) **Step 4:** Select the Start and End Dates for hiding the application.  If you aren’t sure when you’d like to unhide the application, you can leave that field blank to keep the application hidden until you set a date or unhide it. ### ![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-11.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKen&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMBL) **Step 5:** To hide the application from an additional user type, just click **Hide** and set the dates for that user type.  ### ![HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-12.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKen&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMBa) ### **How do I change when an application will be disabled?** You can return to the application visibility options to edit Start and End Dates at any time. You can also immediately unhide an application by clicking **Visible** next to the relevant user type. * * * ## How Clever Admins and School Tech Leads hide resources in the Clever Portal ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKen&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CIS)**Please note:** Applications must be put into a category before they can be hidden. For more detailed instructions please read: [How do I manage the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568) Clever Admins, and if enabled, School Tech Leads, can hide applications directly via Portal settings. Hiding an application via Portal settings will hide the application in the District Resources section of the Portal, but if the teacher has favorited the app or added it to a Teacher Page, it won’t be hidden. Similarly, if a student or staff member has favorited the app, it won’t be hidden. When hiding an application in the Portal, you’ll also have the option to set different hidden dates per user type. For example, you can hide an application from teachers from June 20th to August 1st, but hide it from students June 20th to August 15th. This can be helpful when rolling out a new application. To hide an application: 1. Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal page.](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) 2. Locate the application you wish to hide and click the three vertical dots. 3. Select **Hide/show in Portal.** 4. Select **Hide temporarily**. 5. Select all users (student, teachers, staff) you want to hide the application from for the same timeframe. If you want to hide the application for a separate user type for a different timeframe, you can use the **Add another user type** button after you configure the timeframe for your first user type. 6. Fill in the start and end dates for hiding. 7. Click **Save.** 8. Be sure to select **Publish changes** in the top right corner of the Organize district portal page to apply the visibility settings. ## How do hidden applications appear in Clever Portal? When hiding is enabled, the application icon will display on the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal page](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) was grayed out to indicate it's hidden from users. If you hover over the app, it'll display a tool tip to let you know hiding is enabled. In the user's Clever Portal, the application icon will be _fully_ hidden until the End Date is reached. ![A side-by-side comparison of a visible/hidden application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKen&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XPFLr) _A side-by-side comparison of a visible/hidden application._ * * * **Related articles:** - [Temporarily disable Clever logins using Access Control](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046702972)[](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000311483) - [Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323#organizing_teacher_pages)

title: For Clever Admins: Installing the Clever browser extension
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360019869511#h_2d2f92b1-459d-426b-bd92-f3996344ad7b)  
2\. [Browser Compatibility and Access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360019869511#header2)  
3\. [Clever browser extension installation & directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360019869511#h_8b31c0d4-3ca2-4dec-8a6a-322d0b09ff26)  
4\. [Pushing out the Clever browser extension to all district users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360019869511#step3)  
5\. [Clicking the Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360019869511#clicking)

## Overview

The Clever browser extension is the key to ensuring that [SSO (Saved Passwords) applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US) function properly because it facilitates the secure storing of user login credentials for these types of applications. In addition, the extension provides users with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) experience to these applications through Clever. If the Clever extension is not present on a device, the user will need to manually enter their login credentials when accessing SSO (Saved Passwords) applications through Clever.  
  
Single sign-on (SSO) is available for integrated applications in Clever without the browser extension. To find out which type of application an application is, Clever Admins can navigate to their list of applications from the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page to locate the application and look under the **App Type** column.   
  
![Picture1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TDxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZfSD)

  
For more about the different types of applications in Clever, please visit: [For Clever Admins: Apps - Types of apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127?language=en_US)

* * *

## Browser Compatibility and Access

  
Clever supports the following internet browsers:

-   Chrome
-   Firefox
-   Microsoft Edge
-   Apple Safari (we support this browser for general use with Clever, but _not_ for SSO (Save Passwords) apps, as we do not currently offer a Safari Extension) 

The Clever browser extension is _**not**_ required for iOS devices (e.g., iPads, iPhones) as these devices use the Clever app, which acts as the browser extension. For details, visit: [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: iOS Devices](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360033063711?language=en_US)  
  
For devices where the browser extension cannot be downloaded (e.g., Android, Amazon Fire tablets, Safari), users will need to manually enter their login credentials for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications when accessing them through Clever. For additional details, visit: [Clever Technical Requirements & Supported Devices.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387?language=en_US)

It is expected that when a user clicks on the Chrome Extension, it will take them to clever.com/login.  
  
To streamline your login flow, Clever suggests directing your students and teachers to use your district’s portal URL which can be found in the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings.](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TDxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  If users are accessing SSO (Saved Passwords) applications from home due to remote learning, we recommend standardizing credentials for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications (e.g., student number as the required username and date of birth as the password). Doing this will make it easier for students and families to remember their login credentials when logging in to these types of applications.

* * *

##   
Clever browser extension installation & directions

Please see the links below for information and instructions for installing the Clever browser extension:

-   Google Chrome:  [Install](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/clever/nopfnnpnopgmcnkjchnlpomggcdjfepo)  |  [Directions](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/2588006?hl=en)
-   Microsoft Edge (New):   [Install](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/clever/innfnjgighoafebohpiamhnchmkoilgj?source=sfw)  |  [Directions](https://www.howtogeek.com/411830/how-to-install-google-chrome-extensions-in-microsoft-edge/)
-   Firefox: [Install](https://crx.clever.com/firefox/download) | [Directions](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/find-and-install-add-ons-add-features-to-firefox)

* * *

##   
Pushing out the Clever browser extension to all district users

Please see the following articles for details on pushing out the Clever browser extension to all district users:

-   [Chrome extension instructions](https://support.google.com/chrome/a/answer/6306504?hl=en)
-   [Microsoft Edge](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/deploy/group-policies/extensions-management-gp)
-   [Mozilla Firefox extension instructions](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/deploying-firefox-with-extensions)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If you are experiencing difficulty deploying or pushing out the Clever browser extension to your users, or need further instruction, please contact the browser provider's support team directly. 

* * *

##   
Clicking the Clever browser extension

The primary function of the Clever browser extension is to facilitate logins for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications.

When the extension is clicked, the following actions will occur based on the user's browser state:

-   When already logged into the Portal in another tab, clicking the extension will take the user to their Portal
-   When logged out, but using a browser where the user has logged into the Clever Portal before, clicking the extension will take the user to the district Clever Portal login URL
-   When in an incognito window, new browser, or after clearing browser history, a click will take the user to the Clever school selection screen

To streamline your login flow and provide a consistent experience, we suggest directing your students and teachers to use your district’s Portal URL, which can be found in the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever Technical Requirements & Supported Devices](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387?language=en_US)
-   [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: iOS Devices](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360033063711?language=en_US)
-   [For District Admins: Apps - Types of apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002370127?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Clever Portal - Adding External Links (Hyperlinks)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002942963#header1)  
2\. [Adding external links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002942963#header2)  
3\. [Deleting external links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002942963#header3)

## Overview

In addition to Clever applications, Clever Portal supports adding links to other digital resources that are used in the classroom. External links work just like bookmarks, providing one-click navigation to digital resources. You can customize external link visibility based on user type, grade level, and school sites.

External links do not authenticate users into the linked website. If you would like to authenticate users into the website, you can request Clever build a SSO (Saved Passwords) application by visiting [https://schools.clever.com/applications/request.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/request)

If you’d like to add links to any Google resources, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001597).  
 

* * *

## Adding external links

To add a link: 

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize school organization portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize).
2.  Click **Add to the Portal.**
3.  From the dropdown menu select **Add a link.**
4.  A modal will pop-up for adding the link. Select an icon or upload a custom icon (optimal icon size should be 200x200).
5.  Fill out the required fields for the link Title and URL.
6.  Select which user types, grades, and schools you would like to add the custom link for. Please note that if adding for selected schools, the link will only display for the user if the selected school matches the user's primary school association.
7.  Choose one or multiple categories to organize the link into.
8.  Click **Add.**
9.  Be sure to also click ****Publish Changes** i**n the top right of the Organize school organization portal page to save your link.

   ![Screenshot of Add a link settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSZZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XPLB8)

* * *

## Deleting external links

To delete a link:

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize school organization portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize).
2.  Click the three vertical dots on the link you want to delete.
3.  Select **Edit.**
4.  Select **Remove link.**

![Screenshot of Add a link settings highlighting the Remove link icon.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSZZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZaAsj)

* * *

**Related articles:**   
[Clever Portal: Customizing the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568)

title: For Teachers: Overview of the Clever Portal
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000781723#Overview)  
2\. [Features](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000781723#Features)

##   
Overview

School organizations use Clever as a repository for digital learning resources and applications, providing easy access for staff, teachers, and students. Teachers can add assignments, links, applications, and other resources to their Clever Portals and share them with students. This article highlights some of the main features of the Clever Portal for teachers while also providing links to associated articles that provide more detailed information about each.

##   

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcW)  
Getting started with the Clever Portal? Check out our course [Clever Academy for Teachers: Level 1](https://clever.academy/level-1-getting-started-with-clever?user_type=teacher)  available in Clever Academy!

* * *

## Features

### **Teacher Homeroom**

When first logging in to Clever, teachers are directed to their Clever Portal, which allows them to access their Teacher Pages, Announcements, Clever Library, student support tools, and more!

![Screenshot of the Clever Teacher Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000MFVQE)     
 

### **T****eacher Pages**

Teachers can create multiple personalized Teacher Pages to house a variety of learning resources for themselves and their students. Once a teacher has designed their Teacher Page(s), and they've added applications and resources (e.g., learning applications, links to various websites, PDF files, etc.), teachers can share their page(s) with students. Teachers can design multiple Teacher Pages and can even create a different Teacher Page for every class or subject if desired. Teachers in the same school can also share their Teacher Pages with each other to view.   
  
Examples of the resources that can be added to Teacher Pages include:

-   School organization-wide applications 
-   Various [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471?language=en_US) applications 
-   Links to online tools (e.g., Wikipedia.org, Dictionary.com)
-   Homework or assignments
-   Community websites (e.g., local public library)
-   And more!

Teachers can also create private Teacher Pages for accessing resources and applications that they do not wish to share with students.  

## ![Screenshot of a Teacher Page.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hbx)

  
For detailed information about Teacher Pages, please visit: 

-   [Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323?language=en_US)

### **Clever Library**

If your school organization has this feature enabled, the Clever Library provides a place for teachers to discover, research, and adopt new classroom resources. The resources in the Clever Library can be added to individual Teacher Pages for easy access by teachers and students. Teachers can browse a catalog of over 500 popular resources that they can then add to their Teacher Pages quickly and easily. The Clever Library is organized by grade level and content area and contains descriptions and screenshots of available resources. The search can also be filtered by grade, category, and more!  
 

![Screenshot highlighting the Clever Library filter.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hdZ)

  
For detailed information about adding applications from the Clever Library, please visit: 

-   [For Teachers: Library - adding applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672?language=en_US)

###   
**Teacher Announcements**

Announcements are perfect for when teachers have a message to send to an entire class of students. Teachers can send announcements to all students enrolled in a single class or to all students in all classes. Students can then securely view their teacher's announcement directly from their Clever Portals.

![Example Teacher announcement](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bUJvz)

  
  
For detailed information about Announcements, please visit: 

-   [For Teachers: Announcements](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045714731)

###   
**Teacher Analytics**

With many school organizations implementing distance learning for students, Clever's Teacher Analytics allows teachers to more closely monitor how their students are using Clever (e.g., logging in to clever, accessing associated applications, etc.).   
  

![Screenshot highlighting Teacher Analytics.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000MFUxB)

For detailed information about Teacher Analytics, please visit: 

-   [For Teachers: Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311?language=en_US)

###   
**Student Roster**

From the Student Roster tab, teachers can:

-   Verify a student's Clever login status, 
    
-   Download class [Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408?language=en_US) for individual students or an entire class, 
    
-   Create backup login codes for students who are unable to log in
    
-   Log students out
    
-   Troubleshoot logins
    
-   See student and guardian information
    
-   Set a student or class language
    
-   And in some cases, can reset student passwords.
    

Please note that school organizations need to have Clever Badges and the reset password feature enabled for teachers to access these options. 

![Screenshot of teacher tools in the student roster.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPob&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bUgnh)

  
For detailed information about features available from the Classes tab, please visit: 

-   [For Teachers: Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Configuring languages in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001748)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Library - adding applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Managing Clever Portal
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#Overview)  
2\. [Choosing the Portal you're managing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#choosing)  
3\. [Managing your school organization's Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#managing)  
          •   [Adding & editing categories](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#addingediting)  
          •   [Adding custom external links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#externallinks)  
          •   [Moving application icons](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#movingicons)  
          •   [Adding a custom Portal icon](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#customicons)  
4\. [Previewing the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#previewing)  
5\. [Why Clever updated the Portal management and SSO experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#whyCleverupdated)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#faq)

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CELo)  
Getting started with Clever Portal? Check out our course [**Quick Start - Setting up your Portal**](https://clever.academy/quick-start-guide-set-up-your-clever-portal?user_type=district_admin) available in Clever Academy! 

##   
Overview

From an admin perspective, there are two primary components in Clever; the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) and the [Clever Portal](https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict/district-admin/portal). 

The Clever Dashboard is where you’ll manage your school organization’s Clever account, from setting up applications, to troubleshooting logins, to configuring tools like Classroom MFA.

The Clever Portal is where you and your end users (teachers, students, and staff) will securely access applications. 

In Winter 2025, Clever made updates to the Portal management experience to provide Clever Admins a more efficient way to organize the Portal for end users that also adheres to a least-privileged access model. Previously, admins had one spot to access their applications and organize the district Portal. Now, admins have their own Portal where they can find all of the digital resources scoped for Clever Admins, and in their Clever Dashboard they can organize the end user’s Portal experience to ensure that each individual can easily find and access just the tools they need. This approach ensures that managing a student’s resources doesn't inadvertently grant an admin unnecessary permissions or data exposure within those third-party apps.

If you want to learn more about your Clever Dashboard, check out our [article here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043093). 

If you’re interested in learning more about organizing your school’s Clever Portal, keep reading below!

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**Want to try out organizing your Clever Portal without making changes? Check out our [interactive tutorial here!](https://ior.ad/b8PN)

* * *

## Choosing the Portal you're managing

Depending on the roles and permissions you’ve been granted in Clever, the Clever Portal can be organized at the account level for your entire school organization or at an individual school level.

This enables school organizations with multiple schools to ensure that each school and user has their own custom Portal with only the resources they need, organized in a way that is easy to navigate.

By default, users with the Clever administrator role can manage the Portal for their entire school organization and individual schools.

Additional team members not assigned the Clever admin role can also be granted permission to manage or preview school-specific Portals via [custom roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702). Users assigned a custom role scoped to specific schools can be given permission to manage the Portal. This can include managing Portal notifications and managing the organization of the Portal for the schools they’re assigned to, as well as [previewing that school organization’s Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#previewing).

If you have permission to organize more than one school’s Portal or the entire school organization’s Portal, on the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) page, you’ll see a drop down to select the Portal you want to edit.

![Drop down to select the school organization's Portal to edit](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000niM5R)

* * *

## Managing your school organization's Clever Portal

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008SguA)  Please note:** Previously, Clever Admins both managed the district Portal and accessed applications through SSO directly from the Portal. With the new experience, district Portal management now occurs in the Clever Dashboard, while the Portal itself is reserved for SSO access only.  
  
Learn more about this [change here.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#whyCleverupdated)  
  
If you are missing application icons in your Portal due to missing SSO user scopes, and you’d like to re-add these links, [please see here.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#missingapplication)

From your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal page](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize), you can create categories, organize application icons, and add external links.

Before you get started organizing, be sure you’ve selected the group you want to organize the Portal for (either your entire school org or a specific school) from the drop down. The options in this drop down will vary based on your permissions.

If you’re organizing for a specific school, you may see locked categories. These are categories or resources managed by an admin with access to the entire school organization’s Portal.

![Example of a locked category](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nhtl0)

If you need to organize these resources or a Portal that you don’t have access to, please reach out to a Clever admin or your Clever admin account owner.

###   
Adding & Editing Categories

From your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal page](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize), you can create custom categories to group applications, making it easier for users to locate the applications they need (i.e., Google apps, math applications, reading applications, and newly added applications). To create a new category:

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) page.
    
2.  If necessary, specify the Portal you’d like to edit (entire school org or a specific school).
    
3.  Select the **Add to the Portal** button.
    
4.  From the dropdown menu choose **Add a category**.
    
5.  Click the pencil icon next to the New Category to name the category. 
    
6.  After naming your category, either:
    
    1.  Use the three vertical dots next to an existing resource to move it into the category
        
    2.  Drag and drop an existing resource into the new category or
        
    3.  Select the **Add links** button to add a new external link to the category. Each category must contain at least one resource for changes to save.
        
7.  When you’re done adding your category and adding resources to it, click **Publish changes.**
    

To edit existing categories:

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) page.
    
2.  If necessary, specify the Portal you’d like to edit (entire school org or a specific school).
    
3.  From here, you can edit category names by clicking the pencil, delete a category by clicking the trashcan icon, or rearrange categories using the drag & drop modal on the right side of your screen. You can also rearrange categories one at a time using the up and down arrows next to the trashcan icon.
    
4.  Click the blue checkmark next to your category name to confirm it, then select **Publish changes** to complete any changes you’ve made.
    

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000SuCzF)  Please note:** When setting up sharing rules for any application not assigned to a category (in the default **More Apps** section), you’ll receive a prompt asking if you’d like to add the application to a category. For a category to appear in this dropdown, you must first create it via your [Organize district portal page](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize).

### Adding custom external links

Custom external links are URLs that you can add to your Clever Portal for end users to easily locate. This may include resources like a school website or calendar, as well as links to other resources or applications. If a login is required, external links don’t automatically log users in to the resource. To add a custom external link:

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize).
    
2.  If necessary, specify the Portal you’d like to edit (entire school org or a specific school).
    
3.  Click **Add to the Portal.**
    
4.  From the dropdown menu select **Add a link.**
    
5.  A modal will pop-up for adding the link. Select an icon or upload a custom icon (Note: Optimal icon size should be 200x200)
    
6.  Fill out the required fields for the link Title and URL.
    
7.  Select which user types (audience), grades, and schools you would like to add the custom link for. Please note that if adding for selected schools, the link will only display for the user if the selected school matches the user's primary school association.
    
8.  Choose one or multiple categories to organize the link into.
    
9.  Click **Add.**
    
10.  Be sure to click **Publish Changes** on the top right of the page to finalize your updates.
     

**To delete a link:**

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize).
2.  If necessary, specify the Portal you’d like to edit (entire school org or a specific school).
3.  Click the three vertical dots on the link you want to delete.
4.  Select **Edit.**
5.  Select **Remove link.**

###  Moving and duplicating application icons

To help organize your school organization's resources to make it easy for students and teachers to find what they need, you can move or duplicate application and resource icons to different categories in your Clever Portal. To do so, follow the steps below:

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district portal](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) page.
    
2.  If necessary, specify the Portal you’d like to edit (entire school org or a specific school).
    
3.  Click the three vertical dots in the top right corner of the icon.
    
4.  Select **Move to new category** from the dropdown, and select the category that you’d like to move the application to. If you’d like to include the resource in multiple categories, select **Copy resource** and then move the duplicated resource to the new category. You can also drag and drop resources to organize them if you prefer.
    
5.  Select **Publish Changes** to the top right of the page once you are finished making updates.
    

You can also add an application to a category directly from the **Add to the Portal** drop down. Click the drop down, select **Add an application** then choose the app and category you’d like to assign it to.

![Example of adding an application to a category](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000niay1)

If your Portal management permissions are set to specific schools, you’ll only be able to manage applications that are being **Shared by school.** If you’re missing an application you’d like to manage, please reach out to a Clever admin owner or Clever admin for assistance.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If you are experiencing issues dragging and dropping the application icons, please try adjusting your browser zoom settings to a smaller size and try again!

###   
 Adding a custom Portal icon

Clever admins can upload a custom icon for your school organization's Clever Portal. Having a custom icon helps users quickly identify that they are logging into the correct Portal. Click [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360012942731?language=en_US) to see where the icon appears on the Clever login page.  
  
You can set your icon by going to [Clever Dashboard > Portal settings > Customization tab](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/customization).  These are the required image specs:

-   Upload your icon in .png format only
-   Maximum image size is 200px by 200px
-   Can be color or black & white
-   Should be high-quality, non-blurry, or distorted
-   For best results, upload a square image

  
![Screenshot of the Customization tab under Portal settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XPpHF)   
  
Once you have uploaded the icon, click **Update**. Now users will be able to view the icon on your school organization's login page.

* * *

## Why Clever updated the Portal management and SSO experience

One of the ways Clever builds security into our platform is by moving toward a least-privileged access model. This approach minimizes the attack surface of your school organization's data by ensuring users only have access to the specific tools they need.  
  
To support this, we have intentionally separated Portal Management from Admin SSO Access:  
  
**Portal management:** This functionality is now available in the Admin Dashboard. Icons in the “Organize District Portal” tab are intentionally non-clickable to prevent administrative accounts from having "blanket access" to applications by default.  
  
**The Admin Portal:** This remains the Admin hub for SSO into resources provisioned to Admin accounts. If you need personal access to a specific application, it must be scoped to your account. Once provisioned, it will appear as a clickable icon in your personal Portal.  
  
**Why the change?** By decoupling these experiences, we ensure that managing a student’s resources doesn't inadvertently grant an admin unnecessary permissions or data exposure within those third-party apps.

If you notice that applications you previously accessed via your Portal are no longer present, please follow [these troubleshooting steps in our FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#missingapplication).

To take a look at the previous Portal management experience compared with the updated experience, check out the video below:

##   

* * *

## Previewing the Portal

If you’re a Clever admin owner or a Clever admin, you can preview a specific school’s Portal. You may wish to view a school's Portal to see which categories or links are available to them through that school’s Portal.

To preview a Portal, click the **Preview Portal as** button and select the school Portal you’d like to view.

When previewing the Portal as a specific school, all resources will appear in gray, as you are only previewing the Portal. To return to editing the district Portal, select the Previewing as drop down again and choose **District Portal View.**

![Preview Portal as screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZOxaf)

_An example of previewing a specific school as an administrator with resources grayed out._

If you’d like to view the Portal of a specific student or teacher:

1.  Search for the user using the search bar at the top of your Dashboard.
    
2.  Hover over their name and select **Portal as user.**
    

This will enable you to access their Portal and preview what their Clever experience is. Please be cautious as your actions or changes will impact the teacher’s experience.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Why did the Clever Portal management and organization setup change?**

-   To provide Clever Admins with a more efficient way to organize the Portal for end users and access their own resources.

**Why is an application missing from my personal Clever Portal?**

-   There are a couple of reasons why an application may not appear in your Portal.
    1.  Check the **Supported SSO User Types** to confirm the application supports administrator logins. If the app doesn't support District admin logins, it won't appear in your Portal. If you still want to access the resource via your Portal, you can [add an external link](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205875568#externallinks) to the resource and set the audience to District admins only.  
        ![Screenshot of SSO Supported User Types](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XT7hU)  
    2.  Check the data that the application is receiving on the **Application Overview** **page** to confirm that Clever Admins are shared. If Clever Admins aren't shared, adjust your field access settings to share admins. [Learn more here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049871231?)  
        ![Application receives box with District Admin data highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI57&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XSwAw) 

**Can an admin team member edit an individual school's Portal, not just the Portal for their whole school organization?**

-   Yes, users assigned to the Clever Admin role can edit the entire school organization’s Portal as well as individual school Portals. Users with custom roles and permissions will be able to edit Portals based on whether they’re given permissions to access the entire school org or specific schools.
    

**What if there is a link in my teacher's or student's Portal that I don't see on my Organize district Portal page?**

-   An STL, or another Clever Admin with school-scoped Portal access, likely added the link! You can confirm this by using the **View Portal as...** feature and selecting the school where the student or teacher is seeing the link. If the link is visible when you view the Portal as the school, it was added at the school level, and a user with permissions to edit that school’s Portal will need to update or remove it.

**Why can't students see a resource that a teacher or staff member has favorited?**

-   Favoriting resources is only reflected in individual portals. Resources that teachers favorite will not be favorited for their students. 

**Has the student Portal been recently updated?**

-   Yes! In July 2026 Clever released minor updates to the student Portal to improve accessibility and security, as well as bring the student experience inline with the teacher Portal experience. App icons appear larger, school organization notifications appear in a pop-up box when students click their notifications bell, and students have quick access to any login settings you’ve enabled from a new Account drop down menu.
    

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: How do I use the Clever Dashboard?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043093?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: Clever Portal - Adding External Links (Hyperlinks)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002942963?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: Clever Academy Course Catalog - Learn more about Clever!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360023043372?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Updating the Clever login URL for your school organization
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205818838#h_b851c62f-98d0-4471-be39-fb48ab701aa7)  
2\. [Instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205818838#h_df602678-f8de-447c-90c1-713e2d64229c)

##   
Overview

Every Clever school organization has the ability to customize a unique Clever login URL to share with school organization users in order to simplify the Clever login process. This URL is a direct way for users to log in to your school organization's Clever Portal rather than navigating to [Clever.com](https://clever.com/) to locate and select their school from a drop-down menu.

  
Custom Clever Portal URLs are in the format of: `[https://clever.com/in/](https://clever.com/in/) <YOUR CUSTOM SHORTNAME>`

-   **For example:** Northern School District might use [https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict](https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict)

## Instructions

 **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6Q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you are changing your Portal URL, Clever will not redirect users from the old URL to the new one. Please be sure to communicate accordingly with students, teachers, & staff if changing the URL shortname so they can log in successfully with the new one.

To update your school organization's Clever Portal URL, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page:

-   Click on the URL shortname in the 'Clever Portal URL' box to edit it. The shortname is the part after `[https://clever.com/in/](https://clever.com/in/)`.
-   Update the editable text to the new shortname you'd like to use.
    -   **For example**: Updating the shortname to NorthernSchoolDistrict would change your Portal URL to: [https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict](https://clever.com/in/northernschooldistrict)
-   Select 'Update' to save your changes.
-   Share the updated Portal URL with your school organization users so they can navigate directly to your school organization's Clever login page!

![Screenshot showing where to click to edit your custom Clever Portal URL](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e6Q5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lzMb)

If you have any questions about customizing your school organization's Clever login Portal URL, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Clever Portal: Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002720807#header1)  
2\. [What's the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002720807#header2)  
3\. [How do students, teachers, and staff access Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002720807#header3)

## Overview

This article provides a brief overview of Clever Portal and how users access it. For detailed information on how to customize and use Clever Portal, please reference the [Related articles](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002720807#relatedarticles) section below.  
 

* * *

## What's the Clever Portal?

Clever Portal gives students, teachers, and staff a single, secure login for all digital resources. Each student, teacher, and staff member can access a personalized Portal using a single set of login credentials, or for students, a [Clever Badge](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), to single sign-on (SSO) into every learning application they use—[even those that don't yet roster with Clever.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488)

Clever Portal: 

-   **Is intentionally designed for teachers:** Clever Portal is intuitive for teachers to navigate and quickly access the edtech the district has already purchased.
-   **Works everywhere:** One username and password unlock any connection application or device. Clever offers SSO for thousands of resources, while personalized portals show only what’s relevant for each user.
-   **Provides personalized, secure access:** Clever uses data directly from your student information system (SIS) to deliver a customized experience for each user, eliminating the need for extra setup steps. Students easily find resources and immerse themselves in the learning process.  
    
-   **Is available in multiple languages and locales:** Admins and teachers can configure language settings for their Clever Portal to set a preferred language. Languages currently available include Spanish, British English, and Australian English.

![Example Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCEf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000d0Sib)

  
 

* * *

## How do students, teachers, and staff access Clever Portal?

Students, teachers, and staff can access their Clever Portal by:

1.  Navigating to your district’s unique Portal URL.
2.  Typing in their district username and password, or [using their Badge](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907). 
3.  Users will be logged into their Clever Portal and can access all their resources with a single click - no additional logins are required.

You configure user's credentials for the Portal during SSO setup. [Click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938) to learn how to set up SSO.   

* * *

#### **Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Managing the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568)
-   [For Clever Admins: Configuring languages in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001749)
-   [For Clever Admins: Updating the Clever login URL for your school organization](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838)
-   [For Clever Admins: Apps - Add/request or remove apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997)
-   [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Overview & Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488)

title: Custom Data: Teachers
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#overview)  
2\. [Manually creating custom teacher](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#manual)  
3\. [Bulk uploading custom teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#bulk)  
4\. [Viewing custom teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#view)  
5\. [Deleting custom teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#Deleting%20custom%20teachers)  
6\. [Logging in as a custom teacher](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#Deleting%20custom%20teachers)

##   
Overview

If you would like to add teachers to Clever that don't currently sync from your district's SIS, you can create custom teacher accounts for them in Clever on an individual basis or by bulk upload. Custom teachers can be added to existing sections using the **[Add co-teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748?language=en_US#ManuallyAdding)** feature in Clever or can be added to [custom sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923). Custom teachers can only be added as the **primary** teacher to _custom sections_ and as **co-teachers** to _SIS-synced sections_.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow up to 24 hours for your custom teachers to sync with connected applications. If you are not seeing your district's custom teacher accounts appear in applications they are shared with, you can reach out to the application's support team directly to confirm whether they support co-teachers on their platform. 

* * *

##   
Manually creating a custom teacher

If you'd like to add a teacher to Clever that is not being synced from your district's student information system (SIS), you can create them as a custom teacher directly from your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) using one of the following methods:

### 1) From a section's profile page:

-   Navigate to a section's profile page by searching for the section using the search bar at the top of the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).
-   Under the **Details** tab of your section, select **Add co-teacher** from the right side of the page.
-   Select **Create a teacher.**
-   Then, enter basic demographic information about the user in the subsequent pop-up box to create their custom teacher account.

### 2) From the Custom Data page.

-   Navigate to [Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/teachers) > **Add custom data > Teachers.**
-   Enter basic demographic information about the user in the subsequent pop-up box to create their custom teacher account. Please note that the email address and SIS ID of the user cannot be edited after creation.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CGW)

* * *

##   
Bulk uploading custom teachers via a CSV upload

### Formatting the file

The file must be named **teachers.csv** and saved in the CSV (Comma Separated Value) file format. The _minimum_ header requirements are the following:

-   school\_id
-   teacher\_id
-   last\_name
-   first\_name
-   teacher\_email

Please see our [spec section 3.3](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) for more detailed information on formatting the file, the field values that are accepted, and information about additional headers. Sample files can be downloaded [here](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip).

### Uploading the file

To use the web upload option:

1.  From the left-hand navigation, click [Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)
2.  Select **Add custom data** and then **Upload Records**.****
3.  Select **teachers.csv** and then choose the file from your device.
4.  Once the upload icon displays a green checkmark ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BHTi), select **Upload**.

Clever will automatically trigger a sync within the next five minutes to begin processing the new data, taking about 15-20 minutes to complete. The newly uploaded data will not be fully available in Clever until then.  
 

### SFTP Upload

SFTP Upload is available to all schools. If your primary sync method is not SFTP, please reach out to Clever support for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory. 

To manually upload files to your district's SFTP folder, please:

-   Navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page to locate your district's **SFTP Settings** and corresponding credentials. 
    

 ![SFTP credentials on Sync Settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pBNf3) 

-   Log in to your Clever SFTP box, and create a new subfolder named **customteachers**.
    
    -   For instructions on accessing your district's SFTP folder, please visit: [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US)  
        ![A subdirectory titled customteachers](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HiFET) 
        
-   Upload the _teachers.csv_ to the **customteachers** subfolder            
    
-   Once the files finish processing (within 15-20 minutes), you will be able to see the new custom sections from your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.    
    

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Though Clever will not send an email notification that the data has been processed, the results will be viewable on the Sync page in the Clever Dashboard.  

* * *

##   
Viewing custom teachers

Clever admins can view up to 200 successfully created custom teachers through the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. If your district has more than 200 custom teachers, all records can be viewed from the [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser) or by using the search bar at the top of the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to locate individual custom teacher records.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If the custom teacher(s) will be joining the district's account in the Fall through the normal SIS sync, the **T****eacher\_id** used for the custom account should match their **Teacher******\_**id** in the SIS.

* * *

## Deleting custom teachers

To remove **_all_** custom teachers at once, please upload a blank teachers.csv file to the [Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)[](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/students) page > **Upload Records** option. However, please note that _the file must contain column headers_. Please feel free to use the teachers.csv file contained in this sample file set to remove teachers in bulk: [Download.](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip)  
  
To remove only some teacher records via the bulk upload, simply upload a file using one of the formats listed above. Please be sure to include all records in the file that you do not want to be deleted. As long as the record is present in the file, it will not be deleted from Clever. If a record is missing from the file, it will be deleted.  
  
To remove an individual custom data record, please navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.

-   Select the corresponding tab for the record type you would like to remove.
-   Locate the record, and under the **Actions** column, click the ![trash can icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035kLQ)icon to delete the record.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Manually deleting teachers individually using the trash icon will delete the user entirely from Clever. However, if the teacher was bulk uploaded to the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page, they would still be present in the custom teachers.csv file even after the trash icon is selected. If the user is still present in the following uploaded custom teachers.csv file with the same teacher\_id (i.e., teacher SIS ID), the user will be re-added to Clever.    
  
Conversely, uploading blank files over custom data only deletes **bulk** uploaded custom data and not **manually** created custom data. Manually created custom data will need to be deleted manually by clicking on the trash can under the **Actions** column in the **Custom Records**.

* * *

## Logging in as a custom teacher

Custom teachers will log in to Clever the same way teachers syncing from your SIS log in. Just make sure to add any details (e.g., email, teacher\_id, etc.) required by your selected login method. To check to see what your login method is, navigate in your Clever Dashboard to [SSO & Portal > SSO Settings > Login method.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings)

**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djDN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)Please note:** If you are utilizing the teacher\_number field for login credentials, Clever does not currently support syncing a unique teacher\_number for custom teachers. The teacher\_id (sis\_id) will be used to populate the teacher\_number field.

* * *

  
**Related Articles:** 

-   [Custom Data: Overview (i.e., sections, students, contacts, teachers, staff & fields)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US#Custom%20data%20reports)
-   [Custom Data: Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131)
-   [Custom Data: Teachers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691)
-   [Custom Data: Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471)
-   [Custom Data: Sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923)

title: Custom Data: Students
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#overview)  
2\. [Individually create custom students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#individual)  
3\. [Bulk create custom students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#bulk)  
4\. [Removing custom students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#Remove)  
5\. [Viewing custom students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#view)  
6. [School year rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#rollover)

## Overview

If you would like to add a student that doesn't sync from your school organization's SIS, you can create a custom student account in Clever on an individual basis or bulk upload through a CSV file. 

IMPORTANT Custom students cannot be added to sections synced from your Student Information System (SIS). They can only be added to custom sections. 

* * *

##   
Individually create custom students

To create an individual custom student, navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. Click **Add custom data** \> **Students** and a **Create student** form will appear. Once created, custom student accounts can be treated like an SIS-synced student account.

Please note that the student's SIS ID and email cannot be updated after creation. Be sure to enter these fields accurately.

![Custom data students screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nGu8T)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If the custom student(s) will be joining the school organization's account in the Fall through the normal SIS sync, the **student\_id** used for the custom account should match their **student\_id** in the SIS. 

* * *

##   
Bulk create custom students

### How do I format the file?

The file will need to be titled **students** and saved as a CSV file type. The _minimum_ header requirements are the following:

-   school\_id
-   student\_id
-   last\_name
-   first\_name

Please see our [spec section 3.2](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) for more detailed information on the file format, what values are accepted, and information about additional headers. A sample file can be downloaded here: [Download.](https://assets.clever.com/website/files/districts/students.csv)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Contacts for custom students cannot be uploaded in the custom students.csv file. They need to be uploaded in a separate custom contacts.csv file. [Instructions on how to do so can be found here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047089771?language=en_US)

###   
Web Upload

If you would like to use the web upload option:

1.  From the left-hand navigation, click **Support tools > Custom data**
2.  From the top-right, click **Add custom data** and select **Upload records**  
    ![Custom data with Upload records button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amnk)

Once uploaded, you will see the following status message:

![Message displaying Your latest custom records csv upload was succesful](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000fusg)

### SFTP Upload

SFTP Upload is available to all schools. If your primary sync method is not SFTP, please reach out to Clever support for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory. 

To manually upload files to your school organization's SFTP folder, please:

-   Navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page to locate your **SFTP Settings** and corresponding credentials.
    

 ![SFTP Credentials found on Sync > Settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pAklm) 

-   Log in to your Clever SFTP box, and create a new subfolder named  **customstudents**.
    
    -   For instructions on accessing your SFTP folder, please visit: [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US)  
        ![Subdirectory titled custom students](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HhtAk) 
        
-   Upload the _students.csv_ to the **customstudents** subfolder            
    

Once the files finish processing (within 15-20 minutes), you will be able to see the new custom sections from your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Though Clever will not send an email notification that the data has been processed, the results will be viewable on the Sync page in the Clever Dashboard.  

* * *

##   
Removing custom students

### **Removing individual custom students**

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.
-   Select the **Students** tab at the bottom of the screen.
-   Locate the record, and under **Actions**, click ![trash can icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035kQG) to delete

### **Removing custom students in bulk**

Custom students can be removed in bulk by uploading a blank students.csv file under **Support tools > Custom data > Add custom data > Upload records**. The file must contain column headers. Please feel free to use the students.csv file contained in this sample file set to remove students in bulk: [Download](https://assets.clever.com/website/files/districts/students.csv) 

This is to prevent a "duplicate identifier" error when the student eventually comes through the normal SIS sync with the same sis/student\_id.   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dj5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Uploading blank files over custom data only deletes **bulk** uploaded custom data and not **manually** created custom data. Manually created custom data will need to be deleted manually by clicking on the trash can under the **Actions** column in the **Custom Records**.

* * *

##   
Viewing custom students

Five minutes after the file is uploaded, Clever will automatically trigger a sync in order to process the custom students into our system. Once the sync has successfully completed - around 10-15 minutes after initial file upload - you can view up to 200 successfully created custom students through the [Custom Data](https://clever.com/oauth/district_admin/login?target=%3BbzRrcGh2aDJ5Z252eDgzdnhjNjQ%3D%3BaHR0cHM6Ly9zY2hvb2xzLmNsZXZlci5jb20vYXV0aC1jYWxsYmFjaw%3D%3D%3BOWE3OGE3MTg4YTA3ZGRjOTBlYTkxOTZkNWJjY2IzZTU1NDdkZDFiYmM5MThhYTllN2I0MDBlMzc5MWQxOTRjYg%3D%3D%3BY29kZQ%3D%3D%3BZGlzdHJpY3RfYWRtaW4%3D)  page in the dashboard. If you have 200+ custom students, all can be viewed in the [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) or via the search bar in the dashboard.

* * *

##   
School year rollover

Once the normal SIS sync is running for the next school year, Clever recommends deleting all custom students from the previous academic year. To remove custom students, please follow the directions outlined [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#remove).

title: Custom Data: Non-teaching staff
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#h_1d574568-aa01-4cfb-a497-691b8c2b61d3)  
2. [Creating custom staff in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#h_57cbcc2b-225a-4c06-9d31-4add7a1bad7f)  
     a. [Adding custom staff individually via Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#individually)  
     b. [Bulk uploading custom staff to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#bulk)  
3. [Staff permissions in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#h_c9db7f70-da81-4d95-a76c-c9dcfb9a8c10)  
4. [Updating staff roles](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#h_5fbcc759-ca18-470f-b2b8-e24c533209ce)  
5\. [Removing staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#h_ca20f6f6-db35-4b78-be9d-ffb95e4d4919)  
6\. [Connecting staff to sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#h_01ED9JJYJ2WQGNJKNR86Q793AA)

## Overview

A school organization's non-teaching staff (e.g., principals, counselors, front desk, etc.), including any employees who do not have a designated roster in a district's student information system (SIS), are referred to as staff in Clever.

Individual staff users can be added directly to Clever, bypassing a school organization's SIS sync. Once added to Clever, they can log in using the school organization's existing login methods and leverage Clever single sign-on (SSO). 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Only _Clever Admins_ have permissions to create custom staff in Clever. For details, please visit: [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726)

IMPORTANT Custom staff _**cannot**_ be assigned to sections. However, if a staff member needs co-teacher access to sections from a teacher's perspective, Clever Admins can create a [custom teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691) record for them to associate them with sections. Please visit this article for more: [For Clever Admins: Co-teachers.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748?language=en_US)

* * *

##   
Creating custom staff in Clever

Custom staff can be created individually directly within Clever, or uploaded as a csv in bulk.  
  
Custom staff accounts are **independent** of a district's student information system (SIS) sync. So, for example, if a district's SIS is syncing staff to Clever, or they're being uploaded manually per [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547?language=en_US), this staff data will _**not**_ overwrite custom staff added directly via the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. 

###   
**Adding custom staff individually via Clever**

To add a custom staff member individually in Clever, please:

-   Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).
-   Select ****[Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)****
-   Select **Add custom data.**
-   Select **Staff.**

         ![Picture1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xp3a)  

Please fill out the form, which begins by associating the staff member with their school(s).

-   For all schools, click the switch icon under the **Schools** section.
-   For one school, begin typing the name in the search box to select it.
-   For multiple schools, type and select each school from the search bar. 

![Create staff screen with fields filled out](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aomZ)  
  
  
_****Clever Role****_

-   For an overview of the [Portal Access Only](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772?language=en_US)  vs. [School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663?language=en_US) roles, please see our Clever article visit: [For Staff: School Tech Lead vs. Portal Only Permission.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772?language=en_US)

_**SIS ID & email**_

-   These fields are required and **cannot** be edited once you create the user. Please be sure to correctly enter the user's email and match the SIS ID of the user if they exist in your SIS (if they don't exist in your SIS, any unique ID is acceptable).

_**Username & Password**_

-   These fields are only required if:
    -   Your district uses [Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038?language=en_US), and the district username or password is needed for users to log in to Clever.
    -   An application partner requires a username or password to be populated within their integrated application(s).

_**Expiration Date** ​​​​​​_

-   Enter an optional **Expiration date** if you want the record to be automatically deleted on the selected date.

_**Notifying custom staff of their new account via email**_ 

-   If you would like the user to be notified via email that their account has been created, check the _optional_ **Also notify custom staff of their new account via email** box. The notification email can also be sent after their custom staff record has been saved using the envelope icon under **Actions**.

               ![Custom staff email template](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aome)  
 

### **Bulk uploading custom staff to Clever**

To bulk add multiple custom staff, please:

-   Prepare your Staff.csv file. You can [download a staff.csv template here](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip).
-   Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).
-   Select ****[Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)****
-   Select **Upload records.**
-   Upload your **Staff.csv** file.

### **Associating staff to multiple locations via bulk upload**

To associate a staff member with multiple schools via a bulk custom data upload:

1.  Locate the school\_id column
2.  Select additional schools that should be associated with custom staff > **Save Changes.  
      
    ![screenshot of an example staff user who has multiple schools added to their account](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pJa2P)**   
      
    

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Uploading a custom staff.csv file will not override/delete any staff members you've added manually via the steps in the previous section!

### **Next steps after creating staff**

It will take between 10-15 minutes for the new record(s) to be created in Clever. This process is complete when:

-   The user's name is hyperlinked in blue on the [Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/students) page.
-   Or, they can be located by using the Clever search bar at the top of the [Clever](https://schools.clever.com/) [Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Though Clever will not send an email notification that the data has been processed, the results will be viewable on the Sync page in the Clever Dashboard.  

Finally, please be sure to share any needed applications with them! For instructions, visit: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing staff with applications.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044771711?language=en_US)  
 

* * *

##   
Staff permissions in Clever

By default, custom staff are assigned a [**Portal Access Only**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772?language=en_US) role in Clever which means they will only have access to the applications that have been shared with them on a district level. 

The alternative Clever staff role that provides greater permissions within Clever is the **[School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663?language=en_US)** role. 

* * *

##   
Updating staff roles

Most staff updates happen by uploading an updated _staff.csv_ to Clever (see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547) for details). This includes changes to name, email address, title, and so on. However, if you wish to update the role of a staff user from _Portal Access_ to _School Tech Lead_:

-   Use the Clever search bar at the top of your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to locate the user and open their profile page.
-   Click the drop-down arrow to the right and select **Update Clever Role.**
-   A pop-up will appear, allowing you to select the role of **School Tech Lead.**
-   Select **Save.**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CFT) Once staff have been added to Clever, visit this article to see how to share applications with them: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing staff with applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044771711?language=en_US)

* * *

##   
Removing staff

To remove individual custom staff from Clever:

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data page.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)
-   Select the **Staff** tab at the bottom of the screen.
-   Locate the user, and under **Actions**, click ![trash icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jgh) to delete.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jgc)

To remove individual custom staff from Clever via bulk upload:

-   Prepare your Staff.csv file as mentioned [above](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026950471#bulk). **Please include every record you want to keep in Clever.** If a record is in the new file, our system will keep it. If a record is missing from the file, our system will delete it from Clever.
-   Select ****[Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)****
-   Select **Upload records.**
-   Upload your **Staff.csv** file.

  
To remove all custom staff from Clever: 

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.
-   In the top-right corner, click **Delete all staff.**
-   On the next screen, click **Confirm.** 

![Custom Data screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dmRN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xpJ9)

* * *

##   
Connecting staff to sections

Staff cannot be connected to sections in Clever. To associate a user with an existing section:

1.  [Add the user as a custom teacher.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691)
2.  Connect the custom teacher to a section using the [**Add co-teacher** feature](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748).

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Staff: School Tech Lead vs. Portal Only Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772?language=en_US)
-   [Sharing Permissions: Sharing staff with applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044771711?language=en_US)
-   [Custom Data: Overview (i.e., sections, students, contacts, teachers, staff & fields)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US)
-   [Clever Roles: Staff - How to add to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547?language=en_US)

title: Clever Badges: How do I enable Badges into Active Directory On-prem managed Windows devices?
text:
This article contains the following:  1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Overview) ​  2. [Setup steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Setup)      a. [NetBIOS domain](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Netbios)     b. [Locating user credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Creds)     c. [Downloading software](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Software) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** These instructions only apply to Windows devices that accept Active Directory user credentials. If your users use Entra ID credentials to access Windows devices, please follow the steps listed in our [Setup guide for Clever SSO into Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001546). When using the Entra ID instructions, ensure you do not have the MSI file for this AD On-prem configuration installed on your Windows devices. ## Overview [Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907) make accessing apps simple for young students by logging them in to Clever without requiring a username and password. Students hold their physical Clever Badge up to their device camera to log in. However, students often still need to enter a username and password in order to access their device to get to Clever. To simplify that experience, we also offer Badges into Windows for devices that utilize Active Directory logins. When you set up Badges into Windows, students can log in to their device _and_ Clever with just their Badge. ### Student experience For students, the login experience is simple. The device's login screen prompts them to scan their Clever Badge. They hold the Badge up to the camera, which instantly logs them into the device, Clever, and all of their Clever applications. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CE1) If your district or school is using shared Windows devices for students, the device will remember the login option the previous user selected. Thus, if a user selects **Other user**, as shown in the image below, the Windows device will provide that same option for the following user who logs into the device. Ensure the user selects the correct login method from the device login page.   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CEG)   * * * ## Setup Steps There are three basic steps to setting up this configuration: 1. [Provide your NetBIOS domain](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Netbios) 2. [Locate user credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Creds) 3. [Download software](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000384086#Software) The setup process should take no more than 10 minutes, and you won’t need to configure settings within Active Directory. Clever’s setup wizard will guide you through the Badges setup.
