Navigate to the wizard by going to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges > Windows tab](https://schools.clever.com/badges/windows). * * * ## Finding your NetBIOS domain Each Active Directory instance has a NetBIOS domain, which is different from your DNS domain name. To retrieve your NetBIOS domain, open Windows PowerShell as a user logged into the domain and paste in the command below: Command: `$ENV:USERDOMAIN` The result will look like this: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CEQ) [Paste that domain into Clever](https://schools.clever.com/badges/windows/wizard), and you’re ready to move on to the next step. * * * ## Locating User Credentials To log students into Windows devices equipped with Active Directory logins, Clever needs the student's Active Directory (AD) credentials. Student AD credentials in Clever must stay in sync with actual student AD credentials. If they get out of sync, students can still log in to the devices with Active Directory, but won’t be able to utilize the Badge login option. **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** We recommend **disabling password changes** in Active Directory for students who will be using this setup. There are three different ways that you can locate user credentials: 1. Select them from the dropdown (recommended) 2. Use a custom configuration (recommended) 3. Upload a csv (not recommended) ### Select from dropdown (recommended) The easiest and most reliable way to provide those credentials is to indicate where they are within your existing SIS sync. For example, if student AD usernames are their email addresses, and passwords are their student numbers, and those fields are already syncing to Clever, you would select those fields in the dropdowns within the Badges into Windows configuration wizard. ![Setup screen for Active Directory](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amvU) Make sure that the credentials for the sample student match the Active Directory credentials you have on file. ### Custom configurations (recommended) If student AD usernames and/or passwords are syncing to Clever already but aren’t neatly contained in a single field, you can use a custom configuration to provide those credentials. Instead of selecting a single field, you’ll choose “Custom” in the appropriate dropdown list and paste a formula as pictured below: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CEk) We support the following fields for custom formulas: - sis\_id - email - student\_number - state\_id - credentials.district\_username - credentials.district\_password **Examples of using formulas for credentials** Example student: Scott Kelly Email: [skelly@cleverusd.edu](mailto:sykelly@cleverusd.edu) Username: skelly19
Student AD usernames or passwords are...Formula [fill in portions in brackets]Example formulaSample result for the student above
Username from the sync plus my school organization's email domain{{credentials.district_username}}[add domain name here]{{credentials.district_username}}@cleverusd.eduskelly19@cleverusd.edu
A specific word/phrase that's the same for every student[add that word/phrase here]appleapple
First initial, last name{{substr name.first 0 1}}{{name.last}}{{substr name.first 0 1}}{{name.last}}skelly
Their email without the domain{{textBefore email "@"}}{{textBefore email "@"}}sykelly
Something else...Contact us via the form in our Help Center and we'll create a formula for you!
Once you’ve entered the appropriate formula make sure that the credentials for the sample student match the Active Directory credentials you have on file. ### Uploading Credentials (not recommended) If your student's Active Directory credentials aren’t included in or can't be derived from your synced data using custom formulas, you have the option of uploading those credentials directly to Clever via CSV. Clever doesn't recommend CSV upload as it can require frequent upkeep to ensure that credentials are present for all Badge users. For Badge logins to work successfully, credentials must stay in sync. We recommend re-uploading credentials at least once a week to ensure that new students can utilize the integration. To upload credentials, choose **“Username uploaded from .csv”** and/or **“Password uploaded from .csv”** in the dropdown. File Name (required): students.csv Formatting (required): student\_id, username, password Sample file: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CEp) Web Upload Tool: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CEu) You can also automate that upload via SFTP to the “credentials-sftp.clever.com/clever-windows” folder. The SFTP upload URL, username, and password of your **SFTP Settings - Saved Passwords Applications** can be found at [Clever Dashboard > Sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings). ![SFTP Settings - Saved Passwords Applications box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djLR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pBHBR)  For more information on the tools that you can use to access and upload files to your credentials SFTP server, please see this Help Center article: [What are some recommended tools for SFTP syncs?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206020358) * * * ## Downloading software Finally, you’ll want to [install Clever’s software](https://schools.clever.com/badges/windows/wizard) on any machines you want to have this login option. The installer is an MSI file, so you can remotely install this software in the same way that you would any other piece of software on your Windows machines.

title: Clever Badges: How do I enable both ADFS and Badge logins for Chromebooks?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005458126#overview)  
2. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005458126#requirements)  
3. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005458126#setup)  
4. [Customizing the Login Flow (optional)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005458126#customize)  
5\. [Chromebook Safety Feature](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005458126#safety)

##   
Overview

Clever works seamlessly with Chromebooks, which allows students and teachers to access all of their learning applications while only logging in once per device. There are two methods to use Clever with Chromebooks:  
 

1.  **Users use Clever Badges to log into Chromebooks**
2.  **Users log into Chromebooks, then access Clever**

  
Each method can be configured separately for different Organizational Units (OUs).  
  
Since Clever integrates with many identity providers, including Active Directory, Clever can serve as the authentication pathway for both Badge and Active Directory users! See below for details on this integration.    
 

* * *

##   
Requirements

-   Clever enabled as the third party identity provider in the Google Admin Console (**Security Settings > Setup SSO with third party identity provider**)
-   Active Directory enabled as an identity provider in Clever ([Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Login method tab)](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings)
-   Staff and students that'll use Chromebooks must be active users in Clever
-   Staff and students who'll use Chromebooks must have their Google email address populated in Clever

* * *

## Setup

**Step 1 - Setup Active Directory authentication into Clever**  
To pass through authentication for non-Badge users, we'll need to add Active Directory as a login method for Clever. Directions for adding Active Directory can be found here: [Single sign-on (SSO) with Active Directory Federation Services.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576?language=en_US#h_b9bc4519-fbaa-4521-8b19-719c6b8ec9f2)

  
**Step 2 - Upload student/teacher Google emails to Clever**  
In order to authenticate both Clever Badge and Active Directory users into Chromebooks, the district will need to ensure that all students and teachers have Google emails synced to Clever. If these emails are't populated in the SIS, we can enable manual email uploads as described here: [How do I upload emails that are not in my SIS?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026?language=en_US)

  
**Step 3 - Customize login flow (optional)**  
Districts can adjust settings in the admin console to tweak the login flow to best meet the needs of your district. See below for more details!

  
**Step 4 - Apply settings and test logins**  
Apply the settings for Clever single sign-on (SSO) into Chromebooks as described here: 

-   [https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook/wizard](https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook/wizard)

  
For districts that are actively using Active Directory to sign users into Chromebooks, we recommend completing login tests at a time when most users are't utilizing their Chromebooks to reduce interruptions to learning.  
 

* * *

##   
Customizing the Login Flow (optional)

**Option 1: Bypass badge login**  
By default, once users open the Chromebook and select "Next" they'll be presented with the badge login screen. If the district would prefer, this behavior can be adjusted so the district's general login page is presented first, facilitating faster logins for users logging in via Active Directory. 

  
To implement this option, begin by navigating to the [Security Settings](https://admin.google.com/AdminHome?hl=en&pli=1&fral=1#SecuritySettings:flyout=sso) page in the Google Admin Console and scroll down to the **SSO** section. Under Setup SSO with third party identity provider, let's adjust the "Sign-in page URL"

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bxtj)

Currently your sign-in URL should look something like this: 

-   _[https://samlidp.clever.com/chromebook-login/assert/582df1eb56619d0100000482?specify\_auth=badges](https://samlidp.clever.com/chromebook-login/assert/582df1eb56619d0100000482?specify_auth=badges)_

This URL contains a parameter that forwards users directly to the badge authentication page:  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bxu3)

Let's adjust the URL by removing: _?specify\_auth=badges_  
The result should look like this: 

-   _[https://samlidp.clever.com/chromebook-login/assert/582df1eb56619d0100000482](https://samlidp.clever.com/chromebook-login/assert/582df1eb56619d0100000482)_

This will send all users to the general login page for your district! From there, users can select their preferred login method. Here is what the login page will now look like:

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BxuI)

  
  
**Option 2: Pass-through Google authentication into Clever Portal**

Pass through authentication ensures that all users are automatically logged into the Clever Portal when logged into a Chromebook.  
  
To configure this setting, navigate to the "User Settings" page in the Google Admin Console. Depending on how you have applied the settings, you may need to adjust the Homepage, Pages to Load on Startup, or both. Currently the settings will look similar to below:​![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CCK)

To enable pass-through authentication, add:_?skip=1&specify\_auth=google_ to your district URL. Your district-specific URL can be found here: [https://schools.clever.com/portal.](https://schools.clever.com/portal)

  
The result should look like this: _[https://clever.com/in/cleverdemo?skip=1&specify\_auth=google](https://clever.com/in/cleverdemo?skip=1&specify_auth=google)_ 

  
**Login experience**

1.  **Chrome OS 98 and below:** Open Chromebook, press “Next”![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CCU)           
2.  If a user logs in using:
    -   Badges: user selects 'Log in with Clever Badges'. 
        -   The user scans their Badge and is authenticated into Clever and Google/Chromebook!
    -   ADFS Credentials:
        -   User selects 'Log in with Active Directory.' The Active Directory login screen is presented. User logs in to ADFS. ADFS authenticates the user into Clever, Clever authenticates the user into Google/Chromebook.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028CCe)

3\. Clever portal launches and learning begins!  
  
 

* * *

##   
Chromebook Safety Feature

We'll soon offer an optional query param on the Badges login screen called \`chromebook\_safety.' If it is present, the login screen won't show the "Alternate Login" button to allow non-Badge logins. This serves as a way to definitively prevent users from averting web filters and accessing websites outside of Clever.   
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTTF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BxvL)  
  
To enable this feature, add the following as a query param on the Chromebook Sign-On URL: [https://samlidp.clever.com/chromebook-login/assert/YourDistrictCleverID?specify\_auth=badges&chromebook\_safety=true](https://samlidp.clever.com/chromebook-login/assert/YourDistrictCleverID?specify_auth=badges&chromebook_safety=true)  
 

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Single Sign-on (SSO): multiple IDPs for Google Workspace](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541?language=en_US#header2)

title: Custom Data: Sections
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923#Header1) 2\. [Creating individual custom sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923#Header2) 3\. [Creating multiple custom sections via upload](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923#h_0121e61c-a948-48d6-a98e-a0b29ce05165) 4\. [Editing custom sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923#h_1a3adf24-1145-4e2c-8e5f-2607e34b4b80) 5. [Deleting custom sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923#h_c03f6bab-6890-431d-8e90-bdbf5e5b8bf0) 6. [Sharing custom sections with apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923#h_38db8d0b-07d6-4397-bfd7-f28e17cc3e2f) ## Overview Custom sections are a great way to create rostering data within Clever that doesn't exist in your school organization's student information system (SIS). This can be helpful in cases such as summer school, intervention groups, after-school programs, and more!  Custom sections will **_not_** overwrite any sections being synced to Clever by a school organization's SIS, and they can't be overwritten by SIS-synced sections either.. Custom sections are also indistinguishable from synced SIS sections in most Clever-integrated applications.     **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**Only Clever admins or School Tech Leads can create custom sections in Clever. For more details about Clever roles, please visit: [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) * * * ## Creating individual custom sections There are two ways to create custom sections in Clever. The first method is creating individual sections from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. ### **Step 1: Add section info** - Navigate to [Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) - Click **Add custom data**, then select **Sections**. ![Custom data screen with custom Sections button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ammO) - Begin by entering a section name and the associated school location. - _We recommend being as descriptive as possible with section names (e.g., course\_name - teacher\_last\_name - period)._ - Enter the class information (i.e., grade, subject, and period). ![Untitled\_presentation\_-\_Google\_Slides-3.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BJVg) - If desired, enter the **_optional_** term and course information. These fields may be helpful with identifying the section in Clever and connected applications. ![Untitled\_presentation\_-\_Google\_Slides-4.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BJVq) - Enter an optional section expiration date if you want the section to be automatically deleted on the selected date. - Once all required fields are populated, click **Next** to proceed.  ### **Step 2: Add Teachers** - Click the primary teacher who should be associated with the section. Clever allows up to nine co-teachers per custom section. - _**Please note:** If a teacher is not yet in Clever or in your SIS, please see this article for instructions on creating a custom teacher in Clever:_ [Custom Data: Teachers.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691) **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** To select teachers from a school location other than the one where the section is located, click the white search box to the right to bring up a list of schools. Select additional school location(s) to bring up a list of teachers from selected school(s).          ![Untitled\_presentation\_-\_Google\_Slides-5.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BJVv) - Click **Next** to proceed. Important: Not all applications support co-teachers. We recommend checking with the application’s support team to confirm if co-teachers are a supported feature. ### **Step 3: Select Primary Teacher** - Next, indicate which of the teachers will be the primary teacher for the section. If an application does not support co-teachers, the primary teacher will be the one associated with the custom section in applications. - Click **Next** to proceed. ### **Step 4: Add Students** - Select which students should be enrolled in the section.   - _**Please note:** Clever can support up to 10,000 students enrolled in a single section. However, Clever can only support up to 100 students enrolled in a single section for_ [Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323) _to function correctly._  **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** To select students from a school location other than where the section is located, click the white search box to the right to select students from other schools. You can further filter the list of students by selecting only certain grade levels. Please visit [Custom Data: Students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131?language=en_US) if the student is not yet in Clever or your SIS. ![Untitled\_presentation\_-\_Google\_Slides-6.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BJW0) - Click **Next** to proceed. ### **Step 5: Preview** - Review the custom section to ensure the details look correct before clicking **Create Section**. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Clever won't send an email notification once processing is done, but you can check results on the **Sync** page in your Clever Dashboard. ### **Step 6: Share with applications** - Once the custom section is available in Clever, you can share it with connected applications. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for details. * * * ## Creating multiple custom sections via upload Clever admins can also create custom sections in bulk by uploading two CSV files (_sections.csv_ and _enrollments.csv_) to Clever. The custom sections file will create the section, while the enrollments file will associate students to that section.   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Bulk uploading custom sections will not impact custom sections that were created manually from the [Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/students) page.   ### **Step 1: Create your _sections.csv_ and _enrollments.csv_** - Download the CSV file templates for uploading custom data by clicking [Download](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip), and then use the instructions below to modify the sections.csv and enrollments.csv. - Please ensure the files are named _sections.csv_ and _enrollments.csv_ before uploading them, or Clever won't process them successfully. ### Sections.csv
Column HeaderNotes

School_id

Must match the school_id (i.e., SIS ID) for a school that exists in Clever

Section_id

Must be a unique ID that is not associated with other sections
NameUnique name for the section (e.g., Algebra 101 - Jones - Period 1A)

Teacher_id

Must match a teacher_ID (i.e., teacher SIS ID) for a teacher that exists in Clever
Course_name(e.g., Algebra, Geometry, English, Creative Writing, etc.)
SubjectSubjects should adhere to Clever's specifications
Term_nameIf creating custom sections for summer, include "Summer" in this field for easier data sharing
 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**The fields listed above are _required_, but you can also include additional optional fields listed in Clever's [SFTP specification](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf) for the _sections.csv_. Please note that extension fields are not supported in the custom sections.csv. For information on how to add extension data to custom sections, please see our article [For Clever Admins: Syncing custom (i.e. extension) fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912). ### Enrollments.csv

Column Header

Note

School_id

Must match the school_id (i.e., SIS ID) for a school that exists in Clever

Section_id

Must match the section_id in the sections.csv file

Student_id

Must match an existing student_id (i.e., SIS ID) for a student in Clever

### **Uploading the sections.csv and enrollments.csv**  There are two ways for school organizations to upload sections.csv and enrollments.csv files to Clever.   #### **Option 1 (Recommended): Manual Upload** - Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. - Click **Add custom data** at the top right, and then choose **Upload records**. ![Custom data screen with Upload records button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ammN) #### ****Option 2: Uploading the files to your SFTP folder**** The second option for uploading the sections.csv and enrollments.csv is to access your Clever SFTP folder and manually upload the files.  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** This option is available to all schools. If your primary sync type [isn't SFTP](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078), reach out to Clever Support for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory. Visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206020358) for additional details. To upload files to your SFTP folder, please: - Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab to locate your **SFTP Settings** and corresponding credentials.  ![SFTP credentials found via the Sync > Settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pBI2g) - Log in to your Clever SFTP box, and create a new subfolder named **customsections**. - For instructions on accessing your SFTP folder, please visit: [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US) ![A subdirectory titled customsections](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HiH3N)  - Upload the _sections.csv_ and _enrollments.csv_ to the **customsections** subfolder             Once the files finish processing (within 15-20 minutes), you'll be able to see the new custom sections from your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. * * * ## Editing custom sections You may need to edit a custom section for several reasons, such as changes to the student roster, teacher changes or removals from Clever, or adjustments to the sections term dates. If you remove the teacher assigned to a custom section from Clever, you'll need to edit the section to assign a new primary teacher. If you don't add a new primary teacher, the section will display an error stating **Teacher is not accessible. ** To edit a custom section for any reason: 1. Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. 2. From the **Sections** tab, click the pencil icon under the **Actions** column to the right of the section name. 3. This will open a custom sections wizard which allows you to make any needed adjustments.        ![Untitled\_presentation\_-\_Google\_Slides-11.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BJWP) **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Clever Admins can also edit sections by searching for them using the Clever search bar to locate the section and then clicking the **Edit section** option. * * * ## Deleting custom sections - To delete a custom section, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. - From the **Sections** tab, click the trash icon under the **Actions** column to the right of the section name. ![Untitled\_presentation\_-\_Google\_Slides-12.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BJWy) - To delete _**All**_ custom sections in bulk, you can upload blank _sections.csv_ and _enrollments.csv_ files, _**including the column headers**_, to your [custom data page](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/students) or your SFTP folder, if applicable.  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djGb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Uploading blank files over custom data only deletes **bulk** uploaded custom data and not **manually** created custom data. Manually created custom data will need to be deleted manually by clicking on the trash can under the **Actions** column in the **Custom Records**. * * * ## Sharing custom sections with apps Custom sections are shared with applications in the same way that sections synced from your SIS are shared. Once a custom section is available (within 15-20 minutes of creating it), we recommend reviewing any application sharing permissions to ensure the section is shared as needed. For more information on sharing permissions, see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007). If you have any questions about custom sections, please contact [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help! * * * **Related Articles:** - [Custom Data: Overview (i.e., sections, students, contacts, teachers, staff & fields)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US) - [Custom Data: Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131?language=en_US) - [Custom Data: Teachers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691?language=en_US)

title: Custom Data: Overview (i.e., sections, students, contacts, teachers, staff & fields)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332#Overview)  
2\. [Adding custom data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332#Adding%20custom%20data)  
3\. [Browsing custom data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332#Browsing%20custom%20data)  
4\. [Removing custom data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332#Removing%20custom%20data)  
5\. [Custom data reports](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332#Custom%20data%20reports)

##   
Overview

Custom data allows Clever Admins to create rostering data, including fields and records, directly from the Clever Dashboard that doesn't exist in the school organization's student information system (SIS) or aren't being synced to Clever. Common uses of custom data include:  

-   Adding summer school information
-   Organizing unique groups of students into sections (e.g., after school programs)
-   Adding non-teaching staff members who are not in the district's SIS
-   Maintaining historical data that was deleted from the SIS
    -   For example, if a section is deleted when a teacher leaves midyear, but you want to preserve historical app data for that section. You can build a custom section in Clever using the original SIS section data so app data is preserved.

IMPORTANT   
Please note that custom data can't be used until you start running a [sync with your Student Information System (SIS)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113588). In addition, if Clever has not synced with your SIS in more than 6 months, you won't be able to add new custom data to Clever.   
  
Also, Custom data will run during a [sync pause (such as during summer school)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615912) but not a [sync hold (when your sync has stopped due to unexpected changes to data)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358).  

Clever Admins can upload **_custom fields_** for any data type to track data not currently being synced by the school organization's SIS (e.g., IEP status, Dietary Requirements, Extracurricular Activities, etc.). The types of records that can be created using custom data can either be associated with or include:

-   [Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131)
-   [Teachers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691)
-   [Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471)
-   [Sections & Enrollments](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923?language=en_US)
-   [Student Contacts](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047089771?language=en_US)
-   [Custom fields](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912?language=en_US)

Custom data won't overwrite any rostering data being synced to Clever by your SIS, nor can it be overwritten by your SIS-synced data. Custom data is also indistinguishable from your synced SIS data to most Clever-integrated applications. 

   **![instructor\_c8mlopv788bh4spwj0xrzn2c2\_public\_1712091784\_Lightbulb.1712091783969.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005fPKX)   Clever Tip:** When creating custom records, we recommend using the unique SIS identifier known as the SIS ID (i.e., teacher\_id, student\_id, contact\_id, section\_id, or staff\_id, respectively) if one exists for each record in your SIS. This way, if, at some point, your SIS begins sending those same records in the standard SIS data sync, the SIS record will take precedence over the custom data record. Failure to match SIS IDs will result in duplicate records in Clever. 

* * *

## Adding custom data

Clever supports creating custom records in Clever for the following record types:

-   [Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131)
-   [Teachers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691)
-   [Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471)
-   [Sections & Enrollments](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002764923?language=en_US)

**Custom schools** cannot be created in Clever. To add schools, you must sync them from your SIS. Summer school locations should be included in the standard SIS sync before pausing the sync over summer. Please visit [For Clever Admins: Pausing the sync with your SIS](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507?language=en_US) for more about sync pauses.

Admins can create custom data records either individually or in bulk using CSV uploads via the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. To upload data:

1.  **[Download](https://assets.clever.com/website/files/districts/CleverCustomData.zip) CSV templates**.
2.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data).
3.  Click **Add custom data** in the top right-hand corner.
4.  Choose to add records individually by clicking on the corresponding selection or in bulk by clicking **Upload records**. When creating the file(s), make sure to use the School\_ID field and **not** the School\_number field.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** SIS ID and email fields won't be editable after creating a custom user. Please be sure to accurate enter the SIS ID and email of the user you are adding.

![Custom data page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nGnv0)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Though Clever won't send an email notification that the data has been processed, the results will be viewable on the Sync page in the Clever Dashboard.  

Custom data won't overwrite SIS-synced records and will appear in Clever with a **Custom** label on their Clever profile page.

  
  
![Staff profile with Custom Staff highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amoJ)  
  
 

    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VnzV8)    Please note:** SFTP Upload of custom data is available to all schools. If your primary sync method is not SFTP, please reach out [to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory.

* * *

##   
Browsing custom data

From the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data page](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)**[](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)**, districts can select the appropriate custom data tab (i.e., Students, Teachers, Sections, or Staff) to view any custom data for that respective data type. In addition, records can be edited or deleted by using the icons to the far right of the record name under the **Actions** column.  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035kLu)  
  

If you notice that some of the custom data names aren’t clickable, this is most likely an indication that the data is also synced from your SIS with the same SIS ID.  
  

For example, staff member Jen Cutler has a custom staff account with the SIS ID of 32401969, but they also have a staff account being synced from the SIS with the same SIS ID. This will cause the custom data to be unclickable.

![Screenshot of the custom data page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000039fa5)

_In this screenshot, the custom staff account for Jen Cutler is unclickable._

  
Of note, in the case of staff, even if the SIS ID is different but the email is the same, it will cause the custom staff account to be unclickable.

* * *

##   
Removing custom data

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever does not maintain historical records of users deleted through custom data.

### **Removing individual records**

1.  To remove an individual custom data record, please navigate to the [Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.
2.  Select the corresponding tab for the record type you would like to remove.
3.  Locate the record, and under **Actions** column, click ![trash can icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035kLQ) to delete the record.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jgc)

###   
  
**Removing records in bulk**

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  
•  To remove only certain records, upload a new file via the bulk upload using one of the accepted formats mentioned above. **Please include every record you want to keep in Clever.** If a record is in the new file, our system will keep it. If a record is missing from the file, our system will delete it from Clever.  
•  Uploading blank files over custom data only deletes **bulk** uploaded custom data and **not manually** **created custom data.** Manually created custom data will need to be deleted manually by clicking on the trash can under the **Actions** column in the **Custom Records**. 

**Students**

-   To remove **_all_** bulk custom students at once, please upload a blank students.csv file to the [Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) > **Upload records** option. However, please note that _the file must contain column headers_. Please feel free to use the sample students.csv file contained in this sample file set to remove students in bulk: [Download](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip). 

  
**Teachers**

-   To remove **_all_** bulk custom teachers at once, please upload a blank teachers.csv file to the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page > **Upload records** option. However, please note that _the file must contain column headers_. Please feel free to use the teachers.csv file contained in this sample file set to remove teachers in bulk: [Download.](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip)

  
**Staff**

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.
-   In the top-right corner, select **Delete all staff.**
-   Select **Confirm.**

  
**Sections**

-   To remove **_all_** bulk custom sections at once, please upload a blank sections.csv file to the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) **> Upload records**. However, please note that _the file must contain column headers_. Please feel free to use the sections.csv file contained in this sample file set to remove sections in bulk: [Download.](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip)

* * *

##   
Custom data reports

The [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page > Reports tab will show how custom data has changed since the latest custom data sync. This tab also displays the most recent sync status. The **Previous** column represents the number of records of each data type that existed before the latest successful sync. Select any of the **Download files** options to review recent errors or changes to your district's custom data.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9Rd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lvX1) 

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [Custom Data: Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131)
-   [Custom Data: Teachers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691)
-   [Custom Data: Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471)
-   [Custom Data: Sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923)
-   [For Clever Admins: Syncing custom (i.e. extension) fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912?language=en_US)
-   [Manually Uploading Student Contacts to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047089771?language=en_US)

title: Summer School: Sync settings
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027745731#overview)  
2\. [If you choose to pause your SIS data sync (Recommended)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027745731#choosetopause)  
3\. [If you choose _**not**_ to pause your SIS data sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027745731#h3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027745731#Header4)

##   
Overview

Clever can support multiple sync configurations for summer school, each with its own benefits and possible limitations. We recommend thinking through the following points to help you make informed decisions about the best summer school options for your district:

-   Who will specifically need access to Clever and connected learning applications over the summer? (e.g. all students, teachers, and staff, or only a subset of users, etc.)?
-   Which Clever resources do district users need to access or utilize over the summer?
-   Will your district need to add new users over the summer or before the start of the new school year?
-   Will data need to be dynamically updated in Clever via your student information system (SIS) sync, or will a Clever admin be managing the manual summer school updates in Clever?
-   If you're using Clever IDM, please also review [Clever IDM: Summer rollover](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001513).

Please review the rest of this article to learn of the options available to you based on your district's needs during the summer months! For specific details about school year rollover, please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886).  
 

IMPORTANT In 2026, Clever automatically pauses and removes pauses from syncs based on your school organization’s country:  
  
**USA:** Syncs pause on May 29, and we remove pauses between July 27–31.  
**Canada:** Syncs pause on June 30, and we remove pauses on August 14.  
**UK:** Syncs pause on July 15, and we remove pauses on September 1.  
**Australia and Brazil:** Syncs pause on December 20, and we remove pauses on January 20.  
  
For all other countries, we use the USA dates by default.  
  
You can modify these dates (or remove them altogether) under your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.  

* * *

##   
If you choose to pause your SIS data sync (Recommended)

For 2026, Clever automatically pauses syncs based on the dates listed above unless you specify otherwise. You can modify these dates (or remove them altogether) under your Sync > Sync Settings page. During the pause, Clever will stop processing data updates. This allows districts to make changes to their student information system (SIS) data or CSV data files without allowing those changes to flow into Clever and interrupt student, teacher, or staff access to Clever or their connected applications over the summer. Current school year data will be "frozen" in Clever for the duration of the district's sync pause.  

We recommend using this option if:

-   Your district won't need to update summer rosters often and/or there are minimal changes that need to be made in Clever over the summer.
-   District users need to access their connected applications and associated data from the previous school year during the summer (e.g. students who need to complete summer homework in apps).

This option allows:

-   Clever admins to supplement existing roster data during the pause via [Clever's custom data feature](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332). Custom data can be used for creating summer school sections, intervention groups, after-school programs, adding out-of-district students, and more! Custom data does not overwrite data synced from the SIS, nor can data from the SIS overwrite custom data. This is a perfect option for summer school! Visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332) for details.
-   Clever admins to make updates for the upcoming school year in the SIS without the updates affecting Clever or applications during the sync pause.
-   Clever admins to continue adjusting [application sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for district-wide apps to meet application vendor needs.
-   District users to continue logging in to Clever, and connected applications, to access their data from the previous school year.

If your district is moving forward with initiating a sync pause, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507) for instructions. The next step of the process is [Stage 3: Uploading custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615912)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bkFB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  If you'd like to pause syncing your data to a particular application, please see this article: [For Clever Admins: Pausing your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607). This is a perfect tool for semester rollover and summer school, but shouldn't be confused with an SIS sync pause. 

* * *

##   
If you choose **_not_** to pause your SIS data sync

If your district prefers to continue syncing SIS data to Clever over the summer, the first step is to Clear the sync Pause Start and End Dates on the [Sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. Once removed, data will continue to sync automatically for Clever-managed auto syncs or whenever your district uploads CSV data files to your SFTP directory for SFTP syncs.

Clever admins will still be able to utilize the [custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332) feature in Clever to add any supplemental rostering data that is not available in the SIS.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bkFB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002luTI)

  
We recommend using this option if:

-   Your users need access to their resources and learning applications over the summer, but not historical data from the previous year or semester.
-   You anticipate a large number of students entering your district over the summer will need access to Clever before the new school year. You would prefer their accounts to be created directly from your SIS sync instead of manually uploading the students using [custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332).
-   Your summer school data changes often in your SIS, and you would like a more automated process for updating Clever.

This option allows:

-   Clever admins to create and manage [custom rostering data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332) in Clever.
-   Clever admins to continue adjusting [application sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for district-wide apps.
-   Your district's SIS to continue dynamically updating Clever with ongoing rostering updates daily.
-   New students, teachers, sections, and staff to be added to Clever via the SIS sync. This data will continue to be synced to connected applications.
    -   **Please note:** _Some application(s) stop syncing to Clever over the summer. Please reach out to the app partner(s) directly to understand their summer rollover process._

Important things to consider:

-   Access for students and teachers between school years may be impacted as the data in Clever is updated over the summer via the SIS sync. Therefore, the content that is available to them in their applications, or their ability to access applications, might change.
    -   **For example:**
        -   _If a student's grade is updated from 4 to 5, depending on the application, they may no longer have access to their 4th-grade data._
        -   _A teacher may not be able to access their rosters from the previous school year._
-   For more detailed information about how this might affect your connected applications, please reach out to the app support teams directly.

The next step of the process is [Stage 3: Uploading custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615912)  
 

IMPORTANT If you do **not** pause your SIS data sync over the summer, any new rostering data in your SIS will replace the previous school year's data in Clever. This means that students and teachers who are **not** attending summer school may lose access to Clever and their connected applications over the summer!  

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

### When can I enter new school year dates for the upcoming school year?

-   The school year dates will be updated to the following school year in mid-summer. The start and end dates need to be entered by a Clever admin in the **School Year Dates** section on the [Sync page under the settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings).

![Screenshot of box to update the School Year Dates](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bkFB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004FMCP)

  
However, there's no need for schools to worry about setting these dates until closer to the start of the next school year. 

### Can we pause data syncs to specific applications?

-   You can pause syncing data to any app using [App Sync Pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607).
-   The SIS sync pause in Clever freezes all data in Clever. This ensures that data synced to all connected applications will remain the same over the summer if your SIS sync is paused.

### How does Clever determine the primary location for a user? 

-   By default, Clever assigns users' primary schools where the majority of their sections are located. For more details on this logic, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003279987).

### What if we are switching our district's SIS, sync type, or SIS IDs over the summer?

-   Please contact [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) if you are planning on changing any of this information! We highly encourage districts **_not_** to change SIS IDs for data types (excluding sections) because historical data is tied with SIS IDs which will impact all connected district applications.
-   For details on changing your SIS, sync type, or SIS IDs, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049183691). 

  
The next step of the process is [Stage 3: Creating data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615912)

title: Term Rollover: Overview, Preparation & Recommendations
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204059586#overview)  
2\. [SFTP sync rollover procedure](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204059586#Header1)  
3\. [Auto Sync rollover procedure](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204059586#Header2)  
4\. [Recommended school organization actions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204059586#Header3)  
5\. [Changing SIS IDs (student\_id, teacher\_id, etc.)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204059586#changing_sis_ids)  
5\. [Badge Invalidation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/204059586#Header5)

## Overview

This article covers how Clever handles class roster data as the term/semester changes during a school year. These processes may vary depending upon your sync type and student information system (SIS).  Recommended school organization actions in the Clever Dashboard for rollover periods are listed below.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)**For information about rolling over to the next school year, please see: [How does Clever handle school year rollover?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886)

##   
SFTP sync rollover procedure

Clever will import the second term rosters as soon as you include them in the CSV files you regularly upload. As the data in your SIS changes, you can expect to see the following behavior with your sync:

-   When your CSV files no longer include first term classes or enrollments, Clever will place your sync on hold because the number of student-class enrollments will change significantly.
-   To review the hold, navigate to your Clever [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.
-   If the data looks correct, click **Approve**. Once the hold is cleared, your new term rosters will begin populating in Clever as they become active in your SIS. If the the data looks incorrect, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for assistance.

For more information on clearing holds, please see: [How do I release a hold?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358)  
 

* * *

##   
Auto Sync rollover procedure

Clever pulls the students, teachers, and rosters that are active in your SIS. As the data in your SIS changes, you can expect to see the following behavior with your sync:

-   When first-term classes are no longer active in your SIS, or as enrollments change, your Clever sync may go on hold: "pending significant changes in the data."
-   To review the hold, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.
-   If the data looks correct, click **Approve**. Once the hold is cleared, your new term rosters will begin populating in Clever as they become active in your SIS. If the data looks incorrect, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for assistance.

For more information on clearing holds, please see: [How do I release a hold?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358)  
 

* * *

##   
Recommended school organization actions:

### **1\. Review your school organization's sync information**

-   **For SFTP syncs:** Check your inbox for emails from Clever. 
    -   If you receive any error message in your email such as, _"Error Processing Clever SFTP Upload"_ please review the sync status on your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.
    -   See this article to resolve any sync status errors you may have: ["How do I resolve SFTP sync status errors?"](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203257407)
    -   If your sync is still "On Hold", navigate to your [Last Attempted Sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) to approve the changes. 

-   **For Auto Syncs:** Review your Clever [Last Attempted Sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/) as soon as your term data rolls over in your SIS.
    -   If your sync is still "On Hold", navigate to your [Last Attempted Sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) to approve the changes. 

###   
  
**2\. Review your sharing permissions**

If you are currently utilizing **sharing by rules** for any applications, we recommend reviewing any **sections where** rules that filter on **Term Name**. If a rule contains a filter for Term Name, you may need to adjust your sharing permissions to ensure the desired sections for the new term are available to the application.  
  
In the example below, the account will want to update the **Term Name** filter when transitioning from the Fall → Spring term. 

![Image of example sharing by sections rule where Term Name must be updated at rollover](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhTV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZLiB)

You can review and edit your sharing permissions by selecting the link near your listed application under the "Sharing" section. In the screenshot below, the links to review are those with **"Sharing by rules"**:

![Image of Clever Dashboard with Sharing by rules highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhTV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000063ysD)

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhTV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Zh4CI)** **Please note: If you want to pause syncing your data to a particular application, please see this article: [For Clever Admins: Pausing your sync for a specific app.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)  This is a perfect tool for semester rollover and summer school, but shouldn't be confused with an SIS sync pause.**

###   
  
**3\. Review section\_ids**

For term rollover, it is important to make sure that the ID #s for sections (the **section\_id** field in Clever) are **different** after a term or school year rollover. This is because Clever's system 'remembers' sections that have been deleted, based on their section\_id.  
  
If you have any questions about where to find your section\_id based on your sync type, please do not hesitate to contact Clever Support!  
  
 

###  **4\. Changing SIS IDs (student\_id, teacher\_id, etc.)**

During term rollovers, there are many school organizations that approach Clever about changing the primary identifiers (commonly called SIS IDs) for one or more record types. The following values are SIS IDs in Clever: 

-   Student\_id
-   Teacher\_id
-   Staff\_id
-   School\_id
-   Section\_id

  
Clever highly advises against changing these values in the middle of a school year. Doing so presents a significant risk of loss of historical data for users mid-year. If your school organization has a critical need to adjust SIS IDs mid-year, please reach out to Clever support for consultation. Commonly the need to change the SIS ID for users is due to a school organization needing to meet the data requirements for a specific connection. Clever Support may be able to help you meet this data requirement without disrupting your existing data in Clever.   
  
If you require changing SIS IDs mid-year and cannot wait until the summer academic rollover, please see this article: [Changing SIS IDs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543). Please note, it may take up to 2 weeks to complete the migration process. If you intend on changing SIS IDs, please plan accordingly to ensure minimal disruption to students and teachers. 

###   
**Badge invalidation**

If your school organization uses Clever Badges, please review your [Badge policy](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview) and ensure you void and regenerate all Badges during your school organization’s natural transition period, like summer or winter rollover. This will keep your school organization’s Badge policy secure and up to date.

Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. If a printed Badge has an expiration date, it will continue to work past that date. Newly printed Badges will not have an expiration date.

We suggest voiding and reprinting Badges during your school organization’s natural transition period, such as summer or winter rollover (e.g., void and reprint Badges in July 2026 and annually in July after that).

If you would like to learn how to void all Clever Badges and generate new Clever Badges, please see this article: [Clever Badge Invalidation.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001682?language=en_US#header3)

title: Clever Badges: Troubleshooting issues with Badges
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005208126#Overview)  
2\. [Common Issues and Resolutions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005208126#Common%20Issues%20and%20Resolutions)

## Overview

This article details some troubleshooting tips districts can use when students have issues with Badges, including invalid Badges and logging into Google Chromebooks using Clever Badges.

* * *

## Common Issues and Resolutions

### Badge is invalid

![Error message that mentions Badge is invalid](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bSF3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000072VgP)

This error message means that the student is no longer included in the scope of users who are assigned Badges.

Here's an example: Let's say your district's Badge scope is for students in third grade and below. At the end of the year, the third-grade students move on to fourth grade. If any of those new fourth-graders tried to use their old Badge, they would get this invalid message, since they are no longer included in the scoped users for Badges.

A teacher can generate a new Badge for the student by:  
  

1.  Logging into their _Clever Portal > My Students > Student Roster_. 
2.  Choose the class of the student you want to print a Badge for.
    
3.  Click the student.
    
4.  Select the _Create new badge_ button and print your student’s new Badge. 
    

![Create new badge image in Teacher Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bSF3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000TYfBJ)

### Your connection is not private error

If your web filter is blocking access, you will see a _"Your connection is not private"_ error when using a Clever Badge on the Chromebook login page. You may need to adjust your web filter in order to use Clever Badges with Chromebooks.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bSF3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C9f)  
  
This occurs because Chromebooks do not load custom root certificates (for instance, those used by web filters) before sign-in occurs. Therefore, you will need to allowlist certain URLs so that they are not intercepted and the correct certificate is presented during the login process.

### Allow-listing Necessary Domains

The following domains must be allow-listed for Clever Badges to function properly:

1.  \*.clever.com
2.  \*.s3.amazonaws.com
3.  accounts.google.com (if your district uses Clever Badges for Chromebooks)

With these changes, we believe that districts using any common web filter (such as iBoss, Lightspeed, Cipafilter, Securly, [ZScaler](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005401166), and Fortinet) can use Clever Badges with Chromebooks.

### Popup window interrupting the login flow

Occasionally Google will incorporate popup windows that can not be avoided and disrupt the login flow, requiring users to click through to close the popup in order to successfully log in. 

### Zip file is invalid

Occasionally Badge zip files on Windows devices produce an error that says Windows can’t open the zipped file. This happens when a school’s section names exceed the character limit Windows allows for file paths. You can fix the issue in one of two ways:

1.  **Use a zip tool** like [7-Zip](https://www.7-zip.org/) or [WinRAR](https://www.rarlab.com/) to open your Badges for printing.
    
2.  **Update your Windows Registry** to support longer file paths:
    
    1.  Open **RegEdit**.
    2.  Go to: `Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem`
    3.  Find the key: `LongPathsEnabled`.
    4.  Set its value to `1`.

title: Clever Badges: Chromebook login flow
text:
This article contains the following:  
1.[Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024681032#Header1)  
2.[Badge login flow](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024681032#Header2)  
3.[Recommend login flow for logging in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024681032#Header3)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C8c) For more information on how Clever works with Chromebooks, please see [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247?language=en_US) or navigate to the [Badges into Chromebook Set up Guide](https://schools.clever.com/badges/chromebook) in your district dashboard.

##   
Overview

Clever Badges can be generated for any students to utilize as an easy login method that requires no typing. This article demonstrates the different login flow options available to students who use a Clever Badge to log into their Chromebook.  
 

* * *

##   
Badge login flow

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The login flow for users is dependent upon the Chrome OS. The login flow for most users (Chrome OS 99 and above) is outlined below. Since the login flow for third-party IdPs is managed by Google, it is not possible for Clever to alter the login flow or revert to the previous behavior of Chrome OS 98 and lower.Occasionally Google will incorporate popup windows that can not be avoided and disrupt the login flow, requiring the users to click through to close the popup.

##   

Students who are using Badges will go through the following login flow:  
 

1\. Upon device power on, users will be directly taken to the Clever Badge login screen.

![Chromebook with prompt to hold Badge up](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YGVs)

2\. The Clever Badge login screen will appear. If prompted, grant access to the device camera and **scan your Clever Badge.**   
 

If the Clever Badge is valid, a green checkmark will appear and the Clever Portal will launch on the student's Chromebook. If a red "x" appears, please follow [these directions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907?language=en_US#h_aee89c40-dad3-43c6-badd-f603735a56ec) to void and generate a new Clever Badge.   
  
 

* * *

##   
Recommended login flow for logging in with Google 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The button to log in with Google cannot be removed.

Though the primary login method for Chromebooks may be Clever Badges, users can still log in using their Google email and password. Users should experience the following login flow when they want to log in with their Google credentials:   
  
1\. **Chrome OS 98 and below:** Select **Sign in with a different account**

 ![Chromebook with a sign in with different account prompt](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C8w)   
  
**Chrome OS 99 and above:** In the bottom right, select **Enter Google Account info**

![Chromebook with sign in with Google account prompt](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YGWH)   
 

2\. Enter your Google email and password. Click **Next.** The user is now logged in to the device. 

![Chromebook with Google login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000b72X&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C96)

title: For Clever Admins: Pausing the sync with your SIS
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#overview)  
2\. [When a school organization's sync is paused](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#syncpause)  
3\. [When a school organization's sync pause ends or is canceled](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#end)  
4\. [Scheduling or initiating a pause](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#scheduling)  
5\. [Modifying a scheduled pause](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#Modify)  
6. [Removing a pause](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#Remove)  
7\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507#FAQs)

##   
Overview

Clever allows school organizations to pause the sync from their student information system (SIS). When a sync is paused, the current rostering data is essentially "frozen" in Clever for the duration of the sync pause.   

IMPORTANT In 2026, Clever automatically pauses and removes pauses from syncs based on your school’s country:  
  
**USA:** Syncs pause on May 29, and we remove pauses between July 27–31.  
**Canada:** Syncs pause on June 30, and we remove pauses on August 14.  
**UK:** Syncs pause on July 15, and we remove pauses on September 1.  
**Australia and Brazil:** Syncs pause on December 20, and we remove pauses on January 20.  
  
For all other countries, we use the USA dates by default.  
  
You can modify these dates (or remove them altogether) under your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.

  
The two primary use cases for pausing data are school year rollover and planning for summer school. Please see the following articles for details:

-   [School Year Rollover: Overview, Preparation & Recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886)
-   [Summer School: Sync settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027745731)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you want to pause syncing your data to a particular application, please see this article: [For Clever Admins: Pausing your sync for a specific app.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)  A sync pause prevents you or your SIS from sending updates to Clever until the pause ends or is cleared, while an app pause prevents changes in your Clever data from syncing to one specific application.

* * *

##   
When a school organization's sync is paused

When your school organization's SIS sync to Clever is paused:

-   Rosters will _not_ sync from your SIS to Clever. SFTP uploads and manual uploads on the [SIS sync > Upload tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) will not be processed, and automatic syncs will not run. This means that changes made in your SIS will not interrupt student and teacher access to applications.
-   You cannot edit, add, or delete any user data coming from your SIS. This includes editing emails or user's names.
-   You can still add, edit, and delete [custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332).
-   Applications __may still sync__ rosters from Clever, allowing them to sync records updated via custom data. If you'd like your application(s) to stop pulling data from Clever, please consider an [application pause.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)
-   You can continue to update sharing permissions with applications.
-   Your sync status will appear as **Paused** in your Clever Dashboard.
-   All team members on the account will receive an email notification the day before the pause begins.
-   All team members in your [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page will receive an email notification the day before the pause ends.

      ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxb0)

* * *

##   
When a school organization's sync pause ends or is canceled

When a school organization's sync pause ends or is canceled: 

-   Clever will resume syncing with your SIS (auto-syncs) or process your next upload (SFTP syncs).
-   If your data has changed significantly, your account will go [on hold.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358)
-   You can confirm that your account is syncing correctly by checking the [sync status](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202048663) on your Dashboard.
-   All team members on the account will receive an email reminder on the last day of the pause.

             ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxb5)

* * *

##   
Scheduling or initiating a pause

An admin can initiate or cancel a sync pause on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page by entering pause start and end dates.

![Sync pause area of the Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Ys7j)

**Pause Dates**

-   Pause Start Date: This will be the first day your sync goes on pause.
-   Pause End Date: This will be the last day your sync is paused.

To schedule an indefinite pause:

-   Enter a **Pause Start Date**
-   Leave **Pause End Date** blank
-   Select **Update**
-   To begin syncing again, select **Clear** at any time.

  
Sync pauses run from 12:00 AM on the pause start date to 11:59 PM on the pause end date, _local time._

**☀️ Summer Pause:** Clever recommends the following dates when pausing your sync:  
  
**Pause Start Date:** the last day of the term before a school rollover break. This will ensure data from the normal school year is not deleted.  
  
**Pause End Date:** the day _before_ you want to resume syncing data. For example, if you wish to resume syncing with your SIS on August 1st, set the Pause End Date to July 31st.

* * *

##   
Modifying a scheduled pause

To modify a sync pause that has already been scheduled, navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page:

-   Click within the box next to **Pause Start Date** or **Pause End Date**.
-   Select the desired date(s).
-   Select **Update** to confirm the change.

![sync pause dates](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Ys7Z)  

* * *

##   
Removing a pause

To remove a sync pause and resume syncing data to Clever at any time, navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. Under **Schedule Sync Pause,** click **Clear.** 

![Clear pause button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dDwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Ys6C)

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**Can I pause my SIS sync and my apps at the same time?**

-   Yes, sync pauses and app pauses work independently, so you can enable or disable either one at any time.
    

**Can I update a user's email address during a sync pause?**

-   You can't edit profiles directly while your sync is paused, but you can [sideload](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026) the updated email address of a student or teacher. Once your sync pause ends and completes successfully, confirm the new email in Clever, delete the sideloaded file, and revert your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Login method](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) settings to sync emails from your SIS again.
    

**Can I add or remove admin accounts during a sync pause?**

-   Yes, you can add or remove manually added admins at any time from the Admin Team page. If you synced admins via an administrators.csv file, they cannot be added or removed during a pause.
    

**Can I add students to a teacher's roster during a sync pause?**

-   You can add a student to a teacher's roster during a pause only by creating a custom section with custom data. You can't add a student to an existing SIS-created section while paused.
    

**Can I edit my sync pause to allow a single field to sync with Clever?**

-   You can move up or clear your pause date to pull in the field, then re-enable the pause, but this risks a sync error if rollover isn't complete, or losing access to summer school sections if it is.
-   A safer option is to upload the field as a [custom extension field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) until your pause ends, then sync it normally from your SIS.

**Will Clever's Identity Management (IDM) still work during a sync pause?**

-   Yes, IDM runs independently of your Clever sync and keeps managing existing accounts during a pause, but it will only provision new users automatically if they synced to Clever before the pause began.
    

**Is it possible to pause the sync for specific schools?**

-   No, you can't pause the sync for individual schools. As a workaround, you can pause an app sync to preserve that school's data in a specific app.
    

**What happens if I don't approve a sync hold before pausing my SIS sync?**

-   Clever keeps the data as it was prior to the sync hold.
    

**Can I still upload custom data or extension fields during a pause?**

-   Yes, custom data uploads outside of your SIS sync, so it (and extension fields, which sync through custom data) continues to work during a sync pause or app pause.
    

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Custom Data: Overview (i.e., sections, students, contacts, teachers, staff & fields)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332)
-   [For Clever Admins: Pause your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)

title: For Clever Admins: Assigning "subject" to sections
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203448663#header1)  
2. [How does Clever determine ‘subject’?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203448663#determine)  
3\. [What if my sync doesn’t include a ‘subject’ field?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203448663#include)  
4\. [How can I ensure Clever chooses the correct subject?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203448663#ensure)  
5. [Miscategorized Subjects](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203448663#Miscategorized)

## Overview

Syncing subjects accurately is essential to getting the most out of Clever. Many learning applications require sections to have subjects, and assigning subjects correctly will also make it easier to share data by sections. This article outlines how Clever determines ‘subject’ for each section and how to sync ‘subject’ with Clever to ensure accuracy.

* * *

##   
How does Clever determine ‘subject’?

If your data sync includes a ‘subject’ field, Clever categorizes sections into subject categories based on the values you provide. For example, ‘subject’ field values “English”, “Reading”, and “Writing” are all sorted into “english/language arts”. Everything that can’t be sorted (including blanks) will be assigned to the subject “other”.

All sections will be assigned one of the following subject values:

-   arts and music
-   english/language arts
-   homeroom/advisory
-   interventions/online learning
-   language
-   math
-   PE and health
-   science
-   social studies
-   technology and engineering
-   other 

If Clever can't determine the subject based on the values given in the 'subject' field, then our system looks to values in the section 'name' field, and lastly, to values in the course\_name field.

* * *

##   
What if my sync doesn’t include a subject field?

If you aren’t syncing a ‘subject’ field, Clever categorizes sections into the subject categories above based on what terms are included in the ‘section\_name’ field. For example, sections with section\_name values of “Algebra II Honors 3A”, “5th Grade Mathematics”, and “P4 - Calc - Johnson” are all assigned the subject “math”.

If Clever can’t determine the subject based on section 'name’, Clever will look at the ‘course\_name’ field for terms that indicate subject.

Any section whose subject cannot be determined will be assigned the subject “other”.

* * *

##   
How can I ensure Clever chooses the correct subject?

There are two ways to make sure Clever chooses the right subject for each section:

**1\. Add ‘subject’ field to your sync**

Syncing a ‘subject’ field to Clever with values that exactly match the subject categories listed above is the best way to make sure subjects are accurate in Clever. As long as you provide one of Clever’s accepted subject values, Clever will use the exact value you provide.

If you’re syncing data with Clever via Auto Sync, you’ll want to determine which field is used to sync subjects to Clever, then populate that field with the above subject values.

-   If you’re using a [Clever-Managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/202289278#Clever-Managed%20Automatic%20Sync), contact [Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) Support to determine which SIS field is used for subject. You can also tell us if you’d prefer to pull a different subject field from your SIS.
-   For [SIS-Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/202289278#SIS-Managed%20Automatic%20Sync), please reach out directly to your SIS to determine which fields can be used to send subject values to Clever.

For [SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/202289278#SFTP%20Sync), add a column with header “Subject” and include a value for each section that exactly matches one of the subject categories listed above.

**2\. Change the value of section ‘name’ or ‘course\_name’**
