If you’re not able to sync a ‘subject’ field to Clever, we will make our best guess based on the terms included in the section ‘name’ and ‘course\_name’ fields. To improve accuracy, try some of these tips:

-   Include one of Clever’s subject values in your section or course names.
-   Use full terms whenever possible. For example, “comp” is interpreted as “composition” (subject: “english/language arts”), not “computers” (subject: “technology and engineering”).
-   Creative names can sometimes be miscategorized, so opt for simple and commonly used terms. For example, “astronomy” gets matched to “science”, whereas “rocket ships” would be matched to “other”.

* * *

##   
Miscategorized Subjects

Clever makes the best-educated guess to sort each section into the above subjects. If you see a large number of sections assigned the wrong subject value, please [request help from our Support Team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

title: Clever Badges: How do I manage Badge PINs?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000411306#h_905101fb-d29b-4809-b843-42c68d3e760f)  
​ 2. [Setting Badge PINs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000411306#Header2)  
3\. [Troubleshooting forgotten PINs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000411306#Header4)

##   
Overview

As a security precaution, some school organizations require students to enter a secure PIN when logging in to Clever with a Badge. In addition, Clever requires a Badge PIN for all students in seventh grade or above who log in using a Badge, minus students with an IEP or ELL status. Clever Admins can disable Badge PINs for students in these grade levels on an individual basis, but not for a group of students.

A school organization can choose to adjust the PIN requirement settings for Badges to begin at an earlier grade. This can be managed from the [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges > Settings tab.](https://schools.clever.com/badges/settings)

 **![Pencil icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eMUr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Classroom MFA users who are in seventh grade or above won’t be required to enter a PIN when using a Badge to log into Clever if they are enrolled in an active policy.

* * *

## Setting Badge PINs

To set a PIN, students will navigate to [clever.com/badges](https://clever.com/badges), hold their Badge up to the camera, and then be authenticated to the page displayed below.  
  
The first time a student uses a PIN-enabled Badge, they will see the screen below prompting them to set a PIN.  
  
On this screen, the student will enter their new PIN twice and then be signed in to Clever! After this initial setup, your students will be able to log into Clever using their Badge and their PIN.  
  
![Clever login screen asking a student to create and confirm a PIN](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eMUr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C8N)

Badge PINs can be manually enabled or disabled from a student's details card in the [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) or from the student profile page using the **Support tools** drop-down arrow. These Badge management options are available to Clever Admins, District Help Desk, and School Tech Leads.  
  
![Screenshot of Clever Dashboard dropdown menu showing where to disable the Badge PIN](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eMUr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005T9l4)

 **![Pencil icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eMUr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** PIN requirements are set when a Badge is first generated. As such, if a student's ELL or IEP status changes later, Clever will not automatically update the requirement for a Badge PIN. Also, any student who has a Badge outside the scoped **Grades with Badges** setting will need a PIN (including IEP or ELL students who are set to **Create individually** rather than **Auto include** in [Step 1 of the Badges settings](https://schools.clever.com/badges/settings/edit)). To reset the student's PIN requirements, their current Badge should be voided and a new Badge generated for them.

* * *

## Troubleshooting forgotten PINs

-   **Students**: Here is a resource to share with students who need help with their PIN: [For Students: How do I log in to Clever using a Badge?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020354392)
-   **Teachers**: Here is how teachers can help their students log in using a backup PIN: [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888#h_3bc3e162-9643-4522-91ea-5b7963ce3487)

title: For Clever Admins: Syncing demographic data/sensitive fields
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771#overview)  
2\. [Syncing demographic data/sensitive fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771#syncing)  
3\. [Clever-Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771#clever-managed)  
4\. [SIS-Managed Auto and SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771#sis-sftp)  
5\. [Sharing sensitive data with applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771#sharing)

## Overview

Clever can sync a variety of demographic data, such as ELL status, IEP status, and Free/reduced-price lunch (FRL) status, among others. Because the data in these fields is considered sensitive, Clever doesn't automatically share this data with any applications connected to your school organization. Still, these fields can be included in the application sharing if needed.

 **![pencil](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Not all apps support all demographic data/sensitive fields. If you have specific demographic data you need to share with an app, please contact the app directly to check if they support syncing that field.

* * *

## Syncing demographic data/sensitive fields to Clever

The first step is to ensure that sensitive fields are synced to Clever. Please navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser > Students tab](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=students) to verify if these data points are available. Use the filter option to filter students by the demographic field in question. Then, select the value drop-down menu. If this search is not available, it likely means the data is not in Clever, and therefore, you can't search using these fields.

![IEP status filter in data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwfF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EDLGH)

* * *

## Clever-Managed Auto Syncs

School organizations that utilize the [Clever-managed auto-sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) can [customize their sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003630803) from the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings > Students tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings). If the SIS field you wish to export is not available in the dropdown, please contact Clever Support for assistance.

![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwfF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C8D)**Please note:** OneRoster API syncs cannot sync ell\_status, frl\_status, and iep\_status. They can be manually uploaded via Custom data. Visit [this article for instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912).

* * *

## SIS-Managed Auto and SFTP Syncs

School organizations that utilize an [SIS-managed SFTP Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) or an [SFTP sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408) will need to contact their SIS, or whoever configured the SFTP export, directly to begin syncing these data points to Clever. This data will need to be added to the students.csv export for the school organization with the column headers:

-   ell\_status
-   iep\_status
-   frl\_status
-   preferred\_last\_name
-   preferred\_middle\_name
-   preferred\_first\_name
-   gifted\_status
-   home\_language ([see this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020926771#home-languages) for a list of available languages)
-   section\_504\_status
-   disability\_status
-   disability\_type

Please also review Clever's general SFTP guidelines [here](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf). These instructions contain information about Clever-supported column headers and formatting requirements.

### **Supported home languages**

Check out [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001634) for all of the possible options for home languages. Given the number of languages supported, this list is not included in our [general SFTP guidelines](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf).

When designating the home language within the students.csv file, you can use either the home language _or_ the home language code.

* * *

## Sharing sensitive data with applications

###   
**Sharing demographic data/sensitive fields with applications**

You can locate the [Field Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586) information by navigating to a specific application's overview page from your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) and choosing the application **Settings** tab. Currently, Field Access gives you an overview of the data your applications have indicated they're using. Each learning application partner configures its required/optional fields for school organization data. Please get in touch with the application support teams directly if you have questions.  
  
Select the **Advanced settings** option, and then **Customize fields shared with.** You can customize the student data available to the application from the **Edit Student Fields** tab.

![Edit student fields screen, with sensitive fields such as IEP status and gifted status](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwfF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Jc8T)

-   The list on the left shows the fields available to share with the application.
-   The list on the right shows the list of fields currently being shared with the application.

Move field(s) from the left to the right to share the sensitive data with the application. Once your changes have been made, select **Next** and **Save**. The application should sync the newly shared data within the next 24 hours.  
  

### **Setting up sharing rules to share data based on demographic data/sensitive field information**

By configuring application [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007), school organizations can determine what data they would like to make available to applications. Sharing permissions also help schools to determine which users (e.g., teachers, students, staff) will have access to different applications in their Clever Portals.

Custom sharing rules allow school organizations to share only data that meets certain criteria. Once the field data has been synced to Clever and is available in the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), sharing rules can be configured to share by the data associated with fields. For example:

-   Share only students whose ELL\_Status is 'Y'
-   Share only students whose gifted\_status is 'N'

Configuring sharing rules to share using field data is completed by creating a sharing rule to 'Custom share by student.' From there, school organizations can select the field they would like to use for sharing data. Please visit [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) for more information about setting up sharing rules.  
  
![Screenshot of a custom sharing rule configured to share by student field](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwfF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZVcD)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)

title: Clever Badges: Piloting at your district
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002701366#h_dbc5b2d6-ab37-476b-b89e-7bffe2922f6f)  
2. [Tips for a successful pilot](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002701366#h_d4110822-6f33-4927-967c-5488989478ca)

## Overview

[Clever Badges](https://clever.com/products/badges) make it even easier for your students to access their learning applications through Clever so that your teachers can spend more time instructing and less time troubleshooting username and password errors.

  
Clever Badges are offered at **no charge** to districts and only require that your student’s laptop or desktop device have a webcam enabled. Students will go to clever.com/badges or your district's login page and then hold their Badge up to the camera to log in.

  
If your students are using Chromebooks, or Windows devices with Active Directory logins, Clever Badges can be used to log students into their computer, Clever, and connected apps all at once! To set up these integrations, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview) page. Then select the Chromebook or Windows tab depending, and follow the instructions in the wizard (this should take about 10 minutes).  
 

## Tips for a successful pilot

1.  **Start small**. Pick one or two elementary school sites at which you can initiate your pilot. Our distribution process allows you to select which schools should participate. Include a media specialist, school site leader, or teacher that embraces the adoption of new technology to help you champion this new tool!
2.  **Educate your teachers.** [Using this helpful article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236004408), you can show teachers how to generate badges so that they can help maintain Badges for new students.
3.  **Make them fun and easy.** Whether you place your badges on student folders or create lanyards for students to wear around their necks, ensure your Badges will be be easy to use and won’t be easily lost or damaged.

  
Start now! Get a head start so that you can roll out more broadly for next back to school.

title: Clever Badges: Overview and setup
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Overview)[Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Overview)  
2\. [Setup Requirements & Instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#setup)  
3\. [Generating & Printing Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Generating%20&%20Printing%20Clever%20Badges)  
4\. [Logging in with Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Logging%20in%20with%20Clever%20Badges)  
5. [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Voiding%20Badges)[Voiding Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Voiding%20Badges)  
6. [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#BadgeActivity)[Exporting Badge activity report](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Badge%20Activity)  
7. [Badge Invalidation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Sync%20Pauses%20&%20Badge%20Invalidation)  
8\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/220213907#Frequently%20Asked%20Questions%20\(FAQs\))

## Overview

With Clever Badges, districts can allow students to use a physical Badge to log in to Clever without needing to enter login credentials (i.e., a username and password). Instead, students can simply hold their Clever Badge up to their device webcam to be logged in automatically.  
  
By default, Clever Badges are intended for younger students or those with special needs. However, if your district would prefer to use Badges for older students as well, please visit this article for information on setting up Badges that include pin requirements: [Clever Badges: How do I manage Badge PINs?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000411306)  
  
Please check out the following short video to see how Clever Badges can save both teachers and students time in the classroom! 

## 

  
This article is to help you set up your Clever Badges. If you need help troubleshooting an issue, please see the following:

-   [Clever Badges: How do I troubleshoot issues with Badges into Chromebooks?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005208126)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Setup & Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247)

* * *

## Setup Requirements & Instructions 

### **Setup Requirements**

You will need the following items for the implementation and use of Badges:

-   Compatible devices and/or internet browsers:
    -   [Chromebooks](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247)
    -   [iOS devices](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024746971) (e.g., iPads, iPhones)
    -   [Windows devices](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000384086)
    -   [Browsers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236226387): Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Internet Explorer (2013 or later)
    -   Android devices with a webcam and a compatible mobile browser: Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Internet Explorer
-   A printer to print physical Badges on paper or labels
-   Computers and devices with webcams
    -   _Please note that any variation of webcams will work as long as they are compatible with student devices._

  This video is incredibly helpful for helping you set up Clever Badges for your schools.

##   

### **Setup Instructions**

To begin, on your Clever Dashboard, please navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges > Settings tab.](https://schools.clever.com/badges/settings)  
Under the **Access** box, click **Edit**

![Edit Clever Badges page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxt4)

###   
  
**Step 1: Specify students** 

Please begin by choosing which grade levels and students you would like to enable for Badges. The drop-down menu will allow you to select specific grades. Clever will also automatically provide you with the option to include students with [IEPs or students who are ELL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020926771).

Please note that Clever will automatically invalidate badges as students age out of their district’s policy. For example, if badges are enabled for Grade 2 and below, once a student is promoted from 2nd grade to 3rd grade, their badge will be invalidated. 

![Screenshot of Badges page to specify student grades](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008hE37)

###   
  
**Step 2: Add Schools**

You can now choose all schools or the specific schools you would like to enable for Badges, which will work in conjunction with the student grade settings you selected in the first step. Once done, select **Save** to generate your student Badges!  
 

![Screenshot of Badges page to specify schools](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008gp1X)  

### **Step 3: Edit Visibility (only if using Badge with Chromebook)**

If students will use Badges to log into Chromebooks, make sure Visibility is on. Navigate to [Authentication > Badges > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/badges/settings#:~:text=Show-,Edit), then click **Edit** under Visibility. Turn the toggle on so you see a green check mark.

![Badge visibility on login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ewudt)   

![Visibility settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ewukL)   

  
 

* * *

## Generating & printing Clever Badges

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If Badges aren't available to print for a school or grade level, navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges > Settings tab > Access box](https://schools.clever.com/badges/settings) and confirm if Badges are enabled for the correct school and grade levels.   

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Badges printed to PDF will match the Avery label template size for 2” square Avery labels perfectly! Additionally, printing Badges on sticky labels is a great way to ensure students don't lose them, which is more likely to occur when printed on paper. Clever also highly recommends providing students with Badge holders such as those seen [here](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=badge+holder&crid=1FY4FIYFATYGK&sprefix=badge%2Caps%2C177&ref=nb_sb_ss_ts-doa-p_1_5).

###   
  
**Generating and printing Badges in bulk**

By navigating to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview), you can select to download the Badges for individual schools, multiple schools, or all enabled schools. Clever Admins can choose to download active Badges or those that are associated with new users who have never had Badges generated previously.  

![Badge download options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Zp2t)  

Depending on the file size, Clever will either download the Badges directly to your computer or email you a secure [.zip file](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/zip-and-unzip-files-8d28fa72-f2f9-712f-67df-f80cf89fd4e5) that can be downloaded to your desktop if the file exceeds our standard download limitations. The file will contain the following:

-   Folders with the names of each school 
    -   Subfolders with student Badges by grade level, including the Badge QR codes and names of each student.
        -   PDF of the grade level Badges
        -   PNG images of Badges
    -   Subfolders with student Badges by sections (i.e., courses/classes), including the Badge QR codes and names of each student.
        -   PDF of the grade level Badges
        -   PNG images of Badges

![Example of folder organization when you download Badges](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C6q)  

###   
**Generating Individual Student Badges**

Badges can also be generated or voided on a per-student basis. To do this, please begin by searching for the student using the Clever Dashboard search bar or by navigating to the [Clever Dashboard > Data browser > Students tab](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=students). Once you've located the student's record to access their profile page, select **Support Tools** in the top right to void their Badge or generate a new one.  

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If the option to void or generate a Badge isn't available for a student, the student isn't included in the scope specified when you or another admin set up Clever Badges.

  
  
![Student profile with Support tools > Badge options highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000irLWP)    
  
Badge pins can also be updated from a student's profile page in Clever. For more information, please visit: [Clever Badges: How do I manage Badge PINs?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000411306)  
 

* * *

##   
Logging in with Clever Badges

Below is the expected login flow for a student using their Badge to authenticate with Clever:

-   The student will navigate to either [clever.com/badges](https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login?target=;NGM2M2MxY2Y2MjNkY2U4MmNhYWM=;aHR0cHM6Ly9jbGV2ZXIuY29tL2luL2F1dGhfY2FsbGJhY2s=;OGRkZTliY2NkMjI1MDBmNDRmMmI4MGE2NDllZDAwYWJlNjZhNTE1MGY0Mjc2ZDkyM2UwMWU1MDhkODIwNzY3OA==;Y29kZQ==;) or the district's [custom Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205818838). Clever Badges are designed to be used directly with Clever, and a QR reader won't log you in to Clever.
-   They will select the **Clever Badge login** option.
-   If they haven't previously provided access, they will be prompted to allow Clever access to their device camera so they can scan their Badge. 
-   At this point, their webcam will activate so they can hold their Badge up to the camera. Once Clever's sensors recognize the Badge, the user will see a green check mark and be logged in successfully.
    -   _Please note that if the student sees a red X, their Badge login was unsuccessful._

 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever Badges are an independent login method, separate from other login methods such as Google, Active Directory, and Clever Passwords, which means Clever does not have access to your students' login credentials for alternative Identity Providers (IdPs). Please get in touch with your district's tech support for issues with student usernames and passwords.

* * *

##   
Voiding Badges

Clever Badges can be voided and regenerated if needed. If a student loses their Badge, the best practice would be to direct them to immediately reach out to their teacher, IT support, or a Clever Admin. The missing Badge should be voided to protect the student's information. After you void a badge, you can issue a new one.  
  
Voiding Clever Badges is a safeguard for protecting students. Therefore, this isn't a feature that can be disabled. Clever Badges are comparable to a student's login credentials. If their login credentials or Clever Badge are compromised, they should be reset.  
  
To void a student's Clever Badge, Clever Admins can navigate to the student's profile page using the Clever Search bar at the top of the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/). Choose the **Support Tools** option to the right of the page to void the student's Badge. A new Badge can also be generated from the **Support Tools** menu.  

Clever Badges can also be voided in bulk for district school locations by navigating to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Badges](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview). Once voided, new Badges can be generated.  
 

* * *

## Exporting Badge activity report

Clever Admins can export a Badge activity report to get a complete view of Badge usage across their school organization. The report includes student, school, and Badge information that can help you monitor Badge activity, identify Badges that may need attention, and maintain a healthy Badge program. 

Regularly reviewing the Badge activity report can help you determine when to annually void and reprint Badges, ensuring secure access throughout the school year. 

  
The report includes the following fields:

-   School ID
    
-   School SIS ID
    
-   School Number
    
-   School Name
    
-   Student ID
    
-   Student SIS ID
    
-   Student Name
    
-   Grade Level
    
-   Creation Date
    
-   Last Used Date
    

To export a Badge activity report, navigate to [**SSO & Portal > Badges** > **Export CSV**](https://schools.clever.com/badges/overview).

![Image of Badge activity report.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000mPEVZ)   
  
  

* * *

##   
Badge Invalidation

Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. If a printed Badge has an expiration date, it will continue to work past that date. Newly printed Badges will not have an expiration date. 

Admins should still [void](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001682#header3) and print Badges during your district’s natural transition period, like summer or winter rollover.

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**I downloaded a set of Badges, and there are some Badges missing. What do I do?**

-   If you're noticing there are students missing a Badge in your download, make sure to double-check that they meet the criteria you set in your [Badge settings](https://schools.clever.com/badges/settings). Once you've confirmed the students meet the criteria, you can download the new Badges for these students. 

**Our school district is changing SISs; do we need to create new Clever Badges?**

-   If the students' SIS IDs aren't changing, then you don't need to create new Badges. This is because Clever Badges are tied to the students' Clever ID, which is created based on the SIS ID. So, if the SIS ID doesn't change, the Clever ID won't change, and there's no need to create new Badges.
-   Keep in mind that students in custom sections will need to have Badges generated individually.

**How do I download a Badge for a custom section?** 

-   Students in custom sections will need to have Badges generated individually. 

* * *

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cpeD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Looking for additional support setting up the Clever Portal? [Check out our Clever Academy Quick Start - Setting up your Portal course](https://go.clever.com/l/569832/2020-03-20/kqh52)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For School Tech Leads: Badges](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005209686)
-   [For Teachers: Clever Badges for students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000127406)
-   [How to download a Clever Badge as a parent/guardian](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047770232)
-   [Clever Badges: How do I troubleshoot issues with Badges into Chromebooks?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005208126)
-   [Single Sign-on (SSO): multiple IdPs for Google Workspace](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001541)

title: School year rollover: Overview, preparation & recommendations
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#overview)  
2\. [Summer sync pauses](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#summersyncpause)  
3\. [What to expect when your sync is paused](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#pause)  
4. [Pause Dates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#pause_dates)  
5. [Rollover and section\_ids](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#Rolloverdate)  
6\. [Troubleshooting data for new school year](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#troubleshooting_data)  
7\. [Preparing for the first day of school](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#preparing_for_first_day)  
8. [Changing your SIS, sync method, or SIS IDs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886#changing_ids)

##   
Overview

This article outlines Clever’s school year rollover process and how school organizations can prepare. For summer school recommendations, [check out this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615332).

In Clever, a school year rollover is typically the period during which a school organization transfers data from the previous school year to the upcoming one. For schools that operate on a year-round schedule, this may be when students move from one grade level to another, or when all class rosters change (e.g., students change teachers, teachers change classes, etc.)

* * *

##   
Summer sync pauses 

IMPORTANT   
In 2026, Clever automatically pauses and removes pauses from syncs based on your school organization’s country:  
  
**USA:** Syncs pause on May 29, and we remove pauses between July 27–31.  
**Canada:** Syncs pause on June 30, and we remove pauses on August 14.  
**UK:** Syncs pause on July 15, and we remove pauses on September 1.  
**Australia and Brazil:** Syncs pause on December 20, and we remove pauses on January 20.  
  
For all other countries, we use the USA dates by default.  
  
You can modify these dates (or remove them altogether) under your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.

During the pause, Clever stops processing data updates, letting your school organization update SIS (Student Information System) or CSV files without interrupting students, teachers, or staff access over the summer.

Current school year data will essentially be "frozen" in Clever for the duration of the sync pause.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you'd like to pause syncing your data to a specific application, please see this article: [For Clever Admins: Pausing your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607). This tool is perfect for semester rollover and summer school, but it shouldn't be confused with a SIS sync pause. 

If you wish to freeze your data within Clever over the summer, **we advise setting your sync pause to a date before the last day of school**. Please note that your SIS may attempt to delete current data on the last day of school. We recommend reaching out to your SIS to determine if this is the case so that you can plan accordingly. 

Once the sync pause has ended, Clever will automatically resume syncing with Clever-managed syncs and will resume processing SFTP data file uploads. 

Unless otherwise specified in your settings, Clever automatically removes pauses between July 28 and August 1 to allow Clever admins enough time for [review and testing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886#h_1f8b996e-f3bb-4e85-9dbc-0296e7336baf) (e.g. ensuring new users are able to log in, app sharing rules are correct, etc.) before the start of school. The **Pause Start Date** and **Pause End Date** can be viewed and modified by admins from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.  

![Screenshot of the sync pause page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004Fb8D)

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Did you know?** Application partners manage the app syncing process on their end, so each app sync could be unique. For questions about how apps handle school year rollover, please reach out to the app partner directly.

* * *

##   
What to expect when your sync is paused

**While your SIS sync to Clever is paused:**

-   All Clever admins with [Sync pause email notifications turned on](https://schools.clever.com/profile/emails) will receive an email notification the day before the pause begins. You can see all fellow Clever admins associated with your account at [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page.
    
-   Your sync status will show as **Paused** in your [Clever Dashboard.](https://schools.clever.com/)

![Screenshot of paused sync](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004Fclp)

-   Please note: Updates to data will not sync from your SIS to Clever during a pause, so changes made in your SIS will not interrupt student, teacher or staff access to Clever or their connected applications.  
    -   SFTP uploads will not be processed, even if data is sent to Clever
    -   Clever-managed syncs will run but not process any data changes
-   Applications _may still be retrieving data from Clever_ over the summer even if your SIS sync is paused.
    -   If you'd like your application(s) to stop retrieving data from Clever during the sync pause, you can pause app syncs in Clever using the App Sync Pause settings. For more on this, please see [Pause your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607). 
-   Clever admins _can_ still update sharing permissions for applications.

**When your sync pause ends or is canceled:**

-   All Clever admin with [Sync pause email notifications turned on](https://schools.clever.com/profile/emails) will receive an email notification the day before the pause ends. You can see all fellow Clever admin at [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members).
-   Clever will once again resume:
    -   Syncing with your SIS (auto-syncs)
    -   Or processing your next SFTP upload (SFTP syncs)
-   If the rostering data in Clever changes significantly once the sync resumes, your sync will be placed on an automatic hold as a safeguard to provide you time to review the rostering changes before they are processed. Of note, if Clever detects an unusual amount of potentially disruptive data changes, the Clever Support team will be notified when you attempt to approve these changes to assist you with review. Learn more about [sync holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358).
    
    -   Admins can review sync changes before they are processed from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page by using the **Download Changes** option to the right of each data type.
    

             ![Screenshot of Sync page with highlight on Download Changes column](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004FhdR)

* * *

##   
Pause Dates

Admins can make adjustments to the sync **Pause Start Date** and **Pause End Date** from the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page as follows:

-   Pause Start Date: This will be the first day your sync goes on pause, which should coincide with the last day of the current school year.
    -   **Please note:** _Your current school year data should still be active in your SIS on this day._
-   Pause End Date: This will be the last day your sync is paused, which should be the day _before_ your SIS data is active for the upcoming school year. 
    -   **For example:** _If next school year's data will be active in your SIS on 8/15/25, your Pause End Date should be set for 8/14/25. This might also be your last day of summer._
    -   Sync pauses run from 12:00 AM on the pause start date to 11:59 PM on the pause end date, local time. For example, if you wish to resume syncing with Clever on August 10th, please set the Pause End Date to August 9th.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C7e)**Please note:** If possible, we recommend unpausing your sync a week or two in advance of the new school year to give you time to review the changes, see if there are any errors, and address any issues that may arise.

* * *

## Rollover and section\_ids

In Clever, a school year rollover is typically the period during which a school organization transfers data from the previous school year to the upcoming one. Rollover is a critical time to consider your section\_ids in Clever. Clever maps all historical data to unique Clever IDs, which are directly tied to your SIS IDs (school\_id, student\_id, teacher\_id, section\_id). 

If section IDs are reused for new classes, Clever and your integrated apps may treat them as ongoing sections from last year, leading to merged rosters and inaccurate historical data. To prevent this, Clever can reset the Clever IDs for your sections, establishing a clean slate for the new school year.

When Clever detects that your section data reflects a new school year, your sync goes on [a rollover hold](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001751). This is different from a standard sync hold. Instead of reviewing data changes, you'll be asked to confirm whether the changes represent your new school year before your sync continues. You’ll be presented with a menu of three options for progressing through the rollover hold.

Depending on your school organization, you may be able to approve your own selection, or you may need to submit it to Clever Support for review before your sync releases. 

If the changes were unintended, you can also discard the changes and send corrected data instead. For a deep dive on the decision-making process and what each option means for your data, please [see this article on rollover holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001751).

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C83)  **Reusing Section IDs:** Clever discourages reusing section\_ids between academic years. Rollover holds help prevent the reuse of section Clever IDs, but s**ome applications require that Section\_ids** (not just the Clever IDs associated with the section IDs) be unique to the academic year. Best practice is for new school year class sections to use new, unique section\_ids.

* * *

##   
Troubleshooting data for the new school year

If you are not seeing the current school year data in Clever:   
  
**1\. Confirm that your account is not on pause.**  
Data for the new school year will not be able to sync to Clever until the pause is removed from your sync. You can adjust your pause dates from the bottom of the [Sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.

![Screenshot of Paused sync notification](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GDxCM)

  
  
**2\. Confirm that data was synced to Clever _after_ the pause was removed.**   
You will not see data for the next academic year in Clever until we receive a set of data _after_ the pause is removed. If your new data was uploaded to Clever _prior_ to the pause being removed, please re-upload the data to Clever.  
  
**3\. Confirm your data is not on hold**  
Since there are often major changes to data when transitioning school years, your data sync will likely go on hold. You can approve the data changes to release your hold from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.

If your hold is a rollover hold, you'll need to select one of three options before your sync continues. Please see our [Help Center article on rollover holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001751) for details on what each option means.  
  
**4\. Confirm your student information system (SIS) is sending new school year's data to Clever**  
Rollover information for [Clever-managed syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZnTWAW/clevermanaged-syncs?language=en_US) can be found in our Help Center. For all other sync types and SISs, please contact the support team for your SIS.   
 

* * *

##   
Preparing for the first day of school

Here are some key recommendations to help you prepare for the new school year in Clever:

**1\. Student Information System (SIS)**

-   Confirm that the new rosters are active in your SIS so they'll successfully sync to Clever.
-   If you'll be sharing data with Clever before you want students or teachers to see the new school year data, you can temporarily turn off access to Clever with [Access Controls](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046702972). 

**2\. Sync Hold**

-   Confirm that your SIS sync is no longer [on hold](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358) from your [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.

**3\. Applications**

-   Review all application [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) to ensure the appropriate data is shared prior to the start of school.
    -   **Please note:** If your school organization is **sharing by section** with any applications, you may need to update your section sharing rules for app partners to retrieve the new data.
        
-   Confirm all of your school organization apps are [launched](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360016204711), and the syncs are active. Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) and click on the application name to open the app overview page to verify these details. Keep in mind that applications sync at different times, so you may not see an immediate sync.  
    -   If it’s been more than 24 hours since the last sync, or the sync doesn’t seem to be running, check that any [App Sync Pauses](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607) have been removed. If the issue continues, reach out to the application’s support team for help.
        

                ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d9BV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C7y)

-   For rostering/SSO applications, be sure you have spot-checked students and teachers to ensure they are being logged in successfully to the app(s) through Clever. This can be done using the [Impersonating a User: 'Access Portal as' Feature.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000406146)
-   If your school organization uses any [SSO (Saved Passwords)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0xzWAC/saved-passwords) applications, ensure you’ve provisioned accounts directly with the app, then configured the user credentials in Clever and tested them to make sure they’re working.
-   For priority connections, we recommend communicating with the vendor when your data is ready to be synced for the new school year.

**4\. Data Browser**

-   From your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser), spot-check the following:
    -   **Students:**
        -   Ensure pertinent details are in Clever for your students (e.g. email address, student numbers, section enrollments, apps, etc.)
    -   **Teachers:**
        -   Ensure pertinent details are in Clever for your teachers (e.g. email address, section assignments, apps, etc.)
    -   **Sections:** 
        -   Ensure the updated sections for the new school year are in Clever and look correct. 
        -   If co-teachers need to be manually assigned to sections in Clever, follow the instructions in [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748). 
    -   **Staff:**
        -   Ensure any non-instructional staff who need access to Clever are showing under the 'Staff' tab and their pertinent details are present (e.g. email address, staff ID). See [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791) for more information about staff.

**5\. Badges**

-   Clever recommends that you void and reprint Badges during your school organization's natural transition period, such as a summer or winter rollover. 
    

* * *

## Changing your SIS, sync method, or SIS IDs

  
**Changing your Student Information System (SIS)**  
If you are changing your Student Information System (SIS), please contact Clever Support to notify us of the upcoming change. Our team will partner with you to create a migration plan and timeline based on your new SIS and available sync methods. Please allow at least 2-3 weeks to complete the migration with Clever Support. We **highly** recommend starting this process at least a month before your first day of school. For more information on the transition process, please see this article: [Changing Student Information Systems](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049183691).  
  
  
**Changing your sync method**  
If your school organization is using the same SIS for the upcoming year, but would like to change sync methods, please contact Clever Support for consultation. We will work with you to confirm the sync method provides access to the data required for your connected applications. Depending on the sync method, please allow up to 2 weeks for the migration to be completed. If moving to an SFTP method, we recommend a minimum of 3 weeks to ensure the CSV files sent to Clever are complete and formatted correctly. We highly recommend starting this process at least a month before your first day of school.  
  
When changing sync methods, we recommend maintaining the same primary identifiers (SIS IDs) for your students, teachers, schools, etc. This will ensure historical data is retained in Clever and connected applications. If SIS IDs are changing, our team will need to complete a matching process to preserve existing accounts. In addition to the time to set up the new sync method, please allow an additional 1 week for the account matching process.   
  
For more information on changing sync methods, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049183691).  
  
  
**Changing SIS IDs**  
Commonly, the need to change the SIS ID for users is due to a school organization needing to meet the data requirements for a specific connection. Clever Support may be able to help you meet this data requirement without disrupting your existing data in Clever. If you need to change SIS IDs to meet an application requirement, please contact our team with the following:  

-   The name of the application that requires the data change
-   The user record type that requires the SIS ID change (students, teachers, etc.)
-   The name of the field from your SIS that you need in the SIS ID field in Clever

  
Our team will review the requirements and communicate the next steps to ensure a successful connection to the application while minimizing disruption to your existing applications.   
  
For more information on changing SIS IDs, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543).

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Summer School: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615332)

title: Secure Sync: Changing Student Information Systems
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049183691#overview)  
2\. [Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049183691#process)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049183691#FAQ)

##   
Overview

Is your district moving to a new student information system (SIS)? No worries—Clever has you covered! Clever can assist in keeping your downstream application data clean and ready to go.

This process is a partnership; we are here to ensure your success! Since multiple steps are involved, we recommend planning and starting the process as early as possible to ensure minimal disruption to your students and teachers. 

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000GG41&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Fxm6P)   Please note:** To prevent user disruption, Clever does not recommend completing this transition mid-year. Summer or winter breaks are the best time to work through this process due to the required sync hold that must be enabled during the conversion process.

* * *

## Process

1.  **Identify how you will sync data to Clever**  
    Clever provides districts with multiple methods to sync their data. If your district is transitioning to one of the SISs listed [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US), you can use an Auto Sync to send data to Clever. If your SIS is not listed, you can use an SFTP sync. Learn more about syncing data via SFTP [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US).  
     
2.  **Confirm the primary identifiers for records**  
    Clever recommends keeping the primary identifier (student\_id, teacher\_id, staff\_id, and school\_id) the same when transitioning SISs. Maintaining the same sis\_id will protect you from duplicate or lost records. If your sis\_ids are changing, Clever can complete a matching process to preserve as much historical data as possible. You can learn more about the process for changing SIS IDs [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543?language=en_US).  
     
3.  **Populate data in your new SIS**  
    To complete the transition in Clever, you will need active data in your new SIS. We recommend completing this 3-4 weeks before you would like the conversion process to be completed.  
      
    
4.   **(Optional) Make a note of your current field mappings if your sync type supports field mappings  
    **Some Clever-Managed Auto Syncs allow districts to view or complete their field mappings on the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page. If you see your field mappings available, we recommend taking a screenshot of each data type’s mappings for future reference.  
     
5.  **Contact Clever Support**   
    Once data is ready in your SIS, contact Clever Support and let us know the name of your SIS and your preferred method of syncing (Auto Sync, SFTP, OneRoster, etc.). We will consult with you to ensure your account is set up for success!  
     
6.  **Configure your Auto Sync or SFTP files**  
    Before Clever can complete the migration, we will need a successful data connection. If you have chosen an Auto Sync, work with our support team or your SIS provider to set up the data sync. Setup directions for Clever-managed Auto Syncs are linked [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973).  
    
    Configure files using the directions [found here](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) if you will be syncing via SFTP. Please allow up to one week to troubleshoot getting your sync or SFTP files successfully configured.  
      
    
7.  **Migrate data**  
    Contact Clever Support and let us know when you are ready to upload your first set of data from your new SIS into Clever. Before you upload new data, please consult our team on which applications to pause your data sync with. We will also enable protection settings for your account to ensure your teacher and students are minimally affected by the changes in data. All data syncing between the district and Clever will pause during this time. However, users will still be able to access Clever and their applications.  
      
    Once the safety settings are applied, we will have you sync your uploaded data into Clever! If the data looks good, we will complete a matching process to preserve historical data where possible. Please allow up to 2-3 weeks for the matching process to be completed.  
      
    During this time, your account will appear with a sync status of "On Hold" or "System Maintenance In Progress." This is normal and will be resolved once Clever Support has finished the migration process.   
     
8.  **Confirm data changes, sync with apps**  
    The final step of the process is for you to approve the data changes. Since you have switched to a new SIS, there are probably significant changes to your data, and the sync will be placed on hold pending your approval.  
    
    Review the data on your [SIS sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/) and confirm or discard the changes as appropriate. For more details on Sync Holds, see [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358).
    
    Once the data is live in Clever, please do not remove any application pauses until you have received confirmation from the application that it is ready for new data. Applications that are not paused will receive the data within 24 hours.
    
    Application partners manage pulling data from Clever and processing it into their system. If you have any questions about the effect of data changes in an application, please contact the application's support team. They will be happy to assist!

Ready to get started or have a question? [Contact our Support Team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is there an option if I need more guidance and would like additional services from Clever for my sync conversion?**

-   Yes! We offer [Sync Conversion Consulting Services.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646#SyncSISConversions) The sync conversion process is a collaborative effort involving the district, Clever, and connected applications to achieve a smooth transition. While our sync conversion team is committed to helping you meet your goals, opting for our paid services can provide additional consultation and support to streamline the process further. Please let us know if you're interested in exploring this option or have any questions!

**Can we upload a partial data set and send the rest of the data at a later time?**

-   No, any accounts/data currently in Clever that you want to continue syncing to Clever must be included in your initial sync from your new SIS. For example, suppose you have ten teachers currently in Clever and only upload seven in your initial sync. Only including seven teachers will delete the three you didn't include from Clever and their connected applications. Even if you add the existing accounts later, Clever and their connected apps will see them as new accounts, and they will lose all historical data.

**What if I don't need any historical data preserved? I have old data in Clever and we haven't been actively using it, so I don't need historical data maintained.**

-   If this is the case, you can forego the sync conversion process. Teachers will lose any Teacher Pages in Clever that they have created, and all users will lose their historical data in their connected applications. Please provide in writing that you do not want our teams to preserve the historical data and that you understand that your users will no longer have any historical data in Clever or their connected apps.

**Why does the sync or SIS ID conversion take 2-3 weeks?**

-   Anytime you execute record linkage between data sets, the integrity of the data is always at risk. Sync conversions involve numerous steps that must be performed accurately, and depending on the complexity and size of the data, this can take time.
-   During a school break is the best time to complete a sync conversion because the account is already often in a sync pause status. Many districts are reaching out to our teams to complete a sync conversion during the winter or summer break, which can impact timelines for completion.
