title: For Clever Admins: Troubleshooting - Changing email addresses or email domains in Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header1)  
2\. [How to update user emails for an SFTP or SFTP (SIS-managed) sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header2)  
3\. [How to update user emails for a Clever-managed auto sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header3)  
4\. [How to update manually added (side-loaded) user emails](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header4)  
5\. [Important considerations when updating user emails](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header5)  
6\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header6)

## Overview

As you use Clever, you may need to update your student, teacher, or staff email addresses or domains (@example.com) if you change the format for user emails. Updating emails is a quick change that Clever sees as an update to user accounts. You can change any data point for your users, such as their email address, grade, last name, or graduation year without any need to notify the Clever team.

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2Xl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008U81z) Please note:** If you will be changing your user's SIS IDs (such as teacher\_id, student\_id, or school\_id), please contact Clever Support.

* * *

## How to update user emails for an SFTP or SFTP (SIS-managed) sync

If you utilize an SFTP or SFTP (SIS-Managed) sync, you will need to work on updating the email addresses included in the CSV files you are sending to Clever. If you manage your students.csv, teachers.csv, and staff.csv, please update the student\_email, teacher\_email, and staff\_email columns to include the new email addresses for your users. If you only update emails for one user type, you only need to update that file. Once you have your updated files, you can upload them to Clever to update your user's email addresses.

If your SIS manages the sending of your CSV files to Clever on your behalf, please contact your SIS team directly for more information on updating the email addresses included in these files. Once you've worked with your SIS team to update the emails included in these files and they send the updated email addresses via the CSV files, the emails will update in Clever.

* * *

## How to update user emails for a Clever-managed auto sync

Please review the default fields for your sync type in the article that corresponds with your sync type below:

-   [Skyward API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    
-   [Skyward Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193#header6)
    
-   [Infinite Campus API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/226677767?#default)
    
-   [Infinite Campus Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202094756#default_mappings)
    
-   [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590#default_mappings)
    
-   [PowerSchool Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173?#default_mappings)
    
-   [Aeries Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203005016)
    
-   [Blackbaud API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001544)
    

To update your email addresses in Clever, you will want to work to update the email addresses in the field Clever is pulling from your SIS. If you have a custom mapping in place for emails, or if your sync type supports custom mappings and you'd like to explore syncing emails from an alternate field in your SIS to Clever, please contact Clever Support for further assistance.

* * *

## How to update manually added (side-loaded) user emails

If you manually manage student and teacher emails by uploading student\_emails.csv and teacher\_emails.csv, you'll want to update these files with the new user emails. Once you've updated the email addresses for your users in each file, please upload the new files via your [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page.

![Image of where to upload student/teacher emails](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2Xl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WQW3R)

For more information, please see our article [Manually Uploading (i.e. side-loading) user emails to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026).

* * *

## Important considerations when updating user emails

-   **Updating all users' accounts will likely cause a sync hold.** Once the data sync completes, you can approve the hold on your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. For more information on sync holds please see our article [For Clever Admins: Sync Holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358).
    
-   **If you use Clever Passwords as your identity provider (IdP),** **please check if you are using the "Email" field for your usernames.** If so, you will need to reset Clever Passwords once the new emails sync. This is because Clever Passwords' usernames and passwords are not updated dynamically. [Click here for more information on resetting passwords.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/208333118?#five)
    
-   **Do you utilize SSO (Saved Passwords) applications, and if so is the "Email" field utilized for the username field for any Saved Passwords applications?** If so, after syncing new email addresses, you may need to clear the cache if users are having issues logging into those SSO (Saved Password) applications.
    
-   **Do you utilize any SAML applications?** If so, are you using emails to match accounts? The emails will need to match between Clever and the application to ensure SAML login success.
    
-   **Please notify any application partners** syncing email addresses via Clever of your upcoming email changes to ensure they are prepared for the changes.
    
-   **If Clever Administrator, District Help Desk, or District Curriculum Lead emails are also changing**, these will need to be updated on the individual's [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) > [Profile page](https://schools.clever.com/profile). Each admin will need to update their own email by selecting the "Edit" button in the "Account information" box on their Profile page.
    
-   **Please review and update** your [Tech Support Contact email](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049312351) if required.
    
-   **If you utilize Clever Identity Management (IDM):**
    
    -   If you provision Google accounts via Clever IDM, by default IDM references the SIS email field as the source of truth when matching and updating accounts. Updating email addresses in Clever will cause Clever IDM to update the emails for these users in Google.
        
    -   Clever IDM for Active Directory and Entra ID by default looks first to the District Username field as a source of truth. Updating user emails won't directly impact emails in Active Directory or Entra ID unless you also update the username field.
        

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need to notify Clever that my user's email addresses will be changing?**

-   No. You only need to notify Clever if your user's sis\_ids (teacher\_id, student\_id, staff\_id, etc.) will also be changing.
    

**Why did my sync go on hold when I updated email addresses?**

-   Sync holds are to prevent Clever Admins from making unintended changes to their data when large data changes occur. Review the changes on your [Last Attempted Sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync) and if the changes are as expected you can approve the hold.
    

**What steps should I take to ensure minimal disruption to students and teachers?**

-   Review the [Important considerations when updating user emails section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046978411#header5) above for guidance on steps you can take to prevent disruptions.
    

* * *

title: Troubleshooting: Data incorrect in Clever
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#one) 2. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#two)           • [SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#sftp)           • [SFTP (sis-managed) syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#sftp-sis-managed)           • [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#sftp-sis-managed)[Clever-managed auto syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#clever-managed)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#sftp-sis-managed) 3\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533412#FAQs) ## Overview There may be discrepancies between the data in your student information system (SIS) and Clever. Some common issues are missing teacher, student, staff, or section data, or perhaps a user's primary school in Clever doesn't match what exists in your SIS. To change the data syncing to Clever, in most cases you'll need to update data in your SIS or the files your SIS is sending to Clever.  **It's not possible to manually update data in Clever that is synced via your SIS.** Below is a quick guide to help you troubleshoot missing or incorrect data in Clever.   **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Data incorrect in app:** _Most applications sync with Clever daily. Please allow up to 24 hours for newly updated or shared data in Clever to be reflected in your connected applications.  For more information, visit: [For Clever Admins: Apps - Sync times](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236156648?language=en_US)_[](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236156648). If the data is correct in Clever but incorrect in an app, please **contact the app's support team** directly. Applications are responsible for syncing data from Clever.  ##   * * * ## Troubleshooting Depending on the type of student information system (SIS) sync you have configured with Clever, the process might be different. Your sync type (how your data is getting to Clever) can be found on the [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in the Clever Dashboard.   **SFTP sync:** ![Sync status with sync type highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkVh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xby3) If your sync type is SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol), this means that Clever is receiving CSV files directly from your Student Information System (SIS). The configuration and transmission of these files are managed by a contact at your district rather than Clever. 

Steps to fix data issues

  1. Confirm the data is correct in your student information system (SIS).

  2. Upload an updated set of data files to Clever. Please allow up to 30 minutes for the sync to complete. 

  3. On the Sync page, confirm your sync is not on hold or hitting a sync error.

  4. Review the data files you are sending to Clever for accuracy. You can download them on the Data sources > SIS sync page.

  5. If the data is incorrect in the data files, contact your SIS manager -- Clever Support cannot assist with investigating data export errors.

  6. If the data is correct in the data files but incorrect in Clever, please contact Clever Support.

Tip to fix rollover issues

The data in Clever will rollover once we receive data for the new school year and the resulting data hold has been released. Please contact the sync manager at your district if you have any questions. 

### **SFTP (sis-managed) sync:** ![Sync status with sync type highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkVh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xby8) If your sync type is SFTP (SIS-managed), this means that Clever is receiving CSV files directly from your SIS. The configuration and transmission of these files are managed by your SIS rather than Clever. 

Steps to fix data issues

  1. Confirm the data is correct in your student information system (SIS).

  2. Contact your SIS support team to upload an updated set of data files to Clever. Please allow up to 30 minutes for the sync to complete. 

  3. On the Sync page, confirm your sync is not on hold or hitting a sync error.

  4. Review the data files you are sending to Clever for accuracy. You can download them on the Sync > Last Attempted Sync page. Learn more here!

  5. If the data is incorrect in the data files, contact your SIS support team -- Clever Support cannot assist with investigating data export errors.

  6. If the data is correct in the data files but incorrect in Clever, please contact Clever Support.

Tip to fix rollover issuesThe data in Clever will rollover once we receive data for the new school year and the resulting data hold has been released. Please contact your SIS if you have any questions. 
### **Clever-Managed Auto Sync:** ![Sync status with sync type highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkVh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xbxy) If your sync type is Clever-Managed Auto Sync, this means that your syncs are automated daily and are primarily managed by the Clever Support team. These syncs securely transfer rostering data from your district's student information system (SIS) to Clever.

Steps to fix data issues

  1. Confirm the data is correct in your student information system (SIS).

  2. Navigate to the Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page and push Sync now. Please allow up to 30 minutes for the sync to complete.

  3. On the Sync page, confirm your sync is not on hold or hitting a sync error.

  4. If you've confirmed the data is correct in your SIS, use the documentation for your sync type to troubleshoot the data.  

    • Aeries

    • PowerSchool

    • Infinite Campus API

    • SchoolInsight

    • Skyward Auto

    • Skyward API

    • Blackbaud API Sync

Tips to fix rollover issues
  • All syncs will encounter a hold when you rollover to the new school year. Please confirm the hold has been released in your Clever Dashboard. 

  • See the rollover directions for your sync type to troubleshoot issues related to rollover. 

    • Aeries

    • PowerSchool

    • Infinite Campus API

    • SchoolInsight

    • Skyward Auto

    • Blackbaud API Sync

If the above steps do not resolve your issue, please contact Clever Support.   * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Below are some common questions about incorrect data. ### Why is a student or teacher's primary school wrong in Clever, but correct in our SIS? - For context, Clever dynamically updates the primary school assignment for students based on the total number of sections they have at a particular school site. For example, if a student has seven sections at School A and three sections at School B, their primary school would be School A in Clever.  - If you'd rather Clever use students' primary school exactly as it's listed in your SIS, we can disable our default logic for either students or teachers or both user types. Once this logic is disabled, Clever will look to your SIS data as the source of truth for primary school assignments instead of the student or teacher's sections. Please note that this is a global change that will affect all users of the same type in Clever and not just individual students.  - For more information, please see this article from our Help Center: [For District Admins: Primary School Assignment](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003279987-For-District-Admins-Primary-school-assignments). ### How can a teacher or student be associated with more than one school site? - Teachers and students can only have one primary school site in Clever. However, their additional school sites are associated with their Clever account through their section data.  ### Why are the section names in Clever different than what I expected? - Section names in Clever are auto-generated to ensure uniqueness, improving recognition and usability for teachers and students. However, districts or schools can choose to sync their own section names to Clever. For more information on section names, please see this article that has information on how to sync section names: [For Clever Admins: Section Names](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001501?language=en_US) ### Why is a student and/or teacher not syncing/showing up in Clever? - If you have gone over the troubleshooting steps above and the user is still not syncing to Clever, you can reach out to Clever Support. Some auto syncs have specific criteria as to what is required for certain user types to sync to Clever.  ### Why are some of our sections showing the wrong subject? - If your data sync includes a **subject** field, Clever categorizes sections into subject categories based on the values you provide. For example, **subject** field values **English**, **Reading**, and **Writing** are all sorted into **english/language arts**. Everything that can’t be sorted (including blanks) will be assigned to the subject **other**. You can find more in-depth information here: [For Clever Admins: Assigning "subject" to sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203448663?language=en_US). ### Why are my sections not syncing to Clever?  - In order for section data to sync to Clever, the section must have students and a primary teacher assigned to it.  ### Why are classes with multiple grade levels showing up as "other"? - Check to ensure your students are syncing to Clever with a grade associated with them, or elect a grade for the section in your SIS and sync it to Clever.  ### Can I manually add a student to a section syncing from my SIS? - No, at this time, it is not possible to manually enroll students into SIS-synced sections in the Clever Dashboard.

title: For Clever Admins: How often will my data sync to Clever?
text:
To see when your data last synced to Clever, view the Sync Status on your Clever Dashboard:  
  
![Sync status](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TDt7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WDltA)   
  
The frequency of your uploads to Clever depends on your sync type, as outlined below. 

##   
Clever-Managed Auto Sync

For most Auto Syncs, data will sync from your SIS to Clever every 4-6 hours. You can initiate a new sync from the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page of your Dashboard:

 ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TDt7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BE1b)

Syncs can be customized to occur nightly instead. A nightly sync will occur sometime between 10 pm and 4 am ET, but we can't specify an exact sync time. Please contact Clever Support to request a nightly sync.

##   
SIS-Managed Auto Sync

Your SIS will upload data to Clever once per day. If you have questions about the exact time of your data upload, please reach out to your SIS provider directly.

##   
SFTP Sync

Data will update in Clever each time you upload new data. We recommend that you upload data at least daily.

If you schedule an automated SFTP upload, we recommend scheduling it to run before 7 pm EST because many applications update their data starting at 8 pm ET. If you have questions about the update schedule of a specific app, please reach out to the application directly.

title: Manually Uploading (i.e. side-loading) User Emails to Clever
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004455026#one) 2. [Enabling email uploads](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004455026#two) 3. [Formatting your CSV files](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004455026#three) 4. [How to upload your email files](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004455026#four) 5. [Updating emails](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004455026#five) 6. [Viewing email upload errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115004455026#six) ## Overview When setting up Clever single-sign on (SSO) with Google, you'll need to have Google emails populated in the email field within Clever. If your district doesn't store Google emails in your student information system (SIS), you can upload an additional CSV of emails for your users and the data will be merged within Clever. Student\_emails.csv and teacher\_emails.csv files can only be uploaded via the web browser. SFTP transfer isn't supported.  * * * ## Enabling email uploads If the district uses Google as a login method for Clever, the district can enable email uploads by following these steps: 1. Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol). 2. In the configuration for Google Authentication, click on **Edit Settings**. 3. On the pop-up screen, select **Google email addresses are NOT stored in my district's SIS**.![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUIr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BYBh) 4. Select **Next**. 5. On the next screen, check the box next to **I'll manually upload emails**.![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUIr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BYC6) 6. Select **Save**. 7. Upload your files from your [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload)         ![Upload dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUIr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000013lEj)  If your district doesn't use Google as a login method for Clever but would like to be able to upload emails through a CSV file, [please contact our team,](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) and we'll enable this feature for your district.  * * * ## Formatting your CSV files In order to use this tool, you'll need to create a CSV file that contains two columns: student\_id/teacher\_id & email. Be sure you're using the student\_id/teacher\_id values as highlighted below, and not the Clever ID. **File Name:** student\_emails.csv

Field

Required

Format

Description

student_idYStringStudent’s sis_id, so Clever can tie the email to the associated student. Must be valid Student ID of an existing student and match the value Student ID on the student profile: 

emailYEmailStudent's email address. Must match format x@y.z
**File Name:** teacher\_emails.csv

Field

Required

Format

Description

teacher_idYStringTeacher's sis_id, so Clever can tie the email to the associated teacher. Must be valid Teacher ID of an existing teacher and match the value Teacher ID on the teacher profile: 

emailYEmailTeacher's email address. Must match format x@y.z
This file will need to contain a list of the email and the corresponding sis\_ids for users. For Google districts, this file will be created using a combination of information from your SIS and your Google admin console.  Teachers and students emails require separate uploads. As such, if you wish to upload both student and teacher emails, you will upload two files: - student\_emails.csv - teacher\_emails.csv **Include all users' emails that should be overwritten in your upload.** Removing a user's email from the CSV file before re-uploading the file will cause the email address record to be deleted.  As an example, if you manually upload user A and user B on day 1, and then on day 2 you need to add user C's email, you would need to upload a file including users A, B, and C, not just C.    * * * ## How to upload your email files To upload user emails, navigate to [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page in Clever. You can upload the files under the **Emails** section. **Include all users' emails that should be overwritten in your upload**. Removing an existing user email from the file before re-uploading the file will cause the email address record to be deleted as outlined in the section above.   Once you have selected the CSV file(s) from your local directory and the cloud status turns green, select 'Upload' to upload user emails to Clever. ![Upload dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUIr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000013kk5) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUIr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Though Clever won't send an email notification that the data has been processed, the results will be viewable on the Sync page in the Clever Dashboard.   ## Updating emails In order to update information after the initial upload you’ll be able re-upload the email files(s) with additional information, or you’ll be able to include emails in the SIS data feed for new users who are not listed in the additional file. **Always include all user's emails that should be active in Clever in your upload**. Removing a user email from the file before re-uploading the file will cause the email address record to be deleted.   ## Viewing email upload errors To view errors for your email uploads, navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) page and select 'student\_emails\_errors.csv' or 'teacher\_emails\_errors.csv' on the right hand side.

title: Manually Uploading Student Contacts to Clever
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047089771#overview) 2\. [Formatting your CSV file](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047089771#formatting) 3\. [How to upload your CSV file](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047089771#upload) 4\. [Updating contact data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047089771#update) 5\. [FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047089771#faq) ## Overview Some applications require student contact data that may not be stored in your district's student information system (SIS). If your district does not store student contact data in your SIS, or would like to add additional student contacts outside of your Clever sync, you can now upload student contacts to Clever using a contacts.csv file. Student contacts can be uploaded via the web browser or via SFTP transfer! IMPORTANT Please make sure that contact IDs are never re-used. Clever treats contact IDs as a unique identifier and use it to generate Clever IDs. Likewise, failure to do so may result in security issues. * * * ## Formatting your CSV file To manually upload student contact data to Clever, you will first need to populate a contacts.csv file containing information pertinent to your student contacts. Please click [here](https://assets.clever.com/website/content/contacts.csv) to download a sample contacts.csv template that can be populated with the district's student contact data using the guidelines shown below.  **File Name:** contacts.csv

Field

Required

Format

Description

contact_idYStringUnique identifier for the contact
student_idYStringStudent’s sis_id, so Clever can tie the contact to associated students. Must be valid Student ID of an existing student and match the value Student ID on the student profile: 

first_nameYStringContact’s first name
last_nameYStringContact’s last name
typeYStringType of contact - e.g. “family”, “emergency”, or “guardian”
relationshipNStringContact’s relationship to student - e.g. “Father”, “Aunt”, or “Neighbor”
phoneNIntegerA 10 or 11 digit phone number
phone_typeNOptionType of phone contact. Supported values: Cell, Home, Work.
emailNEmailContact’s email address. Must match format x@y.z
* * * ## How to upload your CSV file ### Web Upload You can upload your contacts.csv file from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) tab. ![Custom data with Upload contacts highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUKT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aolR) Once uploaded, you will see the following status message: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUKT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C5J) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUKT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Please allow 10-15 minutes for custom data to process. Though Clever will not send an email notification that the data has been processed, the results will be viewable on the Sync page in the Clever Dashboard.   ### SFTP Upload If you prefer to upload your contact data via SFTP: 1. Connect to your Clever SFTP directory using the credentials found on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page under **SFTP Settings**. If you use a Clever-managed Auto Sync and don't have SFTP credentials available on this page, please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) and our team can assist with providing access to a remote site for custom data contact uploads. 2. Create a directory called: **customcontacts:** ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUKT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C5O) 3. Add the **contacts.csv** file to the **customcontacts** directory**.** The file will be processed by Clever in 10-15 minutes.  ### Reviewing the results Once your contacts are uploaded to Clever, you can search for a contact record using the search bar, or by locating a specific student's record and navigating to the _Guardians_ tab.   ![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-7.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TUKT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CBJG) * * * ## Updating contact data In order to update information after the initial upload, re-upload the contact.csv file with the edited or altered data. Manually adding or editing contacts is not supported. When re-uploading your contact file, be sure to re-upload the _entire_ file with any new data added to your original file. Uploading a file with only new contacts will delete previously synced contacts.  * * * ## FAQ **Can these contacts be shared with applications?** - Yes! Contacts uploaded via contacts.csv can be shared with applications that support/require student contact information. Contact data is shared implicitly with student records, so there is no need to update your sharing permissions to include student contacts.

title: For Clever Admins: Primary school assignments
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Students & Teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003279987#student_teacher)  
2\. [Students & Teachers: SIS primary school assignment](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003279987#override)  
3\. [Staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003279987#staff)

## Students & Teachers

School association for students and teachers is based on **section enrollments.** If a student or teacher is enrolled in sections at multiple schools, Clever will associate the user with the related schools. A district should NOT attempt to connect a teacher or student with multiple schools by uploading the user multiple times in the students.csv or teachers.csv.  
  
Additionally, Clever will assign a primary school association. This will be the school that displays in their Clever Portal. When an application accesses the data for the user, the application will have access to both the user's primary school association, as well as their secondary associations.  
  
**Primary school is assigned based on where the user has the most section enrollments**.  For example: If a student is enrolled in 2 sections at School A and 4 sections at School B, their primary school assignment in Clever will be School B (regardless of the school assigned in the SIS).

You can see the primary school on the user's profile page, along with the other schools they're associated with listed in their sections.

![Image of teacher's profile page showing primary school](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TFBl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001NTK5)   
 

Additional details:

-   **If a user has the same number of sections** at two or more schools, Clever will choose the school where the total number of students enrolled in the user's sections is the greatest.
-   If a student or teacher's section enrollments change during the year, their primary school in Clever may also change.
-   If a student or teacher is not enrolled in any sections, Clever will use the school the user is assigned to in your SIS data.
-   A user will be shared with an application if either their primary _or_ secondary school is shared.

* * *

## Students & Teachers: SIS primary school assignment

If you'd rather Clever use student and teachers' primary school exactly as it's listed in your student information system (SIS), please contact Clever Support. We can disable our default logic for either students, teachers, or both. Once this logic is disabled, Clever will look to your SIS data as the source of truth for primary school assignments.

* * *

##   
Staff

For information on how staff are associated with multiple schools, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547?language=en_US#h_6ed2513a-8d74-4c7b-8466-f860781757cb).

title: For Clever Admins: Syncing custom (i.e. extension) fields to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header1)  
2\. [Formatting your custom fields file(s)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#Formatting)  
3\. [Uploading custom fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header2)  
4\. [Uploading custom fields via your school organization's SIS sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header3)  
5\. [Viewing and managing custom field data in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header4)  
6\. [Using custom fields with app sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header5)  
7\. [Sharing custom fields with apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header6)

 **![Lightbulb icon marking an important note](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) IMPORTANT:** Please check with your application partners to see if they have the ability to sync custom data (extension) fields from Clever. Not all applications support extension fields.

##   
Overview

If your school organization would like to send data fields outside of the standard fields listed in our [Data Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf), you can do so by uploading custom/extension fields either directly through your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), or through your school organization's existing sync.

Clever admins have the ability to add custom fields for the following data types:

-   Schools
-   Sections
-   Students
-   Teachers
-   Staff

Our system doesn't accept custom fields for enrollments or student contacts at this time.

Custom fields can often be added to your existing sync, using the [steps below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header3) for SFTP syncs, or with assistance from Clever Support for Clever-managed auto syncs. If you'd like to upload extension data independently of your existing sync (or have been instructed by Clever Support to do so), here's what you can expect the process to look like:

1.  [Create your custom fields file.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#Formatting)
    
    1.  Make sure you use the correct SIS ID for the user type.
        
2.  Upload your file to Clever. You can either:
    
    1.  [Upload directly to the Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#header2), or
        
    2.  [Add it to your SFTP directory](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#allsyncs).
        

OR

If you have a Clever-managed auto sync and want to sync custom fields directly from your SIS, please contact Clever Support to review your options.

* * *

## Formatting your custom fields file(s)

The CSV format is the same for students, teachers, schools, and sections:  
sis\_id, {custom fields}

sis\_id, {custom fields}

  
The CSV format for staff is:

staff\_id, {custom fields}

  
Custom field columns must be prefixed with 'ext.'

-   **For example,** a custom field named 'nickname' should be labeled 'ext.nickname'. Please refer to the example below for students:

## ![Example spreadsheet showing a custom field column labeled ext.nickname](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002luXf)

-   Extension headers may only contain one period. For example, a file with 'ext.favorite.food' will not process (ext.favorite\_food is valid).
-   Extension headers may not contain spaces.

 **![Pencil icon marking a helpful tip](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Extension field files that are uploaded directly to a school organization's SFTP folder must be named with all lowercase letters (e.g., schools\_ext.csv, students\_ext.csv, etc.).

* * *

##   
Uploading custom fields to Clever

Custom fields can be uploaded through the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page. Select **Add custom data > Fields**. A window will pop up allowing you to upload a CSV file for each data type that you would like to create custom fields for. When you upload custom extension data, it will take about 15 minutes for the new data to sync to Clever. The sync may also go on hold due to large changes in data. [Click here to read more](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358) about holds and how to resolve them.

![Pencil icon marking a helpful tip](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note: If your school organization already syncs the same custom field through your SIS sync or another custom data sync, those values will take precedence over this custom field upload.

##   
![Custom data screen with Upload fields button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amoi)

All Syncs:

-   All schools can upload custom fields via CSV files directly to your Clever SFTP folder by uploading to a subdirectory named _/extensionfields._
    
-   If your primary sync type is not [SFTP sync type](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078), please reach out to Clever support for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory.  
      
    ![Screenshot of SFTP remote site for extension data](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HiAmf)
    
-   Once the **/extensionfields** subdirectory is created, you can upload the following files inside it:
    
    -   _schools\_ext.csv_
    -   _sections\_ext.csv_
    -   _students\_ext.csv_
    -   _teachers\_ext.csv_
    -   _staff\_ext.csv_

* * *

##   
Uploading custom fields via your school organization's SIS sync

![warning symbol](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jze) Extension fields cannot be added directly from the Infinite Campus API or OneRoster syncs. To add extension fields to these sync types, please upload the extension field data directly to the Clever Dashboard as outlined [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912#header2) or learn about using an SFTP folder [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360024370912#allsyncs).

SFTP and Student Information System (SIS)-Managed Auto Syncs:

If your school organization only syncs data to Clever via SFTP/CSV files:

-   School organizations can add a custom/extension field column to one of the existing rostering files being synced to Clever (_schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv,_ _enrollments.csv, and staff.csv_). The column name must begin with _'ext'_.
    -   **For example:** Fields such as 'Program Code' or 'Gifted Status' could be added to the students.csv with columns named 'ext.program\_code' or 'ext.gifted\_status' to your CSV files.
    -   Don't create an extension field with a space in the name. For example, a name like _ext.iep status_ can fail, so you'd want to use _ext.iep\_status_.

-   You can also upload custom fields via CSV files directly to your Clever SFTP folder by uploading to a subdirectory named _/extensionfields._ The files should be named:
    -   _schools\_ext.csv_
    -   _sections\_ext.csv_
    -   _students\_ext.csv_
    -   _teachers\_ext.csv_
    -   _staff\_ext.csv_

![Information icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p) For information about uploading data via SFTP, please visit: [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408)

For the following auto-syncs, custom fields can also be added and customized via your Clever Dashboard:

-   Illuminate Auto Sync
-   [Aeries Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016)
-   [SchoolInsight Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237)
-   iNow Auto Sync
-   [PowerSchool Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173)
-   [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)
-   [Infinite Campus Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202094756)

For the following syncs, custom fields can also be added and customized by reaching out to Clever support:

-   [Blackbaud API sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544)
-   [Infinite Campus API Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767)
-   [Skyward Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193)
-   [Skyward API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)

* * *

##   
Viewing and managing custom field data in Clever

You can take a look at your most recently uploaded custom fields by navigating to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data > Reports](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/reports). Here, you can view details about the record type, the fields that were added, and the time of the last update. This page also includes an error report detailing any errors in the files. You can also download your school organization's current custom field files.

![Gif of custom data reports](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cxk)

You can view custom field data for each record type on the Profile Page for the school, student, teacher, staff, or section it is associated with, or by exporting all data for a record type from your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser).  
  

* * *

##   
Using custom fields with app sharing rules

You can use custom extension fields to create unique sharing rules for an easier, more seamless sharing process with your connected applications. Whether an application accepts extension fields or not, you can still use extension fields in sharing rules! You can use multiple extension fields in a single sharing rule to create more specificity, and extension fields can be used in any share by rule (share by student, share by teacher, share by section, and share by staff).

![Screenshot of a sharing rule using an extension field as a condition](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002luYm)

* * *

##   
  
Sharing custom fields with apps

  
Many applications allow or require custom field data. To share custom fields with apps, follow these directions:

1.  Navigate to the overview page for the app and click on the **Settings** tab
2.  Under **Field Access**, select **Advanced Settings**
3.  Select **Customize fields shared with {app}** and click **Customize fields**![Screenshot of the Advanced Settings menu showing the Customize fields option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002luYw)
4.  On the **Edit Student Fields** page, select **Next**
5.  On the **Edit Contact Fields** page, select **Next**
6.  On the **Edit District Admin Fields** page, select **Next**
7.  You are now on the **Edit Extension Fields** page. Any extension fields that you have uploaded to Clever will be found in the left column under **Fields.** Click on the fields you wish to share with the app to bring it to the right column under **Share with {app}.** Once you have selected the desired fields to share, select **Save.**  
    ![Screenshot showing extension fields selected for sharing with a connected app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dvJN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C54)

For more information on editing field access for applications, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586).

* * *

**Related articles  
**

-   [Custom Data: Overview (i.e., sections, students, contacts, teachers, staff & fields)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332)
-   [Custom Data: Sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923)
-   [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408)

title: For Clever Admins: Student Contacts
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943#h_bfe2325a-e928-4a6a-961d-65aee4d63342) 2. [Syncing student contacts to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943#h_78d30388-bb8a-47f1-b3e5-10d001897f13) 3. [SFTP and SIS-managed SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943#h_bad449d5-db0d-4e70-be5e-0c2c5aafed68) 4. [Clever-Managed Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943#h_c18653cd-9fba-4e83-9b54-7404a5f9ba4c) 5\. [Duplicate Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943#duplicate_contacts) 6\. [Contact types](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943#Values) ## Overview Student contacts are typically parents, family, guardians or close friends of students who can be contacted by the school or district in the event of an emergency or other important communication need. Clever supports multiple contacts for each student. Once in Clever, this data can be synced to your district's connected applications.  To review student contact data in Clever, admins can navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Data Browser > Contacts tab.](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=contacts) * * * ## Syncing student contacts to Clever Depending on if your district is syncing rostering data to Clever via a Clever-managed auto sync, SIS-Managed auto sync, or SFTP sync, student contact data will vary.  This section details the requirements and processes for the different sync types. ### **SFTP and SIS-managed SFTP Syncs** For [SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078) and [SIS-managed SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973), the following seven fields (i.e. columns) can be added to the _students.csv_ upload to Clever:   Required fields: - **Contact\_type** (required):  Primary, Secondary, Parent/Guardian, Emergency, Family, Other.  - **Contact\_name** (required):  The name of the contact.  Optional: - **Contact\_sis\_id:** The unique identifier for the contact - **Contact\_relationship**: Parent, Grandparent, Self, Aunt/Uncle, Sibling, Other - **Contact\_phone**: 10- or 11-digit phone number without any characters (e.g. parentheses, dashes) - **Contact\_phone\_type:** Cell, Home, Work, Other - **Contact\_email**: Contact email address in the standard email format of [username@demo.com](mailto:username@demo.com)  ### **Multiple student contacts:** - For students with multiple contacts, create multiple rows for the student; one for each contact.  - Each row will contain the identical student details (e.g. student\_id, student\_number, etc.), but will have different contact information on each row.   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TH8j&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4L)   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TH8j&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4Q)**Clever Tip:** There is no limit to the number of student contacts that can be synced to Clever via an SFTP sync! ### **Clever-Managed Auto Syncs** These are the required and optional fields for syncing student contacts to Clever: Required: - **Contact\_type** (required):  Primary, Secondary, Parent/Guardian, Emergency, Family, Other.  - **Contact\_name** (required):  The name of the contact. Optional: - **Contact\_relationship**: Parent, Grandparent, Self, Aunt/Uncle, Sibling, Other - **Contact\_phone**: 10- or 11-digit phone number without any characters (e.g. parentheses, dashes) - **Contact\_phone\_type:** Cell, Home, Work, Other - **Contact\_email**: Contact email address in the standard email format of [username@demo.com](mailto:username@demo.com)  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TH8j&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4V) Find your [Clever-Managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) below for instructions specific to your SIS! ### **Aeries** We pull all contacts associated with a student from the following fields on the Student endpoints of the Aeries API: - CON.FN + CON.LN - CON.EM - CON.CP - CON.RL - CON.OR ### **Infinite Campus API Sync** By default, the Infinite Campus API sync pulls student contacts from the following fields:

 Clever Field

  Infinite Campus Field

 Contact_name 

 identity.firstName + identity.lastName

 Contact_type

 This is flagged within IC: Guardian/Relative = Census >  Relationships

 Contact_phone 

 contact.homePhone

 Contact_email

 contact.email

Customization of the IC API sync is not available at this time.  ### **Illuminate** If you have questions about student contact data for your Illuminate Auto Sync, please [reach out to our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for more information.   ### **PowerSchool** By default, Clever pulls student contact info from the following fields in PowerSchool: - Emerg Contact 1 - Emerg Contact 2 - Emerg Contact 3 - Emerg Phone 1 - Emerg Phone 2 - Emerg Phone 3 - Emerg 1 Ptype - Emerg 2 Ptype - Emerg 3 Ptype - Emerg 1 Rel - Emerg 2 Rel - Emerg 3 Rel The PowerSchool Auto Sync can be customized so that Clever pulls student contacts from different fields than those listed above. Visit our [PowerSchool Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173) for instructions on requesting a custom mapping!   ### **SchoolInsight** If you have questions about student contact data for your SchoolInsight Auto Sync, please [reach out to our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for more information.    ### **Skyward Auto Sync** Clever pulls eight fields for Skyward emergency contact, forming cohesive student contacts in Clever: - E1\_Full\_Name - E1\_Relation\_Dsc - E1\_Cell\_Phone - E1\_Pri\_Phone - E1\_Street\_Addr - E1\_City - E1\_State - E1\_Zip\_Code It is not possible to have more than one contact record per student. However, we can [customize the sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193) to pull from other fields instead. - **For example:** If you want to use Parent\_Name and Parent\_Phone instead of E1 Full Name and E1 Cell Phone, we can do that! ### **Skyward API Sync** Clever syncs student contacts from the guardian endpoint and pulls multiple contacts per student. We can customize the Auto Sync to pull student contact information from different fields, as long as those fields are accessible via Skyward’s API. [Contact Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for more information!   * * * ## Duplicate Contacts Our system will attempt to merge contacts to prevent duplicate contacts in your Clever data. The best way to prevent duplicate contacts is to sync **contact\_sis\_id** for each contact.  If a contact\_sis\_id is not available, Clever will attempt to merge contacts in the following logic: - If contact\_email is available, we will merge contacts by matching on: **contact\_name + contact\_email** - If email is not available and contact\_phone is available, we will merge contacts by matching on: **contact\_name + contact\_phone** - If neither contact\_email or contact\_phone are available, we will try to merge contacts by matching on **student\_id + contact\_name + contact\_type + contact\_relationship + contact\_phone\_type** The above logic relies on exact alphanumeric matches, including case sensitivity. For example, Clever _will not_ match "John Doe" and "john doe".    * * * ## Contact types When Clever normalizes your contact data, we look to the following keywords to match to Parent/Guardian, Emergency, Primary, Secondary, Family, and Other in Clever: | Contact Type | Accepted keywords | | --- | --- | |  Parent/Guardian | - guardian - mother - father - parent - mom - dad - stepmother - stepfather - stepparent | |  Emergency | - emergency | |  Primary | - primary | |  Secondary | - secondary | |  Family | - family - aunt - uncle - relative - grandmother - grandfather - grandparent - sibling | |  Other | - other | If Clever is unable to match a keyword to a contact type, that contact type will be blank in Clever.

title: Clever Roles: Staff - How to add to Clever (updated user interface)
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#h_c2a6891d-29e9-465b-aba2-6fab072bf097) 2\. [Uploading staff for SFTP districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#h_0dd3ead0-753b-4f03-832e-4566de0f0be3) 3. [Uploading staff for auto sync districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#uploadforautosyncs) 4. [Important Upload Tips](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#h_7d34a5fc-7ea7-45b5-b13a-b1714476522c) 5. [Associating staff to multiple locations or the district office](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#h_6ed2513a-8d74-4c7b-8466-f860781757cb)  6. [Editing staff & removing staff or updating their roles](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#h_01fc90f5-dae8-478d-8ac4-55814d917a44) 7. [Districts using Infinite Campus API or Skyward LMS API syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#apisync) 8. [Automated Staff SFTP for auto syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#AutomatedSFTP) IMPORTANT This article shows directions for the updated user interface for adding staff (which most districts use). If you notice the [Staff page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) of your account looks different from the documentation below, [please view this article instead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001617). ## Overview Clever Admins are able to provide various non-instructional staff (i.e. non-teaching staff) access to Clever. For an overview of Clever Roles and permissions, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726). **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If your district uses the **Infinite Campus API** or **Skyward LMS API** sync type, [skip below to this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547?language=en_US#apisync) for information on how staff are automatically synced to Clever. If your district uses Active Directory, [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360028781552?language=en_US) to sync data with Clever automatically. Clever intuitively knows what options are available to sync your staff based on your [sync type](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278). You can view these on your Clever Dashboard by going to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff). From there, choose which option works best for your school district. If you’re unsure of your sync type, you can navigate to your [SIS sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync) and find out by looking under Sync Type at the top of the page. ![Screenshot of the sync page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002NpFC) _This is an example of an SFTP sync type._ For most districts, there are two ways to add staff to Clever:  1. Staff as part of your normal Sync or a one-time Sync upload. 2. [Custom Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471), added individually on a per-user basis. Please see the below table to determine which method is best for your district. Please note that many districts will choose to manage staff in bulk using **Staff** and will manually add individual accounts using **Custom Staff** as needed. If you use a Clever-Managed Auto Sync that is not able to sync staff, please see [this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/229253547#AutomatedSFTP).
