DocumentationLinkLink
* * * ## Uploading staff for SFTP districts For SFTP syncs, there are three options to sync your staff data to Clever (which you can find on your [Staff Data tab)](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff): - Via your SFTP sync - An SFTP client (credentials provided on your [Staff Data tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff)) - Manually upload it on the [Upload tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) - Active Directory sync - If all staff members have accounts in Active Directory (AD), you can quickly sync them using our AD sync tool - Use custom data - Individually add custom staff or make edits to existing staff data on a per-user basis - no staff.csv required ![the Staff Data page on the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002NtaZ) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BqT) For additional information about Clever's SFTP and CSV formatting specifications, click [here](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). * * * ## Uploading staff for auto sync districts If you’re unsure of your sync type, you can navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync) and find out by looking under Sync Type at the top of the page. If you're using the [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590) and want to upload staff, please follow the instructions in this section. ![Screenshot of the sync page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002NugJ) _This is an example of a Clever-managed auto sync._ Suppose your district's student information system (SIS) isn't automatically syncing staff members to Clever (you can sync staff with Infinite Campus API and Skyward LMS API). In that case, you can navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data page](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) to view the options to sync your staff to Clever.  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Staff users must be explicitly shared with your learning applications once they have been created in Clever.  1. From your Clever Dashboard, select the [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) tab. 2. You will be able to view your staff sync options as follows: - Sync staff data as part of your regular SIS auto sync, if syncing with Infinite Campus API and Skyward LMS API - Active Directory - Custom Data - Upload a staff.csv file via an SFTP box (provided by Clever). Learn more about SFTP boxes [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US#option2).  - If you use this option after your initial upload, to add more staff to Clever, open the staff.csv and add an additional row for each staff member you would like to add. If you need an example file, click **Download example files**. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** DO NOT REMOVE any staff users you want to be able to access Clever. Removing a user from the staff.csv before re-uploading it will cause their record to be deleted. Instead, add the additional user information to the file before re-uploading. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BqT) For additional information about Clever's SFTP and CSV formatting specifications, click [here](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf). * * * ## Important Upload Tips When uploading staff to Clever, there are a few important details to consider:   - Each unique staff member requires a unique staff\_id.    - **Always include all staff in the staff.csv** file if you still want them to have access to Clever. Removing a user from the staff.csv before re-uploading the file will cause their record to be deleted.    - The school\_id must match the school\_id (i.e. sis\_id) for a school in Clever. To locate this value, search for the school from the top search bar and select the school to bring up the school's profile page. Under **School Information,** find the **School ID.** This is the school\_id value that should be used in the staff.csv. ![School profile page with School ID highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004akYY) - For staff that are not associated with a specific school, or are associated with the district office, use the school\_id value: DEFAULT\_DISTRICT\_OFFICE - Uploaded staff are auto-assigned the role: [Portal Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772). Portal Access users do not have any administrative rights and will only be able to Single Sign-On (SSO) to applications from their Clever Portal. Applications must first be [shared with them](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360031060451) by a Clever Admin. - For instructions on manually adding individual staff members to Clever via the [Custom Data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/teachers) feature, visit: [Adding custom staff to Clever.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BrR) For information on admin and staff roles in Clever, please visit: [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) * * * ## Associating staff to multiple locations or the district office  **Multiple schools:**   To associate a staff member with multiple schools, create a separate row at each location. The only field that will be different for each row is the school\_id. For example, if a staff member should be associated with three schools, it should look like this: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BrW) **All schools:**   To associate a staff member with all schools in the district, enter school\_id: **district** ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Brl) To see which school(s) a staff member is associated with, head to your Clever Dashboard and search their name via the search bar at the top. ![Screenshot of user's profile in Clever with their two school sites highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004ZyVF) **Default District Office**:   There is a default auto-generated district office in Clever. To associate a staff member with the district office, enter the school\_id: **DEFAULT\_DISTRICT\_OFFICE** ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpH) * * * ## Editing staff & removing staff or updating their roles 1. From your [Clever Dashboard,](https://schools.clever.com/) navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload tab.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload) 2. Under Download existing files, select **staff.csv**. The downloaded staff.csv file will contain all pre-existing staff in Clever for your district.  ![Sync Upload page with staff.csv, Upload Staff CSV, and Upload buttons highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000145Bp) 1. Edit the records for staff as desired and save the file.   2. Next, upload the file. When the cloud displays as green, select **Upload.** The staff updates will be reflected in Clever in 10-15 minutes.   To update a staff member's role from Portal Access to [School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663), please follow the instructions here: [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663)   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bs0) **Please note:** All staff members should be listed in the staff.csv every time you upload a new file to Clever! If a staff member's record is not populated in the staff.csv file, that staff member will be deleted from Clever and connected applications. * * * ## Districts using the Infinite Campus API or Skyward LMS API sync **Infinite Campus API**   Staff are synced to Clever if:   - **Teacher** _is not checked_ for their district assignment in Infinite Campus. All staff members that **do** **not** have 'Teacher' checked will appear as 'Administrator' in the OneRoster API and will be synced to Clever as Staff. If a user has 'Teacher' and another assignment checked. They will be synced to Clever as both a Teacher and Staff. Upon login to Clever, they can select which user session they wish to access. If you prefer greater control over which staff synced to Clever as Staff, we recommend using our manual CSV upload. [Contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) if you want to enable this option for your district.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BsF)    **Skyward LMS API**   Staff are synced to Clever if both conditions below are true:   - "Teacher = False" (unchecked) - Their 'Title' is either blank or contains one of the following words: - Superintendent - Principal - Instruction - Curriculum - Director - Coordinator - Technology - Coach - Counselor - Admin ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BsK) Once staff members have been uploaded to Clever, you must ensure they are shared with the desired applications. For instructions, visit: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing staff with applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044771711?language=en_US) * * * ## Automated Staff SFTP for auto syncs  If your schools use a Clever-Managed Auto Sync that can’t sync staff (like PowerSchool, Infinite Campus auto, Skyward auto, Aeries API, and Blackbaud) we have a solution to automate your staff data upload! This feature provides schools with an SFTP directory that can accept a staff.csv file.  Clever will use this staff.csv file as the source of truth, as this file will supersede any SIS-synced staff data. Schools should use it only if they want to automate staff in this way. In situations where you can use the SIS sync or Custom data to achieve the same effect, those are preferred methods. To activate this feature, reach out to our support team at [support.clever.com](https://support.clever.com/s/?language=en_US). Once activated, you’ll see the SFTP credentials on the Staff Data tab of your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. ![Screenshot of the staff.csv upload credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pCoy9)  Once you have the SFTP credentials, you can use an [FTP client](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US) like [Filezilla](https://filezilla-project.org/), or WinSCP, to upload your staff.csv file to the **preferred-sis-data** directory in your SFTP box. The path for the file upload will be **home/\[your SFTP username\]/preferred-sis-data/.** IMPORTANT: If you upload your staff.csv file to a directory other than preferred-sis-data, your data will not process, and you will **not** receive an error message. Please ensure that your staff.csv file is uploaded to the preferred-sis-data directory in the subdirectory for your SFTP username. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eHQL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** staff.csv data uploaded to the preferred-sis-data directory will be processed during a sync pause. See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507) to learn more about sync pause. If you plan to start syncing these staff members using your normal SIS sync after coming off pause, ensure that the staff\_id field in your staff.csv matches the staff\_id that will be used by your SIS sync. Learn more about the staff.csv file and how to format it [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OZckMFjSEPLYc4rOsncD17eMU3zQdoBB/view?usp=sharing). **Who does NOT need this feature:** - If you already have an SFTP directory, you would just need to automate your staff upload to that SFTP directory. - If you only want to upload staff manually, you would use [custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471?language=en_US).

title: Clever Roles: Staff - How to log in to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005686266#h_5c53ae8d-006c-40c0-8a08-f9a01eb19fe8)  
2. [Logging in](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005686266#h_b53ac537-aa97-4de6-83ea-a532b7a4173f)  
3. [Staff who are also teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005686266#h_e7ccd9d0-5e7f-4b96-8e9b-8bb10ce452c3)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T15Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpL) See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547) for information on how to add your staff members into Clever!

  

## Overview

Your district's non-instructional staff (i.e. non-teaching staff), or employees who do not have a designated roster in your district's Student Information System (SIS), are referred to as staff in Clever. Occasionally, they will also be referred to as school admins. The two terms are synonymous.  
 

Here are some examples of the types of staff members Clever supports:  
 

-   Curriculum Leads
-   District Help Desk users
-   School-specific Tech Leads
-   Principals
-   Nurses
-   District members
-   After-school Coordinators

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T15Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bpf)   For information on the different types of staff members and their permissions in Clever, please see this article: [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726)

  

## Logging in

Once you have set up staff in Clever, there are two ways for them to log in:  
 

1.  They can navigate to your district's [Clever portal login URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838)  which is located in your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page. Staff will use the same single sign-on (SSO) method you've designated for your teachers and students (e.g., if your district uses Google, staff can log in with their Google credentials).
2.  Or from [Clever.com](https://clever.com/). by selecting to log in as 'Teacher or Staff'.

        ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T15Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lvL5)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T15Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bpz) **Please note:** If you're using ADFS, LDAPS, or any other Identity Provider (IDP) that requires manual setup, you'll need to edit your claims rules to allow staff members and school admins to access Clever. If you have any questions about claims rules please see this [Help Center article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617)  

  

## Staff who are also teachers

Clever supports users being both teachers and staff! If an individual is both a teacher and staff user in Clever, they'll log into Clever, and then select their name in the top right to toggle between accounts as needed.

![Example of role switching dropdown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T15Z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Vo5KP)

If you have any questions about how district staff should access Clever, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: For Clever Admins: Co-teachers
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#overview)  
2. [Adding co-teachers in SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#AddingCoTeacher)  
3\. [Adding co-teachers in SIS managed syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#AddingSisManaged)  
4. [Syncing co-teachers in Clever managed auto syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#SyncingCleverManaged)  
5\. [Manually adding existing teachers as co-teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#ManuallyAdding)  
6. [Creating new custom teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#CreatingNewCustomTeachers)  
7. [Removing co-teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#RemoveCoTeacher)  
8. [Co-teachers in applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748#applications)

## Overview

Co-teachers are additional teachers assigned to sections in your SIS but are not the primary teacher. Clever's ability to sync co-teachers depends on your sync type. Read on to learn more!

  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Some connected applications may not support co-teachers. Please contact the application partner directly to confirm whether they support co-teachers.

-   If co-teachers are missing from your connected application, first [check your data in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202483068). If co-teachers are missing in Clever, please read the information below on how to add them to Clever.
-   If co-teachers are syncing to your Clever account but missing from your connected application, please reach out to that application team to learn how their system handles multiple teachers.
-   Clever supports a total of 10 teachers per section, including one primary teacher and up to 9 co-teachers.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Use co-teachers to give special education, intervention, and other unique teachers direct access to their students.

* * *

##   
Adding co-teachers in SFTP syncs

The "Teacher\_id" column in the sections.csv file indicates the primary teacher for that section. Multiple teachers are added to sections through the columns "Teacher\_2\_id", "Teacher\_3\_id", and "Teacher\_4\_id", etc. Clever supports up to 9 co-teachers per section.  
  
A sections.csv file formatted for co-teachers looks like this:  
![Screenshot of a sections.csv.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lwfQ) 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Each teacher\_id must correspond to a record in the teachers.csv file. Check out [Clever's SFTP spec](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf) for more information on CSV formatting; page 13 outlines the multiple teacher\_id fields. Once the multiple teacher\_id fields are added to the sections.csv file, as well as the teachers.csv file, upload the updated files to Clever. 

* * *

## Adding co-teachers in SIS-Managed Auto Syncs

Please contact your SIS if you'd like co-teachers added to your sync. Similar to the process for SFTP syncs, your SIS will need to add multiple teachers through the "Teacher\_2\_id", "Teacher\_3\_id", and "Teacher\_4\_id" fields in the sections.csv sent to Clever. [Click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) to learn more about SIS-Managed Auto Syncs.

* * *

## Syncing co-teachers in Clever-Managed Auto Syncs

To learn if your Auto Sync supports co-teachers, please go to the Clever-Managed Auto Sync page [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZnTWAW)  and select your SIS page. The Auto Sync's "Functionality" section at the top of that page will indicate if the Auto Sync can support co-teachers. Auto Syncs that support co-teachers will bring them into Clever automatically. For example:  
![](/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001698487/Screen_Shot_2017-01-09_at_10.55.58_AM.png)![Screenshot of an active Clever sync.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lwcI)   
 

* * *

## Manually adding existing teachers in Clever as co-teachers

![Screenshot showing the options available for manually adding users.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bpa)   
  

If your sync doesn't support the export of co-teachers, your school organization can manually add co-teachers to sections from a section's detail page. To do this, open the section's detail page and click **Add a co-teacher**. Sections can be easily accessed using the search bar at the top of your Clever dashboard.

Please allow up to 24 hours for manually added co-teachers to be synced by connected applications. If you don't see co-teachers appear in the application, you can contact the application's support team to confirm they support co-teachers on their platform.   
 

![Screenshot of the Section profile with Add co-teacher link highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xbxZ)   
 

* * *

## Creating new custom teachers in Clever

If you'd like to add a teacher who doesn't sync from the SIS, you can do this by clicking **create a teacher** in the modal.  
  
![Screenshot of Add co-teacher page with create a teacher link highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xbxo) 

  
You'll enter basic demographic information about the user in the subsequent screen in order to create this user.

  
Please allow up to 24 hours for your custom-created teachers to sync by connected applications. If you do not see custom-created teachers appear in the application, you can contact the application's support team to confirm they support co-teachers on their platform.

* * *

## Removing co-teachers

The process of removing a co-teacher from a section will depend on how the co-teacher was added to the section. If a co-teacher was added manually, admins will be able to remove the association directly from the section profile in Clever. 

![Screenshot of the section profile page highlighting remove.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSjF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000025bU1)

If this option is not available, the co-teacher association was synced directly from your student information system (SIS). To remove the co-teacher, the association will need to be removed in the SIS. Once removed, the co-teacher association will be removed on the next sync with Clever.  

* * *

## Co-teachers in applications

While all rostering applications on Clever have access to shared co-teacher data, it depends on the application partner whether they support co-teachers or not. The application partners also take care of managing permissions and access control for co-teachers within their app.

If you have any questions about co-teacher behavior in an application, please don't hesitate to reach out to the application's support team directly. They'll be more than happy to assist you!

title: For Clever Admins: Sync Holds
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#h_0aa9e1b0-0ed8-4225-87d8-2f09c2fa1b43)  
2. [Default hold thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#thresholds)  
3. [Custom hold thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#custom-thresholds)  
4. [Reviewing sync reports](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#step3)  
          •   [If the sync changes look good](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#h_40790a48-b6de-424e-a6db-d1dc3020d46e)  
          •   [If the sync changes look incorrect](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#h_0e3f3781-585e-4108-a3d0-387e417f2b5f)  
5. [School year and term rollovers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#roll)

##   
Overview

When your most recent Student Information System (SIS) sync to Clever is about to change a significant amount of rostering data, Clever automatically initiates a sync hold to prevent the changes until a Clever admin reviews and approves them. Sync holds are a safeguard against potentially incorrect or unintended changes being processed and synced to your connected applications. This ensures you're always aware of significant changes before they go through.  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpkD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Significant changes to [custom data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332) can also trigger a hold. Holds are not limited to only your synced data.

  
When a sync is on hold, you can select **Review Hold** under the sync hold alert or can review the information from their [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page before accepting or declining the changes. An email will also be sent to the Clever admins on your account that have their [Sync emails enabled](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000310623).  
  
![An image of a sync on hold message, showing the text “Your sync is on hold due to large changes in your most recent upload”. It then states how many days ago the last sync was, and the review hold button.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpkD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BoS)

If deletions for schools, students, teachers, or staff exceed 95% and you choose to accept the changes, a Clever support ticket is automatically created for review by a Clever support agent. Support cases are not automatically created for sections, contacts, or terms.  
 

* * *

## Default hold thresholds

Your school organization's data automatically goes on hold when at least 75% of any data type (e.g., schools, students, teachers, sections) is being updated, or over 10% is being deleted. These thresholds can be [customized](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358#custom-thresholds).  
 

* * *

## Custom hold thresholds

Clever admins can set custom hold thresholds for all record types (e.g. schools, students, teachers, sections) on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.  
  
Custom hold thresholds are helpful for:

-   Small school organizations where small data changes may represent large percentage changes
-   Clever admins planning large updates who want to avoid a hold for known changes

You can set the percentage threshold for both updates and deletions per record type. Here are the allowed ranges:

-   **Updates**
    -   0 - 100% - Schools, Students, Sections, Teachers, Contacts, Terms
-   **Deletions**
    -   0 - 90% - Schools, Students, Sections, Teachers, Contacts
    -   0 - 100% - Terms

Holds for updates can be disabled if needed. Holds for deletions can't be disabled and have a maximum threshold of 90%.  
  
Example view of custom hold thresholds:

![Example custom holds thresholds](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpkD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZPIR)

* * *

##   
Sync reports

You can review your sync reports from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. The report includes a table summarizing the data changes that triggered the sync hold. These changes won't be processed in Clever until an admin approves them.

Select **Download Changes** to view updates, deletions, warnings, and errors for each record type.  

             ![Last sync page screenshot with Download Changes button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpkD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxex) 

##   
If the sync changes look good

Select **Approve Changes.**

-   If the changes are _**less**_ than 95% deletions, Clever will immediately begin processing the new data.
-   If the changes are _**more**_ than 95% deletions or updates for any record type, a support case will be generated for final review. This is an extra safeguard for districts to ensure there is no negative effect on students, teachers, and applications. **Please include a note explaining why significant changes are being made. Clever Support will use this information to review the hold. If everything looks correct, the team will release the hold. If any concerns arise, they'll follow up via email.** 

## If the sync changes look incorrect

If the changes were not intentional, please follow these steps:  
  
**[For SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078):**

-   Select **Discard Changes.**
-   Depending on your sync type, you'll: 
    -   **SFTP syncs:** Review and correct the CSV file(s) that triggered the hold, then re-upload your CSV files to Clever via your SIS, or via [Data sources > SIS sync > Upload](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload).
    -   **SIS-managed SFTP syncs:** Clever has little insight into how data is filtered and exported from your SIS, so we're not able to help troubleshoot beyond looking at the files we receive. If you can't determine why the data changes were incorrect, reach out to your SIS rep to investigate on their end.
-   **Submit another upload:** If the revised data matches your existing data in Clever closely enough, the new upload will override the hold, and the changes will process automatically.

**[For Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/search?utf8=%E2%9C%93&category=200147297&query=auto+sync):**

-   Select **Discard Changes.**
-   Review the data in your SIS to see if you can determine why the synced data is changing so significantly.  It may be necessary to loop in your SIS rep for assistance. 
-   Once the issues have been addressed in your SIS, initiate a sync to Clever using the **Sync Now** option on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.
-   If the revised data matches your existing data in Clever closely enough, the new upload will override the hold, and the changes will process automatically.

  
 

* * *

## School year and term rollovers 

When a school year or term rolls over, sync updates from your SIS will typically trigger a sync hold. In most cases, the rollover changes will contain significant updates to the rostering data in Clever. Here are some changes that would be expected:

-   **Sections**: 100% deleted, 100% created
-   **Students**: 100% updated, 10-25% deleted, 10-25% created
-   **Teachers**: 10-20% deleted, 10-20% created

If you're not sure about the hold, navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page in the Clever Dashboard and select **Download Changes** for each record type. This downloads a .zip file which includes the creations, updates, deletions, warnings and errors for the related record type.

           ![Last attempted sync page with the Download Changes button highlighted.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpkD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxfR) 

For detailed information regarding school year and term rollovers, please visit:

-   [School Year Rollover: Overview, Preparation & Recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886)
-   [Term Rollover: Overview, Preparation & Recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204059586)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Pausing the sync with your SIS](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507)
-   [School Year Rollover: Overview, Preparation & Recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886)

title: For Clever Admins: Sync Reports
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202213756#h_bcaa61ce-bd39-4973-8aa5-14e0e7270b2e)  
2\. [Reviewing your Sync Report](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202213756#h_01EEE2G3DRAY1H2DDQEBS0N2TN)  
3\. [Viewing data errors and change logs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202213756#h_fcdb3ce5-03ab-4e4f-956d-d51441fb75d2)

## Overview

By navigating to your [Sync Report](https://schools.clever.com/sync), you can see the details of the latest upload to Clever, including the number of records created, updated, and deleted as compared to the data previously in Clever.

![Screenshot of the Sync Report page showing counts of records created, updated, and deleted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtO1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bnt)

* * *

## Reviewing your Sync Report

**Last Sync**  
The date and time of the last successful sync for your data in Clever. If your account is paused or on hold, it will reflect the last sync to fully process into Clever. As such, the Last Sync date time may be different than the last time Clever received data from your SIS.

**Record Type**  
Record type describes the type of record being referenced. Please note, enrollments are rolled into _Sections_ and will be reflected in the Sections change logs.  
  
**Existing**  
The number of active records in Clever _prior_ to the most recent sync.  
  
**Created**  
The number of records created in Clever during the most recent sync.  
  
**Updated**  
The number of records updated in Clever during the most recent sync.  
  
**Deleted**  
The number of records deleted in Clever during the most recent sync.  
  
**Errors**  
The number of errors related to the record type for the most recent sync.  
  
**Download Changes**  
Click this button to download CSV files that outline the changes for each record type for the most recent sync. Also included are any errors for the record type.

* * *

## Viewing data errors and change logs

The Sync Report page offers the ability to review and resolve errors for the data sync to Clever. To view data errors:

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.
-   Download a CSV file of the affected records by selecting the **Download changes** option for the desired record type.

The following articles may help with troubleshooting some of your school organization's sync errors:

-   [Sync Reports: Error Messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001482)
-   [Sync Report error: Records not processed due to duplicate IDs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073603)
-   [Sync Report error: Records not processed due to missing school](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003095266)
-   [Sync Report error: Sections not processed due to missing students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003073643)

If you have any questions about sync reports, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Clever Roles: Staff vs. Teachers
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791#h_ec83a742-ddc6-494e-ad9b-d359487ab489) 2\. [Teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791#teachers) 3. [Staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791#staff) 4. [Can a user be both staff and teacher?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791#can_a_user_be_both) 5. [What features are available to teachers and staff?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791#features) 6. [Clever Portal: Differences for staff vs. teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032149791#portal) ## Overview This article discusses the differences between teachers and non-instructional staff in Clever and provides details about users who might be considered both staff and a teacher. * * * ## Teachers **Teacher** is the term Clever uses to refer to your school organization's teaching staff. These are the individuals who directly manage a classroom and students. Teachers in Clever have unique tools and features that allow them to facilitate digital learning in the classroom. Some resources available to teachers in Clever include: - [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672) - [Login Tools](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005941566) - [Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)   - [Teacher Analytics](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360041755311) * * * ## Staff Staff is the term Clever uses to refer to staff who are not directly in charge of a classroom (e.g., principal, front desk, counselor, etc.). Clever has two user roles associated with the staff user type: - [Portal Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471):  This is the default role provided to staff members in Clever. This role provides permissions to access the Clever Portal and any shared applications. - [School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663): This role in Clever has additional permissions that allow them to manage the Clever Portal on a school-by-school basis.  * * * ## Can a user be both staff and teacher? Yes! An individual can be both a teacher and staff in Clever. In most instances, these users can access both user accounts using the same set of credentials. **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PR1OD) Please note:** Teacher accounts cannot be converted to staff accounts, and vice versa, within Clever. If you need to change a user from teacher to staff, or from staff to teacher, you'll need to create a new account for them of that type. School organizations can link teacher and staff accounts as long as the email for each record matches (this includes case sensitivity). If the user has one account syncing from your student information system, and you need to make a [custom account](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US) for another role for that user, that's totally fine! You'll need to be sure to use the same email. To check if the user's accounts are linked, you can search for the user in the search bar in the Clever Dashboard. If the accounts are linked you will see the teacher/staff toggle button (shown below). ![Image of teacher and staff account on Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063RsG)    The user will log in to Clever using one set of credentials. As long as the teacher and staff accounts are linked, the user can easily toggle between accounts by clicking their name and selecting the account they want to be logged in to. ![Multi-role dropdown menu](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PQytN) _An example of the dropdown a user with multiple accounts will see when clicking their name._ You can learn more about [switching between accounts here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001714).   ![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PR1OD)  **Clever Tip:** If you're accessing Clever via a login method other than the Clever login page (ex: links in another Portal) you may have a different role choosing experience. In this scenario, Clever will prompt the user to select the role they want to login with: ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bne) As a security measure, users with both a teacher and a staff account will be asked to re-enter their username and password after selecting the account they want to access. This is to protect your account in case there is a delay between your initial login attempt and selecting your account type.   For details about configuring sharing permissions for staff, please visit: [How do I share staff with applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044771711) **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PR1OD)Please note:** If your school organization uses 'Log in with Clever' for single sign-on (SSO) (in addition to a third-party identity provider like Google), these users might have different credentials for each account. Their admin should be able to provide information around login credentials. * * * ## What features are available to teachers and staff?

User type in Clever:

Teacher

Staff

User role in Clever:

Teacher

School Tech Lead

Portal Access

Single Sign-on
SSO to applications via Clever✅✅✅
Customize Clever Portal for school✅  
Teacher Pages
Create and share Teacher Pages✅
Teacher Tools
Manage and print Clever Badges✅ ✅2 
Generate backup login codes✅  
Reset student passwords1✅ 
Log a class of students into an application✅ 
Log a class of students out of Clever✅ 
View Clever login status for students✅ 
Clever Library
 Add Clever Library applications✅ 
 Review Clever Library applications✅ 
Clever Dashboard permissions
View login metrics for applications at school✅
Create custom sections✅ 
Manage application sharing permissions3✅ 

Notations: 1Clever Passwords or external (third-party) identity provider passwords if enabled by Clever Admin; 2Only have access to Badges for their schools; 3Must be enabled on a per-application basis by a Clever Admin

* * * ## Clever Portal: Differences for staff vs. teachers ### **Teacher Portal** Teachers can create personalized Teacher Pages to house a variety of learning resources they want their students to access. Some examples include: - Applications managed by your school organization - Various Clever Library applications  - Links to online tools (e.g. Wikipedia.org, Dictionary.com) - Homework or assignments in Google Drive - Community websites (e.g. local public library) ![Screenshot of teacher Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKPEE)  ### **Non-Teaching Staff Portal** The non-teaching staff Clever Portal has more limited functionality than the Teacher Portal. However, staff do have the ability to: - Single sign-on (SSO) into applications that are shared by the school organization - Find all business applications, resources, and links in one place - See school updates on the Portal Announcement board - Easily find any resources using the search option ![Screenshot of staff Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YHo1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063RqU)

title: For Clever Admins: Sync Status
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#overview)  
2\. [Sync Successful](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#successful)  
3\. [Sync in Progress](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#progress)  
4\. [Sync Pending](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#pending)  
5\. [Sync On Hold](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#hold)  
6\. [Sync Error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#error)  
7\. [Sync Paused](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#paused)  
8\. [Sync Out of Date](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#outofdate)  
9\. [Resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#resources)

## Overview

 **![Pencil icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** This Help Center article explains the status of your sync to Clever. If you're trying to troubleshoot sync errors or issues, sync holds, or syncing data to applications, you will want to check out some of our other resources listed at the bottom of this article.

  
If you want to learn more about your school organization's sync status, you've come to the right place! Your sync status is available in real-time on your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) and offers a snapshot of your Clever data sync, including your current sync status and when your data last synced successfully.

When your sync processes, your sync status will show one of the following:

-   [Sync Successful](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#successful)
-   [Sync in Progress](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#progress)
-   [Sync Pending](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#pending)
-   [Sync On Hold](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#hold)
-   [Sync Error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#error)
-   [Sync Paused](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#paused)
-   [Sync Out of Date](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663#outofdate)

Review the sync details below your sync status to learn more about steps you may need to take to resolve an issue.

![Clever "C" logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bmq) Looking for additional support on quickly getting up to speed on Clever? Check out our [Clever Academy Quick Start videos](https://go.clever.com/l/569832/2020-03-30/kssrd)

* * *

##   
Sync Successful

Your sync is fully functional. No action needed!

![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as Successful](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035edd)

* * *

##   
Sync in Progress

When the sync is pushed or started and being processed by Clever, you will see the "In Progress" label. Once the sync is completed, the label turns into "Successful". Most syncs process within 10-15 minutes.  
  
This status also displays when a [hold is released](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358) on an account. It means that Clever is processing the most current data and the account will be fully operational shortly!

  
![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as In Progress](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035ecf)

* * *

##   
Sync Pending

Sometimes we may hit an unexpected error while getting your Auto Sync configured. This sync status means that our team is working on resolving this error as soon as possible and will reach out if we need assistance!

  
![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as Pending](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bn5)

* * *

##   
Sync On Hold

When Clever encounters a significant change in the data syncing from an SIS, we place the sync on hold to prevent potentially incorrect or undesired changes from being sent to your applications.

Click "Review Hold" to view the sync report and to approve or discard the changes. For more information on Holds, see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358).

![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as On Hold, with a Review Hold button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BnA)

* * *

##   
Sync Error

There is an issue with your sync that Clever is unable to resolve on your behalf. The above errors are examples, but you may see other detailed messages for sync errors. Please review [SFTP Syncs: Troubleshooting CSV formatting errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698) and [Auto-Sync resources](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZnTWAW/clevermanaged-syncs?language=en_US) to learn how to resolve your error.

![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as Error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BnK)

* * *

##   
Sync Paused

This means your sync is currently paused, and Clever will not process updates to your data. For details on scheduling, adjusting, or canceling a pause, see [this helpful article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507).

![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as Paused](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035ecp)

* * *

##   
Sync Out of Date

If a new set of data is not successfully processed in over 6 months, your sync may display "Sync Out of Date". To resolve this issue, upload a fresh set of data to Clever. If there are significant changes to your data, it may result in a [Sync Hold](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358). Review and approve the sync changes to finish processing the updated data.

  
![Clever Dashboard showing sync status as Out of Date](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dtfl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035eck)

* * *

##   
Resources

Please see the following Help Center articles for issues with sync errors, sync holds, issues with syncing data to applications, or how to create a sync pause with a specific app:

-   [SFTP Syncs: Sync status errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203257407?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: Pause your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)
-   [For Clever Admins: Apps - Data Warnings and Errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: Sync Holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358?language=en_US)
-   See the troubleshooting sections for the following Clever-managed auto syncs:
    -   [Aeries Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203005016?language=en_US#five)
    -   [Blackbaud API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001544?language=en_US#header5)
    -   [Infinite Campus API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/226677767?language=en_US#troubleshooting)
    -   [PowerSchool Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173?language=en_US#h_01EDYVH1681M1VC03PAMCGEN9T)
    -   [Skyward API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028?language=en_US#h_01EHB1XM013ZNM5DNARJXQPZ5N)
    -   [Skyward Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193?language=en_US#troubleshooting)

title: What is Secure Sync?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113588#overview)  
2\. [Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113588#autosyncs)  
3\. [SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113588#sftp)  
3\. [Changing Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236113588#changingsyncs)

##   
Overview

Think of Clever Secure Sync as a bridge between your Student Information System (SIS) and online learning applications. Secure Sync maintains up-to-date roster information in your learning applications by securely transferring your roster uploads or connecting directly with your SIS. Clever is engineered to be the most secure and convenient way for districts to send vendors data and grant access to learning applications.

The Secure Sync process can be summarized in four steps:

1.  Your school district’s data syncs to your Clever account through an Auto Sync or an SFTP sync.
2.  Sharing permissions with each connected application are set up to determine which data to share with that application.
3.  Applications pull all available data from your Clever account, typically on a nightly basis.
4.  Student, teacher, and staff accounts are automatically created in the applications. From that point on, applications regularly update any changes to your enrollment information as indicated in your Clever account. 

Continue reading to learn about Clever’s different sync types. With all Clever sync types, the school district has complete control over data access and management of the Clever account. 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002JD3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever can only connect to one student information system (SIS) per district account. If your district uses more than one SIS, you will need to set up more than one Clever account. 

##   
Auto Syncs

An Auto Sync with Clever involves basic initial setup and requires minimal IT support from your district because Clever syncs directly with your SIS to securely transfer student roster data. There are two types of Auto Syncs: Clever-Managed and SIS-Managed Auto Syncs. Curious if Clever offers an automated sync with your SIS? [Check out this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973)

##   
SFTP Syncs

This option allows school districts to “push” data to Clever. Districts generate multiple files in a Clever-specific CSV format and submit them to Clever using Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP). The SFTP sync allows districts to upload data using an FTP client or Clever’s Web Upload tool. Districts control exactly what data to include in their upload files, therefore this option provides districts a greater level of customization but requires more robust setup and management. Clever also recommends automating the process of exporting data from your SIS and uploading it to Clever. For more information on SFTP syncs, [read this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078)  
 

##  Changing Syncs

Moving to a new student information system (SIS)? No worries—Clever has you covered! Clever can assist in keeping your downstream application data clean and ready-to-go. For more information on what this process of changing syncs will entail, [read this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049183691?language=en_US)[.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078)

  
If you have any questions about Secure Sync, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Clever Roles: School Tech Lead
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663#h_3be68020-6f75-40a9-aadc-e456a0f9146f)  
2. [Upgrading an existing staff user](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663#Header2)  
3\. [Manually adding a School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663#h_3d389085-ebe4-4a95-b7d0-53c213b99a6a)  
4\. [Bulk uploading School Tech Leads via CSV](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663#h_903f381b-a8df-4c70-9f4d-3f7732c4e6c7)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663#faq)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fbE)  
Getting started with the School Tech Leads? Check out our course [**Clever Academy for STLs: Level 1**](https://clever.academy/path/become-a-clever-certified-stl?user_type=school_admin) available in Clever Academy!

* * *

##   
Overview

District admins can assign certain users the School Tech Lead role which provides them with limited admin permissions in Clever for their associated school(s).

School Tech Leads have been given additional permissions in Clever to allow them to support in troubleshooting for your district!   
 

![STL\_Dashboard.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000DueHr)    
 

School Tech Leads have all of these additional unlocked features!

1.  Can search for students, teachers, sections, and schools.
2.  Troubleshoot student and teacher logins for applications.
3.  Impersonate teachers (Access Portal as) **if enabled by a district admin**. To enable this feature, head to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team > Access control tab.](https://schools.clever.com/team/AccessControl) For more information, please visit: [Troubleshooting: Enable "Access Portal as" for School Tech Leads.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047079271?language=en_US)
4.  Reset individual user passwords. This feature is available for districts using [Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038) and those that have purchased [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466).
5.  View users' Google, Entra ID, and/or Active Directory passwords (for districts that have purchased [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466)).
6.  Print Badges for their school site, specific sections, and individual students. They can also _create_ Badges for individual students.
7.  Create individual custom sections for their associated school(s).

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** To enable School Tech Leads to make updates to application sharing permissions _for their school(s) only_, please visit: [Enabling School Site Sharing for School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366)  

##   

* * *

##   
Upgrading an existing staff user

1.  School Tech Leads must first be added to Clever as staff before being assigned the School Tech Lead role. If the individual is a teacher in Clever, or is not yet in Clever as staff, please visit: [Adding custom staff to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471)
2.  Once the user is in Clever, navigate to their profile page using the search feature at the top of the Dashboard
3.  From their profile page, click the drop-down arrow on the top right of the page
4.  Click **Update Clever Role**
5.  Select **School Tech Lead**

          ![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CBFE)

* * *

## Manually adding a School Tech Lead

1.  In the Clever Dashboard, click [Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)
2.  In the top right corner, click Add custom data.
3.  In the drop-down menu, select **Staff**.**​​​​​​**

          ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bm2)

4.  Fill out the fields for the School Tech Lead you want to create. You’ll need to select which schools they are assigned to, or click **Assign to all schools**, as well as enter some basic identifying information. 

  
**IMPORTANT:** To make them into a School Tech Lead, you must select **School Tech Lead** in the drop-down for **Clever Role.**  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Bm7)

5.  Optional: Check the box to email the staff member informing them that their account has been created.  
     
6.  Click **Create Staff**

![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)**The Username and Password field only needs to be populated if:**   
  
 A) The district login method is Clever Passwords and 'District Username' or 'District Password' is selected for staff logins  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BmM)  
B) The district login method is Active Directory or LDAPS and the username field in Clever is utilized for staff matching (claims rules)   
  
C) You would like to utilize the District Username and District Password fields for staff logging into SSO (Saved Passwords) applications

* * *

## Bulk uploading School Tech Leads via CSV

To add one or multiple School Tech Leads via an uploaded file to Clever, please:

-   Prepare your Staff.csv file. You can [download a staff.csv template here](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/CleverSFTP.zip).
-   Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).
-   Select [Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)
-   Select **Upload records**.
-   Upload your Staff.csv file.

To view existing custom staff data, from the [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data page.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e4GD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Any changes made for a School Tech Lead from the Clever [Team](https://schools.clever.com/team) page will overwrite the data previously uploaded via a staff.csv file.  
  
For example, if Jonathon Jones is uploaded as a School Tech Lead via the staff.csv and then his role is changed to Portal access only from the Team page, this will overwrite the School Tech Lead role assigned to him in the original upload.   

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  
**Can I manually remove STL access through a CSV upload?**

-   STL access must be revoked in the same way that STL access was granted. If a staff member was manually upgraded through the dashboard, STL access should be revoked through the dashboard as well. If a staff member was upgraded in a CSV, update the CSV to represent their new status and re-upload the CSV file.

title: Clever Roles: District Help Desk
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207803#one)   
2. [Adding District Help Desk users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207803#two)  
3. [Removing District Help Desk users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207803#three)  
4\. [Switching between user accounts if you have multiple accounts in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207803#four)

## Overview 

The District Help Desk role is typically assigned to staff members who support district users. This role provides limited district admin permissions in Clever. Here is a graph detailing the permissions available to users in this role compared to a Clever Admin:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BlE)  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BlJ)

## Adding District Help Desk users

     **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VkqL8)     Please note:** Accounts utilizing an SFTP or SIS-Managed SFTP sync can sync, remove, and update District Help Desk users via CSV. [Please see here for more information, including steps for removing admins synced via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709).  
  
If you utilize a SIS-Managed sync and want to automate the syncing of your administrators.csv, you’ll need to work with your SIS directly to add this file to your exports.

Clever admins can add District Help Desk users to Clever by following these steps:

-   Go to [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members)
-   Click _Add team member_ on the top right
-   Add the user's information in the pop-up box, selecting the District Help Desk role
-   Click _Save_

          ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BfiE)

Once the user has been added to Clever, they will receive an email with a link to create an account. If they do not receive this message, please have them check their spam folder for a message from '[no-reply@clever.com](mailto:no-reply@clever.com)'. 

District Help Desk users should use the 'District admin log in' from the Clever login page to access their Clever Admin account.

        ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BfiP)

* * *

## Removing District Help Desk users

     **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VldYj)     Please note:** Accounts utilizing an SFTP or SIS-Managed SFTP sync can sync, remove, and update District Help Desk users via CSV. [Please see here for more information, including steps for removing admins synced via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709).  
  
If you utilize a SIS-Managed sync and want to automate the syncing of your administrators.csv, you’ll need to work with your SIS directly to add this file to your exports.

Clever Admins can remove District Help Desk users from the [Team](https://schools.clever.com/team) page by clicking the trash icon to the far right of the user's name.   
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bfdy)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BlT) _For more information about the various admin and staff roles in Clever, please visit:_ [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726)

  
If you have additional questions about roles in Clever, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

* * *

## Switching between user accounts if you have multiple accounts in Clever

Many administrators add themselves as teachers or staff users in Clever to better understand these end users’ experiences. If you have multiple accounts in Clever, and the accounts are connected, you can easily toggle between any accounts by clicking your name and selecting the account you want to access. You can easily switch between accounts if they are connected by the same email address (case sensitive) or sis\_id values.

![Multi-role dropdown menu](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Szer&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PQPXS)

_An example of the dropdown a user with multiple accounts will see when clicking their name._

title: For School Tech Leads: Student & teacher login errors, password resets
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044867112#Overview)  
2. [Reset student and teacher passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044867112#LoginWithClever)  
3. [Troubleshoot Login tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044867112#TroubleshootLoginTool)     
4. [View a teacher’s Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044867112#ViewATeachersCleverPortal)  

##   
Overview

As a School Tech Lead, you have numerous troubleshooting tools at your disposal! These tools will help you locate student, teacher, section, and school records in Clever to allow you to support users with login issues.  
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** The search bar on your Clever Dashboard is a great tool that allows you to easily search for teachers, students, sections, and your school site for troubleshooting missing or incorrect data. Incorrect data can prevent a user from logging in to Clever and may result in incorrect data within their scoped applications.

## 

* * *

## Reset student and teacher passwords

   
If your district uses **Log in with Clever** or a Third-Party account such as Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google as your login method, you **may** be able to reset student and teacher passwords.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BIC)**Please note:** This feature will only work if your district uses **Log in with Clever** or a Third-Party account (Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google) as a login method to Clever _and_ your district admin has enabled the password reset feature.

**Resetting student and teacher Clever passwords:**

1.  Log in to your Clever Portal, and from your Dashboard, search for the user.   
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BIH)  
      
    
2.  Click **Support Tools**_,_ then **Change password** in the top right-hand side of their profile.  
    ![Image of the Support Tools menu in the STL dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EmT65)    
      
      
    
3.  Input new password and select **Save.**  
       ![Image of the Set new password screen for STLs](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EmTCX)

* * *

##    
Troubleshoot Login tool

Troubleshoot Login is the perfect tool for quickly identifying root cause issues of login errors and missing icons in the portal. Often, your teachers and students may come to you with questions about logging in to Clever or applications.  
 

You can find the tool in two places:  
 

1.  Click **Troubleshoot Login** on your Dashboard  
    ![Troubleshoot login button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHJ) 
2.  Search for the affected teacher or student's profile in your Dashboard and select **Troubleshoot user login**   
    on the upper right-hand side of their Profile Page.   
    ![Troubleshoot user login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CBJz) 

###  **Using the Troubleshoot Login tool**

1.  Navigate to the [**Troubleshoot Login**](https://clever.com/oauth/district_admin/login?target=%3BbzRrcGh2aDJ5Z252eDgzdnhjNjQ%3D%3BaHR0cHM6Ly9zY2hvb2xzLmNsZXZlci5jb20vYXV0aC1jYWxsYmFjaw%3D%3D%3BZjBhMzk4ZDhiMWExNWRjOTg4NmZiMTFjYmVhNjUwZjUwNDcxNGM1NDc2ZDY5OTFiMmI1Mzg1YzlmMGQ4ZWZlOQ%3D%3D%3BY29kZQ%3D%3D%3BZGlzdHJpY3RfYWRtaW4%3D) tool.
2.  Select a user using **Clever ID, SIS ID, Name, or Email,** and select the **name of the application** they having problems accessing.   
    ![Example name and application screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHT)   
    The tool will complete a root cause analysis of the issue.
3.  Review of the summary of checks  
    ![Test summary screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHY) 
4.  Review the **Recommended Action**  
    This will indicate _who_ will need to take action to resolve the issue. There are 3 possible options: District, App, or Clever.  
    ![Recommended action](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHd) 
5.  Review the **Issue Details** shown underneath the Recommended action. This will provide information on how to address any issues that have been flagged by the tool.  
      
    To make communication simple, we have provided a **Copy issue description** function to allow you to easily include this information in your communication with the district, app, or Clever.  
    ![Root cause analysis](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHi)   
    Additionally, the tool will highlight related Help Center articles that can be leveraged to assist with resolving the issues detected.  
      
    Please note, there may be multiple issues that will need to be addressed to restore the login for a user. 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Pro Tip:** Check out [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360051319711) that describes result messages and additional information on how to resolve errors. 

  
  

* * *

##    
View a teacher’s Clever Portal

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHn)**Please note:** You will only have access to this feature if it has been enabled by your district admin

  
Clever now gives you the ability to access the portal as a teacher to identify the source of an issue. For security reasons, the teacher you are accessing the portal as will receive a notification each time you access their Portal.

  
**When to use the "Access Portal as user" feature for a teacher**

  
Teacher Access Portal sessions should be reserved for the following scenarios:  
 

1.  A teacher is reporting they are unable to log in to one of their connected applications
2.  A teacher is reporting that sections are not loading inside a connected application
3.  A teacher is reporting that students are missing from their roster within a connected application
4.  Print Badges for an entire class

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHs) **To print Badges for a teacher’s class, head to: [For Teachers: Printing Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360000127406)**

  
  
**How to use the "Access Portal as user" feature for a teacher**

**Directions**  
 

1.  Log in to your Clever Dashboard
2.  Search for the impacted teacher in the **Search bar**
3.  Select **_Access Portal as user_** in the top right-hand corner from the **Teacher Tools**  
    ![Access Portal as user](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CBKE) 
4.  A box will pop up asking for details on your session. Please enter the details and check the box agreeing that you will not alter their Portal or share sensitive student or teacher information.  
    ![Confirm Portal access screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BI2) 
5.  Select **Begin Portal session.** You will be authenticated into the teacher’s portal to troubleshoot accordingly!
6.  When done troubleshooting, select **End Portal session** to securely return to your Clever account.  
    ![You are currently accessing Portal banner](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EWWH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BI7)
