title: For School Tech Leads: Edtech Analytics
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044719192#Overview)  
2\. [How to navigate the dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044719192#HowToNavigate)

  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BGa)**Please note:** If you select the Edtech Analytics tab in Clever and see the **Get started** message, this means that Edtech Analytics has not been set up by your Clever Admins. Please contact your Clever Admins if you would like this feature set up

## ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BGf)

## Overview

Edtech Analytics shows you all of your assigned schools' app usage in one place down to the school and grade level, whether or not the application is integrated with Clever. Best of all, it’s free!

This will allow you to Identify edtech usage trends and opportunities for intervention. Ensure everyone is getting the best out of the edtech your schools have invested in.  
  
Please note, Edtech Analytics is only available for Chromebook and Windows devices running Chrome and Edge browsers. Edtech Analytics is not supported for mobile devices.  
  
For Microsoft Intune as the mobile device manager on Windows as the operating system, please see:

-   For Chrome
-   For [Edge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001573)

## 

 

* * *

##   
How to navigate the dashboard

When you first log in to Clever you will see an overview of data for the last 7 days from your home page. To access the full report, click **View details.**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BGp)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BGu)**Please note:** Edtech Analytics only reports data from devices with the Clever Plus extension enabled and does not include usage on personal mobile devices, including iOS devices.

Below is helpful information on navigating the Edtech Analytics dashboard!

**Filters:**    
 

-   You can filter data by time range, including last school year, this school year, the last 28 days, or the last 7 days. You can also filter by school and grade level. You'll only be able to see data for schools assigned to you as an STL, and only schools and grades with usage data will be shown in drop-downs.  
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BGz) 

**Reported Users**

**Students reported** and **teachers reported** is usage from devices where the Clever Plus extension is installed. To be counted, users need to:   
 

-   Be synced to Clever (learn more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) about syncing to Clever)
-   Have an email address (Chromebook) or a username (Windows device) 
-   Have an Active Directory or Google session running on their device 
-   Be actively using the application (i.e. spends at least 10 seconds on the app page)

These numbers are updated every 4-6 hours.   
 

You can view reported users **by day** by hovering over the historical trendline.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BH4)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BH9)**Please note:** Edtech Analytics only reports data from devices with the Clever Plus extension enabled and does not include usage on personal mobile devices, including iOS devices.

**Applications**  
 

-   **Total apps:** This shows the total number of [allow listed edtech apps](https://assets.clever.com/pulse/libraryAppDomains.json) identified by Clever. We’re constantly adding to this list so you may see the number of apps increase as these are added. Don’t see an app on our [list](https://assets.clever.com/pulse/libraryAppDomains.json)? [Let us know](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) so we can add it. 
-   **SSO apps:** Single Sign-On (SSO) applications that have been added at the district-level.
-   **[Library apps](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360025230952):** the total number of Clever Library applications added to Clever Portal by your teachers.
-   **Other apps:** Show the total number of allow listed Edtech applications not added through Clever, or any weblink—regardless if it’s accessed through Clever or not.
    
    Each section is clickable so you can view only those specific apps categories in the full list underneath.   
     
    
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BGq)
    

**Applications - Usage data**  
 

-   The **Students %** and **Teacher %** metrics show the percent of students and teachers using the app, out of total reported by the Clever Plus extension. 
-   **Active time per user** is the average time a student and teacher is actively using the app during the time range selected on the page (since initial setup, in the last 28 days, in the last 7 days).   
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCbF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BHE)

**In the example above:**  
 

-   984 students and 97 teachers are reported describes users that are:
    -   synced to Clever
    -   have the Clever Plus extension installed on Chromebooks and/or Windows devices
    -   have been actively using a allow listed Edtech application.
-   4% of the 984 students and 4% of the 97 teachers used Word Munchers for 10 minutes on average during the current school year.

title: For School Tech Leads: Data missing or incorrect
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044925932#Overview)  
2\. [Locating your school site's data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044925932#LocatingYourSchoolsData)

##   
Overview

Using the search bar allows you to easily search for teachers, students, sections and your school site for troubleshooting missing or incorrect data. Incorrect data can prevent a user from logging in to Clever and may result in incorrect data within their scoped applications.  
  
![Image of the search bar on the School Tech Lead dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o61&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000acBd)  
_The search bar on your STL Clever Dashboard._  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o61&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Data syncs to Clever from your student information system (SIS). If data in Clever is incorrect, please contact your registrar or data clerk so they can make the necessary updates in your SIS. 

##   
Locating your school site's data

**Searching for schools:**  
  
On a school’s _Overview page_ you will be able to view all the data associated with that site in Clever.  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o61&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNb5)

**Searching for students:**  
 

Student _Profile pages_ allow you to view the following:  
 

1.  The sections the student is enrolled in
2.  All of their associated data in Clever
3.  Their guardian contacts
4.  Their scoped applications
5.  Their most recent logins to Clever

This allows you to determine whether data in Clever is accurate, they have access to the necessary applications and whether they’re having any difficulty logging in!

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o61&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNbj)

**Searching for teachers:**  
 

Teacher _Profile pages_ allow you to view the following:  
 

1.  The teacher’s rostered sections
2.  All of their associated data in Clever
3.  Their scoped applications
4.  Their most recent logins to Clever

This allows you to determine whether data in Clever is accurate, they have access to the necessary applications and whether they’re having any difficulty logging in!  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o61&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNbt)

**Searching for sections**  
  
Viewing sections _Profile pages_ allows you to:  
 

1.  Confirm section data
2.  Confirm that the necessary teachers are associated with the section
3.  Confirm that all of the correct students are rostered to the section
4.  View the applications shared with the section

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o61&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNah)

title: For School Tech Leads: Custom Sections
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020213371#Header1)  
2\. [How do I manually create custom sections?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020213371#Header2)  
3\. [How do I edit custom sections?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020213371#Header4)  
4\. [How do I delete custom sections?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020213371#Header5)  
5\. [How do I share custom sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020213371#Header6)

## Overview

The Custom Sections feature allows district admins and School Tech Leads to create and manage sections manually within the Clever dashboard. This feature can be used to create sections for summer school, intervention groups, after-school programs, and more!

  
Custom Sections are created and managed from the Clever dashboard and behave just like sections from your SIS. Once the custom sections are created, districts can share them with applications through the same sharing permissions interface.

 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oAr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** School Tech Leads are not able to view or edit Custom Sections created by other School Tech Leads or district admins.   

* * *

##   
How do I manually create custom sections?

  
You can create individual sections from your Clever dashboard.  
  
**Step 1: Add Section Info**  
To create custom sections, log in to the Clever and select **Create Custom Sections**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oAr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BFX)

Next, select **Add Custom Data > Sections**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oAr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BFc)

Begin by entering the name and school to be associated with the section. The following fields are required:  
 

-   Section Name
-   School
-   Subject
-   Grade

Once all required fields are populated, you will be able to press **Next** to proceed. We recommend adding any information that may be helpful in identifying the section in Clever and connected applications.  
  
  
**Step 2: Add Teachers**  
Next, select the primary teacher to associate with the section. You can also add up to 9 co-teachers for each custom section. Clever has provided filters to assist with locating staff members by school.   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oAr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BFh) **Please note:**Not all applications support co-teachers. We recommend checking with the application’s support team to confirm if co-teachers are a supported feature. 

  
  
**Step 3: Select Primary Teacher**  
Next, indicate the primary teacher for the section. If an application does not support co-teachers, this primary teacher will be the teacher that is connected to the custom section. 

  
  
**Step 4: Add Students**  
Next, select students to be enrolled in the section. Clever has provided filters to help locate students using school, grade level, etc.

  
**Step 5: Preview**  
Review the custom section to confirm the section information, including teachers and students, are correct. When ready, select “Create.”

  
**Step 6: Share with applications**  
The custom section will be available to share with connected applications following your district's next successful sync with Clever.   
 

* * *

##   
  
How do I edit custom sections?

To edit a section, click on the pencil icon under ‘Actions’. This will take you back to the custom sections wizard where you can make adjustments as desired.  
 

 

* * *

##   
How do I delete custom sections?

Sections can be deleted from Clever by clicking on the ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oAr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BFm) under **Actions**.   
 

* * *

##   
How do I share custom sections?

Custom sections are shared with applications through the same interface as sections from the SIS. 

  
Once a custom section is created, we recommend reviewing the district's sharing permissions to ensure the section is shared as desired. You may need to adjust your sharing permissions to ensure it is included. For more information on sharing rules, see this article: [How do I set my sharing permissions for applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) .

title: For School Tech Leads: Clever Portal - Managing and organizing
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#overview)  
2. [What is the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#WhatistheCleverPortal)  
3. [Accessing your Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#AccessingyourCleverPortal)  
4\. [Adding & Editing Categories](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#AddingandEditingCategories)  
5\. [Adding Custom External Links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#AddingCustomExternalLinks)  
6\. [Adjust a resource's visibility](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#Adjustaresourcesvisibility)  
7\. [What does "Category Locked" mean?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042044811#WhatdoesCategoryLockedmean)

## Overview

[School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) can organize and manage the Clever Portal for the schools that they are associated with. With this feature enabled, School Tech Leads can arrange tiles, add new categories, and add custom links for their schools.

##   

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008Smpt)  Please note:** School Tech Leads can only edit the Portal for schools they are associated with. Only Clever Admins can edit the district Portal. For more information please see our article [For Clever Admins: Customizing Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568).

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fbO)  
Want to learn more about customizing the Clever Portal as a School Tech Lead? Check out our course [Clever Academy for STLs: Level 1](https://clever.academy/level-1-getting-started-with-clever-as-an-stl?user_type=school_admin) available in Clever Academy!

* * *

## What is the Clever Portal?

The Clever Portal puts learning at teachers’ and students’ fingertips. Each student and teacher can access a personalized portal with single sign-on (SSO) to every learning application they use.  
  
As a School Tech Lead, you can organize and manage the Clever Portal for the schools that you are associated with. Customizations include:

-   Adding new categories
-   Adding custom links
-   Arranging links & categories

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008Smpt) Please note:** A Clever Admin will need to enable Portal organization for School Tech Leads in your district. If you don't have the ability to edit the Portal, be sure to reach out to your admin to have them enable this feature. 

* * *

##   
Accessing your Clever Portal

To access the Portal organization area for your school’s Clever Portal, start by logging into Clever, then navigate to the **Dashboard** tab at the top of the page.

![Image of where to locate the STL Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000YPN7X)

Next, select the **Organize School Portal** button from your Dashboard to begin organizing and managing the Portal for your school.

![Button to Organize School Portal for STLs](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000YPnTN)

* * *

##   
Adding & Editing Categories

As a School Tech Lead, you can easily create custom categories to group resources that are frequently used by your school users to make it easier for them to locate these resources. To do this:

1.  Select the school Portal you would like to organize from the dropdown at the top of the page labeled **Organize as X school.**
2.  Once you've selected the school you'd like to edit, you can select the **Add to the Portal** button to add a category, a link, or add an application to a category.
3.  Any category you add or edit can be moved to the desired spot on the Clever Portal by dragging the category in the right-hand panel. 
4.  To delete a category, select the trashcan next to the corresponding to the category you wish to remove. 
5.  Select **Publish Changes** after you are finished!

* * *

## Adding Custom external links

Custom external links are perfect for adding resources that haven’t already been added to your district’s Clever Portal that are frequently utilized by your school. Some commonly added resources are:

-   The school website
-   Monthly lunch menus
-   Bus routes
-   Forms (tech liability forms, field trip forms, teacher nomination forms, etc.)
-   Morning announcements
-   Field day information
-   Learning resources

**To add custom external links:**

1.  Navigate to your Clever Dashboard and select the **Organize School Portal** button.
2.  Select the school Portal you would like to organize from the dropdown at the top of the page labeled **Organize as X school.**
3.  Once you've selected the school you'd like to edit, you can select the **Add to the Portal** button and select **Add a link.**
4.  A modal will pop-up for adding the link. Select an icon or upload a custom icon (Note: Optimal icon size should be 200x200)
5.  Fill out the required fields for the link Title and URL.
6.  Select which user types (audience), grades, and schools you would like to add the custom link for. Please note that if adding for selected schools, the link will only display for the user if the selected school matches the user's primary school association.
7.  Choose one or multiple categories to organize the link into.
8.  Click **Add.**
9.  Be sure to click **Publish Changes** on the top right of the page to finalize your updates. 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Before adding custom external links to your school’s Clever Portal, make sure to scroll through the current Portal and look at the list of the integrated applications your district has. To look at the existing integrated applications your district has, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) \> [App sharing rules](https://schools.clever.com/applications). 

* * *

## Adjust a resource’s visibility

  
Visibility allows you to hide an icon from a subset of users for a specific period of time. Visibility settings can be set per user type. To hide an icon, follow these steps:  
  

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Organize School Portal page.](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize)
2.  Locate the application you wish to hide and click the three vertical dots.
    
3.  Select **Hide/show in Portal.**
    
4.  Select **Hide temporarily**.
    
5.  Select all users (student, teachers, staff) you want to hide the application from for the same timeframe. If you want to hide the application for a separate user type for a different timeframe, you can use the **Add another user type** button after you configure the timeframe for your first user type.
    
6.  Fill in the start and end dates for hiding.
    
7.  Click **Save.**
    
8.  Be sure to select **Publish changes** in the top right corner of the Organize district portal page to apply the visibility settings.
    

![Hide/show options in Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000YPtk5)   
 

* * *

##   
What does "Category Locked" mean?

District-level categories can’t be modified by School Tech Leads. These categories will appear with the label **Category Locked**. If you wish to edit a district-level category, please contact your Clever admin.

## ![Image of a locked category](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UZpx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000YPukz)

title: For School Tech Leads: Badges
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\.  [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005209686#Overview)  
2\. [What are Clever Badges?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005209686#WhatAreCleverBadges)  
3\. [How do Clever Badges work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005209686#HowDoCleverBadgesWork)  
4\. [Technical requirements for Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005209686#TechnicalRequirementsForBadges)  
5. [How do I generate Badges from my Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005209686#HowDoIGenerateBadgesFromMyPortal)  
6\. [Devices without cameras](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005209686#DevicesWithoutCameras)

## Overview

Clever Badges are a great tool to ease logins in the classroom at your school site. This article will discuss how Clever Badges work, the technical requirements, and how you can generate Clever Badges for students at your school site. 

* * *

## What are Clever Badges?

Clever Badges allow students to use a physical Badge to log in to Clever in lieu of typing in credentials to authenticate users. Badges are an easier way for the youngest students to access their apps. School Tech Leads can print Badges for individual students, entire school sites, or sections, as long as Badges have been enabled by a Clever Admin.

Badges are tied to the student. As such, changes in school, teacher, or section will not affect the Badge.   
  
Grade-level access for Badges is managed by your district administrator. If Badges are not available for the desired grade level, please [contact your district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046673591). For more information about enabling Badges for your district, please see this Help Center [article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907).

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CAjJV)   Please note:** Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. Existing printed Badges will continue to work past the expiration date. Admins are expected to void and print Badges annually during transition periods, like summer, to keep them secure ahead of the first day of school. See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001682) for more information.

##   

* * *

##   
How do Clever Badges work?

1.  Students navigate to clever.com/badges and click **Allow** in the browser prompt to give Clever access to their camera. They can also go to their district's Clever URL and click the Badges icon. Clever Badges are designed to be used directly with Clever, and a QR reader won't log the student in to Clever.
2.  The webcam will activate and students should hold up their Badge to the camera. Once the code is scanned the screen border will flash green.
3.  Students will then be redirected to their Clever Portal.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMAS)

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Pro Tip: Security**  
Badges provide direct access to a student's Clever account and should be protected just like a password. Anyone who has access to a Badge can sign in as a student and access their accounts in both Clever and connected applications. Please protect the security of your students and do not share images of the QR code publicly on social media.

* * *

##   
Technical Requirements for Badges

You will need to following items to implement and use Badges:  
 

1.  Supported web browser (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, Safari)
2.  Printer
3.  Computers/devices with webcam

* * *

##   
How do I generate Badges from my Portal?

Badges can be downloaded using the directions below. They can also be downloaded by teachers and parents/guardians using these directions: 

-   [How to download a Clever Badge as a teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000127406)
-   [How to download a Clever Badge as a parent/guardian](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047770232)

**For School Tech Leads: Printing Individual Badges**

1.  From your Clever Portal, navigate to your Dashboard
2.  Once in the Dashboard, search for the student in the **search bar**
3.  If the student does not have a Badge generated, select **Create Clever Badge** on the right-hand side of their Profile
4.  If the student's Clever Badge is already generated, select a download option

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000W94wQ)  Please note:** If you select **Void Clever Badge** the student's Clever Badge will no longer function and you will need to generate a new Badge for them.

  
**For School Tech Leads: Printing school site and section Badges**

  
 1. From your Clever Portal, navigate to your Dashboard.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMB1)

2\. Once in the Dashboard, choose **Badges.**

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMBB)

3\. In the "Overview" tab, you will have two options to generate Badges. Whenever a new student joins your school (within the configured grade range for Badges), you can click **New** to generate Badges for only those new students at the school.

  
Or, you can select **All** to generate Badges for all the students at your school. Clicking **All** will not void any existing Badges. It will simply regenerate any existing badges as well as create new badges for any students who did not yet have one.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMBQ)

4\. Once you select an option, the Badges will either be emailed to your or immediately start downloading, to a zip file with PDFs of the Badges. You'll have the option to either print by grade level or by section.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMBV)

* * *

##   
Devices without cameras

If a student doesn't have access to a device with a camera, they can log in using the district's normal login method. (e.g. Log in with Google, Log in with Active Directory, Log in with Clever). If you require assistance with identifying their username and password for one of these login methods, please reach out to your [district's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648). 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZhoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BMBf)

Please let us know if you have any questions! You can always submit a ticket to [Clever Support.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/?language=en_US)

title: For School Tech Leads: Announcements
text:
School Tech Leads have the ability to send announcements to the schools they administer through the Clever Dashboard. School Tech Leads assigned to multiple schools will send notifications to **all** schools they are associated with.

This article contains the following:  
1\. [How do I create an announcement for my users in the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037401532#Header1)  
2\. [What will the announcement look like in the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037401532#Header2) 

##  How do I create an announcement for my school's users in the Clever Portal?

To create an announcement, log in to Clever and select **Create portal notifications**.

![Screen Shot 2021-02-16 at 9.29.31 PM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o9F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lUDn)

1.  Select **Create notification**.
2.  Select the Start Date, End Date. 
3.  Enter a title
4.  Enter the body content
5.  Select which users you would like to see the Portal Notification
6.  If you would like to provide users with a link, enter the URL and the text you would like displayed. Example:   
    ![Screen Shot 2021-02-16 at 9.29.37 PM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o9F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lUDs)

![gif.gif](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o9F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lUDx)

**Please note:** URLs must be prefixed with **https://** to be valid. 

## What will the announcement look like in the Clever Portal?

Users that are scoped to receive the message will see a notification in the toolbar of their Portal.

![gif2.gif](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001o9F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lUE2)

**Please note:** Announcements made by School Tech Leads cannot be "prioritized". The prioritization feature is limited to Clever Admins.

  
For instructions on how district administrators can create announcements, please see: [For District Admins: How do I create an announcement in the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025690932)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I delete my district's Clever account?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221200747#h_688b696b-88fd-4460-b067-401a5ee8aa87)  
2\. [Instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221200747#h_e67ded9d-5873-4bcc-8981-9b0562d9b1b6)  
3\. [Retention limits and inactivity](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221200747#header3)

##   
Overview

Only the [Clever Administrator "owner"](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038) can delete a district's Clever account. **Please note that this action is permanent, and the account cannot be restored once deleted.** All data in connected applications will also be deleted for district users.

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBo5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**We strive to improve our products and services consistently and would love to understand why you plan to discontinue using Clever. Any feedback you are willing to provide would be greatly appreciated. Please let us know by contacting [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)!

* * *

## Instructions

If you'd like to proceed with deleting your Clever account, please:  

-   Confirm you're the Clever account owner on the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page.
-   Click on your name in the upper right-hand corner and select **Profile**.
-   Select **Delete district account**.

![District admin profile page with Delete district account button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBo5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TYU4)

-   Confirm your intention in the pop-up by providing a reason for the deletion.
-   Type "CONFIRM DELETE", then click **Delete district account**.

![Delete district account box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBo5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TYUE)

* * *

## Retention limits and inactivity

In addition to requested deletions, Clever has set certain retention limits so that some Student Data expires after extended inactivity criteria are met. Please see Clever Additional Terms of Use for Schools for more information: [https://www.clever.com/trust/terms/schools](https://www.clever.com/trust/terms/schools)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I subscribe to status updates?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1.  [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000955426#h_f37c8dad-8dd9-4f62-8c9e-34643899ebf9)  
2. [Subscribing to status updates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000955426#h_5a554a35-e89a-461a-82e1-ef2145301f7b)  
3. [Managing status update subscriptions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000955426#h_45bf4706-99a7-4d2f-8b01-ed012031a01b)  
4. [Unsubscribing from status updates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000955426#h_b85c35b2-d130-4773-b1da-402dbfcdd0c9)

##   
Overview

There are a variety of Clever status updates available online, or that can be communicated to Clever admins in various ways. This article details the different status update options, the alert methods available, and how to subscribe to receive them.  
  
Clever system status dynamic updates are always available at [https://status.clever.com](https://status.clever.com/). From this page, users can:  
  
View the status of a variety of Clever services:  
  
![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-11.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO6S)

View previous messages and incidents: 

     ![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-12.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO6X)

Review system metrics: 

     ![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-13.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO6c)

* * *

## Subscribing to status updates

To subscribe to receive updates regarding Clever services, select **Subscribe to updates** at the top right of the Clever Status page. 

![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-19.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOAt)

Choose your method of delivery: 

-   **Email:** Get email notifications whenever Clever creates, updates, or resolves an incident.
-   **Phone:** Get SMS notifications whenever Clever creates or resolves an incident.
-   **Webhook:** Get a webhook notification whenever Clever creates, updates, or resolves an incident, or changes a component status.
-   **Tweet:** Follow our status channel - @ssostatus
-   **RSS Feed:** Add Clever's status page to your RSS feed. 

Most Clever admins will select to receive updates via email. To do this, enter your email address and select **Subscribe via email**.

    ![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-15.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO6h)

The next page will allow you to choose which components you want to monitor. Clever recommends the following settings: 

-   Single Sign-On
-   SIS Sync (choose your district's sync type)
-   Support

Select **Save** to save your notification settings.

![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-18.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO9v)

* * *

## Managing status update subscriptions

1.  Open [https://status.clever.com.](https://status.clever.com/)
2.  Click **Subscribe to Updates**
3.  Enter your email address, and select **Subscribe via email.**
4.  You should receive a message that states: "_Your email is already subscribed. Use the form below to manage your subscription."_
5.  Update the components you want to follow or unfollow. 
6.  Select **Update Preferences**

* * *

## Unsubscribing from status updates

1.  Open [https://status.clever.com](https://status.clever.com/)
2.  Click **Subscribe to Updates**
3.  Enter your email address, and select **Subscribe via email**
4.  You should receive a message that states: "_Your email is already subscribed. Use the form below to manage your subscription."_
5.  Select **Cancel Subscription**
6.  Select **Unsubscribe from Updates**

![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-17.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBrJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO7a)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I reset my password?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083536#overview)  
2\. [Reset Password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083536#reset)  
3\. [Update Password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083536#update)  
4. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083536#faqs)

##   
Overview

Clever district admins can easily reset their passwords in case of a lost or forgotten one. This article details the process for resetting a district admin password.

IMPORTANT When resetting your password, you'll also need access to the authentication method you've set up for [Multi Factor Authentication](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333) (e.g. your cell phone to receive a text message code, Google/Microsoft authenticator app, etc.)  
  
If you don't have access to the authentication method you set up, another Clever Admin at your district can [reset MFA for you](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#resetting). Alternatively, you can contact Clever support by clicking the chat icon in the bottom right corner.

  
 

* * *

##   
Reset Password

To reset your District Admin password for Clever,

1.  Visit schools.clever.com and click **Forgot your password?**
2.  Enter the email address associated with your admin account and click Send 
3.  An email will be sent with a link to reset your password. If you don't receive the email, please check your spam filter and make sure [no-reply@clever.com](mailto:no-reply@clever.com) is added as a contact to your email account.

**Quick link:** [https://schools.clever.com/reset](https://schools.clever.com/reset)

 ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBph&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Y5cI)  ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBph&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Y5cS)  
 

* * *

##   
Update Password

If you would like to update your Clever password, click on your name in the top-right of the district dashboard and click **Profile**. Click **Edit** to update your password.  
  
![Edit Clever Admin profile details](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBph&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000W9PZR)   
  
 

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**When attempting to log in to Clever, why do I see a note about my password being part of a public data breach?**

-   Clever determines that a password is unsafe if it's been made public in an unrelated data breach. We perform privacy-preserving checks for passwords which have been leaked online. If a Clever Admin password matches any of these, we require the DA to reset their password.

![Login screen with a note explaining that the user's password was discovered in a breach and has been reset.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBph&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TSZm)

  
  
**Are there recommendations for choosing a secure password?**

-   Use a password management solution like 1Password to use strong/unique passwords for all logins.
-   Combine three or four random words. For example: “student-task-fish-fly”. These combinations are usually easy to remember and very secure.

title: For Clever Admins: How do I update my email preferences?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000310623#h_28e168f7-460f-4d13-9771-b0c67c41c9e0)

Overview

Clever admins have the ability to edit email preferences from their [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) in order to manage the types of emails they will receive from Clever. 

## Instructions

**Step 1:** From the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), click on your name in the top right corner and select 'Profile'.  
  
![Profile page tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBsv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000W9SIn)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I update my profile settings?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043053#overview)  
2. [Personal details](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043053#personaldetails)  
3. [Change password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043053#changepassword)  
4\. [Set language](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043053#setlanguage)  
5. [Multi-factor authentication](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043053#mfa)

##   
Overview

On the [Profile page](https://schools.clever.com/profile) of your Clever Dashboard, you can edit your user information, change your password, and enable multi-factor authentication. To access your Profile page:

1.  Log in to your [Clever Dashboard.](https://schools.clever.com/)
2.  Click on your name in the upper right-hand corner and click **Profile**.
3.  Under Account Information, click **Edit**.

* * *

## Personal details

From here, you can update your personal details.

  
![Admin edit profile screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cC6b&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000W9TYD)    
 

* * *

## Change password

To change your Clever account password, click **Change Password**. You'll be prompted to enter your existing password and then your new password twice. Click **Update** to save your changes.

* * *

## Set language

You can update your personal language preference from your Clever Dashboard.

1.  Click your **name** in the top right corner of the dashboard.
    
2.  Select **Profile**.
    
3.  On the **Overview** page, find the language setting and select your preferred language.
    

Your Dashboard will display in your chosen language every time you log in.

![Screenshot of the admin language setting](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cC6b&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000lLvkz)   
 

* * *

## Multi-factor authentication

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) adds an additional level of security to your account, and is required for Clever Admin who use a username/password to log in. With MFA, you'll add another factor (such as a text message code or security key) to verify your identity alongside your username/password.

![Clever Admin MFA screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cC6b&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IWhgz)

This extra identity confirmation prevents unauthorized individuals from gaining access to your Clever District Administrator account even if your password is compromised. To learn more about MFA authentication, [read this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I update sync settings?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083526#OV)  
2\. [Auto Sync Settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083526#SS)  
3\. [SFTP Sync Settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083526#SFTP)  
4\. [School year & pause dates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083526#school-year-dates)  
5\. [Sync hold thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083526#holds)

##   
Overview

The [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page is where you can view and edit details pertaining to your Clever data sync. The features and editable fields on your Sync Settings page will vary depending on your sync type.  
 

* * *

## Auto Sync Settings

For Auto Sync districts, the Sync Settings page is where you can:

-   View or edit your SIS URL (make sure that the URL you enter matches the one you use to log into your SIS)
-   View or edit your SIS username
-   Change your SIS Password
-   View your sync schedule and initiate a new sync
-   View default field mappings or request sync customizations
-   [Schedule, adjust, or cancel a sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507)

* * *

## SFTP Sync Settings

For SFTP Sync districts, the Sync Settings page is where you can:

-   View your SFTP credentials to upload data to Clever via [FTP Client](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408)
-   Upload files directly from your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) via the [Web Upload Tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408)
-   Download your district-specific SFTP Instructions (these instructions will automatically update as you continue to add learning applications to your Clever Dashboard - use them to determine which roster data to include in your uploads and [how to format your data files](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867) )
-   [Schedule, adjust, or cancel a sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507)

* * *

## School year & pause dates

Below your SIS Sync Settings, you can also adjust settings based on your school year, including:

-   Share your school year dates with us (so we can best support you throughout the year)
-   [Schedule, adjust, or cancel a sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507)

* * *

## Sync hold thresholds

Finally, at the bottom of the Sync Settings page, you'll see the Sync Hold Thresholds section. When your district's most recent attempted sync will change a significant amount of data in Clever, our system initiates an automatic sync hold. This hold prevents the changes from processing until reviewed and approved by a district admin or by Clever.  
  
You can modify the thresholds that trigger a sync hold to prevent unnecessary holds. To prevent accidental data deletions, we do not allow for disabling delete thresholds completely. Learn more about [sync hold thresholds here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202494358).

title: For Clever Admins: Setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA) for Clever Admin
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#overview)  
2\. [What's MFA?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#mfa)  
3\. [Setting up MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#setup)  
4\. [Adding authentication methods](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#header4)  
5. [Using MFA after setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#header5)  
6. [Viewing MFA activation status](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#mfa_visibility)  
7. [Admin access control](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#access)  
8. [Resetting MFA for admin users from the Team Page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#resetting)  
9. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#faq)

##   
Overview

Clever offers all Clever Admins complimentary multi-factor authentication (MFA) to provide an extra layer of security for admin accounts (Clever Admin, Curriculum Lead, or District Help Desk). This article explains MFA and how to set it up for your Clever account.   
 

IMPORTANT  
Secure logins are required for all Clever Admins, either using multi-factor authentication (MFA) or single sign-on (SSO)  
  
**Why is this required?**  
Login credentials can be subject to malicious attacks, resulting in unauthorized access to personally identifiable information (PII). As a trusted guardian of sensitive data, we want to support you in curbing ever-evolving threats and keeping your logins safe.

* * *

##   
What’s MFA?

MFA is a way to log in to programs that requires you to use two methods (or factors) to prove your identity, like your username and password on your computer and a text message code sent to your phone. You likely already use MFA when signing in to other programs, such as your online bank account.  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you previously set up two-factor authentication in Clever for your admin account using the Authy authentication app or SMS, you can upgrade your authentication method to a more secure choice such as, Google and Microsoft authenticator apps, hardware tokens, and voice messages.

  
Having two methods makes it much harder for someone to hack into your account because they’d need to access to both your username/password _and_ the second method you used to prove your identity. The more protected your account credentials are, the safer your account!  
  
To use MFA, you’ll need to add an **authentication method**, such as a text message, phone call, or push notification to your phone. This second method is how MFA confirms your identity in addition to your username/password.  
 

* * *

##   
Setting up MFA

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you’re an admin trying to set up Clever MFA for your district users (such as teachers and staff), please reference [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001538). 

1.  Go to [Clever](https://schools.clever.com/profile) [Dashboard > Profile](https://schools.clever.com/profile). 
2.  Under the Multi-factor authentication section, click **Activate MFA**. If you previously had set up two-factor authentication (TFA/2FA), click **Upgrade MFA**.
3.  Clever's supported authentication methods will be presented. You can learn more about [authentication options below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#header4).  Choose a method and click **Next step**. 
4.  Follow the instructions to set up the authentication method.
5.  Recommended: If you’d like to add more than one authentication method, click **Set up another method** to add another option. This will enable you to still log in should one of your second methods be unavailable (e.g., you don't have cell service for a text message).
6.  Click **Exit settings**. 

* * *

##   
Adding authentication methods

You must add at least one authentication method to use MFA. Authentication method options are listed below.  
  
Adding at least one other authentication method as a backup method is good practice. This way, if you are not able to use one method for any reason (e.g., your cell phone is not charged, so you can’t receive a text message), you can use a backup method to log in successfully. Having multiple methods saves time by providing multiple options.

 ****![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**** Clever only supports US numbers for SMS and voice calls at this time.

### **Text message (also called SMS)** 

Clever texts a numeric code to a cell phone number you choose. You then type this code into your Clever login screen.  
  
Setup tips:

-   Text messages require cellular service. We do not recommend this authentication method if you do not have reliable cellular service in your work environment. Please consider a [Mobile app.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#app)
-   Be sure you can access your cell phone during the school day. You’ll need the code texted to this number to log in to Clever. 
-   A text message will **not** work for a landline. If you can only access a landline, consider an automated voice phone call.
-   **International phone number support:** if your country code is not currently supported, please use an alternate method.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Why doesn't Clever support email as an authentication method?** You can reset your account password using your email. Using MFA with email would provide a single point of failure: a malicious actor could both reset your password _and_ access your account with your email account.

### **Automated voice phone call** 

Clever sends a numeric code via an automated voice phone call to a number you choose (it can be a landline or cell phone). Then, you type this code into your Clever login screen.  
  
Setup tips:

-   An automated voice call will be sent to the number added, so ensure you can answer the phone and hear the code shared.
-   **International phone number support**: if your country code is not currently supported, please use an alternate method, like a Mobile app. The Mobile app method will work with most time-based one-time password (TOTP) apps.
-   If you need to update the phone number, remove this factor and re-add the factor with the new number.
    -   To remove an authentication method from MFA:  
        1\. Click on **Profile** in the top-right of the Clever Dashboard  ![Screenshot of the admin profile page on Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m0t3)  
        2\. Under Multi-factor authentication, click **Settings**    
        3\. Click on the authentication you would like to remove, click **Remove**, then click **Confirm**  
        4\. When complete, click **Exit settings**

  **Mobile app** 

You install an app on a cell phone that provides you with a numeric code you type into your Clever login screen.  
  
Setup tips:

-   Clever highly recommends using Mobile app as a second factor. **It is highly secure and is available even if you do not have cell service.** This is a great option if you do not have cell service at school.
-   To access this option, you’ll need to install an authenticator app to a cell phone and follow the MFA setup steps in Clever, so be sure you’ll have access to the phone during the school day.
-   To set up the mobile app method, you will need to scan a QR code or use the authenticator key with your time-based one-time password (TOTP) mobile app. See the instructions for your mobile app for scanning QR codes or using authenticator keys.
-   Clever supports one Mobile app configuration per account. Check the instructions for your mobile app to see if you can mirror your configuration across multiple devices. To use a different mobile app or reconfigure on a different device, you must remove the mobile app authentication configuration associated with your current device and re-add mobile app authentication using your new app or device.

   
**Setup steps, Google Authenticator App:**

1.  **On your cell phone**, install the app by searching “Google Authenticator App” in the Google Play Store (Android) or the App Store (Apple). The app icon looks like this:

![Google Authenticator app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000EKN3)

**On your phone**, you can also click the links below to access the download page for the apps:  
[![Google Play store logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TEx5)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.authenticator2&hl=en_US&gl=US&pli=1)    [![Apple App Store logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TExA)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/google-authenticator/id388497605)  

2.  **On your computer**, in the Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Dashboard > Profile](https://schools.clever.com/profile) > MFA > Settings.
3.  Click **Mobile app** and click **Next step.** A QR code will appear. 
4.  **On your cell phone**, open the authenticator app and select _Scan a QR code_. You may need to grant permission for the app to use your phone’s camera.
5.  Using your phone's camera, scan the QR code on the computer screen.
6.  After scanning the code, click **Next step** on your computer.
7.  **On your cell phone**, the app will provide you with a code. **On your computer**, enter this code into the provided space on the MFA setup screen. 
8.  Click **Done**.
9.  Click **Exit Settings**.

After this initial setup, when prompted to use MFA, you won’t need to scan a QR code: you’ll just open the Google Authenticator App and tap on the account you added. You’ll be provided with a numeric code to type into Clever.  
   
    
**Setup steps, Microsoft Authenticator App:**

1.  **On your cell phone**, install the app by searching “Microsoft Authenticator App” in the Google Play Store (Android) or the App Store (Apple). The app icon looks like this:

![Microsoft Authenticator app logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TExF)

**On your phone,** you can also click the links below to access the download page for the apps:

[![Google Play store logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TEx5)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.azure.authenticator)    [![Apple App Store logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TExA)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/microsoft-authenticator/id983156458)  

2.  **On your computer**, in the Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Dashboard > Profile](https://schools.clever.com/profile) > MFA > Settings.
3.  Click **Mobile app** and click **Next step.** A QR code will appear.
4.  **From your phone**, open the authenticator app, and review any user/privacy terms. If prompted to log in, you can press **Skip** in the top right corner (unless you have an account your district has given you directions to log into).
5.  Press the **Add account** button, then **Work or school account**, then select **Scan a QR code**. You may need to grant permission for the app to use your phone’s camera. 
6.  Using your phone's camera, scan the QR code on the computer screen.
7.  After scanning the code, click **Next step** on your computer.
8.  **On your cell phone**, the app will provide you with a code. **On your computer**, enter this code into the provided space on the MFA setup screen. 
9.  Click **Done**.
10.  Click **Exit Settings**.

  
After this initial setup, when prompted to use MFA, you won’t need to scan a QR code: you’ll just open the Microsoft Authenticator App and tap on the account you added. You’ll be provided with a numeric code to type into Clever.  
 

### **Security key** 

A security key (such as a USB device) is used to verify the login.  
  
Setup tips:

-   To access this option, you’ll need a district-provided physical key or an enabled device (such as Touch ID for Macs) each time you need to verify your identity with MFA.
-   You can set up to 4 biometrics or security keys (e.g., TouchID, FaceID, or 2 Yubikeys)

  
Setup steps:

1.  From the MFA setup screen, select **Security Key**_._
2.  You may see a prompt from your computer asking which option you’d like.
3.  Insert your security key into your device (if relevant) and/or place your fingerprint on the sensor.
4.  We’ll verify the security key and that the setup is complete.
5.  Click **Exit settings**.

  
After this initial setup, when prompted to use MFA, you’ll simply plug in your Security key (and touch it to verify fingerprint, if applicable).  
  
 

* * *

## Using MFA after setup

After initial setup, you will receive a prompt for MFA upon every login to Clever.

You can elect to have MFA remember a device for 7 days by clicking the checkmark. You’ll need to select this for each device and each MFA method separately. Remembering a device works when you are timed out or close a tab. Remembering will be reset any time you log out.

![Verify your identity screen with Remember this device for 7 days highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TExK)

Whenever you are required to use MFA, you’ll need access to one of the methods you set up.  
  
If you receive a prompt to use MFA and don't have access to one of your second factors, you won’t be able to access your Clever account. If you have lost access to all MFA authentication methods, please contact Clever Support to request assistance with account recovery.  
  
[Access logs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001698) on your Clever Dashboard show Clever Admin logins, including whether they used MFA and which MFA method they used.   
 

* * *

##   
Viewing MFA activation status 

Once enabled, Clever Admins that have not activated MFA will see the following prompt on their next login:   
  
![Multi-factor authentication setup screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TbQl)  
  
  
The MFA status of any Clever Admin is available at the [User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page. Use this information to contact any Clever Admins who need to activate MFA to keep your Clever account as secure as possible!   
  
You won’t see any status for School Tech Leads on the Team page. If you’d like to add MFA for School Tech Leads, please consider the [Classroom MFA.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616)

  
![Clever Team screen with MFA status highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WJnSS)   
  
 

* * *

##   
Admin access control

To simplify account security, you can choose how users with admin roles should log into Clever.   
From your [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team > Access Control tab](https://schools.clever.com/team/AccessControl), you can select from the following options by clicking **Edit**:  
  
![Screenshot of the Access Control tab on the Team page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000LmHl)

-   **Password login:** 
    -   All admins can log into the Clever Dashboard with a Clever password. If this option is disabled, admin users must use a Clever-supported identity provider (IdP) to access their Clever Dashboard.
    -   Users with the Clever Account Owner role can use a password regardless of whether this setting is disabled and must use MFA.
    -   Examples of a district using Google SSO to access Clever:
        -   **When enabled:** admins can use their email and password to log in at schools.clever.com _or_ can log in using Google at your [district's portal login URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838)
        -   **When disabled:** admins must use Google to log in at your [district's portal login URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838)
-   **MFA with IdP (SSO):**
    -   All admins will not use MFA through Clever when logging in with a Clever-supported IdP to Clever Dashboard.
    -   You can disable MFA through Clever so that admins can log in with a Clever-supported IdP to access their Clever Dashboard.
    -   Examples of a district using Google SSO to access Clever:
        -   **When enabled:** admins will be required to use Clever MFA when accessing Clever using Google at your [district's portal login URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838)
        -   **When disabled:** admins will not be required to use Clever MFA when accessing Clever using Google at your [district's portal login URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838) but may have been required to use Google MFA to access their Google accounts. Having MFA enabled on Google accounts is strongly recommended in this setup.

* * *

##   
Resetting MFA for admin users from the Team Page

Clever Admins can reset the MFA settings for other admin user types, including Clever Admins, District Help Desk, and District Curriculum Leads. For security, the Clever Admin Owner account MFA settings can only be reset by contacting Clever Support. We strongly encourage Clever Admin Owners to set up multiple methods to provide backup access if their primary method becomes unavailable. [See FAQ](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333#faq): "What are some good complementary methods to set up to provide a back-up access method for yourself?"  
  
When MFA settings are reset, the user will be instructed to reconfigure their MFA settings the next time they log into the account.  
  
**How to reset MFA for another admin**

On the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page select the **Reset MFA** link for the admin user to reset. Confirm that you would like to reset all of their MFA configurations allowing them to reconfigure on their next login.  
  
![Action > Reset MFA settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000atsP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WPv77)    
 

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions

**If I’m having trouble getting set up with MFA, who do I contact?**

-   Please contact Clever Support

  
**How do I reset MFA for Clever Admin?**

-   Another Clever Admin at your district can reset the MFA settings for admin users other than the Owner. [See this section for instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333#resetting). If the Clever Admin Owner needs to reset their MFA, please contact Clever Support. We strongly encourage Clever Admin Owner users to set up multiple methods to provide back-up access if their primary method becomes unavailable. See FAQ: "What are some good complementary methods to set up to provide a back-up access method for yourself?"

  
**How does MFA for Clever Admin work if I have a teacher/staff _and_ Clever Admin role?**

-   When you go to log in, you'll be presented with a role picker. If you chose your teacher/staff account, you won't be prompted with MFA. If you chose Clever Admin, you'll be prompted with MFA (if you have it set up). 

  
**What are some good complementary methods to set up to provide a back-up access method for yourself?**

-   Complementary methods that make good back-ups use different devices. For example setting up both voice phone call and text message to the same mobile device won’t provide a good back-up if your phone is unavailable. If possible try combining methods across 2 or more devices. Some device options to consider when choosing 2 or more:
    -   **Landline phone**: if you work out of an office with a landline, consider setting up automated voice phone call on your landline
    -   **Mobile phone**: choose between
        -   Text message
        -   Mobile app
    -   **Computer**: choose between
        -   Mobile app: you can use the Mobile app setup to add any TOTP-based authentication application, many of which have desktop versions.
        -   Security key: you can use either a USB device or a biometric sensor built into your device for this method

  
**How do I change my default method?**

-   When asked to verify your identity on the MFA entry screen while logging in, choose **Change MFA method**. MFA will default to the most recently used method on the next login.

**What if I receive an error when attempting login with my second factor (ex: "cannot perform security key authentication")?**

-   Please follow our [instructions above](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202062333#resetting) to have another administrator reset your MFA. Once reset, you can reconfigure your second factor, and the issue should resolve. If not, please contact Clever Support for further assistance.
