title: Impersonating or creating users for demos, training, and troubleshooting
text:
The **Access Portal As tool is not for troubleshooting logins to Clever**. For information on troubleshooting logins to Clever, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202113063). This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146#Overview) 2\. [Which user types can impersonate another user?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146#Impersonation) 3\. [Instructions to impersonate a real user](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146#Instructionstoimpersonate) 4\. [Instructions to create a demo user](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146#demouser) 5\. [Extra Credit: Clever Academy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146#Extra) ## Overview School and district teams often need to see the Clever Portal from a student, teacher, staff, or other administrative perspective for troubleshooting, demos, or training. Clever’s impersonation tools let administrators and STLs access the Portal of a user to investigate issues or confirm what a user should see. Impersonation permissions vary based on your Clever account type. For training or demo needs where accessing an actual account isn’t necessary, districts can instead create demo users via custom data. These accounts offer a safe way to explore features, test configurations, or model workflows without touching real data. Together, impersonation and demo accounts give organizations flexible, secure options for support and training. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BAN)**Please note:** Administrators who are [Clever Admins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) or [District Help Desk](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207803) roles, and [School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663) can use this tool. School Tech Leads only have access to Teacher Portals and can't sign in as students. * * * ## Which user types can impersonate another user? Please reference the table below for more information on which user types and impersonate other users. The only role that can impersonate all other roles by default is the Clever Admin Owner. Additional impersonation permissions can be assigned via [Custom Roles.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702)

User type

Can impersonate into

 

 Clever Admin OwnerClever Admin Non-Owner District Help Desk District Curriculum Lead School Tech Lead 
Clever Admins By default, view-only With custom role, view-only With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only   
District Help Desk By default, view-only  With custom role, view-only With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only  
District Curriculum Lead By default, view-only  With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only 
School Tech Lead By default, view-only With custom role, view-only   With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only 
Portal-only staff By default  With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only  With custom role, view-only 
Teachers By default By default By default With custom role, view-only  If turned on for their school organization
StudentsBy defaultBy defaultBy default With custom role, view-only
* * * ## Instructions to impersonate a real user ### **Impersonating students, teachers, and Portal-only staff** If you’d like to impersonate a student, teacher, or Portal-only staff, there are two ways to do so: 1. Search for the user using the search bar at the top of your Clever Dashboard. From the drop-down, hover over the user and select the **Portal as user** button. ![Screenshot of the search bar, Portal as user steps](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XhmRN)  2. Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser), locate the user, and click their name to navigate to their profile page. Once on their profile page, click the **Support Tools** button and select **Access Portal as user** to access the user's portal. ![Profile Access Portal as user steps](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XhKIE)  With either option, you'll start the Portal session on the next screen. Once in the user’s Portal, you can access any of their connected applications and use any tools to which the user has access. When you’re done, remember to log out of any applications you’ve accessed and select **End Portal session**. ![End Portal session](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XhXfH) ### **Impersonating Clever Admins, District Curriculum Leads, District Help Desk, STLs, and custom admin roles** You can also impersonate a Clever Admin, District Curriculum Lead, District Help Desk, STL, or administrator with a custom role. When impersonating these user types, you’ll have view-only access to their account (both the Clever Dashboard and Portal) and won’t be able to make changes. To impersonate one of these user types: 1\. Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page. 2\. Select the **Actions** button, and choose **Access Portal as user.** The user will receive an email notification that an admin has accessed their account. ![Admin Team page with Actions > Access Portal as user drop down](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XhaoR) If you want STLs in your school organization to have the ability to view teacher accounts for training and troubleshooting, view [this help center article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360047079271).  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BAh)**Please note:** The browsers that support this feature are Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.    * * * ## Instructions to create a demo user If you'd like to create a brand new demo user, so you can use the account without accessing or modifying an actual user's account (like building a Teacher Page), you can create a fake teacher, student, or staff user using Clever's custom data feature. This can also be used if you’d like to preview [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) to see what the login experience would look like for a particular user type. You can learn how to create a [custom teacher here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020051691#manual), a [custom student here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360029599131#individual), and a [staff user here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) Once you've created a user account, you can log in to the account via the credentials you set when creating the custom user. Just be sure to use the student login screen (Clever.com/in/your-district-url), and not the [District Admin login screen](https://clever.com/oauth/district_admin/login?target=%3BNGM2M2MxY2Y2MjNkY2U4MmNhYWM%3D%3BaHR0cHM6Ly9jbGV2ZXIuY29tL2luL2F1dGhfY2FsbGJhY2s%3D%3BMjBmYmFiODhjYzdkZTJlZjU3Njk2YmMyZDRjMDA3N2JhZWJhNDNlNjQ0ZTgyNzcyNzIxZDY4ZDQ4NmRlYTM1NQ%3D%3D%3BY29kZQ%3D%3D%3BZGlzdHJpY3RfYWRtaW4%3D). * * * ## Extra Credit: Clever Academy ![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UDCj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZA9a)If you want to learn more about the Student and Teacher Portal features you can view teacher training content in [Clever Academy.](https://clever.academy/quick-start-teachers?user_type=district_admin)

title: For School Tech Leads: Clever Academy - Learn more about Clever!
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045116211#Overview)  
2\. [How can teachers access the Clever Academy?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045116211#AccessCleverAcademy)  
3. [How can I view my courses or certifications?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045116211#viewcourses)

## Overview

Clever Academy is our free online training and certification program for educators. You can access it through your Clever Portal or at [https://clever.academy](https://skilljar-auth.clever.com/?SAMLRequest=fZJLc9owFIX3%2FAqP934pQIoGmHGhD2YoeALpopvOtXRJ1MoS1ZVp%2Bfe1HGiSReOdpXPOPfezpwSNPvKy9Y%2FmDn%2B1SH4QRX8abYj3V7O4dYZbIEXcQIPEveC78suaszTnR2e9FVbHr0xve4AInVfWBNNqOYu3mw%2Fr7afV5jsUE1kX9fg2HzM5rCeAkxrGOHw3HOeATLARO8gCR8H4FR11GbO4iwzvUVQ5e1IS3aabOIt3P5XWP8BFC9s6wqjS4A%2FWNf1QohZXhjwY3wXkLE8KlhTFPr%2FhN4yz%2FFtQLTsWyoDvpzx6fySeZXSJTaAjlgqNJ3SpsH1sdYHxXhmpzMPbFOonEfHP%2B32VVNvdPkSUVzYLa6ht0O3QnZTA%2B7v1cwcQwrbGU3otEwpkoVAW6GfsQRZ%2BdGom%2BS2dOzXF8x7QNNzyfnk3v4ZdVgABEptzNs1eip5tRx6wrpaV1Uqc%2B%2FPwfOyIgv%2F%2FpkVa9CdKJodeyrEBpUspHRLF%2F3JKre3vhUPw3afzrsU4yuaDwVOb17%2Fn%2FC8%3D&RelayState=%2Fauth%2Fendpoint%2Flogin%2Fresult%3Fd%3D2gd1t5vm907sy%26next%3D%252F&SigAlg=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2F09%2Fxmldsig%23rsa-sha1&Signature=BGxs9BWTK0qw%2FNRT9MKcpGjnERTZ5HyYrqCyTn2IZMJppdrOL6stW%2BOYh1D1Wk94JzuKLAfK0BR4%2B5i4pcTWPfUJnjk%2BtUtvlHVlkQpIiLOe71Yf1t7Xjxk6joVWrKKKjyXW1P%2BXQBp1kWgdF60i47%2FdoGSDz6tvUhBB%2FD5kuks%3D). Go through all the courses and after successful completion, you’ll become a certified Clever Champion.  
  
**NOTE:** You must begin at Level 1, though you can test out of courses if you have the prerequisite knowledge.  
 

## 

### Course outline:

[Level 1: Getting started with Clever](https://clever.academy/welcome-to-clever?user_type=school_admin)  
In this first course, you’ll get an overview of what Clever is and how it can your and teachers’ lives easier!  
  
Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 1. This course is a prerequisite to Level 2 and beyond.

[Level 2: Learning the basics](https://clever.academy/2-getting-started-learn-the-basics?user_type=school_admin)  
Clever’s your school's one-stop shop for digital learning. Get the lowdown on portal features, and start to customize your school's portal.  
  
Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 2. This course is a prerequisite to Level 3 and beyond.

[Level 3: Setting your district up for success](https://clever.academy/3-setting-your-district-up-for-success?user_type=school_admin)  
STL tools are your secret weapon for support teachers and students! Dig into analytic data, training teachers, and troubleshooting tech issues!  
  
Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 3. This course is a prerequisite to Level 4 and beyond.

[Level 4: Becoming a Clever Champion](https://clever.academy/4-becoming-a-clever-champion?user_type=school_admin)  
Become a Clever Champion. Learn how to use your STL powers to support every aspect of digital learning at your school.   
  
Complete this course and you’ll be a certified Clever Champion Admin!

* * *

## How can I access Clever Academy?

Staff and School Tech Leads can access the Clever Academy by logging into the Clever Portal with their district-specific URL or directly going to [https://clever.academy](https://clever.academy/). 

* * *

## How can I view my courses or certifications?

You can see the courses you've registered for or completed at any time by navigating to [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/), clicking person icon in the top right, and selecting My Profile. From here, you'll see a list of all your learning paths and courses. Any course with a certification that you've completed will have a **View certificate** link next to it. Click the link to view the certificate, and then print it if you'd like! Certificates are valid for two years.  If it has been more than two years since you completed a course, you would need to re-take the course to become re-certified.

title: For Clever Admins: How do I browse and search data in Clever with the Data Browser or Search Bar?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068#one)  
2. [Using the Search Bar](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068#two)  
3. [Using the Data Browser](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068#three)  
4. [Searching with filters in the Data Browser](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068#four)  
5\. [Exporting data via the Data Browser](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068#five)  
6. [What data is shared with connected applications?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068#six)

##   
Overview

Clever Admins have two ways to review their school organization's SIS rostering data in Clever. The first method is the search bar at the top of the page from the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to quickly find a specific school, student, teacher, section, staff member, another admin team member, or application in Clever.  
  
The second method is the Data Browser. Clever Admins can use the Data Browser to view and filter the rostering data (schools.csv, teachers.csv, students.csv, sections.csv, and staff.csv) currently in Clever. This includes both custom data and data synced by your school organization's student information system (SIS). Clever Admins can access the Data Browser from the left menu sidebar in the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).

* * *

## Using the Search Bar

The first method for locating data or applications in your Clever account is utilizing the Search Bar at the top of your Clever Dashboard.

Begin typing in the Search Bar, and all possible related content will appear:

![Search bar displaying the search for "Sarah"](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d953&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfdVF)    
  
 Use the icons below the search bar to filter your results further. For example, if we only want students with the name “Sarah” to appear in our results, we can click the **Student** filter icon, and our search results will narrow to just students:

![Using Search Bar filters](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d953&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Mh8kB)

You can also take actions such as viewing their profile for more information, accessing the user’s Portal, or resetting their MFA method directly from the Search Bar by clicking the user to view a dropdown menu.

![Search bar actions](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d953&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000MhYg5)

Actions you can take directly from the Search Bar will vary based on the user type or application you are viewing, as well as settings configured for that particular user type, but may include:

-   Viewing a user’s profile in the Clever Dashboard
    
-   Accessing the user’s Portal
    
-   Resetting a password
    
-   Updating a staff role from Portal Access Only to School Tech Lead
    
-   Editing an admin team member
    
-   Editing application sharing
    
-   Requesting an application
    

In addition to viewing search results and taking actions directly from the Search Bar, you can also navigate to a full page of search results by selecting the **See all X results** text at the bottom of your search.

![See all X results button in Search Bar](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d953&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Pfe9Z)

This option will bring you to a full page of search results, on which you can filter by data type and take actions similar to those within the Search Bar. The full-page results will allow you to review your search results more completely.

![Full page search results](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d953&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PfeMT)

_An example of a full page for search results._

* * *

## Using the Data Browser

The second method for viewing your school organization's information in Clever is to navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser).  
  
Once in the Data Browser, select the appropriate data tab at the top of the page to view schools, students, teachers, staff, sections, terms, courses, or contacts.

After you've selected a tab, you can see context about each record, including:

-   **Data source:** This is where the data came from, such as your SIS, a custom data upload, Active Directory, etc. 
-   **Last Modified:** The last time the record was changed or updated.

![Data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d953&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EDINF)

* * *

## Searching with filters in the Data Browser

You can drill down further by clicking **Add Filter** to search for specific records using one or more filters. Once the list populates, click the name of a record to view the record's associated details.

Filters and hyperlinks allow you to easily review the data in Clever. From the appropriate tab, use the filter feature to search for specific records. Then, narrow your search results by adding additional filters. Finally, click the record name to open the user or record's details window.    
  
There are additional features available to Clever Admins from the user or record's details card. For example:

-   Voiding or generating Clever Badges for students (if enabled at your school organization).
-   Navigating to a user or record's profile page in Clever.
-   Impersonating users to access their Clever Portal(s).
-   Troubleshooting login issues

* * *

## Exporting data via the Data Browser

You can easily export data from the data browser by clicking the **Export** button in the top right. The records will be emailed to the email address associated with your Clever account. 

* * *

## What data is shared with connected applications?

Clever Admins can determine which data is shared with the school organization's connected applications by [setting their sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247). The Data Browser and Search Bar surface the school organization's entire set of rostering data in Clever, but not everything that is visible in Clever is necessarily shared with every application. 

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Sharing Permissions: Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: Apps - Data access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000501586?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: How do I view a user's Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000406146?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I use the Clever Dashboard?
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043093#one) 2. [Clever Dashboard sidebar](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043093#two) 3\. [Clever Dashboard homepage](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043093#three)           •   [How to utilize the Applications area of your homepage](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043093#Applicationsarea) 4\. [Finding more information on Clever’s features, products, and tools](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043093#four) 5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043093#FAQs) ## Overview [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) is where Clever admins can review the status of their sync, manage their applications, view district data, configure Clever Identity Management (IDM), Classroom Multi-factor Authentication (MFA), make necessary adjustments to their account, and more. In Fall 2025, the Clever team reorganized the sidebar to simplify the location of tools you use every day. While we understand that change can be difficult, the new navigation groups tools into similar categories, making them easier to locate. Below, we’ve included a handy guide to help you navigate the updates. Additionally, the Clever home page also has a new, more modernized look! Consider the new Dashboard Homepage your Clever command center. You’ll still be able to access the same information previously found on your home page, in addition to new status features that enable you to assess at-a-glance how your Clever account is performing. Learn more below. * * * ## Clever Dashboard sidebar Below, you can compare the previous sidebar to the updated sidebar, as well as find a table that maps the previous location of features, tools, and products to their updated locations.   ![Comparison of old & new sidebars](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000U0OM1)

* * * ## Clever Dashboard homepage Previously, Clever’s homepage included an overview of your sync, task notifications, and a list of your applications: ![Pre-Fall 2025 homepage](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000U0Pl7) With the **updated homepage**, you’ll still see this information, along with additional status cards that provide more information on the tools you’re using in Clever. This includes: - An updated sync report with more insights into sync changes. - An overview of user logins, allowing you to quickly verify if logins are operating successfully. - A quick summary of applications you’re sharing data with, apps that you still need to set up sharing for, and pending app invites, as well as the ability to pin important applications to your home page. Learn more below. - Task notifications to guide you on the next steps to take with your Clever account. The new homepage is customized based on the features you’re using in Clever. Below is an example homepage, although yours may look different: ![Clever's updated homepage](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000U0PoL) ### How to utilize the applications area of your homepage In the image above, you’ll notice that the **Applications** area of the home page contains a lot of valuable information about your applications. There’s a concise overview of the number of applications you’re currently sharing data with, pending application invites, and apps with no data shared. Your top six applications with the most users shared will appear by default, but you can also pin applications you’re interested in keeping an eye on. Additional actions you can take from the Applications box include: - Clicking the icon above your pending app invites or apps without data shared will navigate to that application and complete the setup. - Click **View all** to navigate to your [My Applications page](https://schools.clever.com/applications). - Click the pin icon in the top right corner to select applications to pin in this area. Applications you pin are unique to you. Pinning applications can help you keep track of the application usage you’re most interested in for your schools. If you’d like to change the order of your pinned applications, please delete the app from your pins and re-add it. * * * ## Finding more information on Clever’s features, products, and tools Browse the articles linked below to learn more about the various features, tools, and products you can find in your Clever Dashboard. ###  Dashboard Home - Select the 'Dashboard Home' option to access your account overview page including district-wide app details, the latest sync information, and Clever updates. ### Applications - Select **My applications** to view all your connected apps; select a specific application to view its [data warnings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083) and [set sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).  - Select **Add applications** to [add a new application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997). - Select **LMS Connect** to configure your [Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001609) setup or review settings. - Select **Teacher installs** to view the apps teachers have added via [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471). - Select **Library Settings** to determine how your district will manage sharing data from [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471). ### Data sources - Select SIS sync to view settings for the sync with your student information system and data created in Clever via the sync with your SIS. - Select [Custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332) to manually create custom data that is not synced to Clever by your SIS. ### Data browser - Select [Data browser](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202483068) to [view all your district's data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202483068) being synced to Clever. ### User management - Select **IDM** to set up or review your configuration for [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466), including reviewing recent syncs. - Select [License manager](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001707) to manage any paid licenses for Google. - Select **Admin team** to manage your [team settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038) and add [Clever admins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218547498)! ### Authentication - Select [Access logs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001698) to view users' single sign-on (SSO) attempts into your Portal.  - Select **SSO settings** to [set up how your users log into Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938). - Select **Badges** to configure student Badges for your district students. With [Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), students can log in to Clever by holding up a physical Badge to the computer's webcam instead of typing in credentials! - Select [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) to configure your Classroom MFA setup or review and edit user policies. ### Portal - Select **Organize district Portal** to view and make changes to your district's Clever Portal.  - Select **Portal settings** to edit your district's unique [Portal URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838), configure [Substitute Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001675), setup your [Digital Learning Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001711), or configure [Teacher Page Settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001723). - Select **Communication** to [create notifications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025690932) for district users in Clever, or to manage your email communications from Clever. ### Support Tools - Select [Data quality](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083) to view application [data warnings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083). - The [Troubleshoot Login tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001477) is the perfect utility for quickly identifying root cause issues of login errors and missing icons in the portal. - The [Troubleshoot Sharing tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001477) is great for identifying why or why not a user is shared with an application. ### Analytics - Check out [Edtech Analytics](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039420391) to see all of your school organization's app usage in one place down to the school and grade level - whether or not the apps are integrated with Clever. For school-scoped admins, this data will automatically filter to your assigned schools. - Using [Portal Analytics](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005292523?language=en_US), you can see graphs and statistics that show how many users are accessing their resources, how often they log in, and which schools or apps are being used the most! For school-scoped admins, this data will automatically filter to your assigned schools. - Select [Reports](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311) to view downloadable usage data that can also be shared with your data warehouse via SFTP.  ### Billing - Select **Billing** to review details of any Clever purchases you have made such as Clever IDM or Classroom MFA subscriptions, premium support, or trainings and consultings. ### Training & Support - Clever Academy is our free online training and certification program for educators. Admins can access it through the District Dashboard and teachers can access it through their Clever Portal. Alternatively, users can go directly to Clever Academy here: [https://clever.academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin). See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360023043372) for more details! - We also offer [personalized, paid training](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/article/000001511). - Our Support team is available to support you if you need help. Submit a ticket here. * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Why was my Clever homepage updated?** - To provide you with additional information on the status of your Clever account and the features and tools you are using in Clever. **Why was my Clever sidebar updated?** - To simplify and streamline the access to tools and features in Clever. **Were any features removed from my Clever Dashboard?** - No. All features and tools are still accessible in your Clever Dashboard. If you need the Clever Admin Checklist, you can find it in [Clever Academy here.](https://clever.academy/admin-checklist?user_type=district_admin) **Can I revert either my homepage or my sidebar to the previous version?** - No. The reorganization of the sidebar and homepage can’t be reversed. * * *

title: For Clever Admins: How do I access Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206214398#h_36843206-d177-4cf3-95ee-a500f804dcf8)  
2. [District Admin Owner](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206214398#h_d2cf4db8-e3dd-454a-a9e1-f04016b1ce29)  
3. [Accessing the Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206214398#h_de6c366c-4ce1-474a-8ddd-0220f4b54c98)  
4. [Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206214398#h_860208a6-859b-4301-a6ba-156b10c8e7e3)

## ![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002J4z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TX2E)![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002J4z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TX2J)![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002J4z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TX2O) Overview

District admins can access the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) by going to the Clever login page ([https://schools.clever.com](https://schools.clever.com/)) and entering your email address and the password you set when you signed up for Clever. Once here, District admins do the following in Clever:

-   Manage the flow of data from their student information system (SIS) to Clever to their district’s connected applications
-   Modify account settings for the whole district, such as the [sync settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202083526) between the SIS and Clever, [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) with connected applications, and single sign-on (SSO) credentials
-   Use [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807) to access learning applications as a district admin

## District Admin Owner

If you were the one to sign up for Clever for your district, congratulations, you are the "owner" of the account! This means you are the first Clever district admin. The owner of the account can add new district admins, and any administrator can add new school admins. For more information on how to add new admins, please see [this article on how to manage your team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038).

## Accessing the Clever Dashboard

The [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) is where you can manage your district's data and account settings. You can access the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) by going to the Clever login page ([https://schools.clever.com](https://schools.clever.com/)) and entering your email address and the password you set when you signed up for Clever, or when you were added to your district’s account. [Read this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043093) to learn how to use the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002J4z&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B8W)

## Logging in to Clever

The Clever Portal is where users in your district access connected applications. To access your Clever applications as a district admin, you’ll use a [customized portal URL](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205818838) for your district that your students and teachers will use to access the Clever Portal. Usually, this URL follow the format: <**clever.com/in/<district shortname**\>. Once there, you have two options for accessing the Portal:

-   **Log in with your** [Identity Provider (IDP)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787) **credentials**
    -   If your single sign-on (SSO) setup is configured to allow for district admin access (e.g. your Google Apps email address is the same as your district admin email address), you can use the ‘Log In’ button on this screen to sign in to the Clever portal. Please note that for some IDPs this may take some custom configuration.
-   **Log in with your Clever credentials**
    -   Admins can also log in using the ‘Log in as a district admin’ link at the bottom of the page. This will allow you to use the same username and password you use to access the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to access your applications. If you ever need to update your email or password, you can do so in the top right-hand corner of your account and click [_Profile_](https://schools.clever.com/profile). From here you will select _Edit_ under Account Information to update your credentials.

If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Custom Formulas
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035539131#Header1) 2\. [Field names](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035539131#Header2) 3\. [Operations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035539131#Header3) ## Overview Districts can use our tool for manipulating SIS synced data to match the usernames/passwords that have been created outside of Clever for SSO (Saved Passwords) apps. This article will help if you have set up the SSO (Saved Passwords) Formula Type to be **Custom Formula.**  By combining the field names and operations below, you should be able to create a credential format that will work for your district.   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001PPN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B5h)   * * * ## Field names **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Copy these field names from this article and directly paste them into the formula box in the Saved Passwords settings on the district dashboard. {{credentials.district\_username}} = username from SIS feed {{credentials.district\_password}} = password from SIS feed {{name.first}} = first name from SIS feed {{name.last}} = last name from SIS feed {{email}} = email from SIS feed {{student\_number}} = student number from SIS feed {{\_id}} = Clever ID  {{sis\_id}} = SIS ID {{graduation\_year}} = graduation year in whatever format the district syncs it {{dob}} = birthday from SIS feed **Extension Fields** [Extension fields](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) can also be used for custom formulas. The name of the extension should match the name of the field uploaded to Clever.  {{ext.extension\_field\_name}} For example, to use the field listed in the image below, the formula field name would be: {{ext.other\_id}} ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001PPN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Z929) * * * ## Operations The following operations are supported:  

Operation

Description

Example

Plain TextIf a district has the same username or password for all of their users, just type that in the box. 

Example: Password for all users is apple.
Type in: apple

 

 

FieldsInsert the whole contents of a field in Clever

Example: Password for all users is their student_number.
Type in: {{student_number}}

 

substringIf you want just a portion of a field, but not the whole thing

Example: Username contains the last two digits of a students’ birth year.
Type in: {{substr dob 2 2}}

The “2 2” means start in after the second character, and grab the next 2 digits (i.e. in 2018 start after "0" and grab "18").

 

Another example: Username contains first or last initial:

{{substr name.first 0 1}} or {{substr name.last 0 1}} 


 

ifAssign a different template based on whether a condition is met (Similar to the Excel / Google Sheets "if" formula)

Example: One school with Clever ID “596e5bd20a932cd57c000032” should have password “Cats”, all others should use password “Dogs”.
Type in:
{{if equals school "596e5bd20a932cd57c000032" "Cats" "Dogs"}}


 

formatDateReformat something that’s coming into Clever as a dateExample: Student Birthday is coming in in format: “2003-02-11T00:00:00Z”, we want it to be “MMDDYYYY”.
Type in: {{formatDate dob "MMDDYYYY"}}

More formats available here.
 
toUpperMakes things upper-caseExample: Student password is their first name in all caps.
Type in: {{toUpper name.first}}
toLowerMakes things lower-caseExample: Student password is their last name, all lower-case. Type in: 
{{toLower name.last}}
textBefore:Grab everything before a specific valueExample: Student username is their email without the domain.
Type in: {{textBefore email "@"}}
replace

Replace all instances of one string with another string.

Example: Remove hyphens from last name
Type in: Type in:
    {{replace name.last "-" ""}}

"" = no character

" " = space

Operations may be used together. For example:  If you wanted the first letter of first name lower case, type in: {{toLower substr name.first 0 1}}

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: School-Specific Login URLs for ThinkCentral
text:
The ThinkCentral [Saved Passwords application](https://support.clever.com/s/article/234746488) requires different login URLs for each school you'd like to use it with. Here's a quick guide (using Chrome) to finding the URLs for your schools:

1\. Go to the ThinkCentral login page at [https://www-k6.thinkcentral.com/ePC/start.do](https://www-k6.thinkcentral.com/ePC/start.do)

2\. Enter your State and District from the dropdown menus:

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiIb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BXA4)

3\. Once your State and District are selected, right click on the 'School' dropdown menu and click 'Inspect' (or 'Inspect Element' on Firefox):     

      ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiIb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B6k)      

4\. A box will open at the bottom of the page. Click the arrow on the left of highlighted bar. A list of your district's schools will appear: 

          ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiIb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B6p)

5\. Take note of the 8-digit values for each school. The login URL for each school should be [https://www-k6.thinkcentral.com/ePC/start.do?orgID=](https://www-k6.thinkcentral.com/ePC/start.do?orgID=) _plus the 8 digit school code._

-   For example, if a school's code is 01234567, then the login URL for that school is [https://www-k6.thinkcentral.com/ePC/start.do?orgID=01234567](https://www-k6.thinkcentral.com/ePC/start.do?orgID=01234567).
-   You can use the school URLs from this process in your [credential uploads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187) for ThinkCentral.

title: SSO (Saved Passwords): Converting external link apps to Saved Passwords apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002016328#h_eee83ada-24f1-40e3-b83e-309e87c22cd3)  
2. [Instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002016328#h_c251ba87-f81b-41b9-a1ec-43bca0eb3e86)

## Overview

So you're ready to start using [Saved Passwords applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488) in your Clever Portal! You've [installed the Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360019869511) for all of your students, added the apps you want in your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), and tested them out to make sure everything's working like a charm.  
 

But, if you're like many districts, you've already created [custom links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568) for some of the applications in your portal. How do you make a seamless transition from those links to the new, shiny Saved Passwords applications?

##   
Instructions

1.  See who the link is shared with by going to your portal and clicking edit on the relevant link:   
      
    ![Modify Link screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ti8v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aq7s)
2.  Add the app you'd like to change from a link to an app at [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add). Click _Request App._ Set up the sharing rules, and [set the credentials for the app if an SSO (Saved Passwords) app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488) .  
      
    ![Add app page with IXL shown, with highlight on Request app link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ti8v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aq8b)
3.  Delete the link you replaced as an app in your Clever Portal by going to [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Organize district Portal,](https://schools.clever.com/portal/customize) clicking the three vertical dots next to the link, select **Edit link,** then select **Remove link** from the modal.  
    ![Modify Link screen with Remove Link highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ti8v&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WxzZi) 

  
Just like that, you've replaced your custom link with a Saved Passwords application! If you'd like to make your users' experience even more seamless, you can [bulk upload their credentials](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187) so they don't even have to type them in the first time they use the application.

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Testing and Piloting
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001921227#h_ffa7d284-f8c1-4546-93c7-c9be657f356d)  
2\. [Testing functionality for different users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001921227#h_e86b6f51-d6ed-4389-a34b-569f6daa37be)  
3\. [Testing successful logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001921227#h_635d19de-a98b-4b78-9596-412d9d2f7fcc)  
4\. [Testing unsuccessful logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001921227#h_c2c483e7-6290-45fb-aed4-3753764c0015)  
5. [If anything goes wrong...](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001921227#h_035f3120-9247-425d-989a-fa91c27c5e85)  
6. [If everything goes right...](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001921227#h_48b2129e-68f5-424b-a8fa-c129f5365ac9)

## Overview

Before you roll out a new Saved Passwords application to all users in your district, we recommend testing a few logins. In most cases, users will need to enter their login credentials the very first time they access the application but will be automatically logged in via single sign-on (SSO) each time thereafter.  
 

For devices other than iOS, please make sure that you are using a Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, or Internet Explorer (2013 or later) browser, and have the [Clever browser extension installed](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511?language=en_US).  For iOS devices, you will need to use the Clever app as it functions as the Clever browser extension for Saved Passwords apps. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiKD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Az6) _Visit these articles for details about the_ [Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511?language=en_US)_,_ [Saved Passwords apps on iOS devices](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360033063711?language=en_US)_, or_ [managing user credentials](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187?language=en_US)_!_

##   
Testing functionality for different users

To ensure students and teachers are being logged into the app successfully, you'll need credentials from both user types for Clever Portal and the Saved Passwords application you are testing.  
 

Before testing, it is important to make sure the users are [shared with the application](https://support.clever.com/s/article/203115007) and have the app icon in their Clever Portals. To do this, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page, and click on the application name to open the app overview page.  Confirm the users you are testing are shared with the application via the **Select Users** tab.  
 

## Testing successful logins

From your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), use the **[Access Portal as](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360000406146)** feature to log in as a student or teacher. Click on the app icon and enter the **correct** credentials for the application. Once you click **Save Login** you should be brought to the application website and successfully logged in.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiKD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B58)**Clever Tip:** _If the application has different login URLs for each school, make sure to test a few different student and teacher accounts to make sure they all work as expected. If you are unsure how to set up school-specific login URLs, please contact_ [Clever Support!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)

##   
Testing unsuccessful logins

You'll also want to make sure you know what to do when things go wrong! To test what happens when a user is logged in unsuccessfully, use the **[Access Portal as](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360000406146)** feature to log in as a student or teacher. Click on the app icon and enter the **wrong** credentials. You should see a page that looks like this:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiKD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B5D)

Enter the correct credentials, and select **Update & Log in** to reset the user's credentials. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiKD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028B5N) _If you have any issues updating the credentials, or if you need additional instructions on troubleshooting logins, please visit [this article!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234759108)_

##   
If anything goes wrong...

If any of the tests above don't go as expected, [let us know](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We're always looking for ways to improve our Saved Passwords application integrations, so your feedback is very much appreciated. As always, any screenshots you can provide will make the troubleshooting process that much easier.

## If everything goes right...

If the tests above work as expected, we recommend piloting the Saved Passwords application with a subset of students and teachers before rolling it out to the entire district. Here are a few quick steps for creating a successful Saved Passwords pilot:  
 

1.  First, you'll want to complete the steps above to ensure users are being logged into the Saved Passwords app successfully. If you run into any issues you can [submit a ticket](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) to our support team.
2.  Choose a few classrooms to pilot the Saved Passwords application. We recommend choosing classes with students who are old enough to log into the application easily outside of Clever in case of any hiccups.
3.  Provide them with login instructions, and allow them to test from their Clever Portals to ensure they are logged into the app successfully.

You can find more information about SSO (Saved Passwords) applications [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US).

title: Clever Roles: Clever Admin
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Overview)  
2. [Clever Account Owner](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Clever%20Account%20Owner)  
3. [Transferring Ownership to a new Account Owner](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Transferownership)  
4. [Adding Clever Admins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Adding%20Clever%20Admins)  
5\. [Logging in as a Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Logging%20in%20as%20a%20Clever%20Admin)  
6. [Removing or Updating Clever Admins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Removing%20Clever%20Admins)  
7\. [Switching between user accounts if you have multiple accounts in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#switchingaccounts)

## Overview

School organizations can provide multiple team members with **Clever Admin** access to assist with account management. Users who are assigned the Clever Admin role, will have account-wide access with varying permissions. This article will explain how to manage team members from [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page, but you can also manage individual admin accounts via their profile page if they were manually created in your Clever Dashboard.

![An admin’s profile page in Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nF3ZG)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** By default, only Clever Admin owners can impersonate other Clever Admins and STLs via the **Access Portal as** feature. Impersonation permissions for other Clever Admins can be can be granted via [custom roles.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702#header5) Learn more about [impersonation permissions here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000406146).

* * *

##   
Clever Account Owner

Each Clever Portal has a single account owner. The owner is indicated by the word (Owner) following their name on the [Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team) page.  
    
![Team page with highlight on the owner of the account](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004apLy)  
  
The account owner’s name and email address are shared with applications connected to the district’s or school's Clever account and, therefore, they are the primary point of contact for all Clever-related issues.

The owner has unique privileges that are unavailable to Clever Admins which include the ability to:

-   Transfer account ownership to another Clever Admin 
-   Delete the Clever account

With the exception of the above privileges, all Clever Admins have equal permissions to view or modify the district Portal.  This includes adding or removing applications, updating sharing permissions, managing Badges, and much more!   
 

* * *

##   
Transferring ownership to a new Account Owner

Each Clever account may have only one owner at a time, and only the current owner can transfer the role to another team member. If you do not see the option to **Change Account Owner**, then you are not the account owner.  
  
The current Account Owner can transfer ownership to another Clever Admin by clicking the **Actions** button and selecting **Change account owner** in the dropdown from the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team page.](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) This option will only be available if there are other Clever Admins on the Clever account. Once ownership is transferred, the options to add/remove Clever Admins or transfer ownership will only be available to the new Account owner. If you need to transfer the ownership to an individual who isn't currently a Clever Admin, you'll need to first create an Admin account for them.   
  
![Image from Team page showing where to click to change the Clever account owner](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pJfEz)   
  
  
If the Clever Account Owner listed on the account is no longer with the district, please contact​ [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for help. Here are the details about what we will need to make the update on your behalf:

-   We will need written approval from a member of the district’s leadership team (e.g. Superintendent, Director of Technology, Curriculum Director, etc.) who is verifiable on the district's website.
-   Please feel free to CC this administrator on the Clever support ticket so they can respond directly to the communication thread. 
-   Once Clever has written confirmation, we can transfer ownership of the district's Clever account.  
      
    

* * *

##   
Adding Clever Admins

Any users who are assigned the Clever Admin role are also able to add other Clever Admins to Clever by following these steps:

1.  Log in to the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/)
2.  Select [User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) from the left navigation menu
3.  Select **Actions** in the top right of the page
4.  Select **Add team member** from the options available
5.  Add the new Clever Admin's information in the pop-up box
6.  Select **Add**

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000UHdV7)

     **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VleWP)     Please note:** Accounts utilizing an SFTP or SIS-Managed SFTP sync can sync, remove, and update Clever Admins via CSV. [Please see here for more information, including steps for removing admins synced via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709).  
  
If you utilize a SIS-Managed sync and want to automate the syncing of your administrators.csv, you’ll need to work with your SIS directly to add this file to your exports.

Once a team member has been added to the account, they will receive an email with a link to create an account. If they do not receive this message, please have them check their spam folder for a message from **[no-reply@clever.com](mailto:no-reply@clever.com)**. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BGM7)  
 

* * *

##   
Logging in as a Clever Admin

  
All Clever Admins should use the **District admin log in** option from the Clever login page to access their Clever Admin account. Please note that admins will enter their username first. Once verified, they will be asked to enter their password. If there's a typo or the account doesn't exist, the user is notified right away, so they don't have to enter a password to find out. This

![screenshot of login page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qUJfB)   
  
![screenshot of login page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000qUJor)   
  
Alternatively, Clever Admins can navigate to Clever.com and choose the **District admin** option using the blue arrow dropdown at the top right of the page.  
  
![Clever login drops down displays log in option as District Admin](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000gcnF)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever District Admin can also use a [Single Sign-on (SSO) Identity Provider (IDP)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166787) to sign in (such as Google or Active Directory) that's powered by user email address. You'll just need to add the IDP to your district first.  
  
If you prefer that all District Admin be required to use SSO to sign in to Clever instead of a username and password, please contact Clever Support by clicking the message icon in the bottom right corner. [**You must be a Clever Admin (owner)**](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202518038#Clever%20Account%20Owner) **to be able to make this request.** 

* * *

##   
Removing or updating Clever Admins

### Removing Clever Admins

     **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Vlf2f)     Please note:** Accounts utilizing an SFTP or SIS-Managed SFTP sync can sync, remove, and update Clever Admins via CSV. [Please see here for more information, including steps for removing admins synced via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709).  
  
If you utilize a SIS-Managed sync and want to automate the syncing of your administrators.csv, you’ll need to work with your SIS directly to add this file to your exports.

Clever Admins also have permission to remove other admins from the [Team](https://schools.clever.com/team) page. To remove another Clever Admin, click the **trash icon** to the far right of the user's name. 

  
  

![Team page with highlight on "Actions" and "Delete" to delete a team member](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cfjjG)

### Updating Clever Admins

     **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VkyiU)     Please note:** Accounts utilizing an SFTP or SIS-Managed SFTP sync can sync, remove, and update Clever Admins via CSV. [Please see here for more information, including steps for removing admins synced via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709).  
  
If you utilize a SIS-Managed sync and want to automate the syncing of your administrators.csv, you’ll need to work with your SIS directly to add this file to your exports.

Once a Clever Admin account has been created, other Clever Admins listed on the account have the ability to update another Admin's Title or Clever Role. To make these updates for another Clever Admin, click the **pencil icon** to the far right of the user's name. 

![Team page with highlight on "Actions" and "Edit" buttons to update a team member Title or Role](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cgOfy)

You can also make these updates from the admin's profile page by selecting **Edit** from the **Actions** dropdown. This option is disabled for Clever admins added via an administrators.csv, since the CSV is the source of truth for their information.

To update the email associated with the Clever Admin account, the admin user must log into their account > click **Profile** > **Overview** \> **Edit** > update the email address > **Update.**

**![Update DA email by clicking Profile > Edit > Update](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004os6A)**

* * *

* * *

## Switching between user accounts if you have multiple accounts in Clever

Many administrators add themselves as teachers or staff users in Clever to better understand these end users’ experiences. If you have multiple accounts in Clever, and the accounts are connected, you can easily toggle between any accounts by clicking your name and selecting the account you want to access. You can easily switch between accounts if they are connected by the same email address (case sensitive) or sis\_id values.

![Multi-role dropdown menu](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eFJh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PQvYv)

_An example of the dropdown a user with multiple accounts will see when clicking their name._

title: Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001733726#Header1) 2. [Determining the best role for a user](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001733726#best_role) 3. [Permissions by role](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001733726#perms) ## Overview Clever admins can provide various staff and admin users with access to Clever at varying permission levels. For example, some users may be able to view and modify settings across their entire school organization in Clever, while others may only be able to make modifications specific to their school. In Clever, a "role" can **_only_** be assigned to an admin team member or staff user. Teachers always have the same permissions, primarily access to their associated sections (i.e. courses/classes), students, and applications.  **![instructor\_c8mlopv788bh4spwj0xrzn2c2\_public\_1712091784\_Lightbulb.1712091783969.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI0H&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Clever Tip:** This article runs through our default roles. You can also create **custom roles** with granular permissions, [as outlined in this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702).  * * * ## Determining the best role for a user  Clever roles should be based on an individual's position in the school organization and the level of permissions the school organization wants them to have in Clever. Users assigned a team admin role (i.e., Clever Admin, District Curriculum Lead, or District Help Desk) will have school organization-wide access with varying permissions, while users in staff roles will have more limited permissions. You can also offer highly granular permissions by creating a [custom admin role](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702). For detailed information about each role, please click on the links below.   **Admin team roles:**   - [Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038) - [District Curriculum Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207703) - [District Help Desk](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207803) - [Custom roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702) **Non-instructional staff roles**:   - [School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663) - [Portal Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039552772) **Teacher vs. Non-instructional Staff** A common question is whether a user should be added to Clever as a Teacher, School Tech Lead, or Staff (Portal Access Only). If a user is responsible for teaching or assisting a student with educational content (i.e. substitute, teacher aide, instructional coach, etc.), we recommend adding the user as a **Teacher**. Directions for adding custom teachers and associating them with sections can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691).  If a user is responsible for helping users access and use technology but is not directly responsible for the instruction of educational content, we recommend adding the user as a **School Tech Lead**. This is usually an individual with a title such as "technology coach." If a user does not support students in the classroom directly, we recommend adding the user as **Staff (Portal Access Only)**. This role is usually best for secretaries, custodial staff, counselors, etc.   * * * ## Permissions by role Please see the graph below for a breakdown of permissions by role.

title: Sharing Permission: View sharing permission history
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025766151#Overview)  
2\. [Where can I see past sharing permissions?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025766151#WhereSeePast)  
3\. [How do I revert sharing to a previous configuration?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025766151#HowRevertPreviousConfig)

## Overview

Clever Admins are now able to view historical changes made to an application’s data sharing permissions. This is available for every application a school organization is connected to on Clever.  
 

* * *

##   
Where can I see past sharing permissions?

Historical sharing configurations can be seen in the **Past Rules** tab when viewing an application’s profile page in the dashboard:  
 

![Duolingo past sharing rules](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL1N&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHSzZ)

The sharing history is broken up by date and exact timestamp, and the page is limited to showing the 20 most recent historical rules.  
 

* * *

##   
How do I revert my present data sharing permissions to a previous configuration?

1.  Navigate to the specific application’s profile page
2.  Click on the **Past Rules** tab at the top
3.  **Identify the exact date and timestamp** of the previous sharing configuration you’d like to bring back for the application
4.  Click the blue **Revert to these rules** button to replace the current sharing configuration with this previous one
5.  For final confirmation, hit the **Revert sharing** button to push this change into production

As with normal sharing changes, this reversion should go into effect instantly and thereafter alter what data an app can sync for your school organization. It typically takes up to 24 hours for data changes to be reflected in an application once sharing permissions are altered.   
 

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL1N&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** **For more information on setting sharing permissions, please see:** [How do I set my sharing permissions for applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)

title: Sharing Permissions: App-recommended sharing permissions
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770232#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [Accept or decline a sharing recommendation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770232#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)

##   
Overview:

Recommended sharing settings allow an application to communicate sharing best practices directly to your school organization in the Clever Dashboard. Even if you have already configured your sharing permissions with an application, they can recommend an update to these settings. You then have the option to accept or decline the application’s recommended sharing settings directly in your Dashboard.  
 

* * *

##   
Accept or decline a sharing recommendation:

If one of your connected applications has recommended an update to your sharing rules, you’ll receive an email notification.

![Email with data sharing request](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL4b&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOTl)

Additionally, you will see the status of **Sharing requested** under Applications in your dashboard, as well as on the Overview page of the application.   
 

![Application with sharing requested status](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL4b&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOU0)

To review the application’s recommended update to your sharing rules, select **Click here** on the profile page of the application or **View sharing request** on the Applications page. Selecting either of these will open up a popup window displaying the recommended update.  
 

![Example sharing recommendation from an application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL4b&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOUZ)

  
To accept the update to your sharing rules, select **Share.**   
 

IMPORTANT If you select **Share,** the application’s recommended sharing settings will replace any current sharing rules that your school organization has configured for this application.

  
If you would not like to update your sharing rules at this time, select **Decline** and your sharing settings for the application will remain the same.

If you are not sure about the application’s reasoning behind the recommended sharing rules, please reach out to the application’s team directly as they’ll be best able to work through with you what should be shared and make any necessary adjustments to their recommendation.

title: Sharing Permissions: Sharing staff with applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044771711#Header1)  
2\. [Share by district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044771711#ShareByDistrict)  
3\. [Share by school](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044771711#ShareBySchool)  
4\. [Share by rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044771711#ShareByRules)  
5\. [Sharing a user that has both a teacher and a staff account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044771711#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044771711#FAQ)

## Overview

Staff (non-teaching faculty) can be shared with applications in the same way as teachers and students! Before sharing staff with an application, we recommend reviewing the Single Sign-On (SSO)-supported user types on the application's Overview page.

![Screenshot of SSO user types](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHKNj)

* * *

##   
Share by district

If your sharing type is set to share by district, staff can be shared or unshared by checking the box that says _Also share all staff with \[application name\]_.  
  
![Screenshot of the "Also share all staff with \[application name\]" checkbox](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZLcw)

* * *

##   
Share by school

If you've selected to share by school, staff members for selected schools are automatically shared. It is not possible to unshare staff associated with shared schools.

* * *

##   
Share by rules

Staff must be shared explicitly by creating an additional sharing rule.

Follow the steps below if you're using the [**Guided sharing view**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001514) to share your staff members and [see a tutorial video here](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/pwbjs3rpiy):

1.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and select the application  
      
    
2.  Under **Shared Data**, select **Edit Sharing  
      
    ****![Edit sharing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fmCz)**
3.  Select **Add Another Rule  
      
    ****![Add another rule](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fmMf)**
4.  Select **Staff members need access** in the drop-down menu  
    ![Drop-down menu of staff members need access](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GGqeC)
5.  Select the desired staff utilizing the filters provided. You can select staff based on their email, schools administered, staff ID, or title. If you choose to share by email, make sure the email addresses match exactly as they appear in Clever (including uppercase and lowercase letters), as they are case-sensitive.  
      
    
6.  Select which school-association information you would like to share. Please note that this does not share additional students, teachers, or sections. This selection only determines which school-associations are available to the application for the shared staff members.  
      
    If you would like to sync the staff to the application without a school association, select **no associated schools.  
    ![Screenshot of "also share no associated schools"](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHYqT)  
      
    **If you would like to sync the staff to the application with specific school associations, select **these associated schools** and choose the desired schools.  
      
      
    If you would like to sync the staff to the application with all their synced school associations included, select **all associated schools.  
      
    **
7.  Select **Done Editing  
      
    **
8.  Select **Save Sharing Rules**

Follow the steps below if you're using the **Standard sharing view** to share your staff members and [see a tutorial video here](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/idcglw53d5):

1.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and select the application
2.  Under **Shared Data**, select **Edit Sharing  
      
    ![Edit sharing button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHUtK)  
      
    **
3.  Select **Edit Sharing Rules  
      
    ![Edit sharing rules](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHatu)  
    **  
    
4.  Select **Add another rule  
      
    ![Add another rule button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHbQ9)  
      
    **
5.  Select **Custom Share Staff  
    **
6.  Select the desired staff utilizing the filters provided. You can select staff based on their email, schools administered, staff ID, or title. If you choose to share by email, make sure the email addresses match exactly as they appear in Clever (including uppercase and lowercase letters), as they are case-sensitive.
7.  Select which school-association information you would like to share. Please note that this does not share additional students, teachers, or sections. This selection only determines which school-associations are available to the application for the shared staff members.  
      
    If you would like to sync the staff to the application without a school association, select **no associated schools.  
      
    ![Screenshot of drop-down menu of no associated schools](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHcCX)**  
      
    If you would like to sync the staff to the application with specific school associations, select **these associated schools** and choose the desired schools.  
      
    If you would like to sync the staff to the application with all their synced school associations included, select **all associated schools.  
      
    **
8.  Select **Done editing  
      
    **
9.  Select **Save Sharing Rules**

* * *

## Sharing a user that has both a teacher and a staff account

Users can have both a teacher and a staff account in Clever. This can get tricky if you want to specify which, or if both, accounts are shared with a particular application. If you need to ensure a specific staff user account is shared, we recommend adding **a staff sharing rule** that specifies the user's Staff ID or email.

![Screenshot of sharing rule based on staff ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHdzp)

To confirm if a specific account type (teacher or staff) is shared with an application, use the [Troubleshoot sharing tool](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing) and pay specific attention to which user account you select.

![Troubleshoot sharing tool](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dcv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHeO1)

_Be sure to select the account type (teacher or staff) that you want to ensure is shared with a particular application._

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How can I confirm if a staff user is shared with an application?**

-   Use the [Troubleshoot sharing tool](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing) and input the user's name. If there is a chance the user has both a teacher and a staff account, be sure that you select the staff account.
    

**What types of sharing do I need to add staff users to?**

-   Whether you share by district, share by school, or set sharing rules, you'll need to check a box, or create a specific rule to share staff users.
    

**Can I share both a teacher and staff account for a single user with an application?**

-   Yes! Clever allows you to share both teacher and staff accounts with applications, however, how the application handles that data may vary. For example, some applications can only sync one account type.
    

**What permissions will my staff user have in their applications?**

-   This varies based on application. The Clever team can not advise what specific permissions or roles a staff user will have within a learning application. Please reach out to the application team for more information.

title: For Staff: Troubleshooting - Data (e.g. rosters, classes, and school association)
text:
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001noJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028APM)**Clever Tip:** If rosters, sections or any data tied to your school's Clever account needs to be updated, **please contact your registrar, clerk or district administrator** **for support** as you are unable to make these changes within Clever.

  
Your district's data is synced to Clever from your school's Student Information System (SIS). This data sync is managed by your district's Clever account owner or district administrator.  
  
There may be times when you notice that your rosters are not up to date, that you have classes missing from your Clever Portal or that you're associated with the wrong school site.

  
If you are noticing incorrect information in Clever, **please confirm that the information is correct within your district's student information system.** You can also contact any person at your school who manages the SIS or enrollments (a clerk, registrar, etc.) to verify the information is correct within the SIS.

  
If you have already confirmed information is correct in the SIS and are still seeing incorrect data in Clever, please reach out to your **[district's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648)** to troubleshoot the issue further. If they need additional help, your district administrator can open a request with Clever Support!  
  
![Clever login screen with tech support contact highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001noJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ao35)

Here are examples of incorrect data you might see in Clever that your district administrator can help with:  
 

-   Missing students on your roster
-   Incorrect students on your roster
-   Incorrect, duplicate or missing classes in Clever
-   Adding a co-teacher to your class
-   Incorrect information for yourself or a student (a misspelled name, email, grade level, etc.)
-   Updating a Clever username for yourself or a student 
-   Duplicate accounts

##   
Data is incorrect in an application

Application partners manage syncing data from Clever and implementing it in their system. If you notice that information is incorrect in application but correct in Clever. **Please contact the application's support team directly.**   
 

We recommend providing the following information: 

 

-   District name + state
-   School name
-   Teacher email address
-   Description of problem

_Example:_ 

 

-   _Clark County School District, NV_
-   _Boulder City High School_
-   _[sample@nv.ccsd.net](mailto:sample@nv.ccsd.net)_
-   _Missing class roster - Algebra I, 6th period_

Please note, applications sync with data on a daily basis. If the missing or incorrect data was recently changed in your student information system, please allow at least 24 hrs for the data to be updated in applications.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001noJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028APR) If you are a **School Tech Lead**, for instructions on how to locate data in Clever, see [For School Tech Leads: Data missing or incorrect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044925932)

title: For Staff: Troubleshooting - Apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039645672#overview)  
2\. [App is missing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039645672#AppIsMissing)  
3\. [Clicked on app, received an error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039645672#ReceivedAnError)  
4\. [Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039645672#UsernameAndPassword)  
5\. [Data incorrect in apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039645672#DataIncorrectInApp)  
6\. [Problems within apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039645672#ProblemWithinApps)

## Overview
