Occasionally, you or your students will have issues with your applications (i.e. apps) in Clever. Here are some steps you can take if you or your students are having trouble logging in to applications from the Clever Portal.  
 

* * *

##   
App is missing

If you or your student is missing a district-provided application from your Clever Portal, **please reach out to your district's support contact**. Your district manages which teachers and students can access each learning application through Clever, so they will need to add the application to your student's Portal. 

​​![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000AkAq&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AOn)

* * *

## Clicked on app, received an error

If you or your students click on an application in the Clever Portal and receive an error on the application's page, **please reach out to the application's support team for help**.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000AkAq&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AOs)**Clever Tip:** If you are seeing an error at a web URL that is **not** a Clever address, it's likely that the application's team is best equipped to help fix the issue. Please reach out to the application's support team to investigate further!

  
Here are examples of common errors you might see for specific applications:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000AkAq&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AOx)![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000AkAq&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AP2)

* * *

## Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password

If a Clever page asks you or your student to enter their username and password for an application, enter the correct login information for that application, and click '**Save Login**'. If the device has the [Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) downloaded, Clever will save this information and automatically log the student in next time they click the icon from the Portal!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000AkAq&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AP7)

If your student clicks on an application and sees the page below, this means we were not able to log your student in with the username and password they provided. Please have them enter their updated username and password for the application, and click '**Update & Log in**'.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000AkAq&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028APC)

If you are still having trouble, please confirm that the username and password entered is correct to log into their account directly on the application's page (i.e. at schoology.com). If you can successfully access the app directly through their website, but not through Clever, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://getclever.zendesk.com/agent/dashboard) for help!  
 

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Did you know?** Applications that prompt users to manually enter credentials as shown above are called **SSO (Saved Passwords)** applications. Learn more about these applications in this Help Center article: [For Teachers: What are Saved Passwords applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026789592)   

* * *

## Data incorrect in apps

If the data in an application is incorrect (e.g. rosters, students, and school associations), [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025400111).   
 

* * *

## Problems within applications

After you click on an application from the Clever Portal, your experience within their product is controlled from the application’s end.  If you are running into an issue within the application, **please contact the application’s support team for help.**

Here are common examples of when an application’s team will be best equipped to provide support:

-   You are receiving an error message on the application’s website
-   You are seeing incorrect data within the application, but correct data within the Clever Portal
-   You are having trouble accessing grades, homework, textbooks, resources, or running reports within the application
-   Your sections have access to the incorrect content within the application
-   You have questions about features within the application
-   The application does not save a student’s progress
-   The application is frozen or logs you or your students out
-   You need to merge or match old account

title: For Staff: Troubleshooting - Logging in
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#Overview) 2\. [Problem logging into Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#ProblemLoggingIntoClever)      _•_  [Log in with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#CleverLogin)      _•_  [Log in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#GoogleLogin)      _•_  [Log in with Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#ActiveDirectoryLogin)      _•_  [Log in with Canvas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#CanvasLogin)          _•_  [Log in with LDAP](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#LoggingIntoLDAP) 3\. [Resetting staff passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#resettingstaffpw)      _•_  [Setting up account recovery](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#accountrecovery)      _•_  [Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#resettingpwloginscreen)      _•_  [Resetting your password in Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#resettingincleverportal) 4. [Problem logging into an app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#ProblemLoggingIntoApp) 6\. [Logging out](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#LoggingOut) 6\. [How do I get help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#HowDoIGetHelp) ## Overview This article outlines the various login issues or error messages that you may encounter when attempting to log in to Clever. Please note, not all error messages are included in this article. Please double-check that you are typing in the correct login credentials and that you have an account in Clever. If your login issues persist after reviewing this article, please contact your district's tech support contact directly  for assistance. You can find their contact information by selecting the **Get help logging in!** option from your district's login page. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ANV) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ANa) For instructions on how to help your students log in to Clever, please visit [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888) ## * * * ## Problems logging in to Clever ## Log in with Clever If you see the error **Invalid username or password,** this means that the username and/or password you entered are not correct for your Clever account.   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ANf)      Select **Get help logging in!** to reset your password using the email address linked to your school's Clever account. **Please note:** Not all districts allow staff to reset their own passwords. If you don't see the option to reset your password, or if this doesn't resolve the issue, please contact your school's tech support contact [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040417231#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd)directly for help. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028ANk) ## Log in with Google Enter is your **school-provided** email address (not an @gmail.com address). The password you enter will be the password associated with your school email address. Below are possible errors you may encounter when logging in and steps to resolve:

Error

Details and next steps

Couldn't find your Google account

This is a Google error. Please confirm you're using your school-provided email, not your personal email. If you still receive the error, please reach out to your school support contact to determine your correct email.

Wrong password. Try again or click Forgot password to reset it.

 This is a Google error. You’ve entered an incorrect password for their school-provided Google email address. Please enter the correct password for their account or reset it if you’re able. If you can’t reset your password, please reach out to your school support contact for help.
 We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email xxxx@gmail.com. Try again with your school issued email address.  This is a Clever-related error. This error means that the email address you entered isn’t the same one linked to your Clever account. Please make sure you are using your school-provided email address. If you believe you’re using the correct email address, please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. The Clever team cannot provide login credentials. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.
We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the email xxxx@example.comThis is a Clever-related error. This error means that the email address you’re attempting to log in with is duplicated in Clever. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team. The Clever team cannot edit email addresses or provide login credentials.
We couldn’t log you in.This is a Clever-related error. You may receive this error with additional details or by itself. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for further assistance in troubleshooting. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.
**For any other login error that states _We couldn’t log you in_ please contact your school’s IT team directly for assistance.** Provide them all of the descriptive information in the error, the Reference ID, and any suggested Admin troubleshooting steps. The Clever team cannot provide your login credentials or edit your email address in Clever. For any other login error that states **We couldn’t log you in** please contact your school’s IT team directly for assistance. Provide them all of the descriptive information in the error, the Reference ID, and any suggested Admin troubleshooting steps. The Clever team cannot provide your login credentials or edit your email address in Clever. ## Log in with Active Directory   When selecting this option, you should be redirected to your district's login page. Below are possible login errors you may encounter and steps for troubleshooting:

Error

Details and next steps

We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email address or username.

 

This error means the email address or username you entered isn’t in the district or school’s Clever account. Please make sure you are using your school-provided email or username. If you’re using the correct email or username, please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. The Clever team cannot provide login credentials. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.

We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the student’s email or username.

 

This error means that the email address or username you’re attempting to log in with is duplicated in Clever. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team. The Clever team cannot edit email addresses or provide login credentials.
 We couldn’t log you in.You may receive this error with additional details or by itself. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for further assistance in troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team.
If you have issues logging in to Active Directory, please contact your [school’s tech support directly](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) as Clever doesn’t have access to login credentials for users. ## Log in with Canvas If you see the error message **We couldn't log you in, we can't find a Clever account for the email or username**, this means that Clever is unable to locate an account based on the credentials you provided.  For any other login error that states **We couldn’t log you in** please contact your school’s IT team directly for assistance. Provide them all of the descriptive information in the error, the Reference ID, and any suggested Admin troubleshooting steps. The Clever team cannot provide your login credentials or edit your email address in Clever. ## Log in with LDAP If you encounter an LDAP login error after entering your login credentials, please contact your school support contact as Clever does not have access to login credentials.   * * *   * * * ## Resetting staff passwords Not all school districts allow staff to reset their passwords. If you don’t see the option to reset your password, or if these steps don't resolve the issue, please get in touch with your [school district's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) directly for help. ### **Setting up account recovery** If your school has enabled it, you can use a backup method (such as email, security questions, or phone number) to regain access to your Clever, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google Workspace accounts right from your Clever login screen. This is handy if you cannot log in with your password successfully. To set up your backup method (again, if your school had enabled this functionality), you need to be logged into your Portal. 1. Click on your blue icon in the upper right corner to bring up your settings.    2. Click on **Set up recovery methods.** The recovery methods available to you depend on what your school district has enabled. 3. Choose a recovery method and input the information. 4. Depending on what you choose for a recovery method, you will be prompted on how to continue. ![Gif of setting up a recovery method](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El83h) It’s also possible that your school organization may have provided a recovery method for you using information in their records. For example, if your schools collect personal email addresses, they may set up your account recovery email as your personal email address. If you’d like to update the information your school organization provides, you can do so using the recovery method setup described above. ### **Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login screen** ### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:** 1. From the Clever login screen, click on **get help logging in.** 2. Choose **Reset your account passwords. ![Reset your account passwords screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El9vp)**  3. Input your school district email address (not to be confused with a recovery email you have set up).  ![Account recovery](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElATh)  4. You’ll be prompted to confirm your identity using a method you set up in your Portal settings. Select how you’ll confirm your identity. 5. You can now set up your new password for both your Clever and third-party accounts by inputting a new password. Your school may have password requirements, which can be viewed by clicking on **See requirements**. Once completed, you can use your new password for your third-party account(s). ![Screenshot of the set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020isj) ### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:** 1. Select **Get help logging in!** to reset your password using the email address linked to your district's Clever account. ![Login page showing an error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hqD) 2. Choose **Reset only your Clever password ![Reset only your Clever Password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElCth)**  3. Enter the email that you signed up with to receive password reset instructions, and click **Send. ![Screenshot of the Recover account page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hdK)** ### **Resetting your password in Clever Portal** Alternatively, if you do have access to your Staff Portal and want to update your password for any reason (e.g., you feel your passwords may have been compromised), you can do so by following these steps from your Staff Portal: 1. Click on your blue icon in the upper right corner to bring up your settings. ![Screenshot of the Password reset option in Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElCKE)  2. From underneath **Log in password** click **Change passwords** to update**.**  This is independent of the account recovery process and doesn’t require you to go through the recovery method.   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkWMe)   Please note:** Your district’s settings will determine which passwords you can reset through Clever. In the screenshot above you’ll see this user will reset both their Google and Clever password. Please pay close attention to the passwords you are resetting. * * * ## Problem logging into an app If you are encountering an error when trying to access an application, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027035111) . * * * ## Logging out To log out of Clever, navigate to the Clever Portal, hovering over your name in the top-right corner, and click **Log out**. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AOJ) Users are also logged out of Clever automatically after:  - 24 hours of inactivity  - The browser is _quit (e.g. "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._ Closing the browser window will not log the user out of Clever.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OiZN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AOO) * * * ## How do I get help? Login credentials for Clever are managed by the school district. If you are unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please reach out to your district support contact or the district's help desk for assistance.  You can typically locate their contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your district's Clever login page. In most cases, districts provide an email address, phone number, or instructions guiding users to the appropriate contact person or department for assistance. ​If you have any questions or need further assistance, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) ! We are happy to help!

title: For Staff: How do I use Zoom through the Clever Portal?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041097671#Overview)  
2\. [How do I create a Zoom account?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041097671#CreateZoomAccount)  
3\. [How do I log in to Zoom?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041097671#LogInToZoom)  
4\. [How do I set up a virtual meeting?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041097671#SetupVirtualMeeting)  
5. [How can I get help with using Zoom?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041097671#GetHelpUsingZoom)

  
 

## Overview

  
Clever has partnered with Zoom to create a seamless way to provide account creation, as well as Single Sign-On (SSO) access for teachers, staff, and district admins.

## How do I create a Zoom account?

  
Adding Zoom and creating accounts are managed at the district level. District administrators can find directions for adding the Zoom integration [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040481852).   
  
If you do not see the Zoom app in your Portal, please contact your district help desk. 

  
 

## How do I log in to Zoom?

  
  
Step 1: [Log in to the Clever Portal](https://clever.com/oauth/district-picker?channel=clever&client_id=4c63c1cf623dce82caac&confirmed=true&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclever.com%2Fin%2Fauth_callback&response_type=code&state=19873f740edf68d17b60b46111fd7fdd9037ad16ae30d018ffa58f53d9a616db)

  
Step 2: Click on the Zoom icon.

You are now logged in and will be directed to your Zoom profile!    
 

  
 

## How do I create a virtual meeting?

  
  
Step 1: [Log in to the Clever Portal](https://clever.com/oauth/district-picker?channel=clever&client_id=4c63c1cf623dce82caac&confirmed=true&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclever.com%2Fin%2Fauth_callback&response_type=code&state=19873f740edf68d17b60b46111fd7fdd9037ad16ae30d018ffa58f53d9a616db)

  
Step 2: Click on the Zoom application in the Clever Portal

  
Step 3: Click on "Schedule a Meeting" 

  
Step 4. Enter the details for your meeting. If you would like to use the same meeting link for a recurring event (example: weekly team meeting), select "Recurring meeting"

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oSb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000289Xj)

  
Step 5. Select "Save." On the next screen, click "Copy the invitation". 

  
Step 6. Send the invitation info to the event participants. This may be in an email, a calendar event's details, or a link in the Clever Portal! 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oSb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000289Xo)

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Pro Tip:**    
Does your school use Google? You may be able to add the [Zoom Scheduler extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/zoom-scheduler/kgjfgplpablkjnlkjmjdecgdpfankdle?hl=en-US) for Google Chrome.  
This extension makes it easy to add a Zoom link to any calendar event in Google Calendar!    
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oSb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000289Xt)

  
 

## How can I get help with using Zoom?

Zoom has a large number of resources to support you and your students. These resources can be found at [https://support.zoom.us](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us)

  
Here are some resources from their Help Center that Clever recommends to get started!

  
[Zoom Video Tutorials (1 Minute each!)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206618765)

 

-   [How to Join a Meeting](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/vFhAEoCF7jg?rel=0&autoplay=1&cc_load_policy=1)
-   [Joining & Configuring Audio & Video](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/HqncX7RE0wM?rel=0&autoplay=1&cc_load_policy=1)
-   [Sharing Your Screen](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/9wsWpnqE6Hw?rel=0&autoplay=1&cc_load_policy=1)
-   [Meeting Controls](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4w_pRMBEALE?rel=0&autoplay=1&cc_load_policy=1)
-   [Meeting and Webinar Best Practices](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/209743263)
-   [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/206175806)

  
**Zoom Technical Support**

  
If you or your students encounter technical problems with Zoom, you can [submit a support request](https://zoom.us/signin) . "Support Hours" are **24 x 7**, including public holidays, where agents or technical engineers are available for email or live support.

title: For Staff: Searching & favoriting apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360022982852#h_f5f3aa27-6ecd-4144-88e7-de84b2858132)  
2. [Favoriting resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360022982852#Header1)  
3\. [Searching for resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360022982852#Header2)

##   
Overview

This article provides an overview of how teachers and staff can easily locate applications and categorize their favorite apps in Clever!  

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zo1x&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000289XU)  Locating and favoriting applications are features that are also [available to your students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026162691)!

##   
Favoriting applications

**Here's how to favorite an application:**

 

-   Log into your Clever Portal from your district's Clever login page, or from [Clever.com](https://clever.com/).
-   Locate your favorite app icon, and click the heart in the upper right-hand corner of the icon.
-   This will add the app to the 'Favorites' section at the top of your Portal. 
-   To remove an app from your ‘Favorites’, simply click the heart again in the top right corner!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Zo1x&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000289XZ)**Please note:** Favoriting resources is only reflected in individual portals. Resources that teachers favorite will not be favorited for their students.

## Finding apps

Users can search for district-wide applications or district-wide app links from their Clever Portals. Simply navigate to the search bar at the top of your Clever Portal to search for the app.

-   Depending on the app, when the result is selected you will be either:
    -   Logged in to the app if it is a district-wide application
    -   Be redirected to the app login page to log in (if a non-integrated app)

If you are unable to locate the app via the Clever search bar, this means it is either not a Clever-integrated app nor a district-wide linked app.

title: Sharing Permissions: Enabling School Site Sharing for School Tech Leads
text:
This article contains the following:  
 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001972366#one)  
 2. [How do I enable school site sharing for School Tech Leads?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115001972366#two)

##   
Overview

The School Tech Lead user type in Clever is able to navigate from the Portal to the Clever Dashboard to help manage schools they are associated with. **School site sharing** means that a School Tech Lead can manage data sharing permissions on a per-school basis.  
  
For more information on adding School Teach Leads, please see this [article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663). 

* * *

##   
How do I enable school site sharing for School Tech Leads?

To allow sharing rules to be managed at the school level:  
 

1\. Visit the application overview page and choose the **Edit sharing** button (for Saved-passwords apps click the **Modify users** button) and select **Change** next to the current sharing rule type.

![Change button for changing your sharing rule type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL7p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Opw8z)

2\. Change sharing rules to **School Site Sharing.**

![School site sharing button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL7p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZLe9)   
 

3\. Click **Enable** to allow School site sharing.  
 

![Enable school site sharing button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL7p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CRcu)

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL7p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Enabling school site sharing will remove any existing sharing rules that you have.

  
Now your School Tech Leads can manage data sharing on a per-school basis! School Tech Leads will see the same interface that you do, except they will only see the schools that they are associated with in Clever. As a Clever Admin, you can also view and edit the same sharing rules.  
 

![School site sharing screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dL7p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZLen)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** For directions on how School Tech Leads can use School site sharing, please see: [For School Tech Leads: What is School site sharing?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020281091)

* * *

**Related articles:**

[For School Tech Leads: Sharing data with apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020281091)

title: Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#h_ffcfa10e-f0b8-4b74-bb6c-7c159475e654) 2. [What is a sharing rule?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#WhatSharingRule) 3\. [Choosing Share by Rules as a sharing type](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#choosing) 4. [How do I add a sharing rule?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#HowShareNewApp) 5. [Constructing sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#constructing) 6\. [Reverting to previous rules/Viewing who made changes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#H7) 7. [Multiple sharing rules and filters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#multiple) 8\. [Adding Notes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#note) 9\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247#FAQ) ## Overview By configuring [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for applications, Clever admins can determine what data will be shared with each app and which users will be able to access the application from their individual Clever Portals. When sharing by rules, Clever will only share data that meets the specific criteria you've set. This is the most recommended sharing type as it provides school organizations with flexibility in determining specifically what data should be included, or excluded, in the sharing. Additionally, applications are dynamically updated as new data is synced to Clever from your student information system (SIS). The data shared with the application via sharing rules evolves based on the new data in Clever. ##  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For an overview of application sharing permissions, please visit:  [Sharing Permissions: Overview.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) * * * ## What is a sharing rule? A sharing rule allows school organizations to be specific about what data is being shared by data type (e.g. teacher, student, section, etc.). Once a sharing type is selected, Clever admins can continue to add filters to ensure only the data they want shared with applications is being shared. **For example, sharing rules might include:**   - All the math classes in a particular school - The english classes for grades 3-6 in the school organization, except for in two schools - One specific teacher’s 11th-grade homeroom class **Think of a sharing rule as a sentence:**   - "Share all records where ” * * * ## Choosing **Sharing by Rules** as a sharing type You can view and edit your sharing rules from your [Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page by clicking on the application's name to open the **Overview** tab. 1. Click **Edit Sharing** ![Screenshot of the application page showing where to click Edit sharing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062dcr)    2.  If you're not already **Sharing by Rules**, you can change the sharing type to **Sharing by Rules. ** If you are using Guided Sharing, click here for instructions on how to switch to Sharing by Rules. 1. Navigate into your sharing rules for the application. 2. Click back to **Step 1: Choose sharing method** on the sidebar. 3. Click **Get started** on the pop-up for Guided Sharing: How it works 4. Select to share Specific sections, teachers, students, and/or staff ![Choose sharing method as specific sections, teachers, etc.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GLgfm)  If you are using Standard Sharing, click here for instructions on how to switch to Sharing by Rules. 1. Navigate into your sharing rules for the application 2. Click on **Change** as shown below (in this example the school district was Sharing by Schools)![Screenshot of the change button highlighted showing how to change your sharing type](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062ddV) 3. Select Share by Rules to change your sharing type ![Share by Rules box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GLlKT)  3. After changing to **Sharing By Rules** in either Guided Sharing or Standard Sharing, you will then be prompted to choose which method you want to use (e.g. Custom Share by Student): ![Screenshot of Sharing by Rules options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fXMqA)   4. Create your rules and filters. Click [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247#h_c94fecee-864a-4256-851b-6d9694491c15) to learn more about the different types of rules and filters. Before saving your rules and filters, you can adjust them as many times as you’d like and preview data at the bottom of your screen before clicking save. This allows you to experiment and ensure the correct data is included in your sharing rules. For sharing rule recommendations, be sure to check out our [tips & troubleshooting article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001548). 5. After creating each rule, select **Done editing.** 6. Once you have finished adding all of your rules and filters, select **Save Sharing Rules.** * * * ## How do I add or edit a sharing rule? If you already use Share by Rules, go to your [Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page and click on the application name to open the app overview page_._ From the app overview page, click **Edit Sharing**_**.**_ Use the **Edit** or **Delete** actions to update your sharing rules.   * * * ## Constructing sharing rules ### **Types of sharing rules** There are a few types of sharing rules available: 

Sharing rule

Purpose

Custom Share by TeacherShare specific teachers by one of their unique identifiers (e.g. email address, teacher ID).
  • When sharing by teacher, you'll have the option to select whether to share their associated student and section data. Custom Share by Teacher sharing rules will not share student contacts, however.

See a tutorial video of Guided sharing: Share by teacher or Standard sharing: Share by teacher.

Custom Share by Staff

Share your non-instructional staff. If Sharing by staff, you will have the option to select if you want to share their school associations. Clever recommends sharing "all associated schools." This will not share additional students, teachers, or sections.

See a tutorial video of Guided sharing: Share by staff or Standard sharing: Share by staff.

Custom Share by Student Use this sharing type to filter by student attributes such as grade, gender, ELL_status, IEP, status, etc.

  • When sharing by student, you'll have the option to select if you want to share their associated section data.

See a tutorial video of Guided sharing: Share by student or Standard sharing: Share by student.

Custom Share by Section

Use this sharing type to filter by section attributes such as subject, school, course, and term.

See a tutorial video of Guided sharing: Share by section or Standard sharing: Share by section.

Custom Share by Admin

Share specific admins by their assigned role in Clever. 

See a tutorial video of Guided sharing: Share by admin or Standard sharing: Share by admins.

### ****Filters**** **Rules** are made up of **Filters.** A **Filter** is an individual requirement that must be met in order for a record to be shared. A rule may have multiple filters. Filters are created by creating a statement using the following: - **Properties** are attributes that you can use to either include or exclude data with the application sharing rules. The fields available are dependent on the type of sharing rule you selected (e.g. share by teacher, share by section, share by student) - **Operators** define how the property should be used. Available operators are: - equals any of - does not equal any of - contains - does not contain - contains any of - starts with - starts with any of - **Values** are the actual values that the rule must meet in order to be shared. Values can be selected manually from the dropdown or by pasting multiple values separated by a semi-colon. Search for values is case-sensitive so it's important to ensure that you are using an exact match to the value that is synced to Clever.  Note: When using the School or Schools properties, you may enter or paste lists with any combination of school names, school sis\_ids, or school Clever ids. For a tutorial video of using filters with Guided sharing, [click here](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/7lng87hc41). For a tutorial video of using filters with Standard sharing, [click here](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/y3pa5e3q1m). In the below example, the filter has a requirement that a section has the subject of math in order to be shared: ![Example of filter for subject \[equals any of\] math](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZL3S)    In this example, the filter is excluding any sections with the subject of PE and Health by using the **does not equal** operator. This means that **every** section with a subject other than PE and Health **will** be shared with the application.  ![Example of a sharing rule filter](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062g0X)   * * * ## Reverting to previous rules/Viewing who made changes By clicking on the **Past rules** tab on the application's page, you can view the sharing rules history, including the date and time the rules were changed and who changed them.  Under the **Past rules** tab, you can click on **View current rules (1)** to see the current sharing rules and view the sharing rules history by date and time. By clicking on one of the small arrows next to the time (2), it will open up to show you what the sharing rules were previously. You can revert a previous rule set by clicking on **Revert to these rules** (3).  ![Screenshot of the Past Rules tab on Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062g0N)   * * * ## Multiple sharing rules and filters An application can have an unlimited number of sharing rules. In the below example, the application has two rules. A record will be shared with the app if it meets the requirements for either rule:  - Rule #1 (Share by section) - Filter #1: School equal any of Discovery Middle School - Filter #2: Subject equals any of Math In Rule #1 a section must meet both filter requirements in order for the section to be shared.    - Rule #2 (Share by student) - Filter #1: Grade equal any of 3;4;5 ![An example of multiple sharing rules](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZL3D)  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** When you have multiple rules, the two rules are mutually exclusive. So, if you want to build off the existing rule, you'll want to add a filter to the rule itself rather than create a new rule entirely. Check out our tutorial videos for [Guided sharing: Using multiple sharing rules](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/feor27pl9k) or [Standard sharing: Using multiple sharing rules](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/8lyer31cvo).   **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000JHVNq)  Clever Tip:** When having multiple sharing rules, there can be a lot of scrolling needed. To get to the top or bottom of the page faster, use the **Jump to start/Jump to end** buttons. When using Guided Sharing, this will be located on the left-hand side of your page, whereas when using Standard Sharing, you will find up and down arrows in the bottom right-hand corner of your screen.  * * * ## Adding Notes To help keep sharing permissions organized, Clever provides the ability for users to add **Notes** to sharing rules.  To add a note to a sharing rule, click **Add Note.** Enter your note and click **Save.** Notes support up to 500 characters. Once saved, the note will appear on the sharing rule. In addition, the note will display the date, time, and user that last updated the note.  ![Screenshot with the Add note option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZNDK)  To edit a note, click **Edit Note.** Any Clever Admin may edit an existing note, even if created by another user.  ![Screenshot with a note that's been left on the sharing rule](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZNCM)  * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **I updated the sharing rule and the new data I shared is not reflected in the application, what do I do?** - Please wait at least 24 hours for sharing changes to be reflected in a connected application. If you need the data to show sooner, please contact the application team directly. **Can I switch between Guided Sharing and Standard Sharing?** - Yes! You can change your sharing setup at any time using the toggle at the top of your screen. **Can I test application rules before applying them?** - Yes. You can add rules and filters and preview the data that will be shared based off of the rule or filter at the bottom of the screen before saving your sharing rule. **Why am I receiving a prompt to add my application to a category?** - When setting up sharing rules for any application not assigned to a category in your Portal (for example, a new application you’ve just added), you’ll also receive a prompt at the end of your sharing setup asking if you’d like to add the application to a category. If you’d like to add it to an existing category, choose one from the dropdown. ![Select a Portal category screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbe1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000SttqB)

title: Sharing Permissions: Sharing data with new applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043482712#one)  
2\. [What are application sharing permissions?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043482712#two)  
3\. [How do I start sharing data with an application?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043482712#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)  
4\. [How do I edit the sharing permissions for an application once the setup guide has been completed?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043482712#h_f00c7c4e-4f30-4072-9c8c-a22cb51bfeaa)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043482712#FAQ)

##   
Overview

This article will walk you through sharing data with an application once the application has accepted your request to connect via Clever.

##   

* * *

##   
What are application sharing permissions?

Once an [application has been added](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997) to a school organization's Clever Portal, Clever Admins configure sharing permissions in order to determine what data should be shared with the app, and which users should be able to access the application from their Clever Portals.

Applications won't have access to any school organization data in Clever that hasn't been specifically shared with them via the application sharing permissions.  
 

* * *

## How do I start sharing data with an application?

Clever acts as a repository that stores the data from a school organization's student information system (SIS) which is then shared with each application. A school organization might share different data with each unique application depending on the application type, licensing contingencies, and so on. In Clever, this is done by setting up sharing permissions.  
  
Clever offers two experiences for sharing data: **Guided Sharing** and **Standard Sharing**.

-   **Guided Sharing** is best for new users or those who don't set up sharing settings often.
-   **Standard sharing** is best for experienced Clever users or those who need to use School Site Sharing.

The choice in experience is custom to each user -- a new admin at your schools can choose to use Guided Sharing while an admin with more Clever experience may choose Standard Sharing.  
  
Users can choose to switch between these two experiences at any time by selecting **Edit Sharing** for an application and selecting **Switch Sharing setup view** in the top right. Your choice in sharing experience will be remembered and used anytime you edit sharing permissions for an app.

Here’s how to set your data sharing permissions for an application for the first time:

-   From your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page, click on an application name to be directed to the application’s overview page.
-   Select **Begin setup** and follow the steps in the guide to finalize your connection with the application.

For your convenience, we are providing sharing instructions for both Standard and Guided sharing.

Whether you are using Standard Sharing or Guided Sharing, you have the option to test sharing rules and filters to configure and reconfigure multiple times and preview the data that will be shared. Your sharing rules will not change until you click **Save**.  
 

### **Standard Sharing**

Standard Sharing is recommended for users familiar with configuring sharing permissions or those who need to set up School Site Sharing. Click here to learn more about the steps of Standard Sharing.

### Step 1: Set sharing

**You’ll specify which sharing type you would like to use in order to share data with the application. These settings will also determine which of your users will have the application available to them in their individual Portals.**

**You have five options for how to share data:**

**1\. Use the application’s sharing recommendation**

**2\. Copy sharing rules from another app**

-   -   **If you select this option, all records that are shared with the chosen application will also be shared with the one you're currently setting up.**
    -   **Please** **note:** copying the sharing only happens once - if you make changes to sharing with the original application, they will not be reflected in the app you're currently setting up (or vice versa)

**3\. Share by district**

-   -   **If you select this option, all schools, students, teachers, and sections in the school organization will be shared. You will also have the option to include staff in the data sharing with the application.**

**4. Share all records for specific schools**

-   -   **If you select this option all students, students, teachers, sections, and staff associated with the selected schools will be shared with the application.**

**5. Customize your sharing**

-   -   **Select **Click here to customize your sharing** to navigate to the data sharing page to configure customized sharing rules. [Read this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) to learn more about how to share by rules.**
    -   **Once you've selected your sharing type, select 'Save' to move on to step 2.**

### ![Set sharing page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fxjV)

### Step 2: Data validation

**Once you’ve shared data, we’ll check for issues that might prevent a record from being synced.**  
**Please note that you may need to wait a few minutes while we process your sharing settings. Any data error and warnings will appear on this page when processing is completed.**

![Data validation page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BYCW) 

-   **If you see an error, this means that the flagged records will not be accessible in the application - users will not be able to log in and data will be missing.**
-   **If you see a warning, this means that the flagged records will be accessible but users may have a degraded experience within the application.**
-   **If you have data that is flagged, please review the impacted records carefully. We recommend resolving as many of these data quality issues as possible to ensure that all of the data is successfully synced with the application and all desired users are able to access the application.**
    -   **For more information on resolving these data warnings and errors, check out our** [guide to data warnings and errors.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083)

Once you've reviewed any data quality issues, select **Next** to move on to step 3.

### Step 3: Finalize Setup

-   **Now that you have enabled data sharing with the application and resolved any data quality issues, the application connection is complete!**
-   **For some applications, you will need to take additional steps to finalize the app connection. Those additional steps will be outlined on this page.**
-   **For any application with single sign-on (SSO), users will be able to access the application on the launch date.**

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036VjE)

-   Once you have read the instructions to finalize your app connection, select **Finish**.
-   You’ll receive a prompt to add the application to a category. Choose a category from the dropdown if you’d like.
-   **If you need to go back to edit the sharing rules for an application, feel free to reference** [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) **for more information about the different types of sharing permissions.**

### **Guided Sharing**

Guided Sharing is recommended for users less familiar with sharing rules or for those who want a more guided experience. Click here to learn more about the steps of Guided Sharing.

### **Step 1: Choose sharing method**

-   **Choose your sharing method. There are multiple data sharing options.**
    -   **Create new sharing settings specific to the application**
    -   **Use the application’s suggested data sharing template (if provided)**
    -   **Copy another app’s data sharing rules**

### ![Screenshot of Guided Sharing step 1 choosing a sharing method](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000DMif)  
  
**Step 2: Choose who needs access**

-   **Set up access for specific sections, teachers, students, and/or staff**

###   
![Screenshot of step 2 of guided sharing, choose who needs access](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000DMnV)  
  
Step 3: Preview & share user data

-   You can preview your sharing rules and, if everything looks correct, share your schools’ data with the application

![Step 3 of guided sharing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000DAKw)  
  

-   You’ll receive a prompt to add the application to a category. Choose an existing category from the dropdown if you’d like. 

* * *

##   
How do I edit the sharing permissions for an application once the setup guide has been completed?

To edit sharing permissions, from your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page, click on the application's name to open its overview page. Under **Shared Data**, select **Edit sharing**. You can **reference** [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) **for more information about the different types of sharing permissions.**  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Why is Clever unable to display the count of shared records?**

**![Rules are too complex to display shared users screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GLxFB)**

-   Clever may be unable to provide a preview of the count of shared records for school organizations with large data sets or highly complex rules. When this occurs, "Unable to display count of shared records" or "Sorry, your rules are too complex to display shared records" may display. 
-   To view the count of shared records, please use the Application Receives section on the app overview page.

![Application Receives box on Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GLxS5)

#### **How do I add NCES IDs and/or MDR Numbers for schools in Clever?**

-   Reach out to our support team and provide a list of the numbers/IDs that need to be added and their corresponding schools. 
    

#### **How do I check to see which school is being shared as the users’ primary location?** 

-   For one-off users, you can search for the user in the search bar of your Clever Dashboard to locate their profile and look at their primary school site.
    

![Student school site highlighted on profile page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GLy6P)

-   For multiple users, you can click on the application in your Clever Dashboard and click the download button under _Application Receives_ for the user type in question.

![Application receives data type highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dd37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GLeME)

#### **How do I share co-teachers with applications?**

-   First, be sure to ask the application if they support co-teachers, as some applications don’t. If they confirm that they do support syncing co-teachers, check in Clever to ensure that they are added to the correct sections. To learn more about adding co-teachers in Clever, check out [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748). Once you have confirmed they are co-teachers to sections in Clever and the application supports co-teachers, they will be shared as long as they meet the sharing permission criteria set up for the application. You can use the [Troubleshoot Sharing tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001477) to confirm if a co-teacher or any user is shared with an application.
    

#### **Why isn’t the user shared with the app?** 

-   Sharing permissions can be tricky! Check out our [tips & troubleshooting article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001548) to help guide you to make sure the user is shared. You can also use the [Troubleshoot Sharing tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001477) to confirm if a user is shared with an application and analyze which sharing rules they don’t meet criteria for.
    

#### **The data is correct in Clever, but is not correct in the app. What do I do?**

-   This could be happening for various reasons, so it’s important to make sure everything checks out. Check out our [app troubleshooting article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533712) to guide you in troubleshooting the issue. Depending on the root of the issue, you may need to reach out to the Clever Support team, or the application’s support team directly.

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Sharing Permissions: Guided Sharing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001514)
-   [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247)

title: Sharing Permissions: Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#h_b43ee36f-2aee-4f67-91ad-8d443515bab2)  
2\. [What data is shared with apps?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#h_6007204d-6863-4f13-b52d-d9403a4cdf4d)  
3\. [Guided vs Standard Sharing view](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#h10)  
4\. [Sharing data with an app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#h_83465b3f-3a12-48b1-b616-0b8b1786d8ad)  
5\. [Viewing the data being shared with an app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#h_1d7400ef-7f1d-4ab4-84a1-2788778cf5c5)  
6. [Editing app sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#h_8e0ac10f-24d3-4521-a18b-83f0b9b21048)  
7\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007#faq)

##   
Overview 

With sharing permissions, you can control exactly which users get access to each application in Clever. Whether your whole school organization uses an app or just a handful of users (e.g., four 3rd-grade math sections), sharing permissions let you decide who gets access and what data the application receives from Clever to roster and maintain user accounts.

We know that not all applications are utilized by the same subset of users, so you can set up sharing permissions on an app-by-app basis. Sharing permissions are typically configured for each application based on its type, licensing requirements, and who needs access.

##   

  
  

* * *

##   
What data is shared with apps?

Clever provides each application with only the data necessary for its operation. To view or [modify what's being shared](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000501586), go to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page and then click on the application's name to open the app overview page. Here, you can click the download icons next to each data type to see the exact data the application receives.

![Data shared with app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fwkD)

* * *

## Guided vs Standard Sharing view

When setting up sharing permissions, you'll first choose your setup view. There are two options: Guided sharing and Standard sharing. Pick whichever works best for you.

-   **Guided sharing** is best for new users or those who don't configure sharing settings often. It walks you through the process with prompts and examples. [Watch a preview of Guided sharing](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/pwbjs3rpiy).
    
-   **Standard sharing** is best for experienced Clever users or those who need to use school site sharing. Watch a preview of [standard sharing here.](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/idcglw53d5)
    

Users can switch between these two experiences at any time by selecting **Edit Sharing** for an application and selecting **Switch Sharing setup view** in the top right. Your preference is saved and applied whenever you edit sharing permissions for an app.

![Guided vs Standard Sharing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fwlp)

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** Whether you use Guided Sharing or Standard Sharing, you’ll always be able to fully review what data is included in your sharing settings before finalizing and saving your rules. This means that you can make adjustments to your rules freely to test including the data you need before hitting save!

* * *

## Sharing data with an app

When sharing data with your applications, it’s essential to understand the sharing permission options to ensure you are only sharing the users who need access. Review the six different options below:

-   ****App’s recommended sharing**:** Applications can recommend sharing settings to communicate sharing best practices directly to your school organization in the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/). If the application has recommended sharing permissions, they'll appear when you set up sharing. Use these as a starting point for your own sharing permissions.
-   **Share by District**: All of your school organization's data in Clever will sync to the application. This includes admins, schools, teachers, students, staff, and sections.
-   **Share by Schools**: Clever will only share data associated with the school(s) you select (e.g., students, teachers, sections, staff).
-   **Share by Rules**: Clever will only share data that meets the specific criteria you've set. Share by Rules is the most recommended sharing type as it allows school organizations to determine precisely what data should be included or excluded. [Learn more about Share by Rules here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)
-   **School Site Sharing**: If your school org has designated [School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663) in Clever, you can give them the ability to configure sharing permissions for their associated schools. provide them with the ability to configure sharing permissions for their associated schools. [Learn more here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366)
-   **Copy Sharing:** Copy the sharing permissions from another application that has already been configured. 

For step-by-step directions on setting up sharing permissions, check out [this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712?language=en_US) We understand that sharing permissions can be tricky to think through, so check out our [sharing permission tips and tricks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001548?language=en_US)! And remember, you can always preview the data your rules will share before saving.

Once you share data with an application, it'll dynamically update based on your sharing permissions. Allow up to 24 hours for sharing changes to be reflected in the learning application. If you need changes reflected sooner, contact the application directly.

When setting up sharing rules for any application not assigned to a category in your Portal (for example, a new app you've just added or one in the default **More Apps** category), you'll see a prompt at the end of your sharing setup asking if you'd like to add the application to a category or notify teachers of the application.

If you'd like to add it to a category, choose a category from the drop down. If you'd like to notify teachers, check the box to do so. Notifying teachers is a great way to share about new or under utilized applications in your account.

![Screenshot of the option to organize an app into a category and notify teachers.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000r9U5C)    
  
 

* * *

##   
Viewing the data being shared with an app

Once you've configured sharing permissions, you can download CSV files of the schools, students, teachers, staff, admins, and sections being shared with an application.

Go to [Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications), then click the application's name to open the overview page. In the **Application Receives** box, click the blue icon to download a file of the data the application is receiving.

Keep in mind that the **Application Receives** files include only a few basic details about each shared record. The application may have access to additional fields based on your field access settings. For example, the students.csv doesn't include student email addresses, but the application partner might be receiving them. For details on which data each application is syncing per record, visit: [What data is available to my connected applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586)

![Application receives data](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lvbm)   
 

* * *

##   
Editing app sharing permissions

To edit sharing permissions, go to [Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and click the application's name to open the overview page.  Then, select **Edit sharing** under the **Shared Data** section.  
  
![Screenshot of edit sharing button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GHPOz) 

If you have any questions about setting up your sharing permissions or what data is being shared with your applications, please reach out to [Clever support.](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360001041326) We are happy to help!

  
 

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

####   
**Why is Clever unable to display the count of shared records?**

  
          ![Screenshot of rules too complex screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZFch) 

-   Clever may be unable to provide a preview of the count of shared records for school organizations with large data sets or highly complex rules. When this occurs, "**Unable to display count of shared records**" or "**Sorry, your rules are too complex to display shared records"** may display. 
-   To view the count of shared records, please use the **Application Receives** section on the app overview page.   
      
    ![Application receives box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZFcm) 

#### **How do I add NCES IDs and/or MDR Numbers for schools in Clever?**

-   Reach out to our support team and provide a list of the numbers/IDs that need to be added and their corresponding schools. 

#### **How do I check to see which school is being shared as the users’ primary location?** 

-   For one-off users, you can search for the user in the search bar of your Clever Dashboard to locate their profile and look at their primary school site. 

![Student profile with primary school circled](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fwsH)

For multiple users, you can click on the application in your Clever Dashboard and click the download button under _Application Receives_ for the user type in question.

![Data shared with app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eWVp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001fwtt)

#### **Why does the data my application is receiving include a school that is not explicitly shared in my sharing rule?**

-   This is common in Share by Schools rules since they share all data associated with teachers, sections, and students. If a teacher or student is associated with multiple schools, this additional school will be implicitly shared as data associated with the student or teacher.
-   This can also happen in Share by Rules if a student or teacher's primary school site is a school not explicitly shared, it will still be implicitly shared as their primary site.

#### **How do I share co-teachers with applications?**

-   First, be sure to ask the application if they support co-teachers, as some applications don’t. If they confirm that they do support syncing co-teachers, check in Clever to ensure that they are added to the correct sections. To learn more about adding co-teachers in Clever, check out [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000988748?language=en_US). Once you have confirmed they are co-teachers to sections in Clever and the application supports co-teachers, they will be shared as long as they meet the sharing permission criteria set up for the application. You can use the [Troubleshoot Sharing tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001477) to confirm if a co-teacher or any user is shared with an application.

#### **Why isn’t the user shared with the app?** 

-   Sharing permissions can be tricky! Check out our [tips & troubleshooting article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001548) to help guide you to make sure the user is shared. You can also use the [Troubleshoot Sharing tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001477) to confirm if a user is shared with an application and analyze which sharing rules they don’t meet criteria for.

#### **The data is correct in Clever, but is not correct in the app. What do I do?**

-   This could be happening for various reasons, so it’s important to make sure everything checks out. Check out our [app troubleshooting article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533712?language=en_US) to guide you in troubleshooting the issue.

* * *

  
**Related Articles:**

-   [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247)
-   [Sharing Permissions: Guided Sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514)

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Troubleshooting issues
text:
This article contains the following:  
[1\. Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234759108#h_bdfd34b1-392b-411c-9077-3a30cf972407)  
[2\. Updating student credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234759108#h_8baf5ee6-ee0f-42d8-9fd3-d6bda06c47bc)  
[3\. Updating staff & teacher credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234759108#h_4b5f5c6a-ea70-48cf-ba13-e76d883231fa)  
[4\. But my issue doesn't look like that!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234759108#h_1498955d-ccac-44be-a8a6-d7498582dc66)

[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234759108#h_1498955d-ccac-44be-a8a6-d7498582dc66)

## Overview

[Every now and then you may have users who have trouble logging into](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234759108#h_1498955d-ccac-44be-a8a6-d7498582dc66) [Saved Passwords applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US), or they need to update their credentials for the app. Here are some tips for troubleshooting these issues which will make the process as painless as possible.

If your current district [settings for the Saved Passwords application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187?language=en_US) allow your users to manually enter their credentials the very first time they log into the app through Clever, Clever will save those credentials for the future providing a single sign-on (SSO) experience for users. 

The challenge is that sometimes users will enter the incorrect credentials the first time around, and those are what gets saved to Clever. The great news is that those credentials can be updated in Clever!  
 

In the vast majority of cases, if users are unable to log into a Saved Passwords application, they'll see a message like the one below:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288VC)

## Updating student credentials

To update a student's credentials, please follow these steps:

1.  Go directly to the application's website login page outside of Clever, and confirm if the user's credentials are successful.
    -   If the credentials are not successful, please contact the application provider directly to correct the error.
    -   If credentials are successful, attempt to enter those same credentials again in the screen shown above and then select 'Update & Log in'. Then, confirm the credentials work by accessing the application again through the Clever Portal.

If for some reason, the 'Update & Log in' option in the screenshot above did not work with resetting the user's credentials, the student's teacher or a district admin can assist by following these steps:  
 

-   The teacher will log in to Clever.  District admins can utilize the 'Access Portal As' feature from their [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to access the teacher's account in order to do the following:
    -   Click on the 'Help​ a Student' option.
    -   Locate the student who needs their credentials updated. 
    -   The prompt will ask if you want to update the student's Clever login or generate a backup code. Click 'No' where it asks if this solved the problem. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bx4N)

-   Locate the Saved Passwords application.
-   When asked if the student has the app icon in their portal, say 'Yes.'
-   Then update the Saved Passwords credentials. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000djEz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bx4C)

-   Finally, have the student test their login to the app to see if it works correctly (or district admins can 'Access Portal As' the student to test it for them).

District admins can also set credentials for Saved Passwords apps [through a bulk upload](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187) in the Clever Dashboard.

##   
Updating staff & teacher credentials

If a staff member or teacher inputs incorrect credentials for an SSO (Saved Passwords) application, they can update them by following these steps:

1.  Log in to the Clever Portal.
2.  Select the application that has incorrect credentials.
3.  Enter the correct username and password for the application, and click 'Update & Log in'.

If for some reason the above steps do not work, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip****:** If you are still having trouble, please confirm that the username and password you've entered work to log into your account directly on the application's page. If you can successfully access the app directly through their website, but not through Clever, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for help!

##   
But my issue doesn't look like that!

If the above doesn't fix the issue or you're experiencing a completely different problem, please try the following steps:

1.  Check the version of the Clever browser extension you're using at chrome://extensions. If there is a more recent version of the extension, download it. For more information, visit either [For Clever Admins: Installing the Clever Browser Extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) or [For Families: Installing the Clever Browser Extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046857272).
2.  Update Chrome at chrome://help.

If all else fails, our support team is more than happy to help troubleshoot with you. To help expedite the process, [in your request please include](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new):

-   The browser details 
-   The version of the Clever browser extension you're using
-   The version of Chrome you're using
-   The student/teacher number of the user affected
-   A screenshot and/or short description of the issue

If you have any additional questions, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: iOS Devices
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360033063711#Header1)  
2\. [How it works](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360033063711#Header2)  
3\. [Unsupported device errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360033063711#Header3)  
4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360033063711#Header3)

## Overview

[SSO (Saved Passwords) applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US) are available to use with the Clever iOS application. Provided that the user has the Clever application installed on their device and is connected to SSO (Saved Passwords) applications in their account, once logged into Clever, they will enjoy a seamless single sign-on experience for more of their favorite education applications!  
  
Please note that the Clever iOS application only works on devices on iOS version 16.6 and up.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ave5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Us)**Please note:** SSO (Saved Passwords) applications on iOS are not yet available for Clever Admins.

   

## How it works

**Clever iOS app for students**

When using the Clever iOS application, users can log into their SSO (Saved Passwords) applications.

Once the student selects the Clever application and logs in, they’ll see their student Portal. From here, they can click on any Saved Passwords application, and the app will load within the Clever application.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ave5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Us)**Please note:** For SSO (Saved Passwords) applications on iOS, they'll always open in the Clever app and never redirect to the native application downloaded on the device. 

**iOS device in a web browser**

If a teacher, staff, or admin user is utilizing an iOS device to access Clever, they’ll need to access it via a web browser. Once logged into Clever in the web browser, the user can choose an SSO (Saved Passwords) application just like they would choose any other SSO application. The user will then be taken to the application's web page in the Clever app and their credentials will be entered for them, providing a single sign-on experience for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications on their mobile device.

   

## Unsupported device errors

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ave5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288V7)

If you see an 'Unsupported device' error when attempting to open an SSO (Saved Passwords) application, it means this particular application is not currently supported on iOS devices. If you would like access to these applications on your iOS device, adding the application as an external link to your district's Clever Portal is recommended. For more information, please visit: [How do I add custom external links to the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002942963?language=en_US)  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ave5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Uo) For more about SSO (Saved Passwords) applications, please see [For Teachers: What are SSO (Saved Passwords) applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026789592)

  

## Troubleshooting

We are always happy to help! For the fastest resolution, please make sure to check the following:

-   Is your mobile device running on iOS 16.6 or above?
-   Is your Clever app updated to version 6.x or above?

If you've confirmed both of these details, please move on to check:

-   Can the user log into the SSO (Saved Passwords) application successfully on a computer (non-mobile device)?
-   Have users confirmed they can access the application outside of Clever?

If the user can't log into the application successfully on a computer, please reach out to the application directly to troubleshoot login credentials.

If the user can log in on a computer or access the application at Clever, please feel free to contact [Clever support.](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360001041326) Please provide all of the details of your troubleshooting steps above, as well as any videos or screenshots of the errors you're encountering. Please avoid sending personally identifiable information (PII) in any pictures or videos you provide.

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Managing Credentials
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#Overview)  
2. [Managing Credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#Header1)  
3\. [Manual input from user at first login](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#Header2)  
4\. [Matching Credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#Header3)  
5\. [Custom Credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#Header4)  
6\. [Uploading Credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#creds)  
7\. [Reset or Remove credentials for users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234973187#Header7)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Tk) Read [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Overview & Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US) first to learn how to add SSO (Saved Passwords) applications to your Clever Portal!

## Overview

SSO (Saved Passwords) applications have the ability to provide your users with a seamless SSO experience despite Clever not having a formal integration with the application you have added. In order for SSO to work properly with your SSO (Saved Passwords) applications, you will need to ensure that you have set up credentials correctly. This article will describe the options that you have as well as provide you with directions on how you can manage credentials.   
 

* * *

##   
Managing Credentials
