Once an application has been added to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page, the next step is to input username and password information for your users to log into the SSO (Saved Passwords) application. You can manage credentials by navigating to the 'Settings' tab of the specific application's [Manage Credentials](https://schools.clever.com/applications/ilpro-type-to-learn/configure) page. This article will go over multiple options for setting up your users' credentials for the specified application.  
 

![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-9.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BSLH)

* * *

##   
Manual input from user at first login

By default, we will request that users enter their credentials manually the first time. After the first time, they will be automatically logged into their application with one click.

* * *

##   
Matching Credentials

If usernames and passwords can be found in your SIS information, you can select which field this information is contained in by selecting the drop-down menu.  The field options are as follows:

-   District username, district password, date of birth, email, SIS ID, student number & state ID

![Drop-down displays available fields that district can match credentials with.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000gzaA)

\>

* * *

##   
Custom Credentials

To match the usernames/passwords created outside of Clever for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications, you can use the "Custom" option in the dropdown and use a formula from below. More information about custom formulas can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035539131?language=en_US).

Available fields: 

-   {{credentials.district\_username}} = username from SIS sync
-   {{credentials.district\_password}} = password from SIS sync
-   {{name.first}} = first name from SIS sync
-   {{name.last}} = last name from SIS sync
-   {{email}} = email from SIS sync
-   {{student\_number}} = student number from SIS sync
-   {{\_id}} = Clever ID 
-   {{sis\_id}} = SIS ID from SIS sync (student\_id, teacher\_id, staff\_id)
-   {{graduation\_year}} = graduation year from SIS sync
-   {{dob}} = birthday from SIS sync

| Desired username or password | Formula \[fill in portions in brackets\] | Example formula | Sample result for an example user |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Username from the sync plus my district's email domain | {{credentials.district\_username}}\[add domain name here\] | {{credentials.district\_username}}@cleverusd.edu | [skelly19@cleverusd.edu](mailto:skelly19@cleverusd.edu)  |
| A specific word/phrase that's the same for every student | \[add that word/phrase here\] | apple | apple |
| Insert the whole contents of a field from either the SIS sync or the .csv upload | {{FIELD NAME}} | {{graduation\_year}} | 2030 |
| First initial, last name | {{substr name.first 0 1}}{{name.last}} | {{substr name.first 0 1}}{{name.last}} | skelly |
| Their email without the domain | {{textBefore email "@"}} | {{textBefore email "@"}} | sykelly |
| Last 4 digits of a field | {{substr FIELDNAME -4 4}} | {{substr student\_number -4 4}} | 5678 |
| Something else... | Contact us via the form in our Help Center and we'll create a formula for you!  
Custom formulas are complicated and are most easily communicated via email. |

* * *

## Uploading Credentials

When a user's credentials are uploaded via CSV, they will not be asked to log in the first time they access the application through Clever. If a user is not included in the credentials upload, the expected behavior is they will be prompted to manually enter their credentials at their first login, and then will be automatically logged in each time thereafter.

  
**Method 1: Upload via Clever** 

You can securely upload credentials directly from the 'Settings' tab of the specific application's [Manage Credentials](https://schools.clever.com/applications/ilpro-type-to-learn/configure) page. To do so, first select **Manual upload from .csv** as the username and password which will enable a web upload tool to upload your CSV file. This does state "not recommended", this is due to the complexity of creating the files and managing the credentials on the district's end. 

![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-10.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BSMZ)

  
Upload the file and select **Save**. We have also provided a downloadable template for reference.

![Notification\_Center-18.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BSO1)

  
**Method 2:** **SFTP Upload**

You can upload user credentials via the Credentials SFTP server. Files should be in the form of `students.csv`, `teachers.csv`, or `staff.csv` and uploaded to the appropriate folder for the application (e.g. /career-cruising). [See tips to format your files](https://assets.clever.com/website/files/Configuring_SSO_Accounts.pdf) to successfully upload credentials or [download template files](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/credentials.zip).

  
The username and password of your Credentials SFTP connection are the same as for your SIS sync SFTP connection, and can be found under the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in the **SFTP Settings - Saved Passwords Applications** box:

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035o0q)

For more information on the tools that you can use to access and upload files to your credentials SFTP server, please see this Help Center article: [What are some recommended tools for SFTP syncs?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206020358)

* * *

## Formatting Credentials Uploads

SSO (Saved Passwords) applications in the Clever Portal accept three files for setup: students.csv, teachers.csv, and staff.csv. Please find the specification on formatting below.

Separate setup files are required for every SSO (Saved Passwords) application, even if the credentials used are the same for all applications.

Generic specifications for students.csv

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288UE)

Generic specifications for teachers.csv

## ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288UJ)

Generic specifications for staff.csv

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288UT)

  
**Uploading credentials: special cases**

Some applications require more than just a username and password. For example, the application may require a school code or a pin number. For these applications, you will need to include an additional column in your credential upload. The required fields will be reflected on the 'Upload Credentials' page and will look something like this:

![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-12.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BSOp)

You will also use an extra column when your users sign into an application from multiple URLs (i.e. URLs that are unique for each school in a district).

  
**Troubleshooting upload issues**

Once you upload credentials, you'll receive a confirmation email with a summary of your upload. If there are any issues, the email will also list the number of rows that could not be processed. Here are some of the most common issues that prevent rows from being processed and how to resolve them:

1.  **Missing data:** All of the fields listed on the 'Upload Credentials' tab of an application are required. Double-check that you're not missing any additional rows (see "Uploading Credentials: Special Cases" above) and that none of your rows have empty cells in them.
2.  **Incorrect user IDs:** Each User\_ID must exactly match the **SIS\_ID** of the user you are uploading credentials for. You can check each user's SIS\_ID in your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser).
    -   _**Please note**_: Leading zeros (i.e. the "000" in "000123") **do** matter. If your users' SIS\_IDs have leading zeros, make sure the zeros aren't getting stripped in your upload file.
3.  **Duplicate rows:** Clever will only process the first set of credentials for each User\_ID. If a User\_ID is included in multiple rows, all rows past the first will be listed as errors.
4.  **Formatting errors:** Sometimes simple formatting errors such as incorrect capitalization can cause errors. Make sure your headers match exactly what is listed on the 'Uploading Credentials' tab. Also, make sure you are saving the file as a CSV.

* * *

## Reset or Remove credentials for users

### **Resetting credentials in bulk**

To remove previously uploaded credentials for a SSO (Saved Passwords) application, please follow these steps: 

1.  Navigate to the application in the Clever Dashboard
2.  Select **Settings**
3.  Select **Manage credentials**
4.  _(Optional)_ Adjust credentials for the correct user type if necessary.
5.  Select **Confirm**
6.  _(Optional)_ Adjust student credentials if needed. Select _**Confirm**_
7.  Select **Done**
8.  Check the box labeled **Delete these credentials and apply new settings**
9.  Click **Match credentials**

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035o0W)

### **Resetting credentials for individual students**

If your students enter in the incorrect credentials for their applications the first time they log in, teachers have the ability to update these passwords!

1.  Click on **My Students** and then **Student Roster** in the drop-down.  
    ![Screenshot 2024-10-02 at 9.41.44 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009IsOC)   
      
    
2.  Select the student that needs help, then click **Troubleshoot app login** in the student menu that appears.  
    ![Screenshot 2024-10-02 at 9.42.11 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009IlOI)   
      
    
3.  Search for the application and select that the student can see the application in their Portal.  
    ![Screenshot 2024-10-02 at 9.43.00 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009J7NB)  
      
    ![Screenshot 2024-10-02 at 9.43.08 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009J7S1)   
      
    
4.  Click on **set or update credentials**. This will allow you to set/update the student’s credentials, allowing them to access the saved password application the next time they log in through their Clever Portal.  
    ![Screenshot 2024-10-02 at 9.43.25 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiFN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009IzRG)

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - App filters
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [What are app filters?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003323043#WhatAppFilters)  
2. [How do app filters work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003323043#HowAppFiltersWork)  
3. [How can we tell that data is filtered?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003323043#HowDataFiltered)  
4. [How do I view the data currently shared with the application?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003323043#HowViewData)  
5. [How do I request a change to an app filter?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003323043#HowRequestChange)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQuL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288TQ)**Please note:** If a change to an app filter is needed, **please contact the application's support team directly**. In your request, please include your school organization's name, the change needed to the current filter, and the reason for requesting this adjustment. 

##   
What are app filters?

App filters are a way for application partners to manage the data that school organizations share. Many applications only need access to limited data for their integrations. For example, some applications only require section data for specific subjects, while others only need data for schools that have licenses. To resolve this issue, applications can create filters to ensure they receive only the data they need, increasing data privacy and enhancing integration quality.

## How do app filters work?

Step 1: [School organizations share data with the application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).

Step 2: Applications apply filters on the school organization data to manage exactly which data they are receiving, whereby ensuring that only relevant data is synced.

**Please note that apps can still filter data even if you have [app sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607) enabled**

## How can we tell that data is filtered?

If an app-side filter is applied to a school organization, the school organization will see an "App Filters" tab in the application area of the Clever dashboard. School Organization Admins can view:  
 

**Shared Data**: the data shared with the application by the school organization.

  
**Filters**: the filters that were applied to the school organization data by the application.

  
**Final Data**: the resulting filtered data that will be synced by the application.  
 

![Screenshot of data being shared and filtered.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQuL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288TV)

If a user is shared with the application but is targeted by an app filter, the application will show as unavailable on their profile: "Currently unavailable - Use Troubleshooting tools to resolve"

![Screenshot of an app showing it is currently available](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQuL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001Jpkb)

## How do I view the data currently shared with the application?

School Organization Admins can download a CSV file of schools, students, teachers, or sections that are included in the data shared with that application.  
 

To download these CSV files, click on the application icon from your Clever dashboard. On the Overview page, you'll see a box titled "Applications Receives".  
 

You can click the blue download icon next to schools, students, teachers, or sections to download the list of data shared for that data type. These files will display the **final data** that is shared with the application.  
 

![Screenshot showing the data an application is receiving.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQuL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Ta)   
 

## How do I request a change to an app filter?

If a change to an app filter is needed, **please contact the application's support team directly**. In your request, please indicate:  
 

School Organization: _school organization name_  
Request: _list requested changes to app filter_  
Notes: _reason for requesting change to app filter_

If the application has provided a Support Contact for you to contact directly, you'll find it at the top of the application overview page:

![Screenshot of the outreach contact on the app overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQuL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Noqsc)

title: SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Overview & Setup
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488#h_711d611d-92bd-4b65-8959-c0141d8b594a)  
2\. [Getting started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488#h_1358ce08-36cb-4d55-a67d-c09c5cec93fa)  
3\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488#h_aee881ac-c0a4-46f6-ad81-e0aa71d08336)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488#h_6869b59b-2899-437e-90b3-53d8f3523c0c)

![Clever Academy logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035jxs)  
Looking for additional support setting up Clever Portal? Check out our [Clever Academy Quick Start - Setting up your Portal course](https://go.clever.com/l/569832/2020-03-20/kqh52)

##   
Overview

SSO (Saved Passwords) applications are apps that don't currently have a rostering or single sign-on (SSO) integration with Clever, but can still be accessed via SSO through Clever Portal. This means districts can provide users with a seamless SSO experience for almost any learning application even if it is not an existing Clever partner.    
  
With the SSO (Saved Passwords) option, rostering data and user accounts are not synced to the app by Clever. This means they must be created within the application in advance, and user login credentials need to be manually set by the district admin, or by the users themselves. Clever will securely store these credentials so district users are logged into the applications automatically via single sign-on through Clever.   
  
This article and the video below provides a detailed overview of SSO (Saved Passwords) applications and the setup process for launching these apps at your district. 

##   

* * *

##   
Getting started

-   **District user accounts and credentials for the app:**
    -   The first step is to confirm your district users have accounts and login credentials for the SSO (Saved Passwords) application. This would be done by working with the app partner directly before setting the app up in Clever.

-   **Non-iOS devices:**
    -   The second step is confirming the Clever browser extension is installed on all non-iOS devices that will be used to access the application through Clever. This includes home devices for users who will be accessing this app from home. The Clever browser extension facilitates single sign-on for SSO (Saved Passwords) apps. Please visit this article for more.
        -   The Clever browser extension is **_not_** required for iOS devices (e.g. iPads, iPhones) as these devices use the Clever app which acts as the browser extension. Please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360033063711) for more.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** For devices where the browser extension cannot be downloaded (e.g. Android, Kindle Fire), Saved Passwords apps will not be accessible. For details, visit: [Clever Browser & Device Compatibility](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236226387)

* * *

##   
Setup

After configuring the above, there are three steps to set up any application for universal single sign-on (SSO) from your Clever Portal.

  
**1\. Find and add an application**

Visit the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add applications](https://schools.clever.com/school/applications) page in your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) to find the application you would like to use. Once identified, click **Request App**_._ 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgRT)

Next, select if you would like to request that the application provider begin supporting rostering via Clever Secure Sync. The more requests Clever receives, the more likely it is to happen in the future.

  
Finally, select **Request Application**.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgRs)

**2\. Configure user access**

The next screen will provide you with an option to share the added application with particular schools.   
You can select the schools as listed and select **Request with sharing** or choose **Request and share later**. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgS7)

Sharing rules can always be changed from the individual application's page under **Modify user selection**.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgSC)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** For more information on setting up your sharing permissions, check out [How do I set my sharing permissions for applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) [](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)

  
**3. Provide your login information**

1.  [Selecting an example user](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488#Selecting%20an%20example%20user)
2.  [Provide your login information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488#Choosing%20a%20formula%20type)

Once you have added the application and set up sharing rules, you'll need to provide information on how Clever should log in your users. 

  
First, select **Begin matching** on the added application's page: 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgSM)

  
Some applications require district specific information for logins to work. If this is the case, the first step will prompt you for the information Clever needs. You will need to obtain the information in these fields from the application. Please see the example below: 

![Screenshot of configuring the district settings for a Saved Passwords application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000YXw1)

You can then choose whether credentials for this application will be set at a district level or if individual users will set their own credentials. 

![Screenshot of the Select login credentials options for Saved Passwords](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000YY8v)

If you choose to have individuals set their own credentials, take note of the flow diagram that details the process, and click **Confirm**.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgSg)

  
Next, you'll need to provide login information: 

####   
1\. Selecting an example user

To begin matching credentials, select an existing user for the specified user type (e.g. student, teacher, staff). This step is meant to provide you with an example as you configure the credentials for this resource. We suggest entering a user for whom you already have the username and password. Once you have selected a user, you will see the data that’s synced from your SIS populated in the box below.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgSl)

####   
2\. Choosing a formula type

Next, you'll choose a formula type for both Username and Password.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgSq)

You can choose from the following:

-   _Exact user attribute_
    -   This setting will pull data fields from a user’s profile as it is synced from your SIS. If we are not currently pulling in the fields you need, then reach out to Clever support to investigate possible alternate mappings.
-   _Manual input from user at first login_
    -   This setting allows users to input their own credentials the first time they access the Saved Passwords resource via the Clever Portal. These credentials will be saved for all future logins.
-   _Custom Formula_
    -   You can use existing fields in the user’s profile to form custom strings for the Username/Password. Please see this Help Center article: [How do I manage Saved Passwords application credentials?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187#Header4)
-   _CSV via SFTP_
    -   When a user's credentials are uploaded via CSV, they will not be asked to log in the first time they access the application through Clever. 
    -   Upload a file containing each user’s credentials using SFTP. You can find the SFTP credentials on your  [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in the **SFTP Settings - Saved Passwords Applications box**.
-   _One time CSV upload_
    -   Upload a file containing each user’s credentials directly to the site using drag and drop.

  
You may choose any combination of these options for your username and password configurations. Once you have completed both fields, you will see a **preview** of the credentials in the card on the left. Click **Confirm** to save those changes. You can return and edit your formulas by clicking on the corresponding card on the left.

  
For additional instructions, please visit: [How do I manage Saved Passwords application credentials?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187)

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions

  
**Why do these applications require a lengthy setup?**

-   SSO (Saved Passwords) applications are not formally integrated with Clever. Our engineering team works to create a connection that will serve your users in the most seamless way possible! In order for our connection to work smoothly, we require you to set up the application beforehand and ask that you provide us with credentials. While these applications do take a bit more setup time, your users will enjoy a seamless experience once everything is done.

  
**What device(s) can I use with Saved Passwords applications?**

-   Applications with Saved Passwords can be used on any devices that support browser extensions with Chrome, Firefox, or Edge. Desktop computers, laptops, Chromebooks, and Windows devices are all supported. Saved Passwords is also supported on iOS devices running on iOS 9.0 and above with the most up to date Clever app installed.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Saved Passwords functionality on iOS** For more information on how to set this up, please see [Clever Saved Passwords for iOS.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360033063711)

  
**Can we use Google / Active Directory / Entra ID / Office365 to log into an application via Clever?** 

-   SSO (Saved Passwords) apps will only function properly with applications that allow for a standard username and password. They will not work with any applications where the district uses a third-party identity provider  (e.g. Google) to log in to the application directly.
-   If your district uses Google to log into Clever, you can add the application as an [external link](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002942963) on your Clever Dashboard. Since there is an active Google session on the device, the user should not need to re-authenticate when they click **Log in with Google** on the application's website. 

  
**What if I don't see an application I want?**

-   Check out [Requesting a single sign-on (SSO) application.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001113446)

**What if the application requires a specific login URL for my district?**

-   If the application has a specific login URL for your district, follow the steps below to enter that URL

1\. Click the application on your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page.

2\. Click the **Settings** tab.

![App Settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000030lDK)

3\. Scroll down to the bottom and click _Edit_

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TiGz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000030mEE)

4\. Enter the login URL.

5\. Click **Save**_._

_6._ This URL will now automatically be the URL Clever uses for SSO for your users. You can always come back and update this URL as needed by following the same steps above.

**Where are some additional resources for SSO (Saved Passwords) apps?**

-   [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Testing and Piloting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001921227)
-   [SSO (Saved Passwords): Converting external link apps to Saved Passwords apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002016328)
-   [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Troubleshooting issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234759108?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Safety thresholds
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047113052#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [Safety thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047113052#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)  
3\. [How to know if your app connection is on hold](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047113052#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)  
4\. [Next steps to continue syncing your school organization’s data with an app on hold](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047113052#h_f00c7c4e-4f30-4072-9c8c-a22cb51bfeaa)

##   
Overview

If your school organization makes large changes to the data that is synced to Clever, we put a hold on the sync to make sure the changes are intentional. In a very similar fashion, if changes to your sync or the sharing permissions for an application would cause a large percentage of data shared with the app to change or be deleted, app-side safety thresholds will not allow that data to be synced to the application until a member of the app team has had a chance to review the data.  
 

App-side safety thresholds are an important part of syncing rostering information as it ensures that both you and the app team are aware of any potentially significant changes to your school organization’s data. Holds are a safeguard to prevent potentially incorrect or undesired changes from being synced to an application. 

## Safety Thresholds

By default, if your school organization’s most recent sync or an update in your sharing permissions results in over 75% of any data type (e.g. schools, students, teachers, sections) being updated or over 10% being deleted, an application safety hold will be triggered. Some applications may set different safety thresholds in order to better support you. 

Once a safety hold is approved, the school organization's data will be fully available in Clever’s API for the application to pull. 

##   
How to know if your app connection is on hold

You will know if your connection to an application is on hold based on the status of the application as seen on the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page. If the application has a status of **Requires App Review**, then a hold has been placed on your school organization’s connection to the application:  
 

![An application that requires app review](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dAlt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288T6)   
 

By navigating to the Overview page of the application, you can also view the application’s status:  
 

![More details on when an app requires app review](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dAlt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288TB)   
 

![Clever "C" Logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dAlt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288TG)  For a description of each of the possible application statuses, please see [What's my application's status?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360016204711)

##   
Next steps to continue syncing your school organization’s data with an app on hold

Please reach out to the application’s team directly to work with their team on reviewing your school organization’s recent changes and releasing the app-side hold.

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Field access
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000501586#Field%20Access)  
2\. [Customizing student field access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000501586#two)  
3\. [Customizing student contact field access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000501586#three)  
4\. [Customizing School Organization Admin field access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000501586#four)

##   
Overview

The Field Access feature helps school organizations view and audit the data fields available to each connected application in the Clever API for students and student contacts. 

You can find the Field Access information by navigating to a specific application in your dashboard and choosing the **Settings** tab:

![Screenshot of Field Access features.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR41&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aBkC)

 Currently, Field Access gives you an overview of the data that your applications have indicated they are using. Each field is set up by each learning application, if you have any questions about this you will need to contact their support team.

If you need to add additional custom fields (i.e. extension data) to Clever, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) for more information.  
 

* * *

##   
Customizing student field access 

You can edit which student fields are currently being shared with the application from this same page.  
  
Select **Advanced settings** > ****Customize fields shared with**.**  You can then customize the student data that is available to the application from the **Edit Student Fields** page: 

![Screenshot of customizing student fields.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR41&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aBjd)

On this screen, you will find two lists:

-   The list on the left-hand side shows all the fields in Clever that you can choose to share with the application. 
-   The list on the right-hand side shows the list of fields that are currently being shared with the application. 

Once you have selected which student fields you would like to share, select **Next** and you will be presented with the ability to customize student contact field access. Click **Save** to finalize your selections.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR41&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288SD)**Please note:**  Some fields cannot be removed from the application's sync. For the fields that can be removed, the result may be a degraded experience depending on the application.  

* * *

##   
Customizing student contacts field access 

[Student contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002711943) are usually students' parents and guardians. You can share student contacts with apps if needed.

To customize student contact field access, select **Advanced settings >** **Customize fields shared with.** You'll be prompted to customize your _student_ fields first and can click **Next** to access the settings for _student contacts._ You can choose to disable student contacts for the application or customize which fields are shared. Once you have selected which _student contact_ fields you would like to share, select **Next** and you will be presented with the ability to customize _school organization administrator_ field access. Click **Save** to finalize your selections.

![Screenshot of editing a contact field.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR41&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgAX)   
 

* * *

##   
Customizing School Organization Admin field access

To customize school organization administrator field access, select ****Advanced settings**** \> ****Customize fields shared with**.** Once you have selected which _student_ and _student contact_ fields you would like to share, select ****Next**** and you will be presented with the ability to customize _school_ _organization_ _administrator_ field access. You can choose to disable school organization administrator access for the application or customize which fields to share. Click **Save** to finalize your selections.

![Screenshot of editing school organization admin field access.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR41&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgAc)

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Data Warnings and Errors
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043083#TypesOfDataIssues) 2\. [Types of data quality issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043083#TypesOfDataIssues) 3\. [Viewing data quality issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043083#ViewingDataQualityIssues) 4\. [Fixing data quality issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043083#FixingDataQualityIssues) 5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043083#FAQs) ## Overview Even after your data syncs with Clever, there may be data quality issues that can affect application performance. The impact of these data quality issues varies by application. Reviewing data quality issues is an important troubleshooting step when user records are missing or users are experiencing problems within an application. If you have questions on how a data quality warning will impact usage of an application, please reach out to the application team directly.   ![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OfbAg)  **Please note:** For more information on how a data quality error or warning will impact the application's use, please contact the application team directly. The application team configures data quality errors and warnings. * * * ## Types of data quality issues ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288RA) **Data Errors** **Impact: High** If a record is flagged by a Data Error, the user or section won't appear in the application. Data errors must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288RF)**Data Warnings** **Impact: Low** If a record is flagged by a Data Warning, the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that _may_ _result_ in a degraded app experience. **We recommend contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning**. Data Warnings can often be ignored. To contact the application team, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and click on the application. If the application team has provided one, you may find a support contact on the app's overview page. If a support contact isn't provided, please search online for the app's contact information. ![Screenshot showing how to contact the application team.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Og9FZ) * * * ## Viewing data quality issues Data Warnings are specific to each application. You can view your Data Warnings via two methods:   - To view all data warnings: **Support Tools > Data Quality** - To view app-specific data warnings: Select an application, select **Data Quality**  **![Screenshot of the support tools Data Quality tab.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288RK)**  **[Support Tools > Data Quality](https://schools.clever.com/data-quality) (recommended)** On this screen you will see five pieces of information:  
Issue TypeData TypeFieldNumber of issuesImpacted Applications
The severity of the data quality issue; data error or data warning. More info can be found here.The record type affected (school, student, teacher, section, etc.). The field that is being flagged for data quality issues (ex: student_email).The number of records flagged for this data quality issue.The applications that may be affected.
To view the details of an issue, click on the number of issues. Here you'll see a description of the issue(s), the number of issues relating to that error, and the affected application(s). To view which specific records are related to the issue, click the download button to download a file containing a list of affected records.    ![Graphic showing how to view the details of an issue.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288RP)    Clever groups issues by issue type, record type, and field. As such, when you select an issue from the main Data Quality screen, you may see multiple related issues on the detail screen. For example:    ![Graphic showing how to view the details by issue type.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288RU) * * * ## Fixing data quality issues First, let's quickly review which errors must be fixed and which are optional:  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288RZ) **Data Errors** Impact: High - Must be fixed ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR0n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Re)**Data Warnings** Impact: Low - Optional to fix. Contact the application directly to determine the impact on user experience.   To resolve most data quality issues, simply adjust the data in your student information system (SIS). Once the updated data is received in your next sync, the data quality issue will be removed. If the data was added via Custom Data in Clever, navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) and locate the record you'd like to edit. If you receive a data quality error about **missing a specific field** for all records:    - **SFTP syncs: Add the field to your CSV exports and upload the updated CSV files to Clever. [Directions for formatting your data files can be found here](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf).**   - **SIS-managed Auto Sync:** Reach out to your SIS and request that they add the field to your CSV exports. Once the updated data files are received, the data quality error will be resolved. [Directions for formatting your data files can be found here.](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf)   - **Clever-managed Auto Sync:** Contact our support team with the following information: - _**Record Type:** i.e. Student, Teacher, Sections, etc._ - _**Name of the field in Clever:** i.e. Username, State ID, FRL\_status_ - _**The exact name of the field in your SIS**_ * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **What will happen if I don't fix a data quality error or warning?** - If you don't resolve a data quality error, users may be unable to access the learning application. If you don't fix a warning, the application experience may be degraded. For specific details on how errors or warnings will impact the application's use, please contact the application directly. Clever's teams can't provide insight into how an app experience may change based on data issues. **Do I have to resolve a data quality error or warning?** - To ensure application access and for the best application experience, we recommend resolving data quality errors and warnings. For specific details on how errors or warnings will impact the application's use, please contact the application directly. Clever's teams can't provide insight into how an app experience may change based on data issues. **How do I resolve any data quality errors or warnings?** - Ensure the data is properly input in your SIS, and that the field it's in is exporting to Clever. If you use a manual SFTP or SIS-Managed Auto Sync, please work with your SIS directly to ensure data is included in the CSV files you are sending to Clever. If you use a Clever-Managed Auto Sync, and you need additional fields added to your data sync, you can contact [the Clever Support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for further assistance.

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Integration status
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360016204711#header1)  
2\. [What's my application's status?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360016204711#status)

## Overview

This article will walk you through sharing data with an application once the application has accepted your request to connect via Clever.  
 

## What's my application's status?

In your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page, you can view each application's integration status:   
 

-   **Hiding enabled:** An administrator at the school organization has hidden the application from users in Clever Portal. Follow the [directions outlined here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045814792) to disable hiding. 
    
-   **Incomplete SAML Setup**: This indicates you will need to finish configuring the settings for an SSO (SAML) application. To finish the setup, click the application in your dashboard and click on the **Settings** tab. Under **SAML details**, click **Edit** and enter any missing information. The application will change to Launched once the SAML details are complete and users are shared.   
      
    
-   **Invited by app:** Applications you are already using at your school organization may invite you to connect via Clever to simplify rostering. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045084272).
-   **Launch Date: XX/XX/XXXX**: This is the date the application will go live. If you need the launch date adjusted, reach out to the app directly as any changes to this are controlled by the app.
-   **Launched**: Your integration is live! If the application supports SSO, the application is available to users in the Clever Portal.
    
-   **No Credentials Set:** The next step is yours! Set the credentials that the SSO (Saved Passwords) app should use to log in users. More info [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234973187). 
    
-   **No Data Shared**: The next step is yours: set your [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)!
    

-   **No Users Selected**: The next step is yours! Select which users you want to share with the application.
    
-   **Requested**: This means that we are waiting on the application's team to accept your request and proceed with the implementation. If you need to expedite the request process, please reach out to the application directly as we do not have insight as to the application's review and acceptance process.
    
-   **Requires App Review:** Some applications have set safety thresholds to prevent unintended changes in data from affecting users in their platform. If you see this message, please reach out to the application partner requesting they review and approve the changes. Information for our application partners on managing safety thresholds can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044699192).
    
-   **Setting Up**: Hang tight! The application is preparing your school organization for launch. You can view the Launch Date by clicking on the application. Users will not be able to access the application until the Launch Date. If you need to expedite the setup process, please reach out to the application directly.
    
-   **Waiting On Approval:** This means that we are still waiting on the application's team to accept your request and proceed with the implementation. You can click 'Remind app' to remind the application partner's team of your request. 
    

![Screenshotting of waiting on approval from an application.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR7F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288R0)

-   You will also see the ability to remind the app from the application's profile page: 

![Screenshot showing the ability to remind the app for approval.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cR7F&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288R5)

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Sync times
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236156648#header1)  
2\. [Sharing permissions and data updates or changes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236156648#header2)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236156648#header6)

## Overview

This article discusses the technical process for how applications sync data from Clever. Clever does not push the data to your learning programs. Applications manage the process of syncing data from Clever's API.  
 

* * *

## Sharing permissions and data updates or changes

When you set [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for an application, you are choosing what data from your account to make available to the application through Clever’s API. Applications then pull the data from Clever to use in their system.

If you make an update to your Clever data (including modifying your sharing permissions), you can expect this change to be reflected in the application **within 24 hours**. If after 24 hours there is no change in the application, please review the troubleshooting steps in this article: [Troubleshooting: App issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360014923052)

If the data is correct in Clever but incorrect in an application, please reach out to the application directly! Their team may need to complete another sync with Clever to get your most recent data into their system. While applications each have their own sync schedules with Clever, most applications sync with Clever on a nightly basis. If you need a manual sync with the application initiated, please contact the application's support team. They may be able to push a manual sync to pull the most current data from Clever.

If you need to contact the application partner for more information, navigate to the app overview page. If the application has provided a Support Contact, you'll find it at the top of this page.

![Screenshot of the outreach contact on the app overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRYf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000NoeWU)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How often do applications pull data from Clever?**

-   While each application manages its sync times with Clever, most applications pull data nightly.

**When can I expect changes in my data in Clever to be reflected in connected learning applications?**

-   Typically within 24 hours. If you do not see data changes reflected in the learning application within 24 hours, please contact the application team directly. If you need changes implemented sooner than 24 hours, we recommend contacting the application directly to see if they may be able to sync data from Clever sooner.

**What steps should I take if data is correct in Clever, but incorrect in a learning application?**

-   Please reach out to the learning application directly to troubleshoot further.

**What does the last sync time on the application overview page indicate?**

-   The last sync time on the application overview page indicates the last time an application queried the API. The last attempted sync time doesn't indicate completion of a complete data sync, so if you see data missing in the application, please contact their team directly.

* * *

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Set launch date
text:
This article contains the following:  
 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002947643#one)  
 2. [How do I set up an SSO and/or Rostering application for future launch?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002947643#two)

## Overview

When setting up a new application, the school organization is able to establish sharing permissions and resolve data quality issues weeks — or even months!— before the application launches. The launch date is the day that an application becomes available to teachers and students in the Clever Portal. This article will show you how to prepare apps for launch. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288PO)**Please note:** If you'd like to adjust the current launch date of an application, **please reach out directly to the application** and they will be happy to help you! After the school organization initially sets the date (as explained below), adjustments are managed by the application's team.

##   
How do I set up an SSO and/or Rostering application for future launch?

1\. Log in to your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the sidebar.

2\. Add the application you want to set up.

3\. You'll be brought to a page where you can authorize the request to add the app. Please share whether or not your school organization has already purchased licenses for the application. At the bottom, select **Request Launch Date.**

 ![Screenshot of requesting a launch date from an app.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bcrm) :

4\. Once the request has been approved by the application's team, go to your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) and click on the app you're setting up.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Q2) For detailed information on your **Application's Status**, please see "[What is my application's status?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360016204711?language=en_US)" **Questions? Please reach out directly to the application's team for insight on the status.** 

  
5\. You can view the launch date that you set for your app. Click "Begin setup" to manage your school organization's sharing permissions with the app.

![Screenshot of beginning setup with an app.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BcsQ)

 ![Screenshot of an app's sharing settings in Clever.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bcsz) 

Once the [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) are set up and any [data quality issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083) have been resolved, you're all done! No further action is required by the school organization. On the day of the launch date, the new application will appear in the [Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002720807) for all shared users.

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Transitioning applications to Clever
text:
## What if my teachers and students already have existing accounts with an application?

Requesting to add an application to your Clever dashboard will not disrupt students and teachers already using the existing accounts.   
 

Most applications are able to preserve your existing accounts and match them to accounts created using Clever. Contact your specific Application Support Teams for details.

##   
Can I add applications mid-year without losing progress or historical data?

You might be hesitant to add new application connections during the middle of the school year or semester. Fear not! With Clever you can connect to applications during the middle of the semester without losing progress or historical data within the app.  
 

Clever provides a matchmaking tool to our partner applications, allowing them to migrate the data that you share in Clever with the existing historical progress in their application. You can seamlessly [add your applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add), share data, and we'll take care of the rest!

If you have any questions at all about connecting with applications, please don't hesitate to [reach out to our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).  
 

For a full list of available apps, be sure to browse through [Clever's Application Gallery!](https://clever.com/app-gallery)

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - App invites
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045084272#overview)  
2\. [Viewing app invites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045084272#view)  
3\. [Accepting app invites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045084272#accept)  
4\. [Declining app invites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045084272#decline)  
5\. [Disabling app invite notifications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045084272#disable)

##   
Overview

Did you know you can save time setting up applications for your schools by accepting app invitations? If you already have an established relationship with an app partner, and it's also available on Clever, you may receive an invitation from the app partner to roster via Clever in your dashboard.  
  
By accepting the invitation, you can set up automated rostering and students can have a seamless learning experience through Clever.  
 

* * *

##   
Viewing app invites

When sent an invitation, the school organization account owner will receive an email with the invitation request.   
  
The email will have the subject "Set Up {App Name}". It will provide useful information such as the name of the app, a custom message from the app, and a link to accept the invitation.

![Screenshot showing the invitation from an app.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Nr)   
 

Additionally, you will also receive the invite in your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/). You can find the invite by navigating to your dashboard and clicking **View invite** in the Applications tab.  
 

![Screenshot of an application invite viewed from the Clever dashboard.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Nw)    
  
 

* * *

##   
Accepting app invites

If you choose to accept an app invite, you can do so by clicking **Accept Your Invitation** in the email (which will redirect you to the invite in Clever) or the **Accept** on the application invite in the Clever Dashboard.  
 

![Screenshot of accepting an app invite.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288O1)   
 

Once you accept the invite, you can begin the setup process and start sharing data with the app. You can learn more about our setup process in our article about [Sharing Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712).

  
 

* * *

##   
Declining app invites

If you would like to decline an app invite, you can do so by clicking the **Decline** button on the application invite in Clever.  
 

![Screenshot of declining an app invite.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288O6)   
 

When you decline the invite, you'll see a brief survey from Clever. We request a short note as to why you are declining the app invite, which is only visible to Clever. You can also choose to send a message to the application explaining why you declined the invite.   
  
Once you've declined the invite, the app will disappear from your Dashboard. If the application has questions about your decision to decline the invite, they'll be provided with the email for your school organization contact.  
  
If an app invite is declined in error, contact Clever Support with the name of the school organization and application. Our team can restore the invite so the school organization may accept.   
 

![Screenshot of the declined invite survey.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288OB)

* * *

##   
Disabling app invite notifications

To turn off app invite notifications, click your name in the top-right corner, then select **Profile**.

![Screenshot showing how to turn off app invite notifications.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000heBwr)    
 

Navigate to the **Emails** tab and turn off the toggle next to **Requests and invite changes**.

![Screenshot showing how to turn off app invite notifications.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQxZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hdd2M)

title: For Clever Admins: Apps - Add/request or remove apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h1)  
2\. [Adding an application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h2)  
3\. [Application sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h3)   
4\. [What if my desired application isn’t listed?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h4)  
5. [What's my application's status?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h5)  
6. [Removing an application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h6)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Getting started with adding applications? Check out our guide, [Onboarding - Adding Applications to Clever](https://clever.academy/onboarding-adding-apps?user_type=district_admin), available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

Clever single sign-on (SSO) enables users to be securely authenticated into connected applications via their individual Clever Portals. This article explains how school organization admins can add or remove an online learning application to their school organization's Clever Portal in order to share the app with school organization users. To learn about the different types of Clever applications, please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002370127). 

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For specific details about each of the Clever-integrated SSO, Rostering or Library applications, visit our application gallery [here](https://www.clever.com/app-gallery).

* * *

##   
Adding an application

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page.

![Screenshot of the application search bar on Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000S8Qr)

_The application search bar and filters_

-   Using the filters at the top of the page, you can search for applications by:
    -   **Type** (e.g. Rostering, SSO, Free)
        -   **Please note:** _Some learning applications do require certain fees to use their products through Clever (e.g. licensing or subscription fees)._  _Sorting by 'Free' provides a list of learning applications that are completely free to school organizations._

-   **Subject** (e.g. Assessment, Communication, Math, Reading)
-   **Name** (e.g. i-Ready, SeeSaw, Big Ideas Math, Achieve3000)

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**If the app you are looking for is not available to request, please review [this section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203114997#h_34c61619-1c0d-4d4d-aeec-0c3897700bf5).

-   Once you locate the desired application, select 'Request App' to the right of the selection. 

          ![Screenshot of Add applications](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amWZ)

-   Once you click Request App, you'll be taken to a page where you can view more information about the application, including its [Edtech quality indicators](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001722) if available.
-   You will then be prompted to authorize the request of the application. You will need to first:

-   Select whether or not your school organization has already purchased the application, or would like to try a free trial of the app (if applicable).  
-   Select a preferred Launch Date for the application. Please note:
    -   The [Custom Launch Date](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002947643) you enter is a suggested or preferred date of launch that may later be updated by the application partner if it is not feasible. Please contact app partners directly to adjust app Launch Dates.
    -   The Launch Date is the date the app will become available to all [shared school organization users](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) in their Clever portals.
    -   For rostering apps, view the fields required by the application under the **Required fields** section. You can determine if your sync can meet these requirements.

             ![Screenshot of an example rostering application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Pbkv7)               
_Example of a rostering application_   
  
  
![Screenshot of an example SSO application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000AqRx)   
_Example of an SSO application_

-   Once you've made the appropriate selections, select **Send integration request** to submit the request to the application provider.
-   The application has now been requested! Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360016204711) to understand the application's status as it progresses to the Launch Date.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you previously rostered the learning application via another method (ex: manual data entry) and you have questions about whether accounts will be matched or managed moving forward, please contact the application partner directly. The Clever team doesn't have insight into how applications manage switching rostering services.

* * *

## Application sharing permissions

Once the application has approved your connection, you will then specify which sharing type you would like to use in order to share data with the application. These settings will also determine which of your school organization users will have the application available to them in their individual Portals. Please  follow the steps outlined in [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712) to set up your sharing permissions for the first time. 

After the application has been connected, school organization admins can add or modify the app sharing permissions to determine what school organization data should be shared with the app, and which school organization users should have access to the application from their Clever Portals after the [Launch Date](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002947643). The options available are:  
 

-   **Share by School Organization**: All school organization data in Clever will be synced to the application. This includes school organization admins, schools, teachers, students, staff and sections.  
-   **Share by Schools**: Clever will only share any data associated with the schools you've selected (e.g. students, teachers, sections, staff). 
-   **Share by Rules**: Clever will only share data that meets the specific criteria you've set. This is the most recommended sharing type as it provides school organizations with the flexibility in determining specifically what data should be included, or excluded, in the sharing.  [Read this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) to learn more about how to Share by Rules!
-   **School Site Sharing**: If your school organization has designated [School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663) in Clever, you can provide them with the ability to configure application sharing permissions for their associated schools. [More info here!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366)
-   **Copy Sharing**: This option will copy the same sharing permissions from another application that has already been set up. 

Applications will not have access to any school organization data in Clever that has not been specifically shared with them via the application sharing permissions. Please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for detailed instructions.

* * *

##    
What if my desired application isn’t listed?

If your desired application is not available to request per the process outlined above:

-   **SSO or Rostering integrated apps:**
    -   This means the app provider has a specific policy that requires them to send school organizations an invite rather than school organizations requesting their app (e.g. BrainPOP). Please contact the app partner directly to request their app.
-   **Clever Library apps:** 
    -   Most Library apps can _only_ be added individually by teachers to their Clever Portals. In most cases, these types of apps are _not_ available as school organization-wide applications. For details, please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471?language=en_US) .
-   **Non-Clever integrated apps:** 
    -   Clever can build a secure connection for almost any application through our SSO (Saved Passwords) product. SSO (Saved Passwords) applications are apps that don't currently integrate directly with Clever, but can still be accessed through the Clever Portal providing users with a seamless single sign-on experience for the app. 
    -   To add an SSO (Saved Passwords) application, select the 'Request \[ApplicationName\]' below the search results.

                ![Screenshot showing how to request applications not currently listed.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288N3)

-   Then, enter some important details to help us configure this SSO (Saved Passwords) application before selecting the 'Request' option.  You will receive an email once the app is ready for your school organization. For more, please visit: [SSO (Saved Passwords) Apps: Overview & Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488).

We also encourage you to contact non-Clever integrated application providers directly to let them know you’re interested in syncing your data through Clever. Your voice is extremely important as they consider working with us! If you do have a contact at the vendor, feel free to email us at [application-interest@clever.com](mailto:application-interest@clever.com), and we can follow up about building an integration.  
  
For any app that doesn't require a per-user login, you can also consider adding a link to your Clever Portal for school organization users. Learn more about adding links [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002942963)!  
 

* * *

##    
What's my application's status?

You can view the status of all school organization applications from your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page or by clicking on the application name to open the app overview page.  
  
In the Dashboard you can see the App Status column which lists the status for each of your applications. Next to that is the Next step column which lists the next step that needs to be taken.  
  
![Screenshot of the Application page showing the apps status and next step columns](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000AqYP)  
  
Here's a list including every application status:

-   **Requested**: We're waiting for the application's team to accept your request and proceed with the implementation. If you need to expedite the request process, please reach out to the application provider directly as Clever does not have insight into their review and acceptance process.
-   **Invited by app**: The app has invited you to connect! They're waiting on you to accept the invitation in your Clever Dashboard. 
-   **Waiting On Approval:** We are still waiting for the application's team to accept your request and proceed with the implementation. School organization admins can select the 'Remind App' option to the right of the application name to remind the application partner of the request. 

         ![Screenshot of an app waiting on approval.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288ND)

-   **No Data Shared**: The next step is yours! Complete the [setup guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712?language=en_US) to enable data sharing with the application.
-   **No Users Selected**: The next step is yours! Select which users you want to share with the application.
-   **No Credentials Set:** The next step is yours! For SSO (Saved Passwords) apps, you will need to set up your school organization users' login credential requirements for the application. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488) for details.
-   **Setting Up**: Hang tight! The application partner is preparing your school organization for launch. Users will not be able to access the application until the Launch Date. If you need to expedite the setup process, please reach out to the application partner directly.
-   **Launched**: Your integration is live! If the application supports SSO, the application is available to users in the Clever Portal. 

If you need to contact the application partner for more information on the application’s status, navigate to the app overview page. If the application has provided a Support Contact, you'll find it at the top of this page.

![Screenshot of the outreach contact on the app overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000NowTO)

* * *

##    
Removing an application

If you would like to remove an application from your school organization's Clever Portal:

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page.
-   Click on the application name to open the app overview page.
-   Select the arrow icon on the upper right-hand corner of the page.
-   Choose **Disconnect App**.
-   A dialogue box will open, asking you to select **OK** to confirm the deletion.

![Screenshot of Disconnecting an app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amWe)

  
The application icon will no longer be available in Clever for your school organization, and your data will be unavailable to the application immediately. If it was a Clever-integrated app, an email notification will be sent to Clever’s main contact from the application's team, informing them that you are no longer sharing your data with them.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQr7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  
• The Clever team cannot restore deleted applications. You'll need to re-add the application and set up your sharing rules again.  
• If you decide to re-add this application to your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), your user accounts will likely **not** be restored automatically. An additional setup will likely be required to match users to their historical data.   
• For [Saved Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488) applications, disconnecting the app will delete all credential information (usernames and passwords) associated with the app.

title: For Clever Admins: Applications - What types of apps are on Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#one)  
2\. [Rostering apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#two)  
3. [Single sign-on (SSO) apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#three)  
4. [SSO (SAML) apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#SAML)  
5. [Rostering and single sign-on (SSO) apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#four)  
6. [Library apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#five)  
7. [SSO (Saved Passwords) apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#six)  
8\. [External Links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127#ExternalLinks)

##   
Overview

Clever supports several types of learning applications. This article outlines the differences between each type of application. 

##   

Most applications are added by Clever Admins via the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page. From this page, applications can be sorted by integration type to make it easier to locate the right one for your school organization.

![Screenshot of App types in Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amaq)

Clever is available at no cost to school organizations - they do not pay Clever to utilize our platform. However, some learning applications do require certain fees to use their products through Clever (e.g. licensing or subscription fees). The 'Request Applications' list can also be sorted by 'Free' which provides a list of learning applications that are completely free to school organizations.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Lv) For more information, please visit: [How do I add or remove an application?](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/203114997)

The following application types can only be added by a Clever Admin: 

-   Rostering
-   Single Sign-on (SSO)
-   Rostering & Single Sign-on (SSO)
-   SSO (SAML)
-   SSO (Saved Passwords)  
      
    

The following application types can only be added to Clever by a teacher:

-   Library  
    _Clever Admins can recommend library apps. [Learn more](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042933711)._

Once an application is launched or requested, you can find out what the application type is on the [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page under "App Type." 

![Screenshot of My applications App Types](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VpsCb)

* * *

##   
Rostering apps

Rostering applications support [Secure Sync Rostering](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/236113588). This means the rostering data from your school organization's student information system (SIS) is synced to Clever, which is then synced to your connected rostering applications. Up-to-date rostering data is maintained in your connected learning applications by the secure transfer of your SIS data from Clever to the applications.

![Screenshot of apps that support Secure Sync Rostering](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BUZG)   
 

* * *

##   
Single sign-on (SSO) apps

These applications are integrated with Clever and support [single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/203166807) without rostering data. Applications that are SSO-only have a legacy integration with Clever, and all new applications will have a rostering + sso integration.

![Screenshot of apps that support Single sign-on (SSO)](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BUZV)    
 

In addition to traditional SSO apps, we also offer SSO ([SAML](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/access-management/what-is-saml/)) apps.  
  
These apps are integrated with Clever for Single Sign-On (SSO) but require additional setup in order to authenticate users. Most SSO (SAML) applications have a setup guide available in Clever's Help Center, or you can reach out to the application partner directly for help with the setup process. If you're unsure about application URLs, usernames, or passwords, please contact the app team. SSO (SAML) applications do not provide applications access to rostering data.  
  
If interested in rostering for the application, please search for the app partner's "Rostering" application if available, as some SSO (SAML) apps offer both SSO and Rostering. If offered they are two separate apps you must add to Clever.

* * *

##   
Rostering and single sign-on (SSO) apps

These applications support both rostering and SSO! This means all rostering and single sign-on data is synced to the application by Clever.

![Screenshot of apps that support both Rostering and Single Sign-on (SSO)](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BUZp)   
 

* * *

##   
Library apps

The [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/360013488672) is a place for teachers to discover, add, and review new resources for their classrooms. Resources in the Library can be added by teachers to their [Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001158323) for easy access by students.   
  
Library apps provide lightweight rostering and are able to create accounts for students/teachers! They are the easiest and most secure way for teachers to add applications for their classrooms and provide a seamless SSO experience.

School organization administrators have the ability to recommend and block Library resources, or disable the Library feature completely for their school organization.
