Information on managing the Library at the school organization-level can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/360015683471).  
 

* * *

##   
SSO (Saved Passwords) apps

SSO (Saved Passwords) applications are apps that don't currently have a rostering or single sign-on (SSO) integration with Clever, but can still be accessed via SSO through the Clever Portal. This means school organizations can provide users with a seamless SSO experience for almost any learning application even if it is not an existing Clever partner. 

With the SSO (Saved Passwords) option, rostering data and user accounts are not synced to the app by Clever. This means they must be created within the application in advance, and user login credentials need to be manually set by the school organization admin, or by the users themselves. Clever will securely store these credentials so school organization users are logged into the applications automatically via single sign-on through Clever. 

[Click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/234746488) to read more about SSO (Saved Passwords) applications.

![Screenshot of apps that support SSO (Saved Passwords)](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCL7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BUZg)   
 

* * *

## External Links

Custom external links work much like bookmarks by bringing school organization users directly to the application's login page where they can enter their credentials for that application. These types of applications are not integrated with Clever.  
[Click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002942963?language=en_US) to read more about how to add custom external links.

* * *

If you have any questions about the types of learning applications in Clever, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Clever + Lightspeed Setup Guide
text:
In order for your Lightspeed and Clever integration to be optimized, you’ll need to send Lightspeed your users’ directory services usernames. This may be the same as your AD usernames, your emails, or something completely different. You’ll be able to choose or create the format needed by your district with this tool. If you don’t know your DSU you should contact your IT department within your district for the format. You can find the link to create and send your DSU field on the “Settings” page of Lightspeed’s profile.

![Directory services username notice](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dECn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288FE)

There are two different ways that you can locate user credentials:

1.  Select them from the dropdown
2.  Use a custom configuration

### **Select from dropdown**

The easiest and most reliable way to provide your directory services username is by indicating where they are within your existing SIS sync. For example, if student directory services usernames are their email addresses and those fields are already syncing to Clever regularly, you would select those fields in the dropdowns within the directory services username tool linked on the “Settings” page for Lightspeed.

![Directory services username page in the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dECn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288FJ)

**Custom configurations**

If student directory services usernames are syncing to Clever already, but aren’t neatly contained in a single field, we’re still able to get you set up! You can use a custom configuration to provide those credentials. Instead of selecting a single field, you’ll select “Custom” in the appropriate dropdown list and paste in one of the formulas below:

![Clever Dashboard with the Lightspeed app's directory services username page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dECn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nTIdF)

Example student: Scott Kelly

Email: [sykelly@cleverusd.edu](mailto:sykelly@cleverusd.edu)

Username: skelly19

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dECn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Fd)

Once you’ve entered the appropriate formula, make sure that the credentials for the sample student match the directory services username you have on file.

Have questions or need help creating a custom formula? [Contact us](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

title: Troubleshooting: Data missing or incorrect in an app
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533712#one)  
2\. [Troubleshooting steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046533712#two)

##   
Overview

There may sometimes be discrepancies between the data in Clever and in connected rostering applications. **In most cases, you'll need to contact the application's support team to resolve the error**. Before contacting the application, please use the troubleshooting steps below to confirm the point of contact for resolving the error. 

##   

 

* * *

##   
Troubleshooting steps

**Step 1:** Confirm the data is correct in Student Information System (SIS) and Clever.  
_Use the [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser) or the search bar for reviewing data._  
  
  
**Step 2:** Confirm the data is shared with the app by reviewing the user or section's profile.  
_For students and teachers, use the_ [_Troubleshoot Sharing_](https://schools.clever.com/troubleshoot-sharing) _tool to confirm the data is being shared with the app._

Please note: If the user has recently changed schools or classes, or was recently synced to Clever, please allow 24 hours for their connected applications to be updated so they can log in.

  
If an application has filtered out the record, it will display a special message - to remove the filter, contact the app's support team. 

![This is an image of an application that is showing it as being filtered out for a user.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UGDp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Y7wF)  
  
  
**Step 3:** Confirm that the fields your district needs to be shared with an application are being shared with that app. You can do this by going to [My applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) on your Clever Dashboard > click on the application name > click on the settings tab > scroll to the Field Access box and click on _Advanced settings_ to edit field access.  
  
See: [For Clever Admins: Apps - Field access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586?language=en_US)  
  
![This is an image of the Field Access box which contains the name of the fields shared with a particular application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UGDp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RP9R)  
  
  
**Step 4:** Confirm there are no data errors. These can be viewed on the application's page under the _Overview_ tab.  
  
See: [Application Syncs: Data Warnings and Errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083)  
  
  
**Step 5:** Check the application's last sync time on the app's overview page. If the change in data occurred after the application's last sync, the change will not be reflected in the application until the next time the app syncs with Clever. Most apps sync every 24 hrs.  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UGDp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005T5Bb)  
  
  
**Step 6:** Check the [application's integration status](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360016204711). If the status says **Requires app review** you'll need the application partner to review and approve your data changes. Some applications have set safety thresholds to prevent unintended changes in data from affecting users in their platform.  
![App status highlight](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UGDp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000XpMrW) 

**Step 7:** If all items above have been confirmed, **please contact the application's support team to investigate the issue**. Application partners fully manage pulling data from Clever's API and processing it into their system. As such, Clever Support is unable to resolve the error. Each application team will be most familiar with the data fields they sync from Clever. Some application partners may only receive certain data fields from Clever depending on their current integration setup.  
  
If the application has provided a Support Contact for you to contact directly, you’ll find it at the top of the application overview page:  

![Screenshot of the outreach contact on the app overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000UGDp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000NpBNZ)

title: Troubleshooting: App issues
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#overview)  
2. [App is missing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#missing)  
2\. [User clicked on app, and received an error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#app_error)  
3[. User c](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#savedpasswords)[licked on app, and Clever asked for a username and password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#savedpasswords)  
4\. [Data incorrect in apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#data)  
5\. [Problems within apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360014923052#other)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** It's important to distinguish between an issue logging into Clever (a user can't access Clever) and an issue accessing an application from within the Clever portal (e.g after the user has successfully logged into Clever). If a user can't access Clever, that is a separate troubleshooting issue from what we cover here. Please see this article to help troubleshoot users' access to Clever: [Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot Login tool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046240972).  
For more information about what team you should contact for support, we have a great video resource that can provide more insight: [Getting support for district admin](https://clever.academy/quick-start-da/1700281?reg=1).

##   
Overview

Occasionally users run into issues with their applications. This can be due to a user not being shared with an app to errors occurring within the application (which would need to be addressed by the application's support team). This article will go over some of the common issues and guide you on how to troubleshoot. 

* * *

##   
App is missing

If a user is missing an app in the Clever Portal, please confirm the user is shared with the application. The most common reasons a user is not shared with an app are:

1.  The user does not have any sections in Clever.
2.  The user does not meet the filter criteria for sharing rules (usually section grade level or subject)

In both cases, you will want to confirm they are enrolled in sections in your student information system (SIS) and that the data is synced to Clever. Alternatively, you may need to adjust the sharing permissions for the application to ensure the user is shared. You can learn about sharing permissions here: [Sharing Permissions: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US#h_8e0ac10f-24d3-4521-a18b-83f0b9b21048).

​​![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lzX0)

* * *

##   
User clicked on app, and received an error

Clever has an excellent tool for debugging this scenario. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046240972) for information on using the "Troubleshoot Login" tool.   
  
In general, if a user clicks on an application in the Clever Portal and receives an error on the application's page, **please reach out to the application's support team for help**. Most login issues must be resolved by the application's support team.  
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If they are seeing an error at a web URL that is **not** a Clever address, it's likely that the application's team is best equipped to help fix the issue. Please reach out to the application's support team to investigate further!

  
Here are examples of common errors you might see for specific applications:  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Ai)  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288As)  
  
 ​  
 

* * *

##   
Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password

If a Clever page asks a user to enter their username and password for an application, enter the correct login information for that application, and click **Save Login.** If the device has the [Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) downloaded, Clever will save this information and automatically log the student in next time they click the icon from the Portal!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288Ax)  
 

If a user clicks on an application and sees the page below, this means we were not able to log in the user with the username and password they provided. Please have them enter their correct username and password for the application, and click '**Update & Log in**'.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288B7)  
 

If they are still having trouble, please confirm that the username and password they entered will allow them to successfully log into their account directly on the application's page (i.e. at schoology.com). If you can access the app directly through the app's website but not through Clever, please contact Clever Support for help!  
 

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Did you know?** Applications that prompt users to manually enter credentials as shown above are called **SSO (Saved Passwords)** applications. Learn more about these applications in this Help Center article: [For Teachers: What are Saved Passwords applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026789592)   

* * *

## Data incorrect in apps

If the data in an application is incorrect (e.g. rosters, students, and school associations), [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025400111).   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkFZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288BC)**Please note:** Most applications sync with Clever daily. Please allow up to 24 hrs for newly updated or shared data in Clever to be reflected in your connected applications.  For more information, visit: [How often will my applications sync with Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236156648)

* * *

## Problems within applications

After a user clicks on an application from the Clever Portal, their experience within the app is controlled by that app. Clever does not have any insight into the inner workings of an application.  A good analogy would be to think of Clever as the key to opening the door to the application, but once that door is open, we do not go inside. If a user is running into an issue within the application, **please contact the application’s support team for help.**

Here are common examples of when an application’s team will be best equipped to provide support:

-   You are receiving an error message on the application’s website
-   You are seeing incorrect data within the application, but correct data within the Clever
-   You are having trouble accessing grades, homework, textbooks, videos, resources, or running reports within the application
-   Your sections have access to the incorrect content within the application
-   You have questions about features within the application
-   The application does not save a student’s progress
-   The application is frozen
-   The application logs or kicks you or your students out
-   You need to merge or match an old or preexisting account with the one created through Clever

title: Sharing Permissions: Sharing Clever Admins
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049871231#header1)  
2\. [How to share admins with applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049871231#header2)  
3\. [How to adjust admin sharing via Field Access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049871231#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049871231#header4)

**![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288AT)Please note:** All existing application connections established before April 7, 2026 will maintain the behavior of sharing all admins with applications. Moving forward, school organizations should plan to share admins with newly connected applications appropriately via sharing permissions. Learn more about how admins will be shared with existing applications [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049871231#admins_shared). 

## Overview

Clever helps your team control which [administrator team members](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) can see specific data within connected applications. Just like you set sharing permissions for students, teachers, and staff, you can choose which admins have access to each application.

Field Access being toggled off will take precedence over admin rules being created. If you would like for the admins to be shared with applications, Clever recommends that you ensure the Field Access toggle is turned on. 

Follow the steps below to update admin sharing settings for each application.

  
 

* * *

## How to share admins with applications

To adjust whether administrators are shared with a given application:

Follow the steps below if you’re using the [**Guided sharing view**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001514) to share your admins and [see a tutorial video here](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/vr3mcx04sw):

1.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and select the application  
      
    
2.  Under **Shared Data**, select **Edit Sharing**![Edit sharing](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZyWL) 
    
3.  Select **Add Another Rule**
    
4.  Select **District admins need access** in the drop-down menu  
    ![Drop-down menu of district admins need access](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZyxl)  
    
5.  Select the desired admins utilizing the **Role** filter. You can either select the role from the dropdown menu or type the role. If you choose to type the role make sure the role entered matches exactly as it appears in Clever (including uppercase and lowercase letters), as this is case-sensitive.  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZbRi)   
    
6.  Select **Done Editing**
    
7.  Select **Save Sharing Rules**
    

Follow the steps below if you’re using the **Standard sharing view** to share your admin members and [see a tutorial video here](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/xrtxa235or):

1.  Navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) and select the application
    
2.  Under **Shared Data**, select **Edit Sharing** **![Edit sharing button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZg1b)**
    
3.  Select **Edit Sharing Rules** **![Edit sharing rules](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZP2N)**
    
4.  Select **Add another rule** **![Add another rule button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZznN)**
    
5.  Select **Custom Share District Admins** **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fa057)**
    
6.  Select the desired admins utilizing the **Role** filter. You can either select the role from the dropdown menu or type the role. If you choose to type the role make sure the role entered matches exactly as it appears in Clever (including uppercase and lowercase letters), as this is case-sensitive.  
     **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fYyrn)**
    
7.  Select **Done editing**
    
8.  Select **Save Sharing Rules**  
     
    

* * *

## How to adjust admin sharing via Field Access

If you do not want to share admins with an app that uses share by school or school-site sharing, you can turn off admin access using Field Access. When the slider is grey, admins are not shared with the application.

To adjust whether administrators are shared with a given application via Field Access:

1.  Navigate to the application's overview page and select **Settings**
2.  Under the **Field Access** section, select **Advanced Settings**
3.  Select **Customize fields shared with {app}** and click **Customize fields**  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288AJ)
4.  On the **Edit Student Fields** page, select **Next**
5.  On the **Edit Contact Fields** page, select **Next**
6.  On the **Edit District Admin Fields** page, click on the slider selection for **Share District Admins with {app}.**  
    ![Edit District Admin fields box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002889g) 
7.  Confirm the slider selection is grey to remove admins from being shared, or green to share admins. Select **Save**

  
Once complete, admins will no longer be shared with the application. If you require administrator accounts in the application, please contact the application directly for assistance.   
 

**![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKrh&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000288AT)Please note:** If you have uploaded extension fields to Clever. You may need to navigate through one additional "fields" page before selecting **Save**. 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Clever currently shares all admins with apps by default. Will this change when admin sharing permissions launch in April 2026?**

-   **For existing app connections:**Clever will keep the current behavior—all admins will continue to be shared. You don’t need to take any action.
    -   If you use share by rules, Clever will automatically add a rule to continue sharing all admins that looks like: _Share all district admins where \[role\] \[equals any of\] \[all existing roles\]_ created by Clever.
    -   If you use share by district, Clever will add a toggle and turn it on to continue sharing all admins.
    -   If you use share by school or school-site sharing, all admins will continue to be shared with apps. If you want more control over which admins are shared, you can switch to share by rules or share by district.
-   **For new app connections:** Sharing depends on the setup you choose.
    -   If you use share by rules or share by district, you will need to follow the [steps here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049871231#header2) to add a rule to share admins.
    -   If you use share by school or school-site, all admins will be shared by default.

**We use share by school and school site sharing. Why don’t we see the option to share admins?**

-   With share by school or school-site sharing, all DAs will continue to be shared. You should switch share by rule if you want to share DAs granularly.
    

  
 

* * *

title: Clever + Reading Plus Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and Reading Plus:  
1. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038688192#h_fb536501-a1a0-42b7-8d1a-340f380418f2)  
2\. [Recommended Sharing Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038688192#h_0848764b-1751-425e-838b-d4db406fe07d)  
3. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038688192#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015)  
4\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038688192#h_3e676fb3-8db1-45fc-9b3c-f13a34bb03d0)

## Setup Process

-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup.](https://clever.com/signup)
-   If your district is already on Clever, you can add Reading Plus by following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)
    -   Search for **Reading Plus**.
    -   You will then be brought to a page where you can authorize requesting the applications. When requesting an application, you can select whether or not your district has already purchased the application. When you click "Haven't Purchased" for applications that have free trials, you'll receive a prompt asking if you would like to try a free trial.
    -   You will also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click **Request**.
    -   Email [integrations@readingplus.com](mailto:integration@readingplus.com) to connect Reading Plus to your Clever account.

## Recommended Sharing Rules

Reading Plus recommends sharing only the types of classes that will be using the program. We generally recommend including ELA, English, and Reading classes.

  
If you’re using Reading Plus in your elementary schools and don’t have ELA, English, or Reading classes as separate sections in your SIS, please share the elementary school classes you’d like to have access to Reading Plus.

##   
FAQs

**Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?**

-   A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with Reading Plus' integration with Clever. The user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.
-   A **data warning** error occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.

  
**Why is my data not showing up in Reading Plus?**

-   Depending on your sync type, Clever either pulls data from your SIS, or data is submitted to Clever from your SIS. That data is then made available to Reading Plus to sync to their system. There is a lag time between these processes, as the sync with Clever and the sync with Reading Plus may not happen at the same time. If you do not see updated data within 48 hours after making a change, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us). 

  
**Why is my student or teacher missing from Reading Plus?**

-   Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Reading Plus:
    -   In your SIS data
    -   In your Clever data
-   If the user is missing from your Clever data, but in your SIS, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).
-   If it’s related to an aspect of Reading Plus, please contact [https://www.readingplus.com/customer-support/](https://www.readingplus.com/customer-support/)

##

[https://www.readingplus.com/customer-support/](https://www.readingplus.com/customer-support/)

title: Clever + Newsela Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#overview)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#step1)  
3\. [Recommended sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#step2)  
4\. [Setting up Newsela for school and district leaders](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#step3)  
5\. [Setting up co-teachers in Newsela](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#step4)  
6\. [Users with old Newsela accounts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#step5)  
7\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037833191#step7)

## Overview

This article runs through key steps when connecting with Newsela, including any unique aspects to ensure your users are set up for success!

* * *

## Setup Process

1.  Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup)
2.  If your district is already on Clever, you can add Newsela by following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [**Applications > Add Applications.**](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)
    -   Search for Newsela.
    -   You'll also be asked if you'd like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the application through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click **Request**.
3.  Once you have made your request, it will be sent to the Newsela team for approval. This process usually takes one business day but may take as long as a week during peak periods.
4.  Once the request is accepted, Newsela recommends logging in a few users to confirm that they can sign in and import classes.

* * *

##   
Recommended sharing rules

Newsela recommends **sharing data by school**. You can share data for all your schools - including schools that may not have Newsela PRO licenses yet. Any users not covered by a Newsela PRO license who log in with Clever will be taken to Newsela's free product.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ssez&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002887P) For more information on sharing data with applications, please see: [How do I set my sharing permissions for applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)

* * *

##   
Setting up Newsela for school and district leaders

Newsela's [Binder](https://support.newsela.com/item/supportArticle/types-of-admin-access) feature provides school and district leaders with the ability to aggregate student performance data. School and district leaders will need to be set up in Clever and log into Newsela with Clever to ensure Binder access.

-   Any administrators who need district-wide binder access should be added to Clever in the [District Curriculum Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207703) or [District Administrator](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038) role.
-   Any school administrators who need school level binder access should be added to Clever in the [Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) role.

* * *

##   
**Setting up co-teachers in Newsela**

Newsela supports co-teachers and will import co-teachers from Clever. If you are using the Clever integration, Newsela [co-teachers have to be set up in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748?language=en_US) by a system administrator and cannot be set up by individual teachers in Newsela.

* * *

##   
**Users with old Newsela accounts**

Many teachers create free Newsela accounts before their district purchases Newsela and are concerned about retaining data associated with their free accounts.

  
Newsela automatically merges user accounts with matching email addresses. If a teacher sets up a free Newsela account with their district email address, the system will recognize and merge their account the first time they log in to Newsela with Clever using that email address. As long as the email addresses match in all systems, users can easily change authentication methods. Users who log in using accounts associated with different email addresses will create duplicate accounts.

  
Newsela's support team can merge accounts if users provide both email addresses. Teachers who need accounts merged should contact Newsela's support team at [https://support.newsela.com/hc/en-us](https://support.newsela.com/hc/en-us)

* * *

##   
FAQs

**Why am I getting a "data warning" or a "data requirement" error?**

-   A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with Newsela's integration with Clever. In this case, the user or section will not appear in the application. Data requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.
-   A **data warning** error occurs when the user or section has a data compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded experience within the application. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular data warning.  
     

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ssez&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002886N) For more information on data compatibility, please see: [What are data warnings and data errors?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083)

  
**Why is my student or teacher missing from Newsela?**

-   Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Newsela:
    -   Student or teacher is present in your SIS data
    -   Student or teacher is present in our Clever data and shared with Newsela
-   If the user is missing from your Clever data, but in your SIS, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).

  
**Why are classes missing from Clever?**

-   Newsela only imports current classes from Clever. If a teacher attempts to sync a Clever class before the term start date, the class will not import.
-   Teachers might be missing classes because the classes have either not been imported or because they've been archived. Teachers can resolve this by following these steps:
    -   In Newsela, click on the **Archived Classes** tab.
    -   Select "Restore" to reactivate the missing classes. If there are no classes in the page, skip to the next step.
    -   Navigate back to the **Classes** tab.
    -   Click "Sync with Clever"
-   If the class is missing from your Clever data, but in your SIS, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).

  
**Who should I ask for help with this issue?**

-   If the issue is related to data within Clever or data coming from Clever, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).
-   If the issue is related to functionality within Newsela, please contact [Newsela Support](https://support.newsela.com/contact).

title: For Clever Admins: Content Mapping
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#overview) 2\. [Getting started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#gettingstarted) 3\. [Uploading your resource file](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#uploadingresourcefile) 4\. [Assigning your resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#assigningresources) 5\. [Finishing up](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#FinishingUp) 6\. [Editing your assignments](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#editing) 7\. [FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360052615892#faq) ## Overview Some applications allow you to map resources to specific courses, classes, or users. While administrators often have to work with each application directly to create these mappings, this feature lets you manage content mapping right from your Clever Dashboard. Once you’ve successfully mapped your resources, applications can automatically assign the correct content to your students and teachers. **Please ensure the application knows you’re setting this up before you begin!** * * * ## Getting started To use content mapping, navigate to the **Content assignment** tab on the application page in the Clever Dashboard and click **Get started**.   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002886C)**Please note:** If you don't see this tab on the application page, the application doesn't support content mapping through Clever. Always check with an application before mapping content to avoid issues. ![Graphic showing how to navigate to Content Assignment.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002886H)     * * * ## Uploading your resource file In order to use this tool, you'll need to create a resources.csv containing information pertinent to the resources you intend to map.  **File Name:** resources.csv  

Field

Required

Format

Description

resource_idYStringThe unique identifier of the resource as assigned by the application.
titleYStringThe name of the resource
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002886W)**Please note:** The resource\_id and title must match with values that the application recognizes. If you aren't sure what to use as the resource\_id and title, you will need to reach out to the application provider. When you're ready, upload your file in **Step 1** of the wizard.   ![Graphic showing how to upload a file.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002886b)    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002886q)   **Download**    [Example resources.csv file](https://assets.clever.com/website/content/resources.csv) * * * ## Assigning your resources Once you have uploaded your resources.csv file, you can start assigning those resources to your courses in **Step 2.** To add a course to a resource, click the ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002887F)button on the right side of the page. You can then enter a course name or course number to search for the courses you would like to map. Sections only map if they're associated with a course name or number, so please ensure you associate all sections with a course. You can map resources to a course across all schools or to a course at a specific school. Additionally, courses at different schools can map to the same resource. Click the blue link at the end of a mapping rule to see which school it's for.   ![Graphic showing how to assign resources.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002887Z)    * * * ## Finishing up In **Step 3** you can review your changes. You can always go back and edit your mappings by selecting **Edit assignment rules**. Otherwise, click **Finish** and you're all set! The application can now access your content mapping information and assign its resources to the intended users.   ![Graphic highlighting the Edit Assignment Rules and Finish icons.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002889L) If your mapping is successful, you will see the following message:   ![Screenshot of successfully saving resource assignments.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002889Q)    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002889V)**Please note:** After these settings are applied, the application will still need to sync with your account in order for you to see those changes. If you don't see any changes, contact the application to have them sync with your account.  ✨ Additionally, **please ensure you have set sharing rules for the application**. If an application requires content mapping, both sharing rules and content assignments must be configured.   * * * ## Editing your assignments To review and edit your content assignments navigate to the **Content assignment** tab. You'll see a summary of your current resources assigned. You'll also be able to edit your existing rules. Select **Edit assignment rules** and you will be taken back to **Step 2** of the wizard where you can make changes as needed.  ![Graphic showing how to navigate to edit existing assignment rules.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSmT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002889f) * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **Where can I find resource IDs?**    - The application creates resource IDs. If you're unsure what to use, reach out to the application provider.   **What if I don't see the Content assignment tab?**   - If you don't see the **Content assignment** tab, that means the application doesn't have this feature available through Clever. You'll need to reach out to the application to discuss your options for assigning resources.   **Why can't I see the course I would like to assign resources to?**   - If you're unable to find the course you're trying to assign a resource to, please be sure that the course is included in the application's sharing permissions. For more on sharing permissions, [please refer to this article.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) **What do I do if I upload an incorrect resources.csv file?**   - You can always re-upload a new file! New files overwrite the previously uploaded files.   **Do I have to assign my content this way?**   - This is up to each application and how they choose to map content in their integration. If you have questions about other content mapping methods, you'll need to reach out to the application. If you have any additional questions please feel free to [open a support request](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) and our team will be glad to help further!

title: Clever + Lexia: Contacting Support
text:
Lexia Support is happy to help districts using Clever who have any trouble or questions about Lexia.

##   
Contacting Support

District staff can contact Lexia or Clever Support when they need help. 

-   If the issue is related to data within Clever, or data being sent to Lexia Learning from Clever, please reach out to Clever Support.  
-   If the issue is related to a feature within a Lexia Learning program, please reach out to [Lexia Support.](https://help.lexialearning.com/s/)  
-   If Clever Support is contacted first the Clever team will send the inquiry to Lexia's support email address. In order to provide the quickest resolution possible, Clever's support ticket and Lexia's support ticket are then tied together and all replies are tracked by both support teams.
-   Clever will then assign the ticket to a Clever Support agent that works closely with the Lexia integration, this facilitates a quick response time.

##   
Advanced Troubleshooting

All Lexia Support team members have access to a Clever data dashboard in order to assist districts in resolving Clever related issues. If an issue is complex, the Lexia support ticket is immediately escalated to a senior Lexia Support team member for assistance.

##   
Collaboration

In addition to as-needed support, Lexia and Clever have regular meetings to discuss the best ways to support districts. We have a mutual goal of assisting districts as quickly and efficiently as possible to minimize disruption to teachers and students.

title: Clever + Imagine Learning Classroom Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and Imagine Learning Classroom:  
1. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039079351#h_fb536501-a1a0-42b7-8d1a-340f380418f2)  
2\. [Recommended Sharing Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039079351#h_0848764b-1751-425e-838b-d4db406fe07d)  
3. [Data Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039079351#h_3a195647-5b55-4295-861a-8bbd513adf6b)  
4\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039079351#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015)  
5. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039079351#h_3e676fb3-8db1-45fc-9b3c-f13a34bb03d0)

_Note: LearnZillion has become Imagine Learning Classroom_

## Setup Process

-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup)
-   If your district is already on Clever, please reach out to your Imagine Learning Classroom account manager to let them know you’d like to connect with them on Clever:
    -   If your district is not sure who your Imagine Learning Classroom representative is, then you can email [support@learnzillion.com](mailto:support@learnzillion.com) for assistance.
    -   Once in contact, Imagine Learning Classroom will send an invitation to connect with your district via Clever.
    -   To approve the invitation, a district administrator with the ‘Clever Admin’ role will need to log into their [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/applications) to review and accept the invite.
-   Imagine Learning Classroom supports rostering and single sign-on (SSO) through Clever for student, teacher, and staff user types.
-   To help curb user login issues, Imagine Learning Classroom recommends customizing the Clever Portal login page to include password hints and a district tech support contact to make it easier for SSO to be possible. More information on how to do this can be found here: [How do I set up Single Sign-On?](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/204982938)
-   Users will be able to utilize Clever SSO for logins, as well as continue to log in manually on the Imagine Learning Classroom site. Please refer to the instructions sent directly by your Imagine Learning Classroom representative for information on how to designate your Imagine Learning Classroom account password for manual logins.

## Recommended Sharing Rules

Imagine Learning Classroom recommends creating a **custom share by students** rule for only the _specific_ grade levels and school sites that have purchased licenses for Imagine Learning Classroom at your district.

##   
Data Rules

1.  All teachers must have email addresses associated with their accounts. Users with no email address will not get synced over to Imagine Learning Classroom.
2.  The Clever "U_sername_" and/or the "_student\_number_" field should be shared with the Imagine Learning Classroom application.
    -   If the "U_sername_" field is shared with Imagine Learning Classroom, then this field will be used to generate the student usernames on Imagine Learning Classroom.
    -   If the "_student\_number_" field is shared with Imagine Learning Classroom and the "_Username_" is NOT shared, then the "_student\_number_” field will be used to generate student usernames on Imagine Learning Classroom.
    -   If both "_Username_" and the "_student\_number_" fields are shared with Imagine Learning Classroom, then Imagine Learning Classroom will default to using the "_Username_" for generating student usernames on Imagine Learning Classroom.

More information on the exact data fields requested by Imagine Learning Classroom, as well as how Clever user roles are mapped to their program, can be found here: [Clever Roster Sync and Instant Login.](https://help.learnzillion.com/customer/en/portal/articles/2804331-clever-roster-sync-and-instant-login?b_id=16018)

##   
FAQs

### Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?

A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with Imagine Learning Classroom’s integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.

A **data warning** error occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting Imagine Learning Classroom directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.

### Why is my data not showing up in Imagine Learning Classroom?

Depending on your sync type, Clever either pulls data from your SIS, or data is submitted to Clever from your SIS. That data is then made available to Imagine Learning Classroom to sync to their system. There is a lag time between these processes, as the sync with Clever and the sync with Imagine Learning Classroom may not happen at the same time. If you do not see updated data in Imagine Learning Classroom within 48 hours after making a change, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).

###   
Why is my student or teacher missing from Imagine Learning Classroom?

Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Imagine Learning Classroom:

-   User is in your SIS data
-   User is in the [Clever data browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser)
-   Teachers have email addresses associated with their Clever accounts
-   The user’s email address is not associated with multiple Clever accounts (e.g. multiple teacher accounts or a teacher that also has a staff account)
-   If the user is in your SIS, but missing from the Clever data browser, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).

###   
Who should I ask for help with an issue?

If it’s related to data within Clever, application sharing rules, or data coming from the SIS, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).  
 

If it’s related to an aspect of the Imagine Learning Classroom program such as questions regarding licenses or contracts, launch dates, or program content (e.g. lessons, assignments, reports), then please contact [Imagine Learning Classroom Support](https://ilclassroom.com/contact).

##   
Support Contacts

Submit a ticket through [Imagine Learning Classroom Help Portal](https://ilclassroom.com/contact).  
  
Email: [support@learnzillion.com](mailto:support@learnzillion.com)  
  
Answers to FAQs can be found in [Imagine Learning Classroom’s Help Portal.](https://learnzillion.com/wikis/1891356-clever-roster-sync-and-instant-login)

title: Clever + Schoology Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046282971#h_01EGHCVAH46STCMBC2KJAPXXPV)  
2\. [Clever SSO via SAML](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046282971#h_01EGHCV5KG1TM5M6PBZ6J1CFGZ)  
3\. [Clever SSO via Saved Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046282971#h_01EGHCTYFTM83HXFQ0B0WK3F0Z)

## Overview

Districts can easily set up single sign-on (SSO) for Schoology, providing a seamless login experience for every user. 

There are two options for enabling SSO to Schoology from Clever:

1.  Clever SSO via SAML (recommended)
2.  Clever SSO via Saved Passwords

Important notes about Clever SSO via SAML:

  
**Login pathways**  
If you choose Clever as your SAML Identity Provider (IDP) for Schoology, users will not be able to use another third-party IDP (e.g. Google, ADFS) to log into Schoology. Users can continue to log in to Schoology via app.schoology.com with their Schoology-managed credentials. If your district uses another third-party IDP to log into Schoology and would like to retain that login path, please see our [Clever SSO via Saved Passwords setup guide](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046282971#h_01EGHCTYFTM83HXFQ0B0WK3F0Z). 

  
**iOS - Login flow**  
All authentication methods, including Clever Badges, are compatible with both iOS login flows.

-   **Log in directly via the Schoology app.**  
    If you click the app and search for your district, you’ll be redirected to the Clever login flow. Once you log in, you’ll be redirected to the _Schoology app._  
     
-   **Log in via the Clever app (or at [https://clever.com](https://clever.com/)** **in a web browser).**  
    The user will log in to Clever and click on the Schoology icon. The user will be logged in to Schoology _in the web browser_.  
     

## Clever SSO via SAML

### Pre-work:

The first step is to ensure your district users have accounts in Schoology. Please work with Schoology to ensure Schoology accounts are created _prior_ to setting up SSO via SAML in Clever. Clever does not have a rostering integration with Schoology

### Setup:

### In Clever: 

1.  Log into your Clever Dashboard and add the Schoology application via this link: [https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-schoology](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-schoology)
2.  Share the users that need SSO access to Schoology.
3.  In your Clever Dashboard, click the Schoology app, click on **Settings,** and scroll to **SAML Details.** Click **Edit.** 
4.  Enter your Schoology domain (e.g. clever.schoology.com). _Do not include "https:// " or anything after ".com"_
5.  (Optional) Matching attributes will default to email for all users. If you’d like to use a different attribute to match users between Clever and Schoology, you can edit them on the Settings page as well.
6.  Click **Confirm.**
7.  Under **SAML Details** copy your metadata URL:   
    ![Screenshot of Metadata URL](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000EH5J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNzq)   
     
    
    ### **In Schoology:** 
    
8.  Log into your administrator account and navigate to Tools > School Management > Integration: [https://clever.schoology.com/system\_settings/integration](https://clever.schoology.com/system_settings/integration)
9.  Go to the **Authentication** tab and click **Cloud /On-Premise Directory.**
10.  Paste the metadata URL from Clever in the [Metadata URL](https://share.getcloudapp.com/bLuRm81A) field.
11.  Click **Fill fields below from metadata.**
12.  (Optional) "Match ID to Schoology Account Using field" should default to email. If you changed the matching attribute within Clever in Step 5, please choose the correct corresponding attribute here.
13.  Click **Save.**

Once you’ve completed the above steps, you should be good to go! Make sure to test the Schoology app for each user type (student, teacher, etc.) and on different devices before rolling out to your users. If you encounter any problems, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

## Clever SSO via Saved Passwords

1\. District user accounts and credentials for the app:

-   -   The first step is to ensure your district users have accounts and login credentials for the SSO (Saved Passwords) application. Please work with Schoology to ensure Schoology accounts are created and login credentials are configured. This must be done prior to setting up SSO in Clever. 

2\. Device setup

-   -   Install the Clever Chrome extension on all **non-iOS** devices that will be used to access the application through Clever. This includes home devices for users who will be accessing this app from home. The Clever browser extension facilitates single sign-on for SSO (Saved Passwords) apps. Please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) for more information.  
         
    -   The Clever browser extension is **_not_** required for iOS devices (e.g. iPads, iPhones) as these devices use the Clever app which acts as the browser extension. Please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360033063711) for more information.

3\. [Click here](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/ilpro-schoology) to add the Schoology app.

4\. Select **Request application.**

5\. On the next screen, select which schools you would like to have access to Schoology. Select **Share.**

6\. Select **Finish.**

The base setup is now complete! Please see below for more information on the user experience and pre-populating user credentials.  
 

### User Experience (SSO via Saved Passwords)

When users first click on Schoology in the Clever Portal, they will be asked for their Schoology username and password. Clever will save this username and password for future use and enable one-click access. 

  
If you would like to pre-populate credentials for users, you can navigate to this page: [https://schools.clever.com/applications/ilpro-schoology/settings](https://schools.clever.com/applications/ilpro-schoology/settings) and follow the directions listed here: [SSO (Saved Passwords) Overview and Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488)
