title: Clever + Keyboarding Without Tears Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and Keyboarding Without Tears: 1. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039085451#h_fb536501-a1a0-42b7-8d1a-340f380418f2) 2\. [Recommended Sharing Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039085451#h_0848764b-1751-425e-838b-d4db406fe07d) 3. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039085451#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015) 4\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039085451#h_3e676fb3-8db1-45fc-9b3c-f13a34bb03d0) ## Setup Process - Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup) - If your district is already on Clever, you can add Keyboarding Without Tears by following these instructions: - Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) - Search for **Keyboarding Without Tears.** - Authorize the request. When requesting an application, you can select whether or not your district has already purchased the application. When you click "Haven't Purchased" for applications that have free trials, you'll receive a prompt asking if you would like a free trial. - You will also have the option to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever. - Once you have made your selections, click **Request**. - If your district is adding Keyboarding Without Tears for the first time: - Confirm you have sent a purchase order to KWT. If you haven’t received a response to the purchase order within 48 hours, please contact [technology@lwtears.com](mailto:technology@lwtears.com)  - If your district has used Keyboarding Without Tears in the past: - Send an email to [technology@lwtears.com](mailto:technology@lwtears.com) once you’ve shared data in Clever to confirm your order - Confirm your roster data does not exceed your grade level license data ## Recommended Sharing Rules It’s important to only share the one section that is using Keyboarding Without Tears in the classroom. The simplest way to do so, is to “Share by Rules” in Clever. You can create a sharing rule by following these steps:   1. Access the Sharing Permissions page for Keyboarding Without Tears. To do this, log in to your Clever account and click the icon for the name of the app in the sidebar. From the 'Data Sharing' tab, click Share by Rules 2. Select the type of rule you want to create. You can build off one of our pre-existing templates or create your own. We recommend choosing “Custom share by section”, as it will allow you to create your own rule that can apply specifically to classes using Keyboarding Without Tears 3. Create your rule. You can share classes with certain course names or numbers, grades, subjects or schools We also recommend [using this Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) when setting up custom sharing rules.  If you need any further assistance setting up sharing rules please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us). ## FAQs **Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?** - A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with Keyboarding Without Tears’ integration with Clever. The user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.   - A **data warning** error occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting Keyboarding Without Tears directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.   **How do I manually add a user or a co-teacher?** - You can manually add users as staff members, through a CSV upload to Clever through your District Dashboard, or by creating a custom staff account. For more information on adding staff users to Clever, check out the following Help Center article: [How do I add staff and school administrators in Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/article/229253547) - You can also add co-teachers to Clever either through your sync, or manually within the district dashboard. Find more information on how to do this here: [How do I sync co-teachers?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748) - If your district is using a **Clever-managed sync**, such as PowerSchool or Illuminate, you can see in the chart below if your SIS supports syncing co-teachers to Clever:  

Supports Co-Teachers in Clever

    Does Not Support Co-Teachers in Clever

Aeries Auto Sync

    Powerschool Auto Sync

Illuminate Auto Sync

    SchoolInsight Auto-Sync

Infinite Campus Auto Sync

 

Infinite Campus API Sync

 

Skyward Auto Sync

 

Skyward API Sync

 
**I have teachers and students at more than one school site. Can they still connect to KWT through Clever?** -  Keyboarding Without Tears doesn’t accept students or teachers that are associated with more than one school. You can change this in your SIS or you can modify the sharing rules to exclude the student or teachers’ secondary associations. Please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us) for help setting this up.   **Why is my student or teacher missing from Keyboarding Without Tears?** - Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Keyboarding Without Tears: - In your SIS data - In your Clever data - Also, make sure that the student or teacher doesn’t have any dual enrollments. ## Support Contacts ## [Keyboarding Without Tears Support](mailto:technology@lwtears.com)

title: Clever + Hapara Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and Hapara:  
1. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038690172#h_fb536501-a1a0-42b7-8d1a-340f380418f2)  
2\. [Required Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038690172#h_0848764b-1751-425e-838b-d4db406fe07d)  
3. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038690172#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015)

## Setup Process

-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup.](https://clever.com/signup)
-   If your district is already on Clever, you can add Hapara by following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation.
    -   Search for Hapara.
    -   You'll then be brought to a page where you can authorize requesting the applications. When requesting an application, you can select whether or not your district has already purchased the application. When you click "Haven't Purchased", **we'll notify Hapara of your interest**. You'll also be asked if you'd like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click Request! You will receive a response within 1 business day (usually sooner). Initial integration requires a short session with Hapara Implementation to make sure you are aware of your options.
    -   If you already have Hapara up and running for the school year when you request Hapara through Clever, **your current classes will need to be archived or deleted before the new Clever sync**. This can be done over a weekend or holiday.
    -   After your initial integration, your class and student data will automatically sync to Hapara nightly.

##   
Required Fields

In order for Hapara to integrate your data, your **Teacher Google IDs** **and** **Student Google IDs must be synced with Clever.** These Google IDs take the form of email addresses and should be synced to the teacher or student email fields in Clever. There are a couple of ways you can sync this data to Clever:  
 

-   If this data is already in your SIS, you can set these fields to sync automatically.
-   If this data is not in your SIS, you can create a CSV file and manually sync the emails to Clever. You can find out more information about this option in this Help Center article:

[How do I upload emails not in my SIS?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026)

If you would like to use this option, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us) to enable the upload for your district!

##   
FAQs

### Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?

A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with Hapara’s integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.  
 

A **data warning** error occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.  
 

### Why is my student or teacher missing from Hapara?

Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Hapara:

-   Student or teacher is in your SIS data
-   Student or teacher is in your Clever data
-   Student or teacher ID in your SIS matches their Google ID

### Who should I ask for help with this issue?

-   If it’s related to data within Clever, or data coming from Clever, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).
-   If the data is in Clever but not integrating into Hapara, please contact [Hapara Implementation](mailto:implementation@hapara.com).

title: Clever + GradeCam Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and GradeCam:  
1. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038693152#h_fb536501-a1a0-42b7-8d1a-340f380418f2)  
2\. [Required Fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038693152#h_0848764b-1751-425e-838b-d4db406fe07d)  
3. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038693152#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015)  
4\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038693152#h_3e676fb3-8db1-45fc-9b3c-f13a34bb03d0)

##   
Setup Process

-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has't been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup.](https://clever.com/signup)
-   If your district is already on Clever, you can add GradeCam by following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)
    -   Search for GradeCam
    -   You'll then be brought to a page where you can request the application. When requesting an application, select whether or not your district has already purchased the application. When you click "Haven't Purchased" for applications that have free trials, you'll receive a prompt asking if you'd like to try a free trial.
    -   You'll also be asked if you'd like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   Once you've made your selections, click Request!
-   GradeCam supports rostering and single sign-on (SSO) for **teacher** users. Upon first SSO login through Clever, GradeCam will prompt teachers to either enter existing GradeCam login credentials or create new ones, allowing SSO ongoing. (SSO through Clever isn't required by GradeCam as teachers can log in directly at app.gradecam.com.)
-   Once districts have shared data with GradeCam, the GradeCam team will set up the initial sync - they’ll reach out to let you know when that’s finished!

* * *

##   
Required Fields

GradeCam requires **Term Name** for sections, and they would prefer to have **Term Start** and **Term End** dates as well. Depending on your SIS, setting this up can be a little tricky, so here are some general guidelines:

###   
**Clever-Managed Auto Syncs:**

For our **Aeries, Infinite Campus API, PowerSchool, Illuminate, Skyward API and Skyward Auto Syncs**, Clever pulls these fields by default. If the default field Clever is using isn’t the best for your district, you can set up a custom mapping by following the instructions in this Help Center article: [How do I customize my auto-sync?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003630803)  
 

If you’re having trouble setting up the custom mapping, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)!  
 

For our **Infinite Campus Auto Sync**, mapping the term dates from the SIS can pull dates for the full year, which doesn't allow the classes to show correctly in GradeCam. For Infinite Campus Auto Sync districts, please make sure that each term shows the correct dates. Ex: a Q1 term may have a start date of 8/1/2021 and an end date of 10/15/2021 but it should NOT have a start date of 8/1/2021 and an end date of 7/1/2022 (full year). Please check your data browser to see if dates have synced correctly and reach out to Clever Support with questions.

###   
**SIS-Managed Auto Syncs:**

Please reach out to your SIS vendor and let them know that you'd like to have Term Name, Term Start, and Term End dates added to your sync.

A full list of Clever-managed and SIS-managed auto syncs can be found here: [Which SISs support an auto sync?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973)

###   
**SFTP Syncs:**

Your district will need to add the Term\_name, Term\_start, and Term\_end fields to your Sections CSV file. You can use this Help Center article to help you format your file: [SFTP: How do I format my CSV files?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867)  
 

* * *

##   
FAQs

### **Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?**

-   A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with GradeCam's integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.
-   A **data warning** error occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.
-   For an in-depth look into any existing GradeCam data warnings or errors, please refer to the [Data Quality](https://schools.clever.com/data-quality) page of the Clever dashboard.

###   
**Why is a teacher missing from GradeCam?**

-   Make sure that the teacher has sections in Clever - GradeCam won't import teachers without section assignments. You can check this by searching for the teacher in the [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser).
-   GradeCam only supports primary teachers. If a section has co-teachers, they won't be synced to GradeCam.

* * *

##   
Support Contacts

-   [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)
-   [GradeCam Support](mailto:support@gradecam.com)

title: Clever + EVERFI Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and EVERFI:  
1. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039082511#setup_process)  
2\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039082511#required_field)  
3. [FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039082511#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015)[s](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039082511#h_23310e6c-a4d8-48c4-a2e1-3b74c4abc015)  
4\. [Support contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039082511#support_contacts)

## Setup process

-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup)
-   If your district is already on Clever, you can add EVERFI by following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)
    -   Search for EVERFI and click **Request app**.
    -   You'll then be brought to a page where you can authorize your EVERFI request. As EVERFI is provided at no cost to the district, you can mark that it has already been purchased for the district.
    -   You'll also be asked if you'd like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click **Request application.**

Once you have shared data with EVERFI, the EVERFI team will set up the initial sync and will reach out to you to discuss communicating with teachers.  
 

## Required fields

EVERFI recommends that you share all data for your district. The simplest way to do so is to select “Share All Data” in Clever. If you plan to share specific schools, (you can find more info about [“Share by Rules” here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)). You can create a sharing rule by following these steps:

-   Access the Sharing Permissions page for EVERFI. To do this, log in to your Clever account and click the icon for EVERFI in the sidebar. From the 'Data Sharing' tab, click **Share by Rules**.

Description of Data to be provided to EVERFI through Clever:

-   Teachers: First Name, Last Name, Email, Subject, School, Section, Grade, Clever ID, Sections 
-   Students: First Name, Last Name or Last Initial, Email (optional), School, Birthdate, Clever ID 

## FAQs

**Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?** 

-   A **data requirement** ​error occurs when the record is incompatible with EVERFI’s integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application. 
-   A **data warning** ​error occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning. 

**Why is a student or teacher missing from EVERFI?**   
Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to EVERFI: 

-   In your SIS data 
-   In your shared Clever data with EVERFI

**What if a teacher (and/or student) already has an EVERFI account outside of Clever?**   
When existing EVERFI users (both teachers and students) login through Clever, they will be prompted to type in their previous EVERFI username and password. Once users merge their old account with the new account, all past progress will show up on their new account.   
  
**Can teachers and students be assigned to multiple school locations?**  
Yes, EVERFI does allow teachers and students to be assigned to multiple school locations. However, all schools must be shared in order for the sync to work accurately.   
  
**Can multiple teachers/staff be assigned to the same course/section?**  
EVERFI does not currently support multiple teachers or staff to be assigned to the same course/section.   
  
**How are building administrators provided access to the system and to building level location?**   
Admin can log in via Clever to access the EVERFI courses and resources.  Admin will have the same access any teacher has and be able to create courses.  EVERFI does not currently have an Admin role to oversee the entire school/district.  
  
**Who should I ask for help with an issue?**

If it’s related to data within Clever, or data coming from Clever, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).

##   
Support contacts

EVERFI Team

Alice Wagner, Vice President and Dakota Rubin, Operations

[clever@everfi.com](mailto:clever@everfi.com)

title: Clever + DreamBox Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and DreamBox:  
1. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038689272#setup)  
2\. [Recommended Sharing Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038689272#sharing)  
3. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038689272#faqs)  
4\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038689272#support)

## Setup Process

-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://www.clever.com/district-signup](https://www.clever.com/district-signup)
-   If your district is already on Clever, you can add DreamBox by following these instructions:
    -   Log in to your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation.
    -        Search for your DreamBox product – DreamBox Math, DreamBox Reading Park, and/or DreamBox Reading Plus.
    -   You will then be brought to a page where you can authorize requesting the applications. 
    -   You will also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click Request!
    -   Once your request has been approved by DreamBox, please contact DreamBox Support at [https://www.dreambox.com/support](https://www.dreambox.com/support) to initiate the sync between your data in Clever and DreamBox and discuss communicating with teachers.

## Recommended Sharing Rules

DreamBox recommends that you only share schools, classrooms, educators, and students who should have access to each product. DreamBox recommends sharing the following subjects for each product: 

-   DreamBox Math: Homeroom/Advisory, Math, Technology, Engineering, and Other 
-   DreamBox Reading Plus and Reading Park: Homeroom/Advisory, English/Language Arts   
     

## FAQs

### **Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data requirement” error?**

A **data requirement** error occurs when the record is incompatible with DreamBox’s integration with Clever, and the user or section will not appear in the application. Data Requirements must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application.  
 

A **data warning** occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular Data Warning.  
 

### **Why is my data not showing up in DreamBox?**

Depending on your sync type, Clever either pulls data from your SIS, or data is submitted to Clever from your SIS. That data is then made available to DreamBox to sync to their system. There is a lag time between these processes, as the sync with Clever and the sync with DreamBox may not happen at the same time. If you do not see updated data within 48 hours after making a change, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).  
 

### **Why is my student or teacher missing from DreamBox Learning?**

Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to DreamBox Learning:

-   In your SIS data
-   In your Clever data

##   
Support Contacts

### **Who should I ask for help with this issue?**

If it’s related to data within Clever, or data coming from Clever, please contact [Clever Support.](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)

If it’s related to an aspect of the DreamBox, please contact [DreamBox Support.](https://www.dreambox.com/support)

title: Clever + Canvas Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045827552#step1)  
2\. [Clever SSO via SAML](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045827552#step2)  
3\. [Clever SSO + Rostering](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045827552#h_01EF14FPKTKP48H2ABSQ4FDJRF)

## Overview

Clever has partnered with Canvas to create a seamless way to provide account creation, as well as Single Sign-On (SSO) access for users. There are two options for enabling SSO to Canvas from Clever:  
 

1.  Clever SSO via SAML 
2.  Canvas SSO + rostering

  
If you are already using Kimono/grade passback and only want to use Clever for SSO, you can do so by using the first option, [Clever SSO via SAML](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045827552#step2). Choosing this method will add a new SSO pathway to access Canvas from Clever while preserving your current rostering and grade passback setup.  
  
  
If your district intends to use Clever for rostering and single sign-on purposes using the **Canvas SSO + Rostering application**, please note the following cautions: 

-   Your district will be prevented from using Kimono, Canvas’ grade passback tool.  
     
-   Your district's users will only be able to log in to Canvas through Clever. Users will no longer be able to log in to Canvas directly without being redirected to Clever to facilitate the login. (i.e. no hybrid logins).

For directions on how to log in _to Clever from Canvas_, please see the Help Center article [Single Sign-On (SSO): "Log in with Canvas"](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206629117?language=en_US)

# Setup Directions

## Clever SSO via SAML

1.  Add the Canvas SSO (SAML) application to your Clever Dashboard.

a. From the left menu bar, navigate to [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) and request the [Canvas app](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-canvas). Select the option that says **SSO (SAML).**

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZqVB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028825)

d.  Request the app and set your data sharing permissions.  
 

2\. Configure Clever SSO via SAML for Canvas in your Clever Dashboard.

a.  In your Clever Dashboard, click the [Canvas](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-canvas) app, click on [**Settings**](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-canvas/settings), and scroll to **SAML Details**. Click **Edit**.  
b. Set your district's Canvas domain (e.g. clever.instructure.com). Do not include https:// or any other value after **.com**.  
c. (Optional) If you would like to match users on a field other than email address, you can configure the matching attributes on a per-user basis from the settings page.  
d. Copy the **Metadata URL** which you’ll enter in your Canvas admin account.  
 

3.  Complete configuration in your Canvas administrator account.  
 

a.  Log in to your Canvas administrator account and navigate to **Admin > Authentication.** Click on the **Choose an Authentication** drop-down, then select **SAML.** _Do **not** choose Clever._  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZqVB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002882A)  
b.  Paste the metadata URL you copied from Clever in the **IdP Metadata URI** field.   
c.  _Optional:_ Add your portal URL in the “Log Out URL” field.  
d.  Click **Save**.   
e.  The page will reload and automatically fill the SAML values.  
f.  Test the setup by opening a new incognito window. Go to   
https://<YOURDOMAIN>.instructure.com/login/saml. You should be prompted to enter your Clever SSO credentials. You will then be logged in and redirected to Canvas.   
 

**Please note:** Canvas will not automatically roster user accounts from successful SSO logins. Your district needs to work directly with Canvas to roster users through SIS or manual import options.  
 

## Clever SSO + Rostering

To set up SSO for Canvas, please follow the directions below:  
 

1.  Email your Canvas contact and let them know you intend to use SSO via Clever so Canvas can enable this on their side.
2.  Navigate to [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) and request the [Canvas app](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/canvas). Select the option that says **SSO, Rostering**.  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZqVB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002882F)
3.  Share Canvas with all intended users.
4.  In Canvas, navigate to **Admin > Authentication**, then click **Add an identity provider to this account** and add Clever. There, you can enter your Clever District ID, choose a Login Attribute, and click **Save.** Your district ID can be found in the top-left of the [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser).
5.  Confirm that users can log in to your district's instance URL**.** Please navigate to **https://<your domain>.instructure.com/login/clever and confirm that a student and teacher can log in to Canvas using Clever.** 
6.  **Once these two steps are completed, [reach out to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new), and we can enable the Canvas icon on your Clever portal.** 

If you have any questions about setting up Clever SSO, please contact Clever Support. We are happy to help!

title: Clever + Amazon Business Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and Amazon Business:  
1. [Connect Amazon Business to your Clever account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041544772#h_86963af1-0803-4e5d-9293-4dc226024fd8)  
2\. [Set up Clever SSO via SAML](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041544772#h_d008b5e2-976a-438e-ada5-fded7bccd5ff)  
3\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041544772#h_ed52f50d-7e05-4463-8299-19cd4f7f67a3)

##   
Connect Amazon Business to your Clever account

1.  If your district is **new to Clever**, create a Clever account at [clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup).   
     If you **have a Clever account**, log into your Clever Dashboard at schools.clever.com.  
 

2.  Add the ‘Amazon Business’ application to your Clever Dashboard:  
 

a.  On the left menu bar, click Applications > Add Applications   
b.  Search for [Amazon Business](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-amazon-business).  
c.  Click **Request App**   
d.  Enter a Launch Date (the first day users can access Amazon Business via Clever) and set your data sharing permissions.  
 

3.  Amazon Business will review your request and reach out to help configure your setup.   
 

* * *

##   
Set up Clever SSO via SAML

Amazon Business utilizes a secure technology called SAML for SSO. It requires a couple of additional setup steps. If you have not yet heard from the Amazon Business team and would like assistance with the steps listed below, please contact [Clever-SSO@amazon.com](mailto:Clever-SSO@amazon.com).  
 

1.  In your Clever Dashboard, click the [Amazon Business](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-amazon-business) app, click on '[Settings](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-amazon-business/settings)', and scroll to ‘SAML Details’. Copy the ‘Metadata URL,’ which you’ll enter in your Amazon Business admin account.  
 

a.  Copy the **Metadata URL** field and open that address in a new tab.  
b.  Right-click the page and save the Metadata file.  
 

2.  Log into your Amazon Business administrator account and navigate to the ‘Business Settings’ page  
 

a.  Select **Clever** as your identity provider (IDP).  
b.  Select the default group and default buying role for new SSO users.  
c.  Enter the Clever Metadata URL, which you found under ‘SAML Details’ in Clever.  
d.  Select the attribute mappings listed in the table below:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Fpwf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002881M)

e.  Click **Publish** in the **Status** section   
f.   Copy the **SP Initiated Login URL,** which you’ll need to enter in Clever  
 

 3.  In your Clever Dashboard, click the Amazon Business app and scroll to ‘SAML Details’  
 

a.  Enter the ‘SP Initiated Login URL’ (from your AB account) in the ‘Login URL’ field  
b.  If necessary, update the default ‘attribute’ field for each user type. \*Please note that the default attribute fields will likely be correct, so we recommend leaving them in place unless instructed otherwise.\*  
  
 

* * *

## Questions? 

**Amazon Business**: Email [Clever-SSO@amazon.com](mailto:Clever-SSO@amazon.com) 

-   Creating an Amazon Business account
-   Setting up Clever SSO via SAML
-   Administering your Amazon Business account

  
**Clever**: Submit a ticket with [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)

-   Creating a Clever account
-   Adding the Amazon Business application
-   Setting sharing permissions

title: Clever + ANet Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header1)  
2\. [New Clever districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header2)  
3\. [Existing Clever districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header3)  
4\. [Initial setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header4)  
5\. [Recommended sharing rules  
](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header5)6\. [Teacher emails](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header6)  
7\. [How to set up single sign-on  
](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header7)8\. [Additional considerations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header8)  
      •   [Creating Custom Sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#subhead1)  
      •   [Term Changes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#subhead2)  
      •   [Maintaing Student Rostering Information  
](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#subhead3)9\. [Who to contact for support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043425531#header9)

## Overview

This article is a guide to help connect the ANet learning application.  
 

* * *

## New Clever Districts

1.  If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup) or accept your invite to set up with Clever by clicking the **Set up with Clever** link in your email invitation from ANet.
2.  Set your password and log in to the Clever Dashboard (your username is your email address).
3.  Connect your student information system (SIS) data to Clever by going to [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) and choosing your SIS from the dropdown menu.  
       
    The instructions to connect your SIS data will appear once you’ve selected your SIS and will vary depending on your sync type. Check out this article for more information: [Which sync option should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) 

* * *

## Existing Clever Districts

If your district already uses Clever, connecting to ANet can take only a few clicks! These are the steps you can expect:

-   Accept ANet’s invite to connect or request to connect with ANet.
-   Accept ANet's sharing suggestions or share the applicable roster data.

* * *

## Initial Setup Process

Here are your steps to get started:  
  
1\. Connect with the ANet application by either accepting our invite or requesting our application.

2\. Share your data with ANet.

Now it’s time to set your sharing permissions for the ANet application. If you accepted our “recommended sharing” you’re probably already done or nearly there! If you choose to decline ANet’s “recommended sharing” read [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) to learn more about setting sharing permissions. More information about sharing permissions can be found below. _Please note, you can always update data sharing at any time!_

**3.Review your data**  
  
Review your ANet overview page to see what data you’ve approved to share. For an even deeper look at your data in Clever, review the data in the [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) or simply search for a record in the “Search” box, located on the top of your Dashboard screen.  
  
If you need to make any updates to the data you are sharing with ANet, use the **Edit sharing** link on the ANet Overview page.

**4\. Check your launch date**

Once you’ve confirmed the right data is being shared, make sure that students can start logging into ANet at the right time by checking your launch date.  
 

Your launch date is the day that the ANet icon (pictured below) will appear in the Clever Portal for students to login. If you need the launch date updated, please request that action from ANet Support. For more on launch dates, [see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002947643).

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002880Y) 

* * *

## Recommended sharing rules

ANet recommends you share your data **by rules.** This ensures Clever is only sharing the data that ANet needs, and additional data isn’t being shared unnecessarily. If you are accepting ANet’s invitation to connect, we will already have suggested sharing rules set up through the invitation. **Accepting ANet’s invitation is the recommended process**. If you are requesting to sync with ANet, you'll need to set up your own sharing rules. [Read this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) to learn more about how to Share by Rules or follow the guidance below:

There are a number of 'Fields' districts can use to either include or exclude data with the application sharing rules. The fields available are dependent on the type of sharing rule you selected (e.g. share by teacher, share by section, share by student)  
 

-   The modifiers available are:
    -   equals any of
    -   does not equal any of
    -   contains text
    -   does not contain text
    -   starts with text

You should only share the classes that will be administering ANet assessments (subjects and grade levels). This is typically limited to only classes that are labeled ELA and/or Math in your SIS, and grades 2 through 12.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002880d)

If your special education or gifted classes are listed as something other than ELA and/or Math, and are administering ANet assessments, you will want to share these classes as well.  
 

* * *

## Teacher Emails

Please note, ANet cannot process rostering information for classes whose teacher’s do not have school email addresses in Clever. Please confirm all teachers have unique school emails when sharing your rostering information with ANet.

If you have any teachers without email addresses, these will appear in your data warnings, illustrated below.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002880i)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrEH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002880n)

* * *

## How to set up single sign-on

Students can use Clever SSO to log into their ANet application. To set up student SSO, please view [this resource](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938). We recommend [testing student SSO](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360012704892) prior to their ANet administration to limit unforeseen challenges. At this time the ANet application does not support Clever SSO for teachers.  
 

* * *

## Additional considerations

### Creating Custom Sections

Clever Custom Sections allow district administrators to create and manage sections manually within the Clever Dashboard. Once custom sections are created in Clever, administrators can share them with ANet through the Clever sharing permissions interface. You can read more about Clever custom sections [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923).  
 

A few examples for when you’d want to create Custom Sections are:  
 

-   <High School Only> One class period contains multiple courses. ANet can only assign one course per period, so if students take different courses in the same class, you will need to create Clever Custom Sections for each course within the period
-   If you want to view your data differently than is currently coming through Clever (e.g. view data by homeroom as opposed to ELA and/or Math class)
-   If there are students who do not need access to ANet products (assessments or quiz tool).

###   
Term Changes

In your SIS, some sections may be assigned to a specific term. Students in a given section will have an active enrollment in Clever during the dates of that term. When a term ends, students in those sections no longer have an active enrollment. When this occurs, a student may not have access to ANet through Clever for 1-2 business days while the ANet team shifts the student from their old section to their new section.  Please reach out to ANet Support in advance to coordinate logistics.  
 

[This resource](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204059586) provides additional information about terms.  If you have any questions or concerns about the ability for a student to view their ANet interim during a term rollover, please contact ANet Support so we can strategize with your district.  
 

### Maintaining Student Rostering Information

Throughout the year, ANet will automatically receive any student or enrollment changes that are made in your SIS through Clever. Please ensure that your Student Information System is up-to-date so students are properly enrolled at the time of their administration. You should expect these changes to be reflected in ANet within 48 hours of the update in your Student Information System. If you have questions about maintaining your student roster, reach out to [ANet Support](https://achievementnetwork.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new).

* * *

## Who to contact for support

-   If the issue is related to data within Clever or data coming from Clever, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).
-   If the issue is related to functionality within ANet, such as assessment availability, please contact [ANet Support](https://achievementnetwork.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new).

* * *

title: Clever + McGraw Hill Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912#overview)  
2. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912#setup)  
3\. [Recommended sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)  
4\. [Data requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)  
5\. [Managing licenses & assigning content](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912#managing)  
6\. [Where can I go for support?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912#where)

## Overview

McGraw Hill and Clever’s expanded partnership makes it easier than ever before for students to access digital learning tools. The integration supports account provisioning and access to any programs hosted on the ConnectED or Open Learning Platform. This guide contains important information about the setup process including integration requirements.   
 

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)IMPORTANT:** Please read before proceeding with the setup process  
  
**Communication:** Setting up a Clever integration requires a conversation with McGraw Hill Digital Integration Services. Make sure to schedule a project call with McGraw Hill.  
  
**Switching rostering methods:**  If you’re moving to Clever from self-registered accounts, please be ready to work with McGraw Hill on a user clean-up process to delete old data (students & possibly teachers).  
  
If you’re switching from a different method, McGraw Hill may have to re-match your historic customer data with your shared Clever data to retain historical data.  
  
**Data readiness:** Your district should be sending Clever term and course data. McGraw Hill requires term data in order to create courses, classes, users, etc. Not having this will prevent your district from proceeding. Stable course data will allow your district to more easily assign digital content (e.g. so classes receive the correct textbooks) prior to launch.  
  
**Interoperability:** If you plan on having users access McGraw Hill from platforms outside of Clever (e.g. Canvas), please be prepared to send Clever the same unique user ID you use to identify those users on other platforms (e.g., SIS ID) in your SIS sync.

* * *

##   
Setup Process

1\. Make sure your district is set up with Clever. If your district does not yet have a Clever account, you can get started by navigating to [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup). 

2\. If your district is already on Clever, you can add McGraw Hill by following these steps:

-   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation.
-   Search for McGraw Hill
-   When you request a connection with the application, you will also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the application through Clever.
-   Once you have made your selections, click Request.

3\. These requests will create a ticket with the McGraw Hill Digital Integration Services team, who will schedule an implementation call with you. The timing of these requests will be based on McGraw Hill’s current volume and having a conversation with McGraw Hill to develop your project plan.

-   McGraw Hill integration services must be configured at the Clever district/account level and include all users of your McGraw Hill K-12 content currently hosted on our ConnectED and Open Learning platforms. McGraw Hill Digital Integration Services may discuss the details of your full Clever integration on a scheduled implementation call. ​​​​​​

4. FYI: If you are already discussing this integration with your McGraw Hill representative, you may receive an invitation to connect directly in your Clever Dashboard. If so, please check your Clever Dashboard to accept your [app invite](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/article/360045084272). 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000034QT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BEHo)  
  

* * *

##   
Recommended sharing rules 

McGraw Hill recommends sharing only the classes and users at the school sites that will be using the program. This can include grades K-12 and subjects ranging from english/language arts, math, science, social studies, language, interventions/online learning, science, and arts and music. Please note: Data sharing permissions will vary according to your district’s purchasing agreement.

You can find more information about setting up sharing rules in [this guide](https://support.clever.com/s/article/115000392247).   
  

* * *

##   
Data requirements

The following fields must be successfully synced to Clever in order for your data to successfully sync with McGraw Hill:

-   Term names, start dates, and end dates
-   Course names 
-   Teacher, student, and staff usernames
-   Teacher email addresses 
-   Student email (recommended but not required)

Please note that user IDs (sis\_ids) must be globally unique across your district. In other words, a teacher and a student cannot have the same sis\_id in Clever.

You can check if your data meets the requirements by navigating to the [McGraw Hill > Data Quality](https://schools.clever.com/applications/access-manager/warnings) tab in your Clever Dashboard. 

In Clever, data quality issues will be represented as “data warnings” or “data errors”. For more information on resolving data quality issues, please review [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/article/202043083).   
 

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)IMPORTANT:** The data requirements outlined above are hard requirements for setting up rostering and SSO successfully with Clever and McGraw Hill. Failure to fulfill these requirements means McGraw Hill will not be able to create courses, classes, and users for your district. If you are not sending some of these required fields to Clever or are experiencing issues with data quality issues, please work with [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) to troubleshoot.

##   
  

* * *

##   
Managing licenses & assigning content

Once you have resolved all of the data quality issues, please work with the McGraw Hill Digital Integration Services team to ensure your district’s licenses and McGraw Hill content have been properly assigned in their rostering platform, Access Manager. For more information on how to assign your content in McGraw Hill, please see their [documentation](https://mhedu.force.com/DTS/s/article/Assign-Content-on-Access-Manager).  
  

* * *

##   
Where can I go for support?

**Clever Support:**

-   For help troubleshooting rosters, SIS Clever syncs, or login settings, check out our [Help Center](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/categories/200147297) where you can open a ticket with [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

**McGraw Hill Digital Technical Support:**

-   For help with McGraw Hill platforms, please contact [integrationsupport@mheducation.com](mailto:integrationsupport@mheducation.com).

title: Clever + PLTW Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047728891#header1)  
2\. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047728891#header2)  
3\. [Recommended Sharing Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047728891#header3)  
4\. [FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047728891#header4)  
5\. [Here to Help](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047728891#header5)

## Overview

Clever has partnered with myPLTW to create a seamless way to provide account creation, as well as Single Sign-On (SSO) access for users. This article will review the setup process so that you feel ready to add myPLTW for your district!  
 

* * *

## Setup Process

-   **Please note that integration between Clever and myPLTW could take up to a week and a half to complete.**
-   Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://www.clever.com/district-signup](https://www.clever.com/district-signup).
-   If your district is already on Clever, you can add the **myPLTW** application by following these instructions:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add)
    -   Search for **myPLTW**. 
    -   Click the **PLTW icon** to authorize requesting the application. During this process, you can select whether your district has already purchased the application. If your district or school has an active PLTW program, then select **Yes**. Otherwise, select **No** and we will notify PLTW of your interest. You can also learn more about getting started with PLTW by visiting [https://www.pltw.org/get-started](https://www.pltw.org/get-started).
    -   You will also be asked if you would like to request a custom launch date. The launch date is the first day users can access the app through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click **Request**.
    -   Note: Now that you’ve clicked the Request to Join button, please note that integration between Clever and myPLTW could take up to a week and a half to complete.
-   If your district receives an invitation from **myPLTW**, you can refer to this link for instructions on how to accept application invites: [For District Admins: How do I accept app invites?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045084272) 

* * *

##   
Recommended Sharing Rules

We recommend sharing only your related PLTW courses and including the subjects math, science, and technology and engineering. Please also share your district/school admins.

![Sharing rule displays rule sharing all sections where subject is one of math, science, technology and engineering.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Ssgb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000hZTx)

  
**Required Fields**

  
For **myPLTW** to integrate your data, you must include the following:

-   Adult users (teachers, admins): email address
-   Students: first name, last name, district, state id, and date of birth
-   Districts: NCES ID (primary)
    -   If NCES ID is not available, send the district name

-   Schools: NCES ID (primary)
    -   If NCES ID is not available, send the schools’ name and location

  
**Data Considerations**

Please Note: **myPLTW** cannot match rostering information for classes whose teachers do not have an email address in Clever. Additionally, if you do have an email address on file, please ensure that the email address in **myPLTW** matches the email address in Clever.  If no match is found, an educator account cannot be created in **myPLTW**.  
 

**Maintaining Student Rostering Information**

Throughout the year, **myPLTW** will automatically receive any student or enrollment changes that are made in your Student Information System (SIS) through Clever. Please ensure that your SIS is up-to-date so students are properly enrolled. You should expect these changes to be available in **myPLTW** within 48 hours of the update.  
 

**Clever Import Classrooms Guide**

Once your Clever integration is complete, please refer to [this link](https://storage-ext.pltw.org/l/82012/2020-08-24/5nddpt/82012/1663163563KmbpOt3m/How_to_Import_Clever_Classrooms_into_myPLTW_2022_23.pdf) for instructions to import classroom(s) into myPLTW after a district/site launches in Clever.

_Please note once your Clever integration is complete, you will only be able to roster via Clever moving forward._  
 

* * *

## FAQs

**Why is my data not showing up in** **myPLTW****?**

-   Depending on your sync type, Clever either pulls data from your SIS or data is submitted to Clever from your SIS. That data is then made available to **myPLTW** to sync to their system. There is a lag time between these processes, as the sync with Clever and the sync with **myPLTW** may not occur at the same time.  
     

**Why is my student or teacher missing from a** **myPLTW** **roster?**

-   Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to PLTW:
    -   Student or teacher is present in your SIS data
    -   Student or teacher is present in our Clever data and shared with **myPLTW**
-   If the user is missing from your Clever data but is in your SIS, please contact [**Clever Support**](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).  
     

**Why are classes missing from Clever?**

-   If the class is missing from your Clever data but is in your SIS, please contact [**Clever Support**](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)**.**  
     

**Why is a teacher missing from a** **myPLTW** **roster?**

-   Make sure that the teacher has sections in Clever; **myPLTW** will import teachers but teachers will not be able to view their associated sections in **myPLTW**. You can check this by searching for the teacher in the [**Data browser**](https://schools.clever.com/browser).
-   **myPLTW** only rosters primary teachers. If a section has co-teachers, they will not sync to your **myPLTW** roster.

  
**Who should I ask for help with this issue?**

-   If it’s related to data within Clever or data coming from Clever, please contact [**Clever Support**](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).
-   If the data is in Clever but not integrating into **myPLTW**, please contact us at 877.335.7589.

* * *

##   
Here to Help

The friendly PLTW Solution Center Team Members are here to answer all of your questions as well! Call PLTW at 877.335.7589 for live, one-on-one support 7 a.m.-9 p.m. Monday through Friday, or **[email](mailto:solutioncenter@pltw.org)** them and they’ll follow up with you.   
 

**Project Lead The Way**  
5939 Castle Creek Parkway North Drive  
Indianapolis, IN 46250

Local: 317.669.0200

title: Which Clever domains should my network grant access?
text:
This article contains the following:

##   
Overview

Some school organizations have firewalls or web filters in place that only allow outbound connections to certain domains. If your network uses systems like these, you'll need to grant access to Clever's domains so that your school organization will be able to successfully use Clever.  
 

* * *

##   
Domains

The list of domains your school organization should grant access for Clever users are:

1.  \*.clever.com
2.  \*.s3.amazonaws.com
3.  accounts.google.com (if your district uses Clever Badges for Chromebooks)
4.  \*.twilio.com

The exact syntax to use will depend on your network.  
  
If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Which sync type should I choose?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202289278#overview)  
2\. [Clever-Managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202289278#clever_managed_sync)  
3\. [SIS-Managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202289278#sis_managed_auto_sync)  
4. [SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202289278#sftp_syncs)

## xx  
Overview

Clever is compatible with all Student Information Systems (SIS), and depending on the SIS we offer a Clever-Managed Auto Sync, an SIS-Managed Auto Sync, or an SFTP Sync. The following information helps to explain the three supported sync types:   
 

* * *

## Clever-Managed Auto Sync

How does it work?

-   For Clever-Managed Auto Syncs, Clever has written an integration that exports data directly from the SIS and securely transfers it to Clever.
-   For these syncs, Clever requires configured credentials to access your SIS. As with all Clever syncs, you will still have complete control over data sharing and management of your Clever account.

Can I customize what roster data is synced?

-   The ability to customize data for Clever-Managed Auto Syncs is limited, but we may be able to remove unwanted fields or include additional fields in your sync to meet your district’s needs. [Contact our Support Team to request help](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

What are the next steps?

-   Before signing up for a Clever account, create a Clever read-only account in your SIS. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmR3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287qs) Check out [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US) for a complete list of Clever-Managed Auto Syncs!

* * *

## SIS-Managed Auto Sync

How does it work?

-   For SIS-Managed Auto Syncs, Clever has partnered directly with the SIS provider to offer an automated sync option. Clever does not require credentials or access to the SIS directly.
-   To take advantage of these SIS-managed syncs, select the 'Automatic' option during signup, and Clever will provide instructions to initiate the sync from your SIS to Clever.
-   In most cases, you will need to share Clever sync credentials with your SIS provider, and the SIS will generate and regularly upload data to Clever on your behalf. As with all Clever syncs, you will still have complete control over data sharing and management of your Clever account.

Can I customize what roster data is synced? 

-   If you have questions about customizing, please contact your SIS directly.

What are the next steps?

-   After creating your Clever account, navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab for instructions on how to activate your SIS-Managed Auto Sync.  

* * *

## SFTP Syncs

How does it work?

-   The SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol) Sync option allows school districts to “push” data to Clever. Clever provides credentials for Secure File Transfer Protocol as well as a web-based upload option, and districts generate files to upload to their accounts.
-   Clever recommends that you investigate automating the process for exporting and uploading data via SFTP; regular uploads to Clever mean current data in your apps.

Which student information systems (SIS) are available?

-   SFTP Sync is available for all SISs.

Can I customize what roster data is synced?

-   Because districts control exactly what data to include in their upload files, this option provides districts a greater level of customization but requires a more robust setup and management.

What are the next steps?

-   To learn more about the data upload process for districts using SFTP Sync, see [SFTP Syncs: What is the sync process?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US) 
-   If you are interested in automating your SFTP uploads, Clever supports data ingestion via nightly SFTP transmission to a secure SFTP server. While this method does not allow for real-time data uploads and requires additional configuration, it may be a useful option for schools whose IT Departments have already prepared SFTP scripts. The SFTP data transfer to Clever requires the submission of multiple files in a specific [CSV format](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867?language=en_US).

If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: Does Clever work with schools outside of the USA?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043013#overview)  
2\. [GDPR, UK, Canada, and Australia](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043013#gdpr)  
3\. [Other Regions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043013#OtherRegions)  
4. [Getting Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043013#getting-started)

## Overview

Thank you for your interest! Clever is fully supported in the United States, UK, Ireland, Australia, and [Canada](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001519). Although we can support usage in other countries under the circumstances outlined herein, we are not able to fully ensure local compliance in places outside those named areas. If you have questions about compliance in your country, email [legal@clever.com](mailto:legal@clever.com).

* * *

## GDPR, UK, Canada, and Australia

Clever’s services are provided to schools in the European Economic Area (the “EEA”), the United Kingdom (the “UK”), Switzerland, Canada, and Australia in compliance with local requirements, including the European Union’s (“EU”) General Data Protection Regulation ( “GDPR”) and its UK GDPR counterpart, Canadian PIPEDA, and the Australia Privacy Principles. For more information, please see our Additional Terms for Schools: 

-   [European Data Processing Addendum](https://clever.com/trust/europe-data-processing-addendum)  
-   [Canadian Privacy Notice](https://www.clever.com/trust/privacy/canada)
-   [Australian Privacy Notice](https://www.clever.com/trust/privacy/australia)

* * *

## Other Regions

Clever has not specifically localized our services or product offerings for other regions apart from Canada, the UK, EU/EEA, Australia, and the USA. Although some of the regions that we are compliant with are considered to be world-class in terms of consumer and privacy regulations, Clever may not be aware of unique compliance requirements from some international jurisdictions.

If your school is located in a region not named in the list above, Clever is open to providing services to you on an “as-is” basis and without any representation or warranty of compliance with local laws.

Before you use Clever’s services, you should familiarize yourself with our [Terms of Use](https://www.clever.com/trust/terms) and [Privacy Policy](https://www.clever.com/trust/privacy/policy) and confirm (a) that you are comfortable with the terms of our services; and (b) that they meet the requirements of your local jurisdiction. Notwithstanding the foregoing, please note that Clever is subject to relevant sanctions laws and Clever is not available in regions that are prohibited by various sanctions regulations.

* * *

## Getting Started

**Canada**

Canadian schools can learn more about [Clever in Canada](https://www.clever.com/canada) and sign up for Clever [here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup). 

Once your [account is created](https://www.clever.com/district-signup), your next step will be to sync your student data. Browse this [list](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) to determine whether your student information system supports Clever. 

-   **If it does**, you can find instructions on how to sync [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) or on your dashboard
    
-   **If it does not**, you can sync your data by following our [SFTP file instructions](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf)
    

Once your student data is synced, you can [add applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997), [print Badges](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), and [design your Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568).

**UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and other regions**

Learn more about Clever in your country [here.](https://www.clever.com/clever-global)

Once your [account is created](https://www.clever.com/district-signup), your next step will be to sync your student data. Browse this [list](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973) to determine whether your student information system supports Clever. 

-   **If it does**, you can find instructions on how to sync [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) or on your dashboard
    
-   **If it does not**, you can sync your data by following our [SFTP file instructions](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf)
    

Once your student data is synced, you can [add applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997), [print Badges](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907), and [design your Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568).

If you’d like Clever to be fully supported in your country, please contact us at [international@clever.com](mailto:international@clever.com).  We are working to expand our services into more countries and would love to hear from you.

title: Does Clever require third-party "write access" to my SIS?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203512033#h_4b1e7df4-3e3f-4333-8d03-c8bfee9097ec)  
2. [Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203512033#h_70047873-47e9-45b2-ada3-4b20b52e9b61)  
3. [SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203512033#h_1453c70d-030c-49a4-9082-24fe51fe87e0)

## Overview

[Security and privacy](https://clever.com/security) are top priorities at Clever. All roster data synced with Clever is protected by industry leading infrastructure and strict adherence to FERPA. Please read Clever's [security whitepaper](https://clever.com/about/security/practices) for more information on our privacy and security policies.  
 

Clever does not require write access to your SIS. See below for specifics SIS access for your sync type, and [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278?language=en_US) to learn more about Clever’s sync options.

##   
Auto Syncs

Clever supports the guidance to not grant write access to third parties – which is why Clever is a **read-only service**. As a result, the permissions you should grant Clever for your student information system (SIS) are **read-only**.

##   
SFTP Syncs

If you are syncing via [SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol)](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/sections/200431637), Clever does not have any access to your student information system (SIS). SFTP Syncs require you to compile all roster data you upload to Clever, and you control which fields are included in your data uploads. Clever provides credentials for Secure File Transfer Protocol as well as a web-based upload option, and districts generate files to upload to their accounts. You will not be asked to provide Clever with your SIS’s URL or credentials, and Clever has no way of directly exporting data from your SIS.  
 

If you have any questions about how to properly set up Clever, please [request assistance](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) from Clever Support.

title: How do I sign up for Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083506#h_4c99da9e-742d-4615-bbcb-67a69ffb6924)  
2. [Clever offerings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083506#h_72318bb1-6157-4d7d-a732-27b55c1cf1bd)  
3. [Sign-up for Clever!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202083506#h_2eca9fb5-adfd-4668-ba5f-6cb3fe1f594d)

## Overview

Thanks for your interest in Clever! If you are a district or school interested in using Clever, use the sign-up link below to get started. Read on to learn more about Clever!

  
[![Sign up for Clever button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000JIfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ycRW)](https://www.clever.com/district-signup/?utm_source=Help+Center&utm_medium=Link&utm_campaign=Onboarding)

Clever is an identity platform that helps schools with many daily tasks, such as:

-   Automating the secure transfer of student rosters to authorized parties
    
-   Providing single sign-on (SSO) for students, teachers, and staff to access learning applications easily
    
-   Managing account life cycles for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID
    
-   Providing end users with school-friendly multi-factor authentication (MFA) solutions
    

Before signing up, we recommend reviewing the following articles from our Help Center to learn more about us:

-   [What is Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202000976)
-   [How much does Clever cost for districts or schools?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202393278)
-   [What is single sign-on (SSO)?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807)
-   [How does Clever help districts protect student information?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202393058)

##   

##    
Clever offerings

Clever is the identity platform for education that offers:

-   **[Secure Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588)**: Secure sync maintains up-to-date roster information in your learning applications by ****connecting with your Student Information System (SIS) to securely roster your data with your connected applications, all in one place******.** With the majority of K-12 schools nationwide on Clever, Clever is the safest and fastest way for districts to securely send vendors data and grant access to learning applications.
    
-   **[Single Sign-On (SSO):](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807)** SSO allows students and teachers to access all of their applications with a single set of credentials so that they can focus on learning, not logging in.
    
-   **[Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002720807)**: A personalized portal through which users can use SSO to log in to every learning application they use. Customize your district’s or school’s Portal to add personalized resources like your school website or calendar.
-   **Additional complimentary tools** such as analytics, troubleshooting tools, and Access Logs.
-   In addition to our no-cost complimentary tools, we offer districts other optional paid tools such as [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) and [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616).

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000JIfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Iz3Hy)   Please note:** To get a full overview of all the tools in Clever, check out our [What's Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202000976) article! 

##    
Sign-up for Clever!

If you're ready to sign up, please [click here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup/?utm_source=Help+Center&utm_medium=Link&utm_campaign=Onboarding) to complete the sign-up form. Our District Onboarding team will be in touch with you to discuss next steps.

If you already use Clever and are interested in learning more about Clever IDM or Classroom MFA, please [contact our team here](https://www.clever.com/security-consultation).

title: Setting up Clever: Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020721271#one)  
2\. [Connect your student information system (SIS)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020721271#two)  
3\. [Add Applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020721271#ADDAPPS)  
4\. [Choose your identity provider (IdP)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020721271#three)  
5. [After onboarding, roll out Clever to your schools!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020721271#six)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020721271#FAQs)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bFXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fec)  
Getting started with the Clever? Check out our [onboarding courses](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding?user_type=district_admin), available in Clever Academy!

##   
Overview

Welcome to Clever! We’re so excited to get you set up. Clever offers many features, and getting started with the basics is easy.

For the best onboarding experience, we encourage you to access the onboarding courses listed above in Clever Academy once you have set up your Clever account. It’s a comprehensive resource to guide you in setting up Clever!

Below is a summary of the four essential steps to get your Clever account running. The first three steps are part of your onboarding journey, and the fourth is to get your schools using Clever so they can benefit from it!

* * *

## Step 1: Connect your student information system (SIS)

To start, you need to connect your SIS to Clever so we can help you share data you designate with relevant apps. Syncing data with Clever can be done with any SIS. Your sync is what sends information from your SIS to Clever so that we can share the data you authorize with the applications you specify. 

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bFXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever supports one source of truth per district**.** You must select a single Student Information System (SIS) or SFTP as your data source. Our system can't sync data from multiple SISs simultaneously. If your school organization has multiple schools using different systems, determine which single source you'll use for your Clever sync before getting started.

Navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in the dashboard and find your SIS from the drop-down menu. If you can’t find your SIS listed here, choose _Other_. 

There are three ways to sync data to Clever: 

-   [Clever-managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US)
-   [SIS-managed Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US)
-   [SFTP Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US)

For any SIS-Managed or SFTP syncs, our teams have limited insight into the export processes within your SIS. Please work with your SIS team directly for any questions on how to export data from their system.

If you need guidance on what sync type you should use, you can learn more here: [Which sync type should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) 

##   

 

* * *

 

## Step 2: Add Applications

Clever seamlessly syncs data with any of your schools' applications, or apps, that you connect to Clever. Examples include Newsela, Reading A-Z, and Mathspace.

To [add an application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114997), navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add applications page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add), and then request your desired application(s). 

Once you’ve requested a learning application, each app partner has its own approval process. If you have questions about getting your request approved, impacts on existing application data, or changes to the login flow for your students and teachers, please reach out to the application partner directly.

**Sharing Data**

After you have added a new application to Clever, you’ll need to set data sharing permissions for the application. Sharing permissions specify what data you want to make available to a specific application.

-   From the [Applications page](https://schools.clever.com/applications), find your newest application(s) from your list of connected learning applications. 
    
-   On the right side, choose **Share data now**.   
      
    ![Screenshot of the Application page showing “No data shared”](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bFXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000024z0Y) 
    

Find more information about sharing data with new applications here: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing data with new applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043482712?language=en_US).

  
 

* * *

## Step 3: Choose your identity provider (IdP)

If you decide to utilize the Clever Portal, you'll choose how students, teachers, and staff will log into Clever and access all your online learning applications in one place with a single click!

To set up single sign-on (SSO):

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
    
2.  Choose the identity provider (e.g. [Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503), [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576), [LDAP](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387), etc.) that works best for users in your school district. Find more information here: [Single Sign-On (SSO): identity provider (IdP) Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787?language=en_US).
    

Our Help Center offers step-by-step instructions for how to set up each login method within your Clever Dashboard: [Single Sign-On (SSO): Identity Provider (IDP)/Login Method Options](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787).

  
 

* * *

##   
Step 4: Roll Out

Woohoo! Now it’s time to share the exciting news with your teachers and make sure they’re all set.

If you’ve chosen to use Clever Portal with your district, navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page to provide instructions on how they will access Clever. You can find instructions to download on your Clever Dashboard as shown in this screenshot: 

![Screenshot of the Portal settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bFXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000obys)

If you’re using Clever just for rostering, make sure all apps your schools are using are added to Clever, and ensure teachers know how to log in to them.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Is there a quick list to walk me through the steps of setting up my Clever account?**
