-   Yes! We’ve created customized resources for districts and schools just getting started with Clever. Check out our [Clever Admin Onboarding checklist and Onboarding Quick Start Guides](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding?user_type=district_admin) for a handheld approach to setting up your account.
    

**Who do I contact if I have questions as I work on setting up my account?**

-   You should have received a welcome email with detailed setup instructions when your Clever account was created. Please respond directly to this email with any questions and your dedicated Onboarding Specialist will respond to assist you. If you cannot find the email or any other emails from your onboarding specialist, please feel free to reach out directly to our support team at support.clever.com and they will put you in touch with your Onboarding Specialist.
    

**Can I add other administrators to help with account setup?**

-   Yes! Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page of your Clever account and follow the steps in our article: [Clever Roles: Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038).
    

**What if I don’t know how to export data from my SIS?**

-   Check out our onboarding resources in Clever Academy, or reach out to your district/school’s onboarding specialist and they can share where you can find additional instructions.
    
-   With SFTP syncs, we have limited insight into how to export data from your SIS. We recommend reaching out directly to your SIS for the best assistance with any SIS-specific export instructions for your SFTP sync.
    

**What if I don’t have a SIS?**

-   You can manually create and upload CSV files to sync your data to Clever.
    

**How long does it take to set up my Clever account?**

-   This varies for each district and school depending on your SIS, sync type, and the applications you hope to set up. Most schools can have their data sync and first application launched for rostering within a week!
    

**How do I know when I have completed onboarding with Clever?**

-   You can expect a congratulatory email from your Onboarding Specialist when you have completed Clever onboarding. This email will provide next-step resources and instructions on how to reach our support team for any further assistance needed beyond onboarding.
    

**What are my next steps after syncing data, setting up an application, and adding a login method?**

-   Check out [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin) for more information on Clever Core and Clever+ tools! Once you have completed the onboarding process, please reach out to our support team with any questions about troubleshooting or resources to help you further utilize Clever.

title: Can small districts, charters, parochial, and private schools use Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236358047#header1)  
2\. [Things to Consider](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236358047#header2)  
3\. [Getting Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236358047#header3)

## Overview

Clever is a no-cost data integration and single sign-on (SSO) service that gives back hours of teaching time to school organizations across the country. Clever can be used by various types of school organizations, including charter and parochial schools.  
 

* * *

## Things to consider

**Charter and private schools:**

-   Student Information System (SIS) requirement: Clever is designed to sync student data from your SIS, but we understand that many private and charter schools don't have an SIS. You can find a list of our SIS partners [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973). If you don't have an SIS or don't see your SIS on the list, you will have to create CSV files and [upload them via SFTP](https://schools.clever.com/documents/clever-sftp-default-pdf).

**Local school organization:** 

-   If a school organization doesn't manage your private or charter school, type your school's name into the **Name of School, District/Organization** box.

**School organizations:**

-   Syncing**:** When completing your first sync, you can find more information in these articles:
    -   [SIS Partners](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973)
    -   [Which sync option should you choose?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278)
    -   [Sync Error: What are "Insufficient Permissions"?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206830627) 
    -   [Sync Error: How do I resolve "Invalid username/password specified"?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202493868)
    -   [All other Secure Sync topics](https://support.clever.com/hc/sections/207400687)

* * *

## Getting Started

Clever setup works best when there's a dedicated technology team managing the account. Before signing up, think about who'll be setting up and running things. You can get an overview of the different roles and permissions in Clever [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726). 

Think you’ll need a little extra support? We’ve got you covered. Clever offers Consulting and Premium Support for organizations looking for a higher level of guidance. As your partner in simplifying digital learning, we provide VIP dedicated support and expert coaching tailored to your needs. Check it out [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646?language=en_US).

If you are still interested in using Clever and ready to sign up, please visit our Self-Service Guides on [Secure Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0y0WAC/secure-sync?language=en_US) and [Single Sign-on (SSO).](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0xxWAC/single-signon-sso?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: How do I add an STL to Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360048169811#h_3be68020-6f75-40a9-aadc-e456a0f9146f)  
2. [Bulk uploading School Tech Leads via CSV](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360048169811#h_903f381b-a8df-4c70-9f4d-3f7732c4e6c7)  
3\. [Upgrading an existing staff user](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360048169811#h_f8a48f82-f06f-4769-9fb3-8ba08c5a5866)  
4. [Manually adding a School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360048169811#h_3d389085-ebe4-4a95-b7d0-53c213b99a6a)

##   
Overview

District Admins can assign certain users the School Tech Lead role which provides them with limited admin permissions in Clever for their associated school(s). To learn more about the School Tech lead role, read: [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663). 

  
As educators are increasingly relying on technology to support online learning, having a dedicated role in Clever to help teachers manage their digital classroom in Clever is now more important than ever.

  
Clever Admins can add STLs to their Clever Portal today. Follow the instructions in this [quick video](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/jf4w35elee) or follow the instructions below.

##   
Bulk uploading School Tech Leads via CSV

To add a School Tech Lead, or multiple School Tech Leads, via an uploaded file to Clever, please:

-   Navigate to [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff).
-   Scroll down to the 'Manual Upload' section and select 'Download existing staff.csv'

  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287o3)      

-   The staff.csv file will contain all pre-existing staff in Clever for your district.  
     
    -   _**Note**: DO NOT REMOVE any staff users you still want to have access to Clever. Removing a user from the staff.csv before re-uploading it will cause their record to be deleted. Rather, just add the additional user information to the file before re-uploading._  
         
-   Add the desired staff members to the file, entering 'STL' or 'School Tech Lead' in the Role column.   
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287o8)
-   Navigate to [Data sources > SIS sync > Staff Data](https://schools.clever.com/sync/staff) > Manual Upload, and upload the updated staff.csv.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287oD)      

-   The upload changes should be reflected in Clever in approximately 10-15 minutes

## Upgrading an existing staff user to School Tech Lead

1.  School Tech Leads must first be added to Clever as staff before they can be assigned the School Tech Lead role. If the individual is a teacher in Clever, or are not yet in Clever as staff, please visit: [Adding custom staff to Clever.](https://support.clever.com/s/article/360026950471)
2.  Once the user is in Clever, navigate to their profile page using the 'Search' feature at the top of the dashboard.
3.  From their profile page, click the drop-down arrow on the top right of the page.
4.  Select 'Update Clever Role'.
5.  Select 'School Tech Lead'.

![Staff profile with Update role button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004aozT)

## Manually adding a School Tech Lead

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.
2.  In top right corner, click **Add custom data**. 
3.  In the drop-down menu, select **Staff.**   
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287om)
    1.  Fill out the fields for the School Tech Lead you want to create. You’ll need to select which schools they are assigned to, or select 'Assign to all schools', as well as enter some basic identifying information.   
          
        **IMPORTANT: To make them into a School Tech Lead, you need to select 'School Tech Lead' in the drop-down for 'Clever Role'.**  
          
        ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287or)
    2.  Optional: Check the box to send an email notifying the staff member that their account has been created.  
         
    3.  Select 'Create Staff'

![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)**The Username and Password field only needs to be populated if:**   
  
 A) The district login method is Clever Passwords and 'District Username' or 'District Password' is selected for staff logins  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBkr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287ow)  
B) The district login method is Active Directory or LDAPS and the 'username' field in Clever is utilized for staff matching (claims rules)   
  
C) You would like to utilize the 'District Username' and 'District Password' fields for staff logging into SSO (Saved Passwords) applications

title: For Teachers: Clever + Zoom guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header1)  
2\. [How do I create a Zoom account?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header2)  
3\. [How do I log in to Zoom?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header3)  
4\. [How do I set up my virtual meetings?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header4)  
5. [How do I update my virtual meetings to support password protection?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header5)  
6\. [How do my students log in to Zoom?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header6)  
7\. [Recommended Zoom settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header7)  
8\. [How can I get help with using Zoom?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#header8)

## Overview

Clever has partnered with Zoom to create a seamless way to enable account creation and Single Sign-On (SSO) access for teachers, staff, and admins who need to support remote learning.

* * *

## How do I create a Zoom account?

Adding Zoom and creating accounts are managed at the school organization level. Administrators can find directions for adding the Zoom integration [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040481852). 

If you don't see the Zoom app in your Portal, please contact your administrator or IT team.

* * *

## How do I log in to Zoom?

1.  Log in to the Clever Portal
2.  Click on the **Zoom icon**.  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287ZS)

You're now logged in and will be directed to your Zoom profile! On this page, you can find your Personal Meeting ID URL that you'll share with your students. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287ZJ)**Please note:** The _Zoom - Teachers & Staff_ application is only for use by teachers and staff. Do not add this application to your Teacher Pages. See "[How do I set up my virtual meetings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040514352#h_c4742499-9d79-40c9-a61f-0bd63c47f227)" for information on providing students access to Zoom. 

* * *

## How do I set up my virtual meetings?

1.  [Log in to your Clever Portal](https://clever.com/login).
2.  Create a Teacher Page for each of your classes. Instructions can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323).
3.  Click on the Zoom application in the Clever Portal.
4.  Click on **Schedule a Meeting.**
5.  Enter the details for your class. For example:  
      
                  _Topic: 1st Hr - Algebra_  
                  _When: 8:00am - 8:52am_
6.  Select **Recurring meeting**. 
7.  Select **Save**. On the next screen, click **Copy the invitation.**
8.  Go to the Clever Portal and click on your Teacher Page for the corresponding class (Example: _1st Hr - Algebra)._
9.  Click **Add** in the top-right corner and select **Link**. Paste the Meeting URL where it says **Link URL** → name the link (ex. Mr. Conn's Zoom) → upload the Zoom logo as the icon → Click **Add link.  
    **![Add Zoom link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004ETPd)
10.  The Zoom icon will now appear on your teacher page for both you and your students to access. Any time you and your students want to join your virtual classroom, simply click on the Zoom icon!
11.  Repeat steps 3-10 for each of your classes. 

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Pro Tip:**   Consider adding your picture as your app icon for Zoom to create a more personalized experience! 

* * *

## How do I update my virtual meetings to support password protection?

Zoom has updated the default settings for education customers to enable password protection for meetings automatically. However, if you created a meeting link prior to April 6th, please follow the directions below to update the link on your Clever Teacher Page. This will ensure students won't need to enter a password when joining your meeting:

1.  [Log in to the Clever Portal.](https://clever.com/login)
2.  Click on the **Zoom application** in the Clever Portal.
3.  Click on **Meetings** from the left-hand navigation.
4.  Click on the name of the scheduled meeting you wish to adjust.  
    ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CCMk)
5.  Copy the updated Join URL  
    ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CCMp)
6.  Go to the Clever Portal → Click on your Teacher Page for the corresponding class (Example: _Algebra 1)_
7.  Click the **three vertical dots** on the icon for your existing Zoom link and click **Edit**
8.  Paste the updated Join URL where it says **Link URL.  
    ![Update Zoom link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004ETRF)**
9.  Click **Update**
10.  The updated URL will now be available to your students. Repeat these steps for each of your Zoom links.

For meetings scheduled moving forward, the meeting password can be found in the invitation and will automatically be included in the Join URL.

* * *

## How do my students log in to Zoom?

Once you have created a Zoom icon for your students, they will simply log in to the Clever Portal > Click on your Teacher Page > Click on the Zoom icon that you added. They'll immediately be taken to your virtual meeting! 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BFBN)

* * *

## Recommended Zoom Settings

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Zw) **Tips from Zoom:** [How to Keep the Party Crashers from Crashing Your Zoom Event](https://blog.zoom.us/wordpress/2020/03/20/keep-the-party-crashers-from-crashing-your-zoom-event/)

###   
**Waiting Room**

**Description:** The Waiting Room feature allows the host to control when a participant joins the meeting. As the meeting host, you can admit attendees one by one or hold all attendees in the waiting room and admit them all at once  
**Directions**: [Setup](https://support.zoom.us/hc/articles/115000332726)  
**Tutorial:** [How to use](https://support.zoom.us/hc/articles/115000332726)

### **Mute upon entry**

**Description:** Automatically mute all participants when they join the meeting. The host controls whether participants can unmute themselves  
**Directions:** Setup - Log in to Clever >  Click on Zoom > Settings > Mute participants upon entry > toggle to green  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287a1)  
**Tutorial:** [How to use](https://support.zoom.us/hc/articles/203435537) 

### **Disable screen sharing for students**

**Description:** Allow only the teacher to share their screen or content during meetings  
**Directions:** Setup - Log in to Clever >  Click on Zoom > Settings > Screen Sharing > Who can share? > Select "Host only" _>_ Click "Save"  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XwjZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287a6)  
**Tutorial:** [How to use](https://support.zoom.us/hc/articles/203435537) 

### **Disabling In-Meeting Chat**

**Description:** This will prevent the host, co-hosts, and participants from chatting for any meetings you host. The Chat option will no longer appear in the Meeting Controls.

**Directions:** 

1.  1.  Sign in to Clever
    2.  Click on the Zoom icon to sign in to the Zoom web portal.
    3.  Click [Settings](https://zoom.us/profile/setting).
    4.  Click the **Chat and Private Chat** toggles to **disable** in-meeting chat.
    5.  Click **Save** **Changes**.

* * *

## How can I get help with using Zoom?

Zoom has a large number of resources to support you and your students. These resources can be found at [https://support.zoom.us](https://support.zoom.us/hc)

Here are some resources from their Help Center that Clever recommends to get started!

-   [Zoom Video Tutorials (1 Minute each!)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/206618765)
-   [Meeting and Webinar Best Practices](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/209743263)
-   [Managing meetings with updated controls](https://blog.zoom.us/wordpress/2020/04/08/zoom-product-updates-new-security-toolbar-icon-for-hosts-meeting-id-hidden/)
-   [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/articles/206175806)

**Zoom Technical Support**

If you or your students encounter technical problems with Zoom, you can [submit a support request](https://zoom.us/zendesk/sso?return_to=https://support.zoom.us/hc/requests/new). "Support Hours" are **24 x 7**, including public holidays, where agents or technical engineers are available for email or live support.

title: For Teachers: SSO (Saved Passwords) applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026789592#one)  
2\. [How does my school organization provide user credentials for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026789592#two)  
3. [How do I reset my student's SSO (Saved Passwords) credentials?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026789592#three)  
4\. [How do I reset my SSO (Saved Passwords) credentials?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026789592#four)

## Overview

Single Sign-on SSO (Saved Passwords) applications are icons in the Clever Portal that automatically log students and teachers into websites that do not currently have a formal integration with Clever. From a user's experience, these icons appear to be the same as other resources in the Portal.   
  
In order for an SSO (Saved Passwords) application to automatically log users into a website, **you and your students' must already have existing accounts with the website**. Your school organization will provide Clever with credentials for these accounts, then Clever's system securely saves this login information to help users automatically sign into the website from the Portal!  
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Make sure the [Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) is downloaded on your school's devices to ensure users are able to log into these Saved Passwords applications!

* * *

## How does my school organization provide user credentials for SSO (Saved Passwords) applications?

Your school organization administrator manages the process of adding SSO (Saved Passwords) applications to your Clever account. They also configure settings that determine how user credentials for the website are provided to Clever.

If they have chosen to have users manually provide their credentials, you will see a prompt to enter login information the first time you click on the SSO (Saved Passwords) application in the Clever Portal.

## ![Screenshot of a login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRQV)

Once you enter the correct login information for your account with this application, click **'Save Login'**. Clever will save this information and automatically log you into the application next time you click the icon from the Portal!

If you click on an application and see the page below, this means we were not able to log you into the application with the provided credentials. Please enter your updated username and password for the application, and click '**Update & Log in**'.

![Screenshot of a filled in login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRQk)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Yy) If you'd like to learn about how Clever securely stores user credentials for Saved Passwords applications, feel free to read our blog post [here](https://engineering.clever.com/2017/01/10/securing-saved-password-applications/)!

* * *

## How do I reset my student's SSO (Saved Passwords) credentials?

If your student has trouble with an SSO (Saved Passwords) application, you can help them troubleshoot! Log into your Clever account, then follow these steps:

1.  Go to Clever Portal > My Students > Student Roster > Select the class of the student having trouble.
2.  Click **Troubleshoot app login**.

![Screenshot of student roster screen with Troubleshoot app login button highlighted.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RwoRV)

3.  Search for the app that requires new student credentials.

![Screenshot of how to troubleshoot an app login.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RwX46)

4.  Determine if the student can see the application from their Clever Portal. If they can't, you'll need to contact an Admin for help.

![Screenshot of how to troubleshoot an app login.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RwlF7)

5.  Click **Update credentials**.

![Screenshot prompting to update a user's credentials.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Rwmaz)

6.  Enter the correct username and password. Click **Set credentials**.

![Screenshot of where to enter username and password.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RwnAT)

If you still need help, you can contact our Support Team by clicking the chat icon in the bottom right corner of Support.Clever.com.

* * *

## How do I reset my SSO (Saved Passwords) credentials?

If incorrect credentials are inputted for one of your SSO (Saved Passwords) applications, you are able to update them by:

1.  Log in to your Clever Portal
2.  Select the application that has incorrect credentials
3.  Enter your updated username and password for the application, and click **Update & Log in**.

![Screenshot highlighting where to reset SSO credentials.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BRUI)

If for some reason the above steps do not work for you, please follow these steps to update your credentials in an incognito window:

1.  On your computer, open [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/).
2.  At the top right, click More ![menu.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lWFb)![arros.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lWFg)  **New Incognito Window**.
3.  A new window appears. In the top corner, check for the Incognito icon ![incognito.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QYPR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lWFq).
4.  Log in to Clever: clever.com/login
5.  Click on the **<<App Name>> ap**p.
6.  You should be prompted to update your username and password.
7.  Click **Save**.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If you're still having trouble, please confirm that the username and password you've entered work to log into your account directly on the application's page (i.e. at schoology.com). If you can successfully access the app directly through their website, but not through Clever, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for help!

title: For Teachers: Rename a Class
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001199243#one)  
2. [Renaming steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001199243#two)

## Overview

Teachers can rename classes within their Clever Portal. By default, your class names will be what is listed in your school organization's student information system (SIS).

Renaming a class is especially useful if your class names are long and difficult to remember (e.g. "Grade 5 Reading, Class 501 - 501 (14\_10)").  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPrp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  Renaming of classes will only apply to classes **within the Clever Portal**. If you would like to rename your classes within an application, please reach out to your Clever administrator or check in with the application's support team to see if they can help!

##    
Renaming steps

1\. From your Clever Portal, head to My Students > Student Roster.

2 Choose the class you want to rename.

3\. Click **Edit class nickname**, update the name, and click **Save**.

![Screenshot of student roster page with Edit student nickname highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPrp&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004M5Uz)

title: For Teachers: Announcements
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045714731#overview)  
2. [Sending an announcement](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045714731#sending_messages)  
3\. [Deleting an announcement](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045714731#DeletingMessages)  
4\. [The student experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045714731#StudentExperience)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045714731#faq)

## Overview

Clever enables teachers to send one-way announcements to keep students informed quickly and efficiently. These announcements are perfect for reaching an entire class or multiple classes at once. Teachers can easily create and send announcements directly from their Clever Portal. Students can’t reply to teacher announcements.

* * *

## Sending an announcement

  **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEbR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKiGr)  Clever Tip:** Press the **shift + return** keys to move to the next line without sending the message! 

**To send an announcement to a specific class, follow the steps below:**

1.  Navigate to your Clever Portal.
    
2.  Click **My students > Announcements** in the left menu.
    
3.  Click the +New Announcement button.
    
4.  Select the class you'd like to create a channel for.
5.  Enter a name.
6.  Select or upload an icon that will be associated with your channel.
7.  Click **Create.  
    ![Create class to send announcement](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEbR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKaO9)**
8.  Type your announcement in the text box of the chat.
9.  Click **Send** to send your announcement.

**To send an announcement to _all_ students, follow the steps below:**

1.  Navigate to your **Clever Portal**.
    
2.  Click **My Students > Announcements** in the left menu.
    
3.  Select the **All classes** option or click on the class titled **\[Your name’s\] Students.** Make sure that the highlighted text under your page name shows All students.
    
4.  Type your announcement in the text box of the chat.
    
5.  Click **Send** to send your announcement.
    

![Sending an announcement](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEbR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000efGZe)

   **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEbR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKiGr)   Clever Tip:** You can also add attachments to your announcements! Click the paperclip icon in the announcement box and select a file that you’d like to attach.

* * *

## Deleting an announcement

If you need to delete an announcement, click the three vertical dots on the announcement you want to delete, then select **Delete.** Deletion is permanent and can’t be undone. Deleting it will prevent the announcement from being seen by you and your students.

* * *

##   
The student experience

The announcements icon in the student’s Portal will display a dot with a number to show they have received an announcement.

![Announcements notification symbol](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEbR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000efpKT) 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can I send an announcement to an individual student?**

-   No. You can send announcements to an entire class or all of your students at once.
    

**Who has access to my announcement history?**

-   Clever Admins for your school can access your announcement history.
    

**Can announcements be deleted or edited?**

-   Yes! You can delete Announcements by clicking the three vertical dots on the announcement and selecting **Delete.** Announcements cannot be edited once sent.

**What happens to announcements when the school year rolls over?** 

-   When the new school year starts, if you no longer have classes with the previous year's students, you won’t be able to send announcements to those students and will no longer have access to the announcement history.
    

**Is there a character limit for announcements?** 

-   Announcements are limited to 8,000 characters.  
    

  
**Can students reply to announcements?**

-   No, announcements offer one-way communication from teachers to students.

title: For Teachers: Searching and Favoriting apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025873072#h_f5f3aa27-6ecd-4144-88e7-de84b2858132)  
2. [Favoriting resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025873072#Header1)  
3\. [Searching for resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025873072#Header2)

This article provides an overview of how teachers can easily locate applications and categorize their favorite apps in Clever!  

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287W9)  Locating and favoriting applications are features that are also [available to your students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026162691)!

## Favoriting applications

**Here's how to favorite an application:**

-   Log into your Clever Portal from your school organization's Clever login page, or from [Clever.com](https://clever.com/).
-   Locate your favorite app icon, and click the heart in the upper right-hand corner of the icon.
-   This will add the app to the 'Favorites' section at the top of your Portal. 
-   To remove an app from your ‘Favorites’, simply click the heart again in the top right corner!

![Image of the i-Ready icon with the heart selected.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BHe7)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPv3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287WE)**Please note:** Favoriting resources is only reflected in individual Portals. Resources that teachers favorite will not be favorited for their students.

##   
Searching for applications

Teachers can search for school organization-wide applications, [Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672) resources, or school organization-wide app links from their Clever Portals.

-   Simply navigate to the search bar at the top of your Clever Portal to search for the app.
-   Depending on the app, when the result is selected you will be either:
    -   Logged in to the app if it is a school organization-wide application
    -   Provided the option to install the app if it is a [Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672) app 
    -   Be redirected to the app login page to log in (if a non-integrated app)

If you are unable to locate the app via the Clever search bar, this means it is either not a Clever-integrated app nor a school organization-wide linked app. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323) for instructions on how to add links to your Teacher Page for these types of apps.

title: For Teachers: Adding apps & resources
text:
This article contains directions for adding:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045975172#header1)  
2\. [Library apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045975172#header2)  
3\. [Apps provisioned by your school organization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045975172#header3)  
4\. [Links](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045975172#header4)  
5\. [PDFs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045975172#header5)  
6\. [Missing an app?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045975172#header6)

## Overview

You can add various resources to your Teacher Page. This article will guide you through the process of adding these different types of resources available in Clever.  
 

* * *

##   
Library apps:

The Clever Library is a resource hub for teachers to discover, learn about, and adopt new educational materials for their classrooms. You can add the resources in the Library to your individual Teacher Pages for easy access by students and teachers. If your school organization has enabled the Clever Library, you can follow the instructions in [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672) to locate and install resources.

![Clever Library](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cF9J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000TqCNl)    
 

* * *

##   
Apps:

Adding applications provided by your school organization to your Teacher Page is a quick and easy process. Please follow these steps:

1.  Navigate to **Pages** > **District** **page** on the left-hand side of your Clever Portal.
2.  Click on the **three vertical dots** on any resource you want to add to your Teacher Portal and click **Add to Teacher Page.**

**Please note:** Resources that have a link icon ![link icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cF9J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hfC)  in the top right-hand corner of the resource indicate it is a hyperlink and **not** an application that supports single sign-on. The resource in the image below doesn't have the link icon, suggesting it's an application that will log you and your students in instantly from the Clever Portal. 

**![Add app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cF9J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hth)**

3.  A pop-up will display for you to select which Teacher Page you'd like to add the app to.  
    _**Please note:** If you are unable to locate an application provisioned by your school org, please reach out to your Clever admin to request that they share the application with you._
4.  Click **Add.**

* * *

##   
Links:

Teachers typically add links as redirects to applications, resources that aren't provisioned by your school org, or aren't integrated with Clever. For these types of resources, the link might direct you and your students to the login page of a specific application, or a resource website. Single sign-on (SSO) isn't available for linked resources, and rostering data won't be synced by Clever; instead it must be updated manually within the resource as needed.  
  
Links are a great way to provide easy access to websites, videos, Google docs, and more! 

Adding links to your Teacher Page is a quick and easy process! Please follow these steps:

1.  Navigate to **Pages** > **My Teacher Pages.**
2.  Select the **Add** option at the top of your Teacher Page and select **Link**.
3.  A pop-up will display allowing you to paste the URL for the page this link should direct to which should always begin with **https://**
4.  Enter a title to help your students locate the link.
5.  Choose the appropriate [category](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323?language=en_US#h_a7b41463-341c-4e5c-b17b-6beba3ae8118) for your link.
6.  Select one of the provided icons to represent your link, or upload your own icon! _To upload your own icon, select **Upload** in order to search for the appropriate image from your desktop. Images must be in the .png file format, and less than 2MB._ 
7.  Click **Add link**.

  
![Add link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cF9J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hvJ) 

* * *

##   
PDFs

Uploading resources as PDFs is quick and easy on Clever! Simply follow these directions: 

1.  Navigate to **Pages** > **My Teacher Pages**
2.  Select the **Add** option at the top of your Teacher Page and select **PDF**.
3.  Select the **File** to be uploaded from your device. The max file size is 10MB.
4.  Enter the **File Name** to display to students
5.  Select the **Category** where you want the file to be displayed on your Teacher Page
6.  Select the desired **Icon** or upload your own!
7.  Once the file has been successfully uploaded to Clever (Cloud is Green), select **Add PDF**

  
![Add PDF](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cF9J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044i09)  

The file is now accessible to students on your Teacher Page! When the student clicks on the file, the PDF will open in their web browser (e.g. Google Chrome). They can download or print the PDF using the tools in the top-right corner: 

![Tools for downloading and printing PDFs](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cF9J&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287W4)

Need help downloading your resource as a PDF to upload to Clever? Directions for popular programs can be found below: 

-   **Google Docs**  
    File > Download > PDF Document (.pdf)
-   **Google Slides**  
    File > Download > PDF Document (.pdf)
-   **Microsoft Word**  
    File > Save as > File Format: PDF > Export
-   **Microsoft PowerPoint**  
    File > Save as > File Format: PDF > Save

* * *

## Missing an app?

If you or your student is missing an application from your Clever Portal, [please reach out to your school organizations support contact.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648?language=en_US#h_ffa9b241-1ab9-4cc4-bc4d-677ae0ece396)  Your school org manages which teachers and students can access each learning application through Clever, so they'll need to add the application to your student's Portal.

title: For Teachers: Analytics
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311#header1)  
2\. [How do I access Analytics in my Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311#header2) [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
3\. [Student activity](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311#header3)  
4\. [Weekly overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311#header4)  
5\. [FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311#header5)

![Clever Academy symbol](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEWb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fde)   
Getting started with the Clever Portal? Check out our [Product Spotlight: Using Class Analytics to support students](https://clever.academy/product-spotlight-using-class-analytics-to-support-students?user_type=teacher), available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

With so many digital learning tools in use in school, it can be hard for teachers to keep track of student engagement and activities. Class Analytics in the Clever Teacher Portal gives you key information about which students are logging in to Clever and when they last logged in. It also shows which resources (applications, links, and PDFs teachers have added) the students have accessed in the past seven days.  
  
The Analytics page has two tabs: **Student activity** and **Weekly overview**. Continue reading to learn more about the features on each tab.

##   

* * *

##   
How do I access Analytics in my Clever Portal? 

1.  Log in to your Clever Portal at your school organization's specific URL.
2.  Click on **My Students** > **Analytics** in the menu on the left side of the Portal.

  
![Class Analytics](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEWb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000MFPaw)   

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEWb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287V6)  Please note:** The data on this page will update every 60 seconds. If you believe there is a discrepancy, please feel free to reach out!

* * *

##   
Student activity

The **Student activity** tab includes data and tools that allow teachers to easily view and manage student participation in one central location. It includes the most recent login for each student and which resources they utilized for the previous seven days. 

This data can be filtered by class, resource, and level of activity.

![Student activity view](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEWb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000MFSdd)

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEWb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287VG)  Please note:** This feature only shows the students' most recent logins. If a student has logged in multiple times, only their most recent login to Clever will appear.  

* * *

##   
Weekly overview

The **Weekly overview** tab shows student login history for the previous seven days and the resources that they have been using.

![Weekly overview](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cEWb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004EH3V)

If a student has accessed more than two resources, you can click the **and (number) more** hyperlink and a pop-up window of the student's last accessed resources will appear. Teachers can toggle the '_Show resources'_ button if they would like to hide the resources and only see login data.   
 

* * *

## FAQ

**Can I see the number of times each student logged in over the past week in addition to the most recent login?** 

-   The Teacher Analytics feature currently only shows the last time a student logged in to the Clever portal. We are looking to expand the kinds of student activity that appear on this page. Please use the feedback dialog on the page to let us know what actions you would like to take and additional information you would like to see. 

**Can I download or save the login analytics for a given week?** 

-   Not at this time.  

**Are there plans to add login data for more than the past seven days?** 

-   We plan to surface the last time a student logged into the portal for up to 30 days. 

**My student/student’s guardian said that they logged in to their EdTech resources this week. Why don’t I see them in the analytics?**

-   Teacher Analytics currently only surface the last time a student logged in to the Clever Portal. If students access EdTech resources outside of the Clever Portal, we are unable to track or report that information. You can add links and applications to your [Teacher Page](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323), which will allow Clever to surface information about student activity.

title: For Teachers: Login Tools
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566#Overview)  
2. [Opening resources for your students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566#launching_apps)  
3. [Logging students out of Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566#logging_students_out)  
4\. [View student login status](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566#viewing_login_status)  
5. [Log in with Clever - Download student usernames](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566#download_username)  
6\. [Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (Classroom MFA) for students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566#mfa)

## Overview

In your Clever Portal, you'll have access to a variety of Login Tools. This article details the different Login Tools available to teachers, including:

-   Opening resources for your students 
-   Logging students out of Clever
-   Reviewing student login status

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Tj)**Clever Tip:** Teacher tools are not currently supported on the Clever iOS application.

* * *

##   
Opening resources for your students

If students are logged into Clever using an internet browser window (e.g., Internet Explorer, Chrome, Edge, etc.), their teachers can open resources, such as applications, for them. This option is not currently available for students using the Clever iOS application.

  
Teachers can open a resource, such as an application, for their students, from either their Portal or any of their Teacher Pages (the process is the same). Opening a resource for students won't close out browser tabs or lock students into using only the opened resource.

To open a resource for your students:

1.  Navigate to your Portal on the Resources page or to one of your Teacher Pages (in this screenshot, we’re showing the Resources page). 

 _![Resources page of the Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZH6jB)_

2.  Choose a resource to open, click on the three blue buttons in the upper right of the icon, and click **Open for Students**.
    
3.  You can open the resource for an entire class, multiple classes, or a subset of students.
    
      
    ![Screenshot of the Open for students screen showing “Choose Classes”](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001lVuD)   
      
    
4.  Click **Open** after your selection and a green box will appear, letting you know the resource was successfully opened on student devices!

  
See below for a video showing the student view when a teacher has opened an resource for them:

##   

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287U8)**Please note:** If a student doesn't have access to the resource you're opening, they'll see an error message. See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020618731) for troubleshooting steps. 

* * *

##   
Logging students out of Clever

Teachers also can log students out of Clever! Log your class out of Clever by following the steps below:

-   Navigate to **My Students** > **Student Roster** in the menu on the left side of your Portal
-   Filter by class.
-   Select **More class tools** > **Log out class**.

![Screenshot highlighting how to log out of a class.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZHBMH)

-   Clicking this button will log your students out of Clever. This will also be reflected under the **Name** column as students will appear as offline.

![Screenshot highlighting student login status.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004EK1N)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287US)**Please note:** If students are using Google Chrome with the [Clever Extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) installed, students will also be logged out of their applications. 

##   
Viewing student login status

The **My Students** > **Student Roster** page shows which students have successfully logged into Clever. 

1.  Select your class by clicking the **Filter by class** drop-down. 
2.  Review the student login status under the **Name** column. It will either say Offline or Online above the student's name.

 ![Screenshot highlighting student login status.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004EJZy)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Want to learn more about resetting passwords? Check out this article: [**For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)

* * *

##   
**Log in with Clever** \- Download student usernames

If your school organization uses **Log in with Clever** you'll have the ability to download a list of your students' usernames within your Clever Portal! You can download the list of usernames for each of your classes.

## Step 1:

From your Portal click on **My Students > Student Roster** on the left-hand side of your Portal. 

## Step 2: 

Click on **More class tools** on the right side of the page. 

![Screenshot highlighting how to download student usernames.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZHDr7)

## Step 3: 

Click **Download student usernames** in the dropdown menu. This will download a CSV file containing the students' usernames along with each student's first and last name. 

_Note: Usernames can also be downloaded via the **Classes** tab at the top of your Portal._ 

* * *

## Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (Classroom MFA) for students

If your school organization requires Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (Classroom MFA) for students, they will need to activate it to log in to Clever. You can view which students haven’t activated their MFA by navigating to your **Clever Portal > My Students > Student Roster.** If the student hasn’t activated their Classroom MFA, it'll be indicated by their name in the student roster.

![Screenshot of the My Students page showing students who haven’t activated their MFA.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZGYCt)

You can find instructions for students to set up their Classroom MFA here: [For Students: Setting up Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001618). 

If one of your students has lost their Classroom MFA Badge, you can void it and create a new one for them in your Student Roster by selecting a student and reviewing your options in the MFA column of the right sidebar.

![Screenshot of how to void and create an MFA Badge.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044guP)

Voiding and creating a new Badge will allow you to download the new Badge to your device, which you can print out for the student. The next time the student logs in, Clever will prompt them to follow a login flow to validate the Badge.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cPi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Uw) Be sure to visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360041755311) to learn about Teacher Analytics which provides specific details about students logging in to Clever, and accessing their connected applications!

title: Clever Portal: Teacher Pages
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#overview)  
2\. [Creating a new Teacher Page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#creating_a_new_teacher_page)  
3. [Adding & managing resources o](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#h_d47d23ae-1c94-48e4-a007-621527b0d20b)[n my Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#h_d47d23ae-1c94-48e4-a007-621527b0d20b)  
4\. [Organizing my Teacher Page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#organizing_teacher_pages)  
5. [Sharing with students and the student experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#sharing_with_students_and_the_student_experience)  
6. [Sharing resources with other teachers and viewing shared resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#sharing_your_teacher_page_and_viewing_shared_pages)  
7. [Deleting a Teacher Page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#deleting_teacher_pages)  
8\. [Transitioning to a new school year](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#newschoolyear)    
9\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#troubleshooting)    
10. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#FAQ)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Getting started with Teacher Pages? Check out our [Product Spotlight: Building culture in your classroom with Teacher Pages](https://clever.academy/product-spotlight-building-culture-in-your-classroom-with-teacher-pages?user_type=teacher) , available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

Teachers can create personalized Teacher Pages to house a variety of learning resources they want their students to access. Some examples include:

-   District-wide applications 
-   Various [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672) applications 
-   Links to online tools (e.g., Schooltube, Wikipedia.org, Dictionary.com)
-   PDFs for vocab lists, booklets, permission slips, etc.
-   Homework or assignments in Google Drive, Office Online, or Google Classroom
-   Community websites (e.g., local public library)

  
Before we talk about building Teacher Pages, let's talk about the Pages tab. From your Clever Portal > Pages, you'll see three options: 

-   **My Teacher Pages**, which house:
    -   Your Teacher Pages! All teachers start with two Teacher Pages:
        -   One that is private and not visible to students, which can house various resources that are not student-facing.
        -   One that is scoped to students. Page visibility can be modified to include students in just one class, multiple classes, all students, and so on! You can make more pages (more on that below).
    -   Any [resources you’ve favorited](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025873072) by hovering on the icon and clicking the heart.
    -   All resources you’ve added to Clever via your Teacher Pages (such as Clever Library apps, links, and PDFs).
-   **District Page**, which houses any apps, programs, and links your district has shared with you.
-   **Shared with Me Pages**, which houses any Teacher Pages that other teachers at your school have shared with you.

* * *

##   
Creating a new Teacher Page

-   In the Clever Portal, click the **Pages** tab from the left-hand side menu and select **My Teacher Pages** from the drop-down
-   Click **Add** in the top right-hand corner

![Add button to create a new Teacher Page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000057gqr)

-   Edit the page title, add a description, add class resources, and personalize your icon.

![Teacher Page set up](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000057hi5)

-   Design your Teacher Page by adding your desired [resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#h_d47d23ae-1c94-48e4-a007-621527b0d20b), [categories](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#h_a7b41463-341c-4e5c-b17b-6beba3ae8118), and content.
-   Once you're ready to publish your page to make it visible to students, click **More page actions** **\> Share** at the top of your page, then select the classe(s) you’d like to share the page with.
    
    ![Share my Teacher Page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009Zhsw)
    
-   Click **Update**.

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**Teacher Login Tools will become available to teachers once they have shared their Teacher Page with students. Visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005941566) for more!

* * *

##   
Adding & managing resources to my Teacher Pages 

There are a variety of different resources that can be added to your Teacher Page!

### **Adding resources** 

You can add four types of resources to your Teacher Page(s):

1.  Clever Library applications
2.  District-added applications
3.  Links to websites
4.  Uploaded PDFs

  
**Library resources:**

Clever Library is where teachers can find and adopt new classroom resources. If your district has enabled Clever Library, follow [these instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672) to add Library apps to your Teacher Page.

![Clever Library](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y4S1)   
 

**District-provisioned applications:** 

Apps your district has added to your Clever Portal say “District” below the app. Adding these to your Teacher Page can make them easier for you and your students to find and access. To add a district app to your Teacher Page:

1.  Click **Add** at the top-right of your Teacher Page.
2.  Click **App**
3.  A menu will display where you can search for the application and select it. Please note: If you can’t find a district-provisioned application, please contact your Clever district admin to request that they share it with you.
4.  Click **Add <app name>** to add it to your Teacher Page.

![District app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y4bh)

If you notice an app on your Teacher Page has turned gray, this means that your district has removed your access to the app. To remove the app icon from your Teacher Page, click **⋮** _(The three vertical dots)_ **\>**  **Remove.**

![Gray app icons on a teacher page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RgC3)

    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000X5EH3)    Please note:** If you don't see the ability to add links or PDFs to your Teacher Page, your Clever administrator may have disabled this setting. Please reach out to your IT team or administrators directly for assistance.

  
**Links:**

You can add links to any website you want students to access. Links are a great way to provide easy access to websites, videos, Google docs, and more! To add a link:

1.  Click **Add** in the top right-hand corner of your Teacher Page and click **Link**.
2.  A menu will display allowing you to **paste the URL** for the page this link should direct to, which should always begin with HTTPS://
3.  Enter a **Title** to help your students locate the link.
4.  Choose a **[category](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323?language=en_US#h_a7b41463-341c-4e5c-b17b-6beba3ae8118)** for your link.
5.  Select one of the provided icons to represent your link, or upload your own icon!
6.  To upload your own icon, click **Upload** to search for the appropriate image from your desktop. Images must be in the .png file format and less than 2 megabytes. 
7.  Click **Add link**

![Add link](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y4lN)

  
When you add a link, the icon will have a little link icon in the top right corner, so you'll know it's a link. This little identifier on the icon isn't visible to students.

![Google Classroom icon with a link icon in the top right corner](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000057caM)

  
**PDFs**

If you have a PDF file, you can add that to your Teacher Page. Simply:

1.  Click **Add** in the top right-hand coner of your Teacher Page
2.  Click **PDF**.
3.  Select the file to be uploaded from your device. The max file size is 10 megabytes.
4.  Enter the **File name** to display to students.
5.  Select the **Category** where you want the file displayed on your Teacher Page.
6.  Select the desired **Icon** or upload your own.
7.  Once the file has been successfully uploaded to Clever (Cloud is Green), click **Add PDF**
8.  The file is now accessible to students on your Teacher Page!  
      
    ![Add PDF](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y4wf)  

  
The icon will have a red PDF icon in the top right corner so you’ll know it's a PDF. This little identifier on the icon isn’t visible to students.  
  
![PDF resource](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000057iJB) 

Need help downloading your resource as a PDF to upload to Clever? Directions for popular programs can be found below: 

-   **Google Docs**  
    File > Download > PDF Document (.pdf)
-   **Google Slides**  
    File > Download > PDF Document (.pdf)
-   **Microsoft Word**  
    File > Save as > File Format: PDF > Export
-   **Microsoft PowerPoint**  
    File > Save as > File Format: PDF > Save

   
  
When the student clicks on the file from your Teacher Page, the PDF will open in their web browser (e.g., Google Chrome). They can download or print the PDF using the tools in the top-right corner: 

  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Sv)

* * *

##   
Organizing Teacher Pages

To keep your Teacher Page neat and easy for students to navigate, you can organize resources into different categories. Categories provide a way to separate your resources by unit, topic, etc. Please note:

-   Create new categories by clicking the **Add** button in the top right of your Teacher Page and then selecting **Category**.
-   Categories can be reordered or deleted by using the arrow and trash icons next to the category name.  
    Resources can be reorganized by dragging and dropping them into the appropriate categories.
-   If you have a category that you don’t want students to see just yet (such as your next unit of study that’s starting in a few weeks), you can hide the category by clicking the eye icon in the top right of the category!
-   When you’re ready for the category to be visible, click on the eye icon again. If a student is already on your page when you hide/unhide a category, they’ll need to refresh the page to see the change.

![Teacher Page with categories and controls highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000057c0s)    
 

**Modifying links and resources**

_Deleting content_  
Links and resources can be deleted from Teacher Pages by following these instructions:

1.  From your Teacher Page, hover over the resource or link you'd like to remove and click the _three vertical dots (⋮)_. 
2.  In the menu that opens, click **Remove**

_Copying content to another page_  
You can also copy any link or resource to another Teacher Page that you've created:

1.  From your Teacher Page, hover over the resource or link you'd like to remove and click the _three vertical dots (⋮)_. 
2.  In the menu that opens, click **Edit** and choose the page to which you want to add the resource at the bottom of the pop-up.

![Add resource to another page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y5az)

* * *

##   
Sharing with students and the student experience

Once you've created a Teacher Page, be sure to preview what it looks like for students by clicking **More page actions > Preview Page** at the top of your Teacher Page. 

![Preview Teacher Page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009Zs6n)

After confirming it looks great, you can share it with students by following these steps:

-   Click **Share** at the top of your Teacher Page, and select the appropriate student access. 
-   Click **Save**.

You can remove student access anytime by returning to the **Share** button.   
  
When students log into Clever, they’ll see an icon in their Portal for each Teacher Page that has been shared with them:

![Student Clever Portal with Teacher Pages section at the top](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Rg9j)

  
When students click on your Teacher Page icon, they’ll be directed to your page and can access all associated resources.

![Student view of Mr. Emard's ELA All-Stars teacher page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RgD6)

    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000X5Ec1)    Please note:** For security reasons, Clever admins can disable Teacher Pages for students for up to 90 days. You will see a notification in the Teacher Pages area of your Portal stating the dates for which pages are disabled. Students will see a note that their Teacher Pages will be right back! You'll still be able to access and edit your page, but students won't be able to see it during this timeframe.

* * *

##   
Sharing resources with other teachers and viewing shared resources

You can share your Teacher Pages and individual resources with teachers in your school and view others’ resources when they share them with you. [Learn more here!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001523)  
 

* * *

##   
Deleting Teacher Pages

Clever requires at least one Teacher Page per teacher account. If you determine you don’t want students to access a page, you can modify the student sharing, so the page is only visible to you.  
  
If you have multiple Teacher Pages and would like to delete one of them, navigate to your **My Teachers Pages** tab, then click **Delete**.  
  
Please know that **there is no way to undo deleting a Page**. If you have a page you might want to use in the future, we recommend unsharing it with students and keeping it for future use.  
 

![Delete page button outlined in red](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000057SpX)

* * *

##   
Transitioning to a new school year 

Great news: Teacher Pages are preserved across academic years! You don't need to recreate Teacher Pages for your students.  
  
When your school transitions to a new school year in Clever, our system automatically updates any Teacher Pages shared with specific sections to Just me sharing. This excludes pages set to **Only You** or **All students you teach** as the sharing setting.  
  
This update ensures that Teacher Pages are consciously shared with your students. As such, students won't see a section-specific Teacher Page until you decide to share it with them.  
  
As a teacher, you’ll see an **Attention Needed** message for any Teacher Page that’s affected. When you click on the Teacher Page, you’ll be guided through re-sharing it with students for the new academic year.

    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aWe5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000X5EiT)    Please note:** To prevent schedule exposure during school year rollovers, Clever admins may disable Teacher Pages for students for up to 90 days. You will see a notification in the Teacher Pages area of your Portal stating the dates for which pages are disabled. Students will see a note that their Teacher Pages will be right back! You'll still be able to access and edit your page, but students won't be able to see it during this timeframe.

* * *

## Troubleshooting

**New School Year**  
If your students can't see your Teacher Page, you may need to **reshare** the page at the start of the new school year. See: [Transitioning to a new school year](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323#newschoolyear)

**New Teacher\_ID (SIS\_ID)**  
If you can't see your Teacher Pages, please check with your school to see if your teacher ID has changed. If it has, you won't be able to access your previous Teacher Pages. If your district _can_ revert your teacher ID to its previous value, your Teacher Pages will be restored. If your district _cannot_ revert your teacher ID to its previous value, Clever cannot restore the Teacher Pages. If you are unsure why a user's teacher\_id has changed, please contact your SIS provider. Clever is unable to troubleshoot why a teacher\_id value may have changed in the data being synced to Clever.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Can Teacher Pages be shared with individual students or custom groups of students?**

-   Teacher Pages cannot be shared with individual students/select groups of students. You can only share Teacher Pages with whole classes or all students you teach.
    

**Can I copy resources from one Teacher Page to another?**

-   Yes, once a resource is added to a Teacher Page, you can add it to another Teacher Page by clicking the 3 dots (⋮) in the corner of the resource > Edit, and then select the page you want to add the resource to under Add to another page at the bottom.

**Can I duplicate my Teacher Page?**

-   No, Teacher Pages cannot be duplicated.

**When creating a resource, can I select multiple Teacher Pages to add it to?**

-   No, but you can add it to other Teacher Pages after the resource has been created. Once created, click the 3 dots (⋮) in the corner of the resource > Edit, and then select the page you want to add the resource to under Add to another page at the bottom.

**Why am I unable to add PDFs or links to my Teacher Page?**

-   For security reasons, Clever admins can turn off the option for teachers to add links and PDFs to their Teacher Pages. If you are unable to add PDFs or links, please contact your IT team or administrator.

**Why are my links and PDFs missing from my Teacher Page?**

-   For security reasons, Clever admins can turn off the option for teachers to add links and PDFs to their Teacher Pages. If you are unable to add PDFs or links, please contact your IT team or administrator.

**Why do I see a notification that my Teacher Pages are disabled?**

-   Clever admins can disable Teacher Pages for up to 90 days. You'll still be able to access and edit your page, but students won't be able to see it during this timeframe.

**How many Teacher Pages do I need to create?**

-   Whatever works best for you and your students! If you have multiple classes you teach, it can be helpful to have a Teacher Page for each class you teach. However, if that's too much to manage, you can have one Teacher Page and organize it by class using categories. 

**Can I transfer my Teacher Page to my new school district?**

-   No, at this time you aren't able to transfer your existing Teacher Page to a new school district.

title: For Teachers: Getting help and contacting support
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673671#header1)  
2\. [Contact the school or district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673671#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
3\. [Contact the application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673671#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)  
4\. [Contact Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046673671#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)

## Overview

This article provides guidance on who to contact for support with Clever-related issues as a teacher.  Teachers will learn when to reach out to the school's tech support, contact the application's support team directly, or reach out to Clever Support.

* * *

## Contact the school or school organization

Here are common examples of when your school's support contact will be best equipped to provide support:

-   You or your student is unable to log in to Clever
-   An application is missing from the Clever Portal or the icon needs to be updated
-   Students or sections are missing from Clever or an application
-   Data is missing or incorrect in Clever or an application
-   Adding a co-teacher to a class
-   Changing your user type in Clever

You can find your school organization's tech support contact information by clicking Get help at the bottom of your district's Clever login screen. From here, click the District contact. You should see a box appear with an email address or phone number for the support contact. 

​![Clever login screen with highlight around Get help](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOKpe)

![Two panel login screen with highlight District contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOL8z)

![District contact information](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hORHd)

* * *

## Contact the application

Here are common examples of when an application’s team will be best equipped to provide support:

-   You or your students click on an application in the Clever Portal and receives an error on the application's page or URL
-   You are receiving an error message on the application’s website
-   You are seeing incorrect data within the application, but correct data within the Clever Portal
-   You are having trouble accessing grades, homework, textbooks, resources, or running reports within the application
-   Your sections have access to the incorrect content within the application
-   You have questions about features within the application
-   The application does not save a student’s progress
-   The application is frozen or logs you or your students out

We recommend reaching out to the application's support team directly. Their contact information can usually be found by searching the app's name and "support contact" in Google.

* * *

## Contact Clever

For all other questions, Clever Support can be reached by clicking the chat icon on the bottom right of this page. Describe your issue, and tell us if the resource provided fixes your issue. If you click no, you'll have the opportunity to submit a support ticket. Our team is available Monday - Friday 7am - 8pm ET.

title: For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Shared devices
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header1)  
2\. [Ho](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header2)[w should students log out of Clever and connected apps?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header2)  
3\. [How do students log out of the Clever Portal on any device?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header3)  
4\. [How do I log out of Clever and applications while using an iPad?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header4)  
5\. [What is the shared devices notification?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header5)  
6\. [What about time-out and inactivity?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040646931#header6)

## Overview

This article explains how students should properly log out of Clever and connected applications, as well as best practices for shared devices. You'll also find details on shared device settings and automatic logout rules, including inactivity timeouts and browser behavior.

* * *

## How should students log out of Clever and connected apps?

When logging out, it's important to remember that Clever single sign-on (SSO) can be broken down into three separate login processes behind the scenes:

1.  Identity provider login (e.g., Google or Active Directory)
2.  Clever Portal login
3.  Application login (e.g., Khan Academy)

If a student is accessing a shared device, Clever recommends that they log out of each application and device after their session. Students should log out of the application, the Clever Portal, and the identity provider (Google, ADFS, etc.).

* * *

## How do students log out of the Clever Portal on any device?

Users can log out of the Clever Portal by navigating to the top right corner of their Portal (where they can find their name), and clicking **Log out.**

 **![Student Portal with log out button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIjt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cgub0)**

* * *

## How do I log out of Clever and applications while using an iPad?

On the iPad, double-click the home button (on newer iPad Pros, swipe up from the bottom of the display) to expose the application thumbnails. Swipe up on the Clever app and any learning apps that were launched. This will end a student's session when the device is shared.

Alternatively, students can log out of their Clever Portal and each application individually. To log out of the Clever Portal, navigate to the top right corner of their Portal (where they can find their name), and click **Log out.** Each learning application will have its own logout process.

 **![Student Portal with log out button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIjt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cgub0)**

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Your school organization may have custom settings applied to the Clever application that cause users to be logged out of the Clever app any time they launch a resource that brings them away from the Clever Portal. If you have questions about this logout behavior, please contact your admin or IT team directly.

* * *

## What is the "shared devices notification"?

On certain devices, upon initial sign-in to Clever, students will be asked whether or not they should be remembered on the device. If they select **No, only I use it;** their Clever session will remain intact for **2 hours.**   
 

![Screenshot of "Do you share this computer?" prompt](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIjt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BTEM)

If the user selects **Yes**, Clever will treat the device as a shared device. In this case, users will be prompted to sign in as a different user **after 10 minutes of inactivity** on the Clever Portal.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** this feature gives users who share devices the option to log into another account, in case the best logout practices were not followed 

* * *

## What about time-out and inactivity?

Users are logged out of Clever automatically if: 

-   If a user is inactive in Clever for 24 hours, they will automatically be logged out. Currently, there is no way to customize this behavior.  
     
-   The browser is _quit (e.g., "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._  
    Closing the browser window will not log the user out of Clever.

title: For Teachers: Troubleshooting - iOS (e.g. iPads and iPhones)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040332591#Overview)
