2\. [Basic Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040332591#Basic%20Troubleshooting)  
3\. [Advanced Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040332591#Advanced%20Troubleshooting)

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Please note:** The Clever iOS app requires iOS 16.6+. If you are using a device with an earlier iOS, you can still access Clever via the web browser.

##   
Overview

If your student is having issues with their iOS device and Clever, here are some recommended troubleshooting steps you can try to help. 

* * *

## Basic Troubleshooting

-   Before you begin, please make sure your device is using iOS version 9.0 or above.
-   Turn the device off and on again, then try again.
-   Uninstall, then re-install the Clever app, then try again.
-   Attempt logging in via [https://clever.com/badges](https://clever.com/badges) in the Safari app.
-   Attempt using the Clever app outside of your school network (such as on a home network or mobile hotspot).
-   Ensure that the iOS device has internet connectivity by navigating to any webpage in the Safari app.
-   Ensure that “Private Mode” is not enabled for Safari on the iOS device.
-   Ensure cookies are enabled for Safari.  This includes the device-wide setting, as well as for the Clever domain (clever.com). **Settings > Safari Block All Cookies**. Make sure Block All Cookies is toggled off -- you will know it is off when the slider turns grey.
-   Ensure Javascript is enabled for Safari. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Safari > Javascript**.
-   Ensure camera access is enabled for Safari. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Safari > Camera**.

* * *

## Advanced Troubleshooting

-   Ensure that on the device, the iOS network deny list is not enabled. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > General > Restrictions > Websites**.
-   Ensure that requests to Clever servers are not blocked or filtered by a firewall or network filtering software. See our Help Center article: [Which Clever's domains should my network grant access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203256516)?
-   If using Safari, please ensure that the setting for **Request Desktop Website** is disabled. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Safari > Request Desktop Website**.
-   In iOS 14 and later, users have the ability to choose a default browser other than Safari. Please ensure that Safari is the default browser for any device that will be used with the Clever app. You can adjust this by navigating to **Settings > Browser > Safari**.
-   Ensure that no other software affects the way that Safari operates.

  
If the issue still persists, feel free to open a ticket with Clever Support!

title: For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Data (e.g. rosters, classes, and school association)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025400111#header1)  
2\. [Data is incorrect in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025400111#inclever)  
3\. [Data is incorrect in an application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025400111#inapp)

## Overview

This article covers how to address data that's incorrect in Clever or a learning application you use.

* * *

## Data is incorrect in Clever

Your school organization's data is synced to Clever from your school's Student Information System (SIS). If you are noticing incorrect information in Clever, **please contact your school's tech support contact.** 

Here are examples of incorrect data you might see in Clever that your School Organization Administrator can help with:

-   Missing / incorrect students on your roster
-   Incorrect, duplicate, or missing classes in Clever
-   Wrong school association
-   Adding a co-teacher to your class
-   Incorrect information for yourself or a student (a misspelled name, email, grade level, etc.)
-   Updating a Clever username for yourself or a student 
-   Duplicate accounts

  
![Screenshot of login screen showing where to get help logging into Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ6L&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002xxyz)  

### **Editing Data in Clever**

Records cannot be edited or manually created in Clever by teachers. We cannot assist with updating rosters, editing names, or adding classes. Please contact your school organization's tech support contact for assistance with these requests.   
  
 

* * *

##   
Data is incorrect in an application

Application partners manage syncing data from Clever and implementing it in their system. If you notice that information is incorrect in an application but is correct in Clever. **Please contact the application's support team directly.** 

We recommend providing the following information: 

-   School organization name + state
-   School name
-   Teacher email address
-   Description of problem

_Example:_ 

-   _Clark County School School Organization, NV_
-   _Boulder City High School_
-   _[sample@nv.ccsd.net](mailto:sample@nv.ccsd.net)_
-   _Missing class roster - Algebra I, 6th period_

Please note, most applications sync data from Clever on a daily basis. If the missing or incorrect data was recently changed in your SIS, please allow at least 48 hrs for the data to be updated in applications.

title: For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Apps
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#overview)  
2\. [Troubleshoot app login tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#login_tool)  
3\. [App is missing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#app_missing)  
4\. [Clicked on app, received an error](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#app_error)  
5\. [Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#saved_passwords)  
6\. [Data incorrect in apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#data_incorrect)  
7\. [Problems within apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360027035111#app_specific_error)

## Overview

Occasionally, you or your students will have issues with your applications (i.e. apps) in Clever. Here are some steps you can take if you or your students are having trouble logging in to applications from the Clever Portal.

​​

* * *

## Troubleshoot app login tool

The Troubleshoot App Login tool helps you quickly solve student app issues. Use it to:

-   Find out why a student can’t see or log into an app
    
-   Report a login issue to your Clever Admin
    
-   Set student credentials for SSO Saved Passwords apps
    
-   Connect with Clever Support if the issue needs more investigation
    

![Teacher portal highlighting where to troubleshoot app logins.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Rxodx)

* * *

## App is missing

If you or your student is missing a school organization-provided application, **please reach out to your school organization's admin support** using the Troubleshoot app login tool. Your school organization's Clever Admin manages which applications teachers and students have access to in the Clever Portal. 

To reach out to your administrator: 

1.  Navigate to My Students > Student Roster > select the student who is missing an app.
    
2.  Click **Troubleshoot app login**
    

![Teacher portal highlighting where to troubleshoot app logins.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxLvM)

3.  Click the dropdown to select the app that is missing.
    

![Screenshot of using the search bar when Troubleshooting app login.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxhxR)

4.  Provide additional details for your admin.
    

![Screenshot displaying space to provide additional details to admin.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxZJy)

5.  Click **Send email to school organization admin**.  
      
    

![Arrow highlighting Send to district admin button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxcWM)

   
​​

* * *

## Clicked on app, received an error

If you or your students click on an application in the Clever Portal and receive an error, **please reach out to the application's support team for help**.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028AOs)**Clever Tip:** If you are seeing an error at a web URL that is **not** a Clever address, it's likely that the application's team is best equipped to help fix the issue. Please reach out to the application's support team to investigate further!

Here are examples of common errors you might see for specific applications:

![Screenshot highlighting the url of an error.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000gfMv)

![Screenshot highlighting the url of an error.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000gaYa)

  
 ​​​

* * *

## Clicked on app, Clever asked for a username and password

If a Clever page asks you or your student to enter their username and password for an application, enter the correct login information for that application, and click **Save**. If the device has the [Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511) downloaded, Clever will save this information and automatically log the student in the next time they click the icon from the Portal!

![Screenshot of an app login screen.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004EEwr)

If your student clicks on an application and sees the page below, this means we were not able to log your student in with the username and password they provided. Please have them enter their updated username and password for the application, and click **Update & Log in**.

![Screenshot of an app login screen highlighting Update and Log in.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004EF3J)

You can also support your student by entering their credentials for them. To manually enter credentials for a student:

1.  Navigate to My Students > Student Roster > select the student missing an app.
2.  Click **Troubleshoot app login**

![Screenshot highlighting troubleshoot app login.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxLvM)

3.  Click the dropdown to select the app that is missing.

![Screenshot highlighting dropdown selection of apps](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxSdS)

4.  Confirm if the student can see the application from their Clever Portal. You'll need to contact an Admin for help if they can't.

![Screenshot of troubleshooting app login.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Rxibl)

5.  Click **Update credentials**.

![Screenshot of troubleshooting app login highlighting update credentials.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Rxizx)

6.  Enter the correct username and password. Click **Set credentials**.

![Screenshot of troubleshooting app login credentials.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQ37&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000RxO0M)

If you are still having trouble, please confirm that the username and password entered is correct to log into their account directly on the application's page (i.e. at duolingo.com). If you can successfully access the app directly through their website, but not through Clever, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for help!

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Did you know?** Applications that prompt users to manually enter credentials as shown above are called **SSO (Saved Passwords)** applications. Learn more about these applications in this Help Center article: [For Teachers: What are Saved Passwords applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026789592)   

​​

* * *

##   
Data incorrect in apps

If the data in an application is incorrect (e.g. rosters, students, and school associations), [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025400111). 

​​

* * *

## Problems within applications

After you click on an application from the Clever Portal, your experience within their product is controlled from the application’s end.  If you are running into an issue within the application, **please contact the application’s support team for help.** 

Here are common examples of when an application’s team will be best equipped to provide support:

-   You are receiving an error message on the application’s website
-   You are seeing incorrect data within the application, but correct data within the Clever Portal
-   You are having trouble accessing grades, homework, textbooks, resources, or running reports within the application
-   Your sections have access to the incorrect content within the application
-   You have questions about features within the application
-   The application does not save a student’s progress
-   The application is frozen or logs you or your students out
-   You need to merge or match old account

title: For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#overview)  
2. [Backup Login Codes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#backup)  
3. [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#clever)[Problem logging into Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#problems-clever)  
4. [Problem logging into an app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#app)  
5. [Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#badges)  
6. [Reset a student's password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#reset-password)  
7. [Logging out](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#logging_out)  
8. [How do I get help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#help)

## Overview

First, please ensure the student is using a Clever-compatible device. [Clever's system requirements can be found here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387?language=en_US#devices).

If your student is using a compatible device or browser and is receiving an error when attempting to log in to Clever, please ensure they are listed in your roster by navigating to **My Students** > **Student Roster** in your Clever Portal. This is to confirm the student has an active record in Clever. If the student is missing, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025400111).  
 

![Student Roster](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044gcg)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Looking for additional support on quickly getting up to speed on Clever? Check out our [Clever Academy Quick Start videos](https://go.clever.com/l/569832/2020-04-02/ktxxd)

* * *

##   
Backup Login Codes

Backup codes are temporary codes that allow students to log in to Clever when their login credentials are not working. These codes can be generated multiple times per day by various teachers, ensuring the student can log in continually until the primary login issue is resolved. **Backup codes expire after 15 minutes**, therefore the student does need to log in before the expiration time, or another backup code will need to be generated.

##   

###   **To generate a backup code:**

1.  From your Clever Portal, click the **My Students** drop-down on the left-hand side and select **Student Roster**   
2.  Select the class the student is in from the **Filter by class** drop-down
3.  Locate the student record from the list and click Get backup login code on the right-hand side

![Backup login code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044h0r)

4.  A seven-digit backup code will be provided. Write this code down and pass it along securely to your student. **The code will expire in 15 minutes****.**

![Backup login code for student](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044h2T) 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Want a downloadable PDF for backup login code instructions? Find it in the work aid section [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001622?language=en_US#Workaids).

### **How does a student log in using a Backup Code?**

1.  The student will go to your school organization's Clever Portal login page and select **Get help**.
2.  They will then select **Use Backup Code**  
                  ![get help backup code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iR5dO)  ![use your backup code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iQw5S)
3.  They will enter the backup code, and select **Log in.**  

          ![type backup code](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iQu6s)  
  
 

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For more information on **login errors**, please see [For Teachers: How do I troubleshoot logging into the Clever Portal?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112)

* * *

##   
Problem logging into Clever

Login errors can occur for several reasons. The most common issues are:

-   The student inputs the incorrect login credentials
-   The [student doesn't have an account in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025400111)
-   There is an issue with the school organization's login setup

![third party icons](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CKAr)

If a student is having difficulty logging in with their credentials, in the short term, you can log your student in using a Clever [backup code](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#h_3bc3e162-9643-4522-91ea-5b7963ce3487). However, for third-party accounts (Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google, your school may have enabled it so that you can reset the student's password. Please learn more here: [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612).

![clever icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Q1)

If your student receives a login error and your school organization's login method is Clever Passwords (i.e. 'Log in with Clever'), please ensure the student is using the correct credentials. If you have confirmed they are using the correct credentials but the login is still unsuccessful, you may be able to [reset their password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#h_f4895d2a-a170-442a-81f9-6cd04254e0c9) if your school organization has enabled teachers to do so. 

If you do not have the ability to reset the student's password, please have them log in to Clever using a [backup code](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222933888#h_3bc3e162-9643-4522-91ea-5b7963ce3487), and contact your school organization's technology support contact directly for assistance with the login issue.  
 

* * *

##   
Problem logging into an app

If a student is encountering an error when trying to access an application, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027035111).

* * *

##   
Clever Badges

Badges allow students to hold up a physical badge to their device's webcam to get logged in, instead of typing in login credentials. Teachers get more time to teach and students get more time to learn! Please note, that Badges must be enabled by your school organization before they can be used.

For information and instructions, please visit:

-   [For Teachers: What are Clever Badges?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236004408)
-   [For Teachers: How do I print Clever Badges?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000127406)  

* * *

##   
Reset a student's password

If your school organization's students see an option that says _Password_ (Clever Passwords) or a third-party account such as Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google on their Clever login screen, like the screenshot below, you may be able to reset your student’s password.

![Image of a login screen showing Google, Active Directory, and Password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iQ6QF)

  
   
You can only reset students' passwords if your **school organization has enabled it for teachers.**  To learn more about resetting passwords, check out this article: [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612).  
 

* * *

##   
Logging out

To log out of Clever, navigate to the Clever Portal, hover over your name in the top-right corner, and click **Log out**.

![log out of portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Qf)   
 

Users are also logged out of Clever automatically after: 

-   24 hours of inactivity 
-   The browser is _quit (e.g. "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._  
    Closing the browser window won't log the user out of Clever. 

* * *

##   
   
How do I get help?

Login credentials for Clever are managed by the school organization. If you are unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please reach out to your school organization's support contact or the school organization's help desk for assistance. 

You can find your school organization's technology support contact information on the Clever login screen. In most cases, school organizations provide an email address, phone number, or instructions guiding users to the appropriate contact person or department for assistance.

![get login help](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iQdlz)    ![district contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iRHt3)   

 ![example of a district contact's email](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIS9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iRIIr)

text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_8aebfea6-738c-4c58-a1d5-249a84ccea70) 2\. [Problem logging into Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_7e83abf2-8c13-4414-8390-e5574ff69887)      _•_  [Log in with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#loginwithclever)      _•_  Log in with Google      _•_  Log in with Active Directory      _•_  [Log in with Canvas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#canvas)     _•_  [Log in with LDAP](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#ldap) 3\. [Problem logging into an app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_01EDENABCENC56XEVA3T46949Q) 4\. [Logging out](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_01EDVSB20CBMCDMN9TBZR8NJNQ) 5\. [How do I get help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) # Overview This article outlines the various login issues or error messages that you may encounter when attempting to log in to Clever. Please note that not all error messages are included in this article. Please double-check that you're typing in the correct login credentials and that you have an account in Clever.    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000aRC1y)    Please note:** If you're encountering an error from an application when attempting to access it via Clever, please contact the application's support team. Clever support cannot assist with troubleshooting application-side login errors. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027035111). If your login issues persist after reviewing this article, please contact your [tech support contact directly](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112?language=en_US#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) for assistance. You can find their contact information by selecting the **Get help logging in!** option from your school organization's login page.![Contact tech support contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Ot)  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Nl) For instructions on how to help your students log in to Clever, please visit [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888) # Problems logging in to Clever ## Log in with Clever ![login with Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BFTW) If you see **I****nvalid username or password** the credentials you entered don’t match your Clever account. ![invalid username and password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Nq)       Select **Get help logging in!** to reset your password using the email linked to your Clever account. Some school organizations don’t allow self-service password resets. If you don’t see the reset option or it doesn’t resolve the issue, contact your school’s tech support. ## Log in with Google ![login with Google](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BFTb)  Enter your **school-provided email address**, not a personal @gmail.com account. Use the password associated with your school email. Below are possible errors you may encounter when logging in and steps to resolve:

Error

Details and next steps

Couldn't find your Google account

This is a Google error. Please confirm you're using your school-provided email, not your personal email. If you still receive the error, please reach out to your school support contact to determine your correct email.

Wrong password. Try again or click Forgot password to reset it.

 This is a Google error. You’ve entered an incorrect password for their school-provided Google email address. Please enter the correct password for their account or reset it if you’re able. If you can’t reset your password, please reach out to your school support contact for help.
 We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email xxxx@gmail.com. Try again with your school issued email address.  This is a Clever-related error. This error means that the email address you entered isn’t the same one linked to your Clever account. Please make sure you are using your school-provided email address. If you believe you’re using the correct email address, please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. The Clever team cannot provide login credentials. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.
We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the email xxxx@example.comThis is a Clever-related error. This error means that the email address you’re attempting to log in with is duplicated in Clever. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team. The Clever team cannot edit email addresses or provide login credentials.
We couldn’t log you in.This is a Clever-related error. You may receive this error with additional details or by itself. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for further assistance in troubleshooting. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.
**For any other login error that states _We couldn’t log you in_ please contact your school’s IT team directly for assistance.** Provide them all of the descriptive information in the error, the Reference ID, and any suggested Admin troubleshooting steps. The Clever team cannot provide your login credentials or edit your email address in Clever. ## Log in with Active Directory  ![login with Active Directory](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BFTg) When selecting this option, you should be redirected to your school's login page. Below are possible login errors you may encounter and steps for troubleshooting:

Error

Details and next steps

We couldn’t log you in. We can’t find a Clever account for the email address or username.

 

This error means the email address or username you entered isn’t in the school organization's Clever account. Please make sure you are using your school-provided email or username. If you’re using the correct email or username, please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. The Clever team cannot provide login credentials. Provide the error and the copyable Reference ID to your school’s team.

We couldn’t log you in. Multiple accounts are linked to the student’s email or username.

 

This error means that the email address or username you’re attempting to log in with is duplicated in Clever. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for help troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team. The Clever team cannot edit email addresses or provide login credentials.
 We couldn’t log you in.You may receive this error with additional details or by itself. Please contact your school’s IT team directly for further assistance in troubleshooting. Provide the error and the Reference ID to your school’s team.
If you have issues logging in to Active Directory, please contact your [school’s tech support directly](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) as Clever doesn’t have access to login credentials. ## Log in with Canvas ![login with Canvas](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287OF) If you see the error message **We couldn't log you in, we can't find a Clever account for the email or username**, this means that Clever is unable to locate an account based on the credentials you provided.  For any other login error that states **We couldn’t log you in** please contact your school’s IT team directly for assistance. Provide them all of the descriptive information in the error, the Reference ID, and any suggested Admin troubleshooting steps. The Clever team cannot provide your login credentials or edit your email address in Clever. ## Log in with LDAP ![login with LADP](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287OP) If you encounter an LDAP login error after entering your login credentials, please contact your [school support contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039685112?language=en_US#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) as Clever doesn't have access to login credentials. ## Problem logging into an app If you are having an error when trying to access an application, please take a look at [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027035111).   ## Logging out To log out of Clever, navigate to the Clever Portal, click the **person icon** in the top-right corner, and click **Log out**. ![Log out](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004EHoH) Users are also logged out of Clever automatically after:  - 24 hours of inactivity  - The browser is _quit (e.g. "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._ Closing the browser window will not log the user out of Clever.  ![quit Google Chrome](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Oe)  ## How do I get help? Login credentials for Clever are managed by your school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please reach out to your tech support contact or your school's IT help desk for assistance.  You can find your tech support contact information on the Clever login screen. In most cases, school organizations provide an email address, phone number, or instructions guiding users to the appropriate contact person or department for assistance. ![contact help desk](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cIOv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000287Oj) If you have any questions or need further assistance, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help!

title: For Teachers: Getting Started with Khan Academy in the Clever Library
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_bae39fa1-3d09-4cde-9904-b200deb0d12a)  
2\. [Teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#teachers)  
           •  [Getting Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_8971a062-8413-4e91-8fa5-9c4e0bc437cf)  
           •  [Creating a New Account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_cea1dad4-e54a-4305-869a-d85cfeb39ab1)  
           •  [Logging into an Existing Account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_83ebc9c6-774e-46ba-8ab9-09f7f40b3949)  
           •  [Student Registration After Class Creation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_22c4450c-c23b-4906-9814-1b875d4c3a86)  
           •  [Tips and Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_b2c24b99-5570-48b2-a393-d6abac077055)  
[3\. Students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#students)  
           ​​​​​​​•  [Getting Started](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_ce88753c-3120-4e92-abe7-05bd41e0815d)  
           ​​​​​​​•  [Creating a New Account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_7026060b-7a2e-4dba-aad7-e9bae91fb656)  
           ​​​​​​​•  [Logging into an Existing Account (13 years and older)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044223131#h_d00c3c52-393b-4bd8-a0ba-5a82dcdc76e1)

## Overview

Khan Academy can now be found in the [Clever Library](https://clever.com/library) for free! The Clever Library is a place for teachers to discover, learn about, and adopt new resources for their classrooms.  
  
Teachers that have access to Clever and the Library can install Khan Academy and gain the benefit of automatic rostering of their classes for them, and their students gain Single Sign-on (SSO), so no new username or password to remember! If your district uses Clever, you’ll have access to these benefits whether you’re new to Khan Academy or already using us.

This article is for teachers new to using the free Clever Library app with Khan Academy. It is not for teachers in districts with a [Khan Academy Districts](https://districts.khanacademy.org/) partnership and roster at the district level using Clever Secure Sync.  Below are the steps for new or existing Teachers and Students to get started via Clever Library. 

* * *

##   
Teachers: Getting started

Log in to Clever, choose the **Library** tab, and find Khan Academy by browsing or using the search bar at the top of the Library. 

![Clever Library with highlight of Khan Academy app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Bxw4r)

Next, click on the blue **Install** button for Khan Academy. Then, choose which of your Teacher Page(s) you'd like to add Khan Academy.

![Khan Academy account creation screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286rL)

Then you’ll be taken to Khan Academy. You'll be asked whether you want to create a new Khan Academy account or if you already have an existing school account you want to use:

![Welcome to Khan Academy](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286rQ)

Here's an example of what Khan Academy will look like once added to a Teacher Page:

![Khan Academy on a Teacher Page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000BxqCM)

* * *

##   
Teachers: Creating a New Account

If you don’t already have a Khan Academy account through your school, click **Create a new account**, confirm or enter your school email, and then click **Sign up**. 

![Teacher account creation screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286rV)

This will create your new account, and your classes will automatically be rostered for you (this can take a few minutes the first time). After the rostering process is complete, you’ll be taken to your Teacher Dashboard:

![Khan Academy teacher dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286rf)

You can also go to the Khan Academy website and sign up directly. To do this, click on the **Sign up** link in the upper right corner of the home page, and then choose the sign up as a **Teacher** button. Click on the **Continue with Clever**:

![Khan Academy log in screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Bxpg7)

If you choose that option and are already logged into Clever, you’ll be asked to confirm that you want to share your class data with Khan Academy:

![Class data sharing screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286rp)

If you’re not logged into Clever, you’ll be asked to do that first.

![Clever Login Screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286ru)

There’s one final step you’ll want to complete if you’re creating a new Khan Academy account via Clever Library, which is to verify the email you provided when you signed up. You’ll receive an email that looks like this:

![Khan Academy verify email screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286rz)

Click on the **Link this email address** button in the email. You’ll be brought to the Khan Academy login screen; click on the **Continue with Clever** option: 

![Khan Academy login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000BxvlV)

This will enable you to verify your email with us, which will add it to your Settings under Email.

* * *

##   
Teachers: Logging into an Existing Account

If you already have a Khan Academy account through your school, click **Log into your existing account**. You can log in to that existing account using Google (click on **Continue with Google**) or by entering your school email address and your password.

![Khan Academy log in to existing account screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286sE)

Once you’ve logged into your Khan Academy account, you’ll be taken to your Teacher Dashboard, where you’ll see your Clever-rostered classes, as well as any other classes you had previously created. 

![Khan Academy teacher dashboard with classes](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286sJ)

* * *

##   
Student Registration After Class Creation

Note that there is no class code, and **you should not give one out**; your students need to complete their registration by logging into Clever and choosing the Khan Academy tile in their portal, then go through the steps to create or sign into their account.

Once in your Teacher Dashboard, you’ll see that, your classes have been created and your students have been rostered, but the class student count will show as zero. Once your students complete their registration and access the Khan Academy through the Clever portal, you’ll see them in your Student Roster as normal.

Until then, if you select one of your newly rostered classes, you’ll see that the students are listed as pending:

`![Khan Academy student roster with students pending](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286sO)`

Please also note there is no class code, and **you should not give one out**; your students need to complete their registration by logging into Clever and choosing the Khan Academy tile in their portal, then go through the steps to create or sign into their account.

Once your students have completed this process, the number of students in your Khan Academy class(es) will match what you see in Clever for your roster and you will be able to give them assignments or mastery goals. This is easy to do; to start assigning you just open “Assignments” and select “Assign” in the left-hand navigation and you’ll be asked to add a course, like this:

![Assign content screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286sT)

If your students haven’t completed signup by logging into Clever and choosing the Khan Academy tile, they won’t be reflected in your student count, and they’ll still show as pending in your Student Roster.

* * *

##   
Tips and Troubleshooting

There are a few other helpful things to know about how Khan Academy works with the Clever Library:  
 

### Syncing with Clever

Your student and class data in Khan Academy will sync with your Clever roster each time you log into your Khan Academy account, so if you’re missing updates, try logging out and back in again. 

Information only syncs one way, from your school district’s SIS to Clever to Khan Academy. In other words, the Clever roster “rules”; we consider your Clever roster the source of truth. This means that any student additions made to your district or schools’ SIS will flow through to Clever, and then on to Khan Academy, and **you should not take any additional action in Khan Academy to add students.** Additions to your rosters will automatically refresh the next time you log in. 

Khan Academy receives very limited data on your students (first name and last initial only, and no email via the roster data). This means that you will see limited data on your students in your Teacher Dashboard, and email address updates made in Clever won’t flow through to Khan Academy.

* * *

## Students: How do my students get started with Khan Academy through the Clever Library?

Since the Clever Library is for teachers to discover applications they may want to use with their classes, students don’t have access to it directly.

Students see the Khan Academy tile in their student portal (through your teacher’s page) after you’ve found Khan Academy in the Clever Library, installed it, and completed your activation process. It’ll look something like this: 

![Clever Teacher Page with Khan Academy added](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286sY)

Students can favorite Khan Academy so it’s easy to find within their portal, and also search for it within their portal. Once your students find Khan Academy in their student portal, they select the tile to begin their activation process. 

They’ll be able to create a new account for Khan Academy or (if they’re 13 or older) log into an existing school account (a Khan Academy account that has their school email associated with it).

* * *

##   
Students: Creating a New Account

The first time a student selects the Khan Academy tile, they’ll see a welcome message urging them to create a new account or log into their existing account. 

![Khan Academy student's create account screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286sn)

They’ll be asked to enter their birth date and to sign up with their school email.

![Screenshot of request to enter student birthday](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286ss)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286t2)

After they’ve clicked **Sign up**, they’ll be taken to their newly-created account, and their Clever ID will be attached to their account (this is behind the scenes, but helpful for understanding how it works).  
  
They’ll see a welcome message that will explain that they won’t see anything to do on their Learner homepage until their teacher (you!) has made an assignment.

![Welcome to Khan Academy screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286t7)

When they dismiss the message by clicking **Onward,** they’ll see their Learner home, ready to display your class once you give assignments.

![Student view of Khan Academy courses](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286tH)

If the student chooses **Teachers** (the bottom option in the left-hand navigation bar) they’ll see you linked as their teacher (specifically, your first name and last initial) which validates that they have completed their part of the process, and can wait for you to give them an assignment.

* * *

##   
​​​​​​​Students: Logging into an Existing Account (13 years and older)

Students who are 13 years of age or older have the option to use an existing Khan Academy school account instead of creating a new one. To do this, they’ll choose the bottom option **Log in to your existing account**.

![Create a new account screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286tM)

Then they’ll enter the school email address and password for their account:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286so)

Our system will check that the account belongs to a student who is at least 13 years old. If the account belongs to a student who isn’t at least 13 years old, the system will recognize that they are attempting to use an under 13 account, and they’ll receive an error message directing them to go back and create a new account instead.

If the student is indeed at least 13 years old, they’ll see a screen asking for permission to link their Clever account to their Khan Academy account, like this:

![Screenshot of the prompt to use an existing account](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000EAcD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286tR)

The message will explain that by using their existing account, all teachers linked to it will be able to see any activity on assignments, as well as any activity they’ve done independently (outside of a class). 

They’ll either sign in or create a new account, and then they’ll be brought to their Learner Home in Khan Academy.

title: For Teachers: Clever Library - sharing applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360036031712#Header1)  
2\. [How do I share the apps I installed from the Library with others?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360036031712#Header2)  
3\. [What will teachers see when I share an app with them in Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360036031712#Header3)

## Overview

There are hundreds of apps in the Clever Library that you can securely sign up for at no cost. These apps will create accounts for your students automatically. Read more about the Clever Library [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672). 

If you think that an app would be useful for other teachers, you can easily share it through Clever, email, social media, or your preferred channel! The people you share with can view the details about the app, read reviews, and browse screenshots. If they have a Clever account and have access to the Clever Library, they’ll be able to sign up for the app for free through Clever, too!

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dllR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Sn0LJ)  Please note:** If you don’t see the Library icon in your Clever Portal, or if the **Install** button for a Library application is gray and unclickable, your Clever Admin has disabled the Library or blocked the application. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672?#header6) or contact your admin or IT team for more information.

* * *

## How do I share the apps I installed from the Library with others?

Here are the different ways you can share an app you’re using via the Clever Library:

-   **Go directly to the app detail page in the Library: Search for the app you’re interested in, click the button to **Share**, and select to share with teacher(s) in your grade, or specific teachers.**

![Screenshot of Clever Library app with share button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dllR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004KJiX)

-   **Respond to a prompt from Clever: To make it easier for you to let your peers know about apps you and your students are enjoying in the classroom, Clever may prompt you occasionally in your Clever Portal. In this prompt, we’ll ask you if you’d like to share one of the Library apps you’re using with other teachers in your school.** 

We hear from SO many teachers that they treasure these recommendations from their peers, so don’t hesitate to share!

* * *

## What will teachers see when I share an app with them in Clever?

The people you choose will get a notification in their Clever Portal that you shared an app with them, accessible via the bell icon in their Clever Portal:  

![Screenshot of a notification that a teacher has shared an app with you](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dllR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004Sgur)

When they check out your recommendation, you’ll also receive a notification accessible via the bell icon in your Clever Portal:

![Example notification when someone adds your recommended app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dllR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bi5e)

Happy sharing!

title: For Teachers: Clever Library - adding applications
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#Header1)  
2\. [Locating resources in the Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#h_c0329a1e-9fc5-4252-8e43-9873f5028912)  
3\. [Installing resources from the Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#h_903bdf47-0d1e-4c0f-940a-f223dcf9c410)  
4\. [What will my students see?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#Header4)  
5\. [How do I remove a resource installed from the Library?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#h_908e52bd-0a2a-47f1-ae4d-17adaea00cbd)  
6\. [Why might my school system restrict the Library?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#header6)

## Overview

Clever Library is a safe way for teachers to explore new classroom tools. Instead of finding new applications that may have varied data privacy standards, teachers can try new apps from the Library with data-privacy guardrails and admin oversight. When a teacher adopts a Library application with SSO, Clever shares only the absolute minimum information: student first name, last initial, grade level, and course enrollment. The resources in the Library can be added to individual Teacher Pages for easy access by students and teachers.

##   

* * *

##   
Locating resources in the Library

To find resources in Clever Library, please follow these steps:

1.  Log in to your Clever Portal.
2.  From there you can either:
    -   Select the **Library** tab on the left sidebar to browse for resources and install apps for your students and classes.
    -   Or, use the search bar at the top of the page to locate specific resources to install.

![Clever Library](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VZDWn)

If you follow the steps above and you are unable to locate Clever Library or locate a specific resource, either:

1.  Your Clever Admin has disabled the Library. You won’t see a Library tab in your Clever Portal. If you attempt to add an application directly via their website using a Sign Up with Clever button, you’ll see a notification that “Your district has disabled sign up with Clever”.
    
2.  The app isn’t available in Clever Library and may be a district-level application that your Clever Admin must add.
    
3.  The application isn’t a Library application, and you must add it to your Teacher Page [as a link.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)
    

* * *

##   
Installing resources from the Library 

Adding resources from the Library is quick and easy! However, before installing a new resource, please be sure to follow your district and school policies for vetting new applications. This may include taking steps with your IT or administrative team to confirm the application abides by your district’s security and data privacy policies.

Once confirmed, locate the resource in Clever Library, and select the blue **Install** button at the top right corner.

![Install app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hAX)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286pA)**Please note:** If you navigate to a Library application and see the _Install_ button is grayed out, your school has blocked this application. You can read more about [Library restrictions below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672#header6) or reach out to your IT team or Clever Admin for more information.  
  
![Example of blocked Library application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VZ7BG)   
  
If a Clever Admin blocks an application you’re already using, the application will be removed for your Teacher Pages and student Portals.  

Installing an application will add it to your Teacher Page and also automatically set up single sign-on (SSO) accounts for you and your students. There is no need to manually input student information, or print out password cards!

Library applications require certain data points from Clever in order to set up single sign-on for you and your students. This includes data such as first name, last initial, grade. Library applications only receive a limited set of data from Clever, however, when installing a Library resource, Clever may ask you to verify that you want to share this data with the application.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BtNA)  
_An example of the prompt you may receive to share data with a Library app_ 

* * *

##   
What will my students see?

Students don't have access to browse resources in Clever Library. However, they will see any Library resources you made visible to them in your Teacher Page!

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BtNF)

When your students click on your Teacher Page icon from their Clever Portal, they'll be presented with your designed page and associated applications.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BtNt)

For more information, please visit: [For Teachers: What are Teacher Pages?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)

* * *

##   
How do I remove a resource installed from the Library?

If you no longer want a Clever Library app to show up on one of your Teacher Pages, head to the Teacher Page where you added the Library app.

Then, click the **three vertical dots** and then select **Remove** from your Teacher Page.

![Remove app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hDl)

  
A pop-up will appear confirming you'd like to remove the app. Click **Remove**.

![Remove app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hFN)

The app will be removed from your Teacher Page and will no longer be visible to students on that Page.

The library app will continue to appear on your Resources page unless you Uninstall it by going to Clever Library, finding the app, removing it from any Teacher Pages, and clicking **Uninstall**.

![Khan Academy app in Clever Library with Uninstall button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000WSnZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009QY5h)

For more information about Teacher Pages, please visit: [For Teachers: What are Teacher Pages?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)

* * *

## Why might my school system restrict the Library?

Your school system’s Clever Admin can block specific applications in the Library or disable the Library entirely. Clever gives admins this control because school systems often have different policies about which applications can be used with students, and they must comply with student data privacy and cybersecurity laws that vary by state.

With cyber threats on the rise—and attacks becoming more sophisticated through AI—some school systems are taking a stricter approach. This allows them to oversee where and how student data is shared. Since school systems, not teachers, are ultimately responsible for any student data breaches, many are tightening control over which applications students can access to better protect sensitive information.

If you have questions about why a Library application has been blocked or why the Library is disabled, we recommend contacting your IT team. They can explain any review or approval processes in place for the applications you’d like to use with students.
