title: For Teachers: Clever Badges - PINs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039864311#step1)  
2\. [Setting student PIN](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039864311#step2)  
3\. [Troubleshooting forgotten PINs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039864311#step3)

## Overview

For best security practices, school organizations may require a secure PIN for older students to log into Clever when using a Clever Badge. Clever requires a PIN for all students grades 7 and above that login using a Badge. A school organization can choose to adjust this setting to require PINs for Badges beginning at an earlier grade if desired.

* * *

## Setting student PIN

To set a PIN, students will navigate to clever.com/badges, hold their Badge up to the camera, and then be authenticated to the page displayed below.

The first time a student uses a PIN-enabled Badge, they will see the screen below that will prompt them to set a PIN.

On this screen, the student will enter their new PIN twice and then be signed in to Clever! After this initial setup, your students will be able to log into Clever using their Badge and their PIN!

![PIN setup screen prompting student to enter and confirm a new PIN](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFaj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxvt)

* * *

## Troubleshooting forgotten PINs

In order for your student to reset their Badge PIN they will need to be logged in to their Clever Portal. If your student has forgotten their PIN, they can log in to Clever by using a Backup Login Code. You are able to generate a Backup Login Code from your teacher Portal.

From the teacher's Clever Portal:

1.  Log into your Clever Portal and navigate to **My Students** > **Student Roster**
2.  Choose the student you wish to help
3.  Click **Get backup login code** on the right-hand side for that student. You will see a six-digit backup code. Write this code down and pass it along securely to your student. **The code will expire in 20 minutes.**

![Teacher Portal showing Get backup login code button next to a student's name](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFaj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000TYPbC)

  
How does a student log in using a Backup Code?

1.  The student will go to your school organization's Clever Portal login page and click **Get help signing in** under the password field.
2.  The student will then click **Log in with a Backup Code.**

![Login help screen showing Get help signing in and Log in with a Backup Code options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFaj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxw3)

3.  The student will then enter the Backup Code on the next screen, and click Log in. This will log them into their Clever account.  
      
    

Once the student is logged into their Clever Portal, they can reset their 6-digit PIN by clicking on their name in the top-right corner, and selecting **Reset your Badge PIN**.  
  

![Clever Portal user menu showing Reset your Badge PIN option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFaj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000002lxw8)

title: For Teachers: Clever Badges - iOS
text:
This article contains the following:  
1.  [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039888692#h_dceafc29-0e15-4992-b5ea-6374e5d2d1f2)  
2. [Students who log in using Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039888692#h_8a738d38-91c7-4d0b-8477-875708f463d0)  
3\. [Logging in using credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039888692#credentials)  
4. [Accessing Clever apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039888692#h_1c97478b-ae81-4aec-9e01-a74265b88d69)  
5\. [Logging out of the Clever app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039888692#h_afa3ba69-460b-45bd-8278-7816b6af26d3)

## Overview

This article will cover the expected student experience for the Clever iOS app on iPads or mobile devices running on iOS version 16.6 or later. If your students' experience doesn’t match what is described below, please reach out to your Clever Admin or IT team about updating your school organization to the latest version of the Clever App from the Apple App Store [found here.](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clever/id1134186971)

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFUH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZgATR)  Please note:** The Clever iOS application doesn't support teacher logins. If you'd like to log in to Clever on an iOS device as a teacher, please use a web browser, such as Safari, Google Chrome, etc.

* * *

## Students who log in using Clever Badges

These are the instructions for students who will be logging in to Clever using Badges on iOS devices:

-   Download the Clever app on your students’ iOS device.
-   Select the Clever application.
-   Display the student's Badge to the camera (your students have the ability to toggle between the front-facing and back-facing camera).
-   If the student is using a valid badge, a green checkmark should appear with sparkles to signify a successful login!
-   The student will be logged into the Clever Portal and all of its features, including Teacher Pages, directly in the Clever app. When they select a learning application, the app will either open in a web browser or via the iOS application. The app itself determines this behavior and it can’t be changed by Clever.

* * *

## Logging in using credentials

The Clever iOS app works best for students using Badges. Students and teachers who are not using Badges can **log in to Clever directly from a Safari web browser.**

1.  When opening the Clever app, users will see the Badge Camera.
2.  They’ll select the **Password** option at the bottom of the screen.
3.  The user will locate their school from the Clever login page.
4.  They’ll then select the method they want to use to login (ex: Login with Google or Login with Clever).
5.  The user will type their credentials and then be logged into the Clever application and their Clever Portal.
6.  Please see our section below on what happens when a user selects a learning application to learn more about the user experience beyond logging in.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFUH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZW4p7)  Clever Tip:** The Clever app will remember the user's school organization after their first login on the device, so this user won’t need to go through the process of selecting their school again if the Clever app was never fully closed, and device history has not been deleted. 

* * *

## Accessing Clever apps

After a student logs into the Clever iOS application, they’ll be able to click on one of their connected applications. The application or external link will open either in a web browser or the iOS application for the app. The app itself determines this behavior.

If a student wants to go back to their Portal, they should navigate back to the Clever app. From here they can click a new app icon to launch a new app, or access the same app again by clicking its icon.

![Clever "C" logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFUH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286jR)  For details about multiple users on a shared device, visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020614031)!

* * *

## Logging out of the Clever app

Students that share iOS devices will need to log out of the Clever application and any learning applications in order to ensure the next student can successfully log in to their own accounts. 

Users can log out of Clever by clicking their name in the top right corner, then **Log out**.

For security reasons, it's best that users on 1:1 devices also log out of the Clever application and any learning applications when they are done using the device.

If a student doesn’t log out, they will remain logged in as long as their session is valid (~24 hours).

![Clever "C" logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFUH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286jR) For more troubleshooting tips, please see this Help Center article: [Troubleshooting issues with the Clever iOS app.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020343092)

* * *

title: For Teachers: Clever Badges for students
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000127406#overview)   
2. [How do I print Badges for a class?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000127406#Header2)  
3. [How do I print a Badge for a student?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000127406#Header3)  
4\. [How do I void a Badge for a student?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000127406#void)  
5\. [Logging in with a Clever Badge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000127406#LogginginwithBadge)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000127406#FAQ)

## Overview

Badges allow students to hold up a physical badge to their device's webcam to get logged in, instead of typing in usernames and passwords. Badges are perfect for students who have trouble typing or remembering complex passwords - especially younger learners. Teachers get more time to teach, and students get more time to learn!

Badges are tied to the student. As such, changes in school, teacher, or section will not affect the Badge.

If the administrators on your school organization's Clever account have enabled Badges there are several ways you can manage Clever Badges as a teacher. You can print, regenerate, and void Badges for individual students, print Badges for whole classes, and even void Badges for all students en masse at the end of a school year.

##   

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** If you don't see the option to download student Badges, from your Student Roster tab, this means that Badges are not enabled for your school or grade level. [Please reach out to your school organization's tech support for more information.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648)

 **![Lightbulb](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Pro Tip: Security**  
Badges provide direct access to a student's Clever account and should be protected just like a password. Anyone who has access to a Badge can sign in as the student and access their accounts in both Clever and connected applications. Please protect the security of your students and do not share images of the Badge publicly on social media.

* * *

## How do I print Badges for a class?

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu 
    
     ![My Students > Student Roster of the teacher Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y2Jl) 
    
2.  Select the desired Class. 
3.  Click **Download class badges**. This will download all Badges for eligible students in your class.

  
 The Badges PDF format matches the Avery label template for 2” square Avery labels. 

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. Existing printed Badges will continue to work past the expiration date. Admins are expected to void and print Badges annually during transition periods, like summer, to keep them secure ahead of the first day of school. 

* * *

## How do I print a Badge for a student?

###   
**Classes**

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu.
2.  Select the student's class.
3.  Select the student from your roster and click **Download Badge.**
4.  The Badge will download to your computer, which you can print and give to the student.

* * *

## How do I void a Badge for a student?

###   
**Classes**

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu  
2.  Select the student's class
3.  Select the student from your roster and click **Void Badge.**
4.  The Badge will be voided. You can then click **Download Badge** to download a brand new Badge for that student.

    **![Clever Academy logo icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**To help your student **log in with a backup code**, please visit: [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888#backup)

## ​​

* * *

## Logging in with a Clever Badge

1.  Students navigate to www.clever.com/badges. If prompted, click **Allow** to provide Clever access to the device camera.
2.  Hold the Badge up to the camera. Once the Badge is scanned, a green checkmark will appear.
3.  Students will then be redirected to their Clever Portal.

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** Clever Badges are designed only to be used at clever.com/badges. Scanning the Badge with a QR code reader won't log you in to Clever.

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Do all students have Badges?**

-   Not all students have access to Badges. Your school organization's administrators can choose which users have access to Badges. If your student doesn't have access to a Clever Badge and will need one, [please reach out to your school organization's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648?language=en_US#h_ffa9b241-1ab9-4cc4-bc4d-677ae0ece396).

**Can teachers and staff login using Clever Badges?**

-   No. Clever Badges are only available for students as a primary login method. Teachers can use a Clever Badge as a second factor if your schools use Clever’s Classroom Multi-factor authentication (MFA).

**What do I do if I see in my student has a Badge that expires soon?**

-   Existing printed Badges will continue to work past the expiration date. You can reach out to an admin to learn more about when you should expect Badges to be annually voided and reprinted.

title: For Teachers: Logging in to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#Overview)  
2\. [New login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#header2)  
3\. [Directions for logging in](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#directionsforloggingin)   
          •   [Log in with Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#cleverpasswords)  
          •   [Log in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#google)  
          •   [Log in with Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#activedirectory)  
          •   [Log in with Canvas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#canvas)  
          •   [Log in with LDAP](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#LDAP)  
          •   [Log in with Clever - Change Password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#cleverchangepassword)  
4\. [Logging out](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#Loggingout)  
5. [How do I get help?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236003648#gettinghelp)

##   
Overview

This article provides general login instructions for teachers. Please navigate to the appropriate section of this article for additional instructions for your district's single sign-on (SSO) method (e.g. Google, Active Directory, LDAP, etc.).

-   Go to your school organization's Clever Portal login page. The web address usually looks like this: _[https://clever.com/in/](https://clever.com/in/)<district name>_ (for example, clever.com/in/cleverusd).
    -   _If you’re not sure what your school organization's Clever login page is, visit clever.com/login and search for your school._
-   Log in to Clever with your username and password. Your username and password credentials are set up by your school organization. They may be your teacher number, ID, or email address.
-   After you log in to your Clever Portal, you can open your applications, set up your Teacher Pages, explore the Clever Library, or assist a student.

## 

  
  

* * *

## New login page

Beginning February 3, Clever will have a refreshed login page. If your login page looks a little different, there’s no need to worry. You can still log in the same way you always have. Refer to the image below to see an example of the updated design. This example shows Google and Clever Badges as the login methods. Your login page may look slightly different depending on the login options your school uses.

![New login page with two panel view](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hEIxB)

If you don’t use your school’s custom portal URL, go to the [main login page](https://clever.com/login). You’ll see a login screen like the image below. Select the **Password** option, then search for your school.

![Clever's main login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fZCWZ)

* * *

## Directions for Logging in

## Logging in with Clever Passwords

![Login with Clever option](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286RI)

If using the **Log in with Clever** option, enter your school organization username and password. Your username and password are set up by your school organization's. They may be your teacher number, ID, or email address.   
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:**  Your school organization may have login hints to help determine the correct username and password. Login hints will appear once you click on the username and password fields. 

  
![Clever Passwords login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOQ8f)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Need help?** Your login credentials are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your [district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112) or help desk for assistance. You can typically locate their contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your school organization's Clever login page.

* * *

##    
Logging in with Google

  
![Login with Google icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286RS) 

If you use the **Log in with Google** option, you will be redirected to Google to sign in with your school-provided email address. Please note: using your personal Google email address won't work.  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Need help?** Your login credentials are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your [district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112) or help desk for assistance. You can typically locate their contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your school organization's Clever login page.

* * *

##   
Logging in with Active Directory 

![Login with Active Directory button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286RX)

If you use the **Log in with Active Directory** option, you will be redirected to sign in to your school account through Active Directory Federation Services. The username and password for ADFS are managed by your school organization administration.  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)****Need help?** Your login credentials are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your [district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112) or help desk for assistance. You can typically locate their contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your school organization's Clever login page.

* * *

##   
Logging in with Canvas

## ![Login with Canvas button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Rc)  

If you use the **Log in with Canvas** option, you will be redirected to sign in to your school account through Canvas. The username and password for Canvas are managed by your school organization administration.  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Need help?** Your login credentials are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your [district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112) or help desk for assistance. You can typically locate their contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your school organization's Clever login page. 

* * *

## Logging in with LDAP

![Login with LDAP button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Rh)

If you use the **Log in with LDAP** option, enter your school organization-provided username and password. This is generally the same username and password you use to sign in to school organization devices and email.

_**Need help?** Your login credentials are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your [district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112) or help desk for assistance. You can typically locate their contact information by clicking **Get help** from your school organization's Clever login page._  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)****Need help?** Your login credentials are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your [district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112) or help desk for assistance. You can typically locate their contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your school organization's Clever login page.

* * *

## Log in with Clever - Change Password  
   
![Login with Clever button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Rr) 

If you're using the **Log in with Clever** and your school organization has allowed teachers to change their passwords, you can do this through the following steps:

1.  Log in to your Clever account.
2.  Click on the person icon in the top right corner of the screen and click **Change Password**.

![Change password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044h5h) 

3.  Type your current password and desired new password (twice).
4.  Click **Change Password**.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you're logging into Clever through **Google**, **Active Directory,** **LDAP or Canvas**, Clever can't change your password. This is because our system does not have access to your actual password in these instances. If you’ve double-checked that you used the correct credentials but are still having trouble logging in, please contact your school organization's tech support contact for assistance.

  
  

* * *

##   
Logging out

To log out of Clever, navigate to Clever Portal, hover over your name in the top-right corner, and click **Log out**.

![Logout](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044h7J)

Users are also logged out of Clever automatically after: 

-   24 hours of inactivity 
-   The browser is _quit (e.g. "Quit Google Chrome**"**)._  
    Closing the browser window will not log the user out of Clever. 

![Quite Google Chrome Button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286SL)   
  
 

* * *

##   
How do I get help?

Login credentials for Clever are managed by the school organization. If you're unsure of your login credentials or receive an error, please contact your school organization's support contact or help desk for assistance.   
  
You can find your school organization's tech support contact information by clicking the **Get help** link on the Clever login screen. From here, click **District contact**. You should see a box appear with email or phone number to reach your school organization's support contact.  
 

​![Get help page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hONfR)

![District Contact button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hNhDD)

![District Contact Info](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hOBKw)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aMd7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Want to learn more about Clever? Check out [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=teacher) !

title: For Teachers: How do I use Single Sign-On (SSO)?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001057603#overview)  
2. [Single sign-on (SSO) from your school organization's Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001057603#Header1)  
​3. [SSO from a school organization website](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001057603#Header2)  
​4. [SSO from an application’s website](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001057603#Header3)

## Overview

Single sign-on (SSO) allows you and your students to access hundreds of applications with one click using your existing Clever account. This way, you only need to remember one set of login credentials.

There are a few options to use Clever's SSO based on your school organization's setup, listed below.

* * *

## Single sign-on from your school organization's Clever Portal

![Example Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNgL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004MAT3)   
With your Clever account, you can log in to your school organization's Clever Portal, a single page with all of the SSO applications and links set up for you by your district. 

To access an application, simply click on the icon, and you’ll be taken to the application and logged in automatically.   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNgL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** You and your students will only see the applications your school organization has set up for you - if your portal or a student’s portal is missing an app, [contact your district support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888?language=en_US#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd).

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNgL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Qe) For more information on how to access your Clever Portal, see [How do I log in to the Clever Portal as a teacher](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648)?

* * *

## SSO from a school organization's website

## ![Example district website](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNgL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Qj)

In addition to the Clever Portal, your district might also embed Clever SSO links into other websites, such as a school organization website or an alternative portal like Stoneware or Encore. In these cases, after clicking on the Clever SSO link, you may be asked to log in to Clever. Once you have logged in to your Clever account, you will be taken directly to the application and logged in.

* * *

## Single sign-on (SSO) from an application’s website

![SSO from application webpage](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNgL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BGFp)

Many applications will have a way that you can use Clever SSO directly from their login page - you and your students may simply click **Sign In with Clever**” or **Log In with Clever** to log in to the application using your Clever account.

If this is your first time signing in to the application via Clever, and if your school organization has not already created an account for you in the application, the application may ask to create a new SSO account for you based on your existing Clever account. Similar to what you may have experienced before when using “Log in with Google” or “Log in with Facebook,” Clever will ask you if you are okay sharing information with the application about yourself and the classes you teach for the purposes of creating SSO accounts:

![Application request to create an account](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cNgL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Qa)

Once you click **Allow and continue,** you will be logged in to the application and will have SSO accounts created for you and your students! There is no need to manually create accounts or share out class codes. All accounts will be created automatically based on your classes in Clever.

Once you’re ready to share the resource with your students, be sure to add the resource to your Teacher Page for easy access.

title: For Clever Admins: Clever Academy Course Catalog - Learn more about Clever!
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023043372#overview)  
2\. [Learning topics for Clever Admins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023043372#topics)  
3\. [How can I view my courses or certifications?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023043372#viewcourses)

## Overview

Clever Academy is our free online training and certification program for educators. School Organization Administrators can access it through the school organization dashboard, and School Tech Leads and teachers can access it through their Clever Portal. Alternatively, users can go directly to Clever Academy: [https://clever.academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin)

By completing courses, you can learn how to get the most out of Clever for your school organization (in addition to certifications and badges)! After all, you're already the go-to person for all things edtech. We just make supporting educators a little easier. This content is designed to help you create a smooth, friendly experience with edtech for everyone in your school organization.  
 

You can also access materials to lead trainings for your school organization, helping to spread the word about Clever’s useful features.  Feel free to share these with relevant team members so they too can live the Clever life!

##   

* * *

## Learning topics for Clever Admins 

### Clever Certified Champion courses

[Level 1: Intro to Clever & getting started (for Clever Admin)](https://clever.academy/welcome-to-clever?user_type=district_admin)  
In this course, you’ll learn the basics of Clever, from our rostering and single sign-on features, to our suite of additional products. You’ll get the full scoop on how Clever makes it easier and safer for your school organization to connect to technology.   
  
You’ll learn about:

-   Clever's time-saving tools
-   How we protect your school organization's data
-   How your school organization's users will interact with Clever

Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 1: Clever Cadet. This course is a prerequisite to Level 2 and beyond.   
    
[Level 2: Getting your school organization going (for Clever Admin)](https://clever.academy/2-getting-started-learn-the-basics?user_type=district_admin)  
Get acquainted with the Clever platform and complete the activities to start setting up your Clever account. You’ll learn how to set up your sync, your portal, and Clever Badges. Once your portal is set up, you’ll create user accounts and add applications to your portal.   
  
You’ll learn about:

-   Setting up your school organization's account with SSO
-   Setting up Clever Badges
-   Organizing your school organization's Clever Portal 
-   Adding applications and team members

Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 2: Clever Coach. This course is a prerequisite to Level 3 and beyond.   
   
[Level 3: Troubleshooting and advanced sharing rules (for Clever Admin)](https://clever.academy/3-setting-your-district-up-for-success?user_type=district_admin)  
Learn to master the Clever features that will make your teachers’ and students’ lives easier! In this course, you’ll dig into troubleshooting tools and advantage features, such as adding custom data and connecting Clever to any app, whether it’s integrated with Clever or not.   
  
You’ll learn about:

-   Helping teachers and staff log in to Clever
-   Tackling common troubleshooting
-   Working with Advanced School Organization Admin tools
-   Adding custom data

Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 3: Clever Captain. This course is a prerequisite to Level 4 and beyond. 

  
[Level 4: Advanced tools & teacher features (for Clever Admin)](https://clever.academy/4-becoming-a-clever-champion?user_type=district_admin) In this final level, you'll dig into Clever's most advanced features to help you manage your edtech resources. From advanced sharing rules, to analyzing user engagement data, and various teacher tools!  
  
You’ll learn about:

-   Advanced sharing rules & Content mapping to share data precisely with apps
-   Analyzing data with Edtech and Portal Analytics to inform your edtech strategy 
-   Internalizing Teacher features to support teachers and lead training

Complete this course, and you’ll be certified Level 4: Clever Champion, earning a badge, certificate, and ability to post your new certification on LinkedIn.

[Clever & Google: Secure Connected Classroom Certification](https://clever.academy/clever-google-cert?user_type=district_admin) in this course you'll learn how you can use Clever and Google together to deliver a seamless and secure digital learning experience for your school organization.

You'll learn about:

-   Using Google as a login method for Clever
-   Simplifying logins with Clever Badges and Chromebooks
-   Google SSO Applications
-   The Google Classroom roster import application
-   Clever LMS Connect
-   Classroom MFA
-   Clever Identity Management (IDM)
-   Google for Education Plus + Clever IDM: The Google Bundle

Complete this course and you’ll be certified, earning a badge, certificate, and ability to post your new certification on LinkedIn.

###   
Trainer

[Clever Trainers](https://clever.academy/clever-trainers)  
Everything you need to lead an in-person or virtual training at your school, swag included!

###   
Quick Start Guides

Quick start videos for DAs  
Only have a few minutes to learn about Clever? Here are some short videos to get you on your way! When you're ready to earn your official Clever certification, start the certification track by enrolling in Level 1: Intro to Clever. 

[Quick Start - Getting set up with Clever](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding)  
This Quick Start guide will take you through the steps to onboard your school organization to Clever.  
You’ll learn about:

-   Syncing your schools' data with Clever
-   How to connect applications to Clever
-   How to add a login method

[Quick Start - Setting up your Portal](https://clever.academy/series/quick-start-district-admins/quick-start-guide-set-up-your-clever-portal)  
Use this Quick Start guide to learn the essentials of the Clever Portal, and how to make it work for the teachers and students in your school organization.   
  
You’ll learn about:

-   How to customize and organize your school organization's portal 
-   How to add commonly used external links 
-   How Clever works for teachers

[Quick start - Troubleshooting tips](https://clever.academy/troubleshooting-course)  
We try to make Clever as easy to use as possible -- but we know there will be moments when you need additional support. We've compiled some of our most frequently asked questions in this course, and given you step-by-step instructions on how to solve them. Come here when you need a refresher or need to train others on these common troubleshooting tips.  
  
You’ll learn about:

-   Sync statuses and what they mean 
-   What to do when there's "missing information"
-   Refresher on logging in
-   What to do when Badges aren't working
-   What to do when students can't access an application

[Quick start - Maximizing Clever in your school organization](https://clever.academy/maximizing-clever)  
So you've got Clever Portal up and running – and now you just need to make sure you roll it out to your users. In this course, we provide all of the steps you need to take, as well as the resources you need to maximize Clever in your school organization!  
  
You’ll learn about:

-   Determining strategies to push Portal usage in the school organization
-   Choosing between a few options to train the school organization on the portal

[Quick start - School organization cybersecurity](https://clever.academy/quick-start-cybersecurity)  
Use this guide to support cybersecurity for your schools. This is perfect to bolster your school organization's security practices!

You’ll learn about:

-   The different types of cybersecurity threats that schools most frequently face
-   Implementing the most vital cybersecurity best practices to help make your schools more secure
-   Leading training for your teachers and staff 
-   Next steps to stay in the know on cybersecurity

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSBN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Pg)  For directions and information about the Clever Academy specifically for teachers and School Tech Leads (STLs), see these articles:  
[For Teachers: How can I learn more about Clever? (Clever Academy)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360023293231)  
  
[For School Tech Leads: Clever Academy - Learn more about Clever!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045116211?language=en_US)

* * *

## How can I view my courses or certifications?

You can see the courses you've registered for or completed at any time by navigating to [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/), clicking person icon in the top right, and selecting My Profile. From here, you'll see a list of all your learning paths and courses. Any course with a certification that you've completed will have a **View certificate** link next to it. Click the link to view the certificate, and then print it if you'd like! Certificates are valid for two years.  If it has been more than two years since you completed a course, you would need to re-take the course to become re-certified.

title: Clever Technical Requirements & Supported Devices
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Devices & Internet Browsers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387#devices)  
2\. [Clever Browser Extension](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387#extension)  
3. [iOS Devices](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387#ios)  
4\. [Android Devices & Amazon Fire Tablets](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387#android)

## Devices & Internet Browsers

Clever is compatible with all computer devices (e.g., Microsoft Windows, macOS, Chrome OS/Chromebooks), but we have certain recommendations to provide users with the most optimized experience. Clever supports the following internet browsers.

-   Google Chrome
-   Microsoft Edge
-   Mozilla Firefox
-   Apple Safari (we support this browser for general use with Clever, but not for SSO (Save Passwords) apps, as we do not currently offer a Safari Extension)

While these browsers are compatible with Clever, we recommend using the Chrome browser for the best user experience.   
   
Please visit the following articles for specifics around using Clever on Chromebooks:

-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Setup & Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Chromebooks - the student experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004628?language=en_US)

* * *

## Clever Browser Extension

The Clever browser extension is required for specific applications to work correctly on computers and Chromebooks. Specifically, [single sign-on (SSO) applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166807?language=en_US) that are integrated with Clever do not require the Clever browser extension, but the browser extension is needed for [SSO (Saved Passwords) applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US) to function correctly.

-   The Clever browser extension is not required for iOS devices (e.g., iPads, iPhones) as these devices use the [Clever app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236226387#ios), which is downloadable from the device App Store and functions in the same way as the Clever browser extension.  
-   For devices where the Clever browser extension cannot be downloaded (e.g., Android), some applications may not be accessible.

Please see the links below for information and instructions for installing the Clever browser extension for your browser:

-   Google Chrome:  [Install](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/clever/nopfnnpnopgmcnkjchnlpomggcdjfepo)  |  [Directions](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/2588006?hl=en)
-   Microsoft Edge (New):   [Install](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/clever/innfnjgighoafebohpiamhnchmkoilgj?source=sfw)  |  [Directions](https://www.howtogeek.com/411830/how-to-install-google-chrome-extensions-in-microsoft-edge/)
-   Firefox: [Install](https://crx.clever.com/firefox/download) | [Directions](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/find-and-install-add-ons-add-features-to-firefox)

* * *

## iOS Devices

The Clever app is compatible with iOS devices (e.g., iPads, iPhones) running version 16.6 or later, and iPadOS 16.6 or later. The app is available for download from the device's App Store.  

See the following article for more information regarding the Clever iOS app: [iOS devices (e.g. iPads, iPhones)](https://support.clever.com/hc/es/articles/360024746971)  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cvoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286PM)  
 

* * *

## Android Devices & Amazon Fire Tablets

Clever does not currently have an app for Android devices. However, users can still use their Android devices to access Clever! Users log in to Clever from Clever.com or their district's custom Clever login page using their internet browser just as they would when using a computer or laptop. Clever recommends using the Google Chrome browser for the best user experience. Users must manually log in to [SSO (Saved Passwords) applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US) when using Android devices.   
  
Amazon Fire tablets provide the same user experience as Android.   
  
For students to access Clever on the Amazon Kids web browser, you must [add Clever.com as an allowable domain](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201957100#:~:text=7.%20How%20can%20I%20permit%20access%20to%20additional%20web%20videos%20and%20websites%3F).  
  

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For District Admins: Apps - Types of apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002370127)
-   [Clever Portal: Installing the Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: iOS devices & the Clever app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024746971?language=en_US)

title: How much does Clever cost districts and schools?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202393278#h_82f45db0-2de3-4d38-a178-4d13fa3fba28)  
2. [How does Clever generate revenue?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202393278#h_8bbd0664-c5fa-4ab6-ac78-c774c0823dc7)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTzV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you are outside of the United States, check out our [international article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202043013?language=en_US) for more information.

## Overview

Clever is a _**free**_ service for schools and districts in the United States and Canada! This means Clever doesn’t charge schools or districts to utilize our platform. 

We offer the following services at no charge to districts!

-   [Secure Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0y0WAC/secure-sync)
-   [Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000DZn3WAG/clever-portal)
-   [Single-sign on (SSO)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0xxWAC/single-signon-sso)
-   Clever Badges
-   [Clever Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050299552)
-   Clever Library

  
**Optional paid add-ons:**

-   [**Clever IDM**](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466) is an optional, paid add-on for school districts. School districts can add Clever IDM to their free Clever digital learning platform to automate identity management to help keep Google and Active Directory in sync with their SIS. 
-   **[Classroom Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616)** allows your students and teachers to securely MFA into Clever to protect all of your Clever applications without the requirement of a second device.  This solution helps you stay ahead of cybersecurity threats without disrupting learning. You can add this as an optional, paid add-on.

##   
How does Clever generate revenue?

Clever's partnerships with online learning providers (i.e. application partners) are what generate revenue for us. Our application partners pay Clever based on their usage of our Application Programming Interface (API). Essentially, they purchase Clever’s technology, including complex integrations with various Student Information Systems (SIS). This allows our partners to focus on their core business needs instead of dedicating time to complicated district setups. With a Clever integration, application partners avoid building and maintaining custom integrations for every district—freeing up resources and streamlining operations.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTzV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286O4) For more information regarding application partner pricing, please visit our [pricing page here.](https://clever.com/pricing)

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever's Business Model](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001468?language=en_US)

This article contains the following:

7\. [Clever IDM and Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202000976#add-ons)  
8. [Who should sign up for Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202000976#use-clever)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000audB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035feX)  
Getting started with Clever? Check out our course [Clever Academy for Clever Admin, Level 1](https://clever.academy/welcome-to-clever?user_type=district_admin), available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

Clever automates the secure transfer of student rosters to authorized parties, ensuring learning programs always have updated information. We also offer single sign-on (SSO) access for students and teachers through the Clever Portal. Clever's core features are free for school organizations. This means Clever doesn’t charge schools or districts to utilize our platform. For more information about Clever's pricing, please visit: [How much does Clever cost districts and schools?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202393278)

Clever replaces outdated, insecure systems like emailed CSV files or manual vendor-specific bulk transfers. It's engineered to be the most secure way for school organizations to send data to vendors while granting users access to all their edtech tools with a single set of credentials via the Clever Portal.

**Accessibility**

We understand how important it is for all users to be able to use the Clever platform easily. To ensure we meet the accessibility standards for all students and families, we conduct a voluntary audit each year and update the platform in line with the latest guidelines.

 Please reach out to our [support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport) if you would like more information. You can review our full [accessibility statement here](https://clever.com/trust/accessibility).

##   

  
  

* * *

##   
Secure Sync

Secure Sync maintains up-to-date roster information in your learning applications. It securely transfers your roster uploads or connects directly with your Student Information System (SIS) to provision student, teacher, and staff accounts.

Data is shared according to the sharing permissions you set in your Clever Dashboard, so you're always in control. Learning applications regularly update your enrollment information with any changes. You can learn more about Secure Sync [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588).

* * *

##   
Single sign-on (SSO)

Single sign-on (SSO) allows students and teachers to use a single set of credentials to sign in to all their learning applications. Clever integrates with your existing identity provider (IdP), such as Google or ADFS, or it accepts your own synced credentials. Learn more about SSO [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807).

* * *

##   
Clever Portal

As part of Single sign-on (SSO), each student and teacher has access to a free personalized portal with their learning applications.

With the Clever Portal, students spend more time learning instead of searching for applications or remembering passwords. Students and teachers can access their learning programs through the Clever Portal in three easy steps:  
  

1.  Navigate to your school organization's custom Portal URL (the Clever login page).
2.  Enter their familiar username and password, or log in using a [Clever Badge.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/220213907)
3.  They'll be signed in to their Clever Portal, where they can access connected apps via SSO!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000audB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Np) For more information on using the Clever Portal, visit: [For Clever Admins: Managing Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205875568).

* * *

##   
Clever Library

Clever Library is a place for teachers to discover and adopt new resources for their classroom. Resources in the Library can be added to a teacher's Teacher Page for easy access. You can read more about Clever Library here. 

* * *

##   
Clever Analytics

As a Clever admin, you can keep your finger on the pulse of student and teacher engagement with edtech programs. You can view data as charts in Clever, export them as CSVs, or send them to your data warehouse via SFTP. You can learn more about your [analytics options here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050299552). Teachers also have access to [Class Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360041755311) to view student engagement data.

* * *

## Clever IDM and Classroom MFA

While Clever's rostering and SSO services are free, we also offer powerful paid tools to further streamline your school organization's workflow:

-   [Identity Management (IDM)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466): Clever offers IDM for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID.
-   [Classroom Multi-factor authentication (MFA)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616): We offer an MFA solution designed for K-12 schools that does not require a second device for logins. 

* * *

## Who should sign up for Clever?

Clever's optimized for management at the school organization level. To create an account, you'll need administrative access to your SIS and the authority to sign Clever's Terms of Service.

Typical roles with sufficient access include Chief Technology Officers, SIS managers, and other IT Administrators. Teachers and principals usually don't have enough SIS access to set up an account.

If you're ready to sign up, please go here: [clever.com/district-signup](https://www.clever.com/district-signup). We're looking forward to working with you!

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [How much does Clever cost school organizations?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202393278)
-   [What's Single sign-on?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166807)
-   [What's Secure sync?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588)

title: How does Clever protect student data and privacy?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202393058#h_f6f57824-960f-44fd-8485-56a9ced6d5b1)  
2. [Full District Control](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202393058#h_269ab97c-d25b-4f33-9092-d497b3393549)  
3\. [Student Data Privacy at Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202393058#h_f4e00d03-509a-4e93-9ae5-f0b4789c8793)  
4. [Infrastructure](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202393058#h_b43c44b3-b85c-46cc-8148-2dad99bb7d3f)

## Overview

School districts across the nation rely on Clever to sync roster data with their applications, in part because security is a top priority. Clever keeps student information safe by ensuring:  
 

-   Full district control over data access rights at all times;
-   A robust [privacy policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy) that governs our use of student data; and
-   Protection through a tested and secure infrastructure.

## 

##   
Full District Control

Districts control data access at all points in the process, from signup all the way through account provisioning. Districts determine:  
 

-   What data Clever can access (always read-only);
-   How often they sync data with Clever;
-   Which applications can access data; and
-   How much data each application can access (via [data sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)).

Districts can fine-tune these settings at any time through the Clever Dashboard. If a district chooses to discontinue their Clever sync, they can do so at any time. Clever will delete their account and remove any residual data immediately upon request.

##   
Student Data Privacy at Clever

Clever syncs basic information to manage user accounts in online learning applications, such as student and teacher identifiers, section names, and enrollment information.  
 

All rostering data that is synced with Clever is protected by industry-leading infrastructure (see below). Clever will never use or sell student information for marketing or other purposes.  
 

Additionally, Clever maintains FERPA compliance under the FTC's School Officials Exemption, meaning Clever provides a service on behalf of schools that the schools themselves would usually provide. Furthermore, all Clever-supported applications agree to adhere to FERPA requirements in the terms of our partnership.  
 

To learn more about data privacy, you can read Clever's full [Privacy Policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy)

##   
Infrastructure

Clever has spent years developing one of the best security infrastructures in K-12 education. Key features of Clever's industry-leading infrastructure are:  
 

-   AES256 data encryption for data at rest;
-   TLS with strong ciphers, with a preference for those with perfect-forward secrecy, for data in transit;
-   Multiple factor authentication;
-   Third-party security audits and code reviews;
-   Responsible disclosure (“bug bounty”) program;
-   Full-time security administrator; and
-   Employee background checks.

The syncing process is encrypted at all times using 256-bit encryption, which is double the standard used by the consumer banking industry. In addition, Clever's production environment is completely isolated from the internet, and all access is logged and secured using [multiple factor authentication](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333).  
 

Clever has a full-time security administrator and invests in regular third-party audits in order to ensure continual improvement of security protocols.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004Q8n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286On) If you’re interested in learning more, please read more about our [comprehensive security program](https://www.clever.com/trust/security).
