title: For Clever Admins: Zoom - transitioning from Upgraded to Basic accounts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045571251#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [For teachers: adding a password login for Zoom](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045571251#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)

##   
Overview 

  
If your district participated in the free Zoom upgrade during school closures, the district Zoom account will revert to Zoom Basic on Wednesday, July 1, 2020 if your district does not upgrade to a Business or Education account. If your account reverts to Zoom Basic on Wednesday, your teachers will encounter two primary changes: **SAML SSO through Clever will no longer work, as Zoom provides SAML SSO only to premium customers, and meeting length will be capped at 40 minutes.**  

  
If you plan to use Zoom through its Basic service after July 1st, we recommend that you:

1.  Communicate the above changes to teachers for awareness.
2.  Let teachers know they can set a password to log in manually to their account with their email address by using the directions below. 
3.  Remove the SSO app from teacher dashboards by clicking “disconnect app” on the Zoom page in your Clever dashboard. This will prevent teachers from becoming confused if they attempt to SSO into Zoom after July 1st and receive an error message

## For teachers: adding a password login for Zoom

If you have previously logged in SSO via Clever, on [**Profile**](https://zoom.us/profile), you will see icons indicating SSO, but no icon for email.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000019CX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Mm)

Unless restricted by your Account owner, you can easily add an email and password login for the same account.  
 

1.  Sign out of your Zoom existing account.
2.  Go to [**zoom.us/signup**](https://zoom.us/signup)
3.  Enter your school-provided email address that matches your email in Clever.
4.  Click **Sign Up**.
5.  You will receive an email with Sign Up instructions. Click to **Activate Account.**
6.  Enter your desired password twice.  
    **Note**: Make sure your password meets the [requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/s/articles/115005166483).
7.  Click **Continue**.
8.  You can enter in email addresses of contacts to invite or choose **Skip this Step.**
9.  Click **Go to My Account.**
10.  This will take you to **My Profile** of the existing Zoom account. It should now show the SSO icon that it showed previously, as well as an email icon to indicate that you can log in with email address and password.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000019CX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Mw)

title: For Clever Admins: Zoom - Secure Experience
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042696791#header1)  
2\. [Directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042696791#header2)  
3\. [Testing the Zoom Secure Experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042696791#header3)  
4\. [Student Experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042696791#header4)

## Overview

We’ve heard from school organizations that want to improve Zoom security to ensure the safety of students and teachers. In response, we have worked with Zoom to develop a new solution for schools called the Zoom Secure Experience. This new experience “locks down” meetings in your domain – only teachers, staff, and admins can create meetings, and only verified users (including students) in your domain can join them.

  
Additionally, usernames for individuals joining will be locked. Students will have the default name: "First Name + Last Name" (Example: John Smith) as displayed in Clever. Notably, this Secure Experience **does not** require students to have Zoom accounts!

  
We think this is a great experience and now recommend it to our school organizations as a best practice. If you’d like to enable Zoom Secure Experience for your school organization, please follow the steps below.  
 

## Things to Note: 

-   The Zoom Secure Experience requires all users to authenticate via Clever before joining a Zoom meeting.  
     
-   This experience does not give Zoom accounts to students.  
     
-   These instructions assume you’ve already set up Zoom + Clever SSO for your teachers & staff. If you have not already done so, please start by following the [instructions here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040481852)  
     
-   If there are any users in your school organization who want to join Zoom meetings and aren't in Clever, you'll want to add them to your Clever upload (e.g., staff.csv).  
     
-   If certain users in your school organization need to continue hosting unauthenticated meetings, you can allow this by creating multiple Zoom User Groups and applying the settings below on a group-by-group basis.
    

* * *

## Directions

First, please confirm you have completed Zoom + Clever SSO for your teachers & staff as described here: [https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040481852.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040481852)

### Clever Setup

1.  Log in as a Clever admin and click this link:   
    [https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-zoom-external-auth](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-zoom-external-auth)
2.  Add the **Zoom External Auth** application by selecting **Request application.**
3.  Select the top-left checkbox to enable this application for all users in the school organization and select **Request with sharing.**  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286LF)

Please Note: This is a special application that _will not_ appear in any user-facing portals. This application must be added in addition to the **Zoom - Teachers & Staff** app you’ve already configured.

### Zoom Setup

1.  Log in to [Zoom](https://zoom.us/signin)
2.  Navigate to **Account Management > [Account Settings](https://zoom.us/account/setting)**
3.  Turn OFF "Allow participants to rename themselves"  
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286LK)
4.  Turn ON “Only authenticated users can join meetings”
5.  Turn OFF “Only authenticated users can join meetings from Web client”
    
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Kw)  
        _Image:_ _Steps 3-5_
    
6.  Next to “Only authenticated users can join meetings,” click the lock icon to enforce this for all your users:  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286LU)
    
7.  Click **Edit** next to **Sign in to Zoom (Default)**
    
8.  In a new tab, navigate to: [https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom-external-auth/settings](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom-external-auth/settings)  
         •  Under 'SAML Details' copy the Metadata URL  
     
9.  Enter the copied Metadata URL in a new browser tab and press Enter.   
    •  Copy the value found between the tags: _<ds:X509Certificate>_  
     
10.  Configure settings in **Authentication Configuration** as follows and click **Save**  
       
     **Name**: Sign in with Clever  
     **Authentication Method**: Sign in to External SSO (If this doesn't show up as an option, please reach out to Zoom Support and let them know that External Auth needs to be turned on for your school organization's Zoom account.)  
     **Sign-in page URL**: [https://samlidp.clever.com/saml-zoom-external-auth/assert](https://samlidp.clever.com/saml-zoom-external-auth/assert)  
     **Identity provider certificate:** Enter the X509 certificate from the [_Zoom External Auth_](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom-external-auth/settings) app as identified in steps 8-9.  
     **Issuer**: http://samlidp.clever.com/services/trust  
     **Email Address:** <blank>  
     **Binding:** HTTP-Redirect  
     **First Name:** FirstName  
     **Last Name:** LastName  
       
     ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286LZ)
11.  In the Zoom dashboard, once you have clicked **Save** an option to download your “SP metadata XML” will appear. Download and open this file. Locate the **entityID** and **Location values** and enter those [in Clever](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom-external-auth/saml) as the “Entity ID” and “Assertion Consumer Service URL”, respectively.  
       
     Zoom:  
     ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Le)  
       
     SP metadata XML:  
     ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Lj)  
     Clever: [https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom-external-auth/saml](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom-external-auth/saml)  
     ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Lk)  
     _(Note: your values will be different than what’s pictured)_
12.  Click **Confirm** to save the variables.  
      

* * *

## Testing the Zoom Secure Experience

 To test the Zoom Secure Experience:

1.  Create a new meeting using a school organization Zoom account and start the meeting
2.  In the Zoom meeting, click the ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286LV) icon at the top left to locate the meeting URL  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Lo)
3.  Copy the URL and attempt to join the meeting from a new private/incognito browsing window (make sure to NOT be logged in to Zoom or Clever)  
     
4.  You should be prompted to log in to Clever before proceeding.  
      
    _Please note, if using a private/incognito window you will need to search for your school before logging in. During a normal browsing session, if they are clicking on the Zoom link from Clever, they will be automatically authenticated!_  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Ly)

* * *

## Student Experience

1.  Student clicks on a meeting link in the Clever Portal
2.  Student is prompted to authenticate with Clever. If they are already logged into Clever, the authentication will happen automatically! 
3.  Student enters the Zoom meeting. Their Zoom name will be auto-populated with"First Name + Last Name" (Example: John Smith)    
      
    _Join from your browser: if a student is joining from their browser, they will be prompted to enter a name, however, this name will be overwritten by the Clever authentication._

_Pictured below: self-selected name_

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286M3)

_Pictured below: the correct Clever name_ 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000098O9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286L1)

title: For App Partners: Tagging your app with key search terms in the Clever Library
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360031356852#overview)  
2. [How to add tags to your application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360031356852#h_3063269a-7528-4527-9b68-6938ed714ab2)   
3\. [Tips and best practices for tagging](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360031356852#h_888ea907-96af-4d74-83be-bbf4597c8e08)   
4\. [Examples of common edtech search terms](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360031356852#h_28fe74d0-e536-4b9a-ab0e-d28d6a7aee5b) 

## Overview

Teachers can search for applications in the Clever Library by name and using keywords. To improve their applications' discoverability, partners can add up to 10 tags directly in your [Clever App Dashboard > Library > Marketing Collateral.](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/library/collateral) 

Adding tags will give partners the opportunity to provide additional definitions and characteristics about their application, making it easier for teachers to find the right application for their needs.   
 

* * *

## How to add tags to your applications

1.  Sign into your Clever Dashboard
2.  Go to the **Library** tab in the left-hand menu
3.  Go to **Marketing Collateral** in the left-hand menu
4.  Scroll down to **App details** and click Edit
5.  Create tags for your app, then save your changes

The changes will go live on your app detail page as soon as you save. To see the results on and test the new search results, you can impersonate a teacher via your demo account.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULgX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028EOw)

* * *

## Tips and best practices for tagging

-   To optimize search, make sure your tags are less than 24 characters each.
-   Add tags that reference specific skills (i.e. ‘addition’, ‘subtraction’) , features and capabilities (‘student-paced’, ‘gamified’) , or curriculum requirements (‘experimental method’, ‘earth and space science’). These are typical search terms that teachers query with.
-   Add non-Library categories as tags since the Library has 10 official categories. Do not repeat your existing categories as tags because the Clever search algorithm already surfaces your app based on its category. The 10 official categories include: Assessment, Authoring, Classroom Management, English, Math, Presentation, Science, Social Studies, Technology, Other.

* * *

## Examples of common edtech search terms

-   SEL
-   RtI
-   MTSS
-   ELL
-   Adaptive Learning
-   Reading comprehension
-   Classroom management
-   Offline access
-   Group activities
-   Game-based learning
-   Computer science
-   Puzzles
-   Design
-   SPED
-   SAT
-   PSAT
-   Bilingual
-   Standards
-   Video
-   Inclusion
-   Common core
-   Fluency

  
For more examples, [click here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a9RW2b5E9aovnNgVv7-n5DTbSiCS7nGH1zGusmrsT34/edit?usp=sharing).

title: For Clever Admins: Configuring SSO for Zoom
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040481852#Header1)  
2\. [Setup Directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040481852#Header2)  
3\. [Sending additional attributes](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040481852#h_01EGP2BW7RVXT4F0A831QE1YWX)  
4\. [Security & Privacy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040481852#SandP)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040481852#Header4)

 

## Overview

Clever has partnered with Zoom to create a seamless way to provide account creation, as well as Single Sign-On (SSO) access for teachers, staff, and Clever admins. To set up [SAML SSO](https://zoom.us/account/sso) for Zoom, please follow the directions below.

To configure Single Sign-On (SSO) for Zoom, you must have a paid account (Edu/Business) or a Free "Licensed" Trial account provided by Zoom. You can check your account type in Zoom by selecting **Account Management > Account Profile**. 

## Setup Directions

1.  Confirm you have a Zoom Edu or Business account by logging in to [zoom.us/signin](https://zoom.us/signin) and navigating to: **Account Management > Account Profile**. 
2.  Under your **Account Profile** in Zoom, apply for a “Vanity URL.”   
      
    To ensure your Vanity URL is approved, please follow [Zoom's guidelines for Vanity URL requests](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/215062646-Guidelines-for-Vanity-URL-Requests).  
      
    ![Account profile page in Zoom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNLv)   
     
    
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Ji)  
    You won't be able to proceed to Step 3 until you have received an  
    email from Zoom confirming your Vanity URL.
    
3.  Once your Vanity URL has been approved by Zoom, add the Zoom application to your Clever account by clicking [on this link](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-zoom) and selecting **Request application**.  
     
4.  Select which schools to share with Zoom and click **Request with sharing**.  
     
    
     **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Tip:** You can easily select all schools in the district by using the checkbox in the top left.    
    
      
    ![Select which schools to share with Zoom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNM0) 
5.  Navigate to: [https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom/settings](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom/settings)   
         •  Under 'SAML Details' copy the Metadata URL
6.  Enter the copied Metadata URL in a new browser tab and press Enter.   
    •  Copy the value found between the tags: _<ds:X509Certificate>_  
             ![Screenshot of XML screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNM5)          
7.  Navigate to: [https://zoom.us/account/sso](https://zoom.us/account/sso) and select **Enable Single Sign-On.**  
     
8.  Choose to “Configure SSO Manually” and set the following values.  
      
    **Sign-in page URL**: [https://samlidp.clever.com/saml-zoom/assert](https://samlidp.clever.com/saml-zoom/assert)  
    **Sign-out page URL**: Leave blank  
    **Identity provider certificate**: Enter the X509 Certificate value copied in Step 6  
    **Service Provider (SP) Entity ID**: Leave as default  
    **Issuer (IDP Entity ID)**: http://samlidp.clever.com/services/trust  
    **Binding**: HTTP-Redirect  
    **Signature Hash Algorithm**: SHA-256  
    **Security:** Check “Save SAML response logs on user sign-in” (optional, but useful for debugging issues)  
    **Provision User**: Leave as “At Sign-In (Default)"  
      
    ![Screenshot of Zoom configure SSO manually page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNMA)   
      
    _**Remember to save your work at the bottom of this tab before moving on to the next step!![Zoom save changes screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNMP)**_ 
9.  Switch to the 'SAML Response Mapping' tab and set the following values (note that they are case sensitive). Do not set any additional attributes.
    
    **Default user type:** Basic  
    **Email address:** NameID  
    **First name:** FirstName  
    **Last name:** LastName
    
    ![Zoom SAML response mapping screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNMe) 
10.   Navigate to [https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom/settings.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom/settings)  
       •  Under 'SAML Details' select **Edit.**   
       •  Provide the subdomain of your approved Vanity URL and select **Confirm.**  
       
     **IMPORTANT:** Provide only the subdomain.  
     For example, if your Zoom Vanity URL is ‘[https://district.zoom.us](https://district.zoom.us/)’, enter ‘district.'                                          
11.  You are now ready to test a teacher & staff login! Issues can be debugged by looking at the “SAML Response Logs” in Zoom settings. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)!  
      

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286KM)   **Download:** [School Administrator’s Guide: Rolling Out Zoom](https://zoom.us/docs/doc/School%20Administrators%20Guide%20to%20Rolling%20Out%20Zoom.pdf)

##   
Sending additional attributes

Additional attributes can be sent to Zoom as part of the SAML assertion. This allows districts to identify and group users more easily. If sending additional attributes, please be sure to adjust the settings for all three user tabs: District Admin Attributes, Staff Attributes, Teacher Attributes and select **Confirm.**

![Screenshot of "Attributes" screen in Zoom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286KR)

**SchoolID**  
This field allows you to send the **School** for a user. The only accepted value from the drop-down is **School**. If selected, the value passed to Zoom will be the Clever ID. This value can be viewed in the [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser) or on the school's profile page: 

![School profile with school id highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amqP)

**UserType**  
This field allows you to send the **user type** for a user. The only accepted value from the drop-down is **Custom.** In the box labeled **USER TYPE CUSTOM VALUE** enter **{{type}}.** The values passed to Zoom will be one of the following: teacher, school admin, or district admin.

![Screenshot of "Attributes" screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Kb)

## Security & Privacy

Data privacy is always a top priority. **Only teachers & staff** will have accounts created in Zoom, and only the following information will be provided to facilitate account creation for teachers & staff: 

-   First Name
-   Last Name
-   Email

Students attending a Zoom meeting will be prompted to enter their name. Directing students to enter only their first name will further minimize data sharing. See our [FAQ section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360040481852#Header4) for more information on the student experience.

Zoom is COPPA, FERPA, and CCPA compliant. Learn more about Zoom’s [best practices for schools](https://zoom.us/docs/doc/School%20Administrators%20Guide%20to%20Rolling%20Out%20Zoom.pdf) and [K-12 School and District Privacy Policy](https://www.zoom.us/docs/en-us/childrens-privacy.html). 

The usage of Zoom is governed by their [terms of service](https://zoom.us/terms).

## FAQs

**What type of integration does Clever have with Zoom?**

-   Zoom can be configured as a Single Sign-On (SSO) application within Clever. Teacher accounts will be provisioned on-demand. Student roster information will not be shared with Zoom.

**Who will have a Zoom account?**

-   District admins, staff, and teachers will have accounts in Zoom.

**Where can teachers find more information on utilizing Zoom?**

-   A full guide for teachers to set up their virtual classroom can be [found here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040514352).

**How will students use Zoom? Can they call each other?**

-   Teachers can create meetings for their students to join, but students will not have their own accounts, and students will not be able to initiate meetings with each other.
-   Teachers may find it useful to post their custom Zoom URL on their Teacher Page within Clever.

**Can we use Google to log into Zoom instead of going through the Clever Portal?**

-   Our partnership has been designed and tested using the Clever > Zoom integration. Clever is not able to support district users who access Zoom by any other methods.

**Will cloud storage for recordings be provided?**

-   Cloud storage will be dependent upon your license type. The features associated with each meeting plan can be reviewed here: [https://zoom.us/pricing.](https://zoom.us/pricing)

**Can Staff users in Clever use Zoom?**

-   Yes! Staff can log in via Clever and host virtual meetings through Zoom. A full guide for staff to sign in to Zoom and create virtual meeting links can be [found here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360041097671).
    

**My district has multiple email domains. Do I need multiple accounts?** 

-   Each district will be provided **one** Zoom account, even if your district has multiple email domains. Please enter the Vanity URL of your choice for Step 3. All teachers within your district will be associated with the district account when they log in to Zoom from Clever, regardless of email domain. 

**Do students and teachers have to download the Zoom app?**

-   No. Students and teachers can join by selecting "Join from your browser" once they have clicked on a meeting link.   
      
    We recommend turning on **Show a "Join from your browser" link** for the entire organization using the directions from Zoom [found here](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005666383).

![Screenshot of enable join from your browser screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNMj)

**Students receive the error message: "Zoom does not support Clever SSO for students."**

-   In April of 2020 Zoom began enabling the setting "Only authenticated users can join meetings from Web Client" by default. With this new setting enabled, students will see a login error when attempting to join a meeting through the web browser.
    
    To resolve this issue there are two options: 
    
    1.  Download the Zoom app for the device ([download here](https://zoom.us/download)).
    2.  Log in to Zoom as the Zoom account owner, navigate to Account Management > [Account Settings](https://zoom.us/account/setting) and disable "Only authenticated users can join meetings from Web Client"
    
    ![Screenshot of "Only authenticated users can join Zoom meetings"](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SiXZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Kq)
    
    Students joining meetings through the Zoom app are not affected. They can join a meeting without logging in
    

**How do I assign users to groups and licenses?**

-   Though Clever assists with provisioning accounts, assigning teachers and staff to users groups and assigning licenses must be completed manually by the district. Information on both of these topics can be found here: 
    -   -   [https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Managing-user-groups](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Managing-user-groups)
        -   [https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115004976063-Assigning-a-License](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115004976063-Assigning-a-License)

**How can I determine when my Zoom certificate is expiring?**

-   You can view the expiration date for the Zoom certificate by taking the metadata URL from the 'SAML details' on the [Settings tab of Zoom's profile page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-zoom/settings) and pasting it into an incognito window. At the end of the top row of text, you'll see the **'validUntil=' date!** This is the date your certificate is valid until.

**Who should I contact with questions?**

-   Please [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/?) with any questions about setting up or administering your free Zoom account. We're here to help, and look forward to getting you and your teachers Zooming!

title: For App Partners: Creating filters for district data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003249203#Overview)  
2\. [How does app-side filtering work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003249203#HowFilterWork)  
3\. [How do I filter district data?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003249203#HowFilterData)  
4\. [What do districts see when data is filtered?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003249203#WhatDistrictsSee)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003249203#FAQ)

## Overview

Districts oversharing data is a common problem for applications on Clever. To help resolve this, applications can create filters to receive only the data you need, giving you control over data sharing and enhancing integration quality. 

* * *

## How does app-side filtering work?

Step 1: [Districts share data with the application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).

Step 2: Applications apply filters on the district data to manage exactly which data they are receiving, whereby ensuring that only relevant data is synced.  

  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004b4D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** if new schools are added to a district's sync or additional data needs to be shared, it will be necessary to update the app-side filters to allow this data to be accessible to you (the application).

* * *

## How do I filter district data?

Filtering is located on the District Profile page.

1.  Click **Create a filter**
2.  Determine if you would like to filter by school or more granular data using sharing rules (such as grade level, subject, etc.)
3.  Select the data that _should be included_ in the sync. If using sharing rules to select more granular data, see the Tips and best practices section below. When done, click **Next**
4.  Preview data. If correct, click **Save**
5.  Clever will apply the filter to the district's data. The results are displayed under **Final Data** once it's done processing. Filters can take up to 24 hours to apply, depending on the size of the district data set.

  
![Filter shared data screen with step one shown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004b4D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005SemS)

###   
**Tips and best practices for sharing rules**

If you select **Our data agreement requires more granular data sharing** in step two of the data filter setup, you'll select the data your app needs using sharing rules. **Sharing rules** allow you to select specific data using rules, such as all students in a given grade, subject, course name, etc.  
  
![Data filter screen with Set Custom Rules section](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004b4D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005SemN)  
_An example of an App Filter set up using sharing rules._   
  
Here are some tips when using sharing rules:

-   You can include and/or exclude subsets of data. Data can be excluded by selecting the **is not one of** modifier.
-   For values, you can either type in any value you’d like, or use it as a search bar to find and click on the value you want. Some values will not be available in a dropdown as the district has not authorized an application to see them.
-   If you’d like to filter down a rule further, you can select the **\+ AND** option to add new criteria. This will act as an "and" statement, rather than an "or" statement.
    -   Example Rule with Filters: Share all sections located at Pineapple Elementary School AND their section grade level is 1 AND the section name must contain the text "homeroom".
-   Once you have finished creating your first rule, you can click **Add Rule** to add more rules.
-   When you have multiple rules, the two rules don’t interact with each other. This means if you want to build off the existing rule, you'll want to add a filter to the rule itself, rather than create a new rule entirely. See the example below that shows two separate rules:
    -   "Share all sections where grade is one of 6, 7, 8.”
    -   Also, "Match all staff where school is Pineapple Elementary.”

**![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)Please note:** Only one filter can be placed _per school_. If you need to further filter data for a school, please contact Clever Support, and our team will work with the district to adjust the initial data being shared to meet your specifications. 

* * *

## What do districts see when data is filtered?

If an app-side filter is applied to a district, they will see an **App Filters** tab in the application area of the Clever Dashboard. Here they can view:

-   **Shared Data**: the data shared with the application by the district.
-   **Filters**: the filters that were applied to the district data by the application.
-   **Application Receives:** the resulting filtered data that will be synced by the application. 

![Application profile with Filters section highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004b4D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xbuQ)  
 

* * *

## FAQs

**Why is Clever unable to display a preview of allowed records?**  
  
![Screenshot of a preview filter](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004b4D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TrlS)  
 

-   Clever may be unable to provide a preview of allowed records for districts with large data sets or highly complex rules. When this occurs, **Unable to display count of allowed records** or **Sorry, there is too much data…** may display. However, you may still safely save your app filters, and they will be applied as intended.

**Can I filter data for a district if they have [app sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607) enabled?**

-   Yes! You can still filter data even if they have paused their sync to your app.

title: For App Partners: Setting Up License Usage Limits
text:
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001tqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286H3)**Please note:** Licensing only applies to Secure Sync applications. This feature is not available for SSO only applications.

  
The licensing feature makes it possible for you to set license limits and to communicate more effectively with school districts about the number of licenses that they are using. This can help to prevent data oversharing and confusion about license limits!  
 

## Setting Up License Limits and Expiration Dates

Licenses can be set on a district's overview page or when approving a district connection request. The approval email that is sent to the requestor will include information about the number of available licenses.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001tqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286H8)  
 

Once the expiration date for a set of licenses passes, you and the relevant district will see a small alert on your Clever Dashboards. No other changes will result from the expiration.  
 

## Filtering and Viewing Districts Based on Licenses Exceeded or Expired

You can also view and filter districts in your app developer dashboard, based on whether the available licenses have been exceeded or expired.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001tqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286HI)  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001tqT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286HN)**Please note:** it is only possible to set license limits based on the number of **students or schools.** Be sure to set an expiration date if you want the licenses to expire after a set period of time!

-   The licensing feature does not restrict a district from exceeding their licenses when they set data sharing rules. This feature makes it easier to manage and communicate with districts about licenses, but it does not limit how many students or schools can be shared.

title: For App Partners: Manage inbound district requests
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806167#overview)  
2\. [Approve a request](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806167#approve_a_request)  
3. [Decline a req](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806167#header3)[uest](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806167#header3)  
4\. [Monitor pending requests](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806167#monitor_pending_requests)  
5\. [Launch dates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806167#launch_dates)

## Overview

In the Clever Dashboard, the Districts Overview page displays an alert if your application has new requests from districts that would like to connect through Clever.  
 

![Screenshot of District Overview page on Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044XxZ)

By clicking on _Invited Districts_, you can view more details about these recent requests. District requests are divided into three types:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286GK)

-   **Sales Lead**: These districts may not already use your app, but are interested in connecting through Clever.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286GP)    

-   **Existing Customer**: These districts already use your app and have requested to connect through Clever.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286GZ)

-   **Free Trial Request**: This district is interested in a free trial of your app.

  
By clicking on _Invited Districts_, you can view more details about the districts that _you_ have invited to connect with Clever. See our article about [Finding and connecting with districts](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215120718)  for more information.  
  
You can also click on the district name to view information about that district, as well as a district contact:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Ge)  
 

## Approve a request

Once you are ready to start receiving data from a district, you can approve their request. The district will need to set sharing permissions for your application if they haven't already.

## Decline a request

If you decide not to integrate a district via Clever, click the _Decline Request_ button to remove the request from your dashboard. This will send an email to the district with a message explaining the reason you are rejecting the request. This message is required in the message box when you reject a request.  
 

If you are unsure whether or not you will be using Clever to integrate with the district, we recommend that you neither approve nor decline the request until you've settled on next steps.  
 

## Monitor pending requests

You can view and filter through your Pending Requests on the District Overview page:  
 

#### ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Go)

## Launch Dates

Districts are able to request applications for a future date. That way they can set sharing permissions in preparation for going live. You can set the launch date in your application dashboard by clicking on the hyperlinked district name under Pending Requests on the District Overview page. You are able to insert a date to launch for the district or choose Launch now if you want the district to immediately go live:   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Gj)  
 

**On the District Overview page you can filter and order districts based on their launch dates:**  
 

![Screenshot of the District Overview page on the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002uan&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062sKF)
