title: For App Partners: Adding internal notes to your districts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001061583#overview)  
2\. [Adding an internal note](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001061583#adding)  
3\. [Viewing notes from your homepage](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001061583#homepage)  
4\. [Adding notes to districts that aren't yet connected](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001061583#not-connected)

## Overview

Application partners can leave internal notes on districts in the Clever dashboard. This is helpful for noting any special aspects for that district. These notes are viewable by your colleagues but not the district.

* * *

## Adding an internal note

To add an internal note, navigate to a district's [profile page](https://apps.clever.com/districts/district-profile), click **Add District Note**, in the District Info section, then write your note!  
 

![Animated gif showing how to add a note to a district's account](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003Ain&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286FM)

To edit a note, just click the small pencil icon next to the district note header, insert the updated text, and click save. You'll notice that whenever you update a note, the fields beneath the note, "Last Updated By" and "Last Updated," are updated to reflect the most recent editor and the time that the editing was done. 

## ![Animated gif showing how to edit a note to a district's account](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003Ain&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Fb)

* * *

## Viewing notes from your homepage

Once you create a note on a district, a note icon will appear next to the district's name on your home page. The same icon will also appear for all the other people who have access to your team's Clever account.   
 

 ![Screenshot of list of districts with arrow pointing to note icon for one district](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003Ain&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004Wsnl) 

  
 

* * *

## Adding notes to districts that aren't yet connected

District notes work with districts that you aren't connected with too! Navigate to any district in your "Pending Requests" or "Invited Districts" tabs to try it out:  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003Ain&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BFGc)

title: For App Partners: Updating my email preferences
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001188006#Overview)  
2. [Instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001188006#Instructions)

##   
Overview

Application partners have the ability to edit their email preferences in Clever in order to manage which communications they will receive related to district connections. Application email preferences do not include marketing emails from Clever!

##   
Instructions

To update your email preferences, follow these steps:

### Step 1:

From the application dashboard, click on your name in the top right corner and select 'Email Settings'.

![Red arrow pointing to email settings link from dropdown menu](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000QluP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y7gb)

### Step 2:

Update your email preferences as desired. A category of emails will be disabled if 'Disabled' appears as white text with a blue background.  
  
There are five types of email options that can be enabled or disabled:

1.  **Sharing:** Notifications are sent when districts change their data sharing permissions
2.  **Connected districts:** Notifications are sent when a connection to a district is updated (ex. if a district disconnects your application, you will receive a notification about it)
3.  **Requests and invite changes:** Notifications about status updates on your requests and invitations to districts
4.  **Requests and invite initiations:** Notifications about new requests from districts
5.  **Disconnects:** Notifications about districts disconnecting from your app 

![Email preferences toggles with save button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka01P000000QluP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZgfN)

### Step 3:

**Select 'Save'** to save your updated email preferences.

title: For App Partners: How can I manage my account?
text:
This article contains information regarding the following two sections of the Settings tab in your application's Clever dashboard:  
1\. [General](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026500832#General)  
2\. [Instant Login](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026500832#InstantLogIn)

  
Account team members with Administrator privileges are able to edit their account settings from within the Clever Dashboard. This can mean anything from editing your account name to accessing your API credentials.

## General

### Profile Settings

Here’s a quick overview of what you can do from your Clever Dashboard in the Settings tab under the General view:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286C8)

Use this view to manage and edit your:  
 

-   **_Name:_** This is the display name your application will have in our Application Gallery and what is used when districts search to add your application from the district dashboard.
-   **_Description:_** This description will display along with your application name in the district dashboard when a district searches for and adds your application.
-   **_Categories:_** Select which categories your application falls under. This information can be used by districts to filter by when searching for applications in the district dashboard.
-   **_Shortname:_** This name will be appended to the district signup URL.
-   **_Website URL:_** This URL should take users straight to the main page for your application’s homepage/main login screen.
-   **_District Signup URL:_** This URL can be distributed to districts who are interested in adding your application through Clever - it will take them directly to the screen within their district dashboard which will allow them to add it.
-   **_Alternate Names:_** Add any alternate names which can be used by districts to search for your application from the district dashboard.
-   **_Support Contact:_** Provide contact information for the go-to person to reach out to regarding support issues. Note: This contact information will be viewable to Clever Support and to District Admins and School Tech Leads if they use Clever's Troubleshoot Login Tool and the login issue is determined to likely be an app issue.

###   
API Credentials

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286CS)  
These API credentials are used to access our API. [View our Postman collection here](https://www.postman.com/clever-pe/developer-collections/overview?sideView=agentMode). You can also generate a new client secret for these credentials from this screen.

###   
Image Settings

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286AI)

View your current application icon and logo which is visible to districts when they search for and add your application. If you would like to change either of these, please open a ticket with [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).

###   
Additional Info

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286D6)

View information on the current data resource types your application is scoped to view when accessing district data via our API explorer. Please contact [integrations@clever.com](mailto:integrations@clever.com) if you would like to adjust these scopes or add additional ones.

## Instant Login

View and edit your [Instant Login settings](https://apps.clever.com/settings/instant-login) to customize the SSO experience for your districts.

###   
Website Settings

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286DQ)

**_Redirect URIs:_** When districts click on your application’s icon, they will be taken to the URL specified here. You can add multiple redirect URIs based on what your application’s integration finds necessary, but users using the Clever Portal flow to log into your application will be taken to the first URL listed.

###   
Additional Settings

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286DV)

**_Supported User Types:_** Adjust which user types can log into your application using the Clever Portal. There are 4 user types total: district admins, school admins, teachers, and students.  
 

If you have any additional questions on how to manage your application using the Clever dashboard, please don't hesitate to open up a ticket with [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)!

title: For Teachers: Why did I receive an email from Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004188#header1)  
2\. [Why did I receive a "Your accounts are ready to use" email from Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004188#header2)  
3\. [How do I access my new apps?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004188#header3)  
4\. [I don't know my username/password!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004188#header4)

## Overview

This article discusses some common scenarios in which a teacher may receive an email from Clever. Please reach out to our support team if you have any questions about emails received from Clever not discussed below.  
 

* * *

## Why did I receive a "Your accounts are ready to use" email from Clever?

When your school organization gives you access to a new application through Clever, we email you a summary of the apps newly available to you and your students. You can find these new apps in your Clever Portal and log in right away! Consider our email a virtual invitation to start using your new apps. To learn more about how teachers use Clever, [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222633468).

* * *

##   
How do I access my new apps?

You can access your new apps by logging in to your Clever Portal. The email should have a "Get Started" link which brings you to your school organization's Portal. Enter your username and password to log in to Clever, and click on any app to access your account. Be sure to bookmark the link to your Clever Portal so you can easily find it again!

* * *

##    
I don't know my username/password!

First, we recommend reading [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648), which covers how to log into the Clever portal as a teacher. You can also reach out to your administrator -- they'll usually be listed on the "Login Help" page of your portal, and their email address is in the email you received.

title: For Teachers: How do I create a Clever account?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025400151#header1)  
2\. [How do I create a Clever account for myself or my students?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025400151#header2)  
3\. [I already have a teacher account in Clever. How can I have admin privileges?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025400151#header3)

## Overview

We're excited to hear that you're interested in using Clever! Student, teacher, and staff accounts are created when your school organization syncs information into Clever from your Student Information System (SIS). Your school organization's administrator manages this process. Clever Support is not authorized to create accounts for users in your school organization manually.  
 

* * *

## How do I create a Clever account for myself or my students?

If you are a teacher and want access to your school organization's Clever account, **you will need to contact your District Administrator**. They can ensure that your teacher account is created through the sync from the SIS or manually within Clever.

If you'd like your students to have access to Clever accounts, you should also contact your District Administrator.

If your school organization doesn't have a Clever account, your District Administrator or technology staff can [sign up for one](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202083506) at no cost.

* * *

## I already have a teacher account in Clever. How can I add admin privileges?

If you already have a teacher account in Clever, but you'd like to have admin privileges, **please contact your District Administrator.** Clever Support cannot change these permissions for your account.  
 

* * *

title: For Teachers: Clever Academy - Learn more about Clever!
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023293231#Header1)  
2. [Learning topics for teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023293231#topics)  
3\. [How can teachers access Clever Academy?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023293231#Header2)  
4\. [How can I review my courses or print my certification?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023293231#viewingcert)

##   
Overview

Clever Academy is our free online training and certification program for educators. You can access it through your Clever Portal or at [clever.academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=teacher). 

We offer a variety of courses based on your background and need. Check out the video, below, for more info.

##   

* * *

## Learning topics for Teachers

### Clever Certified Champion courses

If you'd like to become a Clever Certified Champion Teacher, complete Levels 1-4. Learn more about these below.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** For the certification path (levels 1-4), you must begin at Level 1, though you can test out of courses if you have the prerequisite knowledge. All other courses can be completed in any order!  

###   
**Course outline:**

[Level 1: Getting started with Clever](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers/level-1-getting-started-with-clever?user_type=teacher)  
In this course, learn what you need to know to get started with Clever, including an overview of what Clever can do to make your life easier!   
  
Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 1. This course is a prerequisite to Level 2 and beyond. 

[Level 2: Learning the basics](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers/level-2-helping-your-students?user_type=teacher)  
In this course, you'll learn how to help students access Clever and their learning applications, along with handy troubleshooting tips.   
  
Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 2. This course is a prerequisite to Level 3 and beyond. 

[Level 3: Setting up your portal](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers/level-3-master-classroom-management?user_type=teacher)  
Clever can help you set up and manage your digital classroom! Discover the hidden gems of the Clever platform with these time-saving tools.  
  
Complete this course and you’ll earn a badge for Level 3. This course is a prerequisite to Level 4 and beyond.

[Level 4: Master classroom management](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers/level-4-setting-up-your-portal?user_type=teacher)  
In this final level, you'll dig into Clever's fanciest features to help you master classroom management. From communicating with students and families to monitoring edtech usage!  
  
Complete this course and you’ll be a certified Clever Champion Teacher!

### Quick Start Guides

[Quick start - Get going with Clever (for teachers)](https://clever.academy/quick-start-teachers)   
This course is for teachers who are new to Clever and don’t have much immediate time to deep dive into all there is to know.

[Quick start videos for teachers](https://clever.academy/quick-start)   
Only have a few minutes to learn about Clever? Here are some short videos to get you on your way! When you're ready to earn your official Clever certification, start the certification track by enrolling in Level 1: Getting started with Clever

### Product Spotlights

[Product Spotlight: Build your digital classroom with Teacher Pages](https://clever.academy/product-spotlight-building-culture-in-your-classroom-with-teacher-pages)

This lesson gives you the low-down on teacher pages.[](https://clever.academy/product-spotlight-building-culture-in-your-classroom-with-teacher-pages)

[Product Spotlight: Using Class Analytics to support students](https://clever.academy/product-spotlight-using-class-analytics-to-support-students)  
This lesson will show you how to use Class Analytics with your students!

### Trainer

[Clever Trainers for Teachers](https://clever.academy/clever-trainers-for-teachers)  
Everything you need to lead an in-person or virtual training at your school!

* * *

## How can I access the Clever Academy?

Teachers can access the Clever Academy by logging into the Clever Portal with their district-specific URL or directly going to [clever.academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=teacher). 

* * *

## How can I review my courses or print my certification?

You can see the courses you've registered for or completed at any time by navigating to [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/), clicking person icon in the top right, and selecting My Profile. From here, you'll see a list of all your learning paths and courses. Any course with a certification that you've completed will have a **View certificate** link next to it. Click the link to view the certificate, and then print it if you'd like! Certificates are valid for two years.  If it has been more than two years since you completed a course, you would need to re-take the course to become re-certified.

title: For Teachers: What's Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222633468#header1)  
2\. [How you can use the Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222633468#header2)  
3. [Why Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222633468#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/222633468#header4)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cI8n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Getting started with the Clever? Check out our course [**Clever Academy for Teachers: Level 1**](https://clever.academy/level-1-getting-started-with-clever?user_type=teacher) available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

Clever is your school’s digital learning hub, providing one friendly place for all your resources and instruction. It streamlines your digital classroom by giving you and your students one-click access to all your learning apps in one spot. Instead of spending the first 15 minutes of class troubleshooting logins, Clever handles the technical hurdles so you can focus on teaching. Clever is so much more than a list of favorite apps or a bookmark bar; it does the work behind the scenes to ensure that your classes are always accurately rostered and student accounts are automatically created in those applications.

This article will provide you with details on what Clever is and how it simplifies your digital teaching experience.

* * *

## How you can use the Clever Portal

The Clever Portal is more than just a landing page; it’s a powerful toolkit designed to help you organize your instruction and support your students in real-time all while keep everyone’s data safe. By customizing your Teacher Page and utilizing built-in tools, you can turn the Portal into your classroom’s digital headquarters. Learn more about the various features of the Clever Portal below.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cI8n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000gU0f7)  Clever Tip:** Some features are optional and may be turned on or off by your Clever Admin. These are noted below by the tag (Managed by your Clever Admin). If you have questions, please reach out to your IT team directly. 

##   

###   
**Teacher Pages**

You can use Teacher Pages to create a personalized environment for your students. Since Clever automatically keeps your class lists up to date behind the scenes, you can spend your time customizing the experience rather than managing rosters. You can:

-   Organize apps your school org uses into custom categories like "Math Small Group" or "Morning Choice."
    
-   Add external links to helpful websites, YouTube videos, or Google Drive files.
    
-   Link your **LMS** assignments directly on your Teacher Page so students have one starting point for their entire day.
    
-   Share specific pages with different groups of students to differentiate instruction effortlessly.
    

### **Classroom Analytics**

Ever wonder if your students are actually logging into their assigned programs? **Teacher Analytics** gives you a window into student engagement. You can see exactly which students have logged in and which apps they’re using. This is especially helpful for monitoring independent work or checking in on student progress during remote learning days.

###   
**Backup login codes**

If a student forgets their password or loses their physical Badge, you don't have to wait for the IT department to save the day. You can generate a 20-minute "backup login code" directly from your Teacher Portal. This temporary code gives the student immediate access so they don't miss a minute of instruction while you work on a permanent fix.  
  

### **Support for Substitutes (managed by your Clever Admin)**

Planning for a sub shouldn't involve writing down 30 different passwords. With Substitute Access, you can generate a special Badge or login for a guest teacher. This allows them to access the resources they need to keep your classroom running smoothly without compromising your personal account security.

### **Clever Badges (managed by your Clever Admin)**

For younger learners or students who struggle with typing, we offer Clever Badges. These are physical codes that students simply hold up to their device's camera to log in instantly. It’s a game-changer for early elementary and special education classrooms where typing a complex username can be a major barrier to learning. Badge settings are managed by your Clever Administrator. If you have questions, please reach out to your IT team.

### **Clever Library (managed by your Clever Admin)**

Clever Library gives you a safe, streamlined way to discover and try new digital learning tools for your classroom. With built-in data privacy protections, you can confidently explore apps knowing only the minimum necessary student information is shared. When you install a Library app, Clever automatically creates and rosters accounts with SSO, so your students can start learning right away with no extra setup required. It’s an easy way to expand your instructional toolkit while staying aligned with your school’s privacy and security policies.

### **Password and Security Management (managed by your Clever Admin)**

In many school organizations, teachers have the power to reset student passwords or void and regenerate a lost Badge directly from their roster. This self-serve approach keeps the control in your hands and keeps your students learning.

* * *

## Why Clever?

We know how much time it takes to manage a dozen different digital tools, and how critical it is to keep your student data private and secure while doing it. Clever solves the issue of managing multiple usernames and passwords for students by using **Single Sign-On** (**SSO**), which is an authentication method that lets you and your students sign into all your connected apps with just one set of credentials, like your Google email and password. Once you're in the Clever Portal, you can launch apps like Newsela, Khan Academy, or IXL instantly. You’ve also got troubleshooting tools at your fingertips that help you resolve login issues right away, instead of having to file a support ticket with your IT team.

In addition to SSO, Clever offers the following benefits:

-   **Secure Sync Rostering**: Ensures you and your students have accounts in all of your applications and that classes are kept up-to-date in those apps.
    
-   **Clever LMS Connect:** For supported applications, Clever can help automatically sync assignment grades back to your Learning Management System (LMS) such as Schoology, Google Classroom or Canvas.
    
-   **Additional teacher tools:** Classroom analytics, backup login codes, and password management options.
    

Clever doesn't replace the tools you already love; it makes them easier to reach. If you use a **Learning Management System** (**LMS**), such as Schoology, Google Classroom, or Canvas, Clever is the perfect partner. Think of Clever as the secure front door to your digital school and your **LMS** as the virtual classroom where the work happens. Clever works alongside your LMS to ensure every student has the right access at the right time.

Don’t have an LMS? No worries! Clever is the perfect spot for building out a virtual classroom with [Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323).

Clever also helps your IT and administrative team with account management, ensuring your students have access when they need it. Clever connects your school’s **SIS** (**Student Information System**) with your school organization’s learning applications to simplify the process of creating accounts in learning applications.

This process, called rostering, automatically creates student accounts and adds them to the correct digital programs based on your current class lists. If a new student joins your class, as long as your school’s SIS is updated, the student will automatically get their accounts created in learning applications.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**How do I sign up for Clever?**

-   Your school organization manages Clever accounts at the administrative level through its **Student Information System** (**SIS**). Since accounts are automatically created from school org data, you usually don't need to sign up. If you don't have access yet, reach out to your IT department.
    

**What should I do if a student can’t log in?**

-   First, try generating a backup login code from your Teacher Portal. If they use Badges, ensure the camera is clean, and the Badge isn't folded. If the issue persists, your school organization’s tech support is the best point of contact.
    

**Can I use Clever on an iPad or a home computer?**

-   Yes! Clever works on any device with a web browser. On iPads, we recommend using the Clever app, which fully supports Badge scanning for easy logins at home.
    

**How do I add a new app to my Teacher Page?**

-   Click the "Add" button on your Teacher Page to search for apps in the Clever Library. You can also add "Links" to any website that doesn't have a dedicated Clever app.
    

**What if I don’t know how to use Clever?**

-   If you have a Clever account, check out our free online training, [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/page/course-catalog)! You can learn everything you need to know in our [Teacher Certification](https://clever.academy/path/clever-academy-for-teachers).
    

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Teachers: Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648)
    
-   [Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323)
    
-   [For Families: What’s Clever?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113708)

title: For App Partners: Create your Teacher Quickstart Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [What is a Teacher Quickstart Guide](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046090612#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [How do I create a Teacher Quickstart Guide](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046090612#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)  
3\. [Tips for creating an effective guide](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046090612#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)

##   
What is a Teacher Quickstart Guide

Library applications can create a Quickstart guide on Clever to help teachers feel confident about setting up your application. This proven format generates a 10% increase in user engagement with your application.

  
The structure of this guide was developed in response to teacher feedback: _the biggest barrier to using an app is finding the time and energy to get it set up._  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000CKJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gv)  
 

Once your Quickstart Guide is published in Clever, your app detail page will show a link that teachers can access anytime, and any teacher that installs your app from the Library will be notified and nudged to use your guide if they have not yet logged in and used your application. Sometimes, teachers just need a reminder and easy steps - and Clever is here to help with that!  
 

Teachers can immediately launch your application from the Quickstart Guide.  
 

## How do I create a Teacher Quickstart Guide

-   Log in to Clever
-   Navigate to Library > Teacher Quickstart Guide in your left hand navigation menu
-   To begin, first input _Account Syncing_ information. The answer is **yes** only if your application requires teachers to take an additional action after Clever sends your app the rostering data. Example actions:
    -   Teacher is required to click a button to ‘sync’  their class from Clever. 
    -   Teacher is required to upload or input their classes into the application
-   Fill out the following _How to use_ steps. Your application must fill out a minimum of 1 step, and can fill out a max of 3 steps. Note that there is a character limit per step to improve readability for teachers. 

## Tips for creating an effective guide

A successful Quickstart Guide is one that motivates teachers to launch the application and take the simple steps involved in setup. A less successful guide might contain accurate _Getting Started_ content, but may ultimately feel too complex for teachers to launch at that moment.   
 

Tips: 

1.  Avoid linking to your website’s help center articles instead of writing the essential content within Clever
2.  If you’re uploading screenshots for each step, indicate which button(s)/sections teachers need to engage with, using arrows, callout boxes, etc.

title: For App Partners: Clever’s API change policy
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050157812#Overview)  
2\. [Switching to a new API version](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050157812#SwitchingNewVersion)  
3\. [Releasing a new API version](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050157812#ReleasingNewAPI)  
4\. [Deprecating an existing API version](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050157812#DepricatingExistingVersion)

##   
Overview

Clever is committed to providing the best experience for developers building on our platform. In order to make it easier and faster to build on Clever, we constantly improve by adding new features and deprecating ones that are redundant. Here’s what to expect from Clever when we make changes to our API.  
 

## Switching to a new API version

As of Back to School 2021, you will need to set the major version (e.g. v1, v2) that you will be using in production. If you are moving between major versions in production, please reach out to our [Partner Engineering team](mailto:integrations@clever.com) to ensure a smooth transition.

  
Within a major version, you can freely make calls against any associated minor version (for example, you could use both 2.0 and 2.1, but not 3.0) by updating your URLS (e.g. [https://api.clever.com/v2.1/district](https://api.clever.com/v2.1/district)). 

  
For detailed information on changing API versions, check out our developer documentation on [Upgrading to the latest version of Clever’s API.](https://dev.clever.com/docs/migrating-to-api-30#teachers-staff-district-admins)

###   
Major vs minor versions

We define a minor release as one that will only add new features (e.g. response fields, input parameters, endpoints, etc) and fix small bugs. Minor versions will be backwards compatible.

  
Major version releases may contain features that are not backwards compatible as well as feature deprecations.  
 

## Releasing a new API version

Clever is committed to releasing planned API versions no more than once a year, based on the following release timeline:  
 

-   New API versions will be announced by November. 
-   Rostering (data and events) API versions should be released by December. 
-   Identity API changes should be released by March. 

  
Any delay in this timeline will be communicated to customers in advance. In case of an emergency, Clever reserves the right to release an API version outside of this schedule to meet customer needs with proactive communications to partners. 

  
When a new version is fully released, new applications will build to the newest API version, and will not be able to use any previous version of the API.

###   
Updating versions after release

While we consider new versions code complete upon official release, we recognize that bugs can slip by our testing processes! For three months after a version is released, we will make updates to the version to fix any discovered bugs. Once three months have passed, we will freeze the version as-is and make no further updates.

###   
Global changes

We sometimes need to make changes to all API versions - if we do, we will communicate this with partners as soon as possible.  
 

## Deprecating an existing API version

Clever will support no more than two major API versions at a time. This policy aligns with industry best practice to ensure a great front-end experience for you and your customers. This means that when a new major version is released, we will begin the deprecation and end of life process for the oldest major version.

  
We are committed to ensuring that deprecation goes smoothly for all customers. Therefore, the deprecation and end of life process is as follows:  
 

-   At least one year in advance of deprecation, Clever will send notice of deprecation to all partners. We will also reach out to partners who are using the API version to help determine their upgrade path and timeline.
-   Once an API version is deprecated, Clever will provide only limited support for bug fixes.
-   An API version will no longer be supported six months after it is deprecated. At this point, applications will be unable to access any of the version’s endpoints.

  
Upon announcement of API v3, we are officially beginning the deprecation and end of life process for API v1, which includes both v1.1 and v1.2. The version will be deprecated by **Back to School June 2022** and no longer accessible by **December 2022.**

title: For App Partners: Billing FAQs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#overview)  
2. [How does Clever bill app partners?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#HowDoesCleverBill)   
3. [What counts as a billable school?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#WhatCountsBillableSchool)  
4. [What is the billing frequency for app partners?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#HowOftenAmIBilled)  
5. [When do I start getting billed for a school or user?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#StartBilling)  
6\. [How can I view the number of billed schools or users?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#WhenCheck)  
7. [What do I do if a school organization overshares data?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#WhatHappenTooMuchData)  
8\. [What tools can I use to manage data sharing?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#tools1)  
     •[Using licensing to monitor sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#tools2)  
     •[Applying app-side filters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#tools3)  
     •[Recommending sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#tools4)  
     •[Modifying launch dates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#tools5)  
9. [I see schools shared with apparently no teachers, students, or sections. Why might this be happening?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#NoData)  
10\. [What if there are discrepancies between school data in Clever and MDR data?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000508126#WhatIfDescrep)

## Overview

This article contains frequently asked billing questions. The answers to these questions will vary depending on the terms of your current contract. Most contracts follow the same general structure, but reach out to [accounts-receivable@clever.com](mailto:accounts-receivable@clever.com) with any questions.

* * *

## How does Clever bill app partners?

Clever bills by billable schools or users shared depending on your contract. For questions, [contact support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport).  
 

* * *

##   
What counts as a billable school?

We only charge for schools that are explicitly shared and launched.  
  
**Explicitly shared:** This excludes any schools that are shared via dually enrolled users. For example, student X is enrolled in classes at both Clever Middle School and Clever High School. Clever Middle School is shared with your application, but Clever High School isn't. We'll provide access to both school objects via the API, but will only bill for Clever Middle School.   
  
**Launched:** We only bill for launched connections, giving you time to test and get set up! Read more about setting launch dates [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005704686).

* * *

##   
What is the billing frequency for app partners?

App partners are billed annually upfront. If you go over your contracted amount, Clever will send an invoice for the overage and a "top-up" to cover your estimated usage for the rest of the contract term.

The top-up is calculated based on your most recent month of usage, multiplied by the number of months remaining on your contract.

For example, a customer purchases 600 connections for a 12-month term. In June 2025, they used 650 connections during the first 6 months of their contract, which is 50 over their limit. Since they're on pace to keep using more, we project that usage (150 connections/month) forward for the remaining 6 months of the contract.

Overage: 50 connections  
Projected future use: 150 × 6 = 900 connections  
Total top-up: 950 connections × $100/connection = $95,000

* * *

##   
When do I start getting billed for a school or user?

You're billed for any schools or users shared through **launched** school organization connections on the last day of the month that haven't been filtered out from within your Clever Dashboard. If a school is connected midway through the month, you will still be charged full price for that school for the rest of the month.

* * *

##   
How can I view the number of billed schools or users?

View the number of schools or users you’ll be billed for any given month on the **Billing** tab of your Clever dashboard.  
  
In the billing tab, you can select a billing period by selecting **Billing period as of**.

-   This is updated nightly.
-   This data represents the total number of shared schools and users in launched school organization connections.
-   The number excludes any schools or users you’ve filtered out from within your Clever dashboard.  
-   Schools or users who have been shared multiple times are counted only once for billing purposes.

From the billing tab, you can:

1.  Change the billing period to see what you were billed for in previous months.
2.  Request to have a CSV emailed to you for all of the schools or users you're currently being billed for, to keep for your records.

* * *

##   
What do I do if a school organization overshares data?

Use the billing tab to check the number of schools each connected school organization shares with your application via Clever. We recommend checking the tab monthly to avoid any over-sharing issues before your monthly invoice.

If a school organization shares too much data, there are two ways to remedy this.

1.  Reach out to the school organization to request that they [adjust their sharing settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) so that the appropriate amount of data is shared with your application. If the school org needs assistance, they can submit a ticket to our Support Team [via the Help Center form](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
2.  You can also use the application-side filtering tool to remove excess data from the API. Any schools filtered out using this tool will also be removed from all future invoices. For more information on how to filter excess data, please see this article: [Creating filters for school organization data.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003249203)

Finally, you can use our License feature to flag school organizations that are oversharing, so that you can check this programmatically in your Clever Dashboard. For more information on how to set up licenses for a school organization in your dashboard please see this article: [Setting Up License Usage Limits](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003921667). 

* * *

##   
What tools can I use to manage data sharing?

We have a few tools that help surface when a school organization shares too much data with your application.   
 

### Using licensing to monitor sharing

The first is the licensing feature. This feature allows you to set the number of school or student licenses a school organization has purchased for your application. If a school org exceeds the number of licenses, you and the school org will be notified in the Clever dashboard. For more information on the licensing feature, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003921667).

### Applying app-side filters

Applications can create filters to receive only the data they need, giving you control over data sharing and enhancing integration quality. For instructions on setting up filters, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003249203).

### Recommending sharing permissions 

Smarter data sharing lets you recommend sharing settings to school organizations connected to your app. You can send updated recommendations even after school orgs have enabled data sharing with you. [This article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046189771#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b) covers how to send sharing recommendations to a school organization.

### Modifying launch dates

As mentioned above, you are only charged for launched connections. If a school org isn't ready to launch, you can modify the launch date to be further into the future until they are set up to begin using the application. This will allow them to set sharing permissions, resolve data quality errors, and complete all their steps on the school org end before you begin getting billed for the shared data. More information about setting launch dates can be found here: [For App Partners: Managing school organization launch dates](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005704686?language=en_US).

* * *

##   
I see schools shared with apparently no teachers, students, or sections. Why might this be happening?

We provide access to schools that aren't explicitly shared with your application for users who are associated with multiple schools in Clever. As a result, you might see a school with very limited teacher, section, and student data. You aren't billed for schools not explicitly shared with your application via Clever.  

* * *

##   
What if there are discrepancies between school data in Clever and MDR data?

You're invoiced based on the number of unique schools shared with your application via Clever. ‘Shared schools’ is defined by the total number of unique Clever IDs available to your application via the API, not by the total number of unique MDR numbers. This data doesn't always align perfectly with MDR data, depending on how the school organization has structured its schools in their SIS.   

* * *

  
Need help? For more information, refer to your contract or reach out to [accounts-receivable@clever.com](mailto:accounts-receivable@clever.com)

title: For App Partners: How do I add and manage account team members?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Adding team members](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218547498#Overview)  
2\. [Managing team member permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218547498#Managing%20team%20member%20permissions)  
3\. [Managing Individual Profile Settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218547498#Managing%20Individual%20Profile%20Settings)  
4\. [Recommended Permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218547498#Recommended%20Permissions)

## Adding team members

The [Team](https://apps.clever.com/squidword-dev/team) tab in your Clever Dashboard lists all users currently set up as administrators. Only team members with **Admin** privileges can add new team members.  
  
To add new team members, navigate to the **Team** page and select **Add Team Member.**  Enter the required details and select the desired user permissions. Click **Save.** The user will receive an email to activate their account and set a password.  
  

Activation emails are valid for 30 days. If a user does not activate their account within the first 30 days, the pending user must be deleted and their account recreated. 

![Example app team page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZM45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000fX2Rd)

* * *

##   
Managing team member permissions

To adjust, add, or remove permissions for a team member’s account, click the pencil icon underneath **Actions** to the right of the team member’s name.  
  
You can toggle permissions from this screen to best suit the team member’s needs.  

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZM45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNRK)

-   **Administrator:** Administrators can edit team settings and receive email notifications when connected school organizations change their sharing settings.
-   **Application Settings:** This allows this user to update your app's settings, such as the name or redirect URIs.
-   **Application Secrets:** **Can Edit** allows this user to reset the client secret for your app.
-   **Can disconnect school organizations:** This allows this user to disconnect school organizations that your app is connected to with Clever.
-   **School organization Requests + Invitations:** **Can Edit** allows this user to accept or reject inbound requests from school organizations and to invite schools to connect using Search.
-   **Data Browser + User Search:** This allows the user to access the Data Browser and User Search pages in their dashboard. It also allows this user to log into your app using the Instant Login Testing tool.

* * *

##   
Managing Individual Profile Settings

To make adjustments to your individual profile, such as editing your name or email address, click your name in the top-right corner of the page.

### Profile Settings

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZM45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNRP)

**Profile Settings** allow you to edit your name, email, and phone number, in addition to changing your password and enabling two-factor authentication for your account.  
 

Email Settings

![AppEmailPreferences.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZM45&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004XAtr)

**Email Settings** allow you to adjust which email notifications you receive from Clever when there are updates to your school orgs or your accounts.  
 

* * *

Recommended Permissions

title: For App Partners: What is single sign-on (SSO)?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#Overview)  
2. [How does single sign-on (SSO) work?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#HowSSOWork)  
3\. [How do users log into the IdP?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#HowUsersLogin)  
4\. [Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#LoggingIntoClever)  
5\. [Logging in to your App](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#LoggingIntoApp)  
6\. [T](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#Troubleshooting)[roubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221208767#Troubleshooting)

## Overview

Single sign-on (SSO) allows students and teachers to log in to your application through Clever. This means that as an application partner, you support every Identity Provider (IdP) that Clever supports.

To implement school organization-managed Clever SSO, your application needs a Clever Complete agreement and should use SSO as part of a Rostering + SSO integration. 

* * *

##   
How does single sign-on (SSO) work?

While users may see logging into your application to Clever as one quick step, behind the scenes, single sign-on (SSO) actually consists of three separate logins:

-   A user logs in to Clever via the district's Identity Provider (IDP) (e.g. Active Directory, Google, etc.) from the Clever login page.
-   Clever authenticates the user through the district's IDP.
-   If the user is verified, Clever creates a "token" (i.e. a piece of data) that identifies the user and then logs them in successfully.
-   The user then clicks on the appropriate application icon to open an application, and Clever provides the user's token to the application which authenticates the user. This means the user does not need to enter login credentials a second time. 
-   The user is logged into the application successfully!

* * *

## How do users log into the IdP?

When users access the Clever Portal or an Instant Login Link, they’ll be taken to their district’s login page. When they click on one of the “Log in with <IdP>” buttons, they’ll be redirected to their identity provider to log in.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCHt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285WW)  
 

If users are already logged into their IdP, they will not need to log in again - they’ll skip right to the “Logging in with Clever” step.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCHt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Wb)**Please note:** If a district's IdP for Clever is LDAPS, a user is authenticated to Active Directory locally, and their district’s chosen identity provider is LDAPS, they will need to enter in their Active Directory credentials to log in to Clever. This is a limitation of the LDAP protocol.

### Can users skip the 'Log in with IdP' page?

Users can skip this page by appending

 ‘?skip’ 

to the end of the Clever Portal or Instant Login Link URL (ex. [https://clever.com/in/<shortname>?skip](https://clever.com/in/%3Cshortname%3E?skip)).  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCHt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Wg)**Please note:** The above is for districts with a single IdP. If a district has multiple IdPs, they should [contact Clever Support.](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)

* * *

## Logging in to Clever

Once the user is logged into their IdP, it will securely send a piece of identifying information to Clever and tells us what that data should match in our records. This is generally non-PII information such as student number, sis id, or email. More information on this can be found in [our article on Claims Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617).  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cCHt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Wl)**Please note:** The identifying information that we receive is never the users' IdP credentials.

* * *

## Logging in to your App

The user can then log in to your application by clicking on the icon in their Clever Portal (or if they’re using Instant Login links, they’ll automatically start the login process).  
 

Instant Login uses the OAuth2, an open standard for securely accessing information. Here’s how it works:  
 

1.  Clever redirects the user to a special URL for your application, along with a code.
2.  Your application automatically uses the code to ask Clever for a token that grants additional access to our API.
3.  Clever checks the code and the application credentials to make sure they are valid before returning an API token.
4.  Your application uses the API token to get basic information about the user - at the very least, it will get the district id, user Clever id, and user type.
5.  Depending on your implementation, your app may then search for the user in your existing database and/or provision an account for the user.

* * *

## Troubleshooting

While it looks simple to the end user, there’s definitely a lot of moving parts! For help with login issues, [check out our Troubleshooting Resources.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0wEWAS/supporting-your-districts?language=en_US)

title: For App Partners: Navigating the Clever Dashboard
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215800557#one)  
2\. [Search](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215800557#two)  
3\. [Profile and Email settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215800557#three)

## Overview

From the Clever application dashboard, you can review requests from districts, manage your existing accounts, and troubleshoot issues.  
 

![App Dashboard nav](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TAVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000DTsf6)

1.  **Home:** This will display an alphabetical list of the districts currently using your application. Next to the district you'll also see the day they connected, the last time they synced data to Clever, and the sync status of their account. You can also search for users or view a district's data warnings.
2.  **Clever Academy:** Here you can access our free online training and certification program, Clever Academy. Alternatively, users can go directly to Clever Academy here: [https://clever.academy](https://clever.academy/). 
3.  **Data Browser**: View and filter the data being shared with your application.
4.  **Analytics**: See how districts are using your application in the Analytics Overview page. This page aggregates login data from all of your active districts—find out what all the charts mean in this [article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218475117).
5.  **Dev Tools**: Here you can access the Instant Login Testing tool, the Certifications (Clever integrations) of your application, and the Matchmaker tool, where you can match up accounts from outside Clever to Clever's data. Instructions for using this can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215806767).
6.  **Library:** Create and manage your app’s Marketing Collateral, Teacher Quick start Guide, and access your Integration Guide; view and respond to teacher reviews; view app install and usage analytics. 
7.  **Settings**:
    -   General: Settings related to profile, image, and other configurations  
        Populate a District Outreach Contact that will be available to districts so they can efficiently contact your team for troubleshooting. Clever will also use this contact for school communications, such as app invites, sync requests, etc.  
        If you’d only like the contact to appear on direct communications, and not in the Clever Dashboard for Clever Admins, you can check the box for **Don’t show District Outreach Contact as a support option for districts.**
    -   Instant Login: Website, iOS, and additional settings. 
    -   Data Access: Settings related to which fields are available to your application via Clever’s API.
    -   District Setup: Set up global recommended sharing settings, add a message to districts who are setting up your app for the first time, enable safety thresholds, and request API V3 Migration CSVs.
8.  **Team**: The team page allows the account owner to add users to the application dashboard and gives them access to the available tools. You'll just need the name and the email for the user you're looking to add.
9.  **Billing**: The Billing tab is where you can check the number of schools each connected district is sharing with your application. We recommend looking at the tab monthly to get in front of any oversharing issues before your monthly invoice.  
    _NOTE: Your app must have a Secure Sync account to see this feature._
10.  **Clever Concierge:** Clever Concierge is our premium district onboarding service for partners implementing at scale. We’ll help you match your existing customers and quickly invite them to connect via Clever.   
     _NOTE: Your app must have a Secure Sync account to see this feature._  
      

## Search

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TAVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bg9Z)

1.  Search by district name, Clever ID, or MDR number to quickly find the district you're seeking.
2.  From a district page, use the Omnisearch bar to find a student, teacher, administrator, or section. You can use the ID number or name to find the specific record.

## Profile and Email settings

Note: These settings can be found in the upper right corner of the dashboard.

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TAVR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bg9e)

1.  **Profile Settings:** User information, change your password, two-factor authentication.
2.  **Email Settings:** Sharing rule updates, connected district changes, district requests.

title: For App Partners: Clever products overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Clever Secure Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218727678#CleverSecureSync)  
2\. [Clever Single Sign-on](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218727678#CleverSSO)  
3. [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218727678#CleverLibrary)  
4\. [Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218727678#LMS)  
5\. [Clever Complete](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/218727678#Complete)

  
Clever offers several products to both district and application partners, keep reading for more information!

##   

  
  

![Graphic of Clever app options for app partners](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000R4gqj)   
  
 

* * *

## Clever Secure Sync

![Screenshot of app data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m1Rt)

Clever's rostering solution allows your team to partner with any district, regardless of their SIS. By building one Secure Sync integration to Clever, you can be assured of clean and normalized district data with every district connection you make.  
 

Secure Sync cuts down on data errors with automatic data fixes and district requirements that are specific to your application. Districts use a powerful sharing interface to ensure only the data necessary for your program is coming through the API.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285W2) Learn more about [Secure Sync here!](https://clever.com/products/secure-sync)

* * *

## Clever Single Sign-on

![HC\_articles\_-\_Google\_Slides-10.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOwd)

  
Clever’s single sign-on (SSO) solution increases instructional time by getting students and teachers into all of their digital software and resources with one username and password. With Clever's simple OAuth 2 integration, you can leave the security concerns to Clever and bypass username and password provisioning. Instead, users can access your platform directly through Clever.  
 

Clever Badges are an added benefit for our SSO users that gives all students a unique and fun way to log in to your learning software—no typing necessary. Teachers don’t have to spend classroom time getting everybody set up, and with Clever's unique direct-device login for Google Chromebooks and Windows devices, even the youngest of learners can immediately start their lessons in your app without any help. For older students, Badges can also be paired with a 6-digit PIN to ensure additional security.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285WC) To learn more about the district experience with Clever Badges, check out the [Clever Badges section](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/sections/207412147-Clever-Badges) of the Help Center for districts!

* * *

## Clever Library  
  

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** After reviewing our Library application process, we’ve decided to pause acceptance of new applications for Clever Library certification at this time. If you have any questions, please reach out to [application-interest@clever.com](mailto:application-interest@clever.com). 

![Clever Library screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004xw8x)

  
The library is a resource available for partners with free, freemium, and free-trial versions of your product. The Library supports and empowers teacher-driven adoption of your product, and surfaces this adoption data to school and district administrators to better facilitate purchasing conversations.  
 

Users get to find and try your product organically, and you expand your network. If you already have a Single Sign-On integration, the developer time for the Library integration is quoted at about a week.  
 

For more information about Clever Library, reach out to [application-success@clever.com](mailto:application-success@clever.com). 

* * *

## Clever LMS Connect

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000S6yas)

Clever LMS Connect allows you to integrate with district LMSs through the Clever API, enabling assignments and gradebooks to flow seamlessly between your application and the district’s LMS. This saves teachers hours of time.

You can now fast track interoperability, making it simple and secure for schools to use your application directly from their LMS. With Clever LMS Connect, you can enable districts to easily sync and launch your application within their LMS.

For more information about Clever LMS Connect, connect with our team [here](https://www.getclever.com/lms-connect-contact/). 

* * *

## Clever Complete

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhxx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000S7uIH)

Simplify district and school data management into one system with Clever Complete. Clever Complete builds on Clever’s existing 1EdTech OneRoster® integrations, allowing you to automate rostering via OneRoster for any school—even those not using Clever.

We designed Clever Complete to replace the multiple integrations you manage with one secure, efficient solution. With Clever Complete, you get rostering, SSO, and LMS connections for any school through a single integration.

  
For more information about Clever Complete, [connect with our team](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup).

title: For App Partners: Upgrading API versions (V2 > V3.1)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051233111#overview)  
2\. [Benefits of upgrading](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051233111#header2)  
3\. [Timeline and transition overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051233111#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360051233111#FAQ)

##   
Overview

This article briefly overviews the benefits of utilizing Clever’s API V3.1 and the transition process.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5Yr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPNgb)   Please note:** You can upgrade to API V3.1 at any time **for no additional cost**! Fill out [our commit form here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfta36iHh3kB4y-IsvMTlSISO6eM4u5j5eAir_TB03-JVIyWQ/viewform) to let us know you're ready or contact your Application Success Manager at [application-success@clever.com](mailto:application-success@clever.com) for more information.

* * *

## Benefits of upgrading

With the release of Clever’s API v3 and now v3.1, there have been several updates to the API that benefit application partners. By upgrading from v2 to V3.1, you gain access to:

-   Support for multi-role users to streamline provisioning with a single Clever ID.
-   Richer staff data to enable access to all users who support student learning.
-   Improved student contact relationships
    -   Utilize a student relationships array, which details each contact’s relationships with any students in the district’s Student Information System (SIS).
    -   For example, if a contact is listed as a parent for two students and an aunt for another, they will have one Clever ID and three entries in the student\_relationships array.  
        
           **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e5Yr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPNgb)   Please note:** Clever has deprecated the API v2 contacts endpoint. If you require assistance, please contact Clever Support.
        
-   New content/resource mapping API
    -   This feature allows districts to indicate via the API which resources they want shared with courses, classes, and users.
-   Access to five new demographic data fields: Disability Status, Primary Disability Type, Section 504 Status, Gifted/Talented Status, and Home Language Code. For a complete summary of available new fields and the accepted field values, please see our [Dev Docs: What’s New in API v3.1](https://dev.clever.com/docs/whats-new-in-api-v31).
-   Access to [attendance data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001705).
-   Access to [Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001636). This integration extends our existing rostering capabilities and supports assignment and grade passback from your application through Clever into a district LMS.  
     

* * *

## Timeline and transition overview

The timeline for the transition from V2 to V3.1 varies from partner to partner based on your current setup. Some items that may impact the transition timeline include:

-   If you utilize V2 student contacts versus V3
-   User types and data points match or are similar to Clever’s data model
-   How you plan to handle multi-role users (i.e. a user who is both a staff and a teacher in Clever) moving forward. In V3 these users will have the same Clever ID, and roles will be listed on their user record on the API.
-   Your development team’s bandwidth

For more details on your transition process and timeline, please reach out to our team at [integrations@clever.com](mailto:integrations@clever.com) directly.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is the timeline to transition?**

-   This varies based on a number of factors regarding your current setup.
    

**What are the benefits of upgrading?**

-   You will be on the most current API version and gain access to a number of new data types. See the Benefits of upgrading section above for full details.
    

* * *

**Related Articles**

-   [For App Partners: Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001636)
