* * * ## What account type do I have? If you are unsure which account type, please reference the Clever URL after logging in to your account. Staff accounts will lead to a Clever URL that ends with **/staff/portal**. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI3V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000284mJ) If you are unsure whether you have a School Tech Lead or Portal Access account, please reference the top right corner of your screen after logging in.  - **Portal Access** will only see Portal after logging in to Clever. - **School Tech Leads** will see both the **Clever Dashboard _&_ Portal.**              ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI3V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000284mY) * * * ## Staff Permissions There are two primary roles for staff in Clever: **Portal Access:** - Non-teaching staff with the Portal Access role can log in to applications via single sign-on (SSO) from their Clever Portal but have no other permissions within Clever. Please note that applications must first be shared with staff by a Clever Admin. **School Tech Lead:** - [View usage metrics for their district & school](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020383911) (using the **Portal Analytics** tab in their dashboard). - [Modify sharing rules for an application](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020281091) for their associated school(s). - [Manage and print Clever Badges for their school or individual students and sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005209686).  - Manage and customize the Clever Portal on a per-school basis. - Create and manage [custom section data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923). **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI3V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Sharing rules modification must first be enabled on a per-application basis by a Clever Admin by selecting **School Site Sharing** in the sharing permissions for any needed applications. See [How do I enable School site sharing for School Tech Leads?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366?language=en_US)  for more detailed instructions.  **School Tech Lead users cannot:** - Request or add new applications - Change Student Information System settings - View troubleshooting logs - View or edit any Clever settings - Browse SIS data synced with Clever  - Add co-teachers to sections If you need assistance with these topics, [](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648)[please contact your tech support contact for more information.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648) [](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0vmWAC/school-tech-leads?language=en_US) * * * ## Creating or updating staff Clever accounts are managed by Clever Admins. If you are unsure if you have a Clever account or need to have an account created or updated, please reach out to your district's Tech Support Contact or help desk for assistance.   You can locate your district's Tech Support Contact information by selecting **Get help logging in!** from your district's Clever login page. In most cases, districts provide an email address, phone number, or instructions guiding users to the appropriate contact person or department for assistance. ![For\_Teachers\_\_Logging\_in\_to\_Clever.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dI3V&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BSVC) If you have any questions or need further assistance, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help! * * * **Related articles:** - [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663?language=en_US) - [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726?language=en_US) - [School Tech Lead Help Center Articles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/topic/0TO1P000000V0vmWAC/school-tech-leads?language=en_US)

title: For Staff: What is Clever?
text:
## What is Clever?

Clever is a secure pipeline between your district's data and the learning applications that you and your students use. We help your district's IT office provide applications with all the information they need to be seamlessly set up for your school.

Clever Single sign-on (SSO) allows users to log into applications with a single set of credentials, configured at the district level. With the ease of only one username and password, Clever can help teachers reclaim valuable class time. Students and teachers can open their devices, sign into the Clever Portal, and click on their connected applications to automatically access the online learning program!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000001oIv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Vi)**Clever Tip:** If you notice that data is missing or incorrect in Clever or one of your connected learning applications, you’ll want to [reach out to your district tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648) to verify that the data is syncing from your Student Information System (SIS) and included in the sharing permissions for the application. Clever is unable to make changes on the district's behalf.

## Who can sign up for Clever?

We recommend creating one Clever account for your school district that’s managed at the district level. In order to create and administer a Clever account, you need administrative access to your SIS and authority to sign Clever’s [Terms of Service.](https://clever.com/about/terms)

Examples of individuals with sufficient access to manage a Clever account include Chief Technology Officers, SIS/Database Managers, and other district IT Administrators. Non-teaching staff, such as Principals, typically do not have the access to the SIS that is needed to set up a Clever account, therefore we recommend reaching out to a colleague at the district level to create your district’s Clever account.

## How can I access my district's Clever account? 

If you’d like access to Clever as a non-teaching staff member, we encourage you to reach out to your district’s tech department. The Clever account owner must upload your non-teaching staff record to the Clever dashboard. If they need guidance in creating your non-teaching staff account, feel free to [pass on this article_._](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547)

title: For App Partners: District data Access
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000216886#Header1)  
2. [Setting up Data Access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000216886#Header2)  
3. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000216886#Header3)

##   
Overview

Data access allows you to select which fields are available to your application via Clever’s API. The feature helps districts audit the fields each of their connected applications ingests and ensures you and our other application partners only receive and sync data relevant to your integration. Only application partners with the Rostering (Secure Sync) integration should expect to see the "Data Access" settings in their App Dashboard. Learn more about app integration options with Clever [here](https://dev.clever.com/docs/integration-types).   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000006c7R&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**If your app requires fields outside of Clever's API, you can have them upload them as extension fields. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001493).

Data access is broken into two categories for sensitive records types:  
 

-   **Required:** Fields that are marked as required must be sent by the district to your application
-   **Optional:** Districts can select which optional fields they want to send to your application

  
For non-sensitive record types please select all fields that your application can ingest. Districts cannot opt out of sending these fields if they are included from their SIS to Clever. 

* * *

## Setting up Data Access

Start with your developer application! By setting and testing changes on your developer application, you can avoid any disruptions for your end users.  
 

1\. Navigate to the [**Data Access**](https://apps.clever.com/il-test-app/settings/data-access) tab under **Application Settings**. Here, you’ll see separate modules for each data type, with the option to edit both required and optional fields for sensitive data types and non-sensitive data types. 

![Screenshot of the Application Settings > Data Access page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000006c7R&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bg9y)

2\. Click **Edit Required** or **Edit Optional** (only available for student-related collections) to adjust the data access settings for your application. On the left hand side, you’ll see all fields available for the specific data type. Click on a field name to move it over to the **Required field** list. Fields under **Required fields** are made available to your application via the API. Fields saved under **Available fields** will no longer be available for your application once saved. _You will be able to come back to this page and add those fields at a later date if you need them._

![Screenshot of the Edit Required Fields page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000006c7R&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BgAD)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000006c7R&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gq)**Please Note:**  
\- A field can be marked as either required or optional, but not both.  
\- Fields that are greyed out under ‘Required fields’ are required by Clever to be made available to every application.  
\- If you don’t utilize an entire record type (ex. Student contacts), simply click the **Disable \[data type\]** option for the specific data type. 

  
3\. Click **Save** and repeat for other data types.

4\. Test the settings with your developer application and sandbox district before adjusting them in your production application.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### **How is data access different from data validation?**

-   Data access changes the fields that are available to your application via Clever’s API.
    -   Example: Student DOB is not marked as a required or optional field in your dashboard, so it won’t be available to your application via the API even if the district includes it in their feed to Clever from their SIS.
-   Data validation is a way to check that the data available to your application meets the requirements of your integration.
    -   Example: Student number must be unique within a district. Please read ["What are Data Warnings?"](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083) for more information on data validation.

###   
**Can I adjust field requirements on a district-by-district basis?**

-   No. The field requirements set in your dashboard apply to all connected districts. Districts can select which optional fields they make available to your application via Clever, so the fields available to you via the API may differ slightly from district to district.

###   
**How are districts notified of changes to field requirements?**

-   Districts will receive a notification within their Clever dashboard if you make any updates to the required or optional fields once the connection is launched.

###   
**What is the difference between sensitive collections and non-sensitive collections?**

-   Sensitive collections are data that pertains directly to students (student + student contacts). Districts have more autonomy to exclude or include fields for these collections on a per app basis. 

###   
**Some of my fields are missing, how can I get them?**

-   If your application requires ell\_status, iep\_status, or frl\_status let us know and we'll be happy to add those fields for you!

###   
**What if I want some of this data in the future?**

-   These settings will be available for you in your dashboard. If your application requires a piece of data in the future you'll simply be able to navigate here and add it. For the majority of districts, that data field will be available upon next sync.

title: For App Partners: Viewing district usage metrics
text:
​ This article contains the following:  
​ 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000312543#overview)  
 2. [Filters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000312543#Filters)  
​ 3. [Key Metrics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000312543#KeyMetrics)  
​ 4. [District Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000312543#DistrictAnalytics)  
​ 5. [Sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000312543#Sharing)

## Overview

At Clever, we understand how important it is to have insight into how your application is used. With [Clever Analytics](https://apps.clever.com/analytics), you can see graphs and statistics that show how your users are accessing your application and drill down into district usage! This article will give you a breakdown of the available data and how you can use filters to narrow down the information you see.

* * *

##   
Filters

First, let's take a look at the available filters:

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285fx)

You can use the filters to narrow down the usage data and focus on specific users, applications, and school sites. Different filter sets will cause charts to change- if the filters chosen do not apply to a chart, the chart will temporarily be hidden.

### ​  
Time Range

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285eR)

### Units

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285g2)

Here you can select whether you'd like to view your data as a **percentage** (75% of all students have logged in) or in **absolute** terms (7,500 students have logged in). 

###   
Users and Grades

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285g7)  
 

Here you can select whether you want to see usage data for students, teachers, or both.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gC)  
  
  
To look at the analytics for specific grade levels, select the grade(s) from the dropdown. Grades are based on _student_ grades, not the grade level for a section or a teacher. Please note: the teacher filter cannot be used with the grade filter.

* * *

  

## Key Metrics

Now that we know how to use filters to focus on specific areas let's take a look at the different measures! The statistics shown are based on the _users who are being shared with apps._ The metrics are not based on the total number of users in your Clever account.  
 

    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gH)  
 

**Usage by scoped users:** This number reflects the number of logins from the users that are shared with your application.  
  
  
  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gM)  
 

**Unique users:** This number reflects the unique number of users who have logged into an application.  
  
  
 ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gR)  
 

**Total Logins:** This number reflects the overall number of user logins.  
 

##   
Daily unique users

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gW)

**Daily unique users:** This chart reflects the unique number of users who have logged into an application per day. Hover your mouse over a date to see the number of daily unique users for that day. Please note that this chart is disabled if you are using the _School year to date_ time frame filter.  
 

## Logins by district

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gb)  
 

**Logins by district:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins to an individual district. Click on _Ascending_ or _Descending_ to order districts by the number of unique logins. Click on the bar for a district to view analytics for that district.  
 

## Logins by school  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285fo)  
 

**Logins by school:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins from users at each school site. Click on _Ascending_ or _Descending_ to order schools by the number of unique logins.  
 

## Login Method/SIS Type

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285gg)  
 

**Login Method:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins by login type. Users will be counted twice if they log in using different login methods- but only once if logging in multiple times using the same identity provider.

  
**District SIS Type**: This number reflects the number of your districts syncing to Clever with each SIS type.

* * *

##   
District Analytics

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286QK)  
 

Analytics are also available at the district level, in "Analytics" tab on the district profile.

* * *

## Sharing

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002tTR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286QF)

**Export data:** This button will download a csv of the data you've currently filtered in your analytics view.  
 

**Share:** Share insights with members of your team by inviting them to Clever. These users will be given read-only permissions. Your app admin can adjust these permissions on the Team page.

title: For App Partners: Troubleshooting Application Logins
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900323#overview)  
2\. [User Clever login issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900323#User_Clever_login_issues)  
3\. [Users who do not have access to your app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900323#Users_who_do_not_have_access)  
4. [Users who cannot log in to your app through Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900323#Users_who_cannot_log_in)  
5. [Student accounts are not correct in your app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900323#Student_accounts_are_not_correct)

## Overview

This article will walk you through helpful tips to troubleshoot user login issues with your application – for both district and Library-enabled connections. Library-enabled teacher sign-ups are much simpler than district connections - there are no sharing rules to configure or overnight syncs, and teachers can make changes directly regarding which of their classes are shared, rather than having to go through a district admin. However, as with any integration, there are potential things that could go wrong.

##   
User Clever login issues

The first step in troubleshooting a login issue is to verify that the user can log in to Clever. To do this, follow the steps outlined in our [Common Single-Sign On (SSO) issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/221231247) article to triage the issue and identify where the issue is occurring. Login methods are configured by the district, so if the user has issues logging in to Clever, we recommend directing the user to their district support contact for further investigation.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tips:**  
• Occasionally, school districts may hide applications in their Clever Portal, which causes users to lose access to the app. You can find out more here: [Clever Portal: Hiding Applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000311483)  
• School districts can pause the app sync, which could cause potential login issues (e.g., a new student’s account won’t be synced if on pause). You can view this status on your homepage and see more info here: [For Clever Admins: Pausing your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)

## Users who do not have access to your app

**District-enabled connections**

For district-enabled connections, you can identify whether a teacher or student is configured to have access to your product by searching for their name in your Clever Dashboard. 

First search for the name of the district, and then search for the name of the user:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285fd)

* * *

**Library-enabled connections**

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Since Clever does not share sensitive information with Library applications, the user search feature is only available to district-enabled connections. 

  
If a user has trouble logging into your Library application, they should reach out to their Clever Admin for further assistance (helpful articles to reference: [For Clever Admins: Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471?language=en_US), [Troubleshooting: Logging in to applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046240972?language=en_US)). Your app’s Library integration can also always be tested on the Integration guide page found in your dashboard, under [Library > Integration Guide](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/library/integration-guide).

## Users who cannot log in to your app through Clever

If teachers or students can click on your product’s icon, but are not logged in successfully, there is likely an issue with how your product processes the login.  
  
For district-enabled connections, to allow your team to reproduce and identify the issue, you can initiate a Clever log-in to your application as a specific student or teacher by clicking the **Log in as…** button on the user’s profile page (accessed by searching for the user by name):

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285fn)  
 

This kicks off the same OAuth process that occurs when that user logs in via Clever, and should surface any issues that the user is seeing.  
  
 For Library-enabled connections, verify your Library integration is working as expected by navigating to [Library > Integration Guide](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/library/integration-guide) in your dashboard.

## Student accounts are not correct in your app

This issue most commonly occurs when your product has not synced the latest information from Clever. We recommend either syncing data on each teacher log-in, or adding a **Sync with Clever** or **Import from Clever** button to the page in your product where teachers manage their classes, for example:  
 

![Import from Clever button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ygPb)

In your Clever Dashboard, you can navigate to the profile page for a student or teacher to see the current information that has been synced from the district’s Student Information System (SIS):  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULi9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285fs)

If the data in Clever for a teacher is incorrect, for example if they are missing a student, it is likely that the district’s SIS is not accurate. In this case, direct the teacher to check with the person at their school who manages the SIS, often referred to as the school secretary or the school registrar.

title: For App Partners: Diagnosing school organization SSO issues via impersonation
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037963271#h_68036efd-33e7-4959-b637-a1bebbf4c714)  
2. [Impersonating school organization users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037963271#h_365c1681-76b7-4d31-a13d-f237d0c054ba)

  

## Overview

Clever enables application partners to view exactly what a user sees when they attempt to log in to your application from the Clever Portal. You can use this tool when troubleshooting logins to diagnose issues, retrieve an error code or message, or gain visibility into what might be confusing for the user. You’ll only be able to impersonate users that are directly shared with you by a school organization.  
 

![Note icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dql7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ep)**Please note:**  Only Secure Sync certified applications are able to use this feature.

For more information regarding common SSO issues, please visit [this Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/221231247).   
  

## Impersonating school organization users

1.  Navigate to the [Data Browser](https://apps.clever.com/canvas/browser#{%22sidebar%22:%22districts%22}) and select the tab for the user type you will need to debug.
2.  Input the name of the school organization or choose from the list of names in the drop down.

![Data Browser showing school organization selection and drop-down](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dql7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m4Sz)

3.  Search for the user that you need to test. To refine your search you can add an additional filter.

![Screenshot of adding an additional search filter on the app data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dql7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m4Q0)

4.  Select the user and a _Detail View_ will pop up. Here, you'll be able to log in as the user by selecting **Log in as**.

![Screenshot of the user profile](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dql7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m4Rc)  
 

5.  When you’re finished, remember to log out of the application as this user.

While using the impersonation tool, you’ll only have access to the SSO process for your application. You won’t be able to access any other applications, manage a teacher or student's Portal, or take actions on behalf of the user. To protect school organization transparency and trust, these logins are logged as app impersonation logins and the logs can be viewed by the school organization's Clever admins.

* * *

**Related Articles**

-   [For App Partners: Common Single sign-on (SSO) issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/221231247)
-   [For App Partners: Troubleshooting school organization data](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002947243-For-App-Partners-Troubleshooting-district-data)

title: For App Partners: Staff vs. School Admin
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043911831#Overview) 2\. [How do school organizations sync staff to Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043911831#HowDistrictsSynceStaff) 3\. [What school organizations see](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043911831#WhatDistrictsSee) 4. [What applications see](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043911831#WhatApplicationsSee) 5. [How are staff shared with applications?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043911831#HowStaffAreShared) ## Overview A common point of confusion in Clever is the difference between School Admins and Staff users in Clever. These are the same user type in Clever but are represented with different titles depending on if you are a school organization or application partner.

Admin Dashboard for schools

Application Dashboard

Clever API

 Staff School AdminSchool Admin 
## How do school organizations sync staff to Clever? The staff role is designed for users that are not connected to rosters but need access to applications, including school admins! By default, all staff users are created as [Portal Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) only users, meaning they'll have access to the Clever Portal for Single Sign-On (SSO) into applications just as students and teachers do. However, staff can be assigned the role of [School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) which offers additional administrative capabilities. Depending on a school organization's sync type, there are four ways that they can sync staff users to Clever:   1. [Uploading staff via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547) 2. [Sync staff with Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360028781552) 3. [Using Infinite Campus API or Skyward API syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547) 4. [Custom data: staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471) ## What school organizations see The [Data Browser](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202483068) in the school's Clever Dashboard shows staff under a single tab titled _Staff_. Selecting the _Staff_ tab will show a list of staff/school admins that currently exist in Clever for the school organization.   ![Data browser staff screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000arsD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004akYi) ## What applications see The application-facing [Data Browser](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215115268) shows staff/school admins under the _School Admins_ tab.   ![application partner facing data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000arsD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004afK2) Selecting the _School Admins_ tab will allow applications to apply a filter and view staff/school admins associated with your connected school organizations.   ## How are staff shared with applications? Staff and school administrators can use SSO to access learning applications as administrators. Staff users abide by explicit sharing logic so that only staff that are intentionally shared with an application through a sharing rule will gain access to the program. This aligns with existing behavior for sharing all other data types.   ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000arsD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ek)**Please note:** The _Staff_ tab on the Schools Dashboard and the _School Admins_ tab on the Application Dashboard reflect the same data.

title: For App Partners: How to enable safety thresholds
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192#step1)  
2\. [What are safety thresholds?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192#step2)  
3\. [How to enable safety thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192#step3)  
4.[How to customize safety thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192#step4)  
5\. [How to approve school organizations that require a review](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192#step5)

## Overview

When a school organization's data management system such as a student information system (SIS) or school management system (MIS) syncs to Clever or the school organization makes a change to their sharing permissions with your application, this can result in significant changes to the rostering data available in Clever’s API for this school organization.

If you enable safety thresholds, Clever will check to see if there are major data changes every time a school organization syncs or changes their sharing settings, If there are large changes, we’ll prevent data from being updated in Clever’s API until the changes are reviewed and approved by your team.

Enabling safety thresholds is an important part of syncing rostering information as it ensures that your app team is aware of any potentially significant changes to a school organization's data. Safety thresholds are a safeguard to prevent potentially incorrect or undesired changes from being synced to your application.  
 

* * *

##   
What are safety thresholds?

If a school organization's most recent sync or an update in their sharing permissions results in significant changes, a safety hold will be triggered. The school organization will go into the **Requires Review** state. Data for that school organization won't be updated in Clever until the changes are either reverted by the school or approved by a member of your team.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YAeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Only application team members with the **Admin** role in Clever will receive and will be able to approve Safety Threshold notifications

   
You'll see a notification on the Home page of your Clever Dashboard regarding any school organizations in the **Requires Review** status.

![Example of the app safety threshold notification in the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YAeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000d5DRD)   
   
Syncs requiring a review will need to be manually approved on a per school org basis for these changes to be synced, which can be done in their profile page via the Sync Status tab.  
   
Once a safety hold is approved, the school organization’s data will be fully available in Clever’s API.  
 

* * *

##   
How to enable safety thresholds

To enable safety thresholds, navigate to _Settings > District Setup_ tab in the dashboard.  
  
Once safety thresholds are enabled, Clever will begin checking for major changes any time a school organization syncs or changes their sharing settings. You can enable or disable this setting at any time, but if there are school orgs that are awaiting review when you disable the feature, their data will not be updated until their next sync or sharing change.  
 

* * *

##   
How to customize safety thresholds

By default, a school organization will enter the **Requires Review** state if:

-   Over 75% of any data type (e.g. schools, students, teachers, sections) being updated
-   Over 10% of any data type (e.g. schools, students, teachers, sections) being deleted

If these thresholds don't meet your needs, you can change them in _Settings > District Setup_. Here, you can change the percentages of updates and deletes that will trigger a safety threshold. Additionally, you can choose whether you would like creation events to also send a school organization to the **Requires Review** state.  
  
If you leave any box unchecked, we'll ignore that type of data change (such as data creations or deletions). So, for instance, if you leave the creations box unchecked for Teachers, we'll ignore any data creations for teachers.  
 

![Safety thresholds screen, with green checkmark that says Safety thresholds are ON for districts](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YAeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Yy9d)  
 

* * *

##   
How to approve school organizations that require a review

When you log into your dashboard, we’ll let you know if there are any school organizations that are awaiting review. You can click on this alert or filter for school organizations where Sync Status is **Requires Review** to see all accounts that have major data changes.   
   
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YAeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BIuz)  
 

Once you click into a profile, you will see an alert that the school organization has major data changes that require your team’s review. You can click on this alert or on the **Sync Status** tab to view the changes. 

 ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YAeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BIv4)

If the changes look good - they’re expected, or won’t cause major issues - you can click the **Approve changes** button. Once the changes are approved, Clever will process the latest data changes and update the API accordingly.

If you’re not sure if the changes are intentional or if the changes could cause major issues, you can use the **Email district** link to reach out to the school organization's team.  
  
If the approval button is greyed out, please reach out the school org and ask them to push another sync with Clever. The following message will show when you attempt to click the greyed-out button if the data from the school organization is stale: _"The district's data is out of date - please reach out to the district and have them re-sync with Clever."_  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YAeT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** While a school organization has the status of **Requires Review**, no changes will be processed unless the school org reverts changes or you approve them.

title: For App Partners: School year rollovers
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/219324877#Overview?)  
2. [What if a district wants to add summer school rosters to Clever over the summer?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/219324877#What%20if%20a%20district%20wants%20to%20add%20summer%20school%20rosters%20to%20Clever%20over%20the%20summer?)  
3\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/219324877#FAQs)

## Overview

Clever auto-schedules SIS "sync pause dates" for all districts at the end of each school year, or districts can choose to customize their own sync pause dates based on their respective school year schedule. Clever provides districts with end-of-year and rollover guides to help them to plan for summer and the new school year rollover. No data from the district's student information system (SIS) will be synced to Clever during a sync pause. Essentially, the data in Clever will be "frozen in time" during the sync pause period. Depending on the district's school year dates, data will typically begin syncing again between August 1st and August 12th.

-   **First \[Pause\] Day**: This will be the first day the district’s sync is paused, which should coincide with the district’s last day of the school year.
-   **Last \[Pause\] Day**: This will be the last day the district’s sync is paused, which should be the day before the district’s SIS data is active for the new school year.

While a district's sync is paused, Clever will not process any data, allowing the district to make rostering changes to their SIS without interrupting student or teacher access to your application(s). The prior school year's data will be "frozen" in Clever for the duration of the district's pause, allowing the previous school year's users to continue logging into your application without disruption.  
 

## What if a district wants to add summer school rosters over the summer?

While pausing a sync prevents SIS-synced data from processing in a district's Clever account and, therefore, updating in their applications, Clever does provide the ability for Clever Admins to create custom data directly from their [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page during a sync pause. This includes custom students, teachers, staff (i.e., school admins), and sections. Custom Data is the method we recommend to districts who would like to continue adding data to Clever during a sync pause. 

For more information, please visit: [Custom Data: Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US)

## FAQs

  
**How can we see a district’s pause dates?**

Check out a district’s modal on the District Overview page of your Clever Dashboard to view their school year and pause dates!  
  
**Can districts still adjust their sharing permissions while their sync is paused?**

Yes!  
  
**What does it mean when a district’s sync pause ends?**

Clever will resume the district's scheduled syncs with their student information system (SIS). Each SIS handles rollover differently, so we encourage districts to check out their SIS-specific information. Districts can learn more about school year rollover [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886?language=en_US). Once a district's pause has ended and the data for the new school year has synced to Clever, their sync will be placed on an automatic hold, allowing Clever Admins the opportunity to review the data updates before the changes process in Clever. Once reviewed, the district can submit a request to release the sync hold from their [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. Please note that if the changes are above a certain threshold, a ticket will then be created with Clever Support to review the changes before the sync hold is officially released. This is an added security precaution to ensure massive amounts of data changes do not impact connected applications until they have been thoroughly reviewed by a district's Clever Admin and Clever Support. 

**What should we do if we need to offer summer school access?**

Have the district contact Clever Support to determine the best way for them to sync summer school data with your application.   
  
**What does it mean for a district to be syncing over the summer?**

Clever will continue to sync their data throughout the summer for districts that opt out of using Clever's pause feature. However, during this time, applications will likely see a decrease in the number of students, teachers, staff (i.e., school admins), and sections syncing from Clever.   
  
**How can we ensure our districts are ready for the new school year?**

We encourage districts to check 3-4 things once their pause has ended to confirm they’re ready for the new school year:

1.  Browse their data from their [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/) > [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser) in Clever to check that the new school year's rostering data looks correct.
2.  Review the sharing permissions for each connected application to ensure they are correct.
3.  Review their section\_ids to confirm that the ID #s for sections (the section\_id field in Clever) are different after a term or school year rollover. We ask districts do this because Clever 'remembers' the sections that have been deleted based on their section\_ids changing.
4.  If applicable, we ask Clever Admins to review their Clever Badges to ensure they are ready for the new school year.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Sync Holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358?language=en_US)
-   [Summer School: Sync settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027745731?language=en_US)
-   [For Clever Admins: Troubleshooting Tools - How do I browse district data in Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202483068?language=en_US)
-   [School Year Rollover: Overview, Preparation & Recommendations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202118886?language=en_US)

title: For App Partners: Predicted next sync times
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/225602568#Overview)  
2. [Predicted next sync times](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/225602568#predicted_next_sync_times)  
3\. [Sync types](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/225602568#sync_types)

##   
Overview

This article is for application partners and provides an overview of viewing district sync times and district sync types.

* * *

##   
Predicted next sync times

On the district’s overview page of your Clever Dashboard, you can view the last time a district's SIS synced with Clever, as well as the next time our system predicts it will sync:   
  
![Sync info displaying last successful sync and the next predicted sync](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002iBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004yfvV)

  
You can also view a detailed Sync Report on the Warnings tab on the district’s overview page.   
  
![detailed sync report on the Warnings tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002iBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004yfva)  
  
Many districts sync data to Clever on a regular schedule, so by looking at their previous syncs, we can infer when they will next sync. This is not guaranteed, as the district could change its sync pattern or miss a sync. Other districts sync data in an irregular pattern, and in those cases, we cannot predict the next sync.

Understanding a bit about the different sync types provides clarity on a district's sync frequency as well.

* * *

##   
Sync types

### Auto Sync

An Auto Sync with Clever involves a basic initial setup. It requires minimal IT support from a district, as Clever syncs directly with the district's SIS to securely transfer student roster data. These auto syncs typically run every two to three hours, although some districts are set to sync daily (per their request).

###   
SFTP Sync

A Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Sync allows school districts to “push” data to Clever. Districts generate .csv files in a Clever-specific CSV format and submit them to Clever using SFTP. Many districts automate the export of their files sent to an FTP client daily, but SFTP Syncs are more challenging to predict, as the district pushes the data to Clever.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002iBR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285e6) For additional details on sync types, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278), which helps district admins choose which sync type is right for them.

title: For App Partners: Verifying district data quality
text:
This article contains the following:
1. Overview
2. Data Errors vs Warnings
3. Where to Find Data Errors/Warnings
4. Types of Data Warnings
5. Resolving Data Warnings

## Overview Clever has minimum requirements in order to sync a district's data to our system. If your application has additional fields you require (or even prefer), we can flag a district's data with either _Data Errors_ or _Data Warnings._ These let a district know their data needs to be further optimized for your application. To add additional fields to your data errors, or warnings, [reach out to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)!  * * * ## Data Errors vs Warnings - Data Errors are fields that don't meet the requirements you specified. Records with data errors won't be sent to your application at all, but they will show up under the Data Errors table in app and district dashboards. **Please note:** records with Data Errors won't be present in your API responses.   - Data Warnings are fields that, if missing, will prevent your users from having an optimal experience with your application. - For example, if you prefer student contact information but creating users isn't dependent on these fields being populated, student contact fields will be listed as Data Warnings. * * * ## Where to Find Data Warnings/Errors From the home page of your Dashboard, click on the name of a school district. Click on the **Warnings** tab: ![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000O76n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNyn) * * * ## Types of Data Warnings Missing Information   - Your application requires specific fields to be populated in Clever. Issues related to missing information show the number of records without data in those fields.   - To resolve these issues, the district must update its data to include the missing values. They'll need to input the missing data into their student information system (SIS). If the school uses a manual SFTP or SIS-Managed sync, they'll need to work with their SIS to ensure that the data is exported as part of the CSV files they're sending to Clever. If they utilize a Clever-Managed Auto Sync, they can [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance with adding fields missing from their sync.   Non-unique Information   - Issues related to non-unique information will be listed in Data Warnings for the fields below. The issue will include every record that shares each non-unique field value. For example, users with duplicate usernames.   - To resolve these issues, the school will need to update data in its SIS to provide a unique value for each record. Once the data is updated in their SIS and syncs to Clever, the error or warning will resolve. * * * ## Resolving Data Warnings To download details about a district's data warnings click on the **Download** hyperlink next to the number of affected records:   ![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-2.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000O76n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNz2) For schools to resolve data warnings they will usually need to make changes directly in their SIS.   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000O76n&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000OgQRi)   Please note:** For a school to resolve a data warning or error, they'll need to make updates in their student information system (SIS). The error or warning will resolve once they edit data in their SIS and it syncs to Clever. If a school is missing a data field entirely and uses a manual SFTP or SIS-Managed sync, they'll need to work with their SIS directly to add fields to the CSV files they are sending to Clever. If they use a Clever-Managed Auto Sync, they can [contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) to explore options for adding additional fields to their sync. If you have any questions about helping resolve data warnings for a specific school, please [contact Clever Support!](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)

title: For App Partners: Common Single sign-on (SSO) issues
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221231247#overview)  
1\. [Triaging Login Issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221231247#TriagingLoginIssues)  
2\. [Logging into an IdP](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221231247#LoggingintoIDP)  
3\. [Issues Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221231247#IssuesLoggingIn)  
4\. [Issues Logging in to Your Application](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/221231247#IssuesLogginginApp)

## Overview

  
As mentioned in our article on [For App Partners: What is single sign-on (SSO)?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/221208767), SSO has many moving parts, which means many things can cause logins to fail. This article will help you navigate these issues and get your users logged in quickly and efficiently!

* * *

##   
Triaging Login Issues

First, we’ll want to narrow down where the issue is.

###   
**What are the exact steps the user is taking to log in?**

Are they logging in with SSO or app-specific credentials (or are they entering credentials for one method into the other’s login page)? This step allows us to check the user is attempting to use Clever correctly. The correct login flows are:  
 

### **Clever Portal**

1.  Go to the Clever Portal URL for your district ([https://clever.com/in/<shortname>](https://clever.com/in/%3Cshortname%3E)).
2.  Click the “Log in with <Identity Provider (IdP)>” button.
3.  Enter in their IdP credentials.
4.  They’ll see a loading screen with a book, followed by the Clever Portal.

### **Instant Login Links**

1.  Click on the link provided by the district.
2.  Click the “Log in with <IdP>” button
3.  Enter in their IdP credentials.
4.  They’ll see a loading screen with a book, followed by your application’s page.

### **Log in with Clever Button**

1.  Click on the "Log in with Clever" Button.
2.  Enter the name of your school in the search.
3.  Click the “Log in with <IdP> button.”
4.  Enter in their IdP credentials.
5.  They’ll see a loading screen with a book, followed by your application’s page.

### **Are they seeing any error messages?**

Error messages can help determine at which login stage the issue is occurring. Clever error messages look like this:

![Example login error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Y08bW)

We’ll go into specific error messages below. As part of the troubleshooting process, we recommend providing screenshots of any errors.

## Logging into an IdP

If a user is having issues logging in to their Identity provider (IdP), they should contact their district support contact. The user can find the contact information on their portal login page. You can also see the contact in their SSO Settings. To see their settings, click on the district in your [Dashboard](https://apps.clever.com/). The SSO info for each district will be available on the **Overview** page.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285dS)

Here are some common issues in this category:

### **Incorrect Portal**

Sometimes, your Clever users, especially young students using **Log in with Clever** buttons, will end up at a different district's Portal URL and won't be able to log in. To ensure they’re using the correct Portal URL, have them check the district's name at the top of the page. Does it match their district's name? If not, you can provide them with their Portal URL or have them click the **Not your district** button to try their search again.  
  
![Image showing login page and the "Not your district" button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002d2SE) 

###   
**Invalid SSO link**

SSO links are great for embedding in district portals or distributing as bookmarks! However, sometimes, these URLs are incorrectly added. The correct format is [https://clever.com/oauth/instant-login?client\_id=<your](https://clever.com/oauth/instant-login?client_id=%3Cyour) client id>&district\_id=<district id>

### **“Not successfully authenticated by your identity provider”**

This error occurs when the IdP sends us a code representing a login failure. Although it is relatively rare, we have noticed that most cases are caused by saved/cached passwords in Google Chrome**.** Clearing the browser history usually resolves this issue.

### **Incorrect Username / Password**

If the user can't log in with their credentials, direct them to their district support contact, who should be able to help them get their correct credentials.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285dX)**Please note:** Clever cannot provide users with their credentials or reset passwords for users.

## Issues Logging in to Clever

Once the user successfully logs into their IdP, the IdP attempts to send information to Clever and find a matching user. If we find a match, we’ll log the user in. The two most common login issues are listed below. If you see something else, direct the user to their district support contact, who will work with Clever to resolve the issue.

### **Not Authorized**

Some IdPs, like Google and Canvas, require the user to allow Clever to receive identifying information such as email addresses. If the user does not grant Clever access, we can't log them in. The user will need to log in again and authorize the data access.

### **Unable to find Matching User**

The majority of login issues stem from missing data in Clever; either the user needs to be synced with Clever, or their record needs to include the identifying information needed to make a match with their IdP data.

If the IdP setup is misconfigured, this error can also occur. We recommend directing the user to their district support contact for further investigation.

## Issues Logging in to your Application

If the user is able to log in to their IdP and Clever but isn’t able to log in to your application, this usually suggests that something has interrupted the OAuth2 flow.  
  
Clever has provided the ability to replicate the login flow from Clever to your application in the Clever Dashboard. To recreate the login error: 

1.  Select the district for the user.
2.  Search for the user reporting the error.
3.  Verify the user is shared by the district.
4.  Click on the name of the user to load their **Detail View**. Select **Log in as \[student name\]** to test the connection with your app.

  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULJx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285cp)  
  
  
If the login to your application fails, this suggests that something has interrupted the OAuth2 flow. Here are the most common issues:

###   
**App Icon Missing / “Ask your administrator to add this app to your Portal”**

Users can only log in to applications if their data is shared with the application. If their data isn't shared, the app icon won't appear in the Portal, and they will see the above error if they attempt to use an SSO link or **Log in with Clever** button.

To resolve the issue, have the user contact their district support contact. Their district administrators will need to share their data with your application.

###   
**Logging in to Incorrect Account**

If districts have shared devices, users may find themselves logged in to the account of the user who was previously logged in.

###   
**Unable to Log into Application**

If your users are seeing an error message after clicking on your application icon or SSO link, we recommend the following steps:

1.  Confirm the user’s Clever ID is in your app’s database.
2.  Make sure the record tied to the user’s Clever ID isn't deactivated or otherwise prevented from logging in on the application side.
3.  Please reach out to Clever Support with the Clever ID of the user and a screenshot of the error message. We’re happy to help investigate the login issue!
