title: For App Partners: Transferring existing districts to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767#Overview)  
2. [Matchmaker](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767#Matchmaker)  
3\. [How it works](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767#HowITWorks)  
4\. [Input CSV guidelines](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767#InputCSV)  
5\. [Output CSV format](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767#OutputCSV)  
6\. [Privacy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806767#Privacy)

##   
Overview

This article will go over how to convert your existing district customer accounts to Clever user accounts and includes information on our Matchmaker tool, as well as CSV file formatting and guidelines.

* * *

##   
Matchmaker

When converting your existing district customers to Clever user accounts, you'll need to match your existing records to records in Clever. Doing this preserves historical data and ensures that records are not deleted and then re-created.

Clever's [Matchmaker](https://apps.clever.com/apps/matchmaker) is a tool that takes records from your application and matches them with records in Clever. You can access Matchmaker by logging into your Clever dashboard and clicking _Matchmaker_ on the left menu bar.   
  
![Matchmaker tool](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002i9p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y7fY)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002i9p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Matchmaker is currently only enabled for applications that support Secure Sync since it requires access to full district records.  

* * *

##   
How it works

1.  A district authorizes your application through Clever and shares records.
2.  You upload a CSV with your existing student, teacher, admin, school, or section/enrollment records.
3.  Clever's Matchmaker matches the records you uploaded with the records shared with your application in Clever.
4.  Clever emails you a CSV with a list of both matched records and a list of unmatched records.

* * *

##   
Input CSV guidelines

When creating an input CSV to upload to Clever's Matchmaker, follow the guidelines below to help produce accurate matches. Use this [example CSV](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/matchmaker_input_example.csv)  as a guide.

-   It must be a valid CSV file (in accordance with [RFC 4180](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4180))—that means:
    -   Every row should have the same number of columns, separated by commas
    -   Any values with commas in them should be surrounded by a matching set of quotes
-   It must contain a column header for each field
-   It should contain as many fields as possible—the more information you provide about each record, the better chance it will have of being matched
-   It must contain a unique internal identifier for each record—you should use this identifier to associate matched records with the original accounts in your application
-   It should contain exactly _one_ record for each user—if a user has multiple accounts in your application, please choose one to match with Clever since duplicate records will not be matched

* * *

##   
Output CSV format

Clever's Matchmaker outputs a CSV containing all of the fields from your input CSV, including additional identifying fields from Clever:  
 

-   Column headers for your input fields will begin with _app_ (e.g. `app.email`)
-   Column headers for Clever fields will begin with _clever_ (e.g. `clever.id`)
-   The `matchmaker_results` column will contain a string telling you whether or not the record was matched. There are five possible values for this column:
    -   `match:` The record was matched
    -   `from app, no match:` The record from your application could not be matched to any record in Clever
    -   `from app, duplicate:` The record from your application was a duplicate of another record in your application. To match these records, we recommend you pick _one_ record to serve as the representative for all groups of duplicate records, remove the rest, and re-run Matchmaker.
    -   `from Clever, no match:` The record in Clever could not be matched to any record from your application
    -   `from Clever, duplicate:` The record from Clever was a duplicate of another record from Clever. To match these records, you may need to work with the district and Clever Support to clean up their data.

Once you receive your matching output, you can associate the matched records in your application with the corresponding Clever ID (found in the `clever.id` column).

* * *

##   
Privacy

Matchmaker will only match application records against district records that have been shared with your application in Clever. Matchmaker input and output CSVs are purged from Clever's system 30 days after upload.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000002i9p&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285d3)If you have further questions about Clever's Matchmaker, please [submit a ticket](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) to our support team.

title: For App Partners: Data sharing permissions & recommended settings
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236233907#header1)  
2\. [School organization data sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236233907#header2)  
3\. [School organization sharing experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236233907#header3)

## Overview

Learn about several of the available settings available to application partners to help your school organizations succeed! This includes setting up recommended data sharing permissions for your school organizations. As a best practice, we recommend configuring these settings before inviting school organizations to your application; however, these settings can also be updated at any time in the future.  
   
Please visit this article for instructions on how to invite school organizations to your application in Clever here: [For App Partners: Inviting & connecting school organizations to your app.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718)  
 

* * *

## School organization data sharing

To access your **District Setup** page to modify the settings detailed in this article, please:

-   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard](https://apps.clever.com/amplify/districts/overview) > [Settings](https://apps.clever.com/amplify/settings/general) page.
-   Select the **District Setup** tab.

The **District Setup** tab includes the following options:

-   **Globally Recommended Sharing**: This feature allows application partners to configure recommended data sharing permissions so school organizations will share the correct data with your application. Essentially, you are providing your school organizations with data-sharing best practices when connecting with your application for the first time.
    -   Please visit the **District sharing experience** section of this article for details about the different options available for school organizations when sharing their data with your application. The information in the **District sharing experience** section will help you to provide the appropriate recommend sharing permissions. For detailed setup instructions, see [our guide to global recommended sharing settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046189771).
        
-   **Custom setup wizard**: This feature allows you to add a custom message which will display for school organization admins in Clever who are adding your application for the first time and have configured their data sharing. We recommend using this feature to inform school organization admins about additional setup steps for successfully launching your application, providing them with other specifics they might need, or just letting them know you'll be in touch! Utilizing this feature to inform school organization admins will help mitigate potential challenges for school organizations that are setting up your application in Clever. Once you've saved your updates, you will have the option to preview your changes.  
    ![Screenshot of the custom setup wizard message editor](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e9Nx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036fer)
-   **Enable safety thresholds**: This feature helps to ensure that significant data changes from a school organization (e.g., updating their sharing permissions for your application) will place the next application sync on an automatic hold before processing the data, giving your team time to review the changes before they update your application. For detailed instructions, see [our guide to safety thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192).
-   **Request API V3 Migration CSVs**: This option will map the legacy "role-based" Clever IDs to the more recent Application Programming Interface (API) v3.0 User IDs. When choosing this option, a zip file containing one CSV for every one of your connected school organizations will be provided for download for one week after being created. In the rare case that a school organization mapping cannot be completed, there will be an error file created documenting this information.

* * *

## School organization sharing experience

When a school organization either requests your application or is sent an invite by you, they have the option to create "sharing permissions" to determine what school organization data they want synced to your application.

School organization admins can configure application sharing permission in any one of the following ways:

-   **Share by District**: All school organization data in Clever will be synced to the application, including school organization admins, schools, teachers, students, staff, sections, and enrollments.
-   **Share by Schools**: Clever will only share any data associated with the schools the school organization has selected for your application.
-   **Share by Rules**: Clever will only share data that meets the specific criteria the school organization sets. This is the most recommended sharing type as it provides school organizations with the most flexibility in specifically determining what data should be included, or excluded, in the sharing. [Read this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247) to learn more about how to Share by Rules!
-   **School Site Sharing**: If the school organization has designated [School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003207663) in Clever, a school organization admin can provide them with the ability to configure application sharing permissions for their associated schools. [More info here!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007)
-   **Copy Sharing**: Clever will copy the sharing permissions from another application that has already been set up.

* * *

**Related articles  
  
**

-   [For App Partners: Inviting & connecting school organizations to your app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718)
-   [For App Partners: Recommending sharing for specific school organizations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046189771)
-   [For App Partners: School organization setup recommendations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192)
-   [For App Partners: Navigating the Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215800557)

* * *

title: For Staff: How do I bring Clever to my school?
text:
Before Clever can help students and teachers access learning applications at your school, the Clever account needs to be set up by a district administrator. Clever supports all US and Canadian school districts. Clever is a no-cost, secure integration solution that is available to both public and private institutions.  
  
Clever allows international districts to create Clever accounts, but these accounts are [self-service](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043013). Clever’s services are provided to schools in the European Economic Area (the “EEA”), the United Kingdom (the “UK”), and Switzerland in compliance with the European Union’s (“EU”) General Data Protection Regulation ( “GDPR”) and its UK GDPR counterpart.  For more information, please see our Additional Terms for Schools and the European Data Processing Addendum that applies to the EEA, UK, and  Switzerland.  
 

Please reach out to your IT or Curriculum Director to set up Clever today. Here is a template email to send to your district administrators:

Hi \[_admin name_\],  
  
My name is \[_your name_\] and I am a staff member at \[_school name_\]. Please consider deploying Clever at \[_district name_\], because \[_your reason_\].  
  
Clever's single sign-on (SSO) will help students and teachers at my school access online learning apps, without needing to remember a new username or password.  
  
Clever is a no-cost, secure integration solution that is used by over 60,000 schools and takes just minutes to roll out.  
  
You can sign up our district by visiting Clever.com. If you have any questions, the Clever team will be happy to help. Just email [success@clever.com](mailto:success@clever.com).  
  
Thank you for your help,  
\[_your name_\]  
\[_your email_\]

title: For Staff: How do I log in to Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236225647#overview)  
2. [Directions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236225647#Header1)  
3\. [What to do if you've forgotten your password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236225647#Header2)

## Overview 

Learn more in this article about how to log in to Clever as a staff (non-teaching) user in your school organization.

* * *

##  How do I log into Clever as a staff member?

1.  **Go to your district's Clever Portal login**, which should follow the format: _[https://clever.com/in/<district](https://clever.com/in/%3Cdistrict) name>_ (e.g., clever.com/in/cleverusd).  
      
    If you don't know your district's Clever login page, you can go to clever.com/login and search for your school.   
     
2.  **Log in to Clever with your username and password**. Your username and password credentials are set up by your school district. They may be your teacher number, ID, or email address.
    
    If you are both a teacher and a staff member in Clever, you can access both user accounts using the same set of credentials in most instances. After logging in, you'll be able to toggle to switch between accounts using the Profile button in the top right of your Portal.
    
    ![Example of account toggle](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Z9Vd7)
    
    _An example of the dropdown menu of a user who can switch accounts within their Portal._
    
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Vs)**Please note:** If your district uses custom usernames and passwords for single sign-on (SSO) (rather than through a third party like Google), you may have two distinct set of credentials: one for your teacher account and one for your staff account. This means your Username will be different between your two accounts. Please check with your district admin for more information on what your credentials should be for your teacher account and staff account.
    
3.  Once logged in to your Clever Portal, you can access your applications!  
      
    

* * *

##  What to do if you've forgotten your password

There are a few different methods districts can choose for how you log into Clever. See below for more information.  
  
**If you district has set up Log in with Clever**   
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CEUq)  
If your district has set up custom username and passwords through Clever then you may be able to reset your password. Here's how:

1.  Go to your Clever Portal URL and click **Get help signing in!** under the password field.
2.  On the Login Help page, click **Reset your password**
3.  On the Reset Password page, submit your email address and Clever will send you a link to set a new password. 

If your email is associated with both a teacher and staff account in Clever, the email will contain two links - one for each user type. Select the link for the account you wish to reset!  
 

**If you district has set up** **any other login method**

## ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CEUX)  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CEVF)  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CEVA)  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBf7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CEVK)

Depending on your school organization's configuration, you may be able to reset your password if your organization uses a third-party identity provider for login. [Please see here for more information](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040417231#resettingpwloginscreen) to determine if you can reset your third-party password on the Clever login page. If you don't see the option to reset your password, please contact your Clever admin or IT team for further assistance. The Clever team doesn't have access to your login information.

title: For App Partners: Troubleshooting district data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002947243#overview)  
2. [Browsing District Data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002947243#header1)  
3. [Missing Data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002947243#header2)  
4. [Incorrect Data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002947243#header3)

##   
Overview

If you hear from a school organization that's running into issues with missing or incorrect data in your app, these are the steps to view, troubleshoot, and help schools to resolve issues with their student information system (SIS) data.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000W2Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ce)**Clever Tip:** Enable **App Sync Notifications** to stay updated on school sync statuses. Utilize our API to verify the last successful SIS upload and proactively manage data updates. Learn more in [our dev docs](https://dev.clever.com/docs/ss-design#sync-frequency) or reach out to [our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) to request this feature be turned on for your account.

* * *

##   
Browsing District Data

To filter and view specific records that are shared with your app, click the _Data Browser_ in the left-hand sidebar:  
![Screenshot of the sidebar menu](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000W2Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m0xt)

Select the user or data type that you are searching for, and click _Add Filter_ to narrow down your results. You will only see data that has been shared with your application:  
![Screenshot of the data browser filters](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000W2Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m0y9)

Click on each record to view more information and to see the "Detail View":  
 

![Screenshot of the detail view on data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000W2Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m0ym)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000W2Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ce)**Clever Tip:** You're able to debug instant login problems using the Detailed View as well by clicking **"Log in as <user's name>"** at the top! 

* * *

##   
Missing Data

You will only see data that has been shared with your application. Districts control the data that is shared with your app by setting up [data sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236233907) and [data access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000216886).

  
There are two potential reasons that district data is missing from your app dashboard:  
 

**1\. _The district has not shared the data with your application._** Check the _Sharing Rules_ to make sure that the data-sharing rules are configured correctly.  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000W2Mr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNJG)

**2\.** _**The district's data has not made it from their SIS into Clever.**_ You can pass along or view these SIS-specific articles for troubleshooting steps based on SIS-type. If the district doesn't see the data in their own data browser, something specific to the SIS sync is likely keeping the data out of Clever:  
 

-   [Aeries](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203005016)
-   [Infinite Campus API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/226677767)
-   [PowerSchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058173)
-   [SchoolInsight Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206090237)
-   [Skyward Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193)
-   [Skyward API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
-   [SFTP](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698)

* * *

##   
Incorrect Data

If data is incorrect, Clever might be pulling the field (e.g. Course\_name) from the wrong field within the district's SIS. For most [SIS Auto Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973), Clever can customize the fields that we pull data from, or filter out unnecessary data.

[Reach out to Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) so that we can get that all set up!

* * *

title: For Application Partners: Viewing information about a connected district
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215115268#header1)  
2\. [Viewing school organization data on your Home page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215115268#header2)  
3\. [Viewing school organization data on their profile page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215115268#header3)

## Overview

This article describes how to find and view key details about school organizations connected to your app via Clever. This includes information such as how to confirm the school organizations connected to your application, their SIS sync status, login methods, and more granular details, such as the users syncing from a school.  
 

* * *

## Viewing school organization data on your Home page

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cHmf3)   
 

On your homepage, you’ll see a list of your districts. The tags under each district indicate whether the district is:  
 

-   **No Data Shared** - the district has approved your invitation, the launch date is in the future, but the district still needs to setup their sharing permissions. No action is required on the app-side unless you would like to recommend any sharing rules for the district.
-   **Setup Wizard Complete** \- the district has completed their setup (i.e. the setup wizard you created and sharing permissions) and the connection is now pending the launch date. During this phase, your team has the opportunity to confirm that you're receiving the data you need ahead of the launch date (i.e. when the icon will appear on user Portals and allow logins). You can also choose to move the launch date up if you're ready to launch earlier.
-   **Launched** - this district is ready to use your app through Clever!
-   **Setting Up** - during this phase, teachers and students cannot see or access your application.
-   **Licenses Exceeded** - the district has overshared students or schools with your application and need to adjust their sharing permissions.
-   **Requires** **Review** \- references the data safety thresholds your team has placed (Clever Dashboard > [Settings](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/settings/general) > [District Setup page](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/settings/district-setup)). This tag indicates the district's data has changed significantly according to your thresholds. The changes will not sync until a member of your team has had a chance to review and approve them.
-   **Sync Paused** - the school district has paused the data sync with your application. This temporarily disables data updates.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285cK)**Please note:** The licensing feature makes it easier to manage and communicate with districts about licenses, but it does not limit how many students or schools can be shared.

* * *

## Viewing school organization data on their profile page

From your home page, if you click on a school organization's name, you'll see a few key details about it. At the top of the page, you’ll find the following information:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cHsZB)   
 

1.  **Sync Status:** The icon indicates the status of the district's sync. For details on possible sync statuses, please see: [District Sync Statuses](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215806797).
2.  **Sharing type:** This indicates how a district has scoped their data for your application. Any permissions updates must be made by a district administrator. Possible descriptions include:
    -   Sharing no data
    -   Sharing all data
    -   Sharing selected schools
    -   Sharing selected sections
    -   Sharing data by rules
3.  **Shared schools**: This is the number of schools shared by the district. Here, you are also able to set the number of licenses that you have allotted to the district. For more information on using the license feature in Clever, see [Set Up License Usage Limits](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003921667).
4.  **Launch date**: This is the date that end-users will have access to your application. Usually, this date is agreed upon by you and the district, but the Launch Date in Clever is set by your team. For more information about managing launch dates, reference [Setting and managing launch dates](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005704686).

Further down on the overview page, you will see the following 3 sections:  
 

-   District Info
-   LMS Connect
-   Sync Info
-   Instant Login Info
-   Clever SSO Info
-   Data Compatibility
-   Schools
-   Clever Training Usage

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cHnXt) 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cHnkn) 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cHC0W)   
 

### **District Info:**

In this section, you can find contact information for the district administrator maintaining the Clever account, in addition to the district’s Clever ID, MDR number, and OAuth token.

### **LMS Connect:**

In this section, you can enable sharing with the district’s LMS. Click **Invite to connect** and get started. Learn more about LMS Connect [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001609?language=en_US).

###   
**Sync Info:**

Here, you can view which SIS and sync type (SFTP, Auto-Sync, etc.) the school organization is using to sync data into Clever, and if the sync from Clever is paused by them. The last successful sync date indicates when the school org last synced fresh data with Clever. If the school org's syncs are configured to occur nightly or hourly, you’ll also find the predicted next sync time. 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bdFJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ce)**Clever Tip:** For the most precise information and data regarding a district’s last sync, please contact our support team to enable **App Sync Notifications.** Utilize our API to verify the last successful SIS upload and proactively manage data changes. [Learn more in our dev docs here.](https://dev.clever.com/docs/ss-design#sync-frequency)

###   
**Clever SSO info:**

This section provides information on the district’s Clever Portal URL, as well as their login method into Clever. If the district does not use the Clever Portal, they can use the listed Instant Login Link to embed Clever authentication for your application into a different SSO portal. (Note: the district has access to the Instant Login link for your application in their Clever dashboard, as well.)

### **Data Compatibility:**

Review how well the district’s data matches the required fields you set in your Data Access Settings. This section provides a quick overview of the data. Click **Details** to see more information about what’s syncing, or click **Download CSV** to export all of the data in one consolidated file.

###   
**Schools:** 

This section lists all schools associated with the district. The table shows whether each school is shared and how many students, sections, and teachers are shared. You can filter the list by **All Schools**, **Shared**, or **Not Shared**.

### **Clever Training Usage:** 

This section shows Clever Training usage for the district. You can see whether admins associated with the district have engaged with Clever Academy (Y or N). You can also see whether they are a Clever Champion, which means they’ve completed Clever Admin Certification Levels 1–4.

* * *

title: For App Partners: Managing launch dates
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005704686#header1)  
2\. [Managing launch dates](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005704686#header2)

## Overview

The launch date is the optional calendar date that your application goes live for a specific school organization. On this date, students and teachers will begin to see and access your application from their school organization's Clever Portal.

When school organizations request your app, they can optionally request a specific launch date. When you invite a school organization to connect, you have that option as well. If you leave this blank, the default is 30 days after the school organization accepts the invitation.  
   
![Launch date modal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e9RB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062nyP)

* * *

## Managing launch dates

You can manage, set, and reschedule launch dates for school organizations by navigating to your [app dashboard's](https://apps.clever.com/learningaz/districts/overview) **District Overview** page and searching for the school organization you need to update. Click on their hyperlinked name to open the school organization's overview page.

Then click on the pencil icon to the right of the existing launch date.

![Clever Dashboard view of a school organization's existing launch date with an edit icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e9RB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNJa)

From there you can select an updated date to **Re-schedule** or choose **Launch Now** if you want the school organization to go live immediately:

![Launch date edit menu showing Re-schedule and Launch now buttons](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e9RB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BNJk)

Prior to the launch date, the connection status will show as **Setting Up**. This means that you are able to see the data that the school organization has shared with you, but school organization users cannot yet view or access your application from their Clever Portal. During the Setting Up stage, no action is required, but the school organization admin can use the time to make sure they are sharing the correct data with you and check that they aren't hitting any data warnings or errors.  
   
You're able to modify a launch date up to the date of the launch. If you want to change a launch date after the original date has passed, you can [contact our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) for assistance.

* * *

**Related articles  
  
**

-   [For App Partners: Inviting & connecting school organizations to your app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718)
-   [For App Partners: District setup recommendations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192)
-   [For App Partners: Navigating the Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215800557)

title: Edtech Analytics - Overview and FAQs
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039420391#Header1)  
2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039420391#Header2)  
3\. [Viewing Edtech Analytics data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039420391#header3)  
4\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039420391#header4)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035ff1)  
Getting started with Analytics? Check out our [Product Spotlight: Supporting your school and district with Clever Analytics,](https://clever.academy/supporting-your-school-and-district-with-clever-analytics?user_type=district_admin)  available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

Edtech Analytics shows you all of your school organization's app usage in one place down to the school and grade level, whether or not they are integrated with Clever. Best of all, it’s free!

Through our opt-in-only secure browser extension, you’ll get visibility into how many students and teachers are using apps added by your school organization through Clever, added by teachers through [Clever Library](https://clever.com/products/sso/library), and hundreds of others accessed outside of Clever. Edtech Analytics is currently available for Chromebook and Windows devices managed by your school organization.

If the scope of your administrator role is set to specific schools, you’ll only see Edtech Analytics data for your scoped schools. [Learn more about custom roles and scoped schools here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702)

##   

* * *

##   
Setup

To enable Edtech Analytics in your school organization, you’ll need to set up the Clever Plus extension. Even if your schools already use the standard [Clever browser extension](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360019869511?language=en_US) for students and teachers to access [SSO (Saved Passwords)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/234746488?language=en_US) applications, you’ll still need to set up the Clever Plus extension, which will replace the standard Clever extension. Clever Plus supports both SSO (Saved Passwords) applications and Edtech Analytics. You can find a short setup guide in your [Clever Dashboard > Analytics > Edtech analytics](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/edtech-usage) page which will allow you to download the new extension.

The setup guide is only visible to Clever Admins. If you're setting up Edtech Analytics on Chromebooks, we recommend adding your Google Console admin to Clever if they don't already have an account. Learn more about [adding additional Clever Admins here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038).

To learn about setting up EdTech Analytics via the Google Admin console, click here.

1\. In your Google Admin console navigate to Device Management > Chrome > Apps & extensions.

![Google Admin Console: Device management > Chrome > Apps & extensions page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000M2DVx)

2\. If you have already force-installed the Clever extension, please remove it. You can identify the Clever extension by its ID - nopfnnpnopgmcnkjchnlpomggcdjfepo.

3\. Choose the organizational unit (OU) in which you want to install the Clever Plus extension. We recommend you configure the Clever Plus extension for all OUs.

4\. Add the new extension. First, click the yellow plus sign in the bottom right, then choose **Add Chrome app or extension by ID.**

**Extension ID:** dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa

**Source:** From a custom URL

**URL:** [https://crx.clever.com/updates](https://crx.clever.com/updates)

![Add extension by ID screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000M2EOn)

5\. Click **Save**. After saving, you should automatically be taken to the configuration details for the extension.

6\. On this page, set **Policy for extensions** then click **Save** in the top right corner. The Policy for extension will follow the format below. Please be sure to replace DISTRICT ID with your District ID value in your [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser).

{ "AnalyticsToken": { "Value": "DISTRICTID" } }

![Analytics token](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000M2Ev3)

7\. Set the app's installation policy to **Force Install** then click **Save.**

**![Force install and save](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000M21oA)**

8\. To verify the install was successful, log in on a targeted device and confirm the following:

-   In Chrome, navigate to chrome://extensions and look for **Clever Plus**
-   In Chrome, navigate to chrome://policy and ensure the AnalyticsToken is set

To learn more about how to deploy Edtech Analytics using Microsoft Intune, please see:

-   For [Chrome](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574)
-   For [Edge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001573)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285QY) Edtech Analytics is available for Chrome and Edge browsers. Please note that Edtech Analytics is supported on MacBooks that have the Chrome browser enabled. Edtech Analytics is not supported for mobile devices.

* * *

##   
Viewing Edtech Analytics data

Once your usage data is ready, you can access it from your [Clever Dashboard > Analytics > Edtech analytics](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/edtech-usage) page.

If the scope of your administrator role is set to specific schools, you’ll only see Edtech Analytics data for your scoped schools. If you need additional access please reach out to your Clever Admin account owner.

**Filters:**  

-   Admins can filter data by time range, including last school year, this school year, the last 28 days, or the last 7 days. You can also filter by school and grade level. Only schools and grades with usage data will be shown in drop-downs.  
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Qd)

**Reported Users**

**Students reported** and **teachers reported** provides insight into the usage from devices where the Clever Plus extension is installed. To be counted, users need to: 

-   Be synced to Clever (learn more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278) about syncing to Clever)
-   Have an email address (Chromebook) or a username (Windows device) 
-   Have an Active Directory or Google session running on their device. The Google or Active Directory session running on a user's device must be for the Google or Active Directory account associated with the user in Clever for Edtech Analytics to track it. For example, if a student is logged into their personal gmail address ([jsmith@gmail.com](mailto:jsmith@gmail.com)), but their email address in Clever is [john.smith@exampleschool.com](mailto:john.smith@exampleschool.com), their edtech usage **will not** be tracked.
-   Be actively using the application (i.e. spends at least 10 seconds on the app page)

These numbers are updated daily. 

You can view reported users **by day** by hovering over the historical trendline.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Qi)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Edtech Analytics only reports data from devices with the Clever Plus extension enabled and does not include usage on personal mobile devices, including iOS devices.  

**Applications**

-   **Total apps:** This shows the total number of [allow listed edtech apps](https://assets.clever.com/pulse/libraryAppDomains.json) identified by Clever. We’re constantly adding to this list, so you may see the number of apps increase as these are added. Don’t see an app on our [list](https://assets.clever.com/pulse/libraryAppDomains.json)? [Let us know](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326?language=en_US) so we can add it. 
-   **Clever apps:** Applications that have been added at the district level.
-   [Library apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672?language=en_US)**:** The total number of Clever Library applications added to Clever Portal by your teachers.
-   **Other apps:** Show the total number of allow listed Edtech applications not added through Clever, or any weblink—regardless of whether it’s accessed through Clever or not.
    
    Each section is clickable so you can view only those specific application categories in the full list underneath.   
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Qs)
    

**Applications - Usage data**

-   The **Students %** and **Teacher %** metrics show the percent of students and teachers using the app, out of the total reported by the Clever Plus extension.
-   **Active time per user** is the average time of all user sessions during the time range selected on the page (since initial setup, in the last 28 days, in the last 7 days, etc.). A user session occurs when a student or teacher is actively using the app. **Active time** is when the user is on the application tab in their browser. If they navigate away from the tab, they're not considered active.  
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFhB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Qx)

**In the example above:**

-   984 students and 97 teachers are reported which includes users that are:
    -   synced to Clever
    -   have the Clever Plus extension installed on Chromebooks and/or Windows devices
    -   have been actively using a allow listed Edtech application.
-   4% of the 984 students and 4% of the 97 teachers used Word Munchers for 10 minutes on average during the current school year.

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Below are some common questions about EdTech Analytics If you have more questions not answered in this article, please feel free to reach out to support!  
 

**What devices and browsers are supported?**

-   Clever's extension is available for Chrome and Edge browsers. Clever's setup guide provides instructions for **Chromebooks** and **Windows devices using Chrome browsers**. Districts using MacBooks can access Edtech Analytics as long as they run Chrome with the extension enabled. While Clever does not currently provide setup guidelines for mobile devices (e.g. iOS, Android, etc.), the extension can report on other types of devices as long as the user is logged into the browser with an email that the district has applied the settings to.

**Which Identity Providers are supported?**

-   Your users must be logging into their devices with either Google, ADFS, or Entra ID. We currently do not support devices using LDAPS to authenticate users.

**Where can I find a copy of Clever's privacy policy?**

-   In Step 2 of the guide, you'll find the [Clever Edtech Analytics Addendum](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/terms). We also recommend checking out our [Trust Center](https://clever.com/trust) for more information on how Clever handles student data privacy as a whole. 

**Should I apply the policies to User and Device OUs?**

-   Your district can apply the settings to either user or device OUs, and we recommend applying the policies to both.

**How many users or devices should I set this for?**

-   We recommend applying this to at least 500 devices or 10% of students. The Edtech Analytics dashboard will not appear until data is collected at that threshold.

**Do I need to complete both guides?**

-   The first guide is for Chromebooks and the second guide is for Windows Devices. If your district is only using one type of device, then you can skip ahead to complete the guide. 

**Which extension should I delete?**

-   The Clever Plus extension (ID - `dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa`) provides the functionality for both Saved Passwords and Edtech Analytics. We recommend removing the Clever extension (ID - `nopfnnpnopgmcnkjchnlpomggcdjfepo`), but having both will not affect the normal user flow.

**Can I export EdTech Analytics data?**

-   Yes! Data can be exported by clicking **Export all data** in the top right. Clever does not support the automatic export of EdTech Analytics data (i.e. to a SFTP directory)

  
If you have any questions about Edtech Analytics, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help! 

* * *

### **Related Articles:**

-   [For School Tech Leads: EdTech Analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044719192)

title: Participation & Resource Usage Reports
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554) 2\. [Participation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311#step2) 3\. [Resource Usage](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2) 4\. [Exporting Reports](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311#h_01EQC67PNP6Z0TAJJ6VDYHHHAA)  5. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311#FAQs) ## Overview With participation reports, Clever provides greater insight into your users' participation and daily activities. To opt in to participation reports, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Analytics > Reports](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/reports/signup). Clever currently requires a two-week setup time to aggregate data and make reports available to districts. Once you have signed up, Clever email you when participation reports are ready for your account. **Subject:** _Your participation reports are ready!_ ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TV6r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Qo) Once Clever has prepared participation reports for your schools, navigate to [Analytics > Reports](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/reports/signup) to view the data. On this page, you can view reports for the current week, Monday-Sunday. To view previous weeks, use the date selector in the top left:  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TV6r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285R7) At this time, reports are available via manual download or [automated SFTP delivery](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049642311#ExportingReports). ## Participation Participation reports provide a daily snapshot that summarizes usage for students, teachers, and staff in your district, including inactive ones. Participation reports can be downloaded individually or in bulk. Clicking **Download week** will download a zip file with the student, teacher, and staff files for each day of the selected week. ![Participation reports](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TV6r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285RC) The data fields available in the download files are:

Field Name

Description

dateDate when user was active in the district timezone
sis_idThe SIS ID (student_id) associated with the Clever record for the user. If the user's record is no longer active in Clever, the SIS ID field will display as blank.
clever_user_idThe Clever ID for the user
clever_school_idThe Clever ID of the school associated with the Clever record for the user. 
activeUser was active on Clever on this date. 

The active use of Clever is currently defined if the user performs any of the following actions:

  • Log into their district Clever account
  • Access an application by clicking on the app icon in the Clever Portal
  • Access an application through an Instant Login Link
  • Logged in to an application using a Log in with Clever button
  • Accessing any link added to the Clever portal by the district, school, or teacher
num_loginsThe number of times the user accessed resources through Clever during the day
num_resources_accessedThe number of unique resources accessed through Clever during the day
school_nameThe name of the primary school assigned for the user
## Resource Usage Resource Usage reports provide a daily snapshot of each resource accessed by a user on a given day and are available for active students, teachers, and staff.  Resource Usage reports can be downloaded individually or in bulk. Clicking **Download week** will download a zip file with the student, teacher, and staff files for each day of the selected week. ![Resource usage](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TV6r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Q5) The data fields available in the download files are:

Field

Description

dateDate when user was active in the district timezone
sis_idThe SIS ID (student_id) associated with the Clever record for the user. If the user's record is no longer active in Clever, the SIS ID field will display as blank.
clever_user_idThe Clever ID for the user
clever_school_idThe Clever ID of the school associated with the Clever record for the use
resource_typeThe type of resource accessed by the user. Can be one of:
  • clever-district-added
  • clever-teacher-added
  • district-link
  • teacher-link
resource_nameThe name of the resource on the portal. Could be the URL in case an unnamed link was added to the Clever portal
resource_idThe Clever ID of the resource accessed by the user. Useful in case the name of the resource is changed.
num_accessThe number of times the specific resource was accessed through Clever during the day
school_nameThe name of the primary school assigned for the user
## Exporting Reports  Navigate to [Analytics > Analytics settings](https://schools.clever.com/analytics/settings) to enable SFTP exports of reports. Once enabled, Clever will display the information to connect to the SFTP directory for your schools. Clever will automatically upload reports to the SFTP directory at the same time the data is made available in the Clever Dashboard. Daily activity reports are available the next day by 1pm local time. Reports will be organized as follows: - Folder: daily-participation - File: {yyyy-mm-dd}-daily-participation-students.csv - File: {yyyy-mm-dd}-daily-participation-teachers.csv - File: {yyyy-mm-dd}-daily-participation-staff.csv - Folder: resource-usage - File: {yyyy-mm-dd}-resource-usage-students.csv - File: {yyyy-mm-dd}-resource-usage-teachers.csv - File: {yyyy-mm-dd}-resource-usage-staff.csv ![Analytics Settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TV6r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004apIV) * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Which roles have access to Participation Reports?** - Clever Admins and District Curriculum Leads can _enable_ reports.  - Clever Admins and District Curriculum Leads can _view_ reports. **How can teachers view student participation data?** - Teachers have a version of participation reports called **Analytics**. You can find information on Analytics [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360041755311).  **When are Participation Reports updated?** - Reports for daily activity are available the next day by 1 pm local time. _Example: the participation activity for Tuesday will be available on Wednesday at 1 pm local time._  **Is this the same data that is available to teachers through Analytics?** - Yes, Clever generates the exports using the same information visible to teachers in the Portal. This ensures that the teacher and school can access the same information! **Will teachers be able to export the reports in the Portal?** - No. Export functionality will only be available to Clever Admins. * * * **Related articles:** - [Analytics Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360050299552) - [Portal Analytics](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115005292523) - [Edtech Analytics - Overview and FAQs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039420391)

title: Portal Analytics
text:
![Screen Shot 2022-07-18 at 4.19.25 PM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004apkt)

This article contains the following:  
1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005292523#h_8e6733e5-38fb-4cc7-a5e2-13459ff0f366)  
2. [Filters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005292523#h_7bdcab68-cfca-4fe0-8f69-75150ae2defa)  
3. [Metrics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005292523#h_a4ea8388-d017-4684-8196-9904534e9091)

##   
Overview

At Clever, we understand how important it is to track application logins and usage for your users. Using [Portal Analytics](https://schools.clever.com/analytics), Clever admins have access to graphs and statistics that show how many users are accessing their applications, how often they log in, and which schools or apps are being used the most! This article provides a breakdown of the available data and how it can be filtered.  
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png)**Portal Analytics includes data for all logins powered by Clever, including [instant login links](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205546348).

![Portal analytics page with filters and line chart of data](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WjR4r)

* * *

##   
Filters

First, let's take a look at the available filters. You can apply different filters to narrow down the usage data and focus on specific users, applications, and school sites. If the selected filters don't apply to a chart, the chart will temporarily be hidden.

###   
**Time & date range**

You can filter Portal Analytics by time and date ranges.  
  
Click the time range to choose from the las 7 days, 28 days, by school year, or Custom dates, which allows for a custom time range any time in the past year. The **Export all data** button will download data associated with your selected filters.   
  
![Time range with Last 7 days selected](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285PV)  
  
Choose the start and end date to select a custom date range.  
![Start and end date range selections](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062lWY)

###   
**Units**

Select whether you'd like to view your data as a percentage (e.g., 75% of all students have logged in) or in absolute terms (e.g., 7,500 students have logged in).   
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Pa)

### **App**

Select **All Apps** to view login data for all apps connected to your district's Clever account. To look more closely at a specific app's usage, select the application from the dropdown. When you select a specific app, the 'Usage by App' graph is disabled.  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Pf)  
  
 

### **Users, Grades, and Schools**

Here you can select whether you want to see usage data for students, teachers, or both.  
 ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Pk)

To look at the Portal Analytics for specific grade levels, select the grade(s) from the dropdown. Grades are based on _student_ grades, not the grade level for sections or teachers.

-   **Please note:** _The teacher filter can't be used with the grade filter._

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285NL)  
 

To focus on a specific site instead of **All Schools**, you can select the school location from the dropdown. Multiple school sites can be selected from the dropdown as well.

If you’re assigned a custom role in Clever that only allows you access to analytics data for specific scoped schools, you’ll only be able to select these schools or _All my schools_ from the dropdown. [Learn more about custom roles here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702).

-   **Please note:** _The_ _**Usage by School** graph is disabled when you select a single school._

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Pu)

* * *

##   
  
Metrics

Now that we know how to use filters to focus on specific areas, let's look at the different measures! The statistics shown are based on the users being [shared with the apps](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US). The metrics are **_not_** based on the total number of users in Clever.

If another admin scoped your analytics permissions to specific schools, you’ll only see metrics applicable to your scoped schools. Please reach out to your Clever admin account owner if you need settings adjusted.  
 

### **Usage by scoped users**

    ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOnD)

**Usage by scoped users:** This number reflects the number of users shared with the application.  
  
  
 

### **Unique Users**

  ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOot)

**Unique users:** This number reflects the unique number of **_shared_** users who have logged into the application.  
 

###   
  
**Total Logins**  
 ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOp3)

**Total Logins:** This number reflects the overall number of user logins.

###   
 

###   
**Daily Unique Users**

### ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOp8)

**Daily unique users:** This chart reflects the unique number of users who have logged into an application per day. Hover your mouse over a date to see the number of daily unique users for that day.

-   **Please note:** _This chart is disabled if you're using the_ _**School year to date** time frame filter or **Custom dates** filter._
    

###   
  
 

### **Logins by app**

### ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOpI)

**Logins by App:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins for an individual application. Select the **Ascending** or **Descending** option to order apps by the number of unique logins.

###   
 

### **Logins by school**  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOnr)

**Logins by school:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins from users at each school site. Select the 'Ascending' or 'Descending' option to order schools by the number of unique logins.

###   
  
  
**Login Method / Device / Browser**

### ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cFfZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BOpS)

**Login Method****:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins by login type. Users will be counted twice if they log in using different login methods, but only once if they log in multiple times using the same Identity Provider (IDP).

**Device****:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins for each device. Users will be counted twice if they are logging into different devices, but only once if they log in multiple times to the same device type.

**Browser****:** This number reflects the number of unique user logins for each browser. Users will be counted twice if logging in through different browsers, but only once if they log in multiple times through the same browser.

-   **Please note:** _These charts are disabled if you're using the_ _**Custom dates** filter._

 

### **Usage by Additional Resources**

If you've [added any links to your district's Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115002942963), you can view the number of clicks each resource has gotten under the "Usage by Additional Resources" section! For instance, let's say you added a link to your Student Information System for teachers. You can see how many times this was clicked during a specific timeframe as set by the filters mentioned above. 

-   **Please note:** _This section is disabled if you're using the_ _**Custom dates** filter._
