title: For Clever Admins: Clever’s email policy for teachers
text:
## Overview

This article details Clever's policy around teacher email communications.  If enabled from the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Communication](https://schools.clever.com/portal/communication/notifications) page, there are three types of emails Clever may send to teachers:

-   **Professional development:** Emails about training, certification, webinars, tutorials, and Clever Academy, our free online training and certification program for educators.
-   **News and product updates:** Emails that cover new feature announcements, partnerships, new product resources, and Clever seasonal programs just for teachers.
-   **Service-related:** Emails that facilitate the teacher's login and use of Clever according to the features enabled by their school organization. Examples of these emails include:

1.  Shared school organization resources
2.  Password retrieval
3.  Changes in terms of service
4.  Product notifications

## Teacher Communications

Teachers will only receive **professional development** and **news and product update** emails from Clever if:

-   Their school organization has subscribed them to receive emails from the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Communications](https://schools.clever.com/portal/communication/notifications) page.
-   They have a teacher account in Clever.
-   The teacher has not unsubscribed themselves from receiving Clever emails.
-   Their school organization has committed to using the Clever Portal throughout the school year.

**Service-related emails** are critical for account functionality; for this reason, they are not subject to the school organization or teacher's email subscription settings. However, teachers can disable service-related emails by using the unsubscribe link in the email(s) they receive. In addition, teachers will only receive service-related emails from Clever if their user account is synced with Clever.

**Unsubscribe:** Every teacher email will contain a clear unsubscribe link providing the ability to opt out of receiving Clever emails.

**Third-parties:** Clever promises to never rent, sell or share teacher email addresses with third-party vendors for marketing purposes, per [Clever's privacy policy](https://clever.com/about/privacy-policy).

## Clever's Teacher Email Policy

Clever receives frequent requests from teachers and school organizations for more information about Clever utilization best practices. Our email content helps equip teachers with the knowledge and tools they need to succeed, whether teaching from school or remotely. Our goal is to help teachers save time while managing their digital classrooms and staying connected with students and families or guardians. In addition, we provide them with resources that enable them to address questions and issues quickly and independently. 

Aside from professional development and news/product updates, Clever also sends service-related emails or account alerts to teachers (e.g., resetting password emails, downloading Clever Badges, etc.). These transactional emails facilitate the teacher's login and use of Clever according to the features contracted and enabled by the school organization and are often critical to account functionality. 

We're excited to help teachers get the most out of the Clever Portal for their classroom and continue to save them valuable teaching time!

title: For Clever Admins: Announcements
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025690932#h_34bc5df4-a48b-404b-a5a9-7ae3560a8be0)  
2. [Creating announcements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025690932#h_83e722fd-99a6-49e9-accc-69892848c46e)  
3. [Announcement preview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025690932#h_c91156f5-25ab-4ea9-8342-dc80fb097d4a)  
4. [Setting a priority notification](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360025690932#h_35d16f3a-a8b0-4673-a2a6-ea768e5ae0c8)

## Overview

Depending on the role and permissions they have in Clever, administrators on your Admin team can send announcements to various users in the Clever Portal! This article details the process for creating, previewing and sharing announcements.

## Creating announcements

To create an announcement for users in your school organization:

-   Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings > Communication](https://schools.clever.com/portal/communication/notifications) page.
-   Select 'Create notification', and then complete the form.
    -   **Dates: When should this announcement appear?** 
        -   The announcement will be visible in Clever Portal for selected users between 12:00AM on the Start Date and 11:59PM on the End Date (in your school organization's time zone)
    -   **Select Schools**  
        -   Select the schools where this announcement will display
    -   **Title & Body: What should this announcement say?** 
        -   You can create an announcement of up to 250 characters for your users to see.
    -   **Visibility: Who should see this announcement?**
        -   Students, teachers and/or staff
    -   **Links (Optional):** **Add a link to more information**
        -   You can include a hyperlink to direct users to resources or additional information.
-   Once the announcement is created, you'll be able to see whether it is 'Live', 'Upcoming' or 'Expired' for the selected users in Clever.

![Example Portal announcement](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHvR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nhzYf)

![Announcement status examples](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHvR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ni1U1)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHvR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Os)**Please note:** Notifications for users in your school organization can be created be created by admins with school scoped permissions and School Tech Leads. For more information on user roles, [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726). 

## Announcement preview

When a selected user logs in to Clever, they will see a bell icon in the top-right corner with the number of unread notifications. They can click on the bell icon to open the announcement.

![Screenshot highlighting the Clever portal's notification bell.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHvR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bd0t)

## Setting a priority notification

A priority notification can also be assigned to announcements. Priority notifications will display at the top of the list for selected users. Only one notification can be priority across the entire school organization. 

-   To set a notification as priority, select the star icon in the 'Actions' column. Priority notifications will also be noted under the 'Status' column.  
    ![Screenshot showcasing the priority notification.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHvR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Rg) 
-   Priority notifications will display in Clever Portal at the top of the notifications dropdown and are denoted with a blue star. 

          ![Screenshot of a priority notification display.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHvR&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003Bd13) 

## FAQs

**How do School Tech Leads create announcements?**

-   School Tech Leads can create announcements for the schools they are connected to. For instructions on how School Tech Leads can create announcements, visit: [For School Tech Leads: Announcements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360037401532?language=en_US)

**Can I create an announcement for select schools?**

-   Yes! Announcements can be filtered by School and User Type.

title: For Clever Admins: Using and recommending Clever Library
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471#overview) 2\. [Recommending the Library to teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471#header1) 3\. [Recommending Library applications to teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471#header2) 4\. [Viewing Library installs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471#header3) 5\. [Additional Library settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471#header4) 6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360015683471#header5) ## Overview The Clever Library is a safe way for teachers to explore new classroom tools. Instead of finding new applications anywhere on the internet that may have varying data privacy standards, teachers can try new apps in the Clever Library with built-in data-privacy guardrails and admin oversight. When a teacher adopts a Library application with SSO, Clever shares only the absolute minimum information: student first name, last initial, grade level, and course enrollment. Clever does not share any sensitive information with Library applications, including student numbers, SIS IDs, emails, state IDs, or demographic information. Furthermore, all Library applications sign a universal data privacy agreement. This article will guide you through supporting the use of the Clever Library and making recommendations for teachers. If you need information on setting up Library restrictions, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741). * * * ## Recommending the Library to teachers Clever Library handles rostering automatically and ensures data minimization, making it safer than teachers signing up for apps independently. You can actively recommend the Library as the primary place for teachers to discover tools. Below is a suggested email template you can utilize to share more about the Clever Library with your teachers. **Email template to recommend teachers use the Library for resources**   _Subject: The safest way to find new classroom apps_ Hi Team, We know how important it is to find the right digital tools to engage your students. To help you do this safely and save you time on setup, we recommend using the **Clever Library** to discover new applications. **Why use the Clever Library?** - **It's Safer:** Apps in the Library sign a universal data privacy agreement and only receive the minimum necessary student data (just first name and last initial). - **It's Faster:** You don't need to manually create student accounts. Rostering is handled automatically through Clever. - **It's Approved:** Tools in the Library operate within our data privacy guardrails. You can access the Library directly from your Teacher Portal, and learn more about adding applications [in this Clever article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672). Best, \[Admin Name\] * * * ## Recommending Library applications to teachers To recommend resources, go to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Library Controls > Recommended.](https://schools.clever.com/library/recommended) Recommend a resource by searching for it by name. We also encourage adding notes to your recommendations to highlight to teachers why and for what purpose a resource is recommended. You may also delete a recommendation at any time. ![Library recommendations page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cc04M) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Tc) **Please note:** The Clever Library is a place for teachers to find and adopt resources - therefore, the only resources that can be recommended are those that support teacher sign-ups. School or district-adopted resources, such as Dreambox, Lexia, or iReady, aren't available in the Library. Resources that are recommended will appear front and center when a teacher visits the Library. ![Clever Library home page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VYqFG) When a teacher visits a recommended resource, your recommendation and associated notes are featured prominently.  ![Recommended app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000SmyEf) * * * ## Viewing Library Installs To view applications that have been installed by teachers, navigate to your [Library controls > Applications](https://schools.clever.com/teacher-installs) tab**.** Here you'll see a column next to each application that shows you how many Teacher Installs the app has. ![Teacher Install column](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZGzON)  To view installs with greater detail, scroll to the bottom and select **Export teacher install data.** ![Export button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Tr) The information provided in the downloadable CSV is described below:

Field

Description

teacher_idThe Clever ID of the teacher that installed the resource
first_nameThe first name of the teacher that installed the resource
last_nameThe last name of the teacher that installed the resource
emailThe email address of the teacher that installed the resource
schoolThe school of the teacher that installed the resource
app_idThe Clever ID of the resource installed
app_nameThe name of the installed resource
install_dateThe date the teacher added the resource
* * * ## Additional Library settings To ensure administrators always have control over their school organization’s EdTech usage through Clever, there are additional controls admins can utilize to manage the Library. Below is a short list of these additional controls. You can learn more in this article. - **New application approvals:** Configure settings so that any newly added Library application requires your approval before teachers can begin utilizing it. - **New application notifications:** Ensure you are informed about new Library applications by setting up email notifications. - **Block a resource:** If there is an application your school organization has determined your teachers shouldn’t utilize, you can block it in the Library. You can also bulk block applications. - **Turn off the Clever Library:** You can also elect to turn off the Clever Library for your school organization. * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Can I block the Library or specific applications?** - Yes, please [see this article for more information](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741). * * * **Related articles:** - [For Clever Admins: Managing Library restrictions and application approvals](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741) - [For Clever Admins: Clever Library privacy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001453)

title: Summer School: Application requirements
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042616652#header1)  
2\. [Integration details](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042616652#header2)  
3\. [Data requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042616652#header3)  
4\. [Contract](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042616652#header4)  
5\. [Content mapping](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042616652#header5)

## Overview

Every application your school organization wants to use during the summer has different considerations regarding how it supports Summer School. This section breaks down some of the common circumstances and suggests guiding questions you can ask your app partner to make sure your school organization has all the information you need to offer that app this summer.  
 

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dUSr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you want to pause syncing your data to a particular application, please see this article: [For Clever Admins: Pausing your sync for a specific app.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)  This is a great tool for semester rollover and summer school, but don't confuse it with a [SIS sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507). 

* * *

## Integration details

You'll want to speak with your app partners about their Clever integrations as you prepare for summer school. Certain realities of summer school (such as students transferring to a new campus) can create difficulties for how applications process your data. You'll want to reach out to your app partners as soon as possible to plan for any of these considerations. 

  
**Questions for your app partners:**

-   Does your application accept students enrolled at multiple schools and/or sections?
-   Does your application accept Clever’s extension fields?
-   Does your application recommend specific sharing permissions?  

* * *

## Data requirements

Every application has slightly different data requirements. While some require just first name, last name, and class associations, others may require further data points.

Make sure to ask your vendors what data is required for summer school and if it is different than during the rest of the year to avoid needing to make last-minute changes to your rosters to meet requirements.

**Questions for your app partners:**

-   What data is required for accounts to be generated?
-   What data is recommended to take full advantage of your application features?

* * *

## Contract

Check with your curriculum team and/or the application 'owner' at your school organization. Some contracts are due for renewal during the summer which might mean you need a new contract to maintain service, even if your sync is paused. Other contracts might limit the number of users your school organization has access to and assigning that application over summer school might exceed that limit. Have a conversation within your schools to ensure you are ready for these limitations.

**Questions for your app partners:**

-   When does our contract for your service expire? Does it include summer school?
-   How many licenses have we purchased for this service? Do we have remaining licenses for summer school?

  
  

* * *

## Content mapping

Certain textbooks require a manual content-mapping process after rostering through Clever is complete to ensure the right students receive the right books. Reach out to your application partner to understand if and how they map content and get tips from their experts on best practices for the summer.

Most apps will require a specific class or course codes to help with that content assignment that you may need to pass along to your summer school staff for activation.  
  
**Questions for your app partners:**

-   Do you require content mapping from Clever? 

* * *

**Related articles**

-   [Summer school: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615332)
-   [Summer school: Sync settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027745731)
-   [Summer school: Creating data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615912)
-   [Summer school: Final details](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043055471)

title: Summer School: Final details
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043055471#overview)  
2. [Sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043055471#sharing)  
3\. [Notify teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043055471#notify)  
4\. [Review your Admin Team and account owner](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043055471#adminteam)  
5\. [Update tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043055471#techsupportcontact)  
6\. [Review Clever Badges](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043055471#step2)

## Overview

This article outlines the final steps to ensure a smooth transition to summer school. We'll walk you through reviewing application sharing permissions, including recommended best practices for sharing summer school data. Additionally, you'll find essential reminders on communicating plans to teachers, updating your tech support contact information, and managing the annual review process for Clever Badges.

* * *

## Sharing permissions

Once you finalize your summer school rosters in Clever, ensure that all of your users have access to the correct applications. In your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), review the sharing rules for each application, taking care to ensure that you are sharing the new sections, students, teachers, and staff with the applications they need. 

**Questions to ask:** 

-   Which applications do we need to use over the summer?
-   Who needs to use these apps?
-   How can we easily identify and share summer school users? (Recommended: [extension fields](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912))

View instructions for [adjusting sharing permissions here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).   
  
Please note, when using a **Sharing by Schools** rule, sections with a school association that is different from a teacher's primary school won't be shared. For example, a teacher has sections at two schools: School A and School B. If you set the sharing permissions for the application to share School A, only the teacher's section at School A will be shared. This is important for teachers who will be providing instruction at an alternate school location during summer school.   
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** We recommend using a **[Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)** sharing type for summer school data. 

* * *

## Notify teachers 

We highly recommend notifying teachers of your summer school plan! You can use templates [found here](https://clever.academy/quick-start-prepping-for-summer-school/784593?user_type=district_admin&reg=1).  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bSOj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** When you start your new school year in Clever, our system will automatically update any Teacher Pages shared with specific sections to **Just me** sharing. This excludes **Just Me** and **All sections** pages. We recommend you notify your teachers so they can take action. Learn more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001158323#newschoolyear).

  
Clever's announcements tool is available to all school organizations and delivers notifications directly to students and teachers in the Clever Portal. To learn more about announcements, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360025690932).

* * *

## Review your Admin team and account owner

Changes in personnel and procedures often occur at the end of the school year. For account security, please review the administrators listed on your [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page. You'll want to remove any administrators who are no longer working at your school organization. If new administrators are joining your Clever team, have them check out our [quick start guides](https://clever.academy/page/quick-starts?user_type=district_admin) in [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin)!

Additionally, please ensure that your Clever Admin (owner) will continue to work for your school organization. Only the account owner can transfer ownership to another administrator. If your current owner is leaving your school organization, Clever recommends that the owner transfer ownership of the Clever account to another admin before they leave.

* * *

## Update tech support contact 

As we mentioned above, we know that changes in personnel and procedures often occur at the end of the school year. In addition to reviewing your Admin team, please review your [tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049312351) to ensure that students and teachers can receive help from your team if needed. You can find directions for updating your tech support contact [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360049312351). 

* * *

##   
Review Clever Badges

Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. If a printed Badge has an expiration date, it will continue to work past that date. Newly printed Badges will not have an expiration date. 

Admins should still void and print Badges during your district’s natural transition period, like summer or winter rollover. 

If your rollover period is in the summer, we recommend voiding and reprinting all Badges during the summer so you can plan to do so annually each summer moving forward.

title: For Clever Admins: Purchasing Clever's paid products
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050628211#header1)  
2\. [Purchasing Clever’s paid products](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050628211#header2)  
3\. [Reviewing your paid products](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050628211#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360050628211#faq)

## Overview

The [Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043093) is your one-stop shop for educators to purchase Clever's paid products, including [Clever IDM,](https://support.clever.com/s/article/000001466) [Classroom MFA,](https://support.clever.com/s/article/000001616) and [Premium Support, as well as consulting and training services](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646). This article addresses making purchases, locating order information, managing quotes, invoices, and more. If you have additional questions, this guide may help resolve them without needing to reach out.  
 

* * *

## Purchasing Clever’s paid products

To get started with purchasing a Clever product, follow the steps below:

1.  Log into your Clever Admin account by heading to schools.clever.com.
    
2.  Navigate to the Clever Product you’d like to purchase:
    
    -   Clever IDM: [Clever Dashboard > User Management > IDM](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) 
        
    -   Classroom MFA: [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Classroom MFA](https://schools.clever.com/mfa) 
        
    -   Premium Support: Training & Support > Premium Support
        
    -   Consulting: Training & Support > Clever Consulting
        
    -   Training: Training & Support > Clever Training
        
    -   CI Solutions & Clever Badges: [Authentication > Badges > Badges+](https://schools.clever.com/badges/product/clever-badges-plus)
        
3.  Review the overview of the product and if it feels like a good fit, click **Get started**.
    
4.  Enter the number of licenses or sessions you wish to purchase, then click **Proceed to pricing summary.**
    
5.  Select your desired subscription length and dates before reviewing your pricing summary. If all looks good, click **Proceed to payment method**.
    
    -   Please note that the total number of users may exceed the amount specified in step 1, as each product may have a minimum user requirement for access.
        
6.  To purchase, select whether you’d like to pay by credit card or by purchase order and enter the required information.
    
7.  Next, click **Review your order/quote** (depending on the payment method selected)
    
8.  Lastly, review your order or quote and complete your purchase.
    

If you currently use a paid product with Clever, you can also renew your subscription via the App Store! For more information on renewals, please see our article [Clever products: Purchasing, billing, and renewals](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001472).

* * *

## Reviewing your paid products

You can also review any current paid product subscriptions in the Clever Dashboard. Navigate to your [Billing page](https://schools.clever.com/orders), and you’ll see an overview of your subscriptions, in-progress orders, and saved items:

![Subscriptions page in the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Uvgn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IPzQv)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can I send a check to pay for my order? If so, where do I send my check?** 

-   Yes, you can send us a check to pay for your order! Please send it to 75 Remittance Drive, Dept. 6598 Chicago, IL 60675.
    

**Where do I need to send my PO and/or Tax-Exempt forms?**

-   POs and Tax-Exempt forms are uploaded on the order page which is accessible in the Sidebar when you click [**Billing**](https://schools.clever.com/orders).
    

**Why do I see more student licenses than I wanted to purchase?** 

-   Some of Clever’s paid products have a minimum amount you must spend to use the product. So if your quote is below the minimum, Clever will update the total to meet the minimum for that product. 
    

**How do I request a demo?**

-   To request a demo for one of Clever’s products, simply fill out [this form](https://www.clever.com/district-request-demo) and Clever will reach out to get the demo scheduled for you.
    

**Who do I contact to manage my subscription?**

-   If you need to manage your subscription and you don’t have a direct contact, please reach out to our Support Team at support.clever.com.
    

**How to edit a quote to change the number of licenses?** 

-   To update your quote, you will need to start a new order. 
    

**How do I switch my quote from one product to another?**

-   If you created a quote for the wrong product, you must start a new order for the correct product.
    

**My badges aren’t working with the CI Solutions + Clever Badges integration. Help!**

-   We recommend reaching out to our award-winning support team at support.clever.com.
    

**Find more info about Clever’s paid products:  
**[Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466?language=en_US)  
[Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616?language=en_US)  
[Premium Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646?language=en_US#header3)  
[Training and consulting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646?language=en_US#header2)  
[CI Solutions + Clever Badges](https://www.cardintegrators.com/industry-solutions/student-id-card-printing/)  
[Google for Education Plus + Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001653?language=en_US)

title: Summer School: Creating data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [What is custom data?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615912#step1)  
2\. [How does custom data support rostering for summer school?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615912#step2)  
3\. [How can I upload custom data?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615912#step3)

##   
What's custom data?

Custom data is a way to create data records within Clever that don't exist in your district’s SIS (Student Information System) or CSV data files. This can be helpful in cases such as creating summer school data, organizing unique groups of students, and adding staff members who are not in the district’s information system. Custom data can be created, edited, and browsed from the Custom Data page at [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data.](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data)  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmyX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Custom data should not duplicate data that is already in Clever that is synced by your SIS. If a user or a section is already in Clever, do not add it to your custom data. 

* * *

## How does custom data support rostering for summer school?

We know that many districts house summer school data outside of the SISs or CSV data files used during the school year. Custom data enables you to easily upload new summer rosters into Clever without reconfiguring the regular school-year sync. Custom data also allows you to consistently update summer school data while "freezing" previous school-year data in Clever via the [sync pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507).

If you plan to add new summer school users and sections to Clever and share them with learning applications after your sync is paused you’ll need to use custom data. Please note, you will only need to upload custom students, teachers, and staff if the users are not already synced to Clever. 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bmyX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you [pause your sync for specific app(s)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607), custom data will **not** be shared with any apps you pause the sync for.

* * *

##   
How can I upload custom data?

The easiest way to upload custom data is usually by manually uploading [custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data/browse/students) in the Clever Dashboard.

Alternatively, all schools can upload data via your SFTP client using the directions below. If your primary sync type is not an [SFTP sync type](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US), contact Clever support to get access to your own Clever SFTP Directory before proceeding.

1.  Log in to your SFTP client.
2.  Enter your Clever SFTP credentials. If you don’t have them handy, you can access them in Clever under [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings).
3.  Upload your custom data. If you’re new to adding custom data, reference the following Help Center articles: 
    -   [Custom Data: Sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923) 
    -   [Custom Data: Teachers](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020051691)
    -   [Custom Data: Staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026950471)
    -   [Custom Data: Students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360029599131)

Before getting started, there are a few important points to keep in mind: 

-   **Schools cannot be added via custom data. Please ensure all necessary school sites are syncing from your SIS before any sync pauses.**
-   You can bulk upload custom teachers, staff, students, sections, and enrollments via the Clever Dashboard or SFTP. 
-   **Custom students cannot be added to existing non-custom sections.**   
-   **Co-teachers can be added manually to custom sections.** 
-   **You can bulk upload [extension fields](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912). Adding extension fields may help with setting up sharing rules.** 

  
Learn more about how to upload custom data [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332).  
 

  
The final step of the process is [Stage 4: Final details](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043055471)

title: Summer School: Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615332#header1)  
2\. [Guiding questions for summer school setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615332#header2)  
3\. [Steps for success](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042615332#header3)

## Overview

We're here to help ensure that your schools have the best summer with Clever yet. Each of our summer school Help Center articles listed in the steps for success below has guiding questions and resources for you to review to ensure that your rosters and applications are ready for summer school. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000OoYL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YsyZ)  
For more robust support, including activities, email templates for teachers, and more, check out [Prepping for Summer School](https://clever.academy/quick-start-prepping-for-summer-school?reg=1?user_type=district_admin) in Clever Academy! 

This guide is designed to be useful for all schools regardless of their summer school plans.

  
 

* * *

## Guiding questions for summer school setup

The first step to prepare for summer school is to ask three key questions:

-   Which applications will you be using over the summer?
-   Will you need to add new students, teachers, staff, or sections to your Clever sync?
-   How does my district generate summer school rosters?

  
 

* * *

## Steps for success

Summer school is unique because most districts need to have two sets of rostering data:

1.  Rostering data from the previous school year (Spring, second semester, Q4, etc.) is typically paused over the summer to preserve access to learning applications and resources for students, teachers, and staff not enrolled in summer school.
2.  Rostering data for summer school. To maintain both rosters in Clever, we recommend that districts pause their regular Clever sync and supplement their summer school rosters using custom data.

To set up your Clever account for summer, you'll need to review:

-   Step 1: [Application requirements](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042616652)
-   Step 2: [Sync settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360027745731)
-   Step 3: [Creating data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615912)
-   Step 4: [Final details](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043055471)

  
All steps must be completed in order to ensure student, teacher, and staff access during the summer.

To get started configuring your Clever account for summer school, please move on to Step 1: [Application requirements](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042616652?language=en_US).
