title: How do I contact Clever Support?
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326#overview) 2. [Hours of operation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326#hours) 3. [Holidays](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326#holidays) 4. [How to contact support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326#contactus) 5\. [Ensure you can receive emails from Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326#delivery) ## Overview At Clever Support, our goal is to provide the information you need as quickly as possible. Our Help Center provides 24/7 access to our extensive knowledge base and learning courses to support you.  If you're unable to find the solution to your question or issue, you can click **Contact Support** to submit a request to our support team. When filling out the support request form, please provide as much detail as possible, including example users, records, error messages, steps to reproduce the problem, etc. This will ensure we route your request to the correct team and specialist to meet your needs. ## ## Hours of Operation Monday - Friday, 7am - 8pm ET If you do not receive a response from our team within 1 business day, please check your spam and junk folders. Additionally, ensure your email provider has enabled access for both **@clever.com** and **@salesforce.com**. As Clever team members, we value the opportunity to come together during special events and important meetings. This may mean our response times are a bit slower or that we’re unavailable by phone for a short period. If you need help, reach out at support.clever.com — we’ll be glad to assist you via email. Need quick help? Clever’s Virtual Assistant is available 24/7 with product tips and guidance * * * ## Holidays

Holiday

Date

Day of Week

Winter HolidaysDecember 24, 2026 - January 1, 2027Thursday- Following Wednesday
Martin Luther King Jr. DayJanuary 19, 2026Monday
President's DayFebruary 16, 2026Monday
Memorial DayMay 25, 2026Monday
JuneteenthJune 19, 2026Friday
Independence DayJuly 3, 2026Friday
Labor DaySeptember 7, 2026Monday
Thanksgiving DayNovember 26, 2026Thursday
Day after ThanksgivingNovember 27, 2026Friday
Winter HolidaysDecember 24, 2025 - January 1, 2026Wednesday - Following Friday
* * * ## How to contact support  Clever Support is most efficient at quickly solving issues submitted via the **Support** button, which is available at the bottom right of the Clever Help Center. ![support button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dEpV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000040Nbp)   _This is an example image of the support button. If you don't see the support button in the bottom right, please see the note below about your network settings._  **⚠️** If you do not see the button for support, please contact your IT department. They will need to [allow network access to IP addresses associated with Zoom Contact Center](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0060548#contact-center). For additional network questions, please contact [ipaddresses@clever.com](mailto:ipaddresses@clever.com). Once you click the button, select your Clever user type. Once selected, select a common question or enter your own in the chat. Please **do not** share [sensitive data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001041326#noPII) like names, passwords, or data files. If you need to identify an example user for our team, please use their Clever ID from their Profile page in the Clever Dashboard. To get the best results, please try to provide a short description of your question or problem. This helps us deliver the most accurate answer possible. For example, instead of writing "**Login",** a better entry would be "**Students using Google can't log in to Clever"** or "**I am a teacher that can not access Newsela".** ![chat bot dialogue](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dEpV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000040NiH) Once your question is submitted, you will be presented with directions or knowledge related to the question. Use the scrollbar to the right to scroll through the articles provided. To view an article, select **Read more.** When prompted, if the provided information was helpful, select **Yes** If the provided information did not answer your question, select **No** Our virtual assistant will attempt twice to assist with your problem or question. If it's unable to help, select how you'd like to contact support to submit a request with our support team. Clever Support is open Monday - Friday, 7am - 8pm ET.  IMPORTANT  Please **do not** share sensitive data with Clever Support, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII), including: • Students' names • Any credentials (such as usernames and passwords) • API Tokens for applications When you need to specify a user running into trouble, please instead share their Clever ID, or, if that's unavailable, their Student Information System ID. When in doubt, please contact us first and clarify if it's safe to share data before sending anything. * * * ## Ensure you can receive emails from Clever In order to ensure you can properly receive mail sent from Clever's help desk platform (Salesforce), please check with your IT department to ensure that:  - Antivirus system is not blocking Salesforce emails (including how your rules and filters are set up) - SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are properly configured - Firewall is not blocking IPs - Mail is not arriving in the SPAM folder - [Issues with TLS](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000326722&type=1&mode=1&language=en_US) - notes Salesforce currently only supports TLS 1.2 for email encryption - [TLS Mail Delivery - Supported TLS Cipher suites](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?language=en_US&type=1&id=TLS-Mail-Delivery-Supported-TLS-cipher-suites)   Additional information such as **IP Addresses** and **Domains to Allow** can be found in [this article](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000321501&type=1).

title: For App Partners: Inviting & connecting districts to your app
text:
This article contains the following:   
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#overview)  
2. [Inviting districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#inviting)  
      • [Inviting districts that are already using Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#already)  
      • [Inviting districts that are not on Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#notonclever)  
3\. [Viewing pending invites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#pendinginvites)  
4. [Setting up a District Outreach Contact email address](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#EMAIL)  
5\. [Filtering for district statuses on the District Overview page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215120718#filtering)

## Overview

This article briefly overviews how to invite districts to connect with your application via Clever and how to follow up on these requests. For instructions on how to approving inbound requests from districts, please see our article [For App Partners: Manage inbound district requests](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/215806167). 

##   

##   
Inviting districts

You can invite districts individually, or if you want to send bulk invitations (to 50 or more districts), please contact your Application Success Manager.   
 

### Inviting districts that are already using Clever:

1\. Type in the name of the district that you want to search for.

2\. Click the district's name or **Invite to Connect**_._  
  
![invite district.jpg](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y8eb)  
 

[](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/articles/215806167)

3\. You can see whether the district is already utilizing Clever, their sync status, and how well their data matches up against your application's schema. Learn more about data compatibility [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360032261991). You can also **Invite** a district to connect with your app.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285bb) **Please note:** Invitations to connect through Clever are intended for districts that have already subscribed to your software services.

  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285bR)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285bW)  
 

4\. Once you click the **Invite**, fill out your message and the contact information. You can use the default message or edit it. You can also add a primary contact at the district or school. You can include multiple contacts through the **Additional Contact Emails** field.   
  

![App launch date modal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062qv4)  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285bb) **Please note:** The default app launch date is set to 30 days from district acceptance. District Administrators will still be able to edit their sharing rules and modify data before the date, but teachers and students won't see your application until the launch date has passed. You can also set a custom launch date if you wish!

  
  
5\. If the district is already on Clever you'll see an option to add a sharing request, requesting specific data to be shared.

![Recommend sharing settings modal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062qvY)  
  
6\. Once you send the invite, the email will automatically copy you, the district, and a member of the Clever team.

7\. Repeat! 

###   
Inviting districts that are not on Clever:

1\. Type in the name of the district you would like to search for. If they are not on Clever, it will be tagged as "Off Clever" when you search for it:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285bq)  
 

2\. From there, you will need to fill out the following information for this district and specify a curriculum contact that will be notified:  
 

![Off Clever app invite form](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063JuQ)

3\. The contact that you specify in this form will receive an email inviting them to connect their district through Clever so that they can connect with your application. It will look something like this:  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285bv)  
 

4\. From this email, the district or school can create a Clever account for themselves. If they create an account, a member of our District Onboarding team will reach out to help them get set up.   
 

* * *

## Viewing pending invites

To view and manage your existing invitations to districts, head to **District Overview > Pending Invites**. From there you can view and filter results based on the status of the invitation. Invitation statuses are either "pending", "approved", or "rejected".   
  
You can even send a one-time email reminder to districts who haven't yet accepted your invite!   
  
![District overview page with pending invites shown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062nyK)  
 

* * *

## Setting up a District Outreach Contact email address

You can also set a District Outreach Contact email when initiating the following communications with a district:

-   app invite
-   app un-invite
-   app invite reminder
-   data warning
-   district request approval
-   district request rejection
-   district disconnects
-   sync requests
-   app-side safety thresholds

This will allow you to send these communications with the name and email of your choice from any user without creating and maintaining a shared email account.

This contact will also surface to Clever Administrators in their Dashboard if they utilize your application, providing them with a quick reference for who to contact should they need help with the application. When adding the contact, you can check a box to prevent the Outreach Contact from showing to Clever Admins.  
  
Application team members with edit permissions can set a District Outreach Contact by:

1.  ​​​Navigating to your **Clever App Dashboard >Settings > General tab > Profile Settings > District Outreach Contact**. 

  
![Screenshot of the application settings page with district outreach contact highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000bjsb)

2.  Add the name and email address of your District Outreach Contact. An example would be Onboarding Team and [onboarding@app.com](mailto:onboarding@app.com)

![Screenshot of the update profile settings popup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000MWorU)

3.  Once added, when inviting districts to connect, you'll see a dropdown where you can set a Sender contact. This will be the contact from whom emails to districts, such as app invites or sync requests, will come from. There are two options: the app-wide District Outreach Contact or you as the current user.

  
![Screenshot of the application “Invite to connect via Clever” popup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000bjvp)

If no outreach contact is set, then you won’t see the dropdown, and you, as the current user, will default as the sender.

* * *

##   
Filtering for district statuses on the District Overview page

You can use the filters on your **District Overview** page to find which districts have connected with your application, the status of their setup process, their launch date, and if they’ve shared data.

  
![Screenshot of the Application District Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000M7nd&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000Cm7J)  
  
Here’s a list of filters that can be used:

-   District name
-   District status
    -   Any
    -   Setting Up
    -   Launched 
    -   Licenses Exceeded
    -   Licenses Expired
    -   Setup Wizard Complete
-   Launch date
    -   Any
    -   Next Week
    -   Overdue
-   Shared schools
    -   Any
    -   No Data Shared
    -   Data Shared
-   Starred
    -   Any
    -   Starred

* * *

  
**Related articles:** 

-   [For App Partners: Manage inbound district requests](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215806167?language=en_US)

title: For App Partners: Using the Clever Library
text:
This article contains the following:  
 1. [How your product appears in the Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900143#HowProductAppears)  
​ 2. [How to customize your listing in the Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900143#HowCustomize)  
​ 3. [How to evaluate the performance of your listing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360000900143#HowEvaluatePerf)

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhwL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** After reviewing our Library application process, we’ve decided to pause acceptance of new applications for Clever Library certification at this time. If you have any questions, please reach out to [application-interest@clever.com](mailto:application-interest@clever.com). 

## Overview

If you support [Sign Up with Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001036226?language=en_US), you can showcase your product in the Clever Library, a destination for teachers to discover new resources to use in their classroom.

## How your product appears in the Clever Library

Teachers looking for products in the Clever Library can search for resources by name or browse by subject and grade range. When browsing resources, teachers are shown your product’s icon, name, and a short tagline. 

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dhwL&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000SmY48)  Please note:** The Clever Admin for each school organization can turn off the Clever Library and block individual resources that they don’t want teachers to access. [Please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471) for more information on district and school controls over Library applications.

When they click through to your listing, teachers are additionally shown:  
 

-   A 50-100 word description of your product
-   The subject, platforms, and grade levels supported by your product
-   Up to 5 screenshots and accompanying descriptions showing key features of your product
-   The number of teachers using your product in their school, and the number of schools using your product in their district
-   Whether your product is a signatory of the Student Data Privacy Pledge or has a review from CommonSenseMedia

  
In your Clever Dashboard, you can see the current icon, description, and other information that populates your listing in the Clever Library.

##   
How to customize your listing in the Clever Library

Clever currently reviews all updates to the Clever Library - if you would like to change any information about your listing, please reach out to your Application Partnership Manager or Clever Support with the changes you would like to make.

##   
How to evaluate the performance of your listing

In your Clever Dashboard, you can see the number of visitors to your listing in the Clever Library over the last 30 days, as well as the total signups. If you would like more detailed reports on the activity and demographics of teachers visiting your listing, contact [discovery@clever.com](mailto:discovery@clever.com).

title: For App Partners: The School Tech Lead user role in Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049421731#overview)  
2. [What is a School Tech Lead?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049421731#what_is_a_school_tech_lead)  
3\. [School Tech Lead tools and permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049421731#stl_tools_permissions)  
4\. [How School Tech Leads interact with your apps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049421731#how_stls_interact_with_your_apps)

## Overview

This article will give our application partners an overview of the School Tech Lead role in Clever and how School Tech Leads can interact with applications.  
  

* * *

## What is a School Tech Lead?

A School Tech Lead is a staff user role in Clever with additional permissions. District Admins can assign certain users the School Tech Lead role, which provides them with a set of specific permissions in Clever for their associated school(s).   
 

For instructions on how a district admin can assign a staff member to the School Tech Lead Role, please see [Clever Roles: School Tech Lead](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663)  
 

These permissions are designed to empower this user in their role as an edtech coach, instructional technology specialist, digital learning specialist, etc. Users with School Tech Lead permissions are often the individuals at a school who evaluate, roll out, support, and troubleshoot technology.   
 

School Tech Leads play an important role in helping teachers and students access your application through Clever. Continue reading to learn more about their permissions and how you can collaborate with them to drive engagement for your application.   
  

* * *

## School Tech Lead tools and permissions

In the past, School Tech Leads only had limited admin permissions. In July 2020, Clever launched a new and improved user experience to empower School Tech Leads. They have the following tools in Clever:   
 

**Help districts roll out edtech**

-   [Personalizing school portals](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042044811)
-   [Creating custom sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020213371)
-   [Monitoring edtech usage](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044719192) 

**Help train teachers and students**

-   [Become a certified Clever Trainer](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360023043372)
-   [Access all new Clever Academy training for School Tech Leads](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360023043372)

**Quickly resolve issues with new troubleshooting tools**

-   [Temporarily access a teacher’s portal](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044867112)
-   [Troubleshoot logins to quickly diagnose the root cause of access issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360044867112)

**Evaluate Clever+ products in the Clever App Store**

-   [Find add-on Clever+ products, such as Clever IDM, in the Clever App Store](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360050628211?language=en_US)   
      
    

* * *

## How School Tech Leads interact with your apps

School Tech Leads (STLs) play an important role in helping teachers and students access your application through Clever. There are three ways a School Tech Lead might interact with your application:  
 

1.  **SSO into your application:** If you have shared data with the staff user role for School Tech Leads.
2.  **Viewing your application in the school’s portal:** When customizing the school’s portal, an STL can view any applications the district has shared with that school.

title: For App Partners: District Data Compatibility
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032261991#overview)  
2\. [How do I check a district's data compatibility?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032261991#check)  
3\. [How do I set up required and optional fields?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360032261991#required)

## Overview

Data compatibility allows your application's implementation team to gather insight on a district's data coverage before sending them an application invite. This feature allows you to quickly check which of your application's required fields are currently syncing from the district's student Information system (SIS) to Clever so that your team can ensure a smooth implementation process with less time spent troubleshooting missing data. Please note that, in most cases, additional fields can be added to the SIS sync to Clever. Please reach out to Clever Support for additional information.

* * *

## How do I check a district's data compatibility?

1\. Search for the district at the top search bar and select **Invite to connect**.  
 

![Screenshot of Clever Apps dashboard with search bar highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003gHF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285YO)   
 

2\. Scroll down to the **Data Compatibility** section of the district overview page to see which required fields are missing.

-   **Please** **Note:** These statistics are based on the district's last successful student information sync (SIS) sync to Clever.

![Screenshot of data compatibility screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003gHF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285aT)   
 

3\. To drill into specific data collections, click **Details** for more information including the coverage of specific fields. Selecting the **Download CSV option** will provide a spreadsheet with all of the district's field coverage statistics  
 

![Screenshot of data compatibility screen with Details button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003gHF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285aY)    
 

**Details Page:**

![Screenshot of Contacts page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003gHF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ad)   
 

* * *

## How do I set up required and optional fields?

Start with your developer application! By setting and testing changes on your developer application, you can avoid any disruptions for your end-users.

To begin, navigate to your **Clever Dashboard** \> **Settings** > **Application Settings >** [**Data Access**](https://apps.clever.com/il-test-app/settings/data-access) tab. Listed here are separate modules for each data type that provide the option to edit both required and optional fields for sensitive and non-sensitive data types ([More information here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000216886)).

![Screenshot of Application Settings > Data Access page with highlights around Edit Required and Edit Optional buttons](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000003gHF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036Tlq)

title: For App Partners: Browsing district data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038554692#overview)  
2. [Searching the district's shared data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038554692#Searching)  
3\. [Using the Data Browser to view data shared by a district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038554692#using)  
4\. [Differences between v2 & v3 API](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038554692#VS)  
5. [](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038554692#download)[Downloading data shared by a district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360038554692#download)

##   
Overview

The Data Browser is a great tool for application partners to view district data. This article will go over how to use the Data Browser and its' features, including viewing data using Clever’s v2 API or v3 API.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285a9)**Please note:** This feature is only available for applications with a Secure Sync integration.

* * *

## Searching District Data

From the district's profile in your Clever dashboard, you can use the search bar at the top of the page to find any record that the district is currently sharing with your application:

![Search bar](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m1Mf)

* * *

## Using the Data Browser

Another way to view the district's data in Clever is by clicking the **Data Browser** in the left-hand sidebar.  
  
![Screenshot of the app data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m1N8)  
  
Here, you can browse the district's data by record type, and use the **Add Filter** button to narrow down your results. You can also click on each record to view a full list of the fields that the district is sharing for the record.  
  
![Screenshot of the data browser showing a filter](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m1QC)

* * *

## Differences between v2 & v3 API

Clever now offers access to the v3 API as well as v2. These are some updates to note:

-   **Version Switcher**
    -   The Version Switcher allows apps to toggle between the v2 and v3 Clever APIs, thus better understanding how Clever's API works, which can benefit app developers.
    -   For applications that have access to the v3 API, they’ll see a label on the top right indicating what version they're on and that they can switch to the other version. ![Screenshot of the application data browser](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000003f53)
    -   Clicking on this button will open a new tab with the different version of the data browser and preserve all other states, such as any current collection being viewed as well as any filters currently applied.
-   **Data updates**
    -   While the v3 API contains similar information to v2, the data browser will now display additional record fields when clicking any record in any collection. When viewing v3 data for a user type, the ID field refers to the v3 user ID which is used for identifying users with multiple roles. Any similarly named or ambiguous fields related to v2 data are prefixed with legacy\_, such as legacy\_id on a teacher record. 
    -   In the Detail view, you'll see both the ID field for a specific teacher, representing their user Clever ID, their v2 Clever ID, and their sis\_id. ![Detail view on application dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000003dha)

If you want to know more about the differences between v2 and v3, please take a look at [our API documentation](https://dev.clever.com/docs/whats-new-in-api-v31).

* * *

## Downloading data shared by a district

From the Data Browser, you can also download the data the district has shared with your application. This feature can come in handy if your team would like to manipulate the district's data, or perform a manual matching of existing accounts for your application.  
 

To use this feature, navigate to the record type you'd like to download information for (e.g. schools, students, teachers, sections, etc.), and click the '**Download**' button:  
 

![Screenshot of data browser showing download button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005m1MV)

The export will include **all** data that the district has shared for the record type you've selected and is also based on API type. For example, if downloading a list of student records in the v3 data browser, they will have both user and legacy IDs, whereas downloading from v2 will only contain relevant v2 API data. Any filters applied to view data in the Data Browser tab will not be reflected in the final data export.

After clicking the **Download** button, a warning will appear to notify you that the CSV file being exported may contain PII. Please keep in mind that files containing sensitive student information must be treated carefully.  
 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YdN7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BaLK)

title: For App Partners: Setting up global recommended sharing for districts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043113752#Overview)  
2\. [Setting globally recommended sharing rules for all districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043113752#Setting_globally_recommended_sharing_rules)

## Overview

Globally recommended sharing settings allow you to communicate sharing best practices to districts who are connecting with your app for the first time. Note: You can also recommend sharing settings [for specific districts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046189771?language=en_US).

* * *

##   
Setting globally recommended sharing rules for all districts

To configure globally recommended sharing rules, navigate to Settings > District Setup in the dashboard and select **Edit.** This will open a setup guide that will walk you through the following steps:  
 

![App partner app settings.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULdJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y7eG)  
  
 

### **1\. Choose sharing type**

You can recommend that districts:

-   Share all records in the district
-   Share all records in a specific school
-   Share custom records

### ![app partner choose sharing type.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULdJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y7ea)

###   
**2\. Set custom rules (optional)**

If you select 'Share custom records' you will be able to configure custom sharing rules for districts.   
  
To find more information about the different types of sharing permissions, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).  
 

![App partner set custom rules.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULdJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y7ep)

###   
**3\. Preview and save**

Preview and save the sharing settings you configured in the earlier steps of the guide.  
 

### ![App partner preview and save.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULdJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y7ek)  
  

* * *

**Related articles:** 

-   [For App Partners: Recommending sharing for specific districts](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046189771?language=en_US)

title: For App Partners: District setup recommendations
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Overview)  
2\. [Globally Recommended Sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Globally%20Recommended%20Sharing)  
3\. [Custom Setup wizard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Custom%20Setup%20wizard)  
4\. [Data quality settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Data%20quality%20settings)  
5\. [Enable safety thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Enable%20safety%20thresholds)  
6\. [Request App Sync Notifications for your account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#appsyncnotifications)  
7\. [Populate a District Outreach Contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Outreachcontact)  
8\. [Request API V3 Migration CSVs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043514192#Request%20API%20V3%20Migration%20CSVs) 

## Overview

Application partners can provide recommendations for districts that are adding your application(s) to Clever for the first time. To do this, please navigate to your [Clever Portal > Settings > District Setup page](https://apps.clever.com/athleticity-dev-copy-dev/settings/district-setup) to configure the requirements and recommended settings for connected districts. The available options include:

-   Globally Recommended Sharing
-   Custom Setup wizard
-   Enable safety thresholds
-   Request API V3 Migration CSVs

* * *

## Globally Recommended Sharing 

Configure your application's recommended sharing settings to include best practices for sharing district data with your application.  For detailed information about sharing permissions, please visit [Sharing Permissions: Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US).

* * *

## Custom Setup wizard

The custom setup wizard allows you to create suggested steps to help guide districts that recently launched your application in Clever. This is the perfect place to detail recommended setup instructions and settings for district Clever Admins. Examples include:

-   Recommendations for how to share data with your application. Click [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US) for more.
-   Instructions on how to resolve data quality errors. Click [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/215806337?language=en_US) for more.
-   Additional recommended setup steps. 

![Picture1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bOub&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZdZl)          

This feature can also be used to link to external setup instructions located on your district's website, manage district expectations for finalizing their connection with your application, and more! Once your customized setup is configured, it will display to districts on the last step of the setup wizard within their Clever Dashboard.  
 

* * *

## Data quality settings

Data validation is key to ensuring that districts resolve data issues before their official launch date for your application! These settings should accurately reflect your application's data quality requirements. For more information, please visit [our guide to verifying district data quality](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215806337). 

* * *

## Enable safety thresholds

Safety thresholds ensure that significant data changes made by your districts in their student information systems (SIS) are placed on an automatic hold before syncing to your application, giving you time to review the changes before they process in your application. For more, please visit our [guide to safety thresholds](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044699192?language=en_US).

* * *

## Request App Sync Notifications for your account

For the most accurate information and data regarding a district’s last sync, please [contact our support team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) to enable **App Sync Notifications.** Use our API to confirm the last successful SIS upload from a school organization to:

-   Minimize your nightly syncs to only the school organizations that have had data changes or
    
-   Proactively sync data changes throughout the day to prevent support tickets and minimize friction for school organizations.
    

Learn more [here in our dev docs](https://dev.clever.com/docs/ss-design#sync-frequency).

* * *

## Populate a District Outreach Contact

If you haven’t already, provide a district outreach contact on your [Settings > General page](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/settings/general) to increase efficiency and minimize customer frustration. This contact will surface to Clever Administrators in their Dashboard if they utilize your application, providing them with a quick reference for who to contact should they need help with your application.

 Clever will also use this contact for school communications, such as app invites, sync requests, etc.

If you’d only like the contact to appear only on direct communications, and not in the Clever Dashboard for Clever Admins, you can check the box for **Don’t show District Outreach Contact as a support option for districts**.

![Screenshot of where to update the District Outreach Contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bOub&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000LWFkb)

* * *

## Request API V3 Migration CSVs

This tool maps legacy role-based Clever IDs to the new API v3.0 user IDs. A zip file with one CSV for every connected district will be available to download for one week after its creation. In the rare case that a district mapping cannot be completed, Clever will send an error file detailing the issues to you.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bOub&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Zu)**Clever Tip:** Please make sure that your application's data quality warnings and errors are current by navigating to the 'Warnings' tab of any district in your Clever Dashboard. Contact your Application Success Manager or Clever Support if updates are needed.

title: For App Partners: Recommending sharing for specific districts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046189771#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [How to set recommended sharing for a district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046189771#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)

##   
Overview

Smarter data sharing allows you to recommend sharing settings to districts that are connected with your app. You can send updated recommendations even after districts have enabled data sharing with you. If you do not set specific recommended sharing rules for the specific district, the district will receive your [global sharing recommendation](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360043113752).

  
When you send a sharing recommendation to a district, they can preview the sharing settings and choose to accept or decline the sharing update. **If a district accepts your recommendation, the recommended sharing settings will replace any current sharing rules that the district has configured for your application.** After accepting, the district can still update its sharing settings at any time.

  
This article covers how to send sharing recommendations to a district. To view the district experience, see our district admin guide for [sharing recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US).

## How to set recommended sharing for a district

To request a sharing update from a district, go to the district’s profile page in your dashboard and use the ‘Request sharing’ button in the upper right. Alternatively, you can navigate to the 'Sharing' tab from the district profile and select ‘Edit’.  
 

![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-7.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000008X3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO3Y)

  
This will open a setup guide that will walk you through the following steps to recommend sharing rules for a district:

1\. Choosing a sharing type:

-   You can recommend that districts:
-   Share all records in the district
-   Share all records in specific schools
-   Share custom records
-   You can also
-   Edit an existing recommendation if you’ve already sent one to the district
-   Import the district’s current sharing setting and recommend changes  
     

![Recommended sharing settings screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000008X3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YOQG)

2\. Setting customized recommendations

-   If you choose to recommend sharing all records in the district, you’ll skip this step.
-   If you select ‘Share all records in specific schools’, you can select which schools should be shared. 

![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-9.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000008X3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO3i)

-   If you select ‘Share custom records’, you can configure custom sharing rules for the district. For an in-depth guide to configuring sharing rules, see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045770492).

![Cursor\_and\_HC\_artilces\_-\_Google\_Slides-10.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000008X3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003BO4b)  
  
3\. Preview and save

-   On this step, preview the sharing settings you configured in the earlier steps of the guide.
-   Add a message for the district that will appear in their dashboard when they review your recommended sharing settings.

  
Once you save your sharing recommendation, the district will receive a notification via email as well as within the Clever Dashboard. To view the district experience, you can reference [this district-facing article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045770232).

title: For App Partners: Sending custom sharing recommendations to districts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#overview)  
2\. [What is a sharing recommendation?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#what_is_a_sharing_recommendation)  
3\. [How to recommend custom record sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#how_to_recommend)  
4\. [Constructing custom record recommendations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#constructing_custom_record_recommendations)  
5\. [Tips and best practices](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#tips_and_best_practices)  
6. [Editing or deleting a sharing recommendation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#editing_or_deleting)

## Overview

By configuring custom sharing recommendations for districts, applications can suggest, as closely as possible, the correct users and rosters you need to set up your district customers.  
 

When choosing to “share custom records”, once the recommendations have been accepted by the district, they will only share the rostering information that meets the specific criteria you've set. Please make sure all the data you need is included in the recommendation!  
 

The data shared with the application via sharing rules updates based on the data synced to Clever by the district.  
 

## What is a sharing recommendation?

A sharing recommendation is a request for specific data that you can send to a district to ensure only the data you want to receive is being shared. A district administrator can review the recommendation and immediately accept (or decline) the sharing update.  
 

For example, a sharing recommendation might include:

-   All the math classes in a particular school
-   The math classes for grades 3-6 in the district, except for in two schools
-   One specific teacher’s 11th-grade homeroom class

Think of a custom recommendation as a sentence:

-   "Share all sections where <a field in Clever> <is/is not/contains/does not contain> <value>”

## How to recommend custom record sharing

To request a sharing update for a district, go to the district’s profile page in your dashboard and use the ‘Request sharing’ button in the upper right. Alternatively, you can navigate to the Sharing tab from the district profile and select ‘Edit’.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004wqD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ZB)  
 

Once you select 'Edit' to recommend sharing for a specific district, select 'Share custom records' to configure specific data sharing rules.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004wqD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ZG)  
 

For other sharing types, see [our guide to sending sharing recommendations for specific districts](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046189771).

## Constructing custom record recommendations

Our interface allows you to create recommendations with the same structure as outlined in the '[What is a sharing recommendation?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045770492#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)' section above (e.g. share all sections where <a field in Clever> <is/is not/contains> <value>).  
 

-   There are a number of 'Fields' that applications can request to either include or exclude data with the sharing recommendation. Fields include teachers, sections, students, and school admins (staff)
-   We recommend adding non-school constraints first as the larger the district, the longer the school list can be!
-   The modifiers available are:
    -   Is
    -   Is not
    -   Is one of
    -   Is not one of
    -   Contains text
    -   Does not contain text

## Tips and best practices

-   You can include and/or exclude subsets of data. Data can be excluded by selecting the _'is not one of'_ modifier.
-   For values, you can either type in any value you’d like, or search to find and click on the value you want. Some values will not be available in a dropdown as the district has not authorized an application to see them.
    -   Warning: if you are typing an option in a text field, you must click 'Add: \[value\]’ or else the value will not be saved
-   If you’d like to filter down a rule further, you can select the ‘+ADD' option to add new criteria. This will act as an 'and' statement, rather than an 'or' statement.
    -   **_Example Rule with Filters:_** Share all sections that are located at Pineapple Elementary School AND their section grade level is 1 AND the section name must contain the text 'homeroom'. ![Screenshot of example custom sharing recommendation](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004wqD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000006lGM1)  
-   If you recommend sharing specific students, you will also have the option to select which of these students' subjects or courses you'd like to receive. You can even choose to share no sections at all! If sections are shared, you will also receive the sections' associated teacher(s).

-   Once you have finished creating your first rule, you can click “Add Rule” to add more sharing recommendations.
    -   When you have multiple rules, the two rules don’t interact with each other. This means if you want to build off the existing rule, you'll want to add a filter to the rule itself, rather than create a new rule entirely. 
    -   If a rule is a sentence, having multiple rules is a paragraph:  
        "Share all sections where grade is one of 6, 7, 8.” **Also**, "Match all staff where school is Pineapple Elementary.” ![Screenshot of sharing recommendation with section and staff](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004wqD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000006lHQ9)  
-   We highly recommend adding a message so that the district administrator can easily understand the request being made

Once you have finished creating the rules and associated filters, select ‘Next', add a message, and then 'Save' to send the recommendation to the district. You can only have one open sharing recommendation for a specific district at a time.   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl0000004wqD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285ZL)**Please note:** A district administrator must accept your sharing recommendation in order for their sharing to be updated. They may also choose to decline this recommendation. If a district has accepted a recommendation, they can still edit their sharing settings at any time.

## Editing or deleting a sharing recommendation

If you’d like to change or remove a sharing recommendation, you can do so by going to the district’s page and going to the Sharing tab. 

  
If you have any questions about setting up your sharing recommendations or what you are requesting from connected districts, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)!

title: For App Partners: Update marketing collateral to showcase your product in Clever Library
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047962012#overview)  
2\. [How your app is showcased in Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047962012#How_your_app_is_showcased)  
3\. [Updating marketing collateral](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047962012#updating_your_marketing_collateral)

##   
Overview

Your app's profile in Clever Library is how teachers discover and learn about what your product does. Your profile helps explain to teachers what you do and what makes you unique. You can update your app's profile under the marketing collateral tab in your dashboard.

##   
How your app is showcased in Clever Library

When an educator searches for your application in Clever Library, they will be directed to your app's profile page.  
  
The following information appears on your app profile:

-   Basic information about your application (Name, tagline, description)
-   Details about your application (categories, grade levels, standards alignment, tags, device and platform compatibility, case studies and links to your website)
-   Images to show what your application looks like (app icon, banner, and screenshots)

The application profile will also include verified teacher reviews, which includes a 5-star rating scale for how engaging, educational and easy-to-use your application is, as well as comments. [Learn more about teacher reviews](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001454?language=en_US).  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULlN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Z1)

To see what your profile page looks like to a user, visit the public-facing [Clever Library](https://clever.com/library) and search for your application.

## Updating your marketing collateral

You can update what appears on your app's profile page by adding content under the marketing collateral tab in your Clever Dashboard. Every Clever Library application partner starts with a basic profile consisting of their application name and icon.  
  
Follow these instructions to update your profile with screenshots, description, and other information:  
 

-   Log in to Clever at [https://apps.clever.com/](https://apps.clever.com/)
-   Navigate to [Library > Marketing Collateral](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/library/collateral) in the left-hand navigation menu

  
There, you can add the following information:

### Basic information

-   **App name:** The name of your product
-   **Tagline:** A short description (60 characters max)
-   **Long description:** A full description of your applications capabilities and features (1000 characters max)

### App details 

-   **Subject and categories:** Choose from a list of subject or categories your application should be listed under
-   **Grade levels:** Select all grade levels your product supports
-   **Standards Alignment:** Link to web pages that outline standards alignments for your application.
-   **Tags:** Add up to 10 tags to help your application better appear in search ([learn more about tags](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360031356852))
-   **Device and platform compatibility:** Select which platforms and operating systems your product supports
-   **Pricing:** Your application’s pricing model (Freemium, Free Trial, and Free)
-   **Research and case studies:** Link to web pages that host research, case studies or relevant content.
-   Links to your application’s website, terms of service, and privacy policy

### Artwork 

-   **App icon:** 200px wide by 200px high, PNG, no transparency
-   **Feature banner:** 400px wide by 240px high, PNG, no transparency
-   **Screenshots:** Include up to 5 screenshots, along with an associated text description to describe what the screenshot displays. 1200px wide by 800px high, PNG, no transparency.

For more detail on designing great artwork for your profile, [download the artwork spec](https://clever-partner-images.s3.amazonaws.com/library/spec/library-artwork-spec.pdf).

title: Troubleshooting: Enable "Access Portal as" for School Tech Leads
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047079271#h_b1931707-7878-4e19-8cb9-6b1d21597554)  
2\. [Enabling "Access Portal as" for STLs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047079271#h_f723888c-6033-4cba-b3fa-f30388209a1b)  
3\. [Using the "Access Portal as" feature](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360047079271#h_7698d144-7ceb-4d63-88b8-e9ca2aa378d2)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285N5)**Please note:** This tool needs to be **enabled by a district admin** from the **Team > [Role Settings](https://schools.clever.com/team/settings)** page of the dashboard in order for the STLs at your district to start using this feature

##    
Overview

Clever makes it easy for School Tech Leads (STLs) to access the Clever Portal as an individual teacher and see exactly what they see. When troubleshooting, this can help STLs diagnose an issue, retrieve an error code or message, or gain visibility into what might be confusing. This is overall a great way to empower more folks in your district to support teachers with their technical requests.   
 

This tool enables STLs to view a portal as a teacher in their scoped school. Unlike [District Admins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000406146), STLs cannot view a student’s Clever Portal through this tool.  
 

This tool needs to be **enabled by a District Admin** in order for the STLs at your district to start using this feature.

##   
Enabling "Access Portal as" for STLs

As a district admin, you have full control over whether your School Tech Leads (STLs) can use the "Access Portal as" feature for teachers at their associated school sites. This is a setting you can turn on/off by navigating to **Team > [Role Settings](https://schools.clever.com/team/settings).** This setting is turned off by default.   
 

If you decide to turn it on, Clever will walk you through a few informational steps prior to switching the tool on for your STLs.   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285NA)  
 

As a district admin, you'll have the option to send an email to your STLs about their new tool. We recommend communicating this update to them so they have the opportunity to take advantage of this tool while supporting teachers and students.  
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285NF)

##   
Using the "Access Portal as" feature

After you’ve turned on this tool for the STLs in your district, they will start seeing the button to **Access Portal as user** on teacher profiles.  
 

![HC\_shadow\_box\_updates\_-\_Google\_Slides-9.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CBJf)

  
Upon clicking this option, STLs will first need to offer a reason for accessing the Clever Portal as this particular user. Next, the STL will need to confirm that they understand teacher profiles may contain sensitive user information. Only then can they proceed to **Begin Portal Session.**   
 

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285NP)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285NU)**Please note:** As an additional transparency measure, the teacher whose portal is being accessed, will receive an automatic email from Clever with the message that the STL included

  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000KuVt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285NZ)

title: Clever and North Carolina third-party data integration
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#header1)  
2\. [North Carolina DPA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#header2)  
3\. [Third-party collection worksheet](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#header3)  
4\. [Vendor Readiness Assessment Report (VRAR)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#header4)  
5\. [Third-party assessment](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#header5)  
6. [Statewide Information Security Manual](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#Statewide)  
7\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001587#faqs)

## Overview

In May 2023, the North Carolina Department of Public Instruction (NC DPI) released new data security standards for any system that receives student information from a statewide system. Since Clever connects to the North Carolina student information system (SIS), we understand that these requirements apply to Clever. This article will provide districts with information and materials about Clever’s compliance with these new requirements.   
  
The requirements go into effect January 1, 2024 (originally August 1, 2023), and must be met before any new service agreement or renewal can be signed. Clever’s Secure Sync service does not operate on a renewal schedule, however, we still intend to meet the requirements on or before August 1, 2023, to give school districts assurance of compliance and non-interruption of service.   
  
The North Carolina requirements are:

1.  Signed Data Confidentiality and Security Agreement for Online Service Providers and Public School Units (Student Data)
2.  Completed Third-Party Collection Worksheet
3.  Completed Vendor Readiness Assessment Report (VRAR) self-assessment 
4.  Third-Party Assessment Report
5.  Compliance with North Carolina’s Statewide Information Security Manual  
     

* * *

## North Carolina DPA

NC DPI has determined that all vendors who connect with North Carolina’s statewide SIS need to sign the Data Confidentiality and Security Agreement for Online Service Providers and Public School Units (Student Data) (“DCSA”) in whole with no modifications. Please follow this [DocuSign link](https://na2.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=95ed9d92-25bc-462c-9818-b6460e314f12&env=na2&acct=8f3af476-5ae1-4be5-8870-8f8f1790daf1&v=2) to access a pre-signed version of the document. Using the link, you may countersign and download your own copy of the DCSA. If you have trouble with DocuSign, please contact [legal@clever.com](mailto:legal@clever.com) to find a different process.

* * *

## Third-party collection worksheet

Please follow [this link](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nLZ35YXPHh4ckNgfv2lTiieiyCtv5nWuF8eOOhplr3Q/edit) to access a completed Third Party Collection Worksheet using the NC DPI’s required template. You can fill out the top portion with your own school district’s information and keep a copy for your records.

* * *

## Vendor Readiness Assessment Report (VRAR)

Please follow [this link](https://www.clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/North-Carolina-Department-of-Information-Technology-vrar-non-state-hosted-solutions.docx-1-1.pdf) to access Clever’s signed and completed VRAR self-assessment using the NC DPI’s required template.

* * *

## Third-party assessment report

The NC DPI requires a third-party conducted security assessment report, such as the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) authorization, SOC (Security Operations Center) 2 Type 2 audit, ISO 27001 certification, or HITRUST certification, dated within the last 12 months.

  
Clever has obtained and intends to maintain a SOC 2 Type 2 Security report on an annual basis. The SOC 2 organization requires that an NDA be entered into before sharing the report with existing or potential customers.  If you are a school district that is connected to or connecting to Clever, please [click this link to sign an NDA](https://na2.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=5d039b52-88c8-4926-aefa-02a13d533d38&env=na2&acct=8f3af476-5ae1-4be5-8870-8f8f1790daf1&v=2) if you would like to review a copy of our report.

* * *

## Statewide Information Security Manual

The NC DPI requires alignment with the Statewide Information Security Manual. While Clever complies with a majority of the elements, there are some gaps that we expect to close during the next year during our SOC 2 Type 2 assessment process. In the meantime, if you would like to review Clever’s most recent penetration testing and/or vulnerability scans, please sign an NDA using [this DocuSign link](https://na2.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=6fc6637f-6d6d-40a4-a3c6-45dbc6a00805&env=na2&acct=8f3af476-5ae1-4be5-8870-8f8f1790daf1&v=2) and we will provide a copy to the email address of the person signing the document. If you have trouble with DocuSign, please contact [legal@clever.com](mailto:legal@clever.com) to find a different process.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Where can I find out more information about the North Carolina requirements?**

-   The [North Carolina DPI has created a website](https://www.dpi.nc.gov/about-dpi/technology-services/third-party-data-integration) to provide schools and vendors information about the new requirements and updates.

**What if I have more questions about Clever’s compliance with the North Carolina requirements?**

-   Please contact [legal@clever.com](mailto:legal@clever.com) if you have any additional questions.

**Related Resources:** 

-   [For Families: Clever security policies for student data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360020791011)
-   To learn more about data privacy, you can read [Clever's full Privacy Policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy)
-   To learn more about our security practices, you can read our [comprehensive security program](https://www.clever.com/trust/security)

title: Deploy Edtech Analytics for Google Chrome using Microsoft Intune
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header1)  
2\. [Step 1: Silently install the Clever Plus Chrome Extension](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header2)  
3\. [Step 2:](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header3) [Add verification domain to the Authentication allowlist](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header3)  
4\. [Step 3:](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header4) [Configure the Extension with your District ID Analytics Token](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header4)  
5\. [Step 4: Verify](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001574#header5)

## Overview

This article will go over the steps on how to deploy Edtech Analytics for Google Chrome using Microsoft Intune.  
 

* * *

## Step 1: Silently install the Clever Plus Chrome Extension

1.  Sign in to [Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune)](https://endpoint.microsoft.com/).
2.  Select **Devices** in the left-hand navigation pane.
3.  From the **Devices | Overview** right-hand pane, select **Configuration Profiles**.

![Screenshot of the Microsoft Endpoint Manager admin center](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lf2N)

4.  On the top command bar, select **Create profile**.
5.  From the drop-down list: 
    1.  Below Platform, select **Windows 10 and later**.
    2.  Below Profile Type, select **Templates**.
    3.  Below Template name, select **Administrative Templates** and then click the **Create** button.

![Showing Administrative Templates drop-down list in Microsoft Endpoint Manager](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lf78)

6.  On the Basics tab, enter a descriptive Name, such as **\[Google Chrome\] Clever Plus Extension Install Policy**. Select **Next**. 
7.  On the Configuration settings tab, search and select **Configure the list of force-installed apps..** under Path **\\Google\\Google Chrome\\Extensions**

![Screenshot of the configure settings tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lgOZ)

8.  The settings will be shown on the right pane. 
    1.  Set it to **Enabled**
    2.  For the **Extension/App IDs** use dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa;[https://crx.clever.com/updates](https://crx.clever.com/updates) then click **OK** and **Next** to progress.
9.  Set Scope tags if applicable, click **Next**.
10.  Set Group Assignments & Exclusions with Filters as applicable, click **Next.**
11.  Review the profile then click **Create.**

* * *

## Step 2: Add verification domain to the Authentication allowlist

This next section is very similar to the previous - a new Configuration Profile is needed.

1.  Sign in to [Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune)](https://endpoint.microsoft.com/).
2.  Select **Devices** in the left-hand navigation pane.
3.  From the **Devices | Overview** right-hand pane, select **Configuration Profiles**.
4.  On the top command bar, select **Create profile**.
5.  In the drop-down list:
    1.  below Platform, select **Windows 10 and later**.
    2.  below Profile Type, select **Templates**.
    3.  below Template name, select **Administrative Templates** and then click the **Create** button.
6.  On the Basics tab, enter a descriptive Name, such as **\[Google Chrome\] Authentication service allowlist for EdtechAnalytics**. Select **Next**.
7.  On the Configuration settings tab, search and select **Authentication server allowlist** under Path **\\Google\\Google Chrome\\HTTP authentication**
8.  The settings will be shown on the right pane. 
    1.  Set it to **Enabled**
    2.  For the **servers** use **autologon.microsoftazuread-sso.com,login.microsoftonline.com,analytics-domainverify.clever.com** then click **OK** and **Next** to progress.

  
![Screenshot of the configuration settings tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lgQ6)

* * *

## Step 3: Configure the Extension with your District ID Analytics Token

The following steps set the AnalyticsToken for the extension, which enables usage data collection.

1.  Sign in to [Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune)](https://endpoint.microsoft.com/).
2.  Select **Devices** in the left-hand navigation pane.
3.  From **Devices | Overview**, select **Scripts and remediations,** then the **Platform Scripts** tab.  
      
    ![Screenshot of devices scripts and remediations page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003YnHX)   
      
    
4.  On the top command bar, select **Add**, and **Windows 10 and Later**
5.  On the Basics tab, enter a descriptive Name, such as **Set\_Clever\_Chrome\_Token**. Select **Next**.
    1.  Create a powershell script with the .ps1 extension (e.g. Set\_Clever\_Chrome\_Token.ps1), save it with the following command replacing YOURANALYTICSTOKEN then upload to **Script location  
          
        New-Item -Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\ \-Name Google  
        New-Item \-Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google \-Name Chrome  
        New-Item \-Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google\\Chrome \-Name 3rdparty  
        New-Item \-Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google\\Chrome\\3rdparty \-Name extensions  
        New-Item \-Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google\\Chrome\\3rdparty\\extensions \-Name dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa  
        New-Item \-Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google\\Chrome\\3rdparty\\extensions\\dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa \-Name policyNew-ItemProperty \-Path HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google\\Chrome\\3rdparty\\extensions\\dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa\\policy \-Name AnalyticsToken \-PropertyType String -Value YOURANALYTICSTOKEN  
          
        **
    2.  Toggle each of these options to **No**
        1.  **Run this script using the logged on credentials No**
        2.  **Enforce script signature check No**
        3.  **Run script in 64 bit PowerShell Host No  
              
             ![Screenshot of where to add powershell script](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003YziT)** 

6.  Set Group Assignments & Exclusions with Filters as applicable, click **Next**.
7.  Review the profile then click **Add**.

  
  
 

* * *

## Step 4: Verify

To verify the install worked, log in on a targeted device and confirm the following:

1.  In Chrome, navigate to chrome://extensions and look for **Clever Plus**. Click into it to see details.

  
![Screenshot showing the Clever Plus extension in Chrome](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lgUI)  
![Screenshot of the Clever Plus extension in Chrome](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lgUN)

2.  Check **Registry Editor** on a target Endpoint, navigate to HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Google\\Chrome\\3rdparty\\extensions\\dikiaagfielfbnbbopidjjagldjopbpa\\policy\\AnalyticsToken, and check that the Analytics Token string value is set accurately.

![Screenshot of the analytics token](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lgUS)  
 

3.  In Chrome, navigate to chrome://policy and ensure the AnalyticsToken and other policies are appropriately set.

  
![Screenshot of the Policies page in Chrome](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TXAH&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lgV1)  
 

* * *

**Related articles:** 

-   [Edtech Analytics - Overview and FAQs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039420391?language=en_US)

## Step 3: Configure the Extension with your District ID Analytics Token

The following steps set the AnalyticsToken for the extension, which determines which sessions should be tracked and enables usage data collection.  The AnalyticsToken for your district or school's Clever account is the District ID found on your [Clever Dashboard > Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser).

    2.  Toggle each of these options to **No**

1.  1.  **Run this script using the logged on credentials No**
    2.  **Enforce script signature check No**
    3.  **Run script in 64 bit PowerShell Host No**

  
![Image of script settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TX5R&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003YyuU)  

6.  Set **Group Assignments & Exclusions with Filters** as applicable, click **Next**.
7.  Review the profile then click **Add**.

* * *

## Step 4: Verify

To verify the install worked, log in on a targeted device and confirm the following:

1.  ​In Edge, navigate to **edge://extensions** and look for **Clever Plus**. Click into it to see details.

title: For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA Google Workspace SAML Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001572#header1)  
2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001572#header2)  
3\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001572#Troubleshooting)  
4\. [Using Classroom MFA Google Workspace SAML for Chromebook Logins](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001572#header5)

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The Google Workspace app requires an MFA subscription.  
  
If you're interested in adding MFA to your Clever account, you can [learn more here](https://www.getclever.com/mfa-contact-a-specialist) or get started directly at your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Classroom MFA page.](https://schools.clever.com/mfa)

## Overview

This article is a step-by-step walkthrough for setting up Google SAML with Clever's Classroom MFA.  
  
Before reading this setup guide, please make sure your school organization is set up with Classroom MFA and Google! If your school organization has not purchased Classroom MFA, you can get started in your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Classroom MFA page](https://schools.clever.com/mfa)[,](https://schools.clever.com/mfa) or if you are new to Clever, get started by going to this link: [https://www.clever.com/district-signup](https://www.clever.com/district-signup). For more information on setting up Classroom MFA, please see this [article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625).  
  
Classroom MFA protects the Clever Portal, Google Workspace, and Google Chromebooks. With the classroom-friendly MFA methods and the ability to require re-authentication for login attempts outside your designated geographical location or network, you can rest assured that potential bad actors will hit your MFA wall and get turned away.

* * *

## Setup

1.  Search for the [Google Workspace](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-google-workspace) app and click **Request Application**. You can set up user sharing now or do so later.

![Screenshot of requesting the Google Workspace application.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lb88)

-   If you’re getting a 404 error, copy and paste directly into the address bar: [https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-google-workspace](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-google-workspace)
-   If you already have this app installed and you don’t see the Request application button, go to step 2 below.

2.  Share the Google Workspace app with any Clever users who need access to Google through Clever but don’t use Badges to access a Chromebook. Typically, this includes older students, teachers, and staff users in Clever. **Your students who use Badges to access Chromebooks should not be shared with this app.** Students who use Badges to access Chromebooks will use the Badge configuration to access their Google accounts through Clever. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247).   
      
    
     **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Sharing the Google Workspace app with the same users in the Google OUs you will set up in [step 9](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001572#step9) below is required for those users to successfully access Google from Clever.
    
      
      
      
    
3.  On the [Google Workspace](https://schools.clever.com/applications/saml-google-workspace/settings) app page, click **Settings**. Scroll down to find the **SAML Details** section.

![Screenshot of Google Workspace SAML settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lb9o)

3.  Go to your organization’s Google Admin SSO page by navigating to [Admin console > Menu > Security > Authentication > SSO with third party IdP](https://admin.google.com/u/3/ac/security/sso). Click **ADD SAML PROFILE**:

![Screenshot within Google Workspace highlighting how to add a SAML profile](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lb9y)    
 

4.  Add Clever as an Identity Provider to your new Google SAML Profile by providing SAML information from the Clever dashboard Google Workspace page (left) to the Google Admin New SAML SSO Profile (right):
    

a. **Identity Provider Entity ID > IDP entity ID**  
b. Copy **Identity Provider ACS URL**, add “?specify\_auth=sis” to the end > **Sign-in page URL**  
c. **Download Verification Certificate > Upload Certificate**  
d. Make sure to add an SSO Profile name  
e. Click **Save**

![Screenshot of Clever Dashboard's Google Workspace setting.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbA3)   
 

5.  Your new Google SSO Profile should now show your own SAML information.  
    ![Screenshot of Google Workspace SAML settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbAX)    
     
6.  In the Clever dashboard, on the Google Workspace page, click the Edit button under the SAML Details section, and provide SAML information from the Google Admin New SAML SSO Profile (right) to the Clever dashboard Google Workspace page (left):

**a. Entity ID > Entity ID  
b. ACS URL > Assertion Consumer Service URL**

![Screenshot of Google Workspace SAML settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbAw)

7.  If needed, you can change the attribute mappings for any user type necessary. This is **usually not** required. Click **Confirm** to finish setup.

![Screenshot of Google Workspace SAML settings highlighting Attributes.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbBB)

8.  From your new Google SSO Profile (screen in Step 5 above), click **Back** to return to your [Google Admin SSO page](https://admin.google.com/ac/security/sso). Next, assign your new SSO Profile to an OU by scrolling down to the Manage SSO profile assignments section. You'll find one of two views:

a. If you’ve never set up an SSO assignment, click on **GET STARTED**:  
![Screenshot of managing SSO profile assignments.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbG1)    
b. If you already have SSO assignments set up, click on **Manage**:

![Screenshot of SSO profile assignments highlighting the Manage link.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbGf)

9.  Select both the intended device OUs and user OUs for the devices and users you want to target in the left sidebar. Whatever OU you have successfully selected will be shown at the top of the page. Please remember that the users in this OU must also be shared with the Google Workspace application ([step 2 above](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001572#step2)) to successfully access Google from Clever.

IMPORTANT   
Google does not allow Superadmins to SSO via another IdP, so if you apply the Clever SSO profile you just made to a Superadmin at your school organization, it will not work.

  
![Screenshot of managing SSO with third-party settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lcCA)   
 

10.  Next, click **Another SSO profile,** and in the dropdown, select the new SSO Profile you created in the above steps.

![Screenshot of managing SSO settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbH4)   
 

11.  Make sure to **Have Google prompt for their username**… selected. Finally, click **OVERRIDE** to finish setup. That’s it, you’re all set!

![Screenshot of managing SSO settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbHY)   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Once you have successfully set up the above steps, the user will need to log in with Clever Password to access their Google Workspace. 

  
![Screenshot of login page highlighting Clever Login.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lbHi) 

You can optionally turn on a setting in your SSO profile so that when a user enters their Google username on the Google sign-in page, they’re automatically redirected to Clever with their username already filled in.

-   If your Clever Passwords username is set to **“email,”** we recommend enabling this setting.
-   If your Clever Passwords username is set to anything else, you should not enable this setting in the Google Admin Console. For example: If your Clever Passwords username is "email username" (i.e. username before "@" in domain) then this would autofill the wrong username)

##   

You can enable this setting by navigating to your SSO Profile > update **Autofill email** settings under **SP details**
