Clever supports the **Send email address in the URL as the _login\_hint_ parameter** option

![Screenshot of Google Workspace Clever MFA settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cVVZV)

![Screenshot of Google Workspace Clever MFA settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cUuID)

* * *

## Troubleshooting

**Users are looping between Google sign in and Clever without gaining access**

-   This can sometimes be caused by the individual user setting in the Google Admin Console to force a password reset on the next login. If your users are experiencing this, ensure the the Google Admin Console: Directory > Users > \[Individual User\] > Security > **Require password change** is set to “off.” Also be sure that your Google account creation process is not automatically setting this setting to “on” by default. [Learn more here](https://support.google.com/a/answer/2537800?hl=en&sjid=11041586361089944329-NC#zippy=%2Cforce-a-password-change).

**Google Super Admins can’t use Clever SSO to access Google**

-   This is a Google limitation. Google does not allow SSO access for Super Admin users. [Learn more here](https://support.google.com/a/answer/6341409?sjid=10990245056427422068-NC).

* * *

## Using Classroom MFA Google Workspace SAML for Chromebook logins

To configure Chromebook logins with Clever credentials and Classroom MFA, you'll need to enable:

-   Clever to access the device camera on the login screen
    
-   Re-prompt for a Badge after the device is reopened after being closed
    
-   Sign the user into Clever automatically when they sign in to the device
    

1.  Navigate to Devices > Chrome > Settings > [Users & browsers](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/chrome/settings/user) and scroll down to the Security section
    
2.  Set Lock Screen settings to: "Do not allow locking screen"  
    ![Screenshot of Lock Screen settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lw7u) 
    
3.  Scroll a little bit until you reach the Single sign-on and SAML single sign-on login frequency settings in the Security section.
    
    1.  Set Single sign-on to "Enable SAML-based single sign on for Chrome devices".  
        ![Screenshot of Single sign-on settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lxvD) 
        
    2.  Set SAML single sign-on login frequency to an appropriate duration. We recommend "Every 2 weeks" for the best experience.  
        ![Screenshot of Single Sign-on login frequency settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lqTu)  
        
4.  Scroll to the Power and Shutdown section. Set the following Idle settings
    

-   Set Action on lid close to **Logout**
    
-   Set Lock screen on sleep to **Don't lock screen**
    
-   Set AC idle action to **Logout**
    
-   Set Battery idle action to **Logout**
    

![Screenshot of Idle settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004m0LB)

5.  Next, scroll down to the Startup section further down on the same page
    
    1.  Change the Homepage configuration to **Homepage is always the URL set below**. Set your Homepage URL to your Clever Portal URL. [You can find your Clever Portal URL here](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url).  
        ![Screenshot of Homepage settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lxok) 
        
6.  Click the [Device settings](https://admin.google.com/u/2/ac/chrome/settings/device) tab at the top of the settings panel and scroll down to Sign-in settings  
    ![Screenshot of Device settings options.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004m0eX) 
    
7.  Set Guest Mode to **Disable guest mode**  
    ![Screenshot of disabling guest mode.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004m0oD) 
    
8.  Set Sign-in Screen to **Never show user names and photos**
    

![Screenshot of Sign-in Screen settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004llXV)

9.  Set Single Sign-On IdP Redirection to **Allow users to go directly to SAML SSO IdP page**  
    ![Screenshot of IdP redirection settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004lmJq) 
    
10.  Set Single Sign-On Cookie Behavior to **Enable transfer of SAML SSO Cookies into user session**  
     ![Screenshot of Single sign-on cookie behavior](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008Jdx8)  
     
11.  Enter [https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login](https://clever.com/oauth/badges/login) under Single sign-on camera permissions. These settings ensure that Clever has access to your Chromebooks' cameras to validate Clever Badge logins  
     ![Screenshot of Single sign-on camera permissions.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000KawMv)  
     
12.  Scroll down to Kiosk Settings and ensure that Managed guest session is set to **Do not allow managed guest sessions**  
     ![Screenshot of Managed Guest Session settings.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cRon&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000004loWx) 
     

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616)
-   [For Clever Admins: Classroom MFA setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625)
-   [Adding Google SAML applications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001597)

title: Clever + Raptor Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header1)  
2\. [Adding staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header2)  
3\. [Sharing considerations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header3)  
4\. [Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header4)  
5\. [Users at multiple school sites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header5)  
6. [Co-teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header6)  
7. [Duplicate sections](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001570#header7)

## Overview

Founded in 2002, Raptor has partnered with over 52,000 schools globally, including over 5,000 K-12 U.S. school districts, to provide integrated visitor, volunteer, emergency management, safeguarding, and early intervention software and services that cover the full spectrum of school and student safety.  
  
By adding Raptor Technologies to your district’s Clever account, you're securely and automatically sending your most up-to-date roster data from your SIS to Raptor.  
  
In this article, we’ll go over some best practices to consider when connecting with Raptor through Clever. Since each district’s sync setup is different, please reach out to Clever Support with any questions or concerns.  
 

* * *

## Adding staff

For Raptor Technologies and in general, you will want to have all of your staff in Clever, including non-teaching and non-admin staff. Please see [Clever Roles: Staff - How to add to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547) for instructions. We typically recommend the “uploading staff via CSV” method, but please reach out to Clever Support if this does not work for your district’s setup.  
 

* * *

## Sharing considerations

For Raptor Technologies, we recommend sharing all district data with the app. Please see [Sharing Permissions: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) and the **Share by District** option.  
  
One common concern is that districts want to make sure their staff members, especially non-teaching and non-admin staff, don't have access to some/all of the district’s other applications. You can avoid oversharing staff with your other applications by setting your other apps to [**Share by Rules**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) and making sure only to include the appropriate staff users.

You'll also want to utilize Share by Rules if you need to share users with multiple roles in Clever (i.e., users with both a teacher and a staff account). At this time, Raptor does not support users with dual roles. Raptor will create duplicate profiles if multiple account types sync to the application. To prevent this, you should determine which account type should be shared with the application and set your sharing rules so that only that account is shared.  
  
If there are staff members you only want to share with Raptor, and none of your other applications, we recommend giving them a title such as “Raptor Only” when creating your Staff.csv file. This way, they will be easy to exclude from your other apps’ sharing rules.  
 

* * *

## Contacts

Contacts are important to include in your sync with Raptor, since parents/guardians will need to be notified if there is an emergency. To make sure your student contacts are syncing from your SIS to Clever, please visit your [Data browser](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser) and check the Contacts tab.  
  
Contacts are automatically shared with Raptor. You can make sure they are shared by visiting [Raptor’s Settings page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/raptor/settings) within your Clever Dashboard.  
  
If you're concerned about oversharing contacts with your other applications, you can go into the settings for your other apps and make sure that contacts are not shared if not appropriate. See [For District Admins: Apps - Field Access](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586) for how to do this. If you’re unsure about this, please reach out to Clever Support for assistance.  
 

* * *

## Users at multiple school sites

Raptor prefers that all users are associated with one school site only. If possible, you can edit your Staff.csv file to ensure staff are each associated with only one school site.

If needed, Raptor can support users at multiple schools, with the caveat that staff assigned to multiple buildings will most likely impact the reporting of emergency accountability at schools that they are not at during the time of the emergency. For example, if a staff person is at School B today but School A has an emergency, they will be seen as "missing" during School A’s emergency because they are physically at School B. The same would apply to students assigned to multiple sites.  
 

* * *

## Co-teachers

Raptor doesn't currently support syncing co-teachers/secondary teachers from Clever. The primary teacher will sync to Raptor for each section.  
 

* * *

## Duplicate sections

Raptor doesn't sync duplicate sections. For any two sections that have **the same teacher** and **the same section** name, the following is true:

-   If the section name and the student list are identical on both rosters, then all shared students on both rosters do not sync.
-   If the section name is the same but the student list is different on the two sections, Raptor will combine them into one larger section.

To avoid this, we recommend making sure that teachers have unique section names for each of their sections. It is not an issue if two different teachers have sections with the same names since Raptor will recognize they're different sections belonging to different teachers.

title: For App Partners: Resetting app dashboard passwords
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001569#header1)  
2\. [Password strength](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001569#header2)  
3\. [Reset password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001569#header3)  
4\. [Update password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001569#header4)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001569#header5)

## Overview

Clever app team members can easily reset their passwords in case of a lost or forgotten one. This article details the process for resetting an app team member's password.  
  
This only applies to app partners who log in with an email address and password. App partners who log in with Sign in with Google or App Dashboard SSO should reset their IDP passwords in their IDP.  
  
 

* * *

## Password strength

Clever requires a certain level of complexity to ensure a strong password and also does privacy-preserving checks.  
  
During account creation, password reset, and login, Clever will determine if a password is unsafe if it's been made public in an unrelated data breach. If an app team member’s password is determined unsafe, we require the user to select a different password.  
  
For recommendations on selecting strong passwords, see the FAQ.  
  
 

* * *

## Reset password

To reset your app team member password for Clever,

1.  Visit [apps.clever.com](https://apps.clever.com/) and click Forgot your password?
2.  Enter the email address associated with your admin account, click the Captcha, and click Reset 
3.  An email will be sent with a link to reset your password. If you don't receive the email, please check your spam filter and make sure [no-reply@clever.com](mailto:no-reply@clever.com) is added as a contact to your email account.

Quick link: [https://apps.clever.com/reset?captcha=true](https://apps.clever.com/reset?captcha=true)  
  
 

* * *

## Update password

If you'd like to update your Clever password, click on your name in the top-right of the app dashboard and click Profile Settings. Enter your existing password and new password and then click Update to update your password.  
  
![Profile page with Profile Settings and Change Password sections highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063MMZ)  
  
 

* * *

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

**When attempting to log in to Clever, why do I see a note about my password being part of a public data breach?**

-   Clever determines that a password is unsafe if it's been made public in an unrelated data breach. We perform privacy-preserving checks for passwords which have been leaked online. If an app team member password matches any of these, we require the user to reset their password.  
    ![Log in screen with a note about the password having been found in a public data breach](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ULWr&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063MMo)

  
**Are there recommendations for choosing a secure password?**

-   Use a password management solution like 1Password to use strong/unique passwords for all logins.
-   Combine three or four random words. For example: “student-task-fish-fly”. These combinations are usually easy to remember and very secure.  
     

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For App Partners: Securing users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563)
-   [For App Partners: How do I enable two-factor authentication?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001551)
-   [For App Partners: App Dashboard SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564)

title: For Clever Admins: SSO access to the Clever Dashboard
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001568#header1)  
2\. [Configuration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001568#header2)  
3\. [Logging into the admin Clever Dashboard and Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001568#header3)  
4\. [SSO and Multi-factor Authentication (MFA)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001568#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001568#header5)

## Overview

In addition to logging in using your email address and password at schools.clever.com, admin users can also log into the district dashboard and admin Portal using their identity provider (IdP) via single sign-on (SSO). SSO logins use the “Log in with” button from your Clever Portal URL. This article applies to users with the following roles: Clever Admins, District Curriculum Lead, District Help Desk.  
  
![image3.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTuf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063Jq9)

* * *

## Configuration

Requirements for admin SSO access:

-   You must have an external IdP, such as Google or Entra ID, configured for SSO into Clever on the [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) tab. You can learn more about [configuring SSO here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938).

![External IdPs in the Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTuf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WgRnl)

-   The email address associated with your admin account as seen on the [Profile](https://schools.clever.com/profile) or [Admin Team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) pages must match the email address in your IdP. See details for your IdP below.
    -   Admins must update their own email addresses from the [Profile page](https://schools.clever.com/profile). You can learn more about how to update your profile settings [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043053).
-   Your username or login claims rule in your IdP must be your email address.

  
**Google**  
Google will always use an email address as the username. If you have added Google as a login method and your admin user email address is a Google email address, you are configured for Clever Dashboard SSO.  
  
**Entra ID**  
A claims rule for clever.district\_admin.email or clever.any.email should be added in Entra ID as outlined here. The claims rule should indicate which field in Active Directory contains the same email address that matches the email address on the Clever Admin's Profile in Clever.  
  
**Active Directory**  
A claims rule for clever.district\_admin.email should be added in Active Directory as outlined here. The claims rule should indicate which field in Active Directory contains the same email address that matches the email address on the Clever Admin's Profile in Clever.  
  
**Canvas**  
By default, Canvas will try to match on email. Ensure that your admins have an email address in Canvas that matches the email address on the Clever Admin's Profile in Clever to enable SSO access with Canvas. If these default matches do not work for your district, please let us know in your support request.  
  
 

* * *

## Logging into the admin Clever Dashboard and Portal

To log in as an admin user using SSO, you will need to navigate to your district's Portal URL. This is the URL that your students, teachers, and staff use to log in, and can be found on your [Clever Dashboard > Portal > Portal settings](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings/url) page.  
  
![Portal URL page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTuf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WfRrT)   
  
When logging in directly from your Portal URL, you will first access your admin Clever Portal. To navigate to the Clever Dashboard, click Dashboard at the top of your Portal.  
 

* * *

## SSO and Multi-factor authentication (MFA)

By default, admin users still need to use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access the Clever Portal when using SSO (learn more about [MFA for admin users here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333)). If your district admin team already uses MFA when accessing your identity provider (IdP) and you would like to by-pass admin MFA when accessing Clever, contact our support team and be prepared to provide details about your admin team and IdP MFA. Learn more about [managing your Admin Team here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001560).  
  
**Disabling password login for your admin team**  
As an additional layer of security, Clever can disable password login for your admin team. This means that email address and password logins will no longer work at schools.clever.com and your team must use SSO through your district Portal URL. If you would like to disable password logins for your district, contact our support team.   
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTuf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The Clever Account Owner can always use an email address with a password login and MFA to access the Clever Dashboard. This is to provide a backup in case your IdP configurations change and other admins lose access.

  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can admins use Clever Passwords to log in to the Clever Dashboard?**

-   No. SSO admin login through the Portal URL must use an external IdP.

**Sometimes I log in directly to the Clever Dashboard when using SSO. Why does that happen?**

-   If you start at schools.clever.com and click School Login to navigate to your district Portal URL, you will log into the Clever Dashboard directly instead of the admin Portal.

![District Admin Login](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TTuf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000063JuL)  
  

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA) for Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202062333)
-   [Managing your District Clever Admin Team](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001560)
-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Setup & Configuration](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204982938)

title: For App Partners: What is a sync conversion?
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001567#header1) 2\. [What is a sync or SIS ID conversion?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001567#header2) 3\. [What is the Clever ID vs the SIS ID?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001567#header3) 4\. [How Clever preserves user accounts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001567#header4) 5\. [Application requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001567#header5) 6. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001567#FAQ) ## Overview This article is to provide our application partners with information on the sync or SIS ID conversion process for districts and schools. * * * ## What is a sync or SIS ID conversion? A [sync conversion](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001566?language=en_US) is when schools change their way of syncing their data to Clever. This means they have either: - Changed their sync type (e.g. going from a manual SFTP sync to a Clever-managed auto sync) - Changed their Student Information System (SIS) (e.g. going from Infinite Campus to PowerSchool) An [SIS ID conversion](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543?language=en_US) is when schools keep the same syncing system but need to change their users’ SIS IDs.  **Both of these require Clever go through the conversion process to preserve the Clever IDs for users.**   * * * ## What is the Clever ID vs the SIS ID? The primary identifiers for records in Clever are known as SIS IDs. The following fields are SIS IDs:  
Data typeColumn Header/Field NameNotes
SchoolSchool_idTypically the school local id. Used in all other files. Corresponds to ’sis id’ field in Clever. Must be unique across the district.
StudentStudent_idUnique and constant id for student, may be student number, state id, or other unique identifier, to be used in enrollments.csv upload. Corresponds to ’sis id’ field in Clever. Must be unique across the district.
TeacherTeacher_idUnique and constant id for teacher, may be teacher number, state id, or other unique identifier, to be used in sections.csv upload. Corresponds to ’sis id’ field in Clever. Must be unique across the district.
SectionsSection_idUnique and constant id for section, to be used in enrollments.csv upload. Corresponds to ’sis id’ field in Clever. Must be unique across the district
StaffStaff_idAn identifier provided by the district when syncing or creating this staff member. Must be unique across the district.
Contacts  Contact_sis_idThe unique identifier for this contact, if one exists
Clever ID refers to the globally unique identifier that's assigned to a record in Clever. This ID is based on the SIS ID. If the SIS ID changes, the Clever ID will change. If schools change their SIS IDs, this causes the users' accounts to be deleted and will generate new accounts. This can cause the loss of historic data in connected applications as most apps use the Clever ID as the identifier to create accounts. * * * ## How Clever preserves the user accounts When schools reach out about starting either conversion process, we enable protection settings on their account to ensure teachers and students are minimally affected by the changes in data.  During this time, all syncing of data between the district and Clever will be paused, however, users will still be able to access Clever and their applications. We can then work with the district to make sure that their data is error-free and use our matchmaker tool to ensure that the new sis\_ids are associated with the old sis\_ids for each user, thus preserving the Clever IDs for each user. This process can take up to 3 weeks during peak times for various reasons such as troubleshooting sync errors, the need to notify applications for any reason, cleaning up data, etc. The schools’ role in the conversion is to supply accurate, error-free data. Schools should **not** reuse SIS IDs. If schools do re-use SIS IDs or have duplicate accounts for users, this can add to the sync conversion delay.  * * * ## Application requirements The best practice for our application partners is to use the Clever ID for account creation. However, if you’re unable to match the Clever ID for account creation (you use another field), we need to know what your requirements are when our districts go through a sync or SIS ID conversion. - If you're **not** using the Clever ID for account creation, **what fields are you using to create these accounts?** - Do you require a crosswalk file (a file that matches up the old data to the updated)?  - Is there any additional support or information you need during the conversion process?  Please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/?language=en_US) if you need any of this additional support. **If you don’t require a crosswalk file or additional support, there is no need to reach out.**   * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions #### **What fields are required by Clever?**  - For school data: - **School\_id** - **School\_number** - **School\_name** - For student data: - **School\_id** - **Student\_id** - **First\_name** - **Last\_name** - For teacher data - **School\_id** - **Teacher\_id** - **First\_name** - **Last\_name** - For section data - **School\_id** - **Section\_id** - **Teacher\_id** (Unique identifier of primary teacher for section, must match a Teacher id found in teachers.csv) - For enrollments data - **School\_id** (School id must match a School id provided in schools.csv upload) - **Section\_id** (Section id must match a Section id provided in sections.csv upload) - **Student\_id** (Student id must match a Student id provided in students.csv upload) - Contact data is not required but if the district decides to sync this data, we require the following: - **Contact\_relationship** (Contact’s relationship to student - e.g. ”Father”, ”Aunt” or ”Neighbor”) - **Contact\_type** (Type of contact - e.g. ”family”, ”emergency” or ”guardian”. If providing student contacts, then Contact type is required) - **Contact\_name**  - Staff data is not required but if the district decides to sync this data, we require the following: - **Staff\_id** - **Staff\_email** - **First\_name** - **Last\_name** If your application requires certain fields that you are not seeing as synced, please reach out to the district to make sure they are syncing that field to Clever. #### **Who handles the sync or SIS ID conversion?** - Clever completes the conversion process while working with the schools   If you have any questions, please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/?language=en_US)! * * *

title: Secure Sync: Sync or SIS ID conversions
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001566#header1)  
2\. [What is a sync or SIS ID Conversion and why is this important?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001566#header2)  
3\. [Sync Conversion requirements + pre-work](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001566#header3)  
4\. [The Sync or SIS ID Conversion process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001566#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001566#FAQ)

## Overview

This article explains what a [Sync or SIS (S](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543)[tudent Information System) ID conversion](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543?language=en_US) is, why it matters, and how your school organization can prepare.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cnxN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Sync or [SIS ID conversions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543?language=en_US) can take 2-3 weeks to complete.

* * *

## What is a Sync or SIS ID conversion and why is it important?

You need a sync conversion when you change how data syncs to Clever. This includes switching SIS providers or changing sync types, such as moving from a manual SFTP sync to a Clever-managed auto sync.

You need a [SIS ID conversion](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001543?language=en_US) when you change school\_ids, student\_ids, teacher\_ids, or staff\_ids in Clever.

These conversions help preserve Clever records and historical data in connected applications.

Most transitions require both a sync conversion and a SIS ID conversion. If your SIS provider and sync type stay the same, you’ll only need a SIS ID conversion. We'll help you determine the best approach.  
 

* * *

## Sync Conversion requirements + pre-work

Before starting a sync or SIS ID conversion, make sure the following requirements are met:

-   Your SIS includes all users who still need access to Clever.
    
-   Your SIS includes rosters for the current calendar year. If rosters aren’t final for a new school year, you can still start as long as at least one active section or enrollment exists.
    

Clever also recommends completing this pre-work to ensure a smooth process:

1.  **Identify how you'll sync data to Clever:** Clever provides school organizations with multiple methods to sync their data. If your school organization is transitioning to one of the SISs listed [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973#Clever-Managed%20Auto%20Sync), you may be able to use an auto sync to send data to Clever. If your SIS isn't listed, you'll use an SFTP sync. Learn more about syncing data via SFTP [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078).
2.  **Confirm the primary identifiers for records:** Clever recommends keeping student\_id and teacher\_id the same when transitioning SISs to avoid duplicate or lost records. If IDs must change, we can match records to preserve historical data in Clever and connected applications.
3.  **Clear duplicate teacher or student accounts.** Duplicates often occur when users have separate SIS records for multiple schools. These duplicates can cause login issues, rostering problems, or data loss. Consolidate records in your SIS before starting the conversion whenever possible.
4.  **Confirm that SIS IDs aren't being reused.** Clever treats SIS IDs as unique identifiers. Reusing an ID within 300 days of its last sync can cause data issues both within Clever and connected applications. Confirm with your SIS admin that IDs won’t be recycled. If your SIS reuses IDs automatically, assign unique identifiers that haven’t synced with Clever in the past 300 days.
5.  **Populate data in your new SIS.** Your new SIS must contain active data before the conversion. Plan to have data ready 3–4 weeks before you want it live in Clever.
6.  **Proactively start notifying SSO, Rostering apps:** App coordination often takes the most time. Work with Clever Support to identify impacted SSO and rostering apps. Notify those vendors early so they can prepare for the data change. We also recommend pausing the sync with these specific applications to prevent data changes during the sync conversion process. See our article [For Clever Admins: Pause your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607?language=en_US) for more information on how to pause the sync with an application.

* * *

## The Sync or SIS ID conversion process

1.  **Reach out to Clever**: Reach out to Clever Support before syncing new or updated data. A specialist will guide you through the process and help protect your data.
2.  **Configure your Auto Sync or SFTP files:** You need to set up your new sync connection before migration begins. If you've chosen an auto sync, work with our support team or your SIS provider as appropriate to set up the data sync. If you'll be syncing via SFTP, use [the directions found here.](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) Please allow up to one additional week to troubleshoot getting your sync or SFTP files successfully configured.
3.  **Migrate data:** Once your new data is ready, notify Clever Support. We'll enable protection settings to ensure your teachers, students, and staff are minimally affected by the changes in data by preventing SIS > Clever syncing during the migration. Existing users will still access Clever and apps, but new users won’t gain access until the conversion finishes. No new data will sync until the conversion process is complete.
4.  **Confirm data changes, sync with apps:** The final step of the process is to approve the data changes. After migration, Clever will place your sync on hold so you can review changes. No new or custom data will sync during this time. Approve or Discard changes from your Sync page as appropriate. You can find more details on [holds here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358) Once data goes live, allow up to 48 hours for apps to reflect updates. App vendors control how and when they ingest data. If you have any questions about the effect of data changes in an application, please get in touch with the application's support team.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is there an option if I need more guidance and would like additional services from Clever for my sync conversion?** 

-   Yes! We offer [Sync Conversion Consulting Services](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646#SyncSISConversions) for school organizations that want extra guidance and hands-on support. Opting for our paid services can provide additional consultation and support to further streamline the process. If you're interested in exploring this option or have any questions, please let us know!

**Can this be done during a sync pause?** 

-   Yes, and we recommend it. Since no new data or data changes process during a conversion, a planned pause works best.

**Why does the sync conversion take up to 2-3 weeks?** 

-   Sync conversions involve complex data matching, which carries risk if done incorrectly. Larger or more complex datasets take longer. Many school organizations schedule conversions during winter or summer breaks.

**What are common issues that occur during the sync conversion process that I should be aware of?**

-   Incorrect credentials for the new sync
    
-   Duplicate user accounts in the SIS. In Clever, users shouldn’t have multiple accounts if they're at more than one school; Clever associates a user with various schools via sections and enrollments. If a user is duplicated in your SIS to associate them with multiple schools, this can cause issues in the data-matching process in Clever.
    
-   SIS ID reuse
    
-   Unexpected SIS ID changes
    

**When should I reach out to start this process?**

-   Contact Clever at least 3 weeks before your desired completion date and only after your SIS data is fully populated. Our support team can't schedule sync conversions in advance, so please be sure the data in your SIS is ready for upload when you contact our team. If you'd like to schedule a sync conversion in advance, please read about our [sync conversion consulting services](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001646#SyncSISConversions).

**Can I only change the SIS ID of one user?**

-   Not at this time. Our internal tools only work for large numbers of SIS ID changes (e.g., 100 IDs or more).  
    Anytime you run record linkage between data sets, data integrity is at risk. If you need to change student IDs for individual students, the best course of action is to contact your connected applications and let them know so that they can attempt to match up the new student ID and Clever ID to the student's historical data within their application.

**What are some Clever-managed sync options school organizations can switch over to?**

-   This [article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?language=en_US) details the types of Clever-managed auto syncs available to you.

**Who do I reach out to when doing a sync conversion?**

-   [Contact our Support Team.](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)

**Are section IDs preserved during sync conversions?**

-   Our migration tool isn't configured to preserve section IDs, since section IDs are expected to change during a sync conversion. However, if section IDs need preservation for an app connection, you can speak with the Clever team to discuss potential options.

* * *

  
**Related articles:**

-   [Secure Sync: Changing Student Information Systems](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360049183691?language=en_US)
-   [Secure Sync: Changing SIS IDs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001543?language=en_US)

title: For App Partners: App Dashboard SSO
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564#header1)  
2\. [Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564#header2)  
3\. [Configuration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564#header3)  
4\. [Multiple Domains](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564#header5)

## Overview

App Dashboard SSO allows app partners to configure organization level logins using SAML from their existing Identity Provider (IdP). You’ll work with our Partner Engineering team to configure the settings on your IdP to allow for seamless logins using the **Log in with SSO** button found at apps.clever.com.

![Screenshot of app partner login page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T1S9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003Gh8v)   
 

* * *

## Requirements

**Team Review**

-   Please review your current app team to ensure that you have accounts for the correct users. To view your team, navigate to the Team section of your Clever dashboard.
-   It is required that the email addresses associated with user accounts in Clever match the email addresses associated with accounts in your IdP.

  
**Organization Review**

-   If your team administers multiple apps on Clever or your organization spans multiple email domains, you may need Multiple Domain support. To prepare for App Dashboard SSO across your organization, ensure that the correct users have user accounts created with all of the appropriate applications in Clever using credentials that align with the IdP you intend to use for App Dashboard SSO.

* * *

## Configuration

**To get started:**  
If you would like to configure single sign-on for your organization, please contact our team at [integrations@clever.com](mailto:integrations@clever.com) with the following information:  
  
**Email Domain:**

-   This will be the @ of your email address. ex: At Clever, our email address has a “clever.com” domain.

  
**Encrypted Assertion?:**

-   Will the SAML assertions that their IdP sends to Clever be encrypted or unencrypted?

  
**metadata.xml Info:**

-   This can either be provided via an URL (recommended) or a file.
-   Your metadata info must include the following information:
    -   EntityDescriptor with an Entity ID
    -   KeyDescriptor tag that includes the X509Certificate
    -   SingleSignOnService tag with HTTP-Redirect Binding

  
**Configuration Steps to take In your IdP:**

1.  Add [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/metadata.xml) as the EntityID
2.  Add [https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert](https://clever.com/oauth/saml/assert) as the Assertion Consumer Service URL (ACS URL)
3.  Add a SAML assertion attribute “clever.email” that is mapped to email addresses in your IdP. Please note that the email addresses in your IdP will need to match the email addresses in Clever.

  
**Our integrations team will contact you with next steps to complete the configuration.  
  
**

* * *

## Multiple Domains

App Dashboard SSO can now support multiple email domains across the same organization. This will allow you to set up App Dashboard SSO across all of your applications. Reach out to [integrations@clever.com](mailto:integrations@clever.com) to explore your options.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Which IdPs can we use as our SSO Provider for App Dashboard SSO?**

-   Any IdP that can set up a SAML connection will work. See your IdP documentation for IdP-specific instructions on configuring the SAML connection.

  
**Will Dashboard logins using email and password continue to work?**

-   Dashboard logins will continue to work through the configuration and transition period and when you are ready to fully transition to App Dashboard SSO, we will disable logins using email and password.

  
**We have a Third-party development team that needs access, but we don’t have them as part of our SSO org. How can they have access?**

-   We believe that our Multiple Domain solution will work for your situation. Reach out to [integrations@clever.com](mailto:integrations@clever.com) to explore your options.

  
**We have team members from two different organizations, both of which have their own SSO solutions. What’s the best solution for us?**

-   We believe that our Multiple Domain solution will work for your situation. Reach out to [integrations@clever.com](mailto:integrations@clever.com) to explore your options.

  
**We don’t have an IdP; what options are available for securing our user logins?**

-   In addition to App Dashboard SSO, Clever offers both Sign in with Google and two-factor authentication. See the following articles for additional information.
    -   [For App Partners: Securing Users](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563?language=en_US)
    -   [For App Partners: How do I enable two-factor authentication](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001551)

title: For App Partners: Securing Users
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563#header1)  
2\. [Sign in with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563#header2)  
3\. [App Dashboard SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563#header3)  
4\. [Two Factor Authentication](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001563#header5)

## Overview

Securing logins with SSO or two-factor authentication (2FA) is a simple, effective way to protect accounts and data. Many enterprise applications make secure logins standard - and now, so is Clever.   
  
Explore your options for becoming more secure below.   
 

* * *

## Sign in with Google

Sign in with Google helps you to quickly and easily manage user authentication into the Clever dashboard. Users sign into the Google account associated with their Clever user email address and then simply click the **Sign in with Google** button found at apps.clever.com  
  
To support Sign in with Google, ensure that your Clever user account email addresses match your Google email addresses. You can review your team on the **Team** page of your Clever Dashboard.   
 

* * *

## App Dashboard SSO

App Dashboard SSO allows app partners to configure organization level logins using SAML from their existing Identity Provider (IDP). You'll work with our Partner Engineering team to configure the settings on your IDP to allow for seamless logins using the **Login in with SSO** button found at apps.clever.com  
  
Learn more about configuration in the [For App Partners: App Dashboard SSO](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001564?language=en_US) article.

* * *

## Two Factor Authentication

Two-factor authentication adds another level of security to your account. If you enable two-factor authentication, you'll be asked to enter a verification code in addition to your username and password every time you log in to Clever. This extra verification prevents unauthorized parties from accessing your account, even if your password has been compromised.   
  
Learn more about configuration in the [For App Partners: How do I enable two-factor authentication?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001551) article.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why is there a focus on improving account security now?

-   Cybercrime is on the rise, and school district technology is a popular target. We want to help increase the security of app partner accounts as soon as possible to ensure all data is protected. 

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For App Partners: How do I enable two-factor authentication?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001551)
-   [For App Partners: App Dashboard SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001564?language=en_US)

title: Clever IDM: Prerequisites and Planning
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001561#header1)  
2\. [Set up your sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001561#header2)  
3\. [How IDM decides whether to match an account or create a new one](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001561#header3)  
4\. [Email Notifications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001561#email)  
5\. [Planning steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001561#header4)  
6\. [Additional tools](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001561#header5)

## Overview

Clever IDM helps districts automate account provisioning and lifecycle management for Microsoft Active Directory services and Google Workspace. This affordable solution can create user accounts and organizational units based on data in Clever. However, before using this service, we recommend making sure your data is in tip-top shape. This article will guide you through a few things to check before starting your IDM journey and some tips to ensure you make the most of it after you complete the setup. As always, if you have any questions, feel free to open a new case in our [Help Center](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/?language=en_US).  
  
A note on verbiage - Clever IDM may be confusing if you haven't used an identity management system before. Here's some quick lingo: 

-   **Destination** - Google Workspace, ADFS, or Entra ID, where Clever IDM will create and manage your users. 
-   **Formula** - the part of your Clever IDM configuration that determines how we create email addresses and Organization Units (OUs). This uses "templates", or combinations of data or predetermined values, to specify what Clever puts into your destinations. 
-   **OU (organizational unit)** - the "folder" of your destinations, a group where users are placed when managed by Clever IDM.

* * *

## Set up your sync

You'll want to ensure that your sync from your SIS to Clever is running before adding IDM to the mix. Everything else in Clever depends on Secure Sync to work! You can read about Secure Sync in this Help Center article: [What is Secure Sync?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588?language=en_US)  
  
A wide variety of sync types are available, each with its own set of quirks and advantages. Check out your specific sync type in the list below, and pay close attention to any field limitations or the timings of automated syncs.  
 

-   [Which sync type should I choose?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202289278)
-   [SFTP](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US)
-   [Aeries](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203005016?language=en_US#five)
-   [PowerSchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)
-   [Infinite Campus Auto](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202094756?language=en_US#Header4)
-   [Infinite Campus API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/226677767?language=en_US#troubleshooting)
-   [SchoolInsight](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/206090237)
-   [Skyward API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028?language=en_US#h_01EHB1XM013ZNM5DNARJXQPZ5N)
-   [Blackbaud API Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001544?language=en_US)

  
For instance, if your sync type doesn't automatically include student emails, you should review our options for populating that field, such as field mapping. Clever Support is happy to assist you with these mappings. Note that not all sync types support mappings - you'll want to check out your respective sync type above for details.

Additionally, if you plan to use Clever IDM to manage non-teaching staff in Clever, there are various options for syncing staff users, including CSV files, custom data, or an Active Directory sync. You'll want to ensure that you sync staff users to Clever before setting up Clever IDM. [Learn more in our article about adding staff to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547).

Note that Clever IDM can create emails using a template you've set in your Clever Dashboard **even if the email field isn’t populated** by data from your SIS. If you're syncing data to Clever’s email field, we'll use that instead of your template.  
  
In addition to the email address, you'll want to consider getting other data to Clever that you want to sync over including data like student lunch numbers, building IDs, or other information you may need to populate in your destination automatically.

Additionally, if your sync only runs once daily, you may want to schedule your IDM sync to run after your SIS sync. Our teams can assist with configuring a time for your IDM sync.

* * *

## How IDM decides whether to match an account or create new one 

IDM matches and creates users using the standard fields: the email from your Student Information System (SIS) for Google, and the district username field from your SIS for AD/Entra.

-   If your SIS syncs the email you want into Clever, you don’t need to change anything.  
      
    
-   If it doesn’t, IDM will use the template you create in **Step 4: Set login credentials** to create the user.  
      
    

Below is a breakdown of the most common paths that IDM may take depending on whether you’re syncing with Google or AD/Entra ID.

### **IDM logic for Google**

-   If Clever already has an email from SIS:  
      
    
    -   IDM looks for a Google account with that email.  
          
        
    -   If it finds one, it links the account.  
          
        
    -   If it doesn’t find one, IDM creates a new Google account with that email.  
          
        
-   If Clever does not have a SIS email:  
      
    
    -   IDM creates an email using the template you set in **Step 4: Set login credentials**.  
          
        
-   If the templated email already exists in Google:  
      
    
    -   If IDM manages that account, it will add a **1** to the username (or use your fallback option configured in Step 4).  
          
        
    -   If IDM does not manage that account, it shows up as a **Conflict with Existing User** in the Issues report. You can manually match these accounts under the **Tasks** tab in IDM after IDM syncs.  
          
        

### **IDM logic for AD or Entra ID**

-   IDM matches accounts based on **District Username**. If you would prefer for IDM to match by email prefix, please let our team know so that we can update this on our end.  
      
    
-   If Clever already has a username or email from SIS:  
      
    
    -   IDM combines that username or email with the domain set in your IDM configuration.  
          
        
    -   If this matches a UPN in AD/Entra, IDM links the account.  
          
        
    -   If it doesn’t match, IDM creates a new account using that format.  
          
        
-   If Clever does not have a username/email in Clever and formula doesn't match, IDM creates using template configured in **Step 3: Set login credentials**  
      
    
    -   If the templated formula produces a value, IDM moves forward with creating the UPN with that value. If that UPN configuration is already assigned to another user, this will result in a conflict.
        
    -   If the templated formula results in a blank value or there is a missing attribute (username or email in most cases), then IDM assigns '1' to the end of the username by default, or uses the custom fallback configured in **Step 3: Set login credentials**.
        
    
-   If the UPN already exists on another account:  
      
    
    -   If IDM manages that account, it will add a **1** to the username or use your fallback from Step 4.  
          
        

If IDM does not manage that account, it shows as a **Conflict with Existing User** in the Issues report. You can manually match these in the **Tasks** tab.

You can start setting up Clever IDM free from your Clever Dashboard. For detailed instructions on the setup process, use the following resources:  

-   [Clever IDM: Setup for Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)
-   [Clever IDM: Setup for Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505?language=en_US)
-   [Clever IDM: Entra ID Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553)
-   [Clever Academy Course: Quick Start - Setting up Clever IDM](https://clever.academy/quick-start-idm)

* * *

##   
Email Notifications

The Clever Admin Owner is sent weekly IDM Sync Report emails that contain key metrics for IDM syncs over the prior week. You can determine the Clever Admin Owner at your district by checking the Role column on the [Team Page](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) of your District Dashboard. You can request daily sync report emails by contacting Clever Support. If additional team  members need access to these emailed reports, please have the Clever Admin Owner configure a forwarding filter in their email system.

* * *

## Planning steps

After you've got your IDM sync up and running, plan out your long-term implementation. For example, if you intend to use Clever's Badges into Chromebooks solutions or Badges into Windows solutions, you'll want to ensure you've applied the necessary settings to the OUs or devices where they're required. If you'll be managing your OUs with Clever IDM, think about which groups of students will need access to those solutions, such as K-5.  
 

-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Chromebooks - Setup & Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/224420247?language=en_US)
-   [Clever Badges: How do I enable Badges into Windows devices?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000384086?language=en_US)  

  
You'll also want to disable any other IDM or automated software or scripts that may be running - Clever IDM can't override or disable these other tools, and you may see unintended behavior with multiple automations running. Some may work well in tandem, but we'd recommend just using one at a time until you're sure they'll complement each other.  
 

* * *

##   
Additional tools

Password management can be difficult and may present security concerns. [Consider setting up account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662) to simplify management for your schools.  
  
If you're running both Entra ID _and_ ADFS but only one instance of Clever IDM, you may consider checking out [this Microsoft Help Center article about Entra ID Connect](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/hybrid/how-to-connect-fed-management).   
  
Good luck with your implementation, and remember we're here to help!   
 

* * *

**Related Articles:**  
  
[Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)  
[Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)  
[Clever IDM: Entra ID Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553)  
[Clever IDM: Purchasing & Billing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001472)

title: Managing your Clever administrative team
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header1)  
2\. [What are Clever admin users?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header2)  
3\. [Do you have the right Clever account owner?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header3)  
4. [Adding and removing users from your admin team](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header4)  
5\. [Admin users and rostering](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header5)  
6\. [Do users have the right role?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header6)  
7\. [Removing outdated accounts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header7)  
8\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001560#header8)

##   
Overview

Keeping your admin team users in Clever up to date is an essential part of maintaining account security. There are numerous [roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) and [custom roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702) that you can assign to your administrative team in Clever to minimize risk and ensure that team members have the minimum access required in Clever. This article will guide you through reviewing and cleaning up your team.  
  
To view your Clever team, navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members). You can also search for a specific user via the search bar if you prefer.

* * *

## What are Clever admin users?

Your Clever administrative team may include users with one of the following roles: Clever Admin (Owner), Clever Admin, District Curriculum Lead, District Help Desk, or a [Custom Role](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702) that you've created in the Clever Dashboard. To learn more about the default admin team roles, [see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726).

  
While School Tech Leads (STLs) appear on your [User management > Admin team page](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) they are not admin users. School Tech Leads are staff users with additional permissions in Clever, allowing them to provide support and troubleshoot for your schools. If you need to delete or edit an STL in your account, please edit them via your staff data (custom data or staff.csv). [Learn more about School Tech Leads here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003207663).

You can find any admin team member using the search bar at the top of your Clever Dashboard, the same way you'd search for a student, teacher, or staff member. Start typing their name or email, then click their name to open their profile page. Profile pages are also linked from the Admin team page and anywhere else an admin is listed.

* * *

## Do you have the right Clever account owner?

The Clever Admin Owner holds unique privileges and is designated as the primary point of contact for all Clever-related issues. See this [article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038#Clever%20Account%20Owner) to learn more about Clever Admin Owners.  
  
The Clever Admin Owner account must be in the possession of the person at your schools who is empowered to make important decisions about your Clever account. If your account owner leaves your school organization, you may experience delays when making some requests.  
  
To transfer the account owner, [see the instructions here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038#Transferring%20Ownership%20to%20a%20new%20Account%20Owner).

* * *

## Adding and removing users from your admin team

Any users who are assigned the Clever Admin role are also able to add other Clever Admins to Clever by following these steps:

1.  Log in to the [Clever Dashboard.](https://schools.clever.com/)
    
2.  Select [User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) from the left navigation menu.
    
3.  Select **Actions** in the top right of the page.
    
4.  Select **Add team member** from the options available.
    
5.  Add the new Clever Admin's information in the pop-up box and select their role. Remember to select the role that will provide the minimum permissions required in Clever for security.
    
6.  Select **Add.**
    

Once a team member has been added to the account, they will receive an email with a link to create an account. If they do not receive this message, please have them check their spam folder for a message from [no-reply@clever.com](mailto:no-reply@clever.com). 

To remove an administrator from your team, navigate to [User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) and click the **Actions** button next to the user. From this drop down, select **Delete** to remove the user.

If you are utilizing an SFTP or SIS-Managed SFTP sync you can also sync, remove, and update Clever Admins via CSV. [Please see here for more information, including steps for removing admins synced via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709).  
  
If you utilize a SIS-Managed sync and want to automate the syncing of your administrators.csv, you’ll need to work with your SIS directly to add this file to your exports.

* * *

## Admin users and rostering

If you'd like any administrators you add to Clever to have access to learning applications, be sure that your sharing permissions are configured to share those users. [Learn more here about setting up admin sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247#constructing).

If you’re considering removing team members, consider if they'll still need access to learning applications via Clever. If so, you may want to add them as staff users to Clever and share them with the appropriate applications so they maintain application access if needed.  
  
Learn about [Staff users](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547) here.

* * *

## Do users have the right role?

When reviewing your team, you can edit which role your users have. See this article to [determine the best default Clever role for a user,](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726#best_role) or this article to learn more about creating [custom roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702).

You can review all roles assigned to a given user on [the Admin team page](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) or their profile page.

* * *

## Removing outdated accounts

To keep your Clever account secure, we recommend reviewing your Team page periodically to:

-   Delete any admin users who are no longer with your schools.
-   Delete any admin users who have moved to a new position where they no longer need an admin role.

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**What should I do if another admin or I can’t remember our login information?**

-   If an admin can’t sign in, they can follow the steps below to recover their account:
    1.  On the admin login page, click **Forgot your password?**
    2.  On the **Recover account** page, enter the email address connected to the Clever account. If you’re unsure which email address was used, another admin on your team can check the Team page to find the correct one.

**Will deleted admins receive an email notifying them that their account has been deleted?** 

-   No. However, you may choose to reach out to inform your team about updated accounts. 

**I am the Clever account owner and will be leaving my role soon. Do I need to transfer ownership before I leave?** 

-   It is best practice for a seamless transition to transfer the Clever account ownership before you leave while you still have access to the Clever account as the account owner.

**How do I know which permissions I should assign a role?**

-   Clever recommends assigning the minimum required permissions to user for their role. There is no limit to the number of custom roles in Clever, so you can create as many unique roles as needed to ensure proper permissions are in place for each admin.

**Where can I locate and edit admin users?**

-   On your [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page or by searching for the admin in the search bar and navigating to their profile page.
    

**Why is the Edit option disabled on an admin's profile page?**

-   This means the admin was added [via an administrators.csv.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709) To make changes, update the record in your administrators.csv either via your SIS or by manually editing the file.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726)
-   [For Clever Admin: Custom admin roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702)
-   [Clever Roles: Clever Admin](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202518038)
-   [Clever Roles: Staff - How to add to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547)

title: For Clever Admins: Course Data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001559#header1)  
2\. [How are courses created?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001559#header2)  
3\. [Viewing courses in the data browser](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001559#header3)  
4\. [How is course data used?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001559#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001559#header5)

## Overview

This article will explain how you can import course data to Clever, how to view it, and how you can use it!

* * *

## How are courses created?

Course data is synced to Clever as part of your standard sync, usually through sections data (sections.csv). Course data is not required by Clever, but it may be required by certain applications. The fields associated with courses are: 

-   Course\_name
-   Course\_number
-   Course\_description

Clever auto-generates a unique Clever ID for each course, based on the  course\_number and course\_name fields. This value is distinct to the course and is different than a section Clever ID. The course Clever ID is used to identify unique courses within your data and is used for [content mapping](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360052615892) .   
  
Since we use the course\_number and course\_name fields to generate the course ID, any changes to the values in those fields will auto-generate a new course Clever ID. If a Clever ID for a course is regenerated, it will require updating the content mappings for any applications that use the content mapping feature.  
  
Unfortunately, Clever is unable to revert to any previous values of this number, since the IDs are auto-generated and old IDs are auto-deprecated when changed, as they behave just like a Clever ID.

* * *

## Viewing courses in the data browser

To view the course data that has synced to Clever, you can go to the Data Browser and look at the [Courses tab](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=courses&filters=%255B%255D).   
  
![Screenshot of the Data Browser highlighting the Courses tab.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSsv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062f8f)   
  
The Courses tab includes the course number, the course name, the Clever ID of the course, a link to sections related to the course, and when that course was last modified. 

* * *

## How is course data used?

Course data can be used to share with applications. When constructing sharing rules, you can **Custom Share by Section** when **Sharing by Rules**. You can use this sharing type to filter by section attributes such as subject, school, course, and term. For more information on this, please see [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247?language=en_US). This will allow you to share your data with an application by specific courses. As an example, you can see below there is a section sharing rule that has been set up to share sections with a specific course name. This will share sections that have a course name of Algebra II/Trigonometry.  
  
![Screenshot of a section sharing rule](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSsv&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062f9E)   
  
Course data can also be used for content mapping as some applications allow you to map resources to specific courses.  For more information on content mapping, please click here: [For Clever Admins: Content Mapping](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360052615892?language=en_US).  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What if our Student Information System doesn’t sync course data?

-   If you have a Clever-managed auto sync, you can reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/s/?language=en_US) to see if your sync can be customized to include course data.
-   If your sync type does not allow for the syncing of course data, we can discuss changing your account to a sync type that does allow for this data to be synced.   
     

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For School Organization Admins: Sync Reports](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202213756?language=en_US)
-   [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Term Data
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001558#header1)  
2\. [How are terms created?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001558#header2)  
3\. [Viewing term data in the Data browser](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001558#header3)  
4\. [How is term data used?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001558#header4)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001558#header5)

## Overview

This article will help to explain how you can import term data to Clever, how to view it, and how you can use it!

* * *

## How are terms created?

Term data is synced to Clever from your student information system (SIS) as part of your section data. Term data is not required by Clever, but it may be required by certain applications.

  
The fields associated with term data are:

-   term\_name
-   term\_start
-   term\_end

For most Clever-managed auto syncs, term data is included by default. If your Clever-managed auto sync does not include term data, please contact Clever Support to discuss what options are available for your sync type.  
  
Clever auto-generates a unique Clever ID for each term based on term\_start, term\_end, and term\_name. If any of those values change, a new term Clever ID will be generated which could affect term data in some connected applications.

* * *

## Viewing term data in the Data browser

To view the term data that has synced to Clever, you can go to the [Clever Dashboard > Data browser > Terms](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=terms) tab.  
  
![Screenshot of the Data Browser showing the Terms tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2BB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062e9C)  
  
The Terms tab includes the term name, the start and end dates, the Clever ID of the term, when it was created, when it was last modified, and a link to the Sections tab.

* * *

## How is term data used?

Term data can be used to share with applications. When constructing sharing rules, you can **Custom Share by Section** when **Sharing by Rules**. You can use this sharing type to filter by section attributes such as subject, school, course, and term. For more information on this, please see [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). This will allow you to share your data with an application by certain terms. As an example, you can see below there is a sections sharing rule that has been set up to share sections with a specific term. This will share sections that are associated with the Spring 2022 term.  
  
![Screenshot of a sections sharing rule using term name as a property](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000e2BB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062eAP)

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

Can I side-load term data?

-   No, it is not possible to manually upload term data (term\_name, term\_start, term\_end) for sections. For school organizations syncing via SFTP that are unable to export term data in their sections.csv, we recommend manually updating the sections.csv file to include term data and to update/upload their sections.csv on a regular cadence (i.e. every week)

Since section data is relatively static (e.g. name, course, period, etc. don't change just because student enrollments do), schools will only need to manually update and upload their sections.csv when sections are added or removed from their school's SIS.

What if our SIS doesn’t sync term data?

-   If you have a Clever-managed auto sync, you can contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/) to see if your sync type can be customized to pull term data.
-   If your sync type doesn’t allow for the syncing of term data, we can discuss changing you to a sync type that does allow for this data to be synced.

* * *

  
**Related Articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Sync Reports](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202213756)
-   [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)
