title: SFTP Syncs: SFTP Sync FAQ
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#header1)  
2\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#header2)

![Clever Academy.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035fcv)  
Onboarding to Clever and want to learn about uploading CSV files? Check out our [Onboarding - Getting your schools’ data into Clever](https://clever.academy/path/onboarding/onboarding-sync?user_type=district_admin) course, available in Clever Academy!

## Overview

Whether you’re exporting data for an SFTP sync directly from your Student Information System (SIS) or building your own CSV files to sync data to Clever, there are several commonly asked questions our team receives, as shown below:

### General SFTP sync questions

-   [What CSV files are required to sync with Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#One)
-   [How do my data files work together?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#datagraphic)
-   [What if I’m not sure how to export data from my SIS?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Three)
-   [Is there a way to manually sync data to Clever, or add users one at a time?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Two)
-   [Can your team review my data files before I upload them?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Four)
-   [Can I upload the files one at a time so you can make sure I'm on the right track before uploading all of them?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Five)
-   [How do I know if my data upload went through?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Eight)

### File requirements and formatting questions

-   [Do I need to include a schools.csv file if we’re a single school?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Six)
-   [Do I need to include a sections.csv file?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Seven)
-   [What's the difference between teacher\_id and teacher\_number (or school\_id and school\_number, or student\_id and student\_number)?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Nine)
-   [How do I know if additional fields are required for a particular application?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Ten)

### Updating or editing data

-   [Can I manually trigger a sync?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#trigger)
-   [How do I archive classes in Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#archiveclasses)
-   [How do I remove data from Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#removedata)

### Troubleshooting

-   [Why didn't my data update after pushing a sync?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#Data_not_appearing_after_sync)
-   [Why is grade level showing as "Other" in Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#gradelevel)
-   [Do you have content to help me troubleshoot the data errors on my last attempted sync page?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001556#dataerrors)

  
Please note: This article is specifically about SFTP syncs. If you use a Clever-managed auto-sync, please [click here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202042973?#Clever-Managed%20Auto%20Sync).

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What CSV files are required to sync with Clever?**

-   The [Clever SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) outline the five required CSV files for a data sync to complete: 
    -   schools.csv
    -   teachers.csv
    -   students.csv
    -   sections.csv
    -   enrollments.csv

The staff.csv is an optional additional file for adding non-teaching staff to Clever. Learn more in [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547).

  
  
**How do my data files work together?**

-   This graphic is helpful to explain how your files work together:

![Graphic of how Clever sync files work with each other](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000002aH7)

  
**Is there a way to manually sync data to Clever or add users one at a time?**

-   Your 5 required CSV files must initially be synced simultaneously. They can be synced to Clever directly from your SIS, via an FTP client, or manually uploaded to your Clever Dashboard via the Web Upload Tool found on your [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.
-   You can make any updates or changes to users by editing and re-uploading these data files. Please note that the entire file must be uploaded as each file overwrites the previous.
-   Clever doesn't recommend adding or managing accounts through the [Custom Data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US) tool if you’re managing your own CSV files manually, as this often creates confusion on the primary source of data for your district. Custom data is intended to complement data coming from the primary CSV files, not replace it.

  
  
**What if I’m not sure how to export data from my SIS?**  
 

-   We recommend reaching out to your SIS team directly or checking for online help center documentation if you have questions about using the export tools in your SIS.
-   While our teams are happy to answer any questions you have regarding our [Clever SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf), file formatting, or the manual data upload process to Clever, we don’t have insight into your individual SIS instance and the export processes.

  
  
**Can your team review my data files before I upload them?**  
 

-   It is most secure to upload your files to Clever for our team to review. For security reasons, the Clever team does not recommend sending CSV files via email.
-   Additionally, our system automatically surfaces errors that our team may not manually detect! We recommend completing all five required CSV files and uploading them to Clever, and then our team is happy to review the files and provide additional insight into any errors that may occur.

  
  
**Can I upload the files one at a time so you can make sure I'm on the right track before uploading all of them?**  
 

-   For your first data sync, you must upload all five files simultaneously. When troubleshooting, we also recommend uploading all five files to ensure they work properly together during the sync.
-   As you add each file to Clever [via the upload tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/upload), our system automatically surfaces basic errors.
-   Once you’ve uploaded your CSV files to Clever, our team is happy to review the files and provide additional insight into any errors that may occur.

  
  
**Do I need to include a schools.csv file if we are a single school?**  
 

-   Yes! The schools.csv is required even if you’re a single school. This is how Clever’s sync system will know to associate your teachers and students with the school.

  
**Do I need to include a sections.csv file?**  
 

-   Yes! The sections.csv file is how Clever syncs your classes and assigns students to their class(es).
-   Even if you only have one section/class per grade, a sections.csv is required. The section\_id can be any unique value that is kept consistent across the sections.csv and enrollments.csv. If you’re making your own files, our team recommends keeping it simple and using single numbers (section\_id = 1, section\_id = 2 for each section/class).

  
  
**How do I know if my data upload went through?**  
 

-   A sync will occur any time data is successfully uploaded to Clever.
-   Syncs generally take 15-30 minutes to complete. If you’ve uploaded new data to Clever, please give the sync at least 30 minutes to complete.
-   Once 30 minutes have passed, please review your [Data sources > SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page for the status of your sync. You should also receive an email to the email address in your Clever profile.
-   [Click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202048663) to learn more about your sync status!

  
![Screenshot of last attempted sync page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062WPW) 

**Why didn't my data update after pushing a sync?**

-   First, make sure the sync actually processed by looking at the sync status at the top of the [home page of your Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/).

   **![Sync status](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WjxCn)**

-   After confirming that the sync went through and that the data did not update by reviewing the [SIS sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync), the next step is to check your files. 
-   Head to your FTP directory to ensure you don't have duplicate files. Having duplicate files will cause Clever to continue reading the first file that was uploaded while ignoring the newest one. [Click here for a tutorial](https://ior.ad/a88l) on accessing your remote site via an FTP client, or follow the instructions below:

1.  Open the FTP client (like [Filezilla](https://filezilla-project.org/), which is what this example uses) and enter the directory details found on your [**Sync > Settings**](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. Click **Quickconnect.**

![SFTP credentials in Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pAXN7)

![Enter credentials into FTP client](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pAVhu)

2.  Once connected, on the right, you will see the CSV files in your Clever SFTP directory (Remote site). Check to see if any files are duplicated. In the example below, you can see the teachers.csv file has a duplicate file.

![Duplicate files](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005SLHx)

3.  Right-click the duplicate files and select "delete."
4.  Re-upload the correct file to replace the duplicates.
5.  Clever will begin processing the updated file approximately five minutes after it has been uploaded to your FTP box. Please note that it may take 30 minutes for the sync to fully complete

  
**What's the difference between teacher\_id and teacher\_number (or school\_id and school\_number, or student\_id and student\_number)?**  
 

-   All of the user\_id fields (school\_id, teacher\_id, student\_id) are required fields for syncing data to Clever as this ID is the basis for the creation of a Clever ID, and the source of truth for which historical data is tied to in Clever. Our [Clever SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) requires this field be unique to each user in the district.

-   While school\_number is required, any additional user\_number fields (teacher\_number, student\_number) are optional in Clever. 
-   Many schools will re-use their chosen user\_id for this field, or populate it with another unique number available in their SIS such as a user’s state ID
-   Should you choose to populate the user\_number field, please note that this field should also be unique to each user in the district.

  
  
**How do I know if additional fields are required for a particular application?**  
 

-   If you think an application partner may require specific data fields, we recommend reaching out to the application partner directly to confirm if they have required fields in addition to the fields required to sync data to Clever.

-   Once you’ve added the application, your district/school-specific [Clever SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) can be found on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. After adding applications, this document will show any required fields for a particular application that the Clever team is aware of.![SFTP Specifications with example details for school org applications](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000difV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062dg5) 
-   For the most accurate data field requirements, we also recommend reaching out directly to the application partner!

  
  
**Can I manually trigger a sync?**

-   Yes! To trigger a sync, you'll need to send a new set of files to Clever, and Clever will automatically trigger a sync. Uploading too many times in a short period of time may trigger a sync upload error.

**How do I archive classes in Clever?**

-   You can't archive sections/classes within Clever at this time. However, sections can be assigned term data to show applications when the section is active or not. If you wish to remove old sections in Clever, you'll need to remove the sections from your SIS sync. For SFTP sync, this would mean removing the sections from the sections.csv file.

**How do I remove data in Clever?**

-   To remove data in Clever, you'll need to remove the data from the CSV files being sent to Clever for your SIS sync. Once Clever is no longer receiving that data, it'll be removed. You can see any data that has been removed from the most recent sync on the [SIS sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page.

**Why is grade level showing as "Other" in Clever?**

-   If grade level data is showing as "Other" in Clever, this means that the data we are receiving doesn't align with the Clever data requirements. Check out the accepted grade-level entries here: [Data Formatting Instructions](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf).

**Do you have content to help me troubleshoot the data errors on my last attempted sync page?**

-   Yes! Check out our article [Sync Reports: Error Messages](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001482). This article also links to additional articles for troubleshooting which contain helpful tutorial videos!

**Why is my FTP Client unable to connect to the remote site for Clever?**

-   This most commonly occurs when a school organization has a firewall that restricts traffic to or from Clever. Please check with your team internally to ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752).

**Why are my uploads via the Web Upload tool in Clever not completing?**

-   If you aren’t receiving a specific sync error and it appears that files aren't processing at all, your school organization may have a firewall blocking uploads.  Please check with your team internally to ensure you have allowlisted the [IP addresses outlined here for SFTP syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001752).

title: Clever IDM: Formulas
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#header1) 2\. [Building formulas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#header7) 3\. [Common operations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#header2) 4\. [Supported operations on fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#header3) 5\. [Supported field names](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#header4) 6. [Complex modifications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#header4) 7\. [Random password custom formulas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#randompasswords) 7\. [Using the forEach function](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555#Using_the_forEach_function) ## Overview IMPORTANT  This article is intended for Clever IDM users who connected before 8/4/26. If you connected after, please refer to the [User Groups article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755?language=en_US) to learn about how to configure user groups.  This article will walk you through common operations that you can use to manipulate data in Clever to create formulas for Clever IDM. These allow you to build a format for many different products in Clever - from IDM email addresses to SSO (Saved Passwords) application credentials and many other places in the [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/). These formulas work all across Clever - so if you’re setting up Clever IDM for Google, Active Directory, or even Entra ID, you’ll still be able to transform data into the format you need! * * * ## Building formulas Easily tailor formulas with Clever IDM's format builder. This intuitive tool guides you through crafting formats for IDM fields like sub-OUs and login credentials. Choose between the standard block builder for simplicity or the advanced format editor for more customization. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The block builder approach for building formats doesn’t currently support extension fields or advanced use of functions. If you need to use your extension fields or write more complex functions that you know Clever supports but don’t see as an option, you’ll need to use the advanced option of entering a format string. See the [Complex modifications](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555) for assistance with format strings.   ![Image directing you to click on "use he advanced format editor." to write your own string format.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PX4L) _Click **use the advanced format editor** to access the advanced format string format._ **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Dark purple SIS variables, such as School Name (as shown above), indicate a field that is required in your sync. Light purple SIS variables, such as Graduation Year, indicate that they're an optional variable that is not required in  your sync. If you use an optional variable and don't sync data for that field for all users, any user who doesn't have that data populated shows as an error and won't sync successfully. ### Add an SIS Variable This option allows you to select from the available fields that you are syncing to Clever.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PXIr) ### Add Custom Text This option allows you to type out custom text that you would like to use in your formula. ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PKrv) ### Add a Function _This option allows you to use functions to build a formula. For more context on how to use functions, review [Common Operations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555?language=en_US#header4)._  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PXXN) * * * ## Common operations **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Copy these formats from this article and directly paste them in the IDM setup for your email or password format. Then, click **Add format** to set the format (see image below).  ![image1.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062STt)

Description

Custom Format

First three letters of last name{{substr name.last 0 3}}
Last two letters of student graduation year{{substr student.graduation_year -2 2}}
First name initial{{substr name.first 0 1}}
Last 6 of SIS ID for student{{substr student.sis_id -6 6}}
Last 4 of SIS ID for teacher{{substr student.sis_id -4 4}}
First word of last name{{textBefore name.last " "}}
Replace - with . in last name{{replace name.last "-" "."}}
Date from student date of birth{{formatDate student.dob "DD"}}
Initials of school name{{initials school_name}}
* * * ## Supported operations on fields **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Note that field names that are not available for all users have a prefix with the user type e.g. student. or teacher.

Formula

Example

Description

substr

{{substr student.graduation_year -2 2}}
 		For graduation_year 2034, result is 34

The “-2 2” means start from 2 characters from the end, and grab the next 2 digits		If you want just a portion of a field, but not the whole thing

subtract

{{subtract student.graduation_year 4}}

For graduation_year 2034, result is 2030

If you want to subtract from a number.

For example, if the graduation year provided to Clever IDM is for high school graduation, but you want to adjust it to 8th grade graduation.

add

{{add student.graduation_year 4}}

For graduation_year 2034, result is 2038.

If you want to add to a number.

For example, if the graduation year provided to Clever IDM is for 8th grade graduation, but you want to adjust it to high school graduation.

formatDate

{{formatDate student.dob "MMDDYYYY"}}

 

Note: “MMM” produces Jan/Feb/etc and “MMMM” produces January/February/etc

Student Birthday of 21st October, 2008 results in 10212008Reformat something that’s coming into Clever as a date
replace

{{replace name.first "-" "."}}		For Anne-marrie the formula returns Anne.marrieReplace a character with another
textBefore

{{textBefore email "@"}}		For email maya@district.edu returns mayaReturn all characters before the one specified. Can be used to get the first word or the username only from the email field.
textAfter

{{textAfter email “@”}}		For email maya@example.edu returns example.eduReturn all characters after the one specified.
{{textAfterLast}}
i.e. {{textAfterLast name.last "-"}}		For a user with the last name Doe-Smith-Jenkins, {{textAfterLast name.last "-"}} output would be Jenkins.Will take the text after the last occurrence of a substring.
trimLeft

{{trimLeft email “C”}}		For email CCCmaya@example.edu, returns maya@example.eduReturns all characters after trimming off all occurrences of the specified characters from the front.
toUpper

{{toUpper name.first}}		For Maya, the formula results in MAYAMakes all the characters uppercase. 
toLower

{{toLower name.first}}		For Maya, the formula results in mayaMakes all the characters lowercase.
alphanumeric

{{alphanumeric name.first}}		For Anne-marrie the formula below results in AnnemarrieReturns a field with all non-alphanumeric characters removed. 
initials

{{initials student.school_name}}		For school_name Star Falls Elementary, the formula results in SFEReturns the initials of a value. The value can be more than one word, as shown in the example.
concat 

{{concat name.first name.last}}		For name John Doe, the formula results in JohnDoeConcatenates two values 
ignoreIfNull

{{ignoreIfNull name.middle}}		For the full name “John Jacob Doe”, the formula results in “Jacob”.

For the full name “John Doe”, where the user does not have a middle name, the formula results in nothing and will display as blank.		If you want to use fields that may not exist for all users in formulas.
if

{if equals student.sis_id "12345" "yes" "no"}}		For the sis_id 12345, the formula results in “yes”

For any other sis_id, the formula results in “no”		Allows different values to be returned based on the included condition. 


Follows the form: {{if <condition> <value if condition is true> <value if condition is false>}}
equals

{{equals student.sis_id “12345”}}		For the sis_id 12345, the formula results in “true”. 

For any other sis_id, the formula results in “false”.		Returns “true” when the two values equal each other, and “false” otherwise.
not 

{{not equals student.sis_id “12345”}}		For the sis_id 12345, the formula results in “false”. 

For any other sis_id, the formula results in “true”.		Flips true values to false and false values to true.
and 

{{and equals student.sis_id “12345” equals name.first “John”}} 		For sis_id 12345 and name “John Doe”, the formula results in “true”.Returns true when both the first and second values are true.
or
 
{{or equals student.sis_id “12345” equals name.first “John”}} 		For sis_id 12345 and the name “John Doe”, the formula results in true.Returns true when either the first or second values are true. Also returns true when both values are true.
greater 

{{greater student.graduation_year “2034”}}		For graduation_year 2035 and above, this returns true. Otherwise, this returns false.Returns true when the first value is greater than the second value.
less 

{{less student.graduation_year “2034”}}		For graduation_year 2033 and below, this returns true. Otherwise, this returns false.Returns true when the first value is less than the second value.

contains

{{contains "2024" email}}

For any email address that has 2024 in it, this returns true. Otherwise, this returns false. 

For instance, if your email format for the Class of 2024 is first.last.2024@yourdomain.edu, the function would return true for any of the Class of 2024 email addresses.

Returns true when the first argument (e.g. "2024") is found in the second argument (e.g. email).
geq

{{geq student.graduation_year “2034”}}		For graduation_year 2034 and above, this returns true. Otherwise, this returns false.Returns true when the first value is greater than or equal to the second value.
leq 

{{leq student.graduation_year “2034”}}		For graduation_year 2034 and below, this returns true. Otherwise, this returns false.Returns true when the first value is less than or equal to the second value.
in 

{{in student.graduation_year “2034 2036”}}		For graduation_year 2034 or 2036, this returns true. Otherwise, this returns false.Returns true when the first value is in the second value, which can be a list of values separated by a single space. 
length
{{length name.first}}		For Maya, this returns 4Returns the number of characters in a string.
first
{{first name.first}}		For Maya, this returns MReturns the first character of a string.
Capitalize after a delimiter (space, hyphen, variation of apostrophes)

{{delimiterCapitalize string}}

For the name Michael de'shawn-williams the formula returns Michael De'Shawn-Williams.Capitalizes the first letter after each occurrence of a delimiter. Delimiters included are spaces, hyphens, and variations of apostrophes.
* * * ## Supported field names **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** Note that field names that are not available for all users have a prefix with the user type e.g. student. or teacher.

* * * ## Random Password Custom Formulas To create random passwords for [IDM login credentials](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001605), you can manipulate these random features in an IDM Custom Formula using these functions: - {{randomString 6 "ULDS"}} - The randomString function randomly creates a string with these parameters: length, upper, lower, digit, and symbol. - The digit after randomString dictates the length of the random string. - The characters afterward correspond to specific types of characters to include in the random string. They are: - U = uppercase character - L = lowercase character - D = digit - S = symbol - For example, if you wanted a four-letter random password that is only upper and lower-case characters, you’d use {{randomString 4 “UL”}} - Clever will automatically remove ambiguous characters \[zero, uppercase "O", one, uppercase "i" and lowercase "ell"\] for any character type combinations containing "UL", "UD", or "LD" - Character type combinations that don't contain any ambiguous sets will use all available characters. For example: "DS" random strings include zero and one. - {{randomWord}} or {{randomUpperWord}}   - The randomWord function randomly selects a 4-5 letter word from a kid-friendly dictionary. - The randomUpperWord function selects from the same dictionary but capitalizes the first letter.  * * * ## Using the forEach function The forEach function allows you to assign multiple groups to a single user based on a single group rule. This functionality is only available in the group membership management step of the Clever IDM setup wizard. The forEach function will iterate over a selected array of values associated with a user and apply a format to each value in that array. The selected array can either be: 1. Schools associated with a user 2. Sections associated with a user 3. A space-delimited string where each element of the "array" is URL encoded This functionality is available in Clever IDM’s basic format builder. **We recommend trying to set up a forEach rule using the basic format builder first.** ### **Using forEach in the advanced format builder** If you need more customization, you can do so via the advanced format builder. Take the example format: {{forEach "s" schools "%7B%7Bs.name%7D%7D"}}. This format would look through each school associated with a user and place them in a group that matches the school’s name. The forEach function is accepting three arguments: 1. The first argument, "s" in this instance, is the name we assign the variable 2. The second argument, schools, is the array that we’d like to use 3. The final argument, "%7B%7Bs.name%7D%7D", is the format to apply to each value in the array **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dZ9B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** The final argument in the format must be URL encoded. URL encoding replaces special characters and spaces with codes. For example, “%20” encodes a "space" and “%7B” encodes the left curly bracket character "{". URL encoding allows the format builder to interpret the format correctly in all cases.    The final argument can also use other IDM-compatible functions. An example using the required URL encoding for a format where we want to put users in groups that are a combination of their school name and “Staff” would look like this: {{forEach "s" schools "%7B%7Bconcat%20s.name%20%22Staff%22%7D%7D"}}. Please contact Support.Clever.com if you need additional help with custom formats.

title: Clever + Google Classroom: Reprovision Classes that Teachers Declined Accidentally
text:
## How to reprovision any classes that teachers declined by accident

  
Be sure to let your teachers know that they need to **accept** the synced classes in Google Classroom:  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DA3B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y2yG)  
  
**If a teacher hit the _Decline_ button by accident, a Clever Admin can reprovision those classes in the Clever Dashboard** by following these steps:  
  
1\. Find the declined section in the Clever Dashboard by using [the search bar or the data browser.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202483068?language=en_US)  
  
2\. From the section's profile page in the Clever Dashboard, you'll see the option to reprovision the class:  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DA3B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004y2yp)  
  
_Please note: each accidentally-declined class will need to be reprovisioned following this method. Only declined and archived classes will show the option to Reprovision Section._

title: Clever Portal: Sharing Teacher Pages & resources with other teachers
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#Overview)  
2. [Sharing Pages with other teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#sharing_pages)  
3\. [Sharing resources with other teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#sharing-resources)  
4. [Accessing pages & resources shared with you](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#accessing_pages_shared_with_you)  
5\. [How to copy resources from a page shared with you](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#how_to_copy_resources)  
6\. [Sharing resources with other teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#sharing-resources)  
7\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001523#faqs)

## Overview

You can share Teacher Pages and resources with other teachers **in your school**, and they can share their pages and resources with you as well.   
  
Sharing Teacher Pages is perfect for:

-   Teachers covering a class who want to know what resources students have access to
-   Sharing content with teachers in your department to spark more collaboration
-   Sharing a stellar Teacher Page as an exemplar for other teachers
-   A common unit of study that a class team might be doing in tandem (so other teachers don’t need to reinvent the wheel).

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**If you’re not yet familiar with Teacher Pages, [check out this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323) first!

* * *

##   
Sharing Pages with other teachers

You can increase collaboration with colleagues by sharing your page with other teachers within your school. Click the **More page actions > Share Page** button at the top of the Teacher Page you are sharing and enter the person you’d like to share the page with.   
  
Rest assured, they won’t be able to modify your page! They’ll only be able to see the resources you’ve added to your page and add any desired resources to their own page.  
  
![Share my teacher page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009ZsGT)   
 

* * *

##   
 Sharing resources with other teachers

You can also share a single specific resource, such as an app, PDF, or link. To share a resource, click on the **three vertical dots (⋮)** on the resource, then click **Send**. You can send the resource to a specific teacher or your entire grade level.  
  
  
![Teacher Page resource with Send button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005SzE8)

* * *

##   
Accessing pages & resources shared with you

When a page or resource is shared with you, you’ll see a notification in the bell icon of your Clever Portal.  
 

![Teacher notification icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hIb)

![Teacher notification panel](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hKD)

  
You can also access shared pages by going to the **Shared with Me Pages** tab of your Clever Portal under the **Pages** drop-down on the left-hand side of your Portal.  
  
![Teacher Page Shared with Me page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hSH) 

* * *

## How to copy resources from a page shared with you

See a resource on another teacher’s Page that you like? You can add that resource to your own Teacher Page by clicking on the **Add** button. If the resource is a [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360013488672) app that you don’t already have, you’ll be able to provision accounts for your students when adding the app to your Page.  
  
Please remember that if a district app on a Teacher Page isn’t shared with you in Clever, you won’t have access to it. For instance, let’s say you’re a science teacher. If an ELA teacher shares their Page, which has a **district-added** reading program that only reading teachers can view in your school, you’ll see a grayed-out icon and won’t be able to access the app.  
  
![Add resources from this page to your Teacher Page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SicP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000044hYj) 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who can I share my Teacher Page or resource with?**  
Currently, you can select to share with any teacher who works at your school site. Your district assigns your school site. If you teach at more than one school, you'll only be able to share at your primary school, which is either the school your district has assigned as your primary school or the school where you teach the most classes/sections.  
  
**Can I revoke shared access from someone after I have shared my Teacher Page with them?**  
Yes! You can remove view access from others at any time via the sharing settings.  
  
**Can I dismiss Pages that are shared with me that I am not interested in?**   
Not at this time. Those Pages will only be accessible under the “Shared with Me” tab of your homeroom.   
  
**Can teachers edit or change my Page while they’re viewing it?**  
No! At this time, teachers can view your Page and add resources from it to their own Page. They won't be able to make any changes to your Page.  
  
**If I share a Page with another teacher, can their students access my Teacher Page?**  
No, only your students can view your Page(s). When you share with another teacher, only that teacher can view your Page.  
  
**How can I add a resource from another teacher’s Page to my own?**  
Click the **Add button** on a resource that you’d like on your own Page. You’ll be able to select the Page and category you’d like to add that resource to! If it is a Clever Library app, Clever will prompt you to provision accounts for your students first.  
  
**Why can’t I add a grayed-out resource to my Page?**  
Your district may add resources that aren't provisioned for your use. If this is the case, the resource will appear grayed out, and you’ll need to contact your district for permission.  
  
**How will I know if another teacher has shared a page with me?**  
You will receive a notification on your Homeroom Page and see an icon for their Teacher Page underneath the **Shared with Me** tab.  
 

* * *

**Related Articles:**   
[Clever Portal: Teacher Pages](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360001158323?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: I'm a new Clever Admin at an existing Clever District
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001522#overview)  
2\. [Recommended actions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001522#recommended_actions)  
3\. [How to access Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001522#how_to_access_clever_support)

  ​

## Overview

​

Welcome, new district admin! If you’ve recently been added to your district’s Clever account as a district administrator, this article is for you.

​

* * *

## Recommended actions

​

Sometimes, we hear about Clever district administrators who are added to Clever but not trained on how to support their district with Clever. We want to ensure you feel ready to support your district with Clever, so we’ve laid out some recommended steps:

1.  [Watch this overview of Clever video](https://youtu.be/mDk28C5iuI8): it’ll give you a quick rundown of what Clever is, and how it works to support your district, from your role as a District Admin to school tech coaches, teachers, and students. 
2.  [Be sure to update your email preferences](https://schools.clever.com/profile/emails): We send a variety of emails to support you and your district throughout the year, including important emails about your Clever sync, data pauses, and more. **These are disabled by default**, so it's vital that you turn them on if you want to be notified via email.
3.  [Work through our Clever Admin checklist](https://clever.academy/admin-checklist-23-24?user_type=district_admin?user_type=district_admin): this checklist is perfect for new and returning districts. For some of the steps, like “Adding a team member,” you might not have anyone to add just yet, but being able to check on who is already in your Clever account can help you take stock of how your account is set up.
4.  [Complete Clever Academy for Clever Admins](https://clever.academy/path/become-a-clever-certified-admin?user_type=district_admin): This comprehensive set of courses will ensure you’re a Clever Champion in no time! You’ll learn how to use Clever to share data, troubleshoot, and more. 

​

* * *

## How to access Clever Support

​

Everyone needs a little help from time to time. You can rely on our award-winning support team when you need assistance.   
  
To access support, click the chat icon in the bottom right corner of any page on Support.Clever.com. You’ll be asked to select your user type (Clever Admin), then to explain your issue. If we can’t identify a Help Center article that solves your problem, click “No” or “Contact Support.” You’ll be able to submit a ticket to our team, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

​

title: Clever + EBSCO Information Services Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#Overview)  
2\. [EBSCO Information Services Requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#EBSCO_information_services_reqs)  
3\. [Adding EBSCO Information Services](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#Adding_EBSCO_Information_Services)  
4\. [Additional Customization Options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#additional_setup_steps)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#FAQs)  
6. [EBSCO Customer Support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#EBSCO_Customer_support)  
7. [Clever Customer Support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001521#Clever_customer_support)

  ​

## Overview​

Now, it’s easier than ever to enhance student research and classroom instruction with user-friendly research tools from EBSCO, including Explora, EBSCOhost, EBSCO Discovery Service and subject-specific Reference Centers. Clever also integrates with EBSCO eBooks, Flipster digital magazines and NoveList, a database of book recommendations to support readers’ advisory.   
 

​

* * *

## EBSCO Information Services Requirements

Setting up Clever to access your EBSCO resources is simple and entirely self-service. First, you will add the EBSCO Information Services app and configure sharing permissions within the Clever dashboard.  
  
Then, you will enable schools for Clever access in EBSCO Experience Manager. This step maps schools to EBSCO accounts, which allows EBSCO to direct Clever users to the specific resources for their school. This step is important because every district subscribes to a different set of EBSCO products.  
  
Before you begin, it’s important to understand how your EBSCO products are set up on your district and school EBSCO customer accounts. Every school and district has an EBSCO account that their EBSCO resources are associated with. When enabling schools in EBSCO Experience Manager, you will need to know if any schools should be enabled in their own EBSCO account, or if all schools can be enabled in the district account.  
  
The easiest way to decide is to find out if any schools in your district have subscribed to EBSCO products just for their school. If they have, you will need to enable those schools in their own EBSCO accounts. This way, users at those schools will have access to their school’s unique content as well as any shared content across the district.  
  
If none of your schools have their own subscriptions, you can enable every school in the district’s EBSCO account.  
  
For help with this, you can [contact EBSCO support](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/How-do-I-contact-EBSCO-Support), ask your school or district librarians, or reach out to your district’s EBSCO administrator. Your EBSCO administrator has primary responsibility for configuring EBSCO resources for your school or district and may be someone associated with your school library, district office, or consortium office.

​

* * *

## Adding EBSCO Information Services

​To add EBSCO Information Services to your Clever Dashboard, please search for it from the [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page.

We recommend sharing all records in your district with EBSCO Information Services. Once the sharing permissions have been configured, you will need to enable schools in the Authentication & Access module of EBSCO Experience Manager. For instructions, please visit EBSCO Connect: [Setting Up Clever for Your District or School](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Setting-Up-Clever-for-Your-District-or-School).    
  
Completing these steps will allow users to anonymously access EBSCO resources from within the Clever Portal. All users will be directed to the same EBSCO product. To change the product your users are directed to, ask your EBSCO administrator to help you change the top-ranked profile so that it corresponds with that product.  
  
To direct your users straight to different EBSCO products, you can create EBSCO links that prompt for Clever authentication and add these to Clever as External Links. For example, using links you can direct primary school students to Explora, and high schoolers to EBSCOhost, and provide a separate link to access Flipster.   
  
To learn more, please visit EBSCO Connect: [Clever SSO - Additional Customization Options](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Clever-SSO-Additional-Customization-Options).

​

* * *

## Additional Customization Options

Once you have enabled schools in EBSCO Experience Manager and confirmed that your integration is working, there’s more that you can do. You can customize the user experience within the Clever portal, and your district can use Clever to authenticate users to EBSCO resources from outside the portal as well. For more information on these options, please see: [Clever SSO – Additional Customization Options](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Clever-SSO-Additional-Customization-Options). 

You can also control whether and when MyEBSCO accounts are automatically created for users. MyEBSCO accounts allow users to persistently save items they find in EBSCO products, download eBooks, and engage in other activities, such as placing a hold on an ILS item in EBSCO Discovery Service. No personally identifiable information is shared for accounts created for students. For more information on the options available, please see [How do I configure personalization for Clever?](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/How-do-I-configure-personalization-for-Clever?language=en_US)

* * *

## FAQs

For questions about your EBSCO account settings and configuration, please review [Clever SSO - Frequently Asked Questions for Administrators](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Clever-SSO-Frequently-Asked-Questions-for-Administrators) on EBSCO Connect or reach out to your EBSCO administrator.  
  ​​

* * *

## EBSCO Customer Support

Please review:

-   [Setting Up Clever for Your District or School](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Setting-Up-Clever-for-Your-District-or-School)
-   [Clever SSO - Additional Customization Options](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Clever-SSO-Additional-Customization-Options)
-   [How do I configure personalization for Clever?](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/How-do-I-configure-personalization-for-Clever?language=en_US)
-   [Clever SSO - Frequently Asked Questions for Administrators](https://connect.ebsco.com/s/article/Clever-SSO-Frequently-Asked-Questions-for-Administrators) on EBSCO Connect.

If you still have questions, or if you see an EBSCO-branded error message, please submit a support case.  
​ 

* * *

## Clever Customer Support

​For additional help requesting the EBSCO Information Services app in your Clever Dashboard or questions on setting up sharing permissions, you can open a ticket with Clever Support by clicking the messaging icon in the lower right corner of the Clever Help Center.  
​

title: Clever and Canadian Educational Institutions
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header1)  
2\. [Clever’s Compliance with Canadian Privacy Laws](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header2)  
3\. [Schools are in control of student personal information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header3)  
4\. [Clever lets schools maintain strong privacy settings by default](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header4)  
5\. [Clever does not rent or sell data, permit advertising or profile students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header5)  
6. [Clever does not use biometrics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header6)  
7. [Clever has a comprehensive security program](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header7)  
8. [Cross-border transfers of Student Data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header8)  
9. [Privacy impact assessments](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header9)  
10. [Clever’s privacy team](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001519#header10)

## Overview

Schools in Canada are permitted to use online services, such as Clever. Clever’s services follow privacy principles and data security standards that can help schools comply with regulations applicable to Canadian schools.   
In order to meet the needs of Canadian schools, Clever has:

-   Updated its [Terms of Use](https://clever.com/trust/terms)
-   Updated its privacy notice for [Canada-specific regulatory requirements](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/canada)
-   Created a [Canadian Data Processing Addendum](https://clever.com/trust/canada-data-processing-addendum)

* * *

## Clever’s Compliance with Canadian Privacy Laws 

Clever adheres to internationally recognized privacy principles. Clever understands that Canadian schools are subject to specific Canadian privacy laws. With Clever’s services, public schools can comply with provincial Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy legislation and private schools can comply with private sector personal information protection laws such as the British Columbia Personal Information Protection Act, the Alberta Personal Information Protection Act and the Quebec Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector.   
  
Clever is also a proud signatory of the [Student Data Privacy Pledge](https://studentprivacypledge.org/), the first recipient of the IMS TrustEd Apps Seal, and has received [CommonSense Privacy Program](https://privacy.commonsense.org/evaluation/Clever)’s highest possible rating, **Use Responsibly**, based on a full privacy evaluation.  
 

* * *

## Schools are in control of student personal information

Clever understands that Student Data is generally considered to be sensitive under Canadian privacy laws and that schools must retain control over that Student Data.   
  
With Clever, schools can see and control all data shared with their authorized partners in one Clever dashboard rather than having to access multiple systems. When a school uses Clever, it maintains complete control over what data to share and in what circumstances.   
  
Clever will delete Student Data and other school information from Clever’s systems upon request.  
 

* * *

## Clever lets schools maintain strong privacy settings by default

Clever only shares data with applications that have been explicitly authorized by the school.  
  
Student Data is private by design. Schools are able to minimize the amount of student information shared with third-party applications. Role-based access allows authorized school organization users to access only the features they need, without being able to modify important settings. And Clever proactively prevents end-user mistakes from leaking unauthorized data by placing automatic security holds on unusual data transfers.  
 

* * *

## Clever does not rent or sell data, permit advertising or profile students

Clever doesn't sell or monetize Student Data. Clever does not display advertising to students through Clever’s services. Clever does not profile students based on their behaviour. Clever doesn't allow behavioral tracking by any third-parties on Clever for the purpose of targeted advertising or to show ads on Clever.   
 

* * *

## Clever does not use biometrics 

Clever doesn't sell or monetize Student Data. Clever doesn't display advertising to students through Clever’s services. Clever doesn't profile students based on their behaviour. Clever doesn't allow behavioral tracking by any third parties on Clever for the purpose of targeted advertising or to show ads on Clever. 

* * *

## Clever has a comprehensive security program

Clever’s comprehensive security program is designed to secure Student Data from loss, unauthorized access, unauthorized use, unauthorized alternation and unauthorized disclosure. In accordance with Canadian legal obligations, Clever considers the sensitivity of the information in designing its security practices. Clever regularly aligns its security practices with the internationally recognized NIST Cybersecurity Framework. Clever’s Security Overview describes Clever’s approach to security. To dive deeper, please see the Clever Security Practices.  
  
As part of Clever’s security program, Clever evaluates its vendors and works with vendors that meet Clever’s standards. 

* * *

## Cross-border transfers of Student Data

Clever’s robust security practices allow Canadian schools to access and use Clever’s services hosted in the United States. Canadian laws do not prohibit the use of U.S.-based cloud services as long as the student personal information is protected in an equivalent manner as it would be in Canada. In Nova Scotia, schools may also need permission of the head of the school board as defined under the Nova Scotia Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act.  
  
Clever is also a proud signatory of the [Student Data Privacy Pledge](https://studentprivacypledge.org/), a member of the [Student Data Privacy Consortium](https://privacy.a4l.org/), the first recipient of the IMS TrustEd Apps Seal, and have received [CommonSense Privacy Program](https://privacy.commonsense.org/evaluation/Clever)’s highest possible rating, "Use Responsibly," based on a full privacy evaluation.  
 

* * *

## Privacy impact assessments

Clever doesn't have a one-size fits all privacy impact assessment because each school’s use of the Clever platform may vary depending on how the school configures the Clever platform services.   
  
However, Clever understands that public bodies in Canada and some private sector organizations are required to conduct privacy impact assessments or PIAs. Clever makes information publicly available on its privacy practices: Working with schools to safeguard data privacy. We are here to help if a school needs to conduct a PIA and Clever’s publicly available information does not provide all of the information the school needs.  
 

* * *

## Clever’s privacy team

Every member of the Clever team is responsible for ensuring that Clever meets its commitments with respect to Student Data. Clever’s privacy team can be contacted at: [trust@clever.com](mailto:trust@clever.com).  
  
For more information on privacy, see this page: [Working with schools to safeguard data privacy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy).

title: Clever IDM: Group Membership Management
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#overview)  
2\. [Prerequisites](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#setting_up)  
3\. [Configuration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#membership_rules)  
4\. [Automatic matching](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#matching)  
5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#faqs)

​

## Overview  
  

IMPORTANT  
If your school was connected to IDM before 8/4/26, refer to the [Legacy Group Membership Management section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#legacy) instead.

This article describes the group membership management functionality available in Clever IDM. This functionality is only available to Clever IDM subscribers who have configured Clever IDM with Active Directory or Google.  
  
Clever IDM can create, update, and archive users in your Active Directory or Google Workspace instances. In addition, Clever IDM can now manage these users’ memberships in groups – including both security and mailing (or distribution) groups.

* * *

## Prerequisites

​To set up group membership management, start by confirming that the groups you want managed are properly configured.

  
For Clever IDM to do _automatic_ management between your Clever user groups and IDM destination user groups, the names of the groups must be an exact match. Clever user groups can still be _manually_ assigned to manage any selected destination groups.

* * *

## Configuration

Legacy Group Membership Management

### **Prerequisites**

​In order to set up group membership management, you will need to start by confirming the groups you want managed are properly configured.  
  
All Clever-managed groups must have unique names.

Also, if you want to set up a rule to put users into different groups, the relevant group names must follow the same conventions. For example, if you want a rule set up that will add each user to a group for their school, the relevant groups need to be consistently named – e.g. “Toll Gate Elementary - Students”, “Hopewell Valley High School - Students.”

### **Configuration**

You can configure your group membership in your IDM setup under the Configure Groups step.  
  
First, select a user type you would like to manage groups for. You can manage groups for students, teachers, and/or staff.  
  
Note: You should only select groups that you want Clever IDM to add users to and remove them from. If a user is in a group but none of Clever IDM’s membership rules indicate they should be in that group, Clever IDM will remove the user from the group.

![Screenshot of the legacy Configure Groups step showing available groups to select](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ofPww)  
Once you’ve selected all the groups you’d like Clever IDM to manage for your selected user type, you can set up membership rules for those groups. Click **Add membership** rule and create a rule for your groups. In this example, the rule will place users in groups based on their graduation years.  
  

 **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Navigate to the [Clever IDM: Formulas Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555?language=en_US) to learn more about common formulas and operations that you can use to manipulate data in Clever to create formulas!

![Screenshot of a membership rule based on graduation year](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ofHBO)  
You can add as many rules as you would like for each user type. Once you have created rules, you can always go back and edit or delete them.  
![List of configured membership rules with edit and delete options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ofi0I)

Click **Review Summary** and run a sync preview to see any changes Clever IDM would make to users’ group memberships.

###   
  
**Active Directory: Nested Groups**

Active Directory allows for group nesting. This is the process of making one Active Directory group a member of another group. A nested group inherits all the permissions and privileges of each group it is a member of.

![Screenshot showing a parent group containing nested sub-groups](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ofWyQ)

In the example below, the group is **SamTest,** the sub-group is **Groups**, and the nested groups are **3-Group 4-Group, PreKindergarten-Group, etc.**

![Screenshot of nested groups including PreKindergarten-Group and grade-level groups](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oflJ7)  
  

### **Clever Groups**

Clever IDM can match Clever Groups to an existing group in your destination to automatically manage that group's membership. To get started, create your Clever Groups first, then match them to your destination groups in your IDM setup.

If you're already an IDM customer using formulas and want to switch to Clever Groups, reach out to Clever Support for help setting up the match.

To start this process, [create a Clever Group](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001755#header2) or [create multiple Clever Groups](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001755#header3). You will determine membership rules when creating Clever Groups.

### **IDM Configuration**

You can then configure your group membership in your IDM setup under the Configure Groups step. If the Clever user group name exactly matches the destination group name, you can use Auto-match. Learn how to use this [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#matching).

  
First, select all of the groups you would like Clever IDM to manage.  
  
Please note that you should only select groups that you want Clever IDM to add users to and remove them from. If a user is in a group but none of Clever IDM’s membership rules indicate they should be in that group, Clever IDM will remove the user from the group.  
  
![Image of the groups selected](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000obTXh)  
  
**Active Directory: Nested Groups**

Active Directory allows for group nesting. This is the process of making one Active Directory group a member of another group. A nested group inherits all the permissions and privileges of each group it is a member of.

In the example below, the group is **SamTest,** the sub-group is **Groups**, and the nested groups are **3-Group 4-Group, PreKindergarten-Group, etc.**

**![Screenshot of AD nested groups](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000006v0Cj)**

* * *

## Automatic matching

 **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** This feature is only available if you are using Clever user groups. If you connected your school to Clever IDM before 8/4/26, please refer to the [Legacy Group Membership Management section](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001517#legacy) instead.

To simplify matching your Clever user groups to your destination user groups, you can auto-match any groups where the name of the Clever user groups is an exact match for the name of the destination group.

Clicking Auto-match groups will match any current Clever user groups to their matching destination user groups. Auto-match does not perform continuous matching. If you create new destination groups, you can create Clever user groups with exactly matching names, then click Auto-match groups again to assign management for any newly selected destination groups.

![Image of auto-match feature](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTMf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000obU0j)

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Can membership rules place users in distribution/email groups and security groups?**

-   Yes! Clever IDM does not distinguish between security and distribution/email groups, so will add/remove users from any groups per the school organization’s membership rules.

**What happens when a user leaves my school organization?**

-   When a user leaves a school organization, Clever IDM will archive that user. If group membership management is enabled, Clever IDM will remove the user from all groups, including default AD groups. If the user returns, Clever IDM will unarchive them and place them back in the appropriate groups per the school organization’s membership rules.

**Will users’ group membership update automatically?**

-   Yes! Whenever Clever IDM syncs, it will re-evaluate all the membership rules for each user type and adjust users’ group memberships accordingly. For example, if a user moves schools and a school organization’s membership rules are school-based, Clever IDM will remove that user from their old school and add them to the new school group.

**Will Clever IDM create a new group if one doesn’t exist?**

-   No, Clever IDM will never create, edit, or delete existing groups. If Clever IDM evaluates a membership rule and the resulting group doesn’t exist, it will create an issue in the sync report. Once the relevant group is created in AD, the relevant users will be added to it, and the issue will be resolved.

**Why are some users not being added to groups?**

-   Clever IDM won't manage group membership for groups outside of your chosen OU. You may manually add users to groups outside of your OU, and Clever IDM will not remove a user from that group except when the users are archived.

**What will happen if a user has both a teacher and a staff account in Clever?**

-   Clever IDM will manage their groups based on the primary role selected during Clever IDM setup.

**Can I review any potential changes before enabling group management?**

-   Yes, after you set up your rules, Clever IDM will generate a preview. You'll review any changes to be made, and if satisfied, click **Provision**!

title: Clever IDM: Multi-destination support
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001516#overview)  
2\. [Adding additional destinations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001516#header1)  
3\. [Managing multiple active destinations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001516#header2)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001516#header3)

## Overview

Clever IDM allows you to manage accounts in on-premise Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google Workspace simultaneously.  
  

* * *

## Adding additional destinations

If you haven’t started setting Clever IDM up yet, please visit [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466?language=en_US). Once you have your first destination set up, you can add another destination by simply clicking the **Add new destination** button on your Clever IDM homepage:

  
![Clever IDM homepage](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Z6Ft)  
  
After adding an additional destination, you can start configuring it. For guidance on setting up the new destination, see [Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505), [Clever IDM: Entra ID Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553), or [Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467).

Of note, each destination will be set up independently, meaning that you can use the same credential and OU conventions or different ones – depending on the setup that works best for you.

* * *

## Managing multiple active destinations

Once Clever IDM is syncing with multiple destinations, you’ll see them each as cards on your Clever IDM homepage. The cards contain summary metrics from your most recent sync. To view more about a destination, click the card to see the relevant tasks, reports, and more.  
  
  
![Clever IDM destination cards](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Z6PZ)

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Can we manage different sets of users for each destination?**

-   Yes. Clever IDM allows you to configure each destination independently, so you can select whichever user types you’d like to be managed for each destination. If you’d like to filter down users by school or grade level for a given destination, reach out to Clever Support and we can help.

**Can we keep the passwords the same across multiple destinations?**

-   Clever IDM will set passwords based on your chosen convention whenever accounts are created. Clever IDM also supports random passwords across multiple destinations. Once one destination is configured, you’ll see the option to use that destination’s password in other destinations.
-   School organizations using Clever IDM can also enable [recovery and reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613) functionality for any connected destinations.  
      
    ![Screenshot of the password format setup for IDM](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eTXx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Z3Bb)  
      
    
-   Once accounts are created, passwords can be managed via Clever. See this article on how to do so: [For Clever Admins: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613#header3).

**Does it cost more to add multiple destinations?**

-   No! Clever IDM charges based on the total number of managed users, regardless of how many destinations we manage. The only case where adding another destination will increase the cost of Clever IDM is if you use the new destination to manage users that aren’t already being managed by the first destination you configured.

**Can I add two different destinations of the same type?**

-   We support multiple destinations of the same type, e.g., you can use Clever IDM to sync users to two or more Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google Workspace domains. If you’re interested in this feature, reach out to [implementation@clever.com](mailto:implementation@clever.com).

**I use Google Directory Sync (GDS) and Google Password Sync to keep my AD and Google in sync. Should I still keep that running if I set up IDM for both?**

-   Clever IDM will manage users and their placement in OUs in Google. If those are the only things you use Google Directory Sync to manage in Google Workspace, running it in tandem with Clever IDM is unnecessary.
-   If there are other elements, like Groups or Passwords, that you use Google Directory Sync to keep in sync between AD and Google, we recommend you continue to use GDS alongside Clever IDM. **Ensure you only use GDS to sync the data Clever IDM isn’t already managing.**

If you still need support or have additional questions, please reach out to [support.clever.com](https://support.clever.com/).

title: Sharing Permissions: Guided Sharing
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#header1)  
2\. [Guided Sharing](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#header2)  
          •   [Choose setup method](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#setup_method)  
          •   [Choose who needs access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#user_access)  
          •   [Preview & share user data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#preview)  
          •   [Data validation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#data_validation)  
          •   [Finalize setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001514#finalize_setup)

## Overview

As part of the process of adding an application, Clever Admins can configure sharing permissions in order to determine what school organization data should be shared with the app, and which users should have access to the application from their Clever Portal.   
  
Clever offers two experiences for sharing data: **Guided Sharing** and [**Standard Sharing**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007).

-   **Guided Sharing** is best for new users or those who don't set up sharing settings often.
-   **Standard sharing** is best for experienced Clever users or those who need to use [School Site Sharing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001972366).

  
The choice in experience is custom to each user. A new admin at your school organization can choose to use Guided Sharing while an admin with more Clever experience may choose Standard Sharing.  
  
Users can choose to switch between these two experiences at any time by selecting **Edit Sharing** for an application, and selecting **Switch Sharing setup view** in the top-right. Your choice in sharing experience will be remembered and used anytime you edit sharing permissions for an app.  
 

![Guided Sharing with Switch Sharing setup view highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLB3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amsB)

  
 

* * *

##   
Guided Sharing

### **Step 1: Choose sharing method**

You have options for how to share data, however, you can only choose to share based on one of the criteria below.

-   **Share specific sections, teachers, students, and/or staff:** Clever will only share data that meets the specific criteria you've set. This is the most recommended sharing type as it provides school organizations with the flexibility in determining specifically what data should be included, or excluded, in the sharing. [Read this article to learn more about this sharing option](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115000392247).  
      
    

    **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLB3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000HMiFA)    Clever tip:** Need help with structuring a rule to Share by specific sections, teachers, students, and/or staff? Check out our tutorial videos for Guided sharing to help create rules to share by share by [section](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/rq3ugv6qh3), share by [teacher,](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/0s33d1uq3g) share by [student](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/hpe61jdhyc), and share by [staff](https://clever-for-schools.wistia.com/medias/pwbjs3rpiy).

-   **Share everyone in specific schools:** Clever will only share any data associated with the schools you've selected (e.g. students, teachers, sections, staff). 

-   **Share everyone in the district:** All school organization data in Clever will be synced to the application. This includes Clever admins, schools, teachers, students, staff and sections. 

-   **Use an application’s suggested data sharing template:** Some applications have set general recommendations for how to share data. You can view the recommendation and see if it’s a good fit for you.

-   **Use an application’s customized data sharing template:** In addition to general recommendations, sometimes an application team member will create a custom recommendation for your school organization. You can view the recommendation and see if it’s a good fit for you.

-   **Copy another app’s data sharing rules:** If you’ve already set up sharing with another application and want to apply the same settings to this application, you can select this option. [Read this article to learn more about copying sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001509)!

  
The data shared with the application will dynamically update based on the sharing permissions configured. As a new record meets the sharing criteria, please allow up to 24 hours for the record to be created in the application.  
 

* * *

###   
**Step 2: Choose who needs access**

In Step 2, you will select which users to share with an application using the selected sharing method.   
  
For additional information on using the various sharing methods, please see these articles: 

-   [Specific sections, teachers, students, and/or staff](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247)
-   [Use an application’s customized data sharing template for your school organization](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045770232)
-   [Copy another app's data sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001509)

During this step, you can configure sharing rules and filters as many times as you’d like. Data will not be changed in your learning applications until you click **Save** at the end of the Guided Sharing experience. In the next step you’ll be able to preview the data that will be shared.

If you have a lot of rules, use the **Jump to end/Jump to start** button to scroll to the bottom/top of your rules. 

![Jump to end](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dLB3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000JGNDs)

Once you’re ready to preview that data that will be shared based on your rules, click **Next.**  
 

* * *

###   
**Step 3: Preview & share user data**

In Step 3 you can preview the records that will be shared by your data sharing settings. Clever provides both the total number of shared records as well as a table of the individual records that will be shared with the application.   
  
After you have reviewed the shared records for accuracy, click **Share with application.** The data is now successfully shared with the application!   
 

* * *

###   
**Step 4: Data validation**

Many applications set data errors and warnings to flag potential data issues that will affect students and teachers. If any data errors or warnings are triggered, they will display on this page. For more information on data errors and warnings, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083). This step may or may not appear depending on the application's settings.  
  
When ready to proceed, click **Next**.  
 

* * *

###   
**Step 5: Finalize Setup**

Some applications will provide additional instructions for finalizing setup for their application. If any final instructions have been provided, they will be surfaced here. If this is your first time setting up sharing for the application you may also see a Launch Date. This is the date when the application will be available to users in the Clever Portal. If you need to adjust this date, please contact the application's support team directly.  
  
Once you read the setup information and complete any required steps, click **Finish.**

If you haven’t chosen a category for the application in your Clever Portal (it’s in the More Apps section) you’ll receive a prompt to add the application to a category. Choose a category from the dropdown if you’d like.

* * *

title: Clever IDM: Summer Rollover
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513#overview)  
2. [Default behavior](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513#header1)  
3. [Pausing Clever IDM syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513#pause)  
4\. [Options for syncing during the summer](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513#header2)  
5\. [Back to school](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513#header3)  
6\. [Preserving access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001513#header4)

## Overview

Clever IDM is built to work seamlessly with your existing summer rollover practices, from preparing for summer school to getting ready for back to school to preserving access for graduated students. This article is your guide for what to expect and the tools and processes you can use to customize Clever IDM – and Clever, more broadly – to fit your needs.  
 

* * *

## Default Behavior

Clever syncs are set to pause at the end of the school year and unpause just before the back to school season. See [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507) for more on sync pauses and when default sync pause dates are set for this year. When your sync is paused, data in Clever won’t be automatically updated.  
  
By default, Clever IDM’s nightly syncs will continue to run. Since there are no automatic data updates happening in Clever, these syncs usually have no impact. There are two exceptions:

1.  [Custom data](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360035757332?language=en_US). If your school organization modifies custom data in Clever during your sync pause, Clever IDM will sync newly created or modified custom data users to your identity provider.
2.  Manual changes in a destination. If someone in your school organization manually updates users in Google or Active Directory, Clever IDM may revert those changes on its next sync – if they conflict with Clever data. For example, if you move a Clever-managed user to a new OU in Google, Clever IDM will move that user back to its original OU during the next sync. This is only true for users that Clever IDM actively manages; users not managed by Clever IDM won't be affected by any changes made in Clever.

* * *

## Pausing Clever IDM syncs

If you'd like Clever IDM’s nightly syncs to pause during this time, please use the “Pause <destination> Syncs” button, found on the IDM dashboard.   
  
If you have multiple IDM destinations (e.g., Google and Entra ID, or Entra ID AND Active Directory), you must pause both of them, as pausing only applies to the currently selected destination. You can resume Clever IDM syncs at any time.
