[Learn more about pausing IDM syncs here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001532).  
 

* * *

## Options for syncing during the summer

Some school organizations may want Clever IDM to automatically create and manage user accounts over the summer. The easiest way to manage this is to use custom data. Our [Summer School: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360042615332?language=en_US) article includes a comprehensive guide for how to manage summer school data in Clever. Any users added via custom data will be automatically synced through Clever IDM’s nightly syncs.  
  
If custom data isn’t a good option for your school organization you can consider delaying your sync pause so that summer school data is updated in Clever before your pause starts.  
  
In some cases, it may make sense not to pause your Clever sync at all. For example, if you’d like to continue syncing staff and teachers to Clever – so they have their accounts created – but don’t want to use custom data. School orgs using an SFTP sync can achieve this by continuing to sync the teachers.csv and staff.csv, but temporarily pausing the syncing of all other files. We recommend discussing this option with the Clever team so you understand the implications.  
  
Lastly, as need be, you can manually provision users in Google, Entra ID, or Active Directory while your sync is paused. When your sync resumes, Clever IDM will match the newly created users and begin to manage them.

* * *

## Back to school

Once your sync is unpaused for the coming school year, new data will begin flowing into Clever, and old data will be removed. Once the data for the upcoming year is successfully synced, Clever IDM will update data in Google, Entra ID, and/or Active Directory accordingly.  
  
Here are the most common changes you can expect from Clever IDM:

-   Creating new users who’ve joined your schools for the new school year. This includes the newest class of students, any students who’ve transferred from other school organizations, as well as any teachers or staff who have joined.
-   Updating existing users. The most common updates are OU changes. If your school organization's OU structure involves schools or grade levels, you should expect Clever IDM to move students to their new OUs and sub-OUs.
-   Archiving removed users. Any users who've been removed from your Clever sync during your pause will be archived by Clever IDM. That includes graduated or promoted students as well as any students, teachers, and staff who have left your schools for other reasons.

If you’re using the graduation year field in Clever IDM and aren’t syncing graduation year values directly to Clever from your SIS, you’ll also see the following prompt in Clever IDM when you unpause:  
  
![Screenshot of example of graduation year issue](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZM0r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000007RBwD)   
  
Clever IDM calculates the graduation year based on the student’s synced grade level if you are not already sending graduation year data via your SIS. This prompt ensures that this calculation associates your data with the correct school year. Data synced before the graduation rollover date will be associated with the previous school year for graduation year calculations. Data synced after the graduation rollover date will be associated with the upcoming school year for graduation year calculations. Providing a graduation rollover date enables Clever IDM to automatically update any information based on the graduation year (OUs, groups, etc.) as grade levels change during rollover. If your expected graduation rollover date changes, you can edit the graduation rollover date anytime by navigating to the **Select Users** step in Clever IDM. Once you confirm that the graduation rollover date is correct, Clever IDM will continue syncing with the correct graduation years.

* * *

## Preserving access 

By default, Clever IDM will archive graduated students as soon as they’re removed from Clever. In most cases, graduated students remain in Clever until a school organization's sync is unpaused. That means, they’ll retain access to Google, Entra ID, and/or Active Directory during that period. Once the sync resumes, these users will then lose access.  
  
If you’d like graduated users to retain access beyond your unpause date, you can:

1.  Set Clever IDM to not suspend or deactivate users in ignored OU in the OUs setup step (see below), and
2.  Move those graduated students to an ignored OU. Once in an ignored OUs, these users will retain access until you move them out of an ignored OU or manually deactivate them.

  
If you’d like graduated users not to retain access beyond your unpause date, you can either remove them from your Clever sync before you pause, or move them to an ignored OU in Google or Active Directory and manually deactivate them there.  
   
![IDM suspension screen with No option selected](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ZM0r&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003x3WP)   
   
If you have any questions about summer rollover with Clever IDM that haven’t been answered here, please reach out to Support.Clever.com.

* * *

  
**Related articles:**   
[Clever IDM: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466)  
[Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505?language=en_US)  
[Clever IDM: Purchasing & Billing](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001472)  
[Clever IDM: Sync Reports](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001473)  
[Clever IDM: Pausing Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001532)

title: For Clever Admins: Field mappings and customizing your data sync
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001512#header1)  
2\. [Viewing field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001512#VIEWING)  
3\. [Editing field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001512#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001512#FAQ)

## Overview

Sync field mappings refer to the relationship between fields from a student information system (SIS) and fields in Clever. A field mapping is when you specify the field in your SIS that you want to map to a specific data value in Clever. For example, Clever accepts student\_email as a data value. Depending on the field (e.g., emailaddress.emailaddress, SchoolEmail, etc.)  in which you store emails in your SIS, you may want to map a specific field to the student\_email field.

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For **SFTP syncs**, Clever has an SFTP web upload feature with field mapping! Find out more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001608).

* * *

##   
Viewing field mappings

To view sync mappings, navigate to [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings). This page shows the relationship between each Clever Field & SIS Field.

###   
**Clever Field ¹**

Clever Field refers to the data field in Clever where the SIS data is being stored.

###   
**SIS Field ²**

SIS Field refers to the name of the field in the SIS where the data is being pulled from. In the below screenshot, we can see that for students, School\_id is being synced from HomeSchoolId³. If the SIS Field is followed by **(custom mapping)**⁴, it means the mapping was added custom for your account. If the SIS field is blank⁵, Clever is not pulling any information from the SIS for the corresponding Clever Field.

###   
**Actions ⁶**

**Edit⁷** indicates that Clever Admins may customize which SIS field to sync to the corresponding Clever Field. If the value you are looking for is unavailable from the dropdown, please contact Clever Support with the exact name of the SIS field you want to map, and our team will investigate whether the mapping is supported. If the **Action** field is blank⁸, the SIS Field either is not customizable or requires a Clever Support team member to customize the field for your account. Contact Clever Support to learn about your available options.

###   
**Record Types ⁹**

Use the view record type selectors to view the mappings for each record type. If you require a field mapping for a record type not listed, please contact Clever Support to learn about your options.  
  
  
![Clever Field Mappings page with sections highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TSW4)

* * *

## Editing field mappings

Depending on your sync type, you may be able to customize which field in your SIS correlates to which field in Clever through a field mapping. If you utilize an SFTP sync, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001608) for more information on field mapping.

If you utilize a Clever-managed auto sync, you may be able to complete basic field mappings yourself via your Clever Dashboard, or you can reach out to Clever Support, and our team can assist with more complex field mappings.

For the following auto-syncs, some custom fields can be added and customized via your Clever Dashboard for self-service field mapping:

-   Illuminate Auto Sync
    
-   [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)
    
-   [SchoolInsight Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237)
    
-   [Skyward LMS API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    

For the following syncs, custom fields can be added and customized by reaching out to Clever support:

-   [Aeries Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016)
    
-   [Blackbaud API sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544)
    
-   [Infinite Campus API sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767)
    
-   [Skyward Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193) 
    
-   [Skyward OneRoster (Qmlativ) API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    

If you utilize one of the syncs above that supports self-service mappings and want to determine if you can edit a field mapping yourself, navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page, locate the Sync Mappings box, and click on the [View field mappings button](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings).

![View field mappings button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000H5Tqn)

If you see an **Edit** button in the actions column, you can customize the field mapping for a specific data type (schools, teachers, students, sections, enrollments).

Click on **Edit** to view a dropdown of available SIS Fields to map from.

![Edit field mappings dropdown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000H5MJ4)

If you do not see the SIS field you wish to map from in the dropdown, please contact Clever Support to see if the field is available for mapping by our team.

If the field is available, please select it and then click **Update**. This will save the field mapping, and the data will be pulled from the new field the next time your sync runs. You can push a manual sync following [these instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004747027).

Depending on the percentage of changes, this may cause a [sync hold](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358). Please review the hold carefully via your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page[](https://schools.clever.com/sync). If the changes are intended, you can approve them and the new data will sync to Clever.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Which sync types support self-service mappings?**

-   Illuminate Auto Sync
    
-   [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)
    
-   [SchoolInsight Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237)
    
-   [Skyward LMS API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    

**What if I do not see an edit button on the Field Mappings page?**

-   You cannot complete a self-service field mapping for this field. Please contact Clever Support for additional information.
    

**What if I do not see the SIS field I want to map from?**

-   Please contact Clever Support for additional information.
    

**What if I accidentally chose the wrong field for my mapping?**

-   If your sync is on hold, discard the hold, then navigate back to your [field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page and edit the mapping.
    
-   If your sync is not on hold or you already approved the hold, navigate to your [field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page and edit the mapping. If more than 24 hours have passed since you completed the mapping, you may want to notify users or application partners that there may have been accidental data changes.

title: Clever Professional Development & Training
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001511#header1)  
2\. [Training options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001511#header2)  
3\. [Clever Professional Development offerings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001511#header3)

## Overview

The world of digital learning is changing. With 8 in 10 teachers using more technology now than before the pandemic, it’s growing more complex for district IT administrators to manage technology and train teachers.   
  
As a partner in helping you simplify digital learning, we’re also here to help you simplify teacher and school tech lead training. We offer incredible free training options as well as customized Professional Development for school districts to ensure that your users are set up for success.   
 

* * *

## Training options

### Clever Academy

Clever Academy is our free online training and certification program for educators. You can access it through your Clever Portal or at [clever.academy](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin) . Go through all the courses and after successful completion, you’ll become a certified Clever Champion.

### District-led Training

Lead your own training with help from our free [Clever Trainers program](https://clever.academy/clever-trainers).

### Clever Professional Development

Let Clever take the work off your plate by delivering customized training tailored to your school district’s needs! Clever offers in-depth, 90-minute trainings for teachers and school tech leads. Learn more about the offering and pricing [here](https://schools.clever.com/applications/browse/clever-training).   
  

* * *

## Clever Professional Development offerings

Customizable virtual teacher and school tech lead training for districts that desire training beyond Clever Academy and the Clever Trainers program. 

### Trainings are: 

**Created by and for educators:** Our trainings are developed by former teachers. Trainings are designed with best practices straight from the field to support every learner's development.   
  
**Tap the technical experts:** Learn from former Clever support specialists that have worked to solve technical issues for thousands of districts, teachers, and tech coaches.  
  
**Certified professional development:** Trainees receive certificate of completion, which your district can count towards professional development time.

### Trainings include:

-   Live, interactive virtual training (90 minutes)
-   Customized to meet your district’s needs 
-   Live Q&A and Troubleshooting support 
-   Follow-up emails with additional tips 
-   Access to Clever Resource Hub 
-   Certificates of completion 
-   Access to online recording (30 days) 

### How to learn more about Clever-led Training

Please use [this link](https://schools.clever.com/applications/browse/clever-training) to learn how we can set your school district up for success through Clever Professional Development. We can work together to customize your training sessions to best meet your district’s needs!

title: Setting up Single Sign-On (SSO) for HMH
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510#header1) 2\. [HMH SAML Applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510#header2) 3\. [Setup Instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510#header3) 4\. [Common Troubleshooting Help](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510#header4) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** We are in the process of updating this article, and some information may be out-of-date. We apologize for any inconvenience and are working to resolve this as quickly as possible.  ## Overview Clever has multiple different [application types](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002370127?language=en_US) which determine how you should set up your applications. This article describes how to set up various different HMH SAML applications. * * * ## HMH SAML Applications The following directions are for configuring Single Sign-On (SSO) for these HMH products:   - [HMH ThinkCentral](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-thinkcentral-okta) - [HMH MyHRW](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-myhrw-okta)   - [HMH Ed Learning Platform](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-ed-your-friend-in-learning-okta)   - [HMH SAML](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-hmh-sam-okta) - [Heinemann Flight SSO](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/saml-hnm-flight)   These are the directions that should be used if your HMH application displays the status: **Incomplete SAML Setup** ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004yDfy) **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  These steps will need to be followed for each of your HMH applications. If you're looking to set up rostering for these products, you'll also need to [follow the directions here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001525). * * * ## Setup 1\. In the Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add). Search for the desired application and select **Request application**. It is optional to set your sharing at this point. ![MyHRW app request page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004amp7) 2. On the application’s page, click **Settings**. Under **SAML Details**, copy the **Metadata URL.**   ![HMH app page, with metadata section highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ampC) 3. In a new browser tab, log in to your HMH Admin account. From the left-hand navigation, select Roster. Under **Roster** information, click on **Roster Actions** and select **Manage SSO Configuration.** ![Manage SSO Configuration in HMH](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000007jYcb) 4\. Click **Add SAML.** ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZHyo) 5. Paste the **Metadata URL** from Step 2 and give the SSO Configuration a name (e.g. “Clever”). Click **Add** and wait for HMH to complete the setup (~10 seconds). ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Zbnm) 6\. Copy the SSO endpoint for the application you are setting up in Clever.

Clever App

HMH SSO Endpoint

 HMH ThinkCentralThinkCentral (grades PK-8) SSO Endpoint 
 HMH myHRWHolt McDoughal Online (Grades 6-12) SSO Endpoint 
HMH Ed Learning Platform HMH Ed SSO Endpoint 
 HMH SAMStudent Achievement Manager (SAM) 
Heinemann Flight Flight 
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Zbo6) 7. Return to the browser tab containing the Clever Dashboard. On the application’s settings  tab, find the section titled **SAML Details** and select **Edit**. ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZboG) 8. Paste the SSO endpoint from [Step 6](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510#step6) into the textbox titled **SSO Endpoint** ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZHus)  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008SimH)  Please note:** For Heinemann Flight, the textbox for the SSO Endpoint is titled "Login URL." For this application, please put the SSO Endpoint from [Step 6](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510#step6) in the Login URL box: ![Heinemann Flight SSO app login URL screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008SjVR)  9\. Return to the **HMH Admin dashboard**. Copy the **HMH Metadata URL** and enter it in your SAML app settings. Click **Parse Metadata,** which will automatically populate the Asset URL and Encryption Certificate, and then **Confirm.** ![step 9.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Q3bq) 10\. Your SAML connection is pre-configured with a set of default attributes that should work for most SSO configurations with HMH. If necessary, you can change the mappings here at any time. Otherwise, click **Confirm.**    ![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVQD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005Q3bv) 11.  If you have not already, set your sharing permissions and verify the configuration with a test user! If you need to configure any other HMH apps, you can do so by copying the relevant SSO Endpoint from HMH, and re-using the same HMH Metadata URL from the Clever app you just configured. * * * ## Common Troubleshooting Tips Below are some common pitfalls in setting up HMH SAML Connections through Clever. Please use these if you are running into issues: - **Incorrect SAML configuration** - If a user sees a Clever login error screen after launching an HMH SAML application the application is most likely set up with the SAML information for another Clever application (possibly one the school had been connected to previously). The resolution for this issue is to delete the SAML connection in the HMH admin dashboard and create a new one with the metadata link from the application.  - **Encryption Certificate Issues** - Sometimes, the Encryption Certificate is pasted into the SAML Details with extra spaces. This will lead to an “Unknown error occurred” message for the user. To resolve this issue, check for any spaces in the Encryption Certificate field (a valid certificate will not have any spaces).

title: For Clever Admins: Copying Sharing Rules
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001509#header1)  
2\. [How do I copy sharing settings from another application?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001509#header2)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001509#header3)

## Overview

By configuring sharing permissions for applications, school organization admins can determine what data will be shared with each school organization app, and which school organization users will be able to access the application from their individual Clever portals.  
If you’ve already set up sharing for an application and need to use the same sharing settings for another application, you can copy the settings over to simplify your setup process.  
  
When you use copy sharing, Clever will take the sharing settings from the source application and apply them to the new application. This is a one-time copy that allows you to then update each application’s sharing settings independently.

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** For an overview of application sharing permissions, please visit: [Sharing Permissions: Sharing data with new applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360043482712).  

* * *

## How do I copy sharing settings from another application?

When selecting a sharing type, choose the “Copy Sharing” option.  
  
![Screenshot of an app's Sharing settings highlighting Copy Sharing.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSph&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZS0u)     
   
   
Next, choose which existing application’s sharing settings you’d like to copy.  
   
![Screenshot of Copy Sharing settings choosing an existing application's sharing rules.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cSph&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZS1J)    
  
   
Once you’ve selected a source application, you’ll see a preview of the sharing settings that will be applied. If the settings are correct, click “Apply settings.”  
  
By configuring [sharing permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for applications, school organization admins can determine what data will be shared with each school organization app, and which school organization users will be able to access the application from their individual Clever portals.  
   
When sharing by rules, Clever will only share data that meets the specific criteria you've set. This is the most recommended sharing type as it provides school organizations with the flexibility in determining specifically what data should be included, or excluded, in the sharing.   
   
Additionally, applications are dynamically updated as new data is synced to Clever from your school organization's student information system (SIS). The data shared with the application via sharing rules evolves based on the new data in Clever.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

  
If I copy sharing settings, then change the sharing settings for the source application, will the updated sharing settings be applied to the second application?

-   Since this is a one-time copy, you’d need to update the sharing settings for the second application separately.

title: Clever IDs
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001507#overview) 2\. [Changing Clever IDs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001507#change) 3\. [Clever ID Retention Policy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001507#policy) **Clever ID** refers to the globally unique identifier that is assigned to a record in Clever. This value is important as it ensures that every student, teacher, section, etc. on Clever has a unique ID across all active schools on Clever. Since it is globally unique, most application partners use the Clever ID as the primary identifier for a record when pulling data from Clever.  Clever IDs are an alpha-numeric string that is generated by Clever and can be viewed on the profile page for a record.  Clever IDs are directly connected to the following primary ids provided by the district to Clever. For more information on Clever's field specifications, please see this [document](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf).  

Record Type

Primary ID Field

SchoolSchool_id
StaffStaff_id
TeacherTeacher_id
StudentStudent_id
SectionSection_id
  * * * ## Changing Clever IDs Changes in Clever IDs are the result of the primary id field for the record being changed. If the primary id field is changed for a record, a new Clever ID will be provisioned. For example:  **IF              Student A** is uploaded from the SIS to Clever with **Student\_id: 1234**. **THEN**              A new student record with **Student\_id: 1234 / Clever ID: 53446ae050bb279fb03d2a3e** is created. **IF**              **Student A** is updated in the SIS and uploaded from the SIS to Clever with **Student\_id: 5678**. **THEN**              Student record with **Student\_id: 1234 / Clever ID: 53446ae050bb279fb03d2a3e** is deleted.                        A new student record with **Student\_id: 5678 / Clever ID: 54d263946cc968010000007a** is created.   * * * ## Clever ID Retention Policy Clever retains the relationship between a primary id and Clever ID for 300 days. For example, if a student is deleted from Clever and added back within 300 days, the student will be assigned the same Clever ID. If a student is deleted from Clever and added back after 300 days, the student will be assigned a NEW Clever ID.  Since applications build off the Clever ID, students that are added back within 300 days will be restored with their historical data (progress, scores, etc.) Students that are added back after 300 days will have a new account provisioned in the application and will have no historical data.  If your district has a student population that regularly cycles between enrollment and withdrawal, Clever can extend this 300-day window to one that will preserve Clever IDs for longer. (i.e. 730 days). If interested in extending your Clever ID retention policy, please submit a support request at support.clever.com.

title: Clever + Benchmark Education Company Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following information to help your district get set up with Clever and Benchmark:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001506#Overview)  
2. [Benchmark Education requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001506#Requirements)  
3\. [Adding Benchmark Education](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001506#Adding)  
4. [Setting up your Benchmark Education sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001506#Sharing)  
5\. [Sharing staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001506#Staff)  
6\. [Next steps](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001506#Steps)

## Overview

Benchmark’s award-winning print and digital solutions feature content-rich leveled texts in English and Spanish; explicit instruction in close reading and analysis, genre, and cross-text study; and a wide array of differentiated resources that enable educators to target literacy intervention. Since Clever and Benchmark began their partnership in 2013, it’s easier than ever for students and teachers to access their learning resources.  
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:** If you’re interested in learning more about Clever, such as using our SSO Portal and connecting other applications through our dashboard, you can learn a lot more here in our Help Center or by visiting [Clever Academy.](https://clever.academy/?user_type=district_admin)

IMPORTANT: Please read before proceeding with the setup process.

  
Communication: Setting up a Clever integration requires a conversation with Benchmark Education Company. After requesting Benchmark through Clever, please make sure to email or schedule a call with Benchmark with any questions.  
  
Switching rostering methods: If you’re moving to Clever from self-registered accounts, please be ready to work with Benchmark on a user clean-up process. The Benchmark team can work with you to map accounts and avoid losing historical data. Please contact the Benchmark team before making any changes.  
  
Data readiness: Your district should be sharing with Benchmark only the subjects and grade levels specified below in the “Benchmark Education requirements - overview” section. **Please be sure to only share schools and users with Benchmark subscriptions.**   
 

## Benchmark Education requirements - overview

Here are the requirements and recommendations for sharing data with Benchmark. Please note: school site must be shared!

-   Subjects:
    -   Please only share the relevant sections from any of the following subjects with Benchmark Education:
        -   English/Language Arts
        -   Language
        -   Homeroom/Advisory
        -   Social Studies
        -   Other
    -   Please exclude the following subjects:
        -   PE and Health
        -   Art and Music
        -   Math
        -   Science
        -   Technology and Engineering
-   Grades:
    -   Typical grades using Benchmark Education are K-5 but it can be used across preK-12. Please check in with your curriculum purchaser to determine who should have access.
-   Student data must include the following:
    -   Grade level
    -   Username (highly recommended)
-   Teachers:
    -   Email address (recommended)
-   Sections:
    -   Should have unique names to avoid confusion
-   Staff/Admins:
    -   Unique email address 
    -   A user cannot be shared as both a teacher and a staff member - one role only can be shared  
         

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For an overview of sharing rules, please visit: [Sharing Permissions: Share by Rules](https://support.clever.com/hc/articles/115000392247-Sharing-Permissions-Share-by-Rules). If you still need help setting up your sharing rules after reading this article, please contact Clever’s support team by clicking the message icon in the lower right corner of the page. Be sure to include “Benchmark Education Sharing Rule” in the subject line of your email.

##    
  
Adding Benchmark Education

To add Benchmark Education to your Clever Dashboard, please search for it under [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/benchmarkuniverse).  
 

## Setting up your Benchmark Education sharing rules

Using sharing rules, you can customize precisely the data you want shared with Benchmark Education.  
 

IMPORTANT: Please remember to ONLY share schools and users with Benchmark subscriptions.

Example: All elementary ELA/homeroom sections and middle school ELA and Spanish sections.

  
English/Language Arts and Language classes (as subscribed) should be shared with Benchmark Education. However, you may need to include other subjects to cover your entire student body. For example, elementary school students may only be enrolled in one section where all instruction occurs, and that section may have the subject listed as “Homeroom/Advisory” or “Other.”  
 

  **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**How do I know how subjects synced to Clever? Check the “Sections” tab of the Data Browser (schools.clever.com/browser). “Subject” is one of the columns listed.

   
Step 1: If you’ve never set up the sharing rules before, you will be able to customize them from the setup guide (pictured). Alternatively, click **Edit sharing** from the [Benchmark Education overview page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/benchmarkuniverse) to edit rules you’ve previously set up.  
  
![Sharing rules screen with](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Yyl8)  
  
Step 2: You will likely need to set up multiple rules. We recommend **Share by Section**  
  
  
Step 3: Set up your filters to include only the data you want to share.   
  
For example, if your elementary school students are only enrolled in one section where all instruction occurs, and that section has “Homeroom/Advisory” listed as the subject, you can include filters for the school, grades, and subject.  
  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004ZLm8)  
  
Click **Done editing** once you are finished adding filters.

Step 4 (optional): Add additional rules to capture different users.  
  
For example, your middle school or junior high students may be enrolled in sections where the subject is listed as “English/Language Arts” and “Language.” You can create another rule to broaden your sharing to include elementary students where the section’s subject equals Homeroom/Advisory OR middle school students where the section’s subject equals English/Language Arts or Language.  
  
From here, you can again set up a rule with filters to include the new group of users. After creating each rule, select **Done editing** to add an additional rule or **Save** your changes.  
  
Step 5: Once you’ve captured the appropriate users, click **Save Sharing Rules**.  
  
  
 

## Sharing staff

If you have non-instructional staff (users listed in the “Staff” tab in your [Data Browser](https://schools.clever.com/browser)) who also need access to Benchmark Education, they will not be included in a sections sharing rule. You will need to set up an additional rule to capture these users.

1.  Click **Edit Sharing Rules**
2.  Click **Add Another Rule**
3.  Click **Custom Share Staff**

We recommend taking a look at your list of staff to determine who will need access rather than sharing all staff. Once you have the list of staff members ready, you can share them by an identifier such as email, ID, or title.  
  
As always, don’t forget to click **Done editing** and **Save Sharing Rules** before leaving the page!  
 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Clever Admins are shared by default with all connected learning applications. Staff, Teachers, and Students must be explicitly shared with each application in order for data to be shared for each account type.

  
   

## Next steps

Data errors or warnings will show up here on your Clever Dashboard.  
  
![Benchmark Education Company app with Fix data warnings highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrJ7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004YymV)

This most likely means that one of the fields required by Benchmark Education is missing (for example, student grade). This will need to be resolved in your SIS data or CSV uploads to Clever.  
  
If you need to change your sharing rules in the future, you can always do so by clicking “Sharing by rules” on the [My Applications page](https://schools.clever.com/applications) or “Edit sharing” on the [Benchmark Education overview page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/benchmarkuniverse).

title: Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001505#overview)  
2. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001505#setup)
