title: SFTP Syncs: Viewing Clever CSV files
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001499#Overview)  
2\. [Downloading SIS files from your Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001499#Downloading)   
2\. [Downloading SIS files using an FTP client](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001499#Accessing%20your%20Clever%20SFTP%20directory)

## Overview

This article is for school organizations that use an SFTP sync or SIS-Managed Auto Sync who want to view the CSV files being exported from their student information system (SIS) to Clever. Your sync type can be found at the top of the [Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in the Clever Dashboard.   
  
There are two ways to view the data:

-   [Downloading the files via the Last Attempted Sync page of your Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001499#Downloading)
-   [Using an FTP client (like Filezilla, shown below).](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001499#Accessing%20your%20Clever%20SFTP%20directory)

* * *

## Downloading SIS files from your Clever Dashboard

Head to your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page. On the right side of the table, you'll see a **Download SIS File** column. Click the download icon for any file(s) you'd like. After clicking the download button, a download link for the file(s) will be emailed to the address connected to your Clever account. Clicking the **Sections** download icon will email a link for both the sections.csv and enrollments.csv files.

Please note, for security purposes, you will need to be logged into the Clever Dashboard to use the download link.  
  
![Last Attempted Sync page with arrow pointing at download button to download SIS files](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKlF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000062msk)  
 

* * *

## Downloading SIS files using an FTP client

Open the FTP client (like [Filezilla](https://filezilla-project.org/), which is what this example uses) and enter the directory details found on your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page. Click **Quickconnect.**  
  
![Example of SFTP settings in your Clever Dashboard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKlF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Y0iG)   
_Clever **Sync > Settings** page_  
  
![FTP client example of inputting remote site credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKlF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Y0iL)   
_Filezilla application_  
 

Once you're connected, you'll see the CSV files in your Clever SFTP directory on the right side (labeled Remote site).   
  
On the left side (labeled Local site), select where you'd like to download the files. We recommend your Desktop or Downloads folder for easy access.  
  
Once selected, right-click on the files you would like to download and click **Download**. The files will immediately download to the local site selected. The files are now available for you to review on your computer!

For a clickable tutorial on accessing your remote site via an FTP Client, [click here](https://ior.ad/a88l).  
  
![Example SFTP directory in Filezilla](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dKlF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000004Y0if)   
 

* * *

#### **Related Articles:**

-   [SFTP Syncs: How do I format my CSV files?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203114867?language=en_US)
-   [SFTP Syncs: Troubleshooting CSV formatting errors](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218518698?language=en_US)
-   [SFTP Syncs: Uploading data to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494408?language=en_US)

title: For Clever Admins: Renew with Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header1)  
2\. [Who should answer this question?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header2)  
3\. [Why does Clever ask if we're renewing?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header3)  
4\. [What does it mean if I say yes to using Clever?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header4)  
5\. [What if I only plan to use Clever for some schools in my school organization?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header5)  
6\. [What happens when I select applications I want to connect with for the upcoming year?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header8)  
7\. [When should I answer?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header6)  
8\. [Paid renewals](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001497#header7) 

## Overview

For the past few years, we’ve asked schools whether they plan to use Clever Portal with a simple question at the top of their Clever Dashboard. This year, you’ll find the question located in your tasks on the right side of your dashboard!

![A screenshot of the task to renew with Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aDmj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cUzwE)    

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aDmj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cVCdJ)

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aDmj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000hCSNz)

This article describes why we ask this question, who can answer it, and what will happen when you select your answer.  
 

* * *

## Who should answer this question?

Only users assigned to the role “Clever Admin” can answer this question. No other users (curriculum leads, help desk, and School Tech Leads) can answer at this time. Whether you are a Clever Admin or not, if you don’t think you’re the right person to answer this question, please start the conversation with your team and let us know so that we can best support you this year.  
 

* * *

## Why does Clever ask if we're renewing?

Our goal is to better understand how our school organizations plan to use Clever. When we understand who will use it, we can provide: 

-   New teacher training resources
-   Support connecting with applications that you want to roster on Clever

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000aDmj&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000G759r)   Please note:** You cannot renew your Clever IDM or Classroom MFA subscription via this form. If you would like to renew your subscription, please visit [schools.clever.com/orders](https://schools.clever.com/orders). 

* * *

## What does it mean if I say yes to using Clever?

If you say yes to using **Clever Portal**, it means you plan to use Clever Portal in your school organization for students, teachers, and/or staff to access resources and applications.  
  
If you say yes to using Clever for **rostering**, it means you plan to use Clever to roster applications for students, teachers, and/or staff to access resources and applications.

* * *

## What if I only plan to use Clever for some schools in my school organization?

Please still answer “Yes”! We want you to have the resources you need to help those schools use Clever.  
 

* * *

## What happens when I select applications I want to connect with for the upcoming year?

When you select applications, we’ll coordinate with those application providers to send your school organization an invitation to connect.

You can also request an application at any time. If you don’t have a contract with the application yet, contact the application provider directly to get started.

* * *

## When should I answer?

The sooner you answer, the better we’ll be able to provide you with training resources in advance of your strategic planning for the upcoming school year.

* * *

## Paid Renewals

The renewal form on the right side of your dashboard is only intended to help us understand how you plan to use Clever Portal and Clever rostering in the next school year, and it is not a place to renew any paid subscriptions. If your school organization has a Clever IDM and/or Classroom MFA subscription that you would like to extend, please visit: [schools.clever.com/orders.](https://schools.clever.com/orders)

title: For App Partners: Learn about Clever Academy
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001496#Header1)  
2\. [Clever Academy for App Partners](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001496#h_d69a946a-bef3-4a95-a085-d0ed7178080b)  
3\. [How can I view my courses or certifications?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001496#viewcourses)

## Overview

Clever Academy is our free online training and certification program for Clever users. App Partners can access Clever Academy via the App Dashboard ([https://apps.clever.com/](https://apps.clever.com/)).  
  
Meanwhile, District Administrators and School Tech Leads can access it through their Clever Dashboards  and teachers can access it through their Clever Portal. Alternatively, users can go directly to Clever Academy: [https://clever.academy](https://clever.academy/)

By completing courses, you can learn how to get the most out of Clever for you and your districts. In addition to your own course (Clever Academy for App Partners), you also have access to all District Admin, School Tech Lead, and teacher content.

##   

* * *

## Learning topics for Application Partners

[Level 1: Intro to Clever & getting started (for Application Partners)](https://clever.academy/path/certification-for-apps/ca-app-partners)

In this course you'll learn what Clever is and the basics of how you and school organizations use Clever to simplify setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

[Level 2: Clever Dashboard deep dive (for Application Partners)](https://clever.academy/path/certification-for-apps/ca-app-partners-2)

In this course you'll take a deeper dive into your Clever Dashboard learning about more advanced features and how to utilize them effectively to increase efficiency for your teams.  

When you complete these courses, you'll become a Certified Clever Champion. You'll earn a badge and certificate so you can show off your accomplishment!

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000VBYf&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000286Pg)  For directions and information about the Clever Academy specifically for teachers and School Tech Leads (STLs), see these articles:  
[For Teachers: How can I learn more about Clever? (Clever Academy)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360023293231)  
  
[For School Tech Leads: Clever Academy - Learn more about Clever!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360045116211?language=en_US)  
  
[For Clever Admin: Clever Academy Course Catalog - Learn more about Clever!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360023043372?language=en_US)

* * *

## How can I view my courses or certifications?

You can see the courses you've registered for or completed at any time by navigating to [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/), clicking person icon in the top right, and selecting My Profile. From here, you'll see a list of all your learning paths and courses. Any course with a certification that you've completed will have a **View certificate** link next to it. Click the link to view the certificate, and then print it if you'd like! Certificates are valid for two years.  If it has been more than two years since you completed a course, you would need to re-take the course to become re-certified.

title: PowerSchool Auto Sync: Student Emails
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001494#overview)  
2\. [If student emails are stored in a field exportable via DDE](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001494#dde)  
3\. [If student emails are stored on the Email Configuration page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001494#email_configuration)  
           -  [Troubleshooting email deletions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001494#troubleshooting_deletions2)  
4\. [Other options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001494#other_options)

##   
Overview

For the PowerSchool Auto Sync, student email addresses are not synced by default, but they can be synced using the following methods. However, districts have 3 options to sync student email addresses, depending on where they are housed in PowerSchool. District Admins must reach out to Clever Support and request emails to be synced using one of these options.

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DHk) **Please Note:**    
   • **This sync type is no longer available for new setups.** If new to Clever or updating your configuration to pull data from PowerSchool, please reference our article [PowerSchool Plugin Sync.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)  
   • If your schools use ESchoolPLUS as your SIS, please see our article on [SFTP Syncs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078). This article is intended for districts using PowerSchool as their SIS.

  
To review student email data currently in Clever, District Admins can navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > Data browser > Students](https://schools.clever.com/data-browser?collection=students&filters=%255B%255D) tab and add a filter for students with an email that contains @.  
![Data browser students tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EDLo9)

* * *

##   
If student emails are stored in a field exportable via DDE

If your student emails are stored in a field that is exportable by Direct Database Export (DDE), contact Clever Support with the exact field name as it appears in the DDE. Our team can assist with updating your sync to pull student emails from this location.  
  
To determine if the field is exportable via DDE, please follow these directions. 

1.  In PowerSchool, navigate to **System > Data Management > Direct Database Export (DDE)**
2.  Select **Current Table: Students**
3.  Click **Select all records in this table** 
4.  Click **Export Records**
5.  Review the available fields in the dropdown. If you find the field, please provide the exact name of the field (including capitalization and punctuation) to Clever Support. If you cannot locate the field, it is not exportable via DDE.

* * *

##   
If student emails are stored on the Email Configuration page

If student emails are stored on the Email configuration page in PowerSchool, Clever can pull this data with additional PowerSchool permissions. The Email configuration page looks similar to this:

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036VQV)  
  
In order to sync your student email addresses, we'll need you to enable page level-permissions for Quick Export. 

1\. Navigate to **System > Security > Access to Page Permissions** (/admin/security/changepageaccesspriv.html). Set **Turn modify permissions = On** and click Submit. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkW3)  
   
2\. Navigate to Quick Exports: **System > Page and Data Management > Quick Export** (admin/importexport/exportstudents.html). Click **Modify access privileges.**

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkV1)  
   
3\. Find the security group assigned to Clever and set **Level of Access** to **Full**. Click **Submit** (The security group should be the group assigned to the PowerSchool user you've shared with Clever).

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkWS)  
    
4\. Navigate to **System > Security > Access to Page Permissions** (/admin/security/changepageaccesspriv.html). Set **Turn modify permissions = Off** and click Submit. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkWX)

  
5\. To confirm the permissions, log in to PowerSchool using the credentials provided to Clever. Navigate to Quick Exports: **System > Page and Data Management > Quick Export** (admin/importexport/exportstudents.html). If permissions were correctly applied, the Clever user account should have access to the **Submit** button. 

In the Clever Dashboard, navigate to [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) and press **Sync Now.** You can review the results on the Sync page once the sync completes (15-20 minutes).

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TVDJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005PkWr)

###   
  
 **Troubleshooting email deletions**

  
When your district chooses to sync student emails via the Email Configuration page, this is a separate process from the rest of your sync. For some districts, on occasion, our system may fail to successfully sync all student emails, resulting in some student emails being deleted from Clever. If this occurs, try rerunning a sync by navigating to your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page and pressing **Sync Now**. This should resolve the issue.  
  
If your district regularly encounters issues with student email deletions, contact our team and we can discuss applying a safety threshold for the sync. For example, we can reject the email sync if more than 10% of student emails fail to export, preventing large changes to active Clever email data. Please contact our support team if you would like to learn more.

* * *

##   
Other options

If emails are not exportable via DDE or the Email Configuration page, Clever won't be able to pull student emails as part of the auto sync. However, you do have the ability to manually sideload emails.  
  
Please see the following Help Center article to upload student emails: [How do I upload emails that are not in my SIS?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004455026).

title: For App Partners: Extension Fields
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001493#header1)  
2\. [Syncing extension fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001493#header2)  
3\. [Accessing extension fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001493#header3)

## Overview

If a district needs to send data fields outside of the standard fields listed in Clever's [SFTP Specifications](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf), they can do so by uploading extension fields.   
  
District admins can add custom fields for the following data types:  
•    Schools  
•    Sections  
•    Students  
•    Teachers  
•    Staff  
  
We do not accept custom fields for enrollments or student contacts.

* * *

##   
Syncing extension fields to Clever

A district can upload extension fields in two ways:   
  
1\. Manual upload via the Clever Dashboard: [Clever Dashboard > Data sources > Custom data](https://schools.clever.com/custom-data) page.  
2\. Automatic upload through the district's current student information system (SIS) sync.  
  
Directions for districts that would like to add extension fields can be found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912).  
 

* * *

##   
Accessing extension fields

Extension field data is available for v2.1 and higher. These fields will appear on the associated record as an extension field.  
  
Full documentation for supporting extension fields can be found in our [Dev Docs](https://dev.clever.com/docs/extension-fields).   
 

### **Update your application settings**

In order to receive extension fields, you'll need to add the fields to the list of fields you will accept in your Data Access settings ([Settings > Data Access](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/settings/data-access)). You'll need to mark the **ext** field as optional for any record types you'll support.  
  
Additionally, a district will need enable access to extension fields from their Clever Dashboard under the **Settings > Field Access** for your application. Once the district has enabled access, the data will be available to your application in the Clever API. 

###   
**Field Normalization**

Because fields are created and populated by the district outside of our schema, we cannot normalize the data within the field. Additionally, there are no constraints on what districts can use for field name(s).  
 

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

[For Clever Admins: Syncing custom (i.e., extension) fields to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912)

title: Managing Rollover with Google Classroom Roster Import
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#Overview)  
2\. [Plan for rollover: pause and access dates, and course archiving](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#requirements)  
3. [Review sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#teacher_experience)  
4\. [Let your teachers know what to expect!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#errors)  
5\. [Monitor the sync history page for errors and successfully-synced data](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#H4)  
6. [Steps to take as-needed](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#repro)  
7. [Bulk Archive Tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#bulkarchive)

##   
Overview

Google Classroom roster import makes setting up courses in Google Classroom easier than ever for school-year rollover! We’ve created this guide to help ensure that you’re set up for a smooth semester or summer term rollover with Google Classroom roster import.   
  
If you’re new to using roster import, be sure to accept your invite and initiate your sync first! You can find an [overview of the integration here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001463?language=en_US), and our [full setup guide here.](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001469?language=en_US)  
 

* * *

##   
Step 1: Plan for rollover: pause and access dates, and course archiving

When a district's student information system's (SIS) data rolls over to the new semester or school year, courses are synced automatically with Google Classroom once they are active in Clever and shared with Google Classroom roster import. Once a district [approves its SIS sync hold](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358?language=en_US) and rolls over to the new semester’s rostering data in Clever, those shared sections will create corresponding courses in Google Classroom! 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**  If sections are removed from your SIS and Clever account, it won't result in the corresponding Google Classroom course being removed from Google Classroom. The course will remain active unless one of the following occurs:  
\- A Clever Admin archives the section using the [Bulk Archive Tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#bulkarchive)  
\- The section is archived or deleted by the teacher or a Clever Admin   
\- The section is archived

  
  
However, districts can delay syncing new courses to Google Classroom by pausing their Google Classroom sync and setting teacher and student access dates. Please note that this pause is separate from any [pauses to a district's SIS sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507?language=en_US) to Clever. To pause your district's Google Classroom sync, please follow these steps:

-   Navigate to the [Settings](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/settings) tab of your Google Classroom roster import application.
-   Add a start for your pause. Clever will stop syncing new information to Google Classroom when your start date arrives. Pausing will not remove or change any existing data in Google Classroom. To pause the sync immediately, set the start date to today. Please see the default Summer 2026 pause start dates below, based on your school organization’s country:
-   -   **USA:** May 29, 2026
        
    -   **Canada:** June 30, 2026
        
    -   **UK:** July 15, 2026
        
    -   **Australia and Brazil:** December 20, 2026
        
    -   All other countries follow USA dates
-   Add access to dates for teachers and students.
    -   Teachers will see courses when the teacher access date arrives, allowing them to prepare for the upcoming semester. The teacher will not see students in these courses until the student access date.
    -   Students will be added to courses on the student access date, allowing them to see the courses teachers have accepted.
    -   If you would like students to see courses as soon as teachers accept them, you can set the access dates to the same day. 
    -   The sync will run for each user type at 12:30 AM PST/3:30 AM EST on the corresponding access date
-   Select the **Update** option to save the pause start date and access dates.
-   By default the pause end dates for teachers and students were set to your SIS sync pause end dates if configured.

Please select the Clear option to unpause the sync, and the Google Classroom roster import will begin syncing again for both teachers and students.  
  
![Google Classroom roster import pause dates](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WhEA9)    
  
The Google Classroom roster import sync pause is a great tool to use if your district does not want students to see their courses in Google Classroom before schedules are officially announced. Simply set a teacher access date for the day schedules are updated in Clever and set a student access date for the day your district schedule will be released.  
  
Please note that previously created courses that are no longer shared can be archived using the [Bulk Archive Tool](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001492#bulkarchive).   
 

 **![](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Clever Tip:**  For additional tips on preventing students from viewing their schedules prematurely in  
Clever, please visit this article detailing Clever's [Access Control](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046702972) feature. 

* * *

##   
Step 2: Review sharing rules![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000006nsT)

Navigate to [your district's sharing rules for Google Classroom roster import.](https://schools.clever.com/school/applications/google-classroom-rostering/sharing#/settings/rules) Do the sharing rules you have in place now work for the coming semester’s data as well? **This is a great time to ensure that your district is sharing all necessary courses with Google Classroom.** Need help with sharing rules? [Clever Support can help.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/contactsupport?language=en_US)  
  
Many districts prefer to share only the current term's sections to avoid confusion for their teachers. See the [term rollover article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/204059586?language=en_US) for more information.  
 

* * *

##   
Step 3: Let your teachers know what to expect!

This is one of the most important steps! For a great rollout, make sure your teachers know the following three things:

1.  When they should see courses populated in Google Classroom (and what they look like - see below). Google Classroom courses should be synced within about an hour after your teacher access date arrives.
2.  When students will be added to those courses. If your student access date is after your teacher access date, make sure to let teachers know when students will be added - so they don't add them on their own and are prepared for when they appear! 
3.  That they need to "accept" courses for them to be editable and visible to students. Courses that aren't accepted will not be visible to anyone except their primary teacher. 

![123.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036Tef)  
 ![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000036RRu)  
 

* * *

##   
Step 4: Monitor the sync history page for errors and successfully-synced data

Navigate to the [Sync History page for Google Classroom roster import](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/gc-sync-history) to monitor the courses that are being created and updated. Be sure to review any sync error reports, including the reason and resolution for any sync issues.  
 

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008zl2D)  Please note:** When sections match, we may or may not have updated the class. It'll also show as an update, but this doesn't mean that anything changed. It's just indicating that it is the new current state of the Google Classroom class.

* * *

##   
Steps to take as-needed 

###   
Reprovision any courses that teachers declined by accident

Be sure to let your teachers know that they need to **accept the synced courses in Google Classroom!** If you need to reprovision any courses that teachers declined or archived by accident, Clever Admins can do that from the section's profile page in the Clever Dashboard:  
  
![GCri reprovision](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WhA3K)   
_An example screenshot of what the course will look like if declined._  
 

### Customize course names

If the default naming convention or a previous year’s customized naming convention needs to be changed during rollover, you can utilize the course naming tool from the [Google Classroom roster import settings page](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/settings) in your Clever Dashboard. These changes will only be reflected in courses created in future syncs and will not overwrite previously synced courses. If courses are created and already in use, the names will not update dynamically when using the custom course naming feature.  
  
![Google Classroom roster import app page with highlight around Course Naming box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WhBdi)   
  

### Teachers can customize course names

If a teacher has courses with the same name syncing due to a previous year or term's course having the same name as a new course, the teacher can change one of the course names manually to differentiate them. The sync will not overwrite any changes the teacher makes to the course name.

### Disable student access to Google Classroom in the Google Workspace Admin Console

If you do not set a pause during a rollover period (e.g., summer, winter) students will be able to see schedules as soon as the teacher accepts their course in Google Classroom.  This can cause students to see their schedule before the school is ready.  If this occurs, the school can disable the student's access to Google Classroom in the Google Workspace Admin Console to prevent schedules from being revealed to students.

* * *

##   
Bulk Archive Tool

The Bulk Archive Tool in Google Workspace offers a streamlined way to manage your courses by allowing you to archive multiple courses at once, preventing your Google Classroom from getting cluttered with old courses that are no longer in use. This tool is especially useful during term rollovers or when you need to tidy up your Google Classroom environment. This tool will only allow you to archive courses that Clever created. If a course is archived, Google Classroom roster import can still add or remove students and teachers, and update the class owner. 

Bulk archive cannot archive sections while they are still shared with the Google Classroom Roster Import application. If you need to archive a section shared with this application, you must first update the sharing permissions to exclude it from sharing. Once this is done, you can proceed with archiving the section using the Bulk Archive Tool.

The Bulk Archive preview allows you to see which courses are no longer shared with Google Classroom Roster Import. This ensures that you archive only the courses that are ready to be archived.

To begin using the Bulk Archive Tool, follow these steps:

1.  Navigate to the Google Classroom Roster Import application > [**Settings**](https://schools.clever.com/applications/google-classroom-rostering/settings) \> Courses bulk archive box.
    
2.  Adjust the course creation dates so that the tool archives any sections that were created in Clever during a specific time period. The start and end date filters for creation date will use your Time Zone and start at 12:00am and end at 11:59pm on the dates selected. 
    
3.  Click **Preview** if you would like to see which sections you will archive. This is an optional step.
    
4.  Click **Archive** when you are ready to archive all courses created by Clever within the specified dates.
    

![Screenshot 2024-07-23 at 10.03.18 AM.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000d5RF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000006gB6t)

## Sample Email Template

**Before archiving sections, we recommend that you reach out to your teachers to let them know what will take place.** Here’s an email template that you can use: 

_Subject line: Upcoming Google Classroom Archiving_

_Dear Teachers,_

_We hope this message finds you well._

_\[School District\] has archived  classes within Google Classroom to help reduce clutter and ensure you no longer see outdated classes. This change will affect Google Classroom courses that were automatically created between  \[From Date\] and \[To Date\]. Please note that this will only impact classes automatically created, not classes you created._

_If you need to unarchive any classes, you can follow the instructions listed_ [_here._](https://support.google.com/edu/classroom/answer/6149813?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop#zippy=%2Crestore-an-archived-class%2Cview-an-archived-class)

_Should you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact \[insert school Clever admin name or email address\]._

_Best regards,_

_\[Name\]_

_\[Title\]_

_\[School District\]_

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [Clever + Google Classroom: Overview](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001503?language=en_US)
-   [Clever + Google Classroom: Setup guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001469?language=en_US)
-   [Clever + Google Classroom: Requirements & Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001463?language=en_US)
-   [For Teachers: Clever + Google Classroom](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001470)

title: Clever + Google Classroom: Resolving License Errors
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001486#Overview)  
2\. [Related Errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001486#teacher_experience)  
3. [Google Workspace Admin Help Resources](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001486#requirements)

##   
Overview

  
**Google Classroom requires all teachers and students to have an active and assigned license before they can be a part of the roster sync.**  
  
To avoid sync errors, ensure that Edu Plus licenses are assigned to all students and teachers whose sections will be synced with Classroom. To review, assign, or changes licenses, go to _Billing > License Settings_ in the Google Admin Console.  
 

## Related Errors

If a user doesn’t have an active license, you will see the following error in your sync errors report:  
  
**Failed Precondition: Joining User Not \*Eligible\* For Roster Import**  
  
Download the sync errors log to see which student and teacher accounts are running into the error:

  
![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sre5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035ZFp)  
 

Make sure that a Google Workspace Education Plus or Google Standard Edition license is assigned to the students in teachers with the error in the Sync Error Log file. To review, assign, or changes licenses, go to _Billing > License Settings_ in the Google Admin Console.

## Google Workspace Admin Help Resources

  
If you are uncertain about how to assign licenses to students and teachers, please review these resources:

-   [How to assign, remove, and reassign licenses](https://support.google.com/a/answer/1727173?hl=en)
-   [Provisioning Google Workspace for Education Paid Licenses](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HOc3vvPvVsgF5vwHQ1QUUvuJxSEtxPEd47L-DhHI3D8)

  
If you are still having challenges assigning licenses – please contact Google Workspace support:

-   [How to contact Google Workspace support](https://support.google.com/a/answer/1047213?hl=en)

title: Clever + ARC Setup Guide
text:
1\. [Overview of applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001485#header1)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001485#header2)  
3\. [Recommended sharing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001485#header3)  
4\. [Setting up SchoolPace for co-teachers and support staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001485#header4)  
5\. [FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001485#header5)

## Overview of applications

**SchoolPace:** SchoolPace is ARC’s analytics platform for schools and districts. This web-based platform is accessed by teachers, school administrators, and district administrators. Teachers use the built-in assessment tools to evaluate student reading skills and record observations. Data is aggregated into graphs and charts to help schools and districts monitor progress. 

**myARC:** _myARC_ is a web-based platform that allows ARC to organize and distribute curricular content, digital books, videos, and other intellectual property securely with educators, families, and students. 

**ARC Bookshelf:** _ARC Bookshelf_ is American Reading Company’s digital book platform, and fully integrated with SchoolPace (for analytics) and myARC (for sharing). Students can read digital books on the web, or on native apps for iOS and Android.

**ARC Adventures:** ARC Adventures allows students to practice foundational reading skills in a fun, 3D game world. 

****ARC Reads®-****  A student portal for the 100 Book Challenge® and ARC Core® classrooms, offers powerful tools to enhance reading growth, practice, and engagement. With the Digital Logbook, students log their reading practice, receive book recommendations, and track their reading habits. The My IRLA tool identifies where a student might be able to handle text independently through phonics and vocabulary questions.

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrHV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Important note:** Not all license purchases will include myARC, ARC Bookshelf, ARC Adventures and ARC Reads.

* * *

##   
Setup process

1\. Make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [https://clever.com/signup.](https://clever.com/signup)  
  
2\. **Submit Implementation Checklist:** Once your district’s licenses have been activated, districts and schools will be emailed a link to the “Implementation Checklist”. Districts must complete and submit the “Implementation Checklist” and choose Clever as their rostering method. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrHV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035X3h)

  
3\. **SchoolPace Support confirmation email:** Once the implementation checklist has been submitted and finalized, SchoolPace Support will email confirming the rostering method and rostering dates, and include information on next steps.   
  
4\. **Accept Invitations:** After submitting the “Implementation Checklist”, the SchoolPace Support team will invite your district or school to Clever. You should see a Clever invite for each application purchased in your email inbox. 

![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrHV&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000035Wap)

  
5\. **Notify SchoolPace Support when Accepting Clever Invitation:** Districts and schools should accept the invitation and notify SchoolPace Support of the acceptance. Notifying SchoolPace Support of acceptance helps ensure that syncing with Clever is set up properly. To notify SchoolPace support simply reply to the email sent to you by SchoolPace Support, or email [schoolpace@americanreading.com](mailto:schoolpace@americanreading.com).   
  
6. **Set sharing rules:** Districts set up sharing rules in Clever.   
  
7. **Start syncing:** SchoolPace starts syncing with Clever on the “Rostering Start Date” as provided on the implementation checklist.   
 

* * *

##   
Recommended sharing rules

It’s important to only share the sections that are using SchoolPace in the classroom. The simplest way to do so is to choose “Share by Rules” in Clever. You can create a sharing rule by following these steps:  
 

1.  Access the Sharing Permissions page for SchoolPace. To do this, log in to your Clever account and click the icon for the name of the application on the Home page. From the 'Data Sharing' tab, click Share by Rules
2.  Select the type of rule you want to create. We recommend choosing “Custom share by section”, as it will allow you to create your own rule that can apply specifically to classes that will be using SchoolPace. 
3.  Create your rule. You can share classes with certain course names or numbers, grades, subjects or schools. 

  
We also recommend [using this Help Center article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247) when setting up custom sharing rules.  
  
If you need any further assistance setting up sharing rules please contact Clever Support.  
 

### Important Notes:

-   SchoolPace is the main rostering application. **You must set up your rules for SchoolPace and copy those rules over to myARC, ARC Bookshelf, and ARC Adventures to enable sign sign-on (SSO), if purchased.** If you set up rules for myARC, ARC Bookshelf, or ARC Adventures that are different from the sharing rules for SchoolPace, there can be access errors. 
-   Students can only be in one school at a time. If a student is shared in two classrooms, the classrooms must be in the same school. For example, if you share student A to a homeroom section and an ELA section, the sections must be assigned to the same school.

* * *

##   
Setting up SchoolPace for co-teachers and support staff

**Co-teachers:** The best way to add co-teachers is to add them as a co-teacher in the Student Information System (SIS) to the section they will be supporting. If you manually add the co-teacher in SchoolPace, they will lose access the next day due to the nightly sync with Clever.   
  
**SpEd teachers and other support staff:** You can manually add users as staff members, through a CSV upload to Clever through your [Clever Dashboard](https://schools.clever.com/), or by creating a custom staff account. When you upload a staff file, they will have admin access.   
  
For more information on adding staff users to Clever, check out the following Help Center article: [Clever Roles: Staff - How to add to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/229253547).  
  
Once the staff user accounts have been created in Clever, create a sharing rule that will share that staff member with SchoolPace and accompanying apps. 

* * *

##   
FAQ

**Why is a student or teacher missing from SchoolPace?** 

-   Schoolpace is rostered nightly through Clever. So if a student or teacher was missing from SchoolPace, it may be because they have been removed from the Clever share. 
-   If a student is missing from a classroom, check to see if the student is assigned to two classrooms. If a student is assigned to two classrooms, SchoolPace will roster the student in only one of those classrooms. 
-   If a teacher doesn’t have access to SchoolPace, check if the section was shared in Clever, and check if there are students assigned to those sections. 

  
**I made updates and it’s reflected in Clever. Why don’t I see those changes in SchoolPace?** 

-   Changes from Clever will be reflected in SchoolPace the next day. 

  
For support, please email [SchoolPace@americanreading.com](mailto:SchoolPace@americanreading.com)

title: For Clever Admins: Clever Passwords - Custom Configurations
text:
This article contains the following: 1. Overview 2. Instructions 3. Available Fields 4. Examples 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 

 

 Overview

 When setting up Clever Passwords as an Identity Provider, you may want a combination of the fields you're syncing to Clever as the username/password format, rather than using a single field. You can create a custom format to combine fields directly in the Clever Passwords configuration modal on the SSO Settings page.

 Please note: This article is for the Clever passwords (classic) interface . If you are using the updated interface please see this article for custom formula guidance. Not sure which interface you're using? Check the screenshots below to determine which matches your experience: Clever Passwords (classic): Clever Passwords (updated): 

 

 
 Instructions

 • Set up Clever Passwords. For more information see Single Sign-On (SSO): Clever Passwords - Log in with Clever .
• Enter any available code from below or select a configuration from the dropdown for username and/or password.
• Choose reset all usernames and passwords now for any user types you've modified, and save.
• Test a login!
 • Look up the login credentials for a user
• Navigate to your district's portal URL 
• Enter the login credentials for the user to confirm the login works.
 

 
 

 
 Available Fields

 • {{.SISID}}
 • The unique ID number shared with Clever from your SIS. Seen as "Student ID", "Staff ID" or "Teacher ID" in Clever.
 

• {{.StaffID}}
 • The unique ID number shared with Clever from your SIS or SFTP upload. Seen as "Staff ID" in Clever.
 

• {{.StudentNumber}}
 • If shared, seen as "Student Number" in Clever.
 

• {{.Name.First}}
• {{.Name.Last}}
• {{.Name.Middle}}
• {{.TeacherNumber}}
 • If shared with Clever, seen as "Teacher Number" in Clever. 
 

• {{formatDate.Dob}}
 • If shared with Clever, the user's date of birth.
• Uses M/D/YYYY format.
 

• {{.Email}}
 • If shared with Clever, the user's email address.
 

• {{.Credentials.DistrictUsername}}
 • If shared with Clever, seen as "District Username" in Clever.
 

• {{.Credentials.DistrictPassword}}
 • If shared with Clever, seen as "District Password" in Clever.
 

• Individual words or email domains
 • For instance, if you want username to include @ cleverusd.k12.edu , you'd add that to the end of any other formulas. You might also add a period/dot in between two formulas (like if you want to add a period between the first and last name formulas for username). 
 

 
 
 Examples

 Username "John.Doe" would be formatted as: {{.Name.First}}.{{.Name.Last}} Username " John.Doe@cleverusd.k12.edu " would be formatted as: {{.Name.First}}.{{.Name.Last}}@ cleverusd.k12.edu 

 
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

 Can I concatenate partial fields? (i.e. first two letters of last name) 

 • Currently, formulas can't be concatenated.
 
 Are usernames and passwords case-sensitive? 

 • Yes, all usernames and passwords are case-sensitive!
 
 I used {{formatDate.Dob}}, what format is the DOB in? 

 • This field uses the M/D/YYYY format. For example, January 1st, 2001 would be 1/1/2001 and December 1st, 2001 would be 12/1/2001.

title: Clever + HMHCore Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [HMH Rostering Service Rostering](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001525#HMHCore_Rostering)  
2\. [Setup instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001525#Setup_instructions)  
3\. [Common troubleshooting tips](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001525#Common_troubleshooting_tips)

  ​

## HMH Rostering Service 

The HMH Rostering Service integration with Clever supports automated rostering only for the following product lines:  

-   HMH ThinkCentral
-   HMH MyHRW  
-   HMH Ed Learning Platform

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YqSP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you wish to set up SSO for these products, you will need to follow [the instructions here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001510) separately.

  
​

* * *

## Setup instructions

To set up rostering for HMH Rostering Service, you will need to follow one of two sets of steps. We highly recommend following the API setup unless you are already using the SFTP setup:

-   If you've already completed the SFTP setup, you should wait until the end of the school year to [convert to the API option](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585). 

###    
API Setup (Recommended)

-   Request the [HMH Rostering Service application here.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/hmhcore)
-   Follow the setup instructions here.

WARNING   
When you change rostering methods mid-year, IDs can change, which may result in the loss of data. There are specific and detailed warnings about precautions that must be taken in the setup instructions.

###   
SFTP Setup

-   Request the [HMH Rostering Service application here.](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add/hmhcore)
-   ​If you are rostering HMH for the first time or do not wish to retain historical data, you can follow these instructions.
-   If you already roster with HMH and would like to now roster through Clever, you can follow these instructions.

* * *

## Common troubleshooting tips

​Below is a common pitfall in setting up HMH Rostering Service setup on the Clever side:

-   **Lack of Terms or Courses**  
    In order to use this rostering setup for HMH, your district must have populated term data and it must be shared with HMH Rostering Service. If you only wish to share users and not sections (which include terms), the current setup between HMH Rostering Service and Clever will not be usable. If you do not have terms data currently due to SIS or sync limitations, please contact Clever support to discuss potential options.

title: Clever + Canva for Education: Setup guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001596#header1)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001596#header2)  
3\. [Important information](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001596#header3)  
4\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001596#header5)  
5\. [Support contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001596#header4)

## Overview

This guide walks through how to get set up with Canva for Education in Clever, which is 100% free for districts to use.  
  
Before reading this guide, please make sure your district is set up with Clever! If your district has not been set up with Clever, you can get started by going to this link: [clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup) or by accepting your invitation from Canva for Education.   
  
For more information on setting up Clever for the first time, please see [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271) .  
 

* * *

## Setup process 

IMPORTANT   
  
Please do not skip any steps, as doing so might lead to access issues, account duplication, or data loss. If you have any questions during your setup, please contact your Canva representative or the [Canva SSO support team](mailto:sso-support@canvateam.zendesk.org).If you haven’t already, your district will need to complete an application form to receive the Canva for Districts product, after which point the Canva team will provision a special version of the product which you can integrate with Clever. [Apply here](https://bit.ly/canva-district-application) to get started. 

  
**Step 1: Connect the Canva for Education Application in Clever**  
  
If your district is already on Clever, you can connect the Canva for Education application in one of two ways:   
  
**Invitation:**  
If Canva for Education invites you to connect, Accept the invitation in your Clever Dashboard home page and continue with the next setup step.   
  
**Request:**  
You can also request the Canva for Education app by following the steps below.

1.  Log into your Clever Dashboard and click [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation.
2.  Search for Canva for Education.
    -   ![search for Canva application in Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrRB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000MORt)
3.  You’ll then be brought to a page where you can authorize your Canva request. As Clever SSO and rostering for Canva is provided at no cost to the district, you can mark that it has already been purchased for the district. 
4.  You’ll be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the Canva icons in their Clever portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day (pending approval from Canva).
5.  Once you have made your selections, click **Request**!
6.  The app status will then appear as **Waiting on Approval**. Once the Canva team grants you access to the Canva for Education app, the status will change to **No data shared** and you can continue the set up.

**Step 2: Set up the Canva SAML & Rostering Configuration**   
  
Set up the Canva SAML & Rostering Configuration for Clever [using this guide](https://www.canva.com/help/saml-configuration-clever-edu/). Please don’t skip any steps, as doing so might lead to access issues, account duplication, or data loss.  
  
Come back here once you're successfully connected to the app to set up data sharing, to indicate which school(s) should have access to Canva.  
  
**Step 3: Recommended Sharing**  
  
Share data with Canva so they know who should have access.  
  
Before sharing:

-   Ensure that students and teachers are in their correct grade levels and that classes are updated for the current school year in your Student Information System (SIS).

Canva recommends that you share all data for your district. The Canva for Education platform is free to you so there are no license concerns with this sharing setting.  
  
The simplest way to do so is to select **Share All Data** in Clever.   
  
If you plan to share specific schools, you can find [more info about “Share by Rules” here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). You can create a sharing rule by going to the Sharing Permissions page for Canva for Education.   
  
To do this, log in to your Clever account and click the icon for Canva in the sidebar. From the Data Sharing tab, click **Share All Data**.  
 

* * *

## Important information

**Canva for Education is a SAML application in Clever**  
What does this mean?

-   The application is automatically configured to SSO via SAML with Canva.
-   To view SAML Details in your Clever Dashboard, click the Canva for Education app, click on **Settings** and scroll to **SAML Details**.
    -   ![SAML Details](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SrRB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000DnSj)
-   For more information on how to configure SAML with Canva see the [Clever SAML & Rostering Configuration Guide.](https://www.canva.com/help/saml-configuration-clever-edu/)

   
**Required Fields**  
Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. Canva requires the following data fields be sent:

-   **Student:** district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, email, grade
-   **Contact:** district, name, sis\_id, students, relationship, student\_relationships, type
-   **Teacher:** district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, email, title
-   **School Admin:** district, name, schools, staff\_id, email, roles
-   **District Admin:** district, name.first, name.last, email, title  
     

* * *

## FAQs

**Who can configure this application in Canva?**  
This feature is available to Canva for Districts. However, only team administrators and owners can enable, configure, and change their team or district’s SSO & Provisioning settings.  
  
**Why is a student or teacher missing from Canva?**  
Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Canva:

-   In your SIS data
-   In your Clever data
-   Is shared with Canva in your data sharing permissions

  
**Can multiple teachers/staff be assigned to the same course/section?**  
Canva can support multiple teachers or staff assigned to the same course/section.  
  
**Are staff supported?**  
Yes, Canva supports staff with Clever.   
  
**Who should I ask for help with an issue?**  
If it’s related to data within Clever, or data coming from Clever, please contact Clever. If you are receiving an error message within the Canva URL, please contact Canva.  
 

* * *

## Support contacts

**Canva**   
Support Contact: [Canva.com/help/get-in-touch/contact-support](https://www.canva.com/help/get-in-touch/contact-support)  
  
Contact Canva with issues that relate to:

-   An error message within any Canva URL

  
**Clever**  
Support Contact: Support.clever.com (click the chat icon in the corner of the screen)  
  
Contact Clever with issues that relate to:

-   Data within Clever
-   Data coming from Clever

title: For Clever Admins: Accepting app invites or requesting applications you already roster
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001706#header1)  
2\. [What to expect during the transition](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001706#header2)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001706#header3)

## Overview

This article outlines the process for adding applications to your Clever account that you are currently rostering via other means. It includes information on both accepting an application invite or requesting an application to begin rostering via Clever.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQcb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IwQUQ)   Please note:** You can add applications in Clever at any time of year!

* * *

## What to expect during the transition

### When accepting an application invite

If you already have an established relationship with an application, and it's also available on Clever, you may receive an invitation from the app partner to roster via Clever in your dashboard.

![Screenshot of application invite](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQcb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000IwKVS)

You can view and accept the application invite at any time, and it **will not** impact your current rostering or login setup for the application. The application partner won’t be able to access data until you configure sharing permissions.

If an application partner has sent you an invite in Clever, they are ready to assist you in transitioning to rostering and SSO via Clever. Each application partner will have their processes for supporting you in the transition.

We recommend that once you have a timeline for the transition with the application’s team, that you notify your staff, teachers, and students. You may want to communicate any changes to links or login instructions for users.

### When requesting an application

You can request to add a learning application in Clever at any time of year, and it **will not** impact your current rostering or login setup with the application until you begin sharing data. Each application partner will have their processes for supporting you in the transition. If you have questions about the transitioning process during the school year, we recommend contacting the application directly.

Once you have established a timeline for the transition with your application partner, we recommend you notify your staff, teachers, and students. You may want to communicate any changes to links or user login instructions.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What will happen if I accept an application invite?**

-   No changes will immediately take place. The application’s team will work with you to ensure a smooth transition. They will be able to assist with matching existing accounts and preserving historical data. Once you’re ready to share data with the application, you’ll want to set up your sharing rules. 
    

**What happens when I request an application?**

-   The application will receive a notification that you’d like to start rostering and/or using SSO via Clever, but there won’t be any immediate changes. The application team will need to approve the request and collaborate on your setup. You’ll want to complete your sharing permissions when you’re ready to share data with the application. We recommend that you contact the application directly for more information on your transition plan.
    

**Why did I receive an application invite?**

-   If you already have an established relationship with an app partner, and the app is also available on Clever, you may receive an invitation from the app partner to roster via Clever in your dashboard.
    
-   If you’ve received an invitation to connect from an application, it’s likely because the application has detected active users in your school organization and believes your school organization could benefit from using its Clever integration. If you have any questions about the invitation, feel free to respond directly or reach out to the support contact listed for more details.
    

**How do I limit the data I share with each application?**

-   You can customize the data you share with each application via your [Sharing Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007). You can further limit the specific fields shared with an application via [Field Access Settings](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000501586).  
     

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Apps - App invites](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360045084272)

title: For Application Partners: Clever Complete Overview
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001700#header1)  
2\. [Features](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001700#header2)  
3\. [Benefits](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001700#header3)  
4\. [Learn more](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001700#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001700#header5)

## Overview

Clever Complete is the platform solution purpose-built for edtech scalability—connecting your application to any school through a single, secure integration for rostering, SSO, and LMS connections.

   ![Image of diagram explaining the features of Clever Complete](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bv7N&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000kceoL)

* * *

## Features

Today, Clever Complete extends Clever’s existing 1EdTech OneRoster® integrations to enable application partners to automate rostering via OneRoster for any school, even if they’re not using Clever.

In the future, Clever Complete will enable:

-   Access to a single integration point for rostering, SSO, and LMS for any school or district, regardless of whether they use Clever.
    
-   Additional data fields related to demographics and attendance
    
-   Best-in-class data visibility and management
    

  
 

* * *

## Benefits

With a single, powerful integration that consolidates and secures edtech interoperability, edtech applications, and schools benefit from the following:

-   **One integration for all schools.** Stop maintaining custom builds for every school or system—connect once and support them all.
    
-   **Cut integration costs and optimize efficiency.** Free up engineering resources by consolidating fragile, one-off integrations—allowing your team to focus on growth and innovation.
    
-   **Built-in data privacy and security.** Offload compliance and security concerns while ensuring school trust by decreasing attack surface for users to gain unauthorized access.
    
-   **Expand faster and reduce time to value—without extra engineering work.** Reach new schools quickly while reducing manual processes, custom builds, and technical overhead.   
     
    

* * *

## Learn more

If you're interested in utilizing Clever Complete, you can: 

-   [Sign up for a call](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup) to learn more.
    
-   Learn more in [Clever Academy](https://clever.academy/ca-app-partners-2/2183600).  
     
    

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How does SSO work with Clever Complete?**

-   Clever Complete enables edtech applications to authenticate users through Clever’s secure SSO infrastructure, regardless of whether a school is currently on Clever or not. Schools and applications can continue using their preferred authentication methods while ensuring a seamless login experience for students and educators.
    

**Can apps filter or manage connections when importing data via CSV or OneRoster?**

-   Yes, partners will be able to control which data they import using the existing filters in their Clever dashboards. Additionally, depending on the data source, districts may be able to filter what data is sent to Clever and the application.
    

**How will districts and schools currently using our application be impacted if we begin using Clever Complete?**

-   Districts and schools already on Clever will continue to use Clever as they currently do- there will be no changes. For districts or schools that are not currently using Clever, they may need to configure additional settings to begin the data flow through Clever. Our support teams will assist in this process!
    

**How will Clever Complete impact our district integrations?**

-   Clever Complete acts as a unified integration layer for application partners. Districts, on the other hand, will be able to choose whatever rostering solution they want to use -- whether that be Clever, ClassLink, GG4L, direct SIS syncs, or manual uploads. Clever will be integrated with all of those sources, in doing so, will allow applications to support any of those sources as well. Districts and schools will still need to meet Clever’s field requirements for data ingestion, ensuring consistency and data integrity across all integrations.
    

  
 

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Clever Complete](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001701)

title: For Application Partners: Clever LMS Connect and AnySchool
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001733#header1)  
2. [Inviting an off-Clever district or school](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001725?language=en_US#header2)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001733#header2)  
3. [The district/school experience](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001725?language=en_US#header3)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001733#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001733#header4)

## Overview

Clever LMS Connect allows you to integrate with district LMSs easily via the Clever API. Through the AnySchool capability in Clever Complete, you can connect with districts and schools that don't use Clever, enabling them and you to benefit from Clever LMS Connect.

Clever Complete with AnySchool enables any district or school to launch your application directly from their LMS using SSO.. Clever LMS Connect also saves teachers time with gradebook syncs and allows students to jump into learning with seamless assignment syncs. You can learn more about [Clever LMS Connect here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001636).

This article covers the setup of Clever LMS Connect for off-Clever districts and schools.

  
 

* * *

## Inviting an off-Clever school or district

To connect with a district or school that isn’t currently utilizing Clever, you must have a Clever Complete contract, which includes AnySchool connections. If you don’t have a Clever Complete agreement in place and are interested in learning more, please [contact our team here](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup).

If you have an existing Clever Secure Sync or Clever LMS Connect integration with V3.0+ of the API, you can use your existing integrations to utilize all of the Clever Complete features, including AnySchool.

Clever hosts the setup flow, and it’s white-labeled to align with your application’s branding.

To use AnySchool to invite an off-Clever district or school to utilize Clever LMS Connect, the district or school must first set up rostering via AnySchool. This setup will enable Clever to make the necessary connections between their users and courses in their data and their LMS. If the district or school has not set up AnySchool rostering yet, please refer to our article [For App Partners: Rostering schools via the AnySchool district setup flow](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001725). Once you’ve worked with the school to complete their rostering setup, you’ll be able to proceed with the Clever LMS Connect setup. To do so, please: 

1.  Confirm you have the email address of the administrator at the district or school who will be setting up Clever LMS Connect with your application.
    
2.  Navigate to the district/school’s AnySchool account in your Clever account using the Search bar.
    
3.  In the **LMS Connect Access Link** box, select the button to **Generate access link.**
    
4.  Input the District Email. Clever will use this email address to verify the user during the setup process. Then click **Generate link.**
    
5.  Copy the generated link and provide it to the admin. The link will expire in 48 hours.
    
6.  Once the administrator receives the link, they’ll complete the steps below to set up Clever LMS Connect with your application.
    

  
 

* * *

## The district/school experience

Once you’ve generated the access link and provided it to the school administrator, they’ll be able to begin the setup process on their side. To complete the set up, they’ll:

1.  Navigate to the link you’ve provided.
    
2.  Review the information for utilizing AnySchool and click the **Get started** button.
    
3.  They’ll receive an additional confirmation email to verify their account. They’ll need to select the **Verify account** button in this email.
    
4.  Once they verify the account, they’ll be logged in to begin their setup. They'll start by selecting their LMS as either Canvas, Schoology, or Google Classroom.
    
      **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eA2H&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WdG46)  Clever Tip:** Once a district begins their setup, they have 48 hours to complete the process. If they don’t complete their setup in this timeframe, you’ll need to provide a new setup link.
    
5.  They’ll receive a prompt to enter additional information for their LMS, such as their URL and account connection information.
    
6.  Once the admin establishes the connection with their LMS, Clever will begin a record-matching process. Recording-matching typically takes 2-3 days.
    
7.  While waiting for record matching to complete, the administrator can generate the LTI 1.3 SSO link for your application. This link will enable users to access your application directly from their LMS. Logins won’t work until the record matching process completes.
    

Once matching is complete and the admin has configured the SSO setup in their LMS, users will be able to begin accessing your application directly from their LMS!  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Why does a district or school need to set up Secure Sync rostering with AnySchool to utilize Clever LMS Connect?**

-   Clever will use the data provided via rostering to connect users and courses for SSO, gradebook sync, and assignment syncs.
    

**Who should we contact if there are issues during the setup process?**

-   For issues during the initial setup and matching process, the Clever support team can assist you.
    
-   Beyond initial setup, depending on the issue, you can always start with the Clever support team. We might be able to help you diagnose the problem and either resolve it or point you in the right direction.
    
-   For questions regarding where to find information within their LMS, the district should reach out directly to their LMS provider.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For App Partners: Clever Complete](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001700)
    
-   [For App Partners: Rostering schools via the AnySchool district setup flow](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001725)
-   [Rostering applications with AnySchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001726)
