title: For Clever Admin: Google License Manager
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001707#header1)  
2\. [Step 1: Connect your Google account](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001707#header2)  
3\. [Step 2: Turn off automatic licensing in Google Workspace](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001707#header3)  
4\. [Step 3: Select Organizational Units (OUs) and license type(s)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001707#header4)  
5\. [Sync History](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001707#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001707#header6)

## Overview

For schools using Google products, we offer an optional Google License Manager. Google License manager will manage any paid license access for selected users via your Organizational Units (OUs) in Google, so you don’t have to apply or remove them manually!

Read on to learn more about the feature and how to use it. This feature is currently being rolled out, so if you may not see the License Manager available yet under Applications in your Clever Dashboard.

 **![instructor\_c8mlopv788bh4spwj0xrzn2c2\_public\_1712091784\_Lightbulb.1712091783969.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Clever Tip:** We recommend utilizing [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) for Google to manage any free Fundamentals, Fundamentals-archive, and Gmail-only licenses.  
  
If you're unsure whether your Google licenses are paid or free, we recommend checking Google's documentation on license types [here](https://support.google.com/a/answer/15603742?hl=en&sjid=6356901834144134382-NA) and [here](https://support.google.com/a/answer/14206754).

* * *

## Step 1: Connect your Google account

Go to your [Clever Dashboard > User management > License manager](https://schools.clever.com/license-manager). To start, you must connect your Google Workspace for Education+ account to Clever. 

The following permissions are required for access:

-   read and write access to licensing
    
-   read-only access to users
    
-   read-only access to customers
    
-   read-only access to organizational units
    
-   read only access to app orders
    

* * *

## Step 2: Turn off automatic licensing in Google Workspace

Go to your Google Workspace admin dashboard > Billing > License settings and ensure "Automatic Licensing" is turned off.

![Screenshot of Google Workspace License settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000KJyud)    
  
Next, go to Billing > Subscriptions and select your license subscription. Ensure that you don't have any conflicting "Locally applied settings" for OUs that you want Clever to manage.  
  
![Screenshot of Google Subscriptions license settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000KJvGo)  

* * *

## Step 3: Select Organizational Units (OUs) and license type(s)

Next, click **Select OUs**. Select the Google OU(s) you want to assign Google licenses to. Keep in mind, the Google License Manager does **not** handle billing. You will need to continue to manage license subscriptions and ensure you have enough licenses to cover users you apply licenses to via the Google License Manager.

![Screenshot of OUs in Google License Manager](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K7JaH)

You can apply the following license types:

-   Google for Education Plus
    
-   Google for Education Plus - Legacy
    
-   Google for Education Standard
    
-   Google for Education - Teacher & Learning Upgrade.
    

Learn more about the [different license types available here](https://edu.google.com/intl/ALL_us/workspace-for-education/editions/compare-editions/).

You can also remove the license for:

-   Users not in the selected OU(s) and
    
-   Users who are suspended
    

 **![instructor\_c8mlopv788bh4spwj0xrzn2c2\_public\_1712091784\_Lightbulb.1712091783969.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you’d like to manage licenses for users with free fundamentals licenses, fundamentals-archive, or gmail-only licenses you can use [Clever IDM for Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467) to do so. When setting up your OUs, you’ll be able to set the action for a user removed from Clever:  
1\. Move to archive OU, suspend, and archive  
2\. Move to archive OU and suspend  
3\. Move to archive OU  
  
If you don't currently have a Clever IDM subscription [please fill out this form to speak with our team and learn more](https://www.clever.com/security-consultation).

You can add rules for different licenses applied to them by clicking + **Add rule**.

![Screenshot of Google License Manager](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K7KCz)   

We recommend using the Preview functionality to see what license changes your Google License Manager will apply when you first configure your settings.

Once you’ve identified all OU settings and confirmed your Preview, click **Apply** at the bottom to apply the licenses.  
  
Ongoing syncs with few changes will take up to 10 minutes. For syncs with large numbers of changes, the sync could take multiple hours.

![Screenshot of Google License Manager applying licenses](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K7HF8)

After you apply the license rules, the license manager will automatically apply these rules to your users nightly based on any users added or removed from the OU(s) you’ve selected.

You can always return to edit or remove license access by OU as needed!

* * *

## Sync History

Click on the Sync History tab to view a table of recent Google License Manager syncs and download a CSV of license updates the Google License Manager applied. 

![Screenshot of Google License Manager Sync History tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQJF&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K7KzN)    
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**If I use Clever IDM for Google, will my licenses get applied automatically?**

-   Yes, a successful IDM sync will kick off a license manager sync to apply licenses to new users automatically, and remove licenses for suspended users if you have configured the manager to do so.
    

**I’m seeing error 412 in my Google License Manager sync log what is that?**

-   This means you have gone over your purchased Google licenses. You need to ensure you have enough licenses to cover the OU(s) selected in the Google License manager.
    

**Are users notified of their license access?**

-   No, they are not notified. 
    

**Am I notified once licenses are applied?**

-   You can return to the Google License Manager page to see once the licenses are applied.

title: Skyward API Sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#h_01EHB1VH34VHB2DZYJ3VAFADQG) 2\. [Setting up the API sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#h_01EHB1VTNCWB7SNJTP6GM07PX7) 3\. [School Year Rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#rollover) 4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#troubleshooting)        • [Sync errors](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#errors) 5\. [Special Characters](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#h_01EHB2RJBH0SNK9VCDMEQBDD7R) 6\. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#h5) ## Overview ✓ Runs every six hours, by querying the Skyward API ✓ Pulls all students and teachers who have an active school association ✓ Supports co-teachers for sections ✓ Supports multiple student contacts per student; these are pulled from the guardian data in Skyward ✓ Supports custom field mappings (please contact Clever Support to set this up). **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YFZJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:**          •  The Skyward API doesn't sync IEP, ELL, FRL, or Home\_language fields.          •   For student contacts we are **unable** to:                - filter contacts                - customize contact data Clever supports three Skyward API sync options. You can learn more about each one below: **Skyward API SMS 2.0** This sync option is no longer available to new school organizations joining Clever. If you were hoping to use this sync type, we recommend choosing one of the other options or using the [SFTP sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205783078?language=en_US) instead. **Skyward API LMS** This is a custom API sync that allows for more flexibility. It supports: - Field mappings - Value mappings  - Filtering (for example, excluding certain schools or sections) - Staff syncing, including non-teaching staff\* - Co-teachers - Student contacts (with some limitations) Clever can pull student contacts from the guardian endpoint and can sync multiple contacts per student. However, we don’t support custom filtering or field mapping for student contacts. For the default Skyward fields Clever uses, refer to the [default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/232211028#h5). **Skyward API Qmlativ (OneRoster 1.1)** This sync option uses the OneRoster v1.1 standard API format. Because it follows a strict standard: - Custom field mappings aren’t supported - Filtering isn’t supported The Skyward API Qmlativ sync includes teaching staff only. It doesn’t support syncing non-teaching staff. ## Version To use the Skyward API sync, your district must be on version 05.16.10.00 or newer (any add-on update to that version is fine). This requirement applies to all Skyward API sync types, including: - Skyward API Qmlativ - Skyward API LMS - Skyward SMS 2.0 (not available for new school organizations joining Clever)    **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YFZJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WxSic)    Please note:** If you’d like to sync additional data to Clever, you can do so via our automated custom data sync for auto sync districts and schools. Please reach out [to Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for access to your Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automatic exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for automation scripting. * * * ## Setting up the API sync Setting up the API sync depends on how your district is hosted. The instructions below apply to all Skyward API syncs and will guide you through connecting the API to Clever so your data can start syncing. **1\. Obtain API credentials** Finding your API credentials will differ depending on how you’re hosted. Please follow the directions below:   1. **Secure Cloud (ISCorp) Hosted Districts**: Create an IT Services service call to have ISCorp set up the Read Only API by visiting the **[Support Center](https://support.skyward.com/)** or **[ISCorp Helpdesk](https://support.iscorp.com/)**. 2. **Managed Services / TN State Hosted Districts**: Create an IT Services service call to have Skyward set up the Read Only API install by visiting the **[Support Center](https://support.skyward.com/)**. 3. **Self-Hosted Districts**: Use the **[API Server Launch Kit](https://support.skyward.com/DeptDocs/Corporate/IT%20Services/Public%20Website/Technical%20Information/system/current_requirements/Api%20Server%20Launch%20kit.pdf)** to set up the Read Only API. Optionally, districts can create an IT Services service call to have Skyward set up the Read Only API as a billable service by visiting the **[Support Center](https://support.skyward.com/)**.  We recommend checking **page 19** of [Skyward’s official guide on sharing API details](https://support.skyward.com/DeptDocs/Corporate/IT%20Services/Public%20Website/Technical%20Information/system/current_requirements/Api%20Server%20Launch%20kit.pdf). The page shows you how to find your district's specific connection link (URL). Once you've got that link, follow the steps below to connect Skyward to Clever and finish your setup. **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YFZJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** When setting up Skyward API, districts must choose **OA2 - OAuth 2.0.** If you experience sync issues with OAuth 2.0, please reach out to Clever Support for assistance. ![OAuth 2.0](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YFZJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hjn)   **2\. Change sync type of Clever account** If you already have a Clever account and are switching to the API sync, [please contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). Our team will need to switch your account sync type before you can move forward. If you signed up for a new account, the Skyward API sync will be the default sync type for your account and no switch needs to be made. You're free to move on to the next step!   **3\. Enter API credentials in Clever** Once your account's sync type is the Skyward API sync, please take the credentials for the API and enter them into the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in your Clever Dashboard:   - **Web URL:** API URL (does not include swagger suffix)  - **Username:** Key  - **Password:** Secret **4\. Sync** Push **Sync Now** on the Sync Settings page to kick off the initial Skyward API sync! **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YFZJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000KNUt7) Please note:** Skyward syncs can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every six hours, but the time of day that the syncs occur is not customizable. Syncs can always be initiated at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [SIS sync > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) * * * ## School Year Rollover Rollover behavior is dependent upon which version of the Skyward API your district is syncing from: **LMS API** Once you complete the rollover process in your Skyward database, those changes should reflect in the Skyward API for Clever   ### **OneRoster API** The OneRoster API requires that students be active in order to be synced through the API. Once a school year ends, students are no longer active in the OneRoster API. This causes the synced data to no longer include enrollments or student files. You may see the following error in your Dashboard: "Encountered zero students data".  Once students and other record types are marked "Active" in Skyward for the next school year, the sync will resume as expected. Alternately, Clever will pull data 21 days prior to the beginning of the district's next active academic session. For example, if school begins on August 22nd, Clever will pull the upcoming data on August 1st. To preserve access for your users between school years, Clever recommends that you put your sync on pause during the summer to prevent deletions.   * * * ## Troubleshooting IMPORTANT The Skyward API Qmlativ integration does not support syncing non-teaching staff. The troubleshooting tips below for staff apply only to the Skyward LMS API sync. If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following:  

Record Type

Troubleshooting

Students
  • Student must have an Active SchoolID
  • Under Web Access, the login name and password fields need to be populated
  • 'Allow student access' must be checked
Teachers
  • Teacher must have an Active SchoolID
  • Teacher must have a status of isTeacher = true or isSubstitute = true
  • PrimarySchoolID must be assigned
Staff
  • Staff must have an active school association
  • Staff must have isTeacher = False
  • Title must be blank or contain one of the following key terms: 
    • Superintendent
    • Principal
    • Instruction
    • Curriculum
    • Director
    • Coordinator
    • Technology
    • Coach
    • Counselor
    • Admin
Sections
  • Is the Skyward instance on version 05.16.10.00.xx or newer?
To **prevent** a record from syncing, ensure it doesn't meet all the criteria listed above for its record type. If the record (student, teacher, section) is in Clever but data is missing or incorrect for the record (i.e. incorrect email, missing username), navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page. Here you can view which fields Clever is pulling for each record and field. In the below example:    1. If a teacher's email address was incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "StaffMember\_Email" field in Skyward 2. If a teacher is missing State\_teacher\_id, you will see that Clever is not currently pulling this data. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YFZJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DA5)   * * * ## Sync errors Below you can find solutions to common sync errors that may display in your Clever Dashboard.   

Error Message:

Context and resolution:

503 errorIf a Skyward API sync fails during this time, push another sync using the Sync Now button (Sync Settings page) after 6am PT and the 503 error should resolve itself.

Invalid sync settings for Skyward API. Please check your sync credentials. Status code 400 Bad Request

This error is most often caused by an invalid API certificate due to an incorrect or outdated login URL, consumer key, or consumer secret. To resolve:

  • Navigate to your API certificate for Clever in Skyward and confirm that the login URL and credentials on your Clever Dashboard > Sync > Settings page match. You may wish to regenerate your certificate and reenter credentials.

If this doesn’t resolve the error, please reach out to Skyward Support directly for further assistance.

We are having trouble connecting to your Skyward API. Please check your sync settings.

Access to the API is unavailable at the time of the sync.

  • Try pushing a sync later using the Sync Now button on our Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page page.

  • If the error doesn’t resolve, reach out to Skyward to see why the API is unavailable.

This error is most often caused by an invalid API certificate due to an incorrect or outdated login URL, consumer key, or consumer secret. To resolve:

  • Navigate to your API certificate for Clever in Skyward and confirm that the login URL and credentials on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS Sync > Settings page match. You may wish to regenerate your certificate and reenter credentials.

If this doesn’t resolve the error, please reach out to Skyward Support directly for further assistance.

If this doesn’t resolve the error, please reach out to Skyward Support directly for further assistance.

Invalid sync credentials for SIS. Please update the sync credentials.

This error is most often caused by an invalid API certificate due to an incorrect or outdated login URL, consumer key, or consumer secret. To resolve:

If this doesn’t resolve the error, please reach out to Skyward Support directly for further assistance.

URL must start with https://

  • Please confirm the URL on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync >  Settings page starts with https://
  • You may also want to confirm the the URL matches the API URL provided in Skyward.
* * * ## Special Characters The Skyward API Sync cannot sync data resources that contain forward slashes **/**, ampersands **&** , or hashes **#** in the ID value. If these special characters are present in any of the school ID or section ID records, the Auto Sync will fail. You will see an error on the [SIS sync page](https://schools.clever.com/sync) of the Dashboard. You can [sign up here](https://www.clever.com/district-signup) to talk to a specialist. The Bromcom sync integration allows Clever to connect to your Management Information System (MIS) and import data into Clever for Badges, rostering, and other services. To set up a Bromcom sync connection, please follow these directions: 1. Log in to [https://cloudmis.bromcom.com/](https://cloudmis.bromcom.com/) and navigate to Config > Setup > Partner Applications: ![Setup > Partner Applications menu in Bromcom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XG1B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bf9A5)  2. Your onboarding specialist will provide you with the name of the application you. See similar format below: _Clever-Trust-Name ![Apps in BromCom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XG1B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bf89C)_   3. Once you’ve found the application, click **Manage** and you’ll see what access permissions Clever is requesting: ![App details screen in BromCom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XG1B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bf9bV)  4. Click **Grant** and then **Confirm**. The application will then have a status of **Installed**_. ![Successful app install screen in Bromcom](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000XG1B&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000bf9y5)_   5. Once the application has been installed and accepted, our team will complete steps on our backend to complete the sync setup! * * * ## Customizations The Bromcom sync can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every four hours, but the time of day at which the sync occurs isn’t customizable.   * * * ## School year rollover We automatically pause your data each year to reduce disruption during your busiest time. Pausing the sync will enable you to update data in your MIS without interrupting pupil, teacher, or staff access over the summer. [Learn more about sync pauses here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507). Your syncs will be automatically paused in late July and resume in early September unless you manually modify the dates in the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) tab of your Dashboard. When you update your Pause dates, Clever also recommends updating your rollover dates in your sync settings. [Learn more about rollover dates here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886#Rolloverdate)    * * * ## Default field mappings Below are the default field mappings for Bromcom syncs managed by Clever. title: For Clever Admin: Instructions to remove Clever+ Extension
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001669#header1)  
2\. [Remove the Clever+ extension from Google Admin console](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001669#header2)  
3\. [Remove the Clever+ extension from Active Directory Group Policies](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001669#header3)

## Overview

If you need to remove the Clever+ Chrome extension because you no longer wish to gather [edtech analytics](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360039420391) data, please follow the instructions below. 

Please remember to [**install the Clever public extension**](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/clever/nopfnnpnopgmcnkjchnlpomggcdjfepo?hl=en&pli=1) after you’ve removed the Clever+ extension. The public extension helps Clever features work better, including Clever's [SSO (Saved Passwords)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/234746488) and [teacher login tools](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115005941566) (like opening a resource on student devices or logging students out of Clever). 

There are two ways to remove the extension: from your Google Admin console, or from Active Directory Group Policies (depending on your school organization's setup). 

* * *

## Remove the Clever+ extension from Google Admin console

1.  From your Google Admin console, go to **Devices > Chrome > Apps and extensions > Users and browsers.**
2.  Select the organization unit (OU) that you want to allow or block the extension for.
    -   Note: The OU will inherit the settings of the parent OU, but you can override per sub OU.
3.  Select the Clever+ extension.
4.  In the installation policy column, select **Block**.
5.  Click **Save.**

* * *

## Remove the Clever+ extension from Active Directory Group Policies

1.  In the Group Policy Editor, open the Google Chrome template you had created for the Clever+ extension.

![Screenshot of Active Directory Group Policy editor](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQMT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009pfWz)

2.  Browse to **Google > Google Chrome > Extension > Configure Extension installation blocklist**.
3.  In the settings, select **Enabled**.
4.  Click **Show.**
5.   Enter the app ID of the Clever+ extension.

![Screenshot of Block app id screen in Active Directory](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQMT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000009pg02)

title: Clever Roles: Switching between Clever accounts
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001714#header1)  
2\. [Login process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001714#header2)  
3\. [Switching accounts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001714#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001714#header4)

## Overview

Some Clever users have multiple types of accounts to accommodate the various roles and permissions they need within their district or school. Multiple accounts are often required when users work in various positions to support their schools.

For example, some teachers work as classroom teachers and IT support persons for their school. In this case, these users often have both a teacher and a staff account. They may use their teacher account to manage and interact with their students and the staff account to help manage sharing permissions at their school site.

Similarly, many administrators choose to add themselves as teachers in Clever to better understand the teacher experience. They’ll use their admin account for any administrative duties (troubleshooting logins, adjusting sharing permissions, adding applications) and use their teacher account to test out Teacher Pages or the Clever Library.

Clever empowers these users with multiple accounts to easily switch between accounts within their Clever Portal.

* * *

## Login process

You need to take no special steps when logging in to switch between your Clever accounts! As long as your various accounts have the same email address associated with them (or sis\_id if your email address isn’t syncing to Clever), the accounts will automatically be linked within Clever.

Generally, when you log in on a device for the first time, you’ll automatically log into the account with the lowest level permissions. For example, you'll be logged into your teacher account if you are both a district administrator and a teacher. Each time following this, Clever will remember which account you were logged into last on the device and log you into that account. 

At times, Clever may be able to identify that you are attempting to log in to a specific account. For example, if you use the district administrator login page, Clever will assume you are trying to log in to your admin account and automatically log into that account. You can still switch accounts once logged in.  
 

* * *

## Switching accounts

While Clever admin and teacher accounts may look very different, it can be trickier to differentiate between a staff and teacher portal! Simply click on your name in the top right corner to determine which account you are currently logged into.

To switch between accounts, click on which account you’d like to switch to. See this in action in the video below:

##   

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What if I do not see my other account listed in the drop-down?**

-   Clever wasn’t able to match your accounts based on the data syncing. Please work with a Clever Admin to review the data in Clever and ensure you have the same email address and sis\_id on both accounts.
    

**How does Clever know which account to log me into?**

-   By default, the first time you log in on a device, you’ll be logged into the account with the lowest permissions. For example, if you have a staff and teacher account, you’ll be logged into your teacher account. Each time after the first login, as long as you are on the same device, Clever will remember the account in which you ended your last session.
    
-   At times, Clever may be able to identify that you are attempting to log in to a specific account. For example, if you use the district administrator login page, Clever will assume you are trying to log in to your admin account and automatically log into that account. You can still switch accounts once logged in.
    

**How does Clever associate multiple user accounts?**

-   Clever references email address or sis\_id to match your accounts.
    

**What if my district or school utilizes Classroom MFA?**

-   Clever will prompt you for your MFA upon login but not when switching accounts. Clever will enforce the highest-ranking MFA policy for a multi-role user. For example, you will receive an admin MFA prompt if you are both a Clever Admin and a teacher.
    

**What if I am a Clever Admin that uses Clever’s MFA when logging in?**

-   Clever will enforce the highest-ranking MFA policy for a multi-role user. If you have Clever’s admin MFA configured, Clever will require your Clever Admin MFA method.
    

**If I disable access control for Clever logins for one of the non-DA roles (staff or teacher), can I still toggle between my role as a Clever Admin and a disabled user type?**

-   Yes, you can toggle between all roles if any of your roles are allowed to log in. For example, if teacher logins are disabled via access control, but you have both a Clever Admin and a teacher role, you'll be able to log in as a Clever Admin, and toggle to your teacher role still.

* * *

        •   [Login hints](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#loginhints)   
        •   [Customize login options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#customizeloginoptions)  
        •   [Tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#techsupportcontact)  
4\. [Resetting passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#header4)  
        •   [Clever admins resetting individual user passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#individualpws)  
        •   [Clever admins resetting all district passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#Cleveradmindistrictpw)  
        •   [Students, teachers, and staff resetting their passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#studentsteachersreset)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#FAQ)  
  

## Overview

In addition to other Clever-supported [Identity Providers (IdPs)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787) like [Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503) and [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576), districts and schools can also choose to utilize Clever passwords for Clever single sign-on (SSO). With Clever passwords, administrators determine what login credentials students, teachers, and staff will use to log in to Clever.

When users navigate to your school's Clever login page, they will enter their username and password. In cases where a district or school uses multiple IdPs, users will select 'Log in with Clever' to enter their credentials.

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008B7ZT)  Please note:**  
• Clever passwords are provisioned **once** and are not dynamically updated to match newly synced data from your Student Information System (SIS). District Administrators must manage passwords after the first provision. Please see [Static Credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#staticcredentials) and [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#configuringpasswordresetoptions) for more on this!  
  
• Provisioning Clever passwords takes approximately 15 minutes after they are initially configured or reset by editing. 

* * *

## Setting up Clever passwords

**To setup Clever passwords for your district:  
  
**

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)
2.  Select **Add Login Method**
3.  **Select Clever Passwords Authentication   
    ![Choose login method screenshot- Clever Passwords Authentication highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BLir)**  
4.  Select the user types that will log in to Clever with Clever passwords.   
    ![Screenshot of select user groups (students, teachers, staff)](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BLsX)   
      
    
5.  Work through steps 2-4 to enter the credentials you'd like for your students, teachers, and/or staff to enter when logging in to Clever. For guidance on choosing usernames and passwords see our sections below on [configuring credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#configuringcredentails) and [setting passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#configuringpasswordresetoptions). [Click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001577?language=en_US) for help with creating custom usernames/passwords.  
      
      
    ![Screenshot of steps 2-4: Setting up user credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000G7rft)    
      
    
6.  You will have different setting options for each user type. Look through them and check off the ones you'd like to set for that user type.   
    ![Selecting settings per user type screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElfpF)    
      
    
7.  Once usernames/passwords and settings are configured, you will be able to review them on the last step.  
      
      
    ![Preview report](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BG3G)   
      
    
8.  Click **Preview** accounts and **Provision** these new credentials.
9.  After completing the initial setup, Clever will automatically create or remove accounts for any users based on the data syncing from your SIS. Users' accounts will be created or deleted shortly after the SIS sync completes with Clever.

* * *

### Configuring credentials for students, teachers, and staff

There are a variety of usernames and passwords available based on the data that is synced to Clever from your Student Information System (SIS). Clever does recommend using the same provisioning configuration for both teachers and staff so that your multirole users have a consistent experience. To learn more about the multirole experience, [see this FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#multiroleprovisioning).

**Username Options:**

-   student number / teacher number / staff ID
-   email address
-   SIS ID
-   or the district username uploaded in your sync
    -   _For this option, you'll need to make sure your district has usernames populated in your SIS that are syncing to Clever. If you're syncing data to Clever via SFTP, please see the_ [_Clever SFTP Specifications_](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) _for instructions on adding usernames. If you're using an Auto Sync, please contact_ [_Clever support_](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) _so we can assist with adding this information into the Clever sync._

**Password options:**

-   Student number / teacher number / staff ID
-   SIS ID
-   Birthday in the following formats: MM/DD/YYYY; MMDDYYYY; M/D/YYYY
-   Random String (ex: \*kJkJ4J5)
-   Random Word
-   District password uploaded in your sync
    -   _For this option, you'll need to make sure your district has passwords populated in your SIS that are syncing to Clever. If you're syncing data to Clever via SFTP, please see the_ [_Clever SFTP Specifications_](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) _for instructions on adding usernames. If you're using an Auto Sync, please contact_ [_Clever support_](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) _so we can assist with adding this information into the Clever sync._
-   Custom password (these can be an individual word(s), or a custom formula
    -   Learn more about [creating custom formulas here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555#header4).
-   IDM generated password - Districts that use Clever IDM can use the password they use for Google, Entra, or Active Directory for Clever Passwords also. [Learn more about Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466).

**Password requirements for individual passwords:**

-   Students: 6 character minimum / Teachers or Staff: 8 character minimum
-   Not the user’s current username
-   Not the user’s current email address
-   If the new password has been made public in an unrelated data breach, it will not be allowed
-   Not the same as the current password
-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

**Password advice:**

-   Combine random words to create a secure but memorable password. For example: “truck-dog-fly”
-   Password exports are available for a short, limited amount of time if enabled. Refer to [step 6](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#step6) to learn how to enable this. 

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El6Mu)   Please note:** You can also complement your Clever passwords setup with an SSO Policy that dictates exactly which users can (or can’t) utilize Clever passwords for logins. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602).

* * *

### Configuring password reset and account recovery options

Administrators can always reset student or teacher passwords individually or by user type. Please see [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038?language=en_US#ResettingPasswords) for more on how to reset a user’s password.

You can also customize password reset settings for staff, teachers, and students. Password reset options can be configured via your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Password Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/passwordsettings).In **Step 1: Select Identity Providers,** you’ll select the IdP for which you want to configure password and account reset settings. For Clever passwords, select **Clever**.

In **Step 2**: **Select user groups**, you’ll be able to check boxes to determine if users can change their own passwords, as well as delegate if you’d like teachers and staff to be able to reset student passwords. You can also configure settings so that only students in specific grades or schools can reset their passwords.

![Screenshot of student password reset settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Elh1R)  
  

In the next steps, you’ll configure password requirements and account recovery settings for each selected user group (students, teachers, or staff).

![Screenshot of option for domain blocking](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000LIee1)

Setting up account recovery methods will allow your users to receive either an SMS or email or answer security questions to regain access to their Clever account if they forget their Clever passwords credentials.

If your schools use Classroom MFA, and SMS or voice calls are used as MFA methods in one of your district's MFA policies, SMS can’t be selected as a recovery method.  
  
If you select SMS or email as an account recovery method, you’ll also have the option to choose a Clever field as the default for account recovery. For example, if you select email as the account recovery option, you can use an [extension field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) with the student’s personal email addresses as the default for student account recovery. Users can update the account recovery SMS number or email later. However, selecting a bulk field ensures that users have at least one recovery method defined without relying on the end user to configure it. The automatic account recovery information will stay up-to-date if the data in the Clever field changes.

If you select Email as a recovery method, you’ll also have the option to block users from using a specific domain for email recovery. Please include all domains you’d like to block on the initial setup. Adding additional domains after setup will remove users who previously set up a recovery email with that domain from receiving reset emails.  
  
An example of a domain you may wish to block is your Google Workspace domain if your users use Google credentials for SSO to access Clever. Suppose your users have forgotten their Google password when logging into Clever. They’ll also have forgotten their Google password for email, which means they can't access the recovery email sent if they use their school Google account as their recovery email. Blocking this domain can help prevent users from using an email they won't have access to for recovery.

A note about password management with Clever Identity Management (IDM)

If you use Clever IDM you’ll also have the option to manage password resets for any destination you provision via Clever IDM such as Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID. For any IdP that you choose to reset passwords for, passwords will synchronize across accounts. This means your users will have the same password for any account managed by Clever.

For example, if you use Clever IDM to manage Google, and you use both Google and Clever passwords as identity providers for Clever, you’ll be able to configure password reset settings for both Google and Clever passwords. When a student updates their password via Clever, the password will update in Google as well. The passwords will sync across all accounts managed by Clever.

* * *

### Static Credentials

After the initial setup of Clever passwords for your district, user passwords won’t be dynamically updated as new or updated data is synced to Clever from your SIS.

-   **For example:** If your district has set up student passwords to be their birthdates, and then you update a student's birthdate in your SIS, their password will not automatically be updated in Clever to reflect the new birthdate. 

To resolve this, it is sometimes necessary to manually update a student or teacher's password in Clever, or run a password reset for all students, teachers or staff. Please see [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038?language=en_US#ResettingPasswords) for more on this.

Due to recent updates in the Clever passwords configuration, you now have the option to enable automatic username updates based on data from your SIS or changes to your Clever passwords username configuration.

If this box is checked, usernames will be updated any time the synced data referenced in your username formula is updated or if you update the formula itself. For example, if your username formula references the {{name.last}} field, and a user’s last name changes in your SIS, their last name will be updated in their username automatically once the new last name syncs to Clever.

![Checkbox to Keep usernames updated](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000G7qlS)

You can also use this checkbox to update usernames in bulk. See [our FAQ here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#bulkreset) for more information.

If you don't see the checkbox to **Keep usernames updated** as you set up student, teacher, or staff credentials, please reach out to Clever Support to learn more about enabling this feature for your district.

* * *

## District Details and Login Hints

### Login Hints

To help district users, you can add login hints for Clever passwords that will appear on your district's Clever login page (e.g. _Student Password_ = _10-digit Student Number_, _Teacher Username_ = _Teacher ID_).

To add login hints, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Customize tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/customize). In the example below, a hint is provided for the _Login with Clever option._

![Login hint](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000osH8m)

### Customize login options

The Clever login page can be further customized by:

-   Editing selection option text (e.g. Log in with Google or Google Login)
-   Editing login method order

![Editing IdP order on login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BLni)

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008B7ZT) Please note:** These options are only available if you have multiple IdP SSO methods set up in Clever. If Clever passwords is your only SSO method, users will simply see a username and password box when accessing your district portal, and will not be provided with a selection option.

### Tech support contact

We also highly recommend you enter a Tech Support Contact for your district to assist users with difficulties logging in to Clever. This information will be available to users on your district's Clever login page. The Tech Support Contact can be added by navigating to [Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol). This field is located in the top left, as seen below. 

![Tech support contact edit box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BN4j)

![Highlight around Get help on login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ot7qT)   ![Image with highlight around District contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ot3zm)   
![District contact email as it appears from login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ot8Ht)  

  **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BMmz)  Clever Tip:** The Tech Support Contact field can contain an individual or multiple email addresses, a URL for a website, or a directional sentence letting users know what to do in the event of login issues.  

###   
  

* * *

## Resetting passwords

If a student or teacher forgets their password, or you need to complete a reset due to changing SIS data and static credentials, you can manually update a student or teacher's password in Clever, or run a password reset for all students, teachers, or staff.

Depending on your current [Password Settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/passwordsettings) for each user type, the password reset option might be available for some users to reset their own passwords or for teachers to reset student passwords.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElhuH)   Please note:** Account recovery and password reset options have recently been updated in Clever. If your password reset flows do not match those described below, please reach out to our support team and we’d be happy to help update you to the newest system!

As is mentioned above, if you are currently utilizing Clever IDM with Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID password resets will synchronize across all accounts you’ve configured account recovery and password resets for.

### Clever admins resetting individual user passwords

Clever Admins can manually reset passwords for individual students, teachers, and staff members.

1.  Use the search bar at the top of the Clever Dashboard to search for and view the student or teacher, or staff member's profile.
2.  In the top right, click **Support tools > Change Clever password.** If you have multiple identity providers in Clever, you may see **Support tools > Change password** instead.  
    ![Set new password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Elk8z)  
3.  Enter a new password and then confirm that password.
4.  Click **Save.**

###  Clever admins resetting all district passwords

1.   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
2.  Select the **Edit settings** option for Clever Passwords.
    -   To reset ALL users of that type back to the default setting or to the new credentials set for their user type (student, teacher, or staff), check the box to **Reset all credentials**.   
        ![Reset all usernames and passwords](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BNPh)   
          
        
    -   To force ALL users of that type (student, teacher, or staff) to reset their passwords on the next login, check the box for **Students must change their password on next login**.  
        ![Student must change password settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BNUX)   
          
        
    -   To update permissions for who can update their passwords check the appropriate box in the permissions section for each user type and continue through all user types to save your updates.

_For additional information, please visit_: [Clever Passwords: Troubleshooting User Login Issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/208333118).

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008B7ZT) Please note:** Any changes made to your Clever passwords configuration will take about 15 minutes to complete after clicking **P****rovision accounts** in the final step of setup.

**Resetting all passwords for a third-party destinations managed through Clever IDM**

If your district is using Clever IDM to provision passwords for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID, please contact the Clever Support team to bulk reset user passwords. [You can learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662#header4).

### Students, teachers, and staff resetting their passwords

Depending on the settings you’ve configured, students, teachers, and staff may have the ability to reset their passwords. If password resets are enabled, users will be able to reset their passwords both on the Clever Login screen at your district’s Portal URL, as well as within the Clever Portal itself.

For districts that only utilize Clever Passwords for logins, users must have an email address in Clever for the password resets from the login screen to work.  
  

For instructions on how each individual user type can reset their own passwords, please see the relevant article below:

1.  [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)
2.  [For School Tech Leads: Account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026004792)
3.  [For Students: Password recovery and resets](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Why isn't my student's password updating when I updated it in our SIS?**

-   Clever passwords are not dynamically updated to match newly synced data from your SIS. Please see our section on [static credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001658#staticcredentials) above.

**Is it possible to bulk reset usernames?**

-   Yes! If you’d like the bulk reset or change your usernames for students, teachers, or staff, check the box to Keep usernames updated when setting credentials for your Clever passwords setup. To update the usernames, either update the data syncing from your SIS or change the formula used to generate usernames.

**What if I need help to create a custom formula for passwords?**

-   Please contact Clever Support for further assistance with custom Clever passwords formulas.

**What if there are two users with the same username?**

-   If you have checked the **Keep usernames updated** option in your Clever passwords configuration, Clever will automatically resolve any conflicting usernames by adding a number to the end.
-   For example, if username john.smith already exists, Clever will automatically append a 1 at the end for the second John Smith’s account (john.smith1). If a third John Smith joins the district, they’ll receive the username john.smith2.
-   If the original John Smith (john.smith) username is removed, the following usernames will remain the same (john.smith1 and john.smith2).

**How is provisioning handled for users who have both teacher and non-teaching staff accounts in Clever?**

-   Clever recommends setting the same provisioning configuration for teachers and staff to ensure a consistent login experience for multirole users.
-   Once logged in, users with both teacher and staff accounts in Clever can switch between accounts in their Clever Portal. [Learn more about switching between accounts here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001714) Setting up separate configurations for teachers and staff in Clever Passwords won’t limit access between accounts, as users can easily toggle between the two once logged in.
-   If you choose to configure separate login credentials for teachers and staff, teacher credentials will take precedence over staff credentials, unless Clever created the staff credentials before the teacher account and credentials.  
    For example, if you provision Clever Passwords for both teachers and staff, and a user has both a teacher and a staff account in Clever, both roles will be provisioned using the teacher credentials.  
    Alternatively, consider an individual who's already a staff user in Clever and Clever has provisioned their credentials. Later, you add the user to Clever as a teacher. In this case, their staff credentials will remain intact.  
    Another example is if you decide to provision only staff credentials via Clever passwords initially. Clever will create staff credentials for login, and if the user also has a teacher account, they'll be able to toggle to it in their Portal once logged in. Later, you configure the teacher credential provisioning. The original staff credentials will persist for any user who had a staff account before you set up teacher provisioning.

**Who can reset user's passwords?**

-   This depends on the settings you configure during your Clever passwords setup. You can also update these settings at any time via your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.

**What happens when a new user is added to my account? How long before they can log in?**

-   When you add a new user to your Clever account, they'll have Clever passwords credentials automatically generated as soon as the Clever password provisioner runs just after your SIS sync with Clever. If your SIS sync doesn't change any data affecting Clever password credentials, the Clever password provisioner won't run.

**What do I do if Clever passwords are not working for a whole user type: students, teachers, or staff**

-   Check to ensure that you enabled Clever passwords for that user type on Step 4 of Setting up Clever passwords.
    

**Should I configure Clever passwords for user types that won’t be using them regularly?**

-   A security best practice is to reduce the number of access pathways there are to accounts. Only enable Clever passwords for the user types that will be using them regularly.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)
-   [Troubleshooting: Clever passwords login issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/208333118)
