title: For Clever Admin: Account claim email notifications for new users
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001708#header1)  
2\. [Setting up notifications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001708#header2)  
3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001708#header3)

## Overview

In addition to setting up [account claim](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001695) for new users, you can also trigger an automated email. This feature is exclusively available to [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001466) customers and those on our updated [Clever Passwords SSO method](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658).

This article will guide you through the process of setting up automated emails, so your users are promptly and securely informed about their new accounts. If you’re **only** looking for account claim (without a notification) [see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001695).  
 

* * *

## Setting up notifications

1.  Head to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Account Notifications.](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)
2.  Choose a user type to start with.

![Screenshot of Account claim notification screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQCn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K2Mlj)

3.  You have two options:
    -   Send an email informing users of their new account, without providing a link to access the account. In this case, your users will need to receive their login credentials in some other way, like directly from their supervisor or teacher, or by using [Account Claim](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001696#header2).
        
    -   Send an email with a custom secure link for users to set up their new account.
        

![Screenshot of Account claim notification options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQCn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K2iUT)

4.  If you chose to create an account claim link as part of the notification, you’ll need to determine the password format. Skip this step if you chose Account creation email. Users can either set their own password or have one generated for them. 
    -   If users set their own passwords, it must meet the complexity requirements your school organization has set in [Password Settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/passwordsettings).
        
    -   A generated password uses the template you determined in [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) (for Google, Active Directory and/or Entra ID) or Clever Passwords if using [the updated version of Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658).
        

![Screenshot of password setting and expiration option screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQCn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K2jqL)

5.  If you chose to create an account claim link, decide how many days before the claim link expires. After expiration, the link will no longer grant access to see or set the user’s password.
    
6.  Select the destination(s). A separate email will be sent for each destination you select. If you would like all destinations to have synced passwords, we recommend only sending a notification for the destination your users use to log into Clever, and ensuring that users must reset password on first login. 
    

![Screenshot of Account claim destination options](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQCn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K2ksr)

7.  Select the data field from your sync that contains the end user’s existing email address. Please confirm that it’s accurate, as this is where email notifications will go for new users. Be sure to select a field containing an email address that your end users already have access to.

![Screenshot of email section option for Account Claim notifications](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQCn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K2lc1)

8.  Review the email template and add an optional custom message. This is the perfect place to include any additional instructions and recommended next steps for your users.
9.  Click **Enable Account Notifications for \[user type\]** to turn notifications on. Then, click **Complete setup**.

![Screenshot of email template in account notifications wizard](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cQCn&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000K2mGL)

Once an account is created, users will receive an email notification (with or without their claim link, depending on how you configured it).

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Can we use account claim** **_and_** **account notifications?**

-   Yes: you might set up notifications for users who have an accurate email on file (like teachers). On the other hand, you could use account claim without notifications for users like new students who might not have a reliable email account on file with the school organization.
    

**How do I ensure that my end users have synchronized passwords across destinations?**

1.  Determine the user’s login method to access Clever. For example, do your user’s log into Clever using Google, SAML, or Clever passwords?
    
2.  Configure a notification for the destination that users will use to access Clever.
    
3.  In Password Settings, ensure that users can reset all destinations that you want in sync.
    
4.  In Password Settings, ensure that users will have to reset their password on their first login.
    

User experience:

1.  Users will receive the notification for the destination they use to log into Clever allowing them to see or set their password for that destination
    
2.  Users will log into Clever using the password that they set or saw in step 1
    
3.  Users will be prompted to reset their password. When they reset their password in Clever, the password for every enabled destination in Password Settings for that user type will now be synchronized. 
    

**Why should I choose a data field that contains verified email addresses?**

-   The recipient of the email will receive notification of the creation of their new accounts and may, if configured to send a link, gain access to that account. Using unverified email addresses may grant access to the incorrect recipient.
    

**Why should I choose a data field that contains an email address that users already have access to?**

-   Your end users need to already have access to the email address that you are sending the notification to. For example, if you select a field containing the Gmail address of your users to grant them access to their Google account, they will never be able to log into that Google account to read that Gmail.
    

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Clever Admin: Setting up account claim for your users](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001695)

title: Troubleshooting: Clever passwords login issues
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333118#one)  
2\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333118#troubleshoot_login_logs)  
3\. [Troubleshooting Checklist](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333118#two)  
4. [Resetting passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333118#five)

##   
Overview

In addition to other Clever-supported [Identity Providers (IdPs)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787) like [Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503) and [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576), districts can also choose to utilize Clever passwords for Clever single sign-on (SSO). With Clever passwords, district admins determine which login credentials should be used for students, teachers, and staff. These credentials are configured from the [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.  
  
When district users navigate to your district's [Clever Portal URL](https://schools.clever.com/portal/settings), they will enter their username and password. In cases where a district uses multiple IdPs, users will select **Log in with Clever** to enter their credentials.  

Occasionally, users will have issues logging in, and troubleshooting is required by a Clever Admin. This article details the recommended steps for troubleshooting and resolving Clever Passwords user login issues.  
 

For information about single sign-on (SSO) with Clever passwords, including how to set it up, please [read this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038). 

* * *

##   
Troubleshooting

Occasionally errors do occur with Clever passwords logins. Here are the common errors that we identify, and how to resolve them:  
  

-   **Wrong Password**  
    -   The user input the wrong password associated with their account. Please [reset their password](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001658#header4) and have them attempt to login again.
-   **Username matches to multiple users in Clever**  
    -   Please check your data in Clever to ensure that each user has a unique username for Clever passwords logins.
-   **The ID used during login doesn't match any user in Clever**
    -   There isn't a user with the given username in Clever. Please check your [SSO Settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) and the user's profile page to confirm their Clever passwords username.

* * *

##   
Troubleshooting Checklist

In addition to the Troubleshoot login tool mentioned above, you can use these tips if you need additional support:

-   The user must have an active Clever account.
-   The fields the district is using for username and password for Clever passwords must be populated for the student, teacher, or staff. Review the current fields being used on the [SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) page.
-   Confirm if the values in the above fields are unique for each user. **The username must be unique**.
-   Try resetting their password using the directions found [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333118#five).
-   If resetting the password does not work, it is possible credentials need to be re-synced. To re-sync credentials, follow the directions found [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/208333118#h_01EPYXES8VK81H6R7MZ9GBM4HY). 
-   If a user is excluded from using Clever passwords via [SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203166787#ssopolicy), they'll see a "sso\_policy\_exclusion error" if they try to log in, which indicates that the user entered the correct Clever password username and password combination to log in, but the user isn't allowed to use Clever passwords to login. This will also show up in login logs, which are explained below. 

* * *

## Resetting Passwords

It is important to note that after the initial setup of Clever passwords for your district, user passwords will _not_ be dynamically updated as new or updated data is synced to Clever from your SIS.

-   **For example,** _If your district has set up student passwords to be their birthdates, and then you update a student's birthdate in your SIS, their password will **not** automatically be updated in Clever to reflect the new birthdate._ 

To resolve this, it is sometimes necessary to manually update a student or teacher's password in Clever or run a password reset for all students, teachers, or staff.   
  
Depending on your current [SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/settings) for each user type, the password reset option might be available for some users to reset their own passwords or for teachers to reset student passwords. Users who reset their own passwords must have an email address in Clever for the password reset to work. 

###   
  
****Reset Password (Directions for Teacher/Student)****

1.  From the district's login page, select **Get help logging in!**
2.  Select **Reset your password** and enter your school-provided email address
3.  An email will be sent with a link to reset your password

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkU5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If your district has enabled this feature, teachers can reset student passwords by following the instructions in this article: [For Teachers: Troubleshooting student login issues.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888)

 

### **Reset Password (Directions for Clever Admin)**

#### _To reset individual user passwords:_

Clever Admins can manually reset passwords for individual students, teachers, and staff members.

1.  Use the search bar at the top of the Clever Dashboard to search for and view the student or teacher's profile
2.  In the top right, click **Support tools > Set new Clever password**

![Screenshot of the Set new password screen for individual password reset](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TkU5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000FvPO)

3.  Enter a new password and then confirm that password
4.  If you wish to require users to change their password upon their next login, check off the box to do so
5.  Click **Save**

####   
_To reset all credentials back to the default setting by user type (student, teacher, or staff):_

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
2.  Select the **Edit settings** option for Clever passwords
3.  If you would like to reset all student passwords, check the box **Reset all student usernames and passwords now**. If you do not want student passwords updated, leave the box unchecked
4.  Select **Next**  
5.  You can also choose to reset teacher and staff credentials in steps 2 and 3 if desired
6.  Select **Next** until you get to the option to **Save**
7.  Please allow up to 15 minutes for Clever to reset all passwords. Once complete, users will be able to log in with their default credentials.

title: For Substitutes: Substitute Access to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001674#header1)  
2\. [How it works](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001674#header2)

## Overview

The new Substitute Access feature in Clever allows you to easily access the resources and Teacher Page set up by the teacher for the day. Using a unique Sub Badge provided in the teacher’s sub plans, you’ll be able to log in and view only the specific materials and tools needed to manage the classroom’s online resources. This ensures that you have everything you need to support the students without needing the teacher’s personal login credentials.  
 

* * *

## How it works

On the day you are subbing, follow the steps below to gain access to the teacher’s Teacher Page and resources:

1.  Navigate to www.clever.com/badges. 
    
2.  Scan your Substitute Badge that the teacher provided to log in.
    
3.  That’s it! Now just click on whichever resource you need to access for the class. 

When you click on a resource, if it is an application, you will be logged in as the teacher you are subbing for. Please proceed with caution and make sure to only access the things needed for instruction!

You may notice that some applications are grey and inaccessible. These are applications that the school’s Clever Admin has chosen not to provide substitute access to for security reasons. Please contact your school's IT team if you need to access one of these applications.

![Example image of a blocked application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfw9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Npmzr) 

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfw9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000NpJpn)  Please note:** Google Suite and PowerSchool applications are always restricted applications for security reasons.

  
If you receive this notification when attempting to log in, your Sub Badge has either expired or been voided. Please reach out to the teacher you’re covering for or your school’s IT team for assistance.

![Badge expiration notification](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfw9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ozQgk)

title: For App Partners: Substitute Access to Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001673#header1)  
2\. [The app experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001673#header2)

## Overview

Our new Substitute Access to Clever feature makes it easy for teachers to securely provide temporary access to Clever for their substitute. Instead of sharing their personal login credentials, teachers can now generate a Sub Badge that allows substitutes to log in and view the resources and Teacher Page they have provided them access to. This allows teachers to maintain secure credentials while also giving substitutes the tools they need to manage their online resources effectively for the day.  
 

* * *

## The app experience

If a district toggles this feature on, subs will then be able to log in as the teacher in Clever and access their applications. The access given to the substitute will only last for 14 days and will auto-expire, unless the teacher suspends access before the auto-expire date.

  
Since this is just providing access to the sub as the main teacher while they are out, the licensing for the district will **not** be affected by this new feature.

District and school Clever Admins have the option to customize which applications substitute teachers will be able to access. They may block any application if they see substitute access as a security concern. Blocking an application will only block the substitute from impersonating into the application as the teacher. Students and the primary teacher will still have access. If the substitute has access through their own Clever Portal, they will also maintain this access.  
 

* * *

title: Single Sign-On (SSO): Clever passwords - Log in with Clever
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#header1)  
2\. [Setting up Clever passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#header2)  
        •  [To setup Clever passwords for your district](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#setupcp)        •   [Configuring credentials for students, teachers, and staff](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#configuringcredentails)  
        •   [Configuring password reset and account recovery options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#configuringpasswordresetoptions)        •   [Static credentials  
](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#staticcredentials)3\. [District details and login hints](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#header3)  
        •   [Login hints](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#loginhints)   
        •   [Customize login options](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#customizeloginoptions)  
        •   [Tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#techsupportcontact)  
4\. [Resetting passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#header4)  
        •   [Clever admins resetting individual user passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#individualpws)  
        •   [Clever admins resetting all district passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#Cleveradmindistrictpw)  
        •   [Students, teachers, and staff resetting their passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#studentsteachersreset)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#FAQ)  
  

## Overview

In addition to other Clever-supported [Identity Providers (IdPs)](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203166787) like [Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503) and [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576), districts and schools can also choose to utilize Clever passwords for Clever single sign-on (SSO). With Clever passwords, administrators determine what login credentials students, teachers, and staff will use to log in to Clever.

When users navigate to your school's Clever login page, they will enter their username and password. In cases where a district or school uses multiple IdPs, users will select 'Log in with Clever' to enter their credentials.

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008B7ZT)  Please note:**  
• Clever passwords are provisioned **once** and are not dynamically updated to match newly synced data from your Student Information System (SIS). District Administrators must manage passwords after the first provision. Please see [Static Credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#staticcredentials) and [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#configuringpasswordresetoptions) for more on this!  
  
• Provisioning Clever passwords takes approximately 15 minutes after they are initially configured or reset by editing. 

* * *

## Setting up Clever passwords

**To setup Clever passwords for your district:  
  
**

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol)
2.  Select **Add Login Method**
3.  **Select Clever Passwords Authentication   
    ![Choose login method screenshot- Clever Passwords Authentication highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BLir)**  
4.  Select the user types that will log in to Clever with Clever passwords.   
    ![Screenshot of select user groups (students, teachers, staff)](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BLsX)   
      
    
5.  Work through steps 2-4 to enter the credentials you'd like for your students, teachers, and/or staff to enter when logging in to Clever. For guidance on choosing usernames and passwords see our sections below on [configuring credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#configuringcredentails) and [setting passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#configuringpasswordresetoptions). [Click here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001577?language=en_US) for help with creating custom usernames/passwords.  
      
      
    ![Screenshot of steps 2-4: Setting up user credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000G7rft)    
      
    
6.  You will have different setting options for each user type. Look through them and check off the ones you'd like to set for that user type.   
    ![Selecting settings per user type screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElfpF)    
      
    
7.  Once usernames/passwords and settings are configured, you will be able to review them on the last step.  
      
      
    ![Preview report](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BG3G)   
      
    
8.  Click **Preview** accounts and **Provision** these new credentials.
9.  After completing the initial setup, Clever will automatically create or remove accounts for any users based on the data syncing from your SIS. Users' accounts will be created or deleted shortly after the SIS sync completes with Clever.

* * *

### Configuring credentials for students, teachers, and staff

There are a variety of usernames and passwords available based on the data that is synced to Clever from your Student Information System (SIS). Clever does recommend using the same provisioning configuration for both teachers and staff so that your multirole users have a consistent experience. To learn more about the multirole experience, [see this FAQ](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#multiroleprovisioning).

**Username Options:**

-   student number / teacher number / staff ID
-   email address
-   SIS ID
-   or the district username uploaded in your sync
    -   _For this option, you'll need to make sure your district has usernames populated in your SIS that are syncing to Clever. If you're syncing data to Clever via SFTP, please see the_ [_Clever SFTP Specifications_](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) _for instructions on adding usernames. If you're using an Auto Sync, please contact_ [_Clever support_](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) _so we can assist with adding this information into the Clever sync._

**Password options:**

-   Student number / teacher number / staff ID
-   SIS ID
-   Birthday in the following formats: MM/DD/YYYY; MMDDYYYY; M/D/YYYY
-   Random String (ex: \*kJkJ4J5)
-   Random Word
-   District password uploaded in your sync
    -   _For this option, you'll need to make sure your district has passwords populated in your SIS that are syncing to Clever. If you're syncing data to Clever via SFTP, please see the_ [_Clever SFTP Specifications_](https://schools.clever.com/files/clever-sftp.pdf) _for instructions on adding usernames. If you're using an Auto Sync, please contact_ [_Clever support_](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) _so we can assist with adding this information into the Clever sync._
-   Custom password (these can be an individual word(s), or a custom formula
    -   Learn more about [creating custom formulas here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555#header4).
-   IDM generated password - Districts that use Clever IDM can use the password they use for Google, Entra, or Active Directory for Clever Passwords also. [Learn more about Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466).

**Password requirements for individual passwords:**

-   Students: 6 character minimum / Teachers or Staff: 8 character minimum
-   Not the user’s current username
-   Not the user’s current email address
-   If the new password has been made public in an unrelated data breach, it will not be allowed
-   Not the same as the current password
-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

**Password advice:**

-   Combine random words to create a secure but memorable password. For example: “truck-dog-fly”
-   Password exports are available for a short, limited amount of time if enabled. Refer to [step 6](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#step6) to learn how to enable this. 

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El6Mu)   Please note:** You can also complement your Clever passwords setup with an SSO Policy that dictates exactly which users can (or can’t) utilize Clever passwords for logins. [Learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602).

* * *

### Configuring password reset and account recovery options

Administrators can always reset student or teacher passwords individually or by user type. Please see [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038?language=en_US#ResettingPasswords) for more on how to reset a user’s password.

You can also customize password reset settings for staff, teachers, and students. Password reset options can be configured via your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Password Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/passwordsettings).In **Step 1: Select Identity Providers,** you’ll select the IdP for which you want to configure password and account reset settings. For Clever passwords, select **Clever**.

In **Step 2**: **Select user groups**, you’ll be able to check boxes to determine if users can change their own passwords, as well as delegate if you’d like teachers and staff to be able to reset student passwords. You can also configure settings so that only students in specific grades or schools can reset their passwords.

![Screenshot of student password reset settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Elh1R)  
  

In the next steps, you’ll configure password requirements and account recovery settings for each selected user group (students, teachers, or staff).

![Screenshot of option for domain blocking](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000LIee1)

Setting up account recovery methods will allow your users to receive either an SMS or email or answer security questions to regain access to their Clever account if they forget their Clever passwords credentials.

If your schools use Classroom MFA, and SMS or voice calls are used as MFA methods in one of your district's MFA policies, SMS can’t be selected as a recovery method.  
  
If you select SMS or email as an account recovery method, you’ll also have the option to choose a Clever field as the default for account recovery. For example, if you select email as the account recovery option, you can use an [extension field](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912) with the student’s personal email addresses as the default for student account recovery. Users can update the account recovery SMS number or email later. However, selecting a bulk field ensures that users have at least one recovery method defined without relying on the end user to configure it. The automatic account recovery information will stay up-to-date if the data in the Clever field changes.

If you select Email as a recovery method, you’ll also have the option to block users from using a specific domain for email recovery. Please include all domains you’d like to block on the initial setup. Adding additional domains after setup will remove users who previously set up a recovery email with that domain from receiving reset emails.  
  
An example of a domain you may wish to block is your Google Workspace domain if your users use Google credentials for SSO to access Clever. Suppose your users have forgotten their Google password when logging into Clever. They’ll also have forgotten their Google password for email, which means they can't access the recovery email sent if they use their school Google account as their recovery email. Blocking this domain can help prevent users from using an email they won't have access to for recovery.

A note about password management with Clever Identity Management (IDM)

If you use Clever IDM you’ll also have the option to manage password resets for any destination you provision via Clever IDM such as Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID. For any IdP that you choose to reset passwords for, passwords will synchronize across accounts. This means your users will have the same password for any account managed by Clever.

For example, if you use Clever IDM to manage Google, and you use both Google and Clever passwords as identity providers for Clever, you’ll be able to configure password reset settings for both Google and Clever passwords. When a student updates their password via Clever, the password will update in Google as well. The passwords will sync across all accounts managed by Clever.

* * *

### Static Credentials

After the initial setup of Clever passwords for your district, user passwords won’t be dynamically updated as new or updated data is synced to Clever from your SIS.

-   **For example:** If your district has set up student passwords to be their birthdates, and then you update a student's birthdate in your SIS, their password will not automatically be updated in Clever to reflect the new birthdate. 

To resolve this, it is sometimes necessary to manually update a student or teacher's password in Clever, or run a password reset for all students, teachers or staff. Please see [Resetting Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889038?language=en_US#ResettingPasswords) for more on this.

Due to recent updates in the Clever passwords configuration, you now have the option to enable automatic username updates based on data from your SIS or changes to your Clever passwords username configuration.

If this box is checked, usernames will be updated any time the synced data referenced in your username formula is updated or if you update the formula itself. For example, if your username formula references the {{name.last}} field, and a user’s last name changes in your SIS, their last name will be updated in their username automatically once the new last name syncs to Clever.

![Checkbox to Keep usernames updated](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000G7qlS)

You can also use this checkbox to update usernames in bulk. See [our FAQ here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#bulkreset) for more information.

If you don't see the checkbox to **Keep usernames updated** as you set up student, teacher, or staff credentials, please reach out to Clever Support to learn more about enabling this feature for your district.

* * *

## District Details and Login Hints

### Login Hints

To help district users, you can add login hints for Clever passwords that will appear on your district's Clever login page (e.g. _Student Password_ = _10-digit Student Number_, _Teacher Username_ = _Teacher ID_).

To add login hints, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > Customize tab](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/customize). In the example below, a hint is provided for the _Login with Clever option._

![Login hint](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000osH8m)

### Customize login options

The Clever login page can be further customized by:

-   Editing selection option text (e.g. Log in with Google or Google Login)
-   Editing login method order

![Editing IdP order on login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BLni)

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008B7ZT) Please note:** These options are only available if you have multiple IdP SSO methods set up in Clever. If Clever passwords is your only SSO method, users will simply see a username and password box when accessing your district portal, and will not be provided with a selection option.

### Tech support contact

We also highly recommend you enter a Tech Support Contact for your district to assist users with difficulties logging in to Clever. This information will be available to users on your district's Clever login page. The Tech Support Contact can be added by navigating to [Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol). This field is located in the top left, as seen below. 

![Tech support contact edit box](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BN4j)

![Highlight around Get help on login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ot7qT)   ![Image with highlight around District contact](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ot3zm)   
![District contact email as it appears from login screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ot8Ht)  

  **![lightbulb](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BMmz)  Clever Tip:** The Tech Support Contact field can contain an individual or multiple email addresses, a URL for a website, or a directional sentence letting users know what to do in the event of login issues.  

###   
  

* * *

## Resetting passwords

If a student or teacher forgets their password, or you need to complete a reset due to changing SIS data and static credentials, you can manually update a student or teacher's password in Clever, or run a password reset for all students, teachers, or staff.

Depending on your current [Password Settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/passwordsettings) for each user type, the password reset option might be available for some users to reset their own passwords or for teachers to reset student passwords.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElhuH)   Please note:** Account recovery and password reset options have recently been updated in Clever. If your password reset flows do not match those described below, please reach out to our support team and we’d be happy to help update you to the newest system!

As is mentioned above, if you are currently utilizing Clever IDM with Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID password resets will synchronize across all accounts you’ve configured account recovery and password resets for.

### Clever admins resetting individual user passwords

Clever Admins can manually reset passwords for individual students, teachers, and staff members.

1.  Use the search bar at the top of the Clever Dashboard to search for and view the student or teacher, or staff member's profile.
2.  In the top right, click **Support tools > Change Clever password.** If you have multiple identity providers in Clever, you may see **Support tools > Change password** instead.  
    ![Set new password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Elk8z)  
3.  Enter a new password and then confirm that password.
4.  Click **Save.**

###  Clever admins resetting all district passwords

1.   Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.
2.  Select the **Edit settings** option for Clever Passwords.
    -   To reset ALL users of that type back to the default setting or to the new credentials set for their user type (student, teacher, or staff), check the box to **Reset all credentials**.   
        ![Reset all usernames and passwords](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BNPh)   
          
        
    -   To force ALL users of that type (student, teacher, or staff) to reset their passwords on the next login, check the box for **Students must change their password on next login**.  
        ![Student must change password settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008BNUX)   
          
        
    -   To update permissions for who can update their passwords check the appropriate box in the permissions section for each user type and continue through all user types to save your updates.

_For additional information, please visit_: [Clever Passwords: Troubleshooting User Login Issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/208333118).

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000deOz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008B7ZT) Please note:** Any changes made to your Clever passwords configuration will take about 15 minutes to complete after clicking **P****rovision accounts** in the final step of setup.

**Resetting all passwords for a third-party destinations managed through Clever IDM**

If your district is using Clever IDM to provision passwords for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID, please contact the Clever Support team to bulk reset user passwords. [You can learn more here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001662#header4).

### Students, teachers, and staff resetting their passwords

Depending on the settings you’ve configured, students, teachers, and staff may have the ability to reset their passwords. If password resets are enabled, users will be able to reset their passwords both on the Clever Login screen at your district’s Portal URL, as well as within the Clever Portal itself.

For districts that only utilize Clever Passwords for logins, users must have an email address in Clever for the password resets from the login screen to work.  
  

For instructions on how each individual user type can reset their own passwords, please see the relevant article below:

1.  [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)
2.  [For School Tech Leads: Account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever Passwords](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360026004792)
3.  [For Students: Password recovery and resets](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Why isn't my student's password updating when I updated it in our SIS?**

-   Clever passwords are not dynamically updated to match newly synced data from your SIS. Please see our section on [static credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205889038#staticcredentials) above.

**Is it possible to bulk reset usernames?**

-   Yes! If you’d like the bulk reset or change your usernames for students, teachers, or staff, check the box to Keep usernames updated when setting credentials for your Clever passwords setup. To update the usernames, either update the data syncing from your SIS or change the formula used to generate usernames.

**What if I need help to create a custom formula for passwords?**

-   Please contact Clever Support for further assistance with custom Clever passwords formulas.

**What if there are two users with the same username?**

-   If you have checked the **Keep usernames updated** option in your Clever passwords configuration, Clever will automatically resolve any conflicting usernames by adding a number to the end.
-   For example, if username john.smith already exists, Clever will automatically append a 1 at the end for the second John Smith’s account (john.smith1). If a third John Smith joins the district, they’ll receive the username john.smith2.
-   If the original John Smith (john.smith) username is removed, the following usernames will remain the same (john.smith1 and john.smith2).

**How is provisioning handled for users who have both teacher and non-teaching staff accounts in Clever?**

-   Clever recommends setting the same provisioning configuration for teachers and staff to ensure a consistent login experience for multirole users.
-   Once logged in, users with both teacher and staff accounts in Clever can switch between accounts in their Clever Portal. [Learn more about switching between accounts here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001714) Setting up separate configurations for teachers and staff in Clever Passwords won’t limit access between accounts, as users can easily toggle between the two once logged in.
-   If you choose to configure separate login credentials for teachers and staff, teacher credentials will take precedence over staff credentials, unless Clever created the staff credentials before the teacher account and credentials.  
    For example, if you provision Clever Passwords for both teachers and staff, and a user has both a teacher and a staff account in Clever, both roles will be provisioned using the teacher credentials.  
    Alternatively, consider an individual who's already a staff user in Clever and Clever has provisioned their credentials. Later, you add the user to Clever as a teacher. In this case, their staff credentials will remain intact.  
    Another example is if you decide to provision only staff credentials via Clever passwords initially. Clever will create staff credentials for login, and if the user also has a teacher account, they'll be able to toggle to it in their Portal once logged in. Later, you configure the teacher credential provisioning. The original staff credentials will persist for any user who had a staff account before you set up teacher provisioning.

**Who can reset user's passwords?**

-   This depends on the settings you configure during your Clever passwords setup. You can also update these settings at any time via your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) page.

**What happens when a new user is added to my account? How long before they can log in?**

-   When you add a new user to your Clever account, they'll have Clever passwords credentials automatically generated as soon as the Clever password provisioner runs just after your SIS sync with Clever. If your SIS sync doesn't change any data affecting Clever password credentials, the Clever password provisioner won't run.

**What do I do if Clever passwords are not working for a whole user type: students, teachers, or staff**

-   Check to ensure that you enabled Clever passwords for that user type on Step 4 of Setting up Clever passwords.
    

**Should I configure Clever passwords for user types that won’t be using them regularly?**

-   A security best practice is to reduce the number of access pathways there are to accounts. Only enable Clever passwords for the user types that will be using them regularly.
    

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Clever SSO Policy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001602)
-   [Troubleshooting: Clever passwords login issues](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/208333118)

title: Connecting your learning applications and LMS with AnySchool
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001734#header1)  
2\. [What's AnySchool?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001734#header2)  
3\. [Setting up your AnySchool connection](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001734#header3)  
4\. [Obtaining LMS credentials to configure your connection](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001734#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001734#header5)

## Overview

Clever AnySchool enables applications to connect with districts or schools that haven't adopted Clever in one centralized place.

If you currently use Clever, or are [interested in signing up](https://www.clever.com/district-signup), you can easily roster your learning applications, connect with your LMS, and get all of the benefits of Clever! [Learn more here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588)

If you do not currently utilize Clever, application partners you work with may use Clever AnySchool to more easily synchronize data from your schools, leveraging your existing systems, such as your student information system (SIS) or another OneRoster API data source. This doesn’t require you to set up a Clever account. Instead, Clever acts as an extension of the learning application with no additional signup or credentials required. Clever is a sub-processor of the learning application and follows the terms of any data processing agreements you have in place with the application. Your student data privacy is a top priority for Clever. Learn more about our practices, FERPA, COPPA, GDPR, and state-level compliance in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust).

In this article you’ll learn more about the AnySchool integration and setup process.

* * *

## What's AnySchool?

If you use one of the data sources listed below, application partners using Clever may invite you to connect directly to their application using the AnySchool connection.  As always, your student data privacy is a top priority for Clever. Learn more about our practices, FERPA, COPPA, GDPR, and state-level compliance in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust).

If an application requests that you connect via AnySchool, you don’t need to set up a Clever account. Instead, you’ll use Clever to connect your preferred data source (e.g. Infinite Campus) with your application. Once you’ve set up rostering via AnySchool, you can also configure Clever LMS Connect to launch applications directly from your LMS.

AnySchool supports syncing roster data from the following sources:

-   Infinite Campus
    
-   Skyward
    
-   Blackbaud
    
-   Another OneRoster API connection (please reach out to your application for more details)
    
-   CSV files (users.csv, sections.csv)
    

  
 

* * *

## Setting up your AnySchool connection

If an application partner is interested in syncing your data via AnySchool and setting up Clever LMS Connect, they’ll contact you to confirm that you use one of the data sources listed above and to confirm your email address for setup. 

Before you can utilize Clever LMS Connect, you must first complete your AnySchool rostering setup. For detailed instructions in this setup process, please see our article [Rostering applications with AnySchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001726). 

Once you’ve completed your rostering setup, you’ll be able to configure your Clever LMS Connect configuration. To start, the application will confirm the email of the administrator that will be completing your Clever LMS Connect setup. Once confirmed, they’ll send that admin a custom setup link.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000WeGV3)  Clever Tip:** The link the application partner provides you will expire in 48 hours and is unique to your email address and can’t be shared with other admins.

This link can’t be shared with other administrators as it is unique to your email address. To complete the set up:

1.  Navigate to the link the application provided.
    
2.  Review the information for utilizing AnySchool and click the **Get started** button.
    
3.  You’ll receive an additional confirmation email to verify your account. Click the **Verify your email** button in this email.
    
4.  Once you verify the account, you’ll be logged in to begin your setup. You’ll start by selecting your LMS (Canvas or Schoology). Then click **Continue.** At this time, it is only possible to connect with one LMS.
    
5.  You’ll receive a prompt to enter additional information for your LMS such as a URL and account connection information. Detailed instructions on obtaining this [information for each LMS are below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001734#header3).
    
6.  Once the connection is established with their LMS, Clever will begin a record matching process. This typically takes 2-3 days. You’ll receive an email once matching is complete.
    
7.  While waiting for the matching process to complete, you can generate LTI 1.3 SSO links for your application. These links enable users to access the application directly from your LMS. Logins won’t work until you receive the email that your record matching process is complete.
    

  
 

* * *

## Obtaining LMS credentials to configure your connection

Setting up Schoology

1.  Navigate to Clever Dashboard > Applications > [LMS Connect](https://schools.clever.com/lms-connect?source=main_nav)
    
2.  Click **Connect your LMS  
    **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000piVsN) 
    
3.  Select Schoology 
    
4.  Click **Next: Log into Schoology**
    
5.  Log into Schoology using your system admin account.
    
6.  Navigate to Tools > School Management > **Integration**
    
7.  Open the API tab
    
8.  Check **I am human**
    
9.  Click **Reveal Existing Secret**.
    
10.  Find and copy your current consumer key and consumer secret 
     
11.  Return to [Clever Dashboard > **Applications > LMS Connect**](https://schools.clever.com/lms-connect?source=main_nav) and enter your Schoology information into the modal  
     ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pjjOc) 
     
12.  Paste the consumer key into its matching field in the modal.
     
13.  Paste the consumer secret into its matching field in the modal.
     
14.  Once both fields are filled in, click **Continue**.
     
15.  Click **Finish Setup**.  
     ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pjq6j) 
     
16.  [Set up LTI SSO for Schoology](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001647?language=en_US#header3)
     
17.  If any of your LMS Connected apps need to be reconnected, request the connection again. You can find step-by-step instructions [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001647?language=en_US#header3). 

Setting up Canvas

After choosing Canvas as your LMS:

1.  In your Clever Dashboard, go to [**Applications > LMS Connect**](https://schools.clever.com/lms-connect?source=main_nav) page.
2.  Click **Continue setup**

![LMS Connect home page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pkJWx)

3.  Log into Canvas and navigate to Developer Keys
4.  Click **\+ Developer Key > + API Key** button
    
    1.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pieKY)
        

5.  Complete the fields as follows:
    
    -   **Key Name:** Clever LMS Connect
        
    -   **Owner Email:** \[your email address\]
        
    -   **Redirect URIs:** [https://schools.clever.com/canvas/callback](https://schools.clever.com/canvas/callback)
        
    -   **Icon URL: (optional)**
        
    -   **Redirect URI (Legacy): (optional)**
        
    -   **Vendor Code (LTI 2)**: (optional)
        
    -   **Notes:** You can add any private notes about this integration.
        
6.  Disable **Enforce Scopes**
    
    1.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pjbxJ)
        
7.  Click **Save**
    
8.  Enable the key in Canvas by clicking the checkmark under the **State** column on the Developer Keys page.
    
    1.  ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000piupA)
        
9.  Return to Clever Dashboard [**Applications > LMS Connect** page](https://schools.clever.com/lms-connect?source=main_nav) and enter your Canvas information:
    
    1.  Enter your **Canvas URL**. Be sure to include https:// at the beginning.
        
    2.  Copy the number above **Show Key** and paste it into the **Client ID** field in Clever.
        
    3.  Click **Show Key**, then copy and paste the value into the **Client Secret** field in Clever
        
10.  Click **Continue**
     

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pjdCj)

10.  Click **Authorize**
     

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dwvN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000piGDO) 

Once signed in, you’ll see confirmation that your account is connected. 

  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Why is an application partner using AnySchool?**

-   AnySchool simplifies data rostering, SSO, and LMS integrations for learning applications regardless of your tech stack. Clever Complete securely automates rostering, and ensures applications receive data in a normalized format via Clever’s API that simplifies and speeds up the integration process for their teams.
    

**How do I know my data is safe?**

-   Your student data privacy is a top priority for Clever, and Clever **never** sells student data. 77% of schools in the United States trust Clever to automate rostering for their schools and districts. Clever is FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR compliant, and also complies with multiple state-level requirements for data security and privacy. Learn more in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust).
    

**Who should I contact if my setup link expires?**

-   Please contact the application partner that provided the setup link. They’ll be able to provide a new link.
    

**How can I filter the data being sent to an application partner?**

-   If you're connecting directly to your SIS, please contact the application partner you’re working with for your filtering options. If you are using another OneRoster API system that allows for filtering before sending data to the API, you can work with their team to set up filters.
    

**Who should I contact if I have issues during the setup process?**

-   If you’re having issues locating the necessary SIS credentials, contact your SIS directly.
    
-   If you’re having issues with the setup in another system that supports the OneRoster API, please contact their team directly.
    
-   For all other issues, please contact the application partner you are working with and they can assist further.
    

**Will there be support for additional LMSs?**

-   Support for Google Classroom is coming soon!

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [For Clever Admins: Clever Complete](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001701)

title: For Clever Admins: Pause your sync for a specific app
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001607#header1) 2\. [Pausing and unpausing app syncs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001607#header2) 3\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001607#header3) ## Overview You can pause syncing data to any app using App Sync Pause. This allows currently shared users to maintain stable access during transitions in SIS data (for example, during summer school or annual rollover). Disabling the pause will make the most current data in Clever available to the app. When the app sync is paused: - All users shared prior to enabling can continue to use the app - Changes in your Clever data, including custom data, will not be reflected in the app - Sharing settings can be edited, but the resulting data changes will not take effect until the app sync is unpaused.  This is not to be confused with an [SIS sync pause](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507), which is best for when you want to prevent updated SIS data from flowing into Clever, as explained in the chart below.

SIS sync pause

Application sync pause

Pauses the sync from your SISPauses the sync from Clever to an application, including any sharing permissions
Prevents new data from syncing to CleverPrevents data changes in Clever from syncing to a specific app. However, any data shared before the app pause was implemented can still be synced by the application. As such, the application sync with Clever may still overwrite manual changes made within the application. If you need to fully prevent any syncs between Clever and your application, please reach out to the app team directly.
All users shared with apps prior to pause can continue to use those appsAll users shared with apps prior to pause can continue to use those apps
Any updates in your SIS will not be updated in CleverChanges synced to Clever will not be reflected in the app
* * * ## Pausing and unpausing app syncs You can pause your app sync from your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > My Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications) page by selecting the app you want to pause the sync for and navigating to the **Settings** tab for that application. ### **To turn on the pause** Click **Turn on App Sync Pause** and confirm that you want to pause the sync. ![Screenshot of application sync pause option under the settings tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TF25&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001CNQ7) ### **To turn off the pause** If your app sync is paused and you want to start syncing again, you can turn on the sync from the same Settings tab. ![Settings tab showing the option to turn off the sync pause](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TF25&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001CR2I) * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Does pausing app sync hide the app or prevent logins?** - Pausing the app sync does not hide the app nor prevent logins for those already shared with the app. If you’d like to hide the app or prevent logins, see [Clever Portal: Hiding applications and disabling logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000311483). **Can I modify sharing settings while the sync is paused to the app?** - You can modify sharing settings, but they won’t go into effect until the pause is turned off. Pausing the sync is helpful if you want to spend some time modifying sharing settings but don’t want to implement them just yet. **How long does it take the sync pause to go into effect or be removed?** - It takes ~5 minutes to turn the pause on. When you unpause, we’ll trigger a new Clever sync, which will apply any modified sharing permissions and send any modified data to the app. **What does last sync time on the application overview page indicate?** - The last sync time on the application overview page indicates the last time an application queried Clever's API. It does not indicate that a full sync has been completed. * * * **Related Articles:**  - [Clever Portal: Hiding applications and disabling logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360000311483). - [For Clever Admins: Pausing the sync with your SIS](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/205666507)

title: For Clever Admins: Bulk Security Actions
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#header1)  
2\. [Setting up bulk security actions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#header2)  
          •   [Step 1: Select user groups](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#step1)  
          •   [Step 2: Select security action(s)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#step2)  
          •   [Step 3: Configure security action(s)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#step3)  
          •   [Step 4: Schedule action(s)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#step4)  
          •   [Step 5: Preview and confirm](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#step5)  
3\. [Monitoring activity](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#header3)  
4\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#header5)

## Overview

Bulk security actions let you reset passwords, account claim status, or MFA configurations for users in just a few clicks. Use them to respond to a security concern or prepare for a new school year with minimal disruption to learning.

From your Clever Dashboard, a step-by-step wizard walks you through the entire process: selecting your users, choosing your action, configuring settings, scheduling, and previewing before anything goes live. This article will walk you through each step.  
 

* * *

## Setting up bulk security actions

To get started with taking bulk security actions, navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Security > Bulk security actions.](https://schools.clever.com/bulk-security-actions)

![Clever Dashboard Security menu with Bulk security actions highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000jqBlU)

From here, you can click into the wizard that will take you through five steps. Learn more about each step below. Please note that you'll need to complete the wizard and click **Save** in order for the actions to be set.

### Step 1: Select user groups

### ![Image of Select users step](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oajRf)

Start by selecting the group of users you want to apply actions to. You can select: **by user group** or **by specific users.**

With each user group you have the option to select whether the security action should be taken for:

-   **Select by user group:** you can add a check mark to any Clever group
    
-   **Select specific users:** you can add a check mark to the users you would like to continue with
    

Once you've made your selections, click **Continue to select security action(s)**.

If you created a new group for your security action to act on, please ensure that the group membership has completed processing before scheduling your action.

### Step 2: Select security action(s)

![Image of Select security action(s)](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000obBpK)

Choose the following action to apply to your selected users:   
  
**Reset passwords**

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Update passwords is only available for IDM destinations and Clever Passwords.

Select how you'd like to handle the password reset:

-   Reset passwords only
    
    -   Sets users' existing passwords to one you specify. Best if you plan to distribute the new passwords directly.
        
-   Force a reset on next login only
    
    -   Users are prompted to create their own new password the next time they log in. Best when most users have permission to reset their own passwords.
        
-   Reset passwords and force reset on next login
    
    -   Sets an initial password you choose, then prompts users to create their own after first login. Great for back-to-school or first-time setup.
        

**Reset selected users'** **multi-factor authentication (MFA) configurations**

If a user has an active MFA policy, they'll be required to set up MFA again at their next login.

**Reset account claim flow for selected users**

Allows users to re-claim their accounts on their own, either through a provided URL or the standard login flow. Navigate to Clever Dashboard > Authentication > SSO settings > [Account Claiming](https://schools.clever.com/instant-login/accesscontrol) to access your settings. Learn how to adjust your Account Claiming settings [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001695#:~:text=1.%20Overview%0A2.-,Setup%20process,-3.%20Rolling). 

### Step 3: Configure security action(s)

![Screenshot of Configure security action(s) step](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000jrEXZ)

This step is where you fine-tune the details of your selected action(s). What you see here depends on what you chose in [step 2](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#step2).

### Reset passwords and force reset on next login

If you selected a password reset option, you’ll configure:

1\. Where the force reset happens

Choose whether users are prompted to reset their password when they log in to Clever, or when they log in to another destination:

-   -   Force reset on next login to Clever 
        
        -   The reset is triggered when users log in to Clever using their Clever password.
            
        -   Note: if you want this to apply regardless of what credentials users use to log in, you’ll need to contact Clever Support to enable that setting.
            
    -   Force reset on next login to other destination(s)
        
        -   The reset is triggered when users log in to a specific identity provider (IdP), such as Microsoft Active Directory (AD), Microsoft Entra ID, or Google Workspace. If a user logs in with a different IdP (e.g. Google), the reset happens via that IdP.
            

2\. Which destination(s)’ passwords to reset

Select which provider(s) should have their passwords reset: Microsoft Active Directory (AD), Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, or Clever passwords. Only the destinations you select here will be updated. If your school uses multiple providers, make sure to select each one you want included.

3\. What to reset passwords to

Choose how new passwords are generated:

-   -   Existing IDM formula
        
        -   Uses the password formula already set up in your identity data management (IDM) system (e.g. Google Workspace). The formula is shown for your reference, for example: {{randomWord}}-{{randomWord}}-{{randomWord}}.
            
    -   Temporary password formula 
        
        -   Uses a customizable formula based on student or teacher attributes, like last name, Student Information System (SIS) ID, or graduation year. For example: {{name.last}}-{{student.sis\_id}}-{{student.graduation\_year}}. You can edit the formula for both students and teachers by clicking **Edit temporary student formula** or **Edit temporary teacher formula**.
            

If you're only resetting passwords, click **Next step: Schedule action(s)**. If you also want to reset MFA configurations, continue to [Reset MFA configurations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001747#resetmfa).

### Reset MFA configurations

If you selected a MFA configuration reset, you’ll configure:

1\. Which MFA method users will be required to set up again. Learn more about MFA options [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001625#selectmethods).

-   -   All MFA methods
        
        -   Time-based one-time password (TOTP)
        -   Voice
        -   SMS
        -   WebAuthn
        -   Badge 
        -   Picture
        -   PIN

![Image of MFA reset](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000obP5u)

Once you’ve filled in the required fields, click **Next step: Schedule action(s)**.

### Step 4: Schedule action(s)

![Screenshot of Schedule action(s) step](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000jrEnh)

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Scheduled actions can be canceled or edited before they run. Immediate actions are permanent once confirmed. 

Choose when your bulk action(s) should run:

-   Immediately 
    
    -   Actions run as soon as you confirm.
        
    -   If an IDM configuration sync is actively running, you can't trigger an immediate bulk action. Clever can't run both at the same time.
        
-   On a specific date and time 
    
    -   Schedule it for a future date within the next two weeks. Scheduling overnight or before the school day starts can help minimize disruption. Times are based on your local timezone.
        
    -   Clever won't let you schedule a bulk action at a time that overlaps with an existing IDM configuration sync. 
        

### Step 5: Preview and confirm

![Bulk security action preview summary screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000jrFYT)

Before anything runs, you’ll see a full summary of your configuration. Use this to verify everything looks right:

-   User types and total number of users affected
    
-   Applied filters (e.g. school name)
    
-   Bulk security actions selected
    
-   Password formula and identity provider
    
-   Scheduled time (e.g. Immediately)
    

You can also browse the full list of affected users (by teacher, staff, or student tab) before confirming.

To confirm, check the acknowledgment box:

![Acknowledgment checkbox for confirming bulk security action](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000jrFzt)

 **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Once executed by clicking **Complete bulk actions for X users**, bulk security actions cannot be undone. We recommend reviewing the preview step closely before proceeding.

Once you’ve reviewed and checked the box, click **Complete bulk actions** to kick things off.  
  
 

* * *

## Monitoring activity

![Screenshot of Bulk security actions Activity tab](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000ePyz&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000jr4DG)

To monitor progress, navigate to [Clever Dashboard > Security > Bulk security actions > Activity](https://schools.clever.com/bulk-security-actions?tab=activity). Here you can:

-   See which admin on your team ran or scheduled security actions
    
-   Review actions that have been completed or are scheduled to run
    
-   Download a CSV of new passwords for distribution
    
-   Cancel or edit actions that are still scheduled 
    

  
 

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I undo a bulk security action after it runs?**

-   Bulk security actions can't be reversed automatically. If you need to make changes after the fact, you'll need to run a new bulk action. Scheduled bulk security actions can be canceled. 
    

**Why can I only schedule ahead up to 2 weeks?**

-   Beyond the two-week window, the possibility of a surprise action that will disrupt access for your users is too great. If you'd like to schedule out further than two weeks, we recommend a calendar reminder in your calendar of choice reminding you to schedule the action closer to the actual date to ensure that conditions haven’t changed.
    

**Can I schedule bulk security actions for my admin team?**

-   No, bulk security actions can only be set for students, teachers, and staff users in Clever.

**Can I schedule bulk security actions for multi-role users?**

-   Only if the user isn't part of your admin team. For example, you can't schedule a password reset for a user that has a teacher and a Clever admin account, but you can schedule one for a user that has a teacher and a staff account.
