title: For Clever Admins: Edtech quality indicators
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001722#header1)  
2\. [The importance of edtech quality indicators](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001722#header2)  
3\. [Using the edtech quality indicators in your Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001722#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001722#header4)

## Overview

Clever is making it easier for districts and schools to create safer, smarter decisions when connecting to edtech and AI tools by surfacing trusted quality indicators in the Clever Dashboard.

The EdTech Index, powered by ISTE+ASCD’s Learning Technology Directory, gives educators a trusted resource for identifying high-quality edtech solutions. The Five Common Quality Indicators are central to this effort, providing a shared framework for evaluating edtech and AI tools.

These five indicators help answer essential questions about whether an edtech product is:

-   Safe
    
-   Interoperable
    
-   Evidence-based 
    
-   Inclusive
    
-   Usable
    

Validated information comes from trusted third-party sources to illuminate key areas to consider when exploring and vetting new tools. These indicators are part of a national initiative to help reduce the burden for school systems to identify quality digital learning tools.  
 

* * *

## The importance of the edtech quality indicators in your Clever Dashboard

Schools today face an overwhelming number of edtech tools and growing pressure to evaluate each one for safety, accessibility, and impact. Yet, many lack the time, resources, or frameworks to do so consistently.

That pressure is reflected in the numbers: nearly half of administrators report challenges protecting students from online threats (45%) and maintaining student data privacy (45%). Additionally, 61% cite broader cybersecurity concerns as their top identity management challenge, according to [Clever’s Cybersecure 2025 Report](https://www.clever.com/cybersecure-report). By highlighting these indicators, we’re helping schools quickly identify which tools meet national standards for quality and trust.

Clever includes the indicators in the Clever Dashboard to ease the burden of evaluating applications for Clever admins. We believe that by including these indicators, we can:

-   Help schools better understand their vendors’ certifications and use them to inform how they share data.
    
-   Provide applications a platform to showcase their certifications to districts and schools to encourage use and connections.
    
-   Build trust across the ecosystem for administrators and applications.
    

  
 

* * *

## Using the edtech quality indicators

You can find the Five EdTech Quality Indicators directly in the Clever Dashboard when adding a new application:

1.  Navigate to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) page.
    
2.  Search for the application you’d like to add.
    
3.  If available, Clever will display the indicators along with trusted certifications and badges to help inform your decisions.
    
4.  Learn more in our [press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/helping-schools-make-safer-smarter-edtech-connectionsnow-with-trusted-quality-indicators-302494504.html).
    

 ![An example application with quality index certifications shown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBZZ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000PbSrl) 

_An example of the EdTech Quality Index certifications you may see when adding an application._

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What if I don’t see the edtech quality indicators for a specific application?**

-   The edtech quality indicators for that application aren’t available via Clever at this time. If you have questions about the application and how they meet the indicators, we recommend reaching out to the app partner directly.
    

**Which third party validations are included as part of the Edtech Index Quality Indicators?** 

-   ISTE + ACSD work alongside partners on a collective vision: to provide education leaders and educators with easy access to valuable information, including alignments, badges, certifications about edtech interoperability, privacy, accessibility, usability, and efficacy, to find the right tools for learners. These validations are critical but might be hard to find, so we've provided links to expert organizations to help you and your team dig deeper as you progress along your product decision-making journey. [Read the descriptions on the Edtech Index](https://edtechindex.org/validations/) to learn more about the different validation areas included in the Index and why they are critical to helping you determine if a product or tool will meet your needs.
    

**How often are the validations updated?**

-   Clever works with ISTE to update the validations every quarter. 
    

* * *

title: For Clever Admins: Google SSO 3rd party confirmation
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588#header1)  
2\. [Steps to take for SSO with Google](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588#header2)  
3\. [Steps to take for Google Classroom roster import and Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588#header3)  
4\. [Google documentation](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588#header4)  
5\. [Helping teachers and students navigate this change](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588#help)  
6\. [For Teachers & Students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001588#teachers_students)

## Overview

IMPORTANT Confirm your third-party app settings for Clever in the Google Admin Console to prevent issues with teachers and students accessing Clever.   
  
If you're a teacher or student receiving the error "**Access blocked: Your institution’s admin needs to review**," please contact your school or district's tech support contact for help and provide them with this Help Center article.

  
To protect student data privacy, Google will restrict access to third-party applications (including Clever) for students under the age of 18 unless the admin confirms access in the Google Admin Console.   
  
**Admins must mark Clever as a trusted app in Google by October 23, 2023, or students, teachers, and administrators may lose access to Clever.**   
  
Google will automatically designate users to under 18. Please ensure that Clever Admins are designated as over 18. This article provides instructions for updating your settings in Google for Clever apps.  
  
More information is available here: [Manage access to unconfigured third-party apps for users designated as under 18](https://support.google.com/a/answer/13288950?hl=en&ref_topic=13485859&sjid=1333872646032376841-NA).   
 

* * *

## Steps to take for SSO with Google

To confirm Clever as a trusted third-party configured app:

1.  To get started, sign in to the [Google Admin console](https://admin.google.com/) (note: you must be a Google Admin to access this).
2.  Head to **Menu** > **Security** \> **Access Control and Data** \> **API Controls** in the Admin Console. You should see a section titled “App access control”.  
    ![Screenshot with App access control highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EQcxf)   
      
    
3.  Click **Manage Third-Party App Access** to configure third-party apps. You should see a table listing your configured apps.  
    ![Screenshot with Manage third party app access button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EQxZ7)   
      
    
4.  If Clever appears in the table, click here for instructions.
    
    ![Screenshot of the third-party app table with view details and change app access highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ER3Uo)
    
    -   Hover over Clever in the table and click on the **View Details** button that appears.
    -   If the details panel lists Clever as "**Trusted"** then you are all set.
    -   If Clever is not listed as **"Trusted"**, hover over the table row again and click **Change access** then follow the instructions in the article below under **Changing App Access**.
    
      
    If Clever does not appear in the table, click here for instructions.
    
    -   Click on **Configure new app.  
          
        **![Table with "Configure new app" button highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ER5TP)  
          
        
    -   Search for **Clever** or **423491012759.**
    -   Select the Clever app from the list.
    -   Follow the instructions in the article below for **Changing app access**
    

**Changing App Access**

1.  Select the appropriate scope (all users in the domain or specific organizational units) for app access then click **Next**.  
    ![Screenshot of the scopes for the selected third-party application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ERJ9l) 
2.  Select “**Trusted**” to allow access.  
      
    ![Screenshot of selecting "Trusted" for a third-party application](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ERKVd)   
      
    
3.  Review your settings. If they look good, click **Change Access  
    ![Screenshot of Change Access button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EQxly)**   
     

* * *

##   
Steps to take for Google Classroom roster import and Clever IDM

Since users don’t log into Google Classroom roster import and Clever IDM, Google Admins must simply ensure the Clever Admin authorizing the application is over 18. Districts that have already authorized these apps before October 23, 2023 won't be affected.  
  
View the Google Help Center for additional information: [Manage access to unconfigured third-party apps for users designated as under 18](https://support.google.com/a/answer/13288950?hl=en&ref_topic=13485859&sjid=1333872646032376841-NA).  
 

* * *

##   
Google documentation

For the most up to date content, please visit Google’s Help Center and blog:

-   [Third-party app access enhancements for Google Workspace for Education](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2023/08/third-party-app-access-enhancements-for-google-workspace-edu.html?m=0)
-   [Confirm your third-party app settings by October 23, 2023](https://support.google.com/a/answer/13289151)
-   [Manage access to unconfigured third-party apps for users designated as under 18](https://support.google.com/a/answer/13288950?hl=en&ref_topic=13485859&sjid=1333872646032376841-NA) 
-   [Google Workspace for Education Admin Console: How to review existing configured apps](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jAlmZ_lwr_Q)
-   [Third-party app access enhancements for Google Workspace for Education](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2023/08/third-party-app-access-enhancements-for-google-workspace-edu.html?m=0)

* * *

##   
Helping teachers and students navigate this change

As long as teachers are designated over 18 years of age, they will not be impacted by third-party app access enhancements directly. However, their students may be - so it is important they understand why students may not be able to log into applications, and what to do next.

We recommend that you proactively reach out to teachers to let them know Google’s updatewhat error message they might see, and who to reach out to with questions. You can use this example email template to reach out to them. **Please ensure that you have marked Clever as trusted before you send this email so that teachers and students have a way to access their applications!**

Teachers,

Google Workspace for Education recently updated their settings to help admins control how third-party apps (like Clever) access their organizations' Google data when users sign-in using their Google Workspace for Education accounts. 

The IT team has configured the applications that you and your students need to access. However, if your students encounter an error message stating: "**Access blocked: Your institution’s admin needs to review**," here’s what you should do:

1.  Ask the student to access the application through Clever - we have confirmed Clever as a trusted application.
2.  If they are still unable to login, ask the student to request access to the application using the link provided on the screen.
3.  Contact our help desk \[link\] with the request. Please include the date, application, and reason for your request.

_Please do not contact the application directly. They will not be able to help approve requests._

We appreciate your patience as we work through outstanding requests. We appreciate your partnership in keeping student data safe and private!

Thank you,

\-\[Your name\]

* * *

##   
For Teachers and Students

If your student encounters the error **Access blocked: Your institution’s admin needs to review Clever****,** please contact your district's [tech support contact listed on your Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360046673671). 

![example error message from google](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000DWoT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000jyT4)

You can use the following language:  
  
_My student(s) are having issues logging into Clever due to Google's 3rd party confirmation. Can you please assist with confirming this resource has been approved in Google as outlined here: [https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001588](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001588)_

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [Single Sign-On (SSO): Log in with Google](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202084503)

title: Customer Interaction Policy for Support
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header1) 2\. [Our Commitments to You](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header2) 3\. [Customer Interaction Standards](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header3) 4\. [Violation of Interaction Standards](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header4) 5\. [Tips for the Best Customer Experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header5) 6\. [Accessibility Accommodations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header6) 7\. [Closing Remarks](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001715#header7) ## Overview In our efforts to build stronger relationships with our districts, schools, and App Partners, we want to establish clear, consistent, and high-quality customer interaction standards that enhance the customer experience, improve satisfaction, and align with our company’s values and service expectations. This article will define best practices for customer interactions across various channels, including phone and email engagements. Additionally, it covers tone, responses, issue resolution, escalation procedures, and overall customer engagement strategies.   * * * ## Our commitments to you 1. **Professionalism**: Our team will treat all customers with courtesy, respect, and professionalism at all times. 2. #### **Responsiveness**: We aim to get back to you with accurate and timely answers as quickly as we can. 3. #### **Empathy**: We understand that issues can be frustrating, and we’re here to help resolve them in a compassionate manner.   * * * ## Customer interaction standards 1. **Respectful Language**: Our support team is here to help, and we ask that all conversations remain kind and respectful. We understand that issues can be frustrating, and we can best assist you when interactions remain positive and professional. To ensure a safe and supportive environment for everyone, we won’t be able to continue conversations that include threats, intimidation, or discriminatory language. In such cases, we may need to end the interaction and escalate the issue to management to handle the situation further. 2. **Working Together**: We’re here to help and want to make things right for you! If you have any concerns or aren’t satisfied with a solution, we encourage you to share your feedback with us in a constructive and respectful way. We’ll do our best to find a resolution that works for you. 3. **Call Procedures Cooperation**: If a support agent indicates they need to end the call to conduct additional investigation before following up, please respect their need to do so. Prolonging a call unnecessarily can hinder our ability to assist you and other customers effectively. If needed, the support agent will end the call. - Phone Escalation Pathway: We don’t have a phone escalation pathway. Our support agents will be your primary point of contact for all support cases. If management or engineering involvement is required, arrangements must be made in advance. If you have a complaint about your interaction, you can submit a complaint in writing via the blue support button in the bottom right of the Help Center by following the prompts. Please input the subject as “Customer Interaction Complaint - \[Case Number\].” Please include a detailed explanation of the incident and the reason for your complaint. A senior Clever Support Manager who wasn’t involved in the original interaction will review your message and provide a written response to you within 15 business days of receipt. - Call Transfers: If you call in for assistance with an existing case, we’ll connect you with the assigned agent if available, as they are most familiar with the issue and the troubleshooting steps that have already been taken. 4. **Scheduling a Call**: If you wish to discuss your existing case via phone, it’s recommended to schedule a time with your agent by replying via email on the existing case to ensure availability. Attempting to reach out via the general support line doesn’t guarantee direct contact with your assigned support agent, as they may be assisting other districts or schools. 5. **Confidentiality & Data Security**: We ask that customers respect the need for privacy and security during interactions. Please ensure that any personal information shared with support agents is relevant to the issue and is shared in a secure manner. The below table provides confirmation on Clever’s views on personal identifiable information (PII).

Can share

Avoid sharing

Audience

Email Correspondence: User’s Clever ID (which can be found in the District Dashboard).

Phone Correspondence: User’s Clever ID or other identifiers like name or email can be shared.		 Email Correspondence: 

  • Full names

  • Local or State IDs

  • Username

  • Email Address

  • Preferred names

 All Clever roles + user types 

(Clever admin roles, non-instructional staff, teachers, and students)
* * * ## Violation of interaction standards While we’re dedicated to resolving issues and providing support, repeated or severe violations of these standards may result in additional action from our Support Mangers. We'll assess the level of violation, and follow-up may include the steps indicated below: - **Level 1 Violation**: A Clever Support Manager may reach out to discuss the incident with the individual in violation. - **Level 2 Violation**: A Clever Support Manager will reach out to discuss the behavior with the individual in violation, including District/Clever admin. We’ll also aim to discuss and solidify a better method for working together. - **Level 3 Violation**: The situation will be escalated both internally and at the district-level or school-level. All stakeholders will meet to discuss how we should move forward with servicing the district or school. If you believe that a violation has been incorrectly assessed, you can initiate an appeal to ensure fair treatment for all customers. We value your partnership and want to ensure that all concerns are addressed appropriately.  **Appeals must:** 1. Be initiated within 10 business days of being notified of a violation.  2. Be submitted in writing via the Clever Support button in the bottom right of the Clever Help Center.  3. Have the subject line \[Violation Appeal - Case Number\].  4. Include a detailed explanation of why you believe the assessment was incorrect.  A different Clever Support Manager who wasn’t involved in the original violation assessment will review your appeal and provide a written decision to you within 15 business days of receipt. If additional time is needed due to complexity, we’ll notify you of the extended timeline. The decision made through this appeals process will be considered final. However, we remain committed to working with you to ensure positive interactions moving forward. * * * ## Tips for the best customer experience 1. **Openness to Resolution Options**: We’re always striving to provide the best possible solutions for your needs. While we’ll do everything we can to assist you, there may be times when our current product isn’t able to support a specific request. If this happens, we’ll be transparent with you, log it as feedback and offer alternative suggestions or workarounds when possible. 2. **Details Matter**: To help resolve issues efficiently, we encourage customers to provide as much detail and context as possible when submitting a request via email or on the call with a support agent. The more specific you can be about the issue, the quicker and more efficient our agents can assist you in resolving the issue   Examples of what to include are as follows:  - Account Details - Clever IDs for example users who are impacted - Error Messages - Screenshots to assist the agent in diagnosing the problem * * * ## Accessibility accommodations At Clever, we’re committed to ensuring all customers can effectively communicate with our support team, regardless of disability status. We strive to provide accessibility to our support services in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and related accessibility laws.  If you’d like to request an accommodation, please contact us via the support button at the bottom right of the Help Center. Please make the subject Accommodation Request - Case Number and/or mention your accommodation needs at the beginning of any support call. Please specify the accommodation you're requesting and your preferred communication method. We’ll implement reasonable accommodations as quickly as possible, or, for complex accommodation requests, we’ll provide an estimated implementation timeline. * * * ## Closing remarks We're committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience. These standards guide how we can work together with learners, educators, and partners to ensure every interaction is rooted in providing the best customer experience. Thank you for choosing Clever and we are always here to support you!    * * * **Related articles: ** - [How do I contact Clever Support?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)

title: Classe365 Sync
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001694#header1)  
2\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001694#header2)  
3\. [API overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001694#header3)  
4\. [Important endpoints](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001694#header4)

## Overview

Classe365 is a unified Student Information System (SIS), Learning Management System (LMS), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform designed for educational institutions of all sizes. It streamlines student management processes such as admissions, enrollment, attendance, and grading. The LMS enables course creation, assignment management, and assessments, while the CRM helps institutions engage with students, parents, and staff.

**Extra things to note about the SIS functionality:**

✓ Uploads all academic sessions, sections, and courses into Clever.  
✓ Supports custom student and teacher attributes.  
✓ Syncs staff.

**X** Doesn't have an automatic sync. The API needs to be triggered manually from “App Settings > Clever > Upload Files to Clever”.

* * *

## Setup

### **Copy your SFTP credentials in Clever**

1.  Log in to the **Clever Dashboard**.
2.  Navigate to the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page.
3.  Copy your SFTP Username and Password

![SFTP username and password box on sync settings page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sr6D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VXtn4)

### **Setup in Classe365**

1.  Log in to **Classe365**.
2.  Navigate to **Accounts** > **Org Settings** > **Apps Settings** > **Clever**.

![Classe365 navigation](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sr6D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000FMUzh)

3.  Paste the copied **SFTP username** and **STFP Password** from Clever to Classe365's **App Setting** and **Save** the configuration.  
4.  After saving the configurations, open the Clever App settings again. Click **Upload Files in Clever**.

![Upload files to Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000Sr6D&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000FMVNt)

5.  Now, the system will push the information securely to Clever and show a success message after sending the information.

For more information, visit the [Classe365 Clever Integration Guide.](https://docs.classe365.com/en/articles/4601186-clever-integration-with-classe365)

* * *

## API overview

Classe365 offers a user-friendly API designed to simplify integration for developers. Built on REST architecture, the API provides consistent, resource-oriented URLs and clear HTTP response codes to assist with troubleshooting. It supports standard HTTP features, including authentication and verbs, and allows for secure cross-origin resource sharing. For security reasons, developers should avoid exposing secret API keys in public-facing client-side code. All API responses, including errors, are returned in JSON format.

Classe365 uses Basic HTTP authentication. To authenticate, users must provide a base64-encoded string in the format `<subdomain>:<api_key>`.

For more details, visit the [Classe365 API Authentication Guide](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#authentication_group).

* * *

## Important endpoints

-   **Academics API**: [Insert/Update and Retrieve Academic Data](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#insert-department)
-   **Academic Sessions API**: [Retrieve Academic Session Details](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#academic-sessions_group)
-   **Teachers API**: [Add/Update and Retrieve Teacher Details](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#teachers-and-admin-staff_group)
-   **Admin Staff API**: [Add/Update and Retrieve Admin Staff Details](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#insert-update-admin)
-   **Student Data API**: [Retrieve Student Data](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#get-student-data)
-   **Enrollment API**: [Enroll Students in Academic Sessions, Classes, and Sections](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#add-update-student)
-   **Elective Subject API**: [Manage Elective Subject Enrollment](https://speca.io/classe365/academics#manage-elective-subject-allocation)

  
 

* * *

title: Clever + Checkology: Setup guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001717#header1)  
2\. [Setup process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001717#header2)  
3\. [Required fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001717#header3)  
4. [Support contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001717#header4)  
5\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001717#header5)

## Overview

This guide walks through how to get set up with Checkology in Clever. 

Before reading this guide, please ensure you and your schools are set up with Clever! If you haven't set up Clever yet, you can [get started](https://clever.com/district-signup) [by clicking here](https://clever.com/district-signup) or by accepting your invitation from Checkology. [Please see this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020721271) for more information on setting up Clever for the first time.

* * *

## Setup process

If you're already on Clever, you can connect Checkology by accepting your invite, or following these instructions:  
  

-   -   Log in to your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation.
    -   Search for Checkology.
    -   Clever will bring you to a page where you can authorize your Checkology request. On this page, you can mark that it has already been purchased since Clever SSO and rostering for Checkology are provided at no cost to your schools.
    -   You can also request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can see the Checkology icon in their Clever Portal. Product access may or may not be available on this day.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click **Request**! A request will be sent to the Checkology team for approval.

Once you have shared data with Checkology, the Checkology team will set up the initial sync and will reach out to you to discuss communicating with teachers.

### **Recommended Sharing**

Before sharing:

-   Make sure to match product applications with purchased license counts. 
-   Ensure that students and teachers are in their correct grade levels and that you've updated classes for the current school year in your Student Information System (SIS).

Checkology recommends that you “Share by Rules” in Clever. You can find more info about [Share by Rules here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247). Create a sharing rule by following these steps:

1.  To access the Sharing Permissions page for Checkology, log in to your Clever account, navigate to **My Applications**, and click the icon for Checkology. From the **Data Sharing** tab, click Share by Rules.
2.  Configure your sharing rules by limiting sharing to only the schools and students that should be synced and by sharing only sections with the appropriate subject.

  
 

* * *

## Required fields

Check the Data Quality tab in your Clever Dashboard to see whether you’re meeting the required data fields. Checkology requires the following data fields:

-   **Student**: district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, student\_number
    
-   **Teacher**: district, name, school, schools, sis\_id, email, title
    
-   **School Admin**: district, name, schools, staff\_id, email, roles, title
    
-   **District admin**: district, name.first, name.last, email, title  
     
    

A few things to keep in mind for Checkology products:

-   It is a web-based application
-   Videos are on three different platforms: Wistia, Vimeo, and YouTube (default).

* * *

## Support contacts

**Checkology** 

Contact info: [nlp.product@newslit.org](mailto:nlp.product@newslit.org)

Contact Checkology with problems that relate to any issues using Checkology or issues while in the Checkology URL.

**Clever**

Support.clever.com (click the chat icon in the corner of the screen)

Contact Clever with issues that relate to:

-   Syncing iep\_status and other required fields to Clever
    
-   Customizing field access
    

  
 

* * *

## FAQs

**Why am I getting a “data warning” or a “data error”?**

-   A data error occurs when the record is incompatible with Checkology’s integration with Clever, and the user or section won't appear in the application. Data errors must be resolved for users or sections to be successfully processed by the application. Reach out to Clever Support if you have questions about how to resolve your data error.
    
-   A data warning occurs when the user or section has a compatibility issue with the application that may result in a degraded app experience. We recommend addressing these issues or contacting the application directly to determine the impact of a particular data warning.
    

**Why is a student or teacher missing from Checkology?**

-   Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements before reaching out to Checkology:
    -   In your SIS data
        
    -   In your Clever data
        
    -   Is shared with Checkology in your data sharing permissions
        

**Can multiple teachers/staff be assigned to the same course/section?**

-   Checkology can support multiple teachers or staff assigned to the same course/section as co-teachers.

**Are staff supported?**

-   Yes, Checkology supports staff with Clever. 

**Who should I ask for help with an issue?**

-   If it’s related to data within Clever, or data coming from Clever, please contact Clever.
-   If you're receiving an error message within the Checkology URL, please contact Checkology. 

* * *

title: Clever IDM: Setting login credentials
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#header1)  
2\. [Syncing usernames](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#header2)  
3\. [Creating user email formats](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#header3)  
4\. [Collisions and fallback format](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#header4)  
5\. [Passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#header5)  
     •[Random passwords option](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#randompassword)  
     •[Multiple destinations](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#multipledest)  
     •[Distribution](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#Distribution)  
     •[Emails and passwords using custom formulas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#emailpassword)  
6. [Mapping additional fields](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#mapping)

## Overview

Setting up your login credentials for Clever IDM is part of the setup process. You can find the general setup for each destination type here:

-   [Clever IDM: Google Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001467)
-   [Clever IDM: Active Directory Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001505)
-   [Clever IDM: Entra ID Setup](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001553)

Login credential setup for Clever IDM is similar for each destination: Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID (formerly Azure).

Clever IDM provisions login credentials based on the format you specify, and you can customize these formats per user role (e.g., students can have a different format than teachers).

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Some examples cover all three destinations, and portions of those examples may not apply to all (e.g., sAMAccountName would apply to Active Directory but not Entra ID and Google).

* * *

## Syncing usernames

Clever IDM syncs usernames based on your SIS data and the destination: Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID, and can also update usernames in the destinations if desired. A basic understanding of what username fields sync for each destination is beneficial, especially if you need to troubleshoot.

**Google**:

-   Clever IDM identifies and matches existing Google accounts automatically.
-   We match accounts on the SIS Email field.
-   Users with the same email address in Clever and Google will be matched and updated.
    -   Ensure existing Google email addresses are updated in your SIS so Clever can match them.
-   To view guidelines for username formatting, please view [this Google Support article](https://support.google.com/a/answer/9193374).

**Active Directory**:

-   Clever IDM matches your existing AD users based on their district username from the District\_Username field in Clever.
    -   Ensure district usernames are updated in your SIS so Clever can match them.
-   Please contact Clever support if your UserPrincipalName convention does not match your sAMAccountName convention.
-   Once you have selected a username format for a particular user role, Clever will use it to generate the sAMAccountName for that user role.
-   If unable to match on district username, Clever IDM will attempt to match using your login credentials.

**Entra ID**:

-   Clever IDM identifies and matches existing Microsoft Entra ID accounts automatically based on users’ District\_Username field in Clever.
-   By default, Clever IDM will use the username synced from the SIS for UserPrincipalName and the email synced from the SIS for email. If the SIS data is blank, Clever IDM will use the fallback format you specify.
-   If unable to match on district username, Clever IDM will attempt to match using your login credentials.

If you need to change the default usernames to match on, we’re happy to help! Please reach out to Support.Clever.com. 

**Active Directory and Entra ID**:

-   IDM can update userPrincipalName (primary username) in Active Directory and Entra ID.
-   Users whose username in Clever matches an existing UPN in Active Directory or Entra ID are matched to that account.
-   Once matched, Clever will update the UserPrincipalNames and sAMAccountNames for existing Active Directory accounts on subsequent syncs if a new username is synced from the SIS. 

Please contact Clever support at Support.Clever.com to turn UPN update behavior on or off.

* * *

## Creating user email formats

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Navigate to the [Clever IDM: Formulas](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555) article to learn more about common formulas and operations that you can use to manipulate data in Clever to create formulas.

To create an email format for users, combine a username and a domain. Clever IDM will only use this format if the user's email address isn't already populated in Clever.

  
Clever IDM provides options in the format builder for email and password formats that utilize existing fields imported from your SIS, or custom text. School districts can also use [custom formulas](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555) to learn about supported field names and operations.

![Clever IDM step to create email format for students](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000006Mcj7) 

![Format Builder view](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000006Lvaw) 

**Active Directory**:

-   Clever IDM writes values to the Mail field but cannot currently provision mailboxes in the Exchange Server.

* * *

## Collisions and fallback format

In the event of a collision, when two or more users have the same sAMAccountName, UserPrincipalName, or email field, Clever IDM will, by default, append a number to the original format until we find a unique value.

For example: 

-   [johndoe@clever.com](mailto:johndoe@clever.com)
-   [johndoe1@clever.com](mailto:johndoe1@clever.com)
-   [johndoe2@clever.com](mailto:johndoe2@clever.com)

If desired, you can create your own custom fallback formats for use in the event of a collision by selecting **Add fallback format**. 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Fallback formats will only work if IDM is generating your email addresses.

![screenshot of fallback formats](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000xMNt)

Here, you can create a custom fallback format by starting with a premade email format, building an email format using blocks, or entering a format string. Please note that the last option is advanced and will require you to type a string that fits the format you would like to see applied. To learn more about your options with building a format, review our [Clever IDM: Formulas article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555?language=en_US).

![Image of adding a student fallback formula](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PGwL)

Once you add the fallback format, you can change the order in which Clever IDM will attempt to use them. When there’s a collision, Clever IDM will go through each fallback format in order until there isn’t a collision. If there’s a collision on every fallback format, Clever IDM will append a number to the original format until we find a unique value.

**Active Directory**:

-   Clever IDM does not support fallback formats for the CommonName field. In the case of a collision, CommonName will have a number appended and incremented until a unique value is found. For example:
    -   John Doe
    -   John Doe 1
    -   John Doe 2

* * *

## Passwords

The password format needs to meet domain-level restrictions. Clever IDM requires passwords to have a minimum of 8 characters.

**Google**:

-   There are a few specific restrictions for this destination, outlined [here](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32040).

Teachers and staff are required to change their passwords upon first login. As such, the format selected in Clever IDM will only be utilized for the teacher or staff member's first login. To learn more about password formats available, please review our [Clever IDM: Formulas article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555?language=en_US).

**Random passwords option  
**Clever IDM offers a random password format as part of your Clever IDM password credentials, as well as ways to export these generated passwords out of Clever IDM. Whenever possible, we recommend using random passwords to reduce the risk of compromised accounts. 

To configure random passwords for users on account creation, go to  the **Set login** **credentials** step of the Provisioning Setup:

1.  Click **Edit your format**
2.  **Click Add a Function**
3.  Select one of the random password options from the drop-down.
4.  Check off the **Allow password export**.  
      
    

![Image of setting a password format](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PHXR)

When **Allow password export** is checked, this also enables the IDM-generated student passwords to be viewed by teachers in their Portal. This will help teachers to assist with student logins.

You can manipulate these random features using an IDM Custom Formula found [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001555).

  
**Multiple Destinations**  
Clever IDM also supports using the same password across multiple destinations as long as the district has added a check next to **Allow password export**. Once you have one destination configured, you’ll see the option to use that destination’s password in other destinations. 

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** **For security purposes, passwords will only be available for ten days after they are created**. If AD is configured to use passwords from Google, an AD account must be created within ten days after the same account is created in Google. Otherwise, Clever IDM will throw an issue for the affected account.

![Image of using a password format from Active Directory](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000xOr7)

_This image shows the ability to use the password format from Active Directory, but you can use it from Google or Entra ID as well._

**Distribution  
**As a Clever Admin, you can make passwords available for export. If you choose to use random passwords, you’ll be required to export passwords.

There are three ways to access passwords once export is enabled:

-   Clever Admin can download passwords from the last ten days from the Clever IDM homepage.
-   These recent account reports are available via an SFTP box.
-   Passwords are visible for Clever Admin in the Clever Dashboard on the **Details** tab of user profiles.
    -   Teacher/Staff user passwords will be available for ten days.
    -   Student passwords will remain indefinitely unless Clever IDM generates another password for the user, thus overwriting the previous password.

![Image shows where to download recent accounts](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000xOsj)

_This image shows where to download recent accounts. This step is the same for Google, Active Directory, and Entra ID._

Users with the Clever Admin/STL/District Help Desk role can view student passwords on a one-off basis in the school's dashboard. In addition, teachers can view their students’ passwords in the Portal.  
If the 10-day period ends before the password can be distributed to the user, we recommend referencing the password from the student’s profile in the Clever Dashboard or having the user reset their password manually in the destination.

To enable SFTP access for IDM exports, please see our article [Clever IDM: Exporting data to your SIS (also known as writeback).](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001593)

**Emails and Passwords using Custom Formulas**  
Clever IDM provides options in the drop-down for email and password formats that utilize existing fields imported from your SIS, such as the first\_name followed by last\_name. Districts can also use custom formulas to combine field names and apply operations on them. For more complex formulas, please reach out to Support.Clever.com.  

**Active Directory**:

-   Clever IDM writes values to the Mail field but cannot currently provision mailboxes in the Exchange Server

 **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Navigate to the [Clever IDM: Formulas article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001555) to learn more about common formulas and operations that you can use to manipulate data in Clever to create formulas.

* * *

## Mapping additional fields

IDM allows districts to map values to additional fields beyond names, emails, and passwords.

**Active Directory** and **Entra ID:**

-   Beyond email and password, Clever IDM can manage a variety of other fields in Active Directory or Entra ID. The mapping functionality is available in step 5 when setting credentials.

**Google:**

-   School districts can write values to:
    -   job title
    -   type of employee
    -   department
    -   manager’s email
    -   phone (home)
    -   address (home)
    -   cost center

To populate these fields in Google, districts can use formulas based on any user data in Clever.

If you’d like to write to fields that aren’t visible in the drop-down or listed above, please contact Support.Clever.com.

Note that, by default, Clever IDM will overwrite any values in mapped fields. However, when setting up mapping rules for custom fields in the Clever IDM setup, you have control over when to sync those custom fields.

There are two options:

-   **Update the field on each sync**
    -   This means Clever IDM will always sync the field
-   **Update the field when the user is created, or the field is blank**
    -   This means Clever IDM only syncs the field when it’s **empty** on the destination user

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000StMX&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000005PE6Y)

_This image shows the two options for when to sync custom fields. This example shows the Department field for Active Directory._

Now, you’ll want to finish your setup by completing the steps in the [appropriate guide](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001605#header1).

title: For Clever Admins: Clever + Kahoot! EDU Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#header1)  
2\. [Initial Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#header2)  
3\. [What to expect if your school organization is new to Kahoot!](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#header3)  
4\. [What to expect if your school organization is connected to the legacy Kahoot! App](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#header4)  
5\. [What to expect if your school organization has teachers using the Library app](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#Header6)  
6\. [Support Contacts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001678#header7)

## Overview

This guide will walk you through the steps needed to successfully set up Kahoot! EDU for your school organization via Clever. Follow the instructions below to ensure a smooth integration and setup process.  
 

* * *

## Initial Setup Process

### **1\. Kahoot Invitation**

When working with your Kahoot representative, you’ll be asked to confirm your Clever District ID for them to locate your record in Clever. Then, you can expect to receive an email notification when the Kahoot team has sent you an invitation to connect via Clever. 

You can use the link on the email or log into your Clever Dashboard to accept the invitation. Make sure to take note of any sharing recommendations your representative may have included as part of the invite.

### **2\. Setting Up**

After accepting the invitation, you can begin setting up your sharing permissions. When you accept the invitation, please share only schools that will be utilizing Kahoot! EDU. [You can find more information about setting up sharing permissions here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007?language=en_US).

For your staff to be able to use open-ended and word cloud questions in Kahoot! EDU, you’d need to agree to our terms and conditions and student privacy policy. Click [here](https://create.kahoot.it/organization/team-details) to view these documents and accept these policies before your launch date. 

Over the course of the next 24 hours, the Kahoot team will automatically begin setting up your organization in Kahoot.

### **3\. Launch Date**

On the launch date, the Kahoot! EDU application will appear in your teachers’ Clever Portals based on the sharing permissions you set.

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cS89&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Axccz)  Please note:** If the organization has not been set up via the Kahoot sync, users will receive a “this user does not exist” message until the sync has run.

* * *

## What to expect if your school organization is new to Kahoot!

The Kahoot! EDU app will appear in your teachers’ Clever Portals on the launch date, according to the sharing permissions you set.

Teachers will be able to SSO into both a Kahoot! EDU workspace and a Kahoot teacher/private workspace.  
 

* * *

## What to expect if your school organization is connected to the legacy Kahoot! app

The Kahoot! EDU app will still appear in your teachers’ Clever Portals on the launch date, according to the sharing permissions you set.

Teachers will be able to SSO into both a Kahoot! EDU workspace and a Kahoot teacher/private workspace.

After the initial SSO into the Kahoot! EDU app, teachers will also be able to access the EDU workspace via the legacy app.

 **![instructor\_c8mlopv788bh4spwj0xrzn2c2\_public\_1712091784\_Lightbulb.1712091783969.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cS89&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ax4jQ) Tip:** For simplicity, we advise you to uninstall the legacy app once the Kahoot! EDU application is up and running to avoid confusion. The Kahoot! EDU application will give you access to the most up-to-date features.

  
 

* * *

## What to expect if your school organization has teachers using the Library app

The Kahoot! EDU app will still appear in your teachers’ Clever Portals on the launch date, according to the sharing permissions you set. 

Teachers will be able to SSO into both a Kahoot! EDU workspace and a Kahoot teacher/private workspace.

After the initial SSO into the Kahoot! EDU app, teachers will also be able to access the EDU workspace via the Library app.

 **![instructor\_c8mlopv788bh4spwj0xrzn2c2\_public\_1712091784\_Lightbulb.1712091783969.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cS89&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Ax4jQ) Tip:** We advise teachers uninstall the Library app once the Kahoot! EDU application is up and running to avoid confusion. The Kahoot! EDU application will give you access to the most up-to-date features.

For further assistance, please contact Clever Support or refer to the Clever Help Center.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Will existing teacher accounts be preserved?** 

-   Yes, existing accounts can be preserved if the email associated with their account matches their email in Clever. If a teacher had been using a personal email address or an email that does not appear in Clever, they should update their email address to match what appears in Clever to ensure their account is matched. 
    
-   If the emails do not match, the existing accounts will still be preserved but the teacher may have a duplicate account created for them.
    

**What is the best way to direct students to Kahoot?**

-   Create an external link to share with students directing them to [https://kahoot.it/](https://kahoot.it/). [You can find instructions on how to create an external link here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002942963?language=en_US).

**How do I know if I have the legacy app installed?**

-   You can identify if you have the legacy app installed by checking the app icon, which appears as a purple ‘K.’ If you see this icon, it indicates the legacy version is still installed.

![Kahoot! Logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cS89&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AxZlb) 

* * *

## Support Contacts

Support Contact: [CleverSSO@kahoot.com](mailto:cleversso@kahoot.com)

Contact Kahoot! with issues that relate to:

-   An error message within any Kahoot URL
    

### **Clever**

Support Contact: support.clever.com (click the chat icon in the corner of the screen)

Contact Clever with issues that relate to:

-   Data within Clever
    
-   Data coming from Clever

title: For Clever Admins: District Data Privacy Agreements (DPAs)
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001687#header1)  
2\. [Clever’s Terms of Use](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001687#header2)  
3\. [Clever Pre-signed DPA](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001687#header3)  
4\. [Student Data Privacy Consortium](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001687#header4)  
5\. [Using your District’s Template](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001687#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001687#FAQ)

## Overview

This Help Center article outlines best practices and processes for managing Data Privacy Agreements (DPAs), also known as Data Sharing Agreements, between U.S. school districts and Clever. DPAs specify how Clever handles, stores, and protects student information for our school district partners. These agreements help ensure Clever upholds the privacy and confidentiality of student data and may be required by state student data privacy laws. As a "data processor," Clever processes student data solely for educational purposes as directed by the school district.

Depending on your district’s needs, there are several options for managing DPAs with Clever:

1.  Use Clever’s online [Terms of Service](https://clever.com/trust/terms) and [Privacy Policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy), which include key provisions commonly found in a DPA.
2.  Sign Clever’s pre-signed DPA.
3.  Join Exhibit E through the Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC).
4.  Submit your district’s DPA template or form for Clever’s review.

Read on for more details about each option and how to proceed.

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000BNVx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CQS09)  Note for Application Partners:** This article does not apply to Application Partners. Clever does not sign DPAs with App Partners because apps do not share student data with Clever. Instead, Clever acts solely as a data processor for school districts, which retain ownership and control of student data. For App Partners, the most important DPA is the one established directly with the school districts you serve.

* * *

## Clever Terms of Use

During the initial onboarding process, districts typically sign up for Clever through an automated flow. As part of this process, districts agree to Clever’s [Privacy Policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy), [Terms of Service](https://clever.com/trust/terms), and [Additional Terms of Use for Schools](https://clever.com/trust/terms/schools). These terms are designed to be fair, transparent, and compliant with federal and state student data protection laws, ensuring that districts maintain control over their data.

To provide clarity and legal protection, our terms outline the parameters of specific clauses related to student data privacy and security. We believe that these terms, by themselves, may meet many DPA requirements so please feel free to review and confirm.

You can review the documents using the links below:

-   [Terms of Service](https://clever.com/trust/terms)
-   [Additional Terms of Use for Schools](https://clever.com/trust/terms/schools)
-   [Privacy Policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy)

  
 

* * *

## Clever Pre-signed DPA

Clever has created a DPA template modeled on the national agreements from the Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC), providing robust protections for districts.

If your district would like to use Clever’s pre-signed DPA, you have two options:

1.  Complete the agreement using [this DocuSign Powerform](https://na2.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=474cffdd-de6c-4363-a36b-bcc899238d3e&env=na2&acct=8f3af476-5ae1-4be5-8870-8f8f1790daf1&v=2).
2.  Download and sign the [Clever DPA](https://clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Clever-DPA-presigned-updated-2024-1-12.pdf), then send a copy to legal@clever.com.

  
 

* * *

## Student Data Privacy Consortium

The [Student Data Privacy Consortium](https://privacy.a4l.org/) arose to streamline the process of contracting between districts and edtech vendors. The consortium has created a [SDPC Resource Registry](https://sdpc.a4l.org/) that uses a template National Data Privacy Agreement ([NDPA](https://cdn.ymaws.com/www.a4l.org/resource/resmgr/files/sdpc-publicdocs/final_sdpc_ndpa_v1-7.pdf)) for districts and applications to use. The NDPA  includes an Exhibit E  “General Offer of Privacy Terms” for other districts in the state to sign onto that same DPA. 

To check if your state has a signed NDPA that your district can join, follow these steps:

### Steps to Search the SDPC Database

1.  Visit the [SDPC Resource Registry](https://sdpc.a4l.org/).
2.  On the homepage, locate the **State Alliances** section and click it.
3.  Select your state from the list, then click **Visit Alliance**.
    -   (The state’s name will appear on the left side of the page.)
4.  In the middle of the page, find the **Search the Database** box and click **Start Exploring**.
5.  Under **Search by Vendor Member's Resources**, use the dropdown menu to search for “Clever.”
6.  Select "Clever" (not Clever Badges) from the results and click **Search**.

This will display contracts Clever has signed with districts in your state. Most agreements are linked directly, allowing you to download them. If your state has a signed NDPA, you can simply download the agreement and sign onto **Exhibit E**.

  
 

* * *

## District’s DPA Template

What if your District has their own template they would like to use?

Please contact [legal@clever.com](mailto:legal@clever.com) with the following information:

-   Name of your School District
    
-   State
    
-   Attach any documents that you would like reviewed.
    

  **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000BNVx&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000CQS09)  Please note:** This option will take longer as we will have to review, likely redline, and negotiate the agreement.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

-   **Where can I find out more information about the State NDPA requirements and the State NDPA template?**
    -   [Student Data Privacy Consortium](https://privacy.a4l.org/) 
    -   [NDPA](https://cdn.ymaws.com/www.a4l.org/resource/resmgr/files/sdpc-publicdocs/final_sdpc_ndpa_v1-7.pdf)

-   **Where can I find more information about Clever Security?**
    -   Clever’s [Security page](https://clever.com/trust/security).

-   **What if I have a general legal question?**
    -   Please reach out to [legal@clever.com](mailto:legal@clever.com) 

* * *

**Related Resources:**

-   [Trust Center](https://clever.com/trust)
-    [Privacy Policy](https://clever.com/trust/privacy/policy)
-    [Terms of Service](https://clever.com/trust/terms)
-   [Additional Terms of Use for Schools](https://clever.com/trust/terms/schools)
-   [Third Party Subprocessors page](https://clever.com/trust/subprocessors)
-   [Data Elements Table](https://clever.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Data-Elements-Table-2.pdf)

title: For App Partners: Rostering schools via the AnySchool district setup flow
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001725#header1)  
2\. [Inviting an off-Clever district or school](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001725#header2)  
3\. [The district/school experience](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001725#header3)  
        •   [Set up SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001725#sso)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001725#header4)

## Overview

Clever Complete is the platform solution purpose-built for edtech scalability—connecting your application to any school through a single, secure integration for rostering, SSO, and LMS connections. Through the AnySchool capability within Clever Complete, you can connect with school organizations that don't use Clever.  

This article provides information on using the AnySchool district/school set up flow to invite districts and schools without a Clever account to connect to your application. This setup flow is hosted by Clever and white-labeled to align with your application’s branding. 

AnySchool supports syncing roster data from the following sources for schools that don't directly utilize Clever:

-   Infinite Campus (API v1.2)
    
-   Skyward
    
-   Blackbaud
    
-   Additional OneRoster API connections (please reach out to your success manager for more details)
    
-   CSV upload (users.csv, sections.csv)
    

If you have a district or school using one of these systems, invite them to connect for rostering via AnySchool in your Clever Dashboard.

* * *

## Inviting an off-Clever district or school

To connect with a district or school that isn’t currently utilizing Clever, you must have AnySchool connections included in your Clever contract. If you don’t have an AnySchool agreement in place and are interested in learning more, please [contact our team here](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup).

If you have an existing Clever Secure Sync or Clever LMS Connect integration, you can use your existing integrations to utilize all of the Clever Complete features, including AnySchool.

For schools or districts connected via AnySchool, you’ll have access to relevant data management features like the Overview tab, Filters, Warnings, Analytics, etc.

![A screenshot of the Overview tab for an example AnySchool district.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAXDS)  

_A screenshot of the Overview tab for an example AnySchool district._

To use AnySchool to invite an off-Clever district or school to connect please:

1.  Confirm they utilize one of the following for storing data:
    
    -   Infinite Campus (API v1.2)
        
    -   Skyward
        
    -   Blackbaud
        
    -   Another OneRoster API connection (please reach out to your success manager for more details)
        
    -   Or they can upload two CSV files, a users.csv and a sections.csv
        
2.  Confirm you have the email address of the administrator at the district or school who will be setting up rostering with your application.
    
3.  Navigate to your [**Clever Dashboard > Home > Invite Districts**](https://apps.clever.com/clever-academy-dev/districts/invite-districts) tab.
    
4.  Select the button to Connect to an AnySchool district.
    
5.  Input the district or school name and click **Create new district.**
    
6.  Select **Send email invite**, then enter the District Email, Email subject, and Email body. The district will use this email address to verify the user during setup.  
      
    You can customize the subject and message so the school understands that this email will guide them through setup. When you're ready, click **Send email**.  **![Adding an off-Clever school or district](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000euis9)**
    
7.  When the administrator receives the link, they’ll follow the steps below to set up their sync with your application. If they click the link but don’t finish setup within 48 hours, they’ll need to request a new link. 

Once the administrator completes the setup process on their side, our system will automatically run a sync. When the sync completes, you’ll be able to review the data in your Clever Dashboard. Clever will continue to run syncs on a nightly basis. If you’d like to customize your sync time, please reach out to Clever Support.

  
 

* * *

## The district/school experience

Once you’ve generated the access link and provided it to the school administrator, they’ll be able to begin the setup process on their side. To complete the setup, they’ll:

1.  Navigate to the link within the automated email.
    
2.  Review the setup information and click the **Get started** button.
    
3.  They’ll be logged in to begin their setup. They’ll start by selecting their data source: Infinite Campus, Skyward, Blackbaud, another OneRoster API source, or CSV upload. Once they select a data source, they’ll click **Continue.  
    **
    
        ****![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAonl)    Please note:**** Once a district begins setup, they have 48 hours to complete the process. If they don’t complete their setup in this timeframe, you’ll need to provide a new setup link.
    
4.  They’ll receive a prompt to enter additional information for their data source.
    
    -   If they’re utilizing Infinite Campus, Skyward, or Blackbaud, they’ll enter the credentials for connecting to their data source’s API. This includes Base URL, Client ID, and Client Secret. Clever will provide instructions for generating and locating this information in their SIS, however, if the admin needs assistance, we suggest they reach out to their data source’s support team directly (i.e., if using Infinite Campus to connect, they should reach out to the Infinite Campus support team for assistance locating the Base URL, Client ID, and Client Secret).
        
    -   If they’re utilizing another OneRoster API connection, they’ll follow instructions for locating credentials for this data source. Once they complete the setup in their data source system, they'll confirm any necessary details in the AnySchool flow
        
    -   If they’re uploading a users.csv and sections.csv, they’ll be able to download file templates and must prepare their CSV files. When the files are ready, the admin will upload them via the provided link. If the link expires before the admin has completed the upload, you may need to provide a new link. You can do this by repeating the steps outlined in the _Inviting an off-Clever district or school_ section.
        
5.  Once the data source credentials are entered, or they've uploaded the CSV files, they'll click **Continue.**
    

Once the school administrator clicks continue, their data will begin syncing to the application. Administrators using CSV files will receive a sync report email with any errors or issues that may prevent data from syncing. They’ll want to resolve these errors in the files and reupload them to their provided AnySchool link.

You can view two examples of setup below:

##   

##   

## Set up SSO

School organizations can set up Single Sign-On (SSO) using a supported OneRoster API data source. Many schools use providers such as ClassLink for this setup process.

To complete setup, the school organization will need to locate and exchange metadata URLs between systems. Schools should reference their SSO provider’s help center or support team for provider-specific instructions. Depending on the school’s familiarity with SSO setup, you may need to provide additional guidance during this process.

Schools can also use Instant Login Links (ILLs). Instant Login Links allow schools to place direct login links within their SSO portal, website, or Learning Management System (LMS). When users select an Instant Login Link, they are automatically signed into the application through SSO.

Review the example below to understand the setup experience schools may follow when configuring SSO with ClassLink.

Classlink

1.  Copy the Clever metadata URL. 
    
2.  Review [this article](https://help.classlink.com/s/login/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fs%2Farticle%2FClever-SAML) to learn more about how to configure Clever’s metadata URL if needed.
    
3.  Log in to ClassLink LaunchPad and paste the Clever metadata URL.
    
4.  Copy the ClassLink metadata URL.
    
5.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen and paste the ClassLink metadata URL.
    
6.  (Optional) Copy the Instant Login Link to add it to the school’s SSO portal, website, or LMS.
    
7.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.
    
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iUS2L)  
      
    Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to **SAML** on the AnySchool district overview page.  
      
    ![AnySchool Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iUS5Z) 

Google

1.  Log into your Google Admin console.
    
2.  Add Clever as a trusted app in Google. 
    
3.  (Optional) If you would like to restrict logins to your Google domain complete the steps below:
    
    1.  Navigate to Account > Domains to access your Google Workspace domain.
        
    2.  Copy the domain.
        
    3.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen and paste the domain.
        
4.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.
    
      
    ![screenshot of Google SSO setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oFQ8g)   
      
    Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to **SAML** on the AnySchool district overview page.  
      
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iUS5Z)
    

Okta

1.  Copy Okta's IdP metadata URL from your Okta admin console.
2.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen in Clever and paste Okta's metadata URL. Clever uses this to generate your district's SP metadata.
3.  Open Clever's SP metadata XML (the Clever metadata URL from Step 1's demo screen) and find the **ACS URL** and **Entity ID**. Okta doesn't support a direct metadata upload here, so you'll copy these two values by hand into your Okta SAML app's settings.
4.  From that same SP metadata file, grab Clever's signing certificate and save it as a `.crt` file. Upload it in Okta. This unlocks Single Logout (SLO), which Clever's spec requires.
5.  In Okta, open the app's **Sign On** tab (this moved out of the main setup wizard in a recent Okta update, so it's easy to miss) and add an attribute statement mapping `clever.any.email` to `user.profile.email`. Skip this and logins will fail silently with a "no matching account" error, even with a valid signed assertion.
6.  (Optional) Copy the Instant Login link to add it to the school's SSO portal, website, or LMS.
7.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.  
      
    ![Image of Okta steps to complete in Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWg5B) 

Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to SAML on the district overview page.  
  
![AnySchool Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWqe1)  

Rapid ID

1.  Copy the Clever metadata URL.
2.  Review \[this article\] to learn more about how to configure Clever's metadata URL if needed.
3.  Log in to RapidID and paste the Clever metadata URL.
4.  Copy the RapidID metadata URL.
5.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen and paste the RapidID metadata URL.
6.  (Optional) Copy the Instant Login link to add it to the school's SSO portal, website, or LMS.
7.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.  
      
    ![Image of setup steps for Rapid ID](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWmLt) 

Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to SAML on the district overview page.  
  
![AnySchool Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWrOn) 

Canvas

1.  Log into your Canvas account.
    
2.  Navigate to **Admin > Developer Keys**, and click **\+ Developer Key**
    
3.  Create a new Developer Key for Clever. 
    
    1.  Include the following URI in the Developer Key settings: [https://clever.com/oauth/canvas/callback](https://clever.com/oauth/canvas/callback) 
        
    2.  Uncheck **Enforce Scopes**.![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oFiDd) 
        
    3.  Turn the toggle under State **on**.![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oEvOE) 
        
4.  Copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
    
5.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen and paste the following: Canvas Instance URL, Client ID,and Client Secret 
    
6.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.
    

  
Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to **SAML** on the AnySchool district overview page.  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000iUS5Z)

Microsoft Entra

1.  Copy the Clever metadata URL.
    
2.  Review \[this article\] to learn more about how to configure Clever's metadata URL if needed.
    
3.  Log in to Microsoft Entra and paste the Clever metadata URL.
    
4.  Copy the Microsoft Entra metadata URL.
    
5.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen and paste the Microsoft Entra metadata URL.
    
6.  (Optional) Copy the Instant Login link to add it to the school's SSO portal, website, or LMS.
    
7.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.  
      
    ![Image of Microsoft Entra setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWZTW) 
    

Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to SAML on the district overview page.  
  
![AnySchool Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWrlN)  

Microsoft ADFS

1.  Copy the Clever metadata URL.
2.  Review \[this article\] to learn more about how to configure Clever's metadata URL if needed.
3.  Log in to Microsoft ADFS and paste the Clever metadata URL.
4.  Copy the Microsoft ADFS metadata URL.
5.  Return to the Set Up SSO screen and paste the Microsoft ADFS metadata URL.
6.  (Optional) Copy the Instant Login link to add it to the school's SSO portal, website, or LMS.
7.  Click **Continue** to finish setup.  
      
    ![Image of Microsoft ADFS setup](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWioa) 

_Once a school organization completes their setup, the app will see the SSO method updated to SAML on the district overview page.  
  
![AnySchool Overview page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dfEb&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000pWrDV)_ 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What if a district or school I’m working with is concerned about data privacy and Clever?**

-   You can share that student data privacy is a top priority for Clever, and Clever **never** sells student data. 77% of schools in the United States trust Clever to automate rostering for their schools and districts. Clever is FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR compliant, and also complies with multiple state-level requirements for data security and privacy. They can learn more in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust).

**What can I share with a school organization when introducing AnySchool?**

-   We recommend the following language when reaching out to schools regarding AnySchool:  
      
    Hi \[Contact\],  
    _\[App\]_ can now directly connect to _\[source\]_ to keep your roster data synced automatically. Behind the scenes, _\[App\]_ uses a secure processing service to handle the data transfer, but you'll manage and control the sync entirely within _\[source\]._ No separate setup or login needed elsewhere.  
    To get started, I can send you a link to set up the connection in _\[source\]_. Please let me know if you have any questions before we begin.  
    Thanks,  
    \[Your name\]
    

**How can I filter the data being sent by a district or school?**

-   You can utilize [the filters in your Clever Dashboard](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115003249203) to limit the data a school is sending to you. If the school is utilizing a data source that allows for filtering of their data before the API, they can use that system to filter data as well. If the school has connected directly via their SIS and wishes to filter data before it reaches your application, please loop in Clever Support for more options in regards to filtering data from their SIS exports.

**Who should we contact if there are issues during the setup process?**

-   For support with rostering, the district should work primarily with the app partner as the point of contact. We want our application partners to feel free to loop Clever in as needed to address any rostering issues!
    
-   If they’re having issues locating the necessary SIS credentials, they should contact their SIS directly.
    
-   If they’re having issues with the setup for another OneRoster API data source, they should contact the company supporting that API.
    

**What development work is required in order to use AnySchool for rostering?**

-   None! Roster data synced via AnySchool will be made available through the same API endpoints that your existing rostering integrations use. Authentication into the AnySchool district experience is managed via access link, so no new authentication integrations are required either.
    

**What are the required fields for a users.csv and sections.csv?**

-   Required fields for the users.csv and sections.csv can be found in our [article for school admins here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001726#CSVuploadinstructions)

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For App Partners: Clever Complete](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001700)
    
-   [Rostering applications with AnySchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001726)
