* * *

## Best practices for using multiple apps in one session

We aim to connect students, teachers, and staff to as many of their resources as possible. After a user is logged in to Clever:  
 

1.  They can click on one of their connected applications.
    
2.  This will open the application or external link either in the device’s default web browser or the iOS application.
    
3.  If a user wants to go back to their Clever Portal, they should go back to the Clever application. From here they can launch an additional application, or access the same app again.
    

* * *

## Best practices for logging out of Clever

Whether using a shared device or not, the best practice is to always log out of your school organization's Identity Provider (IDP) in addition to Clever when you are finished. To do this, follow these steps:  
 

**Step 1:** Log out of the Clever application.

-   From the Clever Portal, click on your name in the top right corner, and select Log out.

  
**Step 2:** Log out of any learning applications and your school organization's Identity Provider (IdP) on your web browser.

-   **For example:** Google, Active Directory, LDAP, Canvas, Clever Passwords

![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000bfDt&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028Cle) For information regarding best practices on shared devices, please see this Help Center article: [For Families: Logging your students out of Clever on a shared device.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020614031)

If you have any additional questions, please reach out to [Clever support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326)! We are happy to help![](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020343092)

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Will the Clever application log students out after any period of time?**

-   Clever won't log the student out. To log out they must select the person icon in the top right corner and **Log out**.

**Can teachers or staff use the Clever application to log in?**

-   No, the application is for students only. If teachers, staff, or administrators want to log in to Clever on an iOS device, they should use a web browser.

**I'm still using V5 or earlier of the Clever application. How can I update to the newest version of the Clever app?**

-   If you haven't already, Clever recommends that you opt into updates for the Clever Application in the App Store.
-   For school organizations using an MDM:
    -   If you've enabled auto updates in your MDM, the Clever application should automatically update.
    -   If you don't have auto updates enabled you’ll need to follow your MDM's instructions for manually opting into updates for a specific app. [The Clever app can be found in the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clever/id1134186971) and also found via Apple School Manager.
-   For school organizations without an MDM**:**
    -   Your team can manually install the new Clever app on student devices via the Apple App Store.

* * *

**Related articles:**

-   [For Families: Troubleshooting issues with the Clever iOS app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360020343092)
-   [For Teachers: How do I troubleshoot using the Clever iOS app?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360040332591)

title: Troubleshooting Claims Rules
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001611#header1)  
2\. [Common Issues](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001611#common)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001611#header2)  
3\. [Missing Claims Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001611#missing)

## Overview

Claims rules define which attributes are sent to Clever from the identity provider and which fields Clever should use to perform the match and log the user into their Clever account. If you’re using any of the following login methods with Clever, learning how to troubleshoot claims rules related login issues can come in handy:  
  

-   [Active Directory](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202102576)
-   [Lenovo Stoneware / webNetwork](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215140667)
-   [LDAPS](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/207090387)
-   [Office 365 / Entra ID](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205889768)  
     

* * *

## Common Issues

For solving individual login issues, the [Access Logs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202113063)are your best friend! If you see a login failure that says **Unable to match SAML data with a user in Clever**, click on **View details** next to the failed login record, and you can see what’s failing to match:   
  

![Screenshot of a login log error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmMD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001mv6f)   
  

The Login Failure Details in your [Clever Dashboard > Authentication > Access logs](https://schools.clever.com/access-logs) will show you what we tried to match.  Please check there first and then look up the corresponding information in your student information system (SIS) or Clever Data Browser to see if you can spot any inconsistencies that would cause the login failure.

  
Alternatively, consider adjusting the claims rules to match users on a different field in Clever. You can find commonly used Clever fields here: [Claims Rules.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/215176617)

  
In the example below, the user is failing to log in because the username and email returned to Clever from the identity provider don't match any student username (Claim #1) or any email (Claim #2) currently in Clever.   
  
  
![Screenshot of a failed login details](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TmMD&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000001mvBV)   
  

In essence, a user (let's call her "Susan") was successfully able to prove who she was to the district's identity provider (IdP), but when the IdP spoke to Clever and said, "Hey, can you log Susan in for me?", Clever responded, "Sorry, we don't have a Susan here!" This is often caused by a user trying to log in that hasn't been synced to Clever.  
  
Other issues that can cause a login issue: 

-   The field we match on, say username or email address, is missing or incorrect in the SIS upload for the user in question.
-   There are duplicate or multiple users in the Clever account that we're able to match the login to (e.g., two users have the same email, which is also their username).

* * *

## Missing Claims Rules

Another common issue is that claims rules aren’t being configured to match _all_ user types who may be trying to sign into Clever using your identity provider.  
  
If your district uses separate claims rules for each user type and notices logins failing for one particular user type, your claims rules may need to be adjusted.   
  
Most commonly, districts will need to add additional claims rules in their identity provider for staff users. The following fields can be used to build your staff rules:

-   clever.staff.email
-   clever.staff.staff\_id
-   clever.staff.credentials.district\_username

We recommend matching across the same field for multiple user types by using **any** in place of the user type:

-   clever.**any**.email
-   clever.**any**.sis\_id
-   clever.**any**.credentials.district\_username

title: For School Tech Leads: Account recovery and password reset for Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever passwords
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026283931#Overview)  
2\. [Set up Account Recovery](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026283931#header2)  
3\. [Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026283931#header3)  
4\. [Resetting your password in Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026283931#header4)  
5\. [Resetting a student or teacher's password](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360026283931#header5)

  
 

## Overview

If your school district has enabled  Active Directory (AD), Entra ID, Google, or Clever passwords as a login method for Clever, you may be able to reset your passwords from Clever. Please note that this setup will only be available to you if your district-level admin has enabled this.  
  
In your Clever Portal, if you click on your name and do not see the **Account recovery** or **Set new password** in your Clever Portal, you must contact your district to reset your Google, Active Directory, Entra ID (i.e., third-party), or Clever password.  
  

![Set new password drop down](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElIuH)

If you do see the option for password reset, you can reset your Google, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Clever passwords from within the Clever Portal. To ensure you can reset your password outside of the Clever Portal, you will need to set up an account recovery method.

* * *

## Set Up Account recovery

You will need to set up account recovery to have the ability to reset your password for a third-party when you are not signed in to your Clever account. To configure account recovery, from your Portal click your name, **Account recovery.**

![Account recovery Portal screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElJIT)

  
Once clicked, a modal will pop up where you can select your preferred account recovery method. Depending on what your school district has enabled, you may have the option to enter an email address, a phone number, or answer security questions when you need to reset your password.  
 

![Clever\_\_\_Portal.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000002Lig2)

  
 

It’s also possible that your school organization may have provided a recovery method for you using information in their records. For example, if your schools collect personal email addresses, they may set up your account recovery email as your personal email address. If you’d like to update the information your school organization provides, you can do so using the recovery method setup described above. 

* * *

##   
Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page 

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords**

1.  From the Clever login screen, click on **get help logging in.**
    
2.  Choose ****Reset your account passwords.  
      
    ![Reset your account passwords screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElK9h)**** 
    
3.  Input your school district email address (not to be confused with a recovery email you have set up).  
      
    ![Account recovery page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008rDCD)
4.  You’ll be prompted to confirm your identity using a method you set up in your Portal settings. Select how you’ll confirm your identity.  
    ![Confirm identity screenshot](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElQev)   
      
    
5.  You can now set up your new password for both your Clever and third-party accounts by inputting a new password. Your school may have password requirements, which can be viewed by clicking on **See requirements**. Once completed, you can use your new password for your third-party account(s).  
    ![Set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElQzt) 

### **To reset only your Clever password**

1.  Navigate to your district's login page and select **Get help logging in.  
    ![Get help logging in](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000008rD2X)  
      
    **
2.   Click **Reset only your Clever password.  
      
    ![Screenshot of resetting only a Clever password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000Elwms)** 
3.  Please enter your school email address. If you are unsure of the email address to utilize, please contact your district support contact. Clever Support cannot provide this information to you.\\
4.  After you enter your email, Clever will send you a verification code through the method selected when setting up account recovery. Once you enter the verification code, you can set a new password:  
      
    ![Set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EmE8g) 

The password must match the requirements set by your district and Clever. Here are some of the requirements from Clever:

-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name

Once you've reset your password, you will be prompted to log in to the Clever Portal using your new password.

* * *

## Resetting your password in the Clever Portal

To reset your password while in the Clever Portal:

1.  Click on your name then **Set new password**.  
    ![Set new password drop down](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElIuH)  
      
    
2.  Input your new password, confirm the new password, and click **Set new password** to save.  
      
    ![Set new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000QNll&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EmGws) 

The password must match the requirements set by your district (example: minimum of 10 characters, including 1 number).

* * *

## Resetting a student or teacher's password (for school admin)

If you're a Clever School Tech Lead trying to reset a student or teacher's password, please [check out this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360044867112)!

* * *

**Related Articles:**

-   [For Clever Admins: Account recovery and password reset](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001613)
    
-   [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307)
    
-   [For Students: Password recovery and resets](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001663)
    
-   [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001612)

title: For Teachers: Clever Badges for students
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408#overview)   
2. [How do I print Badges for a class?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408#Header2)  
3. [How do I print a Badge for a student?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408#Header3)  
4\. [How do I void a Badge for a student?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408#void)  
5\. [Logging in with a Clever Badge](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408#LogginginwithBadge)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/236004408#FAQ)

## Overview

Badges allow students to hold up a physical badge to their device's webcam to get logged in, instead of typing in usernames and passwords. Badges are perfect for students who have trouble typing or remembering complex passwords - especially younger learners. Teachers get more time to teach, and students get more time to learn!

Badges are tied to the student. As such, changes in school, teacher, or section will not affect the Badge.

If the administrators on your school organization's Clever account have enabled Badges there are several ways you can manage Clever Badges as a teacher. You can print, regenerate, and void Badges for individual students, print Badges for whole classes, and even void Badges for all students en masse at the end of a school year.

##   

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** If you don't see the option to download student Badges, from your Student Roster tab, this means that Badges are not enabled for your school or grade level. [Please reach out to your school organization's tech support for more information.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648)

 **![Lightbulb](https://theme.zdassets.com/theme_assets/364037/af574183f2df705f2c75ac31fc7ab01b1a5a3d9a.png) Pro Tip: Security**  
Badges provide direct access to a student's Clever account and should be protected just like a password. Anyone who has access to a Badge can sign in as the student and access their accounts in both Clever and connected applications. Please protect the security of your students and do not share images of the Badge publicly on social media.

* * *

## How do I print Badges for a class?

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu 
    
     ![My Students > Student Roster of the teacher Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000003y2Jl) 
    
2.  Select the desired Class. 
3.  Click **Download class badges**. This will download all Badges for eligible students in your class.

  
 The Badges PDF format matches the Avery label template for 2” square Avery labels. 

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** Newly generated and printed Badges will no longer feature an expiration date. Existing printed Badges will continue to work past the expiration date. Admins are expected to void and print Badges annually during transition periods, like summer, to keep them secure ahead of the first day of school. 

* * *

## How do I print a Badge for a student?

###   
**Classes**

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu.
2.  Select the student's class.
3.  Select the student from your roster and click **Download Badge.**
4.  The Badge will download to your computer, which you can print and give to the student.

* * *

## How do I void a Badge for a student?

###   
**Classes**

1.  Navigate to the **Student Roster** tab under **My** **Students** in the left-hand menu  
2.  Select the student's class
3.  Select the student from your roster and click **Void Badge.**
4.  The Badge will be voided. You can then click **Download Badge** to download a brand new Badge for that student.

    **![Clever Academy logo icon](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**To help your student **log in with a backup code**, please visit: [For Teachers: Troubleshooting - Student logins](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/222933888#backup)

## ​​

* * *

## Logging in with a Clever Badge

1.  Students navigate to www.clever.com/badges. If prompted, click **Allow** to provide Clever access to the device camera.
2.  Hold the Badge up to the camera. Once the Badge is scanned, a green checkmark will appear.
3.  Students will then be redirected to their Clever Portal.

  **![Pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cGrl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB)  Please note:** Clever Badges are designed only to be used at clever.com/badges. Scanning the Badge with a QR code reader won't log you in to Clever.

* * *

##   
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Do all students have Badges?**

-   Not all students have access to Badges. Your school organization's administrators can choose which users have access to Badges. If your student doesn't have access to a Clever Badge and will need one, [please reach out to your school organization's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236003648?language=en_US#h_ffa9b241-1ab9-4cc4-bc4d-677ae0ece396).

**Can teachers and staff login using Clever Badges?**

-   No. Clever Badges are only available for students as a primary login method. Teachers can use a Clever Badge as a second factor if your schools use Clever’s Classroom Multi-factor authentication (MFA).

**What do I do if I see in my student has a Badge that expires soon?**

-   Existing printed Badges will continue to work past the expiration date. You can reach out to an admin to learn more about when you should expect Badges to be annually voided and reprinted.

title: For Clever Admins: Field mappings and customizing your data sync
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003630803#header1)  
2\. [Viewing field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003630803#VIEWING)  
3\. [Editing field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003630803#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/115003630803#FAQ)

## Overview

Sync field mappings refer to the relationship between fields from a student information system (SIS) and fields in Clever. A field mapping is when you specify the field in your SIS that you want to map to a specific data value in Clever. For example, Clever accepts student\_email as a data value. Depending on the field (e.g., emailaddress.emailaddress, SchoolEmail, etc.)  in which you store emails in your SIS, you may want to map a specific field to the student\_email field.

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For **SFTP syncs**, Clever has an SFTP web upload feature with field mapping! Find out more [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001608).

* * *

##   
Viewing field mappings

To view sync mappings, navigate to [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings > Sync Mappings box > View field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings). This page shows the relationship between each Clever Field & SIS Field.

###   
**Clever Field ¹**

Clever Field refers to the data field in Clever where the SIS data is being stored.

###   
**SIS Field ²**

SIS Field refers to the name of the field in the SIS where the data is being pulled from. In the below screenshot, we can see that for students, School\_id is being synced from HomeSchoolId³. If the SIS Field is followed by **(custom mapping)**⁴, it means the mapping was added custom for your account. If the SIS field is blank⁵, Clever is not pulling any information from the SIS for the corresponding Clever Field.

###   
**Actions ⁶**

**Edit⁷** indicates that Clever Admins may customize which SIS field to sync to the corresponding Clever Field. If the value you are looking for is unavailable from the dropdown, please contact Clever Support with the exact name of the SIS field you want to map, and our team will investigate whether the mapping is supported. If the **Action** field is blank⁸, the SIS Field either is not customizable or requires a Clever Support team member to customize the field for your account. Contact Clever Support to learn about your available options.

###   
**Record Types ⁹**

Use the view record type selectors to view the mappings for each record type. If you require a field mapping for a record type not listed, please contact Clever Support to learn about your options.  
  
  
![Clever Field Mappings page with sections highlighted](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005TSW4)

* * *

## Editing field mappings

Depending on your sync type, you may be able to customize which field in your SIS correlates to which field in Clever through a field mapping. If you utilize an SFTP sync, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001608) for more information on field mapping.

If you utilize a Clever-managed auto sync, you may be able to complete basic field mappings yourself via your Clever Dashboard, or you can reach out to Clever Support, and our team can assist with more complex field mappings.

For the following auto-syncs, some custom fields can be added and customized via your Clever Dashboard for self-service field mapping:

-   Illuminate Auto Sync
    
-   [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)
    
-   [SchoolInsight Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237)
    
-   [Skyward LMS API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    

For the following syncs, custom fields can be added and customized by reaching out to Clever support:

-   [Aeries Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/203005016)
    
-   [Blackbaud API sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001544)
    
-   [Infinite Campus API sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/226677767)
    
-   [Skyward Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202058193) 
    
-   [Skyward OneRoster (Qmlativ) API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    

If you utilize one of the syncs above that supports self-service mappings and want to determine if you can edit a field mapping yourself, navigate to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page, locate the Sync Mappings box, and click on the [View field mappings button](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings).

![View field mappings button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000H5Tqn)

If you see an **Edit** button in the actions column, you can customize the field mapping for a specific data type (schools, teachers, students, sections, enrollments).

Click on **Edit** to view a dropdown of available SIS Fields to map from.

![Edit field mappings dropdown](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000TBbB&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000H5MJ4)

If you do not see the SIS field you wish to map from in the dropdown, please contact Clever Support to see if the field is available for mapping by our team.

If the field is available, please select it and then click **Update**. This will save the field mapping, and the data will be pulled from the new field the next time your sync runs. You can push a manual sync following [these instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115004747027).

Depending on the percentage of changes, this may cause a [sync hold](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358). Please review the hold carefully via your [Clever Dashboard > SIS sync > Last Attempted Sync](https://schools.clever.com/sync) page[](https://schools.clever.com/sync). If the changes are intended, you can approve them and the new data will sync to Clever.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Which sync types support self-service mappings?**

-   Illuminate Auto Sync
    
-   [PowerSchool Plugin Sync](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001590)
    
-   [SchoolInsight Auto Sync](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/206090237)
    
-   [Skyward LMS API](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/232211028)
    

**What if I do not see an edit button on the Field Mappings page?**

-   You cannot complete a self-service field mapping for this field. Please contact Clever Support for additional information.
    

**What if I do not see the SIS field I want to map from?**

-   Please contact Clever Support for additional information.
    

**What if I accidentally chose the wrong field for my mapping?**

-   If your sync is on hold, discard the hold, then navigate back to your [field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page and edit the mapping.
    
-   If your sync is not on hold or you already approved the hold, navigate to your [field mappings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings/mappings) page and edit the mapping. If more than 24 hours have passed since you completed the mapping, you may want to notify users or application partners that there may have been accidental data changes.

title: Infinite Campus API Sync
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#h_01EHZEZF2XJN2MMVWZ04HEB6WS) ​ 2\. [Requirement: User (Portal) accounts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#portal_accounts) 3\. [Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#setup) 4\. [Troubleshooting](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#troubleshooting) ​ 5\. [School year/term rollover](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#Header5) 6\. [Default field mappings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#default) ## Overview This article provides information on the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of the Infinite Campus API sync.[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#ICurlupdate) If you utilize or plan to utilize this sync, please note: - Your system version - Clever pulls data from Infinite Campus via the OneRoster Provisioning API, which is free for school organizations. In order to sync your data through the OneRoster API you'll need to make sure your Infinite Campus is on version 1733 or higher.      •  School organizations using OneRoster provisioning prior to Campus 1733 are free to continue using it      •  School organizations that were not using OneRoster provisioning prior to Campus 1733 may contact Campus Support to have the functionality enabled - Which version of OneRoster you plan to utilize. [1edtech](https://www.1edtech.org/) (formerly IMS Global) has released the final version of the OneRoster v1.2 format. See below for information on how to set up your connection with OneRoster 1.2 or how to upgrade your existing connection.[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#ICurlupdate) The Infinite Campus API Sync: - Runs every six hours, by querying the OneRoster API - Syncs all students who are designated as "active today" (activeToday = 1) - Syncs all active staff members (employment.active = 1) - Supports co-teachers for sections (sectionInfo\_teacherPersonID, sectionInfo\_teacher2PersonID, etc) - Students and teachers need Infinite Campus Portal accounts in order to sync to Clever (see below) - Support custom field mappings (please contact Clever Support to set this up) - The available fields can be found [here](https://www.imsglobal.org/lis/imsOneRosterv1p0/imsOneRosterCSV-v1p0.html#_Toc421598318)  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DGw)  Please Note:** Infinite Campus OneRoster API sync cannot sync ell\_status, frl\_status, and iep\_status. They can be uploaded via custom data. Visit [this article for instructions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912).  SFTP upload of custom data is available to all schools. Please reach out to [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326) for assistance with gaining access to your own Clever SFTP Directory. You'll need to set up any automatic exports to the remote site, as Clever doesn't provide support for automation scripting. * * * ## Requirement: User (Portal) accounts In order for a person to be accessible in the Infinite Campus OneRoster API (and thus synced to Clever) the person needs a User (Portal) account in Infinite Campus. For documentation on creating user accounts, please review [this documentation](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/user-account). To create user accounts in bulk, please review [this documentation](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/user-account-batch-wizard). To verify if a person has a user account, search for the user in Infinite Campus. If the person has a username, they have a user account. In the example below, "Amelkin, Federique" has a user account but "Freda, Irene" does not. As a result, "Freda, Irene" will not be accessible to Clever via the Infinite Campus OneRoster API. To add a user account in Infinite Campus, click **Add User.**  ![Example of a user with vs. without a Portal account in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005RvZm) * * * ## Setup ### **1\. Obtain API credentials** In order to configure the API sync you'll first generate API credentials in Infinite Campus:  1. Navigate to **Instruction > Settings > Digital Learning Application Configuration** (or **System Administration > Learning Interoperability** in the Classic Navigation) 2. Click **Add Application**, scroll to the bottom, and click **Connect to Other Applications** 3. Enter **Clever** as the application name ![Screenshot of browsing for applications in Infinite Campus to add Clever](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lvqY)  4. Click **Generate New OneRoster Connection** ![Screenshot of where to generate a new OneRoster connection in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lvpL)  5. For OneRoster version, select your OneRoster version > **Generate ![Screenshot of generating a new OneRoster connection in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000GgB7Y)**   6. Share ClientID, Client Secret, Base URL and Token URL ![Screenshot of setting up OneRoster connection in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005lvml) **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DGw) Please Note:** If you already have connected Infinite Campus to Clever and would like to move from OAuth 1.0 OneRoster v1.2 with OAuth 2.0, please go to your [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page and click the **Upgrade** button. Then, start at [step 4](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/202094756#step4) in the directions above. After moving to OneRoster 1.2 with OAuth 2.0, we recommend deleting or disabling your old connection that used OAuth 1.0.   IMPORTANT Regarding Staff: Before upgrading, be sure to check that any non-instructional staff you wish to include are associated with one of the following roles in Infinite Campus: **counselor**, **districtadministrator**, **principal**, **siteadministrator**, **systemadministrator**, or **proctor**.  ![Sync Settings screen with arrow pointing to OneRoster 1.2 upgrade button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl000000CCyH) ### **2\. Change sync type of Clever account** If you already have a Clever account and are switching to the API sync, [please contact Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). In your message, please specify which version of OneRoster (v1.1 or v1.2) you plan to use. Our team will need to switch your account sync type before you can move forward. If you are just getting started with Clever, the Infinite Campus API sync will be the default when you choose your sync type for your account. You're free to move on to the next step! ### **3\. Enter API credentials in Clever** Once your account's sync type is the Infinite Campus API sync, please take the credentials for the API and enter them into the [Sync Settings page](https://schools.clever.com/settings/system) in your Clever Dashboard: - **Base** **URL**: Enter the base URL copied from Infinite Campus  - For OneRoster v1.2, the URL should look like this: https:///campus/api/oneroster/v1p2//ims/oneroster - For OneRoster v1.1, the URL should look like this:  https:///api/oneroster/v1p1//ims/oneroster/v1p1 - **Client ID:** Enter the Client ID copied from Infinite Campus - **Client Secret:** Enter the Client Secret copied from Infinite Campus - **Confirm Client Secret:** Enter the Client Secret copied from Infinite Campus   ### **4\. Sync** Once you input and save your sync credentials, the sync will automatically begin running and complete within approximately 30 minutes. You can also click **Sync Now** on the Sync Settings page to start a sync at any time.  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028DGw) Please note:** Infinite Campus syncs can be customized to sync nightly, instead of every six hours, but the time of day that the syncs occur is not customizable. Syncs can always be initiated at any time from your Clever Dashboard on the [Data sources > SIS sync > Settings tab > Sync Controls box > Sync Now button.](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) * * * ## Troubleshooting ### **Common sync errors and troubleshooting steps** #### Below are some sync errors you may see in your Clever Dashboard. We recommend the following steps to resolve:

Error

Context and resolution

There are currently no active academic sessions in your Infinite Campus instance. Your sync will resume once your academic sessions become active again.

Your current school year has ended, but the new school year has not yet begun.

Clever begins pulling enrollments 21 days before the enrollments become active. If the start of school is more than 21 days away but you'd like to see your new school year enrollments syncing into Clever, please reach out to Clever Support and let us know the first day of school, as well as when you'd like your enrollments to begin syncing.

Invalid Key/Secret specified. Please check SIS credentials on settings page.The credentials you have provided to Clever on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page don't match the credentials in Infinite Campus. Please follow these setup instructions and ensure the URL, client ID, and client secret match in Infinite Campus and Clever.
InfiniteCampus API is not currently available at the URL provided. Please update the URL in your system settings page if necessary.

Either the URL you have provided to Clever doesn't match the URL in Infinite Campus, or the Infinite Campus API is currently unavailable.

  • You can wait and try using the Sync Now button on your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page after a period of time to see if API becomes available. If the issue doesn't resolve try the steps below.
  • Please follow these setup instructions and ensure the URL in Infinite Campus matches the URL in Clever.

Invalid sync credentials for Infinite Campus. Please update the sync credentials.

Or

Invalid username/password specified. Please check SIS credentials on settings page.

This error most commonly occurs if an API certificate has expired. To resolve:

  • Please confirm if your Clever API certificate status is valid (green).

  • To do so, navigate to User Security > OAuth Management > OAuth Client Management. The location may vary based on your SIS setup. Please reach out to Infinite Campus directly if you can’t locate the certificate status in your SIS.

  • If the status is red, please update the token expiration date and status. Once updated and green in Infinite Campus, update your web access URL, consumer key, and secret on the Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page.

Invalid API URL for Infinite Campus. Please update the Web Access URL in sync settings.

This error commonly occurs if the API certificate is generated for the wrong sync or OAuth type or the certificate information is input incorrectly. To resolve:

  • Navigate to your Clever Dashboard > Data sources > SIS sync > Settings page. Confirm if your sync type is set to Infinite Campus OneRoster 1.1 or 1.2 at the top of the page.

  • Review your Base URL. Confirm that the correct version of the api is referenced in the URL (v1p1 or v1p2).

  • If your sync type and Base URL do not match either:

    • Contact Clever Support to change your sync type on our backend

    • Regenerate your API certificate with the correct OneRoster version selected

  • If your sync type and Base URL do match, please confirm that you have entered the web access URL, consumer key, and consumer secret correctly:

    • Clever > Infinite Campus

    • Web Access URL > Base URL

    • Consumer Key > Client ID

    • Consumer Secret > Client Secret

  • If you have confirmed your sync settings are entered correctly, please ensure the following Clever IPs are allow-listed in your network:

    • 54.241.134.131

    • 50.18.217.135

    • 54.241.154.41

  • If the sync error persists, please contact Clever Support

URL must start with https://

Please confirm your URL starts with https://.

You may want to follow these setup instructions and ensure the URL in Infinite Campus matches the URL in Clever.

### **Missing records** If an entire record is missing, we recommend checking the following:  

Record Type

Troubleshooting

Student
  • Must have an active Infinite Campus User (Portal) account
  • Check that the student's Enrollment = Active
  • Must have a username populated in the useraccount.personID field in Infinite Campus
  • Make sure the student's enrollment start and end dates are in the active school year
  • The student's enrollment must not be flagged as a no show
  • The student must have person and current identity records
  • Make sure the student has a valid grade level designation
  • The following data items associated with the student’s enrollment must not be marked external LMS exclude: School, Calendar, Schedule Structure, Enrollment, and Grade Level
Student Contacts
  • Must have Infinite CampusUser (Portal) account
  • Also have to be listed as Type = Guardian
  • Each guardian must have the "Portal" checkbox checked under their student's relationship tab
Teacher
  • Must have an active Infinite Campus User (Portal) account
  • Check that EmploymentAssignment = Active
  • Check that the District Assignment start and end dates are valid
  • Assignment must be flagged as Teacher (Users > Status / Role)

Teachers are associated with schools based on their sections. If a teacher does not have any assigned sections and needs to be associated with multiple schools, Clever recommends syncing the user as "Staff". Please see the requirements below to sync a user as "Staff" from Infinite Campus. As an alternative, a user can also be added to Clever and associated to multiple schools using Clever's custom staff feature.
StaffThe user's District Assignment in Infinite Campus must meet all the following requirements:
  • Start Date and End Date are inclusive of current date
  • Username field must be populated
  • The record must have an email address
  • At least one flag other than 'Teacher' checked. 'Teacher' can be checked. (If 'Teacher' is checked, both a teacher and staff account will be provisioned for the user.)
  • A user must be associated with one of the following roles to be considered Staff: counselor, districtadministrator, principal, siteadministrator, systemadministrator, or proctor
School
  • The API sync only pulls the Primary master schedule, so if you have more than one master schedule at a site, each must be created as their own school instance
  • Check active status: District.Inactive !=1 or District.Inactive is null
Section
  • Check active status: Trial.Active=1 + Course.Active=1 + SchoolYear.Active=1
  • Check whether the section's term is current
  • Section must have a primary teacher and there must be at least one student enrolled
To **prevent** a record from syncing, ensure it doesn't meet all the criteria listed above for its record type. If the record (student, teacher, section) is in Clever but data is missing or incorrect for the record (i.e. incorrect email, missing username), navigate to the [**Sync > Settings**](https://schools.clever.com/sync/settings) page in your Clever Dashboard. Under **Sync Controls**, click **[View defaults.](https://assets.clever.com/documents/autosyncs/infinitecampusapi.pdf)** Here you can view which fields Clever is pulling for each record and field. In the below example:    1. If a teacher's email address was incorrect, confirm the email is correct in the "contact.email" field in Infinite Campus 2. If a teacher is missing State\_teacher\_id, you will see that Clever does not have this data available to us via the OneRoster API. Please contact Clever Support to see what options may be available to pull this data.  * * * ## School year/term rollover The Infinite Campus API sync requires that students be active in order to be synced through the API. Once a school year ends, students are no longer active in Infinite Campus. This causes the synced data to no longer include enrollments or student files. You may see the following error in your Dashboard: _"Encountered zero students data"_.  Once students and other record types are marked "Active" in Infinite Campus for the next school year, the sync will resume as expected. Alternatively, Clever will pull data 21 days prior to the beginning of the school organization's next active academic session. For example, if school begins on August 22nd, Clever will pull the upcoming data on August 1st. To preserve access for your users between school years, Clever recommends that you [put your sync on pause](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/205666507) during the summer to prevent deletions.   * * * ## Default field mappings **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dYg9&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** Infinite Campus OneRoster v1.2 has released a UI checkbox that when checked "Legal Names" are used over preferred names. When not checked, preferred names will be sent to Clever. To access this navigate to: Digital App Configuration > Select Clever app > Edit > Connection Configuration in Infinite Campus. Below are the default field mappings for Infinite Campus OneRoster API syncs that are managed by Clever. If you'd like to customize your field mappings, please contact Clever Support.   - If a field is blank, the field is either not pulled by default, or not accessible to Clever. Infinite Campus determines what data to surface via the API. Learn more about Infinite Campus' data models below:  - [OneRoster 1.1 Data Models](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/oneroster-11-data-models) - [OneRoster 1.2 Data Models](https://kb.infinitecampus.com/help/oneroster-12-data-models) - If you want to change a field mapping, please contact Clever Support to learn what options are available.  - If a field is not coming through with the correct value, Clever Support may need to complete a value mapping. This is common for: Grade, FRL\_Status, ELL\_Status, and IEP\_Status. - If you want to sync data that isn’t surfaced to Clever, you can upload the data to Clever via SFTP as custom (extension) fields. Learn more about this [here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360024370912). ### Schools

title: For Clever Admins: Using and recommending Clever Library
text:
This article contains the following: 1. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042933711#overview) 2\. [Recommending the Library to teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042933711#header1) 3\. [Recommending Library applications to teachers](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042933711#header2) 4\. [Viewing Library installs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042933711#header3) 5\. [Additional Library settings](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042933711#header4) 6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360042933711#header5) ## Overview The Clever Library is a safe way for teachers to explore new classroom tools. Instead of finding new applications anywhere on the internet that may have varying data privacy standards, teachers can try new apps in the Clever Library with built-in data-privacy guardrails and admin oversight. When a teacher adopts a Library application with SSO, Clever shares only the absolute minimum information: student first name, last initial, grade level, and course enrollment. Clever does not share any sensitive information with Library applications, including student numbers, SIS IDs, emails, state IDs, or demographic information. Furthermore, all Library applications sign a universal data privacy agreement. This article will guide you through supporting the use of the Clever Library and making recommendations for teachers. If you need information on setting up Library restrictions, [please see this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741). * * * ## Recommending the Library to teachers Clever Library handles rostering automatically and ensures data minimization, making it safer than teachers signing up for apps independently. You can actively recommend the Library as the primary place for teachers to discover tools. Below is a suggested email template you can utilize to share more about the Clever Library with your teachers. **Email template to recommend teachers use the Library for resources**   _Subject: The safest way to find new classroom apps_ Hi Team, We know how important it is to find the right digital tools to engage your students. To help you do this safely and save you time on setup, we recommend using the **Clever Library** to discover new applications. **Why use the Clever Library?** - **It's Safer:** Apps in the Library sign a universal data privacy agreement and only receive the minimum necessary student data (just first name and last initial). - **It's Faster:** You don't need to manually create student accounts. Rostering is handled automatically through Clever. - **It's Approved:** Tools in the Library operate within our data privacy guardrails. You can access the Library directly from your Teacher Portal, and learn more about adding applications [in this Clever article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360013488672). Best, \[Admin Name\] * * * ## Recommending Library applications to teachers To recommend resources, go to [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Library Controls > Recommended.](https://schools.clever.com/library/recommended) Recommend a resource by searching for it by name. We also encourage adding notes to your recommendations to highlight to teachers why and for what purpose a resource is recommended. You may also delete a recommendation at any time. ![Library recommendations page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000cc04M) ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Tc) **Please note:** The Clever Library is a place for teachers to find and adopt resources - therefore, the only resources that can be recommended are those that support teacher sign-ups. School or district-adopted resources, such as Dreambox, Lexia, or iReady, aren't available in the Library. Resources that are recommended will appear front and center when a teacher visits the Library. ![Clever Library home page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000VYqFG) When a teacher visits a recommended resource, your recommendation and associated notes are featured prominently.  ![Recommended app](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000SmyEf) * * * ## Viewing Library Installs To view applications that have been installed by teachers, navigate to your [Library controls > Applications](https://schools.clever.com/teacher-installs) tab**.** Here you'll see a column next to each application that shows you how many Teacher Installs the app has. ![Teacher Install column](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ZGzON)  To view installs with greater detail, scroll to the bottom and select **Export teacher install data.** ![Export button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YGVN&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P00000285Tr) The information provided in the downloadable CSV is described below:

Field

Description

teacher_idThe Clever ID of the teacher that installed the resource
first_nameThe first name of the teacher that installed the resource
last_nameThe last name of the teacher that installed the resource
emailThe email address of the teacher that installed the resource
schoolThe school of the teacher that installed the resource
app_idThe Clever ID of the resource installed
app_nameThe name of the installed resource
install_dateThe date the teacher added the resource
* * * ## Additional Library settings To ensure administrators always have control over their school organization’s EdTech usage through Clever, there are additional controls admins can utilize to manage the Library. Below is a short list of these additional controls. You can learn more in this article. - **New application approvals:** Configure settings so that any newly added Library application requires your approval before teachers can begin utilizing it. - **New application notifications:** Ensure you are informed about new Library applications by setting up email notifications. - **Block a resource:** If there is an application your school organization has determined your teachers shouldn’t utilize, you can block it in the Library. You can also bulk block applications. - **Turn off the Clever Library:** You can also elect to turn off the Clever Library for your school organization. * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Can I block the Library or specific applications?** - Yes, please [see this article for more information](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741). * * * **Related articles:** - [For Clever Admins: Managing Library restrictions and application approvals](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001741) - [For Clever Admins: Clever Library privacy](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001453)

title: Achieve3000 and Actively Learn to McGraw Hill Migration
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001716#header1)  
2\. [Key steps: Districts already connected to McGraw Hill app on Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001716#header2)  
3\. [Key steps: Districts not yet connected to McGraw Hill app on Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001716#header3)  
4\. [Data requirements](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001716#header4)  
5\. [Getting support](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001716#header5)

## Overview

Access for Achieve3000 and Actively Learn is transitioning to the McGraw Platform beginning with the 2025-26 school year.

**Who’s impacted? All districts that are currently connected to the Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn apps.**

The McGraw Hill integration through Clever can do the following:

-   Provide Single Sign-On (SSO) access to McGraw Hill content and classes.
    
-   Create and update class rosters on the McGraw Hill platform.
    
-   Assign McGraw Hill content to the appropriate users.
    

We will be sharing a webinar recording that walks you through the following steps on our joint resource hub, clever.com/mcgraw-hill.

  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000SqtJ&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000NDXnJ)  Please note:** If anyone at your district or school is using Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn for summer school, please hold off on making the changes detailed below until summer school is over.

* * *

## Key steps: Districts already connected to McGraw Hill app on Clever

1.  Please review and update any data sharing rules set in the Clever Dashboard to include Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn roster data in the McGraw Hill application. You can click into your apps from your Clever Dashboard to review the data currently shared with Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn, then edit the sharing for McGraw Hill to include this data.
    
2.  Assign McGraw Hill online content to the relevant courses/classes via McGraw Hill’s web-based tool: Access Manager.  The McGraw Hill team can help with any questions about Access Manager.
    
3.  Once the transition is completed, please confirm with the McGraw Hill team and then disconnect the Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn apps.
    

  
 

* * *

## Key steps: Districts not yet connected to McGraw Hill app on Clever

1.  Please request the McGraw Hill app on Clever by going to your [Clever Dashboard > Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) and searching for McGraw Hill, then requesting the app.
    
2.  Set your data sharing rules for McGraw Hill to reflect what is currently shared with Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn. Please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007) for more guidance on setting data sharing in Clever.
    
3.  After the McGraw Hill team has received and reviewed your data, they’ll guide you through the remaining steps to complete your McGraw Hill integration through Clever, including guidance on when to disconnect Achieve3000 and/or Actively Learn.
    

  
 

* * *

## Data requirements

The following fields must be successfully synced to Clever in order for your data to successfully sync with McGraw Hill:

-   Term names, start dates, and end dates
    
-   Course names 
    
-   Teacher, student, and staff usernames
    
-   Teacher email addresses 
    
-   Student email (recommended but not required)
    

Please note that user IDs (sis\_ids) must be globally unique across your district. In other words, a teacher and a student cannot have the same sis\_id in Clever.

You can check if your data meets the requirements by navigating to the [McGraw Hill > Data Quality tab](https://schools.clever.com/applications/mcgraw-hill/warnings) in your Clever Dashboard. 

For more information about the McGraw Hill Clever integration, please see [this article](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/360046491912).  
 

* * *

## Getting support

Please stay tuned for our webinar recording detailed this migration process, which will be posted to clever.com/mcgraw-hill.

**Clever Support:**

-   For help troubleshooting rosters, SIS Clever syncs, login settings, or data sharing rules, check out our [Help Center](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us/categories/200147297) where you can open a ticket with Clever Support using the blue chat box in the bottom right corner.
    

**McGraw Hill Digital Technical Support:**

-   For help with McGraw Hill platforms, please contact **[integrationsupport@mheducation.com](mailto:integrationsupport@mheducation.com)**.  
     

* * *

title: For App Partners: What's Clever?
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001731#header1)  
2\. [Clever Complete](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001731#header2)  
3\. [Clever's products for application partners](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001731#header3)  
4\. [Clever's products for schools](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001731#header4)  
5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001731#header5)

## Overview

Clever is the global identity platform for education that works with any school, unifying rostering, single sign-on (SSO), and Learning Management System (LMS) connections. By automating data transfers directly from school organizations, Clever ensures that your application always has up-to-date roster information. Using Clever means that you’ll have fewer custom integrations, faster onboarding, and more time spent building great learning experiences.

Clever also supports Single Sign-On (SSO) for students and teachers through the Clever Portal, making it easier and more secure for users to access your application with just one login.

Best of all, Clever is free for school organizations in the U.S. and Canada, so there’s no cost barrier for them to connect with your app. You can learn more about [Clever’s partner pricing here](https://www.clever.com/pricing#partners).

Clever is built to be the most secure and reliable way for schools to connect with edtech applications—streamlining implementation and improving the user experience for everyone involved.  
 

* * *

## Clever Complete

Clever Complete is the strategic solution purpose-built for edtech scalability. It connects your application to any school through a single, secure integration for rostering, SSO, and LMS connections, whether they use Clever or not.

The Secure Sync rostering integration includes additional data fields, including demographics and attendance.

![How Clever Complete works](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000arU1&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000S7PG5)

Clever Complete provides universal connectivity to any school. For school organizations not currently on the Clever platform, this is enabled via the [AnySchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001725) capability, which is included in your Clever Complete agreement.  
 

* * *

## Clever's products for application partners

Clever products for application partners include:

-   **Secure Sync rostering:** Real-time, standardized rostering
    
-   **Clever LMS Connect:** LMS integrations with Schoology, Google Classroom, and Canvas that simplify single sign-on and save teachers time with gradebook syncs.
    
-   **Clever SSO:** Single sign-on into your application for all users
    
-   **Clever Library:** An integration for partners with free and freemium versions of their application that helps you promote and track teacher-driven adoption of your education products.
    

Depending on the Clever integration you choose, you’ll also gain access to additional features via your Clever Dashboard that help with school data management, such as:

-   Safety thresholds, which help prevent unintended data changes
    
-   Filters to block schools from sending unnecessary rostering data
    
-   Extended data fields such as demographics and attendance
    
-   Tools for troubleshooting
    
-   And more!
    

Learn more about Clever’s [product offerings here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/218727678), or schedule a call [with our team to learn more](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup).  
 

* * *

## Clever's products for schools

In addition to simplifying rostering and SSO for schools, Clever provides several other products and features that help simplify and secure edtech usage in schools, such as Analytics, Clever Identity Management (IDM), and Classroom MFA. Learn more about [the school experience with Clever here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202000976).  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**What is the cost of Clever?**

-   You can find [general pricing information here](https://www.clever.com/pricing#partners), or set up a call with our team t[o learn more and receive a quote](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup).
    

**Where can I learn more about the integration process?**

-   Consult our [developer documentation here](https://dev.clever.com/?_gl=1*18jgfhz*_ga*MTYwNzMxOTUxMi4xNzUyMDY1MjM5*_ga_RKDHZLJBH6*czE3NTc1OTQ4OTAkbzMyJGcxJHQxNzU3NTk1ODE5JGo2MCRsMCRoMA..), or schedule a call with [our team here](https://www.clever.com/developer-signup).
    

**What if I already use Clever, but I’m interested in changing our integration?**

Please reach out to your Application Success manager, or [contact our support team for further assistance](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360001041326).
