title: For Clever Admins: Downloading & deleting announcement and messaging history
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001483#overview) 2. [Downloading the announcement and messaging history for a student or teacher](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001483#header1) 3\. [Viewing the announcement and messaging transcript](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001483#header2) 4\. [Deleting transcripts](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001483#header3) 5\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001483#header4) ![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YxiP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000065eMa)![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YxiP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000065eMf)![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YxiP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000065eMV)![image](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YxiP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000065eM7) ## Overview Clever admins can download the announcement and messaging history for an individual student or teacher from that user’s Profile page in the Clever Dashboard! Clever Messaging was discontinued in January 2026 to allow the Clever teams to focus on features that enhance our identity platform offerings, including recent free tools like [Substitute Access](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001675), [role-based access control](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702), and [access logs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001698).  Clever messaging previously enabled teachers and students to engage in bidirectional messaging via their Clever Portal. Announcements allow teachers to send unidirectional announcements to an entire class or all students assigned to them. Announcements are still available. You can still access transcripts for both messaging and announcements via a user’s Profile page. Clever maintains message history based on [your settings here](https://schools.clever.com/portal/communication/district-messaging-settings). * * * ## Downloading the announcement and messaging history for a student or teacher 1\. Navigate to the student or teacher’s profile page in Clever by searching for their name, SIS ID, or Clever ID using the search tool in the upper right-hand corner of your Clever Dashboard. 2. From the student or teacher’s profile page, select **Download message history**. You should see a notification that an email with the transcript will be sent shortly. ![image.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YxiP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000003CPum) 3\. You’ll receive an email with a link to the transcript. Please note that you’ll need to be logged in to your Clever account to open the link. The transcript will then open as a CSV file.   * * * ## Viewing the announcement and messaging transcript The transcript will include every message or announcement the user has ever sent, including any that were deleted by the user. The transcript won’t include any messages or announcements that were deleted as part of the summer rollover process if you've opted into this [(see below)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001483#header3). The transcript file will be organized into four fields:

Field

Description

 Date_created The timestamp of the message in UTC-0
 From The Clever ID of the user that sent the message
 To The Clever ID of the user that received the message. For an announcement this field will be blank.
 BodyThe message sent from the sender to the recipient
  * * * ## Deleting messaging and announcement transcripts Clever has retained all messaging and announcement transcripts since the messaging product was launched in August 2020. Districts can **opt in** to have messages and announcements deleted by [navigating to this page](https://schools.clever.com/portal/communication/district-messaging-settings). If the toggle on the messaging settings page is turned on, the previous school year's messages and announcements will be deleted starting after August 1 of the new school year. This toggle will gray out after August 1 until the last year's messages and announcements are deleted. ![Messaging settings](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000YxiP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000efwNZ)    * * * ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) **Will I see any messages or announcements that a user has received in the transcript, or will it only list the messages the user has sent to other users?** - Yes! The transcript will contain the messages the user has received, as well as the messages they sent before messaging was deprecated in January 2026, depending on your messaging history settings. Announcements beyond January 2026 will be included. **Can I download the Messaging** **and announcement** **history for multiple users at one time?** - No. Message and announcement history can only be downloaded on a per-user basis.  **Can I delete a user’s messages or announcements from the Clever Dashboard?** - No. This feature allows Clever Admins to view a user’s Messaging history, but not to delete messages. If you need to delete a Messaging thread for a user, please contact Clever Support with the Clever IDs of the sender and recipient, and the date of the thread that needs to be deleted, and we will be happy to assist! * * *

title: Converting to HMHCore API Integration
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585#header1)  
2\. [Warning](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585#header2)  
3\. [How do I know which connection I'm using?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585#header3)  
4\. [Steps in Clever](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585#header4)  
5\. [Steps in HMH](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585#header5)  
6\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001585#header6)

## Overview

In Summer 2022, HMH enabled the ability for districts to roster through Clever. At the time, districts who set up rostering were able to export data from Clever to HMH in One Roster format. Now, HMH is making use of Clever’s API to roster.   
  
We recommend all new districts use the API Connection to reduce points of failure. This article will guide those districts who wish to convert from the One Roster integration to the API integration for easier support and reliability.  
 

* * *

## Warning

When you change rostering methods mid-year, IDs can change, which may result in the loss of data. It is suggested to make changes such as this one during the summer period. There are specific and detailed warnings about precautions that must be taken in the setup instructions.  
 

* * *

## How do I know which connection I'm using?

In your Clever admin dashboard, confirm if you are set up with HMHCore.  
  
![HMH core app in Clever with logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T1AP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKU4E)   
  
If you are, check under Settings > SFTP credentials. If this data is blank, your district is either already set up on the API or has not yet set up the [HMHCore integration](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001525). If this information is complete, you are most likely making use of Clever’s OneRoster export to HMH.  
  
![SFTP credentials](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T1AP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005mVyz)  
 

* * *

## Steps in Clever

In order to switch to the API, you will first need to stop sending rostering data to HMH through Clever’s One Roster Connection by following these steps:

1.  Navigate to HMHCore in your Clever Dashboard  
    ![HMHcore in Clever with logo](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T1AP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKUnN)
2.  Click on Settings  
    ![HMHCore finish setting up](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T1AP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000AKVBZ)
3.  Scroll down to the bottom and disable your One Roster Exports![disable oneroster exports](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000T1AP&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P000005mVzs)

* * *

## Steps in HMH

If you have followed the steps above, you can start at Step 3 in the onboarding steps here: Rostering HMH by Clever API connection

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can I make this change mid school year?

-   As there is the possibility that IDs and data can change in this conversion, it is recommended to take place during a off-school period between academic years

* * *

**Related Articles:** 

-   [HMHCore Setup](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001525)
-   [HMH SAML SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001510)

title: Clever + easyCBM Setup Guide
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001591#header1)  
2\. [Setup Process](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001591#header2)  
3\. [Recommended Sharing Rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001591#header3)  
4\. [FAQs](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001591#header4)  
 

## Overview

The district version of easyCBM with Riverside Insights has partnered with Clever to make rostering easier. This guide contains important information about the setup process.   
 

**IMPORTANT:** Please read before proceeding with the setup process

**Communication:** Setting up a Clever integration requires a conversation with Riverside Insights Data Integration Team.  
  
**Switching from self-rostering:**  To move to Clever, Riverside Insights and easyCBM need to work with districts to ensure teachers or school administrators who need ‘building’ or ‘district’ level access in easyCBM are be marked ‘staff’ in Clever and have ‘building’ access in Clever to the buildings shared with easyCBM. In the case of teachers who need easyCBM district-level access, a second ‘staff’ user with the same email address as the teacher user can be created in Clever, and they will match up and work as one user with both teacher and district-level (or building level) access.  
  
Further, teachers will be paired with students in easyCBM who are in common sections in Clever.  
  
When data is shared, easyCBM will review to make sure the Student ID matches the student’s sis\_id in Clever. If it is not matching:

-   easyCBM requests district to send us a file with old/new mappings for Student ID matching the Clever sis\_id field.  CSV file with oldid,newid.
-   District sends CSV file and halts further imports from manual or automated processes of CSV uploads themselves.
-   EasyCBM migrates Student ID to new (matching) numbers using data sent and verifies students match up with Clever. This will re-match your historic data with your shared Clever data to retain historical data.

* * *

## Setup Process

1.  Make sure your district is set up with Clever. If your district does not yet have a Clever account, you can get started by navigating to [https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup)[https://clever.com/signup](https://clever.com/signup). 
2.   If your district is already on Clever, you can add easyCBM by following these steps:
    -   Log into your Clever Dashboard and select [Applications > Add Applications](https://schools.clever.com/applications/add) from the left navigation.
    -   Search for easyCBM
    -   When you request a connection with the application, you will also be asked if you would like to request a custom Launch Date. The Launch Date is the first day users can access the application through Clever.
    -   Once you have made your selections, click Request.
3.  These requests will create a notice to easyCBM, who will schedule an implementation call with you. The timing of these requests will be based on current volume and having a conversation with easyCBM to develop your plan.
4.  If you are already discussing integration with easyCBM, you may receive an invitation to connect directly in your Clever Dashboard. If so, please check your Clever Dashboard to accept your [app invite](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/article/360045084272). 
5.  After a meeting and once the sync occurs, easyCBM recommends logging in a few users to confirm that they can sign in.

* * *

## Recommended Sharing Rules

   **![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl00000003M5&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028C4p)**For more information on sharing data with applications, please see: [How do I set my sharing permissions for applications?](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/203115007)

EasyCBM recommends sharing only the grades, classes, and users at the school sites that will be using the program. This can include grades K-8 and specific subjects like reading or math. You can find more information about setting up sharing rules in [this guide](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000392247).   
  
easyCBM supports co-teachers, aids, or interventionists who may not be currently in Clever to use easyCBM. These staff will need to [be set up in Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115000988748?language=en_US) by a system administrator and cannot be set up by individual teachers.  
  
In Clever, data quality issues will be represented as “data warnings” or “data errors”. For more information on resolving data quality issues, please review [this article](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202043083). 

* * *

## FAQs

**Why is a student or teacher missing from easyCBM?**  
Please check to see if this user meets the following requirements:

-   Student or teacher is present in your SIS data
-   Student or teacher is present in our Clever data and shared with easyCBM

If the user is missing from your Clever data, but is in your SIS, please contact [Clever Support](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us).  
  
**Who should I ask for help?**  
If the issue is related to data within Clever or data coming from Clever, please contact [Clever Support.](https://support.clever.com/hc/en-us)  
  
If the issue is related to functionality within easyCBM, please contact [CleverSupport@service.riversideinsights.com](mailto:CleverSupport@service.riversideinsights.com) or Riverside Insights Tech Support, [techsupport@service.riversideinsights.com](mailto:techsupport@service.riversideinsights.com).

* * *

title: Rostering applications with AnySchool
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header1) 2\. [What’s AnySchool?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header2) 3\. [Setting up your AnySchool connection](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header3) 4\. [Obtaining SIS or other OneRoster API configuration instructions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header4) 5\. [Set up SSO](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header6) 6\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header5) ## Overview Clever AnySchool enables applications to connect with districts or schools that haven't adopted Clever in one centralized place. If you currently use Clever, or are [interested in signing up](https://www.clever.com/district-signup), you can easily roster your learning applications with Clever’s rostering services. [Learn more here.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/236113588) If you do not currently utilize Clever, application partners you work with may utilize Clever AnySchool to more easily synchronize data from your schools using your existing systems like your student information system (SIS) or another OneRoster API data source. This doesn’t require you to set up a Clever account. Instead, Clever acts as an extension of the learning application with no additional signup or credentials required. Clever is a sub-processor of the learning application and follows the terms of any data processing agreements you have in place with the application. Your student data privacy is a top priority for Clever. Learn more about our practices, FERPA, COPPA, GDPR, and state-level compliance in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust). In this article you’ll learn more about the AnySchool integration and setup process.  * * * ## What’s AnySchool? If you use one of the data sources listed below, application partners using Clever may invite you to connect directly to their application using AnySchool, a capability within Clever Complete. As always, your student data privacy is a top priority for Clever. Learn more about our practices, FERPA, COPPA, GDPR, and state-level compliance in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust). If an application requests that you connect via AnySchool, you don’t need to set up a Clever account. Instead, you’ll use Clever to connect your preferred data source (e.g. Infinite Campus) with your application. AnySchool supports syncing roster data from the following sources: - Infinite Campus (API v1.2) - Skyward - Blackbaud - Another OneRoster API connection (please reach out to your application for more details) - CSV upload (users.csv, sections.csv) * * * ## Setting up your AnySchool connection If an application partner is interested in syncing your data via AnySchool, they’ll contact you to confirm that you use one of the data sources listed above and to confirm your email address for setup. Once confirmed, they’ll send you a custom setup link.    **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpx7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAs9p)    Please note:**  Once you click the link to begin setup, you will have 48 hours to complete the process. If you don’t complete your setup within this timeframe, please contact the application partner to request a new setup link. This link can’t be shared with other administrators as it is unique to your email address. To complete the set up: 1. Navigate to the link the application provided. 2. Review the information for utilizing AnySchool and click the **Get started** button. 3. You’ll start by selecting your data source as either Infinite Campus, Skyward, Blackbaud, another OneRoster API data source, or CSV upload. Once you select a data source, click **Continue.** 4. You’ll receive a prompt to enter additional information for your data source. - If you’re utilizing Infinite Campus (API v1.2), Skyward, or Blackbaud, you’ll enter the credentials for connecting to your data source’s API. This includes Base URL, Client ID, and Client Secret. You can follow the instructions linked in the setup to obtain this information from your student information system (SIS), or [find instructions below](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001726#header4). If you need assistance locating this information, please contact your SIS team directly (i.e., if using Infinite Campus, reach out to the Infinite Campus support team for assistance locating the Base URL, Client ID, and Client Secret in their system). - If you’re utilizing another OneRoster API data source, follow the instructions and enter the credentials for your data source. If you have any questions, please reach out to the application you are connecting with. - If you’re utilizing CSV files, you’ll be provided with file templates for the users.csv and sections.csv. You’ll complete these files and then upload them to sync your data. Remember, your access link will last 48 hours. If you need a new link, please contact your application partner to provide it. 5. Once you’ve entered your SIS credentials, or you’ve completed the setup in your OneRoster API data source, or uploaded your CSV files, you’ll click **Continue.** 6. A sync will automatically begin running with the application and they’ll provide next steps on the setup to you!  If you upload CSV files, you’ll receive a sync report via email to warn of any data quality issues that may need to be resolved in your files.   * * * ## Obtaining SIS or other OneRoster API configuration instructions Infinite Campus Instructions Please note, you must be using Infinite Campus API v1.2 for this setup. To generate or locate your Infinite Campus base URL, Client ID, and Client Secret: 1. Navigate to Instruction > Settings > Digital Learning Application Configuration (or System Administration > Learning Interoperability in the Classic Navigation) 2. Click **Add Application**, scroll to the bottom, and click **Connect to Other Applications** 3. Enter **Clever** as the application name ![Clever as the application name in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpx7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAvSf)  4. Click **Generate New OneRoster Connection ![Generate OneRoster connection button](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpx7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAvkQ)**  5. For OneRoster version, select OneRoster 1.2 **> Generate ![Generate button in Infinite Campus](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpx7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAwF3)**  6. Share ClientID, Client Secret, Base URL and Token URL ![Client ID, Client Secret, Base URL, and Token URL](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dpx7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000QAXF6)  Skyward Instructions Finding your API credentials for Skyward will differ depending on how you’re hosted. Please follow the instructions below: 1. **Secure Cloud (ISCorp) Hosted Districts**: Create an IT Services service call to have ISCorp set up the Read Only API by visiting the [Support Center](https://support.skyward.com/) or [ISCorp Helpdesk.](https://support.iscorp.com/) 2. **Managed Services / TN State Hosted Districts**: Create an IT Services service call to have Skyward set up the Read Only API install by visiting the [Support Center.](https://support.skyward.com/) 3. **Self-Hosted Districts**: Use the [API Server Launch Kit](https://support.skyward.com/DeptDocs/Corporate/IT%20Services/Public%20Website/Technical%20Information/system/current_requirements/Api%20Server%20Launch%20kit.pdf) to set up the Read Only API. Optionally, districts can create an IT Services service call to have Skyward set up the Read Only API as a billable service by visiting the [Support Center.](https://support.skyward.com/) When setting up Skyward API, you must choose **OA2 - OAuth 2.0.** Blackbaud Instructions To generate credentials, follow [these directions](https://webfiles.blackbaud.com/files/support/helpfiles/education/k12/full-help/content/bb-core-oauth.html). Please note that your Web Access URL will look like this: [https://{](https://{/)schoolDomain}.myschoolapp.com/ims/oneroster/v1p1/ We recommend the following settings: **Provider** - Name: Clever AnySchool - Provider: Standard - Select Use **Legacy OAuth 1.0 authentication** **Rostering Options** - School Years: Current year - Multi-term classes: One record per term - Offering Types - Academic Groups: Required - Activity Groups: Optional - Advisory Groups: Optional - Courses: Return all - Parents: Include or exclude all parents **Gradebook Options**No options need to be selected. **Integration Mappings** The following fields require the district to set Integration Mappings in Blackbaud in order for the data to pass via Clever AnySchool:     •  Gender     •  Ethnicity For more information on Integration mappings, [click here](https://webfiles.blackbaud.com/files/support/helpfiles/education/k12/full-help/content/bb-core-integration-mappings.html). Other OneRoster API Instructions To set up a connection with another OneRoster API, please utilize your data source’s help center for setting up the API, or reach out to your application partner to see if they can provide additional setup steps.  CSV Upload Instructions 1. Use our [file templates](https://assets.clever.com/example-data/ManualRostering.zip) to create your users.csv and sections.csv. Please reference the tables below for specifications on field requirements and formats. 2. Once you’ve completed creating your files, please upload them using the link provided by your application partner. If your link has expired, please contact the application for a new link. 3. Once you upload your files, the sync process will begin. The sync time will vary based on the amount of data you are uploading. 4. Once the sync completes, you’ll receive a sync report email. If you encounter any errors that you need to resolve, please edit your files and reupload them. If your link for uploading data has expired, please reach out to the application for a new link. #### Users.csv The users.csv file is a single file used to create all users – including students, teachers, and staff.

Column Header

Required

Format

Notes

School_name

YES

String

Name of primary school of enrollment.

User_type

YES

Option

Denotes the type of user. Can be “student”, “teacher”, or “staff” for school administrator.

User_id

YES

String

Unique and constant id for user. Must match user_id in sections.csv file in order for user to be assigned to a section.

First_name

YES

String

Last_name

YES

String

Email

NO

String

User’s email address.

Username

Clever is FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR compliant, and also complies with multiple state-level requirements for data security and privacy. Learn more in [our Trust Center](https://www.clever.com/trust). **Who should I contact if my setup link expires?** - Please contact the application partner that provided the setup link. They’ll be able to provide a new link. **How can I filter the data being sent to an application partner?** - If you're connecting directly to your SIS, please contact the application partner you’re working with for your filtering options. If you are using another OneRoster API system that allows for filtering before sending data to the API, you can work with their team to set up filters. **Who should I contact if I have issues during the setup process?** - If you’re having issues locating the necessary SIS credentials, contact your SIS directly. - If you’re having issues with the setup in another system that supports the OneRoster API, please contact their team directly. - For all other issues, please contact the application partner you are working with, and they can assist further. **What should I do if my sync report includes file errors?** - Resolve any listed errors in your files, and reupload them via the link your application provided you. title: For Clever Admins: Custom role granular permissions
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001756#header1)  
2\. [Granular permissions available](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001756#header2)  
3\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001756#header3)

## Overview

We know that every admin team has a unique structure and set of needs. Custom admin roles grant specific access in Clever based on your team's unique roles. Custom roles minimize risk by ensuring users have the minimum access required in Clever.

This article lists the granular permissions available for your custom roles. For information on creating, managing, and deleting custom roles, [please see our article here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702).  
 

* * *

## Granular permissions available

Below are the granular permissions you can choose from when creating a custom role. These control what a user can do in Clever, but they don't affect a user's role or access inside a connected application. For questions about app-specific behavior and permissions, please contact the application's support team.

If you scope a custom role to specific schools, you'll only be able to choose from a set of specific permissions within these permission categories: 

1.  Support Tools
    
2.  Analytics
    
3.  Portal Management
    
4.  SSO + Login Management. 
    

Permissions marked with a **\*school-scoped** tag below can be limited to specific schools. Admins with school-scoped permissions can only see data, users, and troubleshooting tools for the schools they're associated with.

**Admin Team Management**

-   View admin team members
    
    -   View all admin team members
        

**Analytics**

-   Manage analytics settings
    
    -   Setup and manage Analytics settings for your Clever account
        
-   View analytics data
    
    -   View Edtech and Portal Analytics data **\*school-scoped**
        
-   View analytics reports
    
    -   View participation and resource usage data
        

**Application Management**

-   Application Sharing Permissions For Connected Apps
    
    -   View all applications
        
        -   View application sharing permissions for applications connected with the school organization (Includes access to user data)
            
    -   Manage
        
        -   All applications
            
            -   Manage application sharing permissions for applications connected with the school organization (Includes access to user data)
                
        -   Specific applications
            -   Manage application sharing permissions for specific applications connected with the school organization as defined by this role (Includes access to user data)
-   Manage Clever subscriptions
    
    -   View the Clever App Store, purchase and submit payment for Clever products
        
-   Clever LMS Connect
    
    -   View
        
        -   View Clever LMS Connect applications in [Clever LMS Connect](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001609)
            
    -   Manage
        
        -   Create, update, and delete LMS Connect applications
            
-   Manage application connections
    
    -   Add or delete an application connection, configure content mappings, field access settings, and saved password application connections (Includes access to user data)
        
-   View application data quality and issues
    
    -   View data quality issues with data shared with specific applications
        
-   View teacher-installed applications
    
    -   View login data associated with teacher-installed [Clever Library](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360015683471) applications
        

**Portal Management**

-   Manage Portal settings
    
    -   Manage Portal settings including the school organization's Portal URL, enabling Portal customization for School Tech Lead users, setting the default icon for the Portal, and substitute access
        
-   Manage Library settings
    
    -   Enable or disable the Clever Library and block or allow applications for the school organization
        
-   Messaging settings
    
    -   View
        
        -   View School Organization Messaging settings
            
    -   Manage
        
        -   Enable or disable Messaging settings
            
-   Manage Portal notifications **\*school-scoped**
    
    -   Create, edit, and delete Portal notifications to students, teachers, and/or staff
        
-   Teacher email settings
    
    -   View
        
        -   View and update teacher email settings, such as whether they can receive emails on Clever training resources.
            
    -   Manage
        
        -   View and update teacher email settings
            
-   Manage the Portal **\*school-scoped**
    
    -   Customize and categorize the Portal, and add and edit Portal links
        

**SSO + Login Management**

-   Manage Clever Badges
    
    -   Configure, enable, print, and void Clever Badges (Includes access to user data through bulk downloading Badges only)
        
-   View access logs
    
    -   View all data associated with users logging in to Clever and applications
        
-   Manage SSO settings
    
    -   Manage all SSO settings on the SSO settings page, such as student and teacher access to Clever and login methods.
        
-   Manage Classroom MFA settings
    
    -   Configure, update, and delete [Classroom MFA](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001616) settings (Includes access to user data)
        
-   Manage Clever IDM settings
    
    -   Configure, update, and delete [Clever IDM](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001466) settings (Includes access to user data)
        
-   Manage MFA bypass codes
    
    -   Reset MFA bypass codes for specific users (includes access to user data through bulk downloading Badges only)
        
-   Manage management of Clever Badges
    
    -   Download and/or void all badges (Includes access to user data through bulk downloading Badges only)
        
    -   Download Badge activity report
-   Manage groups
    -   Remove
        -   Configure Clever groups
    -   Manage
        -   Configure Clever groups
-   Manage Group Memberships **\*school-scoped**
    -   Can be added as a Group Manager who can edit the membership of specific groups.

**Support Tools**

-   Manage the Portal as a staff, teacher, or student user
    
    -   Troubleshoot issues by accessing the Clever Portal as the user (Includes access to user data)
        
-   Manage Individual User Passwords **\*school-scoped**
    -   Reset an individual user's Clever password from their profile or user search — for users who sign in with a Clever username and password or for users who leverage Clever IDM. Separate from MFA reset. Includes the ability to search for and view users.
-   View the Portal or Dashboard as another admin  
    -   Troubleshoot issues by impersonating another admin to access the Portal or Dashboard
-   View the Portal or Dashboard as a School Tech Lead
    -   Troubleshoot issues by impersonating a School Tech Lead to access the Portal or Dashboard
-   View Users **\*school-scoped**
    -   Search for users and view their profiles and account details, including the Data Browser and exporting user data.
-   View Login & Sharing Troubleshooting Tools **\*school-scoped**
    -   Use troubleshooting tools to diagnose user login and app-sharing issues, including connected apps and sync details. Includes the ability to search for and view users.
-   Manage Individual MFA Reset **\*school-scoped**
    -   Reset a user's MFA settings when they're locked out or need to re-enroll. Includes the ability to search for and view users.
-   Manage Messaging & Announcements **\*school-scoped**
    -   View a user's message and announcement history, download messaging history and manage a teacher's announcement settings, including blocking or unblocking announcements.
-   Manage Individual Account Claim Reset **\*school-scoped**
    -   Reset a user's account claim so they can re-claim their account, and view account-claim configuration. Includes the ability to search for and view users.
-   Manage Individual Login Badges **\*school-scoped**
    -   Create or reset login badges for individual users from their profile. Includes the ability to search for and view users.

**Sync Management**

-   Manage custom data: sections
    
    -   Create, update, and delete custom sections created by the user (Includes access to user data)
        
-   Manage sync settings
    
    -   Configure all sync settings including viewing sync statuses, uploading sync files, updating sync specific data, configuring sync hold thresholds, field mappings, viewing SFTP credentials, and enabling/disabling preferred Student Information System (SIS) data.
        
-   Manage all custom data: users
    
    -   Create, update, and delete all custom data related to users (Includes access to user data)
        

* * *

## Frequently asked questions

**Why don't I see all permission categories when I scope a role to specific schools?**

-   School-scoped roles are limited to specific permissions within the Support Tools, Analytics, Portal Management, and SSO + Login Management categories.
    

**Do these permissions control what a user can do inside a connected application?**

-   No. Custom role permissions only control what a user can do in Clever. They don't determine a user's role or access level within a connected application. For questions about app-specific permissions, contact that application's support team.
    

**What does school-scoped mean?**

-   Admins with school-scoped permissions for a specific Clever feature will only see the data they have access to in that feature. For example, if an admin has a role with the analytics permission that's school scoped, they'll only see analytics for those schools.

**How do I create, edit, or delete a custom role?**

-   Head to your [Clever Dashboard > User management > Admin team](https://schools.clever.com/team/members) page, then follow the steps [in our article here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702) to set up or manage roles.
    

**Can a user have multiple roles?**

-   Yes, a user can be assigned multiple roles, each with its own set of permissions. When a user has more than one admin role, they’ll be granted all permissions associated with both roles.
    

**Can a user have multiple roles with permissions with access to different schools?** 

-   No - if a custom role includes a permission with restricted access to specific schools, it cannot be granted to users with other roles. Only one role with school scoped access can be granted to a user at a time.
    

**Will I still be able to use** [**standard roles**](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726) **(such as School Organization Help Desk or School Organization Curriculum Lead)?**

-   Yes, those roles will remain available.
    

* * *

**Related articles  
**

-   [For Clever Admins: Managing custom admin roles](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001702)
    
-   [Clever Roles: Overview of Roles & Permissions](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115001733726)
    
-   [For Clever Admins: Syncing administrators via CSV](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001709)

title: For Clever Admins: User Groups
text:
This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header1)  
2\. [Create a group](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header2)  
3\. [Create multiple groups](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header3)  
4\. [Constructing rules](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header4)  
5\. [Matching IDM groups](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header5)  
6\. [Managing groups](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header6)  
7\. [Group permissions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header7)  
8\. [Frequently Asked Questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header8)

## Overview

User Groups help you organize Clever users into custom groups that you can use throughout Clever. For example, you can use groups in [Clever IDM](https://schools.clever.com/identity-management) to manage security settings or in [Bulk security actions](https://schools.clever.com/bulk-security-actions) to reset passwords for everyone in a group at once.  
  

Note: Clever user groups are not available for all features. Over time, additional features will take advantage of the power of groups. See the FAQ for the current list of features that can use groups.

  
Create a single group, or save time by creating multiple groups at once. When creating multiple groups, Clever can automatically create groups based on common categories, such as graduation year, grade level, user type, or school.

Choose how you want to add members to your group:

-   Automatically: Create rules that add users who meet the criteria you choose. Clever keeps these groups up to date as user information changes. 
    
-   Manually: Add or remove individual users whenever you need to.
    

If a user meets both an inclusion rule and an exclusion rule, Clever will exclude that user from the group. Manual inclusions and exclusions always override rules.

You can also assign one or more Group Managers to help manage the group. You choose who can manage each group.

  
  

* * *

## Create a group

Use this option to create a new group. If you need to create multiple groups at once, learn how [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header3).

1.  Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > User groups](https://schools.clever.com/user-groups)
    
2.  Click **Create new group****![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oaCp5)**
    
3.  Create a name for the group, provide a short description of the group, and select **Add a group manager** from the dropdown menu. Please note that managers must be Clever admins with a role that supports the Manage Group Memberships permission.   
    Learn more about which roles are supported [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header7).  
      ![Screenshot of group creation](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oaujd) 
    
4.  You can create rules to dynamically include or exclude members of a group that meet your group criteria. Alternatively, manually include or exclude specific members. Exclusion criteria applies across all inclusion criteria. Click [here](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001755#header4) to learn more about the different types of rules and filters.
    
    1.  **Inclusion:** Add rules to include users who match the criteria you choose. When new users join Clever and meet those criteria, Clever automatically adds them to the group.
        
    2.  **Exclusion:** Add rules to exclude users who match the criteria you choose. When new users join Clever and meet those criteria, Clever automatically excludes them from the group, even if they also match an inclusion rule.
        
    3.  **Individual Members:** Manually include or exclude specific users. Update this list at any time. Individual selections override any inclusion or exclusion rules.  
          
        In this example, we will create a rule for K-5, 7, and 8th-grade students in all elementary and middle schools.  
        ![Screenshot of add rules and memberships page.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oavKj) 
        
    4.  Click **Save group**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oawK1) 
        

Review the group details page. Here, you can see who created the group, when it was created, and when it was last modified. You can also edit or delete the group from this page.  
![Screenshot of group details screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oawez)

## Create multiple groups

1.  Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > User groups](https://schools.clever.com/user-groups)
    
2.  Click **Create multiple groups**![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oawv7) 
    
3.  In the pop-up window, select the categories you’d like to use to create groups.  
    ![Screenshot of Bulk group pop-up](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oauF0)
    
4.  Click **Create groups**
5.  You will now see your new groups created on the [User groups page](https://schools.clever.com/user-groups).

  
 

* * *

## Constructing rules

When creating User groups, you can use inclusion or exclusion rules to determine membership. **Rules** are made up of **Filters.** A **Filter** is an individual requirement that must be met in order for a user to be included or excluded from a group. A rule may have multiple filters.  
  
Filters are created by creating a statement using the following:

-   **Properties** are the user attributes available to build your rules, for example, grade level or ELL status. The specific fields available depend on the data your organization shares with Clever.
    
-   **Operators** define how the property should be used. Available operators are:
    
    -   equals
        
    -   equals any of
        
    -   does not equal
        
    -   does not equal any of
        
    -   contains
        
    -   does not contain
        
    -   does not contain any of
        
    -   contains any of
        
    -   has a value
        
    -   has no value
        
    -   is greater than
        
    -   is greater than or equal to
        
    -   is less than
        
    -   is less than or equal
        
    -   starts with
        
    -   starts with any of
        
-   **Values** are what the property is compared against to determine group membership Values can be selected manually from the dropdown. Search for values is case-sensitive so it's important to ensure that you are using an exact match to the value that is synced to Clever. 
    

  
In the inclusion example below, the filter requires a user to be in grade 8. This means only users in grade 8 will be included in the group.  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oae3m)     
In the exclusion example below, the filter excludes any users with an ELL code of Y. This means any user with an ELL code of Y will be excluded from this group, even if they meet the inclusion rules.  
  
![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oayfB) 

 **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** A group can contain multiple inclusion and exclusion rules with different filters. If a user matches both an inclusion rule and an exclusion rule, they will be excluded from the group.

  
  
 

* * *

## Matching IDM groups

Clever IDM can match your Clever Groups to an existing group in your destination to automatically manage that group's membership. If you're already an IDM customer using formulas and want to switch to Clever Groups, first create your Clever Groups, then reach out to Clever Support for help setting up the match.

Clever IDM can auto-match your Clever user groups to start managing membership in your destination groups if the names in Clever and in your IDM destination are an exact match. You can also manually assign groups whose names don’t match.

You can learn more about how to manage groups in [Clever IDM: Group Membership Management](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001517?language=en_US)

  
  
 

* * *

## Managing groups

### Duplicate a group

When you duplicate a group, the new group inherits the original group's sharing settings as a one-time copy. Once duplicated, you can update either group's settings independently.

To duplicate follow these directions: 

1.  Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > User groups](https://schools.clever.com/user-groups).
    
2.  Find the group you would like to duplicate.
    
3.  Click the ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oa3KM)icon under **Actions**
    
4.  You'll be taken to the newly created group page (named Copy of \[original name\] by default), where you can edit the group name, description, or group managers.
    
5.  Click **Next: Add rules and members**.
    
6.  Adjust the inclusion or exclusion rules as well as the individual members. 
    
7.  Click **Save group**. Your duplicated group is now saved and active.
    

### Edit a group

You can edit any existing group to update the group name, description, managers, or membership criteria. To do this you’ll:

1.  Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > User groups](https://schools.clever.com/user-groups).
    
2.  Find the group you would like to edit.
    
3.  Click the ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oaUSc)icon under **Actions.**
    
4.  You'll be taken to the Group info page where you can edit the name, description, or managers. When you’re ready, click **Next: Add rules and members**.
    
5.  Adjust the inclusion or exclusion rules as well as the individual members. 
    
6.  Click **Save group**. Your group is now saved.
    

### Delete a group

You can delete any existing group. To do this you’ll:

1.  Navigate to the [Clever Dashboard > User management > User groups](https://schools.clever.com/user-groups).
    
2.  Under **Group name**, select the group you want to delete.
    
3.  Click **Delete group**.  
    ![](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oazD3) 
    
4.  In the confirmation window, click **Delete group** again.  
    ![Screenshot of delete group message that appears](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oazWP) 
    

A green **Group deleted** banner appears at the bottom of the page to confirm that Clever deleted the group.

![Group deleted confirmation](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oaGnr)    
 

* * *

## Group permissions

Clever Admins, or admins with a custom role that includes the Group administration permission, can create, delete, edit, and manage group memberships.

The District Help Desk, District Curriculum Lead, and admins with a custom role that includes the Manage Group Memberships permission can edit group memberships for groups they manage.  
 

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

What features currently support Clever user groups

-   Clever IDM for Google and Active Directory
    
-   Bulk Security Actions
    

How long does it take before my group can be used in a feature after being created or edited?

-   Clever user groups need to be evaluated across your user base to ensure that the right members are included and excluded. This process will usually resolve within 15 minutes. Until your group is done processing, there will be a **Pending** badge next to the group name indicating that group rules are still being evaluated.  
    ![All Students notification](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dbJ3&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oazxp)

title: How to set up AnySchool SFTP uploads
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001754#header1) 2\. [Accessing your SFTP credentials](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001754#header2) 3\. [Supported file formats and directories](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001754#header3) 4\. [Testing your SFTP connection](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001754#header4) 5\. [Frequently asked questions](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001754#header5) ## Overview AnySchool SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol) uploads allow your school organization to automate and streamline the rostering process. Instead of making one-time manual comma-separated values (CSV) uploads, you can establish an ongoing, automated connection by uploading your roster files directly to a dedicated Clever SFTP directory. Both methods share the same backend, but the SFTP Directory option provides persistent credentials for automation.   * * * ## Accessing your SFTP credentials To set up your automated sync, you first need to generate your unique SFTP credentials within Clever. 1. Open the application invite email and click the link to access the onboarding flow. 2. Choose SFTP Directory as your data source. You will see the following information on your screen: - **SFTP Upload URL:** sftp://sftp2.clever.com - **SFTP Port:** 22 - **SFTP Username:** (Auto-generated for your school organization) - **SFTP Password:** (Auto-generated; click the eye icon to reveal)   **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eJTl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you encounter a **Failed to provision SFTP credentials** error banner, click **Try again**. If the issue persists, please reach out to your application’s support team. * * * ## Supported file formats and directories Clever supports several roster formats. When you connect via your SFTP client, you must route your files to the subdirectory corresponding to your data format. The exception is the 5-file format. If you are using this format, upload your files to your home directory rather than to a subdirectory. **![pencil.png](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eJTl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EM1P0000028BpB) Please note:** If you send OneRoster files, please ensure the manifest.csv is in the OneRoster zipped file. Zip the files together as a group; zipping the folder itself will cause this error. 

Roster format

IMPORTANT Uploading files to the incorrect directory will cause the Clever normalizer to reject your data. Ensure your SFTP script or client targets the exact subdirectory listed above. * * * ## Testing your SFTP connection Before scheduling your automated uploads, we recommend running an end-to-end test to ensure your files are picked up and processed correctly. ![Example of a school organization that has placed the required users.csv and sections.csv files into their AnySchool subdirectory.](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000eJTl&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000oGmDZ) _Example of a school organization that has placed the required users.csv and sections.csv files into their AnySchool subdirectory._  1. Open your preferred SFTP client (such as Transmit, [FileZilla](https://filezilla-project.org/) or WinSCP. Make sure your client supports SFTP specifically. SFTP is not the same as _FTP over SSH, FTP over SSL, FTPS or Simple File Transfer Protocol_. Each client's interface will look a little different, but each will involve similar steps.  2. Host an active session using your Clever SFTP credentials (the host URL, port, and the unique username and password you grabbed from the Clever Dashboard). 3. Upload your test files into the relevant subdirectory from the table above (for example, upload your OneRoster 1.2 zip file into the /oneroster12 folder). 4. Verify your Clever Dashboard to confirm that the files were successfully retrieved and normalized without errors.   * * * ## Frequently asked questions **What is the difference between CSV upload and SFTP Directory?** - While both options process your data similarly on our backend, the standard CSV upload is a one-time manual process that involves uploading 2  files. Selecting the SFTP Directory option grants you persistent, permanent credentials so you can script and automate your transfers. SFTP allows you the option to upload 2 files, 5 files, or OneRoster to your Clever SFTP directory.  **Can I change my data format later?** - Yes. If you decide to switch formats (e.g., moving from Standard Clever CSV to OneRoster 1.2), you simply need to change the subdirectory destination in your SFTP client to match the new format.  * * * **Related articles:** - [Rostering applications with AnySchool](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001726)

title: For Clever Admins: School year rollover holds
text:
This article contains the following: 1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#header1) 2\. [What is a rollover hold?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#header2) 3\. [How section IDs affect applications](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#header3) 3\. [Options for managing a rollover hold](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#header3) 4\. [Choosing how to manage a rollover hold for your school organization](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#header4) 5\. [What happens after my rollover hold selection?](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#header5) 6\. [Frequently asked questions (FAQs)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001751#FAQ) ## Overview This article explains what a rollover hold is, the three options you can choose from when your account encounters a rollover hold, and what happens after you make your decision on how you’d like Clever to manage your data. Not every school organization will encounter a rollover hold. For a broader look at how school year rollover works in Clever, see [School year rollover: Overview, preparation & recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886). Rollover holds are designed to give you visibility into significant section data changes at rollover time, and control over how they're handled, rather than an automatic change made without your input. Rollover holds are particularly important for school organizations that have a Student Information System (SIS) that reuses [section IDs](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001507) year over year. If you'd like to see what a rollover hold may look like, check out our [clickable tutorial here](https://ior.ad/bwdJ). * * * ## What is a rollover hold? Clever tracks your school organization's section data using Clever IDs, which are tied to your SIS section IDs. If your SIS reuses section IDs from year to year, Clever and your connected applications can mistake this year's classes for continuations of last year's, which can lead to merged rosters and inaccurate data in your learning applications. This mainly affects school organizations whose SIS reuses section IDs year over year. Reusing section IDs can lead an application to treat this year's algebra class as a continuation of last year's kindergarten class. This may lead to mixed up rosters, assignments, and analytics, or even cause a teacher to lose access to their current class. The main impact is for your end users, students and teachers, which is why it’s critical to select the rollover hold process that aligns with your school organization’s practices.  **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHaT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000n4KVN)  Please note:** This only affects section IDs for SIS synced, non-custom sections. [Custom sections](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002764923), sections that you’ve synced to Clever outside of your SIS sync, won’t be impacted. To prevent section ID reuse issues, Clever monitors for signs that your section data reflects a new school year, such as significant changes to your sections combined with enough time having passed since your last rollover and coming off of a sync pause. When Clever detects this, your sync enters a rollover hold, and you're asked to confirm what's happening before it continues. ![Example of a rollover hold](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHaT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nA0Ig) In previous years, Clever handled this automatically for most school organizations around the same time each July and August, without asking you to confirm the change. Rollover holds now give you the chance to review and confirm this decision yourself before it takes effect. Creating new section IDs across the board when you sync new data for the year sends a strong signal to the apps that you roster through Clever that your new year’s data is coming.  * * * ## How section IDs affect applications When your SIS system provides a new section ID for a section, or you prompt Clever’s system to provide new section IDs for you, connected apps see it as a brand new section with no history, which is exactly what you want at the start of a school year. If you allow section IDs to persist for a genuinely new school year, apps keep treating it as the same ongoing section, so last year's students, assignments, and grades can carry over into this year's class. On the other hand, if you change your section IDs mid-session, apps lose the thread on that section's existing rosters, assignments, and analytics, even though nothing about the class has actually changed. In both cases, the underlying data in Clever may look fine, but what apps see and act on is wrong.  This is why your rollover hold selection matters: it tells Clever whether this moment is a true year boundary that calls for a refresh, or a normal mid-year change that shouldn't get one.   * * * ## Options for managing a rollover hold When you open a rollover hold, you'll see a summary of what triggered it and three options to choose from for how to proceed through the hold. ![Three options for continuing with a rollover hold](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHaT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nAijV) **The three options are:** 1. **Yes, this is my new school year data.** - This is the recommended option for most school organizations and is selected by default - This option is not recommended for _semester or term rollover_ where some sections continue into the next term. This option is explicitly for year rollover. 2. **No, my schools don't have a traditional year rollover.** - This is intended for year-round schools or school organizations whose SIS already generates unique section IDs. 3. **No, we're still mid-year.** - This is intended for school organizations mid-year, where section changes reflect normal in-session updates rather than a new school year. If you choose **Yes, this is my new school year data:** - New Clever IDs are assigned to all SIS-synced, non-custom sections, so connected applications treat them as brand new sections. - If students and teachers are actively using SIS-synced, non-custom sections in Clever or apps that are rostered through Clever, all sections will look new in Clever and to connected rostering apps after this sync. - Your prior section history is cleared, so old sections won't be mistaken for current ones. Learn more about ID [reuse, retention, and restoration here](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001507?language=en_US#policy). - You won't be prompted again for 300 days. If you choose **No, my schools don't have a traditional year rollover:** - Your sync proceeds without any Clever section ID reassignment. Sections with old SIS section IDs that are still in your sync are treated as updates. Sections with new section IDs will be created as new sections in Clever with new Clever section IDs.  - Your school organization is responsible for making sure new sections use unique SIS section IDs going forward. - You won't be prompted again for 300 days. If you choose **No, we're still mid-year:** - Your sync proceeds normally, and connected applications treat your section changes as updates to existing sections rather than new ones. - You'll be prompted again the next time Clever detects rollover-like changes. You can also **discard changes** at any point if the data changes were unintentional. This works the same way as discarding changes on [a standard sync hold.](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358#h_0e3f3781-585e-4108-a3d0-387e417f2b5f) Below we outline common scenarios to help you identify which option is the right choice for your school organization. If you're not sure which option fits your situation, you can always submit your hold to Clever support for help making the right decision.   * * * ## Choosing how to manage a rollover hold for your school organization The first option for resolving your rollover hold, **Yes, this is my new school year data,** is the right choice for the vast majority of school organizations. This is because it reflects what's actually happening, that your students and teachers are moving into a new school year with new sections and classes. The main exception is if any of your current, SIS-synced sections are still actively in use. For example, if your school organization operates on a year round schedule. Refreshing a section's ID while it's still active disrupts that work just as much as failing to refresh it for a genuinely new year would. If this applies to your school organization, select **No, we’re still mid-year.** This can also come up if you sync new school year data in batches, such as one school at a time. If this is the case for your school organization you should consider: 1. If your SIS already assigns unique section IDs to new sections on its own. If it does, select **No, my schools don't have a traditional year rollover**. This lets your school organization roll over on a staggered schedule without disrupting the schools that aren't ready yet. 2. If your SIS may reuse section IDs, contact Clever support for help to effectively roll your data over for the new school year without disrupting old sections that are still in use. You may also come off a sync pause while still having last year's section data, ahead of having new school year data. In most cases, if you don't have active sections, you should still select **Yes, this is my new school year data**. This recreates your previous sections as new in Clever and clears out the restoration database of old sections. It's fine for these to sit as new sections with new Clever IDs before you're back in session. Once your new section data is ready, you can either update them or delete them as needed. This is a common pattern, and something hundreds of school organizations have historically done ahead of sending new data. If you do have active sections, the same guidance above applies: select **No, my schools don't have a traditional year rollover** if your SIS assigns unique section IDs on its own, or contact Clever support if your SIS may reuse section IDs. Below is a summary of the various scenarios discussed above and the recommended action. If you’re unsure which option you should select for resolving your rollover hold, please submit your hold to be reviewed by Clever support and we’d be happy to assist further!

If...

Then...

Your students and teachers are moving into a new school year (most school organizations)Select Yes, this is my new school year data
Any current, SIS-synced sections are still actively in use (e.g., year-round schedule) Select No, we're still mid-year
You sync in batches and your SIS assigns unique section IDs to new sections on its ownSelect No, my schools don't have a traditional year rollover
You sync in batches and your SIS may reuse section IDsContact Clever support for help rolling over without disrupting active sections
You're coming off sync pause with last year's data, but no active sections Select Yes, this is my new school year data
You're coming off sync pause with last year's data, and you have active sections, with a SIS that assigns unique IDsSelect No, my schools don't have a traditional year rollover
You're coming off sync pause with last year's data, and you have active sections, with a SIS that may reuse IDsContact Clever support for help rolling over without disrupting active sections
* * * ## What happens after my rollover hold selection? Depending on your school organization's setup, the potential data changes due to your hold, and the selection you make from the three above, you may be required to work with Clever support to review your hold. ![A screenshot of the options to submit your hold to Clever support](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000dHaT&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000nAnKz) If you’ll be working with Clever support to review your hold, a case will be created automatically, and our team will respond with more information about your hold and next steps. While your sync is on hold, your Clever Dashboard will show your sync status as **On hold**, along with a message explaining that Clever detected changes that may indicate a new school year. You can select Edit rollover hold to revisit your decision, or Discard changes to send corrected data instead. If you don’t need to work with Clever support, your hold will clear, and your data will begin processing based on your rollover choice. **Choose this only if you're confident in your decision, since it typically can't be reversed.** If you don't take action on a rollover hold, your data will stop syncing through until you do. Closing the window without completing your selection won't cancel the hold. You'll still see an alert in your Clever Dashboard that lets you reopen the review at any time. * * * ## Frequently asked questions (FAQs) **What happens if I reuse a section\_id but I indicated that I am syncing new school year data?** - If you choose **Yes, this is my new school year data** and a section ID you've used in a past school year appears again in a future sync, Clever treats it as a new section from that point forward, since your prior section history was cleared. **Why didn't I receive a rollover hold after coming off pause or changing my section data?** - If you don't see a rollover hold after ending your pause or updating section data, that's okay! You may not see a rollover hold if your sync was paused consistently for a three week period. This is because Clever will automatically interpret this as a rollover period for you and refresh your section IDs when you come off pause. Since this refresh already happened automatically, you won't see a rollover hold, and you won't be prompted again for at least 300 days. **Which school organizations does this apply to?** - This applies to any school organization where Clever detects rollover-like changes in section data. **What happens if I select "No, we're still mid-year" by mistake, or things change?** - You'll be prompted again the next time Clever detects rollover-like changes in your data. If you re-use section IDs or want to clear out your section data before receiving this prompt again, please reach out to Clever support for further assistance. Additionally, if you’ve selected this option by mistake please contact Clever support to see what your options are. **What if I don't see a rollover hold, but I expected one?** - If your sync includes 95% or more of a data type being deleted, you'll see the standard hold review instead. You can contact Clever support if you have additional questions or concerns. **Does this affect my school organization if we're outside the US?** - Yes. Rollover holds are based on your school organization's rollover timing, not a fixed calendar date, so they work the same way regardless of where you're located. If this is not your school year rollover, then you should select **No, we're still mid-year** so that we’ll continue watching for your year rollover. **Do rollover holds impact custom sections?** - Custom sections are never changed by your rollover hold selection, no matter which option you choose**.**  **Does this apply to any other data type IDs?** - No. Rollover holds and section ID refresh only applies to section IDs. * * * **Related articles:** - [School year rollover: Overview, preparation & recommendations](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202118886) - [For Clever Admins: Sync holds](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/202494358) - [For Clever Admins: Pause your sync for a specific app](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/000001607)
